items.desc: Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Du besitzt das Outcome auf dem Roboter: Du treibst die Entwicklung kognitiver Robotics-Anwendungen durch Physical AI und die NeuraGym-Plattform voran — du besitzt das Outcome auf dem Kundenroboter, nicht nur das Modell im Repo. Führe die gesamte Pipeline aus: Du führst Foundation Models in produktionsreife Robotics-Intelligence über — die komplette NeuraGym-Pipeline mit Teleoperation, Data Annotation, Training, Simulation, Deployment und Validation — tailored auf echte Robotics-Anwendungen. Du definierst die Data Strategy und besitzt den gesamten Post-Training-Loop mit Hyperparameter-Iteration, Data Mixture, LoRA und ehrlicher Evaluation. Deploye zu Real-Time Control: Du bringst Policies vom Checkpoint zu Real-Time Closed-Loop Control — Distillation, Quantization, Action Chunking, Latency Budgets und On-Device/Edge Inference unter den Cycle-Time und Reliability Requirements des Kunden. Beherrsche den vollen Robotics Stack: Du arbeitest über NEURA OS und die Control Layer hinweg — Real-Time Control, Kinematics, Motion Planning, Force/Impedance Control und Safety Architecture — und integrierst gelernte Policies sauber mit dem Low-Level Controller statt ihn als Black Box zu behandeln. Hands-on System Integration: Du arbeitest direkt an MAiRA, MiPA, LARA und humanoiden Plattformen zusammen mit multidisziplinären Engineering-Teams — End-Effektoren und Tool Changer, Sensor-Auswahl und Mounting, Calibration, elektrische und Fieldbus-Schnittstellen und die mechanische Realität der Zelle. Aktiviere und unterstütze Kunden: Du leitest Nutzer in NeuraGym ein, reviewst Training Pipelines und Scripts, identifizierst Data-Quality-Issues, troubleshootst Model-Verhalten und bietest Hands-On-Support, um hartnäckige Blockers zu lösen. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du bist eine Schlüsselschnittstelle zwischen Cloud und AI Teams — du gewährleistest sanfte Zusammenarbeit, technische Alignment und effiziente Problem-Lösungen über Domänen hinweg. Baue Evaluation-Rigor auf: Du erstellst die Eval Harnesses, Success-Rate Benchmarks und Regression Tests, die entscheiden, ob eine Policy ready für Handover ist — und machst Failure Modes sichtbar, bevor der Kunde sie findet. Research in Production: Du prototypisierst Techniken aus aktuellen Papers zusammen mit unserem Research-Team und bringst die ins Produktionsdeployment, die Kontakt mit der Realität überstehen. Schließe den Feedback-Loop: Du übersetzt Field-Erfahrung und Customer Insights in Actionable Feedback für sowohl die NeuraGym Product-Roadmap als auch die NEURA Core AI Roadmap. Was du mitbringst Dein Hintergrund: Master-Abschluss oder PhD in Informatik, Robotik, Elektrotechnik oder verwandtem Bereich. ML in Robotics Tiefe: 5+ Jahre praktische Machine-Learning-Erfahrung in Robotics — stark in mindestens einer von Vision-Based Manipulation, Reinforcement/Imitation Learning oder Multimodalen Modellen, und motiviert, den Rest zu lernen. Fine-Tuning-Expertise: Nachgewiesene Erfahrung beim Fine-Tuning großer vortrainierter Modelle für Robotics oder eine andere Domäne: PEFT/LoRA und vollständige Fine-Tunes, Dataset Curation, Distillation und Evaluation. Vertrautheit mit dem Open-VLA- und Policy-Learning-Ecosystem (z. B. π0/π0.5, OpenVLA, LeRobot, Diffusion Policies) ist ein großer Plus. Programming-Skills: Solide Python-Kenntnisse (C++ ist ein Plus); praktische Erfahrung mit PyTorch oder TensorFlow. Cloud und Simulation: AWS-, Azure- oder GCP-Erfahrung und Vertrautheit mit Robotics-Simulation-Tools (IsaacSim, MuJoCo, etc.) sind Pluses. Robotics Software Stack: Working Command des Robotics Software Stack jenseits der Model Layer — Robot Operating Systems und Middleware (NEURA OS, ROS/ROS2 oder vergleichbar), Real-Time Control, Kinematics und Motion Planning, Force/Impedance Control und wie eine gelernte Policy in den Low-Level Controller und seine Safety Layer integriert wird. Hardware-Literacy: Solides Verständnis von Roboter-Hardware — Drives und Joint Modules, Torque Sensing und Encoder, End-Effektoren, Sensor-Integration, Calibration, elektrische und Fieldbus-Schnittstellen (z. B. EtherCAT) und Functional Safety Concepts — genug, um ein Model-Problem von einem Machine-Problem vor Ort zu unterscheiden. Execution-Mindset: Nachgewiesene Problem-Solving-Fähigkeiten, Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel zu handhaben, und ein starker Bias zu Execution und persönlichem Commitment. Du nimmst Deployments persönlich, arbeitest dich durch Rückschläge und misst dich daran, was beim Kunden läuft. Kommunikation: Klarer Communicator, der zwischen Forschern, Ingenieuren und End-Usern übersetzt. Du sprichst Englisch und Deutsch auf solidem Niveau (B2–C1). Reisebereitschaft: Bereitschaft, häufig zu Kundenseiten und NeuraGyms zu reisen (ca. 40–60%).

Overview Strep A is a common bacterial infection that causes spectacular, unexpected outbreaks of disease every few years. The cause of these outbreaks is unknown, but several factors are likely to contribute, for example, the burden of circulating viral infections. This project strives to develop an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven early warning system to predict the risk of Strep A outbreaks and upsurges before they occur. The RA will work to integrate multiple datasets and apply a combination of mathematical modelling methods, including time-series modelling and probabilistic machine learning. items.card: You will design research-grade tasks that a leading AI model cannot solve, then review how and why the model fails. items.desc: Job Type: Flexible Contract (Remote) Job Summary: We are hiring senior security researchers, including faculty, research scientists, and experienced postdoctoral researchers, for a contract project that tests whether frontier AI models can carry out real research work in a command line environment. You will design research-grade tasks that a leading AI model cannot solve, then review how and why the model fails. What you will do Design self-contained command line tasks drawn from the practice of machine learning research, such as implementing a method from a paper's description alone, locating the error in a flawed experimental setup, reproducing a reported result and explaining a discrepancy, implementing a custom loss function or optimizer correctly, and running a sound statistical comparison between two models. Build the task environment, including code, data, and dependencies, write a reference solution, and write automated tests that verify whether a solution is correct. Because results can vary between runs, tests need to be deterministic or use well-justified tolerances. Run your task against a frontier AI model, review its attempt with the same rigor you would apply to a paper under peer review, and refine the task until the failure reflects a real gap in the model's capability rather than ambiguity or trick wording. Work with reviewers to bring each task to acceptance. Who we are looking for A PhD in security engineering, machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a closely related field. Industry or academic experience in machine learning research, in academia or industry. Years spent on doctoral research count toward this total. At least one publication, ideally peer-reviewed work at a recognized machine learning venue or journal. Deep working knowledge of Python and at least one major framework, such as PyTorch or JAX. Fluency in the Linux command line, shell scripting, Docker, and Git. Experience as a peer reviewer, or in designing course assignments and automated grading, is a strong advantage, because the work draws on the same skills. Why Cobalt AI Advance frontier AI where it counts. Apply your research expertise to the data that frontier labs cannot obtain any other way, where your reasoning directly shapes how the next generation of models works through technical problems. Grow professionally. Expand your influence through evaluation projects, advisory roles, and research collaborations, while deepening your understanding of how frontier models are trained and assessed. Work with a top-tier network. Collaborate with researchers from leading institutions and labs on high-impact, flexible work. Set your own schedule. Flexible 10 to 40 hour weeks that fit around your research position and your life. Competitive pay. Rates vary by project and are determined by a number of factors, including scope, skillset, and experience.

Hier ga je werken SURF is de ict-coöperatie van Nederlandse onderwijs- en onderzoeksinstellingen. Samen ontwikkelen we digitale diensten en werken we aan complexe innovatievraagstukken die de kwaliteit van onderwijs en onderzoek verbeteren. We doen dit samen met de instellingen, met oog voor publieke waarden, en zoveel mogelijk open en open source. Je krijgt ruimte om architectuurkeuzes te maken, nieuwe technologieën te onderzoeken en proofs of concept door te ontwikkelen tot productieklare oplossingen. Zo draag je direct bij aan een infrastructuur die het Nederlandse onderwijs toekomstbestendig maakt. Wie bij SURF werkt, werkt bij een unieke en open organisatie. SURF biedt uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en gaat flexibel om met de werk/privé-balans. Medewerkers werken graag zelfstandig. Daarnaast krijgt iedereen de ruimte en de vrijheid om talenten zo goed en breed mogelijk in te zetten en te ontwikkelen. Juist daarom is je nieuwsgierigheid belangrijk: je zoekt zelf uit wat nodig is, stelt vragen wanneer dat nodig is en werkt samen met je teamleden om tot de beste oplossing te komen. Je hoeft daarbij niet alle onderdelen van onze stack al te kennen. Dit breng je mee Je bent een ervaren software engineer met een sterke Python-basis en ruime ervaring met development, testen en DevOps. Je werkt graag zelfstandig, bent technisch nieuwsgierig en vindt het leuk om complexe vraagstukken uit te zoeken. Je hebt oog voor kwaliteit en security en voelt je prettig in een technische omgeving waarin Engels de voertaal is. Minimaal 5 jaar werkervaring als software developer; Ruime ervaring met CI/CD-pipelines, bij voorkeur met Git en GitLab; Ervaring met het opzetten en beheren van Docker-omgevingen; Ruimte ervaring met unit-, integratie- en end-to-endtests; Ervaring met PostgreSQL, SQLAlchemy en databasemigraties Ervaring met Linux-commandline Ervarign met security-by-designprincipes; Goede beheersing van de Engelse taal. Het is een voordeel als je: Ervaring hebt met software in productieomgevingen; Ervaring hebt met Apptainer Ervarign met REST- en streaming-API’s; Ervaring met de integratie van AI in applicaties; Ervaring met Slurm/clustercomputes; Ervaring met Kafka of een vergelijkbare technologie. Voorafgaand aan indiensttreding geldt voor deze functie dat een VOG moet worden overlegd . Bij SURF doen we onze werving met veel plezier zelf, acquisitie stellen we daarom niet op prijs. items.desc: We are looking for an early-career researcher to apply and develop Al and automation approaches across the evidence synthesis process - from literature searching and eligibility screening to (meta)data extraction. The role The role combines hands-on evidence synthesis with the development and evaluation of Al-driven approaches to make evidence synthesis processes more efficient. You will work on manual evidence-synthesis tasks, while also using Python and/or R to build and validate machine learning, automation and Al-assisted workflows for searching, eligibility screening, and (meta)data extraction. Your work will also contribute to new meta-research on how, and under what conditions, automated and Al-based tools can speed up and improve evidence synthesis in the environmental field without compromising reliability, robustness or scientific quality. Our team spans many disciplines and we welcome candidates from different backgrounds. If you have strong research and programming skills, want to help connect sustainability science with policymaking and are keen to learn evidence synthesis methods, we would like to hear from you. Key Tasks And Responsibilities Conduct and support manual literature searching, screening and (meta)data extraction for evidence synthesis projects, working with large volumes of scientific publications and grey literature (including bibliographic information and textual data). Develop and maintain reproducible workflows in Python and/or R for screening, extraction, classification, quality-checking, cleaning and harmonization of textual and bibliographic data. Apply and evaluate machine learning, natural language processing and LLM-based methods for text classification, information extraction and document analysis. Validate automated and Al-generated outputs against human decisions, quantifying errors, uncertainty and potential biases. Document methods, decisions and validation procedures to support transparent and reproducible research. Work collaboratively with researchers across environmental, sustainability, climate, energy and social science. Who You Are You are an early-career researcher with strong analytical and programming skills who enjoys working where sustainability research meets technology development - engaging with both the details of evidence synthesis and the computational methods that support it. You are happy to do detailed manual eligibility screening and (meta) data extraction, while looking for opportunities to automate these processes and make them more efficient. You have a background in, or strong interest in, sustainability or environmental research and enjoy learning from people with different disciplinary backgrounds. You do not need to be an expert in every method or technology used in this role. We value someone who is curious, careful, quick to learn and a constructive team player. The role would suit someone with: Programming and data analysis skills in Python and/or R, including version control with GitHub Experience handling large volumes of structured and unstructured text Practical experience applying machine learning, NLP or large language models to text classification, information extraction or eligibility screening An interest in evidence synthesis methodology Knowledge of, or interest in, sustainability or environmental research Experience with more advanced Al development, such as model fine-tuning or deployment, is welcome but deep expertise in machine learning or software engineering is not required. Experience with any of the following is highly desirable, but not required: Literature reviews, including systematic, scoping and rapid reviews Working with bibliographic datasets Literature eligibility screening or (meta)data extraction Formal qualifications A master's degree in data science, computer science, engineering, socio-environmental science, sustainability science or a related field. Early-career experience (1-2 years) in academic or applied research involving data analysis and Al/data-driven Personal skills Collaborative: comfortable working in teams and across disciplinary boundaries. Analytical and critical: able to assess evidence and critically evaluate Al-generated results. Systematic and data-oriented: enjoys turning complex information into reliable datasets Clear communicator: able to explain technical concepts to non-technical Curious and adaptable: interested in learning and applying rapidly developing Al Quality-focused and responsible: attentive to research integrity, transparency, uncertainty and Al-related Additional information You will join the International Climate Risk and Adaptation Team, which develops and applies pioneering research methods to define, describe, measure and communicate systemic climate risk in interdependent global systems. Are you excited by applying data science and AI to support the green transition? If you’re passionate about using data to solve real engineering challenges and working with purpose, we’d love to hear from you. At Everllence, we are pioneers in advanced propulsion technologies. We develop the control systems and digital solutions behind the world’s largest two-stroke engines – systems that now support operation on carbon-neutral alternative fuels. Data, simulation, edge ML, LLM integration, and advanced analytics are becoming increasingly important enablers in our company's mission to move big things to zero. About The Role As an R&D Data Scientist in our Engine Control Systems team, you will help unlock the value of data across the entire Engine Control Systems function. Working closely with Everllence R&D engineers, technical specialists, and operators you will transform operational, simulation, and test data into actionable insights that strengthen engineering decisions. You’ll be entrusted with exploring complex datasets, identifying patterns and opportunities, and developing analytical solutions that engineers can trust and use. Your work may range from data preparation, exploratory analysis, and visualization to machine-learning models, virtual sensors, optimization algorithms, and decision-support tools. You will support initiatives across core engine controls, emission reduction technologies, alternative fuels, diagnostics, simulation, verification, and future digital products, while establish robust approaches to data quality and model validation. This is a role for someone who finds satisfaction in making complex engineering data understandable and useful, enjoys close collaboration across disciplines, and wants to leave a tangible mark on how data science and AI enable the next generation of marine two-stroke engines and related systems. What We're Looking For We’re looking for someone who wants to grow with us – professionally and personally – as we expand the use of data science and AI within two-stroke propulsion technology. You might already have experience applying data science in an engineering environment, or you might be at an earlier stage in your career and ready to take on significant challenges. Either way, what matters most is that you’re motivated by solving real-world problems and enjoy seeing data translated into reliable insights, models, and working solutions. Because the results may inform safety-critical evaluations, you understand the importance of high-confidence outputs, uncertainty assessment, and being able to identify and communicate when the available evidence or model confidence is insufficient to support a decision. Success in this role means developing a deep understanding of complex engineering data, identifying patterns and opportunities, and translating your findings into trusted tools and evidence-based decisions. Over time, we’ll count on you to lead data science activities from problem definition and data exploration through model development, validation, communication, and implementation, working independently when needed while contributing to shared goals across the Engine Control Systems function. You can contribute to this role by exploring new approaches, developing your knowledge, and collaborating with colleagues across disciplines, cultures, and locations. We value initiative, constructive questioning, structured problem-solving, and openness to feedback and continuous learning. Our Team Culture We work in agile-inspired teams with strong collaboration and shared accountability. Our software and systems are designed with a focus on reliability, safety, and usability. We value informal, open dialogue and support personal development. You’ll be working with skilled and motivated colleagues who are happy to share knowledge and learn from you. Our teams include people of many nationalities, and we foster a workplace where everyone feels welcome and included. Unleash your potential: Join us towards a carbon-neutral future Join us on our journey toward a carbon‑neutral future. At Everllence, you will help shape innovative energy solutions while growing your skills and advancing your career. We prioritize work-life balance, flexible working hours and remote work options. We value creativity, diversity, well‑being, and have a wide range of social clubs -from yoga and fishing to creative activities. By the end of 2027, we will unite our Copenhagen and Holeby locations at a new and modern site in Trekroner, Roskilde. Our warehouse and production facilities are expected to move in 2029. Build your own Future If you have any questions after reading the job advertisement, you are welcome to contact Head of Alternative Fuel Control Systems Nikolai Viuf …

Data Pipelines: Build workflows for collecting, structuring, and validating multimodal robot data from teleoperation, simulation, and real-world experiments, covering video,
items.desc: The AI Teams at Agile Robots are looking for a Robot Learning Engineer (m/f/d) in VLA & Foundation Models , who will develop and deploy vision- and language-conditioned robot policies for real-world manipulation on physical robot platforms. Your Responsibilities Policy Development: Design, train, and evaluate vision- and language-conditioned robot policies using approaches such as imitation learning, diffusion models, transformer architectures, or reinforcement learning. Data Pipelines: Build workflows for collecting, structuring, and validating multimodal robot data from teleoperation, simulation, and real-world experiments, covering video, proprioception, force signals, and task outcomes. Robot Integration: Define action spaces, control interfaces, temporal chunking, and evaluation protocols to ensure learned policies are compatible with real robot execution contexts. Failure Analysis: Test policies in simulation and on physical robots, diagnosing failures caused by distribution shift, perception errors, contact dynamics, latency, and data quality. Deployment: Integrate learned policies into robot software stacks, with attention to latency, synchronization, safety checks, fallback behavior, and runtime monitoring. Research Application: Track developments in robot learning, VLA models, and foundation model methods, applying relevant advances to Agile's robot platforms and use cases. Essential Skills Background: Degree in computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a closely related field, or an equivalent combination of research and professional experience in robot learning or embodied AI. Robot Learning: Hands-on experience building or working with learning-based robot policies, including imitation learning, visuomotor control, VLA models, or closely related embodied AI methods. Robotics Systems: Practical experience with robotic hardware, including real robot manipulation, ROS/ROS2, sensor integration, control interfaces, or real-world robot deployment. ML Engineering: Working proficiency in Python and PyTorch, including the ability to implement models, training loops, data loaders, and evaluation pipelines beyond notebook-level prototypes. Experimental Practice: Ability to design experiments, compare model variants, debug failures across the ML/robotics boundary, and iterate toward measurable performance on real tasks. Beneficial Skills VLA Experience: Familiarity with VLA models or robotic foundation models such as π0, GR00T, or equivalent, including action-token or action-chunk representations. Policy Deployment: Experience deploying learned models on physical robots or edge compute platforms, including latency-constrained inference pipelines. Reinforcement Learning: Experience with online or offline RL for robotics, including reward design, simulation-based training, or combining RL with imitation learning. Simulation: Experience with simulators such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, or ManiSkill and with sim-to-real transfer workflows. Data Collection: Experience building or operating teleoperation systems, human-in-the-loop data collection, or intervention learning setups. What we offer A dynamic high-tech company, combined with financial soundness and world-class investors. Join an interdisciplinary, international team with 60+ different nationalities in a collaborative work environment. Lots of development opportunities as we continue to grow. Challenging tasks and impactful projects alongside experts that enable professional and personal growth. Corporate Benefits Program covering health, mobility, and learning for 100€ net per month. Modern office facilities with a rooftop terrace overlooking Munich, free drinks & fruits, and regular company events contribute to a good working environment Agile Robots SE is an international high-tech company based in Munich, Germany with a production site in Kaufbeuren and more than 3500 employees worldwide. Our mission is to bridge the gap between artificial intelligence and robotics by developing systems that combine state-of-the-art force-moment-sensing and world-leading image-processing technology. This unique combination of technologies allows us to provide user-friendly and affordable robotic solutions that enable intelligent precision assembly. This is made possible by our employees, who bring out the best in each and every day with creativity and enthusiasm. Become part of this team and shape the future of robotics with us! We are proud of our diversity and welcome your application regardless of gender and sexual identity, nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, or disability.

items.desc: Take AI from the frontier into the field. The AI Office is a small team with a direct mandate from the CEO to make Bittium an AI-native company. We build the AI tools and infrastructure Bittium works with, and work inside our business segments to bring AI into their products. We are hiring two new Members of Technical Staff to join the AI Office and work side by side with our Head of AI. What you build ends up in your colleagues' daily work and in products depended on by defence forces, public authorities and healthcare professionals. You might be the person who has rewritten their own agent harness more than once. shipped a full app in a weekend for a team that wasn't yours, and they still use it. fine-tuned a model and knows whether the eval moving meant anything. had a new open-weights model running on their own hardware the day it came out, and had an opinion about it by lunch. was pushed by API pricing, or dreams of personal AI sovereignty, into squeezing a model onto hardware it had no business running on. has broken a guardrail, and knows why you never rely on just one. daydreams of dark software factories. What you will do We shape the role around the person, and we make room for exceptional people. If your strength isn't listed below, tell us. Keep us ahead. You live and breathe the AI takeoff: the models, the hardware, the tools and where the whole industry is heading. Separate what matters from the noise early, and steer where we put our effort. Go where the work is. Sit with legal, finance, sales, R&D or production, find the work AI should be doing, and build it fast. Run and grow our AI infrastructure and applications. Inference on our own GPUs, the services on top of it and the end-user applications people work with every day. When a new model is worth having, it is live the same week. Build the AI our products run on. Build and maintain the agent harnesses, models and safeguards our business segments build products on, and keep them working all the way out to battlefield conditions. Make models ours. Post-train open-weights models until they beat the general-purpose ones at our work. Make agents safe to trust. Alignment on the model side, and a hard boundary around it that holds even when the model gets it wrong. What we are looking for above all Taste. You know what good looks like in code, in interfaces and in products, and you don't ship less. You look for the simple solution even when it takes longer to find, because clarity is worth the effort, but you also know when to take a shortcut. An edge. At work or outside it, you have taken something further than most people ever do. We care about that far more than titles, degrees or years of experience. Ownership. We set the direction together, and you own what you build and answer for the results. Lots of freedom, lots of responsibility, so you need to be good at directing your own work. What we ask You have mastered the craft of working with language models: prompting, context, agent skills, multi-agent orchestration and compiling intent into working software, including the spells that make the difference. You build real software, fast, with coding agents, and you have opinions about where agentic development is going. One thing is sure: the future is not TUIs on laptops. A strong full-stack engineer: frontend, APIs, databases, auth and deployment (ours is mostly Go, Python, TypeScript, SolidJS, Svelte and Postgres today, but we don't hire for a stack). You take a tool from an empty repo to production on your own. Strong software engineering fundamentals: architecture, data modelling, clean interfaces, testing, Linux and networking. When agents write the code, fundamentals are how you judge it. An eye for opportunity. You have a vision. You spot what should be automated and where a product is hiding, and you find the real problem behind a request, working easily with people who are not engineers. Fluent English and at least working Finnish. Any of these will make you stand out Security: agent sandboxing, red or blue team experience. Evals: designing evals that measure what matters in real work, and knowing when a good number is misleading. AI products: you have taken an AI-driven product or technology from idea to production, with real users or customers relying on it. Inference and GPU systems: SGLang or vLLM internals, speculative decoding, disaggregated serving, KV-cache offloading, low-bit quantization, kernels in Triton or CUDA, ROCm. Infrastructure and trust: confidential computing and attestation, bare metal, AWS or other cloud. Model training: post-training, preference optimization, RL, distillation, datasets, alignment and safety. AI hardware beyond NVIDIA: AMD, Tenstorrent, Cerebras, Etched, hardwired inference silicon, NPUs and other edge accelerators. Classic ML and sensing: anomaly detection, RF signal processing, biosignals (ECG, EEG), computer vision, sensor fusion. Mission-critical and regulated domains: defence, public …

items.desc: The opportunity Perform the hands-on experimental work that shows whether promising AI technologies hold up under realistic conditions. As AI Experimentation Engineer in the Technology Validation team, part of Hitachi Energy's Data, Analytics & Artificial Intelligence (DAAI) organization, you turn selected AI opportunities into feasibility experiments, comparative evaluations, demonstrators and technical spikes. Your evidence gives architecture, platform and delivery teams what they need before they commit to a technology. The team builds to learn and demonstrate, not to operate production systems. How You Will Make An Impact Design and run time-boxed experiments and technical spikes against clear learning questions, testing first the assumption most likely to change the conclusion. Build prototypes, test harnesses, reference implementations and integrations, proportionate to the question and under sufficiently realistic conditions. Conduct fair comparative evaluations of AI models, LLMs, services, frameworks and vendor options, using a baseline or alternative where it strengthens the conclusion. Create early demonstrators that make new AI capabilities tangible for stakeholders, even before a business owner has been identified. Document method, results and constraints concisely. Maintain reproducible, reusable technical assets. Collaborate with the AI Research Engineer and AI Opportunity Lead. Provide evidence, demonstrations and constraints to DAAI Architecture, AI Platform Operations, AI Acceleration and AI Delivery without taking on delivery or product ownership. Your background A genuine passion for AI: you try new tools and models on your own initiative and can show a recent example of something you built or tried. 3+ years of experience in AI/ML experimentation, prototyping, software engineering, data science or applied AI. Strong hands-on programming skills (Python preferred, other languages such as JavaScript or TypeScript welcome) and the ability to build working prototypes quickly, using AI coding assistants where useful. Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure preferred, GCP or AWS) is an advantage. Experience evaluating LLMs, ML models, AI services or integrations. You can run a time-boxed experiment, turn the findings into a decision and stop when more work would not change it. Intellectual honesty and clear communication: you report negative results as clearly as positive ones and explain limits to non-technical audiences. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience and fluent English. A degree in computer science, data science or engineering is an advantage. The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. Our benefit offering is tailored based on your country of employment and generally includes: Competitive salary and incentives Well-being and care Paid and unpaid leave Flexible work options Benefits that support your financial security You will receive more specific information during the recruitment process. Diseño y desarrollo de soluciones innovadoras basadas en 5G-Advanced, Telco Edge Cloud y tecnologías MEC dentro de proyectos de I+D nacionales y europeos. Conocimientos sólidos en redes 5G/5G-Advanced, virtualización de redes (NFV/SDN), Edge Computing y arquitecturas Telco Cloud. Experiencia en la aplicación de IA/ML para la gestión, optimización y automatización de infraestructuras de red. Valorable experiencia con entornos CI/CD (Git, Jenkins, GitLab) y despliegue de soluciones cloud-native mediante Docker y/o Kubernetes. Nivel de inglés alto. Valoramos todas las candidaturas y ofrecemos formación presencial, online y certificaciones. items.card: The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys developing and optimizing machine learning models for real-world applications. items.desc: Now Hiring: Data Scientist in high-tech scale-up Location: Delft, on-site At Luo, we build machines that automate quality inspections of medicine. In many pharmaceutical environments, people still spend hours manually checking products for particles, cosmetic defects, and packaging integrity issues. It’s tedious, and humans make mistakes. Our machines do this job more accurately, faster, and more consistently. The brains of our machines are the detection models: algorithms that decide in real time whether a product passes inspection. We’ve proven the technology works. Now we’re scaling, which means more clients, more applications, and higher accuracy. For that, we need someone who builds, improves, and pushes these models to the next level. Our office is located at YES!Delft, surrounded by dozens of other tech start-ups and scale-ups, right next to TU Delft. Much of the work happens hands-on, with our machines, test setups, and the teams around them. The Role We are looking for a Data Scientist who enjoys developing and optimizing machine learning models for real-world applications. Not just running models and reporting results, but understanding what has impact and executing what must be done to make it better. Most of the time, that is more than just re-training. You’ll work on detection models for particle contamination, cosmetic defects, and closure integrity problems. You stay on top of the latest developments in the field, translate them into concrete improvements, and ensure our models meet the strict requirements of the pharmaceutical industry. You work closely with the Software, Quality Support, and Machine Vision teams, who support you as you grow in the role. What you’ll work on Staying up to date: Following the latest developments in detection models and AI, assessing what’s relevant for our custom models, and translating this into concrete research actions. Building and improving detection models: Adapting existing models to new clients, improving detection, and qualifying model performance offline. Orchestrating data strategy: Managing and executing dataset annotation for model training and defining which data needs to be available to build and improve the best detection models. What we are looking for Education: A bachelor’s (HBO) or master’s degree in data science, AI, Computer Science, or a related field. Strong ML foundation: You have hands-on experience with Python and machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, gained at work or during your studies, graduation project, or internship. Data analysis: You have a strong focus on analyzing image data, understanding patterns, and extracting meaningful insights to improve model performance. Experience with medical or industrial datasets is a plus. Hands-on experience: You are comfortable owning the full pipeline, including data collection, annotation, and running experiments independently, or you’re eager to learn this quickly. Analytical and communicative: You can explain complex findings clearly to non-technical people and know how to tailor your message to your audience. Languages: Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, is required. Dutch language skills are considered a plus. Eye for quality: You recognize that accuracy is critical in the pharmaceutical industry and understand the real-world impact of your models, especially when it comes to patient safety. Direct and transparent: You communicate openly about challenges. If a model underperforms or data is insufficient, you raise your concerns early so we can solve them together. Office-based work is required , allowing for fast communication and close collaboration with your team. Dutch/EER working permit What it’s like to work here Real impact: Your models run in real machines at real client sites. When you improve something, you directly see the effect! Flat structure, short lines: Good idea? Go for it. Our structure is simple to encourage involvement, creativity, and innovation. Interesting challenges: Detection problems in the pharmaceutical industry are complex and demanding. You’ll work at the edge of technology, where quality standards are high. A solid team: You work alongside engineering, operational, and commercial teams who all share the same goal. Cooperation and teamwork are key to building and delivering machines that actually work. Ready to build detection models that make a difference? Send your CV and a short intro to jobs@luoautomation.com

We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it. Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimise athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT DELIVERING INNOVATIVE SOLUTIONS TO COMPLEX PROBLEMS We are looking for an enthusiastic, inquisitive, full-lifecycle Computer Vision Engineer to join our centralised, multi-disciplinary Data Science team. Our mandate is to drive platform innovation and cross-vertical reusability. Based in our London office, this role is designed for a unique technical practitioner who enjoys owning the complete lifecycle of a feature. Working collaboratively with various stakeholders, you won’t be isolated to just model training or just infrastructure configuration; you will help translate product briefs into algorithmic solutions, train deep learning models, engineer algorithmic pipelines, and deliver optimised, production-ready deployable artifacts that power analytics used by professional sports teams and elite athletes around the world. What You’ll Do End-to-End Pipeline Contribution: Collaborate with senior data scientists, computer vision engineers and vertical teams to translate product requirements into practical computer vision solutions, helping design the pipeline from raw video ingestion to production inference. Algorithm & Model Development: Design, train, and evaluate deep learning architectures alongside classical computer vision pipelines (e.g., feature tracking, optical flow, and spatial filtering via OpenCV). Geometric Computer Vision: Develop robust mathematical pipelines for camera calibration, homography estimation, and coordinate mapping to ensure model spatial outputs are accurate and stable. Modern Cloud & Containerised Deployment: Focus on architecting and containerising Python-based cloud microservices (via Docker) as our primary, future-facing deployment model. Desktop Applications Support: Assist in compiling cross-platform native binaries or shared libraries linking against the ONNX Runtime C++ API to support and maintain our existing Windows/macOS desktop application footprint. Automated Data Curation: Help build intelligent, automated data-ingestion pipelines that utilise model-assisted pre-labeling to continuously clean and version high-throughput training datasets. Interface & Boundary Design: Participate in defining clean API boundaries and interface contracts to ensure our core data science modules integrate seamlessly into downstream vertical applications. What You’ll Need Core Algorithmic Background: Foundational knowledge of classical computer vision (multi-view geometry, object tracking, spatial transformation) and modern deep learning architectures (object detection, semantic/instance segmentation, transformer-based vision models). Production Model Training: Experience sourcing, structuring, training, and benchmarking deep neural networks using PyTorch or TensorFlow. Hybrid Language Skills: High proficiency in Python for prototyping, training, scripting, and deployment pipelines, combined with a practical, supporting capability to read, build, and debug existing C++ codebases (including exposure to build management tools like CMake). Execution Graph Optimisation: Familiarity with optimising model runtimes and inference execution graphs for real-time applications using TensorRT or ONNX Runtime (e.g., quantisation, layer fusion). Modern Infrastructure: Practical experience with Docker containerisation, version control (Git), and cloud platform execution (AWS). NICE TO HAVE Neural Architecture Customisation: Experience modifying, adapting, or designing custom neural network components (e.g., specialised backbones, attention mechanisms, or custom loss functions) rather than just implementing standard off-the-shelf models. Advanced Mathematical Foundations: A strong intuitive grasp or academic background in applied linear algebra and matrix calculus, particularly as it relates to 3D spatial transformations and projective geometry. You will be solving some of the hardest and most challenging problems facing some of the best loved brands in the world – and doing this alongside an experienced team. You will design and deliver data-driven solutions across the full range of client challenges we take on: from predictive modelling and personalisation to end-to-end AI systems. Your focus area is media effectiveness and you will advise clients how to allocate their media budgets with your expertise in Media Mix Modelling, Incrementality and Attribution. Lead media effectiveness projects for our clients - designing, building and interpreting Media Mix Models, incrementality studies, and multi-touchpoint attribution solutions that inform client budget allocation and marketing strategy. Implement end-to-end scalable ML & AI systems - including model training, inferencing, deployment, and monitoring - leveraging latest cloud technologies. Take a leading role in a multidisciplinary team consisting of engineers, consultants and client stakeholders. Communicate complex technical solutions to clients in an understandable way, delivering progress reports and demonstrations. Translate complex model outputs into clear, actionable recommendations for client stakeholders, including senior marketing leadership. Consult and guide clients on data science implementation, serving as a trusted advisor on data-driven decision making What We Are Looking For MSc degree in a highly analytical and quantitative discipline like Econometrics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics or Statistics. Are you interested in shaping new technology capabilities within a growing and innovative high-tech company, where people and fun are part of our core values? We’d love to have you! Who is Xsens Xsens is a leading full-stack provider of sensors, software, and analytics that enable the digitization of movement. Xsens serves entertainment, humanoid robotics, health & sports and automation & mobility markets. By turning complex motion data into actionable insight, we help our partners accelerate development, improve control and learning, and bring physically intelligent systems to life. We collaborate with leading global innovators including Boston Dynamics, Toyota, Siemens, Electronic Arts, Epic Games, Netflix, and 20th Century Studios, alongside more than 1,000 research institutions, humanoid robotics companies and universities worldwide. Your role as a Computer Vision Engineer at Xsens As a Computer Vision Engineer, you will lead camera-based perception for Xsens motion capture. Your role is to establish Deep Learning and Computer Vision pipelines to turn camera images into human pose estimate. You will learn from the highly-skilled team of sensor fusion experts, biomechanists and mathematicians. You will be its computer vision specialist, and report to the Technology Manager. The position is open to hybrid / remote working. Key challenges: Select, adapt and fine-tune deep learning models for 2D and 3D human pose estimation from cameras, that perform robustly in challenging real-world conditions. Develop camera models and calibration routines for a range of camera and lens configurations. Evaluation of motion capture output and developing compensatory algorithms and techniques to handle camera /vision failure modes. Build training and evaluation pipelines from camera and optical motion capture recordings. Use synthetic data where real data is insufficient. Track the computer vision research landscape and assess whether new techniques are feasible for Xsens products. Xsens is looking for a hands-on Computer Vision Engineer who combines strong theoretical foundations with a proven ability to build and ship working systems. Required MSc/PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics or a related field, with years of relevant industry or applied research experience. Hands-on experience training and fine-tuning deep learning models for human pose estimation, with results evaluated on public benchmarks. Solid understanding of camera and lens models, including wide field-of-view optics, intrinsic and extrinsic calibration, and multi-view geometry. Familiarity with the output representations of common pose models, such as keypoint sets and SMPL-family parameters. Experience with tools in markerless eco-system such as OpenCV, Sapiens, and SAM3D. Proficiency in Python. Working knowledge of C++ for integrating models into an existing C++ codebase. Preferred Experience with synthetic data generation and rendering pipelines. Experience optimizing models for real-time deployment, for example with ONNX, TensorRT or quantization. Experience building datasets and benchmarks for human motion. items.desc: Le descriptif de l’offre ci-dessous est en Anglais Type de contrat : CDD Contrat renouvelable : Oui Niveau de diplôme exigé : Bac + 5 ou équivalent Fonction : Ingénieur scientifique contractuel Contexte et atouts du poste This research engineer position is part of the European IPCEI-CIS project (Important Project of Common European Interest – Next Generation Cloud Infrastructure and Services), within the DXP (Data Exchange Platform) project, carried out in collaboration with Amadeus and three Inria research teams: LORELEY, CEDAR and MAGELLAN. The DXP project aims to design and develop an open-source solution for managing a federated and distributed data exchange platform, operating in an open, scalable and massively distributed environment across the entire cloud-edge continuum. In this context, the successful candidate will join the LORELEY project team at the Inria Centre of the University of Lorraine, in Nancy. They will work in an environment at the interface between academic research and software development, interacting with researchers, engineers and industrial partners. The Inria Centre of the University of Lorraine is one of Inria's nine centres and comprises twenty project teams distributed across Nancy, Strasbourg and Saarbrücken. Its activities involve more than 400 people, including scientists and research and innovation support staff, representing 45 different nationalities. The Inria Centre is a major and recognised player in the field of digital sciences. It is located at the heart of a rich research, development and innovation ecosystem, comprising in particular highly innovative small and medium-sized enterprises, large industrial groups, competitiveness clusters, research and higher education institutions, laboratories of excellence and technological research institutes. This position offers the opportunity to work on a topic at the crossroads of applied cryptography, distributed systems, privacy protection and zero-knowledge technologies, with the aim of implementing and evaluating an open-source prototype. Mission confiée End-to-end encryption (E2EE) systems must be able to authenticate users' public keys in order to protect against man-in-the-middle attacks. Existing solutions rely, in particular, on out-of-band channels [1], shared passwords [2], or centralised key distribution servers. These approaches have significant limitations in terms of usability, decentralisation and privacy protection. Indeed, implementing an out-of-band channel that is both secure and intuitive in practice is challenging. Users often neglect password entropy, while comparing fingerprints is error-prone and time-consuming [3]. On the other hand, relying on a centralised trusted authority to distribute and authenticate public keys greatly simplifies the use and implementation of these systems. However, this centralisation introduces a single point of trust and failure, and may facilitate the collection or monitoring of associations between identifiers and public keys. Consequently, achieving secure and intuitive client authentication remains a major challenge for E2EE systems. The objective of this position is to implement and evaluate a decentralised public key infrastructure that enables the authenticity of public keys to be verified while limiting the information exposed about users and their keys. The solution under investigation will rely on zero-knowledge cryptographic techniques as well as on Key Transparency mechanisms, which aims for users to be able to verify that the public keys associated with them have not been modified or replaced without their knowledge. It must mitigate the risk of man-in-the-middle attacks while limiting the possibilities for user enumeration and the automated collection of the directory mapping identifiers to public keys. [1] Zimmermann, P.R.: The official PGP user’s guide. MIT press (1995) [2] Boyko, V., MacKenzie, P., Patel, S.: Provably secure password-authenticated key exchange using diffie-hellman. In: Advances in Cryptology- Eurocrypt 2000. pp. 156–171. Springer (2000) [3] Whitten, A., Tygar, J.D.: Why johnny can’t encrypt: A usability evaluation of pgp 5.0. In: USENIX Security Symposium. vol. 348 (1999) Principales activités Developing an end-to-end proof of concept for the distributed system. Integrating the various cryptographic primitives used by the system, including accumulators, commitments, signatures, SNARKs and hash functions. Integrating existing cryptographic libraries and combining their components to build the cryptographic constructions required by the system, including accumulators, commitments, signatures, SNARKs and hash functions. Conducting experiments to evaluate the performance, resource consumption and scalability of the solution. Contributing to the documentation and open-source publication of the work. items.desc: At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet. Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all. About The Team And The Role Certilogo, an eBay company, empowers brands and consumers through trusted product authentication and brand engagement solutions. You will work within Product & Engineering, alongside product managers, software engineers, data specialists, UX designers and other AI experts to turn AI opportunities into real product capabilities. Working closely with Product, Tech Leads and the Innovation team, you will design, prototype and productionize AI-based solutions across Certilogo’s authentication and digital product experiences. You will help evaluate new AI approaches, translate promising experiments into scalable product features, and continuously evolve the AI capabilities already supporting our platform. This is a full-time position based in Milan, with a hybrid work model (3 days per week in the office) and flexibility to support work-life balance. What You Will Accomplish Turn AI opportunities into measurable product outcomes, from problem framing and data exploration through experimentation, validation and production deployment. Design, develop and evolve Machine Learning and Computer Vision solutions supporting product authentication, fraud detection and digital product experiences, selecting the right approach for the problem rather than applying a fixed model or technique. Evaluate and apply modern AI approaches, including multimodal and foundation models, embeddings and Generative AI, identifying where they can create meaningful value and where simpler, targeted models are preferable. Build robust AI experimentation and evaluation practices, including representative datasets, meaningful metrics, error analysis and repeatable validation, so that model quality and business impact can be assessed objectively. Productionize AI components in collaboration with engineering teams, with attention to scalability, latency, reliability, cost, model/version management, monitoring and continuous improvement. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, UX, Data and external partners to shape requirements, communicate trade-offs and turn AI capabilities into usable, maintainable product features. What You Will Bring 4+ years of hands-on experience designing, developing and deploying Machine Learning / Deep Learning solutions, ideally including Computer Vision and production AI systems. Strong Python skills and solid experience with modern ML frameworks such as PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, plus the ability to build maintainable, testable production code. Strong understanding of Computer Vision and Deep Learning techniques, with experience in areas such as image classification, detection, embeddings, similarity, anomaly detection or related visual recognition problems. Practical experience evaluating and applying foundation models, multimodal / Vision-Language Models or Generative AI techniques; ability to assess accuracy, limitations, latency and cost. Strong data and experimentation skills, including dataset preparation, feature engineering, statistical reasoning, error analysis and model evaluation; familiarity with SQL and common data/ML libraries. Experience with MLOps / production AI practices such as experiment tracking, model versioning, CI/CD, containerization, cloud deployment, monitoring and model performance or drift management. Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, stay current with the AI landscape and work effectively across Product, Engineering and business stakeholders. Fluency in English. Italian language skills are a plus. Additional Details The base pay range for this position is expected in the range below: 42,800 EUR - 59,000 EUR Base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a target bonus and restricted stock units (as applicable) in addition to a range of insurance coverage (including medical) and/or other benefits (including retirement plan eligibility and various paid time off benefits, such as PTO, wellbeing and parental leave). Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided upon an offer of employment. eBay is an equal …

items.desc: Entra nel nostro mondo. Trasforma insieme a noi. Junior Data Scientist – BIP AI LAB Location: Bari – Ibrido Quale sarà la tua sfida? Lavorare in BIP AI LAB significa operare in un contesto internazionale e multidisciplinare, contribuendo a progetti di consulenza, innovazione, ricerca finanziata e formazione sull’Intelligenza Artificiale. Farai parte di un team multidisciplinare che integra tre anime: Research : esperti che presidiano lo stato dell'arte in machine learning, AI generativa e metodi quantitativi. Engineering : sviluppatori e ingegneri specializzati in data engineering, data science, integrazione e visualizzazione del dato. Delivery : consulenti che traducono le soluzioni in risultati di business, dal design alla produzione. Competenze richieste Supportare lo sviluppo di modelli di Machine Learning (classificazione, regressione, clustering) utilizzando scikit-learn, XGBoost e framework di deep learning come PyTorch o TensorFlow. Contribuire ad attività di feature engineering , analisi esplorativa dei dati (EDA) e preparazione dei dataset per il training. Collaborare alla realizzazione di analisi statistiche (test di ipotesi, inferenza, modelli lineari generalizzati) a supporto di use case di business. Partecipare allo sviluppo di soluzioni di deep learning su dati strutturati, immagini o testi. Lavorare con team cross-funzionali (Data Engineer, AI Engineer, Business Analyst) nella traduzione di requisiti di business in soluzioni data-driven. Supportare le iniziative legate a Responsible & Explainable AI . Requisiti principali Fino a 3 anni di esperienza (o stage, tesi, progetti universitari) in Data Science, Machine Learning o analisi statistica. Buona conoscenza di Python (Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn) e del suo ecosistema per la Data Science. Familiarità con almeno un framework di deep learning (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras). Conoscenze di statistica descrittiva e inferenziale e di principi di ML (overfitting, cross-validation, metriche di valutazione). Interesse per l’applicazione di ML e statistica a problemi di business reali. Costituiscono un plus Esperienze (anche solo progettuali) con time series , NLP o computer vision . Conoscenza introduttiva di experiment tracking (MLflow, Weights & Biases). Contributi a progetti open-source, competizioni Kaggle o portfolio di progetti personali in ambito ML/DS. Sarai tu ad entrare nel nostro Team? Perché Bip? Crescita e Formazione Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale. Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro. Salute & Benefits Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati. Famiglia e Genitorialità Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda. Inclusione e Valori Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99). Cosa offriamo? La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 28.000 e € 35.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato. L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda). Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione. Next Steps Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente. Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca. L’iter di selezione comprende generalmente un colloquio con HR, un colloquio tecnico con un line manager ed un eventuale colloquio con un Partner. L’ordine e il numero delle interviste potrebbero variare a seconda delle esigenze di recruiting. In alternativa, saremo felici di conservare il tuo CV nel nostro database per poterlo rivalutare per altre opportunità future. Se dovessi …

items.desc: About Air Apps At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide. Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe. Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way. The Role As an AI/ML Engineer , you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and optimizing machine learning models to power our mobile applications. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to create intelligent, data-driven features that enhance user experiences. Your expertise in artificial intelligence and deep learning will help us innovate and stay ahead in the mobile app industry. This is a fully onsite position, based at our office in Lisbon, where you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams in person and contribute to a dynamic and fast-paced environment. We are open to support with relocation efforts. Responsibilities Develop, train, and optimize machine learning models for various mobile app features. Research and implement state-of-the-art AI techniques to improve user engagement and app performance. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate AI-driven solutions into our applications. Design and maintain scalable ML pipelines, ensuring efficient model deployment and monitoring. Analyze large datasets to derive insights and drive data-driven decision-making. Stay updated with the latest AI trends and best practices, incorporating them into our development processes. Optimize AI models for mobile environments to ensure high performance and low latency. Requirements Around 4+ years of experience in AI/ML development, preferably in mobile applications. Proficiency in Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, or other ML frameworks. Experience with deep learning, NLP, computer vision, and statistical modeling. Familiarity with cloud-based ML services (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure). Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software engineering best practices. Experience in deploying and maintaining ML models in production. Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team environment. Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for innovation. What benefits do we offer? Apple hardware ecosystem for work. Annual Bonus Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind. Transportation Budget to support your commute needs. Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more. Childcare support. Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together. Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning. Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active. Meals 100% free at the hub. Diversity & Inclusion At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger. Application Disclaimer At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification. Important Notice Air Apps does not partner with nor is represented by any recruiting agencies, staffing firms, or third-party recruiters in connection with our hiring efforts. All legitimate communication regarding Air Apps opportunities will come exclusively from an official @ airapps.com email address. Additionally, all open positions are published only through our official careers platform, Ashby . If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent Air Apps from a different email domain, through a recruiting agency, or via a job posting source other than Ashby, please exercise caution. We do not accept unsolicited candidate submissions from agencies, and any such submissions will not be considered.

items.desc: At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors. Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success. About The Role As a Machine Learning Engineer at Kpler, you will play a key role in developing and deploying predictive models that power our global commodity, energy, and maritime intelligence platforms. Working closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, and Product teams, you will bridge the gap between machine learning experimentation and production-grade software delivery. Your work will directly transform complex data flows into real-time, actionable insights that help world-leading trading firms, industrial leaders, and analysts make critical decisions. Key Responsibilities Architect and deploy ML pipelines: Design, build, and maintain production-grade machine learning workflows and microservices for power market forecasting and electricity grid modeling. Bridge research and engineering: Transition statistical and machine learning prototypes from initial experimentation into scalable, production-ready Python applications. Manage time-series and event data systems: Design and optimize database schemas in PostgreSQL to handle high-throughput time-series data, event streams, and normalization routines. Implement robust MLOps practices: Establish automated model training, backtesting, evaluation, tuning, and feature/model versioning standards across deployments. Drive data engineering quality: Construct clean ingestion and transformation pipelines, ensuring high integrity, validation, and low-latency access across analytical models. Champion software excellence: Write modular, well-tested Python code, actively participating in peer code reviews, CI/CD automation, and Agile delivery processes. Experience & Background What you'll need (Must-haves) Software engineering foundation: Approximately two to five years of experience as a data-focused software engineer. Python mastery: Significant experience working with large production Python codebases, rather than working exclusively in notebooks. Domain knowledge: Deep understanding of electricity-grid fundamentals, including generation, transmission, and electricity markets. Data engineering & databases: Experience in data engineering, including working with PostgreSQL or similar databases, database design, data normalisation, and managing time-series and event data. DS & ML research rigor: Proven experience in data science and machine learning research, encompassing statistics, hypothesis testing, model training, evaluation, backtesting, tuning, and model selection. MLOps & versioning: Practical experience in machine learning engineering, specifically including model and feature versioning. Engineering practices & communication: Confidence working with Git, code reviews, and Agile methodologies, supported by strong written and spoken English. Nice-to-haves Cloud platforms: Experience deploying ML workloads on AWS or GCP using Docker and Kubernetes. Workflow orchestration: Familiarity with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, or MLflow. Streaming technologies: Exposure to real-time streaming architectures (e.g., Apache Kafka). items.desc: Environmental Engineering – AI Data Trainer About The Role We're partnering with the world's leading AI research labs to make AI smarter in complex scientific domains — and we need environmental engineers to help get it right. As an AI Data Trainer, you'll stress-test cutting-edge language models on real environmental engineering challenges, expose their blind spots, and help build systems that reason accurately about the problems that matter most to our planet. This is a fully remote, flexible contract role. You set your hours and work on your own schedule. Organization: Alignerr Type: Hourly Contract Location: Remote Commitment: 10–40 hours/week What You'll Do Design Challenging Problems — Craft advanced environmental engineering scenarios spanning contaminant transport, mass balance in treatment systems, hydrology, air dispersion modeling, and Life Cycle Assessments (LCA) Author Gold-Standard Solutions — Develop rigorous, step-by-step technical solutions — including chemical dosage calculations, hydraulic flow models, and pollutant dispersion analyses — that serve as benchmark responses for AI evaluation Audit AI Outputs — Review AI-generated remediation plans, environmental impact statements, and engineering calculations for technical accuracy, regulatory compliance (EPA, ISO 14001), and safety Sharpen AI Reasoning — Identify flaws in model logic — such as incorrect stoichiometry, faulty unit conversions, or failure to account for secondary environmental impacts — and deliver structured feedback to improve how the model thinks Work Across Core Domains — Apply expertise in water and wastewater treatment, air quality management, EHS compliance, and solid or hazardous waste management Who You Are Advanced Degree — Master's (pursuing or completed) or PhD in Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering with an environmental focus, or a closely related discipline Domain Expert — Strong foundational knowledge in at least one core area: aquatic chemistry, wastewater process design, air quality engineering, or hazardous waste remediation Precise Communicator — Able to explain complex ecological and engineering concepts clearly and concisely in writing Detail-Oriented — High accuracy when checking unit conversions (e.g., mg/L to ppm), chemical equations, mass balances, and regulatory logic No prior AI experience required — we'll get you up to speed Nice to Have Prior experience with data annotation, data quality, or AI evaluation workflows Familiarity with environmental modeling software (e.g., AERMOD, SWMM, GoldSim) Experience writing technical reports or environmental impact assessments Why Join Us Work on cutting-edge AI projects alongside top AI research teams and labs Fully remote and flexible — work when and where it suits you Freelance perks: autonomy, variety, and collaboration with experts across the globe Gain rare, hands-on exposure to how advanced large language models are items.desc: The French National Research Institute for Agriculture, Food and Environment (INRAE) is a public research organization employing 12,000 people across more than 270 research, service and experimental units at 18 centres throughout France. INRAE is among the world’s leading institutions in agricultural and food sciences, plant and animal sciences, and environmental and ecological research. Its research aims to develop solutions for high-performing, sustainable agriculture, high-quality food, and the sustainable management of resources and ecosystems. Working environment, responsibilities and activities You will join the Immunocare team within the BIOEPAR joint research unit ( INRAE–Oniris ), which specializes in infectious diseases of farm animals and their impact on animal health and livestock production systems. The team comprises two research groups focusing on respiratory health in pigs and cattle, respectively. It develops innovative approaches to better understand interactions between pathogens and the immune system, with the aim of improving disease prevention and vaccination strategies. The successful candidate will join the group led by Dr Nicolas Bertho , comprising two INRAE researchers, one academic researcher/lecturer, one assistant engineer and one PhD student. The position will be under the scientific supervision of Dr Pauline Maisonnasse , the project leader. The FluOrganoVax project aims to reproduce ex vivo the immune responses induced in porcine lymph nodes following vaccination, with the goal of developing a predictive model for assessing vaccine formulations without systematically relying on animal experimentation. The project is conducted in collaboration with Lisa Chakrabarti’s team and Samy Gobaa’s Organ-on-Chip Platform at Institut Pasteur, as well as CEVA Santé Animale. The research engineer will work closely with a postdoctoral researcher based at Institut Pasteur, who will develop an organ-on-chip model using the same cells. Both approaches will be developed in parallel and compared to build an innovative vaccine-evaluation platform. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to an ambitious collaborative project at the interface of immunology, virology, organ-on-chip technology and vaccine development, within a network bringing together academic and industrial partners. It is suited to someone keen to lead experimental work independently while collaborating closely with team members on a daily basis. Main responsibilities · Develop an ex vivo porcine lymph node model: - Establish and optimize the model and culture conditions. - Standardize experimental protocols. · Characterize the model’s cellular composition and immune responses using: - Spectral and/or conventional flow cytometry, including panel development for myeloid cells and lymphocytes. - Confocal microscopy. - ELISpot assays (to be established in the laboratory). - ELISA for antibody and cytokine measurements. - Virus neutralization assays. · Analyse and present data: statistical analysis, interpretation, graphical presentation and scientific writing. Analysis and dissemination of results · Contribute to experimental study design. · Analyse experimental results. · Present findings internally and externally. · Contribute to scientific publications as a co-author (potentially as first author, depending on involvement). Laboratory activities · Comply with laboratory hygiene, safety and quality procedures. · Contribute to the day-to-day organization of the laboratory. · Potentially supervise Master’s students, depending on project progress. Specific working conditions: Work in a biosafety level 2 (BSL-2) laboratory. No direct animal handling, but work with fresh porcine tissue and blood samples. Occasional travel to Paris may be required, as well as attendance at national and international scientific meetings and conferences. Qualifications and skills Education : · Five to eight years of higher education (Master’s to PhD level) in biology, biotechnology, immunology, microbiology, virology or a related discipline. · Preferred qualification: Master’s degree, engineering degree or PhD. Essential skills · Hands-on experience in cell culture. · Experience with ELISA techniques. · Substantial experience in flow cytometry (spectral flow cytometry is an advantage). · Knowledge of immunology and virology. · Ability to present results in French and English. · Good understanding of biosafety laboratory procedures. Desirable skills · ELISpot assays. · Virus neutralization assays. · Porcine immunology. · Proficiency in data analysis software (R, FlowJo or equivalent). Personnal qualities : · Independence, initiative and scientific rigor. · Team spirit and strong interpersonal skills. · Interest in methodological development. · Ability to troubleshoot experimental problems. · Interest in the interface between immunology and virology. items.desc: Babelscape cerca due NLP & LLM Engineer In Babelscape cerchiamo due NLP & LLM Engineer da inserire in modalità ibrida nel team di Roma. Siamo una PMI innovativa deep tech di intelligenza artificiale nata nel 2016 come spin-off della Sapienza, fondata da Roberto Navigli, Professore Ordinario, vincitore di due prestigiosi grant ERC e Fellow di AAAI, ACL, ELLIS ed EurAI. Babelscape si colloca alla frontiera della ricerca e dell’innovazione, svolgendo un’intensa attività di ricerca e sviluppo sia nell’ambito di iniziative progettuali interne ad alto contenuto innovativo, sia attraverso la partecipazione a progetti di ricerca europei.
