items.desc: Détails de L'OFFRE Vous interviendrez au sein des départements IT de nos clients, dans les équipes responsables des outils dédiés à la lutte contre blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme, ou du respect des sanctions internationales. Vos MISSIONS Vous occuperez le rôle de Business Analyst et serez un élément clé pour aider nos clients dans la définition et/ou la mise en œuvre de leur stratégie LCB/FT. Votre poste pourra nécessiter que vous soyez capable d'analyser de nombreuses données pour alimenter les réflexions et les travaux. Vous pourrez notamment être amené(e) à réaliser les actions suivantes : Analyse des données, identification des cas, Simulations et estimations des impacts des optimisations ou autres évolutions des modèles de détection, Recueil et analyse des besoins métiers, Animation d'ateliers, Diagnostic du dispositif existant, Analyse des recommandations d'audit interne ou externe, Gap analysis, Définition des évolutions ou paramétrages nécessaires dans les outils, Rédaction de spécifications fonctionnelles, Planification et suivi de la mise en œuvre, Rédaction de documents de synthèse, de présentation ou de suivi projet, Définition, réalisation et/ou suivi des plans de tests (contrôles de cohérences, tests fonctionnels ou de non régression, etc. ...) Votre PROFIL Diplômé(e) d'un niveau Master (Ecole de commerce, d'ingénieurs ou d'une université), vous avez une expérience significative en tant que MOA dans le domaine de la LCB/FT ou d'autres thèmes de la Sécurité Financière. Vous maitrisez les techniques d'analyse et de restitution des données. Vos expériences vous ont permis de maitriser un ou plusieurs outils du marché utilisés pour la détection et le traitement des alertes. Vous savez allier autonomie et esprit d'équipe, rigueur et capacité de synthèse, mais aussi être force de proposition et être proactif ou proactive. Idéalement, vous avez déjà réalisé la cartographie des risques, participé à des missions d'audit et/ou mis en place des plans de contrôle interne en lien avec les dispositifs LCB/FT. Une première expérience dans le domaine de l'IA ou du machine learning sera également un atout. Vos COMPÉTENCES Outre les savoir-faire nécessaires à la réalisation des missions énumérées ci-dessus, votre parcours a démontré les compétences suivantes : Techniques de data sciences, d'analyse des données et de restitution, Connaissance des modèles de détection, Expérience dans les données nécessaires et leur gestion, Compréhension des enjeux métiers liés à la LCB/FT et plus largement à la Sécurité Financière, Maitrise d'au moins un outil comme Actimize SAM, Netreveal, Fircosoft Trust ou Continuity, pour la mise en œuvre de modèles/scénarios et son paramétrage, Rédaction ou mise à jour de la documentation projet, notamment pour garantir la traçabilité des décisions ou des justifications pour les paramètres appliqués, Maîtrise de l'anglais obligatoire, à l'écrit et à l'oral, Capacité à travailler en méthodologie Agile (Scrum, Safe, ...) et cycle projet " En V ". Une bonne connaissance des types de messages transactionnels (Swift, MX), ou des mécanismes de lignage des données sont des plus.

items.desc: Job ID: 828744 Associate AI Inference Engineer (m/f/d/x) Hamburg Junior entry Regular T-Systems International GmbH About the position T-Systems is building Europe's next generation of AI infrastructure with the AI Industry Cloud powered by thousands of NVIDIA GPUs, including the latest generation of NVIDIA DGX B200 and B300 systems. Our platform enables companies to deploy, scale, and operate cutting-edge large language models (LLMs) and generative AI applications on a secure and high-performance infrastructure. We are looking for an Associate AI Inference Engineer to join our AI platform team. In this role, you will support the provision, operation and optimization of productive LLM inference services based on the T-Systems AI Foundation platform, which is operated on the Industrial AI Cloud. Working closely with platform engineers, AI researchers and software developers, you will help provide high-performance and reliable AI services for enterprise customers. Optimize inference workloads on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure for latency, throughput, and GPU utilization. Benchmarking and evaluation of LLM serving frameworks, inference configurations, and model deployments. Implementation and optimization of modern LLM serving techniques, such as kV cache optimization, continuous batching, and distributed inference. Working with platform engineers to deploy and scale AI workloads on Kubernetes. Analyze and fix performance issues in inference operations across software, network, and GPU infrastructure. Involvement in automating deployment, benchmarking, and operational processes Monitor inference services using metrics, logging, and dashboards to ensure reliable production operations. Working closely with AI engineers and researchers to onboard new foundation models and inference technologies. Maintaining technical documentation and participating in the continuous development of the AI inference platform. A master's degree in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or a related field is an advantage. Relevant practical experience in AI engineering, machine learning engineering, or AI infrastructure engineering, including experience as a working student or research engineer. Very good programming skills in Python as well as experience in developing AI applications and corresponding tools. Practical experience deploying, benchmarking, or optimizing large language model (LLM) inference workloads. Practical experience with modern LLM serving frameworks such as vLLM and sGLang. Practical experience optimizing LLM inference workloads on NVIDIA GPU infrastructure and points of contact with NVIDIA DGX/HGX systems or next-generation GPU platforms such as B200 and B300. Experience with evaluating or optimizing advanced inference techniques such as KV caching, disaggregated prefill/decode inference, or comparable LLM serving optimizations. Knowledge of modern NVIDIA inference technologies such as NVIDIA Dynamo, LMCache, Tensorrt-LLM, Triton Inference Server, or comparable GPU inference frameworks. Experience benchmarking AI models and analyzing inference performance, latency, throughput, and serving efficiency. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Bash, and Linux-based compute environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, as well as the ability to collaborate within multi-disciplinary engineering teams. Willingness to travel of up to 50%. International experience, for example through study, work or extended stays abroad. Knowledge of observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Experience with Helm, Terraform, GitHub Actions, or Infrastructure-as-Code Experience with enterprise AI platforms or multi-tenant inference environments. Knowledge of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), vector databases or embedded retrieval systems. What we offer The opportunity to work on one of Europe's largest enterprise AI platforms. items.desc: At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees. Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so. Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us! The Role For the Advanced Bioassay & Characterization team we are looking for an enthusiastic and inspiring Research Associate (RA)! The group develops mainly cell-based potency assays used internally and by external parties, such as Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs), to demonstrate the quality and characteristics of our antibody products used in clinical studies. Where possible, automation tools are implemented to support the ongoing activities of this bioassay team. We are looking for a laboratory professional who is genuinely enthusiastic about hands-on experimental work and is motivated to build their expertise in a predominantly lab-based role. The majority of your time will be spent in the laboratory, performing experiments. The remainder of your time will be dedicated to data analysis, interpretation, documentation and discussing results with colleagues. Working alongside scientists and fellow research associates, you will coordinate laboratory activities for multiple projects simultaneously. You will be joining a group of down-to-earth colleagues who value openness, collaboration and a good sense of humour. We work closely together and enjoy supporting one another, while embracing the fact that priorities in drug development can change quickly and no two weeks are exactly the same. We are therefore looking for someone who enjoys a dynamic environment, stays flexible when plans shift, and takes pride in delivering high-quality work. If you enjoy being hands-on in the lab, have a keen eye for detail, and like being part of a supportive team that celebrates successes together, we look forward to receiving your application! This position provides temporary leave coverage, so we offer a 12-month fixed-term contract. Responsibilities As Research Associate in our team, you will be working in a team of scientists and research associates dedicated to developing and validating functional bioassays. Specifically, you will participate in assay development for one of our clinical candidates. We are currently in a growing phase with a ‘knock your socks off’ pipeline of new antibody products. That is where you come in and help us realize our growth ambitions! Responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Working with scientists and RAs to set-up and execute cell-based bioassays; Conducting activities related to assigned study (e.g. conducting experiments, interpretation, and documentation); Presenting results to various teams. Requirements A development focused position lies in store for you. You are someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced biotechnology environment. With your experience in performing and developing cell-based assays, you take an active role in your field of expertise. You are highly motivated to achieve the goals that are important to Genmab’s therapeutic antibody projects. Specifically, we ask the following of you: You have a BSc/HLO degree in a life science related field; Relevant experience in performing bioassays, in industry or academia for at least 1 year. Knowledge of and/or work experience with cell-based assays, flow cytometry and immune-oncology assays. Knowledge and/or work experience with SPR would be an advantage. You are highly organized and are energized by delivering on high-quality documentation. Ability to work on several projects in parallel to each other and adjust priorities appropriately. Team player with pro-active attitude and can-do mentality. Fluency in English. You must already be based in the Netherlands at the time of application. items.desc: Placeringsort Göteborg Diarienummer FK 2026/030664 Varje år fattar Försäkringskassan 21 miljoner beslut som påverkar människors liv och hela samhället. Vi betalar ut cirka 260 miljarder kronor varje år. Det är allas skattepengar vi har hand om. Det är ett stort ansvar. Därför tänker vi nytt och använder den senaste tekniken för att förenkla och förbättra, utveckla och leverera it-tjänsterna för den svenska socialförsäkringen. Välkommen till en av Sveriges största IT-avdelningar. Inom vår enhet arbetar vi med utveckling, implementation, skalning och drift av AI-tjänster som skapar insikter och effektiviserar handläggnings- och stödprocesser inom Försäkringskassan. Vi utvecklar även AI-tjänster som kan erbjudas externt och bidrar till kunskapsspridning, omvärldsbevakning och samverkan inom AI- och dataområdet. Nu söker vi en it-verksamhetsutvecklare som vill bidra till att omsätta verksamhetens behov till utveckling och användning av AI-baserade lösningar. Hos oss får du använda din kompetens i ett område som utvecklas snabbt och där ditt arbete bidrar till Försäkringskassans samhällsviktiga uppdrag. Du får ta ansvar, påverka utvecklingen och bidra med nya idéer tillsammans med kollegor med olika kompetenser och perspektiv. Vi delar kunskap, utmanar befintliga arbetssätt och lär av varandra. Verksamhetsutveckling, Ai, kommunikation och myndighetssamverkan Som verksamhetsutvecklare arbetar du med att identifiera behov och skapa förutsättningar för utveckling av Försäkringskassans interna processer. Du analyserar hur AI, data och digitala lösningar kan bidra till utvecklade handläggningsprocesser och stödprocesser och omsätter verksamhetens behov till konkreta utvecklingsinitiativ. Du genomför utredningar och analyser av komplexa verksamhetsfrågor med ett områdesövergripande perspektiv. Du behöver förstå hur Försäkringskassans verksamhet och processer fungerar i praktiken och kunna se samband mellan olika delar av myndigheten. I arbetet väger du samman verksamhetens behov med tekniska möjligheter och organisatoriska förutsättningar. Kunskap om AI är en viktig del av rollen. Du behöver förstå AI möjligheter och begränsningar och kunna bedöma hur tekniken kan användas för att utveckla verksamheten. Du följer utvecklingen inom AI och omsätter relevant kunskap till analyser, dialoger och konkreta utvecklingsinitiativ inom Försäkringskassan. Du arbetar nära it-verksamheten och andra sakkunniga och fungerar som en länk mellan verksamhetens behov och tekniska möjligheter. IT är ett avgörande verktyg i detta arbete, och vår IT-avdelning med drygt 1 400 medarbetare spelar en central roll i det brottsförebyggande och brottsbekämpande arbetet genom att tillhandahålla effektiva och säkra IT-tjänster till hela organisationen. Inom IT-avdelningen finns AI-plattform, en nyetablerad och expansiv grupp som ansvarar för myndighetens generella AI-förmåga och centrala lösningar. Teamet är placerat i Stockholm och består idag av sex medarbetare, där samtliga är erfarna Data Scientists som arbetat tillsammans i flera år. Nu växer vi och söker två plattformsingenjörer för att komplettera teamet. Eftersom detta är en nyuppbyggd verksamhet utan tidigare Plattformsingenjörer, får du en unik möjlighet att vara med från början och driva arbetet med plattformen framåt. Vi söker dig som är en skicklig plattformsingenjör, redo att ta eget ansvar och leverera en säker och skalbar miljö. Vi erbjuder: Roliga och utvecklande arbetsuppgifter med högt i tak. Ett team där kompetens och ödmjukhet går hand i hand. Möjligheten att påverka och bygga system från grunden i en ständig förbättringsprocess. Generösa förmåner inom bland annat semester, friskvård och pension. Läs mer om våra förmåner https://polisen.se/erbjudande Arbetsbeskrivning Vill du vara med och bygga Polismyndighetens nya AI-förmågor från grunden? Som Plattformsingenjör får du ett stort operativt ansvar för nyutveckling och förvaltning av våra AI-system. Du arbetar hands-on med att bygga robusta lösningar, sätter ribban för kodkvalitet och stöttar teamets kompetensutveckling. I rollen ansvarar du för att säkerställa hög teknisk standard och leverera verklig samhällsnytta på riktigt! En stor del av uppdraget kommer också vara att koordinera och kommunicera med andra grupper inom domänen för plattform. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter innefattar: Design och implementation: Skapa nya, robusta containerlösningar från grunden. Drift och underhåll: Konfigurera, felsöka och förbättra befintliga miljöer. Samarbete: Arbeta tätt tillsammans med utvecklings- och andra plattformsteam för att möjliggöra modern plattformsutveckling. Automatisering & Omvärldsbevakning: Driva arbetet med automatisering och hålla dig uppdaterad på senaste teknik inom open source-världen. Rollen innebär en stor variation av uppgifter och du kommer att ha en central roll i att forma hur vi arbetar med AI-utveckling inom myndigheten. Kvalifikationer För att lyckas i denna roll ser vi att du har: Minst tre års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom området. Praktisk erfarenhet av Kubernetes. God erfarenhet av Linux-systemadministration. Praktisk erfarenhet av verktyg som Ansible, ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize, Terraform eller liknande. Erfarenhet av att konfigurera CI/CD-flöden och arbeta enligt GitOps-principer. Grundläggande förståelse för säkerhet i container- och nätverksmiljöer. Då arbetet innebär hantering av känslig information och säkerhetsskyddsklassade uppgifter ställer vi följande krav: Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift. items.desc: On average it takes 5 minutes to apply for this role. Kick-start your career in the online gaming world and experience the very latest in technology and innovation. Do you see yourself as one of those “out-of-the-box thinkers”, “Technical masterminds”, “Outstanding creatives”, or “Mind-boggling number crunchers”? If so, we want to welcome you to the Betway family and celebrate what makes you unique! Our global customer base is exploding and we need your skills to support us on this exciting journey! Don’t look back and submit your application before the opportunity passes you by.. Data Exploration The Junior Data Scientist is responsible for assisting and participating in exploration of untapped data values in our business ecosystem, regardless of data formats, as well as mining external data, with the aim of utilizing them for the purpose of predictive and prescriptive modelling solutions. Data Validation This role is responsible for ensuring that the data being used is accurate, reliable, and suitable for the model being built. This includes tasks such as data cleaning, data verification, data transformation and validation methods using both statistical and machine learning methods. Model Usage This role assists with marrying business understanding and knowledge with existing, appropriate, predictive and prescriptive model offerings (machine learning and AI) for commercial and/or operational benefits, given a known business challenge. Model Deployment The Junior Data Scientist assists in the integration and implementation of relevant models into the applicable business processes through collaboration with relevant technology and/or operations team(s). Model Evaluation and Monitoring They assist in model validation, evaluation and monitoring in production. Team Development & Stakeholder Engagement The Junior Data Scientist contributes to technical standards, tooling, and best practices across the team. They communicate modelling approaches, trade-offs, and results clearly to non-technical stakeholders, helping with how data science work is understood and adopted across the business. This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of responsibilities. You may be required to complete other reasonable duties in order to achieve business objectives. Should you not hear from us within 2 weeks, please assume your application has not been successful.

A truly interdisciplinary centre, with staff hailing from backgrounds in subjects as diverse as Geography, Transport Studies, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Statistics, Planning, Architecture, the Humanities and the Social Sciences, for more than 20 years we have been combining theory with novel data, sensors, computational models, analysis and cutting edge visualisation to generate new knowledge and insights addressing problems with a spatial dimension and an urban and regional focus. Our work in inherently applied and looks to influence urban planning, policy and design in both the public and private spheres. Further information can be found on our website at https://www.ucl.ac.uk/bartlett/casa/ About the role The Bartlett Centre for Advanced Spatial Analysis (CASA) is recruiting a Research Fellow in Urban AI to contribute to an Innovate UK-funded collaborative project – “Increasing EV charging capacity on the strategic road network”. The project aims to develop an intelligent buffered ultra-rapid EV charging solution for grid-constrained motorway service areas. The role will focus on developing data-driven AI and spatial modelling approaches to understand and predict EV charging demand, particularly to optimise charging and energy management, and to assess the potential transferability of the solution across England’s Strategic Road Network. Working within the UCL research team and in close collaboration with industry partners, the research fellow will integrate large-scale EV charging, energy, transport, grid, and geospatial data to develop and validate models at both the charging-session and site/network scales. The post is available from 1st January 2027 and is funded until 31st December 2027 in the first instance. If not yet awarded, initial appointment will be at Grade 6B (£39,807 - £42,891 per annum, inclusive of London Allowance), with backdating to Grade 7 upon submission of PhD thesis. This appointment is subject to UCL Terms and Conditions of Service for Research and Professional Services Staff. Please visit https://www.ucl.ac.uk/human-resources/conditions-service-research-teaching-and-professional-services staff for more information. Find out about the UCL Ways of Working: www.ucl.ac.uk/ways-of-working. We will consider applications to work on a part-time, flexible and job share basis wherever possible. For any queries about the role please contact Prof Chen Zhong (c.zhong@ucl.ac.uk). A job description and person specification can be accessed at the bottom of this page. To apply for the vacancy please click on the ‘Apply Now’ button below. About you The successful candidate will hold a PhD (or close to completion) in ML/DL, GeoAI, urban informatics, Spatial Data Science or a closely related quantitative discipline. You will work directly with the Associate Director, Applied AI, to assess existing applications, decide what should be retained, refactored or rebuilt, and take ownership of the engineering needed to move them into production. Strong Python skills and experience with FastAPI or comparable Python frameworks. Strong SQL and relational database skills, plus experience designing and integrating APIs. Practical understanding of authentication and authorisation, including OAuth 2.0 or OpenID Connect. Experience with automated testing, Git, CI/CD, cloud deployment and production troubleshooting. Clear communication, pragmatic product and engineering judgement, and the ability to bring structure to unfamiliar or incomplete systems. You should be comfortable making progress with limited documentation, surfacing risks early and working with security, infrastructure and product specialists to resolve them. Preferred Experience: Experience with FastMCP, Azure, Entra ID, API gateways, delegated access or token exchange would be valuable. Other useful experience includes cloud-to-on-premises integration, LLM applications and straightforward JavaScript/TypeScript interfaces. You do not need experience with every technology listed or a legal background. Location and Reporting: This role is based in London, United Kingdom. items.desc: Description du poste Domaine Instrumentation, métrologie et contrôle Contrat Post-doctorat Intitulé de l'offre Instrumentation et reconstruction 3D pour le diagnostic magnétique quantique des batteries Li-ion H/F Sujet de stage Rejoignez le projet OPTIMAQ au CEA-LETI de Grenoble pour repousser les limites du diagnostic batterie. Aujourd'hui, jusqu'à la moitié des cellules Li-ion produites sont mises au rebut lors de l'étape critique de formation, faute de moyens pour voir ce qui se passe à l'intérieur de la cellule en temps réel. Ce post-doctorat de 24 mois vous propose de relever ce défi en associant deux mondes : l'instrumentation de pointe, avec l'intégration d'un magnétomètre quantique à pompage optique hélium 4 capable de détecter les champs magnétiques les plus infimes, et l'intelligence artificielle informée par la physique, à travers le développement d'algorithmes RBF-FD/PINN pour reconstruire en 3D la distribution du courant interne à partir de ces mesures. De la paillasse à l'algorithme, vous piloterez toute la chaîne, en forte collaboration avec le LETI et le LITEN, avec à la clé des publications, des brevets, et une contribution concrète à la souveraineté de la filière batterie européenne. Durée du contrat (en mois) 24 Description de l'offre Le projet OPTIMAQ vise à réduire le taux de rebut de la formation des cellules Li-ion — jusqu'à 50 % aujourd'hui, objectif 5 % — grâce à un système non invasif de mesure magnétique quantique. Ce post-doctorat couvre les volets expérimental (montage du banc de mesure : magnétomètre à pompage optique hélium 4, blindage, translation de la cellule) et logiciel (reconstruction 3D de la densité de courant par RBF-FD/PINN informée par la physique) pour détecter des défauts dès la formation. Hébergé au CEA-LETI à Grenoble (LSSC), en forte transversalité avec L2EP/LAIC (instrumentation, magnétométrie quantique) du LETI et LAPS/LMPS (électrochimie Li-ion, modélisation) du CEA-LITEN, ce poste s'inscrit dans un projet de 24 mois visant un TRL 3, avec perspective de publications et de brevets. Contexte et enjeux La formation — premier cyclage contrôlé d'une cellule (~20 h pour 20 min de fabrication) — conditionne la couche de passivation (SEI), la stabilité et la sécurité de la cellule. Le taux de rebut reste élevé et coûteux, un enjeu accru par les difficultés financières récentes de la filière (faillite de Northvolt). Les pratiques actuelles reposent sur des contrôles invasifs post-production, sans visibilité directe sur la distribution interne du courant. La magnétométrie quantique offre une sensibilité supérieure aux capteurs AMR/fluxgate classiques, mais deux verrous subsistent : intégrer ce capteur dans un banc robuste aux perturbations, et inverser les champs mesurés en une carte 3D de courant à un coût de calcul compatible avec la ligne de production. Objectifs scientifiques Banc expérimental : intégration du magnétomètre He4, du blindage magnétique et du système de translation de la cellule pouch ; caractérisation du bruit et des perturbations. Reconstruction 3D : adaptation des approches RBF-FD/PINN, déjà développées au LSSC pour l'estimation rapide de source, à la géométrie réelle de la cellule et aux lois de conservation. Validation croisée : pré-entraînement sur données FEM puis affinage et détection de défauts sur mesures réelles, vers un suivi quasi temps réel. Méthodologie Le/la post-doctorant(e) interviendra sur l'ensemble de la chaîne : Instrumentation du magnétomètre He4 , intégration dans le blindage et le système de translation (avec L2EP/LAIC). Inversion physique : RBF-FD/PINN combinant écart mesuré/prédit, conservation et régularisation. Entraînement/affinage : pré-entraînement FEM (LMPS), affinage sur mesures réelles de cyclage (L2EP/LAPS). Impact et perspectives Publications (Journal of Power Sources, etc.) et dépôt de brevets sur la reconstruction hybride appliquée au diagnostic batterie. Perspectives : généralisation à d'autres pathologies, classification, fermeture de boucle sur le profil de cyclage — contribuant à la souveraineté industrielle de la filière batterie européenne. Contacts : Sylvain LEIRENS – sylvain.leirens@cea.fr, Romain FRANCHI — romain.franchi@cea.fr Moyens / Méthodes / Logiciels Python / PyTorch Profil du candidat Profil recherché : Doctorat en physique, mathématiques appliquées, traitement du signal ou instrumentation, avec une double sensibilité expérimentale (mise en œuvre de capteurs, mesures) et algorithmique (problèmes inverses, machine learning informé par la physique — PINN, Neural Operators). Une familiarité avec la magnétométrie ou l'électrochimie des batteries est un plus. Compétences clés : Instrumentation et traitement du signal (mise en œuvre de capteurs, réduction de bruit). Python / PyTorch, calcul GPU. Excellente rédaction scientifique et travail en consortium pluridisciplinaire LETI-LITEN. items.desc: L’Université d'Artois est implantée sur différents points du territoire du Nord-Pas de Calais : Arras (siège), Béthune, Douai, Lens et Liévin. Elle comprend huit UFR , deux IUT , une école d'ingénieurs , un service de formation continue (FCU) et quinze centres de recherche . Depuis sa création en 1992 , l’Université d’Artois s’impose comme un acteur de promotion sociale et bénéficie d’un environnement convivial et stimulant propice aux études et à la culture . Placée sous la tutelle du ministère de l’enseignement supérieur et de la recherche, l'Université d'Artois accueille 13 000 étudiants et emploie un peu plus de 1 000 personnes. Elle est dotée d’un budget de 116 M€, dont 89 M€ de masse salariale et 7 M€ d’investissements. L’ensemble des postes à pourvoir publiés par l’Université d’Artois est ouvert aux bénéficiaires de l’obligation d’emploi, en application des dispositions des articles L. 5212-13 et L.5212-2 du Code du Travail. Missions : Dans le cadre du projet de recherche, vous contribuerez à la tâche « Interprétation des mécanismes internes des modèles », qui vise à analyser et comprendre en profondeur le fonctionnement interne des modèles d’IA, en établissant des correspondances explicites entre leurs structures internes (poids, activations, gradients) et des concepts humains interprétables. L’objectif est de dépasser l’interprétabilité purement comportementale pour construire une compréhension mécanistique et causale, essentielle à la transparence et à la fiabilité des systèmes IA. Votre travail s’inscrira dans un plan en trois étapes cohérentes : 1. Cartographier et comprendre les représentations internes des modèles IA, en identifiant les alignements entre modalités et le désentrelacement des concepts latents. 2. Analyser la dynamique d’apprentissage et concevoir des architectures favorisant à la fois performance et interprétabilité. 3. Appliquer la compréhension mécanistique au raisonnement avancé, en rendant le raisonnement implicite lisible et en réduisant les hallucinations Profil de la personne (diplôme, cursus, compétences requises…) : Nous recherchons un(e) chercheur(e) postdoctoral(e) disposant d’une expertise à l’intersection de l’apprentissage automatique, du traitement automatique des langues, de l’interprétabilité des modèles IA et de l’analyse des représentations internes. Le/la candidat(e) contribuera à la tâche « Interprétation des mécanismes internes des modèles » dans le cadre d’un projet de recherche multidisciplinaire visant à développer des méthodes mécanistiques pour expliquer et fiabiliser le fonctionnement des modèles d’IA. Formation et expérience Doctorat en informatique, intelligence artificielle, mathématiques appliquées ou disciplines connexes. Expérience antérieure en recherche avec publications dans des conférences ou revues reconnues en IA, apprentissage automatique ou TAL Compétences et connaissances attendues Connaissances solides en apprentissage automatique, maîtrise des architectures de réseaux neuronaux profonds, en particulier les transformeurs. Connaissance approfondie des approches d’interprétabilité (métriques de similarité de représentations, analyse couche-par-couche, méthodes causales). Pratique des outils et bibliothèques pour l’expérimentation en IA (Python, PyTorch, librairies d’évaluation et de visualisation, etc.). Capacité à concevoir et à analyser des expériences complexes, et à synthétiser des résultats scientifiques. Intérêt marqué pour la transparence, la fiabilité et la compréhension mécanistique des systèmes d’IA.

By combining foundation models, multimodal machine learning, and conversational AI, Neuron aims to build a new generation of clinical intelligence infrastructure that integrates real-world data from smartphones and wearables into meaningful, longitudinal insights. The platform is designed to support pharmaceutical clinical development and, over time, personalized therapeutic delivery. We are seeking a Chief Technology Officer (CTO) to join as a cofounder and lead the development of our AI and technology platform. THE ROLE As CTO and cofounder, you will lead Neuron's technical strategy, AI/ML development, software engineering, and platform architecture. Working closely with the CEO and scientific leadership, you will translate the company's vision into a production-ready platform built around foundation models, multimodal intelligence, and conversational AI. This is a hands-on founding role for a technical leader who combines deep AI/ML expertise with strong software engineering capabilities. You will shape the technical foundations of the company, from model architecture and multimodal data fusion to conversational interfaces, production infrastructure, and clinical-grade systems. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AI/ML and foundation models: Lead the development and integration of AI systems leveraging foundation models, multimodal learning, and modern machine-learning architectures. Conversational AI: Design and build conversational interfaces, including voice-based AI companions, enabling natural, context-aware interactions and personalized engagement. Multimodal intelligence: Develop systems that integrate voice, motor, physiological, behavioral, and cognitive data into meaningful representations of neurological function and longitudinal patient states. ML engineering and deployment: Build end-to-end pipelines for data processing, model evaluation, inference, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Software engineering: Own the end-to-end software architecture, backend services, APIs, mobile integrations, cloud infrastructure, and engineering practices. AI safety and system reliability: Establish robust boundaries between generative AI and safety-critical functions through deterministic controls, auditable workflows, and appropriate safeguards. Clinical intelligence infrastructure: Build the data and analytics infrastructure required to support clinical research, digital biomarker development, and pharmaceutical clinical-development workflows. Data integration: Develop secure, scalable pipelines integrating smartphone and wearable data, including Apple HealthKit, Android Health Connect, and selected third-party devices. Technical leadership: Recruit and lead the initial AI/ML and software engineering team, establish development standards, and manage external technical partners. Technology strategy: Define the technical roadmap, prioritize development against scientific and commercial milestones, and support technical due diligence for investors and partners. QUALIFICATIONS Required Significant experience in AI/ML engineering, applied machine learning, or software engineering, with a track record of building and deploying production-grade systems. Strong software engineering fundamentals across system architecture, APIs, backend development, cloud infrastructure, testing, and deployment. Practical experience with foundation models, including LLM integration, model orchestration, inference, evaluation, and production deployment. Experience developing conversational AI applications, ideally involving voice interfaces, context management, or personalized interactions. Experience building end-to-end machine-learning pipelines and translating research concepts into reliable software products. Familiarity with multimodal data processing, representation learning, or integrating heterogeneous data sources. Ability to combine hands-on technical execution with architectural leadership and team development. A founder's mindset, with the ability to operate in an early-stage environment, make decisions under uncertainty, and build from an initial prototype. Strongly Preferred Experience with multimodal foundation models, cross-modal representation learning, or sensor-based machine learning. Experience with speech technology, audio processing, voice interfaces, or conversational agents. Familiarity with retrieval-augmented generation, fine-tuning, inference optimization, and AI observability. Experience designing agentic or tool-using AI systems with reliable execution boundaries and auditable controls. items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano Institute for Renewable Energy Short description of the position: Eurac Research is looking for a chemist, environmental scientist or engineer with hands-on experience in air pollutant measurements to lead the Volatile Organic Compounds Laboratory (VOC Lab) of the "Human-centric Buildings" (HCB) team, within the Institute for Renewable Energy – Energy and Resources Efficient Building group. The position reports directly to the HCB team leader and has responsibility for the scientific activities, daily operation and development of the lab. ​ ​The VOC Lab is located at NOI Techpark in Bolzano (https://noi.bz.it/en) and operates two airtight emission test chambers (1 m³ and 6 m³) compliant with EN 16516, ISO 16000-6, ISO 16000-9 and EN 717-1, with controlled temperature, humidity and air velocity. The chambers are used to test the emissions of building materials, wood-based products and furnishings, to study the decay of airborne pollutants, and to test and calibrate IAQ sensors. ​ ​You will run the lab's emission, decay and sensor tests, from planning and chamber operation to sampling, coordination of the external analytical laboratory, and interpretation and reporting of results. You will be the main contact for industrial partners using the lab, coordinate the lab technicians, and contribute to the team's research projects on indoor air quality and health in buildings. The work combines research (Horizon Europe, Interreg, ERDF and other projects) with applied testing services for manufacturers, from established industries to developers of innovative materials.​ Tasks: Lab management and testing (about 60% of the working time): planning and running emission, decay and sensor tests according to standards; air sampling for VOCs and aldehydes and real-time measurements; coordination of the external laboratory for chromatographic analyses and quality check of results; QA/QC procedures, maintenance and continuous improvement of the lab; scheduling of lab activities, management of purchasing and safety procedures; coordination of lab technicians. ​Research (about 25%): designing experiments, analysing data, contributing to writing scientific publications and project reports; contributing to the team's research on indoor air quality and health, including field measurement campaigns in occupied buildings. ​Industry and projects (about 15%): acting as main contact for industrial partners using the lab, defining tests and writing test reports; developing the lab's services and collaborations; contributing to research proposals; co-supervising interns; disseminating results to scientific and professional audiences.​ ​ Requirements: Master's degree in Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry or Science, Chemical, Environmental or Materials Engineering, or related fields. ​Hands-on experience with laboratory or field measurements of air pollutants (e.g. active sampling, gas analysers, sensors, controlled test environments), gained in research, industry, or testing and monitoring laboratories. ​Experience in working according to standard procedures and in ensuring data quality. ​Ability to write clear technical reports. ​Very good command of English, written and spoken. ​Willingness to work on site in Bolzano, as the role involves regular hands-on laboratory activity. ​Advantages: knowledge of VOC sampling and analysis methods (e.g. ISO 16000 series, EN 16516, EN 717-1 TD-GC-MS, HPLC for aldehydes); emission testing standards or VOC labelling schemes; QA/QC or ISO/IEC 17025 environments; IAQ sensors and calibration; data analysis with Python; peer-reviewed publications; proposal writing or student supervision; Italian and/or German. We are looking for someone who: can organise their own work and lab schedule, taking ownership of tests from planning to final report; ​enjoys collaborating with colleagues from different backgrounds (engineering, architecture, etc.) and with industrial partners; ​is curious and proactive in proposing improvements to methods and services.​ We offer: The position is initially available with a fixed-term contract with the possibility to be become permanent ​Working conditions which allow professional growth and know how acquisition with carrier opportunity as applied researcher. The chance to work with local and international research centres, universities, and industry partners ​The opportunity to work in a young international team in a fast-growing sector A surrounding offering a high quality of life. Eurac Research has been elected among the best workplaces in Italy. ( https://www.greatplacetowork.it/scheda_azienda/eurac/ ) and offers many opportunities in combining work and family activities. Provide support to the company’s strategic teams on various ad-hoc projects, such as conducting research on educational systems across different countries. items.desc: About myTomorrows myTomorrows is a global health tech company dedicated to breaking down barriers for patients seeking treatment options. We strive to enable earlier and better treatment access by bridging the gap between those searching for possible options, and the companies who develop them. We work closely with patients, healthcare professionals, trial sites, patient advocacy groups, and BioPharma – connecting key stakeholders in the drug development ecosystem. We’ve developed a cutting-edge AI-powered technology platform that simplifies and streamlines access to drugs in development. To support our users and clients, we have a range of industry-expert specialized teams ready to help. Our services include clinical trial patient recruitment, Expanded Access Program management and Real-World Data collection. With a global footprint spanning 134 countries, to date we’ve supported over 17,000 patients, 3,000 physicians and 350 sites, earning the trust of 60+ BioPharma companies. In October 2025, we closed a €25M investment with Avego Healthcare Capital to fuel our global ambitions and scale the business. Join us in shaping the future of treatment access - making tomorrow’s therapies accessible for people who need them today. The opportunity: Real-World Data Associate As a Real-World Data Associate at myTomorrows, you will support the design and execution of real-world data collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Working closely with the Real-World Data team, you will help keep communication with clients, physicians and site staff running smoothly, carry out data validation and quality-control tasks, and contribute to the documentation that supports consistent, high-quality RWD delivery. This is a great opportunity to build hands-on experience in real-world data within a purpose-driven, fast-growing company. Given that most of our team is located in the Netherlands, we only consider candidates for this position who live within commuting distance to our office in Amsterdam. What you’ll do in this role: Support the design and day-to-day execution of RWD collection within Expanded Access Programs and other non-interventional studies. Assist in maintaining communication with clients, physicians and site staff about data collection and data management. Help monitor RWD collection and completion, flagging data discrepancies or missing data for follow-up. Perform basic data validation, cleaning and quality-control tasks in electronic data capture systems. Follow relevant regulatory requirements, internal procedures and ICH-GCP principles in all RWD study activities. Support the preparation and maintenance of SOPs, templates and study documentation for RWD projects. Share observations and ideas that could improve data collection, workflows and supporting tools. Work under the guidance of more senior team members, collaborating closely with colleagues across the team and other relevant functions. What you bring to the table: A bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, biomedical sciences or another relevant scientific field. 0–2 years of experience in Data Management or Clinical Research (e.g. an internship, traineeship or first role). Strong organizational and multitasking skills, with the ability to manage priorities and follow through on commitments. Familiarity with, or a strong interest in learning, electronic data capture systems and structured clinical or real-world data. A basic understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines, or the motivation to develop it quickly. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Close attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented mindset. Eagerness to learn and the ability to contribute positively to a collaborative team environment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications. What Success looks like in the first 6 months: Data completion and quality metrics for your assigned programs are consistently on target. You’re contributing ideas and improvements to RWD processes and documentation, helping to raise the bar for data excellence at myTomorrows. You’re recognized as a reliable partner by both internal teams and external collaborators, someone who ensures the integrity of real-world data to advance patient access What we offer: Serve a purposeful mission: helping patients gain access to potentially lifesaving treatments. International work environment, scale-up energy and a flat organization. Competitive salary, annual performance bonus and equity. Great career-development opportunities in a growing company. Learning and development budget, alongside internal knowledge-sharing sessions. Attractive pension plan, with the full premium covered by us. Hybrid work model (2 days in office). Policies to support working parents. Healthy lunch at the office. Unlimited access to professional guidance by certified psychologists via OpenUp. An additional holiday for Liberation Day on 5 May. items.desc: Vill du utveckla system där mjukvara möter den fysiska världen – och där din kod faktiskt styr, mäter och övervakar verkliga system? Vi söker dig som gillar kombinationen av systemutveckling, problemlösning och teknik på riktigt . Hos oss får du arbeta med lösningar inom bland annat energi, IoT, säkerhet och industriella system – från kod och databaser till nätverk, kommunikationsprotokoll och fysisk utrustning. Det här är inte en roll där du enbart sitter med en avgränsad del av en applikation. Du får möjlighet att förstå hela kedjan , lösa komplexa tekniska problem och samtidigt vara med och påverka hur våra framtida system byggs. Om rollen Som systemutvecklare får du en bred teknisk roll där utveckling kombineras med systemintegration, felsökning, teknisk förvaltning och kontakt med kunder. Du kommer initialt att ha en viktig roll i förvaltningen och vidareutvecklingen av SystemOne , vår etablerade lösning för övervakning och styrning. Här får du arbeta nära både tekniken och kunderna för att utveckla funktioner, lösa problem och säkerställa att systemen fungerar i vardagen. Parallellt får du bidra till nyutveckling inom energi, IoT, integration och övervakning. I detta arbete är modern .NET-utveckling, API:er, MQTT, Edge-system och containerbaserade miljöer centrala delar. Hos oss får du kombinera ansvar för etablerade system med möjligheten att utveckla nya tekniska lösningar som skapar konkret nytta för våra kunder. Du blir en del av ett mindre team där du får ta ansvar, påverka tekniska vägval och vara med från idé till fungerande lösning. Vad kommer du att göra? Ingen dag behöver se exakt likadan ut. Ena dagen utvecklar du funktionalitet i C# och arbetar med SQL. Nästa dag felsöker du tillsammans med en kund varför en mätare har slutat leverera data. Då kanske svaret inte finns i applikationskoden. Problemet kan lika gärna finnas i databasen, nätverket, en gateway, ett kommunikationsprotokoll eller i konfigurationen av den anslutna utrustningen. Du kommer bland annat att: utveckla och vidareutveckla våra system och integrationer arbeta med C#, .NET och SQL Server förvalta och vidareutveckla kundinstallationer felsöka applikationer, databaser, nätverk och kommunikation integrera våra system med extern utrustning och andra system arbeta med industriella protokoll som OPC, Modbus och MQTT ge teknisk support till kunder och kollegor delta vid installationer, uppgraderingar och driftsättning dokumentera tekniska lösningar och förändringar. På sikt får du även möjlighet att arbeta med tekniker som ASP.NET Core, REST API, MQTT, Docker, Edge computing, SQL Server och React . Vem söker vi? Vi söker framför allt en nyfiken och lösningsorienterad tekniker som vill förstå hur saker faktiskt fungerar. Din bakgrund kan exempelvis vara inom systemutveckling, systemintegration, SCADA, automation, IoT, industriell IT eller som applikationsingenjör. Det viktigaste för oss är inte exakt vilken titel du har haft – utan vad du kan och hur du angriper tekniska problem. Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av: C# och .NET SQL och relationsdatabaser Windows-miljöer TCP/IP och nätverk Git eller motsvarande versionshantering teknisk felsökning i system med flera olika komponenter. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt och känna dig bekväm med att ta ansvar för ett problem hela vägen från första felsökningen till en fungerande lösning. Eftersom rollen innebär direkt kontakt med kunder behöver du också kunna diskutera tekniska frågeställningar på ett begripligt och lösningsorienterat sätt. Extra intressant om du kan något av detta Har du erfarenhet från SCADA/HMI, industriell automation, OPC, Modbus, MQTT, PLC-system, energimätning, fastighetsautomation, IoT, Edge-system eller industriella gateways är det meriterande. Detsamma gäller erfarenhet av exempelvis ASP.NET Core, REST API, Docker, React, Linux eller CI/CD . Har du arbetat med WideQuick är det positivt, men det är inget krav. Erfarenhet från andra SCADA- och automationsplattformar som exempelvis Ignition, WinCC, zenon, AVEVA/Wonderware eller iFIX är också relevant. Du behöver alltså inte kunna alla våra tekniker från dag ett. För oss är din tekniska förståelse, problemlösningsförmåga och vilja att lära viktigare än att varje produktnamn finns på ditt CV. Det här får du hos Elajo Vi vill att du ska trivas, utvecklas och ha möjlighet att prestera långsiktigt. Hos oss får du: Ett varierande och utvecklande uppdrag med goda möjligheter att växa. En trivsam och inkluderande arbetsmiljö där laganda och samarbete står i fokus. Kollektivavtal, personalrabatter och friskvårdsbidrag. En trygg och stabil arbetsgivare som värnar om balans mellan arbetsliv och privatliv. Tillgång till samtalsstöd inom bland annat hälsa, kris, stress, ekonomi och juridik. Bli en del av Elajo Elajos värdegrund bygger på Engagemang, Utveckling, Öppenhet och Förtroende . Cardiac Physiology Healthcare Scientist Assistant (Band 3) An exciting opportunity is available to join the Cardiac Physiology team at Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. We are a
items.desc: This is exciting opportunity to work as a Healthcare Scientist Assistant in the Cardiac Physiology Department in the OUH Trust. The role involves supporting Cardiac Physiologists and other medical specialities to perform electrocardiograms (ECGs), Blood pressures and a multitude of other clinical diagnostic testing in the Cardiology directorate. Cardiac Physiology Healthcare Scientist Assistant (Band 3) An exciting opportunity is available to join the Cardiac Physiology team at Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. We are a friendly, dynamic and welcoming multi-disciplinary team working routinely across the John Radcliffe Hospital in Oxford, the Horton Hospital in Banbury and various community settings around the county. The role involves hands-on clinical duties such as performing electrocardiograms (ECG’s), fitting event monitors and assisting with exercise testing. Other duties include measurement of height and weight, cannulation and urine analysis. Alongside these clinical duties this role also requires basic administration skills, good time management and organisational skills and an outstanding approach to customer care. Due to the nature of this patient facing role, candidates should have a calm and caring attitude and excellent interpersonal skills. As the role involves working across the county the ability to adapt to these varied locations, and show flexibility when necessary, is a must. No previous clinical experience is necessary as full training will be given and successful applicants will be expected to work towards SCST Certificate of Electrocardiography examination and the Trust’s Care Certificate. Interested candidates are strongly recommended to visit the department for a greater understanding of the post. Oxford University Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust is one of the largest NHS teaching trusts in the country. It provides a wide range of general and specialist clinical services and is a base for medical education, training and research. The Trust comprises four hospitals - the John Radcliffe Hospital, Churchill Hospital and Nuffield Orthopaedic Centre in Headington and the Horton General Hospital in Banbury. For more information on OUH please view OUH At a Glance by OUHospitals Our values, standards and behaviours define the quality of clinical care we offer and the professional relationships we make with our patients, colleagues and the wider community. We call this Delivering Compassionate Excellence and its focus is on our values of compassion, respect, learning, delivery, improvement and excellence. These values put patients at the heart of what we do and underpin the quality healthcare we would like for ourselves or a member of our family. Watch how we set out to deliver compassionate excellence via the OUH YouTube channel . In this role you will: Without immediate supervision, use appropriate electro-medical equipment (e.g. electrocardiograph, sphygmomanometer, spirometer, weighing scales, and ambulatory recording systems) in wards or departments throughout the organisation to obtain physiological data from patients (adults, children and neonates). To perform, accurately record and report patient observations -temp, pulse, BP, following completion of relevant competencies/training. To be able to identify when to carry out and report observations, should a patients condition alter/deteriorate To perform additional tasks as directed i.e. cannulation and phlebotomy following completion of relevant competencies/training. To demonstrate good communication skills when dealing with patients, relatives and members of the multidisciplinary team utilising sensitivity, empathy and ability to manage conflict. To assist with patient moving and handling using correct methods and equipment as required (as per manual handling policy) and completion of appropriate paperwork. To demonstrate skills at time management and prioritisation of workload with support from senior cardiac physiology support worker/HSA or service lead To undertake mandatory, statutory and local training as required by the Trust and directorate. To be flexible/willing to assist all areas within cardiac physiology e.g. at times of sickness or increased workload.

items.desc: Company Neuphonic is building the future of on-device voice AI. We develop ultra-low-latency voice models that enable super-realistic, human-like speech directly on devices. Our focus is on building efficient generative audio models and infrastructure that can run on CPU-constrained hardware, enabling real-time voice interaction without relying on large cloud infrastructure. By dramatically reducing latency and compute requirements, we're making natural conversational AI possible on phones, embedded devices, browsers, and edge systems. This requires building high-performance systems that bridge machine learning, real-time audio processing, and distributed infrastructure. Neuphonic was founded in April 2024 and has raised significant funding from leading European investors. We work with global enterprises across hardware and consumer AI that are building the next generation of voice-enabled products. Our open source models have been downloaded over 4 million times and earned over 6,500 GitHub stars since launch. Our vision is a world where voice becomes the most natural interface for AI, enabling seamless, intuitive interactions that are accessible to everyone. Role We're looking for a Founding GTM Associate to build the top of our enterprise pipeline, working side by side with our founders and sales team. Our go-to-market runs from open source to enterprise. Developers find and build on our open models, and the companies they work for need production-grade, supported versions for products where latency, privacy and offline operation matter. Your job is to make that path faster and more predictable. This is a hands-on, commercial role with one clear goal: book as many qualified meetings as possible for our sales team. You'll report to the CEO and work directly with the founders, research team and sales team. We are not looking for a marketer measured on impressions. We're looking for someone commercially sharp, comfortable reaching out to people, and technical enough to hold their own with engineers. items.desc: This is an exciting opportunity for an ambitious graduate with the ability and confidence to work on a research project for developing eXplainable AI-powered Decision Models (XAI-DMs) for Insurance Under-writing, which is funded by ESRC IAA to The University of Manchester (UoM) together with Protector In-surance as industrial partner. The University of Manchester is looking to recruit a decision scientist, artificial intelligence (AI) modeller, system scientist to undertake this project, which is based on the research conducted by UoM experts over many years in areas of decision science, systems science, AI and Data Science to develop the Evidential Reasoning (ER) theory, including the Maximum Likelihood Evidential Reasoning (MAKER) framework for probabilistic reasoning with imperfect data, the ER rule for combination of uncertain evidence acquired from imperfect data and human judgment, the ER approach for multiple criteria decision making under uncertainty, and the Belief Rule Base (BRB) methodology for probabilistic system modelling and intrinsi-cally explainable machine learning funded by many EPSRC grants. The RA position will provide the successful candidate with a unique opportunity to take the lead on a strategic project, aimed at translating the ER theory and industrial domain knowledge to develop new XAI-DMs for Insurance Underwriting and to integrate them into existing working practices for Protector Insur-ance, which will be supported by the specialists of the company. The RA will therefore be faced with the challenge of understanding both the theory and the practical applications of decision modelling, data an-alytics, probabilistic inference, XAI decision modelling and evidence-based decision making to support the development of the XAI-DMs; and translating the technical know-how into a form that can be easily un-derstood and used by users within Protector Insurance. Candidates will require a minimum 2:1 with doctoral research experience in Systems Science, Decision Science, Operational Research, Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, or Applied Statistics with Decision, or a PhD degree in the-afore mentioned or related subject areas, with evidence of a strong grounding in probabilistic data analysis and reasoning, XAI decision modelling, decision analysis, multiple criteria assessment, and software development in Python or equivalent. This post is funded through an ESRC IAA award together with Protector Insurance, a UK Government scheme intended to promote sustained and mutually beneficial relationships between universities and industry. Based at Alliance Manchester Business School and Protector Insurance, the successful candidate will work directly with the supervisors from the University and with other researchers and practitioners from Pro-tector Insurance. (Grades 6-9) Our benefits include: Generous employer contribution pension 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure Ride to work and EV car scheme available For more information, please see University of Manchester Benefits. You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working here. We are an open place of enquiry and challenge. We embrace and celebrate difference, diversity and debate, and we pride ourselves on being a place of education, learning and community where we are able, within the law, to question and test received wisdom, express new ideas and explore controversial or unpopular topics and opinions. Find out more from our Freedom of Speech Policy. items.desc: About Fundamental Fundamental is an AI research lab pioneering the future of enterprise decision-making. Our flagship model, NEXUS is the world's most powerful Large Tabular Model (LTM) - purpose-built for the structured records that contain trillions of dollars in business value. With $275m in funding from leading investors and trusted by Fortune 100 companies, Fundamental is giving businesses the Power to Predict. At Fundamental, you'll work on unprecedented technical challenges in foundation model development and build technology that transforms how the world's largest companies make decisions. This is your opportunity to be part of a category-defining company from the ground-up. Join the team defining the future of enterprise AI. About The Role You will join the Research team as our first software engineer, owning the core codebase behind our model development. The codebase needs to be fast to iterate on, robust through experiments and large training runs, and ready to carry models all the way to production. Working alongside research scientists, you'll find what slows them down and build the infrastructure that fixes it, laying the technical foundations that let Fundamental operate at the frontier of large-scale tabular modeling. Key Responsibilities Amplify and Accelerate: You will be proactive in providing solutions which enable our researchers to be more efficient and effective, including agentic workflows. Steward: You will steward the long-term development and maintenance of our codebase. Ensuring it is production-ready, while preserving the flexibility needed for empirically driven research. You will set the bar for code quality by leading pull request reviews and acting as the gatekeeper for external contributions. Champion Best Practices: Establish and implement software engineering best practices in the machine learning domain, serving as a mentor and guide to research scientists on the team. Elevate Code Maturity & Quality: Lead the transition of our core research codebase from an early-stage experimental state to a highly scalable, maintainable and robust engineering standard. You will proactively manage technical debt, ensure experiment reproducibility, and drive overall code quality. Maintain Documentation: Develop and maintain clear, comprehensive documentation for our research infrastructure and systems. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Ensure precise interactions of the research codebase with other code at Fundamental to translate research breakthroughs into tangible, real-world impact. Guard the research–engineering contract: Build and own the testing layer that runs alongside model development: CI, contract tests, and verification that catch when research changes break the interfaces engineering depends on. Bugs should surface in PRs, not in production. Must have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with meaningful time on ML or data-intensive backends, training pipelines, distributed inference, feature infrastructure, or similar. Strong software architecture skills including modular design, clean interfaces, and design patterns for maintainable research codebases. Excellent communication skills with a proven ability to discuss complex technical ideas clearly and collaborate effectively across interdisciplinary teams. Expert-level proficiency in Python and deep familiarity with PyTorch. Hands-on experience with the modern ML research tech stack and cloud infrastructure (e.g., cloud providers (AWS, GCP), Weights & Biases, Datadog, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions). Demonstrated track record of developing and utilizing solutions for robustness and quality assurance within software and/or ML systems. Mission-driven mindset, motivated by the prospect of real-world impact and a relentless focus on excellence in software development. Nice to have Familiarity with MLOps best practices, CI/CD for machine learning, and infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform). Experience working in an early-stage, fast-paced startup environment. A background or strong interest in tabular data, data engineering, or enterprise data architecture. Experience with other programming languages (Rust, C++, Go) Contributions to open-source machine learning libraries, frameworks, or tools. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a STEM field Benefits Competitive compensation with salary and equity Comprehensive health coverage for you and your dependents Paid parental leave for all new parents, inclusive of adoptive and surrogate journeys Relocation support for employees moving to join the team in one of our office locations A mission-driven, low-ego culture that values diversity of thought, ownership, and bias toward action

items.title: Research Fellows in Quantum Many-Body Physics (3 separate projects)
items.card: Do you have a background in quantum many-body physics, with expertise in topological phases of matter, lattice gauge theories, or quantum criticality? Are you interested in computational approaches to quantum many-body systems, such as tensor networks and neural quantum states? Would you like to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive universities? We are advertising three separate projects
items.desc: Do you have a background in quantum many-body physics, with expertise in topological phases of matter, lattice gauge theories, or quantum criticality? Are you interested in computational approaches to quantum many-body systems, such as tensor networks and neural quantum states? Would you like to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive universities? We are advertising three separate projects in the field of quantum many-body physics: Topological quantum matter. The focus areas of this project include topological and geometric properties of fractional quantum Hall states and fractional Chern insulators, including their classical and quantum simulations (in particular, exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods, as well as quantum simulations). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.01955 https://arxiv.org/abs/2107.10267 https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.10395 https://arxiv.org/abs/2301.04169 https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.17352 Far-from-equilibrium physics of lattice gauge theories. The focus areas of the project include many-body dynamics, ergodicity breaking, false-vacuum decay, etc. The project will also involve developing classical and quantum simulations of lattice gauge theories (in particular, via exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods, as well as quantum simulations). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.26156 https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.14223 https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.25889 https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.23794 https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14718 Quantum criticality on the "fuzzy sphere". The focus areas of the project include conformal field theories in 2+1 dimension and their numerical simulations using the noncommutative geometry of the fuzzy sphere (in particular, via exact diagonalisation, matrix product state and neural quantum state methods). Some of our recent papers relevant to the position include: https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.15299 https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.22539 https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.08036 https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.25054 https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.07655 To apply For further information on these vacancies and how to apply, please visit the following websites for each position, where you can also access a full candidate brief. https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1142 Research Fellow in Topological quantum matter https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1143 Research Fellow in Quantum Simulations of Gauge Theories https://jobs.leeds.ac.uk/EPSPA1140 Research Fellow in Quantum Criticality and Conformal Field Theory

items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a Forward Deployed AI Engineer We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to join NestAI. In this role, you will work embedded directly in our customers' environments, sitting at the intersection of advanced machine learning and real-world execution. You will shorten the path from prototype to fielded capability: validating our technology against operational reality, adapting it on the fly to the constraints and data of each deployment, and feeding what you learn back into the core product. This is as much a client-facing role as it is a technical one. You will navigate shifting environments, build trust with operators and customer engineering teams, and take ownership of problems that do not come with a clean spec. You will need to be comfortable being the technical voice in the room with a customer, translating between what they need and what is actually possible, while still being hands-on enough to build, debug, and ship the solution yourself. On the technical side, we are looking for strong AI/ML engineers with real breadth in machine learning, deep learning, decision-making, and increasingly LLM-driven or agentic workflows, who can adapt to whatever a deployment demands. Solid grounding in signal processing, whether from classical methods or modern learned/deep approaches, is particularly valuable given the sensor-heavy, real-time nature of our operating environments, but we do not expect mastery of both AI and signal processing in one person. Squads are built so that complementary backgrounds cover the full stack. What you will work on Working directly with customer teams to understand operational requirements, constraints, and failure modes, and translating those into concrete technical problems. Designing and implementing algorithms for sequential decision-making, autonomous behavior, or specialized application workflows - drawing on whichever combination of ML, LLMs, control, or signal processing the deployment calls for, often alongside teammates with complementary backgrounds. Adapting and fine-tuning models to perform reliably against real operational data, which is often noisier and more constrained than anything seen in the lab. Rapidly building and iterating on prototypes in the field or in customer development environments, then hardening the ones that prove out for production. Collaborating with our internal platform, embedded, and perception teams to bring field learnings back into NestOS(core product) and ensure deployed solutions are supportable long-term. Building lightweight simulations, test harnesses, or data pipelines on-site to validate algorithms before they scale. Adapting state-of-the-art research in deep learning, signal processing, reinforcement learning, or NLP/LLMs into working, production-ready code under real deployment pressure. What We're looking for If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Here is what we are looking for: Working knowledge of signal processing: either a strong background in classical Digital Signal Processing (DSP) (filtering, spectral analysis, estimation) or in modern learned/deep approaches to signal data, with genuine curiosity about the other side. Strong working knowledge of machine learning theory and common deep learning architectures, with the ability to pick up new subfields (decision-making, reinforcement learning, LLMs, or signal processing) as the deployment requires. Proficiency in Python and hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Ollama, LangeChain and other frameworks.. Good communication skills and comfort engaging with customer or non-ML stakeholders; a consultative mindset is a plus but can be developed on the job …

items.desc: Summary Groupe de luxe mondial né d’une histoire familiale et entrepreneuriale, Kering réunit un ensemble de Maisons reconnues pour leur créativité en matière de couture et de prêt-à porter, de maroquinerie, de joaillerie, de lunetterie et de beauté : Gucci, Saint Laurent, Bottega Veneta, Balenciaga, McQueen, Brioni, Boucheron, Pomellato, Dodo, Qeelin, Ginori 1735, ainsi que Kering Eyewear et Kering Beauté. Inspirées par leur histoire et par leur patrimoine, les Maisons du Groupe conçoivent et façonnent des produits et des expériences d'exception qui reflètent l’engagement de Kering pour l’excellence, le développement durable et la culture. Cette vision s’incarne dans la signature du Groupe : Creativity is our Legacy. Comptant 47 000 collaborateurs, Kering a réalisé un chiffre d’affaires de 17,2 milliards d’euros en 2024. Job Description L’équipe Data & IA apporte au Groupe les expertises nécessaires pour tirer toute la valeur des données. Elle délivre des produits et services Data & IA, du conseil interne ainsi que des outils destinés aux collaborateurs du Groupe et des Maisons. Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche d’un(e) Junior AI Scientist pour intégrer l’équipe. Votre opportunité Vous rejoindrez un’équipe basée à Paris et composée d’AI scientists et d’ingénieurs qui développent en Python principalement dans un environnement GCP et AWS. Les projets couvrent des enjeux clés pour l’industrie du luxe, allant du développement à la mise en production, en s’appuyant sur les données stratégiques disponibles à l’échelle du groupe. En tant que Junior AI Scientist, vous intégrerez une squad thématique (Operations, Customer ou Merchandising) et vous contribuerez au développement d’applications IA et GenAI à fort impact business. Accompagné(e) par des profils plus expérimentés, vous monterez progressivement en autonomie sur des sujets concrets. Vous ferez partie d’une équipe dynamique et collaborative, où le partage des connaissances est au cœur de la culture. Comment vous allez contribuer Contribuer à des projets d’IA et de GenAI au sein d’une squad thématique (Operations / Customer / Merchandising), en réponse à des problématiques métier concrètes. Aider à cadrer les problématiques métiers en approches data science : formulation d’hypothèses, choix des méthodes avec l’appui de profils seniors, définition des métriques et interprétation des résultats. Concevoir, entraîner, évaluer et monitorer des modèles ML et GenAI adaptés aux besoins de votre squad : prévision, recommandation, clustering, agents ou approches basées sur des LLMs. Explorer, qualifier et préparer les données nécessaires à vos analyses et à vos modèles. Écrire un code clair, structuré et maintenable en Python et SQL, en appliquant les bonnes pratiques de l’équipe. Collaborer avec les équipes plateforme Data & Agentic pour le déploiement et le monitoring de vos solutions. Participer à la veille technologique, expérimenter de nouvelles approches et partager vos apprentissages avec l’équipe. Comment définir le succès à 12 mois Vous menez en autonomie de premières analyses et modélisations de bout en bout sur des sujets bien cadrés, avec le bon niveau d’accompagnement. Vos modèles et vos analyses produisent des résultats utiles, que les parties prenantes métiers comprennent et utilisent dans leurs décisions. Les métiers de votre squad vous identifient comme un interlocuteur fiable, capable de traduire un besoin en approche data et d’en restituer les résultats simplement. Vous maîtrisez les outils clés du poste (Python, SQL, écosystème GCP et/ou AWS) et intégrez le feedback pour progresser vite. Qui êtes-vous Nous recherchons un(e) candidat(e) ayant de 0 à 2 ans d’expérience en data science, idéalement issu(e) d’une formation solide en data science, mathématiques appliquées, informatique ou dans un domaine similaire. Vous possédez des connaissances ou une première expérience dans plusieurs des domaines suivants : Compréhension des algorithmes de machine learning (boosting, clustering, prévision de séries temporelles) et de leur mise en œuvre sur des cas d’usage concrets. Familiarité avec les outils d’IA générative et leurs applications dans un contexte business. Exploration, qualification et préparation des données. Développement d’un code clair, structuré et maintenable, en Python et SQL. Première exposition aux plateformes cloud (idéalement GCP) et aux pratiques MLOps (Docker, CI/CD) : un plus. Sens de l’utilisateur et capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers. Curiosité, esprit d’initiative, envie d’apprendre et goût du travail en équipe. L’anglais courant est indispensable. Le français est un plus ; si votre français n’est pas encore totalement opérationnel, nous vous accompagnerons pour atteindre un niveau opérationnel sous 6 à 12 mois. L’italien est un plus. Si ce poste vous enthousiasme mais que votre expérience ne correspond pas parfaitement à tous les critères, nous vous encourageons à postuler. Nous valorisons le potentiel, l’agilité …

Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.
