This is your chance to apply your skills to solve complex challenges, leverage diverse data sources, and deliver insights that shape policy, enhance statistics, and drive innovation. The Office for National Statistics (ONS) is the UK’s largest producer of official statistics, covering a range of key economic, social and demographic topics. These include measuring changes in the value of the UK economy, estimating the size, geographic distribution and characteristics of the population, and providing indicators of price inflation, employment, earnings, crime and migration. Job Description Data science is a broad and fast-moving field spanning maths, statistics, software engineering and communications. Data scientists will often work as part of a multidisciplinary team, using data and analytics to inform and achieve organisational goals. In These Roles, You Will Lead Teams That Will: Be inquisitive Explore and visualise data Make recommendations to address complex problems and to inform strategic and operational decision making Use data ethically and appropriately Be innovative and adaptable Explore existing and new data using a range of statistical tools and techniques, such as machine learning, AI, and predictive analytics Find patterns in data and transform them into organisational insight Deliver analysis that is fit for purpose and appropriately assured An associate data scientist is inquisitive, curious about data and keen to learn and develop. Responsibilities Understand the basics of software development and analytical methods, and be able to develop and assure basic models Understand and be able to implement a range of data science techniques, including machine learning Collaborate with others to develop fit for purpose data science solutions and outputs supporting the organisation Prepare and manipulate data and perform analytics, all with appropriate quality assurance. Present and communicate effectively Be aware of project delivery methods Be able to create, interpret, and assure statistical outputs effectively. Be aware of ethical consideration Have knowledge of the technologies used Person specification Essential Criteria: Programming & Build (data science) - Write and test scripts and create basic models in one or more languages, collaborate on shared codebases, using a variety of methodologies. (this skill will be our Lead Essential Skills Criterion). Applied maths, statistics, and scientific practices - Apply analytical methods including exploratory data analysis and statistical testing to a specific data set, to reach accurate and reliable conclusions. Understand and use different performance and accuracy metrics for model validation in data science projects, hypothesis testing and information retrieval. Compare selected applied mathematics and statistical methods and identify their differences access and use the statistical and scientific tools available within the organisation. Data Engineering - Identify the appropriate engineering support to design and provide products for the organisation. Recognise the processes and tools for cleansing and preparing data, and put reusable processes and checks in place. Understanding Product Delivery - Show an awareness of the differences between delivery methods, such as Agile and waterfall, and can propose the most appropriate method to deliver each product, manage your contribution to tasks to fit in with the work of your wider team. Please see role profile attached. items.desc: Description : LE DÉPARTEMENT TERRITORIAL DE LA TRANSFORMATION NUMÉRIQUE ET DE L'INGÉNIERIE BIOMÉDICALE DU CHRU DE NANCY recrute un ingénieur projet Intelligence Artificielle. LE DTNIB : Le Département Territorial de la Transformation Numérique et de l'Ingénierie Biomédicale (DTNIB) du CHRU de Nancy regroupe trois secteurs clés qui collaborent étroitement pour mener à bien les projets de l'hôpital et offrir des services de soutien aux métiers des établissements de santé, assurant ainsi une prise en charge optimale des patients. SYSTÈME NUMÉRIQUE : Ce secteur est chargé de la gestion et de l'optimisation des infrastructures numériques de l'hôpital. Il garantit la sécurité des données, la maintenance des systèmes informatiques, l'accès aux applications métier et le développement de nouvelles solutions technologiques pour améliorer les services de santé. BIOMÉDICAL : Le secteur biomédical se concentre sur l'intégration, la maintenance, la gestion et l'innovation des équipements médicaux. Il veille à ce que les dispositifs médicaux soient toujours à la pointe de la technologie et fonctionnent de manière optimale pour garantir des soins de qualité aux patients. COORDINATION DE L'ACCOMPAGNEMENT MÉDICO-ADMINISTRATIF DU PATIENT : Ce secteur joue un rôle crucial dans l'accompagnement des patients tout au long de leur parcours de soins. Il coordonne les aspects administratifs et médicaux pour assurer une prise en charge fluide et efficace, en facilitant la communication entre les différents services de l'hôpital. En travaillant ensemble, ces trois secteurs permettent au DTNIB de réaliser des projets innovants et de garantir une prise en charge optimale des patients au sein du CHRU de Nancy. LE POSTE SERVICE : Equipe Innovations Numériques au sein de la DTNIB HORAIRES : 39h minimum par semaine CONTEXTE Le CHRU de Nancy se dote en 2026 d'une stratégie intelligence artificielle - Programme Puls'IA - pour donner les lignes directrices du déploiement de l'intelligence artificielle afin de répondre à trois principaux enjeux : Amélioration du parcours de soin par l'innovation et la recherche Optimisation du pilotage opérationnel avec une responsabilité sociale et environnementale Renforcement de la qualité de vie au travail en déchargeant des tâches administrative Cette stratégie s'attache à tirer pleinement partie de cette technologie au service des patients et et des agents tout en maitrisant ses risques. Afin de concevoir, déployer et maintenir des solutions IA, le DTNIB (Département Territorial du Numérique et de l'Ingénierie Biomédicale) accueille la cellule innovations numériques. La candidat.e retenu.e évoluera dans cette équipe en lien avec les autres ingénieurs IA du programme ENACT. fonctionnels à la lumière d'études médico-économiques et s'assurer de la pérennité des déploiements Fiabiliser et professionnaliser les développements internes en participant aux choix des stacks items.desc: Är du vår nästa Data Scientist? Vi utvecklar just nu hur vi arbetar med data och analys på ATG. Med nya verktyg och en modern dataplattform kommer vi kunna både fördjupa den analys vi redan gör och testa nya angreppssätt – från explorativ analys och prediktiva modeller till AI-baserade analysverktyg. Som Data Scientist hos oss arbetar du nära verksamheten med kund- och affärsfrågor. Det kan handla om att förstå kundbeteenden, mäta effekten av förändringar, utveckla modeller som skapar konkret nytta eller hitta helt nya sätt att använda vår data. I rollen kommer du bland annat: Driva analyser hela vägen – från att förstå och konkretisera ett affärsproblem, välja lämplig metod och bearbeta data till att presentera insikter som verksamheten kan förstå och agera på Analysera kundbeteenden och mäta effekten av olika förändringar och initiativ, exempelvis genom experiment och kontrollgruppsanalys Utveckla modeller och se till att de faktiskt går att använda och följa upp Arbeta mycket i SQL och Python/R Samarbeta med olika delar av verksamheten – från affären och andra analytiker till andra kompetenser inom data Vara med och utforska hur vi kan använda AI på ett vettigt sätt – både i verksamheten och i vårt eget analysarbete Är det här du? För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har ett starkt affärsintresse och är bekväm med statistik, machine learning och kvantitativ problemlösning. Du kan självständigt arbeta från rådata till slutsats eller produktionssatt lösning. SQL och Python/R är naturliga delar av ditt dagliga arbete, och erfarenhet av moderna molnbaserade dataplattformar, exempelvis Snowflake, är meriterande. Du har sannolikt en akademisk bakgrund inom ett kvantitativt område, till exempel teknik, statistik, matematik, datavetenskap eller nationalekonomi. Som person tror vi att du är nyfiken, strukturerad och trivs med att jobba självständigt. Du behöver inte ha jobbat med spel tidigare, men vi tror att du har ett genuint intresse för spel och är nyfiken på att förstå våra kunder och hur våra produkter fungerar. ”Som ledare vill jag skapa en välkomnande och tillåtande miljö, där vi har stort förtroende för varandras kompetens, tar eget ansvar och har nära till skratt.” Jag har jobbat på ATG i snart elva år och det som fortfarande gör jobbet roligt är kombinationen av en spännande affär, mycket data och frågor där analys faktiskt kan göra skillnad. I teamet vill jag att vi ska vara nyfikna, testa nya angreppssätt och ha egna idéer om hur vi kan använda vår data bättre för att driva affären framåt. För mig är det viktigt med stort eget ansvar och frihet i hur man löser sina uppgifter - Filip Dyrssen, Head of Customer Analytics We are the game I mer än 50 år har vi på ATG levererat spänning och underhållning till svenska folket. Vi drivs av att trygga den svenska hästnäringen och att fortsatt vara ett ansvarsfullt spelbolag i framkant. Vår vision är att leverera världens bästa spelupplevelse. Vi gillar att samarbeta och uppmuntrar varandra att tänka och testa nytt. Självledarskap och kompetensutveckling är viktiga delar för oss. Vi bryr oss om varandra och våra kunder och vi vill så klart också att alla tävlingshästar ska må bra. Hela vårt överskott går till hästnäringen – något som både känns och gör gott. Join the game! Varmt välkommen med din ansökan via vår rekryteringsportal antingen med ditt cv eller din LinkedIn-profil – det som är enklast och smidigast för dig. Läs gärna mer om oss på vår karriärsida och tveka inte att höra av dig om du har frågor om tjänsten. Vi tillämpar 6 månaders provanställning och kommer att göra en bakgrundskontroll för denna roll. Tjänsten är på heltid och utgår från vårt kontor vid Solvalla, alldeles intill travbanan. Vi har ett flexibelt arbetssätt vilket innebär att du har möjlighet att kombinera distansarbete med arbete från kontoret. Var med och bygg världens bästa spelupplevelse tillsammans med oss!

items.desc: En Dive tendrás la oportunidad de participar en proyectos de Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial, aplicando tus conocimientos técnicos a la resolución de problemas reales de negocio. Una posición en la que podrás combinar el análisis de datos, la estadística y el Machine Learning con una visión práctica de las necesidades de negocio, participando en diferentes fases de los proyectos y asumiendo responsabilidades técnicas de forma progresiva. Tu día a día: Participarás en proyectos de Data Science e Inteligencia Artificial, desarrollando soluciones analíticas para diferentes necesidades de negocio. Trabajarás en la recopilación, preparación, análisis y tratamiento de datos. Desarrollarás, entrenarás y evaluarás modelos estadísticos y de Machine Learning. Colaborarás con los equipos de negocio para comprender sus necesidades y traducirlas en objetivos y soluciones de Data Science. Asumirás la resolución de tareas técnicas con autonomía, contando con el apoyo del equipo en los retos de mayor complejidad. Analizarás e interpretarás resultados, identificando conclusiones y oportunidades de mejora. Participarás en la presentación de resultados y recomendaciones a equipos técnicos y de negocio. ¿Qué te ayudará a tener éxito? Formación universitaria en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ingeniería, Física, Economía o disciplinas similares. Conocimientos sólidos de matemáticas, estadística aplicada, Data Science y Machine Learning. Conocimientos de programación y manejo de herramientas utilizadas en el análisis y tratamiento de datos. Familiaridad con bases de datos y fundamentos de ingeniería de datos y desarrollo de software. Experiencia práctica desarrollando proyectos de Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial o analítica avanzada, ya sea en entornos profesionales, académicos o mediante proyectos propios. Capacidad para analizar problemas, plantear soluciones y trabajar con autonomía en tareas técnicas. Habilidades de comunicación, orientación a resultados y trabajo en equipo. Inglés profesional. Valoraremos especialmente Máster o formación especializada en Data Science, Inteligencia Artificial o Machine Learning. Experiencia participando en proyectos de consultoría, especialmente en entornos de datos e Inteligencia Artificial. Familiaridad con el ciclo de vida de los proyectos de Data Science, desde la definición del problema hasta la presentación de resultados. Experiencia trabajando con clientes o equipos de negocio. Conocimiento de herramientas de desarrollo asistidas por Inteligencia Artificial y vibe coding . ¿Qué puedes encontrar en esta posición? La oportunidad de trabajar en proyectos donde los datos y la Inteligencia Artificial se aplican a necesidades concretas de negocio. Un entorno en el que seguir desarrollando tus capacidades técnicas, ampliar tu conocimiento de distintas soluciones analíticas y asumir progresivamente mayor responsabilidad en los proyectos. Si disfrutas resolviendo problemas mediante los datos, te interesa la aplicación práctica de la Inteligencia Artificial y quieres seguir creciendo profesionalmente en este ámbito, nos encantará conocer tu perfil. Igualdad de oportunidades y diversidad En Dive, como parte de ISPD Group, nos encanta conocer a personas que se atreven a dar un paso más. ¿No tienes claro si cumples el 100 % de los requisitos? ¡No te descartes antes de tiempo! Si crees que esta oportunidad encaja contigo y tienes ganas de aportar al equipo, nos encantará conocer tu candidatura. Estamos comprometidos con la igualdad de oportunidades y con la creación de un entorno diverso e inclusivo, donde cada persona pueda ser ella misma. Por eso, te animamos a presentar tu candidatura.

items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team. This team is the beating heart of Prima. You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details As a Software Engineer working on our AI/ML Platform, you’ll help build the shared services, APIs and developer tools that enable engineers and data scientists across Prima to experiment, build and operate AI and Machine Learning solutions quickly and reliably. AI and Machine Learning are core to how Prima builds products, makes decisions and operates at scale. You’ll work on foundational capabilities used across the company, helping teams move faster and reducing the complexity of building with AI and ML. What You’ll Do Build and evolve our shared AI/ML platform. Design and own core services, APIs and developer tools that support AI and ML across their lifecycle. Solve engineering challenges around scalability, reliability, observability and developer experience. Understand user needs and turn complex problems into simple, reusable platform capabilities. Work closely with engineers and data scientists, taking ownership from technical design through implementation and operation. What We’re Looking For Software engineering experience with Python. Solid foundations in software design and architecture. Experience designing, building and operating reliable software systems. Strong engineering practices around testing, maintainability and code quality. Ability to tackle complex technical problems, make pragmatic design decisions and take ownership of the solutions you build. Stay curious about how AI is changing software engineering and use AI tools pragmatically to work better. Nice-to-Have Experience building platforms, developer tooling, or production AI systems. Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies. Familiarity with ML infrastructure and orchestration tools. Experience with GenAI/LLM infrastructure, such as model APIs, gateways, evaluation systems, observability or cost monitoring. You don’t need to be an ML or AI researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about building the technology that enables AI and ML across the full lifecycle — from experimentation and development to deployment, operation and continuous improvement. We’re open to mid-level and senior engineers, with scope and ownership adapted to experience. €55,000 - €85,000 a year Why You’ll Love It Here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Queremos liderar la conversación europea sobre agricultura ecológica y regenerativa con evidencia, no con relato. CrowdFarming es, en su esencia, una empresa tecnológica. Conectamos a 3.500 agricultores de 15 países con más de 500.000 hogares en toda Europa a través de productos que hemos construido nosotros: nuestro marketplace (crowdfarming.com), CrowdSender (nuestro TMS) y Farmeneur, la plataforma donde los agricultores gestionan sus datos agronómicos y acceden a los servicios que les damos. Nuestra misión es hacer la agricultura ecológica y regenerativa posible para los agricultores y accesible para el consumidor. Reportarás al Head of Sustainability & Impact . Serás el/la primer/a ingeniero/a dedicado/a del equipo, trabajando junto a agricultores, agrónomos, y biólogos. Ellos aportan los problemas del campo y la ciencia; tú decides cómo construir las soluciones. También formarás parte del equipo técnico de CrowdFarming . Te integrarás en sus rituales de equipo y tu código pasará por las mismas revisiones y estándares que los de todos los demás. Serás responsable de tus proyectos, pero con todo un equipo de desarrollo respaldándote. Este no es un puesto de IT de back-office a la espera de tickets para cerrar. Asumirás la responsabilidad de los problemas de principio a fin (end-to-end), y construirás productos que los agricultores, nuestro equipo y nuestros socios realmente utilicen. 👉 Lo que estará sobre tu mesa En el equipo de Sustainability & Impact llevamos años construyendo nuestro programa de agricultura regenerativa. Hoy trabajamos con 100 agricultores, con un protocolo científico sólido y datos agronómicos sobre 10.000 hectáreas en 6 países. Necesitamos que construyas y lideres la columna vertebral digital que hace que todo funcione: las herramientas con las que opera el programa, los datos en los que confían nuestros agricultores y la forma en que todo el equipo trabaja con la tecnología, los datos y la IA. 🧩 Los Retos Que Nos Ayudarás a Resolver ¿Cómo transformamos lo que vemos en el campo en decisiones para la finca? Construye las herramientas que simplifiquen y hagan fiable el trabajo de campo de nuestros agrónomos, y que conviertan los datos en planes de acción concretos. Apóyate en la literatura científica existente para automatizar la mayor parte posible de esa toma de decisiones con reglas que los agrónomos puedan entender y discutir, no una caja negra. ¿Qué nos dicen los datos a gran escala? Detecta las tendencias en cientos de fincas y transfórmalas en información clave (insights) para nuestros agricultores, la industria alimentaria y la ciencia de la agricultura regenerativa-orgánica. Haz que nuestros datos sean limpios, trazables y robustos, de manera que cada cifra de impacto que compartamos resista una auditoría rigurosa. ¿Cómo le sacamos más partido a cada dato? Conecta estas herramientas con el resto de nuestros productos digitales para dar un mejor servicio a nuestros agricultores y que los consumidores puedan ver el valor real detrás de lo que compran. ¿Cómo crecemos sin aumentar el papeleo? Pragmático/a, autónomo/a y con enfoque de principio a fin (end-to-end). Has construido herramientas para usuarios no técnicos, idealmente para personas que trabajan sobre el terreno. Dominio fluido de la IA: Ya trabajas con herramientas de IA y logras entusiasmar a otros con ellas. Sabes transformar un "podríamos usar IA aquí" en algo que el equipo adopte de forma real. Narrador/a de datos (Data Storyteller): Conviertes un conjunto de datos caótico en algo que un agricultor entiende de inmediato. Un plus que te diferenciará: Interés en biología, agronomía o edafología (ciencia del suelo). Quieres entender por qué importan los datos del suelo y la agronomía para modelarlos bien. Si esto es nuevo para ti, sientes una curiosidad genuina y muchas ganas de aprender: estarás rodeado/a de agricultores, agrónomos y biólogos a los que les encanta explicarlo. items.desc: Are you looking for a new challenge? Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance? Prima could be the place for you. Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain. To help fuel that growth, we need a Software Engineer to join our Engineering team. This team is the beating heart of Prima. You’ll be joining over 350 engineers across software development, infrastructure, operations and security. Fueled by curiosity, experimentation and collaboration, you’ll help deliver scalable, impactful solutions that shape the future of insurance. Excited to make an impact? Here are the details As a Software Engineer working on our AI/ML Platform, you’ll help build the shared services, APIs and developer tools that enable engineers and data scientists across Prima to experiment, build and operate AI and Machine Learning solutions quickly and reliably. AI and Machine Learning are core to how Prima builds products, makes decisions and operates at scale. You’ll work on foundational capabilities used across the company, helping teams move faster and reducing the complexity of building with AI and ML. What You’ll Do Build and evolve our shared AI/ML platform. Design and own core services, APIs and developer tools that support AI and ML across their lifecycle. Solve engineering challenges around scalability, reliability, observability and developer experience. Understand user needs and turn complex problems into simple, reusable platform capabilities. Work closely with engineers and data scientists, taking ownership from technical design through implementation and operation. What We’re Looking For Software engineering experience with Python. Solid foundations in software design and architecture. Experience designing, building and operating reliable software systems. Strong engineering practices around testing, maintainability and code quality. Ability to tackle complex technical problems, make pragmatic design decisions and take ownership of the solutions you build. Stay curious about how AI is changing software engineering and use AI tools pragmatically to work better. Nice-to-Have Experience building platforms, developer tooling, or production AI systems. Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies. Familiarity with ML infrastructure and orchestration tools. Experience with GenAI/LLM infrastructure, such as model APIs, gateways, evaluation systems, observability or cost monitoring. You don’t need to be an ML or AI researcher. We’re looking for strong software engineers who are excited about building the technology that enables AI and ML across the full lifecycle — from experimentation and development to deployment, operation and continuous improvement. We’re open to mid-level and senior engineers, with scope and ownership adapted to experience. €55,000 - €75,000 a year Why You’ll Love It Here We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks. 🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year. 🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you. 🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support. Think you’re a match? Apply now. At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives. Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

items.desc: Aufgaben Willkommen bei der Allianz Die strategische Nutzung von Daten und KI beschleunigt sich weiter und birgt gerade in der Finanzdienstleistungsindustrie enorme Potenziale. Immer mehr KI-Fähigkeiten werden dabei konkret als eigenständige, interagierende Agenten umgesetzt, die über offene Standardprotokolle miteinander und mit Fachsystemen kommunizieren. Die technologische Entwicklung - insbesondere von Protokollen wie MCP (Model Context Protocol) und A2A (Agent2Agent) - führt dazu, dass Unternehmen ihre Agenten-Architekturen ständig weiterentwickeln und professionalisieren müssen. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir einen KI-Architekt (m/w/d), der KI-Agenten mit starkem Blick auf die Geschäftsprozesse der Allianz Kunde und Markt GmbH konzipiert, baut und den produktionsreifen Betrieb von Anfang an mitdenkt. Diese Rolle ist explizit Business-orientiert - technische Kenntnisse sind Erfolgsvoraussetzung für ein wirkungsvolles Ausfüllen dieser Position. Das erwartet Dich bei uns als KI-Architekt (m/w/d) Du entwirfst und implementierst KI-Agenten und Multi-Agenten-Systeme auf Basis gängiger Standardprotokolle (insbesondere MCP und A2A) und stellst deren Interoperabilität mit internen und externen Systemen sicher. Du konzipierst mehrschichtige Agenten-Architekturen (z. B. Orchestrierungs-, Tool- und Serverebenen), inklusive Tool- und Resource-Design, Authentifizierung / Autorisierung (u. a. OAuth 2.1) und Anbindung an LLM-Provider (z. B. AWS Bedrock, Anthropic Claude, OpenAI). Du arbeitest eng mit Business Ownern und Experten (m/w/d) der Allianz in Deutschland zusammen, um Anforderungen in konkrete, produktionsreife Agenten-Lösungen zu übersetzen. Du gestaltest Datenarchitekturen im Einklang mit der übergreifenden Datenarchitektur der Allianz in Deutschland und berätst zum Einsatz von agentenbasierten und generativen KI-Lösungen in den Feldern Kundenschnittstelle, Prozessautomation und Versicherungstechnik. Du stellst Betriebsreife sicher: Observability (z. B. OpenTelemetry), Skalierbarkeit und sicheren Cloud-Betrieb (AWS, containerisiert, Infrastructure-as-Code mit Terraform). Du identifizierst bereichsübergreifend Abhängigkeiten und Synergien für KI-Agenten-Lösungen und arbeitest eng mit dem Chief Data Officer (m/w/d), Enterprise- bzw. Facharchitekten (m/w/d) und den verschiedenen AI Governance Funktionen zusammen. Profil Das bringst Du mit als KI-Architekt (m/w/d) Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Data Science, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch Berufserfahrung. Du bringst nachweisbare praktische Erfahrung im Bau von KI-Agenten auf Basis gängiger Standardprotokolle mit, insbesondere MCP und A2A, sowie ein gutes Verständnis von Tool-/Resource-Design und Agent-Orchestrierung. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in mehreren Programmiersprachen (insb. Python und TypeScript) und deren Einsatz in produktiven KI- und Agenten-Umgebungen sowie fundierte Kenntnisse in Data-Warehouse- und Analytics-Architekturen (u. a. SQL, Snowflake, Databricks). Du hast fundierte Praxis im Umgang mit Cloud-Plattformen und -Services, insbesondere AWS (z. B. ECS, Bedrock, Glue), sowie mit modernen Data- & AI-Plattformen wie Snowflake und Databricks. Ebenfalls verfügst du über Erfahrung im Design, Aufbau und sicheren Betrieb containerisierter, cloud-basierter Agenten- und Data-&-Analytics-Architekturen (inkl. Auth-Lösungen wie Keycloak / OAuth 2.1). Du denkst visionär und in architekturellen Zielbildern. Dabei behältst Du unsere Business-Prozesse immer stark im Blick. Deine langjährige Erfahrung in agiler Softwareentwicklung sowie im Design und Aufbau moderner CI/CD-Pipelines lässt Dich Zielbilder schnell in die Praxis umsetzen. Du bist ein starker Kommunikator, der Menschen mit unterschiedlichem technischen Wissen von Ideen überzeugen kann. Dabei arbeitest Du transparent, kollaborativ und mit hohem Fokus auf nachhaltig tragfähige Lösungen. Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse und kommunizierst ebenso souverän auf Englisch. Außerdem werden Mitarbeiter am Unternehmenserfolg beteiligt. Zeit & Flexibilität: Mit unserem Modell „Neues Arbeiten" können Beruf und Privatleben noch besser vereinbart werden. items.desc: About Summary CricViz has established itself as a market leader in the collection, analysis, and dissemination of data across the world’s leading cricket competitions, maintaining the largest and most sophisticated database in world cricket. Our work spans several verticals, including Performance Analysis, Broadcast and Media, and Fantasy and Gaming platforms. Our clients include the BBC, Sky, Sony, the ECB, and IPL-winning franchises like RCB. About the Role We are seeking a talented Data Scientist / Data Engineer with a passion for cricket to join the CricViz team in London. This role focuses on the hands-on development of proprietary metrics, data pipelines, and predictive models derived from high-frequency cricket tracking data. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex data processing and commercial analytics, converting rich tracking datasets into market-leading analytical products. You will combine quantitative modeling and data engineering best practices with a deep, nuanced understanding of the game of cricket to help answer complex performance questions for elite professional clients. Key Responsibilities Metric Development & Data Pipelines: Build and optimize end-to-end data pipelines and algorithms that transform raw ball-tracking and player-tracking data into high-value metrics (e.g., pitch behavior, expected runs/wickets, advanced fielding analysis). Data Engineering & Productionisation: Support the scaling and productisation of predictive models and datasets, ensuring reliable integration into internal tools and client workflows. Bespoke Client Deliverables: Collaborate with senior team members to deliver custom datasets, niche analytics, and predictive modeling for private clients across professional cricket, media, and gaming. Model Validation & Testing: Conduct thorough testing, validation, and optimization of predictive models to maintain high accuracy and data integrity across all operational feeds. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Broadcast teams to ensure raw feeds and derived insights flow seamlessly into production systems. Cricket & Betting Applications: Work on sports analytics across media, fantasy, gaming, and sports betting applications. Candidates should be comfortable operating in an environment where betting-related data and modeling form part of the commercial landscape. Requirements Education: Degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative discipline. Practical Experience: ~2 years of hands-on experience developing data pipelines and applying statistical/data science techniques in a professional or production environment. Data Science & Engineering Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL . Familiarity with the PyData stack (pandas, numpy, scikit-learn, XGBoost, or LightGBM). Experience handling, querying, and structuring structured and semi-structured datasets. Domain Knowledge: Deep understanding of cricket, match dynamics, and tactical nuances, with the ability to reason about how data models reflect real-game scenarios. Desirable Tracking Data: Exposure to working with high-frequency spatial, GPS, or tracking data. Software Practices: Knowledge of modern software tools (Git, CI/CD, Docker, or cloud technologies like AWS/GCP). Technical Communication: Ability to explain technical logic and metrics to non-technical stakeholders clearly. Diversity & Inclusion CricViz is committed to building an open and inclusive culture that supports personal development and continuous learning. As part of Ellipse, we believe in equal opportunity in employment regardless of race, colour, nationality, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marital status, age, ethnic or national origin, disability, or gender reassignment. Benefits 25 days annual leave + bank holidays Flexible hybrid working model with regular collaborative days at our London office Company pension scheme Life insurance & eye test contributions Dedicated training and professional development budget About Ellipse CricViz is part of Ellipse, a global leader in sports data and analytics alongside FootballViz, Horse Racing, RugbyViz, and TennisViz. Working with the world’s leading broadcasters, teams, and rights holders, we simplify complex data to tell compelling stories about the sports we love.

items.desc: Key Responsibilities Collect, clean, preprocess, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources. Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) to identify trends, patterns, and business opportunities. Develop, train, evaluate, and optimize machine learning models. Ensure data quality, privacy, and compliance with organizational standards. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, or a related field. Strong programming skills in Python. Proficiency in SQL and database querying. Good understanding of statistics, probability, and hypothesis testing. Experience with machine learning algorithms and model evaluation techniques. Hands-on experience with Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, and visualization libraries. Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Matplotlib. Understanding of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model validation. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Što očekujemo • Dobro poznavanje barem jednog programskog jezika i čvrsto razumijevanje razvoja softvera: strukture koda, rada s podacima, otklanjanja pogrešaka i testiranja. Konkretan jezik nije presudan; važna je sposobnost usvajanja novih alata. • Iskustvo razvoja stvarnih aplikacija i samostalnost u rješavanju tehničkih problema, uz odgovornost za kvalitetu i održivost rješenja. • Izražen interes za generiranje i analizu slika i videa te vlastite eksperimente s generativnim AI-jem. • Znatiželju, inicijativu i spremnost na kontinuirano učenje. Poželjna znanja i iskustva Ne očekujemo sve navedeno od jedne osobe. Posebno cijenimo praktične projekte i spremnost na istraživanje. • AI alati za razvoj, poput Claude Codea ili Cursora, uz sposobnost razumijevanja, provjere i dorade generiranog koda. • Integracija AI/LLM API-ja, rad s AI agentima, pozivanje alata, strukturirani izlazi te automatizirano testiranje i vrednovanje rezultata. • TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, React ili Python; relacijske baze poput PostgreSQL-a, API-ji i Git. • Modeli za generiranje slika i videa, LoRA prilagodbe, računalni vid, obrada medija i FFmpeg. • Pozadinski zadaci i redovi poslova, praćenje troškova AI poziva, sigurnost podataka te Docker i cloud infrastruktura. Otvoreni smo za stalno zaposlenje, privremeni ili projektni angažman te puno ili nepuno radno vrijeme. Dobrodošli su i kandidati kojima odgovara angažman na pola radnog vremena. Navedi primjer projekta na kojem si imao značajnu ulogu, što si dosad istraživao s AI-jem te željeni oblik suradnje i dostupnost. Kratko predstavljanje je dobrodošlo. items.desc: About The Collective The Human Frontier Collective (HFC) ’s mission is to bring the world's best minds to shape the future of AI – because the future of AI depends not only on powerful models, but on the people who teach them to think. We bring together researchers, academics, and domain leaders across 70+ fields – over 90% of members hold doctorates – to shape how frontier AI systems are built, evaluated, and governed. HFC members have since co-authored published work including SciPredict , PropensityBench , and Professional Reasoning Benchmark. Why join the HFC HFC centers on three core pillars: the network itself, participation in selected AI/ML projects, and opportunities to publish with our research team. Join a unique and exclusive expert network: You’ll become a part of an interdisciplinary community, consisting of over 90% doctorates and field leaders representing 70+ fields from the leading institutions. We’re a collective of top innovators and thought leaders committed to advancing frontier AI to power the world’s most important decisions. Participate in AI/ML projects: Beyond the collective network, you’ll be regularly invited to work on high-impact projects with Scale AI and its affiliated lab and platform: building AI safety and policy guardrails, helping models understand real-world deep learning workflows by designing, reviewing, and optimizing PyTorch models, evaluating complex ML code and AI-generated implementations for efficiency and correctness, and more. Co-author selected research publications: Collaborate with Scale’s research team to co-author technical reports and research papers—boosting your academic visibility and professional recognition. Who should apply Background: PhD, or postdoctoral research experience, in Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field; or senior industry experience in Machine Learning or a related field. Skills: Strong proficiency in Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow). Experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS) and MLOps tools (Docker) and LLM frameworks (LangChain) is a plus. Professional Mindset: Detail-oriented, innovative thinker with a passion for applied AI research and a commitment to collaboration. How it works Duration: This is a fully remote opportunity with no fixed end date; engagements continue as long as there's mutual interest. This is a 1099 independent contractor engagement. Work authorization: We do not sponsor visas for Fellows. To participate in the HFC Fellows program, you need to have or independently obtain full-time work authorization in the country they reside in. Community Network: Once you’ve received an invitation to join the HFC, you’ll also gain access to our newsletters, discussion channels, virtual sessions, IRL events, and much more. Projects Logistics: Project selection: You’ll regularly get matched to carefully selected projects from our partners. Depending on the partner, projects range from evaluating AI models to designing experiments, building RL environments, co-authoring research papers, and more. Flexible schedule: There's no minimum commitment – you decide whether to take on a project. Most fellows spend 10–25 hours per week, on a schedule they set themselves. Competitive pay: Project pay rates vary across platforms and depend on a number of factors, including but not limited to: projects, scope, skillset, and location. You’ll receive the pay information upon receiving project matching notifications. Application process Apply: We review applications on a rolling basis. Interview: Candidates will get to discuss their research experience, professional background, and alignment with our mission to advance human-centered AI. Note: If we invited you directly, your invitation will say whether this step applies. Join the Collective: Successful candidates will receive an invitation to join the Human Frontier Collective Fellowship. PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital …

items.desc: Examensarbete, 30 hp: AI-baserad detektion av små objekt i infraröda bilder Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott. Din roll Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling. Bakgrund Infraröda sensorer används inom bland annat övervakning, sök- och räddningsinsatser samt omvärldsuppfattning. Att detektera små objekt i infraröda bilder är en utmaning eftersom objekten ofta endast upptar ett fåtal pixlar och saknar tydlig form och struktur. Svag kontrast mot bakgrunden, sensorbrus och störande bakgrundsdetaljer gör det dessutom svårt att skilja relevanta objekt från omgivningen. Beskrivning av examensarbetet Syftet med exjobbet är att undersöka och utvärdera metoder för detektion av små objekt i infraröda bilder. Arbetet kan omfatta traditionella bildbehandlingsmetoder baserade på filtrering och lokal kontrast, samt djupinlärningsbaserade metoder för detektion och segmentering. Beroende på tillgång till videodata kan även tidsinformation från flera bildrutor användas för att förbättra detektionen. Utvalda metoder implementeras och utvärderas på separata tränings- och testdataset. Fokus ligger på detektionsförmåga, falsklarm och robusthet vid varierande objektstorlek, kontrast och bakgrund. Arbetet kan även undersöka sambandet mellan modellkomplexitet, beräkningstid och prestanda, med målet att bedöma metodernas lämplighet för praktisk användning. Exempel på forskningsfrågor Hur presterar djupinlärningsbaserade metoder jämfört med traditionella metoder för att detektera små och svagt framträdande objekt i infraröda bilder? Hur påverkas detektionsförmågan och antalet falsklarm av objektens storlek och kontrast samt av brus och komplexa bakgrunder? Hur väl generaliserar metoderna till andra miljöer och sensorer, och hur kan träningsstrategier och dataaugmentering förbättra robustheten? Vilken avvägning mellan detektionsprestanda, falsklarm och beräkningstid är möjlig för tillämpningar med krav på realtidsbearbetning? Saab Dynamics har en lång tradition inom bildbehandlingsområdet och sektionerna för bildbehandling samt optronik & bildbaserad navigering handleder årligen ett antal exjobbare inom området. I dagsläget är vi drygt 30 personer mellan sektionerna och arbetar med allt från elektrooptiska sensorer till realtidsimplementering av våra bildbehandlingsapplikationer. Din profil Arbetet är lämpligt för 1-2 studenter i slutet av er teknisk fysik- eller datorteknik-utbildning (eller motsvarande) och ska påbörja ert 30 hp examensarbete. Erfarenheter av maskininlärning, datorseende och programmering är meriterande. Samt med intresse för maskininlärning och datorseende. Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg! Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap. Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut. Kontaktpersoner Marcus Klomark, Sektionschef Bildbehandling marcus.klomark@saabgroup.com 076-8967055 Simon Wold, kontaktperson/handledare Simon.wold@saabgroup.com Vad du blir en del av Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas. Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

items.desc: At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards. In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other. For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate. A few examples of your responsibilities Build AI-powered product experiences. Work with product teams to identify high-impact opportunities where AI can transform the user experience for millions—and then build these transformative solutions. Drive the process from possibility to production, delivering code that’s robust, reproducible, and built for scale. Amplify your impact with AI. Integrate the most powerful AI tools directly into your development workflow—design, implementation, testing, and documentation—to move faster while maintaining high standards for correctness, reliability, and maintainability. Master your toolkit. Work across diverse stacks with end-to-end ownership, choosing the right technologies for each challenge. From monoliths to microservices, gRPC to REST, Kubernetes to Docker, Python to Rust—you’ll apply technologies thoughtfully, focusing on depth and purpose rather than trends. Build software that matters. Take real ownership from idea to production, creating systems used by millions and evolving them into products at scale. Simplify relentlessly. Question every layer of complexity. Improve architectures, pipelines, and codebases to build systems that are simpler, more scalable, and easier to maintain. What we look for Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter. Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar. Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent. Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English. What we offer Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field. An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too. All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work. A flexible start date and part-time options. You don't need to wait until graduation to apply. We offer flexible start dates and the possibility to begin part-time, transitioning to full-time as you complete your degree. Many Spooners joined before graduating and progressively took on greater responsibility, with arrangements that allowed them to do so without compromising their education. Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity. Commitment & contract Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time. Location …

items.desc: Junior – Artificial Intelligence and Data Stiamo cercando una figura junior da inserire nel team di Artificial Intelligence and Data di Deloitte Consulting nella sede di Roma/Milano , che lavorerà in modalità Hybrid . Nel Team di Artificial Intelligence & Data avrai l’occasione di aiutare, in ambito Analytics, le aziende a valorizzare i dati provenienti da fonti eterogenee trasformandoli in informazioni accurate e immediatamente utilizzabili, elementi indispensabili per quelle aziende che vogliono fare decision-making fact-driven. La Offering Artificial Intelligence & Data è pertanto l’opzione best in class nell’individuazione, progettazione e implementazione di soluzioni di Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, Data Visualization, Big Data Management, con un approccio agnostico dal punto di vista tecnologico. Your Role La risorsa Junior sarà inserita in un team di lavoro, affiancando colleghi senior e occupandosi di: Interpretare proattivamente i bisogni del cliente, individuando metodologie e approcci coerenti Sviluppare iniziative e soluzioni in modo indipendente, raccogliendo ed analizzando dati a supporto dell’elaborazione di soluzioni per i clienti Elaborare teaser e presentazioni per supportare il top management Individuare potenziali rischi e criticità e condividerli tempestivamente con il resto del team Collaborare efficacemente in team eterogenei ed internazionali What We Offer La retribuzione prevista per la posizione di Analyst è compresa tra EUR 26.500 e EUR 31.000 lordi annui. In caso di stage, è prevista un’indennità di tirocinio. L'inquadramento verrà definito in fase di selezione sulla base del profilo e in applicazione del CCNL Terziario Distribuzione e Servizi. items.desc: Founding Robotics Perception Engineer | YC-Backed Physical AI & Robotics Startup | London (Remote) | Full-Time | Up to £150K + Equity About The Company Our client is a Y Combinator-backed (S26) physical AI data company building the foundational human video and motion datasets for leading robotics and embodied-AI teams. Focused on egocentric first-person video and UMI demonstration data, the company turns real-world capture operations into high-precision, versioned data products that foundation-model and VLA teams rely on to train physical robots. Backed by a freshly closed seed round, their core constraint is supply, not demand. They are actively scaling deployment engineering, field operations, and capture hardware to keep up with massive customer demand. The founders are building a three-person founding engineering team to set the technical standards, tooling, and evaluation methodology behind the world's reference dataset for robot learning. About The Role Reporting to the Engineering Lead (with direct collaboration with the Founders), the Founding Robotics Perception Engineer owns hand tracking, motion reconstruction, and capture-device software integration. You will serve as the technical authority on turning raw camera and sensor recordings into accurate, physical 3D trajectories. Your work directly determines whether the motion data is accurate enough for its intended use and sets the company's technical standard for motion data. You will build production pipelines for 3D hand tracking and gripper trajectory estimation, integrate camera SDKs and spatial sensors, and establish the physical accuracy benchmarks and quality flags that give robotics teams total confidence in the data. Key Responsibilities Build, refine, and maintain production pipelines for 3D hand tracking from egocentric video and gripper trajectory reconstruction from UMI recordings. Integrate camera streams, IMUs, and device SDKs into the collection software, ensuring flawless handling of spatial calibration, coordinate frames, timestamps, and units. Develop diagnostic tools to detect occluded hands, lost tracks, motion drift, coordinate discrepancies, dropped frames, and timestamp misalignments, applying automated quality flags for data review. Compare motion estimates against physical reference standards, quantify error and coverage, and maintain automated regression tests to confirm that pipeline changes genuinely improve data accuracy. Test and benchmark newly purchased cameras and capture hardware on representative tasks, evaluating baseline signal quality and reliability prior to wider operational deployment. Skills & Competencies Deep spatial understanding of 3D camera geometry, camera-IMU calibration, coordinate transforms, temporal tracking, and multi-view reconstruction. Hands-on experience with 3D hand tracking, visual odometry, SLAM, or pose estimation using real-world camera and sensor recordings. Strong production programming capabilities in Python (along with C++ and GPU inference where required) backed by practical deep learning implementation skills. Exceptional ability to separate model errors from sensor faults, isolating physical discrepancies, dropped frames, and timestamp drift. Qualifications & Experience Background in hand tracking, motion capture, AR/VR, spatial computing, robotics, autonomous systems, or sensor fusion. Proven track record of taking perception or tracking systems beyond controlled lab conditions to real sensor recordings used by actual applications. Direct experience handling raw device SDKs, coordinate frame conventions, and physical accuracy validation against meaningful ground-truth references. Experience with egocentric video, camera-IMU setups, visual odometry, or multi-view reconstruction is highly valuable. Role Details Timing: Immediate Start Location: London (Remote). Package: Competitive base salary up to £150K + significant founding-engineer equity with total technical ownership over the perception domain.

items.desc: We’ve signed up to an ambitious journey. Join us! As Arrive, we guide customers and communities towards brighter futures and more livable cities, it isn’t a challenge just anyone could take on. Luckily, we have something to help us make it happen. Our people and our values. We Arrive Curious, Focused and Together. Just as our entire brand is inspired by the North Star, the shining light leading travelers to their destinations since time began, our values guide us. They help us be at our best. For our customers. For the cities and communities we serve. For ourselves. As a global team, we are transforming urban mobility. Let’s grow better, together. The Role As a Data Scientist, you will be a valued technical contributor in our Data Science Products team and in the Data, Analytics and AI organisation of Arrive. The Data Science Products team ingests billions of complex sensor data points daily to produce advanced machine learning products that help millions of drivers park or charge electric vehicles. For example, we predict the availability of parking in cities across the world and provide drivers with routes that reduce the time they will spend searching for a space near their destination. This is a data science role focused on building and improving production modelling products. We are looking for a skilled data scientist who combines strong mathematical foundations with the ability to deliver high-quality, production-ready solutions. You will contribute to our modelling approaches and work closely with data scientists and engineers to follow good technical practice. How To Make An Impact Develop New Products: Contribute to projects that solve business challenges relevant to parking, EV charging, and journey routing. This includes conducting in-depth analysis of new data sources, and researching, implementing and testing potential modelling approaches. Enhance Existing Products: Build on products already in production, improving their performance through iterative development and rigorous experimentation. Ship Production-Quality Code: Write high-quality code and contribute to the pipelines in our production codebase, deploying scalable products in collaboration with our engineers. Advance Modelling Practices: Develop new skills and enhance our services and ways of working by researching and implementing relevant approaches or technologies, particularly around statistical and machine learning techniques. Collaborate Across the Team: Be a great member of the team - while the work involves a good degree of autonomy, we value collaborating with and supporting colleagues across Data Science, Analytics and Engineering. About You You are a collaborative data scientist who takes pride in delivering real value to customers through well-built, well-reasoned products. You enjoy tackling complex, ambiguous problems with creative solutions while maintaining rigour in your mathematical and statistical approach. You are passionate about building robust, production-grade models and value working in a supportive, learning-focused environment. Your background Minimum of 2 years professional experience, including building statistical or machine learning products in a commercial setting (preferably being involved in their deployment). Strong mathematical and theoretical skills, especially probability theory, such as from an MSc or a highly mathematical undergraduate degree. An ability to understand complex problems and find creative solutions. Proficient in Python with good knowledge of the Python data science ecosystem (e.g. Pandas, Numpy, Scikit-Learn). Good knowledge of statistical and machine learning techniques, and experience using relevant tools. Good software engineering practices. Nice to have: Background in GIS (Geographic Information Systems), or experience working with geospatial data and relevant Python packages (e.g. GeoPandas) Large data sets and big data tools (ideally PySpark) Cloud computing environments (e.g. AWS) This is a hybrid role based in Chișinău, Moldova. About Arrive Arrive, including brands like EasyPark, Flowbird, RingGo, ParkMobile and Parkopedia, is a leading global mobility platform. Present in over 90 countries and 20,000 cities, the company helps people and decision-makers make smarter decisions about urban mobility and ease the experience of travel worldwide. Arrive delivers a unique combination of the core ingredients to make cities more livable: from smart payments and optimized car parks to data-driven traffic reduction and support for reinvestment in public transport and green space. It’s about more than function, it’s about saving time and simplifying the experience of travel for everyone. Travel is more than a journey, it’s how you Arrive.

items.desc:
Do you like to work on ground breaking technologies that enable amazing new products? Do you have the attention for details and love for excellence to work towards an extraordinary result? Envision what you could do here! At Apple, we believe new insights have a way of becoming extraordinary products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. Bring passion and dedication to your job and there's no telling what you could accomplish!
Apple is looking for a qualified and motivated silicon validation engineer. You will be part of a team doing pre/post-silicon bring- up, debug, validation and characterisation of analog and mixed signal Power Management circuits for battery operated portable devices.
This position is for an engineer with experience in system validation, who understands that the tight interaction between pre-silicon design and post-silicon validation is the key to shipping quality products. In this role, you will work closely with both IC Design teams, Firmware and System teams within Apple, as we drive execution from first silicon through to mass-production release. 
You will be expected to participate in all levels of this process, including the definition of custom board-level hardware for IC bring-up and test, defining and implementing validation plans, and working with module and system teams to support their design integration and debug of system-level issues.
BS/MS/PhD in Electronic Engineering or related fields
First experience in the areas of system validation and ASIC design validation
Experience with analog circuit measurement
Good knowledge in Hardware Design tools, schematic entry and PCB design techniques
Strong bringup and debugging skills and hands-on lab work.
Experience with complex test equipment setups (scopes, programmable power supplies, spectrum/network analyzer, etc.)
Good coding skills (Python, C++) and knowledge of test equipment programming for automating laboratory measurements
Experience with switching converters and linear regulators (LDO)
Technical background in silicon validation, failure analysis and debug
Familiarity with Verilog or VHDL, FPGA prototyping
Good understanding of embedded firmware/software development process is beneficial
An understanding of finite state machines, microcontroller architectures and mixed signal design is a plus
Proven analytical and problem solving abilities
Excellent communication, interpersonal skills and enthusiasm, combined with the ability to collaborate

items.desc: Über die Stelle und unser Unternehmen Mid- oder Senior- Level (m/w/d) mit Perspektive Teamleitung | Österreich bevorzugt, Bewerbungen aus Deutschland willkommen. Reppublika entwickelt SaaS-Produkte für Media und Ad Tech sowie Marktforschung, die Verlage, Agenturen und Marken in ganz Europa nutzen. Unsere Data Scientists verbinden Daten, Produktentwicklung und Kundenbedürfnisse: Sie machen Informationen in großen Verhaltens- und Befragungsdatensätzen so zugänglich, damit unsere Kunden damit können, oder unserer Markforscher oder Software-Entwickler diese in Produktlösungen weiterverwenden können. Du setzt Data Science in funktionierende Lösungen um und nutzt KI als festen Bestandteil deiner Arbeit. Wir suchen Menschen mit Erfahrung und klarem Ehrgeiz: Du bist bereits Senior oder auf Mid-Level-Niveau und bereit, zügig den nächsten Schritt zu machen. Du willst Verantwortung übernehmen, Projekte voranbringen und perspektivisch ein Team führen. Die Möglichkeit dazu kann sich in den nächsten zwei bis drei Jahren ergeben – abhängig von deiner Entwicklung. Deine Aufgaben Projekte bis zur Umsetzung begleiten – du klärst, was der Kunde braucht, planst die nächsten Schritte und übernimmst eigenständig Verantwortung für Umfang, Termine und Übergabe. Im interdisziplinären Team koordinieren – du arbeitest mit Entwicklung, Analyse und Marktforschung zusammen, stimmst Aufgaben und Abhängigkeiten ab und wächst schrittweise in die fachliche Projektleitung hinein. Mit Kunden arbeiten – du präsentierst Ergebnisse, erklärst Führungskräften aus Medien, Marketing und Produktentwicklung deren Bedeutung für ihr Geschäft und begründest deine Vorgehensweise verständlich und ohne unnötigen Fachjargon. Geschäftsfragen in konkrete Analysen übersetzen – du präzisierst offene Fragestellungen und sprichst an, wenn ein anderer Ansatz sinnvoller wäre. Modelle, Datenpipelines und Analysen entwickeln – du arbeitest mit umfangreichen Daten auf Personenebene, darunter Verhaltens- und Befragungsdaten wie Clickstream-, Panel- und Werbekontaktdaten. Deine Lösungen sollen im Produktivbetrieb funktionieren. Eng mit unseren Entwicklern zusammenarbeiten – du schreibst sauberen Code, entwirfst und nutzt Datenstrukturen und verstehst, wie deine Arbeit in unsere SaaS-Architektur passt. KI als zentrales Arbeitswerkzeug nutzen – mit Coding-Agenten, LLM-basierten Pipelines und Automatisierung entwickelst du schneller und erschließt neue Lösungswege. Das bringst du mit Ein Studium in Statistik, Informatik, Mathematik, quantitativen Sozialwissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Fach. Was du bereits umgesetzt hast, ist uns wichtiger als ein Studienabschluss. Fundierte Statistikkenntnisse – Stichproben, Gewichtung, Regression und Signifikanztests sowie ein gutes Urteilsvermögen dafür, welcher Ansatz für die jeweilige Entscheidung ausreicht. Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Data Science oder Analytics im Unternehmensumfeld – du hast bereits Lösungen umgesetzt, die tatsächlich genutzt werden. Du musst noch kein Senior sein, möchtest aber fachlich und in deiner Verantwortung schnell wachsen. Grundlagen der Softwareentwicklung – sicherer Umgang mit Python oder R sowieGit, APIs, Tests und den Grundlagen von Deployment. Du kannst dich auch in bestehenden Code einarbeiten. Datenbankkenntnisse – relationale Datenmodellierung, fortgeschrittenes SQL und Verständnis für Abfrageperformance; Erfahrung mit analytischen oder spaltenorientierten Datenbanken und Cloud-Umgebungen, vorzugsweise AWS. KI als festen Teil deiner Arbeitsweise – du nutzt KI-Coding-Assistenten und Agenten regelmäßig und hast mindestens ein eigenes LLM-basiertes Tool, einen Workflow oder eine Pipeline gebaut, die du uns zeigen kannst. Entscheidend ist die praktische Umsetzung. Freude am Kundenkontakt – du kannst analytische Ergebnisse für ein nichttechnisches Publikum erklären und möchtest im Austausch mit Entscheidungsträgern noch sicherer werden. Erfahrung mit Medien, Ad Tech, Reichweitenmessung oder Marktforschung. Teamgeist und Organisationstalent – du planst und priorisierst deine Arbeit, sprichst Risiken früh an und hältst Zusagen ein. Du möchtest zunehmend Projekte koordinieren und später auch Führungsverantwortung übernehmen. Deutsch auf C1 oder C2 Niveau in Wort und Schrift – du kannst Kundengespräche, Präsentationen und fachliche Diskussionen eigenständig und souverän auf Deutsch führen. Dazu kommt fließendes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit in unserem internationalen Team. Das bieten wir dir 60.000 bis 72.000 Euro brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation,sowie einem leistungsabhängigen Bonus. Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege in einer inhabergeführten Unternehmensgruppe. Arbeit an Produkten, die tatsächlich genutzt werden – mit direktem Einfluss auf ihre Weiterentwicklung. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice und Remote-Arbeit innerhalb des genannten Standortrahmens. Im Büro erwarten dich kostenlose Getränke und Snacks, gemeinsame Mittagessen und kein …

items.title: AI Data Operations Analyst
items.card: The Role As our AI Data Operations Analyst, you will own the full lifecycle of the data that trains our computer vision models: from finding the right video and imagery, to preparing and categorizing it, assigning it to our annotation team, checking the results, and reporting on what the data tells us. You will sit in management and product meetings to understand our current and upcoming projects, and you will
items.desc: About Variene Variene develops advanced AI and computer vision software for defense and autonomous systems, designed to operate in demanding real-world environments. Our technology brings intelligent perception to platforms operating across ISR, autonomous systems, and other mission-critical defense applications. Our models are only as good as the data behind them. The Role As our AI Data Operations Analyst, you will own the full lifecycle of the data that trains our computer vision models: from finding the right video and imagery, to preparing and categorizing it, assigning it to our annotation team, checking the results, and reporting on what the data tells us. You will sit in management and product meetings to understand our current and upcoming projects, and you will translate those priorities into the right material, at the right time, for the annotation team. You will be the bridge between the people who set product direction and the people who create our training data, and you will bring the numbers and the feedback back to product development. Reports to: Head of Product / CTO. Works closely with: Leadership, ML engineers, DevOps, and the Annotation Team Manager. Good to know: due to the nature of our work, some of the material you will review may include footage from real conflict zones, which can occasionally be distressing. We take this seriously and will discuss it openly during the hiring process. What You'll Do Take part in management and product meetings to stay aligned with active and upcoming projects. Translate project goals into concrete data needs: target classes, scenarios, environments, and edge cases. Agree with product development on priorities for the annotation team and keep them visible and up to date. Independently search for, evaluate and secure video and imagery (including FPV, aerial, maritime and thermal footage) relevant to each project. Judge each source for relevance, quality, volume and suitability for secure, off-cloud use. Check, together with the DPO/Legal function, that we have the right to use each source (licensing, platform terms, personal data) before it enters our pipeline. Maintain a rigorous, up-to-date source register. Edit and prepare material for annotation: clipping, trimming, format conversion, frame extraction, de-duplication and cleaning. Categorize and tag material with consistent metadata (class, scenario, sensor type, conditions, source) so every clip is easy to find and trace. Package targeted batches and assign them to the annotation team in CVAT, with clear instructions on what to look at and what to look for. Verify the integrity and completeness of every batch before it reaches the team. Act as a second level of quality control: run sample-based reviews of completed annotations, in coordination with the Annotation Team Manager, who owns day-to-day review. Check that annotations are not only correct, but useful for what the model needs (coverage, consistency, edge cases). Collect annotator feedback and recurring edge cases and turn them into clearer guidance and better batches. Track and analyze the data coming from our tools (CVAT and internal systems): annotation throughput and turnaround time, number of annotated objects per class, rejection and correction rates, and backlog. Spot gaps and imbalances in the datasets (e.g., classes or scenarios that are under-represented) and recommend what to source next. Produce clear, regular reports and dashboards for leadership and product development. Collect productivity and quality metrics in line with Variene's internal policies and data protection requirements. Document sources, preparation steps and dataset versions so every dataset is traceable and repeatable. Follow Variene's security and data-handling procedures for off-cloud work. What We're Looking ForKnowledge and Experience 2–4 years of experience in AI/computer vision data operations, data annotation (lead, QA or coordination roles), dataset curation, or a similar data-focused role. Hands-on experience handling and editing video data (clipping, conversion, frame extraction) with tools such as FFmpeg. Basic Python scripting for downloading, organizing and processing files and data. Strong Excel skills (pivot tables, charts); ability to turn raw numbers into clear reports. Proven ability to research and source material independently and assess its quality. Understanding of how annotation works and of common annotation formats (e.g., COCO, YOLO). Excellent written and spoken English; Greek is a plus. Highly Valued Experience or familiarity involving: Annotation platforms such as CVAT, Label Studio or similar, including their analytics and reporting features. Power BI or similar dashboarding tools. Dataset management tools (e.g., Roboflow, FiftyOne). Defense, maritime or aerial footage; ISR data workflows; thermal (IR) imagery. Open-source intelligence (OSINT) research methods. Working in on-premise or air-gapped environments. Eligibility for a …

items.desc: About the Company G.D is a leading organization headquartered in Bologna, Italy. As a key player in the high-tech machineries production, we specialize in cutting-edge technologies, shaping the future of industrial automation. Our business portfolio encompasses a wide range of innovative making and packing solutions, in particular for Modern Oral and Next Generation products. We strive to continuously expand our offerings and enhance our capabilities to meet the evolving needs of our customers. For more detailed information about G.D and its comprehensive business landscape, please visit www.gidi.it. G.D is part of Coesia, a group of innovation-based industrial and packaging solutions companies operating globally, headquartered in Bologna, Italy. Coesia operates in 34 countries with 21 different companies and employs over 8,000 people as of 2026. About the Role Within the Machine Cost Analysis Team , the candidate will support the analysis of machine and line costs, working on both new prototypes and consolidated machines/lines. This role combines a technical understanding of complex automatic machines with a strong analytical approach to cost evaluation, with the objective of identifying cost deviations, understanding their root causes and supporting cost reduction initiatives. The candidate will work closely with technical departments, Operations and other internal stakeholders to analyze machine baselines, compare actual costs against budget/standard costs, and interpret cost deltas through a technical perspective. In particular, the selected resource will be responsible for: supporting cost simulations and estimates for machines and complete packaging lines; analyzing actual industrial costs and comparing them with budgeted or standard costs; reviewing complex bills of materials and large data files to understand machine cost structures; identifying and explaining the main causes of deviation from expected costs, with a focus on technical and production-related drivers; contributing to cost reduction activities by analyzing components, technologies and manufacturing processes; collaborating with Engineering, Operations and technical offices to ensure accurate and reliable cost analysis. What You Need to Be Successful A Master's Degree in Mechanical Engineering 1-2 years of experience in manufacturing, industrialization, methods & time analysis, production engineering, cost engineering, or similar technical environments Good knowledge of mechanical drawings and manufacturing processes; Strong analytical mindset with the ability to interpret complex technical and cost-related data; Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Excel and good knowledge of the Office Suite; Good knowledge of English language (B2), both written and spoken; Knowledge of SAP will be considered a plus; You are curious, detail-oriented and rigorous, with a genuine interest in understanding how complex machines are designed and manufactured; You are proactive, organized and precise, with strong analytical and critical thinking skills, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work effectively with different stakeholders and teams. Our Offer Compensation for this role includes a base salary ranging from EUR 33,000 to EUR 37,000. A range of additional benefits (e.g., insurances, etc.) is also available in accordance with Company policy. The applicable collective agreement is the CCNL Metalmeccanico . Join the Team! Coesia is an equal opportunity employer. We believe in fair, merit-based recruitment and assess all candidates exclusively on the basis of their qualifications, skills, experience and suitability for the role. Job Reference: CGS13430
