items.desc: Belangrijkste punten Uur 32 - 40 u. Salarisindicatie bruto/mnd. o.b.v. fulltime € 4.728 - € 6.433 Deadline 14 nov 2026 Wat is je rol Vanuit deze positie zorg je ervoor dat processen, werkwijzen en documentatie zo worden ingericht dat de universiteit kan voldoen aan de eisen van de Europese AI-Act. Je bewaakt de registratie en dossiervorming van algoritmen en AI-toepassingen die binnen de organisatie worden ontwikkeld of gebruikt en zorgt ervoor dat de benodigde informatie volledig en actueel beschikbaar is. Daarnaast coördineer je risicoanalyses en impactanalyses van voorgenomen AI-toepassingen en adviseer je management en projectteams over de toelaatbaarheid, de mogelijke risico’s en de maatregelen die nodig zijn om deze risico’s te beperken. Naast deze procescoordinator en adviesrol fungeer je als aanspreekpunt voor studenten en medewerkers met vragen over AI-gebruik binnen de universiteit. Je beoordeelt en triageert binnenkomende vragen, zorgt voor een passende afhandeling en geeft duidelijke terugkoppeling aan de vraagsteller. Tegelijkertijd zorg je ervoor dat opgedane kennis en inzichten worden gedeeld binnen de organisatie, zodat ervaringen en best practices breder beschikbaar komen. Een belangrijk onderdeel van de functie is het vergroten van het AI-bewustzijn binnen de universiteit. Je initieert en coördineert activiteiten die studenten en medewerkers informeren over de AI-Act, de risico’s van AI-gebruik en de maatregelen die nodig zijn om AI verantwoord en veilig toe te passen. Daarbij organiseer je trainingen en ondersteun je bij het opbouwen van een netwerk van decentrale AI-contactpersonen die binnen hun eigen organisatieonderdeel als eerste aanspreekpunt kunnen fungeren. Je werkt hierin niet alleen. Samen met collega’s met expertise op het gebied van onder andere contractmanagement, privacywetgeving, security, juridische vraagstukken, copyright en techniek vorm je een virtuele AI-office. In nauwe samenwerking met dit netwerk zorg je voor een integrale aanpak van AI-vraagstukken binnen de universiteit en draag je bij aan een zorgvuldige, verantwoorde en transparante inzet van AI. Wie ben je Je beschikt over diverse vaardigheden. Je hebt en houdt overzicht en weet orde te scheppen waar dat nodig is. Je volgt vastgestelde processen, maar denkt wel mee met medewerkers en studenten over hoe ze die processen kunnen volgen en helpt ze op weg waar nodig en doet verbetervoorstellen. Je hebt een open persoonlijkheid en je kunt je communicatiestijl aanpassen voor je doel of gesprekspartner. Je kunt een opleiding of campagne organiseren en je werkt nauwgezet, zodat de registratie van algoritmen volledig is. Profiel HBO/ WO werk- en denkniveau NL en EN taal beide B2/C1 Relevante opleiding 4 jaar relevante werkervaring Ervaring met governance, audit, risk of compliance Heeft kennis van AI-Act, AI, LLM's, of in staat en bereid om daar op korte termijn kennis van op te doen Ons aanbod Fulltime/parttime functie voor minimaal 32 uren per week. Dienstverband in eerste instantie voor de periode van één jaar. Mogelijkheid tot vast dienstverband bij gebleken geschiktheid en resultaat Salaris tussen € 4.728,- en € 6.433,- bruto per maand bij een fulltime dienstverband, conform de cao Nederlandse Universiteiten en afhankelijk van opleiding en ervaring. Aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een dertiende maand, Keuzemodel Arbeidsvoorwaarden, interne opleidingsmogelijkheden en gratis toegang tot de sportfaciliteiten op de campus; zie ook onze <https://utwentecareers.nl/nl/ut-als-werkgever/arbeidsvoorwaarden/>). Informatie en aanmelding Voor informatie over deze vacature kan contact opgenomen worden met Henk Swaters (h.w.swaters@utwente.nl). Belangstelling voor deze functie kun je tot en met 14 november 2026 kenbaar maken door je sollicitatiebrief, voorzien van een actueel CV, te sturen via de button ‘solliciteren’. Screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure Over de organisatie De Dienst Library IT Support & Archive (LISA) biedt een breed palet van bibliotheek-, IT- en archiefdiensten voor 4.000 medewerkers en meer dan 12.000 studenten aan de Universiteit Twente. Door verschillende disciplines te combineren kunnen wij betere, efficiëntere diensten leveren aan alle mensen binnen onze universiteit die zich bezighouden met onderzoek, onderwijs en bedrijfsvoering. Hiermee helpen wij UT om als ‘people-first' technische universiteit bij te dragen aan een eerlijke, duurzame en digitale samenleving. Als werkgever biedt LISA werk dat ertoe doet. Wij rusten je toe om nieuwe mogelijkheden te creëren voor jezelf en voor onze samenleving. Je wordt bij ons deel van een toonaangevende technische universiteit met toenemende, positieve maatschappelijke impact. Dat is werken in een inspirerende omgeving dichtbij nieuwe ontwikkelingen. We bieden een open, inclusieve en ondernemende sfeer, waarin we je stimuleren om gezonde keuzes te maken, bijvoorbeeld via onze flexibele, aanpasbare arbeidsvoorwaarden.

items.desc: Vi söker dig som gör LIA inom digital marknadsföring och vill hjälpa oss bygga nästa version av Simflexitys marknadsföring. Inte bara skapa inlägg. Utan bygga systemet bakom. Simflexity är en svensk tech-startup på Södermalm i Stockholm. Vi bygger en plattform för restauranger och serviceföretag som samlar personal, schema, stämpling, tidrapportering och lön. Produkten har vi byggt sedan 2020. Nu vill vi ta nästa stora steg: Få betydligt fler att upptäcka den. Vad är uppdraget? Vi vill bli ett av företagen man hittar när man söker efter frågor kring: Schemaläggning Tidrapportering Stämpelklocka Lön Personalhantering Restaurangpersonal Onboarding Pay-on-Demand Framtidens arbetsliv På Google. I sociala medier. På YouTube. Och allt mer genom ChatGPT och andra AI-tjänster. Din LIA handlar om att tillsammans med oss ta reda på hur vi gör det. AI blir en stor del av arbetet Vi använder redan AI mycket. Men vi tror att vi bara har börjat. Vi vill undersöka hur AI kan hjälpa oss att: Hitta vad våra potentiella kunder söker efter Analysera konkurrenter Upptäcka nya SEO-möjligheter Skapa och förbättra innehåll Återanvända material mellan olika kanaler Analysera vad som faktiskt fungerar Hålla webbplatsen aktuell Identifiera potentiella leads Bygga AI-agenter och automatiserade marknadsflöden En fråga kommer återkomma under din LIA: Kan vi bygga något som gör delar av detta åt oss nästa gång? SEO & kunskap Vi har ett långsiktigt mål. Vi vill bygga en av Sveriges bästa kunskapskällor kring personalhantering för små och medelstora företag. När en restaurangägare undrar: “Hur fungerar semesterlön?” “Vilka regler gäller för personalliggare?” “Hur gör man ett bra schema?” “Behöver personalen stämpla ut på rast?” …vill vi att Simflexity ska vara ett av företagen de hittar. Du kommer bland annat få arbeta med: SEO Sökordsanalys Search intent Konkurrentanalys Artiklar och guider FAQ Internlänkning Uppdatering av befintligt innehåll AI search / GEO Google Search Console Vi vill inte massproducera generiska AI-artiklar. Vi vill skapa saker människor faktiskt har nytta av. Webbplatsen Simflexity.com utvecklas hela tiden. Du kommer vara med och förbättra den. Det kan handla om: Nya landningssidor Produktpresentationer Kundcase SEO Budskap CTA:er Konvertering FAQ Video Tester av olika upplägg Vi bygger. Publicerar. Mäter. Lär oss. Och ändrar igen. Sociala medier & video Vi behöver också bli mycket bättre på att visa vad vi faktiskt gör. Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook och YouTube är därför en viktig del av rollen. Men du kommer inte bara sitta på kontoret och skapa inlägg. Vi är ofta ute hos restauranger och caféer. Du får följa med. Träffa kunder. Prata med krögare. Filma. Hitta historier. Och omvandla verkligheten till innehåll. Det kan bli: Reels och TikToks Produktfilmer Kundintervjuer Före/efter Grundarvideos Tips Behind the scenes Skärminspelningar YouTube Shorts Vi tror mer på att visa än att påstå. Från uppmärksamhet till kund Likes är kul. Kunder är bättre. Därför vill vi förstå hela kedjan: Synlighet → intresse → besök → lead → demo → kund Du kommer få vara med och testa saker som: Landningssidor Guider Checklistor Nyhetsbrev Lead magnets Demo-flöden Kampanjer Olika CTA:er Kundrekommendationer Och sedan mäta vad som faktiskt fungerar. Ett exempel på en dag På förmiddagen analyserar du tillsammans med AI vilka frågor restaurangägare söker efter. Du hittar ett område där Simflexity borde synas bättre. Vi förbättrar en sida på webbplatsen. Efter lunch följer du med ut till en kund på Södermalm. Vi intervjuar ägaren och spelar in några korta videos. Tillbaka på kontoret gör vi material för TikTok, Instagram och LinkedIn. Sedan funderar vi: Kan vi bygga ett AI-flöde som automatiserar delar av det vi precis gjorde? Det är ungefär så vi vill arbeta. Vem söker vi? Du studerar exempelvis: Digital marknadsföring Growth marketing Sociala medier Content marketing Kommunikation E-commerce Och har en kommande LIA-period. Du behöver inte kunna allt ovan. Det vore orimligt. Men vi tror att du: Är väldigt nyfiken på AI Gillar att skapa Vågar testa saker Kan arbeta självständigt Gillar att förstå varför något fungerar Är bekväm med att lära dig nya verktyg Tycker om kombinationen kreativitet och data Vågar prata med människor Ett extra plus om du redan har testat något av: SEO, ChatGPT, Claude, TikTok, Reels, videoredigering, Google Analytics, Search Console, Meta Ads, Canva, Lovable eller andra AI-verktyg. Men nyfikenhet väger tyngre än en lång lista med verktyg på CV:t. Vad får du? Simflexity är ett litet team. Det betyder att du kommer nära produkten, kunderna och besluten. Du kommer jobba direkt tillsammans med grundaren och få stort utrymme att påverka hur vi bygger vår marknadsföring. Vi har inte en färdig manual som du ska följa. Det är en del av möjligheten. Vi vill testa oss fram tillsammans. När din LIA är slut vill vi att du ska kunna visa upp konkreta resultat: Videos du producerat Kundcase du skapat SEO-resultat …

items.desc: Vill du använda data och AI för att förbättra verksamheter som människor är beroende av varje dag? Hos Karlskoga Energi & Miljö får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten, med möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar kommer till användning. Vi har sedan något år tillbaka infört ett datadrivet arbetssätt och en data- och AI-plattform som vi utvecklar vidare. Nu vill vi stärka upp med ytterligare en person för att ta såväl arbetssätt som datakvalitet och teknik till nästa nivå. Din roll Du blir en del av funktionen AI & Digitalisering och arbetar nära kollegor inom OT/ automation, systemutveckling, IT och mätvärdesinsamling. Du kommer också bli en viktig resurs vid implementering av AI, där vi just nu gör en satsning inom machine learning och klustring i en av våra verksamheter. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Vidareutveckla vår data- och AI-plattform Förbättra arbetssätt för hur vi samlar in, bearbetar och använder data Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra dataflöden så att data blir tillförlitliga och användbara för analys och AI Analysera data och utveckla modeller, exempelvis för att upptäcka avvikelser, förstå mönster eller göra prognoser Presentera resultat och utveckla lösningar tillsammans med verksamheten, med fokus på praktisk nytta Bidra till vårt partnerskap med AI Sweden och omsätta nya kunskaper i vårt utvecklingsarbete Därför ska du välja oss: Utlopp för kreativitet: Du får vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för området tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Meningsfullhet: Ditt arbete gör skillnad för hela samhället – vi är motorn i Karlskogas infrastruktur. Variation: Hos oss får du jobba i en spännande, bred och varierad roll med stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter: Vi satsar på kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och ger dig utrymme att växa. Flexibelt arbete: Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till visst distansarbete. Vem är du? Du har relevant högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, statistik, matematik eller liknande Du har flera års arbetslivserfarenhet, där du har arbetat i hela kedjan från identifiering och insamling av data via validering, bearbetning och analys till visualisering och leverans av verksamhetsnytta Du har goda kunskaper inom SQL och SSIS eller motsvarande Du har erfarenhet av maskininlärning, statistisk modellering och dataanalys Du har erfarenhet av Python-programmering och implementering av AI Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av datamodellering Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Du kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och lösa uppgifter tillsammans med personer från andra funktioner och roller. Det är därför viktigt att du är prestigelös, gillar att samarbeta men att du också är självgående och tar egna initiativ. Det här är vi Vi är det lokala energibolaget i Karlskoga med cirka 200 medarbetare och en tydlig vision: Tillsammans ska vi bli Sveriges mest hållbara företag. Vi arbetar brett – från värme, el, ånga och biogas till vatten, avlopp, återvinning, renhållning och stadsnät. Genom våra cirkulära affärer vill vi skapa ett hållbart samhälle och en levande ort – både idag och för kommande generationer. Hos oss får du en arbetsplats med starkt samhällsengagemang, trevliga kollegor och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi värnar om balansen mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder bland annat: Friskvårdsbidrag och fria friskvårdsaktiviteter Arbetstidsförkortning Slopat karensavdrag vid sjukdom Gratis laddning av elbil Förmånlig ersättning vid föräldraledighet Anställningsform Tjänsten är tillsvidare och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt sett sex månaders provanställning. Ansök nu! Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens smarta och hållbara samhälle tillsammans med oss? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – urval sker löpande! Observera att säkerhetsprövning kan bli aktuell då delar av vår verksamhet omfattar skyddsobjekt och samhällskritisk infrastruktur. Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna Åsa Fallqvist, AI & Digitaliseringschef, på 0586-750 105 eller asa.fallqvist@karlskogaenergi.se Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Karlskoga Energi & Miljö är en kommunal verksamhet. Det innebär att din ansökan blir en offentlig handling när den kommit till oss och vi kan därför inte hantera ansökningar med sekretess.

items.desc: Join our Team Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them? At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks. About the Opportunity You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We explore what comes next across Ericsson’s full technology portfolio—from antennas and radio systems to cloud, and turn promising ideas into real-world solutions. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the capabilities to research, prototype, and build state-of-the-art mobile networks. Within this environment, you will collaborate with experienced researchers and product teams to prove new concepts, challenge established thinking, and help set the direction for future radio network products. You will be part of Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication research program, where we research, develop, and validate advanced ISAC systems for 5G and 6G. You will work with one of the world’s most experienced teams in this field, contributing to research that connects theory, experimentation, and product development. Your work will focus on radar sensing, signal processing, and tracking in challenging environments; including dense urban areas and complex sea-clutter scenarios. What you will do Conduct research in radar sensing, signal processing, detection, and tracking algorithms. Develop simulations and generate data for synthetic use cases focused on urban environments. Investigate methods for robust radar sensing and tracking in challenging urban scenarios. Explore extended-object radar trackers suitable for dense urban environments. Develop algorithms for tracking sea objects in the presence of dense sea clutter. Collaborate with product teams to integrate research results into Ericsson products in an efficient and optimized way. Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in sensing design and wireless communication. Generate intellectual property in the ISAC area. Share knowledge and communicate results with stakeholders across research and product development. Skills you bring A recently completed PhD, or equivalent research experience, focused on radar detection pipelines, signal processing, or related fields. Strong understanding of radar sensing and the characteristics of different sensors, including sensor artefacts such as phase noise. Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential. Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines. Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions. A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results. What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.We encourage you to consider applying to jobs where you might not meet all the criteria. We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more. Primary country and city: Sweden; Stockholm Primary Recruiter: Anitha Pulluru

It is important that you take great care in reading and answering these questions as we will not be able to revert your application if an error is made. Please Note: We only allow one application for any of our Graduate schemes per year. Any subsequent applications will be withdrawn. Data Science Graduate Scheme What do ex-grads say have to say about their time on the scheme? Jemima Clifford was asked what a typical day on the scheme looked like: ‘On the data science graduate scheme my day-to-day varied hugely! Sometimes it was a day full of problem solving and trying to fix one tricky bit of code that just didn't want to run. Sometimes I'd take the day to research a new modelling technique that I wanted to try, or I might have been on a training course learning a new coding language. Sometimes I'd be in the office and have a day full of meetings with stakeholders and colleagues where I’d get to present my work or listen to others share theirs. Or sometimes I’d have a quiet day working from home and just get my head down and tick off everything on my to-do list. Two days were rarely the same! ‘ Jemima rolled off the Data Science scheme into TfL's centralised data science team as an Associate Data Scientist, where she worked on text summarisation of survey data using a large language model (LLM), to save colleague time in manually summarising the survey results. After one year, she was successful in securing the role of Environment & Sustainability Data Manager, where she is responsible for improving data governance and analytical insights of TfL's carbon data to support carbon reduction. This was a new role created after the need for it was identified by a placement Jemima undertook working with environmental data demonstrated the need for this data to be managed properly - another success of the scheme! John Galve described what he learned on the scheme: ‘Being on the data science graduate scheme made me realise just how much is encapsulated in the different skills you need for the role. You need to have a good understanding of coding, mathematical reasoning, communicating your results to stakeholders of varying technical knowledge - the list goes on! It has been great to work on meaningful projects in which data can provide better insight for current and future decision making. The role is something that makes me feel challenged and want to help make a positive difference in how Transport for London keeps the city moving.’ John rolled off the Data Science scheme into TfL’s Streets & Network Operations data science team. He has worked on a variety of projects to improve the operation of London's road network, including the borough lane rental scheme, developing a bus route performance tool, and a bus route Graph Neural Network model to enable the more accurate mapping of bus routes. Salary £32,250 per annum increasing to £33, 500 in the second year Location London/Hybrid Hybrid working within this role enables a balance of 50 per cent of time split between the office and home over a four-week period. PURPOSE OF THE ROLE Fancy working on one of the largest media datasets in the world, helping the BBC model how audiences discover, consume and engage with content? The BBC is a major stakeholder in industry-leading audience measurement systems. Alongside this, our digital products—including iPlayer, Sounds, News and Sport—reach millions of people every week and generate billions of audience interactions. As a Data Scientist, you will develop statistical and machine learning models that help understand audience behaviour, improve audience measurement, and support strategic decision-making across the BBC. Working with a range of data sources, from digital behavioural data to audience panels and surveys, you'll deliver robust analysis that influences how the BBC measures success and plans for the future. WHY JOIN THE TEAM You'll join a team of around 12 Data Scientists working on a diverse range of modelling challenges. Our work spans audience measurement, forecasting, consumer behaviour, experimentation and applied machine learning. We work closely with data engineers, researchers, analysts and stakeholders across the BBC, giving you the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects with visible organisational value. You'll also be part of a wider data science community and have dedicated time to develop your technical skills, explore new approaches and contribute to best practice across the organisation. YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT: Apply statistical and machine learning techniques to answer business questions and improve understanding of audience behaviour, combining data from multiple sources including digital activity data, audience panels and surveys. Contribute to the design, development and evaluation of analytical models and solutions, working with senior data scientists and engineering partners to support project delivery and production deployment where appropriate. Develop reproducible analytical workflows using SQL, Python or R on our data and machine learning platform, including exploratory analysis and proof-of-concepts. Develop an understanding of the BBC and wider media landscape to contextualise models and analysis, and communicate findings, assumptions and recommendations appropriately to non-technical stakeholders. Keep up to date with developments in machine learning and generative AI, applying relevant techniques appropriately and contributing ideas for improving team practices. YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE ESSENTIAL CRITERIA: Further degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, econometrics or related field, or equivalent work experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience applying data science and statistical techniques to solve business problems by translating ambiguous business questions into practical analytical solutions and selecting appropriate methods, models or algorithms. Understanding of statistical inference, experimental design and causal reasoning, with the ability to analyse audience behaviours and preferences, distinguish meaningful patterns from statistical noise, and draw robust, evidence-based conclusions. Proven ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and confidently to stakeholders, adapting detail and recommendations to different audiences. Good programming skills in Python or R with version control (Git or others), alongside strong SQL skills for working with large datasets, including data preparation and validation. DESIRED BUT NOT REQUIRED: Experience in a commercial, research or consulting analytical role. Experience applying data science techniques to audience, consumer, marketing or media measurement problems. Experience working with audience behaviour data, digital activity data or related panel datasets, in a research, marketing, strategy or product environment. Experience building machine learning models to scale and deploying them into production. Experience writing clean, well-structured and maintainable code, with an understanding of software engineering best practices such as unit testing, test-driven development, version control and collaborative development using GitHub. items.desc: We are currently recruiting an AI and Digital Transformation Advisor to join our Quality, Impact and Innovation Department . This is a remote, 12-month position open to candidates based in the UK, or any Relief International country of operation within a +/- 4-hour difference from Central European Time (CET) . The role has a global remit and works across departments and country programmes to help shape how Relief International adopts and benefits from artificial intelligence and digital transformation. At Relief International, we are committed to building a representative, inclusive and authentic workplace. We strongly encourage applications from candidates from minoritized backgrounds and those who bring lived experience of the contexts in which we work. This role is classified as requiring standard pre-employment checks. About Relief International Relief International is an international non-profit organization that partners with communities impacted by conflict, climate change and disaster to save lives, build greater resilience and promote long-term health and wellbeing. Our team of more than 4,000 staff and local volunteers work across Africa, Asia and the Middle East, delivering Health and Nutrition, WASH (Water, Sanitation and Hygiene), Education and Livelihoods programming that creates the foundation for community resilience. We do this by working with local actors to develop safe, inclusive and evidence-based programming that is conflict-sensitive, climate-smart and responsive to community needs. About the Opportunity Artificial intelligence is transforming how organizations work, learn and make decisions. At Relief International, we see AI as an opportunity to strengthen humanitarian impact, improve efficiency, enhance knowledge sharing and support better decision-making across our global operations. The AI and Digital Transformation Advisor will lead the development and implementation of Relief International's AI strategy, helping departments identify practical opportunities where AI and digital tools can create meaningful value. Rather than acting as a technical implementer, you will serve as a strategic advisor, facilitator and change leader, supporting teams to adopt AI responsibly, effectively and sustainably. You will work closely with senior leaders, department heads, country directors and IT colleagues to develop an organizational roadmap for AI adoption, coordinate a portfolio of AI initiatives, strengthen staff capability and ensure that innovation remains aligned with organizational priorities, governance requirements and humanitarian principles. This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is passionate about the practical application of AI and digital transformation and wants to help shape how a global humanitarian organization leverages emerging technologies to better serve vulnerable communities around the world. Lead the development and continuous evolution of Relief International's AI and digital transformation strategy, translating organizational priorities into a practical roadmap of initiatives and opportunities. You'll collaborate with fellow graduates across the business, present your achievements and deliver a Business Impact Project with real business value, developing the confidence, experience and connections needed to accelerate your career at Siemens Mobility. Siemens Mobility is a global market leader in rail infrastructure, shaping the future of transportation through cutting edge technology, digital innovation, and sustainable engineering. items.desc: The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud , which is the core of the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing. We address stimulating new technological challenges. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals. Job description : The center is expanding its staff in one of its core areas: research cloud services. We seek an expert in the following areas: Distributed and concurrent systems SQL databases Software development for HPC environments Experience with Slurm, Kubernetes or OpenStack Software development experience using Go, C or C++ Container and virtualization technology Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience with Go, Kubernetes and distributed systems will be strongly preferred. The successful candidate will become part of the cloud team at the eScience Center. Tasks under the user cloud team include, but are not limited to: Designing, developing, and maintaining high-performance distributed systems and services. Integrating with HPC schedulers such as Slurm and container orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Participating in the full feature lifecycle, from requirements gathering and architectural design to coding, automated testing, deployment, and ongoing monitoring of production environments. The cloud team at the eScience Center currently consists of four employees with long expertise in building cloud computing infrastructure, programming and software engineering. Required qualifications for the position: Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description. Strong background in Linux systems. Programming skills (e.g. in Go, C, C++, bash, …). Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, supporting software and consulting with scientists. Other relevant qualifications (not required): MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering. Experience with DevOps practices (e.g. git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation). While the positions offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidates are expected to be on-site in Odense. Condition of Employment The starting date for the positions is 15 January 2027 or as soon as possible. Appointments are for full time positions for a limited time period of at least 1 year based on the candidate’s profile with the possibility of extension. All inquiries are welcome. Please contact: Dan Sebastian Thrane Team leader for Cloud Services SDU eScience Center Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science University of Southern Denmark Email: dthrane@imada.sdu.dk Or: Prof. Director Claudio Pica SDU eScience Center Dept. of Mathematics and Computer Science University of Southern Denmark email: pica@cp3.sdu.dk Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb. We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply. The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background. items.title: Embedded Engineer – Counter-UAS Systems
items.card: In this role, you will help design, build, and validate the embedded core of our drone detection systems from the ground up. The Role You will be responsible for developing the embedded side of our detection systems using edge compute platforms. This is a hands-on technical role that uniquely combines embedded software engineering, hardware evaluation, and real-world field validation. Rather than handing off your
items.desc: About Variene Variene develops advanced AI and computer vision software for defense and autonomous systems, designed to operate in demanding real-world environments. Our technology brings intelligent perception to platforms operating across ISR, autonomous systems, and other mission-critical defense applications. Our defence systems division is expanding into next-generation security, bringing intelligent perception and real-time processing to counter-unmanned aerial systems (C-UAS). We are building a dedicated counter-UAS team and are looking for both Junior and Senior Embedded Engineers to serve as our founding engineering hires. In this role, you will help design, build, and validate the embedded core of our drone detection systems from the ground up. The Role You will be responsible for developing the embedded side of our detection systems using edge compute platforms. This is a hands-on technical role that uniquely combines embedded software engineering, hardware evaluation, and real-world field validation. Rather than handing off your designs, you will own the lifecycle of the product—from bringing up sensors in the lab to testing the fully integrated system against live targets in the field. You will work closely with our mechanical design team and machine learning engineers to translate complex detection algorithms into a ruggedized, deployable, real-time physical system. What You'll Do Bring up advanced ADAS camera modules and sensor interfaces on Jetson-class edge compute hardware. Build, maintain, and optimize the real-time video processing and detection pipeline from camera input to system output. Deploy, optimize, and update deep learning detection models directly on edge devices. Evaluate and bench-test candidate ADAS camera modules against strict performance limits (range, target speed, temperature, vibration, and long-term maintenance). Prepare, deploy, and execute field test campaigns at defined operational distances, environmental backgrounds, and target motions. Collect, record, and analyze field data across varying hardware configurations to drive iterative software changes. Collaborate closely with mechanical design on the physical and structural integration of the C-UAS hardware. What We're Looking For Knowledge and Experience: 4+ years of professional experience, with a proven track record of leading embedded systems development and hands-on hardware evaluation. Deep knowledge of embedded systems development on Linux-based edge hardware (NVIDIA Jetson, Xavier, or equivalent). High proficiency in C or C++ combined with Python. Hands-on experience with camera interfaces, MIPI CSI, GMSL, and real-time video streaming pipelines. Experience deploying and optimizing neural network models on constrained edge hardware (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX). A professional background in automotive systems, specifically working with companies that develop (not just assemble) ADAS camera systems. Excellent written and spoken English. Ability and willingness to travel for outdoor field testing campaigns. Highly Valued Experience or an interest involving : Live field testing of sensors, hardware, or optical systems Drone piloting or UAV operations (commercial or hobbyist) Defence, aerospace, or C-UAS industries Ruggedized hardware standards and environmental testing Professional Profile We are looking for someone with: High ownership and an end-to-end engineering mindset Practical problem-solving skills in both lab and field environments Technical curiosity and a passion for cutting-edge edge-AI systems Structured, analytical thinking for hardware evaluation data Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills Persistence and resilience when troubleshooting hardware in the field What Success Looks Like Success is not measured by code commits alone. We expect you to build a reliable, field-proven detection system that performs flawlessly under real-world conditions. You will help Variene: Successfully benchmark and select the optimal ADAS camera hardware; Achieve low-latency, real-time video pipeline performance on edge devices; Build a seamless model deployment workflow from training to device; Run autonomous, reliable field test campaigns without needing separate field staff; Deliver a production-ready C-UAS system ready for deployment. What We Offer A founding engineering role with direct impact on Variene's next-generation defence product line. Exposure to state-of-the-art edge AI, computer vision, and counter-drone technologies. Direct collaboration with cross-functional engineering leadership. Significant technical autonomy over hardware selection, pipeline architecture, and test methodologies. Competitive compensation based on experience. Performance-related compensation. Job Type: Full-time Expected hours: 40.0 per week Work Location: Hybrid remote in Αθήνα

You'll bring deep expertise on Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift), and be keen to build on the other platform too, working across both apps as your skills grow. items.desc: About SmartRoutes: SmartRoutes builds route planning and optimisation software for last-mile delivery. Couriers, retailers and logistics teams use our platform to plan smarter routes, get drivers out the door faster and keep customers updated on every drop. We're based in the heart of Cork City and have grown quickly over the past eight four years. Our mobile apps sit at the sharp end of that product: they're what drivers rely on, all day, on the road. About the Role: We're looking for a native mobile developer to help build the next generation of our driver and customer apps. You'll bring deep expertise on Android (Kotlin) or iOS (Swift), and be keen to build on the other platform too, working across both apps as your skills grow. We also want someone who is genuinely curious about how AI is changing software development. We don't have a dedicated UI/UX designer, so you'll own the look and feel of our apps too, using AI to design, prototype and iterate. You'll use AI coding and design tools day to day, help us figure out where they make us faster and where they don't, and have the chance to build AI-powered features into the product itself. Responsibilities: Build and maintain native features in our mobile apps, from design handoff to release Work closely with our Tech Lead on architecture, performance and reliability, especially offline use, background location and battery life on the road Own UI/UX for our apps: work with product and drivers to understand real workflows, then design, prototype and refine screens using AI design tools (e.g. Figma AI, Claude, v0) and platform guidelines Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to speed up delivery, while owning the quality, security and correctness of what ships Write tests, review code and help shape our engineering and AI practices Monitor apps in production and troubleshoot issues using crash reporting, logs and metrics What we are looking for: 2+ years building and shipping native mobile apps Deep expertise in one native platform, Kotlin (Jetpack Compose, coroutines) or Swift (SwiftUI, async/await), and a genuine willingness to learn and ship on the other A strong eye for UI/UX and good knowledge of Material Design and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, with the confidence to make design decisions yourself A solid grasp of the mobile app lifecycle, background work, permissions and platform constraints Experience integrating REST APIs, push notifications (FCM / APNs) and local data storage Good knowledge of architecture patterns (MVVM, MVI or similar), dependency injection and testing Hands-on use of AI tools across both development and design, and good judgement about when to trust their output Comfort with Git, code review and CI/CD for mobile (e.g. GitHub Actions, Fastlane) Clear communication and a team-first attitude A Computer Science degree is welcome, but equivalent experience counts just as much. Nice to have: Some hands-on experience with your second platform, or with Kotlin Multiplatform Figma or similar design tools, and running quick usability tests with real users Maps, GPS and location-heavy apps (Google Maps / Mapbox SDKs, geofencing) Building with LLM APIs, or on-device ML (ML Kit, Core ML) Observability tools such as Firebase Crashlytics, Sentry or Datadog AWS or other cloud platforms, and a SaaS background Some Python or TypeScript for scripting and backend work Logistics, delivery or field-service products How we work with AI: We treat AI as part of the toolkit, not a replacement for engineering judgement. You'll have access to modern AI coding and design tools and the freedom to experiment with them. With no dedicated designer, AI is how you'll own UI/UX: generating concepts, prototyping flows and testing ideas with drivers quickly. We expect you to understand and stand behind every line you ship, whoever or whatever wrote the first draft. You don't need to be an AI expert. We care most that you're curious, keep learning and share what works with the team. How to apply: If you’re interested in learning more, please email a copy of your CV to careers@smartroutes.io

items.desc: Veeva’s Consultant Development Program (CDP) is an accelerated pathway that transforms early-career professionals into high-impact consultants who deliver cloud and AI solutions, helping global Life Sciences companies bring life-changing therapies to patients. We are hiring across Europe! At Veeva, you will work at one of our hubs to foster community and collaborative learning. Hubs include: Spain: Barcelona Germany: Frankfurt and Berlin United Kingdom: London Hungary: Budapest Poland: Warsaw, Wroclow, and Krakow To be eligible for the role you must be willing and able to relocate and work long-term at one of our hub locations. The Role You’ll work hands-on with innovative technology, collaborating directly with internal teams and external customers, implementing our products to solve complex business challenges. In this role, you’ll learn our industry-leading cloud platforms and work with cutting-edge AI solutions to transform how life sciences companies operate. Empowered from day one by a team-first culture, you will accelerate your career growth as a technical consultant who thrives in an environment where we work hard for our customers and each other. Start Dates: April 2027 and September 2027 The Program As part of the Consultant Development Program, you will: Ramp up quickly. Your journey begins with an intensive, team-based onboarding program that combines hands-on learning, transparent feedback, and active collaboration to develop the consulting skills and industry knowledge to make an impact right away. Learn by doing. You won't be watching from the sidelines. You will take on real responsibility and work directly with customers to solve problems within your first three months. Thrive together. Grow alongside a supportive team of seasoned leaders and peers who actively champion your development through open communication and actionable feedback. Build your future. Advance from Associate to Consultant in less than 2 years. More importantly, you’ll develop the foundation for a successful, long-term career where you can continually expand your technical expertise, lead complex projects, and evolve with our global and diverse team. What You'll Do As part of our Professional Services team, you are a strategic partner guiding customers through implementation. We will teach you how our software works, and you will use that knowledge to design, configure, and deliver solutions that drive real business value. Your day-to-day will involve: Designing & tailoring the software: You will lead the configuration of our platform to fit each customer's unique business model—setting up workflows, structuring data, and aligning system capabilities to requirements. items.desc: We’re Heidi. We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties. Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart. We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again. We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years. To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund. If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in. The role We’re looking for a doctor who has moved into AI and can code, to join Clinical AI R&D as a Clinical AI Engineer. You’ll sit inside a product pod and own the evidence for its product: define the evaluation before anyone builds, run it to a standard a journal reviewer would accept, keep watching the product once it ships, publish what the evidence shows, and change the product when the evidence says to. The pod’s engineers can change the product but can’t judge whether a discharge summary missed something a consultant would catch. Clinicians can make that call but can’t open a pull request. You do both, and you treat the gap between a model’s output and good clinical practice as the thing you’re here to measure and close. The loop doesn’t end at launch. You stay with the product for its life in market. What You’ll Do Design the evaluation. Define evaluations for greenfield products to an academic standard: endpoints, comparators, ground truth, sample size, analysis plan. Set the bar before the result arrives. Build the measurement. Build, optimize and validate the LLM judges and rubrics that score the product at scale. Report their agreement with clinician ground truth, not their convenience, and retire the ones that drift. Run it and write it up. Execute the evaluation, do the statistics, and write it up once in a form that serves the pod, the regulatory file and an academic submission. Run post-market surveillance. Monitor output quality in production and respond to regulatory feedback with data. Our clinical safety team triages complaints and incidents; you’re their counterpart in the pod, working out what their findings mean for the product and what should change. Fix what the evidence finds. Prompt and rubric changes, evaluation harness changes, code changes in the pod’s codebase, shipped through the pod’s normal review and release process. Publish. Contribute to peer-reviewed literature on the translational benefit of the product. Be the clinician in the room. Catch the output that reads well and is wrong. Hold the line on clinical nuance when a shortcut would ship faster. What You'll Need A medical degree and clinical practice with independent clinical judgment. This role runs on medical nuance, and this requirement doesn’t flex. Academic depth. Study design, inferential statistics, agreement and reliability measures, sample size, handling of multiple comparisons. Thesis or publication-level work, not a methods module. Experience evaluating medical software or clinical AI, including building or validating LLM-as-judge pipelines. Enough engineering to work in a production codebase. Read it, understand what a change will do, make the change in Python or TypeScript, and get it through review. Prompt engineering and AI-assisted coding are daily tools here, and they’re the floor, not the ceiling. Independence. You can run a project for weeks with light direction, and you say early when it’s stuck. Clear writing. Evaluation reports, surveillance summaries and manuscripts are the primary output of this role. Nice to have Post-market surveillance or vigilance work under a medical device framework (TGA, MHRA, FDA or EU MDR). Appetite to learn counts for more than existing depth. Peer-reviewed publications on clinical AI or LLM evaluation. Machine learning background beyond prompting, such as fine-tuning or classical model evaluation. Specialty depth in an area Heidi is moving into. An academic or clinical-site network able to host a study. How We Show Up Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism. Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems …

items.desc: La Direction Générale de la Sécurité Extérieure, DGSE, recrute un Applied AI Engineer, LLM Infra(H/F). Le poste est situé à Paris. La nationalité française est obligatoire. Domaine métier Sciences et Technologies Votre environnement de travail Intégré au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous participez au développement de produits d’IA Générative multi-agents basés sur différents Large Language Models (LLM) pour répondre aux besoins de l’ensemble des agents. Vous sélectionnez, adaptez, évaluez et déployez des LLMs en collaboration avec les autres Applied AI Engineers, Fullstack, Data Engineers, et SRE de l’équipe. Les applications déployées permettront à nos analystes en renseignement d’exploiter plus rapidement de grandes quantités de données et d’en extraire des informations pertinentes pour le renseignement opérationnel. Leurs métiers ainsi que ceux de la direction technique et de l’innovation s’en verront transformés. L’équipe dispose d’un excellent environnement pour adapter ces modèles aux besoins de la DGSE : accès à d’importants volumes de données pour l’apprentissage et mise à disposition d’infrastructures informatiques dédiées (clusters GPU d’entrainement et d’inférence), partenariats avec des laboratoires de recherche et startups. L’équipe mène aussi des activités de recherche afin de maintenir une connaissance de l’état de l’art sur les thématiques d’intérêt, ainsi que sur les technologies, approches et outils et propose de nouveaux cas d’usage pouvant avoir un fort impact sur le métier. Vos missions Vous serez en charge des activités suivantes : participer à l’interconnexion des produits aux sources de données internes, aux autres outils et fonctionnalités (MCP Server, …), participer au stream GenAI Enablement en mettant à disposition des APIs et bibliothèques permettant de rendre accessible l’IA Générative au plus grand nombre, apporter une expertise aux initiatives locales et spécialisées sur un besoin, prendre part à la spécification, à l’implémentation et au maintien en condition opérationnelle des produits, services ou procédés que l’équipe développe et maintient, prendre part à la spécification, à l’implémentation et au maintien en condition opérationnelle du socle MLOps (Langfuse, MLFlow, DVC, …) intervenir sur les phases de mise en production d’un LLM (évaluation, fine-tune, déploiement, suivi des performances du modèle), s’informer des avancées scientifiques dans le domaine d’intérêt de l’équipe, mais aussi et surtout proposer des approches novatrices permettant de répondre aux besoins du Service Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau bac+5 ou doctorat avec une spécialisation en mathématiques appliquées, informatique, data science ou apprentissage automatique. Vous avez un profil junior, confirmé ou senior. Vous possédez les compétences et qualités suivantes : vous êtes apte au travail en équipe, vous êtes curieux de nature, autonome et proactif, vous avez un bon relationnel et une capacité à adapter votre discours à vos interlocuteurs, vous maîtrisez Python, vous disposez de bonnes compétences en sécurité, APIs, vous avez de bonnes connaissances en Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, vous êtes passionné par les nouvelles technologies, vous avez une forte appétence pour les LLM. Les plus de l’offre Technologies à la pointe Missions uniques Absence de routine L’IA générative transforme nos métiers, nos usages, nos pratiques. Nos adversaires adoptent et tirent parti de ces nouveaux outils. Rejoignez-nous et participez à cette révolution d’ampleur en donnant un sens à votre métier !. Le poste est soumis à l’obtention d’une habilitation. L’accès au téléphone et à Internet pour un usage personnel est réglementé. Vos avantages à rejoindre la DGSE La satisfaction de travailler pour votre pays et la défense de ses valeurs Plus de 1000 formations linguistiques et thématiques Nombreuses activités culturelles et sportives Restaurants et points de vente à emporter fait maison 48 à 50 jours de congés annuels Pour connaître les autres avantages, consultez notre site sur https:// www.dgse.gouv.fr /fr/la-dgse/nos-actualites/rejoindre-la-dgse-de-nombreux-atouts-au-quotidien Contact Envoyez-nous votre candidature à l’adresse : dgse-macandidature.cer.fct@intradef.gouv.fr Restez discret sur votre candidature : évitez d'en parler à votre entourage et n'affichez pas votre souhait de rejoindre la DGSE sur vos réseaux sociaux. Plus d’information sur www.dgse.gouv.fr > Nous rejoindre.

items.desc: PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here PATH is a global nonprofit dedicated to achieving health equity. With more than 40 years of experience forging multisector partnerships and with expertise in science, economics, technology, advocacy, and dozens of other specialties, PATH develops and scales up innovative solutions to the world’s most pressing health challenges. About AI For Health PATH’s Artificial Intelligence (AI) Initiative is our flagship technical team working across divisions to deliver best-in-class evaluation and implementation of AI in health, spanning model evaluation to product development and service innovation. We aim to use AI to address the world’s largest health inequities. We’re looking for an early career researcher to help deliver a multi-country programme evaluating whether AI can provide safe and effective mental health/wellbeing support for those most in need. You will contribute to research to test and improve how automated evaluation methods (e.g., patient simulation, LLM-judging) reflect people and languages in different settings, and to make effective use of local clinicians and lived experience input. A key part of the role will be undertaking a fully-funded PhD (supervised by PATH’s Chief AI Officer and Professor at University College London, Dr. Bilal Mateen, and co-supervised by the relevant technical leadership at PATH and UCL), investigating how we can most effectively and efficiently use human expertise and local data to deliver accurate and localised evaluation of AI performance across different languages and contexts. The role is a strong fit for an evaluation science or computational researcher who wants to shape how AI is assessed across settings and earn a PhD through that work as a route into AI safety and global (mental) health. Responsibilities: There won’t be a typical day in this role. You could be doing anything from drafting a protocol for a new study to organising a consensus workshop with partners from around the world or running in-silico experiments and analysing data generated by our partners. If you thrive on tinkering with tools, independently playing around with a task/problem, and having a team that supports you in failing fast and learning a lot, then this is the role for you. Support Research Delivery and Operations across the Programme We’ll carve out a specific set of partners and tasks (aligned with your PhD topic) whom you will be the primary point of contact for, spanning operational and technical needs (as summarised below). Your job will be to make sure those elements of the grant-funded projects we’re collaborating on with our partners happen as planned. Support the AI for Health team’s research agenda: contribute technical input as the team and its partners design, run, and analyse evaluation studies, including developing and testing simulated users/patients and LLM-judges and running evaluations of AI models and products. Work with the Deputy Director of Operations and Finance and their team on the operational, administrative, and project management components of research delivery, including ethics and governance submissions, partner reporting, and workplan tracking. Develop Your Research Skills Complete a fully funded PhD at University College London as the core vehicle for developing your research skills. Under the guidance of your supervisors, conceive, design, and carry out the studies that make up your thesis, which will address how human expertise and local data can most effectively and efficiently be used to deliver accurate and localised evaluation of AI performance across different languages and contexts. Topics could include: Analysing what clinicians and lived experience experts in different countries consider to be helpful and harmful AI behaviour: what is shared between contexts, what is local to individual settings, how much different experts agree/disagree, and how plurality of opinion can be represented in our evaluations. Developing and adapting automated evaluation methods to reflect how people in each setting talk about their mental health and seek support from AI, including in local languages and where people mix languages. Studying how to make the most of scarce expert time and local data: which ways of collecting expert feedback and data improve our evaluation tools most efficiently, and how much ongoing human input we need to stay reliable. Contribute to studies led by other members of the AI for Health team, and to the development of the team’s wider research agenda, whilst building your own methodological and technical skills over the course of the post, with the support of your supervisors. This is a full-time post based in London, combining research delivery at PATH with registration for a PhD at University College London, fully funded for three years. You’ll report to PATH’s Deputy Director for AI for Health, and your PhD will be jointly supervised by leadership at PATH and UCL. The role …

About The Role Intermedia is looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI Data Science team. In this role, you will develop and apply advanced machine learning, generative AI, and statistical techniques to improve the intelligence, effectiveness, and reliability of Intermedia's digital agents. You will work on challenging problems involving large language models, retrieval, agent behavior, experimentation, evaluation, and optimization to help create digital agents that can understand customer needs, access relevant knowledge, and successfully complete complex tasks. You will work closely with AI/ML engineers, software engineers, product managers, and other data scientists to take ideas from experimentation through production. You will have significant ownership of data science solutions while helping establish strong practices for measuring and continuously improving the quality of our AI-powered experiences. What You Will Be Doing Machine Learning & Agent Intelligence Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning and generative AI solutions that power Intermedia's Digital Agent Platform. Apply large language models (LLMs), natural language processing, retrieval, and other advanced AI techniques to improve agent understanding and performance. Develop approaches that improve agent reasoning, tool selection, knowledge retrieval, context management, personalization, and task completion. Experiment with model, prompt, retrieval, and agent configuration strategies to identify approaches that deliver the best customer and business outcomes. Evaluate commercial and open-source models and recommend appropriate approaches based on quality, latency, scalability, and cost. Generative AI & RAG Design, develop, and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions that ground digital agents in relevant enterprise and customer information. Develop and evaluate embeddings, retrieval strategies, ranking approaches, semantic search, and other knowledge-retrieval techniques. Build and refine end-to-end pipelines that combine LLMs with retrieval systems, enterprise knowledge sources, and agent workflows. Develop approaches to improve the relevance, accuracy, and consistency of AI-generated responses. Identify and mitigate issues such as hallucinations, poor retrieval, inappropriate responses, and other failure modes in generative AI applications. Evaluation & Experimentation Develop rigorous evaluation frameworks for measuring digital agent quality, including accuracy, relevance, task completion, reliability, safety, and customer experience. Design offline and online experiments to compare models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent configurations, and other AI approaches. Apply statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, segmentation, and other quantitative methods to evaluate AI performance and identify opportunities for improvement. Define appropriate metrics and benchmarks that connect model and agent performance to customer and business outcomes. Analyze production behavior and feedback to identify patterns, failure modes, and opportunities to continuously improve digital agents. Ensure data and model quality through comprehensive testing, validation, and performance evaluation. Data & Solution Development Gather, preprocess, analyze, and model large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources. Use Python, SQL, Spark, and other relevant technologies to build scalable analytical and machine learning solutions. Develop features, datasets, and analytical approaches that support model development, experimentation, and evaluation. Partner with data and engineering …

items.desc: Akkodis è un leader globale nel mercato dell'ingegneria e della ricerca e sviluppo, che mira ad accelerare l'innovazione e la trasformazione digitale utilizzando la forza dei connected data. Con la passione per la tecnologia e il talento, il gruppo, composto da più di 40.000 ingegneri ed esperti digitali e con un fatturato di €4bn, offre una profonda esperienza intersettoriale in 28 paesi tra Nord America, EMEA e APAC. Akkodis vanta un’esperienza quarantennale e un forte know-how in settori tecnologici chiave come la mobilità, i servizi software e tecnologici, la robotica, i test, le simulazioni, la sicurezza dei dati, l'intelligenza artificiale e l'analisi dei dati. La combinazione di competenze informatiche e ingegneristiche porta a un'offerta unica di soluzioni end-to-end, con quattro linee di servizio - Consulting, Solutions, Talents e Academy - per supportare i clienti nel ripensare ai loro processi di sviluppo prodotto e di business, migliorare la produttività, ridurre al minimo il time-to-market e dare forma a un domani più smart e sostenibile. La divisione Automotive e Transportation è leader in Italia nello sviluppo dei veicoli software-defined vehicles, guidando l’innovazione verso requisiti, operazioni e funzionalità completamente gestite da software. Forniamo soluzioni avanzate per la connettività dei veicoli, attraverso lo sviluppo di infrastrutture, il monitoraggio intelligente, l’IoT e l’architettura cloud, senza dimenticare l’attenzione alla sicurezza informatica nello sviluppo di applicazioni end-to-end. Nell’ottica di un potenziamento della divisione, ricerchiamo una figura di: Machine Learning Engineer Entra a far parte della nostra divisione Automotive e Transportation, un gruppo di oltre 300 consulenti che operano in Italia e circa 8.000 a livello globale. La nostra forza è da sempre l’integrazione delle nostre competenze, che ci permettono di avere una visione a 360° del mondo Auto. Quale sarà il tuo contributo in Akkodis? Per un importante progetto di innovazione tecnologica, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Machine Learning & MLOps Engineer con esperienza nello sviluppo e nella messa in produzione di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Deep Learning. Cerchiamo una persona che sappia trasformare modelli e prototipi di Data Science in applicazioni robuste, scalabili e pronte per ambienti enterprise Principali attività: Progettare, sviluppare e validare modelli di Machine Learning e Deep Learning. Gestire attività di data preprocessing, feature engineering e analisi avanzata dei dati. Implementare pipeline MLOps automatizzate per training, testing e deployment. Ottimizzare modelli per ambienti di produzione e scenari real-time. Sviluppare framework, librerie e API per l'integrazione delle soluzioni ML. Monitorare performance, qualità e deriva dei modelli in esercizio. Collaborare con Data Scientist, Software Engineer e System Engineer per la realizzazione di soluzioni end-to-end. About you Requisiti per iniziare il tuo percorso di crescita: Hai una laurea magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica o similari e hai maturato una esperienza di 3 anni in Machine Learning, Deep Learning o MLOps Potrai entrare nel team Automotive e Transportation, seguire progetti diversi e conoscere varie realtà lavorando in trasferta sul territorio. items.desc: Befristung: 3 Jahre Beginn: 01.01.2027 Standort: Kaiserslautern Umfang: Vollzeit Vergütung: Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L Fachbereich: Maschinenbau und Verfahrenstechnik Die Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU) ist mit rund 15.000 Studierenden, mehr als 300 Professuren und rund 160 Studiengängen die Technische Universität des Landes Rheinland-Pfalz. Als Ort internationaler Spitzenforschung bietet sie exzellente Arbeitsbedingungen und Karrierechancen. Wer an der RPTU lernt, forscht oder arbeitet, erlebt ein weltoffenes Umfeld und gestaltet die Zukunft. Die rasante Entwicklung von Lithium-Ionen-Batterien stellt zunehmend höhere Anforderungen an die Reinheit und Qualität der eingesetzten Materialien. Bereits sehr geringe Mengen partikulärer Verunreinigungen können die Leistung, Sicherheit und Lebensdauer von Batterien beeinträchtigen. Gemeinsam mit einem führenden Hersteller von Batterie-Elektrolyten und einem Unternehmen für Inline-Partikelmessungen sollen in diesem Projekt kritische partikuläre Verunreinigungen in Batterie-Elektrolyten identifiziert und experimentell charakterisiert sowie ein innovatives Adsorber-Filter-System zu deren zuverlässiger Entfernung entwickelt werden. Ihr Aufgabengebiet: Sie werden die partikulären Verunreinigungen physikalisch-chemisch charakterisieren und ihre Wechselwirkungen mit Trennmedien sowie ihre gezielte Abscheidung untersuchen. Auf dieser Grundlage werden Sie maßgeschneiderte Trennprozesse mit hoher Abscheideeffizienz entwickeln. Die Mikrostruktur der Trennmedien wird mithilfe einer Kombination aus Experimenten, numerischen Simulationen und KI-gestützter Prozessanalyse der Strömungs-, Adsorptions- und Filtrationsprozesse optimiert. Ziel des Projekts ist es, die wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen für eine zuverlässige Prozesskontrolle bei der Herstellung hochreiner Elektrolyte zu schaffen und damit zur Entwicklung stabiler, effizienter und langlebiger Batteriezellen beizutragen. Unser Anforderungsprofil: Einschlägiges, erfolgreich abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium Überdurchschnittlicher Universitätsabschluss: Diplom/Master in Verfahrenstechnik Motivation für ein anspruchsvolles Projekt mit experimental-physikalischem Charakter Erfahrungen in Filtration, Adsorption und/oder Partikelcharakterisierung sowie im Handling mit Chemikalien sind erwünscht Wir bieten: Gesundheitsförderung Familien-Service-Stelle Berufliche Weiterbildung Flexibles Arbeiten Jobticket Altersvorsorge Sport & Fitness Kultur & Freizeit Naherholung im Pfälzerwald Die RPTU steht für die Vielfalt aller Beschäftigten. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen Interessierten, unabhängig von deren ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Alter, Religion, Geschlecht, Behinderung und sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Schwerbehinderte und diesen gleichgestellte behinderte Menschen werden bei entsprechender Qualifikation und Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt (bitte der Bewerbung einen Nachweis über die Schwerbehinderung/Gleichstellung beifügen). Die RPTU strebt in Bereichen, in denen Frauen unterrepräsentiert sind, eine Erhöhung des Frauenanteils an. Bewerbungen von Wissenschaftlerinnen und Wissenschaftlern aus dem Ausland sind ausdrücklich erwünscht. Die Stelle ist grds. auch in Teilzeit besetzbar. Ihre Bewerbung: Wir freuen uns über Ihre aussagekräftige Bewerbung (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, usw.) bis spätestens 26.10.2026. Bitte reichen Sie Ihre Bewerbung über den unten stehenden Button „Online Bewerbung“ bzw. über unser Bewerbungsportal ( https://jobs.rptu.de ) ein. Bei Fragen wenden Sie sich bitte an Prof. Dr.-Ing. Sergiy Antonyuk (E-Mail: sergiy.antonyuk@mv.rptu.de ). Research Associate (m/f/d) in a research project “AI-Assisted Process Control for Ultra-Pure Electrolytes” Term limitation: 3 Years Beginning: 01.01.2027 Location: Kaiserslautern Scope: Full time Remuneration: Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L Administration and Services: Mechanical and Process Engineering With about 15,000 students, more than 300 professorships and around 160 degree programs, the RPTU University Kaiserslautern-Landau is the technical university of the state of Rhineland-Palatinate. As a place of top international research, it offers excellent working conditions and career opportunities. Those who study, research or work at RPTU experience a cosmopolitan environment and shape the future. The rapid development of lithium-ion batteries is placing increasingly high demands on the purity and quality of the materials used. Even very small amounts of particulate contaminants can affect battery performance, safety, and lifetime. In cooperation with a leading manufacturer of battery electrolytes and a company specializing in in line particle measurements, this project aims to identify and experimentally characterize critical particulate contaminants in battery electrolytes and develop an innovative adsorber–filter system for their reliable removal. items.card: About the role: Join our Data Science team and help shape the product recommendation experience at Redcare Pharmacy. You will work at the intersection of product, data, and technology, helping customers discover relevant products across our webshop and app. About the tech stack: Our technology landscape includes Databricks, Python, Spark, Machine Learning, Experimentation & Analytics Frameworks, SQL, MLOps, Git,
items.desc: About Redcare Pharmacy: As Europe’s No.1 e-pharmacy Redcare Pharmacy is powered by passionate teams and cutting-edge innovation. We strive to create a healthy collaborative work environment where every employee feels valued and inspired to contribute to our vision “Until every human has their health”. If you’re seeking a career that offers purpose and aligns with your values join us and start your #Redcareer today. About the role: Join our Data Science team and help shape the product recommendation experience at Redcare Pharmacy. You will work at the intersection of product, data, and technology, helping customers discover relevant products across our webshop and app. About the tech stack: Our technology landscape includes Databricks, Python, Spark, Machine Learning, Experimentation & Analytics Frameworks, SQL, MLOps, Git, CI/CD, Azure. Job Description About your tasks: Improve product recommendations in our webshop and app, analysing customer behaviour and product data to make recommendation widgets more relevant and useful. Develop and refine recommendation models, engineering relevant features and applying state-of-the-art machine learning approaches. Work on end-to-end Data Science initiatives, partnering closely with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Engineers, ML Ops, and domain experts to translate product questions into hypotheses and practical improvements. Design, analyse, and interpret A/B tests to measure the impact of recommendation changes. Define success metrics and guardrails, assess statistical uncertainty, and turn results into clear recommendations for the product team. Contribute across the full project lifecycle, from data exploration and experimentation through to implementation, productionizing, monitoring, and continuous improvement, with support from your colleagues. Qualifications About you: You have practical experience developing machine learning models, including data preparation, feature engineering, modelling, and evaluation. You have strong Python and SQL skills and write clear, structured code that others can work with. You are familiar with Git and practices such as testing and reproducible development. You understand how to develop models for production, including reproducible training, reliable data pipelines, and the trade-offs between model quality, scalability, and maintainability. You have practical expertise in A/B testing and experimental design, including metric selection, statistical power, and interpreting results. You have a solid understanding of recommendation systems and relevant machine learning approaches, such as collaborative filtering, ranking models, or embeddings. You enjoy working iteratively in a cross-functional product team, translating business goals into workable solutions, delivering improvements in manageable steps, and refining models based on experiment results and production performance. Additional Information About your benefits: In order to provide you with the best possible support for your individual needs - whether it‘s living a healthy life, having enough time for your family, or developing your skills - we offer a wide range of different, site-specific benefits: Work from Home: If your job does not require you to be present in the office, we can arrange the place you work from individually - even for up to 20 days a year anywhere in the EU. Personal development: Grow! We support and encourage your individual development through various in- and external trainings. Vacation: 30 days paid vacation per annum (plus another day on Rosenmontag) and the option to take unpaid vacation of up to 10 days (after one year working with us). Sports: Stay healthy. Profit from a membership (M) package at Urban Sports Club, so that you can take advantage of a huge variety of sport offers. Redcare events: We promote teambuilding through creative team events, and celebrate our successes together at regularly scheduled parties.
