items.desc: About HappyRobot HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide. Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto. About The Role You’ll be building AI models that make human-like conversations possible. You’ll work at the intersection of speech, language, and intelligence, taking cutting-edge research and transforming it into real-time, scalable systems that power our core products. You’ll have the unique opportunity to make a huge impact as one of our first ML hires, shaping not only the technology but also the direction of our company. From designing robust models to deploying them in production, you’ll own the entire lifecycle of ML systems and help us stay ahead of the curve in AI innovation. About The Role Design, build, and maintain scalable ML systems — from data ingestion and preprocessing to training, testing, and deployment. Develop and optimize end-to-end ML pipelines (data collection, labeling, training, validation, monitoring) to ensure reliability and reproducibility. Implement robust MLOps practices, including model versioning, experiment tracking, CI/CD for ML, and continuous monitoring in production. Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate and deploy models into real-time products with a focus on efficiency and scalability. Ensure data quality, observability, and performance across all AI systems. Stay current with the latest in AI infrastructure, tooling, and research — helping us stay ahead of the curve. Must Have Strong experience in machine learning, deep learning, and NLP. Solid background in MLOps and data pipelines — e.g., model deployment, monitoring, and scaling in production environments. Proficiency in Python and familiarity with Go. Experience with ML lifecycle management tools (e.g., MLflow, Kubeflow, Weights & Biases). Ability to design ML systems for robustness, scalability, and automation. Strong coding, debugging, and data engineering skills. Passion for AI infrastructure and its real-world impact. Founder mindset: ownership, independence, and willingness to go deep. Nice to Have Experience in speech recognition, TTS, or audio processing. Familiarity with LLMs, generative AI, or real-time inference systems. Hands-on experience with data orchestration frameworks (e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster). Prior experience in startup environments with fast iteration cycles. Knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP/Azure) and containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes). Why join us? Join a world-class team of engineers and builders. Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo. Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship. Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage. Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup. Our Operating Principles Extreme Ownership We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us. Craftsmanship Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching. We are “majos” Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego. Urgency with Focus Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our …

items.desc: Job Title: Networks AI & Data Science Professional Req ID: 63444 Job Function: Data & AI Posting Start Date: 14/10/2026 Posting End Date: 21/10/2026 Division: Networks Job Location: GBR Belfast - Riverside Tower, GBR Bristol - Assembly, GBR Ipswich - Adastral Hub, GBR-Birmingham-Three Snowhill, GBR-London-BTHQ One Braham Advertised Salary: Competitive, with great BT benefits! Hybrid 3 days a week together out of our London, Birmingham or Bristol, or Ipswich offices (flexible 2 days remote wherever). About The Role Join the Networks Data & AI team as a Data Science & AI Professional and help turn complex network data into practical products, insights and services that improve decision-making across BT Group. You’ll take a hands-on role in designing and building scalable data products using machine learning and artificial intelligence. Your work will support areas including live network monitoring, network investment, predictive maintenance and the development of services that improve customers’ day-to-day experience. Working alongside data and AI engineers, senior engineering managers, product owners and architects, you’ll translate complex business needs into robust solutions. You’ll also collaborate with teams across BT Group and Research, helping to shape the data capabilities that underpin the future of BT’s fixed and mobile networks. What You’ll Be Doing Design and build innovative data products that turn complex business and network needs into scalable solutions. Extract and analyse large datasets using data science and AI techniques, generating insights that support business decisions and new products and services. Develop and apply machine learning and AI models to areas including network investment and predictive maintenance. Identify opportunities to solve complex problems and create value across fixed and mobile networks. Work closely with data and AI engineers to integrate machine learning models into data pipelines and platforms. Champion effective approaches to data science, machine learning, artificial intelligence and analytics. Monitor relevant technology and market developments, sharing useful knowledge and practices with colleagues. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders through data visualisation and reporting. Essential Skills / Experience Strong practical capability in mathematics, statistics and data science, including analysing very large datasets and performing complex statistical transformations. Experience using Python or R and SQL, together with common data science libraries, to develop analytical solutions that address real business needs. Yet, diagnosing them still takes days, often leaving doctors to prescribe antibiotics without knowing exactly what they're treating. We're changing that. At BugSense, we're combining paper-based diagnostics with intelligent software to identify pathogens, quantify bacterial load, and detect antibiotic resistance, all within a single working day. Our mission? Make precise diagnostics accessible wherever treatment decisions are made. 1.2M€ EXIST FUNDING · 3 PATENT FAMILIES · 4-IN-1 DIAGNOSTICS · 1 DAY TIME TO RESULT ROLE DESCRIPTION As our Founding Software & AI Engineer, you'll take ownership of the entire software ecosystem behind our diagnostic platform: from computer vision and AI to backend, user interfaces, and hardware integration. Your mission is to turn our research technology into a reliable, scalable, and commercially viable medical device. You'll work directly with the founding team, drive technical decisions, and shape how BugSense builds software as the company grows. Establish scalable architecture, testing, documentation, and development processes aligned with medical device requirements. WHAT YOU BRING Must-haves Master Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, AI, or a related field OR equivalent practical experience Strong Python skills and experience building real-world software applications Hands-on experience with computer vision and machine learning Understanding of backend development, APIs, and software architecture Ability to take ownership, solve problems independently, and think beyond individual features An entrepreneurial mindset. You care about building a product, not just writing code Nice-to-haves Frontend or mobile app development C/C++, embedded systems, or hardware integration Cloud/on-premises deployment, CI/CD, or MLOps Medical device software, IEC 62304, or regulated development environments Experience taking technology from prototype to commercial product WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN BUGSENSE Real ownership. Entrepreneurial freedom. Work closely with the founders and influence technology, product strategy, and key decisions. Meaningful impact. Help improve infection diagnostics and tackle antibiotic resistance. Room to grow. Take on increasing technical and strategic responsibility as the company scales. Strong foundation. Join a funded MedTech startup with patented technology and established clinical collaborations. READY TO BUILD WITH US? We're looking for someone who wants to build more than software. We offer careers and roles in just about every area you can think of. Whether you are looking for entry-level, mid-career or roles at the top of your chosen specialism, we can offer you a career where you can flourish and make a real difference in the communities around us while contributing to the world at large. Our people come from a wide range of backgrounds, each bringing their abilities and experiences to our organisation. The University isn’t just any employer. We are part of a local community and a contributor to global thinking, progress and research. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices. Join the University of Edinburgh and you’ll be making a difference to everything around you. Be part of something bigger — where you’ll do meaningful work, grow and progress, be rewarded and recognised, and benefit from our strong commitment to your wellbeing. There are so many reasons to join us. Applications are invited for an Epidemiologist/ Health Data Scientist, to work with Dr Peter Gallacher and Prof. Neeraj Dhaun ( Bean ) (Cardiovascular and Renal Healthcare Data Research Group) on an ambitious research programme utilising high-fidelity, routinely-collected NHS data to improve cardiovascular risk prediction and management in patients with kidney disease. The postholder will work at the interface between cardio-renal epidemiology, data science, medical statistics, and clinical medicine. They will contribute to original, high-impact quantitative research by accessing, curating and interrogating large-scale and complex regional and national datasets, comprising linked administrative, biochemistry, diabetes, hospitalisation, mortality, prescribing, renal and transplantation data. The postholder will work with clinical researchers to transform and curate linked datasets, design novel and exciting data-linkage studies, and perform advanced data analytics and statistical modelling. They will be embedded within our growing research team, comprising clinical research nurses and clinician researchers from a variety of public health, primary and secondary care backgrounds. The postholder will also provide guidance to other members of the research group, including undergraduate or postgraduate students. As our research team grows, they will help to recruit and lead a team of epidemiologists and data scientists. Our research team is based within the Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research – a BHF-funded Centre of Research Excellence in Edinburgh – and works closely and collaboratively with a variety of research teams under the auspices of the Centre’s ‘ Heart Diseases ’ and ‘ Data-Driven Innovation’ Research Themes ( https://cardiovascular-science.ed.ac.uk/research/cvs-bhf-centres/bhf-centre-of-research-excellence ). This role would suit an ambitious individual who is either looking to develop their skills and career in high-impact health data research, or a more experienced epidemiologist/data scientist looking to expand their role within a dynamic and specialist team. You Will Have An undergraduate qualification or equivalent in a mathematics, statistics, computing science, scientific or health-related field; Experience of clinical epidemiology or health data science; Experience of data management (e.g. data cleaning and manipulation); Experience of statistical modelling; Proficiency in programming (e.g. statistical programming in R); A strong level of attention-to-detail that is well-suited to handling and analysing large-scale, complex linked datasets. You will be based in the Institute for Neuroscience and Cardiovascular Research, Queen’s Medical Research Institute, University of Edinburgh, 47 Little France Crescent, Edinburgh EH16 4TJ. The position is funded through an award from the British Heart Foundation and is available immediately for 2 years in the first instance. The BBC is a major stakeholder in industry-leading audience measurement systems. Alongside this, our digital products—including iPlayer, Sounds, News and Sport—reach millions of people every week and generate billions of audience interactions. As a Data Scientist, you will develop statistical and machine learning models that help understand audience behaviour, improve audience measurement, and support strategic decision-making across the BBC. Working with a range of data sources, from digital behavioural data to audience panels and surveys, you'll deliver robust analysis that influences how the BBC measures success and plans for the future. Our work spans audience measurement, forecasting, consumer behaviour, experimentation and applied machine learning. We work closely with data engineers, researchers, analysts and stakeholders across the BBC, giving you the opportunity to contribute to high-impact projects with visible organisational value. You'll also be part of a wider data science community and have dedicated time to develop your technical skills, explore new approaches and contribute to best practice across the organisation. Contribute to the design, development and evaluation of analytical models and solutions, working with senior data scientists and engineering partners to support project delivery and production deployment where appropriate. Develop reproducible analytical workflows using SQL, Python or R on our data and machine learning platform, including exploratory analysis and proof-of-concepts. Develop an understanding of the BBC and wider media landscape to contextualise models and analysis, and communicate findings, assumptions and recommendations appropriately to non-technical stakeholders. Keep up to date with developments in machine learning and generative AI, applying relevant techniques appropriately and contributing ideas for improving team practices. Essential Criteria YOUR SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Further degree in mathematics, statistics, computer science, econometrics or related field, or equivalent work experience. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience applying data science and statistical techniques to solve business problems by translating ambiguous business questions into practical analytical solutions and selecting appropriate methods, models or algorithms. Understanding of statistical inference, experimental design and causal reasoning, with the ability to analyse audience behaviours and preferences, distinguish meaningful patterns from statistical noise, and draw robust, evidence-based conclusions. Proven ability to communicate analytical findings clearly and confidently to stakeholders, adapting detail and recommendations to different audiences. Good programming skills in Python or R with version control (Git or others), alongside strong SQL skills for working with large datasets, including data preparation and validation. Desired But Not Required Experience in a commercial, research or consulting analytical role. Experience applying data science techniques to audience, consumer, marketing or media measurement problems. Experience working with audience behaviour data, digital activity data or related panel datasets, in a research, marketing, strategy or product environment. Experience building machine learning models to scale and deploying them into production. Experience writing clean, well-structured and maintainable code, with an understanding of software engineering best practices such as unit testing, test-driven development, version control and collaborative development using GitHub. items.desc: Funciones y responsabilidades fundamentales inherentes al puesto: Se encargará de realizar/coordinar/subcontratar los diseños software en proyectos del área de Sistemas Embebidos y Redes de CAF Rolling Stock tanto de proyectos del Plan I+D como de la aplicación eficiente de estos en programas. Gestión de diseño SW (arquitectura, programación, pruebas…) para aplicaciones ferroviarias de alto nivel de confiabilidad (Safety) y ciberseguridad. Ingeniero/a Software de nuevos desarrollos de productos con alto componente tecnológico dentro de CAF: Diseño y programación de nuevos sistemas de comunicaciones y protocolos y aplicaciones relacionadas con el registro y preprocesado avanzando de señales en tiempo real. Definición, gestión y ejecución de proyectos de I+D nacionales e internacionales Sistemas de posicionamiento precisos y seguros Sistemas de conducción autónoma de vehículos Realizar vigilancia tecnológica de metodologías y tecnologías software emergentes y su aplicabilidad en sistemas embarcados ferroviarios Colaborar en la transformación del ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software mediante la incorporación de inteligencia artificial en sistemas embebidos, definiendo la hoja de ruta, seleccionando casos de uso y herramientas, coordinando su implantación y midiendo su impacto en calidad, productividad, seguridad y cumplimiento normativo. Participar en grupos de trabajo y estandarización internacionales Requisitos Formación Académica: Ingeniería superior de Automática, Electrónica o Telecomunicaciones (o Master equivalentes). Experiencia Profesional: 3-4 años en puesto similar Idiomas: Ingles avanzado Competencias: Capacidad relacional y Trabajo en equipo Orientación a cliente (interno y externo) Capacidad de coordinación, organización y gestión de prioridades Orientación a resultados Orientación a la innovación Liderazgo del cambio y capacidad para impulsar la adopción de nuevas prácticas y herramientas de inteligencia artificial en equipos multidisciplinares de desarrollo de software. Competencias Técnicas: Se valorará muy positivamente experiencia en el desarrollo de software, principalmente en la programación de sistemas “embedded” de tiempo real. Se requerirá experiencia en lenguajes de programación C/C++ Se valorará experiencia en buses y protocolos de comunicaciones: TCP/IP, MVB, Ethernet, Profibus… y en el uso de sistemas operativos embebidos de tiempo real y/o Safety como eCos, Nucleus, FreeRTOS, VxWorks, Integrity, Linux real-time, Yocto, etc Se valorará muy positivamente la experiencia de desarrollo SW en sector ferroviario (programación de funciones en autómata de Tren, señalización, tracción o entornos de simulación ferroviaria). Se valorará experiencia en otros lenguajes: ADA, Java, C#, … Se requiere familiaridad con diversos entornos y herramientas de desarrollo (compiladores, linkers, depuradores, etc.) tales como Visual Studio, Eclipse, CodeWarrior, GCC, Clang, etc. Se valorará experiencia en programación orientada a objetos y en el uso de herramientas y metodologías de diseño de software: UML, Rational Rose, Enterprise Architect, Rhapsody… Se valorará muy positivamente Experiencia en metodología de diseño SW basada en Ciclo de Vida IEC 61508, EN50126, EN50129, EN5128. Se valorará el uso de herramientas de verificación y validación de software tales como: LRDA, VertorCast, Polyspace, Tessy, Cantata, Jenkins, … Se valorará experiencia en herramientas de control de versiones: GIT, CVS, Subversion, Perforce,... Experiencia en la aplicación de inteligencia artificial al ciclo de vida de desarrollo de software: asistencia a la especificación y diseño, generación y revisión de código, automatización de pruebas, análisis estático, documentación, gestión de requisitos y soporte al mantenimiento. Capacidad para evaluar, seleccionar e integrar herramientas de IA generativa y aprendizaje automático en entornos de desarrollo de sistemas embebidos, garantizando la trazabilidad, la protección de la propiedad intelectual, la ciberseguridad, la calidad del software y el cumplimiento de los estándares ferroviarios y de seguridad funcional aplicables. Conocimientos de Claude Code, Cursor, Github Copilot, LLMs, uso de GWs, Teraform, etc.

items.desc: Bli en del av Accentures AI-satsing og utvikle løsninger som betyr noe. Vi utdanner deg til AI Developer på 6 uker! Vil du utvikle avanserte AI-løsninger som skaper reell verdi og kan bidra til teknologi som brukes av tusenvis av mennesker hver dag? Gjennom en 6-ukers kostnadsfri intensivutdanning får du ferdighetene du trenger innen AI og maskinlæring for å gå rett ut i jobb som AI Developer. Om stillingen Accenture opplever økende etterspørsel etter konsulenter med AI-kompetanse. I samarbeid med Academic Work ser de nå etter deg som ønsker å gjennomføre en 6-ukers utdanning innen kunstig intelligens, maskinlæring og agentiske systemer. Gjennom kurset bygger du den tekniske kompetansen du trenger for å lykkes i prosjektene, før du går ut i jobb som konsulent hos Accenture i en fulltidsstilling via Academic Work. Hos Accenture blir du en del av avdelingen AI & Data - et fagmiljø med over 20 utviklere og spesialister som leverer spisskompetanse innen generativ AI, maskinlæring og Data Engineering. Som AI Developer jobber du i skjæringspunktet mellom disse domenene: fra å utvikle agentiske systemer og robuste maskinlæringsløsninger, til å etablere skalerbare systemer på moderne skyplattformer for å sikre trygg og stabil drift. Du får være med i prosjekter der løsningene du utvikler spenner fra forretningskritiske systemer til samfunnskritiske tjenester for store aktører. Dette lærer du gjennom kurset vårt Under forstudiene bygger du et solid grunnlag i Python, databaser, skyteknologi og dataflyt, samtidig som du får introduksjon til generativ AI og moderne språkmodeller. I intensivkurset beveger du deg fra teori til hands-on utvikling av robuste AI- og ML-løsninger. Du lærer å utvikle, teste og sette modeller i produksjon, jobbe med moderne AI-arkitektur og integrere løsningene med eksisterende systemer. Du får også praktisk erfaring med AI-agenter som kan bruke verktøy, samhandle med eksterne systemer og løse komplekse oppgaver selvstendig. Til slutt får du satt den nye kunnskapen på prøve gjennom et praktisk prosjekt sammen med andre kursdeltakere. Prosjektet presenteres og vurderes av både kursholdere og representanter fra Accentures AI-avdeling. Hva får du som AI Developer hos oss? 6 ukers kostnadsfri opplæring innen AI med mulighet for økonomisk støtte og låneordning under utdanningen Mulighet til å gå rett ut i oppdrag hos Accenture, hvor du får bruke og videreutvikle din nye kompetanse Arbeid med innovative prosjekter for noen av Norges mest innovative og samfunnskritiske selskaper Å bli en del av et sterkt fagmiljø der alt ligger til rette for videre kompetanseutvikling, erfaringsdeling og praktisk læring også etter at intensivkurset er fullført Arbeidsoppgaver Som konsulent i Accenture jobber du i prosjekter enten ute hos kunden eller fra Accentures kontorer. Prosjektene varierer i både omfang og bransje, men felles for dem er fokuset på å løse komplekse problemstillinger ved hjelp av ny teknologi. Dette kan for eksempel være å bygge AI-verktøy som hjelper saksbehandlere i offentlig sektor med å navigere i komplekse regelverk, utvikle maskinlæringsmodeller for ressursoptimalisering i helsesektoren, eller etablere skalerbare skyplattformer for aktører innen energi og finans. I hvert prosjekt jobber du i tverrfaglige team som har ansvar for hele leveransen, fra strategi og design til utvikling, testing, produksjon og videreutvikling. Du vil derfor samarbeide tett med andre utviklere, arkitekter og testere, med fokus på at dere som team leverer kvalitet og gode løsninger. Du vil utvikle, teste og optimalisere agentiske systemer og maskinlæringsmodeller, samt bygge skalerbare og robuste systemer på moderne skyplattformer. Du vil også bidra til å sette løsninger trygt i drift ved hjelp av DevOps-prinsipper, og rådgi kunder om teknologiske muligheter på en tydelig og verdiskapende måte. Vi søker deg som Har høyere utdanning på minimum bachelornivå innen matematikk, ingeniørfag, data science, kybernetikk, informatikk, data, AI eller tilsvarende som har gitt deg en grunnleggende teknisk forståelse Har du utdanning på bachelornivå trenger du også minimum 1,5 år relevant arbeidserfaring, eksempelvis fra arbeid med AI, som utvikler, plattformingeniør, dataingeniør eller fra arbeid med cloud og DevOps Kan sikkerhetsklareres i henhold til norsk sikkerhetslovgivning Behersker norsk og engelsk flytende, skriftlig og muntlig Har tydelig interesse og motivasjon for å jobbe som konsulent innen AI Rollen passer deg som er interessert i AI, teknologi og som trives med problemløsning. Du er pålitelig, tar ansvar og jobber strukturert mot målene du setter deg. Du er kvalitetsbevisst og en lagspiller som trives i tverrfaglig samarbeid. Du er trygg i møte med nye utfordringer, og beholder roen selv i hektiske perioder med korte tidsfrister. Praktisk informasjon om utdanningen: AW Academy-utdanningen er kostnadsfri. Programmet starter 01.03.2027 på Økern Portal i Oslo. Programmet er på heltid og det er obligatorisk …

items.desc: Discover premier remote AI generalist jobs in the UK for 2026. Partner with Rex.zone to drive AI model performance improvement through expert data labeling, RLHF, and LLM evaluation. Senior AI Generalist Title: Senior AI Generalist Date: 25-02-2026 Company: Rexzone Country: UK Remote Type: Remote Employment Type: FULL_TIME Experience Level: Senior Industry: Technology Job Function: Engineering Skills: LLM Training Pipelines, Computer Vision Annotation, Content Safety Labeling, RLHF, Model Evaluation Salary Currency: USD Salary Min: 85000 Salary Max: 145000 Pay Period: YEAR Step into a leadership role as a Senior AI Generalist, where your expertise will directly influence the safety and accuracy of foundational models. In this remote UK position, you will oversee large language model evaluation and guide teams in complex computer vision annotation tasks. Your day-to-day will involve refining RLHF protocols, conducting rigorous content safety labeling, and auditing datasets for training data quality. By collaborating with leading BPOs and specialized annotation vendors like Rex.zone, you will ensure that all LLM training pipelines adhere to the highest standards of annotation guidelines compliance. You will execute RLHF protocols to align AI behavior with human intent, conduct prompt evaluation across diverse NLP scenarios, and perform critical content safety labeling. Additionally, you will support computer vision annotation and named entity recognition tasks, ensuring all data labeling processes meet rigorous annotation guidelines compliance. Whether working on freelance, contract, or full-time projects, your contributions will directly impact model performance improvement for leading AI vendors. Qualifications For AI Generalists To succeed in these remote roles, candidates must possess a strong background in AI/ML training workflows and data annotation. You need proven experience in QA evaluation, LLM training pipelines, and RLHF methodologies. Excellent analytical skills are required for complex prompt evaluation and content safety labeling. As a remote worker in the UK, you must demonstrate self-motivation, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to evolving annotation guidelines. Prior experience working with tech startups, BPOs, or specialized annotation vendors like Rex.zone is highly preferred, whether at an entry-level or senior capacity.

items.desc: Why loveholidays? We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams. The difference you’ll make You’ll sit in the Data Science team, reporting to the Head of Data Science. You’ll work closely with Product and Engineering teams to develop predictive models for pricing, recommendations, and other business domains. Together, the team will leverage data to build statistical models that improve commercial decisions. Data Science sits within our Platform function, which builds the technology and shared capabilities that power the loveholidays experience. By creating scalable products, systems and tools, Platform helps the wider organisation move faster, work more independently and deliver better outcomes for customers. Your Day-to-day Build and improve data science products across pricing, recommendations and other business domains to improve customer experiences and commercial outcomes. Turn ambiguous business problems into practical data science solutions, from exploration and modelling through to experimentation and evaluation. Partner with engineers, analysts and product teams to deploy reliable models and embed recommendations into everyday decision-making. Monitor model performance, investigate changes and continuously improve solutions as customer behaviour and business needs evolve. Communicate findings clearly, challenge assumptions and help teams make confident, evidence-based decisions. Your Skillset Strong experience developing and delivering practical machine learning solutions, balancing model performance, business value and long-term maintainability. Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience working with large, complex datasets. A solid grounding in statistics, experimentation and machine learning, including model evaluation and causal thinking. Experience collaborating with engineers to deploy, monitor and improve models in production. Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and influence product and commercial decisions. The Interview Journey Intro with a member of our Talent Acquisition team - 30 minutes 1st Stage: Virtual Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 minutes 2nd Stage: Two on-site interviews 50 minutes for a project discussion deepdive with member(s) of the Data Science team 1 hour technical discussion around a case study with member(s) of the Data Science team Final-stage: Virtual interview with key stakeholders - 45 minutes Perks Of Joining Us Company pension contributions at 5% Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum Ability to buy and sell annual leave Access to our electric vehicle salary sacrifice scheme Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers Our commitment to inclusion At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions. As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

items.card: The role: We’re looking for a Software Engineer to bring their ambition, creativity, and technical prowess to join our high-powered team to build the technology that powers the world’s first lovable, AI-native benefits platform. You’ll have real ownership, big targets, and a chance to help shape both the work you do and the company in general. We care less about traditional career paths and more about raw talent,
items.desc: About Euphoric: Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world’s largest and most prestigious employers. Born out of Peppy Health — a fast-growing, category-defining Series B startup — we spun out in May 2025 to tackle a far bigger opportunity. Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It’s their second-largest cost after payroll — yet the entire category is still running on legacy systems and outdated assumptions. The space is primed for transformation: despite its scale, it’s been almost completely overlooked by AI-first startups. Incumbents — including one U.S. heavyweight with $2B+ in annual revenue — are constrained by archaic tech stacks and can’t move fast enough to innovate. And this isn’t just a massive market — it’s genuine “tech for good.” Smarter benefits administration, richer analytics, and clearer communication have the power to directly improve the everyday lives, wellbeing, and financial security of millions of employees worldwide. We’re a sharp, high-velocity team with bold ambitions, obsessed with building category-defining technology and partnering with exceptional people who want their work to truly matter. We closed significant seed rounds in October 2025 & May 2026 and are building from a position of strength with a long cash runway. We've already secured contracts with several of the world's largest enterprises and are now preparing for rapid expansion as we scale the platform globally. The role: We’re looking for a Software Engineer to bring their ambition, creativity, and technical prowess to join our high-powered team to build the technology that powers the world’s first lovable, AI-native benefits platform. You’ll have real ownership, big targets, and a chance to help shape both the work you do and the company in general. We care less about traditional career paths and more about raw talent, bias for action, and how much fire you bring. What you’ll do: Build AI-first features end-to-end: You’ll contribute to the design, deployment, and iteration of our next-generation benefits platform features that leverage personalization, experimentation, and AI/ML methods (e.g. agents/LLMs, recommender systems, reinforcement learning) to enhance user experience in a meaningful business domain. Contribute across the tech stack: You’ll work in React (JavaScript/TypeScript) on the frontend and Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy) on the backend, shipping production-ready code and user-facing features in addition to innovative ML work. Live on the cutting edge of AI tooling: You’ll help push the boundary of what’s feasible with modern AI-powered software development tools (Cursor, Windsurf), keep up with the regular drumbeat of AI advances, and find new and exciting ways to build and explore new features faster. Participate in a fast-paced iterative environment: Collaborate closely with design, product, and beyond to deliver and iterate on impressive features and prototypes at world-class pace. Keep code clean and well-tested: Maintain clean, efficient, and tested code with clear documentation for both peers and future reference. Review, refine, and grow: Actively participate in peer reviews, CI/CD processes, and a growth-minded engineering culture, where you continuously seek to level up your technical skills. Be a team player: Sometimes you’ll be iterating on ML pipelines; other times you’ll be refining a frontend component or fixing a tricky bug. We need someone who’s excited about the full product journey and moving together as one. Skills & experience: Industry Experience (4+ years): Prior experience contributing to impactful products in fast-paced or startup environments, with an understanding of both scale and quality from larger tech organisations. Hands-On Full Stack Skills: Proficiency in React/Typescript and/or Python (RESTful APIs, data pipelines), plus comfort with deploying and maintaining services on modern cloud platforms (GCP preferred, AWS or Azure also fine). Applied AI/ML Skills: First-hand experience building and delivering AI/ML features to real users, and an insatiable curiosity to keep up with emerging technologies and trends Team-Oriented Mindset: Strong communication skills for explaining complex ideas to technical and non-technical audiences, and a passion for collaborating within cross-functional teams. Passion and Pride in Shipping: A do-whatever-it-takes attitude to deliver against important business goals that help the entire team win Pragmatic Best Practices: An overarching desire to build efficient, scalable, and maintainable code, while learning the tradeoffs between technical debt and delivery speed What we look for: We’re a great bunch but we have some "Euph" cultural non-negotiables. To do well here you will: Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments Take your work seriously, but not yourself Be proactive, playful, and deeply curious Want to build something that matters Be willing to “do what it takes” What …

items.desc: Overview We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Platform Integration Engineer to work on the integration and enablement of AI/ML accelerator runtimes within embedded Linux platforms. In this role, you will work at the intersection of silicon, embedded software and AI, owning the integration of AI/ML runtime and inference components into Linux BSPs across multiple SoC platforms. You will collaborate closely with kernel/platform, silicon, runtime and application teams, while driving low-level bring-up, debugging and cross-platform enablement. This is a hands-on engineering role requiring strong expertise in Yocto/OpenEmbedded, embedded Linux, C programming and hardware/software debugging, combined with practical exposure to AI/ML inference runtimes and hardware accelerators such as NPUs, GPUs or DSPs. The role follows a hybrid working model and requires 3 days/week presence at the office in Bucharest. items.desc: In the role of Data Engineer for AI (f/m/d), you will design, build and operate data products and reusable data preparation components on the Data and AI Platform at Allianz Global Investors, built on Databricks and Foundry. Your focus is to enable platform customers to reliably source, ingest, transform, validate and serve high-quality, compliant data for AI and ML use cases (including analytics and GenAI), so teams can consume data in a self-service manner. You will provide technical guidance and L3 support to delivery teams, define and promote best practices for data pipelines and data quality, and ensure adherence to security, privacy and regulatory requirements following a compliance-by-design approach. In addition, you will continuously evolve the platform’s data engineering capabilities by integrating new features (e.g., ingestion patterns, transformation frameworks, governance controls and monitoring) and by delivering standardized, reusable pipelines and templates that scale across use cases. Databricks is the platform’s primary technology for data engineering, with Microsoft Foundry part of its wider scope. This position will be based in Frankfurt . What You Will Do Reusable data preparation building blocks & ML‑ready pipelines: Develop, maintain and enhance standardized pipeline patterns, templates and utilities (ingestion, transformation, validation, enrichment) to deliver AI/ML‑ready datasets. Build robust pipelines for structured and unstructured data with reproducible, deterministic outputs Data pipeline engineering on Databricks: Build and operate reliable batch and streaming pipelines to ingest data from internal and external sources, curate datasets, and publish trusted data products for AI, ML and analytical consumption Curated data products (Bronze/Silver/Gold): Establish controlled dataset evolution, enforce data quality and freshness, and curate gold tables explicitly designed for analytical, ML and AI use cases. Feature engineering & feature store: Design, build and operate feature engineering pipelines and curate a ready‑to‑use feature store with proper versioning and lightweight documentation (ownership, purpose, inputs/outputs, SLAs) GenAI / RAG data & embedding pipelines: Collaborate with ML and AI Engineers to build and operate pipelines for GenAI/RAG systems, including new data ingestion, Bronze/Silver updates, chunking, embedding refresh and index updates to maintain knowledge base relevance Systematic experiments & model improvement loops: Enable systematic experimentation (offline evaluations, A/B tests) and support model retraining using user feedback (binary and non‑binary) to continuously improve models Platform capability evolution (Data for AI): Collaborate with the Data and AI Platform Architect to introduce and operationalize platform capabilities for ingestion, transformation and serving (Delta/Unity Catalog patterns, orchestration, monitoring), making them available securely and consistently New data source onboarding & Lakeflow connectors: Facilitate provisioning and rollout of Databricks Lakeflow connectors to integrate new data sources and standardize ingestion across domains Security, governance & compliance‑by‑design: Implement and enforce governance using Unity Catalog, including access control, lineage, retention, encryption and auditing, ensuring compliance with internal standards and regulations Data quality, validation & reliability: Establish automated data quality checks and validations (e.g., DQX), define SLAs/SLOs for freshness and reliability, and implement monitoring and observability Performance & cost optimization: Optimize Spark workloads, storage layouts and compute usage to ensure scalable, stable and cost‑efficient data pipelines Collaboration & enablement: Partner with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, AI CoE, DevOps and SecOps to define data requirements, promote reusable patterns, and enable self‑service through documentation, coaching and reviews Operations & support: Provide L3 support for pipeline and data product incidents, perform root‑cause analysis, and drive continuous improvements to platform stability and customer satisfaction Integration & data product exposure: Integrate Databricks with (Azure) cloud services, enterprise systems, external providers and SaaS items.desc: Our Mission Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all. About The Role Data is playing an increasingly crucial role at the frontier of AI innovation. Many of the most meaningful advances in recent years have come not from new architectures, but from better data. As a member of the Data Team, your mission is to ensure that the data used to train and evaluate our models meets a high bar for quality, reliability, and downstream impact. You will directly shape how our models perform on critical capabilities — agentic tool use, long-horizon reasoning and robust safety alignment. Working with world-class researchers on our post-training teams, you’ll help turn fuzzy notions of “good data” into concrete, measurable standards that scale across large data campaigns. We’re looking for engineers who combine strong engineering fundamentals with a deep curiosity about data quality and its impact on model behavior Working Closely With Our Post-training Teams You Will Own upstream data quality for LLM post-training and evaluation by analyzing expert-developed datasets and operationalizing quality standards for reasoning, alignment, and agentic use cases Partner closely with research and post-training teams to translate requirements into measurable quality signals, and provide actionable feedback to external data vendors Design, validate, and scale automated QA methods, including LLM-as-a-Judge frameworks, to reliably measure data quality across large campaigns Build reusable QA pipelines that reliably deliver high-quality data to post-training teams for model training and evaluation Monitor and report on data quality over time, driving continuous iteration on quality standards, processes, and acceptance criteria About You Strong engineering fundamentals with experience building data pipelines, QA systems, or evaluation workflows for post-training data and agentic environments Detail-oriented with an analytical mindset, able to identify failure modes, inconsistencies, and subtle issues that affect data quality Solid understanding of how data quality impacts training (SFT and RL) and evaluation, with the ability to translate quality concerns into concrete signals, decisions, and feedback Experience designing and validating automated quality checks, including rule-based systems, statistical methods, or model-assisted approaches such as LLM-as-a-Judge Comfortable working autonomously, owning problems end-to-end, and collaborating effectively with researchers, engineers, and operations partners Skills And Qualifications Proficiency in Python and building ML / LLM workflows. Must be comfortable debugging and writing scalable code Experience working with large datasets and automated evaluation or quality-checking systems Familiarity with how LLMs work and can describe how models are trained and evaluated Excellent communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts across teams What We Offer We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models. We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported. Top-tier compensation: Salary and equity structured to recognize and retain our talent globally. Stock options: Everyone who joins and contributes to Reflection's success gets to share in the upside through stock options. Health & wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life, with an annual wellness allowance. Meals: Lunch and dinner are provided in the office daily. Life & family: 22 weeks paid parental leave for all new birthing and non-birthing parents, including adoptive and surrogate journeys. Team building: We have regular off-sites, happy hours, and team celebrations. Day to day, that looks like: designing expert task creation flows, building task assignment and review interfaces,
items.desc: About Aptura We build the evaluation datasets and RL environments that make AI reliable in domains where mistakes are expensive: finance, healthcare, and legal. Our team designs expert-curated training data, calibrated rubrics, and verifiable task environments for AI labs and startups pushing the frontier of what models can do in regulated industries. We're a small, lean, London based team that moves fast and takes the work seriously. Everyone contributes directly. Initiative is rewarded, and ownership is the default. If you want to shape how frontier AI learns to operate in the real world, we'd like to hear from you. About The Role As a Member of Technical Staff on our Software Engineering team, you will build the platform that powers how Aptura operates and scales — the annotation tooling, workflow systems, quality control pipelines, and internal infrastructure that sit behind every dataset and environment we ship. Day to day, that looks like: designing expert task creation flows, building task assignment and review interfaces, writing the data pipelines that move outputs from domain experts into structured training sets, and integrating LLM-powered tooling directly into the product. Some days it's product engineering. Some days it's closer to infrastructure. The common thread is that the software you build is what lets a small team produce high-quality evaluation data at scale. You'll be the person who makes the platform real. Decide what gets built, how it gets built, and set the standard for how we build as we grow. What You'll Do Build and own the core data annotation and workflow platform end to end — from task assignment and expert interfaces to quality control and dataset delivery Design systems that support expert onboarding, task routing, review workflows, and QA at scale Build and improve AI-integrated pipelines across the platform, including LLM-assisted annotation, automated checking, and model-in-the-loop workflows Work directly with founders and domain operators to turn manual, bespoke processes into reliable, scalable software Make strong product and engineering decisions in ambiguous, fast-moving situations — scoping, prioritising, and shipping without waiting for perfect specs Help define how we build as a team: tooling choices, engineering standards, and product direction Who We're Looking For You will not be a good fit if you thrive in well-defined scopes and prefer a clear spec before moving. We are looking for people who are comfortable identifying what needs building, making a call, and shipping — often before the full picture is clear. You will not be a good fit if you like to go deep on one technical area for an extended period. We are looking for people who are energised by moving across product, infrastructure, data systems, and AI tooling — sometimes all in the same week. You will not be a good fit if you prefer to hand work off at the boundaries of your role. We are looking for people who want to own problems end to end, from the first conversation through to something live. You will not be a good fit if you aren't yet integrating AI into how you build day to day. We are looking for people who are already using LLMs and coding agents as part of how they work, and are excited to push that further. You will not be a good fit if you think of speed and quality as things you trade off against each other. We are looking for people who don't cut corners — they cut scope. We don't care about background, experience, or prestige. We want people who can demonstrate they will work hard, learn fast, and ship things that matter. Former founders, early engineers at startups, and people with infrastructure experience are a plus. Nice to Have Experience building internal tools, annotation platforms, workflow software, or operations-heavy products Familiarity with modern product stacks: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, FastAPI, or similar Exposure to AI products, LLM tooling, or evaluation workflows Domain interest in finance, healthcare, or legal Previous experience as an early or founding engineer On-site in London. Compensation (salary + equity) will be competitive.

Melde dich gerne bei uns, wenn du schnell wachsen, lernen und in einer der zukunftsweisendsten Sparten unserer Zeit arbeiten möchtest. Tätigkeiten Du entwickelst mit uns produktive Software rund um generative KI und KI-Agenten. Das hat zwei Seiten: Technisch: das baust du Du setzt moderne Workflows mit Sprachmodellen und Coding Agents sinnvoll ein Du baust Frontends, die komplexe KI verständlich und nutzbar machen Du entwickelst Backends und Integrationen, die Daten, Modelle und Systeme zuverlässig verbinden Du strukturierst Anforderungen und leitest daraus tragfähige technische Lösungen ab Du machst die Ergebnisse der KI messbar und verlässlich, mit Evaluierungen und Tests, die zeigen, dass ein Feature wirklich funktioniert Du machst interne Tools, Frameworks und Prozesse kontinuierlich besser Projektmanagement & Kommunikation: so bringst du es ans Ziel Du treibst Projekte oder Teilprojekte eigenverantwortlich voran, von der Anforderung bis zur Auslieferung, immer mit Umfang, Prioritäten und Zeitplan im Blick Du kommunizierst Projektfortschritte transparent und steuerst Erwartungen aktiv Du triffst pragmatische Entscheidungen gemeinsam mit Kund:innen und im Team und setzt sie zügig um Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Fortschritt und Ergebnis, wofür du bei uns viel Freiraum bekommst Team Du arbeitest eng mit anderen Entwicklern und unseren Kunden zusammen, wobei du die Möglichkeit hast, die Richtung des Projekts aktiv zu beeinflussen und neue Technologien oder Ansätze einzuführen. Do you enjoy translating legal and business challenges into practical AI solutions that are actually used by professionals? And are you energized by the combination of AI, innovation, and knowledge management? Then this AI Engineer role at Loyens & Loeff could be the perfect opportunity for you. As an AI Engineer, you will be part of the AI Solutions Team. The team develops and manages AI solutions for both our legal practice groups and business support departments. Together with other AI Engineers, Innovation Advisors, AI Architects, IT specialists, and business stakeholders, you will develop innovative solutions that contribute to the quality, efficiency, and future readiness of our services. Your role as an AI Engineer Responsibilities You are responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and continuously improving AI solutions that contribute to Loyens & Loeff's strategic objectives. This Role Is Something For You, Because You Have a bachelor's or master’s degree in Law, Information Science, Artificial Intelligence, Business & IT, Innovation Management, Knowledge Management, or a related field, combined with relevant professional experience; a strong interest in both technology and business processes and you enjoy working at the intersection of the two; the ability to analyse complex processes and translate them into practical and scalable solutions; a passion for working with users, understanding their challenges, and helping them realise value from new technologies; experience with AI tools, workflow design, process improvement, low-code/no-code platforms, and/or knowledge management in a professional environment; a solid understanding of the importance of well-structured and reliable information as the foundation for successful AI solutions; experience working in an international environment and strong English communication skills; excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously; strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; the ability to independently lead workstreams and influence stakeholders across legal, business, and technical teams; a strong interest in how AI can transform legal and business services and the motivation to actively contribute to that transformation. To be considered for this position, you must already have a valid work permit for the Netherlands. Please note that Loyens & Loeff does not provide visa or work permit sponsorship for this role. This multidisciplinary and international team plays a central role in the firm's AI transformation and develops and manages AI solutions across all home markets. A critical part of this role is the effective structuring, management, and utilisation of legal knowledge and information. The quality of AI solutions depends heavily on the quality of the underlying knowledge assets and information sources. The combination of AI technology, knowledge management, and innovation is what makes this role unique. You will work with colleagues from multiple disciplines to build solutions that create tangible value for legal and business professionals. items.desc: Vill du använda data och AI för att förbättra verksamheter som människor är beroende av varje dag? Hos Karlskoga Energi & Miljö får du arbeta nära både tekniken och verksamheten, med möjlighet att se hur dina lösningar kommer till användning. Vi har sedan något år tillbaka infört ett datadrivet arbetssätt och en data- och AI-plattform som vi utvecklar vidare. Nu vill vi stärka upp med ytterligare en person för att ta såväl arbetssätt som datakvalitet och teknik till nästa nivå. Din roll Du blir en del av funktionen AI & Digitalisering och arbetar nära kollegor inom OT/ automation, systemutveckling, IT och mätvärdesinsamling. Du kommer också bli en viktig resurs vid implementering av AI, där vi just nu gör en satsning inom machine learning och klustring i en av våra verksamheter. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Vidareutveckla vår data- och AI-plattform Förbättra arbetssätt för hur vi samlar in, bearbetar och använder data Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra dataflöden så att data blir tillförlitliga och användbara för analys och AI Analysera data och utveckla modeller, exempelvis för att upptäcka avvikelser, förstå mönster eller göra prognoser Presentera resultat och utveckla lösningar tillsammans med verksamheten, med fokus på praktisk nytta Bidra till vårt partnerskap med AI Sweden och omsätta nya kunskaper i vårt utvecklingsarbete Därför ska du välja oss: Utlopp för kreativitet: Du får vidareutveckla arbetssätt och processer för området tillsammans med engagerade kollegor. Meningsfullhet: Ditt arbete gör skillnad för hela samhället – vi är motorn i Karlskogas infrastruktur. Variation: Hos oss får du jobba i en spännande, bred och varierad roll med stort eget ansvar. Utvecklingsmöjligheter: Vi satsar på kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling och ger dig utrymme att växa. Flexibelt arbete: Vi erbjuder flexibla arbetstider och möjlighet till visst distansarbete. Vem är du? Du har relevant högskoleutbildning inom datavetenskap, statistik, matematik eller liknande Du har flera års arbetslivserfarenhet, där du har arbetat i hela kedjan från identifiering och insamling av data via validering, bearbetning och analys till visualisering och leverans av verksamhetsnytta Du har goda kunskaper inom SQL och SSIS eller motsvarande Du har erfarenhet av maskininlärning, statistisk modellering och dataanalys Du har erfarenhet av Python-programmering och implementering av AI Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av datamodellering Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper. Du kommer att arbeta tvärfunktionellt och lösa uppgifter tillsammans med personer från andra funktioner och roller. Det är därför viktigt att du är prestigelös, gillar att samarbeta men att du också är självgående och tar egna initiativ. Det här är vi Vi är det lokala energibolaget i Karlskoga med cirka 200 medarbetare och en tydlig vision: Tillsammans ska vi bli Sveriges mest hållbara företag. Vi arbetar brett – från värme, el, ånga och biogas till vatten, avlopp, återvinning, renhållning och stadsnät. Genom våra cirkulära affärer vill vi skapa ett hållbart samhälle och en levande ort – både idag och för kommande generationer. Hos oss får du en arbetsplats med starkt samhällsengagemang, trevliga kollegor och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi värnar om balansen mellan arbete och fritid och erbjuder bland annat: Friskvårdsbidrag och fria friskvårdsaktiviteter Arbetstidsförkortning Slopat karensavdrag vid sjukdom Gratis laddning av elbil Förmånlig ersättning vid föräldraledighet Anställningsform Tjänsten är tillsvidare och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar normalt sett sex månaders provanställning. Ansök nu! Vill du vara med och skapa framtidens smarta och hållbara samhälle tillsammans med oss? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag – urval sker löpande! Observera att säkerhetsprövning kan bli aktuell då delar av vår verksamhet omfattar skyddsobjekt och samhällskritisk infrastruktur. Har du frågor? Kontakta gärna Åsa Fallqvist, AI & Digitaliseringschef, på 0586-750 105 eller asa.fallqvist@karlskogaenergi.se Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig! Karlskoga Energi & Miljö är en kommunal verksamhet. Det innebär att din ansökan blir en offentlig handling när den kommit till oss och vi kan därför inte hantera ansökningar med sekretess.

items.desc: Give Our Robots Consciousness Physical AI can't be trained on internet data alone. Robots need to learn skills in the real world — by observing, interacting with, and operating in real environments. That's the idea behind NEURA Gym: a global network of physical training centers where robots learn industrial tasks/skills directly from experienced human operators/ the people who know these processes inside out. As Physical AI Data Operations Expert , you’ll work side by side with our data operators, our robots, and our customers and keep the NEURAGym, our data production factory, up and running. Your mission & challenges Be the first point of contact for the data operators and data operator interns who teleoperate our robots during your shift. Train, support, and encourage support the data operators staff to produce highest quality data. Enable our customers: translate complex technical concepts in easy to understand trainings. Compile onboarding material, organize workshops for our customers and enable our customer teams to act autonomously. Be the first point of contact with technical questions. Adapt and debug the robotics software stack to ensure and continuously improve Gym operations. You understand robotics fundamentals such as drive control, fieldbus communications, and kinematics. You are familiar with unixiod real-time operating systems including low-latency networking (UDP, DDS), programming (Python/C++) and related best practices (version control, CI/CD). You are fluent with containerized software distribution and deployment workflows. Be the bridge between the Gym staff and Neura’s Research & Development and service departments. Set up and calibrate the tele operations toolchain and instruct both internal colleagues and customers in its use. Configure all necessary IT components (e.g., sensors such as cameras and depth sensors, data recording stations, network-setup), in NEURA's and customers’ Gyms and ensure they meet the requirements for long-term reliable operation. Understand the end to end data flow in the Gym, starting with the initial capture on various sensors, caching, synchronizing and annotating the data until it is uploaded into our cloud infrastructure. You ensure the required data integrity and transport latency. What We Can Look Forward To Degree in Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field. Strong organizational skills and a structured approach to problem-solving. Practical experience with multi sensor setups incl. calibration and synchronization Hands-on-mentality: you like working with hardware, are not shy to to pick a screw driver and a soldering iron Solid understanding of Data Collection and Data Engineering, in particular in the context of Imitation Learning, Robot Learning or Computer Vision Programming experience with C++ and Python, as well as experience with Embedded Computing, real-time operating systems, and networking stacks (knowledge of EtherCAT is a plus) Experience with robotics, AI, automation, or emerging technologies Fluent in English; German is highly beneficial.

items.desc: Chez EDF, la maîtrise des écoulements diphasiques (air/eau) est un enjeu clé, que ce soit pour les évacuateurs de crue des barrages hydrauliques ou dans les circuits de centrales nucléaires. Pour analyser ces phénomènes complexes, nous disposons de données expérimentales (caméras rapides, sondes laser) et d'une méthodologie d'analyse d'images combinant deux approches, présentées sur la Figure 1 : Segmentation par IA (Figure 1b) avec le modèle SAM2 (Segment Anything Model 2) pour détecter et cartographier les bulles (taille, forme, trajectoire). Le Flot Optique (Figure 1c) pour estimer les champs de vitesse globaux de l'écoulement. L'objectif de ce stage est de consolider la chaîne d'analyse pour en faire un outil robuste et validé. Les missions principales s'articuleront autour des axes suivants : Validation quantitative du Flot Optique : Confronter le flot optique aux mesures de référence ("vérité terrain") obtenues par sondes optiques afin de quantifier les incertitudes de la méthode. Automatisation de la brique IA : Développer une méthode de classification pour rendre la segmentation par IA entièrement automatique et scalable. Analyse physique étendue : Exploiter la chaîne validée pour quantifiée les phénnomènes physiques (vitesse, fragmentation …) et alimenter la modélisation. Ces axes constituent une base qui sera co-construite avec le ou la stagiaire pour valoriser son profil et ses appétences. Étudiante ou étudiant avec de solides compétences et/ou une forte appétence pour la mécanique des fluides, le traitement d’images et les sciences des données/IA. La maîtrise d'au moins deux de ces domaines est un atout majeur. Rigueur et éthique scientifique doublée d’un goût pour la recherche appliquée. Date de début : entre janvier et mars 2027 Durée du stage : 5 à 6 mois Localisation : EDF Lab Chatou, 78400, (RER A)

We welcome candidates with strong, transferable geospatial skills and the ability to apply them to new operational challenges. Interested? Apply with your updated CV.

items.desc:
Join our Team
 Shape the future of sensing and wireless communication 
 What if the next generation of mobile networks could do more than connect people and devices? What if they could also sense, interpret, and understand the world around them?
At Ericsson, we are turning that vision into reality through Integrated Sensing and Communication (ISAC) research. Join us as a researcher and help develop the sensing and tracking technologies that will influence future 5G and 6G radio networks.
 About the Opportunity 
You will join the AI & Technology Foresight unit within Business Area Networks. We explore what comes next across Ericsson’s full technology portfolio—from antennas and radio systems to cloud, and turn promising ideas into real-world solutions. We are a community of nearly 400 researchers based across our main sites in Kista, Lund, and Paris. Our strength is the breadth of expertise we bring together: the capabilities to research, prototype, and build state-of-the-art mobile networks.
Within this environment, you will collaborate with experienced researchers and product teams to prove new concepts, challenge established thinking, and help set the direction for future radio network products. You will be part of Ericsson’s Integrated Sensing and Communication research program, where we research, develop, and validate advanced ISAC systems for 5G and 6G. You will work with one of the world’s most experienced teams in this field, contributing to research that connects theory, experimentation, and product development. Your work will focus on radar sensing, signal processing, and tracking in challenging environments; including dense urban areas and complex sea-clutter scenarios.
 What you will do 
• Conduct research in radar sensing, signal processing, detection, and tracking algorithms.
• Develop simulations and generate data for synthetic use cases focused on urban environments.
• Investigate methods for robust radar sensing and tracking in challenging urban scenarios.
• Explore extended-object radar trackers suitable for dense urban environments.
• Develop algorithms for tracking sea objects in the presence of dense sea clutter.
• Collaborate with product teams to integrate research results into Ericsson products in an efficient and optimized way.
• Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in sensing design and wireless communication.
• Generate intellectual property in the ISAC area.
• Share knowledge and communicate results with stakeholders across research and product development.
 Skills you bring 
 • A recently completed PhD, or equivalent research experience, focused on radar detection pipelines, signal processing, or related fields.
• Strong understanding of radar sensing and the characteristics of different sensors, including sensor artefacts such as phase noise.
• Practical experience working with environmental clutter, with hands-on knowledge of sea clutter considered essential.
• Working knowledge of data fusion and end-to-end tracking pipelines.
• Experience developing and evaluating both point-object and extended-object tracking algorithms.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect theoretical research to practical prototypes and product solutions.
• A passion for innovation, curiosity to explore new approaches, and the confidence to turn ideas into demonstrable results.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the personal drive to challenge ideas respectfully, work across diverse teams, and deliver results.

We recognize that we all have transferrable skills, and we can support you with the skills that you need to develop.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

Jouw start bij Sogeti Je begint met een traject waarin je samen met andere starters werkt aan uitdagende opdrachten, coaching krijgt en je skills ontwikkelt zoals samenwerken, communiceren en persoonlijk leiderschap. Een periode vol groei en verbinding. Daarna start je met een inhoudelijke opleiding waarin je jezelf verder ontwikkelt op het gebied van Data & AI. Je leert werken met moderne Data & AI-tools en technieken en behaalt direct relevante certificeringen. Werken als AI Engineer Na twee maanden opleiding is het zover: je gaat het veld in. Samen kijken we welke opdracht het beste bij jou past. Je wordt gedetacheerd bij grote Nederlandse organisaties, waar je aan de slag gaat met AI. Je helpt klanten om AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen die niet op de tekentafel blijven liggen, maar daadwerkelijk in de praktijk gebruikt worden. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering en werkt aan oplossingen die betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en uitlegbaar zijn. Afhankelijk van de opdracht werk je bijvoorbeeld aan het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van AI- en ML-componenten, het bouwen van end-to-end oplossingen van proof of concept tot productie, het integreren van modellen in applicaties en processen of het verbeteren van de uitlegbaarheid en beheersbaarheid van AI-oplossingen. Je werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers en stakeholders aan oplossingen die organisaties helpen beter te beslissen en te innoveren. Tegelijkertijd profiteer je van de slagkracht en expertise van de Capgemini Group. Bij Sogeti geloven we in diversiteit en inclusie: iedereen is welkom en mag zichzelf zijn. items.desc: Ben jij klaar om mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van AI binnen ING? Via Young Colfield krijg je de kans om als Business AI Designer aan de slag te gaan bij ING. Dit team richt zich op het ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen die complexe vraagstukken snel kunnen vertalen naar werkende prototypes en praktische toepassingen. Tegelijkertijd werkt het team aan een grotere ambitie: het bouwen van een schaalbaar AI-platform waarmee AI-oplossingen in de toekomst breder binnen ING kunnen worden toegepast. Je werkt in een omgeving waar business, technologie en innovatie nauw met elkaar samenwerken en waar nieuwe ideeën snel worden omgezet in concrete resultaten. Wat ga je doen? Als Business AI Designer werk je samen met product owners, business stakeholders, engineers, architecten en Risk-specialisten. Je bent de schakel tussen business en technologie en helpt bij het vertalen van vraagstukken naar slimme, werkbare AI-oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het vertalen van complexe vraagstukken naar concrete AI-oplossingen en slimme workflows. Het ontwerpen, testen en verbeteren van nieuwe concepten en prototypes. Trabajar con Python y SQL para la explotación y análisis de datos. Colaborar con equipos técnicos y de negocio para trasladar necesidades a soluciones basadas en datos. Participar en la mejora y evolución de los modelos desarrollados. Requisitos Experiencia de aproximadamente 2 años como Data Scientist . Experiencia previa en el sector Retail imprescindible. Experiencia trabajando con Python y SQL . Conocimientos sólidos de Machine Learning y modelado predictivo . Experiencia en tratamiento, análisis y explotación de datos. Se valorará especialmente experiencia trabajando con GCP (Google Cloud Platform) . ¿Qué ofrecemos? Incorporación a un proyecto estable en el sector Retail. Participación en proyectos relacionados con Data, Machine Learning e Inteligencia Artificial . Entorno tecnológico orientado a la innovación y al desarrollo de soluciones basadas en datos. Salario competitivo , acorde con la experiencia aportada. Posibilidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional. Estamos esperando perfiles como el tuyo, apasionados por el mundo del Data y la tecnología, que quieran enfrentarse a un nuevo reto. ¡Si es tu caso, inscríbete en la oferta para que podamos contarte más!

Aggreghiamo sotto lo stesso tetto persone con professionalità e background molto diversi e da sempre promuoviamo una cultura di condivisione e crescita continua. Eccellenza, Passione, Integrità e Concretezza sono i valori fondanti di Alkemy, che tutti noi condividiamo e che ci guidano nel realizzare la nostra mission. I valori Alkemy definiscono la nostra identità e sono alla base della nostra cultura organizzativa, indirizzano i nostri comportamenti nei confronti di tutte le nostre persone e dei nostri clienti, costruendo evolutivamente il nostro approccio al business.
