items.desc: At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy. Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here! The Applied Decision Science (ADS) team builds production ML models and risk management tools that are the core of Signifyd's product. We help businesses of all sizes minimize their fraud exposure and grow their sales. We improve the e-commerce shopping experience for everyone by reducing the friction experienced by good buyers and blocking fraudulent purchase attempts. ADS builds and manages the entire decision stack - from designing and deploying the ML models that assess the riskiness of a transaction, to building the tools the Risk team uses to manage and fight fraud. We seek to standardize and automate repetitive work so we can spend more time on experiments and high-leverage projects. We value collaboration and team ownership. Data scientists in Signifyd are true “full stack” operators, requiring knowledge of how transaction information received via our API traverses its way through our system and into the models we are responsible for building. When you test a hypothesis at Signifyd, you’re responsible for the end-to-end development, deployment, and evaluation process. This is a massive responsibility, and no one should feel like they're solving a hard problem alone. Together we help each other develop our skillsets through peer review of experiments and code, group paper study to deepen our machine learning and statistical understanding, and frequent knowledge-sharing through live demos, write-ups, and cross-team projects. All team members are expected and encouraged to weigh in as an external reviewer on a peer's idea or approach, regardless of level. A couple quick notes on the Signifyd culture: We’re no stranger to remote work. Most of our workforce (ICs and leaders) are primarily remote. We tend to gather individual teams together once a year. There is no travel requirement for this role. We are heavy Slack users. We are heavy users of generative AI tools. We dislike token-maxxing, but enjoy the expansion of capabilities that have come with genAI. We ask that during the interview you don’t use genAI, as we want to know what you know. Responsibilities: Partner with the Business Unit Lead and their merchant portfolio to identify gaps in decisioning performance and implement solutions, with guidance from senior team members. Utilize existing, or build net new production machine learning models that identify fraud, in collaboration with other data scientists and machine learning engineers. Identify and build automation that reduces repetitive manual work. Run experiments to identify optimal decisioning strategies, balancing complexity and performance. Communicate complex ideas to a variety of audiences, from Customer Success and Sales, to limited interactions with external customers. Write production and offline analytical code in Python. Work with distributed data pipelines in Spark/Databricks/GCP. Requirements: A degree in computer science or a comparable analytical field. 3+ years of post-undergrad work experience required. Strong verbal and written communication skills. Strong machine learning and statistical background. Write code and review others' in a shared codebase in Python. Practical SQL knowledge. Design experiments and collect data. Experience with distributed analytics and data tooling such as Spark and Databricks. This role has on-call shifts, as part of our weekend rotation, Fri/Sat/Sun. While the number of shifts is subject to change, currently it works out to about six weekends a year. Nice to Have: Previous work in fraud, payments, or e-commerce. Data analysis in a distributed environment. A passion for writing well-tested production-grade code. Experience with AI coding agents and automation. Experience of running A/B tests in production environments. An advanced degree. Our UK benefits: Stock Options Annual Performance Bonus or Commissions Pension matched up to 8% ‘Day one’ access to great health, dental and optical insurance scheme Generous annual leave plus public holidays Cycle to Work Scheme Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (12 weeks full-pay for mums & dads, plus 12 weeks half-pay for mums) Regular paid social events organized by our social committee On-Demand Therapy for all employees & their dependents Dedicated …

items.desc: Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité. Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques. Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage. Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support. Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales : Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification; Korner : incubateur de startups tech; Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions. Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité. KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès. Le Poste Rejoignez une équipe engagée dans l'amélioration continue des chaînes communicantes et la valorisation des données pour optimiser leur exploitation. Vous interviendrez sur des sujets à fort impact, mêlant performance, supervision et innovation. items.desc: Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager, operating in all liquid asset classes across the world. We are a technology and data driven group implementing a scientific approach to investing. Combining data, research, technology, and trading expertise has shaped QRT’s collaborative mindset which enables us to solve the most complex challenges. QRT’s culture of innovation continuously drives our ambition to deliver high quality returns for our investors. You will work within a data focused function supporting Quantitative Researchers, Traders and other stakeholders across the firm. The role focuses on designing and developing financial datasets that support systematic strategies and trading decisions, with particular emphasis on market data, pricing datasets and reference data. You will combine financial market knowledge with Python and data engineering skills to build and own the automated production pipelines that create and maintain these datasets. Your future role within QRT Collaborate with Quantitative Researchers and Traders to design financial datasets that support systematic strategies and trading decisions Develop Python code to extract, clean, normalise and aggregate data from a range of financial market data sources Design, build and maintain automated data pipelines covering sourcing, extraction, transformation, validation and delivery Develop and maintain pricing and reference datasets across financial instruments and markets Investigate and resolve data quality and production issues to improve the reliability and availability of datasets Evaluate and implement new approaches to data extraction, processing and onboarding Take ownership of production data workflows and evolve them as data requirements, systems and business priorities change Your present skillset 2 to 5 years of experience in a data focused role working with financial or market data Strong understanding of financial markets and instruments, including the behaviour and characteristics of pricing and reference datasets Advanced Python programming skills, including experience with data processing libraries such as Pandas or Polars Experience designing, building and maintaining automated production data pipelines Strong data analysis and problem solving skills, with the ability to investigate data quality issues and understand their underlying causes Experience working with market data platforms and APIs from providers such as Bloomberg or LSEG is beneficial, including products such as Datastream, DataScope Select, Real Time, BPIPE or Data License Postgraduate degree in Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science or another quantitative discipline Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with Quantitative Researchers, Traders and other stakeholders Ability to operate effectively as priorities, systems, projects and business requirements evolve QRT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome diversity as essential to our success. QRT empowers employees to work openly and respectfully to achieve collective success. In addition to professional achievement, we are offering initiatives and programs to enable employees achieve a healthy work-life balance.

items.desc: Shape the future of AI drug discovery at a pioneering start-up who have just secured an impressive Seed round within a few months of being founded. You’ll have full control over your technical environment, access to world-class compute resources and proprietary biomedical data, and the freedom to shape your research agenda. From day one, you’ll have the tools, support and autonomy to push the boundaries of AI-driven biological research. Other benefits include: Private medical and dental coverage Flexible time off with no strict limits Attendance to leading AI and biology conferences - fully funded Regular team meals and an environment designed to support ambitious research What you’ll do Define the technical stack, research standards and engineering culture from the ground up. Design, train and evaluate deep learning models for high-dimensional biological data, including molecular and clinical datasets. Build robust training infrastructure that enables a small team to run ambitious experiments with speed and scientific discipline, alongside rigorous evaluation frameworks for biological prediction. You’ll also develop AI agents that can reason over biological data, generate hypotheses, design experiments, interpret results and improve through feedback. What you’ll need A deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals and experience building research-grade models. Experience with biological data, such as single-cell, transcriptomics, proteomics, imaging, EHR, clinical trial or other high-dimensional biomedical datasets. Comfort with ambiguity, the ability to move quickly and a willingness to take ownership of hard problems. About the company An AI biology startup developing foundation models and intelligent agents to advance our understanding of human disease and accelerate scientific discovery. The team brings together complex data across molecular, cellular and clinical scales to predict how biological systems respond to interventions and uncover insights that can inform new treatments. Reach out to mason@ct-19.co.uk for more information.

items.desc: CHI SIAMO ADENTIS Italia è un gruppo europeo di consulenza ingegneristica e operativa facente parte del Gruppo MoOngy. Presente in 14 paesi europei con oltre 9.000 dipendenti, abbiamo aperto, da quattro anni, la prima sede italiana a Milano e, vista la continua crescita, stiamo rafforzando e ampliando il nostro team con persone che condividano gli stessi valori della nostra società: AMBIZIONE, DINAMISMO e VOGLIA DI METTERSI IN GIOCO , il tutto in una realtà in continua evoluzione, nella quale le relazioni umane sono sempre al primo posto. Ruolo: Data Scientist Modalità: ibrida Sede: Torino IL TUO RUOLO Per un progetto in ambito Automotive , siamo alla ricerca di un/una Data Scientist con almeno 3 anni di esperienza, da inserire in un team dedicato all'analisi dei dati e allo sviluppo di soluzioni data-driven. La risorsa si occuperà di analizzare grandi volumi di dati, individuare correlazioni e trend significativi e sviluppare modelli analitici e predittivi a supporto dell'ottimizzazione dei processi e delle prestazioni in ambito automotive. Responsabilità Analizzare, elaborare e interpretare dataset provenienti da sistemi e processi in ambito automotive. Eseguire attività di data cleaning, data processing ed esplorazione dei dati per garantirne qualità e affidabilità. Sviluppare e validare modelli statistici e algoritmi di Machine Learning per l'analisi predittiva. Individuare pattern, correlazioni e anomalie nei dati, trasformando i risultati in insight utili al business. Realizzare analisi, report e dashboard per la visualizzazione e la condivisione dei risultati. Collaborare con Data Engineer, sviluppatori e stakeholder tecnici per integrare le soluzioni analitiche nei processi aziendali. Documentare le analisi effettuate, le metodologie adottate e le performance dei modelli sviluppati. Requisiti Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nel ruolo di Data Scientist o in attività analoghe di Data Analysis e Advanced Analytics. Esperienza maturata in progetti o contesti Automotive . Buona conoscenza di Python e delle principali librerie per l'analisi dei dati, come Pandas, NumPy e Scikit-learn. Conoscenza di SQL per l'interrogazione e la manipolazione dei database. Familiarità con tecniche di analisi statistica e Machine Learning. Conoscenza di MATLAB, PySpark e di tecniche di analisi di serie storiche e manutenzione predittiva. Esperienza nella gestione, elaborazione e interpretazione di grandi volumi di dati. Conoscenza di strumenti di data visualization e reporting. Cosa offriamo? Contratto o collaborazione in p.iva. Inserimento in un contesto progettuale stimolante in ambito Automotive. Opportunità di crescita e consolidamento delle competenze tecniche. La retribuzione annua lorda per questo ruolo è compresa tra 28.000 EUR e 33.000 EUR. La posizione è inquadrata nell’ambito del CCNL del Commercio e Terziario applicato dalla nostra società. Il posizionamento all'interno del range sarà definito in base alle competenze tecniche, all'esperienza specifica nel ruolo e agli esiti del processo di selezione, secondo criteri oggettivi e predefiniti. In presenza di profili con caratteristiche eccezionali rispetto al range indicato, una revisione potrà essere valutata previa approvazione interna. The world needs you ADENTIS Italia è un equal opportunities employer: crediamo che tutte le forme di diversità siano fonte di arricchimento reciproco. Ci impegniamo a garantire un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo, nel quale ogni singola risorsa possa apportare un valore unico alla nostra realtà. Pertanto, accogliamo candidature senza distinzione di età, genere, nazionalità, disabilità, orientamento sessuale, religione o stato civile. Inoltre, teniamo fede ai nostri impegni prestando attenzione alle risorse appartenenti alle categorie protette ai sensi degli articoli 1 e 18 della Legge 68/99. I dati personali saranno trattati in conformità alle disposizioni contenute nel regolamento UE 2016/679.

items.desc: Wenn es darum geht, zukünftig Millionen Fahrgäste und Tausende Züge auch digital auf den Weg zu bringen, braucht es die besten IT-Expert:innen. Über 10.000 haben wir schon, aber längst nicht genug. Als Projektleiter:in, Berater:in, Entwickler:in oder IT-Architekt:in ist jetzt die spannendste Zeit, um einzusteigen und in einem starken Team wegweisende Lösungen sowie Großprojekte in den Bereichen Mobilität, Infrastruktur und Logistik umzusetzen. Im Cluster Data & AI Solutions (DAIS) der DB Systel gestalten wir mit Daten und Künstlicher Intelligenz die Mobilität von morgen. Unsere Teams entwickeln Lösungen rund um Data Engineering, Analytics, Data Governance, Datenplattformen sowie KI-gestützte Anwendungen. Gemeinsam mit den Geschäftsfeldern der Deutschen Bahn schaffen wir die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen und digitale Innovationen im gesamten Konzern. Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als Data & AI Engineer:in (w/m/d) für die DB Systel GmbH am Standort Berlin, Dresden, Duisburg, Erfurt, Essen, Frankfurt am Main, Halle (Saale), Hamburg, Hannover, Karlsruhe, Köln, München, Nürnberg oder Schwerin. Dies ist ein "Wo du Willst-Job": In Abstimmung mit deiner Führungskraft kannst du den Ort, an dem du arbeiten möchtest, innerhalb Deutschlands selbst disponieren und zwischen mobilem Arbeiten und Arbeiten im Büro wählen. Dein offizielles Büro wird arbeitsvertraglich festgehalten – bei mehreren ausgeschriebenen Standorten erfolgt die Festlegung im Gespräch zwischen dir und deiner Führungskraft. Deine Aufgaben: Als Data & AI Engineer:in konzipierst, entwickelst und verantwortest du komplexe anspruchsvolle Datenintegrations-, Machine-Learning und KI-lösungen für anspruchsvolle Anwendungs- und Produktumfelder Du entwickelst und optimierst ML-Modelle, Generative-AI-Anwendungen oder agentische KI-Lösungen mit vielfältigen fachlichen und technischen Funktionen sowie einem hohen Neuigkeitsgrad Zusätzlich entwickelst du komplexe Frontends, Backend-Services, Schnittstellen und Datenzugriffe mit einer Vielzahl heterogener Funktionen und technischer Verknüpfungen sowie einem hohen Neuigkeitsgrad Die Entwicklung umfangreicher Datenpipelines, Datenmodelle und cloudbasierter Datenlösungen mit hoher technischer Komplexität gehört zu deinem Verantwortungsbereich Du erarbeitest geeignete Daten- und Lösungsarchitekturen und berücksichtigst dabei Geschäftsprozesse sowie Anforderungen an Skalierbarkeit, Performance, Sicherheit, Wartbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit Bestehende Systemlandschaften entwickelst du durch die Integration neuer Datenlösungen gezielt weiter und koordinierst die Überführung produktionsreifer Lösungen in den Betrieb Gemeinsam mit internen und externen Beteiligten planst und koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit und steuerst fachliche sowie technische Abhängigkeiten eigenständig Als Fachexpert:in berätst du interne Kund:innen, Projektverantwortliche und das Management bei anspruchsvollen Fragestellungen im Data Engineering Dein Profil: Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, einer Naturwissenschaft oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. Alternativ bringst du eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung mit Langjährige Erfahrung im Data Engineering sowie mehrjährige Praxis in angrenzenden technischen Fachgebieten zeichnen deinen beruflichen Hintergrund aus Fundierte Expertise in der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Integration komplexer Datenarchitekturen, Datenplattformen, Datenpipelines und Datenmodelle über mehrere Systeme hinweg gehört zu deinem Profil Unterschiedliche Data-Engineering-Technologien, Cloud- und Datenplattformen, Integrationsmuster sowie Batch- und Streamingverfahren setzt du sicher und zielgerichtet ein Auch für neuartige und besonders anspruchsvolle Problemstellungen entwickelst du eigenständig tragfähige Lösungsansätze und übernimmst dabei eine hohe fachliche Verantwortung Die Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Entwicklungsstandards und Qualitätsvorgaben sowie deren nachhaltige Umsetzung über mehrere Lösungen hinweg fällt dir leicht Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung komplexer Vorhaben sowie in der Koordination zahlreicher interner und externer Beteiligter bringst du ebenfalls mit Komplexe Architektur- und Technologieentscheidungen kannst du adressatengerecht vertreten und überzeugend bis auf Managementebene vermitteln. Dein fachliches Know-how macht dich über dein unmittelbares Aufgabengebiet hinaus zu einer geschätzten Ansprechperson Das ist uns wichtig: Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Join our engineering team to drive large language model evaluation, RLHF, and training data quality across diverse AI/ML pipelines. Key Responsibilities in AI Training Pipelines In this mid-senior engineering position, your daily operations bridge the gap between raw data and deployed AI models. You will conduct comprehensive QA evaluation, named entity recognition, and complex data labeling tasks to maintain exceptional training data quality. By collaborating with remote freelance and full-time teams, you will refine LLM training pipelines and oversee critical annotation initiatives. Your direct contributions to RLHF and prompt evaluation will guarantee that our AI systems remain accurate, safe, and perfectly aligned with human intent. Required Skills And Qualifications Ideal candidates for our AI Generalist jobs in Finland bring a strong foundation in machine learning and AI/ML data operations. You must possess deep expertise in RLHF, large language model evaluation, and content safety labeling. We require a proven track record of annotation guidelines compliance and the ability to execute nuanced QA evaluation. Experience working remotely with annotation vendors, tech startups, or enterprise AI labs is highly desirable. Mastery of training data quality metrics and familiarity with computer vision annotation tools will distinguish top applicants in this 2026 hiring cycle.

items.desc: — Gestalte die Zukunft mit uns als Wissenschaftliche*r Mitarbeiter*in (m/w/d) im Bereich Simulation und Spatial Data Science im Rettungsdienst Vollzeit | Befristet | Karlsruhe | ab sofort Logistik, Simulation, Geodatenanalyse, Rettungsdienst, Versorgungsplanung, Data Science, Operations Research Du hast Lust, in einem innovativen Forschungsumfeld zu arbeiten? Du suchst ein tolles Team, in dem Du Dich weiterentwickeln und einbringen kannst? Und vor allem: Du willst die Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bist Du bei uns am FZI genau richtig! Wir sind eine gemeinnützige Forschungseinrichtung und beschäftigen uns mit spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben der Informatik-Anwendungsforschung. Unsere Aufgabe ist neben dem Transfer unserer Forschungsergebnisse in Wirtschaft, Verwaltung und Gesellschaft auch die Aus- und Weiterbildung von zukünftigen Fach- und Führungskräften für den digitalen Wandel. Das erwartet Dich bei uns Im Kompetenzzentrum für Logistik im Rettungsdienst schaffen wir die methodische und strukturelle Grundlage, um die datenbasierte Entscheidungsunterstützung im Rettungsdienst nachhaltig zu verbessern. Unsere Kernaufgabe ist es, die logistischen Problemstellungen im Rettungsdienst zu analysieren, zu modellieren und für deren Lösung Verfahren aus Operations Research und Data Science zu erforschen und umzusetzen. Du entwickelst im Rahmen des Kompetenzzentrums Simulationsmodelle zur Abbildung rettungsdienstlicher Prozesse und Strukturen. Du verknüpfst historische Einsatzdaten mit Geodaten und Netzwerkinformationen und erprobst Prognosemodelle für räumlich und zeitlich differenzierte Einsatzmuster. Du untersuchst die entwickelten Verfahren hinsichtlich Robustheit gegenüber unterschiedlichen Unsicherheitsfaktoren. Du wendest wissenschaftliche Methoden des Data Science und des Operations Research auf praktische Problemstellungen im Rettungsdienst an. Das bringst Du mit Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Masterstudium (oder Diplom) in Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, (Wirtschafts-/Geo-) Informatik, (Techno-/Wirtschafts-) Mathematik, Statistik oder in einem verwandten Studiengang mit einem Schwerpunkt im Bereich Anwendung von Methoden des Operations Research. Du bringst sehr gute Kenntnisse bei der Modellierung und Umsetzung von ereignisdiskreten und/oder agentenbasierten Simulationsmodellen mit (z.B. mit AnyLogic). Du hast Erfahrung bei der Entwicklung datengetriebener, geotemporaler Prognosen und Planungsszenarien. Du besitzt Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z.B. Java, Python, Rust, …). Du hast Interesse am Umgang mit GIS-nahen Methoden und der Verarbeitung, Analyse und Darstellung von Geodaten. Du besitzt ein überdurchschnittliches Maß an Eigeninitiative sowie eine sorgfältige, gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise und ein hohes Interesse an anwendungsorientierter wissenschaftlicher Arbeit. Du besitzt sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift. Was wir Dir bieten Unser Miteinander ist geprägt von der Begeisterung für unsere Themen und gemeinsamen Werte. Wir sind alle per „Du“ und helfen uns gegenseitig. Mit gelebter Vertrauensarbeitszeit, flexiblen Arbeitsformen sowie bei Vollzeitbeschäftigung 30 Urlaubstagen im Jahr geben wir Dir die Freiheit, die Du benötigst, um Dein Privat- und Berufsleben zu vereinbaren. Sofern die fachlichen und persönlichen Voraussetzungen erfüllt sind, bieten wir Dir ein Entgelt entsprechend TV-L EG 13. Deine Weiterentwicklung steht bei uns im Mittelpunkt: Am FZI hat jedes Teammitglied ein festes Weiterbildungsbudget und regelmäßige Feedbackgespräche. Zudem gibt es zahlreiche Unterstützungsangebote – auch in den Bereichen Freizeit und Gesundheit. Zum Thema Simulation und Optimierung im Rettungsdienst betreut unser Direktor Prof. Dr. Stefan Nickel derzeit eine Reihe von Promotionsvorhaben. Wir bieten Dir professionelle Rahmenbedingungen in einem exzellentem Forschungs- und Anwendungsumfeld. Sprich uns im Rahmen Deiner Bewerbung darauf an, falls Du an einer Promotion ebenfalls Interesse hast. Außerdem bieten wir Dir viele Möglichkeiten zur Mitgestaltung des FZI und ein starkes Netzwerk in Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft. Lerne hier Deinen zukünftigen Bereich und das Team kennen Erhalte hier Einblicke zum Arbeiten am FZI Hier erfährst Du mehr über unsere Benefits Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bewirb Dich bei uns. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen! Fachliche Fragen zur Stelle beantwortet Dir gerne Boris Amberg , Telefon: +49 721 9654-316 . Jetzt bewerben Zurück

items.desc: About us Applications are invited for a Postdoctoral Research Fellow in the Institute of Infection, Immunity and Transplantation, UCL funded by a Wellcome Discovery Team Award to Prof.s McKeating, Issa, Quaglia and Maini. Work within the Maini lab aims to translate advances in the understanding of pathogens, cancer and the immune system into improved diagnosis and therapy. The lab is housed in the newly built Pears Building in Hampstead. Its close links to the adjacent Royal Free London hospital provide an excellent interface between science and medicine. Mala strengthens this translational focus by her own clinical links and those of her clinical colleagues. The Institute provides an effective infrastructure for immunology/virology research and a lively and sociable environment, always striving for excellence. There is an established track record for post-docs gaining personal fellowships, with Mala having successfully supported seven of these just in the last couple of years; independently minded and talented investigators will be encouraged and supported in seeking such fellowship support. About the role The successful candidate will join a dynamic group of basic and clinical scientists all working on integrated aspects of the immunopathogenesis and immunotherapy of hepatitis B, liver cancer and SARS-CoV-2, with a number of leading national and international collaborators. The lab's central research goal is to re-direct the immune response to control hepatitis B virus (HBV) and resultant hepatocellular carcinoma by reconstituting successful T and B cell responses, working with patient samples, murine and in vitro 2D/3D models. Our careful delineation of the unique immune cellular interactions and microenviromental niche within the liver environment is informing the development of tailored therapeutic approaches. This post-holder will work on a cutting-edge programme of work funded by a Wellcome Team Discovery award, collaborating with other group members at UCL and the University of Oxford. This post will be predominantly focused on a detailed in situ examination of viral/host interactions in human HBV-infected liver using cutting-edge multiparameter transciptome and proteome approaches. The project is providing exciting edge new insights into the topology of key immune effectors and suppressors in relation to HBV-infected hepatocytes and zonal hypoxia.The new post-holder will build on spatial transcriptomic data generated and analysed by the team of post-docs based in the McKeating lab in Oxford to complement this with targeted multiplexed cyclic immunoflourecence microscopy liver staining together with flow cytometric phenotyping and functional experiments. This is a fixed term position available for 1 year in the first instance. About you The post holder will be an enthusiastic postdoctoral researcher, expected to perform high quality research under the supervision of the group leader, Mala Maini, working closely with her senior post-docs, PhD students and technicians in the lab. They will also work with co-investigator Prof Quaglia (liver histopathologist at the RFL) and collaboratively with co-investigators Prof McKeating and Prof Issa and their post-docs in the University of Oxford. We are seeking highly motivated individuals with the ability to generate their own research strategies and pursue them with determination, flexibility and creativity. They should have experience in human cellular immunology, ideally in viral immunity, with skills in tissue immunostaining and large data analysis. items.desc: Vuoi iniziare una nuova avventura professionale come C++ Embedded Software Engineer in una delle nostre opportunità nel settore Aeronautico a Milano ? 👉 Cosa farai? • Sviluppare e manutenere applicazioni software in C++ per sistemi aerospaziali e di difesa. • Collaborare con i team di ingegneria per l’analisi dei requisiti e la definizione delle specifiche tecniche. • Progettare, implementare e ottimizzare algoritmi per sistemi di robotica e/o AI-based. • Eseguire attività di debugging, troubleshooting e ottimizzazione delle performance del codice. • Redigere e mantenere la documentazione tecnica a supporto delle soluzioni sviluppate. • Partecipare alle code review garantendo qualità e aderenza agli standard. • Collaborare con i team di test e validazione per l’integrazione del software sui sistemi target. • Contribuire al miglioramento continuo di processi, strumenti e best practice di sviluppo. ✍️ Cosa Richiediamo? • Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Elettronica, dell’Automazione, Robotica, AI Engineering o affini, o esperienza equivalente. • Esperienza di almeno 3 anni nello sviluppo software in C++ in contesti embedded, safety critical o similari. • Solida conoscenza di C++ (preferibilmente versioni moderne) e dei principali paradigmi di programmazione a oggetti. • Conoscenza della lingua italiana a livello madrelingua/C2 e della lingua inglese a livello B1/B2. • Capacità di lavorare in team multidisciplinari e di adattarsi a un ambiente tecnico dinamico. ✨ Che cosa offriamo? • Una comunità internazionale che riunisce oltre 110 nazionalità diverse. • An environment in cui la fiducia è centrale e la crescita interna è valorizzata (oltre il 70% dei nostri leader ha iniziato da ruoli junior). • Un solido sistema di formazione con Academy interna e oltre 250 moduli disponibili. • Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico con eventi interni (afterwork, team building, ecc.). • Un forte impegno verso benessere, CSR (programma WeCare Together) e work-life balance. Benefici locali in Italia: • Buoni pasto. • Programma di welfare con sconti e vantaggi per le persone dipendenti. • Opzioni di lavoro flessibili secondo policy aziendale (politica di lavoro ibrido ove applicabile al ruolo/progetto). • Assicurazione sanitaria e programmi di benessere, ove applicabili. 💰 Remunerazione e trasparenza • Gross Annual Salary Range / RAL iniziale fissa: EUR 24.000 – EUR 36.000 . • CCNL del Commercio. • La fascia retributiva è definita secondo criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. • Componente variabile: eventuali premi discrezionali non garantiti non inclusi nella RAL indicata. • Durante il processo di selezione non chiederemo informazioni sulla tua retribuzione attuale o precedente. Le nostre fasce retributive sono volutamente ampie, perché cerchiamo persone di talento, non “profili standard”. Uno stesso ruolo può attrarre candidature molto diverse tra loro, e crediamo sia importante lasciare spazio a questa varietà. La collocazione all’interno della fascia dipenderà dalla tua esperienza specifica, dalle tue competenze e da ciò che potrai portare nel ruolo. 🙌 La persona ideale si riconosce in questi valori: Boldness: il nostro spirito di avventura imprenditoriale è ciò che ci unisce tutti e ci porta al successo. Trust: la fiducia è il fondamento di tutte le relazioni, la fiducia ci consente di promuovere la libertà di espressione, creatività e innovazione. Performance: questo si traduce in un desiderio costante di andare avanti e non smettere mai di chiedere di più a noi stessi. Commitment: non ci limitiamo a rispettare i nostri impegni e lavoriamo duramente per ottenere grandi risultati. Independence: Amaris Consulting appartiene a chi l'ha creata e a chi la sviluppa ogni giorno. Candidandoti per questa posizione, potresti avere l'opportunità di entrare a far parte di un'azienda che supporta i propri partner nei settori Automotive & Motorsport, Avionic & Aerospace, Difesa, Railway, Industrial, Domotica e Robotica, con attività di ingegneria meccanica ed elettronica nelle aree Development & Design, Testing & Validation, System Engineering, R&D e Project Management. Diversità e Inclusione Amaris Consulting promuove pari opportunità e valuta le candidature sulla base di competenze, esperienza e potenziale. Accogliamo candidature qualificate senza discriminazioni legate a genere, identità o espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, origine etnica, nazionalità, religione o convinzioni personali, età, disabilità, stato civile o familiare, o altre caratteristiche protette. Se hai bisogno di adattamenti ragionevoli durante il processo di selezione, comunicacelo: faremo il possibile per supportarti.

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and communities, we particularly welcome applicants who are currently under- represented in our workforce.

items.desc: At the Fraunhofer Institute of Optronics, System Technology and Image Exploitation IOSB we perform fundamental and applied research in the fields of laser technology, photonics, imaging sensor systems, and much more. Our expertise ranges from the physical fundamentals in optics and photonics to data evaluation using AI for various application domains. The position is located in the interdisciplinary department "Laser Technology" at the Ettlingen site, which focuses on research and development of specific photonic materials and components, special laser sources and nonlinear converters, as well as the optimization of laser systems in the NIR, SWIR, MWIR, and LWIR ranges for different application fields. A particular emphasis is placed on high-power fiber lasers in the 2-µm wavelength range. More information about the department can be found at: www.iosb.fraunhofer.de/las Are you interested in the realization, optimization, and further development of high-power fiber lasers and their components and would like to advance research and development in this area? Do you want to participate in projects that benefit national defense? Then apply to us and seize the opportunity to work in the dynamic research environment of a renowned institute! What You Will Do You will develop, investigate, and optimize fiber laser designs, define new fiber requirements where necessary, and realize laser setups up to demonstrators using also internally realized photonic components with new functionalities. You will engage in the scientific investigation of fiber lasers to evaluate various fiber laser architectures in a broadly positioned team of experts in the field of photonic components, laser sources, and nonlinear converters. You will contribute to the improvement of fiber components and new designs. You will independently work on projects in fiber laser technology and write reports and publications in English and, if possible, in German. What You Bring To The Table You hold a completed scientific degree (Diploma/Master) in Physics, Electrical Engineering, or comparable fields, preferably with a doctorate. You have experience in the design and realization of fiber lasers (design of laser resonators and amplifiers, assembly of optical components, thermal and nonlinear effects in fiber lasers) and related measurement techniques (beam quality, spectrum, temporal dynamics, etc.). Ideally, you have knowledge in the handling of splicing devices and heat sinks for fiber lasers. Knowledge in one or more areas of fiber optics, micro optics, or simulation of fiber lasers is advantageous. You are passionate about scientific work but also want to transfer your research results into practical applications. Very good German (B2/C1 level) and very good English (at least B2 level) in spoken and written form complete your profile. What You Can Expect A varied, exciting role at the interface between science and industry, between present and future. Great freedom for scientific development and self-determined advancement of topics and projects in a young, expanding department. A globally unique laboratory equipment with modern, partly non-commercially available components and measuring devices. Motivated colleagues who inspire each other through their interdisciplinary and international composition. Individual career paths through extensive training and development opportunities (e.g., funding and development program "Fraunhofer TALENTA" for female scientists and leaders). Optimal conditions for balancing work and private life (flexible working hours, mobile working within the requirements of the position, childcare place quota in Karlsruhe, etc.). If suitable, we offer you the opportunity for a doctorate if not yet completed. The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is also available on a part-time basis. The position is initially limited to 2 years. An extension is being sought. We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications - regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability. Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD). Additionally Fraunhofer may grant performance-based variable remuneration components. With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future. Interested? Apply online now. We look forward to getting to know you! If you have questions please contact: Dr. Christelle Kieleck (Abteilungsleiterin Lasertechnologie) Telefon: +49 (0)7243 992-310 Prof. Dr. …

items.desc: ISS STOXX empowers investors and companies to build for long-term and sustainable growth by providing high-quality data, analytics, and insight. We are committed to positively impacting the environment and society through our market-leading solutions and leading by example. Our clients have long turned to ISS STOXX to apply their corporate governance views, identify environmental, social, and governance risks, and manage their global proxy voting needs. Need a refresher on what Corporate Governance and Proxy Voting are? Corporate governance is the system by which companies are directed and controlled. Boards of directors are responsible for the governance of their companies. The shareholders’ role in governance is developing continuously with investors increasingly acting as responsible stewards and taking into account a wide range of ESG topics. This may include considerations such as the appointment of directors, approving executive remuneration schemes, M&A, and equity issuances. Shareholders are invited by public companies they have shares in to vote on a wide range of topics during annual general meetings and special meetings. They can delegate their voting power to a representative, who will then be considered a proxy . Here at ISS STOXX, we provide the research, insight and recommendations for our clients to make informed voting decisions. Enter the world of corporate governance and responsible investment and jumpstart your career by gaining exposure to the fundamental affairs of businesses and economies on a global scale. What you will do ISS STOXX seeks a pool of talented and self-motivated data analyst trainees for February 2027. Our trainees will be assigned to a dynamic regional market (Eastern Europe and other markets based on business needs) and guided by our experienced analysts. As a Corporate Governance Data Analyst Trainee, you will become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of helping deliver data to our clients, that are institutional shareholders. The traineeship will take place during “proxy voting season.” Our goal is to support our clients in making informed voting decisions on that occasion. Your responsibilities will include: Gathering comprehensive data in companies' public documents (annual reports, reference documents, etc.), notably concerning the board composition, related-party transactions, auditors’ fees, etc. Collecting and analyzing the information with regards to the local code of best practice in corporate governance and ISS STOXX voting policy. What you will bring to ISS STOXX: Fluent in English (both spoken and written) and Polish or Russian. A relevant Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Law, or Political Sciences or in the process of obtaining such a degree. A prior experience in a relevant area will be considered as an advantage. A strong analytical ability, numeracy, strong oral and written communication skills. The ability to assimilate large quantities of information, work independently and take initiative while also being a team player. An organized and structured mind. But above all else we are most interested in the things that make you, you. The unique personal qualities, extracurricular activities and accomplishments that show who you are as a person and what value you could bring to the team. What you will gain from this traineeship: Develop a deeper understanding of relevant technical terminology within the world of corporate governance and responsible investment. Receive in-depth training to fulfill your career aspirations. Expand your know-how and contribute significantly to client work. Make a difference and perform in a workplace of integrity and transparency. This traineeship is remunerated 2,242.81€ gross per month and will run for 4.5 months, from the 1st of February 2027 to the 11th of June 2027. Trainees are required to work from the ISS STOXX office 5 days a week and must be based in the country of employment from Day 1 of the traineeship. Please note that this is a fixed-term position with financial remuneration (salary), rather than a formal internship. Students seeking a placement as part of their academic program are welcome to apply and are encouraged to check with their university whether the experience can be recognised as part of their curriculum. Interested in this great learning opportunity? Apply online by sending your CV in English. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous êtes passionné par la Data Science, l'Intelligence Artificielle et les marchés financiers ? Rejoignez l'équipe Business Intelligence de SGCIB, une équipe récemment créée au sein des opérations de marché dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en informations exploitables pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel, accélérer la prise de décision et développer les usages innovants autour de la Data Science et de l'IA. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous souhaitons renforcer notre capacité d'innovation autour du Machine Learning et des analyses avancées afin d'explorer de nouveaux leviers d'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle sur les activités de règlement-livraison et de prêt/emprunt de titres. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Identifier, étudier et expérimenter des cas d'usage Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée pour les métiers Concevoir et développer des Proofs of Concept de Machine Learning permettant notamment de détecter des anomalies, identifier des facteurs explicatifs ou construire des modèles prédictifs Participer à l'évaluation et à la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes autour de l'Intelligence Artificielle, des plateformes analytiques en mutation et des nouvelles technologies de traitement de données Réaliser des analyses exploratoires sur de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, corrélations et opportunités d'amélioration des processus opérationnels Contribuer à la construction et à l'évolution de notre Data Factory en participant à la collecte, à la transformation et à l'enrichissement de données provenant de multiples systèmes Participer à l'industrialisation des pipelines de données et à l'amélioration continue de notre environnement analytique Accompagner la production d'études, d'indicateurs et d'analyses destinés aux équipes opérationnelles et au management Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous préparez un diplôme Bac+5 (École d'Ingénieur, Université ou Master spécialisé) avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, Statistiques appliquées, Big Data ou Informatique décisionnelle Vous disposez idéalement d'une bonne maîtrise de Python et de son écosystème Data (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) Vous avez des connaissances en SQL, manipulation de données, Machine Learning et méthodes statistiques Vous avez une appétence pour l'analyse de données complexes et le traitement de grands volumes d'information Vous avez de l'intérêt pour les architectures de données modernes et les environnements analytiques Une connaissance de technologies telles que Spark, Databricks, dbt, Azure ou Power BI constituera un plus Qualités recherchées: curiosité intellectuelle, goût pour l'expérimentation, esprit analytique, capacité de synthèse, autonomie et force de proposition, capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs métier, esprit d'équipe et sens de la collaboration Vous avez une aisance en anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral Une première sensibilisation aux marchés financiers est appréciée mais n'est pas indispensable Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos seniors qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? items.desc: Passage de capsules via une Squeezing Particles into a Constriction: AI-Based Data Analysis micro-fluidique Réf ABG-140543 Stage master 2 / Ingénieur Durée 6 mois Salaire net mensuel 650 13/10/2026 Laboratoire Biomécanique et Bioingénierie (UMR CNRS 7338) Lieu de travail Compiègne Les Hauts de France France Champs scientifiques Sciences de l’ingénieur Mots clés Particles, Flow, Pores, Constriction, Machine Learning, Data Analysis Date limite de candidature 11/11/2026 Établissement recruteur Site web : https://bmbi.utc.fr Les activités de recherche du laboratoire BMBI concernent la Biomécanique et la Bioingénierie, plus particulièrement la Mécanique du Vivant et l’Ingénierie pour la Santé. La spécificité de BMBI est sa pluridisciplinarité qui se traduit par des projets de recherches interdisciplinaires associant les compétences en mécanique, physique, traitement du signal, biologie (cellulaire et moléculaire), biochimie, physiologie. Description Scientific context - How do soft particles squeeze through narrow pores? This question is relevant to many applications in biological flows, environmental transport, and biomedical microfluidic devices. When deformable particles flow through a constriction, their interactions with the walls and with neighboring particles can lead to complex behaviors, such as, collisions, aggregation and eventually clogging of the constriction. We study these phenomena using fully three-dimensional computer simulations of fluid-filled capsules, performed with our in-house software. By varying key parameters such as the applied flow, number of particles, particle deformability and constriction width, we generate large data-sets covering a wide range of dynamical regimes. Project objective - The main goal of this project is to develop AI based tools for analyzing and extracting automatically information from these large simulation datasets. The student will investigate machine learning and computer vision methods to: automatically detect and track individual particles, extract particle trajectories and velocities, identify particle-particle and particle-wall interactions, classify different dynamical regimes, such as passage, and aggregation, identify patterns linking simulation parameters to the observed dynamics. Required skills - This interdisciplinary project combines computational physics, fluid mechanics, data analysis, machine learning and computer vision. It offers an opportunity to work with large-scale simulation data and develop AI tools for analyzing complex physical systems. Depending on the student's interests, the developed methods can also be applied to other soft-particle systems, including existing datasets of red blood cells flowing through microfluidic channels. Profil Biomécanique / biomatériaux / bioingénierie / biomédical Notions de mécanique des fluides et/ou solides Capacité à travailler en équipe dans un contexte interdisciplinaire Rigueur, motivation, dynamisme Prise de fonction 01/02/2027

items.desc: Wissenschaftliche(r) Mitarbeiter(in) (m/w/d) Im Projekt „KI-gestützte Prozesskontrolle für ultra-reine Elektrolyte – PURElyte“ Befristung: 3 Jahre Beginn: 01.01.2027 Standort: Kaiserslautern Umfang: Vollzeit Vergütung: Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L Fachbereich: Maschinenbau und Verfahrenstechnik Die Rheinland-Pfälzische Technische Universität Kaiserslautern-Landau (RPTU) ist mit rund 15.000 Studierenden, mehr als 300 Professuren und rund 160 Studiengängen die Technische Universität des Landes Rheinland-Pfalz. Als Ort internationaler Spitzenforschung bietet sie exzellente Arbeitsbedingungen und Karrierechancen. Wer an der RPTU lernt, forscht oder arbeitet, erlebt ein weltoffenes Umfeld und gestaltet die Zukunft. Die rasante Entwicklung von Lithium-Ionen-Batterien stellt zunehmend höhere Anforderungen an die Reinheit und Qualität der eingesetzten Materialien. Bereits sehr geringe Mengen partikulärer Verunreinigungen können die Leistung, Sicherheit und Lebensdauer von Batterien beeinträchtigen. Gemeinsam mit einem führenden Hersteller von Batterie-Elektrolyten und einem Unternehmen für Inline-Partikelmessungen sollen in diesem Projekt kritische partikuläre Verunreinigungen in Batterie-Elektrolyten identifiziert und experimentell charakterisiert sowie ein innovatives Adsorber-Filter-System zu deren zuverlässiger Entfernung entwickelt werden. Ihr Aufgabengebiet: Sie werden die partikulären Verunreinigungen physikalisch-chemisch charakterisieren und ihre Wechselwirkungen mit Trennmedien sowie ihre gezielte Abscheidung untersuchen. Auf dieser Grundlage werden Sie maßgeschneiderte Trennprozesse mit hoher Abscheideeffizienz entwickeln. Die Mikrostruktur der Trennmedien wird mithilfe einer Kombination aus Experimenten, numerischen Simulationen und KI-gestützter Prozessanalyse der Strömungs-, Adsorptions- und Filtrationsprozesse optimiert. Ziel des Projekts ist es, die wissenschaftlichen Grundlagen für eine zuverlässige Prozesskontrolle bei der Herstellung hochreiner Elektrolyte zu schaffen und damit zur Entwicklung stabiler, effizienter und langlebiger Batteriezellen beizutragen. items.desc: At Longshot Systems we're building advanced platforms for sports betting analytics and trading. We're hiring Graduate Machine Learning Researchers for our quantitative modelling team. The primary goal of this team is to improve the predictive power of our models based on historical event data. The quality of our models is incredibly important to us and improvements to our models directly impact company success. You will design, test, and implement new machine learning models in Python, continually improving our existing state-of-the-art solutions. Longshot is a small, focused company and so the role suits someone who wants to be involved in all aspects of the R&D process, from high-level design through to production implementation and who has a keenness to learn from experienced industry experts. The ideal candidate will be highly creative and enjoy generating new, innovative ways to tackle problems and suggesting improvements to existing methodologies; you'll have a high level of autonomy to research whichever methods you feel would be best suited to the problem at hand. A strong mathematical understanding of the fundamentals of Machine Learning and core statistics is very important for this role. Knowledge of sports betting isn't required. We are a hybrid working company, working Thursdays in our London (Farringdon) office and remotely the rest of the week. Our typical working hours are 10 am to 6 pm UK time, Monday to Friday, but we support flexible working and trust our team to manage their own schedules to meet their goals. Our interview process is as follows: Intro call (30 mins) - your background + interests Technical interview (60 mins) - modelling discussion + scenario questions Full assessment day (10:00-17:00) - solving a real modelling problem using near-production-level data Requirements PhD or research Masters in a quantitative, technical subject (e.g. Maths, Physics, Machine Learning) from a top university Experience modelling tabular data in Python Benefits Participation in the uncapped company bonus scheme, typically 10-20% of salary depending on experience 10% matched pension contributions Private healthcare insurance Long term illness insurance Gym membership Choose your own hardware & setup for your development environment

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Net afgestudeerd en klaar om écht iets met AI te doen? Heb je al wat ervaring met Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning of Generative AI en wil je je verder ontwikkelen tot een echte AI-expert? Dan is het Young Professional Track AI Engineering bij Sogeti jouw kans om impact te maken. In deze periode leer je hoe je AI slim inzet om organisaties te helpen vernieuwen en verbeteren. Je werkt met moderne technologieën, behaalt relevante certificeringen en doet ervaring op bij klanten in het zuiden! Jouw start bij Sogeti Je begint met een traject waarin je samen met andere starters werkt aan uitdagende opdrachten, coaching krijgt en je skills ontwikkelt zoals samenwerken, communiceren en persoonlijk leiderschap. Een periode vol groei en verbinding. Daarna start je met een inhoudelijke opleiding waarin je jezelf verder ontwikkelt op het gebied van Data & AI. Je leert werken met moderne Data & AI-tools en technieken en behaalt direct relevante certificeringen. Werken als AI Engineer Na twee maanden opleiding is het zover: je gaat het veld in. Samen kijken we welke opdracht het beste bij jou past. Je wordt gedetacheerd bij grote Nederlandse organisaties, waar je aan de slag gaat met AI. Je helpt klanten om AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen die niet op de tekentafel blijven liggen, maar daadwerkelijk in de praktijk gebruikt worden. Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering en werkt aan oplossingen die betrouwbaar, schaalbaar en uitlegbaar zijn. Afhankelijk van de opdracht werk je bijvoorbeeld aan het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van AI- en ML-componenten, het bouwen van end-to-end oplossingen van proof of concept tot productie, het integreren van modellen in applicaties en processen of het verbeteren van de uitlegbaarheid en beheersbaarheid van AI-oplossingen. Je werkt samen met Data Scientists, Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers en stakeholders aan oplossingen die organisaties helpen beter te beslissen en te innoveren. Ondertussen blijf je jezelf ontwikkelen met trainingen, cursussen en coaching van je Talentmanager. Zo ondersteunen wij jou om de beste versie van jezelf te worden Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Persoonlijke begeleiding van jouw Talentmanager; Werken aan impactvolle IT-projecten bij bekende organisaties; Focus op mentale gezondheid en vitaliteit, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, sportvergoeding en vitaliteitsprogramma’s; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op; Startsalaris van €3730,- (incl. mobiliteitsvergoeding van €750 en vakantiegeld); 26 vakantiedagen (met mogelijkheid tot bijkopen), onkostenvergoeding en een salarisgroeimodel met elke 6 maanden kans op een verhoging binnen 1,5 jaar. Direct een vast contract; Mogelijkheid tot hybride werken (thuiswerkvergoeding); Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan. Jouw talenten en ervaringen Je staat aan het begin van je carrière en hebt zin om te leren, te bouwen en impact te maken met AI; Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in AI, Data Science, Computer Science of een vergelijkbare richting; Basiskennis van Python en affiniteit met AI- of ML-frameworks zoals PyTorch, TensorFlow of scikit-learn; Interesse in het bouwen van AI-oplossingen van verkenning tot implementatie, en nieuwsgierigheid naar hoe modellen in productie waarde leveren; Affiniteit met onderwerpen zoals Generative AI, Agentic AI, explainability, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid van oplossingen; Kennis van software engineering, data of cloud is mooi meegenomen, net als interesse in deployment en MLOps; Relevante stage- of werkervaring; Proactief, doelgericht en goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal (minimaal C1-niveau). Meer over Sogeti Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om de beste versie van jezelf te worden - als professional, als collega én als mens. Je werkt in een hechte community van gelijkgestemden, waarin kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is: van inhoudelijke events en communities tot initiatieven als de Gamenight. Met onze sterke lokale aanwezigheid werk je aan échte projecten met impact, altijd met de ondersteuning van een betrokken People Manager die meedenkt over jouw groei. Tegelijkertijd profiteer je van de slagkracht en expertise van de Capgemini Group. Bij Sogeti geloven we in diversiteit en inclusie: iedereen is welkom en mag zichzelf zijn. Twijfel je of dit helemaal past? App ons - dan kijken we samen. Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met Annemiek Schoute (recruiter). items.desc: At Ayvens, progress starts with you. Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move. Tätigkeitsbeschreibung DARAUF KANNST DU DICH FREUEN Dein Onboarding … beginnt mit unserer „Welcome Hour“, in der du, gemeinsam mit allen weiteren neuen Kolleginnen und Kollegen, von der Geschäftsführung und HR begrüßt wirst. Deine Work & Life-Balance … unterstützen wir mit unserem Mobile Working Modell. Du hast die Möglichkeit, im Rahmen flexibler Arbeitszeiten teilweise von zu Hause zu arbeiten, wir freuen uns aber genauso, dich im Office zu sehen. Für deine Urlaubsplanung kannst du selbstverständlich mit 30 Tagen rechnen. Deine Gesundheit … ist uns wichtig - deshalb bieten wir dir umfassende Versicherungsleistungen sowie Resilienz-Workshops an, um deine physische und mentale Gesundheit zu stärken. Deine Mobilität … fördern wir durch einen Fahrtkostenzuschuss für den ÖPNV, attraktive Mietwagenkonditionen sowie weitere spannende Mobilitätsangebote. Unsere Unternehmenskultur … wird geprägt von unserem gemeinsamen Handeln. Das konstante Vorleben unserer Werte - Authenticity, Collaboration, Curiosity und Commitment - ist dafür von großer Bedeutung. Eine offene Feedbackkultur ist fester Bestandteil unseres Alltags, unterstützt durch unser Talent- und Performancemanagement. Wir kommunizieren transparent u.a. in monatlichen All Staff-Meetings und lockeren Austauschgesprächen in unserer „One Hour“ mit dem Management-Team. Und natürlich feiern wir auch gemeinsam Sommerfeste, Weihnachtsfeiern und sind zusammen aktiv bei sportlichen Veranstaltungen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich Du möchtest mit Daten echten Geschäftswert schaffen, innovative Pricing-Modelle entwickeln und strategische Entscheidungen mit fundierten Analysen unterstützen? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte die Zukunft unseres Pricings aktiv mit. Du nutzt Daten und Analytics, um fundierte Preisstrategien zu entwickeln und technische Restwerte zu prognostizieren. Du arbeitest mit modernen Tools und entwickelst analytische Modelle für unsere Dienstleistungen (Reparatur, Wartung, Instandhaltung). Du erkennst Risiken und erstellst automatisierte Dashboards & Reports, um das Management mit den besten Insights zu versorgen. Du arbeitest hands-on mit großen Datensätzen, bereitest Fahrzeugdaten auf und visualisierst sie in verständlicher Form. Du begleitest neben der Konzeption Deiner Ideen auch end-to-end die strategische und technische Umsetzung Deiner Ideen Du bist kommunikativ und vernetzt – mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, um sicherzustellen, dass unsere Pricing-Modelle topaktuell sind. Das bringst Du mit Ein Studium mit analytischem Fokus – BWL, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Data Science, Mathematik, Physik oder ähnliches. Hands-on Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse & Modellierung – erste Berührungspunkte mit Pricing, Risikomanagement oder Controlling sind ein Plus! Tech-Skills: Excel und PowerPoint kannst du im Schlaf – Bonuspunkte gibt’s für Erfahrung mit Python, R oder SQL. Du denkst analytisch & strategisch, hast aber auch Lust, deine Ideen umzusetzen und Prozesse zu challengen. Sprachlich fit: Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch & Englisch – sei es in Präsentationen oder im Austausch mit Kolleg:innen. Why Ayvens? With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive. At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are. Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

items.desc: Liberty Blume Business Solutions, or BBS for short, sits right at the heart of what we do at Liberty Blume, providing technology first, cost effective business services that can be scaled to provide the support our businesses need to operate effectively. This is not a rotation programme designed to give you a flavour of different jobs. It is a structured two-year technical apprenticeship built to produce engineers who understand business context, can operate in AI-native environments, and are ready to contribute meaningfully from day one. We are building Liberty Blume's technology function from the ground up. A GCP-first platform organisation with AI embedded at its core. The graduates who join this scheme will work alongside that buildout, not observe it from the sidelines. We have four places. We are looking for people who are technically sharp, intellectually curious, and willing to work in ambiguity. The Assessment Centre for this scheme will be held in mid January 2027, with anticipated start date September 2027. What To Expect Year 1 — Technology Context Rotations Three rotations of approximately 4 months each across the Technology supplementary functions. The purpose is not job-shadowing — you will own deliverables in each rotation. Product & Delivery — work embedded with our product team on our internal and external products. Learn how technical decisions translate into product outcomes. Tech PMO — contribute to resource and delivery tracking across our engineering portfolio. Understand how technology investment is governed, tracked, and reported. Tech Strategy— support architecture review, vendor assessment, and strategic initiatives. Year 2 — Engineering Team A full year embedded in our central Engineering team. You will contribute to production codebases and AI platform development on Google Cloud Platform. By the end of Year 2, you will be operating as a junior software engineer with real responsibilities. Throughout Year 2, you will work toward Google Cloud certifications, supported by structured study time and access to Google's training resources. What You Will Work On Liberty Blume builds and operates technology platforms for our business and customer. Our core platforms run on a microservices architecture on GCP. Our AI platform (Blume AI) is being built on Vertex AI and is central to our product strategy. During This Scheme You Can Expect Direct Exposure To Google Cloud Platform - e.g. Cloud Run, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Apigee, Document AI AI and LLM integration – e.g. working with large language models in production contexts, not just experimental settings Infrastructure-as-code – e.g. Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD pipelines API-first architecture – e.g. microservices design patterns, integration engineering Data engineering – e.g. structured data pipelines, analytics, FinOps instrumentation We work closely with Google Cloud as a strategic partner. Graduates on this scheme will benefit from that relationship directly, including access to Google-led training and the pathway to formal GCP certifications. Who We Are Looking For We are primarily targeting graduates from Computer Science, Software Engineering, or adjacent STEM disciplines. However, we are open to any STEM background if you can demonstrate strong technical aptitude and the right mindset. We are more interested in how you think, than what you already know. The landscape of software development is changing rapidly, AI-assisted engineering is already here. We want people who can adapt, reason clearly under ambiguity, and learn fast. You Should Apply If You Have or are completing a degree in a STEM subject (Computer Science or Engineering preferred) Can demonstrate genuine curiosity about how technology systems work — not just surface-level interest Are comfortable working with incomplete information and iterating toward a solution Have some exposure to programming, scripting, or data analysis — however that came about Are interested in the intersection of AI, cloud infrastructure, and real business problems Want to understand the full stack from business context to production deployment You Probably Should Not Apply If You Are looking for a clearly defined 9-to-5 with low ambiguity Want to spend Year 1 watching and Year 2 doing Are not interested in engineering as an outcome Salary & Benefits Competitive salary 25 days annual leave with the option to purchase 5 more Access to wellbeing and mental health benefits such as the Calm app, personal medical, critical illness cover and dental insurance Matched pension contribution up to 10% Access to our car benefit scheme 24 hours Paid Volunteer Time Off Entitlement to a birthday day off Access to our online learning platform to continue to develop and grow your career with us The chance to join an innovative, fast-paced and passionate team

FUNCIONES DE PUESTO (FUNCIONES CLAVE) Comprensión de las necesidades del negocio y propuesta de soluciones analíticas basadas en ML & IA que ayuden a conseguir sus objetivos Diseño de las soluciones analíticas, considerando la viabilidad técnica y el impacto en negocio en colaboración con equipos multidisciplinares Realizar los análisis descriptivos, pipelines de transformación de los datos y el entrenamiento de los modelos ML o DL más adecuados a cada caso de uso Monitorizar modelos analíticos, ML e IA de diferente complejidad en producción en el área acompañados de los equipos de MLOPs Seguimiento del impacto en negocio, así como de las métricas técnicas y proponer mejoras Documentación de los casos de uso y decisiones tomadas Participar en la definición de metodologías y buenas prácticas dentro del departamento FORMACIÓN Y CONOCIMIENTOS REQUERIDOS Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Matemáticas, Física, Estadística o titulaciones técnicas afines. Se valorará formación específica en Data Science. Lenguajes de programación: nivel alto de SQL y Python. Se valorará también el conocimiento en Pyspark. Experiencia previa generando modelos empleados técnicas avanzadas y empleando datos de alta complejidad y elevado volumen. Se valorará experiencia trabajando en entornos Cloud, especialmente AWS. Experiencia previa trabajando con metodologías ágiles. Habilidades de comunicación para interactuar con equipos no técnicos. EXPERIENCIA PROFESIONAL REQUERIDA Experiencia mínima de 2 años en el desarrollo, entrenamiento, puesta en producción y medición de proyectos de ML & DL Experiencia mínima de 1 año en implementación de soluciones de IAGen Experiencia mínima de 2 años en implementación de soluciones de NLP Todo proceso de selección que se desarrolla en Mapfre se realiza bajo el principio de IGUALDAD DE OPORTUNIDADES y NO DISCRIMINACIÓN, siendo las APTITUDES y la VALÍA PERSONAL Y PROFESIONAL de la persona candidata, los criterios en los que se basa su elección final para el puesto de trabajo. Creamos entornos de trabajo en los que se valora la diversidad y en los que no se producen discriminaciones por razón de sexo, raza, ideología, religión, orientación sexual, edad, nacionalidad, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal, física o social. Al inscribirte en esta oferta quedas informado y consientes el tratamiento por parte de Mapfre, de los datos personales que has facilitado voluntariamente a través de esta plataforma. Si facilitas datos de terceras personas físicas distintas de ti, garantizas haber recabado y contar con el consentimiento previo de los mismos para la comunicación de sus datos y haberles informado. Mapfre como responsable, tratará tus datos, con la única finalidad de tramitar su participación en procesos de selección, para lo cual se podrán elaborar perfiles y del tratamiento de sus datos se podrá derivar la existencia de decisiones automatizadas. Con la finalidad de gestionar tu participación en diversos procesos de selección en empresas del Grupo Mapfre, filiales y participadas, y Fundación Mapfre, tus datos podrán comunicarse a dichas entidades, y ser objeto de transferencia internacional. Puedes consultar información adicional de protección de datos en Mapfre en https://www.mapfre.com/corporativo-es/clausulas/RRHHseleccion.pdf donde te indicamos donde ejercer los derechos de acceso, rectificación, supresión, limitación, oposición y portabilidad de tus datos personales. Para conocer más ofertas de empleo te invitamos a que accedas a Trabajar en Mapfre y te des de alta en nuestro portal de empleo.

items.desc: Möchtest du mit deinen Ideen und Entwicklungen wirklich etwas bewegen? Hast du Spaß an Logik und tüftelst gerne an komplexen Problemstellungen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! Als Machine Learning Engineer in unserem Team prägst du maßgeblich das Einkaufserlebnis von Millionen Kunden im deutschen Einzelhandel und stellst dich immer wieder spannenden Engineering-Herausforderungen. Deine Aufgaben Du entwickelst innovative analytische Produkte, optimierst nachhaltig unsere Entscheidungsprozesse und steigerst so die Zufriedenheit unserer Kunden. In deiner Rolle baust, skalierst und betreibst du produktspezifische ML-Pipelines. Du verstehst alle Komponenten der Pipeline und bist dabei besonders intensiv in die Bestandteile Analyse der Input-Daten, Feature-Engineering, Modellentwicklung, -produktivierung und -optimierung, Monitoring der Modellergebnisse, Automatisierung und Orchestrierung involviert. Neben der Entwicklung analytischer Produkte trägst du aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung der Infrastruktur bei, indem du ML Ops- oder DevOps-Methoden nutzt. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, arbeitest Konzepte aus und setzt Prototypen mithilfe neuester Cloud-Technologien um. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Data Engineers, Data Scientists und anderen Fachbereichen entwickelst du bestehende analytische Produkte weiter und trägst aktiv zum Rollout bei. Dein Profil Dein sehr gutes analytisches und konzeptionelles Denkvermögen, gepaart mit deiner Leidenschaft für die Themen Machine Learning und Daten. Deine Fähigkeit, neue herausfordernde Geschäftsfragen schnell zu verstehen und mit passgenauen analytischen Modellen flexibel zu beantworten. Deine hohe Dienstleistungs- und Teamorientierung sowie die Freude an der Arbeit in einem agilen und sehr dynamischen Umfeld. Ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium mit Schwerpunkt Analytics (z.B. Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Ökonometrie, Mathematik, Physik o.ä.) und idealerweise Berufserfahrung im Bereich Machine Learning. Gute Python-Kenntnisse; von Vorteil sind zudem Kenntnisse in SQL. Erfahrungen in Unit-Testing, Versionskontrolle (Git) und CI/CD sowie ein sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Cloud-Technologien sind gerne gesehen. Umfassende Erfahrung im gesamten Machine-Learning-Lifecycle; souveränes Aufsetzen und Betreiben von Pipelines mit Tools wie z.B. dbt, ML Flow oder Airflow sowie gängigen Data Science-Bibliotheken wie pandas und scikit-learn. Benefits Work-Life-Balance: Hybrid, flexibler Arbeitszeit ohne Kernzeiten 30 Tage Urlaub Gesundheitsmanagement Persönliche Weiterbildung Mitarbeiterrabatte Agiles Umfeld Melde dich gerne für weitere Infos.
