items.desc: Business Area: Global Chief Information Office Pay Range Min: 11,000.00 PLN per month Pay Range Max: 11,000.00 PLN per month Short Description: Turn data into insight that helps shape decisions, improve experiences and drive change About The Business Area Our technology teams sit within our Group Chief Information Office (GCIO), building the digital platforms, systems, and products our customers and colleagues use every day, keeping assets and data secure, and delivering exceptional digital experiences. Within GCIO, our Data teams protect, deliver, and enhance the value of data and information assets, turning vast data into powerful insights, helping us better understand our customers, our business, and the world we work in. Who you are You’re curious, analytical and excited by the idea of turning data into decisions. You enjoy solving problems, spotting patterns and asking better questions — not just accepting the first answer. You could be a great fit if you like working with data, learning new tools and explaining complex ideas in a way others can actually use. You’re detail-focused, adaptable and motivated to keep improving, especially in fast-moving environments. You take ownership of your work, collaborate well with others and want to understand how data, technology and business decisions connect. You don’t need to know everything from the start. If you bring curiosity, a learning mindset and an interest in helping shape a more data-driven future, we’ll help you build the rest. What you'll do You’ll work on projects that help HSBC use data more effectively across the business. Depending on your team, you could help manage, analyse and improve data used in decision-making, regulatory reporting and digital transformation. You’ll work with colleagues across business, product and technology teams to connect data to real business needs, and use tools such as SQL, Python, Qlik or Spark to explore trends and create clear, useful insights. You may also support work that improves data quality, governance and reporting, helping make sure information is accurate, reliable and ready to use. It’s a practical role where you’ll learn by working on real data challenges with people across the bank. What you'll learn Your learning starts on day one and builds over two years through technical training, self-led learning and hands-on experiences. You’ll deepen your understanding of data movement, governance, management, quality and reporting, while exploring new tools, languages and platforms used across HSBC. You’ll also have funding for industry-recognised certifications , with potential extra support for role-specific qualifications. Hackathons, innovation projects and collaborative events will help you apply what you learn in practical ways and build confidence working with others. By the end of the programme, you’ll have stronger technical depth, a clearer understanding of how data supports decision-making and regulation, and the skills to grow as a data practitioner in a global organisation. Where you'll work You’ll work in HSBC’s data community within the Global Chief Information Office, where teams use data to support smarter decisions, stronger controls and better digital experiences. It’s a collaborative environment that connects technology, business and product teams across the bank. You’ll be part of a professional office culture where people share ideas, work across markets and use data to solve real business challenges. Expect a setting that values curiosity, clarity and a strong team mindset. Eligibility Criteria To Be Eligible, You Must Be available to work full-time from July 2027 Have obtained, or expected to achieve, a 4.0 cumulative GPA or equivalent 2.1 degree from a recognised University (as appears on your official University transcript or degree certificate) Have already graduated, or will have completed studies before July 2027 Be fluent in English Legally permitted to work in Poland for the full duration of the programme and beyond the end date, without requiring HSBC visa sponsorship We only accept one application per recruitment cycle so please take time to explore our opportunities before applying as we may not be able to transfer your application to other vacancies. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis and we may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of applications. Please apply as soon as possible to be considered.

items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial , IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica , la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos a un/a IA Engineer con 2-3 años de experiencia profesional como Data Engineer o Desarrollador de Software, que haya trabajado con IA Generativa en proyectos reales durante mínimo 6 meses . Formarás parte de un equipo estratégico encargado de acelerar la entrega de valor de los equipos de desarrollo mediante la adopción de la IA, impulsando mejoras en su productividad, eficiencia y calidad. Acompañarás a los equipos en su proceso de transformación, experimentando con nuevas prácticas, identificando oportunidades de mejora y compartiendo aprendizajes. Para ello estarás encargado de crear assets como agentes, skills, orquestados, buenas prácticas, formación etc a nivel transversal para ayudar a mejorar el uso de la IA en el ciclo de desarrollo de software completo. Experiencia sólida en Python para el desarrollo de aplicaciones de IA. Experiencia en integración de LLMs vía API (OpenAI, Azure OpenAi, Gemini…etc.) Experiencia en el uso de la IA para desarrollos, habiendo usado Claude Code, Cursor, Antigravity o similares Se valorará diseño de agentes LLM y flujos multiagente. Uso de embeddings, vector databases y búsqueda semántica. Experiencia en gestión de proyectos y uso de herramientas de gestión. Soft skills elevados, con buena comunicación a la hora de presentación de resultados a cliente. Buen nivel de inglés , tanto oral como escrito. ¿Cómo será tu día a día? Te encargarás de la creación y optimización de prompts y agentes, así como de la integración de LLMs en aplicaciones reales. Colaborarás con equipo interno y de cliente para construir aplicaciones escalables, seguras y alineadas con las necesidades del negocio. Mejorarás la fiabilidad, escalabilidad y observabilidad de las soluciones en producción, incorporando buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software aplicadas a LLMs. Tendrás autonomía para investigar tecnologías emergentes. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrado en las Personas , ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. Contrato indefinido y salario de entre 34.000 y 40.000 euros brutos/año de entrada , ajustado según tu experiencia. También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas. Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid , la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly ! Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com Do you want to be Mática? Be Mática!

items.desc: Data Scientist The Opportunity We are seeking a Data Scientist to join our Global Technology Division. This role sits within a highly strategic engineering team focused on predictive enterprise optimization and internal mobility platforms. You will hold the keys to a core mathematical engine, designing and deploying sophisticated recommendation models and matching indexes that mathematically balance complex business constraints against corporate operational overhead. Key Responsibilities Algorithm & Index Design: Develop, tune, and maintain semantic matching algorithms, recommendation engines, or Natural Language Processing (NLP) models to map unstructured text profiles against highly technical corporate frameworks. Predictive Optimisation Modeling: Build mathematical optimization models evaluating personnel distribution variables alongside geographic constraints and operational cost parameters to calculate cost-effective resource strategies. Upholding Statistical Truth: Champion mathematical and statistical rigor. Ensure all machine learning models accurately handle data imbalances, control for historical performance biases, and rigorously evaluate algorithmic fairness. Collaborative AI Deployment: Work closely with upstream data teams to track model metrics, monitor algorithmic prediction drift, and safely surface confidence scores to executive decision-makers. Required Technical Skills Experience: Intermediate experience as a Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or Quantitative Analyst within an enterprise environment (Fintech, Banking, or Scale-up SaaS preferred). Python Mastery: Complete fluency in Python and specialized machine learning/statistical libraries (scikit-learn, SciPy, statsmodels). Hands-on exposure to NLP frameworks or text embeddings (spaCy, HuggingFace) is highly valued. Statistical Rigor: A solid foundation in applied statistics, including clustering, regression architectures, and predictive modeling validation techniques. Exploratory Data Storytelling: Ability to visually explain algorithm performance trends (using Plotly, Seaborn, etc.) and present model logic transparently to senior management. Data Scientist

We have a specialized Financial Services practice that is experiencing rapid growth. At NORRIQ, our employees are at the heart of our organization and our success.. We hire and nurture passionate individuals who strive for excellence for both our clients and colleagues. Our culture supports personal and professional growth with training, opportunities, and creative freedom. Regardless of when you join or how long you stay, you'll experience an unforgettable NORRIQ journey and become a part of our extended family. Connected forever! Role Overview As an MLOps Engineer / AI Engineer, you will play a central role in bridging Data Science and IT Operations. You will design, deploy, and scale production-grade machine learning and AI solutions for our financial services clients. Your mission is to ensure robust, secure, and efficient AI operations—covering deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and continuous improvement. This role is ideal for someone who loves building AI infrastructure, optimizing performance, and enabling data scientists to move faster and safer. Key Responsibilities Deploy ML/AI Models: Work with Data Scientists to deploy secure, scalable, and reliable models into production. Build CI/CD Pipelines: Automate testing, packaging, and deployment for data and model workflows. Manage Data Pipelines: Design and maintain efficient data flows across storage systems, databases, and platforms. Set Up Environments: Manage dependencies, development environments, and tooling for smooth project onboarding. Operate Kubernetes: Deploy and maintain containerized AI components using Kubernetes. Monitor & Troubleshoot: Oversee model/application performance, resolve incidents, and conduct root-cause analyses. Optimize & Innovate: Identify improvements, adopt new technologies, and enhance AI engineering practices. Requirements Education Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Strong background in programming, system engineering, or DevOps is highly valued. Technical Skills Strong proficiency in Python. Experience with REST APIs and Git. Hands-on expertise in CI/CD and MLOps/DevOps practices. Practical experience with Docker and Kubernetes. Familiarity with Linux, software testing, and modern software engineering workflows. Nice to have: SQL/PostgreSQL, MLflow, Helm, or related tooling. Soft Skills Collaborative and team-oriented mindset. Proactive, solution-driven, and comfortable working in dynamic environments. Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. Languages Fluent in English (spoken and written). Knowledge of additional languages (Dutch or French) is a plus. Why Joining Us? You will be part of a fast growing international company with a unique people culture A very competitive salary package including a company car, iPhone and different allowances You will get extensive trainings in Belgium and Denmark on technical matters, as well as soft skills and project management, and you will have access to new technologies and innovative equipment. You will join a dynamic and growing team with a great mix of young and experienced professionals focusing on financial services.

items.desc: Vienna, Austria · Hybrid · Full-time 70% of employees responded. How good is the measurement? At first glance, 70% sounds excellent. But what if almost nobody from one department participated? What if management participated disproportionately? What if the employees experiencing the most serious problems were systematically less likely to respond? A response rate tells you something. It doesn’t necessarily tell you how much confidence you should place in the result . That’s one of the problems we’re trying to solve at Blucentia. The role We’re looking for a Statistician / Data Scientist to help develop the statistical foundations of HSEG™, our organizational Human Risk Intelligence methodology. You’ll investigate how participation, representativeness, missingness, uncertainty and evidence accumulated over time affect what can reasonably be inferred from organizational measurements. What you’ll do You’ll: research and develop statistical approaches to measurement confidence; investigate sampling and nonresponse effects; model uncertainty in relatively small organizational populations; use simulation to evaluate candidate approaches; investigate representativeness and systematic missingness; evaluate how repeated observations affect confidence; establish conditions under which available data are insufficient for reliable interpretation; help communicate uncertainty without manufacturing false precision; work closely with our Measurement Scientist on measurement quality and validity; and help validate methods using real-world pilot data. What we’re looking for You likely have a strong MSc or PhD in: statistics; biostatistics; survey methodology; econometrics; quantitative social science; or another statistically rigorous discipline. Strong R and/or Python skills are expected. Experience with areas such as survey sampling, missing data, nonresponse, Bayesian or hierarchical modelling, simulation, calibration or longitudinal analysis would be particularly useful. This is a statistics-heavy Data Science role . We’re looking for someone interested not only in extracting information from data, but in determining how much information the data can legitimately support. What you’ll be joining Blucentia is an early-stage Vienna technology company developing Human Risk Intelligence. You’ll work alongside measurement scientists, engineers and research specialists to investigate whether organizational human-risk measurements can become more reliable, transparent and defensible. Compensation €66,000+ gross/year, depending on experience and qualifications. Location: Vienna, Austria / hybrid Employment: Full-time We are currently building the scientific team for our next research phase. Hiring for this position is subject to completion of our current funding process, with the start date to be agreed accordingly.

Need a refresher on what Corporate Governance and Proxy Voting are? Corporate governance is the system by which companies are directed and controlled. Boards of directors are responsible for the governance of their companies. The shareholders’ role in governance is developing continuously with investors increasingly acting as responsible stewards and taking into account a wide range of ESG topics. This may include considerations such as the appointment of directors, approving executive remuneration schemes, M&A, and equity issuances. Shareholders are invited by public companies they have shares in to vote on a wide range of topics during annual general meetings and special meetings. They can delegate their voting power to a representative, who will then be considered a proxy. Here at ISS STOXX, we provide the research, insight and recommendations for our clients to make informed voting decisions. Enter the world of corporate governance and responsible investment and jumpstart your career by gaining exposure to the fundamental affairs of businesses and economies on a global scale. What You Will Do ISS STOXX seeks a pool of talented and self-motivated data analyst trainees for February 2027. Our trainees will be assigned to a dynamic regional market (Eastern Europe and other markets based on business needs) and guided by our experienced analysts. As a Corporate Governance Data Analyst Trainee, you will become an integral part of the team with the crucial role of helping deliver data to our clients, that are institutional shareholders. The traineeship will take place during “proxy voting season.” Our goal is to support our clients in making informed voting decisions on that occasion. Your Responsibilities Will Include Gathering comprehensive data in companies' public documents (annual reports, reference documents, etc.), notably concerning the board composition, related-party transactions, auditors’ fees, etc. Collecting and analyzing the information with regards to the local code of best practice in corporate governance and ISS STOXX voting policy. A relevant Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Economics, Business, Finance, Law, or Political Sciences or in the process of obtaining such a degree. A prior experience in a relevant area will be considered as an advantage. A strong analytical ability, numeracy, strong oral and written communication skills. The ability to assimilate large quantities of information, work independently and take initiative while also being a team player. An organized and structured mind. But above all else we are most interested in the things that make you, you. The unique personal qualities, extracurricular activities and accomplishments that show who you are as a person and what value you could bring to the team. What You Will Gain From This Traineeship Develop a deeper understanding of relevant technical terminology within the world of corporate governance and responsible investment. Receive in-depth training to fulfill your career aspirations. Expand your know-how and contribute significantly to client work. Make a difference and perform in a workplace of integrity and transparency. This traineeship is remunerated 2,242.81€ gross per month and will run for 4.5 months, from the 1st of February 2027 to the 11th of June 2027. Trainees are required to work from the ISS STOXX office 5 days a week and must be based in the country of employment from Day 1 of the traineeship. items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Production-ready deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer you will partner directly with leading organizations to design, build, and deploy AI systems that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will combine deep technical judgment, hands-on engineering, and customer leadership to take ambitious ideas from use-case selection and architecture through prototyping, evaluation, production launch, and scale.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

This role is based in Munich. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees

In this role, you will:

 - Partner directly with enterprise and digital native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria.

 - Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes.

 - Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators.

 - Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance.

 - Diagnose complex implementation challenges, reproduce failures, test hypotheses, and drive blockers toward resolution.

 - Help customers progress from promising prototypes to reliable production systems, sustained adoption, and scaled impact.

 - Partner closely with customer engineering teams and OpenAI Product, Research, Engineering, Security, and go-to-market teams, translating deployment experience into high-signal product feedback.

 - Create reusable architectures, tooling, playbooks, and technical guidance that accelerate future enterprise deployments.

You might thrive in this role if you:

 - Have a demonstrated track record of designing, building, and delivering AI or machine-learning systems in enterprise environments, including taking systems from prototype to production. Relevant backgrounds may include applied AI or ML engineering, forward-deployed engineering, software engineering, customer engineering, solutions architecture, product engineering or technical consulting.

 - Are fluent in both German and English

 - Can point to substantial personal contributions in code, architecture, evaluation, debugging, or engineering of production systems—not only program or stakeholder management.

 - Are highly proficient in Python and comfortable working across an AI application stack; experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, or another relevant language is valuable.

 - Understand how to evaluate AI systems systematically using representative data, graders, production signals, and human judgment.

 - Have navigated enterprise production requirements such as integrations, reliability, observability, security, privacy, data governance, performance, and cost.

 - Can connect technical decisions to customer workflows, adoption, and measurable business outcomes.

 - Communicate with clarity and credibility across hands-on engineers, technical leaders, security teams, product leaders, and executives.

 - Bring high agency, strong technical judgment, and end-to-end ownership in ambiguous environments.

 - Learn quickly, challenge assumptions constructively, and collaborate with humility; experience in a particular industry or with OpenAI products is not required.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. items.desc: Role Overview Location: Cork (Hybrid) We’re hiring Graduate Mobile Software Engineers to join NETGEAR’s Mobile Engineering team in Cork. You’ll help build the next generation of native mobile apps that connect millions of customers to their NETGEAR devices. You’ll work alongside experienced mobile engineers across the full product life cycle, from requirements through build and test to release and the production data that follows. You’ll write production code in your first weeks, not your first year, and you’ll use AI coding agents as a standard part of your toolkit. Engineers here own their work end to end, including quality. That ownership is the fastest way to earn trust and take on bigger work. You’ll join our mobile engineering team in Cork, which is part of NETGEAR’s global engineering organization. The team is hybrid, and you’ll spend at least three days a week in the office to collaborate, learn and share ideas. What You Will Be Doing Building features in our native Android (Kotlin) and iOS (Swift) applications, from ticket to release. Owning the quality of what you build, including functional QA, regression testing and release validation. Testing on real devices to make sure setup flows, error states and edge cases work for the person holding the phone, not just for the test suite. Writing and maintaining automated unit, integration and UI tests, so the same bug is never found twice by hand. Working AI-first, using agentic coding tools to plan, write, test, review and refactor, and helping the team get better at it. Automating repetitive work by contributing to CI/CD pipelines, build tooling and release automation. Debugging and optimizing using crash, performance and analytics data from production. Integrating APIs, SDKs and cloud services to power app functionality. Taking part in agile ceremonies and code reviews, giving and receiving feedback. Doing what the release needs, whether that is a test pass, a build fix, a script or a spec. What You Will Gain Hands-on experience building and shipping native Android and iOS apps used by millions of customers worldwide. Real ownership of quality, which is the fastest route to trust and scope on this team. A deep understanding of mobile architectures, UI frameworks and platform APIs. Experience with CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and modern DevOps practice. Fluency in AI-assisted development using Claude Code, Copilot and ChatGPT. A structured graduate onboarding path with a named mentor and a defined first-year development plan. Room to grow within NETGEAR’s global engineering organization. What We Are Looking For A Level 8 honours degree (or an equivalent honours bachelor’s degree) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronic Engineering or a related discipline completed by November 2026. Real evidence that you can code, in any language. College projects, internships, personal apps, open source and hackathons all count. An eye for quality. You notice when something feels wrong for the user, not just when a test fails. Curiosity about AI-assisted development and a willingness to work in a toolchain that is changing quickly. A hands-on attitude. Our best engineers pick up whatever the release needs rather than waiting for it to be assigned. Clear written and spoken communication. Strong problem solving, attention to detail and a collaborative mindset. Nice to Have Native mobile experience, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android, or Swift and SwiftUI on iOS. items.desc: Overview: V-Nova is a London-based technology company specialising in visual data architectures for AI, media and immersive applications. Its hierarchical, compute-aware data formats bring structure and intelligence to video, images and point clouds, enabling systems to access and process only the visual information they need. This can reduce data movement, decoding and compute across demanding visual workflows and make large scale AI processing more efficient. V-Nova has contributed key IP to internationally standardised technologies including MPEG-5 Part 2 LCEVC and SMPTE VC-6 (ST 2117), and also develops PresenZ for volumetric and 6DoF experiences. With a portfolio of more than 1,600 international patents, V-Nova combines deep-science R&D with highly optimised software products and integrations that bring its technology into real-world media, cloud and AI systems. We are committed to the extraordinary and rely on talented, high-performing teams to solve difficult problems and deliver what we promise. Our culture values individual empowerment, excellence, intellectual curiosity and teamwork. Across research, engineering, product and commercial teams, we make active use of the latest AI tools to accelerate analysis, development, writing and experimentation. With ground-breaking technology, a fast-paced collaborative environment and ambitious growth plans, this is an opportunity to make a visible contribution to an emerging category of Visual AI infrastructure. The Visual AI Analyst will join V-Nova's Strategic Analytics & Business Insights (SABI) team and work at the intersection of analytics, product development and business development. The role will help turn V-Nova's hierarchical visual data technologies into measurable performance advantages and compelling customer propositions for Visual AI workflows. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Integration and Commercial teams to develop, validate and take to market Visual AI acceleration solutions based on V-Nova technologies such as VC-6, LCEVC and emerging AI solutions. The work is deliberately varied: one week you may be analysing GPU benchmark logs and isolating a pipeline bottleneck; the next, building an AI-assisted dashboard, assessing caption or embedding quality, researching a new AI framework, or translating technical results into a partner facing business case. This is not a role for somebody who needs a tightly defined playbook. We are looking for a high-learning-velocity analyst who enjoys unfamiliar problems, can structure ambiguity, figures things out with limited supervision and is motivated by getting to a useful result. Deep prior knowledge of video compression or Visual AI is not required; curiosity, analytical rigour and the ability to learn fast are more important. Responsibilities: Designing, supporting and analysing benchmarks and experiments across visual AI training and inference workflows, quantifying the impact of V-Nova technologies on quality, latency, throughput, compute, storage and cost. Turning raw test artefacts into insight, spotting anomalies and bottlenecks; forming hypotheses; and working with engineering colleagues to validate root causes and optimisation opportunities. Building practical internal analytics tools such as dashboards, parsers, report generators, scripts and automations, using modern AI coding agents to extend your own capabilities and make experimentation faster and easier to interpret. Working with Product and Engineering to translate evidence into decisions: defining useful test plans and acceptance criteria, identifying optimal configurations, prioritising follow-up work and producing clear recommendations. Supporting V-Nova's Visual AI go-to-market and business development through use-case and ecosystem research, competitor analysis, market sizing, pricing and business-case work, and by turning technical evidence into concise partner and customer materials and integration priorities. Collaborating with Marketing, other internal teams and external partners to turn technical evidence into high-quality thought-leadership and market-facing content, including blogs, articles, social media communications, scientific publications and event materials. Owning the practical discipline around experiments and analysis: coordinating datasets and cloud GPU resources where needed, keeping results and artefacts reproducible and well documented, communicating progress clearly, and following issues through to resolution. The role offers unusual breadth and exposure for an analyst. You will work directly with senior V-Nova product and engineering specialists and with external technology partners, including NVIDIA and major cloud and hyperscale companies, on projects at the leading edge of Visual AI infrastructure. You will also receive close coaching from V-Nova's SVP Strategic Analytics & Business Insights, a senior strategy leader with a McKinsey background. The environment is demanding, collaborative …

items.desc: Graduate Geotechnical Engineer We are looking for a Graduate Geotechnical Engineer to join our Ground Engineering team in Leeds, London or Bath. Be Challenged From the first appraisal of a site, through to the completion of construction, safety and economy are our goals. Buro Happold's ground engineering team provides clients with expertise that spans structural, building, civil and environmental engineering. We operate an integrated ground engineering approach where geotechnical engineers, geoenvironmental engineers, and engineering geologists, work collaboratively in multi-disciplinary teams throughout the UK and across the world including the US and Middle East. From the earliest stages of your projects, you can be assured of our capability in managing all aspects of ground engineering. This includes geotechnical design for all forms of building and civil engineering structures, understanding the geological settings and addressing contaminated land issues. To find out more about our Ground Engineering discipline, please click here. What sort of projects would I work on? The work the Ground Engineering team undertakes is diverse in terms of scale, location, development type, and the point at which we are engaged through the life of the project. We strive to ensure that our graduates have the opportunity to work across a varied portfolio of projects to broaden their skills during the early stages of their career. Recent projects the team has been involved with include the new Everton Stadium, Battersea Power Station, and Compton & Edrich Stands at Lords What would I do? You will be expected to develop a secure understanding of ground behaviour including response to structural load changes. Our work spans the full range of ground-related activities from outline schemes through site investigation, foundation design, and construction. A typical day could involve any or all of the following; Desk-based assessments of the site geology, history, and possible constraints Identifying and specifying ground investigation requirements Engaging with ground investigation operations Interpreting ground investigation data to develop appropriate and realistic ground models for design Carrying out designs for a wide range of geotechnical elements, from domestic buildings through to major infrastructure On site supervision, direction and supporting construction operations. You will be supported by other senior members of the team, but you will be expected to demonstrate appropriate self-sufficiency in their various tasks for each project. For example; Undertaking geotechnical assessments and design Ensuring project work is carried out within agreed timescales and within budget Ensuring senior staff are informed of important and relevant design decisions and the objectives of the company and the client are achieved Coordinating work with other disciplines in the project team Under guidance of senior staff, representing Buro Happold at meetings with the client, other professionals and suppliers. About you: MSc/MEng in Civil Engineering (or closely related) with a focus on geotechnical engineering Secure understanding of soil mechanics and geology and genuine enthusiasm for fundamental engineering and the environment Shows real interest in the projects being worked on, likes to understand where their contribution fits within the wider project context Actively engages with colleagues on work projects and sees the value of learning from and sharing knowledge with them. Apply academic learning to practical project situations Motivated and committed to your professional development including route to professional qualification An enthusiasm for engineering geology and the environment and a commitment to learning and developing knowledge in engineering geology and broader ground engineering expertise Strong numeracy skills, excellent ability to speak and write English fluently, and a logical and pragmatic approach to problem solving Flexibility to travel, including overnight stays on occasion, is essential, and a valid UK driving licence would be advantageous. Graduates at Buro Happold When you join Buro Happold you are embedded into an exciting network of engineers and consultants, that supports your career development. We have a Graduate Connect learning programme that targets specific learning and supports your journey to chartership as well as our Young Employee's Forum that links all our young talent in terms of knowledge sharing, learning and very importantly socialising. We place great importance on a having a safe and inclusive environment and will seek to make any arrangements that may be required to enable all who work with us to thrive. We have flexible working hours and hybrid working, and welcome applications from all backgrounds and walks of life. If you have any questions about how this could apply to your specific circumstances, please don’t hesitate to get in touch with us. Please see our Early Careers Candidate …

items.desc: About the Role We are looking for an Electronics Design Engineer to take ownership of PCB design, system wiring, cable harnesses, connectors, electronics integration, microcontroller interfaces, and the surrounding charging and support infrastructure for our Counter-UAS interceptor platform. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who is comfortable moving between schematics, PCB layouts, lab debugging, cable harnesses, embedded firmware, EMC topics, production constraints, and system-level integration. You will design, build, debug, and improve the electronics backbone of the interceptor system. Your work will connect flight computers, guidance computers, ESCs, sensors, batteries, charging systems, connectors, cable harnesses, and ground infrastructure into one reliable and production-ready system. What is your Day to Day Mission: Design PCBs using Altium Designer, KiCad, or comparable tools , from schematic capture to layout, manufacturing data, and bring-up. Create and maintain electronics architectures for the interceptor platform, including power distribution, signal routing, communication interfaces, and system wake/sleep behavior. Support PCB prototyping, assembly, rework, debugging, revision management, and preparation for production. Design and specify cable harnesses, connectors, pinouts, contact systems, and mechanical-electrical interfaces. Select connectors and wiring concepts that are robust, compact, and as error-proof as possible during assembly. Work on EMC-related topics, grounding concepts, shielding, signal integrity, and robust communication under demanding operational conditions. Implement and debug simple microcontroller firmware for functions such as battery management interfaces, power-state control, wake-up logic, charging interfaces, and system supervision. Work with communication protocols such as CAN, UART, SPI, I²C, Ethernet , or similar embedded interfaces. Support electronics integration inside the drone across multiple sections, including flight computers, guidance computers, ESCs, batteries, sensors, and antennas. Support external system infrastructure, including charging electronics, multi-vehicle charging concepts, umbilical interfaces, and communication between ground infrastructure and drones. Work closely with mechanical design and production teams to ensure electronics can be assembled quickly, reliably, and repeatedly. Support field tests and flight tests by debugging electronics, wiring, logs, and hardware failures. What You Bring to the Team Degree in electrical engineering, electronics, embedded systems, mechatronics, or a comparable field. Strong practical experience with PCB design, schematic capture, layout, bring-up, and debugging. Experience with lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, power supplies, electronic loads, and soldering/rework tools. Understanding of embedded communication protocols, power distribution, connectors, cable harnesses, and electronics integration. Ability to write or debug basic embedded firmware in C, C++, Rust, or Python . Practical mindset: you are comfortable building, measuring, debugging, and iterating quickly. Structured approach to documentation, pinouts, revision management, BOMs, and production handover. Ability to work across electronics, mechanics, software, production, and testing. Experience with UAVs, robotics, automotive electronics, aerospace electronics, or defense systems. Experience with high-current systems, battery interfaces, chargers, ESCs, or propulsion electronics. Familiarity with EMC testing, environmental testing, or safety-critical hardware. Experience designing electronics for mass production. Hands-on hobby projects involving drones, RC aircraft, robots, embedded boards, or custom PCBs. Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you dont meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. Why Join Quantum-Systems? Be at the forefront of next-generation Defence innovation . Work in a fast-paced, agile environment where your ideas make an impact. Collaborate with a team of industry pioneers who are ambitious, bold, and visionary. Opportunities for individual and professional growth in a globally recognized organization. About us: Quantum Systems specializes in the development, design, and production of small Unmanned Aerial Systems (sUAS). The company’s range of electric vertical take-off and landing (eVTOL) sUAS are built to maximize range and versatility and to provide operators with a seamless user experience. By integrating cutting-edge software capabilities, like edge computing and real-time AI-powered data processing, Quantum Systems is building next-generation UAS for clients in the defense, security, and public sectors. A high focus on AI image processing Helping and/or delivering data sets for investigations. * Ensure adherence to standards, support verify data quality and/or improve data cleaning on the dataset. * Contribute to provisioning and managing the end-user community, accessing and working within the analytical environment. * Align with strict data and intellectual property related security guidelines. * Understand the business objectives/requirements and coach developing models that help achieve them, along with metrics to track their progress. * Manage stakeholders, provide transparency on progress, business case and risks. * Potentially maneuver between AI and RPA solutions, trying to optimize the integration between the 2 technologies. * Your main focus will be AI, whilst you will be cooperating with other RPA developers. What You Need to Succeed * 2-3 years of experience in data science, data engineering, programming or software development. * Degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning or similar faculties. * Passionate about artificial intelligence. * Good knowledge of SQL and Python. * Good understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases (data modeling, data warehousing) * Proficiency in English. * Strong analytical skills related to working with unstructured datasets, good organizational skills and coordination of work in multidisciplinary teams and problem-solving attitude. * Experience with data integration, cloud platforms, Databases like MS-SQL / SAP HANA, APIs, good knowledge of algorithms and data structures will be an asset. * Knowledge of R, Javascript, Scala or C# will be an asset. items.desc: Ihre Aufgaben - Gemeinsam Zukunft Gestalten Sie konzipieren und implementieren Computer-Vision-Lösungen für robuste robotische Automatisierungslösungen im handwerksnahen Umfeld und legen dabei besonderen Wert auf kosteneffiziente Hardware. Sie trainieren, evaluieren und optimieren ML-Modelle für Erkennungs-, Klassifikations- und Lokalisierungsaufgaben und stimmen diese gezielt auf die Anforderungen von Low-Cost-Automatisierungslösungen im Handwerks- und KMU-Umfeld ab. Sie planen Datenerfassungsprozesse, bereiten Trainingsdaten systematisch auf und werten Modell- sowie Versuchsergebnisse datenbasiert aus. Sie arbeiten eng mit internen Fachbereichen sowie externen Partnern zusammen, um Machbarkeitsstudien in marktfähige Produkte zu überführen. Sie integrieren praxistaugliche Computer-Vision-Modelle in robotische Systeme und entwickeln diese iterativ entlang technischer und anwendungsbezogener Anforderungen weiter. Sie beobachten technologische Entwicklungen in den Bereichen Computer Vision, Machine Learning und Robotik und bringen neue Impulse in die Weiterentwicklung innovativer Automatisierungslösungen ein. Ihr Profil - Gemeinsam Wachsen Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Studium in Robotik, Informatik, Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Mathematik, Physik oder einem vergleichbaren MINT-Fach. Sie bringen mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Robotik, Automatisierung und industrieller Bildverarbeitung mit. Sie besitzen fundierte Kenntnisse in relevanten Frameworks und Technologien, wie beispielsweise YOLO, OpenCV oder ROS, und wenden diese sicher in der Entwicklung praxisnaher Lösungen an. Sie begeistern sich für anwendungsorientierte Automatisierungslösungen im Handwerk und bei KMU und verstehen es, technologische Innovation in praxistaugliche Anwendungen zu überführen. Eine handwerkliche Ausbildung oder ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für handwerksnahe Prozesse ist von Vorteil, um Anforderungen unserer Kunden noch besser nachzuvollziehen. Ihre strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Ihre Kommunikationsstärke machen Sie zu einem geschätzten Ansprechpartner in interdisziplinären Projekten. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift setzen wir ebenso voraus wie Reisebereitschaft zu Kunden sowie internationalen Partnern von etwa zwei bis vier Wochen pro Jahr. Ihre Benefits In Einer Wertschätzenden Unternehmenskultur Für Ihren perfekten Einstieg werden Sie strukturiert eingearbeitet. Zum Start erfahren Sie bei der „HELLO PEOPLE" Veranstaltung viel Allgemeines über Würth, anschließend geht es mit der individuellen Einarbeitung in Ihrem Team und Fachbereich weiter. Neben einer attraktiven, leistungsgerechten Vergütung erwarten Sie 30 Tage Urlaub, umfangreiche Zusatzleistungen wie Urlaubs- und Weihnachtsgeld, ein Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zahlreiche Mitarbeiterrabatte. Mit flexiblen Arbeitszeitmodellen sowie bis zu zwei Mobile Office Tagen gelingt Ihnen der Spagat zwischen Berufs- und Privatleben. Wir unterstützen Sie bei der Verwirklichung Ihrer beruflichen Ziele und bieten Ihnen regelmäßige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten durch unsere eigene AKADEMIE WÜRTH. Bleiben Sie aktiv und gesund mit zahlreichen Kursen unseres Gesundheitsmanagements, vielen Betriebssportgruppen wie Fußball, Volleyball, Squash, Badminton, E-Sports, E-Bike Leasing und der Nutzung von über 10.000 Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen mit dem arbeitgebergeförderten EGYM Wellpass. Genießen Sie in unserem hervorragenden Betriebsrestaurant täglich frische, regionale Speisen in entspannter Atmosphäre - dabei wird Ihr Mittagessen zu 50 % vom Arbeitgeber bezuschusst. Zusätzlich können Sie sich kostenlos an unseren Heißgetränken bedienen. Feiern Sie die Gemeinschaft mit Ihrem Team regelmäßig bei Events wie Abteilungsausflügen, Firmenveranstaltungen sowie Weihnachts- und Jubiläumsfeiern. Unsere Kultur ist geprägt von Vertrauen, Respekt, Fairness und Eigenverantwortung. Gehen Sie mit uns neue Wege und zeigen Sie Eigeninitiative. Das sind die besten Voraussetzungen, um Ihre Ideen einzubringen.

items.desc: About Mettler Toledo METTLER TOLEDO is a leading global supplier of precision instruments and services. We are recognized as an innovation leader and our solutions are critical in key R&D, quality control, and manufacturing processes for customers in a wide range of industries including life sciences, food, and chemicals. We operate throughout the world with a culture shaped by innovation and international flair. Our Opening and Your Responsibilities As a DSP Engineer 100% (all genders), you will join our global, cross-functional, and highly innovative Smart Sensor Team at our operational headquarters in Nänikon-Greifensee. In this role, you will be responsible for the design, simulation, and validation of signal-processing algorithms that power our industry-leading smart sensors. You will lead the way as the industry transitions into digitalization and smart factories, combining a deep understanding of signal theory and physical systems with practical software development to improve measurement performance and customer value. Your Responsibilities: * Design and optimize new digital signal processing algorithms for multi-sensor weighing systems (filtering, disturbance compensation, condition monitoring, and noise mitigation) using our modular signal processing platform. * Analyze and model mechanical, electrical, and physical properties of weighing systems to guide algorithm choices and improve system accuracy and stability. * Develop proof-of-concepts and conduct performance analyses using MATLAB/Simulink and other simulation tools. * Collaborate closely with electronics, data science, and firmware teams to ensure seamless integration and product readiness. * Define and execute test plans, including lab measurements, environmental tests, and field verifications to validate performance under real operating conditions. * Prepare technical documentation, including requirements, algorithm descriptions, validation reports, and release artifacts. * Drive innovation by monitoring technology trends, reviewing signal-processing literature, and supporting IP/knowledge capture. What You Need to Succeed The following requirements are necessary for this role: * Master’s or PhD degree in Physics, Mechanics, Robotics, Fluid Dynamics, or a related technical field. * Strong theoretical background in physics, signal theory, and digital signal processing, including control theory, filtering (Kalman, adaptive filters), spectral analysis, system identification, system and noise modeling. * Proficient in MATLAB and Simulink for system modeling and algorithm development * Analytical self-starter with a proactive, solution-oriented approach to technical ownership and problem-solving. * Ability and willingness to work in a global, cross-functional team, including occasional travel for cross-site collaboration and field validation. * Background in embedded software and knowledge of data acquisition methods are considered strong assets. * Excellent communication skills in English; ability to explain complex concepts clearly. German language skills are a plus. items.desc: We are seeking a Post-doctoral Research Fellow to work within the Centre of Excellence for Intelligent & Resilient Ocean Engineering, based at the University of Southampton, on a fixed-term contract for 24 months with potential for extension to 36 months. The Research Fellow will drive development of a whole life geotechnical design framework for offshore anchoring systems. The role will focus on creating a dataset from finite element analysis, interpretation of the results to create a lumped element macro model, and development of a stand-alone calculation tool to enable accessible interaction with the framework. The applicant will work within a large and vibrant group of offshore geotechnical engineers and geoscientists within the Centre of Excellence affiliated with the Chair. items.desc: Climate Simulation & AI Scientist, Built Environment Company: infrared.city Location: Vienna (Hybrid) · Full-time · Stock options (ESOP) About infrared.city infrared.city is building the climate intelligence layer for cities and buildings . Spun off from the Austrian Institute of Technology (AIT), we replace legacy, compute-heavy simulation runtimes with near-instant spatial intelligence deployed interactively at the earliest stages of design. Our multi-scale platform models complex physical dynamics across the urban continuum: Microclimate & Outdoor Comfort: UTCI, mean radiant temperature ($T_{\text{mrt}}$), solar radiation, sky view factor (SVF), and AI-driven pedestrian wind comfort. Building Envelope & Daylight: Facade-level incident solar radiation, spatial daylight autonomy (sDA), daylight factor, and direct sun hours. Indoor Performance: High-speed interior building energy balance and transient thermal performance. Workflows, Auto-Reporting & Agentic Engine: A core pillar of our product is automated spatial intelligence. We chain multi-physics solvers, spatial analytics, and LLM synthesis into automated reporting pipelines that generate audit-grade documentation directly for cities, architects, and engineering practices. Our cloud APIs and SDKs are engineered for headless orchestration by autonomous AI agents. This is a hands-on role : your day-to-day is predominantly coding, validating, and architecting these physical and data pipelines. We build fast, leaning heavily on agentic tools like Claude Code. We are hiring a focused, rock-solid Senior Urban Climate Simulation Scientist to formalize our technical validation benchmarks, co-design next-generation automated workflows, author standard-compliant technical reports, and ensure our headless agentic engines operate with uncompromising physical fidelity. You will operate as an autonomous senior individual contributor working directly with our AI engineers and executive leadership (CTO, CSO, and CPO). What You Will Do1. Hands-On Coding, Validation & Standards Benchmark our multi-scale physical models across urban microclimates, facade radiation, daylighting, and interior building energy. Write production-ready code to resolve physical discrepancies, refine boundary couplings, and enforce energy/radiant flux balances. items.desc: Research Associate (m/f/d) Institute for Thermal Separation Processes Remuneration according to guidelines ofMarie Skłodowska-Curie Actions ID 24226WV8 Start of employment March 1st, 2027 Application deadline December 9th, 2026 Scope fulltime, fixed term until February 28th, 2030 This position forms part of the EU FAroGels research program on food-grade, bio-based, and biodegradable aerogels and their application in sustainable food systems. The selected candidate will be employed by and will be required to enroll as a PhD student at Hamburg University of Technology, in accordance with the relevant admission and enrolment requirements. The scientific project will focus on sub- section DC15 – Doctoral Candidate: Interaction of Aerogels with Complex Food Media The Candidate will investigate how food-grade aerogels interact with complex food environments such as syrups, oils, emulsions, sauces and semi-solid matrices. The project will establish mechanistic structure–property–function relationships describing dynamic processes including swelling, shrinkage, liquid uptake, softening and partial disintegration, which determine aerogel performance in stabilisation, controlled release, sensory modification and shelf-life enhancement. The candidate will combine advanced experimental characterisation with multiscale modelling. Surface and bulk properties, including polarity, hydrogen bonding, rigidity, pore structure, charge, sorption kinetics and viscoelasticity, will be analysed using ATR-FTIR, NMR relaxometry, DSC/TGA, BET analysis, rheology and dynamic sorption. Real-time changes in complex media will be studied using optical and X-ray imaging, swelling analysis, tribology and microfluidic tools. Modelling activities will include diffusion–sorption models, continuum mechanics, coarse-grained simulations and data-driven predictive approaches. The goal is to develop predictive tools and practical guidelines for selecting aerogels for specific food applications. Hosted at TU Hamburg within FAroGels, the project includes secondments at partners and projects as METU, Barilla and Aerofybers, providing complementary training in rheology, oral tribology and others YOUR TASKS Conduct research on development, characterization and validatation of food-grade, bio-based and biodegradable aerogels for sustainable food systems Plan, perform, document and analyse experimental work using relevant laboratory, analytical, processing and/or modelling methods Participate actively in FAroGels network meetings, workshops, training schools, seminars and transferable-skills activities Undertake planned secondments at FAroGels partner organisations, as specified for the DC project Work collaboratively with academic and non-academic partners across the FAroGels network ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA Researchers recruited within the Doctoral Network must be Early Stage Researchers (ESRs) and must not have a doctoral degree. Additionaly, they must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting organization (here: Germany) for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before recruitment date. Doctoral candidates funded by the Doctoral Networks can be of any nationality and should be enrolled in a doctoral programme leading to the award of a doctoral degree. Interdisciplinarity, innovation, regionality and internationality are binding principles in our actions. items.desc: Ce poste n’existe pas encore : tu serais la première personne à l’occuper, et tu le construis avec nous. Dans un grand groupe, on ne peut pas imaginer une formation à l’IA sans savoir ce que l’entreprise permet vraiment : quels outils sont autorisés, à quelles données on a accès, ce que la DSI accepte de connecter. On cherche quelqu’un qui sait faire le pont : comprendre la technique assez bien pour parler d’égal à égal avec une DSI, et la transformer en parcours que n’importe qui peut suivre. Un exemple de projet qu’on a en ce moment : un bootcamp de deux jours pour une trentaine de collaborateur·ices non techniques d’un grand groupe, sur Microsoft Copilot. Le client récolte des idées de cas d’usage auprès de ses équipes. Ton rôle : trier ces idées selon ce qui est réaliste (pédagogiquement et techniquement), construire le déroulé, et faire en sorte que chacun·e reparte avec un petit cas d’usage qui fonctionne vraiment. Ce que tu feras : Tu interviens du début à la fin. En amont, avec les équipes de Pantomeno, tu aides à comprendre le besoin du client, à estimer l’ampleur du projet et à construire la réponse pédagogique, et tu mènes le cadrage avec les interlocuteurs côté client, y compris les équipes techniques. Ensuite, tu conçois les parcours (programmes, exercices, supports, e-learning, ateliers, bootcamps, en français et en anglais) avec nos formateur·ices, nos créateur·ices de contenus et des expert·es techniques quand le sujet l’exige. Pendant le projet, tu gardes le fil : tu intègres les retours, tu t’adaptes quand le périmètre bouge (ça arrive souvent) et tu préviens tôt quand quelque chose coince. Tu travailles avec un·e directeur·ice de projet qui coordonne l’ensemble. Tu n’es pas là pour animer les formations, mais tu assistes à certaines sessions pour voir ce qui marche sur le terrain et améliorer les contenus. Tu t’occupes aussi de mettre de l’ordre : poser un vrai système de knowledge management pour que nos référentiels restent clairs, à jour et réutilisables. Et comme la tech va vite, la veille fait partie du job : repérer et tester les nouveaux outils, avoir des idées, nous proposer de nouveaux formats. Qui on cherche D’abord, quelqu’un d’à l’aise en anglais, vraiment : une partie de nos clients et de nos projets fonctionne dans cette langue, et tu devras mener une réunion et écrire un programme en anglais sans filet. Tu as au moins deux à trois ans d’ingénierie pédagogique derrière toi, à concevoir des programmes de formation (pas seulement à les animer), et tu as déjà travaillé sur des projets pour de grandes entreprises, avec leurs nombreuses parties prenantes, leurs circuits de validation et leurs exigences qualité. Tu as une vraie culture technique : les stacks, les connecteurs et la sécurité ne te font pas peur, et tu aimes la tech pour de bon. Si tu as déjà conçu des formations sur l’IA ou le no-code, c’est un vrai plus, tout comme Microsoft 365, Copilot, Azure ou l’automatisation (Airtable, Zapier, Make, n8n). Côté personnalité, on cherche de la rigueur (c’est ce qui compte le plus pour nous : poser un cadre, documenter, tenir un planning), de la curiosité, de la créativité, et de la transparence, parce qu’on préfère savoir tôt que quelque chose coince. Tu es autonome en télétravail et tu aimes construire dans un cadre qui évolue. Conditions CDI temps plein, convention collective Syntec, démarrage dès que possible Rémunération selon profil Basé·e à Nantes ou à Paris, télétravail au quotidien. L’équipe se retrouve à Nantes toutes les 6 semaines (trajet en train pris en charge), et il y aura des déplacements ponctuels chez les clients, notamment à Paris. Le contrat comporte une clause d’exclusivité : une activité freelance en parallèle n’est donc pas compatible. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Tu rejoins une jeune entreprise en forte croissance, au cœur d’un mouvement qui change la façon de travailler (no-code et IA), avec une petite équipe bienveillante où la collaboration est au centre. Tu travailles sur des comptes ambitieux, et tu as un vrai poids sur la façon dont se construisent l’offre et la méthode, puisque tout est à poser. Si tu aimes garder un œil sur les derniers outils, ça tombe bien : la veille fait partie du poste.

items.desc: Compulsory Internship contract | Belval | 6 Months Are you passionate about research? So are we! items.desc: (Post-Doc) Wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiterin bzw. Wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) an der Fakultät für Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik am Institut für Flugsysteme auf dem Gebiet autonomer KI-Agenten für intelligente Assistenzsysteme in der Luftfahrt (Entgelt bis zur Entgeltgruppe 14 TVöD) zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt zunächst befristet auf ein Jahr, mit der Möglichkeit einer Verlängerung auf insgesamt bis zu zwei Jahre nach Maßgabe des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes, in Voll- oder Teilzeit gesucht. Die Finanzierung für den gesamten Zeitraum ist gesichert. Die Universität der Bundeswehr München ist in der nationalen wie auch internationalen Forschungslandschaft fest verankert. Als Campusuniversität mit sehr guter Grundausstattung bietet sie beste Voraussetzungen für hochqualitative Lehre und Forschung. In unserem Selbstverständnis verstehen wir uns als familienorientierte Einrichtung, die für Gleichstellung, Vielfalt und Chancengerechtigkeit steht. Die Juniorprofessur für Angewandte KI in dynamischen Systemen forscht an intelligenten Methoden für robustes Planen und Handeln ("Robust Planning and Acting“) autonomer KI-Agenten, die auch in komplexen und dynamischen Luftfahrtumgebungen zuverlässig Entscheidungen treffen und umsetzen. Ein Forschungsschwerpunkt liegt auf KI-gestützten Assistenzsystemen, die Pilotinnen und Piloten beim deliberativen Planen und Handeln ("Deliberative Planning and Acting“) unterstützen. Damit soll die Umsetzung von "Reduced-Crew Operations“ ermöglicht werden, ohne die Flugsicherheit durch die reduzierte Redundanz im Cockpit zu beeinträchtigen. Ihre Aufgaben Sie übernehmen die Konzeption, Entwicklung und Implementierung neuer Methoden sowie deren Validierung in Human-in-the-Loop-Tests. Sie entwickeln eigene wissenschaftliche Fragestellungen und Forschungsideen im Themenfeld der Professur und treiben diese selbstständig voran. Sie übernehmen die wissenschaftliche Anleitung und fachliche Mitbetreuung von Promovierenden und studentischen Mitarbeitenden. Sie wirken in der Lehre sowie bei der Betreuung studentischer Arbeiten mit. Sie präsentieren und publizieren Forschungsergebnisse auf einschlägigen internationalen Konferenzen und in Fachzeitschriften. Sie wirken bei der Konzeption und Einwerbung von Drittmittelprojekten mit. Sie übernehmen Organisations- und Verwaltungsaufgaben in Forschung und Lehre. Qualifikationserfordernisse Eine mit mindestens der Note "gut" abgeschlossene wissenschaftliche Hochschulbildung (Master oder Diplom) in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, Kognitions- oder Naturwissenschaften sowie eine abgeschlossene Promotion (oder eine bereits eingereichte Dissertation). Erfahrungen in einem oder mehreren der nachfolgenden Gebiete: Human-AI Interaction, Human-Autonomy Teaming, Human-Robot Interaction, sowie Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, nachgewiesen durch eine berufliche/wissenschaftliche Tätigkeit von in der Regel nicht unter zwei Jahren. Von Vorteil sind Vorkenntnisse in den Bereichen "Human-Aware Planning" und "Machine Learning in Hybrid Discrete-Continuous Domains", sowie Erfahrung bzw. Interesse an Human-in-the-Loop-Validierung. Erfahrungen in der Programmierung und Softwareentwicklung (z. B. C/C++, Python, Linux), nachgewiesen durch eine berufliche oder wissenschaftliche Tätigkeit von in der Regel nicht unter zwei Jahren. Erwünscht Erfahrungen mit empirischen Studien, Human-in-the-Loop-Experimenten oder der Evaluation von Mensch-KI-Interaktion. Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (erforderlich für Projektberichte und Präsentationen im deutschsprachigen Umfeld) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse (für Publikationen und Präsentationen der Forschungsergebnisse im internationalen Umfeld). Was für uns zählt Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative, verantwortungsbewusste und zielgerichtete Arbeitsweise. Begeisterung für die Themen- und Forschungsgebiete der Professur. Starkes Interesse an Forschung, Freude an wissenschaftlichem Arbeiten sowie an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung eigener Ideen. Bekenntnis zur freiheitlichen demokratischen Grundordnung im Sinne des Grundgesetzes. Gleichstellungs- und Diversitätskompetenz. Was für Sie zählt Attraktive Möglichkeiten zur wissenschaftlichen Profilbildung durch aktuelle Forschungsthemen sowie die Zusammenarbeit mit Partnern aus Wissenschaft, Industrie und öffentlichem Sektor. Möglichkeit zur Präsentation Ihrer Ergebnisse auf internationalen Konferenzen. Zugang zu hochmoderner Forschungsinfrastruktur. Arbeit in einem dynamischen und motivierten Team. Eine Campusuniversität mit sehr guter Infrastruktur, betriebseigener Kinderkrippe und Kindergarten (Elterninitiative), einer Familienservicestelle mit Beratung und Hilfestellung zur besseren Vereinbarkeit von Familie, Pflege und Berufstätigkeit. Die Eingruppierung (bis) in die Entgeltgruppe 14 TVöD erfolgt im Hinblick auf die tatsächlich nicht nur vorübergehend auszuübenden Tätigkeiten und die Erfüllung der persönlichen bzw. tariflichen Anforderungen. items.desc: Was wir Ihnen zutrauen Sie agieren als Enabler und Berater für Fachbereiche bei der Integration von KI in Prozesse und Systeme und fördern aktiv Kompetenzaufbau und Netzwerkbildung Sie erheben, bewerten und priorisieren KI-Anforderungen der Fachbereiche und unterstützen bei Risiko- und Impact-Analysen Sie koordinieren die KI-Governance und stellen die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien sowie regulatorische Vorgaben sicher Sie führen Schulungen (zB Copilot) für Endanwender durch Sie koordinieren und begleiten KI-Anwendungsfälle - von gruppenweiten Lösungen bis hin zu lokalen Use Cases Sie analysieren fachliche Anforderungen und übersetzen diese in konzeptionelle und technische Lösungsansätze Sie evaluieren, testen und wählen geeignete AI-Technologien, Tools und Plattformen unter Berücksichtigung von Datenschatz, IT-Sicherheit und Responsible-AI-Prinzipien aus Was wir von Ihnen erwarten Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Data Science, Künstliche Intelligenz oder fundierte praktische Erfahrungen Fundierte Kenntnisse in KI-Technologien und -Methoden sowie ein ausgeprägtes, realistisches Risikobewusstsein im Umgang mit dieser Technologie Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von KI-Lösungen ist von Vorteil Ausgeprägte analytische und konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten sowie eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Inhalte verständlich aufzubereiten Teamorientierung und Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Wir bieten Ihnen Eine verantwortungsvolle, strategische Position innerhalb der Organisation Ein offenes, wertschätzendes Betriebsklima in einem engagierten Team Einen fundierten Onboarding- und Einschulungsprozess mit Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten Attraktive Benefits: Vergünstigte Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, Lebensmittelgutscheine, Sport- und Gesundheitsangebote Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle mit Option auf Homeoffice und gute Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf Wir sind gesetzlich dazu verpflichtet darauf hinzuweisen, dass der Jahresbezug (KV Handel) beträgt EUR 41.000 brutto beträgt. Das tatsächliche Monatsgehalt richtet sich nach Ihrer Qualifikation und Erfahrung und wir legen dieses gemeinsam mit Ihnen fest. Werden Sie Teil unseres Unternehmens und bewerben Sie sich jetzt mit nur einem Klick auf "Jetzt Bewerben" ! Drucken

items.desc: Vil du være med i opbygningen af et nyt rådgivende team til Electronic Warfare og sensor området i en nyoprettet afdeling i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse? Vi søger en faglig stærk og analytisk specialist, der har mod på komplekse tekniske udfordringer indenfor et område i konstant udvikling. Om os Electronic Warfare- og Sensorteknologiafdeling er placeret i udviklingsdivisionen i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse. Afdelingen har været under opbygning igennem det seneste år og denne stilling er en af de sidste brikker der mangler at falde på plads. Afdelingen skal arbejde med forskellige former for Electronic Warfare relaterede områder, som Sensorteknologi, Dataanalyse, Artificial Intelligence samt Modellering and Simulation. Vi rådgiver både internt i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse, eksempelvis i forbindelse med anskaffelsesprojekter samt for Forsvaret som helhed. Vores kerneopgave er at rådgive om den nyeste teknologi og afprøve den ved målrettede test, analyser og teknologidemonstrationer. Desuden indgår vi i samarbejde med tilsvarende organisationer i udlandet, samt industrier og universitetsmiljøer i både ind- og udland. Vi tilbyder et fagligt stærkt og inspirerende miljø, hvor du får stor indflydelse på den faglige udvikling og tilrettelæggelsen af dit arbejde. Vi har gode muligheder for fleksibilitet og hjemmearbejde, så arbejdsliv og privatliv kan hænge godt sammen. Om stillingen Som specialist for AI, Modellering og Simulering vil du indgå i et fagligt team på fire, der opbygger det vidensgrundlag, som skal bringe Forsvarets kapaciteter ind på den digitale kampplads indenfor Electronic Warfare-området. Vidensopbygningen skal understøtte teknologisk rådgivning i forbindelse med anskaffelsesprojekter i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse samt danne grundlag for udviklingen af Forsvarets operative kapaciteter. Du bliver en del af et tværfagligt forsknings- og udviklingsmiljø, hvor du med din faglige ekspertise skal bidrage til anskaffelsesprojekter, beslutningstagere og operative kapaciteter med indsigt indenfor AI, Modellering og Simulering. Stillingen har fokus på at bidrage til opbygningen af et teknologisk fundament, så afdelingen kan levere vidensformidling, teknisk kvalitetssikring og teknologisk rådgivning. Du får en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse og Forsvaret er teknologisk opdaterede indenfor AI, Modellering og Simulering i relation til Electronic Warfare. Som specialist vil din primære opgave være at udvikle, analysere, demonstrere og vurdere AI-, modellerings- og simuleringsmetoder til understøttelse af Forsvarets kapacitetsudvikling og teknologiske beslutningsgrundlag. Dine primære arbejdsopgaver bliver blandt andet at; Yde faglig rådgivning indenfor AI, Modellering og Simulering samt relaterede områder som eksempelvis sensorfusion Opbygge og vedligeholde modellerings- og simuleringskapaciteter Deltage i teknologiske fora i både ind- og udland med relevante partnere fra forsknings- og udviklingsmiljøer i NATO, akademia og industrien Bidrage til kravspecifikationer og tekniske analyser i forbindelse med anskaffelsesprojekter Udarbejde tekniske notater, vurderinger og rapporter til beslutningstagere i Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse og Forsvaret Vurdere teknologimodenhed, muligheder, implikationer og begrænsninger ved blandt andet AI i teknologisk relevante sensorsystemer Bidrage fagligt til interne udviklingsteams i forbindelse med teknologidemonstrationer Udvikle og demonstrere nye koncepter og teknologiske løsninger Om dig Vi forventer, at du har en kandidatuddannelse indenfor et relevant teknologiområde og en stærk faglig forståelse for AI, Modellering og Simulering. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring fra forsknings-, udviklings- eller industriprojekter indenfor området. Du kan formulere dig teknisk og dokumentere dit arbejde på engelsk – både skriftligt og mundtligt. Derudover Har Du Erfaring med analyse, udvikling eller anvendelse af AI, Modellering og Simulering Interesse for at arbejde med komplekse tekniske problemstillinger Evnen til at formidle tekniske emner på en klar og struktureret måde Erfaring med eller interesse for teknologiske analyser og vurderinger Kendskab til relevante systemer i en militærfaglig kontekst er en fordel, men ikke et krav Vi Ser Gerne, At Du Er analytisk, struktureret og arbejder med høj faglig kvalitet Trives i rollen som faglig specialist og motiveres af at udvikle din ekspertise Bidrager aktivt i tværfagligt samarbejde og faglig sparring Har sans for både detaljer og helhed og kan omsætte komplekst teknisk materiale til praktisk anvendelse Er nysgerrig, initiativrig og interesseret i nye teknologiske tendenser Arbejder selvstændigt og ansvarsbevidst, også når tempoet er højt Har lyst til at være med til at udvikle nye faglige kapaciteter Ansættelsesvilkår Ansættelsen sker i henhold til den til enhver tid gældende …

items.desc: Safran.AI - De l'IA qui opère dans le réel Filiale de Safran Electronics & Defense, Safran.AI conçoit des solutions d'IA appliquées à des données complexes telles que les images satellite haute résolution, les flux vidéo FMV et les signaux acoustiques. Ces solutions s'appuient sur des algorithmes capables de détecter et d'identifier automatiquement des objets d'intérêt dans les secteurs du renseignement, de la défense et de l'aéronautique. Depuis son intégration à Safran en septembre 2024, Safran.AI contribue également à la transformation du groupe, en appliquant les solutions d’IA aux domaines de l’industrie 4.0. À titre d’exemple, l’analyse d’images automatisée par l’IA peut assister les contrôleurs en charge de l’inspection de pièces critiques en les aidant à détecter les anomalies éventuelles à partir de clichés numériques. Fort de nos 250 collaborateurs, vous évoluerez au sein d’équipes passionnées et pluridisciplinaires, réunissant des talents parmi les plus reconnus du secteur, tous animés par une même exigence d’excellence et d’innovation technologique. Les enjeux du poste Vous rejoindrez l’équipe AI Platform, qui développe une plateforme data (datalake, datawarehouse), un ensemble d’outils internes de MLOps, IA et DevX visant à accélérer le développement et la mise en production de modèles de machine/deep learning : l’ AI Factory . Toutes les étapes de développement sont couvertes, de l'ingestion des données au déploiement final : construction et stockage des jeux de données, entraînement de modèles, évaluation et packaging de modèles, le tout en garantissant la traçabilité. Nous sommes une vingtaine de collaborateurs au sein de l’équipe, avec des profils mixtes AI / Data Engineering / Software. Notre plateforme IA évolue vers un usage plus large : davantage d'équipes utilisatrices, des contextes de déploiement variés (cloud et on-premise), et une intégration croissante de l'IA dans les flux de développement. En tant qu'AI Engineer, vous contribuerez à faire évoluer notre plateforme et à ancrer les pratiques IA au cœur du quotidien des équipes Engineering. Des déplacements ponctuels en France et à l'étranger sont à prévoir dans le cadre d'engagements clients. Vous travaillerez notamment à : → Faire évoluer notre plateforme d'assistants IA — catalogue de skills, plugins et agents — et accompagner les équipes Engineering dans leur prise en main de ces outils ; → Faire évoluer les composants de la plateforme, aussi bien dans des environnements cloud que dans des contextes on-premise liés à nos activités Défense ; → Améliorer les outils mis à disposition des équipes (interne Safran.AI ou externe chez nos clients) pour accélérer le développement, la maintenance et la sécurisation du code produit ; → Contribuer à notre stratégie de déploiement de l'IA dans les flux de développement : bonnes pratiques, garde-fous, métriques et hébergement de LLMs adaptés à nos cas d'usages ; → Assurer une veille technologique et proposer des évolutions pragmatiques de notre stack, de nos pratiques de développement et de notre culture technique ; → Partager les bonnes pratiques avec l'équipe à travers du pair programming, du mentorat et des retours d'expérience. Vous aurez également un rôle actif dans les choix techniques de l'équipe et dans l'évolution de nos méthodes de travail.
