items.desc: Description We are looking for a passionate AI Engineer specialising in Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML) to contribute to Data Enrichment efforts within Meltwater. As a part of this role, you will work with experienced team members and product managers to design, test, and implement machine learning solutions. Through Meltwater's innovative social listening platform, we ensure our clients never miss any mention of their brand or essential topics across various platforms, automating the entire social listening process. Partner with us and be part of a diverse community that values your unique contributions, empowering you to reach new heights. Join us in crafting something extraordinary. What You’ll Do: Contribute to the development of scalable algorithms for processing large datasets, implement and evaluate machine learning and deep learning algorithms for Natural Language Processing/Understanding. Assist in the design, development, and testing of ML models and pipelines for real-time processing of unstructured data. Collaborate with senior team members to analyze the impact of algorithm changes. Learn and grow under mentorship, gaining exposure to industry-standard NLP tools and techniques. What You’ll Bring: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 3 years working experience OR a Master’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 1 years working experience. Programming Language: Proficiency in Python. Solid understanding of data structures and algorithms. Proficient in Machine Learning, with a solid understanding of neural networks and the Transformer architecture. Familiar with foundational NLP tasks such as tokenization, Named Entity Recognition, and sentiment analysis. Experience with modern approaches built on pretrained language models - fine-tuning and transfer learning, text and token classification. Working knowledge of large language models, including prompting and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Experience or coursework in Deep Learning frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow. Strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity for learning new technologies. Good verbal and written communication skills. Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure (preferable), AWS, or Google Cloud). Basic knowledge of containerization tools like Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes. Interest in infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform. Passion for exploring the intersection of NLP and emerging fields such as generative AI or multimodal systems. What We Offer: Enjoy 26 days of annual paid time off plus an additional day off on your birthday! Enjoy national and global health coverage through our statutory health insurance, ensuring your well-being wherever you are Benefit from a 30% employer contribution to our Company Pension scheme (BAV) Complimentary CalmApp subscription for you and your loved ones because mental wellness matters. Benefit from our family leave program, which grows with your tenure at Meltwater. Thrive within our inclusive community and seize ongoing professional development opportunities to elevate your career. We are innovators at the core who see the potential in people, ideas and technologies. Together, we challenge ourselves to go big, be bold, and build best-in-class solutions for our customers. We’re proud of our diverse team of 2,200+ employees in 50 locations across 25 countries around the world. Buscamos un/a INGENIERO/A de CIENCIA DEL DATO para incorporarse a
items.desc: Una de las empresas con las que colaboramos en Joppy busca un/a Data Scientist para unirse al equipo. Modalidad de trabajo: HÍBRIDA en Barcelona (1 dia/semana en oficina). ¿Te interesaría seguir desarrollándote como Data Scientist en un entorno tecnológico de alto rendimiento, participando en proyectos complejos e innovadores en el sector transporte? Buscamos un/a INGENIERO/A de CIENCIA DEL DATO para incorporarse a nuestra área de Data. Formarás parte de un equipo ubicado en Barcelona. Trabajarás en la creación de soluciones avanzadas basadas en analítica, modelos estadísticos y aprendizaje automático para diferentes unidades de negocio. ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones principales? • Recolectar grandes volúmenes de datos no estructurados y estructurados desde archivos, bases de datos, APIs, etc., y transformarlos en un formato más comprensible. • Realizar análisis exploratorios para entender la naturaleza y distribución de los datos, identificar patrones, correlaciones y visualizarlos de manera efectiva. • Desarrollar y aplicar modelos predictivos, de optimización y estadísticos para resolver problemas de negocio específicos, como regresión, clasificación, clustering, series temporales, etc. • Aplicar técnicas de estadística y Machine Learning para desarrollar modelos predictivos y generar insights accionables para las diferentes áreas de negocio. • Evaluar y validar la precisión y el rendimiento de dichos modelos utilizando técnicas como la validación cruzada, conjuntos de prueba y métricas de desempeño adecuadas. • Colaborar con el equipo de MLOps para integrar los modelos desarrollados en un entorno de producción. • Trabajar en estrecha colaboración con equipos interdisciplinarios como ingenieros de datos, analistas, expertos en el dominio y equipos de negocio para comprender los requisitos y objetivos del proyecto. • Participar en la toma y definición de requisitos, identificando las necesidades de negocio y traduciendo problemas de negocio en casos de uso y soluciones analíticas. • Comunicar de manera efectiva los análisis, resultados de los modelos e implicaciones a diferentes audiencias, incluyendo stakeholders no técnicos, a través de informes, presentaciones y visualizaciones comprensibles. El objetivo será facilitar la toma de decisiones basada en datos. • Monitorizar el rendimiento de los modelos en producción, realizar mantenimientos periódicos y actualizarlos cuando sea necesario para garantizar su vigencia y precisión. • Mantenerse actualizado en técnicas analíticas como machine learning, optimización, deep learning y análisis de texto. Para ello, ¿qué vas a necesitar? • Education: Grado, Máster o Doctorado en Informática, Economía, ADE, Ciencia de Datos o un campo relacionado. • Más de 3 años de experiencia en Data Science, con experiencia en almacenamiento de datos, procesos ETL e integración de datos. Se valorará especialmente experiencia trabajando de forma autónoma en proyectos de estadística y Machine Learning. • Conocimiento avanzado de SQL: dominio en la escritura y optimización de consultas. • Experiencia en desarrollo en entornos AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. • Conocimiento profundo del modelado de datos, gobernanza y mejores prácticas de calidad. • Capacidad para manipular y preprocesar grandes volúmenes de datos utilizando herramientas como SQL, Pandas o Polars. • Experiencia en scripts de Python y familiaridad con bibliotecas y herramientas de Python. • Experiencia práctica en técnicas de Machine Learning y estadística aplicada, incluyendo modelos predictivos, regresión, clasificación, clustering y/o series temporales. • Se valorará tener conocimientos estadísticos: pruebas de hipótesis, análisis de regresión, distribuciones de probabilidad, etc. • Se valorará dominio de librerías de visualización como Matplotlib, Seaborn, ggplot2, etc., para crear visualizaciones claras e informativas (Tableau es un plus). • Experiencia en toma de requisitos, interlocución con stakeholders y comunicación de resultados analíticos a perfiles de negocio. • Se valorará positivamente experiencia en áreas de negocio como Comercial, Ventas, Controlling u otras funciones donde el análisis de datos tenga impacto directo en la toma de decisiones. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? • Estabilidad desde el primer día, con contratación indefinida. • Salario acorde a la experiencia aportada (entre 48.000 - 54.000 euros brutos anuales). • Horario flexible y un día de presencialidad por semana. • Cheque Formación para desarrollarte en las áreas profesionales que más te interesen. • Seguro médico privado. • Retribución flexible aplicable a seguro médico, restaurante, transporte, guardería y formación. • Plan de pensiones con aportación empresarial complementaria. • App de bienestar con acceso a gimnasios, actividades deportivas y profesionales especializados a precios reducidos. • Eventos, afterworks y actividades solidarias para desconectar, compartir y conocer al equipo.

items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Vous êtes passionné par la Data Science, l'Intelligence Artificielle et les marchés financiers ? Rejoignez l'équipe Business Intelligence de SGCIB, une équipe récemment créée au sein des opérations de marché dont la mission est de transformer la donnée en informations exploitables pour améliorer le pilotage opérationnel, accélérer la prise de décision et développer les usages innovants autour de la Data Science et de l'IA. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous souhaitons renforcer notre capacité d'innovation autour du Machine Learning et des analyses avancées afin d'explorer de nouveaux leviers d'amélioration de la performance opérationnelle sur les activités de règlement-livraison et de prêt/emprunt de titres. Concrètement, vous serez amené à : Identifier, étudier et expérimenter des cas d'usage Data Science à forte valeur ajoutée pour les métiers Concevoir et développer des Proofs of Concept de Machine Learning permettant notamment de détecter des anomalies, identifier des facteurs explicatifs ou construire des modèles prédictifs Participer à l'évaluation et à la mise en œuvre de solutions innovantes autour de l'Intelligence Artificielle, des plateformes analytiques en mutation et des nouvelles technologies de traitement de données Réaliser des analyses exploratoires sur de grands volumes de données afin d'identifier des tendances, corrélations et opportunités d'amélioration des processus opérationnels Contribuer à la construction et à l'évolution de notre Data Factory en participant à la collecte, à la transformation et à l'enrichissement de données provenant de multiples systèmes Participer à l'industrialisation des pipelines de données et à l'amélioration continue de notre environnement analytique Accompagner la production d'études, d'indicateurs et d'analyses destinés aux équipes opérationnelles et au management Durée du stage : 6 mois. Et si c’était vous ? Vous préparez un diplôme Bac+5 (École d'Ingénieur, Université ou Master spécialisé) avec une spécialisation en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Machine Learning, Statistiques appliquées, Big Data ou Informatique décisionnelle Vous disposez idéalement d'une bonne maîtrise de Python et de son écosystème Data (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) Vous avez des connaissances en SQL, manipulation de données, Machine Learning et méthodes statistiques Vous avez une appétence pour l'analyse de données complexes et le traitement de grands volumes d'information Vous avez de l'intérêt pour les architectures de données modernes et les environnements analytiques Une connaissance de technologies telles que Spark, Databricks, dbt, Azure ou Power BI constituera un plus Qualités recherchées: curiosité intellectuelle, goût pour l'expérimentation, esprit analytique, capacité de synthèse, autonomie et force de proposition, capacité à vulgariser des sujets techniques auprès d'interlocuteurs métier, esprit d'équipe et sens de la collaboration Vous avez une aisance en anglais à l'écrit comme à l'oral Une première sensibilisation aux marchés financiers est appréciée mais n'est pas indispensable Plus qu’un poste, un tremplin Dès votre arrivée, vous serez intégré dans nos équipes et apprendrez chaque jour aux côtés de nos seniors qui vous accompagneront dans vos missions. Progressivement, vous gagnerez en autonomie sur vos projets pour faire de cette expérience un vrai accélérateur de carrière. Vous découvrirez également toute la diversité de nos métiers, dans un secteur qui évolue et innove en permanence. A la fin de vos études, diverses opportunités pourront s’offrir à vous, en France et à l’international. Pourquoi nous choisir ? Attentif à votre qualité de vie et conditions de travail , vous bénéficiez d’avantages : Télétravail possible selon le rythme de votre service Prise en charge de 60% de votre titre de transport Billetterie à prix réduits de notre Comité d’Entreprise (concerts, cinéma, sport…). Offre variée de restaurants d’entreprise et de cafétérias à tarifs compétitifs ainsi que des titres restaurants dématérialisés quand vous êtes en télétravail Créer, oser, innover, entreprendre font partie de notre ADN. Si vous aussi vous souhaitez être dans l’action, évoluer dans un environnement stimulant et bienveillant, vous sentir utile au quotidien et développer ou renforcer votre expertise, nous sommes faits pour nous rencontrer ! Vous hésitez encore ? Sachez que nos collaborateurs peuvent s’engager quelques jours par an pour des actions de solidarité sur leur temps de travail : parrainer des personnes en difficulté dans leur orientation ou leur insertion professionnelle, participer à l’éducation financière de jeunes en apprentissage ou encore partager leurs compétences avec une association. Les formats d’engagement sont multiples.

items.desc: AI Product Engineer - Hemlo Hemlo bygger framtidens rådgivare för bostadsaffären. Att köpa bostad är en av livets största affärer, och den görs i dag med ofullständig information, svårlästa dokument och årsredovisningar och med hög stressnivå. Hemlo gör bostadsaffären begriplig: vi läser och förklarar föreningens ekonomi, klargör riskerna, hittar de dolda möjligheterna och är köparens bästa vän och rådgivare genom hela processen. Hemlos bostadsrådgivare är snart live, och vi samarbetar redan med en av Sveriges stora mäklarkedjor. Det som ska knäckas nu är att göra rådgivningen så bra att köpare litar på den, och att bygga den snabbare än någon annan. Vi är ett litet grundarteam som rör oss snabbt från problem till färdig produkt, och vi söker nu en AI Product Engineer som blir grundarnas förlängda arm i arbetet med att ta fram Hemlo. Du bygger det med AI-agenter som huvudverktyg och tar stort ansvar för produkten: från analysen av föreningens ekonomi till appen som köparen har i fickan. Rollen Det här är ingen renodlad utvecklarroll. Det som förr tog timmar att koda bygger du nu med AI, och det frigör tid till det som verkligen gör skillnad. Du pratar med kunderna, förstår deras verkliga problem, omvandlar dem till lösningar och bygger dem. Det du bygger ska bli sådant vi säljer och tjänar pengar på, så du tänker lika mycket på värde och affär som på kod. Vad du gör Träffar och pratar med kunder och användare, ställer frågor och gräver fram problemen bakom problemen. Gör research, analyserar och prioriterar. Vilka problem är värda att lösa, och vad är den enklaste vägen till en lösning som håller? Designar och bygger lösningar över hela stacken – från idé och prototyp till produktionssatt funktion. Använder AI som verktyg i varje steg: för att snabbt förstå problem, analysera data och bygga och iterera lösningar. Hjälper till med kampanjer och lanseringar, och ser till att kunderna får support när de behöver det. Jobbar tätt med grundarna och tar egna initiativ – du väntar inte på en spec, du föreslår och levererar. Vem du är Entreprenöriell: du ser affären i tekniken och drivs av att bygga sådant kunder faktiskt vill betala för. Prestigelös: du gör det som behövs - kundsamtal, support, bugfix eller pitch - utan att fastna i titlar. Nyfiken och kreativ: Testar, utforskar och hittar lösningar där andra ser problem. AI-first: du använder AI naturligt som hävstång i både analys och utveckling, och lär dig nya verktyg snabbt. Bred och beslutsför: Du är trygg i att jobba över hela stacken voch ågar fatta beslut på begränsad fakta. Du passar inte om Du ser AI som en bisak snarare än som central byggsten. Du vill helst grotta ner dig i ett smalt teknikområde, undviker kundkontakt och shoppar helst färdiga specs. Vad Hemlo erbjuder En avgörande roll där ditt arbete direkt syns och påverkar produkt och affär, kort väg från idé till lansering, och möjligheten att forma både Hemlo och din egen roll i takt med att vi växer. Marknadsmässiglön och möjlighet till ägande via optioner.

items.desc: Build better digital learning experiences as a Learning Technology Specialist at Vertage Do you enjoy exploring new technologies, creating digital content and finding smarter ways for people to learn? Are you curious about AI and how it can improve everyday learning experiences? Then this could be your next step. As a Learning Technology Specialist at Vertage, you'll help develop and improve the digital learning tools used by colleagues across our global organisation. From managing our Learning Management System (LMS) and creating engaging e-learning content to experimenting with AI and automation, you'll work on practical solutions that make learning more accessible, effective and enjoyable. You'll join our Global Learning & Development team, where technology and creativity come together. Whether you've already gained experience in digital learning or are still building your technical skills, we're interested in what you can create, how you approach challenges and your willingness to learn. Good to know before applying This is a hybrid role based in the UK or the Netherlands, with approximately one or two days per week in the office. You'll collaborate with colleagues across different countries, so a strong command of English is important. Your impact as a Learning Technology Specialist As a Learning Technology Specialist, you'll help ensure our learning platforms and digital resources are accessible, reliable and easy to use. You'll support the day-to-day management of our LMS, SAP Litmos KnowHow, develop digital learning content and help colleagues get the most out of the tools available to them. But this role goes beyond maintaining existing systems. You'll also have the opportunity to explore new technologies, test ideas and build solutions that improve how we create and deliver learning. Whether that's developing an interactive learning experience, automating a repetitive process or experimenting with AI, you'll have the freedom to contribute ideas and develop your skills along the way. What will you do as a Learning Technology Specialist? Responsibilities Within our Global Learning & Development team, you'll work on a variety of digital learning projects, combining technical problem-solving with content creation and continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting and improving our LMS, SAP Litmos KnowHow, including content management, user access, configuration and day-to-day troubleshooting; Creating and updating engaging e-learning modules, videos and digital learning resources using tools such as Articulate 360, Vyond and Camtasia; Working with colleagues across Learning & Development and the wider business to translate learning needs into practical, user-friendly digital solutions; Building and testing simple web pages, learning portals, dashboards or workflow prototypes using HTML, CSS and other digital tools; Exploring how AI tools such as Claude Enterprise and Microsoft Copilot can improve learning experiences, content creation and everyday workflows; Supporting automation and platform improvements using tools such as Power Automate, while developing your understanding of system integrations; Working with learning data, Excel and Power BI to maintain reports, identify issues and help improve the effectiveness of our learning solutions. About Vertage At Vertage, we connect organisations with external professionals and support workforce solutions across the public and private sectors. We operate in an international environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous development play an important role. items.title: AI Engineer - Task Planning and Orchestration, Embodied Agents (Mensch)
items.card: Aufgaben zerlegen, planen, Tools nutzen und State über lange Horizonte halten — nicht nur Single-Turn-Prompting. Mehrere Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung mit physischen Robotern, nicht nur in der Simulation: eigenen Code auf eine echte Plattform bringen, ihn dort betreiben und ein System debuggen, das sich anders verhielt, sobald es einen Körper hatte. Praktische Erfahrung mit VLMs als Arbeitswerkzeug: Grounding von Sprache
items.desc: Bei NEURA Robotics führen kognitive Roboter nicht einfach Befehle aus. Sie nehmen ihre Umgebung wahr, ziehen Schlüsse daraus, planen über lange Zeithorizonte und handeln autonom in der physischen Welt. Unsere Robotic Foundation Models übernehmen die physische Ausführung. Darüber sitzt der Agent: die Instanz, die erarbeitet, was eine Aufgabe tatsächlich erfordert, sie in Schritte zerlegt, die der Roboter ausführen kann, und erkennt, wann die Realität nicht mehr zum Plan passt. Für den Aufbau dieser Agents auf unserer Humanoid-Plattform suchen wir dich. Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Embodied Agent Harness: Du entwickelst den Agent, der auf unserer Humanoid-Plattform läuft — den Loop von Sensorinput über Reasoning bis zur Aktion, seine Interfaces zu Kameras, Tiefendaten und Propriozeption des Roboters sowie das State Management, das eine Aufgabe über Minuten statt Sekunden hinweg kohärent hält. Task Decomposition & Long-Horizon Planning: Du übersetzt übergeordnete menschliche Intention in geordnete, ausführbare Schritte — jeweils mit den nötigen Preconditions, räumlichen Referenzen und Success Criteria — und sequenzierst sie so, dass der Roboter eine Aufgabe bewältigt, die er in dieser exakten Form noch nie gesehen hat. Visual Reasoning & World State: Du nutzt VLMs, um zu interpretieren, was der Roboter sieht, verankerst Sprache in der Szene (Grounding) und pflegst eine Arbeitsrepräsentation von Objekten, Affordances und Task History, über die der Planner schlussfolgern kann. Closed-Loop Execution & Recovery: Du verifizierst jeden Schritt gegen die Beobachtung, statt Erfolg anzunehmen, erkennst Abweichungen vom Plan und planst neu, wiederholst oder eskalierst an einen Menschen, wenn das Risiko zu hoch ist. Evaluation auf dem Roboter: Du misst Task Success in der Simulation und auf echter Hardware, baust Failure Taxonomies aus realen Runs auf und entscheidest darauf basierend, ob ein Fix in den Planner, das Interface oder den ausgegebenen Schritt gehört. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Teams für Foundation Models, Perception, Manipulation und Hardware zusammen, um den Reasoning Layer über den Modellen vom Konzept zu verlässlichem Verhalten auf einem ausgelieferten Roboter zu bringen. Was du mitbringst Einen sehr guten Master oder eine Promotion in Informatik, Robotik oder einem verwandten Feld — oder vergleichbare Tiefe, nachgewiesen durch ausgelieferte Arbeit. Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Aufbau von Agent-Systemen auf Basis von LLMs und VLMs, die Aufgaben zerlegen, planen, Tools nutzen und State über lange Horizonte halten — nicht nur Single-Turn-Prompting. Mehrere Jahre Hands-on-Erfahrung mit physischen Robotern, nicht nur in der Simulation: eigenen Code auf eine echte Plattform bringen, ihn dort betreiben und ein System debuggen, das sich anders verhielt, sobald es einen Körper hatte. Praktische Erfahrung mit VLMs als Arbeitswerkzeug: Grounding von Sprache in Bildern, räumliches und physikalisches Reasoning, strukturierte Outputs, auf die du handeln kannst, und ein realistisches Gefühl dafür, wo sie scheitern. Vertrautheit mit hierarchischer Autonomie, bei der ein Reasoning-Modell plant und gelernte oder klassische Policies ausführen: Subgoal-Interfaces, Progress Verification, Replanning. Erfahrung mit Robotics Middleware und Onboard Deployment: ROS 2, Inferenz auf Embedded GPUs und Arbeiten innerhalb eines realen Latency Budgets. Solides Software Engineering: sauberer Code, Testing und Services, auf denen andere Teams aufbauen können. Cloud, Containerization und CI/CD sind ein Plus. Sehr gutes Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Plus.

items.desc: Job Description Summary Identifier, évaluer et piloter des opportunités d'applications IA/ML à fort impact au sein du site, en collaborant étroitement avec les équipes métier, lean et la fonction IA Centrale. Vous agissez comme partenaire stratégique et ambassadeur AMP 2.0 (IA interne GE Vernova), traduisant les besoins métier en cas d'usage concrets, pilotant le développement de preuves de concept (POC) et accompagnant leur passage à l'échelle en production. Le profil recherché allie compétences techniques en IA/ML (Python, analyse de données, modélisation) et qualités comportementales fortes (communication, résolution de problèmes, gestion de projet agile, travail en équipe transversale). Job Description GE Vernova est une entreprise mondiale du secteur de l’énergie, organisée en trois segments : Power, Wind et Electrification . Fort de plus de 130 ans d’expérience dans la résolution des défis énergétiques mondiaux, GE Vernova est idéalement positionnée pour jouer un rôle de leader dans la transition énergétique, en continuant à électrifier le monde tout en contribuant à sa décarbonation. Le groupe compte plus de 70 000 collaborateurs répartis dans plus de 100 pays . L’entité Grid Solutions de GE Vernova fournit des technologies et systèmes de réseau avancés permettant la transmission et la distribution de l’énergie, depuis le point de génération jusqu’au point de consommation, contribuant ainsi à une transition énergétique fiable, sécurisée et décarbonée. Profil et périmètre du poste Identification des Opportunités Stratégiques : Collaborer étroitement avec les différentes fonctions, équipes lean et parties prenantes pour identifier et évaluer de manière proactive les opportunités à fort impact pour les applications IA/ML au niveau du site. Partenariat avec les Parties Prenantes : Agir en tant que partenaire IA clé auprès des équipes projet transversales, en les guidant à travers les potentiels et les limites de l'IA/ML pour répondre efficacement aux défis métier spécifiques. Traduire les défis métier en énoncés de problèmes clairs, critères de succès mesurables et hypothèses de valeur. Ambassadeur AMP 2.0 : Partenaire clé pour le site afin de tirer parti des possibilités d'AMP 2.0. Former les différentes équipes à AMP 2.0 et les guider à travers les différentes fonctionnalités pour développer leurs propres cas d'usage dans AMP. Études de Faisabilité et Déploiement de Preuves de Concept : Piloter le développement de preuves de concept (POC) pour les opportunités à fort impact au niveau du site et en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe IA Centrale PT, afin de réaliser rapidement des tests de faisabilité ou d'adapter les cas d'usage existants aux besoins métier du site. Passage à l'Échelle : Collaborer avec l'équipe IA centrale PT et les autres parties prenantes pour faire évoluer les POC IA vers des déploiements à l'échelle de la production et activer l'impact métier de la solution IA au niveau du site. Compétences Comportementales Connaissance du Domaine : Bonne compréhension de nos produits et processus Esprit d'Équipe Collaboratif : Capacité à travailler efficacement et de manière collaborative au sein d'équipes diverses et transversales au niveau du site et de PT Communication & Présentation : Bonnes compétences en communication, avec la capacité d'expliquer des concepts techniques complexes à des parties prenantes non techniques et de préparer une documentation claire et concise Résolution de Problèmes & Esprit Critique : Solides compétences analytiques et de résolution de problèmes, avec une approche proactive pour identifier et résoudre les défis techniques Leadership de Projet : Bonne compréhension des principes de gestion de projet, y compris les méthodologies agiles, pour piloter les projets de la conception à la réalisation Qualifications Compétences Appliquées en IA/ML : Expérience pratique dans l'application de l'IA/ML aux opérations (par exemple, analyse de données, prévision de séries temporelles et détection d'anomalies, vision par ordinateur pour la qualité/inspection, optimisation, et cas d'usage basiques de NLP/LLM). Maîtrise de Python et des méthodologies d'analyse de données ; expérience pratique de la collecte de données, l'ingénierie des caractéristiques, l'évaluation de modèles et la conception de POC expérimentaux. Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No

items.desc: CEME Group è un'azienda leader a livello internazionale nella progettazione e produzione si sistemi e soluzioni per il passaggio di fluidi per applicazioni industriali, professionali e domestiche. Per il nostro headquarter sito a Trivolzio (PV) , siamo alla ricerca di un AI Specialist che contribuisca all'implementazione, alla governance e alla diffusione delle soluzioni AI all'interno dell'organizzazione. 🎯 Il ruolo L' AI Specialist , a diretto riporto del Business Intelligence Manager, rappresenterà il punto di riferimento operativo per l'implementazione, il monitoraggio e l'evoluzione delle iniziative di Intelligenza Artificiale all'interno di CEME Group. La figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con i team aziendali, le funzioni di business e i partner tecnologici esterni per garantire la corretta delivery delle soluzioni AI, il raggiungimento degli obiettivi progettuali e la loro adozione efficace da parte degli utenti finali. Il ruolo prevede un coinvolgimento diretto sia nella gestione operativa dei progetti AI, dalla definizione degli use case al deployment delle soluzioni, sia nel monitoraggio delle performance e nella governance delle tecnologie implementate. 💼 Responsabilità principali AI Solutions Implementation & Monitoring Supportare la progettazione, lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di soluzioni basate su Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning e Generative AI. Collaborare con team interni ed esterni per garantire il corretto rilascio delle soluzioni nei tempi e nelle modalità previste. Monitorare le performance dei modelli AI attraverso KPI tecnici e di business (accuracy, precision, recall, drift, utilizzo e valore generato). Garantire il corretto funzionamento delle soluzioni AI in esercizio e gestirne le attività di manutenzione evolutiva. Identificare opportunità di miglioramento continuo e ottimizzazione delle performance. Use Case Development & Business Support Collaborare con le funzioni aziendali per identificare, analizzare e prioritizzare use case AI ad alto impatto. Tradurre esigenze e requisiti di business in specifiche tecniche e modelli analitici. Supportare l'intero ciclo di vita dei progetti AI, dalla fase di analisi alla messa in produzione. Facilitare il dialogo tra stakeholder tecnici e non tecnici. Supportare gli utenti finali nell'adozione delle nuove soluzioni attraverso attività di training e change management. AI Governance & Best Practices Contribuire alla definizione e all'applicazione delle linee guida aziendali relative all'utilizzo dell'Intelligenza Artificiale. Supportare l'implementazione di policy e framework relativi a governance, sicurezza, compliance ed etica dell'AI. Assicurare il rispetto degli standard aziendali e delle best practice di settore. Promuovere la diffusione della cultura AI all'interno dell'organizzazione. Collaborare alle iniziative di formazione e sensibilizzazione sui temi dell'AI 🎓 Requisiti Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Data Science o discipline affini. Esperienza di 3-5 anni in ambito Al / Machine Learning / Advanced Analytics . Conoscenza di linguaggi e strumenti di sviluppo (es. Python, SQL, librerie ML). Familiarità con piattaforme AI/ML e ambienti cloud (es. Azure Al, AWS, Google Cloud). Conoscenza e utilizzo operativo di piattaforme di Al generativa e assistenti enterprise , come Microsoft Copilot, Claude e soluzioni analoghe, con capacità di valutarne applicabilità, limiti e modalità di adozione in contesti aziendali. Conoscenza base di architetture dati e integrazione con sistemi aziendali (ERP, BI, Data Platform). Conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese. 🧠 Soft skills Forte orientamento al problem solving e al miglioramento continuo. Capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team cross-funzionali e multiculturali. Capacità di gestione delle priorità e dei progetti. Proattività, curiosità e forte interesse verso l'innovazione tecnologica. Attitudine all'apprendimento continuo e all'aggiornamento professionale. Contratto collettivo applicato: CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria Livello di inserimento: B2 Fascia retributiva: 45.000 / 50.000 euro lordi

items.desc: Technical Co-Founder & CTO (AI/ML) | Swiss AI Startup Company: Fashion Genius Technology Lab AG Location: Zug / Zurich, Switzerland (Hybrid) Position: Technical Co-Founder & CTO Compensation: Equity-based founding opportunity; salary subject to funding and mutual agreement. Build the Intelligence Layer for the Future of Fashion Commerce Fashion Genius is a Swiss AI startup developing a new intelligence layer for fashion e-commerce. Our vision goes beyond virtual try-on. We aim to connect visual AI, fit intelligence, personalised styling and commerce data into a scalable platform that helps fashion retailers create more relevant shopping experiences, improve conversion and reduce returns. We have already developed an initial MVP and are preparing for pilot validation with retailers and creators. Now, we are looking for an exceptional Technical Co-Founder & CTO to take ownership of our technology, shape our AI strategy and build the next stage of Fashion Genius. This is not a traditional CTO position. It is an opportunity to join as a technical co-founder and help build a venture from its early stages. What You Will Own Lead the technical strategy, architecture and product engineering of Fashion Genius. Evaluate, strengthen and scale our existing MVP into a production-ready SaaS platform. Design and develop our Fashion Intelligence Layer, connecting computer vision, generative AI, fit intelligence and personalised recommendations. Own the AI/ML architecture, data pipelines, APIs and cloud infrastructure. Make pragmatic build-versus-buy decisions, leveraging existing AI models and technologies where appropriate. Work directly with the Founder & CEO on product strategy, customer pilots, technical roadmap and investor discussions. Recruit and lead an engineering team as the company grows. Translate complex AI capabilities into commercially viable products. Who We're Looking For You are a hands-on technology leader with strong engineering expertise and an entrepreneurial mindset. Essential qualifications Strong hands-on background in software engineering, AI/ML or AI-powered product development. Experience designing, building and deploying production-grade software platforms. Ability to take technical ownership from architecture through implementation. Understanding of modern AI technologies, cloud architecture, APIs and scalable SaaS platforms. Comfortable working in an early-stage environment with limited resources, rapid experimentation and evolving priorities. Based in Switzerland or genuinely willing to relocate and build the company from Switzerland. Strong interest in joining as an equity-based technical co-founder. Particularly interesting backgrounds Former Technical Founder, Co-Founder, Founding Engineer, CTO or Head of Engineering at a technology startup. Experience taking a startup product from MVP to commercial launch and scale. Engineering or research background at ETH Zurich, EPFL or a comparable technical university. Previous experience at Google, NVIDIA, Amazon, Meta, Microsoft or other leading technology companies. Experience in venture-backed AI startups, deep-tech ventures or university spin-offs. Expertise in computer vision, multimodal AI, generative AI, recommendation systems or AI infrastructure. Experience with e-commerce platforms, Shopify ecosystems or consumer technology products. We value proven execution, entrepreneurial ownership and technical depth over prestigious titles alone. Why Join Fashion Genius? Build, don't just manage. Take ownership of the technology and help shape a new AI platform from an early stage. Real product foundation. Join a company with an existing MVP and upcoming market validation, rather than starting from a blank page. Meaningful founder responsibility. Influence product, architecture, team building and the long-term technology vision. Equity participation. Join as a genuine technical co-founder with an equity package to be negotiated based on commitment, contribution and responsibilities. Swiss startup ecosystem. Build from the Zug/Zurich region with ambitions to serve the international fashion e-commerce market. Important: Co-Founder Opportunity This is an equity-based founding role, not a conventional salaried CTO vacancy . The compensation structure, equity participation, commitment and potential salary following funding will be discussed transparently during the selection process. We are looking for a long-term technical partner who shares our ambition and wants to create meaningful company value. Co-Founder Investment & Equity Commitment We are seeking a genuine entrepreneurial partner who is prepared to contribute not only technical expertise, leadership and long-term commitment, but also personal capital to the venture. A personal financial investment is expected as part of the co-founder arrangement. The investment amount, equity participation, responsibilities and terms will be negotiated transparently and individually. Interested? Please apply …

items.desc: ¿Te interesa impulsar la innovación educativa y contribuir a preparar a los estudiantes para un entorno profesional marcado por la transformación digital y el uso generalizado de la Inteligencia Artificial? ¿Tienes experiencia en Inteligencia Artificial, innovación educativa y diseño curricular y te motiva acompañar a las facultades en la incorporación de nuevas competencias, metodologías y herramientas de IA en sus programas formativos? Buscamos incorporar un/a Especialista en Innovación Educativa e Inteligencia Artificial al Servei d'Innovació i Qualitat Educativa (SIQE). Nuestra universidad cuenta con más de 8.000 estudiantes y ofrece 16 programas de grado, ocho dobles grados y unos 30 dobles grados internacionales, así como una amplia oferta de másteres, posgrados y cursos. Nuestra actividad se fundamenta en el rigor, el espíritu crítico, la colaboración, la iniciativa, la calidad y la orientación al servicio. La búsqueda de la excelencia forma parte de nuestro ADN. Por ello, en nuestra Universidad buscamos profesionales comprometidos que transmitan estos valores a través de su profesionalidad. Queremos incorporar una persona motivada y comprometida con el propósito de nuestra Universidad: Humanizamos la Transformación de la Sociedad. Más información sobre la UIC: https://www.uic.es/en Lo que buscamos, Una persona con capacidad para impulsar la integración estratégica de las competencias en Inteligencia Artificial en los planes de estudio de grado y máster, garantizando que los programas formativos incorporen los conocimientos, habilidades y competencias necesarios para que los estudiantes puedan incorporarse con garantías al mundo laboral en un contexto profesional altamente digitalizado y con un uso cada vez más generalizado de la IA. La posición tendrá como objetivo asesorar y acompañar a las facultades en la identificación e incorporación de competencias en IA, diseñar marcos de competencias transversales, identificar las necesidades emergentes del mercado laboral y proponer contenidos, actividades y metodologías docentes que permitan desarrollar una formación alineada con las nuevas demandas profesionales. Asimismo, contribuirá a impulsar proyectos de innovación educativa relacionados con la Inteligencia Artificial, evaluar su impacto y participar en las decisiones relativas a la incorporación de herramientas y licencias de IA en la Universidad, en el marco del Plan Estratégico UIC'28. La persona seleccionada trabajará en estrecha colaboración con las facultades, el Observatorio de Inteligencia Artificial y Nuevas Tecnologías (OIANT), el Aula de Calidad e Innovación Docente y la persona responsable del diseño de la formación en IA dirigida a alumnado y PDI. Funciones y responsabilidades: Integración de la IA en los planes de estudio: En el marco de uso de la IA, Identificar necesidades formativas del mercado laboral para poder integrarlas en el currículum. Asesorar a las facultades en la incorporación estratégica de competencias, resultados de aprendizaje y contenidos de IA en los planes de estudio. Diseñar el marco de competencias transversales en IA que debería tener el alumnado de la UIC, alineado con las necesidades del mercado laboral y la evolución de las diferentes áreas profesionales. Innovación educativa y aplicación de la IA: Impulsar proyectos piloto, metodologías y buenas prácticas para la aplicación de la IA en la docencia. Identificar y valorar herramientas, soluciones y licencias de IA con potencial aplicación educativa. Coordinación y acompañamiento: Actuar como referente en IA para las facultades y coordinarse con el OIANT/Aula de Calidad e Innovación Docente. Gestión de proyectos y formación: Participar en el diseño, gestión y seguimiento de proyectos y ayudas de innovación educativa, incluyendo iniciativas de la Alianza Europea DIGI Care. Identificar y apoyar las necesidades formativas de PDI y alumnado relacionadas con la evolución de la IA. Conectar las necesidades curriculares con las iniciativas de formación, innovación y transformación digital de la Universidad. Evaluación e impacto: Definir indicadores y evaluar el impacto de la integración de la IA en los planes de estudio y en los proyectos de innovación educativa. Elaborar propuestas e informes que permitan identificar oportunidades de mejora y apoyar la toma de decisiones institucionales. Qué ofrecemos Transparencia retributiva: compartiremos la banda salarial correspondiente a la posición durante la primera fase del proceso de selección. Horario flexible, de entrada de 8 a 10 de la mañana y salida de 17 a 19 horas. Con posibilidad de hacer intensiva los viernes. 38-41 días aprox. de vacaciones por año devengado Lugar de trabajo: Carrer de Terré, 11-19, Barcelona. Tenemos parking para el personal. Trabajo presencial, con la posibilidad de trabajar un día a la semana de forma remota. Descuento del 50% en el menú del mediodía en el restaurante de nuestra Universidad. Retribución flexible: transporte público, …

items.desc: Riche de plus de 140 années d'histoire, Tarkett est un leader mondial des solutions innovantes et durables de revêtements de sol et de surfaces sportives, et a réalisé un chiffre d'affaires de 3,3 milliards d'euros en 2025. Le Groupe compte près de 12 000 collaborateurs et dispose de 25 centres de R&D, 11 centres de recyclage et 33 sites de production. Tarkett conçoit et fabrique des solutions pour les hôpitaux, les écoles, l'habitat, les hôtels, les bureaux, les commerces et les terrains de sport, au service de clients dans plus de 100 pays. Pour construire "The Way to Better Floors", le Groupe s'engage dans l'économie circulaire et le développement durable, conformément à son approche Tarkett Human-Conscious Design®. www.tarkett-group.com Nous avons déployé Claude et Copilot auprès de nos équipes, et nous souhaitons désormais accélérer leur adoption à grande échelle. Véritable point de contact entre les métiers et les équipes techniques , vous aidez les collaborateurs à tirer le meilleur parti de Claude, Copilot et des outils d'IA générative tout en participant à la création de solutions adaptées à leurs besoins. items.desc: If you need support in completing the application or if you require a different format of this document, please get in touch with at UKI.recruitment@tcs.com with the subject line: “Application Support Request”. Role: Data Scientist Location: Letterkenny, Hybrid (3 days in office) Duration: Permanent Careers at TCS: It means more TCS is a purpose-led transformation company, built on belief. We do not just help businesses to transform through technology. We support them in making a meaningful difference to the people and communities they serve - our clients include some of the biggest brands in the UK and worldwide. For you, it means more to make an impact that matters, through challenging projects which demand ambitious innovation and thought leadership. Work closely with the range of teams within the business to bring ideas to life. Develop and maintain a unified strategy that aligns operational efficiency with marketing and growth objectives. Work with customers and create high-impact customer experiences for our business. The Role We are seeking a Data Scientist with experience in Marketing and Distribution Analytics within Financial Services, particularly Asset Management, Life Insurance, and Retirement. The role focuses on applying data science and advanced analytics to improve customer targeting, campaign effectiveness, and distribution outcomes in regulated, data-rich environments, while providing technical leadership and mentoring junior team members. Your responsibilities: Hands‑on experience applying AI/ML techniques for customer segmentation, propensity modelling, and predictive analytics within Financial Services , with exposure to Asset Management, Life Insurance, or Retirement products and distribution models. Lead the design, development, and deployment of analytical models, ensuring alignment with business objectives and measurable impact on marketing and distribution outcomes. Develop, deploy, and maintain analytical models using AWS and Azure cloud platforms, including services such as Azure Machine Learning, SageMaker, and Databricks, while adhering to established engineering standards, governance frameworks, and model lifecycle practices. Provide technical guidance, mentor junior team members, and contribute to best practices in model development, validation, and deployment. Your Profile Essential skills/knowledge/experience: Strong programming capability in Python and SQL , with experience creating analytical datasets, performing feature engineering, and building reusable analytical code to support marketing performance measurement, advisor engagement, and customer lifecycle analytics . Proven experience leading or contributing to end-to-end data science initiatives, balancing hands-on delivery with oversight of project outcomes and quality. Practical experience using Power BI to design dashboards and analytical views that support: - Audience and segment exploration, - Campaign, channel, and distribution performance analysis, - Interpretation of model outputs for business and marketing stakeholders Emphasis is placed on clarity, explainability, and decision support rather than purely technical visualization. Working familiarity with AI‑driven lead scoring, intent, or signal‑based platforms (such as 6Sense, Bombora, or similar tools), with experience supporting their use in B2B, intermediary‑led, or advisor‑based distribution models. Understanding of financial data structures and constraints , including customer, advisor, product, and transactional data, as well as awareness of regulatory, data privacy, and model risk considerations common to Financial Services environments. Experience collaborating with marketing, distribution, sales, data engineering, and technology teams , contributing to analytics initiatives that improve targeting precision, conversion outcomes, and customer engagement. items.desc: Wil jij mee bepalen hoe AI een concrete plek krijgt in de dagelijkse werking van onze functionele analisten? Binnen het EverESSt-team zoeken we iemand die AI-initiatieven helpt vertalen naar praktische, herbruikbare oplossingen voor functionele analisten. Je staat dicht bij de teams en de functionele analisten, helpt hen experimenteren met concrete use cases, prompts en tools en brengt tegelijk structuur. Wat werkt in één team, help jij opschalen naar andere teams. Je werkt hierbij nauw samen met de Tech Lead en Product Owners en combineert AI-affiniteit met coaching, coördinatie en PMO best practices. Je coacht en ondersteunt proxies bij het inzetten van AI en helpt hen op weg met praktische use cases, prompts en relevante tools. Je stimuleert kennisdeling tussen teams door learnings en best practices samen te brengen en hands-on sessies te faciliteren. Je maakt succesvolle oplossingen herbruikbaar door wat goed werkt binnen één team te vertalen naar duidelijke werkwijzen die ook andere teams kunnen toepassen. Je brengt structuur in nieuwe AI-ideeën vanuit de teams en stemt samen met de tech lead af welke initiatieven voldoende potentieel hebben om verder op te nemen met de Product Owners. Je beheert de backlog van AI-initiatieven in Jira en zorgt ervoor dat goedgekeurde experimenten en features een duidelijke scope, eigenaar en status hebben. Je bewaakt mee de balans tussen het geplande sprintwerk en nieuwe AI-initiatieven binnen de verschillende teams. Je brengt structuur en PMO best practices in de opvolging van initiatieven, zodat experimenten gericht worden opgevolgd en vooruitgang zichtbaar blijft. Je verbindt teams en stakeholders rond AI, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt ervoor dat kennis en oplossingen optimaal over de teams heen worden benut. Wat breng jij mee? Je hebt ervaring als proxy en begrijpt daardoor goed hoe functionele analisten en teams in de praktijk werken. Je hebt een duidelijke affiniteit met AI en bent enthousiast om AI praktisch toepasbaar te maken binnen de dagelijkse werking. Idealiter heb je al AI-initiatieven geïmplementeerd voor functionele analisten of ervaring met vergelijkbare AI-use cases. Je bent bereid om twee dagen per week vanuit Leuven te werken. Wat hebben wij jou te bieden? We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat alle medewerkers hun potentieel kunnen realiseren. Je start bij een Top Employer! Wij hanteren een framework met het oog op eerlijke verloning, waarbij medewerkers worden verloond op basis van hun functie, ervaring en prestaties, onafhankelijk van gender of andere niet-werkgerelateerde kenmerken. Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans. Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij. Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner. Continu bijleren: door innovation centers, leesgroepen, knowledge sharing meetings, hackatons, deelname aan conferenties en externe opleidingen zetten we kennisdeling en bijleren centraal. We ontwikkelen innovatieve oplossingen met een positieve impact op milieu, mens en maatschappij, en streven naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen gewaardeerd en gehoord wordt. items.desc: Company Overview KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us. Group/Division The ICOS Vision Systems division focuses on the backend of the line semiconductor industry providing fully automated tools to inspect and sort, finished integrated circuit packages. For more than 15 years, ICOS has been a market leader with tray-to-tray and tray-to-tape inspection and sorting tools found in the production facilities of all major chipmakers in the world. Our market-leading technology and superior customer service requires strong talent in optics, machine control, algorithms and applications within our engineering teams. The ICOS division headquarters are in Leuven, Belgium with additional engineering and manufacturing operations in Singapore and Shenzhen (China). Job Description/Preferred Qualifications Kick-start your career as an Algorithm Engineer by working on the “Vision Engine”, the brain of our inspection systems. By using groundbreaking technology and developing smart algorithms, from classic computer vision to modern machine learning, we can solve challenging real-world inspection problems. Through teamwork and growth opportunities you will become an expert on our high performance vision systems and contribute directly to support our customers. At KLA, early-career engineers grow by working side-by-side with experienced experts, contributing to real products that shape the semiconductor industry. You will join collaborative, multidisciplinary teams where knowledge sharing, mentorship, and technical excellence are part of everyday work. Through hands-on projects, guidance from senior engineers, and exposure to real customer challenges, you will continuously expand both your technical skills and system-level understanding. If you thrive in a team environment, enjoy learning every day, and want your work to truly matter, KLA offers the ideal place to build a strong and rewarding engineering career. Your work involves Designing and developing so􀅌ware for advanced inspection solutions, translating customer requirements into high-quality, maintainable so􀅌ware used in state-of-the-art manufacturing environments. Collaborating with multiple software teams to validate and integrate new inspection flows, ensuring they are scalable, reliable, and ready for deployment on KLA inspection machines. Working together with senior engineers to evaluate and introduce modern so􀅌ware tools and development practices, continuously improving efficiency and the development environment on Linux and Windows. Supporting field engineers and the Applications (APPS) team, contributing to the full process flow of the vision system and gaining a strong end-to-end understanding of our products. Occasional travel to customers, helping you build real-world insight into customer use cases and the impact of your work in production environments. Requirements A solid foundation in machine vision and software development, combined with curiosity and motivation, enables you to grow into solving increasingly complex inspection challenges. Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Initial professional experience (or strong hands-on academic projects) is a plus, but above all we value your passion for technology, drive to learn, and motivation to make a difference. Good understanding of object-oriented programming, with practical experience in C/C++ gained through coursework, projects, or early career roles. Exposure to Python and deep-learning concepts is a plus. Experience working with Linux environments and open-source tools, at least at project or academic level, with the ambition to deepen this knowledge in a professional setting. Strong interest in new technologies, including emerging hardware trends, modern software frameworks, and computer-vision libraries, with the curiosity to experiment and learn. Analytical mindset and strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration within international, multidisciplinary teams. Fluent in English, written and spoken. …

items.desc: What You'll Do... We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated senior vision systems engineer to join our dynamic team in the battery manufacturing industry. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing, development, implementation and maintaining vision systems for automate inspection, measurement, and quality control in battery production processes The ideal candidate will have a passion for automation and machine vision, with a strong background in engineering and hands-on experience with vision system integration in a manufacturing environment. The Vision Systems Engineer will be proactive, collaborative, and capable of solving complex technical challenges while maintaining a focus on quality, efficiency, and innovation. Who We Are... Agratas is a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons. We will design, develop and manufacture high-quality, high-performance, sustainable batteries for the mobility and energy sectors. We are a scale-up business with a start-up mentality and the backing of a well-established parent company. The UK business headquarters is in the Midlands and we are currently building a battery manufacturing facility in Bridgwater, Somerset. The team you'll join... The Process Engineering team is a dynamic group working across a range of areas such as electrode, cell assembly, FA&T (formation, ageing and testing), control and automation, manufacturing systems, digital manufacturing, process safety and logistics engineering. Being a relatively new team, you’ll play a critical part in creating processes and help building large scale manufacturing lines from the ground up. What You'll Bring... Extensive knowledge of machine vision technologies, including camera systems, lighting, optics, and image processing tools (OpenCV, MATLAB, Halcon, etc.). Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, C++, and familiarity with machine learning libraries for vision system applications. Experience in integrating vision systems into automated manufacturing environments, ideally in high-precision industries such as battery production or electronics. Familiarity with smart manufacturing solutions, machine learning, IoT, and AI-driven vision technologies is a plus. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Vision, Robotics, Mechatronics, or a related field. Experience in manufacturing environments or automated inspection systems is strongly preferred. What You'll Get... As a new company, our reward scheme is constantly evolving. We continue to review the market to deliver a competitive benefits package, which currently includes private healthcare, car allowance, company bonus, enhanced parental leave policy and a cash allowance to boost your benefits. We are a flexible business that is committed to promoting work-life balance, partnering with Yulife to provide our team members with total wellbeing support. You’ll work in a rapidly scaling-up environment as a subsidiary of the multinational corporation, Tata Sons, to help build the UK’s biggest battery manufacturing facility and make your mark in a new organisation. Agratas is a place to be authentically you. At Agratas we strongly believe that people are at their best when they feel supported and happy in their workplace. To that end we continue to cultivate a diverse workforce which protects the individuality of each team member. We therefore warmly welcome applicants from any race, gender, sexuality, and ability. Should you have a preference in how your suitability is assessed for this role or require any reasonable adjustments please let the Talent Acquisition team know.

items.desc: Making a Positive Impact, Together. Doing things differently. Research Fellow Salary- £33,739 - £38,825 per annum Full time and Fixed term for 12 months About The Role Nottingham Trent University is seeking two highly motivated Research Fellow's to join a newly funded research project. The project will accelerate the commercialisation of an innovative intelligent poultry monitoring platform that combines environmental sensing, bioacoustic monitoring and adaptive lighting control to improve poultry health, welfare and productivity. The technology has already demonstrated significant promise in operational settings and will now be further developed and validated to support large-scale commercial deployment. The project focuses on improving manufacturability, reliability, environmental robustness and ease of installation whilst undertaking comprehensive validation under commercial poultry production conditions. We are recruiting two Research Fellows who will contribute to different aspects of the project: Research Fellow - Product Development and Engineering This role will focus on hardware development and optimisation of the monitoring platform. Activities will include prototyping, enclosure and casing design, waterproofing and environmental protection, thermal performance assessment, manufacturability and testing. The successful candidate may also contribute to embedded systems development, sensor integration and deployment of prototype devices. Research Fellow - Poultry Systems Validation This role will be based primarily within NTU's Poultry Research Unit and will focus on evaluating system performance under commercial poultry production conditions. Activities will include planning and conducting flock-scale trials, collecting and analysing behavioural and welfare data, validating system functionality and supporting the refinement of the technology through evidence-based recommendations. Both positions will work closely with a multidisciplinary team comprising experts in poultry science, behaviour and welfare, smart sensing, artificial intelligence, manufacturing engineering and industrial digitalisation. The posts offer an excellent opportunity to contribute to an exciting translational research project that combines engineering innovation with real-world agricultural impact. Applicants should hold (or be close to completion of) a PhD in a relevant discipline and demonstrate experience aligned to one of the two pathways. Strong communication, organisational and collaborative skills are essential. For more details, please take a look at the role profile. We'll still consider applications even if you don't meet every single one of the requirements, so don't be put off if you don't match them perfectly. items.card: Aufgaben und Fähigkeiten direkt von erfahrenen menschlichen Bedienern lernen – von den Leuten, die diese Prozesse in- und auswendig kennen. Als Physical AI Data Operations Expert arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unseren Data Operators, unseren Robotern und unseren Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass das NEURA Gym, unsere Datenproduktionsfabrik, reibungslos läuft. Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Du bist die erste
items.desc: Gib unseren Robotern Bewusstsein Physical AI lässt sich nicht allein mit Internetdaten trainieren. Roboter müssen industrielle Fähigkeiten in der realen Welt erlernen – durch Beobachten, Interagieren und Arbeiten in echten Umgebungen. Das ist die Idee hinter NEURA Gym: einem globalen Netzwerk physischer Trainingszentren, in denen Roboter industrielle Aufgaben und Fähigkeiten direkt von erfahrenen menschlichen Bedienern lernen – von den Leuten, die diese Prozesse in- und auswendig kennen. Als Physical AI Data Operations Expert arbeitest du Seite an Seite mit unseren Data Operators, unseren Robotern und unseren Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass das NEURA Gym, unsere Datenproduktionsfabrik, reibungslos läuft. Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Du bist die erste Anlaufstelle für die Data Operators und Praktikant:innen, die während deiner Schicht unsere Roboter teleoperieren. Du trainierst, unterstützt und motivierst das Data-Operator-Team, damit hochwertigste Daten entstehen. Du befähigst unsere Kunden: Du übersetzt komplexe technische Konzepte in leicht verständliche Schulungen. Du erstellst Onboarding-Material, organisierst Workshops für Kund:innen und befähigst deren Teams, eigenständig zu arbeiten. Du bist erste Ansprechperson bei technischen Fragen. Du passt den Robotik-Software-Stack an und debuggst ihn, um den Gym-Betrieb sicherzustellen und kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Du verstehst die Grundlagen der Robotik wie Antriebssteuerung, Feldbuskommunikation und Kinematik. Du kennst dich mit unixoiden Echtzeitbetriebssystemen aus, inklusive Low-Latency-Networking (UDP, DDS), Programmierung (Python/C++) und den zugehörigen Best Practices (Versionskontrolle, CI/CD). Containerisierte Softwareverteilung und Deployment-Workflows sind dir vertraut. Du bist die Brücke zwischen dem Gym-Team und den Abteilungen Research & Development sowie Service bei NEURA. Du richtest die Teleoperations-Toolchain ein, kalibrierst sie und schulst sowohl interne Kolleg:innen als auch Kund:innen in ihrer Nutzung. Du konfigurierst alle notwendigen IT-Komponenten (z. B. Sensoren wie Kameras und Tiefensensoren, Datenaufzeichnungsstationen, Netzwerk-Setup) in den Gyms von NEURA und der Kund:innen und stellst sicher, dass sie die Anforderungen für einen langfristig zuverlässigen Betrieb erfüllen. Du verstehst den End-to-End-Datenfluss im Gym – von der initialen Erfassung über verschiedene Sensoren, über Zwischenspeicherung, Synchronisation und Annotation bis zum Upload in unsere Cloud-Infrastruktur. Du stellst die erforderliche Datenintegrität und Übertragungslatenz sicher. Worauf wir uns freuen Abschluss in Ingenieurwesen, Mechatronik, Robotik, Informatik, Wirtschaft oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten und eine strukturierte Herangehensweise an Problemlösungen. Praktische Erfahrung mit Multi-Sensor-Setups, inklusive Kalibrierung und Synchronisation. Hands-on-Mentalität: Du arbeitest gerne mit Hardware und scheust dich nicht, auch mal zu Schraubenzieher und Lötkolben zu greifen. Solides Verständnis von Datenerfassung und Data Engineering, insbesondere im Kontext von Imitation Learning, Robot Learning oder Computer Vision. Programmiererfahrung mit C++ und Python sowie Erfahrung mit Embedded Computing, Echtzeitbetriebssystemen und Netzwerk-Stacks (EtherCAT-Kenntnisse von Vorteil). Erfahrung mit Robotik, KI, Automatisierung oder anderen Zukunftstechnologien. Fließendes Englisch; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großes Plus.

items.desc: We’re partnering with an early-stage European defence-tech company building autonomous robotic systems designed to operate in real-world environments. The team is developing next-generation autonomy technology, with a current focus on aerial robotics and counter-drone systems. Their work brings together robotics, AI, perception, embedded software and physical hardware to create autonomous systems that can perform reliably beyond controlled laboratory conditions. This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical engineering team where you’ll have meaningful ownership of the robotics software, contribute to architectural decisions and see your work move from simulation to real-world testing. What You'll Own Robotics & autonomy software: Design, develop and maintain software that enables autonomous robotic systems to perceive, navigate and operate in complex environments. Software architecture: Build scalable and reliable robotics software, working with C++, Python and ROS2 to develop and integrate components across the autonomy stack. Simulation & sim-to-real: Develop and improve simulation workflows using Gazebo and/or NVIDIA Isaac, helping bring algorithms and software from simulation onto physical platforms. System integration: Work closely with perception, controls, embedded and hardware engineers to ensure different parts of the system operate together reliably. Real-world testing: Participate in integration, debugging, validation and testing on physical robotic systems, using real-world results to improve software performance. Technical ownership: Take responsibility for your work from initial design through implementation, testing and deployment, contributing to technical decisions as the product evolves. Who We Are Looking For Strong software engineering experience in robotics, autonomous systems or a closely related field. Hands-on experience developing software in C++ and Python. Practical experience with ROS2, including developing and integrating robotics software components. Experience working with Gazebo and/or NVIDIA Isaac for robotics simulation. Good understanding of robotics software architecture and how different components interact within an autonomous system. Experience working with physical robotic platforms and solving integration challenges beyond simulation. Ability to take ownership of complex engineering problems and deliver practical, reliable solutions. Comfortable working in English within a collaborative, multidisciplinary engineering team. Nice To Have Experience with UAVs, drones or other autonomous vehicles. Familiarity with PX4 or other autopilot frameworks. Experience with navigation, SLAM, sensor fusion or motion planning. Exposure to guidance and control algorithms. Experience with hardware-in-the-loop testing, field testing or embedded systems. Previous experience in defence, aerospace or other safety-critical engineering environments. What Kind Of Engineer Will Thrive Here Ownership-driven — you enjoy taking responsibility for complete features and systems, not just isolated development tasks. Hands-on and pragmatic — you’re equally comfortable writing software, investigating integration issues and testing on physical hardware. Comfortable with ambiguity — you can make progress when requirements are evolving and not every process has been established. Systems-minded — you understand that reliable autonomy depends on how software, sensors, algorithms and hardware work together. Curious and adaptable — you enjoy learning new technologies, exploring unfamiliar problems and working across engineering disciplines. Collaborative — you communicate clearly, share knowledge and enjoy solving challenging problems alongside a small technical team. Why join now You’ll be joining at an early stage, when important engineering decisions are still being made and individual contributions can have a direct impact on the product. Unlike roles focused exclusively on research or simulation, this opportunity offers the chance to work across the full development cycle — from software architecture and algorithm integration to testing autonomous systems in the physical world. You’ll work closely with experienced engineers across robotics, AI, perception and embedded systems, helping build European autonomous defence technology with real operational applications. If you’re a robotics engineer who enjoys building complete systems, taking technical ownership and seeing your software operate on real hardware, we’d love to hear from you

items.desc: Fingrid vastaa Suomen kantaverkosta ja sähköjärjestelmän toimivuudesta. Sähköjärjestelmän murros, kasvavat asiakas- ja investointivolyymit sekä toimintaympäristön monimutkaistuminen edellyttävät meiltä uusia tapoja hyödyntää dataa, automaatiota ja tekoälyä turvallisesti. Etsimme nyt tiimiimme Helsinkiin uuteen vakituiseen tehtävään AI-ARKKITEHTIA Miltä kuulostaisi tehtävä, jossa pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten tekoälyä hyödynnetään Suomen sähköjärjestelmän kehittämisessä? Etsimme nyt tiimimme uutta asiantuntijaa rakentamaan Fingridin tekoälyratkaisujen yhteistä teknologia- ja arkkitehtuuriperustaa. Keskeinen tehtäväsi on olla mahdollistamassa tekoälyn turvallinen, hallittu ja skaalautuva hyödyntäminen koko Fingridissä. AI-arkkitehtina vastaat Fingridin tekoälyratkaisujen yhteisen tavoitearkkitehtuurin ja teknisten ratkaisuperiaatteiden kehittämisestä. Toimit teknologia-alueidemme ja ratkaisutiimiemme tukena varmistaen, että tekoälyratkaisut otetaan käyttöön turvallisesti, hallitusti ja skaalautuvasti koko organisaatiossa. Rakennat tekoälyratkaisujen arkkitehtuuri- ja teknologiaperustaa tiiviissä yhteistyössä data-, ohjelmistokehitys-, integraatio-, alusta- ja tietoturvatiimien kanssa sekä varmistat, että ratkaisut soveltuvat osaksi Fingridin kokonaisarkkitehtuuria. Tehtävässäsi yhdistyvät teknologia-arkkitehtuuri, tekoälyratkaisujen mahdollistaminen sekä eri teknologia-alueiden tukeminen tekoälyn hyödyntämisessä. Autat liiketoiminnan kehitystiimejä valitsemaan tarkoituksenmukaiset ratkaisut ja tuet niiden etenemistä kokeiluista turvalliseen, ylläpidettävään ja skaalautuvaan tuotantokäyttöön. Edistät ratkaisujen yhteentoimivuutta, turvallisuutta ja ylläpidettävyyttä, jotta tekoälyn hyödyntämistä voidaan laajentaa hallitusti ja saavuttaa mitattavaa liiketoimintahyötyä. Tehtävässäsi määrittelet ja ylläpidät tekoälyratkaisujen tavoitearkkitehtuuria, yhteisiä ratkaisumalleja ja teknisiä hyväksyntäkriteerejä sekä ohjaat tekoälyratkaisujen arkkitehtuurisuunnittelua tuet kehitystiimejä tekoälyratkaisujen suunnittelussa ja tuotantoon viennissä arvioit käyttötapausten teknistä toteutettavuutta, riskejä, riippuvuuksia ja tuotantovalmiutta sekä määrittelet tarkoituksenmukaisia toteutusmalleja yhdessä liiketoiminnan ja asiantuntijoiden kanssa arvioit tekoälyyn liittyviä teknologia- ja toimittajavaihtoehtoja edistät ratkaisujen uudelleenkäyttöä ja yhteentoimivuutta eri teknologia-alueiden välillä sovitat yhteen pilvi-, hybridi- ja on-premise-ratkaisuja yhteensovitat tietoturva-, tietosuoja-, jatkuvuus- ja ylläpitovaatimuksia yhdessä vastuullisten asiantuntijoiden kanssa tuot arkkitehtuurikysymykset ja ratkaisusuositukset yhteiseen arkkitehtuuriohjaukseen sekä osallistut teknologialinjausten kehittämiseen. Mitä odotamme sinulta? Sinulla on käytännön kokemusta teknologia-, ratkaisu- tai kokonaisarkkitehtuurista sekä tekoälyratkaisujen suunnittelusta ja toteutuksesta. Ymmärrät ohjelmistokehityksen ja tuotantoympäristöjen vaatimuksia sekä osaat yhdistää tekniset yksityiskohdat laajempaan arkkitehtuurikokonaisuuteen ja pitkän aikavälin suunnitteluun. Työskentelet oma-aloitteisesti, tunnistat tarpeita ja riskejä sekä viet ratkaisuja eteenpäin yli tiimirajojen. Osaat havainnollistaa monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, perustella teknologiavalintoja ja rakentaa yhteistä näkemystä liiketoiminnan, kehitystiimien ja muiden asiantuntijoiden kanssa. Arvostamme erityisesti ymmärrystä ja kokemusta generatiivisen tekoälyn, kielimallien ja agenttipohjaisten ratkaisujen tuotantoon viennistä ja ylläpidettävyyden suunnittelusta tekoälypalveluiden ja ohjelmointirajapintojen käytöstä osana digitaalisia ratkaisuja teknologioiden elinkaaren hallinnasta, laadun arvioinnista ja tuotantokäytön seurannasta, esimerkiksi MLOps- tai LLMOps-käytännöistä pilvi-, hybridi- ja on-premise-ympäristöissä toteutettavista ratkaisuista ohjelmistokehityksestä, integraatioista tai data-alustoista arkkitehtuurin mallintamisesta sekä ratkaisupäätösten dokumentoinnista tekoälyratkaisujen tietoturvasta, tietosuojasta ja vaatimustenmukaisuudesta. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden olla mukana rakentamassa Fingridin yhteistä tekoälykyvykkyyttä vaiheessa, jossa toimintamallit, osaaminen ja käytännön sovellukset kehittyvät nopeasti. Pääset vaikuttamaan siihen, miten tekoäly muuttaa asiantuntijatyötä ja miten sen hyödyt saadaan käyttöön turvallisesti ja hallitusti suomalaisen sähköjärjestelmän kannalta merkityksellisessä organisaatiossa. Saat ympärillesi monialaisen asiantuntijaverkoston ja mahdollisuuden työskennellä sekä käytännön käyttötapausten että Fingridin tekoälyratkaisujen yhteisen teknologia- ja arkkitehtuuriperustan kehittämisen parissa. Teemme töitä hybridimallilla, ja toivomme näkevämme sinua Helsingin toimistollamme noin 2–3 kertaa viikossa. Hakemukset pyydämme toimittamaan viimeistään 2.11.2026. items.desc: Overview Of The Role Are you an ambitious researcher looking for your next challenge? Do you have an established background in Neuroscience? Do you want to further your career in one of the UK’s leading research-intensive Universities? Learning does not just shape what we remember, it reshapes how we perceive, altering the earliest stages of sensory processing. We are recruiting a Postdoctoral Research Fellow for a BBSRC-funded project investigating how the olfactory bulb, the first processing stage of the olfactory system, adjusts how it encodes odours in response to behavioural context. You will use in vivo two-photon calcium imaging in mice, alongside behavioural assays and computational modelling, to track how learning-driven changes emerge in these early circuits and how this shapes perception. You will join a collaborative lab within a thriving neuroscience community at Leeds, home to over 44 research labs across multiple faculties, with access to cutting-edge imaging facilities. The University of Leeds and the Faculty of Biological Sciences are committed to providing equal opportunities for all and offer a range of family friendly policies. The University is a charter member of Athena SWAN (the national body that promotes gender equality in higher education), and the Faculty of Biological Sciences was awarded a Silver award in 2020. We are proud to be an inclusive Faculty that values all staff, and are happy to consider job share applications and requests for flexible working arrangements from our employees. Our Athena SWAN webpage provides more information. What We Offer In Return 26 days holiday plus approx.16 Bank Holidays/days that the University is closed by custom (including Christmas) – That’s 42 days a year! Generous pension scheme options plus life assurance Health and Wellbeing: Discounted staff membership options at The Edge, our state-of-the-art campus gym, with a pool, sauna, climbing wall, cycle circuit, and sports halls. Personal Development: Access to courses run by our Organisational Development & Professional Learning team. Access to on-site childcare, shopping discounts and travel schemes are also available. And much more! To explore the post further or for any queries you may have, please contact: Dr Jamie Johnston, Associate Professor of Neuroscience Email: j.johnston@leeds.ac.uk
