items.desc: About the role: About our Vacancy We are seeking to appoint suitably experienced Teaching Assistants to work in our Early Years and Primary phases. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Experience of working with children with special needs, including those with autism, is essential. The successful candidates will join a friendly, supportive team with opportunities for further training. There is potential for this role to become permanent. We offer a comprehensive and bespoke CPD programme. throughout the year and have a good record of upskilling staff at all levels. As all children have an EHCP and are working significantly below age-related expectations, the role is more likely to suit those who are trained/experienced within Early Years , Primary or Special settings. We operate an EYFS/Primary model of teaching up to and including Year 13 with some specialist teaching in Y10-13. We are particularly keen to hear from you if you have experience of delivering tailored and personalised learning programmes for children with SEND About Us About the Trust London South East Academies Trust is a growing and ambitious Multi-Academy Trust, currently comprising mainstream, special and alternative provision academies, alongside an outreach service and a music hub. Our schools are located across Bromley, Bexley, Sussex, Lambeth and Surrey, serving a wide range of communities and educational contexts. Across the Trust, our schools share a strong commitment to raising attainment, encouraging aspiration and supporting social mobility for every pupil, throughout their educational journey and beyond. We take a holistic but personalised approach to education, recognising that children thrive when their individual strengths, needs and circumstances are properly understood and supported. This enables pupils to flourish and achieve their full potential, whatever their starting point. We believe that great schools are built by great people. As a Trust, we invest in our staff through strong professional development and leadership opportunities, clear expectations and supportive structures. We actively encourage collaboration and the sharing of best practice across schools, supported by high-quality, cost-effective central services that allow leaders and teachers to focus on what matters most: improving outcomes for pupils. London South East Academies Trust sits within the Elevare Civic Education Group, which also includes a multi-campus further and higher education college, London South East Colleges and a charitable foundation, Elevare Education Foundation. This unique structure provides meaningful progression pathways for pupils and families, as well as broad development and career opportunities for staff across the wider Group. Our teams are united by a shared belief in the power of education to change lives. By continuing to grow our Trust and welcoming new expertise and perspectives, we aim to strengthen our schools further and extend the positive impact we have on our communities. Equal Opportunities London South East Academies Trust is fully committed to being an Equal Opportunities Employer and to creating a diverse, inclusive and respectful working environment, free from discrimination and harassment. We welcome and encourage applications from all, regardless of race, nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, parental status or marital or partnership status. As a Disability Confident Committed employer, we will offer an interview to applicants who declare a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role. If you have accessibility needs or require any reasonable adjustments to support you through the application or interview process, please let us know. Please note that if a suitable applicant is identified, we may close the advert before the published closing date. If you have any specific queries about the role, please contact us at lseathr@lsec.ac.uk. As the Trust supports children and vulnerable adults, all roles are exempt from Section 4(2) of the Rehabilitation of Offenders Act 1974. Appointments are subject to an enhanced DBS check and, where relevant, a Children’s and/or Adult’s Barred List check. Any offer of employment may be withdrawn if these checks are unsatisfactory. Self-disclosure is required as part of the recruitment process, and failure to make a full disclosure or to provide sight of a DBS certificate is likely to result in withdrawal of an offer. The Trust’s DBS policy on the recruitment of ex-offenders is available on request. All appointments are also subject to verification of the right to work in the UK, in line with Home Office requirements. Original documentation will be required prior to commencement of employment.

items.desc: About Nomad Digital Nomad Digital is the world's leading provider of passenger and fleet connectivity solutions to the railway industry. Founded in 2002, and headquartered in the UK, currently serving more than 80+ global customers - in more than 40 countries - Nomad designs, builds, deploys and manages passenger Wi-Fi and on-board passenger infotainment systems. Nomad also provides remote online condition-based monitoring and maintenance solutions for optimising fleet management, operational performance and improving fuel economy. When you join Nomad Digital, you will join a forward thinking, fast-growing, fun environment with access to some of the very latest technology in its field. You will work with experts who innovate collaboratively, creating an environment of team work and trustworthiness. Overview: Working within an agile R&D product team (developers, QA, DevOps), you will be the team’s expert in CI/CD automation, currently built on GitLab. You will take the automation code produced by the wider R&D team (today mainly Puppet modules and Ansible playbooks, and in future whatever tools best fit the job) and turn it into reliable, automated deployment pipelines, so that every planned and patch release is rolled out safely, repeatably and at scale rather than by hand. Because much of the estate is remote, resource-constrained and intermittently connected, every change must be automated, tested, controlled and reversible. You will also help the team adopt AI-assisted engineering tools in a safe, secure and auditable way. The role requires an individual with 3+ years of relevant experience and a strong sense of ownership for production quality. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Deployment automation Use and configure the team’s configuration-management and automation code (currently Puppet and Ansible) to deploy, update and maintain systems across the whole hybrid estate. Turn manual or operator-run deployment and update procedures into automated, pipeline-driven workflows. Plan and carry out controlled rollouts of both planned and patch releases, using staged and rolling deployments, pre- and post-deployment health checks, automatic stop on failure, manual approval gates where needed and tested rollback to a known-working version. Ensure deployments are safe for remote, resource-constrained and intermittently connected systems. Coordinate releases across the estate so related changes ship together under one versioned release, with the deployed state recorded and reported. Work closely with the developers who build the automation code: test new versions, report defects with clear evidence, and feed back deployment requirements and improvements. Evaluate and adopt new automation, deployment and infrastructure-as-code tools as the needs of the estate and the business evolve. CI/CD pipelines and release engineering Act as the team’s subject-matter expert for CI/CD (currently GitLab CI/CD): design, build and maintain pipelines, reusable templates, runners and pipeline images. Choose the right deployment model for each part of the estate (push, pull or GitOps), with CI/CD testing and promoting releases, and orchestration tools carrying them out where appropriate. Build automated quality gates into deployment pipelines, e.g. linting, dry runs and configuration diffs, and acceptance testing on reference or virtual systems. Make greater use of virtual machines inside CI/CD pipelines (e.g. KVM / QEMU / libvirt, cloud-init, Packer) to create disposable test environments, run automated tasks and tests against them, and tear them down automatically. Automate release workflows end to end: versioning and tagging, release notes generated from the issue tracker, documentation publishing and promotion of changes between environments. Keep pipelines secure: protected and masked secrets and variables, protected branches and tags, least-privilege runner and token access, and secret and dependency scanning. Measure and improve pipeline speed, reliability and the developer experience for the wider team. AI-assisted engineering Use AI coding assistants productively to write, review, test and document pipelines, deployment configuration and scripts. Share good practice with the team and help evaluate new AI tooling against our security and compliance requirements. items.card: You Will Make An Impact Monitor and interpret AI research, publications, benchmarks and model documentation. Identify developments that merit practical testing. Translate research insight into concrete validation questions and fair experimental designs, with explicit baselines, success criteria and the conditions that would invalidate the hypothesis, together with the AI Experimentation Engineer and AI Opportunity
items.desc: The opportunity Bring research discipline to practical technology validation, so that Hitachi Energy can distinguish credible AI advances from hype before it invests. As AI Research Engineer in the Technology Validation team, part of Hitachi Energy's Data, Analytics & Artificial Intelligence (DAAI) organization, you interpret emerging AI research, methods, models and evaluation approaches, turn the most relevant developments into practical validation questions and answer them through prototypes, benchmarks and comparisons. Your evidence informs architecture, platform and delivery teams. The team builds to learn and demonstrate, not to operate production systems. How You Will Make An Impact Monitor and interpret AI research, publications, benchmarks and model documentation. Identify developments that merit practical testing. Translate research insight into concrete validation questions and fair experimental designs, with explicit baselines, success criteria and the conditions that would invalidate the hypothesis, together with the AI Experimentation Engineer and AI Opportunity Lead. Run research-led prototypes, benchmarks and comparisons across LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, fine-tuning and responsible-AI evaluation. Interpret results with methodological rigor and state the limitations clearly. Recommend a proportionate next step: stop, keep watching, test further or hand over to the team that should build it. Exchange methods and learnings with Hitachi Group colleagues, DAAI peers, vendors and external research communities. Preserve reusable methods, benchmarks and test assets so that work is not repeated. Your background A genuine passion for AI: you try new tools and models on your own initiative and can show a recent example of something you built or tried. 3+ years of experience in applied AI research, AI engineering or ML research, in a company, consultancy or research institution. Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with hands-on AI/ML experimentation, benchmarking and evaluation. You know LLMs, generative AI, fine-tuning, RAG, agentic AI and responsible-AI evaluation. Familiarity with cloud AI platforms (Azure preferred, GCP or AWS) is an advantage. Ability to read research and technical claims critically and translate them into practical, enterprise-relevant experiments. Clear communication of research-level topics and their limitations. You have experience collaborating across research, engineering and business communities. Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience and fluent English. An MSc or PhD in AI, machine learning or computer science is an advantage when combined with practical work. The final offer will be based on candidate location, skills and qualifications, experience, and aligned with internal pay structures. This role may be open in multiple locations. If the salary information listed is not applicable for your current home location, salary details relevant to your location will be discussed with you at a later stage. items.desc: AI macht uns schneller. Das Denken nimmt sie uns nicht ab. Was AI produziert, überprüfen wir. Für alles, was rausgeht, stehen wir gerade. Beim Ausprobieren sind wir schnell, beim Ausliefern gründlich. Du liest ein Paper und willst wissen, ob die Idee hält. Also klonst du das Repo. Läuft es nicht, folgst du dem Stacktrace in den Quellcode. Und widersprechen die Daten deiner Hypothese, stutzt du kurz und freust dich: Jetzt wird es interessant. Ein schönes Ergebnis macht dich dagegen erst mal misstrauisch. Zufall? Bug? Oder hält es? Bei smartclip arbeitest du mit Messdaten von Dutzenden Millionen Geräten, eigener GPU-Infrastruktur und Sidekicks, unserer AI-Initiative für Wissensfragen und echte Workflows. Du verantwortest deine Fragestellung vom ersten Experiment bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Den baut Engineering mit dir zum Produkt aus. Unser Stack basiert auf Linux, Open Source und freier Software. Du kannst nachvollziehen, was unter der Haube passiert. Deine Mission Eine Stelle, zwei Schwerpunkte. Ob du einen vertiefst oder beide, entscheiden dein Können und deine Vorlieben. AI gehört immer dazu. 1. Knowledge Agents & Agentic Retrieval Wie beantwortet ein Agent eine Frage, deren Antwort über Tausende Dokumente verteilt ist? Wie erkennt er Widersprüche zwischen Entwürfen und finalen Fassungen? Und wie belegt er seine Antworten zuverlässig? Entwickle Agenten, die Informationen über große Dokumentbestände hinweg erschließen. Untersuche, wie sich Vollständigkeit, Widersprüche und die Qualität von Quellen bewerten lassen. Sorge dafür, dass Antworten nachvollziehbar bleiben und Unsicherheiten sichtbar werden. 2. Machine Learning at Scale Wir messen das Werbegeschehen bei mehr als 150 TV-Sendern in Europa. Unser Ziel: lineares Fernsehen so planbar und messbar machen wie digitale Werbung. Entwickle Prognosemodelle für die Leistung von Werbeblöcken. Bewerte Unsicherheiten, Messfehler und die Aussagekraft deiner Modelle. Verarbeite große Datenmengen mit Spark auf unserem Cluster und untersuche, wo Datenqualität oder Verarbeitung die Ergebnisse beeinflussen. In beiden Bereichen machst du aus einer guten Frage etwas, das läuft: Experimentiere und evaluiere: Formuliere Hypothesen, entwirf aussagekräftige Tests und lerne aus Ergebnissen, auch wenn diese nicht deine Erwartungen erfüllen. Übernimm Verantwortung: Entwickle deinen Ansatz eigenständig bis zum belastbaren Prototyp. Hol dir einen zweiten Blick oder denk mit deinem Team am Whiteboard weiter. Arbeite mit Engineering: Begleite die Überführung deines Prototyps in ein Produkt und bringe dein Wissen über Problem und Lösung ein. Unterstütze andere Teams: Bewerte Datenfragen, zeige sinnvolle Einsatzmöglichkeiten von AI auf und liefere je nach Bedarf eine fundierte Empfehlung oder einen Prototyp. Deine Skills Fundierte technische Grundlagen: Bring Kenntnisse in Informatik, Softwareentwicklung oder Data Science mit – erworben durch Studium, Promotion oder praktische Erfahrung. Du kannst deine Methodenwahl begründen und Ergebnisse kritisch bewerten. Verständnis für AI: Du musst keine Modelle in PyTorch trainieren. Erkläre aber beispielsweise den Unterschied zwischen Prefill und Decode und dessen Auswirkungen auf Latenz und Kosten. Eigenständiges AI-native Development: Nutze Coding-Agenten, um schneller zu entwickeln. Validiere den generierten Code, teste die Ergebnisse und verstehe, wie deine Anwendung und ihre Komponenten funktionieren. Strukturiertes Experimentieren: Formuliere klare Specs, definiere eine Definition of Done und prüfe mit passenden Tests und Evaluationen, ob deine Umsetzung das richtige Problem löst. Offene Zusammenarbeit: Teile Wissen, diskutiere technische Entscheidungen und gib respektvolles, direktes Feedback. Ein Plus, kein Muss: Erfahrung mit NLP/Computerlinguistik, Agentic Retrieval oder der Entwicklung von LLM-Agenten. Unser Stack Knowledge Agents: Python (Pydantic AI), TypeScript, vLLM/SGLang Daten und Pipelines: Spark, Trino, StarRocks, Postgres und Prefect Infrastruktur und Observability: OpenTelemetry, Docker/Kubernetes Kennst du eher Ray, LangChain, Airflow, passt das genauso: Die Konzepte zählen, nicht die Logos. Was dich bei uns erwartet Remote Work mit gezielten Treffen: Wir arbeiten überwiegend remote und kommen gelegentlich für Workshops, Team-Sessions und den gemeinsamen Austausch in unserem Tech-Office in Berlin zusammen. Außerdem veranstalten wir über das Jahr verteilt Team-Events, darunter unser jährliches Company Offsite, das jedes Jahr an einer anderen Location in Deutschland stattfindet. Die Bereitschaft, für diese Treffen anzureisen und daran teilzunehmen, gehört zur Rolle. Eigenverantwortung statt Mikromanagement: Übernimm Verantwortung für deine Themen und bringe sie selbstständig voran. Build > Talk: Früh ausprobieren, früh danebenliegen, früh dazulernen. Hohe Ansprüche, wenig Ego: Wir geben direktes Feedback und arbeiten offen und respektvoll zusammen. Weiterentwicklung: Nutze Hackathons, Konferenzen und …

The research may, for example, address information influence, political and strategic communication, media and narratives. A central part of the position is to develop and evaluate scientifically rigorous ways of using large language models (LLMs) and other AI-based methods in social science research. The researcher will work in a team that conducts commissioned research on information influence and disinformation. Duties The researcher is expected to plan and conduct both independent and collaborative research and to contribute to scientific publications and conference presentations. The researcher will work in a research team conducting commissioned research on information influence and disinformation. A central part of the position is also to strengthen the research group’s competence in AI-assisted research, computational social science and quantitative methods. The researcher is therefore expected to actively train and supervise other researchers in the group and to contribute to building long-term methodological capacity. Duties Include, Among Other Things plan and conduct independent and collaborative research using AI-based, computational and quantitative methods; develop and evaluate methods involving LLMs, quantitative text analysis, machine learning and NLP; explore the use of local and open-source language models with research data, with particular attention to validation and reproducibility; strengthen the research group’s methodological competence through workshops, individual guidance, and support in programming and analysis; contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations and research funding applications. Qualifications Applicants must hold a doctoral degree, or an equivalent international degree. The Following Qualifications Are Also Required experience of quantitative and/or computational social science methods, including computational text and/or image analysis and processing of social media/platform data, as well as the ability to use Python and/or R for analysis and research experience of machine learning, NLP or quantitative text analysis, with particular emphasis on LLM-based methods a good understanding of research design, validation and reproducible research; excellent ability to communicate in English. Experience of local or open-source language models, RAG, fine-tuning, multilingual NLP or advanced quantitative methods is considered an advantage. Experience of research in political science, political psychology, media studies, computational social science, or another relevant social science field is considered an advantage. Great importance will be attached to the ability to communicate advanced methodological issues clearly and pedagogically, and to collaborate effectively with researchers with varying methodological backgrounds. Experience of supervision, training or methodological support is considered an advantage Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language is considered an advantage. Great importance will be attached to personal suitability. We are looking for a researcher who is independent, proactive and communicative and who has a strong ability to collaborate with researchers from different methodological backgrounds. Application The Application Must Include a cover letter explaining why you are qualified for the position; a CV including a list of scientific publications or a project portfolio copies of official academic degree certificates. Applications must be submitted via the Swedish Defence University’s recruitment system by clicking on the ‘Apply’ link on the job advertisement page. The recruitment system contains a number of screening questions to be answered. Here you should enter your experience and qualifications and upload any supporting documents you wish to submit in support of your application. The complete application must be received by the Swedish Defence University no later than midnight on the closing date, CET/CEST (Central European Time/Central European Summer Time). Terms om Employment The position is a full-time fixed-term appointment for 12 months. Location: Stockholm. Employment at the Swedish Defence University may be subject to security screening in accordance with the Swedish Protective Security Act (2018:585). Starting date January 1, 2027, or by agreement. The Swedish Defence University applies individual salary setting You are welcome to submit your application until October 18th!

items.desc: About Edra Edra is solving one of the hardest problems in enterprise AI: AI models are generic but company processes are specific. We build AI agents that learn how processes actually run, and then run their operations. We're a Series A startup, backed by Sequoia and other leading VC firms, led by Co-Founders who created and led Forward Deployed AI Engineering at Palantir, and we're growing our team in New York and London. We're a deeply technical team of engineers, AI researchers, and strategists with a high bar for talent and a shared belief that exceptional people are the foundation of everything great we'll build. The Role We're building a learning system that teaches AI agents how enterprises actually work. Our system ingests knowledge bases, conversations, tickets, and system logs, then produces written instructions that agents can execute–with confidence scoring to know when to automate and when to seek human input. We're looking for AI Engineers who have built complex, production LLM-based systems. Whether you've scaled LLM workflows handling millions of requests, built multi-agent systems in production, or designed evaluation frameworks for enterprise deployments, we want people who bring intensity and self-direction to their craft. You’ll spend most of your time advancing our core learning library and building the harness that powers our platform’s agents across all customers. The work spans continuous learning systems, agentic features, human-in-the-loop feedback loops, and agent orchestration. What You'll Do Build and extend our core context-learning library, turning customer-informed problems into reusable platform capabilities. Design and implement LLM-powered systems and agentic workflows from concept to production Build agentic features for knowledge management–think agents that can edit, update, and maintain large knowledge bases autonomously Build reliability and confidence systems–evaluation frameworks, confidence scoring, and logic for when to automate vs. when to escalate to a human Architect async, scalable systems that handle complex AI orchestration Contribute to the direction of our AI strategy and product capabilities What We’re Looking For You've built complex, production LLM-based systems with real depth–something with multiple layers of engineering decisions you can walk through in detail You've shipped something meaningful to production and can explain how it evolved You're excited by open-ended problems where the solution might not exist yet You have experience with (or strong interest in) how systems learn and improve over time: human-in-the-loop feedback, prompt optimization and context engineering You have experience building agents and autonomous systems You can navigate between research papers and production code with equal comfort You're a strong communicator who can clearly explain your work to teammates and customers You have 3+ years of professional experience Don’t meet all of the above traits? We’d still love to hear from you. We’re looking for exceptional people with unique skills and interests, and we know that great people have different backgrounds and skillsets. Learn More About Edra Watch our Series A announcement video Read our blog post from our launch Learn more about what we're building Our founders point of view on the market Compensation & Benefits Edra offers generous compensation and benefits in both New York & London: Competitive base salary & meaningful equity Top tier health, dental, & vision plans: Top plans with 100% premium coverage in the US (and a One Medical membership) Private medical & dental coverage in the UK Flexible paid time off Lunch provided in office most days, snacks & drinks too A stipend to set up your workspace A Few Details We work together in person five days a week from our offices in the West Village (New York) and Holborn (London). Edra is an equal opportunity employer and we encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Edra does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

items.desc: About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. For this role, fluency in both spoken and written Dutch is a mandatory requirement, as is residency in the Netherlands. Ben jij de data-expert die het fantastisch vindt om in de data te duiken én om aan tafel te zitten met de leukste A-merken? Krijg jij energie van modelleren en het vertalen van complexe data-inzichten naar strategische, glasheldere adviezen die onze klanten helpen te groeien? Als jij klaar bent om impact te maken door de brug te slaan tussen data en business, dan is dit de rol voor jou. Wat ga je doen als Data Scientist? Als Data Scientist bij WPP Media ben jij de motor achter onze data-gedreven marketing. Je brengt media- en klantdata (zoals CRM en gedragsdata) samen om antwoord te geven op de meest uitdagende klantvragen. Je bent niet alleen aan het programmeren en modelleren; je bent een adviseur die complexe inzichten vertaalt naar concrete aanbevelingen voor onze klanten . Jouw Belangrijkste Verantwoordelijkheden Inzichten & Advies: Je bent een volwaardig adviseur voor onze klanten. Je vertaalt hun businessvragen naar data-oplossingen en presenteert complexe analyses en resultaten op een overtuigende en begrijpelijke manier. Modelleren & Programmeren: De klantadviezen baseer je op geavanceerde Data Science modellen, die je ontwikkelt, implementeert en onderhoudt. Denk aan (conversie) attributiemodellen zoals Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM), voorspelmodellen en (klant)clusteringsalgoritmes. Data Engineering: Je werkt met diverse databronnen en bent bedreven in het ontsluiten en combineren van data met SQL en NO-SQL (bijv. in Snowflake). Samenwerken & Innoveren: Je werkt in een multidisciplinair team met data strategen, analytics experts en engineers, én met mediaspecialisten en creatieven om tot de beste, geïntegreerde oplossingen te komen. Jouw profiel Je hebt WO werk- en denkniveau, met een afgeronde opleiding in een kwantitatieve richting zoals Data Science, Econometrie, Wiskunde, Statistiek of Computerwetenschappen. Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare rol, waarin je hands-on met data hebt gewerkt. Je bent gesprekspartner voor de klant, hebt bewezen ervaring in het adviseren van stakeholders en kunt complexe materie helder en overtuigend presenteren. Je bent een expert in Python (of andere programmeertaal) en hebt ervaring met SQL en/of NO-SQL databases. Je hebt diepgaande kennis van statistiek en kunt zelfstandig statistische en machine learning modellen implementeren en onderhouden. Je hebt een sterke affiniteit met marketing. Ervaring met Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) of andere attributiemodellen is een grote pre. Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend. Wat bieden wij? Flexibiliteit: Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU). Groeikansen: Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie en het werken met een portfolio van A-merken. Toegang tot M Academy: Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen. Reiskostenvergoeding: Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed. Vakantiedagen: 8% vakantiegeld en 26 vakantiedagen per jaar (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!). Hybrid Working allowance: €30 netto per maand bij fulltime. Epassi-vergoeding van €10 per maand die je kunt uitgeven aan persoonlijke behoeften. Bring Your Own Device (BYOD): Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van €57,50 netto. Lunchfaciliteiten: Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie. Zorgverzekering: Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering. Ben jij klaar voor de data-uitdaging? Bij WPP Media , onderdeel van het wereldwijde WPP mediacollectief en de grootste media-organisatie van Nederland, bouwen we aan de toekomst van media in het AI-tijdperk. We brengen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners samen om baanbrekende oplossingen te creëren die merken laten groeien. Onze kernwaarden? We zijn Extraordinary , Open en Optimistic – altijd op zoek naar nieuwe kansen en klaar om grenzen te verleggen. Zie jij jezelf al met de data aan de slag gaan voor baanbrekende marketingstrategieën voor de grootste merken van Nederland? Ben jij de Data Scientist die wij zoeken om ons team te versterken? Solliciteer dan direct! Stuur ons …

items.desc: About Board Of Innovation BOI partners with large, ambitious organizations to design and build applied AI products that create measurable business impact. We help enterprise and scale-up clients move beyond experimentation by embedding AI directly into their operations, decision-making, and products. Our work spans industries, but always centers on production-ready AI, strong engineering, and real-world adoption. About The Role We're looking for an AI Engineer to design and build the AI systems behind real, production-grade applications. This is applied engineering work: building agentic workflows, retrieval pipelines, and orchestration layers that integrate into business-critical environments and stand up to real-world use. You'll take AI capabilities from idea to deployment, owning the full path including evaluation, observability, and the operational concerns that determine whether a system survives contact with users. What You'll Do You'll design, implement, and ship AI systems that automate work, support decisions, and unlock new workflows for enterprise clients. Day-to-day, that means building multi-step agents and tool-using LLM systems, wiring them into structured and unstructured data sources, and packaging them into services that other engineers and applications can consume safely. You'll also own how we know our systems work. That includes evals, observability, and the feedback loops that let us iterate with confidence rather than guesswork. You'll work closely with engineers, strategists, and designers, and you'll be in client conversations from early scoping through delivery. What You Bring You have 3+ years of experience shipping AI-powered systems in production, and a background in computer science, math, physics, engineering, or another technical or scientific field. You're strong in Python and fluent in the patterns of modern LLM engineering: agents, MCP, skills, tool use, retrieval, structured outputs, and evals. You're also a real software engineer underneath. CI/CD, testing, version control hygiene, and code quality matter to you, because they're what let you keep moving fast without things falling over. You understand how to balance accuracy, latency, cost, and maintainability, and you've debugged enough production systems to have opinions about it. You're comfortable wrapping AI logic into services that other engineers can consume without surprises. How You Work You treat AI as an engineering discipline. You care about observability, maintainability, and the underlying engineering that makes the interesting parts possible. You're at home in a consulting environment, where each engagement brings a new domain and a new set of constraints. At BOI, you will work a lot with strategists, designers, and consultants, and most of your clients aren't technical. You're comfortable translating between business problems and technical solutions, and you can hold your own in a client room without a project manager running interference for you. The field moves quickly, and so do we. New models, new tools, and new patterns show up constantly. You enjoy that pace, actively pull in what's useful, and bring it back to the team. You push back when something doesn't make sense, and you care about building systems that get used long after the kickoff energy fades. Contract & Setup We are open to both permanent employment and long-term contractor arrangements. The final setup will depend on your location, work authorization status, and local compliance requirements. Interested? If this sounds like a fit, apply with your CV and a short note on a system you've built that you're proud of. Bonus points for something we can actually look at!

items.desc: Job Description About the role At Bluecrux, we turn AI ideas into solutions people can actually use. As an AI Engineer, you will build AI applications, agents and integrations for our internal teams and clients. We welcome both medior and senior candidates. Your responsibilities will match your experience. You Will Build and deploy LLM applications, AI agents and automations. Develop reliable Python services, APIs, connectors and tool-calling integrations. Translate business needs into practical technical solutions. Build reusable AI components and delivery accelerators. Design prompts, tests and evaluations to improve quality, security and reliability. Work with consultants, architects, product and delivery teams, and clients. At medior level, you will own defined solutions with support from experienced colleagues. At senior level, you will lead solutions end to end, make architecture decisions and guide colleagues and clients. This is a hands-on engineering role for people who want to build and deliver, not a research or data science position. Job Requirements About you We Would Like To Meet You If You have at least two years of relevant experience; senior candidates typically bring five or more. You have strong hands-on Python development experience. You have built and delivered applications using generative AI, LLMs or AI agents. You have experience with APIs, integrations and tool calling. You understand AI testing, security, privacy and maintainability. You have Experience with Microsoft 365, Power Platform, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry or Key Vault. You can translate business needs into technical solutions and explain your decisions clearly. You are fluent in English. You show a willingness to travel globally and to work in a hybrid working model. You have a valid driver’s license, or you will obtain this in the next 6 months. You hold a relevant master’s degree. You learn quickly, take initiative and connect with our values: dig deep, own it, come together, move fast and be kind! Experience in consulting, a software product company or a technology scale-up is a plus. Knowledge of supply chains, cloud platforms, LLMOps or the Model Context Protocol (MCP) is useful but not required. Why join us? Build real AI solutions, not just presentations or experiments. Help shape Bluecrux’s growing AI capability. Work on internal initiatives and high-impact solutions for global clients. Enjoy ownership, visibility and room to explore new technologies. Collaborate with experts across technology, product and consulting. Benefit from a flexible hybrid environment, growth opportunities, a competitive salary, bonus and electric company car. About Us At Bluecrux, we transform supply chains into smart, efficient value chains through a blend of expert consulting and cutting-edge technology. We collaborate closely with industry leaders like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bridgestone, AkzoNobel, Beiersdorf, Oatly, and many more - creating partnerships that drive meaningful impact. With a global presence in Europe, the US and APAC, we're committed to shaping the future of value chains, one success story at a time.

items.desc: SmallClaims is a legal tech company that recovers small, valid claims of up to €25,000 through the courts. Claims that businesses write off today because pursuing them costs more than they are worth. Our AI agents run the whole process, from legal assessment and settlement to filing, judgment and enforcement, while our in-house lawyers quality-assure the work and appear in court. That has cut manual case handling from over 15 hours to about 1.5 hours per case. We have handled 5,000+ cases, win 90%+ in court and serve 500+ Danish customers. Case intake has grown more than 370% since 2023, and we have just raised €2M from Vendep Capital to grow in Europe. Now we are growing the engineering team. THE ROLE You take ownership of your own areas within our AI service (Python/FastAPI, LLM pipelines) and our back-office platform, the tool our case managers and lawyers run the operation on. Ideas take form together with the team, product specialists and the CTO. You take them from there, end to end across the stack: shape, build, ship, verify, follow up. What You’ll Work On Own parts of and build features in our AI service: LLM orchestration with structured outputs, tool calling, and complex agentic workflows. Build the back-office platform our case managers and lawyers use every day, and talk to them to find out what they really need. Set up and improve evals and observability, so we know our agents are right before we scale them. Ship and run what you build, from staging to production on AWS, with tests and CI as a habit. What We Work With Stack: Laravel/PHP, Next.js, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Google. How we build: Coding agents are part of daily work here. We expect you to be ahead of the curve on building with AI, not catching up to it. Who You Are 3+ years building and operating software in production, from a startup, a bigger company, open source or other serious project. You think like a product owner. You want responsibility and ownership, and you take a complicated problem to a shipped feature. You are good with data: you understand complex data sets and data pipelines, and you can build with them, visualise them and explain them. You hold strong opinions lightly. You are direct in disagreement, but easy to work with after the decision. You communicate directly and are honest about mistakes. You can talk to real users and are comfortable with shifting priorities. You love building, love learning, and are curious about the domain itself: the legal process, not just the tech. Experience And Skills Must have Strong backend development, incl. background jobs, auth models and API design. Solid relational database experience (Postgres/SQL or similar): schema design, migrations, performance. Hands-on LLM building in production, not just demos: orchestration, structured outputs, tool calling, evals, tracing, prompt design, injection. Works daily with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, opencode or similar), knows their strengths and limits, and stays up to date. Testing as a habit: feature and end-to-end tests, CI, verifying your own work through staging to production. Cloud and deployment literacy (AWS or similar, Docker, CI/CD). You can operate what you ship. Nice to have Python/FastAPI, Laravel/PHP or Next.js specifically. Production migration: third-party service changes, database moves, major-version upgrades, data backfills. Operating AWS (EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch) and Linux servers hands-on. Eval or observability tooling for agentic workflows. Integrations where no documented API exists: webhooks, browser extensions, automation, scraping. Legaltech, fintech or another regulated domain. What We Offer Real ownership of core parts of the AI platform in a small team that ships every week. Close work with the CTO, product specialists and the lawyers who use what you build. Our base is the office in Copenhagen, but regular remote work is fine How To Apply Apply via The Hub with a short intro, your CV, GitHub and links to things you have built: apps, side projects, something you shipped at work. Next, we send you our skills checklist as a self-assessment plus a few short written questions, then interviews with the team, then an offer. We keep the process short and give you a clear answer at every step.

items.desc: We are DEUS EX MACHINA, a cutting-edge AI Systems company specializing in Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), and Analytics for the food, nutrition, and life sciences industries. We leverage Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), knowledge graphs, and first-principles simulation to accelerate how products are discovered, formulated, and manufactured, contributing breakthroughs in nutrition, healthcare, and petcare. At the core of our successful track record are our people, our commitment to clients, Fortune 100 organizations and startups, and our desire to make a positive impact through a creative, focused, and collaborative mindset. About the role Our products depend on more than a model or a backend service. They require data pipelines, APIs, knowledge systems, agentic workflows, cloud infrastructure, and production software to work as one system. The AI Systems Engineer is responsible for designing and building that system end to end. You will make decisions, write production code, integrate data and AI components, and work on the whole path from raw data to a reliable application. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can move across backend, data engineering, AI systems, and architecture without treating them as separate silos. What you will do Build agentic AI systems using LLMs, retrieval, tools, memory, orchestration, and human-in-the-loop patterns; make explicit decisions about when agents are appropriate and when deterministic software is better. Work on the implementation of production AI systems across backend services, data infrastructure, agentic workflows, and cloud components. Design and build reliable APIs, services, event-driven workflows, and distributed components that connect our applications, models, and data. Build and operate data pipelines for structured, unstructured, scientific, and external data, including ingestion, transformation, indexing, lineage, and quality controls. Design retrieval and knowledge architectures using relational databases, vector stores, search systems, knowledge graphs, and other data stores as appropriate. Turn prototypes into production systems: define interfaces, failure modes, observability, testing, security, performance, and deployment strategy. Make and document architectural decisions, including tradeoffs in cost, reliability, maintainability, scalability, and model performance. Work directly with data scientists, bioinformaticians, product managers, and other engineers while remaining responsible for the technical integrity of the complete system. What we are looking for Solid software engineering fundamentals and at least 2 years of hands-on experience building production systems in Python, or a comparable language. An appetite for simplicity and results-oriented approach to delivery. Actual experience working with backend systems, APIs, microservices, and data-intensive applications. You should be able to understand the architecture, not only implement tickets. Practical experience building with modern AI systems, including LLM APIs, RAG, embeddings, tool use, agentic workflows, evaluation, and production integration. Experience utilizing AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and refactoring workflows. Hands-on experience working with data engineering tasks: SQL, data modeling, ETL/ELT, pipeline orchestration, data quality, and working with large or heterogeneous datasets. Strong English and the ability to explain technical decisions clearly to engineering, product, and scientific teams. Strong pluses Experience with Python and frameworks such as FastAPI, Django, or Flask; PostgreSQL and one or more NoSQL, vector, graph, or search technologies. Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker and containerized deployments; Kubernetes or other orchestration platforms. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic search, ontology-driven systems, scientific data platforms, or bioinformatics applications. Experience evaluating and operating LLM/agent systems in production, including tracing, guardrails, model routing, prompt/version management, and cost/latency optimization. Solid understanding of system design: queues, caching, concurrency, storage choices, service boundaries, fault tolerance, observability, and cloud deployment. What success looks like You deliver on major systems from feature ideation through production operation, with few handoffs between backend, data, and AI teams. New AI capabilities reach production quickly without sacrificing reliability, testability, security, or maintainability. Data, models, agents, and application services behave as one coherent system rather than a collection of disconnected components. What it's like to work with us: DEUS EX MACHINA will provide you with the resources and advanced tools necessary to deliver best-in-class results for our clients, in a workplace that inspires collaboration and creativity. …

items.desc: Quem somos Quando pensas num restaurante cheio ou numa loja com fila à porta, talvez não penses no software e nas soluções de gestão que estão por trás de cada venda. Mas, na SDILAB, é exatamente aí que está o nosso foco. Parte do Grupo José Pimenta Marques, somos a software house que desenvolve o ETPOS, uma solução de faturação e ponto de venda em modelo SaaS (Software as a Service) que todos os dias ajuda negócios na restauração e no retalho a operar de forma mais eficiente. Com mais de 50.000 postos de venda ativos e presença em 30 países, fizemos da evolução constante a nossa forma de estar: atualizações frequentes, novos módulos e apps que transformam dados em decisões. À volta do ETPOS construímos um ecossistema digital completo. Desenvolvemos ferramentas de gestão remota que permitem acompanhar vários pontos de venda a partir de qualquer lugar, módulos de inteligência artificial que dão aos negócios monitorização em tempo real e maior previsibilidade de vendas. E agora precisamos que te juntes a nós neste caminho. Como parte do grupo da Balanças Marques, vais trabalhar com pessoas das nossas instalações em Braga e Lisboa (Portugal), Bilbao, Valencia e Vitória (Espanha), Orleães (França) e Ningbo (China). Junta-te a uma equipa que trabalha todos os dias para pôr a tecnologia ao serviço de cada negócio, para que possa crescer e desenvolver todo o seu potencial. We're ready to scale up your career. Are you? O que procuramos Não procuramos alguém que utilize AI apenas para escrever código mais depressa. Procuramos alguém que queira ajudar-nos a redefinir a forma como o software é desenvolvido. Estamos a construir e evoluir um AI-Native Software Engineering Framework, onde agentes especializados colaboram ao longo de todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento: Business Problem → Requirements → Architecture → Implementation → Testing → Validation → Delivery O objetivo é transformar este processo num workflow agentic, estruturado e progressivamente automatizado, mantendo intervenção humana onde esta realmente acrescenta valor. O que vais fazer Desenhar e experimentar agentic development workflows; Criar e orquestrar agentes especializados para diferentes fases do desenvolvimento; Definir mecanismos de comunicação, contexto, memória e delegação entre agentes; Implementar guardrails, quality gates e mecanismos de validação; Explorar modelos de human-in-the-loop e autonomous execution; Integrar agentes com ferramentas de desenvolvimento, APIs, repositórios e CI/CD; Avaliar e melhorar a qualidade, consistência e fiabilidade dos outputs. Quem tu és Formação superior (obrigatório) na área de Engenharia Informática ou similar (preferencialmente); Experiência mínima de 5 anos (obrigatório); Forte experiência em Software Engineering e interesse prático em AI/LLMs e Agentic Development; Valorizamos experiência com: Multi-agent systems e agent orchestration; AI coding agents e agentic workflows; Prompt e context engineering; MCP e tool integration; Automated testing, validation e evaluation frameworks; Guardrails e quality gates; CI/CD e autonomous/semi-autonomous development pipelines; Software architecture e requirements engineering; Large existing codebases. Experiência com Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, OpenRouter ou outras plataformas semelhantes é valorizada; Bons conhecimentos de inglês (falado e escrito); Forte sentido de responsabilidade; Espírito de equipa. O que podes esperar de nós: Uma carreira com espaço para crescimento pessoal e profissional Um bom ambiente com uma equipa que sabe tudo sobre tecnologia Uma empresa inclusiva e em franco crescimento Um salário de acordo com o teu nível de experiência Prémio pelo nascimento de filhos Descontos e outros benefícios do Grupo José Pimenta Marques Caso te identifiques connosco e consideres que correspondes ao perfil solicitado, envia a tua candidatura no formulário abaixo ou por email com a referência SDI-AINE-2026 no assunto para: recrutamento@grupojpm.pt

items.desc: Founding Engineer – AI Startup 📍 Moorgate, London | Primarily Office-Based Velocity Tech Partners has partnered with an exciting early-stage AI startup building an AI-powered Revenue Command Centre designed to transform how businesses find prospects, engage customers, close deals and grow revenue. Following a successful $3m pre-seed funding round , the business is looking for a Founding Engineer to work directly with the founding team, accelerate product development and help shape the technical foundations of the company. 🚀 The Opportunity This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you'll build across the full stack, from web applications and browser extensions to backend services, AI agents, integrations and infrastructure. You'll work closely with customers, take ownership of features from concept through to production, and have a genuine influence on product and technical decisions. 🛠️ Tech Stack Frontend: Next.js, TypeScript, React Cloud & Infrastructure: Supabase, Vercel AI: Agentic AI, LLM applications, sub-agent and supervisor architectures Testing & Evaluation: Automated testing, AI evaluations and production monitoring Tooling: Claude Code, Codex, PostHog, Sentry and Braintrust 🎯 What They're Looking For Experience building and shipping full-stack software products. A strong understanding of modern AI application development. Familiarity with agentic architectures, AI evaluation and production reliability. An entrepreneurial, product-focused mindset with the ability to work autonomously. Someone comfortable working directly with customers and solving complex technical problems. A willingness to experiment with new technologies and work across the stack. Experience with the specific tech stack is beneficial but not essential. Strong engineering fundamentals, adaptability and a passion for AI are what matter most. 💡 Why Join? Become an early engineering hire with genuine ownership and influence. Build AI-powered products from the ground up. Work directly with experienced founders in a fast-moving environment. Help shape the architecture, product and engineering culture as the business scales.

 The ARP Program is the cornerstone of Airbus's digital transformation, aiming to harmonise and optimise our industrial processes across all global sites.  Strong Product Development and Project Management experience. 
 Fluent in English, German and/or French preferred. 
 Willingness to travel, approximately 20% of the time.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Main activities
 The jobholder is responsible of ensuring the full performance of the Demand anticipation for A/C maintenance events. Main accountabilities are the following ones:
 Interpretation of technical publications material requirements and consequent realisation into material supply/repair forecasts.
 Analysis of material data for historical maintenance events, in order to develop a knowledge database for material scheduled and unscheduled demands.
 Build a method/algorithm to generate a BOM (Bill of Material) for future maintenance events, according to the tasks to be performed during the event. 
 Evaluate the accuracy of the BOM by adherence analysis when compared with real consumption data in order to continuously improve the material prediction and increase material availability for the end customer.
 Definition of internal processes and KPIs (customized according to each Customer’s requirements) in order to implement, monitor and maintain a spares stock and the pool of repairable items.
 Required Skills 
 Knowledge required: 
 Degree in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics or Physics
 Understanding of Aircraft Maintenance environment.
 Strong knowledge and experience in Supply-Chain and logistics areas (APICs, Logistics certifications). Appreciated past experience in Inventory Management.
 Ability for dealing with large sets of data with an advance level in office package (Excel and Access).
 SAP R/3 (Logistic-Production module) expert level, work experience in production, planning, inventory and purchase orders management transactions.
 Ability to concurrently manage multiple complex projects, and adapt effectively in a dynamic environment with unpredictable and shifting priorities.
 Strong problem-solving abilities. Technically capable of determining “what’s wrong” in complex situations and offering potential solutions; identifies root causes of problems and works with others to create effective solutions.
 Strong analytical skills. Ability to break down raw information and unstructured problems into specific, workable components that reflect drivers of causal issues. Makes logical conclusions, anticipates obstacles, and strives for superior results in a creative and resourceful manner.
 Strong and conscientious attention to detail and accuracy; solid organizational skills. You must thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial company. Demonstrated success working in an ambiguous environment.
 Fluent English written and spoken
 Personal skills .
 Person focusing on targets
 Outstanding quantitative and analytical skills
 Capacity for planning and managing processes and people.
 Capacity for solving problems
 Nice to have skills: 
 Knowledge of Visual basic and/or other programming languages.
 Basic database knowledge.
 Good Statistical and probabilistic background
 Basic project management knowledge (L-BIP/PMP)

To work with innovative front-end technology in a diverse and upbeat engineering team. We are passionate about empowering developers with the vital resources, tools, and mentorship they need to harness the full potential of technologies. About the role As our Software Engineer - GenAI, you'll contribute to the GenAI platform that enables engineering teams across the LEGO Group to adopt AI capabilities safely and effectively. You'll work alongside senior engineers and product partners to build platform features, improve developer experience, strengthen reliability and observability, support model and agent enablement capabilities, and help automate engineering workflows. This is a 7-month contract role and a chance to build practical experience at the intersection of software engineering, AI, and platform development. Required Qualifications Developed capabilities using LLMs, agents, or prompt engineering that supported AI adoption within engineering teams. items.desc: About Valova We are building the AI operations platform for European hospitals, so every clinician can focus on patients. Behind every patient sits a chain of admin work: documentation, coding, billing, audits, scheduling. It runs through disconnected systems and endless manual hand-offs , while most German hospitals already operate at a loss . We start where the impact is measurable from day one: case to cash . Valova codes every case, defends it in audits and makes sure the money lands. From there we take on every workflow that runs a hospital , until one agentic system handles the routine and people decide the exceptions. First Germany, then Europe. Doctors, engineers and operators, on-site in Munich and Berlin . Join us! Why this role matters Our agents are the product. Every case Valova codes runs through agentic systems that read clinical documentation, apply coding rules and justify every decision. How accurate, how fast and how efficient these systems are decides how much revenue hospitals recover and how much time coders get back. As AI/ML Engineer, you own the core of Valova : the agents that turn long, unstructured German clinical documentation into codes a hospital can bill and defend. You decide how we combine large and small models, how we measure quality and how new research makes it into production within weeks, not quarters . Your impact is directly measurable: in coding accuracy, in token costs per case and in hospitals that trust every decision because they can trace it. This is a hands-on engineering role building AI systems in production with real users. It’s not academic research, and it’s not prompt tinkering on the side of a product others build. How the role sits in the team You report directly to Christian, our CTO, and work day to day with our engineering team on the agent pipeline, infrastructure and evaluation. With Malte and our product team, you translate what is technically possible into product decisions. Our doctors and coding experts are your sparring partners for clinical quality, and our forward deployed team brings back how the agents perform in real hospitals. Du berichtest direkt an Christian, unseren CTO, und arbeitest täglich mit unserem Engineering-Team an der Agenten-Pipeline, der Infrastruktur und der Evaluation. Mit Malte und unserem Produktteam übersetzt Du, was technisch möglich ist, in Produktentscheidungen. Unsere Ärzt:innen und Kodierexpert:innen sind Deine Sparringspartner für klinische Qualität, und unser Forward-Deployed-Team bringt zurück, wie die Agenten in echten Kliniken performen. What you will do Build state-of-the-art agents: You build high-performing agentic systems that define the state of the art in healthcare text processing, while staying efficient in token usage and leveraging small models wherever possible. Make every decision traceable: You ensure every decision and output of our agents is traced, and you monitor their performance in production. Measure what matters: You build the evaluation and benchmarking setup that tells us, on every change, whether our agents got better or worse. Bring research to production: You follow new AI/ML approaches, benchmark promising ideas and make sure the best results reach production within weeks. Shape the product: You use your AI/ML expertise to evaluate future projects and inform product decisions. What we are looking for: Production experience: At least two years building and shipping ML/AI systems in production. LLM and agent expertise: Strong experience with LLMs and agentic frameworks. Engineering depth: Strong proficiency in your primary programming language. Evaluation mindset: Experience with observability, evaluation and benchmarking of ML systems. Product mindset: You care about outcomes that lead to great user experiences and are passionate about using LLMs in real-world scenarios rather than academic research. Nice to have: Experience in healthcare, regulated environments or with sensitive data. Languages: You speak fluent English. German is a big plus, since the clinical documents our agents process are in German. Location: You work from our office in Munich or Berlin. Missing one or two points, but convinced you’re the right person for this role? Apply anyway. We’re looking forward to meeting you! What you get Work that means something, every day. Your agents are the core of our product and directly help improve the German healthcare system. Ownership from week one. You take over real projects with a clear outcome and your name on it, not a list of tasks someone else defined. Direct access to the founders. You work day to day with our founders Sophia, a physician and ex-McKinsey consultant, and Christian, who has founded two health tech startups and spent a decade building clinical systems. No layers, no waiting weeks for approvals. Trust and freedom. We trust you to solve problems your way, and the team has your back 100%. Learning at startup speed. You will see more in one year here …

items.desc: Job Title: Research Data Scientist Department : Research Job type : Full-time Location: Hybrid, 3 days per week in our Cardiff office (free parking) Salary: Based on experience Closing date: 21 October 2026 About Human Data Sciences (HDS) Human Data Sciences (HDS) is a healthcare data consultancy specialising in the analysis of real-world data for healthcare services and the pharmaceutical industry. With more than 20 years of specialist knowledge and operational experience, we generate evidence to improve understanding of treatment effectiveness and safety and support better healthcare decisions. We have published more than 200 papers and abstracts in peer-reviewed journals and supported numerous submissions to reimbursement authorities, including the National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE). We specialise in research using the Clinical Practice Research Datalink (CPRD) and have recently launched Livingstone, our proprietary platform for analysing electronic medical records and producing real-world evidence and scientific reports on epidemiology, healthcare resource utilisation and costs in minutes. About the role You will join a team of epidemiologists, statisticians and data scientists conducting research using electronic health records and clinical trial data. You will work closely with clients to understand their research questions, advise on feasibility and deliver clear, reliable results. Working across a broad range of disease areas, you will contribute to every stage of a research project, from study design through programming and analysis to interpreting and presenting findings. The role offers opportunities to develop your career in healthcare research, strengthen your programming and statistical skills, present findings at scientific conferences and contribute to publications in peer-reviewed medical journals. Main responsibilities Take ownership of projects and deliver results within agreed timelines. Follow applicable data governance requirements and study protocols. Generate client outputs using automated tools or study-specific analyses. Develop study protocols, statistical analysis plans and study reports. Contribute to high-quality manuscripts for peer-reviewed journals. Represent HDS at scientific conferences and present study findings. Collaborate with colleagues to deliver projects from planning through to completion. Attend client meetings to plan projects, discuss progress and present results. About you You will be client-focused and committed to delivering high-quality research. You will be self-motivated, organised and adaptable, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines. You will also be able to learn new concepts quickly while maintaining a thorough, precise approach to your work. Essential criteria An MSc, PhD or 5+ years experience, preferably in mathematics, statistics, epidemiology or another scientific discipline. Applications from other disciplines are welcome. Experience working with routinely collected healthcare datasets, such as CPRD, SAIL, THIN, HES or PEDW. Proficiency in SQL and at least one other programming language, preferably R. Familiarity with Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint for preparing reports and presenting data. An interest in medical research and healthcare. An understanding of statistical methods. Excellent written English and the ability to communicate findings clearly. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, manage changing priorities and deliver results within agreed deadlines. Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail. Desirable criteria Ability to conduct literature searches and systematic reviews. We reserve the right to close this advertisement early if we receive a high volume of suitable applications. No recruitment agencies please. Pay: £30,000.00-£55,000.00 per year Benefits: Casual dress Company pension Free parking On-site parking Work from home Work Location: Hybrid remote in Roath CF24 3FR

items.desc: The Leibniz Institute for Astrophysics Potsdam (AIP) is dedicated to astrophysical questions ranging from the study of our Sun to the evolution of the cosmos. The research focuses on the area of stars, the Sun and exoplanets, galactic and extragalactic astrophysics, and cosmology. A significant share of the work involves research and development in the area of astrophysical spectroscopy, astrophotonics and the research data infrastructure. The AIP fulfils its research mission through numerous national, European, and international collaborations. The institute is the successor to the Berlin Observatory, founded in 1700, and the Astrophysical Observatory Potsdam, founded in 1874, which was the first institute in the world to devote itself expressly to astrophysics. Since 1992, the AIP has been a member of the Leibniz Association. Around 200 people work at our institute, set in a beautiful park landscape in Potsdam, not far from Berlin. items.desc: THE JOB WE ARE HIRING SOMEONE TO DO ANNEA runs two production systems for clients in the wind energy industry, each with its own backend, frontend, databases and deployment pipeline. Both need someone who ships backend work day to day, and picks up the frontend and infrastructure work around it. One of our senior engineers already carries this work across both projects, on top of everything else they do, and their time for it is about to get scarcer for a while. What we need is a second full-time pair of hands who can take over the day-to-day of it, with a proper handover now and growing independence after that, so they can spend the time they do have on the calls only they can make. THE PROGRESS WE EXPECT Instead of a list of responsibilities, here is what should be true at three points. After one month: You can navigate both codebases end to end, backend first, and run, debug and deploy both stacks through the existing pipelines. Small Sentry bugs are yours to fix, not to ask about. You've shipped at least one small backend change on each project. You've also written down what you had to figure out (setup, gotchas, how the services connect), so the handover lives in the docs and not only in our senior engineer's head. After three months: Our senior engineer has less time to give than in month one, and you've absorbed it: you've shipped self-contained backend features with NestJS on your own, you've created and updated the APIs of both projects, and you're turning client requirements into scoped tasks with only a light review. After six months: You own meaningful chunks of the backend on both projects without being asked, and you can make small, safe changes to the Timescale, ClickHouse, MariaDB and Postgres databases behind them, and to the CI/CD that ships your own code. You're a real second voice in architecture discussions - data model, caching - not just someone who hears the outcome afterwards. You will spend most of your time on the backend, with real but smaller amounts of frontend and infrastructure work alongside it - pipelines, dashboards, the databases underneath. You will work closely with the senior engineer who supports both projects part-time and will review your work and make the calls you're not ready to make yet, as well as with the rest of the ANNEA engineering team. WHO THIS JOB IS FOR This is a job for someone early in their career who has already done real things, even small ones. People who take a job like this one are usually in one of these situations. If none of them sound like you, this is not the right move. You are working somewhere that only lets you touch one layer - frontend tickets, or backend tickets, or nothing but tests - and you know from a side project, an internship or your studies that you can do more of the stack than you're allowed to there. You've used AI tools to ship something in a weekend, the way almost anyone can now, and you already know that's not the same as understanding what you built. You want to close that gap on something with real users, real data and real consequences if it breaks - not another prompt-to-app project. You use AI coding tools every day and don't just take what they output at face value - you've caught an agent confidently shipping something broken or insecure, and you want to work somewhere that treats catching that as a real skill, not an inconvenience. You want backend ownership that goes beyond a ticket queue — real features, real data - with enough exposure to frontend and infrastructure to see how your code actually reaches a user, and you'd rather learn that breadth hands-on with support than only from documentation. WHAT THE DAYS ACTUALLY LOOK LIKE You will have a lot of days like this: Fixing a bug that Sentry flagged, from reading the stack trace to shipping the patch. A backend feature in the morning, a frontend fix or a Docker/CI change in the afternoon. Turning a client requirement into a concrete, scoped task. Writing or reviewing a small piece of TypeScript, JavaScript, Python or SQL, depending on which project needs it that day. Checking a decision you're not sure about with our senior engineer before it goes live, and writing down what you decided and why. You will have very few days like this: A single ticket in a single layer of the stack, for any stretch of time. An architecture decision made entirely without you, that you only hear about afterwards. Long stretches with no client- or user-visible outcome. A full day with nobody available to sanity-check a call you're unsure about. If the second list is the one that gives you energy, you would not enjoy this job. WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE DONE BEFORE We care about what you have done, more than how long you have been doing it or where. items.desc: Introduction The University of Lausanne (UNIL) is a leading public institution of higher education and research in Switzerland. It is composed of seven faculties for a total of approximately 17’000 students and employs around 5’000 researchers, teachers and technical staff. The hosting laboratory is part of the Institute of Earth Sciences, within the Faculty of Geosciences at UNIL. unil.ch/work The National Centre of Competence in Research NCCR Genesis is a research infrastructure project funded by SNSF focussing on exploring the emergence of life in the Universe. This interdisciplinary research infrastructure brings together physicists, earth and planetary scientists, chemists and biologists to understand the conditions and the mechanisms that enable life to emerge. Developing reliable methods to detect reliable traces of life (biosignatures) – whether through remote sensing or direct onsite measurements – requires significant innovation. These challenges demand close collaboration across physics, biology, chemistry and the earth sciences. NCCR Genesis does not aim to provide answers in all fields, but to drive innovative research and achieve decisive progress. Details on NCCR Genesis are available on its website https://nccr-genesis.ch. NCCR Genesis is deeply committed to equality, diversity and inclusion. Our aim is to cultivate a respectful and fair work culture with equal access to professional development and support for all. We strongly encourage applications from under-represented groups. Presentation The Regional Management Office of the NCCR Genesis at the Institute of Earth Sciences at UNIL invites applications for an Equal Opportunities (EO) Expert. The EO Expert will work with the Equal Opportunities Committee to oversee and promote Equality, Diversity and Inclusion (EDI) activities across all aspects of the NCCR Genesis structure and operations. The person in this role will provide expertise on EDI issues and be a driving force for our actions. Expertise consultation on EDI within the NCCR Genesis will involve curating a database and collection of EDI materials, liaising with the Bureau de l’égalité at UNIL and with similar offices across the NCCR Genesis institutions, and providing expert advice, support and information to members of the Genesis research and management team. There will also be a role in advising on the appropriate courses of action following incidents of discrimination and conflicts. The EO Expert will also have a major role in planning, leading and delivering EDI actions, including leading the EO Committee in writing and periodically updating the Gensis code of conduct, as well as organizing EDI workshops and training for Genesis members, and representing our EO actions in presentations. The EO Expert will manage the inter-institutional Mentorship program, and work with the Education Officer to plan and run the International Internship program. This position also offers the opportunity to conduct research on EDI actions within the NCCR Gensis, with the potential to prepare publications on our EO actions. Assistance with administration of the EO Office is also part of the responsibilities of this post, including working with the EO Officer in Zurich on the budget and administration of the EO Committee meetings, as well as managing the email inbox. items.desc: We’re currently seeking a Senior Developer Technology Engineer, Artificial Intelligence. Would you enjoy researching parallel algorithms to accelerate AI workloads on advanced computer architectures? Do you find it rewarding to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks to achieve the best possible performance on pioneering computer hardware? Could you be thrilled about an opportunity to partner with the developer community, working at the forefront of technology breakthroughs that contribute to the success of an industry leader like NVIDIA? If so, the Developer Technology Team invites you to consider this role. What You Will Be Doing In this position, you will research and develop techniques to GPU accelerate workloads in deep learning, machine learning or other AI domains. Work directly with other technical experts in their fields (industry and academia) to perform in-depth analysis and optimization of complex AI and HPC algorithms to ensure optimal AI solutions on modern CPU and GPU architectures. Publish and/or present discovered optimization techniques in developer blogs or relevant conferences to engage and educate the developer community. Influence the design of next-generation hardware architectures, software, and programming models in collaboration with research, hardware, system software, libraries, and tools teams at NVIDIA. What We Need To See An advanced degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related computationally focused science degree (or equivalent experience). You have 8+ years of relevant experience in software development or research work. Programming fluency in C/C++ with a deep understanding of algorithms and software development. A background that includes parallel programming, e.g., CUDA, OpenACC, OpenMP, MPI, pthreads, etc. Hands on experience doing low-level performance optimizations. In-depth expertise with CPU and GPU architecture fundamentals. Effective communication and organization skills, with a logical approach to problem solving, good time management, and prioritization skills. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Expertise in parallelization and performance optimization of Deep Learning models arising from Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, Recommender Systems, etc. Excellent understanding of linear algebra. NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. Are you a creative and autonomous computer scientist with a genuine passion for parallel computing? If so, we want to hear from you. Come, join our AI Compute DevTech team and help build the real-time, cost-effective computing platform driving our success in this exciting and quickly growing field. NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer.
