Bücher erzählen Geschichten – und jeder erfolgreichen Unternehmensgeschichte liegt heutzutage eine starke digitale Infrastruktur zugrunde. Ob Onlineshop, App, Warenwirtschaftssysteme oder smarte Lösungen für unsere Buchhandlungen: Unsere IT sorgt dafür, dass Thalia als moderner Omnichannel-Buchhändler funktioniert. Thalia verbindet Tradition mit Innovation. Was 1919 mit einer Buchhandlung begann, ist heute ein Unternehmen mit 613 Buchhandlungen, 41 Spielwarenfachgeschäften, einem starken eCommerce-Bereich und einem digitalen Ökosystem, das stetig wächst. Unsere IT ist der Schlüssel, um den klassischen Buchhandel und die digitale Welt noch besser zu verzahnen – mit Systemen, die zuverlässig, effizient und zukunftsfähig sind. Wir arbeiten an Lösungen, die nicht nur unserer Kundschaft ein nahtloses Einkaufserlebnis bieten, sondern auch unsere internen Prozesse smarter und effizienter machen. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, IT-Prozesse neu zu denken, innovative Technologien einzusetzen und gemeinsam mit uns den digitalen Wandel im Buchhandel zu gestalten. Du punktest mit deiner Expertise für generative KI und AI-Engineering und hast die Leidenschaft, komplexe Geschäftsprobleme zu verstehen und durch fortschrittliche KI-Technologien zu lösen. Automatisierung: In der Cloud automatisierst du Pipelines für Data Pre-Processing, Model Training und Deployment unter Einsatz von MLOps-Praktiken. Fachbereichsunterstützung: Mit der Entwicklung interner AI-Tools unterstützt du Fachbereiche bei Entscheidungen und steigerst ihre Effizienz. Ausgeprägte Expertise in den Bereichen Machine Learning und Generative AI, insbesondere mit LLMs und Diffusion Models. Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Python sowie in modernen ML- und GenAI-Frameworks und -Libraries wie PyTorch, TensorFlow und relevanten GenAI-Tools. Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Evaluierung von ML-/LLM-Modellen, einschließlich Prompt Engineering, Fine-Tuning, Benchmarks sowie produktiver Deployment-Workflows. Sicherer Umgang mit mit Cloud- und MLOps-Umgebungen, insbesondere GCP, Containerisierung, Git-basierter Versionierung und modernen ML-Workflows. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind für diese Position erforderlich, da die Kommunikation mit internen und externen Schnittstellen einen wesentlichen Bestandteil der Tätigkeit bildet. Das bieten wir dir Neben vielen klassischen Vorteilen wie Company Bike, ÖPNV-Vergünstigung oder Personalrabatt findest du bei uns: Gestaltungsspielraum: Verwirkliche deine Ideen und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft von Thalia mit. Persönliches Wachstum: Profitiere von diversen Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Karrierewegen. Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Dein Einsatz hat direkten Einfluss auf unsere digitale Kompetenz – insbesondere in den Bereichen e-Com, IT-Security & -Maintenance. Agiles Arbeiten und moderne Unternehmenskultur: Arbeite flexibel und eigenverantwortlich in einem offenen, dynamischen Umfeld. Teamspirit: Erlebe Zusammenarbeit und gegenseitige Unterstützung auf allen Ebenen. Vielfalt und Offenheit: Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und fördern Diversität. Treiber des Wandels: Gestalte als Teil von #TeamThalia mit uns die Transformation unseres Unternehmens. In der Welt der Bücher ist Platz für jede Geschichte und jede Perspektive. Bei Thalia sind wir fest davon überzeugt, dass Vielfalt und eine Kultur der Wertschätzung entscheidende Antriebskräfte für Kreativität und Innovation sind. items.desc: Job ID: 4459 We are seeking an experienced and highly hands-on Expert Agentic Business Engineer to design, build, and operationalize agentic AI solutions that solve real business problems in Asset & Wealth Management (AWM). You will work at the intersection of business transformation and advanced AI engineering – translating business needs into robust, well-governed agentic applications that can be safely deployed in a regulated banking environment. About Our Team The AWM Chief Operating Office (COO) drives operational excellence, supports business transformation, and fosters innovation across Asset & Wealth Management. We focus on improving processes, leveraging technology, and ensuring strong governance and compliance – enabling sustainable growth and superior client experiences. The COO team collaborates across business, technology, and control functions to identify opportunities and deliver measurable impact. The AWM AI team is being established in AWM COO to accelerate delivery and scale of AI capabilities across AWM, with a strong focus on Private Banking and selected cross-area dependencies. We build common AI architecture and reusable patterns, support a disciplined governance model, and partner closely with business units, engineering teams, and control functions to turn an active AI pipeline into measurable outcomes. Main responsibilities in this role include, but are not limited to: Own delivery from idea to production: frame business problems, shape agentic AI solution designs, prototype quickly, and industrialize into production-ready services with measurable outcomes. Build agentic AI applications: design and implement agents that can reason, plan, use tools, and interact with enterprise systems (e.g., advisor tooling, analytics platforms, internal APIs). Partner with stakeholders end-to-end: collaborate with Private Banking/AWM business leaders, architects, engineers, and control functions to ensure solutions deliver real value and can be adopted at scale. Engineer for governance and safety: implement evaluation strategies, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns suitable for regulated banking environments (privacy, auditability, model risk expectations). Enable reuse and scale: build reusable patterns, components, and reference implementations to accelerate delivery across a portfolio of use cases. Operate and improve: monitor agent behavior in production, iterate on prompts/tools/logic based on evals and feedback, and continuously improve quality, cost, latency, and safety. Who You Are Collaboration. Ownership. Passion. Courage. These are the values that guide us in being at our best – and that we imagine you share with us. This is the right role for you if you are a curious, outcome-driven and pragmatic senior data scientist who can take ownership, influence stakeholders, and raise modelling and engineering standards while delivering working solutions at pace. Your background and skills include: Are a curious, innovative team player with a can-do attitude, always looking for ways on how we can unlock the next level for our customers. Hands-on agentic AI experience, including designing and building agent workflows (planner–executor, tool calling, multi-agent, human-in-the-loop). Strong LLM ops and evaluation mindset: quality/correctness, latency, cost, and safety; ability to define test sets and run disciplined experimentation. Guardrails and Responsible AI experience: input/output validation, prompt safety, data leakage prevention, and controls appropriate for regulated environments. Strong software engineering skills with Python (modular design, testing, version control) and comfort working in notebook-based experimentation. Cloud and integration experience: deploying AI services in AWS, integrating via REST APIs, and familiarity with containerisation/Kubernetes and CI/CD. Data/analytics platform experience (e.g., Snowflake) for grounding, retrieval, and context management. Business engineering strength: ability to translate stakeholder needs into solution requirements, KPIs, and adoption plans; strong communication and collaboration skills. Why join You will join a team building practical, high-impact AI capabilities across AWM – working on real advisor and operational workflows, with strong visibility and a clear focus on measurable outcomes. You will help shape how we build, govern, and scale agentic AI in a Nordic, regulated banking context. If you are passionate about agentic AI and eager to make a tangible impact in AWM, we invite you to apply and join our innovative COO team. Next steps Submit your application no later than 07/11/2026. Wil jij jouw technische expertise inzetten om AI-oplossingen te bouwen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt? Dan is de rol van AI Engineer Consultant iets voor jou. Als AI Engineer Consultant binnen Rijksorganisatie voor Ontwikkeling, Digitalisering en Innovatie (ODI) ontwerp, ontwikkel en implementeer je AI-oplossingen die daadwerkelijk in de praktijk worden gebruikt. Je combineert sterke software engineering met kennis van moderne AI en werkt aan oplossingen van prototype tot productie. Je werkt onder andere met generatieve AI, LLM’s en machine learning. Je bouwt AI-functionaliteit in applicaties, ontwikkelt API’s en backendservices en integreert modellen met bestaande systemen en cloudomgevingen. Daarbij zorg je dat oplossingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar, veilig en goed te onderhouden zijn. Afhankelijk van de opdracht ligt je focus op ontwikkeling, integratie, optimalisatie of technisch ontwerp. Je werkt samen met andere engineers en technische stakeholders en kunt jouw technische keuzes helder onderbouwen. Een greep uit jouw werkzaamheden Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van AI-toepassingen met generatieve AI, LLM’s en machine learning; Bouwen van API’s, backendservices en intergraties voor AI-functionaliteit; Integreren en deployen van AI-oplossingen in cloud- en productieomgevingen; Toepassen va CI/CD, testing en monitoring ; Optimaliseren van oplossingen voor kwaliteit, performance, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid; Bijdragen aan technische architectuur en technologiekeuzes. items.desc: About Temos The energy transition has a bottleneck nobody talks about: access to the grid. Thousands of solar, wind, storage and industrial projects are stuck waiting for one answer: is there capacity to connect, and where? Temos is a fast-growing Barcelona startup building the intelligence layer for the energy industry , starting with that one very big problem: access to power and access to the grid. We turn fragmented, highly technical public data (grid operator capacity files, regulatory gazettes, permitting records) into products that developers, utilities and investors use to make multi-million-euro decisions. We are a small team with a high density of talent, coming from McKinsey, BCG and leading players in the energy space. More than a team, we are a tight-knit group of people who have each other's backs: we help each other, always look for what's best for the team, and share a deep sense of mission. We are growing fast, already working with major energy companies, and we have a clear ambition: to redefine how a traditional, trillion-euro industry makes decisions. The role We are looking for an AI Engineer to join our Product & Technology team in our Barcelona office. You are a builder at heart . You love using AI to ship products, automate workflows and solve hard problems, and you want to do it in a domain that is highly complex: electrical grids, regulation and engineering constraints, where being right matters. You'll own features end to end, from talking to a customer to shipping to production, and you'll help shape what Temos becomes. What you'll work on AI agents and LLM-powered features that read, reason over and explain complex energy data Data pipelines that ingest and structure messy public sources at scale Product features across our platform, from backend to UI Automating internal workflows so a small team can operate like a big one What we're looking for This is a mid-to-senior role. Most people who'd thrive here have around 2 to 5 years building software. If you have fewer years but have built things people actually use, we'd still love to hear from you. Must-haves Hands-on experience building AI or data products Software engineering and agentic coding skills: you build with AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex…) every day and own the quality of what you ship. Our stack is Python (backend) and React / TypeScript (frontend) You can have complex conversations with customers and work with them directly to understand and solve their problems A team player with a strong sense of mission: you help others without being asked, put the team first, and add to our culture Highly valued Data experience: data engineering, analytics, data architecture Product skills: software development lifecycle, backlog prioritization, talking to users and turning feedback into product Big plus You've lived the 0→1 stage of a startup Energy, electrical engineering or an engineering background. Words like "substation", "MW" or "grid connection" don't scare you What we offer Competitive salary and generous equity: you will be an owner, not just an employee Real ownership and impact from day one, in a team where every hire changes the trajectory Working side by side with a high-talent, high-ambition team in a fast-growing startup A mission that matters: unlocking the energy transition Where we work We believe great products are built together. We ask you to spend most of your week in our new Barcelona office , alongside the Product & Tech team. If you want to build AI that moves a real industry, let's talk. You can send an email to sergi@temos.ai

items.desc: This position is for a Creative AI Engineer who works out quickly what AI can do in a given part of the business, and then builds it. One month that may be on-model imagery and video for ecommerce; the next, a brand-tone translation pipeline, product copy at catalog scale, or a virtual audience that lets marketing test a campaign idea before it goes live. You combine curiosity and creative judgment with the engineering skills to turn an idea into a solution that runs reliably in production. YOUR TASKS The work spans image, video, text and insight, and priorities follow where the business sees the most value. You will join a growing AI Team in a fast-moving fashion retailer and report to the AI Team Lead. This is a hybrid role, partly from home and partly at our office in Hilversum, the Netherlands, so we are only considering applicants who live within commuting distance of Hilversum. We value demonstrated skill over a traditional career path, and the selection process includes a portfolio review and a short practical exercise. Responsibilities Learn the Problem Fast: Sit with a department, understand how the work is done today, and find where generative AI makes a measurable difference. Build Across Image, Video and Text: Build generative solutions from on-model imagery, video and packaging visuals to translation, copywriting, virtual audiences and research insights. Run in Production: Own monitoring, output quality, running cost and fixes for what you deliver. Protect Brand and Quality: Make sure output meets brand, tone of voice, model-likeness and usage-rights requirements through the review process. Integrate with the Business Stack: Connect solutions to Adobe Experience Manager, Microsoft 365 and the Google Cloud data platform. Compare Tools Fairly: Run like-for-like comparisons of external generative tools against internal solutions, with the same inputs and conditions, and share the results openly. Enable Self-Service: Build templates, saved prompts and guidance so business teams can use generative AI themselves within agreed guardrails. Cover for the Team: Back up the AI Agent Engineer on basic work, so the team keeps moving when someone is out. Requirements You have a track record of picking up a new domain or tool quickly and shipping something useful with it. Evidence matters more than years in a role. Recent hands-on experience building with generative AI or creative technology, with shipped work across at least two of image, video and text. A portfolio is required. Hands-on experience with Python, APIs and cloud platforms, prompt and retrieval design for language models, and image or video workflow tools such as ComfyUI. Experience with Google Cloud is a plus. A strong eye for fashion imagery and an ear for brand tone, and the confidence to reject output that is technically fine but off brand. You have built solutions that other people rely on, with monitoring, documentation and cost control, not only demos. You understand image rights, model likeness, consent and data privacy, and build those checks into the workflow. You can deliver what was asked, one step at a time, and you bring stakeholders along before going further. You have previously worked with creative directors, marketers and engineers, and you know how to explain trade-offs in plain language. Written and verbal English communication skills. Dutch is a plus. If you’re interested in this role, we’d love to receive your application via our official career channels. Benefits are subject to the country where you are applying. Please visit the respective country website of the vacancy you are applying for, to learn more about our benefits. THE JOURNEY TO YOUR DREAM JOB 10 seconds Application Send your application! items.desc: About the assignment Our client, a large organisation in the Dutch financial sector, is looking for a GenAI Data Scientist to raise the quality of its in-house chatbot. Your job is to make sure the chatbot actually does what users need it to do. This is not a model training or ML research role. The underlying models are off-the-shelf; the real challenge lies in context engineering, system evaluation, and diagnosing why the chatbot behaves the way it does. The central question you help answer: why isn't the chatbot doing what we expect, and what context or structure does it need to get there? You'll also benchmark the current solution against the state of the art and push innovation across retrieval, generation, reasoning loops, tool calling, and related GenAI techniques. What you'll do Analyse chatbot outputs and pinpoint the improvements with the biggest impact Identify context gaps and define what additional information the agents need Define evaluation criteria for agent performance together with the product owner and engineers Work directly with use-case teams and stakeholders to understand real-world scenarios, feed those into evaluation, and turn feedback into improvements Improve retrieval, data structuring, and the onboarding of new context sources Build evaluation frameworks that support fast, large-scale experimentation Translate functional requirements into concrete technical improvements What you bring Hands-on experience with LLM-based applications and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) A solid grasp of prompts, context windows, retrieval, and grounding, plus the judgement to say whether an output is good or bad, and why Experience with API integrations, batch syncs, and both structured and unstructured data The ability to debug data flows and context ingestion issues alongside engineers Experience designing evaluation approaches that go beyond classical ML metrics Strong functional understanding: you know why a chatbot exists and which user behaviour matters Comfort working between engineering and product Clear communication skills, both in conversations with engineers, product owners and stakeholders, and in written improvement proposals Nice to have Experience with human-in-the-loop evaluation Project Details: Location: Utrecht Type: Contract - To- Perm Duration: 12 months (Possible to go internal) Hours: 36 Must be located in the Netherlands You'll thrive here if... You're genuinely curious about why AI systems behave the way they do and how to make them better. You enjoy debugging behaviour, not just code. You think in structures, connect the dots quickly, and have a strong instinct for what "good" looks like. Interested? Send your CV or get in touch for more details.

items.desc: About The Opportunity We are building a rigorous, verifiable evaluation suite of Terminal-Bench tasks designed to test the limits of large language models on multilingual software challenges. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. We are seeking experienced native-speaking software engineers to design, build, and validate these benchmarks. You will create high-signal, high-quality tasks that genuinely test a model's ability to handle multilingual environments without relying on English translation crutches. Note this is a remote, freelance opportunity What You’ll Deliver Task Engineering: Evaluating Coding Agents. Asset Creation: Build realistic task environments using datasets and files in your native language. Crucially, these assets must remain in the target language to genuinely measure multilingual handling. Prompting & Translation: finding failure points where AI does not work, in your native language Implementation & Verification: Support the development of robust solutions (reference implementations) and write highly reliable, deterministic verifier scripts (using rubric-based judging only when strictly necessary). Calibration & Execution: Analyze execution logs and calibrate task difficulty (Easy to Very Hard) using standard Terminal-Bench run configurations against various model tiers (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus). Quality Assurance: Participate in a rigorous, 4-layer human quality control process (creation, human review, calibration review, and audit) alongside automated LLM-based checks to ensure fairness, grammatical accuracy, and benchmark integrity. Qualifications Experience: 5+ years of industry experience in software engineering. Background: Proven track record at leading technology companies and/or graduation from top-tier engineering universities. Language: Native or near-native fluency, with a deep understanding of its grammar, register, and phrasing rules. High English proficiency. Technical Stack: Strong proficiency in Python, standard shell scripting, and data processing. Workflow: Extensive experience with Terminal/CLI-based development workflows and a working familiarity with coding agents. Domain Expertise: Deep technical understanding of multilingual text processing pitfalls, including: Encoding/decoding robustness and Unicode normalization. Locale-dependent conventions (collation, casing, non-Gregorian dates). Text I/O, toolchain interoperability, and safe string operations. (For specific languages) Bidirectional/RTL handling, font fallbacks, and rendering/typography in UI or artifacts. Why Collaborate with Lilt? Your schedule, your rules. As an independent contractor, work when you want, as much or as little as you want. No fixed hours, no check-ins, no micromanaging. Get paid quickly and fairly. We respect your time and your expertise. Competitive rates, prompt payments, no chasing invoices. Work on projects that actually matter. Contribute to cutting-edge AI and language technology that is shaping how humans and machines communicate. Be part of something bigger. Join a global community of linguists, subject matter experts, and language professionals who are advancing human knowledge together. Grow without limits. As a Lilt contractor you get access to diverse, innovative projects that expand your portfolio and sharpen your skills across industries and domains. Have fun doing what you love. Our goal is to measure multilingual robustness across prompt language effects, non-English data processing, and complex locale/encoding edge cases in terminal workflows. Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help develop unique cutting-edge data science and AI solutions to help drive innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music? Universal Music UK is looking for an AI Product Engineer to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun. The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping ideas and translating business needs into clear product requirements would also be a strength. Alongside this, you will be responsible for building and improving AI-powered products, tools and workflows that solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders and product managers to understand user needs, shape requirements and turn ideas into practical technical solutions. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, designers and business teams, you will help take products from discovery and prototyping through to development, launch, adoption and ongoing iteration. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with data, APIs, technical trade-offs and modern AI-enabled software development. As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape products from the inception of an idea through to fully working technology that supports & supercharges the labels. Key Responsibilities This role will feed directly into our Engineering Lead, where core responsibilities include: Develop AI-powered products, tools and workflows that are tailored to the needs of our labels and central teams. Collaborate with stakeholders, product managers and data teams to understand requirements and turn ideas into practical technical solutions. Build prototypes, applications and product features using modern software development tools, AI technologies and data-driven approaches. Work closely with developers, data scientists and project managers to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality data and AI products that can adapt to the business’ changing needs. Support product testing, troubleshooting and iteration to ensure solutions are reliable, useful, secure, performant and delivering measurable value. Stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in AI, software engineering and product development, applying them to improve the quality and efficiency of our solutions. At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation. Strong experience developing modern web interfaces using React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML and CSS. Experience using component libraries and design systems such as Material UI to build consistent and accessible user interfaces. Experience building back-end services, APIs and applications using Django, Django REST Framework and Python. Ability to turn …

items.desc: Aliz is a Google Cloud partner that builds data, AI and application solutions for enterprise clients. We are building a team of Forward Deployed AI Engineers: expert AI agent developers who work inside the client's organisation as a one-person team, find where AI can help, and build and hand over the solution themselves. A Forward Deployed Engineer is embedded in the client's environment for the length of an engagement, typically one to three months. You sit with the client's teams, often several departments at once, understand how they work, and solve their problems, whether the problem is technical, a business question or a broken process. A solution architect designs and sells a solution and then hands it to a delivery team. In this role you do both: you assess the problem, build the solution, and stay until the client's people understand it, use it and can run it without you. Because engagements are short, you will work on several of them in a year, and sometimes on more than one topic at the same time. The solutions are not tied to one product or vendor. One engagement may be an agentic workflow built into a client's process, another may be applied research with small language models, a third may be helping a team use AI tools such as Claude or Gemini properly in their daily work. You often start in a domain you have not worked in before, and you are expected to get productive in it quickly. What you will do Work on site with client teams to understand their technical, business and process problems and the constraints around them. Assess where AI agents make a measurable difference, and agree with the client how success will be measured. Design and build the solution end to end: agentic workflows, LLM-based applications, integrations with the client's systems, or experiments where the answer is not yet known. Take solutions beyond the proof of concept: get them into use by the client's teams and show the impact with numbers. Hand the solution over: document it, train the people who will use and maintain it, and help the client adopt it. Bring an AI-first way of working into the client's teams, and show them by example how to build with AI agents and tools. Bring what you learn back to Aliz, so the next engagement starts from a reusable solution rather than from zero. What we expect Expert AI agent developer. You design, build and evaluate system with AI agents at an expert level, you build with coding agents every day, and you try new models and frameworks when they come out. You can deliver an engagement on your own, as a one-person team, with Aliz architects and project managers supporting you in the background. A proven track record with measurable impact. You have solved real problems or sped up real work with AI agents, and someone measured the result. We look for results more mature than a proof of concept: solutions that went into use. The domain is open, and a data science background is not required. Customer facing. You understand and assess the client's problem, solve it, and hand the solution over. You explain technical results and their limits in plain language to engineers and managers, and you can teach others to own what you built. Flexible. We place you in the client's environment, where many things are outside our control. Priorities, people and plans change, and you adapt to them calmly. You are comfortable switching between engagements and running more than one topic at a time. Broad engineering experience. Senior level, with exposure to several areas such as application development, data and infrastructure, so you can work with whatever the client already has. On-site availability. You can work at client sites regularly, and travel when the client is outside Budapest. Language: fluent English is required, fluent Hungarian and German are a plus. Nice to have Data science or machine learning background (model training, fine-tuning, evaluation). Google Cloud experience, including Vertex AI / Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform incl Gemini Enterprise App. Experience with agent frameworks such as Google ADK or LangGraph. Consulting or forward deployed experience at other companies.

items.desc: At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences. We’re looking for an engineer who is genuinely on top of agentic AI – someone who believes agents can take over work that today ties up whole people, and who can prove it inside real engineering teams. This is a founding role. You’ll embed with our R&D teams, find the manual, repetitive work that slows them down, and build the automations – agentic where that’s the right tool, plain scripting where it isn’t – that give them their time back. Our engineers are strong and overloaded; your job is to make them much more productive without adding to their plate. Do this well and you’ll grow it into a small team you lead. Here Is a Little Taste Of Your Challenge Embed and find the work worth removing: Shadow our R&D teams to learn how work really flows, and find the bottlenecks and repetitive manual work hiding in plain sight. Rank opportunities by how often they happen and how much they cost – not by how interesting they are to build. Testing and QA processes are often the richest place to start. Prioritise with each team’s manager: The managers want this help – you’ll agree with each of them what to tackle first and the time to protect for it, so the highest-value work gets done. Build it – agent-first, but not agent-only: Design and ship the solution end-to-end. Reach for agents where judgment and language are in the loop; reach for a script, pipeline or bit of tooling where that’s simply more reliable. A simple, dependable solution is worth more than a clever one that breaks. Build for handover, so the team can own it: You build with the team, not for them – and because each team owns its automations after handover, you design them to be owned: documented, monitored where it matters, and maintainable by a normal engineer on that team. A handover isn’t “here’s a tool,” it’s “here’s something your team can run and improve without me.” That’s also how automations earn trust – they have to be robust enough that teams rely on them and make fewer manual mistakes, not more. Set the standard, then grow the team: You’re the first hire and the template for everyone who follows. As the work justifies it, you’ll have the chance to lead a small (2–3 person) team focused entirely on AI adoption across R&D. Who are you? There is no set route into this role. But to be successful, this is the kind of profile we have in mind: Deep, current agentic AI: You live in this space. You know the tools, the patterns and the limits, and you genuinely believe agents can absorb work that’s done by hand today. Empirical about what actually works: And precisely because you believe in agents, you’re honest about when something is just a script. You choose the simplest thing that reliably works. This pairing – conviction plus sober judgment – is the whole job. A strong generalist who ships: You build and deliver, not just design. You’re fluent enough across backend, scripting, CI/CD and tooling to automate almost anything you find. You go after repetitive work: You see manual, repetitive tasks as a problem to solve, and you ask “how often, and how costly?” before deciding what’s worth automating. You earn trust and build alongside people: You embed, listen, and build with a team rather than dropping finished tools on them. Collaborative, not lone-wolf. Fresh eyes, no baggage: You do NOT need mobile or security experience. We want someone who looks at entrenched workflows and questions them – not someone who has already accepted them as normal. Product / platform mindset: Your users are our engineers; the time you give back to them is your product. Leadership is upside, not a requirement: If you want to grow into leading the team, great. If you’d rather stay hands-on and deep, also great. Fluent in English (essential); Spanish is highly valued for working day-to-day with our Barcelona-based teams. Practically Speaking, What's In It For You A rare greenfield mandate – you define how a whole organization adopts agentic AI, starting from a blank page. Freedom to bring the right tools – you’ll start from our current stack (Claude, our core languages and tooling) and have real latitude to introduce whatever works better. Teams who want this – the managers are asking for the help and are ready to work with you. Simplicity – because we like to make things easy and practical. Beautiful office in the heart of Barcelona – with regular team events (breakfast, lunch…). Good transport connections – easy to reach by public transport. Flexible working hours & hybrid working.

items.desc: A Different Kind Of Job Description At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job, so what you'll read here looks a little different from other job ads. It starts with why this is a terrible job. Then it explains why it might be the best career move you'll ever make. Why this is a terrible job This is an incredibly high-paced, high-tempo environment. We're making a generational bet to change all of our lives, and generational bets are not comfortable. You will build agents for subjective workflows. Tax law is objective, but what applies under it and how professionals interpret it is full of judgment. You can give two tax professionals the same task and get two different results where both are right. We're building agentic systems that have to reach their level of accuracy, not a level we decided is good enough. From an engineering standpoint, this is the hardest thing most of us have ever built. At times it will feel like hitting your head against the wall. Customers will sometimes get frustrated, because they expect deterministic results from probabilistic systems, and we're managing the expectations of some of the biggest firms in the world, including the Big Four. And the rhythm is real: we get to the office, we work, we go home and spend time with our families, and then many of us get back online to support our customers in US hours. It's tough. It's relentless. Why it might be the best career choice you'll ever make It's addictive to be part of a business when you know you're winning. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, customers are signing up in numbers, and in under two years we've become the market leader in a space with entrenched incumbents and a drastic need for new AI tools. When we come into head-to-heads with competitors, we win every time, because our product is superior. And we stay focused and diligent: we only work with tax firms that have the right expectations, which is why our typical customer is mid-market and enterprise. The industry looks boring from the outside, but the problem is unsolved, and the space has been riddled with products below the mark for decades. When you push through the wall, there's a spark of joy: a customer says "wow, this is phenomenal." That keeps happening. The opportunity here is not only to make a great deal of money. It's to have real impact on our mission: making this profession extraordinary. Nobody became a tax professional for the admin. They got into this work to be creative with tax law, to have fun, and to change the fabric of society. Filed enables them to do exactly that. We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and you can read the story in TechCrunch. Our focus now is to deliver the roadmap and continue to win. What You'll Build As a Fullstack AI Developer, you'll build the agentic systems at the heart of Filed: Agentic workflows that mirror how tax professionals actually work, judgment call by judgment call Evaluation and verification systems that measure our accuracy against professional standards, not benchmarks we invented for ourselves The model integrations and tooling that turn probabilistic systems into something firms trust with high-stakes work You'll work at the frontier of applying AI to subjective domains, where two different answers can both be correct, and where shipping means earning the trust of professionals who scrutinize every output. What You'll Be Responsible For Building and maintaining fullstack features across our AI tax prep, planning, and review products Owning the UX and backend logic for the workflows tax professionals use every day Shipping fast, watching metrics, and deciding what to improve next, without being told Making LLMs work for our customers to achieve higher accuracy and transparency Keeping the codebase clean, typed, and fast as we scale Your Hard Skillset Comfortable in TypeScript, React, and Python: you've built complex, data-heavy UIs and backend services before Familiar with cloud infrastructure on Google Cloud and/or Azure Bonus if you've worked in fast-paced startups or regulated industries Even bigger bonus if you've taken a product from 0 to 1 and watched real users depend on it Your Soft Skillset Comfortable being uncomfortable and making calls with incomplete data Empathetic and curious: building for the user, not just for clean code Highly collaborative across product, engineering, and tax Detail-oriented but pragmatic: you know when polish matters and when to ship You own your work and welcome the accountability that comes with it A championship team We think of ourselves as a sports team. Incredibly high performance, incredibly high standards, and real success to show for it. Being a championship team means working with people who are deeply proud of the work they do and have great fun doing it together. We measure …

items.desc: This position is for an AI Agent Engineer to build and run AI agents that take on the routine work in Hunkemöller's head office roles. When a role opens, you work with the department to map its work, judge honestly how much an agent can take on, and build and run the agent that does it, up to one a month. You will work across Microsoft 365, Google Cloud and Anthropic, design agents that are safe to rely on, and help teams adopt them. YOUR TASKS You will join a growing AI Team in a fast-moving fashion retailer and report to the AI Team Lead. This is a hybrid role, partly from home and partly at our office in Hilversum, the Netherlands, so we are only considering applicants who live within commuting distance of Hilversum. We value demonstrated skill over a traditional career path, and the selection process includes a short practical exercise. Responsibilities Assess Automation Opportunities: Map a role's processes with the department and decide quickly whether an agent will hold up in daily use, including when the answer is no. Build Production Agents: Build agents in Microsoft 365, on Google Cloud or with Anthropic models that work across the same tools and data the role uses today. Design for Safe Use: Give every agent a named owner, read access by default, write access only with approval, and a person who confirms consequential actions. Run What You Build: Own monitoring, evaluation, maintenance and fixes for the agents you deliver. Support the Teams Using Agents: Onboard and train the people who work alongside each agent, and act on their feedback. Reuse and Document: Turn common patterns into reusable building blocks and document each agent so others can run it. Cover for the Team: Back up the Creative AI Engineer on basic work, so the team keeps moving when someone is out. Requirements You have hands-on experience building automation, such as robotic process automation, Power Platform or workflow tools, and recent work on agents built on language models. Recent, relevant experience matters more than years in a role. You have experience using Python or TypeScript, APIs and system integration, and experience with Microsoft 365 and Copilot Studio, Google Cloud agent tooling, or Anthropic models and agent tooling. Experience with the Model Context Protocol is a plus. Experience with testing an agent's output, handling exceptions and keeping a person in the loop where it matters. You know how to break a role into its tasks, spot what is routine and what needs judgment, and estimate the effort honestly. Have operated systems that people depend on, not only demos. You communicate clearly and work patiently with teams adjusting to new ways of working, as well as knowing how to build trust with HR and department leads. Clear understanding of data access and privacy, and the risks of agents that can change business data. Written and verbal English communication skills. Dutch is a plus. What We Offer 25 days of annual leave, with the option to buy or sell up to 4 additional days Hybrid work model, combining office and remote working Possibility to work from abroad for up to 2 weeks per year An international work environment, working with teams across different countries Travel allowance to support commuting costs Access to the Hunkemöller Academy for professional development 25% employee discount on all Hunkemöller products Please note: We take care of our recruitment directly at Hunkemöller. For this reason, we kindly ask agencies not to reach out , and applications sent by email cannot be considered . If you’re interested in this role, we’d love to receive your application via our official career channels. Benefits are subject to the country where you are applying. Please visit the respective country website of the vacancy you are applying for, to learn more about our benefits. THE JOURNEY TO YOUR DREAM JOB 10 seconds Application Send your application! Our tip: no motivation letter required; we have something much better - see step 2! Live interview(s) Get invited to chat with us... Offer Land your dream job with us! HIRED Welcome to Hunkemöller - You'll sign your digital contract and are ready to start. Onboarding & Development Journey Start your career - kick off with our Onboarding & grow your talents. items.desc: Login and apply The Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies We are seeking a (part-time) trainee to support the Coordination Unit of the Finnish University Partnership for International Development (UniPID). The trainee will mostly work remotely at the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland on the Joensuu campus. Please find more information below and submit your application by 28 October 2026. UniPID is seeking a trainee to support the Coordination Unit, particularly in communications and the implementation of events. UniPID coordinates and participates in a number of externally funded projects. These projects serve to support the Finnish research community in their collaborative partnerships with counterparts in the Global South. About UniPID The Finnish University Partnership for International Development (UniPID) is a network of 10 Finnish universities, established in 2002 to strengthen the capacity of its member universities to enhance global responsibility and Global South perspectives in their education, research, and societal engagement. UniPID also promotes equitable and inclusive global partnerships that advance sustainable development. UniPID is coordinated by the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland. Tasks The trainee will assist UniPID’s Coordination Unit in communications and the organisation of events. The main duties of the trainee are described below. Communication: Assisting in the coordination of communications. This may include managing social media channels, drafting newsletters, and planning and implementing communications materials on the activities of the network and its projects in order to reach Finnish and international audiences. Organising virtual and on-site events: assisting in the planning and organisation of events and meetings, including participant registration and management, technical support and reporting. In addition to the above-mentioned tasks, there will be tasks associated with the Development Days 2027 Conference (DevDays2027), which is organised by the Finnish Society for Development Research (FSDR) in collaboration with UniPID and other stakeholders. The Development Days is Finland’s largest annual international conference dedicated to development research, practice, and activism. The conference will feature a broad spectrum of topics through working groups and panel discussions. The responsibilities will include: Event organisation: Assisting with the planning and organisation of DevDays2027, managing conference registration, drafting the conference programme, aiding with travel arrangements, assisting in budget-related matters, and providing other technical support. Communication: Designing a communication strategy and actions for DevDays2027, updating the webpage, handling email communications, among others. Head of conference secretariat: Responsibility for heading the conference secretariat, including forming and leading a team of conference volunteers. Position details The trainee will mostly work remotely at the Coordination Unit of UniPID in the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland. The traineeship is a part-time position and will commence in November 2026 and continue until the end of April 2027. The starting date will be agreed upon on a case-by-case basis. A trial period is applied to new members of the university’s staff. The trainee will receive supervision from both UniPID and FSDR. The trainee is required to have a university internship subsidy. For more information on subsidy practices, see the Aarresaari website. The trainee’s salary will be EUR 750 per month for a part-time (50%) position. Our requirements and expectations We encourage Master’s level students from UniPID member universities who are entitled to the internship subsidy of their home university to apply. We expect you to be eager to learn new things, be interested in scientific and development cooperation, have good skills in the English language, have good written and oral communication skills and have good teamwork and organisational skills. How to apply Submit your electronic application no later than 28 October 2026 by 24:00 (midnight) Finnish time (UTC +2) with the following attachments in English: a CV a short motivation letter a transcript of records Also indicate the preferred starting date and duration of the traineeship. We value authenticity, so please make sure that your motivation letter reflects your own thoughts and experiences. Applications created by using AI are often generic in nature and fail to reflect the applicant’s personal motivation. Please note that if your application appears to be AI-generated, this may have a negative impact on its assessment. Further information Reach out to Director of UniPID Kaisa Kurki by emailing to kaisa.kurki@uef.fi or calling +358 50 330 6154 between 13–14 and 19–20 October, or …

items.desc: Developer Experience / DevEx Location: Bristol / London About Fractile Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world's most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts. The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems. The Role About the Software organisation at Fractile Developer Experience sits within the Software organisation at Fractile, which is responsible for developing a full software stack for our groundbreaking AI inference systems. That's everything from ML compilers, device drivers and systems firmware, application level runtime and ecosystem integrations, ML and compute libraries, great developer tooling and a full portfolio of simulators, through to datacenter scale workload deployment solutions. At Fractile, we know that a fantastic software stack is a critical and central part of any AI inference solution and it sits at the heart of everything we're doing. About the team and role The Developer Experience team at Fractile helps shape how our customers interact with the Fractile inference accelerator. We work across the company to identify, create, and present information on how the system is being used, as well as providing the tooling to help optimise our customers' usage of the system, while keeping a shallow learning curve. As a member of the Developer Experience team you will need to understand the current state of development for inference hardware. You will need to be able to identify what will work well for engineers wanting to identify potential opportunities for performance improvements, while knowing what tooling will fit into an existing LLM engineer's workflow with the minimal amount of disruption and effort. About you We're looking for someone who is self-driven and capable of identifying tooling opportunities, designing those tools, and delivering them in a way which will fit in with an LLM engineer's existing toolset. You will have worked in this area before, possibly as an FDE or at a company that provides inference services using their own models, and have the ability to develop new tools that are designed to be functional and easy to learn and use. Key Requirements Experience with inference frameworks such as JAX and/or PyTorch Experience of software development in Python, Rust, C/C++, or a similar language Experience monitoring and optimising code written in CUDA, ROCm, OpenCL, or similar Experience monitoring and optimising LLM deployments with 50+ billion parameters Experience working with stakeholders across multiple teams What We Offer Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 Days holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment Fractile is seeking to increase the clock speed of global progress, one chip at a time. We've recently raised $220M from investors including Founders Fund and Accel and our most important work lies ahead. Join us! Export controls Our work involves technologies subject to UK, US and other international export control regulations. Certain roles may require additional eligibility checks to ensure compliance with applicable law. We'll be transparent about this throughout the hiring process.

items.desc: Job Description As a Full-Time Analyst in the Data & AI Program at JPMorganChase, you will drive impact by building end-to-end data, analytics, and artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that translate business objectives into measurable outcomes for clients and customers. Working alongside global experts in collaborative teams, you will design scalable data platforms and pipelines, develop production-ready models, create intuitive dashboards, and help support strong data governance, privacy, and compliance. Leveraging modern tools (e.g., AWS, CoPilot, Snowflake, DataBricks, LLM) you will integrate diverse data, run experiments tied to key performance indicators, and deliver actionable insights. This program offers hands-on experience, mentorship, and training in a supportive, innovation-focused environment—positioning you to contribute to high-impact initiatives across the firm while building a strong foundation in data and artificial intelligence. About The Program As a Full-Time Analyst in the Data & AI Program at JPMorganChase, you will help drive transformation by combining technical skills, business context, and modern tools to deliver real-world impact for our clients and customers. You will collaborate with global experts to develop end-to-end data and AI solutions and contribute to positive change for the diverse communities we serve. You will receive mentorship, training, and support as you build your career in a culture where we value your ideas and help you grow. We will be filling our classes on a rolling basis. We strongly encourage you to submit your application as early as possible before job postings close. Job Responsibilities Build intelligent systems that power real business outcomes, from machine learning models to generative artificial intelligence and agent-based solutions. Work hands-on with cutting-edge technologies to design, develop, and deploy artificial intelligence capabilities that automate processes and enhance decision-making. Apply data, statistics, and modeling to solve complex problems and generate actionable insights. Develop predictive models, test hypotheses, and analyze trends to help teams make smarter, data-driven decisions. Support data governance, risk management, and data standards to help ensure data is secure, trusted, and ready for artificial intelligence use. Implement controls, improve data quality, and enable frameworks and structures that make solutions safe, scalable, and effective Collaborate in agile teams and contribute ideas from day one in a culture that supports your growth and impact. Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Be pursuing a Bachelor's degree or a 5th-year Master's degree with an expected graduation between January 2027 and September 2027. Have graduated by September 2027 and be available to start full-time employment in September 2027. Have streams and specializations in Computer Science, Information Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, or related field Oral and written fluency in English language is essential Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills Demonstrates strong knowledge of machine learning, data science principles, including prompt engineering, with experience handling large, complex datasets. Use programming languages such as SQL and Python. Use data & artificial intelligence tools (e.g., AWS, CoPilot, Snowflake, DataBricks, LLM). Understand data management and governance, including data platforms, pipelines, models, taxonomies, metadata, lineage, privacy, and regulatory compliance. Apply strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills to design experiments and deliver measurable outcomes (e.g., key performance indicators, uplift, return on investment). Communicate clearly in writing and verbally to translate technical work for business stakeholders and collaborate across agile, cross-functional teams. Translate business objectives into testable hypotheses and analytical plans, develops models and experiments, and communicates actionable recommendations to stakeholders. Locations you may join: London Glasgow About Us At JPMorganChase, Data & AI sits at the core of how we operate, innovate, and serve our clients. We harness advanced data, analytics, and artificial intelligence to drive better decisions, power products, and deliver real-world impact across global markets. Our teams work at the intersection of technology and business—developing end-to-end data platforms, applying machine learning, and generating insights that shape everything from client experiences to risk management and operations. From building scalable data infrastructure to deploying AI models and visualization tools, we transform complex data into actionable intelligence. Data & AI at JPMorganChase is not experimental—it is embedded across the firm. Our capabilities support critical functions including trading, fraud prevention, wealth management, and …

items.title: Associate AI Engineer
items.card: you will work closely with users across Cambio to identify problems, build practical AI-powered solutions, and help those solutions become part of everyday work. You'll be embedded in one of our business teams while also being part of a virtual AI engineering team where you'll receive coaching, mentorship and technical guidance from experienced AI engineers. This role is designed for people early in their careers
items.desc: Cambio is one of the Nordics' leading suppliers in e-health with a comprehensive offering for the entire health and care chain. Our e-health solutions supports health care professionals in their daily work and offer patients safer and more easily accessible care. We are proud to be an important part of Swedish healthcare. We are growing continuously and now have about 1000 employees in several countries. The position Imagine starting your career by helping hundreds of colleagues work smarter through AI. As an Associate AI Engineer, you will work closely with users across Cambio to identify problems, build practical AI-powered solutions, and help those solutions become part of everyday work. You'll be embedded in one of our business teams while also being part of a virtual AI engineering team where you'll receive coaching, mentorship and technical guidance from experienced AI engineers. This role is designed for people early in their careers who are passionate about technology, curious about AI, and excited by the idea of turning problems into working solutions. You don't need to be an expert. You need to be eager to learn, comfortable experimenting, and motivated to build things that create real value. What You'll Be Doing Discover Work closely with colleagues and users to understand problems and opportunities. Learn how different parts of Cambio work and identify where AI can make a difference. Turn ideas and pain points into concrete solutions. Build Prototype and build AI-powered applications, agents, automations and workflows. Use AI as a core tool throughout the development process. Test solutions early and improve them based on user feedback. Deliver Help bring solutions into everyday use. Measure the impact of what you build. Share learnings and successful patterns with colleagues. Grow Learn from experienced Product Engineers and AI specialists. Develop your technical skills through hands-on projects. Become increasingly independent in delivering valuable solutions. About You You are curious by nature and enjoy figuring out how things work, whether it's a business process, a technical challenge, or a new AI capability. You like turning ideas into practical solutions and are comfortable working closely with users and stakeholders to understand their needs. You have experience building software, applications, automations, or digital solutions through work, studies, or your own projects. AI is already part of how you learn, experiment, and create, and you're excited about applying it to solve real-world problems. Most importantly, you are eager to learn, take initiative, and continuously develop your skills. As you'll collaborate with colleagues across the organization and help shape solutions that support nearly 1,000 employees, you communicate clearly and confidently in both Swedish and English. Technical Experience We believe you have experience in several of the following areas: Software development through studies, work, side projects or personal initiatives. Building applications, automations or digital solutions using AI tools. Using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude Code or similar. Working with APIs, scripting, low-code/no-code platforms or modern development tools. Taking an idea from concept to something real people can use. Experience in any of the following areas is considered a plus: A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering or a related field. Experience from healthcare, health tech or other highly regulated industries. Experience building AI agents, assistants or workflow automations. Experience from customer-facing roles such as support, consulting or product development. Experience taking an application, automation or digital product from idea to real-world use. Place of employment : Stockholm or Linköping Scope : Full-time, hybrid work model (three days per week in-office) Form of employment: Permanent employment, 6 months trial period Additional Information: The role involves access to sensitive information, therefore a background check will be conducted on the final candidate. We review applications and conduct interviews on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible via the link. We look forward to receiving your application! CAMBIO- FOR A HEALTHIER TOMORROW Welcome to a company where healthcare is improved every day. Here you will work with leading technology in a collaborative, trusting and empowering environment where your contribution will be appreciated and celebrated. In our caring culture you will have the opportunity to pursue different paths of professional growth. Seize the opportunity to do the most important work of your life . Read more about us here! A healthier tomorrow also means taking care of those who make it possible - explore our employee benefits Learn more about our recruitment process here Are you interested in Cambio but you don’t feel that this position is the …

items.desc: About Euphoric Euphoric builds AI-first employee benefits administration software for the world's largest and most prestigious employers. We spun out of Peppy Health - a fast-growing, Series B digital health company serving major global employers - in May 2025 to tackle what we believe is the biggest untouched opportunity in enterprise software. Global employers spend $3–5 trillion on benefits every year. It's their second-largest cost after payroll — yet the entire category is still running on legacy systems and outdated assumptions. AI-first startups have almost completely overlooked it, and incumbents, constrained by decades-old tech stacks, simply can't move fast enough. This isn't just a gigantic market, it's genuine tech for good. Smarter administration, deeper insight into what employees actually need, and clearer communication have the power to directly improve the everyday lives, wellbeing, and financial security of millions of people worldwide. We're a sharp, high-velocity team obsessed with building category-defining technology and partnering with exceptional people who want their work to truly matter. We closed significant seed rounds in October 2025 & May 2026 and are building from a position of strength with a long cash runway. We've already secured contracts with several of the world's largest enterprises and are now preparing for rapid expansion as we scale the platform globally. The Role We're looking for a Forward-Deployed AI Product Associate to bring their ambition, technical curiosity, and product instinct to our high-powered team - helping us build the world's first lovable, AI-native benefits platform. You'll have real ownership, big targets, and a chance to shape both the product and the company from the ground up. We care less about traditional career paths and more about raw talent, bias for action, and the energy you bring to hard problems. What You’ll Do: No two days are the same, but as a Forward-Deployed AI Product Associate you can expect to: Sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and client delivery - owning the end-to-end implementation of our platform for enterprise clients, from onboarding through to live deployment — including visiting clients on-site, with the opportunity for global travel as we scale internationally. Go deep on document analysis, extraction, and data input — foundational work for our platform's AI learning that demands intellectual rigour on the front lines. Design and refine AI evaluation frameworks, engineer prompts across our product suite, and track product analytics on live production data. Build internal agentic AI workflows that automate lengthy or manual processes. Get hands-on with cutting-edge tools like Claude Code, Cursor, and custom MCP integrations, with the freedom to explore new AI tooling that drives product innovation. As these tools evolve, the line between engineering, product, and design will blur — we want you to be at the frontier of that shift. Gather first-hand insight from both benefits administrators and employees at global enterprises, and feed that directly back into the product to shape what we build next. Work closely with our Chief Product Officer, Co-founder, AI Product Lead, engineers, and Product Associates at every stage of development - bridging the gap between what customers need and what gets built. Skills & Experience Academic Excellence: You're a top graduate from a prestigious university, with an exceptional academic record that reflects your intellectual rigour and curiosity. AI Passion and Knowledge: You have a genuine, intense interest in AI. You’ll be asked to share your latest AI projects and explain how you stay on the cutting edge, as this is vitally important to the role. Prior entrepreneurial experience is highly valued. Continuous Learner: You have a voracious appetite for knowledge. What We Look For: We’re a great bunch but we have some Euphoric cultural non-negotiables. To do well here you will: Thrive in fast-paced, feedback-rich environments. Take your work seriously, but not yourself. Be proactive, playful, and deeply curious. Want to build something that matters. Be willing to “do what it takes.” What You’ll Get: Salary between £50k-£70k Meaningful early-stage equity Hybrid or in-person setup out of our office in Central London - the choice is entirely yours. Apple MacBook and unlimited access to AI tooling of your choice. Private healthcare via Vitality. 5% employer pension contribution 25 days holiday per year, plus bank holidays. Exceptional career growth

items.desc: ABOUT THE PROJECT An R&D project extending an industrial equipment monitoring system with AI, to detect unusual behaviour that fixed rules and thresholds cannot capture, including on complex equipment such as pumps and motors in rolling mills. A working prototype already stores data, trains models and runs predictions. The goal is to develop it and validate it on real industrial cases, focusing on: ▪ Anomaly detection on large volumes of sensor data. ▪ Production context , so normal variations (e.g. higher current draw when processing harder material) don't trigger false alarms. ▪ Explainable alerts that point to the relevant signals and, potentially, use an LLM with technical documentation to suggest likely causes. ▪ Wider analysis over time, from time series to logs, images and video. THE ROLE We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer with strong software development skills to work on an existing prototype and test solutions on real industrial data. The role combines application development with data analysis and model experimentation. As this is an R&D project, a significant part of the work is experimenting, comparing methods and deciding, based on results, which approach fits each type of equipment. The collaboration is a B2B type of contract and it's estimated until April 2027. RESPONSIBILITIES ▪Understand the existing prototype's codebase, extend it with new features, and keep it clean, testable and maintainable. ▪ Build processing pipelines for sensor data: synchronising multiple signals, handling missing values and noise, time windows, high-frequency sampling. ▪ Select, implement and compare statistical and machine learning methods for anomaly detection, including on unlabelled data or data that already contains anomalies. ▪ Model the production context (materials, operating regimes) to separate normal variations from real equipment issues. ▪ Define the validation methodology: train/test splits without leakage, relevant metrics, tracking false alarms and missed anomalies. ▪ Develop explainability mechanisms that identify the signals behind an alert and present results in a form useful to operators. ▪ Integrate training and inference into the application, ensuring experiment reproducibility and model versioning. ▪ Explore, together with the team, the use of LLMs and technical documentation to suggest possible causes of an alert. ▪ Document experiments and results as a basis for the project's technical decisions. REQUIREMENTS ▪ Hands-on experience as a Machine Learning Engineer, production-oriented Data Scientist, or Software Engineer with delivered ML projects. ▪ Strong software development skills, preferably in Python: structured, tested code, version control (Git), working in an existing codebase. ▪ Experience with multivariate time series: synchronisation, missing values, noise, time windows, high-frequency data. ▪ Knowledge of statistical and ML anomaly detection methods, and the ability to choose and compare them based on the data, including in unsupervised settings. ▪ Experience processing large data volumes efficiently without loading the full dataset into memory (chunked processing, storage formats suited to time series). ▪ Solid understanding of model evaluation: validation strategies for temporal data, avoiding data leakage, balancing false alarms against missed anomalies. ▪ Experience with model explainability techniques and presenting results to non-technical users. ▪ Experience integrating models into applications: training and inference pipelines, experiment reproducibility, model versioning. ▪ Analytical mindset and appetite for experimentation, suited to an R&D environment. NICE TO HAVE ▪ Integrating LLMs via API and using RAG to query technical documentation. ▪ Experience with logs, images or multimodal models. ▪ Experience in condition monitoring, predictive maintenance or industrial processes. ▪ Using AI coding tools, while reviewing and understanding the generated code.

items.desc: AI & Business Solutions Graduate Reports to: Deputy Chairman Location: Shanly Group, Beaconsfield Level: Graduate / entry level About Shanly Group Shanly Group brings together Shanly Homes, a residential developer building high-quality homes across the South East; Sorbon Estates, which manages a commercial property portfolio including marinas; and the Shanly Foundation, the Group’s registered charity. The businesses are varied, and so are the problems we want this role to help solve. About the role We are looking for a bright, technically capable graduate to help us use AI, automation and emerging technology to make our business simpler and more efficient. Working under the direction of the Deputy Chairman, you will spend time across the Group understanding how things are currently done and identifying where they could be done better. You will then help design, build and deliver working solutions. Projects will be agreed and prioritised with the Deputy Chairman in line with the Group’s business priorities. This is a hands-on role. We want someone who enjoys making things work, not just recommending what could be done. It is not a traditional IT role, and it is not a web development role. But the solutions you help build will be used by busy colleagues, many of whom are not technical, so they must be easy and intuitive to use as well as effective. A key part of the role will be looking at existing processes and software and asking whether there is now a simpler or better way. That might mean automating repetitive tasks, improving how information is captured and shared, connecting existing systems, or building something ourselves using tools already available in the business rather than relying on standalone third-party software. You will work with other stakeholders, such as our IT Manager and external IT partners, so that what you build is secure, supportable and fits with our wider technology plans. What you will do Spend time with teams across the business to understand their processes, systems and day-to-day challenges. Identify repetitive, manual or inefficient processes that could be improved through AI or automation. Help design, build and test practical solutions, including automated workflows, AI agents, apps and other tools, in line with agreed business priorities. Make sure solutions are intuitive and well-designed from the user’s point of view, testing them with the people who will use them and refining them based on feedback. Help to maximise use of the technology we already have, particularly Microsoft 365, Copilot, Power Automate and the wider Power Platform. Help connect information and processes that currently sit across different systems, including through APIs. Research emerging AI tools and assess their practical strengths and limitations. Explore whether existing software can be simplified, consolidated or replaced. Trial ideas on a small scale before wider rollout. Work with external IT and technology specialists where more technical expertise is needed. Document solutions clearly so that they can be understood, supported and maintained by the business. Help colleagues understand and adopt new tools and ways of working. Keep up to date with developments in AI and identify those with a practical application for the Group. What we are looking for This is a graduate role, so we do not expect extensive professional experience. We do expect a serious interest in AI and technology, and evidence that you have acted on it. If you are genuinely interested in this area, you will almost certainly have built things already, whether through your studies, a placement, a job, or projects connected to your own hobbies and interests. They do not need to have had a commercial purpose. What matters is that you can show us what you built, why, and how you went about it. The strongest candidates will be able to point to several examples. Essential A degree or equivalent experience demonstrating strong analytical and problem-solving ability. A serious personal or academic interest in AI, automation and technology. Demonstrable hands-on experience of working with some or all of the following: building AI agents or automated workflows; no-code or low-code development; Microsoft Power Automate or the wider Power Platform (for example Power Apps or Copilot Studio); APIs and connecting different systems. Confident use of generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot or similar. An eye for usability, and an understanding that good solutions need to be simple and intuitive for the people using them. The ability to take an idea from investigation through to a working solution. Good communication skills, including the ability to explain technical ideas simply and to speak confidently with people at all levels of the business. A practical, commercial mindset, recognising that the simplest solution is often better than the most technically sophisticated one. Good organisation and attention to detail. …
