think in primitives, patterns, and systems Already use AI to automate work or build LLM-powered workflows Comfortable translating customer ambiguity into crisp technical solutions Able to unblock yourself through learning, experimentation, and AI tools Thrive under tight deadlines, high expectations, and minimal process You'll have a solid grasp of our tech stack: Python, React / NextJS, Fast API, MongoDB, Redis Nice-to-Haves Built or orchestrated multi-step LLM or agentic workflows Experience with financial workflows (credit, investment, ESG, risk) Infra/ops exposure (Kubernetes, Terraform, Azure/AWS, CI/CD, observability) Experience at early-stage startups Built internal frameworks, tooling, or templates used by multiple teams Experience with evals, guardrails, or workflow orchestration systems Job Responsibilities Take ambiguous workflow requests and turn them into scoped, architected, implemented, and deployed multi-agent systems Build reliable multi-step, multi-agent workflows used in production by financial institutions Own reliability, latency, success metrics, and customer adoption Work directly with customer engineering teams to deliver smooth deployments Convert bespoke workflows into reusable platform primitives and components Build orchestration logic, tools, templates, and pipelines used across engineering pods Ship V1s in days, operate with high agency, tight prioritisation, and strong defaults Identify patterns across customers and turn them into reusable systems Influence architecture and direction of core platform components Use AI for coding, testing, debugging, workflow design, and documentation Build evals, safety nets, and AI-native engineering workflows Job Benefits We are an office-first company and expect regular in-person collaboration as part of this role. items.desc: Agentic Systems Designer Full-time · Copenhagen, Lisbon, or remote within the EU Applicants must currently reside in the EU. NORDFY works with architecture, AEC and creative companies to build AI capability their teams can own. We are part of Verka Collective, a group of independent European design practices. We’re hiring someone to own the architecture and delivery of internal agents, integrations and systems across those practices. “Designer” here means designing how software systems work and building them through to production. You’ll make decisions about architecture, reliability and where human judgment belongs, then deliver systems another team can operate. What you’ll work on: • Build internal systems that help firms run their operations with AI. • Connect tools, data and models through integrations and agentic workflows. • Make systems reliable when third-party APIs are inconsistent, documentation is thin or problems only appear in production. • Design retries, state management and delivery guarantees appropriate to the work. • Decide where people stay involved and how systems should fail safely. • Document the architecture, put backup and recovery arrangements in place, and hand over the work so it remains operable without you. What you need to bring: • Experience building and operating consequential production systems. • A working understanding of idempotency, retries, state and delivery guarantees, including what exactly-once execution actually requires. • Experience with MCP servers, agent orchestration or long-running autonomous workflows. You do not need experience with all three. • Regular use of agentic coding tools, with a clear understanding of their capabilities and limits. • The ability to explain architecture decisions and write software other people can maintain. • Confidence taking responsibility for a substantial area of work. Useful additional experience • Working with architecture, AEC or other design-led organisations. • Delivering software to professional-services firms. • Working across languages and markets in the Nordics or DACH region. Working at NORDFY: You’ll join a small senior team with direct access to the collective’s leadership. You’ll work with frontier AI tools, have time to develop your practice, and take part in gatherings with teams across the collective, including AI Coordinators and Champions. Salary is agreed individually, based on the role, experience and local market. Employment is arranged locally, directly or through an Employer of Record. Contract terms, benefits and pension arrangements follow the rules of your country of residence. How to apply: Tell us about the least reliable system you have ever made reliable, and how you did it. Send your application to info@nordfy.dk with “Agentic Systems Designer” in the subject line. Include a GitHub profile, a write-up or other evidence that shows how you approach these problems. We need to see evidence of delivered work. A general cover letter alone won’t give us enough to assess your application.

items.desc: If you are here, it is because you know that we are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer . indigo.ai is the leading platform in Italy for building next-generation AI Agents that transform the way companies communicate with their customers. Since 2016, we’ve been helping enterprises in industries such as finance, insurance, utilities, retail, and e-commerce to evolve their Customer Experience through conversational AI. We don’t just “sell software”: we enable a shift in how organizations interact with people, automating millions of conversations every year, reducing operational costs, improving conversion rates, and creating more personalized, scalable, and compliant customer journeys. Backed by a recent €10 million investment from Azimut, we are on a mission to take this technology global. This is a unique opportunity to join a well-funded, highly ambitious team and play a direct role in shaping the future of enterprise AI. To make this happen, we are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to support our Chief AI Officer in designing AI Agents and taking them live, side by side with our clients in Spain. What are we looking for? We are looking for a Forward Deployed AI Engineer to take our AI Agents from design to production, working side by side with our enterprise clients. We are growing our team in Madrid to support new projects in the Iberian market, and the role reports directly to our Chief AI Officer. It is a cross-functional role for a T-shaped profile, between technology and business: your value lies in deciding how an assistant should work (its architecture, flows and behavior) and in making it work with real users and traffic, while Product and AI tools handle low-level configuration and detailed debugging. With the right fit, the role can grow into delivery leadership: defining how we design AI Agents, mentoring new hires and helping build our AI implementation team as we expand in Europe. Key Responsibilities: Design the agentic architecture: decide how to frame each problem (for example, a router agent that hands off to specialized agents) and where gates and guardrails are needed, such as user recognition, queue management and handover to a human agent. You design the structure before building it, for both chat and voice, which follow the same logic. Keep hallucinations under control: define the boundaries of each agent, deciding when it answers, when it retrieves information and when it must say “I don’t know” instead of making up a plausible answer. Translate business goals into agent behavior: turn objectives such as “reduce waiting times” or “never share internal details with the user” into precise rules, flows and guardrails. Take care of the user experience: design tone, messages and channel adaptation (voice, chat, messaging) from the end user’s point of view, because perceived quality is part of the solution. Build with AI: use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code to build, read and validate what they produce, framing problems so that the tools execute them well and judging when the output is correct. Go live and iterate: monitor performance and KPIs, handle edge cases, check the quality and reliability of answers and keep improving the solution after go-live. You own the outcome. Guide clients’ decisions: act as the point of reference who helps clients make the right choices and turns them into implementation. Coordinate the right people: work closely with Product, DevOps, Customer Success and Technical Support to stay aligned, manage dependencies and remove blockers quickly. Enable clients: provide training, documentation and ongoing support so that clients can manage and optimize their AI Agents on their own. You will need: Agentic architecture judgment: you can design an agentic system end to end (framing it, deciding where and how to use tools and context retrieval, designing the flows) and explain why you made those choices. Reliability control: you know how to recognize and prevent hallucinations by setting boundaries and understanding when an agent should retrieve, answer or admit it doesn’t know. You treat answer quality as a design responsibility. A functional, product and UX mindset: you design from the end user’s point of view and act as a bridge between business and solution, translating a goal into concrete agent behavior. Hands-on use of AI to build: you use agentic coding tools such as Claude Code every day to move faster, framing problems for the tools to execute and reading and judging the output well enough to work autonomously. We don’t expect you to write production code yourself. Proven experience designing and running virtual assistants, agents or AI products, or a concrete portfolio of things you built yourself. Your track record matters more than your degree: in your application, tell us about an assistant, agent or flow you designed, the decisions you made, where it could fail and how you made it reliable. Excellent written and verbal …

items.desc: About Us: ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges. We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. Collaborative, entrepreneurial and dedicated to problem solving, we bring the step change our customer need to sustain innovation. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. This is an opportunity for you to build the organisation from the ground up, use your voice to drive change and help transform organisations and problem domains. Role This role sits apart from our traditional cloud security engineering positions: it is centred on AI and agentic systems rather than infrastructure alone. You will test and secure AI use cases across an account, not one application or user set, building a broad, first-hand picture of how ClearRoute should approach testing, risk and governance for agentic AI. You will work across teams rather than within one delivery stream, owning the question of what "good" looks like for agentic security testing across the account, and helping ClearRoute build a repeatable, defensible approach that other engagements can adopt. The role is deliberately hands-on in its first phase: you will implement and run the testing yourself, so you understand the detail before asking anyone else to follow it. As that practice matures, the role shifts toward governance across the account, training and upskilling existing security engineers to implement and automate the strategy themselves, so agentic security testing becomes something the wider team can run, not something that depends on one person. Key Responsibilities Agentic Red Teaming & Adversarial Testing: Design and run red-team exercises against AI agents and agentic workflows, probing for prompt injection (direct and indirect), tool-call and argument manipulation, agent hijacking, memory/context poisoning, and privilege or credential escalation. Build repeatable evaluation approaches for non-deterministic systems, including how to test, measure and report against outputs that vary run to run. Define and own an approach for detecting, measuring and mitigating hallucinations in agent and LLM outputs, distinct from traditional functional-testing methods. Agentic Governance & Risk: Own agentic AI risk identification and governance across an account, not one application: build the risk view, the test strategy and the tooling recommendations that other teams can reuse. Map findings and controls to recognised external frameworks (for example OWASP's agent-specific risk taxonomy, NIST's AI Risk Management Framework Govern function, and MITRE ATLAS) so ClearRoute's approach is defensible and auditable, Distinguish and design controls for internal versus external (client-facing) views of agent behaviour, including how outputs are reviewed, sanitised or gated before release. Define rollback and incident-response procedures for agentic systems, so a compromised or misbehaving agent can be safely withdrawn or reverted. Track emerging regulatory expectations relevant to AI testing (for example EU AI Act provisions on adversarial and robustness testing) and translate them into practical test and governance requirements. Cross-Team & Organisational Scope: Work across delivery teams and accounts, acting as the connective view on agentic security testing rather than being embedded in one application or team Recommend and help select tooling for agentic security testing and monitoring, and advise delivery teams on how to embed it into their workflow Represent ClearRoute's agentic security posture with internal stakeholders and, where relevant, clients Train and upskill existing security engineers over time so agentic testing and automation becomes a capability the wider team owns, not one specialist Required Skills & Experience Must Have: Hands-on experience red-teaming or adversarially testing LLM or agentic AI systems, including prompt injection, jailbreaking and tool-misuse scenarios Practical understanding of how to test non-deterministic systems and how to detect, quantify and mitigate hallucination Working knowledge of agentic-AI-specific risk frameworks and taxonomies, such as OWASP's agent risk categories and MITRE ATLAS Experience with the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, including prompt injection and system-prompt-leakage risk categories Experience designing or applying an AI governance framework (for example NIST's AI Risk Management Framework) to translate identified risks into organisational controls Ability to operate across accounts and teams, building test strategy and tooling recommendations that generalise …

items.desc: Das Fraunhofer IPA gehört zu den weltweit führenden Einrichtungen der angewandten Forschung in der Robotik. Im Forschungsbereich »Automatisierung und Robotik« entwickeln wir mit über 70 Mitarbeitenden Roboterlösungen und unterstützende Technologien und ermöglichen so gemeinsam mit Unternehmen den wirtschaftlichen Robotereinsatz in Anwendungsbereichen wie Produktion, Intralogistik, Recycling, Bauwesen und Landwirtschaft. Die Forschungsgruppe »Handling and Dexterity« entwickelt innovative Handhabungslösungen für den Einsatz in Produktion und Intralogistik und befasst sich mit Schlüsseltechnologien wie Objektwahrnehmung, Greifplanung, Imitation Learning sowie simulationsgestütztem Machine Learning. Am Standort Heilbronn entwickeln wir mit Unterstützung der Dieter Schwarz Stiftung über 10 Jahre das Thema KI-basierte Robotik, wobei wir neue Ansätze der Physical AI und Embodied AI für mobile Manipulatoren und Humanoid Roboter erforschen, die zukünftig auch in Anwendungen weiterlernen. Ein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Entwicklung lernfähiger reaktiver Roboterfähigkeiten, die durch Demonstrationen, Teleoperation und multimodale Sensordaten erlernt werden können. Hierfür kommen moderne Verfahren des Robot Learning zum Einsatz, die Informationen aus Bild-, Kraft- und Zustandsdaten kombinieren und eine robuste Interaktion mit realen, teils komplexen und dynamischen, Umgebungen ermöglichen. Die entwickelten Roboterfähigkeiten werden als wiederverwendbare Robot Skills in vorhandene Skill-Bibliotheken integriert und in Anwendungen der Intralogistik und Handhabung erprobt. Aufbauend darauf erforschen wir, wie intelligente Planungs- und Agentensysteme diese Skills automatisch auswählen, parametrieren und zu komplexen Arbeitsabläufen kombinieren können. Die entwickelten Methoden werden auf realen mobilen Manipulatoren und humanoiden Robotern in Industrienahen Anwendungen mit hoher Variantenvielfalt umgesetzt und evaluiert. Weitere Details über den Forschungsbereich und das Zentrum in Heilbronn erhalten Sie über folgende Links: https://lnkd.in/p/eTBjMamu , https://lnkd.in/p/eCcpdwP9 , https://lnkd.in/p/eCtFRY6j , https://www.ipa.fraunhofer.de/de/aktuelle-forschung/roboter--und-assistenzsysteme/intralogistik- und-materialfluss.html#1 Was Sie bei uns tun Sie erforschen neuartige Ansätze des Robot Learning für mobile Manipulatoren und humanoide Roboter und entwickeln robuste, generalisierbare Motor Skills für komplexe Handhabungsaufgaben. Sie entwickeln lernfähige Roboterskills mit Imitation Learning, Learning from Demonstration, Behavioural Cloning und weiteren modernen Lernverfahren auf Basis multimodaler Bild-, Kraft-/Momenten- und Roboterdaten. Sie gestalten den vollständigen Robot-Learning-Zyklus – von Teleoperation und Datenerfassung über Modelltraining und Simulation bis zur Evaluation auf realen Robotersystemen. Sie entwickeln Roboterfähigkeiten, die auch bei wechselnden Objekten, Umgebungsbedingungen und Prozessvarianten robust, adaptiv und reaktiv arbeiten. Sie bauen auf einer über viele Jahre gemeinsam mit Kolleg*innen entwickelten Bibliothek wiederverwendbarer Roboterfähigkeiten auf, erweitern diese um lernbasierte Skills und kombinieren Fähigkeiten für neue Anwendungen. Darauf aufbauend erforschen Sie, wie Planungs- und Agentensysteme Roboterskills automatisch auswählen, parametrieren und zu längeren Handlungsabläufen kombinieren. Sie setzen Ihre Verfahren auf realen mobilen Manipulatoren und humanoiden Robotern Was Sie mitbringen Sie verfügen über ein sehr gut abgeschlossenes Masterstudium in Robotik, technischer Kybernetik, Mechatronik, Automatisierungstechnik, Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung mit Robotikbezug. Sie haben praktische Erfahrung mit realen Robotersystemen, z. B. nachweisbar durch Studienarbeit/Abschlussarbeit o.Ä.; Erfahrung mit mobilen Manipulatoren oder humanoiden Robotern ist besonders willkommen. Sie verfügen über praktische Kenntnisse in Robot Learning bzw. Machine Learning für Robotik und haben Lernverfahren idealerweise bereits auf realer Hardware angewandt. Sie bringen gute Grundlagen in Robotik mit, insbesondere in Kinematik, Dynamik, Regelung, Bewegungsplanung oder Manipulation. Sie verfügen über sehr gute Programmierkenntnisse in Python und Erfahrung mit moderner Softwareentwicklung; Kenntnisse in C++ und ROS/ROS2 sind von Vorteil. Erfahrungen in einem oder mehreren Bereichen wie Imitation Learning, Learning from Demonstration, Reinforcement Learning, Diffusion-/Flow-basierte Policies, VLA Models, Robot Foundation Models oder Sim-to-Real sind besonders willkommen. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse setzen wir voraus; Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil. Was Sie erwarten können Sie arbeiten an aktuellen Forschungsfragen in Robot Learning, Physical AI und intelligenter Manipulation und setzen Ihre Methoden direkt auf realen Robotersystemen um. Help us Close that gap: the evaluation that tells you it's actually good, the latency and cost envelope that makes it viable, the failure modes you find before players do, and the plumbing that makes it boring to operate. We're not looking for someone who wants to train a frontier model. We're looking for someone who gets unreasonable results out of the ones that exist. We are looking for someone to build and ship: AI features in live games, and the internal tools that give superpowers to Supercellians. items.desc: Descriptif de l'organisation Vous souhaitez donner du sens à votre métier ? Vous avez à cœur de contribuer au développement de l'IA de défense et de participer au renforcement de la souveraineté technologique de la France au service des forces armées ? Vous désirez rejoindre une équipe projet dynamique et agile, animée par un esprit start-up et tournée vers l’excellence opérationnelle ? Rejoignez l’AMIAD. Rattachée au Ministre des armées, l’AMIAD est une entité en en forte croissance qui développe et déploie des solutions d’IA au profit des armées. En lien étroit avec l’ensemble des entités du ministère, elle pilote des projets stratégiques et innovants dans des domaines variés tels que les systèmes d’armes, les opérations, le renseignement, le commandement, le soutien et l’administration. Descriptif du poste Ce stage porte sur la détection de deepfakes audios à partir d’une base de signature des générateurs. Les deepfakes notamment audio posent un problème de sécurité qui motive la production de systèmes de détection. La majorité des systèmes de détection existants reposent sur une classification binaire d'un audio ( deepfake ou non). Afin de comprendre la nature de la menace, il peut être souhaitable d'aller plus loin en caractérisant le système de génération, on appelle cette tâche source tracing [Klein et al., ]. D'autre part, des nouveaux systèmes de génération étant produits très fréquemment, il est souhaitable de pouvoir maîtriser l'ensemble des générateurs reconnus par un système de détection, y compris en ajoutant des générateurs à partir d'exemples, sans besoin de réentraîner l'ensemble du système. Ce stage vise à : Découpler l'ensemble d'attaques pris en compte par le détecteur de l'entraînement du modèle. Une première preuve de concept a été réalisée par [Firc et al., ] avec une tâche de vérification : décider si deux enregistrements audios proviennent du même générateur, potentiellement inconnu. Passer de la tâche de vérification à l'identification du générateur à partir d'une base de signatures de générateurs connus. Pour cela, une première étape consistera à construire une base de générateurs, à partir de corpus en accès libres et de générateurs open source . Une deuxième étape consistera à évaluer la qualité des signatures produites, à la fois en terme de quantité et de diversité des exemples, mais aussi de similarité avec d'autres signatures de la base. Références [Firc et al., ] Firc, A., Chhibber, M., Mishra, J., Singh, V. P., Kinnunen, T., and Malinka, K. Stopa : A database of systematic variation of deepfake audio for open-set source tracing and attribution. Interspeech 2025. [Klein et al., ] Klein, N., Chen, T., Tak, H., Casal, R., and Khoury, E. S ource tracing of audio deepfake systems. Interspeech 2024. Vous disposez de compétences en apprentissage automatique, deep learning , traitement de la parole et pytorch . Vous avez des connaissances en anglais. items.desc: Full-Stack Engineer We are looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join our Natural Language Processing team at Neurotechnology. About The Opportunity Neurotechnology is a developer of high-precision algorithms and software based on deep neural networks and other AI-related technologies. The company was launched in 1990 in Vilnius, Lithuania, with the key idea of leveraging neural network capabilities for various applications, such as biometric person identification, natural language processing (NLP), computer vision, and artificial intelligence. The company's solutions and products have been used in more than 140 countries worldwide. As part of our team, you'll contribute to large-scale projects. Position Overview StockGeist.ai is a financial social-sentiment analytics platform for retail traders, developed within our NLP department. It shows who is being talked about across social media and news, what is spiking unusually, and – uniquely – why, explained in plain English. Behind the dashboard sits a full data pipeline that scrapes social and news sources, runs them through our sentiment models, and serves the results through a real-time web application. As a Full-Stack Engineer, you will work across the entire product rather than a single layer. You'll build and improve dashboard features in a Next.js, React and TypeScript application – ranking views, ticker pages, watchlists, charts, and the sentiment surfaces that make the product distinctive. You'll extend our KeystoneJS, MongoDB and GraphQL backend, including schemas, custom mutations, Stripe billing flows and transactional email. You'll help maintain the Python pipeline that powers everything: scrapers, data processors, DistilBERT sentiment models served via TorchServe, and storage and search in Elasticsearch and Redis. You'll also work with Docker Compose across a small server fleet, monitoring pipeline health and helping keep production stable. StockGeist.ai is a small, hands-on team, which means broad exposure, real ownership of the pieces you take on, and code that reaches real users quickly. Required Qualifications A degree in computer science, software engineering, data science, or equivalent practical experience Solid programming fundamentals in at least one of JavaScript/TypeScript or Python, and genuine willingness to learn the other Understanding of core web concepts: HTTP/REST, JSON, and the basics of how a frontend communicates with a backend Familiarity with databases and the ability to reason about data (SQL or NoSQL; we use MongoDB and Elasticsearch) Comfort with Git and collaborative development Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new tools and techniques Good English, clear communication, and the habit of asking questions when stuck Curiosity about finance, markets, or NLP – expertise is not required, but interest helps Nice To Have Qualifications Experience with React, Next.js, or another modern frontend framework Exposure to GraphQL, Docker, or cloud/Linux server basics Hands-on work with machine learning, NLP, or data pipelines, including coursework or side projects Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Redis, or message-queue and streaming concepts Interest in financial data, trading, or social-media analytics What We Offer Competitive salary and performance bonuses – get rewarded for your skills and hard work with a package that truly reflects your value. Real ownership from day one – your code ships to production fast and reaches real users in your first weeks. Career growth and learning – mentorship from experienced engineers, plus access to top-tier courses and training programs to keep you ahead in the AI & tech game. A broad, modern tech stack – TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node/KeystoneJS, GraphQL, Python, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, Docker, and PyTorch/TorchServe, all in one product. Team events and fun perks – we offer annual company events, team buildings, and game nights encouraging a creative and collaborative atmosphere. Flexibility that works for you – flexible and hybrid work arrangements are available to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Health-related bonuses – private health insurance arrangements available. We're always looking for talented individuals to join our team and encourage you to reach out even if your interests lie in other areas within Neurotechnology. The salary for this position starts at 2200 EUR per month (gross) and is negotiable based on your professional experience and skills. Contact us today. If you are interested, please send your CV to career@neurotechnology.com. Contact us

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Zur Verstärkung der Abteilung "Operationelle Analyse und Studien" in der Organisation "Studien und Simulation" suchen wir für Airbus Defence and Space in den nächsten Monaten in Friedrichshafen einen
 Study Engineer - GenAI & Agentic AI (KI) (d/f/m) 
 Wir entwickeln militärische Simulationsumgebungen für Studien und Forschungsprojekte, welche für Analysen und zum KI-Training verwendet werden. Mittels Machine Learning/Deep Learning Ansätzen entwickeln wir KI-Verfahren zur autonomen Planung und Entscheidungsfindung unter unsicheren Bedingungen und in komplexen operationellen, militärischen Situationen.
 Wir suchen einen "Study Engineer - GenAI & Agentic AI (KI) (d/f/m)", der uns bei der Übertragung der Ergebnisse der akademischen Forschung auf reale Systeme unterstützt. Du arbeitest in unserer agilen Studienabteilung an interessanten Studien- und Forschungsprojekten der Bundeswehr, NATO, sowie Europäischen Union im Bereich Sicherheit und Verteidigung.
 Respekt, Teamwork und Kreativität sind die Schlüsselwerte unserer Abteilung. Bei uns findest du das richtige Umfeld, um deine innovativen Ideen voranzutreiben und in die Realität umzusetzen. 
 Dein Standort 
 Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg.
 Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld.
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Technische Leitung in der Entwicklung und Erprobung von KI-Ansätzen zur autonomen Planung und Entscheidungsfindung im militärischen Umfeld
 Verantwortung für die Umsetzung von einer Studie mit einem kleinen Studienteam in Zeit, Kosten und Qualität
 Vorbereitung und Durchführung von Kundenpräsentationen und Besprechungen
 Erstellung von Software Architekturen und sowie von Agentische KI-Frameworks auf modernen Container/Kubernetes Umgebungen und Verteilsystemen
 Führung des technischen Austauschs mit anderen Fachabteilungen und Projektpartnern (Industrie, wissenschaftliche Institute)
 Technische Angebotsleitung für ein/e Studie/Projekt (Scope, Zeit, Kosten)
 Praxisnahe Umsetzung und Erprobung in Kooperation mit anderen Fachabteilungen sowie industriellen und wissenschaftlichen Partnern (Universitäten, Fraunhofer Gesellschaft)
 Erforderliche Qualifikationen 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (Diplom/Master) oder Promotion der Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen mit Vertiefung in Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) und/oder Simulation
 Du verfügst über gute praktische Programmiererfahrung in Python und entsprechenden sowie Single- und Multi-Agent-Systemen. 
 Solide Erfahrungen im Bereich Simulationsentwicklung / Game Engines mit Python und/oder C++ (oder vergleichbar) wären von Vorteil
 Idealerweise, verfügst Du über gute praktische Erfahrungen im Software-Engineering (u.a. Erstellung von Software-Architekturen);
 Praktische Erfahrung im Umgang mit Container/Kubernetes/Docker Umgebungen und Verteilsystemen (z.B. Ray)
 Sicherer Umgang mit CI/CD-Umgebungen wie z.B. GitHub/Gitlab, PyCharm, Visual Studio, etc. (idealerweise auf Windows und Linux)
 Du hast solide Erfahrungen im Bereich des agilen technischen Führens von Projektteams; gute Kenntnisse im Umgang mit dem ATLASSIAN Toolstack (JIRA, Confluence) sind von Vorteil
 Nationale und internationale Reisebereitschaft
 Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse 
 Bei umfangreicher Erfahrung ist die Übernahme eines größeren Aufgabenspektrums möglich.
 Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur …

items.card: you will design, build, test and deploy AI-powered agents and intelligent automation solutions that help transform the way clinical and corporate services operate. items.desc: We are seeking experienced and innovative AI Agent Developers to join our growing Automation and AI team at Mid and South Essex NHS Foundation Trust. This is a 12-month fixed-term opportunity funded through an approved investment to establish and grow the Trust's internal AI delivery capability. As part of this programme, the Trust has identified an initial pipeline of AI use cases designed to improve productivity, reduce administrative burden and support staff in delivering high-quality patient care. Working with Microsoft Copilot Studio and the wider Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem, you will design, build, test and deploy AI-powered agents and intelligent automation solutions that help transform the way clinical and corporate services operate. From supporting frontline teams with routine administrative activities to helping services access information more effectively, your work will contribute directly to improving the experience of both staff and patients. This role forms part of a newly established nine-person multidisciplinary team responsible for delivering end-to-end AI solutions. There are three AI Agent Developer positions available, offering a unique opportunity to join at the beginning of an exciting new journey. Successful candidates will help establish the technical foundations, reusable components and development standards that will shape how AI capabilities are delivered and scaled across the Trust in the years ahead. Be responsible for delivering AI agent solutions throughout the full development lifecycle, from discovery and requirements gathering through to design, build, testing, deployment and ongoing support. Working within the Trust's AI governance framework, develop AI agents, integrations and automated workflows using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Dataverse & related Microsoft technologies. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across clinical, operational and corporate services to understand business challenges, analyse existing processes and identify opportunities where AI can deliver meaningful improvements. You will produce technical specifications, development documentation, testing evidence and deployment records, whilst ensuring solutions meet information governance, cyber security and data protection requirements. Support implementation and release activities, monitor the performance of deployed solutions, investigate issues and deliver enhancements where required. In addition, contribute to the development of reusable components, technical standards and governance artefacts that support the wider Automation and AI function. Work alongside business analysts, solution designers, change specialists & other developers, you will play a key role in establishing a sustainable internal AI capability and delivering innovative solutions that improve the experience of both staff and patients. Our ambition is to deliver excellent local and specialist services, to improve the health and well being of our patients, and provide a vibrant place for staff to develop, innovate and build careers. We aim to make the most of our skills and experiences so we can become the best we can be. As one organisation we will recruit the finest and retain more specialist staff due to more employment opportunities across our Trust For full details about this varied and rewarding role, please see attached job description. We look forward to your application. Please be aware that we reserve the right to close this vacancy early if we receive a suitable number of applications.

This includes development, coding, testing, and debugging. You will also estimate your own tasks and write technical documentation. What you will do: – Implement client features in Unity 6.3 (C#, URP, FMOD) for a cloud-streamed party game, working inside an existing codebase and the client’s SDKs. – Build gameplay and UI features such as challenge modes, trophy and progression screens, and themed content. – Build content authoring tools and add telemetry events. – Integrate audio in FMOD (events and banks) for assets supplied by an audio team. – Fix bugs, support client QA through alpha, regression and release, and prepare documentation. Your Profile: – 3+ years of experience as a Unity game developer. – Worked on at least one shipped game title. – Availability for daily working-hours overlap with Helsinki (EET/EEST). – A passion for video games. – Strong skills in Unity and C#. Unity 6 and URP are a plus. – Able to take a well-defined feature through to delivery, asking questions early when information is missing. – Familiar with performance bottlenecks and ways to resolve them. – Strong debugging skills. – Basic understanding of multiplayer concepts and client-server communication. – Willingness to learn FMOD, the client’s SDKs and the existing tooling. – Good communication skills in English, and good reporting and documentation skills. – Flexibility and ability to adapt to changing priorities. Desirable Pluses: – Experience with multiplayer, party or casual games. – Experience with FMOD or other audio middleware. – Experience building game tools or adding analytics and telemetry. – Familiarity with TypeScript or React. – Solid technical foundation (e.g. Computer Science / Maths Degree or equivalent). We Offer: – Permanently remote position. – An opportunity to experience different pipelines and styles and improve your skills by applying them to a diverse variety of engaging projects. – Be part of an international group with offices worldwide. – Career growth and development. – Working closely with a team of like-minded people in a fast-paced, multicultural environment. – Ongoing training and professional self-improvement opportunities. – Flexible working hours. – An inclusive culture and open communication. At Magic Media, our passion lies in gaming. Our vision is to create and deliver engaging and interesting games for our clients. We can deliver this high-quality work on any platform, whether it be on a console, PC, or mobile. We know that reputation and results go hand-in-hand. Therefore, we work hard to find experts and talented creators to deliver the best results.

items.desc: L'école MIRA est une 'école d'ingénieur·e·s, accréditée par la Commission des Titres d'Ingénieur et reconnue par l'État. Implantée à Ajaccio et à Bastia, elle forme en robotique, intelligence artificielle, cybersécurité, marketing et innovation. Depuis 2010, sa raison d'être est de contribuer au développement économique et social de la Corse en développant les compétences sur l'île et en y ancrant les talents. Son équipe de recherche MIRA-Recherche, travaille sur la robotique interactive : elle étudie les usages pour intégrer l'IA, l'IoT, la robotique dans des interactions humain-machine utiles aux organisations (cobotique, jumeaux numériques, objets connectés). Le contexte Le poste associe des activités d’enseignement, de recherche, de formation professionnelle, d'animation d'ateliers et de représentation de l'école. Les activités pédagogiques. Les activités pédagogiques portent sur les programmes dispensés au sein de l’école. Les activités de recherche s’inscrivent dans le cadre d’un projet financé consacré à la transition des entreprises corses vers l'industrie 5.0 : une industrie qui associe robotique, objets connectés et intelligence artificielle tout en plaçant l'humain au centre des systèmes. Ce que nous proposons Un poste varié qui associe recherche appliquée avec des entreprises partenaires, enseignement en formation initiale et professionnelle, ateliers et représentation de l'école. L'accès au LabTech de MIRA : impression 3D, découpe laser, CNC 4 axes, atelier PCB, matériel IoT et Arduino, réalité virtuelle, drones et rovers. Un travail en réseau avec les partenaires de MIRA-Recherche. Une équipe à taille humaine et un cadre de vie à Ajaccio, entre mer et montagne. Avantages : Mutuelle Formation Vos activités Activités de recherche Concevoir les cellules robotisées des lignes de production : choix des robots et des effecteurs, préhension de produits variés, planification de mouvement, commande, sécurité des installations collaboratives. Intégrer robots mobiles et convoyeurs dans les flux internes, et spécifier le raccordement aux automates et aux systèmes de pilotage de la production. Valider les solutions en conditions réelles avec l’équipe projet. Rédiger les livrables et réaliser des publications. Proposer des sujets de stage et de thèse ; co-encadrer des doctorants, ou les diriger si vous êtes titulaire de l'HDR ; contribuer au montage de nouveaux projets. Activités d'enseignement Assurer des cours, TD, TP et projets dans le programme Ingénieur et dans le parcours CLIC. Encadrer des stages et des missions de fin d'études ; participer aux jurys ; faire évoluer les contenus de robotique industrielle. Intervenir en formation professionnelle auprès des entreprises et des salariés. Vous enseignerez dans le programme Ingénieur en Robotique & Informatique (titre d'ingénieur accrédité CTI, Bac+5), dans le parcours CLIC — Conception Logicielle, IA & Cybersécurité (Bachelor DIAC, Bac+3, et Master of Science BIHAR, Bac+5,), ainsi qu'en formation professionnelle. Les enseignements confiés seront définis avec la Direction des études. Domaines d'enseignement : robotique, automatique, informatique industrielle et robotique mobile, du cycle préparatoire au cycle ingénieur, ainsi que des enseignements scientifiques et de gestion de projet dans le parcours CLIC. Animation d'ateliers Animer des ateliers au LabTech de MIRA et avec les entreprises partenaires, pour des publics étudiants, professionnels et scolaires. Manifestations et représentation Présenter des démonstrations lors des journées portes ouvertes, des salons d'orientation et des événements de l'école. Représenter MIRA dans les salons professionnels, les conférences et auprès des industriels. Diplômes et expérience Doctorat en robotique, automatique ou mécatronique. Une expérience post-doctorale ou industrielle est appréciée. La qualification en tant que maître de conférence est recommandée. Une HDR est un plus. Expérience de projets collaboratifs avec des industriels ; une expérience de projets européens est un atout. Expérience d'enseignement dans le supérieur, de préférence en école d'ingénieurs. Compétences scientifiques et techniques Robotique, modélisation, commande, planification de mouvement, préhension. Cobotique industrielle et robotique mobile : intégration de cellules, robots mobiles autonomes, sécurité des installations collaboratives. Perception pour la robotique : vision 2D/3D appliquée à la saisie et à la localisation. Outils : ROS 2, simulation robotique (Gazebo, Isaac Sim ou équivalent), Python et C++ ; communication avec les automates et les systèmes de production. Qualités attendues Capacité à animer une équipe pluridisciplinaire et à travailler en collaboration avec des industriels. Sens pédagogique, goût pour la transmission auprès d'étudiants de Bac+1 à Bac+5. Autonomie, rigueur, aisance dans la relation avec les entreprises. Français et anglais courants (enseignement possible en anglais).

items.desc: CDI / Gard / YELLOH VILLAGE SIÈGE [CDI] Data & IA Platform Product Owner (H/F) Créé en 2000, Yelloh! Pilotes IA, industrialisation: cadrer les cas d’usage IA, validation avec des prototypes, conception de harnais Yelloh, mesurer la rentabilité, suivre les déploiements et l’amélioration continue. items.desc: Entreprise Établissement d'enseignement supérieur, l'Université d'Orléans est présente sur 7 sites en région Centre Val de Loire. Elle compte 18 000 étudiant.e.s, 141 diplômes nationaux, 2000 personnels et 24 unités de recherche. Lieu d’exercice : Université d’Orléans – Laboratoire d'Economie d'Orléans (LEO) Prise de poste : Poste à pourvoir à partir de janvier 2027 Type de contrat/Statut : Post - doc, temps plein Poste Présentation du service/laboratoire : Le chercheur postdoctoral rejoindra le Laboratoire d'Économie d'Orléans (LEO) et travaillera en collaboration avec des partenaires académiques et institutionnels. L'environnement favorise la recherche de qualité, avec accès à des ressources informatiques performantes, à des données propriétaires en fraude, et à une équipe multidisciplinaire. Le laboratoire soutient la publication scientifique et la participation à des conférences internationales. Une attention particulière sera accordée à la confidentialité des données, à leur usage responsable et à la reproductibilité des résultats. Présentation du projet : La fraude financière génère des coûts majeurs, financiers comme sociaux, et évoluent constamment avec la numérisation et l'émergence de nouveaux canaux de paiement. Le projet développe des méthodes interprétables et opérationnellement pertinentes pour détecter la fraude dans l'assurance, les cotisations sociales et la banque. La recherche s'appuie sur des données volumineuses, hétérogènes et souvent sensibles pour identifier des comportements anormaux, des réseaux suspects et des schémas de fraude émergents, tout en maîtrisant les faux positifs et en préservant l'interprétabilité des modèles. Les travaux porteront sur la modélisation avec déséquilibre de classes, l'apprentissage (semi-)supervisé et sensible au coût, les méthodes de réseau et graphique pour découvrir les schémas coordonnés, ainsi que le développement de modèles explicables et robustes adaptés aux environnements régulés. Une attention particulière sera accordée aux stratégies adaptatives face à l'évolution des techniques frauduleuses et aux dynamiques temporelles. Missions : Nous recherchons un chercheur postdoctoral pour développer des modèles de machine learning et deep learning appliqués à la détection de fraude dans l'assurance, les cotisations sociales et la banque. Le travail comprendra le développement et la mise en œuvre de méthodes interprétables de ML/DL pour la détection d'anomalies, l'analyse et le prétraitement de datasets volumineuses provenant de secteurs financiers divers, des études comparatives des méthodologies de détection, la collaboration avec des partenaires industriels pour valider les modèles sur données propriétaires. Le candidat contribuera à 2-3 publications dans des revues internationales à comité de lecture et à des présentations en conférences majeures. Il disposera d'une autonomie scientifique significative, avec mentorat de chercheurs seniors et accès aux infrastructures du laboratoire. Profil Formation et expérience professionnelle : Doctorat (Ph.D.) en Data Science, Machine Learning, Économétrie, Finance, Statistiques ou dans un domaine connexe ; Expertise en économétrie, machine learning et deep learning, notamment en détection d’anomalies, classification et séries temporelles ; Solides compétences en programmation (Python, R, SQL) ; Expérience en analyse de données volumineuses et en feature engineering, ainsi que connaissance des méthodes d’IA explicable ; Une expérience en analyse de réseau ou de graphique est un atout ; Expérience antérieure avec des données d’assurance, bancaires ou de protection sociale, ainsi que des compétences en français, sont des atouts ; Excellente maîtrise de l’anglais, à l’écrit comme à l’oral. Dossier de candidature : un CV incluant la liste des publications ; une lettre de motivation présentant les intérêts de recherche du candidat et l’adéquation de son profil avec le poste (2 pages maximum) ; un article scientifique représentatif. Dans le cadre du projet mené au sein du département Optique (rattaché à l’unité mixte
items.desc: Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Dans le cadre du projet mené au sein du département Optique (rattaché à l’unité mixte de recherche Lab-STICC CNRS UMR 6285), qui vise à maintenir, faire évoluer et valoriser la plateforme technologique XTREM’IA dédiée aux réseaux optiques passifs de nouvelle génération et à la convergence fixe-mobile (5G/O-RAN), nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement. Sous la responsabilité fonctionnelle de Luiz ANET NETO (Maître de conférences du département Optique) vous assurerez le maintien en condition opérationnelle et l’évolution matérielle et logicielle de la plateforme vers le standard XGS-PON, développerez des activités de Machine Learning et d’apprentissage par renforcement profond pour l’optimisation autonome des réseaux, et participerez à l’industrialisation ainsi qu’à la valorisation des logiciels et des jeux de données ouverts. Consultez la fiche de poste détaillée ✔️ Compétences requises en technologies et architectures d’accès optiques (G-PON, XGS-PON), en programmation Python (et idéalement C/C++), ainsi qu'en environnements de développement logiciel (Git, Docker, CI/CD, Linux). ✔️ Expérience attendue en développement d'algorithmes d'apprentissage automatique ou profond, en architectures SDN (modèles YANG, interfaces RESTCONF) ou en intégration avec des piles 5G/O-RAN. ✔️ Qualités recherchées : rigueur, méthode, pragmatisme, fort esprit d'initiative et curiosité scientifique pour l’expérimentation. Goût prononcé pour le travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire et excellentes qualités de communication orale et écrite en français et en anglais. Titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou d’un master 2 (Bac + 5) en télécommunications, réseaux, informatique ou traitement du signal, ou d’un doctorat (Ph.D.) en réseaux optiques ou intelligence artificielle appliquée aux réseaux. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE : Environnement exceptionnel de travail : Intégrez le campus d'IMT Atlantique à Brest (Plouzané), au cœur d’un pôle d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche d’excellence en technologies de l’information. Écosystème d’innovation stimulant : Collaborez au sein du Lab-STICC (CNRS UMR 6285) et du laboratoire commun Lab’Optic (en partenariat stratégique avec Orange Innovation et l’Institut Foton), au contact direct de chercheurs, de doctorants et de partenaires industriels majeurs. Recherche à forte visibilité : Contribuez à des projets d'envergure nationale et européenne (tels que le PEPR 5G Photonique) et participez activement à la production de publications et de jeux de données ouverts pour la communauté scientifique internationale dans une démarche de science ouverte. LE PLUS : Restauration collective sur place ‍ ️ Offres de loisirs/sport Prise en charge des transports en commun ‍ ️ Forfait mobilité durable (pour le covoiturage ou les trajets en vélo) ‍‍‍ Complément familial Large gamme de prestations sociales ️ Télétravail partiel possible Nombreux congés INDICATIONS DE REMUNERATION : Rémunération indicative : à partir de 33 748€ brut annuel, selon le profil et l’expérience (charges salariales réduites en secteur public). POUR TOUS RENSEIGNEMENTS : Sur le contenu du poste : Luiz ANET NETO – Maître de conférences : luiz.anetneto@imt-atlantique.fr Sur les aspects administratifs/RH: Mélissandre MORVAN – Assistante recrutement rh-recrutement@imt-atlantique.fr Date limite de candidature : 25/10/2026 Début du contrat : 01/01/2027 Entretien : au fil de l’eau Mentions Légales : Nature et durée du contrat : CDD 8 mois de droit public ou détachement sur contrat pour les fonctionnaires Localisation du poste : IMT Atlantique campus de Brest - 655 Av. du Technopôle, 29280 Plouzané À usage interne : Catégorie –métier du poste : II R Catégorie et métier des personnes pouvant postuler : II : D , E, F, G, H, I, R III : J1, J2, K, L, M Les postes offerts au recrutement sont ouverts à toutes et tous avec, sur demande, des aménagements pour les candidates et candidats en situation de handicap Emploi ouvert aux titulaires de la fonction publique et/ou aux personnes contractuelles Toute candidature peut faire l’objet d’une enquête administrative

items.desc: Published on 03.11.2025 Location Hamburg Who we are looking for For our new location in Hamburg, we are looking for IT-savvy and technology-open creative new minds to work in the "Mobility Management & Infrastructure" team - together with the teams at the other locations - on all areas of digitalisation in the public mobility sector with a focus on IT project management & mobility infrastructure for our current and future customers. Main tasks The project engineer at BLIC is partly responsible for a wide range of digitalisation projects in the public transport sector with a focus on technical project management and infrastructure development. This may include tasks in the area of project management of communication technology (radio, WAN, etc.), control technology (monitoring, management), sales technology (ticketing), software architecture, vehicle technology, physical infrastructures, data standardisation, databases, process management, resource planning, quality assurance and documentation for the improvement of local and long-distance public transport. This requires a high degree of openness to technological possibilities and user-centred requirements. For us, the users are the passengers. Your tasks Analysing IT systems, processes and data in public transport Conception/planning of IT systems in public transport Creation of requirements catalogues, specifications and accompanying technical documents Support with procurement and EU tender monitoring and evaluation Sub-project management Technical implementation support for IT systems in public transport Accompaniment of acceptance tests/inspections of IT systems Documentation Your profile Preferably an academic education in the field of IT or engineering with a good university degree and/or very good professional experience in the implementation and application of IT solutions in public transport. High customer orientation and self-confident demeanour Good written and spoken German and English An affinity for mobility, public transport and IT technology for technology by people for people Good analytical skills Willingness to innovate and make decisions Strong communication & team spirit Location: Hamburg If you are interested in this role, we look forward to receiving your detailed application, stating your availability and salary expectations. Your contact person Philipp Bartz E: pb@blic.de Why BLIC? BLIC GmbH, headquartered in Berlin and with offices in Brunswick, Dusseldorf, Hamburg and Leipzig, is an independent consulting company with deep roots in the transport sector and an excellent international reputation. We specialise in IT solutions for public and private transport and their networking. Our services include strategic and technical consulting, advice on financing, procurement and system implementation, project management, operational support and research.

items.desc: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible: Full-Stack Software Developer (m/f/d): TETTRIX project (Full-Time / Part-Time) Location: Frankfurt Employment scope: Full-Time / Part-Time options are available Type of contract: Temporary, initially limited to 2 years Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E11- E13 The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine. The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Centre and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow . The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will develop a web-based, open-access biodiversity mapping and Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) platform that enables reproducible data and modelling workflows and transforms biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. The role combines full-stack software development with biodiversity data integration and close collaboration with researchers and technical partners. Your tasks Develop the platform’s web application end-to-end: SPA frontend (interactive map, species/variable selection, model-run monitoring) and REST API backend. Integrate the application with the PostgreSQL/PostGIS metadata layer and the AWS-side batch and data-lake services. Co-design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform, including a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) covering the full GBIF and OBIS datasets. Develop and operate the hybrid infrastructure, integrating AWS-based services with the institute’s internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, map tiles and APIs), and coordinate the associated technical tasks. Implement map-tile serving, caching and optimise frontend performance. Set up and maintain CI/CD, automated tests and containerised deployment (Docker) in cooperation with central IT. Participate in project and team meetings and coordinate closely with the scientific team on a day-to-day basis. Your profile Degree in Computer Science or comparable practical experience. Solid skills in TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern framework (React, Vue or similar). Backend experience in Python (e.g. FastAPI/Flask) or Node.js; sound REST API design. Experience with SQL/PostgreSQL; PostGIS and web-mapping libraries (MapLibre GL, Leaflet, OpenLayers) are a strong plus. Experience with cloud-based data infrastructure, particularly AWS services (S3, Batch). Knowledge of columnar data storage and lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask). Experience with data pipelines, batch processing and the integration of large-scale datasets. Knowledge of hybrid infrastructure architectures and the integration of cloud-based and on-premises services. Experience with Docker, Git and CI/CD. Very good command of English. Willingness to work on site in Frankfurt (up to 40% remote work is possible). Desirable skills Familiarity with open-access biodiversity databases such as the Global Biodiversity Information Facility (GBIF) and the Ocean Biodiversity Information System (OBIS), Darwin Core standards, and biodiversity data life cycles Familiarity with species …

items.card: THE ROLE Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, within the Human Capital, Organization and Health & Safety Directorate, is looking for a Risk and Special Waste Management Administrative support to assist in the preparation and implementation of all related documentation. The job description includes the following responsibilities at the Genoa headquarters and at the centers within the IIT Network: Duties related to
items.desc: Italy Step into a world of endless possibilities, together let’s leave something for the future! At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds. We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering diversity in all its forms, creating an inclusive environment. We value the unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives of our people. By embracing diversity, we believe science can achieve its fullest potential. THE ROLE Istituto Italiano di Tecnologia, within the Human Capital, Organization and Health & Safety Directorate, is looking for a Risk and Special Waste Management Administrative support to assist in the preparation and implementation of all related documentation. The job description includes the following responsibilities at the Genoa headquarters and at the centers within the IIT Network: Duties related to special waste management: Assisting with the management of special waste generated by the IIT Foundation; Planning and managing waste pickups, including the related documentation (ADR forms and checklists); Characterization of waste and monitoring of related deadlines; Support in managing ISO 14001 environmental certification and waste-related documentation requirements (MUD, RENTRI, and the load and unload register); On-site inspections of work areas for waste management purposes. Risk Management Activities: Support in reviewing and updating all documentation related to workplace health and safety in accordance with the safety management system, OHSAS 45001; Support in verifying, through continuous monitoring of work environments and facilities, compliance with legal regulations regarding safety and the environment, including during site inspections and audits at all IIT locations; Support in developing procedures and operational instructions regarding workplace health and safety; Support in producing training and informational materials on specific risks present in IIT workplaces; Support in the operational oversight of the proper use of personal protective equipment. ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS High school diploma or college degree in a technical or scientific field; Good knowledge of written and spoken English; Good knowledge of current safety and environmental standards and regulations (Legislative Decree 81/08; Legislative Decree 152/06; RENTRI regulations); Good knowledge of management systems related to OHSAS 45001, ISO 14001, and ISO 9001; Professional proficiency with the main Microsoft Office applications; Good organizational skills. ADDITIONAL SKILLS Professional knowledge of management software such as SAP and WINWASTE; Ability to manage documentation related to special waste (paper-based loading/unloading logs, forms, MUD, RENTRI electronic registry, invoice verification, ADR product data sheets); Knowledge of ADR regulations regarding the transport of special waste; Experience gained at medium- to large-sized companies in the research and technological development sector; Specialized training in management systems, particularly regarding the OHSAS 45001 and ISO 14001 standards. COMPENSATION PACKAGE A yearly gross salary ranging between 21.000,00 and 24.000,00, which may include a bonus option depending on your role and contract Private health care coverage depending on your role and contract Up to ten days of remote working per month and flexible working hours are available for certain roles Please submit your application using the online form and including a detailed CV. Application’s deadline: October 31st, 2026 To discover more about life at IIT, visit the dedicated section here: https://www.iit.it/en/work-at-iit

items.title: Instructional Designer
items.card: You will combine instructional-design fundamentals with modern AI-enabled workflows to design, build, test, and continuously improve learning content. You will use AI responsibly to accelerate research, content drafting, adaptation, localization, multimedia production, assessment creation, and learning analytics—while ensuring that all materials remain accurate, inclusive, secure, and aligned with Feedzai's product
items.desc: At Feedzai, we're building a world of safer money. A world where financial institutions move faster than criminals. Where the payments that fund real lives through salaries, savings, and businesses are protected in real time. We use trusted AI to detect and prevent financial crime, fraud, and money laundering at scale: the world's top banks, payment networks, and acquirers trust our technology to safeguard more than one billion consumers and $9 trillion in payment volume every year. Feedzai is a Series D company and has raised $282M to date. With a valuation of $2 billion, our technology protects 1 billion consumers and 90 billion transactions each year. You: We are looking for an AI-native Instructional Designer to create high-quality, scalable, and engaging learning experiences that help customers, partners, and internal teams get the most value from Feedzai's products. This role goes beyond traditional content development. You will combine instructional-design fundamentals with modern AI-enabled workflows to design, build, test, and continuously improve learning content. You will use AI responsibly to accelerate research, content drafting, adaptation, localization, multimedia production, assessment creation, and learning analytics—while ensuring that all materials remain accurate, inclusive, secure, and aligned with Feedzai's product and brand standards. A key focus of the role will be creating engaging video content, in-app learning experiences, tutorials, certifications, and product education journeys. You will partner with Product, UX, Documentation, Customer Success, and subject-matter experts to translate complex fraud-prevention and risk-management capabilities into clear, role-based, actionable learning. You will be curious about how AI is changing learning design: from adaptive and personalized content to AI-assisted simulations, scenario-based practice, and embedded, just-in-time guidance inside the product. You will help evolve Feedzai's learning ecosystem so that it is more efficient to create, easier to maintain, and more effective for global audiences. Your Day-to-Day: 1. Design AI-Enabled Learning Experiences Design and develop learning journeys for customers, partners, and internal teams, including onboarding, feature adoption, role-based enablement, certifications, tutorials, and performance-support resources. Apply adult-learning principles, learning objectives, assessment design, and instructional-design methodologies to create practical, engaging, and measurable learning experiences. Use AI-enabled tools and workflows to accelerate content research, outlining, drafting, rewriting, summarization, assessment creation, scenario generation, and content adaptation. Validate AI-assisted outputs with subject-matter experts and source documentation to ensure factual accuracy, product correctness, appropriate tone, and learner relevance. Design learning experiences that combine self-paced learning, video, interactive practice, knowledge checks, live enablement, in-app guidance, and contextual performance support. Explore responsible uses of generative AI to create realistic role-based scenarios, simulations, exercises, practice questions, and differentiated learning paths. 2. Create Multimedia and In-App Product Learning Develop a range of digital learning assets, including video tutorials, product walkthroughs, microlearning modules, certifications, interactive guides, job aids, and in-app experiences. Script, storyboard, produce, edit, and maintain video-based learning content using tools such as Synthesia, Descript, Camtasia, Adobe Creative Cloud, or comparable platforms. Create and maintain in-app training content using Pendo, or similar digital-adoption platforms, to support contextual learning directly within the Feedzai product. Work with UX and Product teams to identify high-impact moments for embedded education, onboarding guidance, feature discovery, and contextual help. Apply usability, accessibility, and inclusive-design principles to all learning assets, including captions, transcripts, accessible visuals, clear language, and appropriate interaction design. Help establish reusable templates, AI prompt libraries, content patterns, and production workflows that improve quality and reduce time to publish. 3. Partner Across Product, Documentation, and Enablement Collaborate with Product Managers, Product Designers, Engineers, SMEs, Customer Success, Support, and Partner teams to understand learner needs and product priorities. Translate complex product functionality, workflows, risk-management concepts, and technical information into clear and actionable learning content for different audiences. Partner with Documentation to ensure that education content, product documentation, release communications, and in-app guidance are consistent, accurate, and easy to navigate. Work closely with UX to embed learning moments into the product experience and reduce friction for users adopting new …

Interacts directly with immediate supervisor, co-workers and team members; engages in routine exchanges of information; interactions with external contacts, if applicable, would be monitored. Detailed Description Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following: Creates, publishes, controls and constantly improves process documentation for the entire organization. items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. Description of the research group The Clinical Memory Research group at the Department of Clinical Sciences Malmö conducts leading research on biomarkers for Alzheimer's disease and other neurodegenerative diseases, such as Lewy body dementia and Parkinson's disease. The research, internationally recognised through the BioFINDER studies, has for several years been at the forefront of fluid biomarkers and brain imaging, enabling early and accurate detection, diagnosis and prognosis of disease. The group is led by Senior Lecturer Sebastian Palmqvist and Senior Lecturer Niklas Mattsson-Carlgren and consists of research staff and technical/administrative staff. The workplace is located at the Biomedical Centre (BMC) in Lund. We work closely with the Memory Clinic at Skåne University Hospital in Malmö, where several of our researchers also work clinically. Read more about our research here We are an international research group that values a good working environment characterised by respect and consideration. We strive for a workplace that is developing and stimulating for all employees, and we work continuously to create conditions that promote well-being, development and participation. We safeguard both physical safety and the psychosocial work environment. What we offer Lund University is a public authority, which means that you will have special benefits, generous annual leave and an advantageous occupational pension. We also have a flexitime agreement that creates good conditions for work/life balance. Read more on the University’s website about being a Lund University employee, Work at Lund University Project Description The position is primarily associated with a five-year multicentre project (2026-2031) funded by the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH) through a U01 grant for the clinical validation of the blood biomarker MTBR-tau243 in Alzheimer's disease, conducted in collaboration with Washington University in St. Louis, the University of Pennsylvania, and the University of Alabama at Birmingham. However, the work will encompass the activities of the entire research group and involve longitudinal data from several thousand participants in the BioFINDER studies, including blood and cerebrospinal fluid biomarkers, PET and MRI imaging, cognitive assessments, genetics, and proteomics. Work duties and areas of responsibility As biostatistician you work closely with the group's researchers and serve as a resource for statistical analysis. The primary task is to plan and carry out statistical analyses for scientific papers and to compile data across projects. The duties include: planning and carrying out statistical analyses for scientific publications together with the group's researchers, for example regarding diagnostic accuracy (ROC analysis, cutoffs, calibration, prediction models) and longitudinal data (mixed models, time-to-event, etc.) compiling and quality-controlling analysis datasets from the group's databases across projects producing clear, publication-quality figures and tables from the data writing reproducible, well-documented analysis code in R contributing to the U01 project's statistical analysis plan and pre-specified analyses, together with the Principal Investigator and statisticians at the US partner sites drafting methods and results sections and reviewing the statistical parts of manuscripts providing statistical advice on study design, power calculations and choice of methods following methodological developments in the field and introducing new tools and ways of working in the group. Qualifications Requirements for the position: a PhD in statistics, biostatistics, epidemiology or another relevant field with a clear statistical focus. The PhD must have been awarded by the time the employment decision is made. excellent command of R, including data handling and programming of reproducible analyses. a strong ability to visualise data and produce clear, publication-quality figures. good knowledge of statistical modelling, in particular regression models, methods for diagnostic accuracy and analysis of longitudinal data. excellent command of English, spoken and written (English is the group's working language). great importance will be attached to personal qualities. We are looking for someone who is meticulous and structured, able to explain statistical methods and results to clinicians and researchers, service-minded and able to handle several parallel projects and deadlines.
