items.desc: DevSecOps Engineer - FlatPlan UK-based remote model Work hours: 10am–6pm GMT, Monday to Friday Summary FlatPlan is the leading Apple News technology and strategy provider, working with 230+ consumer publishers including The Atlantic, The Athletic, Vox Media and the Premier League. We're a preferred provider to Apple, helping the world's biggest publishers reach hundreds of millions of readers through Apple News and beyond. We're profitable, growing, and scaling sanely: a sharp team doing meaningful work at pace. The Role: We're hiring a DevSecOps Engineer to support our growth in building out and harden the foundations our platform runs on whilst having a close eye and mindset about security. This is a hands-on engineering role with a security mindset at its core. You'll own how we build, deploy, run and secure our platform: support the build of our future pipelines that ship our code, the cloud services it runs on, the way we keep it reliable, and the way we keep it safe. Security at FlatPlan is a shared responsibility and we want the whole team writing secure code, but you are the person who owns the standard, keeps us honest, and is accountable for it. We are looking for somebody to help us grow our pipelines, automation and cloud tooling deliberately as we scale, so there's real room to shape how we do it. When there's focused security or hardening work to do, you lead it: assessing what we run, closing the risks that matter, and raising the baseline. When that's in good shape, you keep adding value on the robustness, performance and reliability of the platform our publishers depend on. We expect you to be fluent with AI development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or equivalent) and to use them daily, for writing and reviewing code, automating work, and finding ways to ship faster and safer. What you'll own will include a mix of: CI/CD pipelines and deployment: building, automating and improving how our code ships Cloud infrastructure on AWS: configuration, automation, and sensible, secure operations Security across the platform: secure coding standards, the OWASP Top 10, hardening, secrets, and staying on top of vulnerabilities and updates Reliability and robustness: observability, alerting, and a steady pair of hands when an incident needs handling Making secure, reliable practices part of how the whole team builds Bringing AI assisted approaches into how we build, automate, harden and ship How we're setup We build primarily with JavaScript and TypeScript, using Node.js. We use a JSON format called Apple News Format for Apple News delivery, which we will provide training on. Our data runs on MongoDB, and we use AWS for our cloud services. We are building out our pipelines, automation and infrastructure as we grow, so you'll have genuine ownership to shape how we do it rather than inheriting a fixed estate. We're always open to innovation and opinions on the tooling and approaches that will serve us best, and you'll be supported by a team with a strong understanding of our current product and great ideas for the future. Why you should apply FlatPlan is a small, lean team with backgrounds at Stripe, New York Times Company and Apple. We're fully remote but intentional about connection: randomised social 1:1s, Friday socials, a virtual office and optional UK meet ups four time a year. We share knowledge openly and regularly, and genuinely care about each other. We are a profitable company, formed in 2019 and backed by TinySeed. Our relationship with Apple runs deep: we are Apple's preferred provider for Apple News, and following a period of assessment, a direct supplier to Apple. We want this team to reflect the breadth of the publishers and audiences we serve. We strongly encourage applicants from underrepresented backgrounds to apply. All qualified candidates will be considered regardless of race, gender, identity, orientation, disability or background. Requirements Must-haves: Significant commercial DevOps experience: building and running CI/CD pipelines, deployment, and cloud infrastructure in production Strong AWS: configuration, automation, and the security basics done well, including IAM, secrets handling and least privilege A genuine security mindset: fluent in secure coding practices and the OWASP Top 10, and able to spot and fix real risk across code and infrastructure Comfortable automating with infrastructure as code and scripting, and keeping systems robust, observable and up to date MongoDB, ideally Atlas, with a sense of how to secure, configure and operate it safely Able to read and work in a JavaScript and TypeScript codebase well enough to review it, secure it, and support the engineers building it Sound instincts for reliability and incident response: monitoring, alerting, and staying calm when something breaks Comfortable making technical decisions with minimal oversight, and bringing the rest of the team along with you Daily, practical use of AI tooling in your workflow …

items.desc: Job Description The Enterprise Machine Learning team drives organizational value through scalable ML solutions and data-driven insights, fundamentally changing how business decisions are made. We collaborate closely with stakeholders, applying the latest advances in machine learning and statistical modeling to create highly impactful outcomes. Our commitment is to advance the state of applied science and robust system design to enhance and expand our core business capabilities. Role Overview We've spent the past year consolidating and validating our revenue data, most signals now live in one place. The next step is building a customer intelligence layer: systems that dynamically learn which signals drive outcomes, adapt as the business evolves, and surface insights that change how we act. As an Applied Machine Learning Scientist, you will be the person who makes that happen. You will train models, design experiments, and uncover the patterns that connect customer behavior to revenue outcomes.Then ship those insights as production systems that the business relies on daily. You own problems end-to-end: from formulating the right question, to training and validating models, to deploying them and measuring whether they actually moved the needle, in a closed feedback loop. You will work alongside a team of AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analysts as part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics department. Your focus is the science: understanding what drives outcomes, building models that learn from data, and turning that understanding into systems that work. Key Responsibilities Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that predict and explain revenue-related outcomes, including churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement. Build and own end-to-end ML systems, from data preparation and experimentation through production deployment, continuous retraining, monitoring, and performance optimization. Develop intelligence from structured and unstructured data, applying statistical modeling, modern NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and deep learning where they create measurable business value. Design and run experiments to uncover the relationships between customer behavior, product usage, and business outcomes, translating model outputs into actionable insights. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize ML initiatives, and embed intelligence into decision-making workflows. Measure and maximize business impact by monitoring model performance, detecting drift, validating outcomes, and continuously iterating based on real-world results and feedback. This Role Is For You If… You have 3–5 years of experience in Applied Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with a track record of building models that deliver measurable business impact. You bring foundation in machine learning and statistics, with hands-on experience training models on messy, real-world data. You're comfortable dealing with label noise, class imbalance, feature leakage, data drift, and designing robust validation strategies. You are experienced in applying ML to both structured and unstructured data, including modern NLP techniques, embeddings, LLMs, or deep learning where they create meaningful business value. You have production-grade engineering skills, including Python, SQL, software engineering best practices, and experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML models. You have pragmatic, product-oriented mindset. You get more satisfaction from shipping a simple model that improves a business metric than building a complex one with marginally better offline performance. You think in terms of business outcomes, user behavior, and measurable impact—not model sophistication alone. You proactively identify high-impact opportunities, form opinions based on data and user understanding, and continuously iterate on your work. items.desc: In the time it takes you to read this job description, RapidSOS will have handled ~1,380 emergencies. At RapidSOS, we are committed to using technology to build a safer, stronger future and working together to save lives. We're in an exciting phase of growth, welcoming new members from across the globe to our mission-driven, ambitious, and inclusive team. Our work is founded on our values of trust and safety , pioneering , urgency , and purpose over pride , all of which support a company culture where people can innovate, collaborate, grow, and, above all, make an impact. RapidSOS is the leading public safety AI company that unlocks mission-critical intelligence for emergency response. It harnesses artificial and human intelligence to fuse life-saving data from the world's largest safety network, which includes over 700M+ connected devices and 200+ global technology companies. This intelligence is delivered to 23,000+ federal, state, and local agencies, serving one million first responders. RapidSOS has supported over one billion emergencies in 16 countries, powering RapidSOS HARMONY, the first purpose-built AI for public safety, designed to save critical time by automatically detecting emergencies, unifying real-time data and video streams, and coordinating a faster, more effective response. Learn more at www.RapidSOS.com. What this role is about: Our Voice AI team is building the next generation of intelligent safety technology. We build AI agents that triage incoming alerts in seconds, relieve the burden on emergency telecommunicators by handling non-emergency calls, and provide real-time translation between callers and call-takers. As an AI Engineer on this team, you'll own core capabilities end to end—from model behavior and backend architecture to evaluation tooling. Every improvement you ship shaves seconds off a response, and in an emergency, seconds are what save lives. What you'll do: End-to-end product delivery: Own Voice AI agent(s) capabilities from problem discovery and rapid experimentation through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, and measurement of impact across the real-time agent, APIs, web application, and cloud infrastructure. Improve conversational quality: Improve the caller experience—including latency, turn-taking, barge-in, speech recognition, multilingual behavior, protocol adherence, and transfers—using production evidence and reproducible experiments. Safety and reliability: Design fail-safe behaviors, strengthen service resilience and observability, and respond to production issues through contributing factors analysis, mitigation, and prevention. Evaluation and continuous improvement: Build and use automated evaluations, call-replay tools, production metrics, and controlled traffic trials to identify regressions, quantify trade-offs, and improve model and system behavior. Work across the full stack, from Python backend and AI model behavior to the React/TypeScript UI that customers and operators use to configure and monitor their AI agents. Use AI tools daily to move faster on code, testing, call analysis, and incident triage, while keeping full ownership of architecture, safety boundaries, and production decisions. What we're looking for in our ideal candidate: 2-3+ years of back-end or full-stack engineering experience shipping production software end to end, with hands-on experience building AI/LLM applications and solid fundamentals in distributed systems, APIs, and operational reliability Real-time voice, streaming media, or conversational agent experience is a strong plus Strong Python proficiency, including async programming, with the flexibility to work full-stack, including our TypeScript/React frontend (prior experience with it a plus or open to learning) Ability to evaluate non-deterministic AI behavior using datasets, automated metrics, qualitative call review, controlled experiments, and clear statistical reasoning A genuine bias for action, balanced with care: a self-starter who moves fast with an ownership mindset, states intent rather than asks for permission, and doesn't cut corners on a safety-sensitive system Product-minded problem solving: able to turn ambiguous problems into simple solutions, make evidence-based trade-offs, and own the outcome rather than only the implementation Clear written and verbal communication along with a collaborative streak that raises the whole team's velocity Genuinely AI-forward: fluent with AI-assisted coding, always looking for new ways to use AI to work faster, and pushing the envelope with fresh ideas on how we can do better as a team Willingness to join a weekly on-call rotation and travel 1-2 times per quarter for in-person team gatherings (mostly within Europe) What we offer: The chance to work with a passionate team on solving one of the largest challenges globally Competitive salary and benefits and equity participation A dynamic, flexible and fun start-up work environment with a highly talented team …

items.desc: Job Description UE09: £63,606 - £78,469 per annum College of Science and Engineering / School of Informatics Full-Time: 35 hours per week Open-Ended (permanent) The Opportunity We are seeking current and emerging leading researchers in the field. We seek candidates with research interests in the development of cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence methods and models, particularly in the joint space of perception (e.g., computer vision) and action (e.g., interactive decision-making systems). We are interested in candidates motivated to establish and expand the principles underlying such methods and models in the context of high-impact application domains (e.g., robotics, health, environment, society, etc.). The candidate's research focus may align with the following, non-exhaustive, list of topics (in no particular order): Continual, open-ended, self-improving AI Agentic AI, world models, and generative models Embodied perception and action Learning from interaction and reinforcement Decision-making under uncertainty Long-duration autonomy Candidates should have a strong research track record. They should also demonstrate interest and ability to teach undergraduate (UG) and master's (MSc) level courses, and to supervise projects for UG, MSc, and PhD in areas related to their research. items.desc: Am Fraunhofer IAIS erforschen und entwickeln rund 360 Mitarbeitende individuelle Lösungen zur Integration und Analyse von Daten für unsere Fördergeber*innen und unsere Kund*innen aus der Wirtschaft. Künstliche Intelligenz, Machine Learning, Big Data, Multimedia Content Analytics, Information Integration sowie Unternehmensmodellierung und -analyse sind die inhaltlichen Schwerpunkte unserer Arbeiten. In der Abteilung AI Assurance and Assessments (AAA) operationalisieren wir KI-Vertrauenswürdigkeit entlang von drei Schritten: Wir analysieren Anforderungen an KI-Systeme aus Gesetzen und Standards. Wir setzen diese Anforderungen um, indem wir technische Absicherungsmethoden für KI-Systeme entwickeln und diese auf organisatorischer Ebene durch effektive KI-Governance Mechanismen komplettieren. Wir entwickeln Prüfkriterien und Testverfahren für KI-Systeme und forschen zu der Frage, wie sich solche Prüfungen und Tests automatisieren lassen. Hierbei beschäftigen uns Fragestellungen wie: Wie lassen sich a priori inkommensurable KI-Risiken, etwa die Verletzung von Persönlichkeitsrechten und Safety-Risiken zu einem Gesamtrisiko aggregieren? Wie lassen sich die Unsicherheiten von Transformer-Modellen messen? Welche Controls in KI-Managementsystemen operationalisieren den AI Act? Wie lassen sich KI-Prüfworkflows automatisieren? Was sind die besten Redteaming Ansätze, um die Safeguards von LLMs zu testen? Wie lassen sich KI-Agenten im Betrieb absichern? Bei Fraunhofer IAIS zu arbeiten, heißt unternehmerisches Denken mit Spitzenforschung zu verbinden: Unsere Abteilung AAA hat weltweit Kunden, die von großen Technologiekonzernen bis hin zu Start-ups reichen. Auch viele Behörden zählen zu unseren Auftraggebern. Gleichzeitig entstehen aus unserer Forschung wissenschaftliche Publikationen und Doktorarbeiten. Unser interdisziplinäres Team hat Abschlüsse in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften, Rechtswissenschaften und Psychologie und freut sich auf Sie! Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung Übersetzung von regulatorischen Vorgaben, wie etwa der KI-Verordnung, in technische Anforderungen an KI-Systeme Konzeption und Entwicklung von technischen Lösungen zur Absicherung von KI-Systemen Konzeption und Entwicklung von KI-Governance Frameworks Konzeption und Durchführung von KI-Prüfungen für konkrete Use Cases Entwicklung von Methoden zur Messung und Quantifizierung von Unsicherheiten in KI-Modellen (z. B. Transformer-Architekturen) Durchführung von Redteaming- und Stresstests zur Absicherung von LLMs und KI-Agenten im produktiven Einsatz Automatisierung von KI-Prüf- und Testworkflows Beratung von Kund*innen aus Wirtschaft und öffentlicher Verwaltung zur regulatorischen Einordnung und Absicherung ihrer KI-Systeme Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master, Diplom) der Informatik, Physik oder Mathematik mit sehr gutem Abschluss an einer Universität mit internationalem Renommee, gerne mit Promotion. Bei guter Passung zu einem der oben genannten Themen kommen auch andere Abschlüsse (z.B. Rechtswissenschaften, Psychologie) in Betracht Sehr gute Vorkenntnisse in den Bereichen Maschinelles Lernen, Künstliche Intelligenz (KI) und Agentische KI Sehr gute Kenntnisse zu Programmierung (insb. Python und ML-Frameworks with pytorch und tensorflow) und technischer Implementierung (Docker/Podman und Containerisierung, Azure, AWS oder andere Cloudprovider, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD) und im Umgang mit Agent Frameworks/Harnesses (z.B. ClaudeCode, OpenAI Codex oder LangGraph) oder KI-Regulierung und Standardisierung (KI-Recht, insb. AI Act, internationale Standardisierung bei ISO, IEC und ITU, europäische Standardisierung bei CEN, CENELEC, ETSI, harmonisierte Normen) Exzellente analytische Fähigkeiten und Freude an abstraktem Denken Hohe Belastbarkeit sowie die Bereitschaft, sich schnell in neue Sachverhalte einzuarbeiten Freude daran, komplizierte technische Zusammenhänge für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufzubereiten Ein hohes Maß an Eigeninitiative und Hands-on Mentalität Strukturiertes Arbeiten und professionelles Auftreten Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und Englischkenntnisse (beides mind. auf Niveau C1) Bitte gehen Sie in ihrem Anschreiben darauf ein, welche Themenschwerpunkte der Abteilung AAA Sie besonders interessieren, welche Vorerfahrungen Sie hierfür mitbringen, was Sie bei Fraunhofer IAIS erreichen möchten und warum wissenschaftliche Exzellenz und unternehmerisches Talent in ihrer Person vereint sind. Was wir für Sie bereithalten Wir bieten Ihnen vielfältige Angebote für Ihre persönliche Weiterbildung in den Bereichen Führung, Kommunikation, Projektmanagement, Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie, Gesundheit, Kultur und Sport. Die Förderung der Chancengerechtigkeit unserer Mitarbeitenden ist ein wichtiges Ziel von Fraunhofer. items.desc: Description Du Poste leboncoin is France's leading classifieds platform for peer-to-peer transactions, the market leader in real estate and automotive, and a key player in jobs and holiday rentals. Every month, leboncoin is the go-to platform for 28 million French users who value the breadth of its listings and the simplicity of everyday transactions. At leboncoin, data is at the heart of every decision. By joining the Recommerce Data Analytics team, you will directly contribute to accelerating the growth of the Recommerce business through analytical and predictive models with a strong business impact. Your scope: Recommerce The Recommerce scope covers all physical goods bought and shipped via leboncoin (electronics, books, cultural products, home décor, etc.). It is a fast-growing market, rooted in circular economy trends, with strong challenges around profitability, user retention, and logistics optimisation. The key challenges of this scope are: Measuring and maximising the long-term value (LTV) of buyers and sellers Understanding the true incrementality of marketing, CRM and promotional actions Predicting and optimising logistics costs and delivery times You will join a Data Analytics team of 8+ Data Analysts and 2 Data Engineers, working closely together on the Recommerce scope. Exigences du poste Minimum 6 years of experience as a Data Scientist Strong expertise in causal inference and experimentation (A/B test design and analysis) Proficiency in Python and SQL; hands-on experience with Databricks and Airflow is a plus Experience in predictive modelling (ML, segmentation, time series) Ability to translate complex results into actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders Curiosity and drive for concrete business impact Autonomy, rigour and strong analytical mindset Fluent in English Fluent in French Responsabilités liées au poste Incrementality measurement and causal analysis : Design methodologies to measure the incrementality of promotional initiatives Conduct exploratory and correlation analyses on historical data (revenue, GMV, supply/demand indicators…) to inform re-pricing and promotional initiatives decisions Strengthen performance measurement with forecasting models and robust baseline definition LTV (Lifetime Value) and segmentation : Identify highest-LTV segments and its drivers to improve prioritization of CRM campaigns and promotional initiatives Compute CAC/LTV for CRM Introduce and test a trajectory-based user segmentation to react quickly to decline and churn in the top buyer and seller segments Prototyping and Discovery : Collaborate with Product MLE and DS on prototyping IA features (weight suggestion, delivery times…) Run exploratory analysis around improving sell-through (= time between an ad listing and its sale) Avantages du poste Company health insurance 50% reimbursement of your public transport pass 25 days of annual leave and 12 RTT days (additional rest days) A Swile meal card worth €9 per day At leboncoin, we believe that diversity in backgrounds, experiences and perspectives is essential. This commitment is reflected in our recruitment process: we assess every application solely on the basis of skills, experience and motivation, without any form of discrimination. If you need any specific accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know. We’ll be happy to support you.

items.desc: AI Adoption Specialist Location: Bristol city centre – 2 days onsite per week Salary: Competitive The Opportunity Artis Recruitment is working with a leading professional services organisation to recruit an AI Adoption Specialist to help colleagues embrace AI and transform the way they work. About You We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds, including AI adoption, Learning & Development, digital learning, business change, digital transformation and process improvement. You'll ideally have: A genuine interest in AI and emerging technologies. Experience helping people adopt new systems, tools or ways of working. Strong communication, facilitation and stakeholder engagement skills. The ability to explain technical concepts in a clear, practical and engaging way. An understanding of how technology can improve business processes and productivity. A proactive, adaptable approach and a willingness to learn. Experience with Microsoft Copilot, generative AI, prompt engineering or workflow automation would be advantageous. Interested? If you're passionate about AI and enjoy helping people discover better ways of working, we'd love to hear from you.

items.desc: Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер — іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших. Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі. Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти — це ключова цінність SKELAR. Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями — і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів. Мене звати Віталій, я Marketing Design Lead у Dressly. Зараз я шукаю людину в свою команду, яка підсилить наш AI-напрям своїми знаннями, досвідом та бажанням експериментувати. Нам потрібна людина, яка не просто генерує відео по короткому промпту, а вміє створювати сильний візуальний контент, шукати нові підходи та впливати на бізнес-метрики через якісні AI-креативи. Про проєкт та твою роль: Dressly — це fashion-tech продукт, де ми допомагаємо користувачам краще підбирати одяг та стилістичні рішення за допомогою AI. У маркетинг-команді ми активно використовуємо AI-інструменти у виробництві performance creatives: від генерації реалістичних сцен, AI-креаторів та fashion-футажів до адаптації креативів під різні ринки, локалі та формати. Виклики, які чекають на тебе: Генерація відео та зображень на основі сценаріїв, робота з композицією, світлом, стилем, реалістичністю та емоційним тоном кадру. Написання структурованих промптів із розумінням руху камери, поведінки персонажа, атмосфери, fashion-візуалу та задачі конкретного креативу. Створення реалістичних AI-футажів для рекламних відео: fashion-сцени, lifestyle-кадри, AI-креатори, try-on/wardrobe/content-style scenes. Збирання окремих AI-генерацій у цілісні відео, робота з динамікою, таймінгами, ритмом та логікою відеоряду. Адаптація AI-контенту під різні мови та ринки, робота з lipsync та візуальною консистентністю персонажів. Що очікуємо від тебе: Досвід роботи з Kling, Veo, Seedance, GPT Image, NanoBanana, HeyGen, ElevenLabs або іншими AI-інструментами. Ти відчуваєш ритм, динаміку, монтаж та розумієш, як з окремих AI-кадрів зібрати відео, яке виглядає цілісно і може працювати в performance marketing. Ти розумієш принципи генерації, prompt engineering, ітеративність та вмієш доводити результат до стабільного й якісного рівня. Ти не чекаєш покрокових інструкцій, можеш самостійно розібратись у задачі, запропонувати рішення, протестувати кілька підходів і довести ідею до фінального результату. Тобі цікаво не просто створити якісне відео, а зрозуміти, чому один креатив може спрацювати краще за інший. У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації: SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті — а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші. Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег — кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки. Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір — від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо. Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці — і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави. Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат — з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефективніше. Більше розповімо на нашій зустрічі-знайомстві. Запрошуємо будувати the next big everything у SKELAR разом!

items.desc: Job Description The Enterprise Machine Learning team drives organizational value through scalable ML solutions and data-driven insights, fundamentally changing how business decisions are made. We collaborate closely with stakeholders, applying the latest advances in machine learning and statistical modeling to create highly impactful outcomes. Our commitment is to advance the state of applied science and robust system design to enhance and expand our core business capabilities. Role Overview We've spent the past year consolidating and validating our revenue data, most signals now live in one place. The next step is building a customer intelligence layer: systems that dynamically learn which signals drive outcomes, adapt as the business evolves, and surface insights that change how we act. As an Applied Machine Learning Scientist, you will be the person who makes that happen. You will train models, design experiments, and uncover the patterns that connect customer behavior to revenue outcomes.Then ship those insights as production systems that the business relies on daily. You own problems end-to-end: from formulating the right question, to training and validating models, to deploying them and measuring whether they actually moved the needle, in a closed feedback loop. You will work alongside a team of AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, and Analysts as part of the Enterprise Data & Analytics department. Your focus is the science: understanding what drives outcomes, building models that learn from data, and turning that understanding into systems that work. Key Responsibilities Design, train, evaluate, and deploy machine learning models that predict and explain revenue-related outcomes, including churn, expansion, conversion, and customer engagement. Build and own end-to-end ML systems, from data preparation and experimentation through production deployment, continuous retraining, monitoring, and performance optimization. Develop intelligence from structured and unstructured data, applying statistical modeling, modern NLP, embeddings, LLMs, and deep learning where they create measurable business value. Design and run experiments to uncover the relationships between customer behavior, product usage, and business outcomes, translating model outputs into actionable insights. Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities, prioritize ML initiatives, and embed intelligence into decision-making workflows. Measure and maximize business impact by monitoring model performance, detecting drift, validating outcomes, and continuously iterating based on real-world results and feedback. This Role Is For You If… You have 3–5 years of experience in Applied Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related quantitative field, with a track record of building models that deliver measurable business impact. You bring foundation in machine learning and statistics, with hands-on experience training models on messy, real-world data. You're comfortable dealing with label noise, class imbalance, feature leakage, data drift, and designing robust validation strategies. You are experienced in applying ML to both structured and unstructured data, including modern NLP techniques, embeddings, LLMs, or deep learning where they create meaningful business value. You have production-grade engineering skills, including Python, SQL, software engineering best practices, and experience deploying, monitoring, and maintaining ML models. You have pragmatic, product-oriented mindset. You get more satisfaction from shipping a simple model that improves a business metric than building a complex one with marginally better offline performance. You think in terms of business outcomes, user behavior, and measurable impact—not model sophistication alone. You proactively identify high-impact opportunities, form opinions based on data and user understanding, and continuously iterate on your work. items.desc: Bedrijfsomschrijving Een positieve toekomst voor iedereen, daar werken we bij Sopra Steria aan. Met meer dan 51.000 collega's in 30 landen zijn we Europa's toonaangevende leverancier van digitale oplossingen. Wij weten als geen ander dat het niet alleen technologie is die transformatie aanstuurt. Het zijn mensen die de kern van verandering vormen. Daarom zijn het mensen die centraal staan in alles wat we doen en bieden we een ondersteunende en inclusieve omgeving waar iedereen zowel individueel als in teamverband kan uitblinken. The world is how we shape it. Let’s shape it together. Vacatureomschrijving Wil jij bouwen aan de volgende generatie AI-oplossingen en organisaties helpen de stap te maken naar agentic werken? Binnen de Microsoft Area van Sopra Steria werk je samen met ervaren Microsoft-professionals aan innovatieve AI-oplossingen voor organisaties binnen defensie, de publieke sector, financiële dienstverlening en de industrie. Als AI Agent Engineer werk je op het snijvlak van technologie en consultancy en help je organisaties om de mogelijkheden van AI praktisch toe te passen. Je werkt met de nieuwste ontwikkelingen binnen het Microsoft AI-ecosysteem, waaronder Copilot Studio, Power Platform en Azure AI, en krijgt volop ruimte om te experimenteren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen agentic AI. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Agent Engineer ga je met klanten in gesprek over hun werkprocessen en uitdagingen. Je ontdekt waar AI het verschil kan maken en vertaalt deze use-cases naar slimme agents die medewerkers ondersteunen en werkzaamheden eenvoudiger en efficiënter maken. Je bent betrokken van het eerste idee en prototype tot het bouwen, testen en doorontwikkelen van de agent. Daarbij werk je veel met Copilot Studio en Power Platform en experimenteer je met nieuwe mogelijkheden binnen Generative en agentic AI. Voorbeelden van opdrachten bij onze klanten AI-agents bouwen met Copilot Studio Je ontwikkelt agents die medewerkers ondersteunen, informatie toegankelijk maken en terugkerende werkzaamheden slimmer uitvoeren. Daarom bieden we een aantrekkelijk en flexibel pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden: Een vast contract en een salaris tussen de €4.000,- en €6.500,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, dienstverband minimaal 32 uur). Bij Sopra Steria vinden we gelijke beloning voor gelijkwaardig werk belangrijk. Daarom bepalen we je salaris op basis van objectieve criteria zoals ervaring, kennis, competenties en verantwoordelijkheden. items.desc: Contexte de la mission Au sein de l'équipe IA de la R&D de SII Sud-Ouest, vous contribuerez à la conception de solutions innovantes visant à lutter contre les fraudes téléphoniques. Dans un contexte où les techniques de vishing, d’usurpation d’identité, de spoofing et de deepfakes vocaux se multiplient, cette mission a pour objectif de renforcer la protection des utilisateurs grâce à des mécanismes de détection et d’assistance en temps réel. Missions Étudier les mécanismes et scénarios de fraude téléphonique afin d’identifier les signaux faibles et les comportements suspects Réaliser un état de l’art des approches basées sur l’intelligence artificielle, le traitement automatique de la parole et l’analyse comportementale appliquées à la détection de fraude Concevoir, développer et évaluer des modèles de détection en temps réel à partir de données vocales et contextuelles Expérimenter différentes architectures d’IA et mesurer leurs performances selon des critères de précision, robustesse et latence Développer des mécanismes d’alerte adaptés permettant d’assister les utilisateurs pendant un appel suspect Collaborer avec des spécialistes en IA générative, des ingénieur·es R&D et des équipes de développement pour intégrer les solutions dans un environnement opérationnel Produire des rapports d’analyse, documenter les expérimentations et présenter les résultats obtenus Participer à la valorisation des travaux de recherche et aux réflexions liées à l’industrialisation de la solution Étudiant·e en dernière année d’École d’Ingénieur ou de Master avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, data science, traitement du signal, traitement de la parole ou cybersécurité Intérêt marqué pour l’IA appliquée, les technologies vocales, la détection d’anomalies et les problématiques de sécurité numérique Expérience académique ou personnelle avec Python, les frameworks de machine learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn) ou les outils de traitement de la parole Capacité à analyser des résultats expérimentaux et à structurer une démarche de recherche appliquée Aisance dans la rédaction de documentation technique ou scientifique et dans la synthèse de travaux complexes Capacité à travailler en collaboration avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires tout en menant des sujets de manière autonome Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®. Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of how software works, identifying performance bottlenecks and figuring out how to make things run faster and more efficiently. You'll be working on complex, compute-intensive systems where performance really matters. The work involves everything from investigating issues deep within existing codebases to improving how software uses memory, processing power and other resources. They're open to engineers at different stages of their careers. You don't need to have worked in AI infrastructure before, but you should have strong programming fundamentals, a curious mindset and an interest in solving difficult technical problems. What you'll be doing Investigating and resolving performance bottlenecks across complex software systems. Profiling and benchmarking applications to understand where improvements can be made. Working with existing codebases, debugging issues and implementing performance improvements. Optimising memory usage, computational efficiency and overall system throughput. Working on performance-sensitive AI workloads and helping improve how models run in production. Experimenting with different approaches, measuring results and making improvements based on real data. Collaborating with other engineers on challenging technical problems. What we're looking for Strong programming experience with Python, C++ or similar languages. A solid understanding of software performance, memory management and computational efficiency. Experience with performance profiling, debugging or optimisation. Comfortable working with complex systems and digging into unfamiliar code. An understanding of parallel processing, concurrency or distributed computing. Someone who enjoys hands-on engineering and solving problems rather than simply working at the application layer. Some of the technology involved The environment includes Python, C++, Linux and GPU-accelerated computing, alongside modern AI and machine learning technologies. Experience with CUDA, PyTorch or other high-performance computing tools would be useful, although we're equally interested in engineers with strong systems programming backgrounds who want to move further into this space. items.desc: We offer you an Ocean of Possibilities. Join our family. About Us At Damen, much effort is put into designing silent and comfortable ships. Therefore, sound level predictions are made to judge the feasibility of each design. This of course asks for accurate prediction methods. Aspects Covered In These Prediction Methods Are The prediction of structure borne as well as airborne excitation levels of diesel engines, gearboxes, generator sets, propellers, etc. Predicting the dynamic response of the ship structure, such as the input mobility of the engine foundation and the transfer of vibrations through the ship structure. Prediction of attenuations due to acoustic countermeasures, such as resilient mountings, floating floors, visco-elastic damping, additional absorption, etc. Prediction of radiation of lining and absorption of the sound levels in the cabins. Prediction methods always need validation by means of measurements. For this purpose, use is made of advanced measurement equipment. Within the RD&I department, the research team Sound & Vibrations is dedicated to the development of these tools. One of the team members of this team will act as daily supervisor. The role During Damen sea trials, extensive datasets are collected (audio, accelerations, operational parameters). Analyzing these data is labor-intensive and highly dependent on expert knowledge. By using automatization, source identification and characterization can be (partly) automated. This leads to faster interpretation of noise measurements and objective detection of critical events (cavitation, resonances, out-of-tolerance behavior). All in all, better linkage between measurements, modeling (SEA/FEM), and design parameters. Your work as an intern is to develop the required methodology to analyze the time domain data and demonstrate the method in a tool. Project Objective Develop a method and build a tool that analyzes an audio recording from a sea trial and automatically: Identifies acoustic sources (diesel engine, electric motor, propeller, cavitation, turbulence, pump/HVAC, etc.). Determines source characteristics (rotational speed/RPM, number of blades/cylinders, etc.). Quantifies the acoustic contribution per source (level, spectrum, and derived metrics). Performs source separation (acoustic representation of the contribution of each detected source). The final result is a prototype that supports acoustic experts in analysis, troubleshooting, and design validation. Key Accountabilities As an intern, you will: Create a model that classifies acoustic sources in an time domain recording of pressures, accelerations, etc. Define source-specific output such as RPM, number of blades, and number of cylinders Create a prototype application (Python/MATLAB) Deliver documentation and evaluation based on real Damen sea trial data Skills & Experience This assignment is intended for a University Master student Naval Architecture / Maritime Technology / Mechanical Engineering / Applied Physics with: Affinity with acoustics such as spectrograms and harmonic analysis Familiarity with signal processing and Machine Learning frameworks Analytical oriented mind set Good programming/scripting skills in Matlab/Python Mastery of the English language (spoken and written) What We Offer Academic level mentoring throughout the internship Internship compensation and travel allowance in line with company policy A project with direct relevance to multiple business functions and future digital products Potential for internal rollout, and possibly a publication or conference contribution depending on results Other Are you ready to sail into your new adventure at Damen? Don’t hesitate, send us your motivation letter and resume here. Due to housing issues we cannot accept international students that do not have accommodation in the Netherlands yet. Recruiter Liselotte van Veenendaal Email liselotte.van.veenendaal@damen.com Please apply through the Apply Button. Due to GDPR reasons we cannot accept applications by email.

items.desc: About The Role In this role, you'll build scientific computing and spatial analytics solutions for a strategic platform inside Anglo American plc, supporting the exploration, extraction, processing, and marketing of copper, premium iron ore, platinum group metals, and diamonds. You'll turn time-series and geospatial data into tools that guide decisions across mining operations in South America, Africa, Australia, Europe, and North America, working alongside a cross-functional team where technical ownership and innovation drive real business outcomes. Responsibilities Design and build data-intensive Python applications that transform raw sensor, geological, and operational data into actionable insights. Develop and deploy Dockerized services to package analytical models for consistent use across global mining sites. Apply spatial interpolation and geostatistical methods to model resource distributions, ore bodies, and operational risk. Collaborate with data scientists, geologists, and platform engineers to integrate machine learning models into production workflows. Query, structure, and optimize large operational datasets in SQL to support reliable downstream analytics. Build and maintain services on Azure, using Container Apps and Service Bus to support scalable, event-driven data processing. Support MLOps practices to monitor, retrain, and version models as new field data becomes available. Share findings and technical approaches with stakeholders across regions and functions. Requirements Strong hands-on experience with Python and numerical/data analysis libraries such as NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, or Polars. Practical experience developing and deploying Dockerized applications. Working knowledge of machine learning concepts and related statistical methods. Proficiency in SQL for querying and managing large datasets. Experience with time-series analysis and spatial interpolation techniques. Exposure to C++ or .NET (C#) is a plus. Familiarity with Microsoft SQL Server, PostGIS, or geostatistics is an advantage. Experience with Azure Cloud services, including Container Apps and Service Bus, is a plus. Comfortable working independently and collaborating across distributed, cross-functional teams. SoftServe is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration regardless of race, color, ancestry, ethnicity, national origin, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship, disability, health condition, marital or family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

items.title: UWB / RF Expert
items.card: Your Mission At Lateration, we believe that Ultra-Wideband technology has far more potential than what is being achieved with conventional implementations today. Our goal is to turn complex physical challenges into robust, high-performance technology that works beyond
items.desc: Push the boundaries of Ultra-Wideband technology. Your Mission At Lateration, we believe that Ultra-Wideband technology has far more potential than what is being achieved with conventional implementations today. We develop advanced UWB systems that combine RF engineering, signal processing, and a deep understanding of electromagnetic wave propagation. Our goal is to turn complex physical challenges into robust, high-performance technology that works beyond controlled laboratory environments. We are looking for exceptional engineers and researchers who understand UWB at its fundamental level and are driven by the question: What else can we make possible? You won't simply integrate existing solutions or optimize predefined designs. You will challenge assumptions, explore new approaches, and help shape the technological foundation of our next-generation systems. We value technical curiosity, independent thinking, and the ability to turn ambitious ideas into working hardware. Your Responsibilities Advanced UWB System Development Design, develop, and optimize UWB systems at the intersection of RF hardware, signal processing, and embedded technology. Explore the physical and technical limits of UWB and develop innovative approaches to overcome them. RF Physics & Signal Processing Investigate complex signal behavior, including phase characteristics, multipath propagation, interference, timing, and channel effects. Develop algorithms and techniques that improve system performance, precision, range, and robustness. Precision Measurement & Algorithm Development Develop and validate advanced ranging, positioning, calibration, and signal-processing methods. Combine mathematical models, simulations, and real-world measurements to understand and improve system behavior. Hardware Development & Experimental Validation Bring new RF boards and modules into operation. Analyze signal integrity, antenna effects, timing behavior, and hardware limitations using professional measurement equipment. Turn theoretical insights into measurable improvements. Technical Innovation & Ownership Take responsibility for challenging technical problems from initial investigation through experimental validation. Question established approaches, develop new concepts, and contribute directly to our long-term technology development. Collaboration Across Disciplines Work closely with experts in RF engineering, embedded systems, firmware, and algorithms. Share knowledge, challenge ideas constructively, and help build a team that values technical excellence over hierarchy. Your First 5 Months — What You'll Be Proud to Have Achieved You have gained a deep understanding of our UWB technology and identified opportunities to push its performance beyond existing capabilities. You have independently developed, implemented, or validated at least one meaningful RF or signal-processing improvement with measurable results. You have tackled a challenging real-world signal or hardware problem and demonstrated a working solution. You have contributed new ideas, experimental methods, or technical approaches that influence our future development. You have become a trusted technical contributor whose expertise helps shape our UWB technology. What You Bring Deep Technical Understanding You have substantial experience in UWB, RF engineering, wireless communication, radar, or advanced signal processing. More importantly, you understand the underlying physics and can reason from first principles rather than relying exclusively on existing implementations. Signal Processing & Algorithms You have experience with topics such as phase measurements, time-of-flight estimation, channel estimation, multipath mitigation, synchronization, calibration, or high-precision positioning. Practical Engineering Skills You are comfortable working with real hardware, conducting experiments, interpreting measurement data, and using equipment such as oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers, and vector network analyzers. Independent Thinking You are not satisfied with the answer "that's how it has always been done." You enjoy investigating difficult problems, questioning assumptions, and developing solutions that others may not have considered. Hands-on Mindset You can move between theory, simulation, code, and hardware. You enjoy seeing your ideas work in practice and understand the difference between a promising simulation and a robust real-world system. Ownership & Curiosity You take initiative, work independently, and are motivated by technical challenges. You care about the quality of your work and are willing to go deep when a problem demands it. Nice to Have Experience with UWB chipsets and low-level RF or firmware development Knowledge of PHY-layer architectures, baseband processing, or digital signal processing Experience with basic antenna design or RF front ends Experience developing novel algorithms or experimental RF systems Research experience, scientific publications, or patents in …

Buscamos incorporar Analistas de Datos con curiosidad, visión de negocio y ganas de seguir aprendiendo. Formarás parte de nuestro equipo ubicado en Cantabria, donde participarás en proyectos a medida de análisis de datos e Inteligencia Artificial. ¿Qué harás en LIS? Colaborarás con el equipo de proyectos y con cliente para entender sus necesidades y traducirlas en preguntas que los datos puedan responder. Extraerás, depurarás y prepararás datos de distintas fuentes mediante SQL y Python. Realizarás análisis exploratorios y estadísticos para identificar tendencias, patrones y oportunidades de mejora. Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards e informes que faciliten la toma de decisiones. Definirás y harás seguimiento de indicadores clave (KPIs) de los proyectos. Comunicarás los resultados de forma clara a perfiles técnicos y no técnicos. ¿Qué valoramos de ti? Imprescindible: Conocimientos de SQL en bases de datos como SQL Server o PostgreSQL. Programación en Python para análisis de datos (NumPy, Pandas) y visualización (Matplotlib, Seaborn). Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Qlik Sense o Tableau. Valorable: Conocimientos de bases de datos NoSQL (MongoDB). Experiencia en el tratamiento de datos en cloud con Azure (Blob Storage, Synapse), PySpark y Databricks. Conocimientos de Data Mining y Machine Learning con librerías como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow o PyTorch, y Azure ML. Conocimientos de Java/Spring o FastAPI. Familiaridad con Git u otros sistemas de control de versiones. Proactividad, compromiso y capacidad de resolución de problemas. Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo en equipo, también en entornos con cliente. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Plan de carrera personalizado, orientado a tu desarrollo profesional. Contrato indefinido a jornada completa. Flexibilidad horaria. 23 días hábiles de vacaciones. Jornada intensiva los viernes, en verano y durante la Navidad. Gimnasio gratuito. Si te gusta hacer las preguntas correctas y encontrar las respuestas en los datos, en LIS tienes mucho por descubrir. ¡Te esperamos!

items.desc: Sia est un groupe international de conseil en management de nouvelle génération, fondé en 1999. Avec une expertise couvrant un large éventail de secteurs et de services, nos 3 000 consultants accompagnent des clients dans le monde entier, depuis 48 bureaux répartis dans 19 pays. Notre expertise produit des résultats concrets. Notre optimisme change la donne. Description du poste Pour accompagner son développement, Sia recrute un(e) consultant(e) Data Analyst. Au sein d’une équipe de consultants expérimentés et en plein essor, vous accompagnerez nos clients notamment sur les missions suivantes : Echanger avec les différentes parties prenantes pour comprendre et définir les besoins métiers Se coordonner avec les intervenants techniques pour anticiper les risques Cartographier, acquérir et préparer les données en effectuant des vérifications de qualité, et en s’assurant de la cohérence Transformer la donnée et calculer des indicateurs afin d’interpréter et analyser les résultats Explorer les résultats des analyses en utilisant la Data Visualisation Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et développer des solutions de reporting, d'analyse de données ou de visualisation, notamment avec Power BI, Tableau, Dataiku, etc. Dans le cadre des activités internes du cabinet, votre participation s’articule autour des axes suivants : Le développement ou le renforcement de notre activité au travers de formations, de groupes de travail, de diffusion de support internes et externes... La contribution au rayonnement du cabinet par le biais de publications (articles, études, etc.), et la participation à différents salons et événements Le développement commercial en contribuant à la définition des besoins et en participant aux actions commerciales Qualifications Formation de haut niveau (Bac +5) en université, école d'ingénieur ou de commerce, dans le domaine de la data Expérience initiale souhaitée en tant qu'analyste de données ou en visualisation de données Solides connaissances en BI et Data Visualisation, incluant les concepts, méthodologies et outils pertinents Expérience avec des outils BI tels que Tableau, Power BI, Qlik, etc. Maîtrise de SQL et de Python pour la manipulation et l'analyse des données Compréhension des techniques d'extraction, de transformation et de chargement des données (ETL), avec préférence pour une expérience avec des outils ETL (e.g. Dataiku) Une expérience sur des plates-formes telles qu'Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, est un atout Vous souhaitez vous impliquer et prendre rapidement des responsabilités sur des missions à forte valeur ajoutée au sein d’une structure dynamique et en croissance. Vous partagez nos valeurs que sont l'excellence, l'entrepreneuriat, l'innovation, le partage, la bienveillance et l'équilibre vie personnelle/vie professionnelle ? Vous parlez français et anglais couramment dans un contexte professionnel ? Alors rejoignez-nous ! items.desc: Energy Forecasting Expert We are looking for an analytical and hands-on forecasting professional to join the Forecasting team at Electrohold Trade. You will own the forecasts that drive our balancing group, our renewable and battery storage portfolio, and our intraday trading decisions aimed at minimizing balancing costs. You will work with real-time data, modern analytical tools and experienced traders in one of Europe&`s fastest-changing electricity markets. What You`ll Do: Prepare daily short-term forecasts at 15-minute resolution for the consumption and generation of customers in the company's portfolio, including end consumers and renewable producers (PV and wind). Forecast PV generation and grid feed-in profiles for co-located PV+BESS sites, taking into account grid connection limits and asset availability. Prepare forecasts of the BESS capacity available for charging and discharging, based on expected PV output, state of charge, grid constraints and technical limitations. Support the planning of daily operating schedules for co-located sites and standalone BESS across day- ahead, intraday and balancing markets. Monitor forecast performance and actual versus planned BESS and co-location operation, and prepare daily, weekly and monthly reports on deviations and their imbalance cost impact. Allocate physical and financial settlement among the participants in the company's balancing groups. Administer the composition of the balancing group portfolio: onboard new sites, handle changes and keep master data up to date. Collect, clean and integrate data from metering systems, SCADA, weather providers and market sources. Improve and automate forecasting models and workflows using Python, SQL and AI-powered tools. Work closely with traders and counterparties, and act as a point of contact for forecasting and settlement questions. What We`re Looking For: A degree in Energy/Electrical Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science or a related field. At least 2 years of experience in a similar role, such as forecasting, balancing, settlement or energy data analysis. Excellent Excel skills, and working experience with SQL and/or Python. Solid understanding of time series analysis and forecasting methods. Knowledge of the Bulgarian electricity market and its regulatory framework (balancing groups, imbalance settlement, ESO rules) is a strong advantage. Experience with weather-driven renewable generation forecasting is a plus. Basic understanding of battery storage operation (state of charge, charge/discharge limits, efficiency) and of renewable co-location is an advantage. Curiosity about AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot, and willingness to use them to automate analytical tasks. Accuracy, ownership and the ability to deliver reliably under daily deadlines. Good command of English, both written and spoken. What We Offer: A key role in a team whose work directly affects the company's imbalance costs and trading results. Hands-on work with real market data, real-time plant data and business-critical models. Exposure to BESS, renewable co-location and flexibility markets, as well as international optimization partners. Modern tools covering Python, cloud and data platforms, and AI-assisted analytics. A collaborative environment and clear opportunities for professional growth.

items.desc: Job Type Full Time Job Reference # 341354BR City London Key Responsibilities We are looking for an etrading quant to join our algorithmic trading team in UBS Global Markets. This is a front-office role specializing in FX and Interest Rate Derivatives. You will work with experienced quant traders, gaining exposure to real-time trading, pricing, risk management, and PnL from day one. Responsibilities: Systematic Trading Strategy Development: Design, back-test, and implement algorithmic trading strategies for FX & interest rate markets, using a data-driven, quantitative approach. Statistical Analysis & Optimisation: Apply advanced statistical analysis and machine learning techniques to optimise pricing, quoting, and automated risk management strategies. Continuously analyse high-frequency market data to refine our models and improve execution. Full Lifecycle Involvement: Contribute to all stages of the trading strategy lifecycle – from research and model development through to coding, deployment, and real-time monitoring of strategies in production. Performance Monitoring: Track and analyse strategy performance, PnL, and risk exposures. Use data insights to identify enhancements or new trading opportunities. Collaboration & Innovation: Work closely with senior traders, software engineers, and quants to integrate new algorithms into our e-trading platform. Proactively suggest improvements to our trading tools, frameworks, and processes to drive revenue and efficiency. The team You will join UBS’s electronic trading team – a dynamic and highly technical group at the forefront of innovation in automated FX and rates trading. We operate in a collaborative, agile environment that prioritises continuous improvement and rapid deployment of strategies. The team is diverse and global, combining deep expertise in data analysis, software development, and quantitative finance. You can expect a challenging yet supportive atmosphere: we are passionate about tackling complex problems, we value intellectual curiosity, and we strive for excellence and integrity in everything we do. This role offers an exciting opportunity to launch or advance your career in quantitative trading, combining deep technology skills with direct trading impact. If you are intellectually curious, technically skilled, and eager to tackle the challenges of the fast-moving FX and interest rate markets, we strongly encourage you to apply. Your Skills And Experience Quantitative & Analytical Excellence: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a degree in a quantitative field. Programming Proficiency: Good programming skills in any language (hands-on experience with data analysis and scientific libraries). Ability to write clean, efficient code is a must. Technical Aptitude: A passion for technology and data-driven decision making. Comfortable handling large datasets and performing rigorous statistical analysis. Self-Starter: Highly motivated and able to work independently, taking initiative to drive projects forward without constant supervision. Ready to take on real ownership of deliverables in a trading environment. Communication: Strong communication skills – able to understand complex business and technical problems, and articulate solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Teamwork: Excellent interpersonal skills. A collaborative team player who can build positive working relationships and is unafraid to ask questions or respectfully challenge ideas. Financial Markets Exposure: Prior exposure to FX, rates, or STIR markets – for example, knowledge of FX swaps/forwards, interest rate derivatives or cash, or yield curve construction – is an advantage (but not a strict requirement). Electronic Trading & Tools: Experience working with electronic trading systems or market data infrastructure (e.g. understanding of order book dynamics, FIX protocol, KDB/time-series databases). Software Engineering Practices: Experience in a professional software development environment (use of version control, testing frameworks, code reviews, DevOps/CI-CD pipelines) and proficiency with additional programming languages (especially Java or C++ for low-latency systems) are plus points. You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use. About Us UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe. We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? items.desc: Organizational Setting FAO's commitment to environmental sustainability is integral to our strategic objectives and operations. The Fisheries and Aquaculture Division (NFI) works with Members and partners to transform aquatic systems and promote the responsible and sustainable management of aquatic food systems. The General Fisheries Commission for the Mediterranean (GFCM) is a regional fisheries management organization (RFMO) established under the provisions of Article XIV of the FAO Constitution. Its main objective is to promote the development, conservation, rational management and best use of living marine resources, as well as the sustainable development of aquaculture in the Mediterranean and the Black Sea. To this end, the GFCM formulates and recommends appropriate measures and ensures these recommendations are implemented; coordinates efforts by countries to effectively manage fisheries and aquaculture; monitors the status of fishery resources and carries out scientific work to support advice and decision-making; coordinates and benefits from the support of projects and programmes at the regional and subregional levels to enhance scientific cooperation and capacity-building among its contracting parties and cooperating non-contracting parties. Data and information are at the core of the GFCM's mandate to support the conservation, management and sustainable use of marine living resources and the sustainable development of aquaculture in the Mediterranean and the Black Sea. Reliable, timely and harmonized data underpin scientific assessments, management advice, monitoring of fisheries and aquaculture activities, and the evaluation of conservation and management measures. In this context, the Data Team is pivotal within the GFCM Secretariat, ensuring the effective collection, validation, quality assurance and control, integration, analysis, management and dissemination of data and information from across the region, for both fisheries and aquaculture. By strengthening data management, quality, analysis and accessibility, the Data Team enhances the GFCM's capacity to provide robust scientific evidence and advice, supporting informed and evidence-based decision-making, facilitating regional cooperation, transparency in data and information exchange and ultimately contributing to the achievement of the GFCM's strategic objectives. The position is located in the GFCM headquarters at Palazzo Blumenstihl (Via Vittoria Colonna 1, Rome, Italy). Reporting Lines The Fishery Officer (Data coordination) reports and operates under the general supervision of the GFCM Executive Secretary, and in close collaboration with the technical staff of the GFCM Secretariat, both at GFCM headquarters and in the subregional technical units, transversally. She/he supervises a team of specialists dedicated to the implementation of the workplan related to the management, analysis, use and dissemination of fisheries and aquaculture data and information. Technical Focus Support the effective implementation and delivery of the GFCM mandate by leading the development, coordination and continuous improvement of fisheries and aquaculture data management systems and processes, by ensuring the timely collection, integration, quality assurance, analysis, use and dissemination of relevant data and information, as per GFCM requirements in place and in line with established priorities and adopted workplans. This includes providing technical leadership on data governance, supporting evidence-based decision-making, enhancing data interoperability and innovation, fostering collaboration with Members, partners and relevant organizations, and promoting data quality, harmonization, accessibility and transparency in support of GFCM scientific, management and compliance-related processes. Key Results Research, technical analysis and project related services to support the delivery of programme projects, products and services. Key Functions Researches, analyses and provides access to fisheries and aquaculture technical, social, economic, environmental, institutional and technology related data, and information and/or related policy issues to support the delivery of fisheries and aquaculture programmes, projects, products, publications and services. Produces a variety of technical data, statistics, information and reports, as well as input for technical documents and web pages. Provides technical, statistical, and/or analytical services on various studies, projects and initiatives, and/or assessments; provides technical backstopping to field projects. Participates in the development of improved/updated technical, statistical and/or analytical tools, methodologies, systems, databases and/or key social/economic/environmental/ nutritional and/or early warning indicators, etc. Participates in multidisciplinary teams and/or leads working groups/teams; collaborates with other Divisions/Offices/Centres on work groups and committees and promotes best …

items.desc: Bouw mee aan de toekomst van de huisartsenzorg Wil jij AI-oplossingen ontwikkelen die direct bijdragen aan toegankelijke en toekomstbestendige zorg? Bij PharmaPartners werk je aan AivyCare : een nieuw, intelligent platform dat huisartsen en zorgorganisaties helpt om zorgvragen slimmer, sneller en beter af te handelen. Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan toepassingen die de druk in de zorg verlagen en de continuïteit van zorg helpen borgen. Je komt terecht in een omgeving waar nog veel te bouwen en te ontdekken is. Samen met onze huidige AI engineer / architect werk je aan de verdere ontwikkeling van AivyCare en help je technische keuzes te vertalen naar een schaalbaar en relevant product voor de zorg. Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer werk je in een klein en gedreven team aan de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Je schakelt direct met engineering, architectuur, product en domeinkennis. Je bouwt niet alleen aan techniek, maar denkt ook mee over hoe we AI slim, veilig en schaalbaar toepassen in een product dat er echt toe doet. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen, bouwen en doorontwikkelen van AI-functionaliteiten binnen AivyCare. Het ontwikkelen van backend services, API-koppelingen en intelligente workflows. Het vertalen van ideeën en use cases naar werkende prototypes en productieklare oplossingen. Het toepassen van LLM’s, agentic workflows en andere AI-technieken waar die aantoonbaar waarde toevoegen. Het verbeteren van kwaliteit, testbaarheid, onderhoudbaarheid en schaalbaarheid. Het meedenken over architectuurkeuzes, technische richting en ontwikkelstandaarden. Het samen met onze AI engineer / architect versnellen van de ontwikkeling van AivyCare. Wie zoeken wij? Wij zoeken niet primair op senioriteit of een vast aantal jaren ervaring. Voor ons zijn mindset, eigenaarschap en het vermogen om mee te bouwen in een ondernemende omgeving belangrijker. We zoeken iemand die initiatief neemt, verantwoordelijkheid pakt en graag werkt aan iets dat nog volop in ontwikkeling is. Jij past waarschijnlijk goed als je: Hbo of wo werk- en denkniveau hebt, bij voorkeur in informatica, AI, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting. Ervaring hebt met softwareontwikkeling, bijvoorbeeld in backend development, integraties of platformontwikkeling. Affiniteit hebt met AI-toepassingen en nieuwsgierig bent naar hoe je die inzet in echte producten. Pragmatisch bent en goed functioneert in een omgeving waar nog niet alles vastligt. Kunt meedenken van concept tot realisatie en verder kijkt dan alleen je eigen code. Kwaliteit belangrijk vindt en begrijpt dat betrouwbaarheid en veiligheid in de zorg essentieel zijn. Goed kunt samenwerken met product, architectuur en andere disciplines. Enthousiast wordt van onze technologie stack: Java 25, Spring Boot Modulith, FHIR R4, PostgreSQL, Keycloak, React/Vite, Azure Cloud Provider. Enthousiast bent over agentic development met Claude Code. Herken je jezelf in dit profiel, maar ligt je kracht meer in fullstack, frontend development of operations? Reageer dan gerust. We zoeken bouwers met de juiste mindset; de exacte invulling van de rol bepalen we samen. Wat bieden wij jou? Bij PharmaPartners krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan een nieuw AI-gedreven product voor de eerstelijnszorg. Je werkt in een omgeving waar technologie, productontwikkeling en maatschappelijke relevantie samenkomen. Wij bieden jou onder andere: Een marktconform salaris: tussen €2972 en €5507 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en niveau als Developer. 26 vakantiedagen + 8,33% vakantiegeld: o.b.v. een fulltime (40 uur p/w) dienstverband. Een goede pensioenregeling: met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%. Jaarlijks €500,- persoonlijk budget: wat je kunt besteden aan sport en persoonlijke groei. Hybride werken: hybride werken betekent bij ons dat je minimaal 3 á 4 dagen per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen interactie en flexibiliteit. Een uitdagende rol: met veel invloed en verantwoordelijkheid. De kans om vanaf een vroeg stadium mee te bouwen aan AivyCare: een nieuw platform in de eerstelijnszorg. Sporten onder werktijd: bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag- en donderdagmiddag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s te gaan bootcampen. Een hechte, open werksfeer: ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en sterke teamspirit. Veel ruimte voor initiatief, ontwikkeling en ondernemerschap. Enthousiast? Wil jij bouwen aan AI-oplossingen die echt verschil maken in de (huisartsen)zorg? Dan komen we graag met je in contact.

We are looking for an experienced Backend Engineer with a strong interest in AI to help shape the future of a proven SaaS platform in the real estate sector. The company develops an innovative SaaS solution used daily by hundreds of customers in the private and public sector. The product is well established, but AI is opening up new possibilities for automation and how users interact with the platform. You will build and experiment with AI agents that can understand what a user wants, work with the existing backend and databases, and take action on their behalf. Requirements: We are looking for a Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience, a solid understanding of backend development and databases, and a genuine interest in AI. You don't need years of AI experience. What matters is that you understand how software works and are excited to explore how agents can be built and integrated into a real product. You will work closely with the engineering team to experiment, build prototypes and turn successful ideas into reliable features. Most importantly, you are curious, pragmatic and not afraid to try something new. Benefits: €90k Bonus Pension Hybrid working Initial 12-month contract, after that permanent. Interested? With 2+ million customers worldwide, we're providing unique opportunities and, attracting talents to join our fast-growing team. If you think you're bold, ambitious, and not afraid to challenge yourself, let's talk! We are looking: At Fleming, we're on the lookout for an Software Engineer who's ready to dive into building the agentic systems that power our products. If you're a strong software engineer excited to bring good engineering practices into a fast-moving new space, then this is the role for you. Not required, but a definite plus if you've built agents that go beyond a single prompt-response loop - think tool use, memory, or multi-step reasoning. Get ready to: Build Agentic Systems: Design and build agents that handle conversations, decisions, and workflows, using LLMs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) and modern agent frameworks. Work with AI Every Day: Embrace our AI-first mindset and apply state-of-the-art models across product, ops, growth, content. Architect Internal Platforms: Build reusable backend services and APIs that let different agent products share infrastructure and grow together. Own the Full Journey: Take agents from early design through building, testing, launching, and improving them over time. Collaborate Across Teams: Work directly with every team to integrate agents and AI into products and processes across the company. We expect you to: 2+ years of solid software engineering experience. Node.js and TypeScript preferred, but not strictly necessary. Agent-building experience isn't required, but it’s a huge plus. If you've never touched an agent framework before, that's completely fine - what matters is that you're genuinely curious and ready to learn quickly once you're here. Be comfortable picking up new concepts on the fly, since things like retrieval systems, vector databases, and prompt writing don't need to be second nature yet. Be familiar with Git and general good engineering habits, like testing your work and setting up smooth ways to ship code. Have strong problem-solving abilities to troubleshoot and identify root causes of issues, whether in a traditional system or a brand-new agent workflow. Be fluent in Lithuanian and English.
