On Fridays, we mix it up, sometimes we head out to San Diego Pub, other times we order in pizza, sushi, or other. Snacks & Refreshments : Unlimited drinks, snacks, fresh fruits, and veggies. Job Description Summary 
Als Elektrotechniker übernehmen Sie eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in der operativen Instandhaltung und stellen den sicheren Betrieb elektrischer Anlagen sicher. Sie führen selbstständig Wartungs‑, Reparatur‑ und Störungsbehebungsarbeiten durch, unterstützen Elektro‑Projekte und bringen sich aktiv in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung von Prozessen (KVP) ein. Dabei arbeiten Sie eng mit internen Kolleg:innen, externen Firmen sowie dem Produktionspersonal zusammen und gewährleisten die fachgerechte Umsetzung und Dokumentation aller Tätigkeiten gemäß GxP‑Richtlinien und geltenden Industriestandards. 
 Job Description 
 Deine Verantwortungen: 
 Durchführung von elektrotechnischen Wartungsarbeiten gemäß interner Vorgaben.
 Mitarbeit bei der Umsetzung von Elektro-Projekten.
 Selbstständige Umsetzung von Wartungstätigkeiten, Reparaturarbeiten, Fehlersuche und Fehlerbehebungen.
 Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Abläufen und Prozessen (KVP).
 Enge Zusammenarbeit und Abstimmung bei der täglichen Arbeit innerhalb der Abteilung, sowie mit externen Firmen und Technikern.
 Umsetzung und Dokumentation aller Arbeiten unter Einhaltung von GxP-Richtlinien und Industriestandards.
 Einhaltung von Vorgaben aus Wartungs und Arbeitsplänen bei der Ausführung spezifischer Tätigkeiten.
 Unterstützung bei der Einschulung von neuen oder externen Mitarbeitern und dem Produktionspersonal.
 Was Sie für die Rolle mitbringen: 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik.
 Für die Stelle sind gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie Grundkenntnisse in Englisch erforderlich.
 Teamfähigkeit (Teamplayer).
 Erste Berufserfahrung idealerweise im GxP-Bereich ist von Vorteil.
 You are applying to be part of the Novartis Talent Pool. We are not currently recruiting for this role but we are building a pipeline for future opportunities. If you would like to be considered for a similar position in future, then please submit your CV. 
 Warum Novartis? 
 Unser Vorsatz ist es, die Medizin neu zu gestalten, um Menschenleben zu verbessern und zu verlängern. Unsere Vision ist es, das wertvollste und vertrauenswürdigste Pharmaunternehmen der Welt zu werden. Wie wir das erreichen werden? Mit unseren Mitarbeitern. Es sind unsere Mitarbeiter, die uns tagtäglich dazu antreiben, unsere Ziele zu erreichen. Werden Sie Teil dieser Mission und dieses großartigen Teams! Erfahren Sie hier mehr: https://www.novartis.com/about/strategy/people-and-culture 
 Stellen Sie sich vor, was Sie bei Novartis tun könnten!
 Was wir bieten: Neben einem marktgerechten Grundgehalt bieten wir ein attraktives Bonus/Incentive Programm, eine moderne Firmenpension, Kinderbetreuungseinrichtungen, Aus- und Weiterbildungsprogramme und weltweite Karrieremöglichkeiten innerhalb der Novartis Gruppe. Das Grundgehalt für diese Position besteht aus dem kollektivvertraglichen Mindestgehalt in Höhe von € 47.532,24/Jahr (auf Vollzeitbasis) sowie einer allfälligen Überzahlung, basierend auf Ihren bisherigen Erfahrungen, Qualifikationen und individuellen Kompetenzen. 
 Engagement für Vielfalt und Inklusion: Novartis setzt sich für Vielfalt, Chancengleichheit und Inklusion ein. Wir sind bestrebt, vielfältige Teams zusammenzustellen, die für die Patienten und Gemeinschaften repräsentativ sind, denen wir dienen. Wir bemühen uns um die Schaffung eines inklusiven Arbeitsplatzes, der durch Zusammenarbeit mutige Innovationen fördert und unsere Mitarbeiter in die Lage versetzt, ihr volles Potenzial zu entfalten. Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Chancengleichheit und der besten Qualifikation, ungeachtet von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, Hautfarbe, Rasse, sexueller Orientierung, Nationalität oder Behinderung.

 Job Description Summary 
#LI-Onsite

Kot tehnik vzdrževanja boste odgovorni za podporo pri pripravi in izvedbi aktivnosti vzdrževanja in usmerjanja. Podpirali boste aktivnosti zagonov za projekte na nivoju lokacije skladno z zakonodajo, internimi predpisi, dobrimi praksami in poslovnimi cilji. 
 Job Description 
 Vaše ključne odgovornosti 
 - Izvajanje vzdrževalnih in kalibracijskih aktivnosti 
 - Priprava orodja, rezervnih delov itd. za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo, dostava na delovno območje, izdelava delov za hitra popravila in izboljšave 
 - Pridobivanje dovoljenj za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo/projekte 
 - Izvajanje delovnih nalogov za vzdrževanje/kalibracijo v skladu z opisom metod/procesom

 - Dokumentiranje izvedbe vzdrževanja/kalibracije 
 - Sodelovanje pri izvajanju dejavnosti vzdrževanja/kalibracije s strani tretjih oseb 
 - Določanje rezervnih delov za vzdrževanje in vodenje seznamov za prevzem 
 - Podpiranje dejavnosti, povezanih s projekti vzdrževanja na ravni lokacije 
 - Predlaganje tehničnih izboljšav ter drugih uporabnih predlogov 
 Vaš doprinos k delovnem mestu: 
 Znanje slovenskega jezika. 
 Poznavanje orodja Microsoft Office. 
 Zaželene delovne izkušnje v farmacevtski / kemijski industriji. 
 Enoizmensko delo in dežurstva 
 Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo 6 mesecev . Prijavo oddajte z življenjepisom v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku. 
 Nagrajevanje: 
 V Novartisu smo zavezani k soustvarjanju prihodnosti medicine ter priznavanju in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki to omogočajo. 
 Pričakovani letni osnovni razpon plače za delovno mesto: 
 • Slovenija: 17.800,00 - 30.420,00 € 
 Osnovna plača se določa na podlagi vnaprej opredeljenih in transparentnih kriterijev, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje, ne glede na spol, ter v skladu z Novartisovo politiko določanja plač. Po zaposlitvi v Novartisu se plača periodično pregleda v skladu z internimi akti in postopki. 
 Plačna enakost je temeljno načelo naše kadrovske politike in odraža našo zavezo k ustvarjanju raznolikega, pravičnega in vključujočega okolja, ki vse zaposlene obravnava dostojanstveno in spoštljivo, kot je opredeljeno v našem Kodeksu etike. 
 Poleg osnovne letne bruto plače so zaposleni upravičeni tudi do spodaj navedenih ugodnosti: 
 Letni bonus, ki pripada vsakemu zaposlenemu: 9% letne plače. 
 Regres za dopust : Leta 2025 je znašal 2.496 € (neto). Za leto 2026 znaša 2.678,28 € (neto). 
 Nagrada za poslovno uspešnost : Leta 2025 je znašala 2.538,64 € (bruto), skupaj z zimskim regresom. 
 Prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje : Novartis v Sloveniji zagotavlja prostovoljno dodatno pokojninsko zavarovanje (5,844 % bruto izplačila, letno omejeno na 3.224,18 €). 
 Dodatek za izmensko delo (15 %); večizmensko delo (20 %), nočno delo (70 %), delo ob nedeljah in praznikih (50 %). 
 Zavarovanje: 
 undefined
 undefined
 Care Connect: Program, ki ponuja zaupno, osebno podporo za vaše duševno zdravje in dobro počutje s pomočjo terapij, svetovanj, orodij in še mnogo več. 
 Ostale ugodnosti v skladu z zakonom in kolektivno pogodbo: Prevoz, prehrana ter ostali dodatki. 
 Preberite brošuro in izvedite več o našem sistemu nagrajevanja: https://www.novartis.com/sites/novartis_com/files/novartis-life-handbook.pdf 
 Opomba: Ugodnosti se lahko razlikujejo glede na državo ter so skladni z lokalno zakonodajo, vključno z določili kolektivnih pogodb. Celovit pregled vašega paketa prejemkov, vključno z morebitnimi relevantnimi določbami kolektivne pogodbe, ki veljajo za vašo delovno mesto glede na lokacijo zaposlitve in delodajalca Novartis, vam bo posredovan v okviru nadaljnjih korakov zaposlitvenega postopka. 
 Predani smo raznolikosti in vključenosti: Novartis si prizadeva ustvariti izjemno, vključujoče delovno okolje in oblikovanje raznolikih timov, saj ti predstavljajo naše bolnike in skupnosti, ki jih oskrbujemo. 
 Zakaj Novartis: Pomagati bolnikom in njihovim družinam zahteva več kot le inovativno znanost. Potrebna je skupnost zavzetih ljudi, kot ste vi. V Novartisu cenimo sodelovanje, podporo in navdihovanje drug drugega za razvoj prebojnih terapij, ki spreminjajo življenja pacientov. items.desc:
Introduction to the job
 Would you like to work hands-on with some of the most advanced semiconductor manufacturing technology in the world? As a Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE at ASML in Veldhoven, you will help install our next-generation lithography systems at customer locations worldwide.
 Your goal is to deliver each system safely, on time, according to specification, and at the expected quality level. This is a highly international position where you will work abroad for more than 50% of your time.
 As a Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE, you will combine hands-on mechanical work with technical troubleshooting, problem solving, teamwork, and direct customer interaction.
 Role and responsibilities
 You will install and commission advanced EXE lithography systems at customer locations. Working closely with colleagues and customers, you will solve technical challenges and contribute to continuously improving our installation activities.
 You will:
 Perform mechanical installation, adjustment, and commissioning of complete EXE systems.
 Install equipment at customer locations, including systems with new features and technologies.
 Perform complex adjustments, upgrades, diagnostics, and troubleshooting with limited support.
 Answer technical customer questions and provide professional on-site support.
 Transfer technical knowledge to local installation and support teams.
 Complete required documentation, handovers, issue tracking, and progress reports.
 Identify and contribute to structural improvements in installation methods and processes.
 Education and experience
 To qualify for the Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE position, you have:
 A vocational degree with at least two years of relevant professional experience, or a bachelor’s degree.
 A technical background in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, aerospace engineering, automotive engineering, or a comparable field.
 Hands-on experience in a high-tech production, engineering, installation, or technical customer service environment.
 Demonstrated experience with mechanical assembly and technical troubleshooting.
 Experience working with both large-scale and precision mechanics is preferred.
 Skills
 Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.
 To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:
 Put safety first in every activity and working environment.
 Communicate clearly in spoken and written English with colleagues and customers.
 Approach hands-on engineering challenges with curiosity and a problem-solving mindset.
 Work accurately and aim to get things right the first time.
 Stay structured and focused while working in a dynamic and changing environment.
 Take initiative and work independently while recognizing when additional support is needed.
 Collaborate effectively with colleagues and customers from different cultures and backgrounds.
 Other information
 The Mechanical Install Engineer - EXE position is based in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. You will work abroad at customer locations for more than 50% of your time. You must also be willing to work flexible shift patterns, both in Veldhoven and at customer sites.
 Due to the investment in your technical development and training, you should be prepared to commit to the installation organization for at least three years.
 Please submit an updated resume and a cover letter explaining your motivation for this specific position at ASML.
 For this position, the indicative (fixed) annual salary range is between 58,500 euro and 66,000 euro. This range comprises vacation allowance and a 13th-month payment and is based on a full-time contract. Company profit sharing is not included in this range. As this is a shift-based position you will receive a shift allowance on top of the indicated salary range. The actual compensation offered will depend on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job-related skills, relevant education and (work) experience, certifications, demonstrated abilities of the candidate, pay relative to other team members. This information is provided for transparency and guidance purposes only, and no rights can be derived from this salary indication.
 We have the intention to organize an interview day on the 24th of November to complete all the interviews for the role. Please make sure you will be available for this day. Of course we aim to give you clarity as soon as possible if you will be invited.

Job Description: 
 Au sein d’une équipe d’ ingénieurs Airworthiness confirmés, vous aurez l’occasion de travailler sur des programmes multiples et de découvrir les processus qui réglementent le suivi de navigabilité chez ATR . 
 Missions & Responsabilités 
 De profil ingénieur, vous serez responsable du suivi de navigabilité d'un ou plusieurs programmes A/C . Vous participerez en collaboration avec différents acteurs du suivi de navigabilité (service navigabilité, bureau d'études, support, programme) aux activités suivantes : 
 Revue des événements en service dans la flotte, 
 Analyse des causes profondes et suivi des incidents, 
 Gérer toute condition dangereuse survenant dans la flotte,
 Coordonner avec le personnel de navigabilité du site et les bureaux d'études pour la préparation des justifications nécessaires pour soutenir la fonction de maintien de la navigabilité. 
 Assurer un reporting approprié sur les progrès réalisés auprès de l'organisation du programme d'ingénierie du site,
 Gérer et coordonner avec le bureau de navigabilité les présentations de la flotte à faire aux autorités de navigabilité 
 Participation aux réunions avec les Autorités de Navigabilité (EASA, FAA, ...) 
 Analyse et suivi de la mise en œuvre des actions correctives proposées, 
 Analyse et suivi du Service Bulletin et des Consignes de Navigabilité. 
 Vous serez responsable du déroulement des activités et du respect des jalons de livraison. Vous devrez également communiquer l'avancement des activités au service de navigabilité. La connaissance de la Partie-21A.3 et de l'AMC/GM associé est requise pour mener à bien les activités de surveillance de la navigabilité. 
 Les compétences qui comptent pour nous: 
 Formation grandes écoles ou universités 
 Idéalement une spécialisation en aéronautique.
 Connaissances en : 
 ARP 5150 (Safety Assessment of Transport Airplanes in Commercial Service), 
 Part-21A.3, Part-M (Continuing airworthiness requirements) 
 CS 23/25/27/29 
 La connaissance des systèmes aéronautiques est un atout pour le poste. 
 Qualités : Ce que vous apporterez à votre future équipe 
 Rigueur et capacité de synthèse (écrite et verbale) 
 Esprit analytique, capacité de synthèse 
 Intérêt pour les aspects techniques 
 De solides compétences en communication. 
 As an international company, we work in a multicultural environment: an negociation level in English is mandatory.
 Votre processus de recrutement : 
 Nous valorisons le contact humain. Afin de mieux vous connaître, voici les étapes habituelles de notre processus de recrutement après analyse de votre candidature : 
 Dossier de candidature à remplir envoyé par votre chargé(e) de recrutement. 
 Entretien technique avec le manager. 
 Entretien avec le/la Chargé(e) de Recrutement. 
 Un feedback personnalisé après le processus 
 Vous recherchez un poste avec une activité variée et de réelles opportunités d'évolution… 
 Venez vivre l'aventure Airbus Protect… On vous attend !

Job Description: 
 About our team... 
 Airbus Helicopters is the world’s largest helicopter manufacturer and the company’s site at Oxford Airport is Britain’s civil helicopter hub. 
 AHUK offers considerable experience in helicopter sales, bespoke completions, maintenance and spares support. Its in-house engineering capabilities include design, customisation, installation, flight-testing and certification, as well as technical support, maintenance, training and the supply of spares for civil and military applications. 
 AHUK is the MoD’s chosen provider of helicopters and maintenance for its No.1 Helicopter Flying school (referred to as MFTS) located in RAF Shawbury (Shropshire) and RAF Valley (Anglesey). 
 Description/Overall purpose of the Job 
 Sheet Metal Fabricator/Fitter role is to contribute to the delivery of bespoke, high-quality helicopter solutions through complex prototype development, retrofit, and series production. The role involves developing and manufacturing detailed parts from sheet metal to aviation standards within a workshop or hangar, assembling components, and working closely with the design team on prototype work. 
 Carry out detailed inspections of subcontractor manufactured parts to ensure compliance with engineering drawings. Carrying out repairs to in service helicopters using sheet metal and composite techniques. With the overall output to maintain the safety and airworthiness of helicopters within the customisation and MRO departments 
 Main responsibilities 
 Accomplishment of work as directed by the Installation Supervisor or Certifying Engineer 
 Manufacture detailed parts from sheet metal 
 Inspect parts manufactured by subcontractors 
 Assembling parts manufactured by subcontractors 
 Applying protective coatings 
 Working closely with the design team 
 All parts manufactured must be in compliance with the design data to ensure safe operation of aircraft 
 Working as part of a team or individually depending on the specific work packages 
 Will also be required to assist in day to day running of the hangar, including aircraft handling. 
 Maintain high standards house keeping in line with the Airbus “Clean As You Go” initiative 
 Working within a highly regulated environment 
 Carry out repairs to helicopter structures and components 
 Flexible working attitude to deal with the changing priorities within the departments 
 Knowledge and Skills 
 Essential 
 Ability to work as part of a team, and on own initiative, as well as to high standards in order to ensure the continued safe operation of the aircraft. 
 Be able to read and understand detailed engineering drawings and associated data 
 Interest in DIY 
 Good manual hand skills 
 Able to work in confined spaces 
 Good communication skills 
 Reliable with ability to remain calm when under pressure 
 Well organised and methodical with a high attention to detail 
 Able to adhere to the requirements of H&S to wear the appropriate PPE for each task 
 Ability to use Google Office and MS products 
 Desirable 
 Knowledge of techniques used in manufacturing parts from sheet metal to close tolerance 
 Knowledge of types of fasteners used to assemble sheet metal and components using rivets, mechanical fasteners and adhesive bonding used in aviation 
 Ability to use SAP / Envision 
 Education, Qualifications or Training 
 Essential 
 Minimum Level 2 qualification in Fabrication 
 Must be able to present examples of work done via photographic record. 
 Previous experience in a similar role such as Sheet Metal Working, Metal Fabrication, Mechanical Fitter or Automotive repair 
 Clean Driving Licence 
 Desirable 
 Aviation experience 
 Sheet Metal Experience 
 Composites Experience 
 About you 
 Attention to detail 
 Punctuality 
 Ability to meet deadlines 
 Ability to work as part of a diverse, multi-skilled workforce 
 High level of integrity and understanding of responsibility 
 Additional requirements 
 Due to the nature of this position you will require DBS Security Clearance and be eligible for SC clearance. 
 Applicants must meet any/all requirements of Export Compliance Regulations. 
 All candidates must possess the current, legal right to work in the United Kingdom. Airbus will not be able to offer sponsorship for any employment Visa's. 
 Shift working may be required as part of a normal working pattern. (shift allowance payable) 
 Occasional need to travel to subcontractors or other Airbus facilities including overseas 
 The Reward 
 In joining the Airbus family, you will play a critical part in delivering the most efficient helicopters for its customers, who serve, protect, save lives and carry passengers in demanding environments. On top of your competitive base salary, you will have access to the following benefits below via our Airbus salary sacrifice schemes: 
 Private Medical Insurance (Bupa) – single cover for employees paid by the company 
 Pension: Employees are auto-enrolled into the Airbus Group UK Retirement Fund. …

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial recherche un(e) Flight Dynamics Model Integrator (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Flight Dynamics & Performance basé à Toulouse , France. 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui développe des modèles intégrés de dynamique du vol (pré-vol et recalés en vol), des outils et environnements de simulation pour les qualités de vol, ainsi que des données de validation et packages logiciels pour les simulateurs d'entraînement et leur qualification. Au sein de l'équipe Flight Dynamics & Performance , vous serez impliqué(e) dans le développement et l'intégration de modèles et de plateformes de simulation visant à répondre aux besoins des équipes Stabilité et Contrôle, des simulateurs d'intégration systèmes et des fabricants de simulateurs d'entraînement. 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d’actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : Couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel : Des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). 
 Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. 
 Vos challenges : 
 Intégrer les modèles de systèmes avion (propulsion, commandes de vol, trains d'atterrissage) dans les environnements de simulation. 
 Fournir des simulations de dynamique du vol haute fidélité avec validation fonctionnelle et opérationnelle. 
 Livrer des assemblages de simulation pour les plateformes d'ingénierie et les simulateurs d'entraînement des pilotes. 
 Assurer l'alignement des plateformes de simulation avec les données réelles d'essais en vol pour garantir cohérence et fidélité. 
 Développer l'amélioration continue des processus de vérification et validation (V&V) au moyen de la simulation en boucle fermée. 
 Votre carte d’embarquement : 
 Formation d’ingénieur aéronautique généraliste, appétence pour la data et l’informatique. 
 Au moins 1 an d'expérience en développement et validation de plateformes de simulation. 
 Expertise technique en mécanique du vol et en intégration de modèles complexes. 
 Solide maîtrise des environnements de simulation temps réel. 
 Ce poste requiert un niveau courant en anglais et un niveau avancé en Français. 
 Vous ne matchez pas à 100%? Pas d'inquiétude! Airbus vous accompagnera dans votre plan de développement. Donnez une nouvelle dimension à votre carrière en candidatant en ligne maintenant!

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an ISR Mission Systems Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) 
 As ISR Mission Systems engineer the candidate will be integrated in a team in charge of developing ISR Mission Systems for several Aircrafts as C295, RPAS/UAS, A400M, etc. The activities to be performed are mainly focused on system detailed design (Functional requirements, modelling & prototyping, Subsystem Specs, ICDs, Drawings, Equipment Integration, etc.) and supplier technical steering considering a V-shape development framework.
 This also considers the V&V activities associated as product laboratory validation, support A/C ground and flight Testing, etc. to achieve the full Qualification and Certification of the product.
 Required skills for a suitable candidate are:
 Technical Profile (no management)
 Expertise in ISR Mission & Avionics disciplines is greatly appreciated
 Previous knowledge/experience in ISR missions as Maritime surveillance/Patrol, antisubmarine warfare, AGS, EW, etc would be considered very positively
 Good knowledge of Mission Sensors & Subsystems as Optronics systems, Radar (SAR, MPR, etc.),SIGINT/ELINT/ESM/COMINT, ASW warfare sensors, etc.
 Good knowledge of Displays, Navigation Systems, Computing Platforms, Transponders, etc.
 Good knowledge of UAS and/or Manned Mission Systems
 Excellent knowledge of development & integration activities, from requirements capture to verification/validation activities to achieve a qualified/certified system. That includes engineering fields as safety, quality assurance, configuration control, etc. applied to Mission Systems
 Good knowledge of procurement activities, from supplier selection to control and monitoring activities.
 Proactiveness is a must
 Good communication skills, assertiveness and willingness to travel
 Strong Spanish and English skills, both verbal and written

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aircraft Control - Test engineer (f/m) to join our Control Modelling, Simulation & V&V department based in Toulouse, France. 
 ​You will be part of an integrated team and will work collaboratively with system designer teams and V&V test teams to coordinate the maturity testing activities of Aircraft control systems (Auto-flight ATA22, Flight Control ATA27) on a simulated platform (VSIM-D) on one or several programs. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
 Work / Life Balance: Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services.

 You will be part of a supportive team who will support you upon your arrival with a specific learning path and all along your journey with us. 
 This position will offer the opportunity to discover/extend your knowledge on Aircraft Control systems and their development working in close collaboration with the designers. 
 The maturity tests are an essential step in the V&V process to ensure maturity of the final products. They allow testing and identifying/correcting potential defects in early stages of the development before the official test campaign. 
 Your challenges: 
 Prepare, perform Tests and associated analysis and investigation on simulated platform 
 Coordinate maturity tests activity on simulated platform: testing roadmap, workload estimation, test results report all along the development and for the dedicated milestones (ex: Flight Clearance) 
 Work in close collaboration with Design team and other testing teams 
 Participate to Testing tools development: Define & update Testing Tools needs, follow-up development and validation 
 Define, update and validate Testing Usage Domain 
 Support V&V manager/leader activities

 System Design and Development

 Negotiation level of English (+ French will be a strong additional asset)

items.desc:
Lieu : Limours, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Situé à 20mn du Pôle technologique de Paris-Saclay, le site est l’un des plus grands centres d’excellence radars de surface. Nous contribuons à développer, concevoir, intégrer et tester des radars de surveillance aériennes dédiés à la détection et l’identification de cibles. 
 En tant qu’Ingénieur Systèmes - Traitement du Signal / Algorithmie Radar chez Thales, vous serez impliqué dans un environnement très dynamique dans le cadre du développement des radars GroundMaster, des projets complexes à haute valeur technique au sein d'une équipe motivée et accueillante.
 Techniquement, vous devrez mener l'enquête en réalisant l'analyse fonctionnelle détaillée du système Radar notamment en tenant compte des besoins client et des autres parties prenantes. De plus, vous devrez démontrer votre capacité à communiquer dans ce type de contexte (diplomatie, capacité à convaincre, management sans lien hiérarchique, etc.).
 A ce titre, en phase de spécification , vous serez en charge des aspects suivants :
 Définir les caractéristiques fonctionnelles du radar (bilan énergétique, séquencements, définition algorithmique de traitement) répondant aux exigences de performances opérationnelles souhaitées,
 Réaliser des analyses et des évaluations en support de la justification de la conception , au moyen de calculs analytiques ou de simulations au moyen de modèles du comportement fonctionnel,
 Proposer des évolutions du système , réaliser les traitements algorithmiques ad-hoc, participer à l’innovation.
 Préparer l'arrivée des nouveaux traitements d'intelligence artificielle qui font progressivement leur apparition dans les chaînes de traitement radar.
 En phase de validation du système vous devrez :
 Apporter votre expertise aux équipes d’intégration en identifiant et résolvant les problèmes remontés par celles-ci,
 Réaliser des analyses fonctionnelles sur des données radar simulées ou enregistrées suite à des essais terrain (éventuellement par la ré-exécution informatique des algorithmes de traitement), en développant au besoin vos propres outils d’analyse,
 Valider les algorithmes et évaluer les performances face à divers scénarios de test,
 Etre un support aux projets, lors de présentations clients, revues, démonstrations.
 Plus globalement, en nous rejoignant, vous participerez à favoriser l'émergence de modèles, algorithmes et éléments de simulation standardisés et réutilisables au sein de la discipline.
 Votre Profil : 
 De formation supérieure niveau BAC +5, type école d'ingénierie ou équivalent universitaire, vous avez acquis de solides compétences en traitement du signal, probabilité, modèles mathématiques et en algorithmie ainsi que des connaissances en électronique et logiciel. Vous présentez un fort intérêt pour les systèmes complexes et les nouvelles techniques, en particulier les radars. Vous avez le goût pour les investigations et mener les enquêtes pour comprendre et remonter à l'origine des problèmes.

items.desc:
OWN YOUR INTELLIGENCE

Prime Intellect is building the open superintelligence stack: infrastructure and tools that help ambitious AI teams train, evaluate, and deploy advanced models.

 


ROLE IMPACT

Platform engineering at Prime Intellect sits on the path from a research idea to a running AI workload. Your core mandate is to make every engineering team faster and safer: turn recurring infrastructure and security needs into paved roads, self-service capabilities, and guardrails that help teams move from idea to production with confidence.

This is a hands-on senior role with broad technical ownership. You will write code, set platform standards, and partner directly with research, product engineering, and security to improve how services are built, shipped, and operated.

 


WHY THIS ROLE STANDS OUT

 - Work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure and distributed, GPU-intensive AI workloads

 - Own foundational systems in a small, senior team where technical decisions have visible impact

 - Multiply the impact of other teams through secure defaults, automation, and a strong developer experience
   
    


WHAT YOU’LL OWN

 - Build reusable infrastructure-as-code and reliable CI/CD workflows for platform services

 - Design cloud foundations spanning compute, networking, identity, secrets, and service delivery

 - Develop progressive rollout, health-check, and rollback patterns for critical infrastructure

 - Build self-service platform capabilities, templates, and guardrails that shorten the path from code to production

 - Partner with research and product teams to remove delivery bottlenecks and turn recurring needs into reusable platform capabilities

 - Define practical observability standards across metrics, logs, dashboards, and alerting using tools such as Grafana

 - Define and own platform SLOs, partnering with service teams on targets, error budgets, and reliability priorities

 - Turn security and compliance requirements into reusable platform controls

 - Lead complex platform projects from technical design through adoption and steady-state operation
   
    


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years in infrastructure, platform, or security-focused engineering

 - Deep hands-on experience with Terraform or similar infrastructure-as-code tooling

 - Strong knowledge of cloud networking, IAM, secrets management, and CI/CD

 - Experience designing secure software delivery lifecycle environments from development through production

 - Production experience with Kubernetes or similar container orchestration platforms

 - Ability to debug across infrastructure layers and make sound trade-offs under ambiguity

 - Clear technical communication and a track record of leading cross-functional projects
   
    


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience operating ML/LLM training or inference infrastructure

 - Exposure to GPU infrastructure and distributed systems

 - Experience with zero-trust access patterns

 - Experience supporting compliance or audit-readiness programs

 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Cash compensation $150K–$300K with significant equity

 - Work from our San Francisco office or remotely from EMEA.

 - Full visa sponsorship and relocation support

 - Professional development budget for courses and conferences

 - Regular team off-sites and conference attendance

 


GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

You’ll have direct influence over the platform behind open frontier AI research and products used by ambitious AI teams. Your impact will show up in faster delivery, safer operations, and less infrastructure work repeated across teams. We value ownership, technical judgment, and engineers who turn complex problems into simple, durable systems.

Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Application Engineering Team(s)

We’re seeking an exceptional Control Engineer to join our Germany-based team within the Application Engineering org, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

We’re seeking an exceptional Control Engineer to join our Germany-based Application Engineering team, focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. You’ll play a pivotal role in integrating, validating, and optimising our MPC-based trajectory controller and AI software stack on new vehicle platforms ensuring safe, reliable, and high-performance driving in diverse real-world conditions.

This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of controls, systems integration, and applied machine learning, helping expand our AV capabilities across new operational domains while collaborating closely with robotics, ML, and vehicle engineering experts.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - Integrate and validate Wayve’s AI software stack and MPC-based trajectory controller on customer hardware and vehicle platforms.
   

 - Maintain and enhance the controller (coupled with ML-driven trajectory generation) to improve performance, stability, and reliability across different vehicles and environments.
   

 - Establish and advance control and integration methods for ML-coupled systems, ensuring robustness and scalability across operational domains.
   

 - Test and optimise system behaviour in challenging driving scenarios — from highways to urban settings and adverse weather conditions.
   

 - Develop and refine simulation and evaluation pipelines to guarantee real-world optimality and control quality.
   

 - Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Verification, Release, OEM partners) to diagnose and resolve integration and performance issues.

 

🙌 You should apply if


Essential 


 - Strong theoretical knowledge of control theory, optimisation, model-predictive control, state estimation and numerical methods.

 - Practical experience in developing and tuning control systems for physical systems, both in simulation and in the real world.

 - Experience productionising and scaling systems including real-time controllers and monitoring their performance at scale.

 - Strong C++ and Python.



Desirable 


 - Experience with control, dynamics and modelling of road vehicles.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

Job Description: 
 Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! 
 Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications.
 Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. 
 We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join the Earth Observation unit within the Operations & Logistics Engineering department.
 The department is responsible for the study, development, and validation of operational and maintenance processes and procedures for complex satellites ground segment systems. Activities include the definition of possible tool supporting the operations execution and are carried out following the standards applied to the space programs (mainly ECSS) and, where necessary, of architectural frameworks (e.g. DoDAF, MoDAF, ...) and international best practices (e.g. ASD, S1000D, S3000L ...)
 You will apply systems engineering to the operational domain of space mission systems, focusing in particular on:
 Definition of the System/Mission Operations Concept (ConOps) and of nominal and contingency operational scenarios
 Derivation and definition of operational and operability requirements, to be applied to the system design
 Contribution to the definition of ground segment requirements from an operational perspective
 Analysis, characterization and modelling of operational processes and mission timelines
 Definition of the operations organization: roles, responsibilities and operational interfaces
 Development of operational products: plans (e.g. Mission/Flight Operations Plan), manuals and operational procedures (nominal, special, contingency)
 Definition and setup of operational tools
 Validation of operational products and verification of their end-to-end consistency
 Planning and support to operational validation campaigns: execution of scenarios, system validation tests
 Support to system operations development throughout the mission phases, supporting Operations Readiness Reviews and Operational Handover
 Requirements: 
 Master's Degree in Aerospace Engineering / Electronic Engineering / Telecommunications Engineering / Management Engineering with a strong technical orientation to systems
 Junior profile or recent graduate
 Knowledge of the aerospace domain (preferred)
 Previous experience, even at an introductory level, in operational concept definition, operational analysis and operational validation of space systems is considered a plus
 Ability to work autonomously and take initiative, combined with intellectual curiosity and a constant drive to question the status quo and bring innovative solutions
 Good command of English (B2)
 Proficiency with MS Office
 Availability to travel abroad for limited periods
 Comfortable with software tools and a hands-on attitude in getting the most out of them
 What We Offer: 
 Our applicable collective labor agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector .
 Working arrangement: Hybrid 
 Employment category: Employee 
 Contract type: Permanent-term 
 13th-month salary payment .
 performance bonus linked to Business results*.
 Welfare vouchers worth €250 per year.
 Meal vouchers worth €9, usable at the company cafeteria or for external expenses.
 Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance both technical expertise and interpersonal skills.
 The Company reserves the right to assess the job grade and compensation package based on objective criteria identified during the recruitment process and in line with the seniority level of the selected candidate and the position itself, in compliance with the principles of fairness, transparency and equal opportunities established by applicable legislation. 
 How Does the Recruitment Process Work? 
 Following the collection of applications, we review and identify the candidates whose profiles best match the required qualifications and skills. Selected candidates will participate in an initial interview with the Human Resources team, focused on getting to know the candidate, as well as assessing motivation and personal competencies. This is followed by a more in-depth technical interview conducted together with the relevant Business team. At the end of the selection process, candidates receive feedback regardless of the outcome, whether positive or negative.

Job Description: 
 Your impact 
 Are you ready to make an impact and gain hands-on experience working on real-world projects from day one? 
 At Leonardo, we’re looking for industrial placement students who want to be part of something extraordinary—shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 Our placements are designed to help you apply your studies in a practical setting, develop your technical skills, and gain valuable insight into how our business operates. 
 Our Industrial Placement Software Engineer Programme 
 Our Industrial Placement Programme offers you the chance to spend a year with us, working on meaningful projects alongside subject matter experts, within multidisciplinary teams, and across the product lifecycle. You’ll receive a salary of £26,228, with coaching and support from a dedicated team to help you achieve both your placement objectives and personal development goals.
 Successful completion of an Industrial Placement with Leonardo may also lead to an offer on our Graduate Development Programme.
 During your placement, we encourage you to spend at least three days each week on site to integrate with your team and maximise your learning experience.
 What you will do as a Software Engineer Industrial Placement 
 As part of our early careers community, you will work alongside developers and experts in an environment that is both challenging and rewarding. Your responsibilities will include:
 Gaining experience, applying your knowledge of software engineering as part of a multi-disciplinary Integrated Project Team.
 Developing practical skills in design techniques for products. 
 Growing your understanding of the business as well as the software engineering lifecycle.
 Skills, Qualifications & Knowledge Required 
 Qualifications 
 This is an exciting and challenging Software Engineering opportunity for students currently studying a science-based degree e.g. Software Engineering, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics or Electronic Engineering (BSc (Hon) / BEng (Hon) / MEng.) You are expected to have an appropriate gap in studies.
 Be enthusiastic and passionate about designing software and writing code with experience of doing this from education or outside interests.
 You will have some experience of computer programming
 Have some experience of an object-oriented programming language such as Java, C++, C# or JavaScript and knowledge of UML (Unified Modelling Language) is an advantage but not essential
 A full statement of courses and projects studied at university and corresponding grades/marks/percentage should be included in your CV
 Applications are also welcomed from candidates who have completed a first degree and are looking to gain industrial experience prior to commencing a relevant higher degree (i.e. PhD, MSc)
 Security Clearance 
 Many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations. As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years. 
 For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV). As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment. 
 To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years. In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks. Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment. 
 For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting 
 Why join us 
 At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do, our teams are key contributors in shaping innovation, advancing technology, and enhancing global safety. 
 We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive. 
 Time to recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year. 
 Secure your future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution. 
 Your wellbeing matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity.

CERN's Engineering Information Management group is looking for a Full-Stack Developer to join our dynamic development team. This role involves designing, developing, and maintaining software solutions that support engineering and information management processes.
 Our applications play a critical role at CERN, enabling domain experts to evaluate intervention risks and grant access to our facilities. Approximately 600 such activities are declared every week, granting daily access to thousands of people who rely on our work for their safety.
 The applications are built on a modern stack, including React, Java Spring Boot, Oracle, and BPMN. We are a small, focused team working with Agile processes that prioritise quality team communication and strong engagement with our users.
 If you're passionate about software development and eager to work in a world-class research environment, we'd love to hear from you!
 Your responsibilities: 
 Develop and maintain applications using Java, React, and Oracle technologies.
 Collaborate with engineers and IT specialists to gather requirements and implement solutions.
 Ensure software quality through testing, debugging, and performance optimisation.
 Participate in Agile development practices within a fast-paced team.
 Your profile: 
 Experience developing Web Applications using modern front-end technologies (React, Angular, Vue JS) and Java back-end.
 Skills: 
 Familiarity with Java, React, and Oracle databases.
 Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to learning.
 Ability to work in a collaborative, international environment.
 Desire to learn processes specific to CERN (Safety, Access, ...).
 Experience with Business Process Model and Notation (BPMN) is a plus.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

 Working hours: 40 hours per week

 Job reference: EN-IM-CAP-2026-245-GRAE

 Global Benefits 
 A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
 Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
 Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
 A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
 Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
 On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! 
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART! 
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

Work with us to evolve the CERN data storage systems used at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC).
 Join the CERN IT Storage and Data Management Group and work with us on services and technology which enables scientific progress at CERN!
 You will be part of the EOS Storage Development and Operations team, delivering large-scale, reliable, high-performance storage services. Today, our infrastructure manages more than 1 Exabyte of disk storage and serves around 10 Exabytes of data annually to researchers and computing facilities worldwide.
 In this role, you will have an opportunity to learn, contribute and gain experience in operations and evolution of innovative, open-source storage platform. You will also work closely with developers and service managers to improve automation, observability, reliability and performance of CERN's storage services.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Operate and maintain EOS large-scale distributed storage services supporting CERN's scientific programmes.
 Integrate, troubleshoot and optimise distributed storage systems at exabyte scale across software, hardware and network layers.
 Contribute to the development, testing, deployment and automation of EOS platform capabilities and operational tools.
 Liaise with users, developers, service managers and external collaborators to support the evolution of CERN storage services.
 Your profile: 
 Experience and good knowledge of Linux, networking and storage technologies.
 Interest in distributed storage systems, data management platforms and large-scale scientific computing.
 Interest in storage performance, scalability and reliability challenges.
 Understanding of concepts such as replication, fault tolerance, caching, scheduling and data consistency.
 Skills: 
 Software development and knowledge of modern programming languages (e.g. C++, Python, Git, CI/CD).
 Linux administration, troubleshooting and performance optimisation.
 Automation, configuration and operational tooling.
 Collaboration skills and working in diverse teams.
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Software Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

 About GE Aerospace 
 Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft . You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives .  Lead environmental and sustainability projects, play an active role in the site Sustainability Committee and Green Team. 
 Lead EcoWeek activities and complete reviews of the site air, waste and water programmes. 
 Develop environmental, hazardous and process waste stream mapping/flowcharts and update the site environmental impact assessments. 
 Complete risk assessments, chemical assessments, develop and write procedures and deliver EHS training. 
 Lead the site first aid and fire marshall programmes, arranging training and maintaining up to date communications and records. 
 Lead on IT EHS applications, including training, Spotfire reporting, workflow development and maintaining /updating the EHS and Occupational Health Intranet sites.

Located in the heart of Gloucestershire, the Power Distribution & Controls (PD&C) site focuses on the design, development and manufacture of state-of-the-art aircraft power distribution and avionics systems for the global aviation industry. Our customers include all major aerospace manufacturers - covering commercial, business jet and military applications. The scale and complexity of engineering projects offer our employees unique opportunities to work on major international projects, developing critical aircraft systems that will be relied on by many people for decades to come.   
 At GE Aerospace we strive to be an employer of choice by offering internships, apprenticeships, mentoring and staff development programmes that create a workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential.

Job Description Summary

 Job Description 
 About GE Aerospace 
 Are you ready to see your future take flight? At GE Aerospace, we are advancing aviation technologies for today and tomorrow. Your work will contribute to the production of advanced jet engines, components, and integrated systems that power commercial and military aircraft . You’ll be part of a team that embraces your drive, your curiosity, and your unique ideas and perspectives . Most importantly, you’ll share in our pride and purpose that affects the lives of millions around the world! 
 Engineering 
 Engineering is at the centre of what we do, and we are looking for talented, innovative engineers who can help us design and develop products for today, tomorrow, and in the future. If you are a dreamer, doer, and inventor who wants your voice to be heard and see your ideas take flight, this is the opportunity for you. 
 Roles and Responsibilities 
 In the 12-month Aeronautical/Aerospace/Mechanical Engineering - (Engines) Placement, you will gain hands-on experience across various teams and locations, contributing to the design, maintenance, and optimization of advanced jet engines.

 This placement offers structured training, mentorship, and opportunities to work on impactful projects that support GE Aerospace's mission of delivering world-class aviation solutions.

 GE9X Product Support Engineering (PSE): Focused on pre-Engine in Service (EIS) readiness, ensuring overhaul shop preparation, tooling development, service bulletin updates, and technical support for customers. Students will gain exposure to the overhaul process, technical data collection, and lean project implementation. 
 Engineering Team (Operations): Supporting jet engine overhaul for GE90 and CFM engine types, with responsibilities including engine work scoping, repair specification implementation, cost optimization, and production support. Students will develop strong customer relations and contribute to transitioning MRO processes to a digital environment.

 GE Aerospace Wales specialises in the maintenance, repair and overhaul of a range of commercial jet engines. The facility, based in Nantgarw, just north of Cardiff, occupies over 1.2 million square feet of workshop space and has two state-of-the-art aircraft engine test facilities, along with a significant repair capability – known as Component Repair Wales. 
 The site has the capability to provide maintenance, repair and overhaul services for a range of engine types – including the world’s most powerful commercial aircraft engine the GE90-115B and the world’s most popular commercial engine the CFM56. 
 As one of the largest commercial aircraft engine maintenance facilities in the world, with annual sales of over $2bn, the business works with over 90 customers worldwide, including Emirates, TUI, Lufthansa, Delta, United, ANA and British Airways.

items.desc:
¡Hola! 
 Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. 
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. 
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. 
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! 
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Marian ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Buscamos un/a Gestor/a para integrarse en el equipo de USM. Tu objetivo será dar soporte a los mediadores en la gestión de operaciones de nuevo negocio y cartera de pólizas. Responsable de operativa en la gestión de nuevo negocio. 
 Soporte y atención a los mediadores en base a los niveles de calidad y de servicio establecidos. 
 Asegurar de forma proactiva que todas las operaciones se realizan en fecha y forma y con un servicio excelente. 
 Cumplimiento de SLA’s y resto de indicadores de servicio. 
 Detectar posibles incidencias, reportar y hacer seguimiento. 
 Participar en proyectos. Implantación de nuevos productos, campañas, (UAT) 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. 
 Alto sentido de la responsabilidad. 
 Capacidad de trabajar en equipo. 
 Capacidad de toma de decisiones y comunicación. 
 Proactividad 
 Enfocado a la excelencia en el servicio al Mediador. 
 Buena actitud y predisposición. 
 Capacidad de aprendizaje. 
 Conocimiento de Excel, word, power point, etc 
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. 
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. 
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar. 
 Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa de mentoring personalizado. 
 Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más! 
 Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil de lo que parece, por eso somos activistas. ¿Y por qué no dedicar un día entero a la causa que más te motive? 
 Referral bonus si nos recomiendas algún talento como tú. No buscamos a nadie perfecto, pero si conoces a alguien que mola, compártele mi contacto, me encantará conocerle. 
 ¡Si tienes espíritu deportivo, en Zurich vamos a por el oro! Maratones, carreras, descuentos en gimnasio y mucho más. 3,2,1… ¡calienta que salimos! 
 ¿Eres más de playa o de montaña? Tendrás 25 días de vacaciones, más el día del seguro y el día de tu cumpleaños para que disfrutes de lo que más te gusta. Pero que no te engañen, desconexión de verdad. Porque sí, todos nos merecemos un descansito y disfrutar de la vida, que son dos días. 
 En Zurich, pensamos en tu futuro y te ofrecemos plan de jubilación y seguro de vida. 
 ¡Buscamos los mejores precios para ti! …

We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at TDC: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich ! 
 First off, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations. 
 What Can You Expect 
 Join DEX at a defining moment: help turn copilots, agents, low-code and intelligent automation into secure, scalable products that deliver measurable value for employees and operations. 
 The Workforce AI & Automation Product Architect provides architecture leadership for one or more AI and automation products or closely related capabilities. The role converts product ambitions into compliant end-to-end designs across data, identity, integration, cloud, security, responsible AI, observability and operational support. 
 This is a hands-on product architecture role with Domain scope. Supported by the DEX Architecture Lead to align broader domain context, target state and cross-portfolio alignment. The Product Architect owns defined product architecture, contributes to domain roadmaps and develops towards wider domain architecture accountability. 
 The role works from discovery through implementation and live operation, partnering with product teams, engineers, vendors, risk and the Operations Factory. It shapes AI4DEX and automation patterns while ensuring human oversight, controls and service ownership are designed in from the start. 
 And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked. 
 Purpose. Provides expert advice, identifies functional and non-functional requirements, and interfaces with vendors and the enterprise architecture community to support the design of compliant solutions which meet business needs. 
 Key Accountabilities. Lead assigned Workforce AI & Automation product and programme work streams by collaborating with product, business and technology stakeholders. Maintain a strong understanding of the relevant product and application portfolio. Independently perform defined end-to-end solution-design assignments, working within DEX domain direction and enterprise standards. Engage architecture and governance stakeholders to secure design approval and ensure approved standards and practices are followed throughout delivery and operational transition. 
 Performance Management Accountabilities . Demonstrate commitment to corporate values. Take accountability for participating in the performance management cycle. Take action to improve performance on the job. Assist and support co-workers. Take action to manage own personal development. 
 Work alongside experts in various technological domains. 
 Enhance your skills with real-world experience 
 Contribute to a team that values your input and creativity . 
 What Makes You a great Fit? 
 While we’re not seeking perfection or expecting you to save the world, we believe that if you meet some of these requirements, you’ll be a fantastic fit for our team. We are waiting for you! 
 We are looking for a hands-on architect who combines credible AI and automation depth with the ability to connect product decisions to wider DEX and enterprise outcomes. 
 Product Architecture & Delivery 
 The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate: 
 Architecture or senior technical leadership for AI, automation, low-code, SaaS or digital products in a complex organisation. 
 Experience translating functional and non-functional requirements into clear, compliant and implementable end-to-end designs. 
 Ability to support product change from discovery and option assessment through implementation, assurance and operational transition. 
 Practical design authority covering decisions, risks, dependencies, exceptions and technical debt. 
 Credibility with engineers and vendors, supported by sufficient hands-on knowledge to challenge designs and guide delivery. 
 AI & Automation Expertise 
 The role requires strong expertise across the capabilities that enable enterprise AI and automation, including: 
 Generative AI, copilots, agents, low-code or workflow automation and their engineering lifecycle.

Overview 
 In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day and we need you as a CO+I CE Field Service Engineer (FSE). 
 Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I FSE, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development for all employees and offers trainings and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion trainings and events, and professional certifications. 
 Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 100 datacenters and 1 million servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide. 
 With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. 
 Do you want to empower billions across the world? Come and join us in CO+I and be at the forefront of the action!

 Data Center Operations

 Engages with appropriate teams and resources to execute tasks or projects. 
 Manages programs associated with area of responsibility.

 Follows and adheres to safety and security policies and procedures. Reports immediately any safety or security issues or concerns. 
 Participates in Root Cause Analysis (RCA) process as appropriate. 
 Service Delivery 
 Maximize Critical Environment (CE) availability in conjunction with our landlord partners at our leased Datacenters and to ensure optimal operational efficiency 
 Oversee the day-to-day operations and maintenance of mechanical and electrical equipment in our leased Datacenters (MOP/SOP/EOP review, RCAs, FMEAs, change governance, and risk mitigation) 
 Reduce high-impact and human-error Critical Environment (CE) incidents year over year 
 Deliver on cost/energy efficiency initiatives 
 Support delivery of the Datacenter’s Emergency Preparedness and Response plans and act as an escalation point for all facilities-related issues within our leased datacenters 
 Coordinate, plan, schedule, and supervise CE audits and compliance verification as needed 
 Ensure routine reporting to effectively manage and analyze our Power/Temperature/Relative Humidity, and SLA monitoring 
 Establish and enhance strong working relationships and engagement with our Engineering Groups (EGs), and Landlord partners (including contributing to MBRs, QBRs) 
 Work with regional and global peers to share and build best practices across the entire datacenter portfolio 
 Data Center Work Environment 
 Shares best practices; assists others in learning role, process, procedures. 
 Provides mentorship across data centers for specific expertise.  
 Seeks training opportunities that meet the interest of the business as well as own career goals and objectives. 
 Suggests ways for reducing risk of performing maintenance; works with others to accommodate scheduling needs. 
 Suggests improvements in implementation based on depth of understanding. 
 Contributes to a positive team environment by learning and adopting best practices. 
 Contributes constructively during team meetings and in cross-disciplinary collaborations within the service team. 
 Ownership 
 In alignment with management priorities, holds self-accountable for the end-to-end service quality, completeness, and resulting customer experience (including but not limited to availability, safety, security, customer service). 
 Supports escalation of issues to appropriate owner.

 Qualifications

 The Industry Solutions Engineering (ISE) team is a global engineering organization that works directly with customers looking to leverage the latest technologies to address their toughest challenges. 
 We work closely with our customers’ engineers to jointly develop code for cloud-based solutions that can accelerate their organization. We work in collaboration with Microsoft product teams, partners, and open-source communities to empower our customers to do more with the cloud. We develop solutions side-by-side with our customers through collaborative innovation to solve their challenges. This work involves the development of broadly applicable, high-impact solution patterns and open-source software assets that contribute to the Microsoft platform.
