items.desc: « BE PASSIONATE ! », c'est notre slogan ! Passionné(e) de technologie et d'innovation, vous avez un tempérament entrepreneurial ? Vous aimez sortir des chemins battus ? Vous êtes curieux(se) et passionné(e) par le challenge technologique ? Alors, plus qu'un job, ce projet peut être le projet de votre vie! PA.COTTE, créée en 2014 par des fondateurs expérimentés, 70 collaborateurs, faisant partie d'un groupe international, centralise son activité R&D près de Nantes. Plusieurs millions d'euros sont investis afin de réaliser notre ambition : devenir l'un des leaders mondiaux dans le luxe technologique. Nous développons une nouvelle catégorie de produits de luxe high-tech, totalement innovants et uniques au monde, soumis à la confidentialité la plus stricte, et agrégeant un panel important de technologies et de savoir-faire dans les domaines de la mécatronique, automatique, logiciels embarqués, connectivité, et process de fabrication de pointe et bien sûr l'intelligence artificielle. Dans ce cadre, nous recrutons un(e) Ingénieur Développement Linux Embarqué pour prendre en charge la plateforme Linux de nos produits, du BSP jusqu’à l’intégration des applicatifs. Vos principales missions seront de : Concevoir, maintenir et faire évoluer la distribution Linux embarquée basée sur Yocto (layers, recettes, BSP) Préparer la plateforme Linux à l’exécution des modèles IA : intégration des drivers et runtimes NPU Concevoir et optimiser les chaînes de traitement audio et vidéo Participer aux phases de spécifications, conception et développement d’applicatifs embarqués, Étendre l’intelligence embarquée par l’ajout de capteurs, actionneurs ou IA embarqué Être force de proposition, apporter de nouvelles solutions technologiques et inventer de nouveaux usages. Compétences : Langage de programmation C / C++ et Python Yocto / OpenEmbedded (création de layers, recettes, BSP) Noyau Linux : device tree, drivers, debug kernel Multimédia sous Linux : GStreamer, V4L2, ALSA Intégration de modèles IA sur accélérateur matériel (NPU/GPU) Protocoles de communications et réseaux embarqués (ex : CAN, I2C, BLE, TCP/IP, UWB...) Connaissance des OS temps réel et des microcontrôleurs Intégration continue (GitLab CI, Jenkins…) Intégré(e) à notre équipe Software, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes Hardware, IT et mécanique. Une formation d’ingénieur dans le développement en environnement embarqué est incontournable pour intégrer notre équipe. Curieux(se), créatif(ve) et rigoureux(se), vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes avant tout passionné(e) ! Vous serez basé(e) dans notre centre de R&D près de Nantes. Dans notre environnement en perpétuelle croissance, le mode d'organisation agile est indispensable pour réussir ! Chacun(e) partage et enrichit le fruit de son travail avec ses collègues et si nécessaire nous remettons en question nos pratiques, dans un esprit collaboratif. Notre mode de fonctionnement est transversal, participatif, un suivi individuel est assuré et au fil des besoins, nous continuons de développer vos compétences en vous formant à des outils et technologies spécifiques. Si vous êtes comme nous fasciné(e) par les produits technologiques innovants, nous vous garantissons une vie professionnelle passionnante au sein de notre équipe extrêmement engagée. On ne vit qu'une fois, venez nous rejoindre ! Type d'emploi : Temps plein, CDI Rémunération : 42 000,00€ à 46 000,00€ par an Avantages : Prise en charge du transport quotidien RTT Travail à domicile occasionnel Lieu du poste : En présentiel

items.desc: About Alma At Alma, we believe sustainable commerce depends on fair, well‑balanced trade. Because finance plays a pivotal role in business, our mission is to put it back in its rightful place - serving merchants and consumers. Our installment and deferred payment solutions help merchants boost sales by 20% or more, increase customer loyalty, and deliver a seamless shopping experience - without encouraging bad debt. As the buy now pay later leader in France and active in 10 European countries, we've empowered over +25,000 merchants and 10 million consumers. With 400+ Almakers and €100M+ ARR, Alma is scaling rapidly across Europe as a member of the Next40, and we're just getting started! About the team The Consumer Tribe builds the Alma app for consumers. To tackle more topics and accelerate the development of the consumer experience, the current Consumer squad is splitting into two dedicated squads: Alma Wallet and Consumer Engagement. Alma Wallet builds the payment experience of the app. With the Alma card, consumers can pay with Alma anywhere, not only at our partner merchants. In the app, they can manage their payments using Apple Pay, Google Pay or local payment methods. By taking Alma beyond our merchant network, the Alma card is one of the company's key strategic bets. Consumer Engagement drives consumer activation, engagement and long-term retention by helping people get more value from Alma. The team builds experiences that make it easier for consumers to discover partner merchants, benefit from loyalty and cashback rewards, and manage their account independently. In 2027, the focus is on turning Alma into a more engaging, everyday consumer experience by strengthening loyalty, increasing repeat usage and making Consumer Engagement a key driver of Alma's long-term growth. This is a new position created as the consumer app organization splits into two squads to tackle more topics. You will join one of these squads and work closely with its Engineering Manager, Product Manager, Designer and back-end engineers. You will report to Gautier Labarre , Engineering Manager . This position is a permanent contract (CDI), open to full remote from Metropolitan France. About the job Build and ship meaningful consumer experiences: Develop and release new features in the Alma app from design to production, working closely with Product, Design and back-end engineers. Make payments simple and secure: Integrate payment SDKs and native mobile capabilities such as Apple Pay, Google Pay, card management, biometrics and secure storage. Raise the quality bar of the app: Keep the application fast, reliable and maintainable through automated testing, monitoring, code reviews and continuous performance improvements. Help the team learn and move forward: Contribute to technical decisions, challenge product and back-end implementation when needed, and improve the team's architecture, tooling and release processes. You will work with Mobile: Expo / EAS, Expo Router, React Native, React 19, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Redux Toolkit, react-hook-form, Zod, Reanimated, Unistyles, MMKV, Nitro modules. Tests: Jest, Testing Library, Maestro. Payments: Adyen, Stripe, Checkout.com SDKs. Observability: Datadog, Sentry, OpenTelemetry, OpenFeature. Back-end: Python, FastAPI. Tools: GitHub, Linear, Notion, Figma, Crowdin, Claude. About you To succeed in this job You have 3+ years of experience building mobile applications with React Native and TypeScript , with experience releasing apps on both the App Store and Google Play. You have a strong understanding of the React Native ecosystem, including Expo, navigation, state management and data fetching. You care deeply about software quality and have experience with testing, code reviews, monitoring and mobile performance. You are fluent in English and comfortable working in a cross-functional, international environment. And it will be nice if you also Have worked on payment products, fintech products or other security-sensitive applications. Have experience contributing to a consumer application used at scale. Are comfortable challenging product or back-end implementation when it does not provide the best user or technical outcome. Have experience with web development in addition to mobile development. Don't meet every single requirement? At Alma, we believe great hires come from diverse paths. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply. We value potential, curiosity and the ability to grow as much as experience. What's in it for you If you join, you will be able to grow and impact on: Work on products at the heart of Alma's strategy, including the Alma card, new payment methods in the app and our loyalty programme. Solve real mobile fintech challenges involving payment SDKs, Apple Pay, Google Pay, biometrics and secure storage. Use a modern mobile stack based on Expo 57, React Native's New Architecture, React 19, TypeScript 7, Reanimated 4 and Nitro modules. Compensation & benefits …

items.desc: C hez EY, nous sommes « All in » pour façonner votre avenir en toute confiance. Ensemble, nous orienterons votre carrière selon vos aspirations. Rejoignez EY et contribuez à construire un monde meilleur. Nous recrutons des Consultantes et Consultants Débutant(e)s en Digital Forensic en CDI, A compter de décembre 2026 pour le bureau de Paris Notre Opportunité : Dans un environnement où la réglementation compliance qui s’impose aux entreprises se renforce et où les exigences en matière d’éthique s’accroissent, le département Forensic & Integrity Services accompagne nos clients pour répondre à leurs enjeux d’intégrité, de compliance et d’éthique. Notre équipe pluridisciplinaire intervient sur: La conception, l’évaluation et l’amélioration de programmes de compliance afin de minimiser leur risque de corruption, de fraude et, plus largement, de non-compliance. Les investigations en cas de fraude suspectée ou avérée (corruption, détournement d’actifs, fraude aux états financiers, blanchiment d’argent, infractions à des règlements spécifiques), ou à la demande des autorités de régulation. Pour ce faire, nous nous appuyons sur une triple expertise : Gestion des risques : compliance, contrôle interne, audit interne, audit financier Innovation digitale : financial data analytics, data science, digital forensic Connaissance de la réglementation (Sapin 2, FCPA, sanctions, etc.), au service de dispositifs opérationnels Vos principales responsabilités : Au sein de notre équipe, vous intervenez pour des acteurs privés et publics sur des missions variées, telles que : Mener des investigations dans le cadre de fraude/corruption alléguée ou confirmée : collecte massive d’informations structurées et non structurées, processing des données, analyse des schémas frauduleux, identification des rôles et responsabilités, évaluation du préjudice, rédaction de rapports pouvant être produits en justice Analyser les données liées aux processus métiers en lien avec les risques de l’entreprise : Achats, Ventes, Trésorerie, RH, etc. Réalisation d’audits de conformité liées aux contraintes imposées par les régulateurs et ce en lien avec les aspects technologiques : analyse de conformité RGPD sur des référentiel CRM, identification de transactions à risque grâce à des méthodologie de scoring. Réaliser des audits financiers : analyse de volumes de données importants en travaillant sur les opérations et les résultats financiers de nos clients (Groupe internationaux, CAC 40, etc.) Contribuer à l'innovation digitale à travers des solutions technologiques : fraude documentaire, reconnaissance d’images, cryptoactifs, etc. Vos compétences pour réussir : Vous maîtrisez divers des langages de programmation par ex : SQL, PYTHON, etc… Vous avez une expérience ou une appétence dans des logiciels de Dataviz tels que Tableau Software, PowerBI. Vous avez des connaissances avancées en mathématiques/statistiques. Vous connaissez les problématiques inhérentes aux systèmes informatiques et vous avez une appétence pour les problématiques financières et un gout pour l’investigation. Ce que nous recherchons: Vous êtes diplômé(e) d’une école d’ingénieur ou d’une université (type Master 2..) avec une majeure en système d’information, en Dataviz ou en Datascience Vous avez jusqu’à 2 ans d’expérience en cabinet d’audit et de conseil en système informatique ou dans des services fonctionnels de grands groupes Vous faites preuve de curiosité, de dynamisme et souhaitez vous investir dans une offre de services en fort développement Vous êtes mobile en France comme à l’étranger Ce que nous vous offrons : Le développement de vos compétences et des expériences uniques au sein d’un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif. Un environnement de travail flexible #Smartworking@EY L’opportunité de découvrir d’autres cultures en travaillant au contact d’équipes connectées à l’échelle mondiale et grâce à notre programme de mobilité à l’international #Mobility4U. Un package complet : un bonus discrétionnaire annuel, une prime de participation, des RTT, une mutuelle avantageuse, une carte titre-restaurant, le remboursement de votre abonnement de transports en commun à hauteur de 75% ou une aide financière pour l’achat d’un vélo. De nombreux autres avantages : des primes de cooptation, un abonnement sportif Wellpass à tarif préférentiel, l’entrée gratuite aux musées du Louvre et Eugène-Delacroix, un accès privilégié à l’Opéra de Paris.. Etes-vous prêt à façonner votre avenir avec confiance ? Postulez dès aujourd'hui. Le processus de recrutement est composé de 3 étapes ; des tests à réaliser en ligne, une rencontre avec nos managers et un dernier entretien avec l’une ou l’un de nos Associé(e)s. Les entretiens, menés à distance et en présentiel, permettent d’échanger sur votre parcours, d’évaluer vos compétences et de répondre à vos questions. items.desc: Basée à Lille, Lyon, Nantes, Grenoble, Marseille, Paris et Bruxelles, Insitoo Freelances est une société du groupe Insitoo, spécialisée dans le placement et le sourcing des Freelances IT et Métier. Depuis 2007, Insitoo Freelances a su s?imposer comme une référence en matière de freelancing par son expertise dans l?IT et ses valeurs de transparence et de proximité. Actuellement, afin de répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous recherchons un Data Analyst / Data Engineer H/F à Toulouse, France. Contexte : Au sein d'une équipe dédiée au support et à l'accompagnement client, vous intervenez à l'interface entre les équipes métier et la technique. Votre rôle est de qualifier les besoins business, d'explorer les données et de concevoir des solutions analytiques ou applicatives sur la plateforme Skywise (Palantir). Les missions attendues par le Data Analyst / Data Engineer H/F : Accompagnement & Cadrage : Échanger avec les utilisateurs métiers pour comprendre, qualifier et traduire leurs besoins complexes. Analyses rapides (Contour) : Concevoir des analyses de données ad hoc et des tableaux de bord interactifs dans Palantir Contour. Développements pérennes (Workshop) : Développer et maintenir des applications analytiques et des dashboards sur-mesure dans Palantir Workshop. Documentation : Rédiger la documentation technique associée aux livrables. Compétences techniques (Hard Skills) Incontournable : Maîtrise de l'écosystème Palantir / Skywise (notamment les briques Contour et Workshop). Analyse fonctionnelle : Capacité à modéliser et structurer des architectures de données adaptées aux problématiques métier. Atout : Maîtrise de Google Apps Script. Qualités relationnelles & comportementales (Soft Skills) Posture Client & Vulgarisation : Excellente aisance relationnelle, capacité à expliquer des concepts techniques à des opérationnels non-techniques. Autonomie : Capacité à s'organiser seul tout en respectant les standards et directives du client. Esprit de synthèse & Proactivité : Capacité à simplifier des problèmes complexes et force de proposition pour optimiser les processus métiers. Profil candidat: Compétences techniques et fonctionnelles attendues : - Google Apps Script - Confirmé - Indispensable - Palantir - Confirmé - Indispensable - Analyse fonctionnelle - Confirmé - Indispensable

items.desc: Job Description: Idéalement si tué au centre ville de Toulouse dans le quartier des Minimes, le site AIRBUS opérations de Saint Eloi recrute! Vous cherchez un nouveau job, ou vous souhaitez découvrir de nouvelles opportunités dans le domaine de la qualité, logistique, manufacturing engineering et gestion de projet, rejoignez nous! Grâce à la diversité des métiers et des salariés qui contribuent à sa réussite, Saint Eloi est le seul site au monde à concevoir, usiner, produire, assembler et livrer les mâts réacteurs pour tous les modèles d’avions Airbus. Résolument tourné vers l’avenir, il investit dans les technologies de pointe et contribue notamment au développement de l'impression 3D métallique et du futur avion Airbus à 0 émissions de CO2. Saint Eloi, ce n’est pas seulement des technologies de pointe, c’est également un site où l’on promeut l’inclusion et la diversité sous toutes ses formes et où l’engagement et la qualité de vie au travail font partie de nos priorités Rejoignez nous et participez à une vaste aventure technologique et humaine. Un poste de Demand & Supply Planner (h/f) vient de s'ouvrir au sein d'Airbus Commercial Aircraft à Toulouse, au sein de l'usine de St Eloi. Missions et responsabilités Vous serez responsable du pilotage de la Demande vers nos fournisseurs en en collaboration étroite avec les équipes Planning et Supply de St Eloi A ce titre, vos activités principales seront les suivantes: Découplage : Vous préparez les scénarios de découplage qui génèreront la demande vers les fournisseurs. Vous animez une MFT et prenez en compte les contraintes de chaque métier (planning de production, sécurisations de stock, moyens de stockage,...) pour valider le scénario de découplage optimal Vous pilotez les plans de découplage avec SAP IBP (mise à jour, suivi, indicateurs, déviation,...) et contrôlez leur cohérence dans SAP Demand Monitoring : Vous analysez la volatilité de la Demande (Gross Need & Net Need) chaque semaine pour sécuriser la diffusion des plans d'approvisionnement vers les fournisseurs Vous animez/participez aux MFT Demand Monitoring Vous suivez la résolution des incidents Vous validez la diffusion des forecast vers les fournisseurs Vous interagissez au quotidien avec une équipe multifonctionnelle (Planning, Manuf Engineering, Supply Officer,...) Vous travaillez sur des sujets/projets d'amélioration outil/process liés à la gestion de la Demande Profil Vous avez les qualités, les expériences et compétences suivantes : Expérience opérationnelle en analyse et gestion de la Demande Maitrise du fonctionnement de la Demande sur le périmètre St Eloi Maitrise de l'outil SAC Demand Monitoring pour les analyses de volatilité Maitrise de l'outil SAP IBP pour le pilotage du découplage Connaissance des processus de planification S&OP, MPS et Exécution Maitrise du fonctionnement du MRP et de sa chaine Connaissance des lignes d'assemblage de St Eloi serait un plus Esprit d'analyse Esprit de synthèse Esprit d'équipe Force de proposition Rigueur Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. This information will only be used by Airbus. Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com . At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

items.desc: TL;DR: We are looking for a gap-year or final-year student to work alongside the leadership team on Davis's go-to-market, strategy and growth . About Davis Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis. We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle. items.desc: Your mission Join us in building solutions that keep space safe and sustainable . As part of our team, you’ll work on varied projects and products across Space Flight Dynamics (FD) , Space Situational Awareness (SSA) , Space Traffic Management (STM) , and Space Surveillance & Tracking (SST) . Your tasks and responsibilities In this role, you will contribute to projects that support Europe’s future space‑safety infrastructure . Your work will include developing and coding key algorithms, integrating data sources, preparing technical documentation, and coordinating project deliverables to meet agency standards. You will work closely with i nstitutional partners, support proposal preparation, and contribute to long‑term programmes that ensure safe and sustainable access to space. If you enjoy complex, multi‑stakeholder projects and creating solutions with real impact on space operations, this role is a great fit. Your profile We don’t expect you to meet every item below. If you are passionate about SSA, astrodynamics, and space safety, please apply — even if you don’t feel “100% ready.” Must‑Have BSc or MSc in Aerospace Engineering, Space Engineering, Applied Physics, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, or related Experience through full-time work, internships, research projects, or thesis work in astrodynamics, SSA/SST, or flight dynamics Basic understanding of orbital mechanics and astrodynamics Ability to write clean, maintainable code in Python, Java, FORTRAN, or a similar language Interest in satellite safety, conjunction assessment, or flight operations Nice‑to‑Have Experience with SST systems, orbit catalogs, mission analysis, sensor data or tracking systems Familiarity with space operations workflows or maneuver planning Curiosity about space policy, standards, and responsible space traffic management Why us? With a lean hierarchy and small working groups , you define your own way of work including flexible work hours . Work on groundbreaking space sustainability challenges with a team of top-tier engineers and scientists. Enjoy technical freedom . Influence system architecture, research methodologies, and data integration approaches. Grow continuously with access to training budgets, industry conferences, and networking opportunities. Be part of a strong engineering culture, with regular knowledge-sharing sessions, technical deep dives, and innovation sprints. Great team spirit , with company-wide events such as social activities like laser tag, dinners, and team-building outings. 30 days of Vacation and Workation Bahncard (25 if you live in Brunswick, 50 if you live outside of the city) Subsidized Hansefit / Wellpass Membership Free Drinks & Snacks in the office (the good ones) Bikeleasing Company Pension Scheme Coporate Benifits (Discount on Brands, Concerts, Holidays ) About us OKAPI:Orbits is at the forefront of space sustainability, addressing some of the most pressing challenges of the space industry: the growing problem of crowded orbital regimes, and the need for more efficient satellite operations. We're providing end-to-end solutions that help various space industry players cover their Space Situation Awareness (SSA), and Space Traffic Management and Coordination (STM & STC) needs. We are committed to safeguarding space missions and access to space for all humanity. Join us on our mission. Last but not least, we would like to share with you that research shows that women are less likely to apply for a position unless they meet 100% of the listed requirements. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: €70.400,00 - €96.800,00 Location: Heimstetten,DEU You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . As an Electrical Engineer, you are responsible for designing, modifying, and troubleshooting electrical or electronic engineering assemblies, layouts, schematics, and drawings to advance the equipment that supports our technology. Using your technical experience and critical thinking skills, you will perform engineering analysis, generate test reports, develop innovative solutions, and create documentation for product releases. You will also coordinate the procurement and assembly of components, identify sources of critical parts, and resolve technical issues to ensure peak performance. We are looking for a highly talented Electronics Engineer (m/f/d) in Munich, Heimstetten with strong expertise in analog (high-precision, low-noise) and power circuit design to join our unique Analog Electronics High Voltage team. What’s in it for you? A combination of high-level theoretical work and hands-on practical design, using the latest technologies, along with research activities across multiple disciplines. Be part of professional design team, with great collaboration and team spirit. Work in a high-tech environment of a strong and stable company – Applied Materials. Our Group The Analog Electronics High Voltage Group develops high-end high-voltage systems that drive electron beam–based advanced wafer test systems for the semiconductor industry. Our team integrates multidisciplinary fields—Physics, Electronics, and Mechanics—into cutting-edge technology products. Your responsibilities Full responsibility for leading missions end-to-end: modeling and simulation, laboratory testing, system debugging, and system integration. Close collaboration with multiple groups across the organization: Electronics, Mechanics, Software, Firmware, and Physics. Development of modules that are integrated into advanced wafer test systems for the semiconductor industry. Deep understanding of the system architecture and principles of operation. Your profile B.Sc., M.Sc., or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, with specialization in analog, power, or high-voltage circuits. Proven experience in the development of precision, low-noise analog, power, or high-voltage circuits. Experience with ORCAD design tools and SPICE-based circuit simulation. Experience with electromagnetic field simulation tools (e.g., CST) – an advantage. Ability to write and review specifications, test documents, and development verification reports. Vendors / projects management experience – an advantage. High level of professional curiosity. System view – a drive to understand the big picture and the physical principles of system operation. Excellent English skills – speaking, reading, and writing. items.desc: Date: Oct 15, 2026 Location: IE - Waterford, IE Company: Bausch+Lomb Companies Inc. Bausch + Lomb (NYSE/TSX: BLCO) is a leading global eye health company dedicated to protecting and enhancing the gift of sight for millions of people around the world—from the moment of birth through every phase of life. Our mission is simple, yet powerful: helping you see better, to live better. Our comprehensive portfolio of over 400 products is fully integrated and built to serve our customers across the full spectrum of their eye health needs throughout their lives. Our iconic brand is built on the deep trust and loyalty of our customers established over our 170-year history. We have a significant global research, development, manufacturing and commercial footprint of approximately 13,000 employees and a presence in approximately 100 countries , extending our reach to billions of potential customers across the globe. We have long been associated with many of the most significant advances in eye health, and we believe we are well positioned to continue leading the advancement of eye health in the future. Scope of Position The Quality Assurance Shift Engineer supports the Manufacturing QA Manager in ensuring that manufacturing produces product that meets specification in an environment compliant with all relevant standards. This is a shift position. Key Activities / Responsibilities Determine appropriate lot-disposition decisions on a shift-by-shift basis. Manage, review and approve non-conformances. Provide quality oversight for manufacturing, including approval of validation documentation, preparation and update of applicable PFMEAs, CAPA activity and continuous improvement. Act as the Manufacturing Quality Management interface with operations and engineering. Disposition product as appropriate and manage non-conformance activity. Highlight relevant issues and participate in or lead resolution. Review validation documentation and change requests. Participate in Quality System continuous improvement activities. Ensure compliance with applicable GMP and medical-device regulatory requirements, including FDA, ISO, MDD & MDR requirements, and internal documentation. Provide direction to ensure product quality is maintained at all stages of manufacturing. Provide shift direction on QASL issues. Complete non-conformance rationales as required. Complete additional requirements specified by the Manufacturing Quality Manager. Follow Standard Operating Procedures at all times. Maintain awareness of applicable standards and QMS requirements. Follow gowning procedures and entry rules for manufacturing and controlled areas. Follow Personal Hygiene Rules defined in the GMP Training Programme and notify supervision of health conditions that may affect product quality. Maintain a clean and tidy work area. Key Relationships Production colleagues Production managers Maintenance technicians Warehouse colleagues Process Excellence Department Training Department QA Department Engineering Department HR Department R&D Department Qualifications / Training Minimum three years' experience in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical-device environment. Full understanding of regulatory-standard requirements. Third-level qualification, ideally in Engineering or Science. Strong analytical skills and good knowledge of process-control systems. Knowledge of Six Sigma and Lean tools. Self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities. Decisive, effective communicator, self-motivated, achievement-focused and a strong team member. Microsoft Office experience. Bausch & Lomb is committed to equal employment opportunity and complies with equal employment opportunity laws in effect wherever it operates.

The world’s leading organisations trust Splunk to go from insight to action fast and at scale; organisations such as McLaren, Heineken, and Tesco are turning data into action with Splunk. Join us as we pursue our innovative vision to make machine data accessible, usable and valuable to everyone. Our company is filled with people passionate about our solutions and seeking to deliver the best experience and outcomes for our customers. At Splunk, we’re committed to our work, customers, having fun and, most importantly, to each other’s success. This is an opportunity to work at a company that is changing how information supports business decisions and makes the world a more digitally resilient place. Splunk seeks a highly motivated, outcome-focused individual to join our Solutions Engineering team as a Solutions Engineer (SE). As a Splunk SE, you’ll be a technical sales resource for the UK Commercial Sales team supporting our clients in the UK. You will be the authority regarding the technical aspects of solutions and how they integrate within our clients' workflow and tooling. In addition to providing technical guidance, Splunk SEs understand their clients' businesses well and can tailor their solution positioning to both a business and technical audience. Role: This Solutions Engineer role is to help build our business in Ireland and Scotland which is growing rapidly. Due to the nature of the role, the ideal candidate will be based in either Ireland or Scotland and happy to travel as required. The successful candidate will be working closely with an existing SE focussed on Ireland and Scotland based in Dublin, and alongside four Reginal Sales Managers, split across Ireland and Scotland. You will also be part of a wider team of Solutions Engineers spread out across the UK. The customer base will be a mixture of Public Sector and Private Sector customers. Understanding the nuances associated with these different sectors, or experience in both would be a bonus Responsibilities; I want to and can do these: Establish and own strong technical relationships within the territories you support. Partner with the Regional Sales Manager in in-person and remote meetings with customers to discover customers’ needs and how Splunk can meet those needs. Support our clients through the buying process by running presentations, demonstrations, workshops and answering technical questions to validate Splunk as the right solution. Scope and run Proof of Concepts with clients to agreed success criteria and timelines. Ensure your knowledge and skills of Splunk solutions are up to date. Maintain timely updates on the state of your opportunities in Salesforce. Attributes; this is who I am: Self-motivated; to research and learn to fill gaps in knowledge and provide the best buying experience to our clients. Innovative; in finding solutions to customer needs, proving integrations, and developing workshops and demonstrations. Passionate; in solving meaningful problems with data. Disruptive; work closely with the SE team and SE management to challenge, develop and continually improve working practices and processes. Curious; with a growth mindset and willingness to be coached. Adaptable; with the ability to shift to constantly evolving requirements. Requirements; I’ve got or done these things in the past: Ability to communicate clearly and appropriately in meetings, phone calls, emails, RFPs, and when submitting reports, both externally with customers and internally. Strong presentation and demonstration skills with an ability to use stories effectively. Ability to actively listen. Good organisational, prioritisation and time management skills. items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards Job Description Data Reviewer- Remote, Cell Lab At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future. Location/Division Specific Information Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic guides. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations. Discover Impactful Work: The role of Data Reviewer is to support our Cell Laboratory teams in ensuring the integrity and quality of laboratory and chromatographic data and reports. Ensures analyses are following validated or experimental analytical procedures, and compare results to methodology, protocol and product specifications, Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) acceptance criteria, and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Reviews data entered into databases and reports and monitors the quality of the laboratory data. This is the perfect job for someone who has strong review experience and is looking to move away from hands on lab duties. A day in the Life Ensures the quality of laboratory data and reports. Reviews chromatographic data, related notebooks and sample results for scientific soundness, completeness, accurate representation of the data, and final reported results. Evaluates data to ensure compliance with analytical methods, client criteria, Good Laboratory Practices (GLP) and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Delivers review findings noting deficiencies within the analytical data or reports in a clear and concise manner Communicates with laboratory staff to proactively address the quality of laboratory documentation. Prepares QC statements noting deficiencies with the analytical data set or notebooks. Reports deficiencies to the project leader for correction. Facilitates in conversations with lab staff on best documentation practices and addressing quality findings. Advocates for quality and review process changes. Identifies and supports process improvement initiatives. Education and Experience BSc in Science or related field required 2+ years of QA/QC analytical experience is essential (gaining thorough knowledge of cell based assays and including experience in reviewing analytical data/results) Thorough knowledge of SOPs and Federal Regulations to include GLP and GMP Strong verbal and written communication skills Strong technical knowledge including an understanding of laboratory procedures, methodology and standards Ability to independently review laboratory reports and analytical methods Strong attention to detail Ability to provide clear and concise feedback and/or documentation of results Work Environment Thermo Fisher Scientific values the health and wellbeing of our employees. We support and encourage individuals to create a healthy and balanced environment where they can thrive. Below is listed the working environment/requirements for this role: Able to communicate, receive, and understand information and ideas with diverse groups of people in a comprehensible and reasonable manner. Able to work upright and stationary and/or standing for typical working hours. Able to lift and move objects up to 25 pounds. Able to work in non-traditional work environments. Able to use and learn standard office equipment and technology with proficiency. May have exposure to potentially hazardous elements, including infectious agents, typically found in healthcare or laboratory environments. Able to perform successfully under pressure while prioritizing and handling multiple projects or activities. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need. #StartYourStory with PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives …

items.desc: We Make Life More Rewarding and Dignified Location : Ballina Department : Summary The Quality Assurance (QA) Technician performs laboratory testing and quality control activities to support protocols, process qualification/certification, supplier approval, and new product introduction. The role executes validated/approved test methods, ensures data integrity and traceability in line with Good Documentation Practices (GDP), and partners with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and R&D to enable timely, compliant product release and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Plan and perform laboratory testing of materials and products per approved methods to support protocols, process control/qualification studies, and new product approval. Record, analyze, and report results with accuracy and completeness; escalate nonconformances and support investigations as required. Support validation/qualification activities for new or modified equipment and processes in accordance with procedures. Conduct audits/inspections of products from external suppliers and compile clear, actionable reports. Calibrate or coordinate calibration of laboratory equipment; maintain calibration and maintenance records. Perform machine waste/defect analysis; collaborate with cross‑functional teams to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions to reduce scrap and rework. Compile release documentation for finished products and support product disposition activities in line with procedures. Apply Good Documentation Practices (GDP) in reviewing production and test records for accuracy and completeness. Contribute to standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and training materials; share knowledge with peers. Maintain a safe and compliant laboratory environment; follow EHS and quality system requirements. Other duties as assigned. Perform visual and dimensional inspections and laboratory tests using computerized test equipment and standard tools. Read and interpret procedures, specifications, and test methods; communicate clearly in writing and verbally. Operate office and laboratory equipment; perform keyboard‑intensive work; maintain accuracy and focus during repetitive tasks. Work independently and collaboratively to meet priorities and timelines; typical travel requirement: none. Essential Functions of the Role Inspect goods for damage or discrepancies and report issues promptly. Conduct audits and inspections (internal and supplier). Maintain scientific and regulatory compliance in all clinical communications. Education & Work Requirements Relevant Degree with 2-4 years of related experience Education & Work Preferences Post‑secondary qualification (certificate, diploma, or degree) in a scientific or engineering discipline. Typically 2-3 years of relevant experience in quality, manufacturing, or laboratory environments, including at least 2 years of hands‑on laboratory testing experience. Proficiency using computerized laboratory test equipment and basic computer applications; ability to follow SOPs and apply GDP. Strong attention to detail, organization, and problem‑solving skills; ability to manage multiple tasks Experience in medical device or other regulated manufacturing environments and exposure to validation activities. Familiarity with quality systems and tools (e.g., ISO 13485, GMP, SPC, CAPA, Minitab/other statistical tools). Experience supporting supplier/product audits and continuous improvement (e.g., Lean/5S). About Hollister Incorporated Hollister Incorporated is an independent, employee-owned company that develops, manufactures and markets healthcare products worldwide. The company spearheads the advancement of innovative products for ostomy care, continence care and critical care, and also creates educational support materials for patients and healthcare professionals. Headquartered in Libertyville, Illinois, Hollister has manufacturing and distribution centers on three continents and sells in nearly 80 countries. Hollister is a wholly owned subsidiary of The Firm of John Dickinson Schneider, Inc., and is guided both by its Mission to make life more rewarding and dignified for people who use our products and services, as well as its Vision to grow and prosper as an independent, employee-owned company, and in the process, to become better human beings. items.desc: For 75 years, Charles River employees have worked together to assist in the discovery, development and safe manufacture of new drug therapies. When you join our family, you will have a significant impact on the health and well-being of people across the globe. Whether your background is in life sciences, finance, IT, sales or another area, your skills will play an important role in the work we perform. In return, we’ll help you build a career that you can feel passionate about. Job Overview Do you have experience working in a microbiology laboratory environment? Have you got the desire to improve health and lives? Charles River Laboratories are excited to be recruiting for a Microbiology Technician to join our team in Ballina. This is an excellent opportunity for a science graduate or laboratory professional looking to develop their career within a GMP-regulated laboratory environment, supporting the testing of products that contribute to improving global health. What you'll be doing: Performing a variety of microbiological testing activities, including bioburden, water testing, sterility testing, microbial limits testing, environmental monitoring and endotoxin (LAL) testing. Recording, reviewing and maintaining accurate laboratory data in accordance with GMP requirements. Preparing, sterilising and managing laboratory media, equipment and glassware. Monitoring laboratory equipment and environmental conditions to ensure compliance with quality standards. Assisting with laboratory investigations, deviations, quality documentation and SOP updates. Supporting internal and external audits and inspections. Contributing to the maintenance of a safe, clean and compliant laboratory environment. Skills and Experience: Degree in Microbiology, Biological Sciences, Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline. Previous laboratory experience, ideally within a microbiology or GMP environment. Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality. Good organisational and record-keeping skills. Ability to work both independently and as part of a team. Experience with microbiological testing techniques and laboratory systems would be advantageous. The salary range for the role is £35,000 - £42,000 per annum + benefits. Please note that regular on-site attendance is required for this laboratory-based role. Join a global organisation dedicated to improving the quality, efficiency and safety of drug development, helping our clients bring life-changing therapies to patients around the world. items.desc: About Analog Devices Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and X . Thermal Management Systems Engineer Position Summary Analog Devices is seeking a Thermal Management Systems Engineer to join the Datacenter Infrastructure team. Datacenter infrastructure encompasses the hardware and supporting systems required for data center operation, including servers, networking equipment, power delivery and energy storage systems, and air and liquid-cooling systems. The engineer will contribute to the design, analysis, prototyping, validation, and optimization of thermal management systems for small and large-scale data center infrastructure. The role will focus on sensing, monitoring, and control of temperature, pressure, flow rate, pumps, fans, and valves, using Analog Devices technologies where applicable. The successful candidate will work with mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, systems, applications, and marketing teams to translate system requirements into practical technical solutions. The position is intended for an engineer who can execute defined technical work independently, contribute to customer-facing demonstrations and proof-of-concept platforms, and grow toward ownership of subsystem-level activities under the guidance of senior technical staff. Job Scope Industry focus: Thermal management systems for data center infrastructure. Territory focus: Worldwide, with collaboration across global engineering, business, and customer teams. Function: Support system engineering activities in thermal sensing, monitoring, control, simulation, prototyping, and validation. Level: P2/P3 individual contributor role. Scope and independence will be aligned with the successful candidate’s experience. Principal Responsibilities Contribute to the development and evaluation of thermal management architectures for data center servers, power systems, energy storage systems, coolant distribution units, and associated infrastructure. Perform thermal, fluid-flow, and system-level analysis to assess performance, identify design limitations, and support design optimization. Develop and execute laboratory test plans for thermal and liquid-cooling systems, including instrumentation, data acquisition, data processing, and results interpretation. Support the design and integration of temperature, pressure, flow-rate, pump, fan, and valve monitoring and control functions. Develop proof-of-concept hardware, reference platforms, and demonstrations that show how Analog Devices technologies can address data center thermal-management challenges. Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, applications, and systems engineers to define requirements and integrate sensing and control functions at system level. Create simulation models, engineering calculations, test procedures, technical reports, presentations, and other design documentation. Support design reviews, failure investigations, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action activities related to thermal performance and system operation. Evaluate technical literature, standards, market information, and emerging cooling technologies relevant to data center infrastructure. Support customer engagements by preparing technical analyses, demonstrations, and application-level recommendations in collaboration with senior engineers and commercial teams. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Thermal Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline. Relevant experience in thermal engineering, electronics cooling, fluid systems, HVAC, power electronics, data center infrastructure, or a closely related field. For P2 consideration, typically 2 or more years of relevant industry experience; for P3 consideration, typically 4 or more years of relevant industry experience. Equivalent advanced education and applicable project experience may be considered. Working knowledge of heat transfer, fluid mechanics, thermodynamics, and engineering measurement principles. Experience planning or executing engineering analysis, simulation, laboratory testing, or prototype validation. Ability to analyze technical data, document conclusions, and communicate recommendations clearly. Ability to work effectively in cross-functional and geographically distributed teams. items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano full-time, fixed-term Research Support Office Short description of the position Eurac Research ( https://eurac.edu ) is a private research organization based in Bolzano/Bozen, Italy. Our research institutes and centers are seeking answers to global challenges through interaction between a variety of disciplines: keeping societies healthy, fostering intact environments, promoting sustainable energy and developing well-functioning political and social systems. We develop concrete solutions for regional problems which can then be applied globally. The KTO (Knowledge Transfer Office) : The newly established Knowledge Transfer Office is a central service department, responsible for the protection and valorisation of Eurac Research’s intellectual property (IP) and enhancing the value of research results by turning them into solutions useful to society, institutions, and the market — representing the central hub for knowledge transfer at Eurac Research. The KTO carries out the following main activities: Training and awareness – promotes an IP culture among researchers and staff, organizes courses, distributes confidentiality agreement templates, and helps researchers plan the protection of their results before disclosure. Disclosure assistance and protection – analyses inventions and registers all new IP. Evaluation and commercialization – supports the technical-commercial evaluation of research results. Patenting support – assists researchers throughout the patenting process, from evaluating the innovative potential of scientific results to filing and protecting the patent. Provides technical and administrative assitance, coordinating relationships with specialized consultants. We are looking for a new team member to provide support in the development of Eurac Research’s patent portfolio. Mission of the Role The Patent Engineer is the point of reference for patent matters for Eurac Research's scientists. The Patent Engineer supports the entire patenting process, from the identification of an invention and preventing its premature disclosure through to managing patent examination, with a focus on prior art searches, strategic analysis (commercial value, freedom-to-operate, geographic coverage), and drafting the patent application. Tasks: Invention scouting – identifying, in close cooperation with our research staff, the research innovative results and defining the appropriate protection measures and commercialisation routes. Prevention: manage the confidentiality of the results, invention traceability, ownership, and define correct inventorship. Prior art search: conduct systematic searches across patent databases and scientific literature, documenting distinctiveness relative to prior art. Strategic analysis: estimate commercial value, coordinate freedom-to-operate analysis, define geographic coverage. Application drafting: oversee the technical description, claims, drawings, and unity of invention together with the patent attorney. Filing: choose between the direct route and the PCT route, manage deadlines Examination: review search reports, coordinate responses to objections, monitor competing applications. Cross-cutting duties: manage the patent portfolio and act as the interface between researchers, patent attorneys, and patent offices Manage the IP protection, strategic analysis, cost benefit evaluation of IPR maintenance. Provide internal advice, awareness training activites to researchers and institutes on IP and IPR matters. Manage relations with patent attorneys and external consultants. Ensure alignment of IP practices with national and European regulations IP internal regulation. Requirements: Master's degree in engineering, or a related technical field; a PhD is a plus; qualification as a registered patent attorney is preferred but not required. 2-3 years of experience in patent-related work, with demonstrated ability in prior art searching and drafting/reviewing patent applications. Knowledge of patent law, filing procedures (national/EPO/PCT), and freedom-to-operate principles. Strong communication skills, ability to manage multiple cases in parallel, fluency in Italian and English, knowledge of German is considered a plus. Previous work experience in an academic or research institution, preferably in the field of technology transfer, is a plus.. Ability to liaise effectively with researchers, companies, law firms, and IP consultants. Knowledge of software tools for patentability analysis and patent management. Excellent organisational, communication, and problem-solving skills. Enjoy working in a team and delivering a service to colleagues. Friendly and self-confident. We offer: Full-time fixed-term contract / initially 1 year. Opportunity to contribute to the development of Eurac Research’s newly established Knowledge Transfer Office. An interdisciplinary and international research environment. Continuous training and networking opportunities with national and international networks …

Le attività comprendono la conduzione di studi clinici e osservazionali, la raccolta e la gestione dei dati, il coordinamento delle attività cliniche e regolatorie e il supporto alla produzione scientifica dell'Unità. Per questo motivo offriamo: un programma di wellbeing che include anche iniziative dedicate alla salute fisica e psicologica; strumenti concreti per la conciliazione vita-lavoro, tra cui misure a sostegno della genitorialità e sostenibilità finanziaria; percorsi di formazione per valorizzare talenti e competenze in un contesto dinamico e innovativo. Transformamos processos complexos em uma jornada encantadora, criando uma experiência de trabalho mais leve, humana e eficiente para todos. Aqui dentro, chamamos isso de Efeito Flamingo : cada ideia, cada linha de código, cada atendimento reverbera muito além da Flash, impactando a rotina de empresas e milhões de pessoas. Trabalhar aqui é viver o poder de fazer voar com criatividade, propósito e impacto real. Vem ser Flamingo! ✨ Por que trabalhar com a gente? Na Flash, acreditamos que grandes transformações nascem de voos individuais, ganham força no coletivo e encontram direção nos valores que nos guiam como bando: ✨Criamos valor com o Cliente ✨Resolvemos problemas com Pragmatismo ✨Jogamos Juntos ✨Entregamos Resultados Consistentes ✨Aprendemos e Transformamos Nosso jeitinho de trabalhar: Ser Flamingo na Flash é viver um ambiente de criatividade e tecnologia, com autonomia para criar, testar e transformar ideias em soluções reais que ajudam empresas e pessoas a voarem mais alto. Aprendizado acelerado: cada desafio é uma chance de crescer e inovar. Pertencimento de verdade: ninguém voa sozinho, sempre em formação. Sentido de propósito: o que começa na Flash transforma o jeito que o mundo trabalha. Deixe sua marca no mundo do trabalho e viva com a gente o poder de fazer voar. ✨ Nossos benefícios: Cartão Flash (o tão amado rosinha! ) com benefício flexível para alimentação, refeição, mobilidade, saúde, educação, cultura e bem-estar Assistência médica Assistência odontológica Seguro de vida Vale-transporte Auxílio home office Auxílio-creche Licenças-maternidade e paternidade estendidas TotalPass para cuidar do corpo e da mente OnHappy para deixar as viagens ainda mais especiais Convênio Pet com a Guapeco C4life, com assistência jurídica, emocional, social e financeira, além de apoio para pets +Família by Avus, com suporte e benefícios para diferentes momentos da vida Convênio com o SESC Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Day off no seu aniversário Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas formas e acreditamos que times plurais constroem soluções mais fortes, humanas e inovadoras para Flash. Por isso, todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de qualquer gênero, raça, etnia, idade, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, religião e pessoa com deficiência (PCD). O que Buscamos: Procuramos uma Pessoa Engenheira de Software Sênior com forte mentalidade de produto. Na Flash, a pessoa engenheira vai além de apenas escrever código: ela entende as dores do negócio, colabora na concepção das soluções, pensa na experiência final do usuário e assume a responsabilidade de ponta a ponta pelo impacto do que constrói. Valorizamos fundamentos sólidos de engenharia de software acima de qualquer linguagem ou framework específico. Em um cenário em que a inteligência artificial transforma a forma como desenvolvemos software, domínio das ferramentas e foco no valor gerado ao cliente são os nossos grandes diferenciais. Suas responsabilidades e desafios: Atuação com Atitude de Produto: Participar ativamente das discussões de negócio e de produto, colaborando para transformar desafios do RH e do Financeiro em soluções técnicas elegantes e eficientes. Excelência e Fundamentos Técnicos: Projetar e evoluir sistemas escaláveis, performáticos e resilientes, aplicando boas práticas de arquitetura de software (como Clean Architecture , Event-Driven Architecture e DDD ). Uso Intensivo de IA no Ciclo de Desenvolvimento: Utilizar proficientemente AI coding agents (como Codex , Claude Code, entre outros) para prototipar, codificar, refatorar e acelerar entregas com alto padrão de qualidade. Cultura "You Build, You Run It": Ter responsabilidade pelo ciclo de vida completo do software — da concepção ao deploy, até o monitoramento e observabilidade em produção (com o suporte do time de SRE). Liderança Técnica e Mentoria: Orientar pessoas desenvolvedoras de níveis plenos e juniores através de revisões de código, pair programming , feedbacks construtivos e disseminação de boas práticas. Inovação e Experimentação: Propor e testar novas abordagens, tecnologias e padrões para manter a engenharia da Flash na vanguarda tecnológica. Colaboração e Rituais: Trabalhar de forma altamente integrativa com peers de engenharia, produto e design , promovendo a cultura de aprendizagem contínua e celebração de conquistas. O que é fundamental você ter: Fundamentos Sólidos de Engenharia de Software: Domínio profundo de estruturas de dados, algoritmos, orientação a objetos/funcional, padrões de projeto, arquitetura de microsserviços e decisões de trade-offs técnicos. items.desc: Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Provides clinical training and support to customers, as a subject matter expert, on-site and/or remotely to ensure customer is prepared to operate their equipment according to a minimum of safe and effective use guidelines and to fully utilize the complex functionality of the technology to meet their business needs.* Conduct product training for customers and employees, in particular training for complex situations involving multiple products. * Lead classroom lectures and laboratory sessions to ensure customers are trained to operate company equipment according to safety guidelines with the highest level of satisfaction. * Prepare lesson plans based on engineering documentation, field service requirements, and software documentation to address customers’ specific implementation questions. * Formulate complementary support training information in the form of quick tips, workbooks, video-media and implementation guides. * Collaborate with customers as well as the sales, product marketing, and technical support departments to ensure course material reflects current product features, and address customer inquiries including testing scenarios using company products. * Work with cross-functional teams as necessary to support and enable best services and optimize customer relations. Who we are : We are a team of more than 72,000 highly dedicated Healthineers in more than 70 countries. As a leader in medical technology, we constantly push the boundaries to create better outcomes and experiences for patients, no matter where they live or what health issues they are facing. Our portfolio is crucial for clinical decision-making and treatment pathways. How we work : When you join Siemens Healthineers, you become one in a global team of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists, who believe in each individual’s potential to contribute with diverse ideas. We are from different backgrounds, cultures, religions, political and/or sexual orientations, and work together, to fight the world’s most threatening diseases and enable access to care, united by one purpose: to pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. To find out more about Healthineers’ specific businesses, please visit our company page here. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities. Data Privacy : We care about your data privacy and take compliance with GDPR as well as other data protection legislation seriously. For this reason, we ask you not to send us your CV or resume by email. We ask instead that you create a profile where you can upload your CV. Setting up a profile also lets us know you are interested in career opportunities with us and makes it easy for us to send you an alert when relevant positions become open. Register here to get started. Beware of Job Scams: Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons that are currently posing as Siemens Healthineers recruiters/employees. These scammers may attempt to collect your confidential personal or financial information. If you are concerned that an offer of employment with Siemens Healthineers might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for the posting on the Siemens Healthineers career site. To all recruitment agencies : Siemens Healthineers does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other company location. Siemens Healthineers is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. As an equal opportunity employer, we welcome applications from individuals with disabilities.

items.desc: Join the Rebel Alliance: Penetration Tester Needed to Outsmart the Dark Side! Are you passionate about offensive security and hacking? So are we! Do you get excited every time you get your reverse shell back? Same here - no matter how many hundreds of times that happened! SECFORCE is a dynamic penetration testing company, with a presence in London, Malta and other regions of Europe. We are here! Waiting for you! SECFORCE is looking for a penetration tester to join our awesome team in the UK, Malta, Greece, Italy, Spain or Poland. Who are we? We are a young team and we promote a fun working environment. We enjoy hacking and are passionate about security testing. However, we also work hard and we believe we are one of the very best testing companies in the world. Tasks We are looking for a techie passionate about offensive security who wants to grow their skills. As such, your primary function will be to deliver penetration testing assessments. Requirements Required Skills: Familiarity with infrastructure and web application vulnerabilities Great communication/presentation skills Ability to write deliverables to a high standard (in English) Ability to communicate technical findings to both board-level executives and technical teams Mindset of being up-to-date with latest attack trends Other requirements: Applicants must have the legal right to work in the EU OR Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK without sponsorship. Nice to have: Knowledge or experience delivering cloud security assessments Knowledge or experience delivering mobile application security assessments Knowledge or experience in LLM technologies Programming/development background Certifications (e.g. OSCP) Participation in CTF platforms (e.g. HTB, THM) Benefits What we offer: A key role in delivering security testing services to some of the biggest names in the industry A work environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing Up to 20% of your time can be spent on research/conferences/skill development Full-remote working policy Relaxed working environment (e.g. no dress code) Annual training budget Bi-annual team events and trips Great! What's next? If you are passionate about offensive security, please get in touch! One piece of advice: Please don't send us the typical - boring - cover letter. We are not that kind of company. We are dynamic and fun. Send us just a paragraph describing why you are passionate and motivated about security testing, what type of projects you have been involved in, what excites you and what your aspirations are..

Participate in site surveys and field assessments to validate project assumptions, collect site constraints and support the development of executable solutions. Assist with the definition of project construction strategies, execution philosophies and contracting approaches. Support the development of constructability studies and construction methodology reviews during engineering and execution phases. Prepare and review installation sequences, construction work packages and execution plans for major plant modifications and new facilities. Contribute to heavy lifting and special transportation studies, including preliminary lifting concepts, transportation strategies and critical logistics assessments. Assist the Home Office Construction Manager in the development of project logistics and material management strategies. Evaluate modularization and offsite construction opportunities, supporting studies aimed at maximizing prefabrication and reducing onsite activities. Prepare construction-related requisitions and technical documentation for specialized construction services, heavy lifting, transportation and fabrication activities. Interface with major international contractors, fabrication yards, heavy lift contractors and specialized vendors during all project phases. Participate in technical bid evaluations and contractor qualification processes, supporting the assessment of construction capabilities, resources and execution strategies. Perform contractor assessments and participate in audits, site visits and fabrication shop inspections when required for critical project packages. Review project requirements and support the development and continuous improvement of the Construction Execution Plan. Liaise with field construction teams to verify the effectiveness of constructability studies and identify opportunities for improvement during project execution. Maintain the necessary records to ensure quality assurance and project requirements are met. This is an exciting opportunity to combine technical know-how, customer interaction, and hands-on problem solving in a dynamic international environment. Your responsibilities Install, start up, service, and upgrade packaging equipment at customer sites worldwide, ensuring successful commissioning and performance Perform functional testing, preventive maintenance, and inspections to maximize equipment reliability and minimize downtime Diagnose and resolve electrical, automation, software, and mechanical issues, providing effective technical support to customers Collaborate closely with customers to manage punch lists, drive issue resolution, and ensure systems operate according to safety standards Document service activities, machine performance, and maintenance records to support continuous improvement and operational excellence Expectations for you Technical diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Automation, or a related field Strong knowledge of electrical components and automation systems; mechanical skills are an advantage Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, schematics, and service documentation Fluency in Italian and English, both written and spoken. You build trust through clear communication, work comfortably with international stakeholders, and take ownership of technical challenges until they are resolved. Previous field service experience is appreciated and will help you quickly adapt to the role. We also expect you to align with Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical behaviours that guide how we lead, collaborate, and succeed together: Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value Additional information Ready to take your technical expertise around the world? We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow. At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. Join the team – and lead the way with us! www.valmet.com/careers

items.desc: Job Description: Closer to Space, closer to the Future: join Telespazio – Leonardo Space Division! Leonardo is a leading global industrial group in Aerospace, Defence and Security, delivering advance multi-domain technologies across Helicopters, Aircraft, Aerostructures, Electronics, Cybersecurity, and Space. As part of the Leonardo Space Division, Telespazio a joint venture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%) , is a global reference in the field of satellite solutions and services. With a workforce of over 3.500 professionals across its offices in Europe and around the world, Telespazio operates an international network of Space Centres and Teleports, offering cutting-edge solutions in Geoinformation Services, Satellite Systems and Operations, and Satellite Communications. Join us as we continue to push the boundaries of what’s possible in Space. We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join the Earth Observation unit within the Operations & Logistics Engineering department. The department is responsible for the study, development, and validation of operational and maintenance processes and procedures for complex satellites ground segment systems. Activities include the definition of possible tool supporting the operations execution and are carried out following the standards applied to the space programs (mainly ECSS) and, where necessary, of architectural frameworks (e.g. DoDAF, MoDAF, ...) and international best practices (e.g. ASD, S1000D, S3000L ...) You will apply systems engineering to the operational domain of space mission systems, focusing in particular on: Definition of the System/Mission Operations Concept (ConOps) and of nominal and contingency operational scenarios Derivation and definition of operational and operability requirements, to be applied to the system design Contribution to the definition of ground segment requirements from an operational perspective Analysis, characterization and modelling of operational processes and mission timelines Definition of the operations organization: roles, responsibilities and operational interfaces Development of operational products: plans (e.g. Mission/Flight Operations Plan), manuals and operational procedures (nominal, special, contingency) Definition and setup of operational tools Validation of operational products and verification of their end-to-end consistency Planning and support to operational validation campaigns: execution of scenarios, system validation tests Support to system operations development throughout the mission phases, supporting Operations Readiness Reviews and Operational Handover Requirements: Master's Degree in Aerospace Engineering / Electronic Engineering / Telecommunications Engineering / Management Engineering with a strong technical orientation to systems Junior profile or recent graduate Knowledge of the aerospace domain (preferred) Previous experience, even at an introductory level, in operational concept definition, operational analysis and operational validation of space systems is considered a plus Ability to work autonomously and take initiative, combined with intellectual curiosity and a constant drive to question the status quo and bring innovative solutions Good command of English (B2) Proficiency with MS Office Availability to travel abroad for limited periods Comfortable with software tools and a hands-on attitude in getting the most out of them What We Offer: Our applicable collective labor agreement is the CCNL for the Private Metalworking Industry and Plant Installation Sector . Working arrangement: Hybrid Employment category: Employee Contract type: Permanent-term 13th-month salary payment . performance bonus linked to Business results*. Welfare vouchers worth €250 per year. Meal vouchers worth €9, usable at the company cafeteria or for external expenses. Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance both technical expertise and interpersonal skills. The Company reserves the right to assess the job grade and compensation package based on objective criteria identified during the recruitment process and in line with the seniority level of the selected candidate and the position itself, in compliance with the principles of fairness, transparency and equal opportunities established by applicable legislation. How Does the Recruitment Process Work? Following the collection of applications, we review and identify the candidates whose profiles best match the required qualifications and skills. Selected candidates will participate in an initial interview with the Human Resources team, focused on getting to know the candidate, as well as assessing motivation and personal competencies. This is followed by a more in-depth technical interview conducted together with the relevant Business team. At the end of the selection process, candidates receive feedback regardless of the outcome, whether positive or negative.
