items.desc: Bozen/Bolzano full-time, part-time, internship Institute for Regional Development Short description of the position/project: We are seeking a trainee researcher (i.e. master’s degree either under development or achieved by less than 1 year) to join the Institute for Regional Development, with a working focus on transport planning and mobility research. The position aims to support our research on the analysis of (rural) transport accessibility and the understanding of rural mobility patterns. The successful candidate will support the Regional Development team in the implementation of one local project. The duration of the internship is at least 6 months and up to 10 months (to be agreed upon with the candidate). Tasks: Project “Passing-through traffic in Passeiertal”: Implement this consultation project with the institute team. The aim of the project is to estimate how much of the motorised traffic affecting the South Tyrolean valley of Passeiertal is generated by passing-through traffic flows (of locals and visitors). To this end, the project will analyse available secondary data, will collect additional primary data, and will derive estimates. Other projects: Support the institute's team in the implementation of other ongoing projects (if and when needed). Such projects typically regard (rural) passenger mobility and local or EU level. Relevant ongoing projects include RECCAM, CLOSING THE GAP, YOUTH4MOBILIT, iMONITRAF!. Requirements: Bachelor/master’s degree in transport-relevant disciplines (such as engineering or spatial planning), ideally with a focus on travel demand analysis, monitoring and estimation (relevant for the Passeiertal project). Hard skills: Good command of transport demand models, survey/statistical tools, and techniques to set up travel demand surveys and primary data collection campaigns (relevant for the Passeiertal project). Soft skills: Strong communication skills and ability to work in international, multidisciplinary teams with a positive and curious mindset. Interest in rural mobility challenges. Language (DE or IT): Professional knowledge of German or Italian for writing, speaking and listening. The Passeiertal project has a local scale, requiring the knowledge of at least one of the local languages. Language (EN): Professional knowledge of English (preferably C1, possibly B2 level) for writing, speaking and listening, to allow a smooth production of project-related scientific outputs. We offer: A full-time job position (40h/week), or 32h/week arrangement if preferred by the candidate. A supportive, international, and interdisciplinary research environment. Access to professional development and training opportunities. An attractive workplace in a highly cyclable city offering excellent access to outdoor and mountain activities. Workplace location: Viale Druso, 1 - 39100 Bolzano. How to apply: Interested candidates should submit their application (CV, cover letter, and any other relevant documents) exclusively through this website by 02.11.2026. Company : Eurac Research Location : Bozen/Bolzano Contact person : Nadja Colafati Phone number : +39 0471 055 682 E-mail address : nadja.colafati@eurac.edu

items.desc: Beschrijving van de vacature Soort vacature: Ondersteunend Wetenschappelijk Personeel (OWP) Instituut: DANS Locatie: Den Haag Sluitingsdatum: 09-11-2026 Minimaal aantal uur per week: 30,4 Salaris Max (€): 5.264 Duur overeenkomst: 1 jaar Quality Assurance Engineer (NL) Vacature: Quality Assurance Engineer Vind jij het belangrijk dat wetenschap transparant en toegankelijk is en dat onderzoeksdata beschikbaar zijn voor hergebruik? En wil je bijdragen aan open science op nationaal en Europees niveau? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou! Voor onze sectie Technologie zoeken wij een Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer 30,4 - 38 uur per week (0,8 – 1 fte) Wat ga je doen? Als QA Engineer speel je een belangrijke rol in het waarborgen van de kwaliteit van onze software. Je zorgt ervoor dat onze softwaresystemen voldoen aan functionele en technische standaarden voordat deze beschikbaar worden gesteld aan gebruikers binnen de wetenschappelijke gemeenschap. Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden: Schrijven, uitvoeren en onderhouden van testplannen voor onze op Dataverse gebaseerde systemen, waaronder de Data Stations, DataverseNL en het ODISSEI Portal. Vroegtijdig signaleren van fouten en in duidelijke, beknopte stappen beschrijven waarmee deze kunnen worden gereproduceerd, zodat ontwikkelaars problemen efficiënt kunnen oplossen. Testen van nieuwe en bestaande functionaliteiten in zowel de gebruikersinterface (UI) als API's, met passende testmethoden zoals functioneel testen, regressietesten en exploratory testing. Ontwikkelen en onderhouden van geautomatiseerde tests om het testproces efficiënter en betrouwbaarder te maken. Nauw samenwerken met developers, product owners en operations om de kwaliteit van het softwareontwikkelings- en opleverproces te verbeteren. Wat breng je mee? Je hebt een technische opleiding (informatica, software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting) of gelijkwaardige professionele ervaring. Je hebt ervaring en veel affiniteit met softwaretesten en bent bekend met gangbare testmethoden en -technieken. Je werkt georganiseerd en kunt zelfstandig je werkzaamheden plannen en uitvoeren. Tegelijkertijd communiceer je proactief met collega's en andere betrokkenen. Je bent nieuwsgierig en wilt je kennis en vaardigheden verder ontwikkelen. Je zoekt graag naar manieren om het testen slimmer en efficiënter te maken en bent gemotiveerd om bij te dragen aan de kwaliteit en betrouwbaarheid van de dienstverlening van DANS. Daarnaast breng je de volgende kennis en vaardigheden mee: Je bent in staat om edge cases te identificeren en problemen te signaleren die anderen mogelijk over het hoofd zien. Je bent bereid scriptingvaardigheden te gebruiken en verder te ontwikkelen om taken te automatiseren. Ervaring met API-testing en/of geautomatiseerd testen is een pluspunt. Een certificering zoals ISTQB of TMap is een pluspunt. Ervaring met Dataverse of vergelijkbare repositorysoftware is een pluspunt. Je beheerst het Engels vloeiend; kennis van het Nederlands is wenselijk. Wat bieden wij? DANS biedt een plezierige werkomgeving, waar een gemotiveerde en goed samenwerkende club van research data experts en engineers zich inzet voor Open Science en FAIR data. Bij DANS vinden we initiatief nemen, deskundigheid, resultaatgerichtheid, betrouwbaarheid en samenwerken belangrijk. We stellen prijs op een levendige sfeer onder collega’s en hechten veel belang aan onderlinge kennisuitwisseling. Persoonlijke ontwikkeling wordt niet vergeten en de medewerkerstevredenheid is hoog. Het salaris bedraagt afhankelijk van leeftijd en ervaring minimaal € 3.873,- en maximaal € 5.264,- bruto per maand op fulltime basis (=38 uur, schaal 9 CAO-NU). Het betreft in eerste instantie een dienstverband voor bepaalde tijd van 1 jaar met uitzicht op een vast contract bij goed functioneren. Een volledig overzicht van de arbeidsvoorwaarden vind je op https://www.knaw.nl/werken-bij-de-knaw. Waar is je werkplek? DANS is gevestigd aan de Anna van Saksenlaan in Den Haag, op loopafstand van het station Laan van NOI. Het is mogelijk om gedeeltelijk (max. 50%) vanuit huis te werken. Bij wie kun je terecht voor meer informatie? Voor nadere inlichtingen over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Jan van Mansum (jan.van.mansum@dans.knaw.nl).Informatie over DANS staat op dans.knaw.nl. Hoe kun je solliciteren? Je motivatiebrief met cv stuur je t.a.v. Patris van Boxel, Head of Technology bij DANS, via het ATS-systeem. Diversiteit & Inclusie De KNAW acht een werkomgeving waarin iedereen zich welkom en gewaardeerd voelt van groot belang. Een werkomgeving waarin aandacht is voor individuele kwaliteit en waar ontwikkelmogelijkheden voorop staan. Samen streven we naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin we verschillen omarmen. We nodigen dan ook graag kandidaten uit die door hun achtergrond en ervaring hieraan een bijdrage willen leveren. Bij gelijke geschiktheid gaat de voorkeur uit naar de kandidaat die de diversiteit binnen de KNAW op deze wijze versterkt. Acquisitie naar …

items.desc: Over Partnify Goed samenwerken vereist informatie: genoeg en vooral de juiste. Juist op dat moment gaat er in de praktijk veel verloren. Er wordt niet genoeg genoteerd, er wordt niet genoeg onthouden en niet genoeg vastgelegd. Werk je in elkaars systemen, dan is het de vraag of je überhaupt bij de informatie kunt. Partnify bouwt het B2B-platform waarmee organisaties van elke omvang, van zzp'er tot multinational, over organisatiegrenzen heen samenwerken: collabs, communicatie, documenten en afspraken op één plek. Het platform vangt zowel de bits, alles wat digitaal wordt gedeeld, als de atoms, alles wat buiten de systemen gebeurt: gesprekken, meetings, afspraken aan tafel. Onze AI-agent PAI zorgt ervoor dat de juiste informatie op het juiste moment bij de juiste mensen ligt. Hoe meer je samenwerkt, hoe meer waarde het platform levert. Onze engineering-afdeling groeide dit jaar van 5 naar 16 collega's, verdeeld over de teams: Core, Integrations, AI en FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering). We zijn een jong en snel groeiend productbedrijf met een enthousiast team in Zwolle. Dat betekent korte lijnen, veel eigenaarschap en direct zichtbare impact van wat je bouwt. Wat ga je doen? Als Software Engineer in het AI-team werk je mee aan PAI, onze AI-agent die gebruikers binnen Partnify helpt bij samenwerken, communiceren en het beheren van documenten en afspraken. Je pakt problemen en kansen zelfstandig op van ontwerp tot productie, en denkt mee over de technische richting van het team. Je werkt vooral aan: Harnessing van PAI. Je onderzoekt en verbetert hoe we de mogelijkheden van taalmodellen benutten binnen PAI, zodat die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegt voor gebruikers. Research. Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en taalmodellen, en vertaalt die naar bruikbare toepassingen binnen ons platform. Agents bouwen. Je ontwikkelt agents die het werk rondom B2B-samenwerkingen op ons platform bevorderen, van eerste opzet tot productie. Webapplicatie. Je bouwt aan de plekken in onze React-webapplicatie waar gebruikers met PAI in aanraking komen, van chat interface tot suggesties die meelopen in de workflow. Cloudinfrastructuur. Je werkt met Google Cloud Platform, Cloud Run, Cloud SQL en volledige CI/CD om AI-functionaliteit schaalbaar en betrouwbaar te laten draaien. Wie zoeken we? Opleiding en ervaring. Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in software engineering of een vergelijkbare richting, en minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als software engineer. Technische basis. Je hebt stevige ervaring met minimaal één moderne programmeertaal, bij voorkeur Python, TypeScript of JavaScript, en pakt nieuwe systemen en technologieën snel op. Communicatie. Je communiceert makkelijk in het Nederlands en kunt technische documentatie in het Engels lezen en schrijven. Van businessprobleem naar oplossing. Je vertaalt een vraag van een gebruiker of collega naar een passende technische oplossing, en legt je keuzes begrijpelijk uit aan mensen zonder technische achtergrond. Teamspeler. Je werkt graag samen, vraagt en geeft feedback, en durft de lat hoger te leggen als je vindt dat het beter kan. Eigenaarschap. Je voelt je verantwoordelijk voor wat je oplevert, denkt mee over het waarom achter een AI-functie en trekt aan de bel als iets niet klopt. Mooi meegenomen, maar geen vereiste: affiniteit met taalmodellen en ervaring met Django, React of AI/LLM-API's zoals die van OpenAI of Anthropic (Claude). Wat bieden we? Fulltime met passend salaris. Een baan van 40 uur per week met een salaris van € 4.250 tot € 7.000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring. Kwaliteit als standaard. Een moderne stack en een team dat kwaliteit belangrijk vindt: code reviews, CI/CD en geautomatiseerde tests zijn bij ons vanzelfsprekend. AI-ondersteund ontwikkelen. Je werkt dagelijks met Claude als programmeerhulp, en bouwt daarnaast mee aan AI-functionaliteit voor onze eigen gebruikers. Hybride werken. Een goed bereikbaar kantoor aan de Dokter Spanjaardweg 19A in Zwolle, met ruimte om deels thuis te werken. Doorgroeimogelijkheden. Je groeipad ligt bij ons niet vast. Je kunt doorgroeien naar tech lead, of naar Forward Deployed Engineer, waar je samen met klanten oplossingen bouwt. Omdat we groeien, ontstaan er steeds nieuwe rollen. Wie initiatief toont, krijgt de ruimte om die mee vorm te geven. Solliciteren Stuur je cv met een korte motivatie, of een link naar je GitHub of portfolio (dat zegt ons vaak meer), naar thomasvermeulen@partnify.com. Vragen over de vacature? Bel of mail gerust. Salaris: €4.250,00 - €7.000,00 per maand Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Flexibele werkuren Pensioen Reiskostenvergoeding Werklocatie: Hybride werken in 8025 Zwolle

items.title: Project Controller
items.card: You will become part of a team of 15 enthusiastic and knowledgeable Project Controllers who are jointly responsible for a diverse portfolio of research projects. Where you will work How can we make our food healthier, safer and more sustainable? And how can we ensure that we can continue to produce enough food in the future? At the Agrotechnology & Food Sciences Group (AFSG) of Wageningen University & Research,
items.desc: Your job Are you looking for a challenging position where you can grow? Would you like to develop your expertise in grant schemes and everything that comes with them? Wageningen University & Research (WUR) is looking for a Project Controller for 36 hours per week. Will you become our new colleague? What are you going to do? As a Project Controller, you are responsible for the administration and financial management of research projects, including grant-funded projects. From budgeting through to final settlement, you translate between finance and research. Together with the Business Controller and project leaders, you ensure effective financial control and risk management of projects within several departments of the Agrotechnology & Food Sciences Group (AFSG). items.desc: Tiny Telescope is looking for an ambitious Earth Observation Specialist to help shape the future of space-based Earth observation. Our payloads, mounted on satellites deliver high-resolution Earth observation data (~5 meters) with daily revisit capabilities. A key challenge is transforming raw sensor data into valuable information products while operating within the strict power, computing, and communication constraints of space systems. AI-driven processing will help identify valuable observations and reject unusable data, such as cloud-covered imagery, minimizing the amount of data that needs to be transmitted to Earth. You understand the complete Earth observation value chain: from satellite hardware and sensors to image processing, AI algorithms, and the applications that depend on the resulting data products. You enjoy working across disciplines and translating mission goals into practical technical solutions. Your Responsibilities : Develop Earth observation processing chains from Level 0 to Level 1 and Level 2 products. Design and implement image processing, AI, and machine learning algorithms for onboard and ground-based systems. Develop methods to identify and filter unwanted imagery, such as clouds and Optimize processing performance within the limited power and computing resources available on satellites. Work closely with hardware, software, and systems engineers to develop next-generation Earth observation capabilities. Support the development of innovative applications and products based on Earth observation data. Your Profile : Background in Earth observation, remote sensing, aerospace engineering, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of satellite imaging systems and remote sensing workflows. Experience with image processing, geospatial data analysis, and algorithm development. Familiarity with AI and machine learning techniques. Ability to bridge hardware, software, and application domains. Innovative, analytical, and comfortable working in a startup/scaleup environment. What We Offer : A unique opportunity to develop cutting-edge Earth observation technology. A multidisciplinary role involving space systems, AI, and remote sensing. Significant responsibility and impact within a fast-growing aerospace company. An enthusiastic startup/scaleup culture with motivated colleagues. Flexible employment from part-time to full-time . Location: The Netherlands . Interested? If you are passionate about Earth observation and space technology, we would love to hear from you. Contact Tiny Telescope to learn more about this opportunity.

items.desc: Tiny Telescope is looking for an ambitious Star Tracker Specialist to help develop the next generation of high-accuracy attitude determination systems for space missions. Despite their compact size, Tiny Telescopes deliver exceptional optical performance and magnification, enabling highly accurate star trackers for spacecraft positioning and attitude control. In this role, you will work at the intersection of optics, electronics, software, and spacecraft systems to develop star trackers that meet the demanding requirements of modern Attitude Determination and Control Systems (ADCS). You understand the architecture and protocols of ADCS systems and can translate system-level requirements into reliable star tracker solutions. From optical design and sensor integration to star pattern recognition algorithms and system qualification, you will play a key role in delivering flight-ready products for space applications. Your Responsibilities : Develop high-accuracy star trackers for spacecraft attitude determination. Design and implement star pattern recognition and attitude estimation algorithms that generate precise quaternions. Define interfaces and protocols. Optimize reliability and processing performance within the limited power and computing resources available on satellites. Contribute to the development of next-generation ADCS technologies. Work across optical, electrical, software, and systems engineering disciplines. Develop and execute test, verification, and qualification programs. Your Profile : Background in aerospace engineering, physics, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field. Understanding of ADCS architectures, and spacecraft pointing requirements. Experience with performance optimization of star trackers, gyroscopes, optical sensors, computer vision, or image processing systems. Familiarity with attitude determination algorithms, star catalog matching, and quaternion-based representations. Knowledge of optical, electrical, and software aspects of embedded space systems. Hands-on, analytical, and comfortable working in a multidisciplinary team. Excited by the challenges of developing hardware and software for space missions. What We Offer : A unique opportunity to develop cutting-edge star tracker technology for space applications. A multidisciplinary role combining optics, electronics, software, and spacecraft systems engineering. Significant responsibility and technical ownership within a fast-growing company. Daarbij richten we ons op het verbeteren van onze detectie- en responscapabilities, het vergroten van onze operationele weerbaarheid en het slimmer inzetten van technologie en automatisering. items.desc: Position:Supervisory Board Member Location:The Netherlands (or someone who can travel to the Netherlands) Application Deadline:1st November 2026 Duration:4 years,4-8h per month About SPARK SPARK is an international NGO that creates high-impact jobs for young people, including women and refugees, in regions affected by fragility and conflict. We work with local and international partners to strengthen entrepreneurial ecosystems and education, ensuring our support is market-driven and contributes to post-conflict economic recovery and stability. Our growing team of 40 employees operates from offices in Amsterdam, Palestine, Iraq, Morocco, Tunisia, and other locations, mainly in the Middle East and Africa. SPARK Strategy SPARK’s journey ahead rests on three pillars: innovation, resilience, and localization. With a digitized organizational backbone, strengthened local governance, and a global marketplace for jobs and business linkages, SPARK is positioned to lead in fragile contexts. Our focus remains on creating dignified jobs, nurturing entrepreneurship, and bridging humanitarian and development divides. With donor and government partners, SPARK will scale its proven models to ensure that young people—especially women and refugees—have the opportunities and support they need to build stable, prosperous futures. The Role Supervisory Board is recruiting one new member with extensive financial experience, particularly in grants management from an operational leadership role. This includes experience in foundation or donor relations (EU, MENA, Africa, Netherlands) and an understanding of P&L responsibilities to support the Finance and Audit Committee. As a board member, you will monitor the Board of Directors performance, advise on and approve overall policy and strategy, and review annual plans, budgets, accounts, and reports. You will join the Finance and Audit Committee alongside existing board members and serve as a sparring partner to the Head of Finance and the Director. What We Seek We are looking for someone with a global perspective and cultural awareness who resides in the Netherlands or can travel to the Netherlands at their own expense at least four times per year. Experience working in or for SPARK operating regions (MENA and Africa) is highly valued. The commitment averages 4-8 hours per month plus occasional engagement with leadership and the committee. Board meetings occur four to six times annually, typically in Amsterdam or other office locations. The position is unremunerated but includes a limited volunteer allowance of €1,500 per year. Ideal Background The ideal candidate has experience in NGO grants, financial-operational leadership, or operational experience with foundation or donor relations. Strong links to SPARK operating regions are preferred. While conflict resolution, fundraising, advocacy, or tech/digital literacy are advantageous, the primary focus remains on financial governance and grant oversight. We encourage diverse backgrounds and individuals from underrepresented groups to apply. Application Process If you are enthusiastic about this opportunity, please submit your expression of interest explaining your alignment with the outlined requirements in a Cover letter, along with your CV finding this specificvacancy and using the ‘apply’ button on https://vacancy.spark-online.org/Tab1/LoadProfileFromVacancy/727 If you have any questions, please reach out to the current SB members Lizette van der Kamp, Fawad Shah, Nic van der Jagt and Fred de Vries through sb@spark-online.org Practical questions can be answered by the senior secretary Liesbeth Molenaar, through the general spark email address spark@spark-online.org Deadline of application: 1 November 2026. If we see a fit, we will get back to you within 2.5 weeks. Due to the high volume of applicants, we cannot provide feedback in all individual cases. We hope you understand. All communications will be treated confidentially. Apply Apply

items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 8.11.2026 Sektor Privat Er du vår neste Analytics Engineer i Team Stingray? Hos Stingray utvikler vi undervannsroboter som overvåker og forbedrer fiskevelferden i oppdrettsanlegg ved hjelp av sensorer, kameraer, maskinsyn og laser. Hver dag samler systemene våre inn enorme mengder data om fisk, miljø og produksjon fra mer enn 180 lokaliteter i Norge, Island og Færøyene. For å skape verdi av disse dataene trenger vi mer enn bare en sterk dataplattform. Vi trenger gode datamodeller og datasett som gjør data tilgjengelige, konsistente og gjenbrukbare på tvers av organisasjonen. Nå ser vi etter en Analytics Engineer som vil være med på å videreutvikle dette grunnlaget i tett samarbeid med dataingeniører, dataanalytikere og andre fagmiljøer i Stingray. Arbeidsoppgaver – hva skal du gjøre? Som Analytics Engineer blir du en del av Data Platform-teamet og får en sentral rolle i arbeidet med å gjøre data tilgjengelige, konsistente og enkle å bruke på tvers av Stingray. Du vil jobbe tett med dataingeniører, dataanalytikere og fagspesialister for å forstå ulike behov og videreutvikle datagrunnlaget som brukes i analysearbeid på tvers av selskapet. Rollen kombinerer datamodellering, analyse og visualisering, og gir deg muligheten til å påvirke hvordan data struktureres, kvalitetssikres og gjøres tilgjengelige for våre ulike fagmiljøer. Du vil blant annet: Utvikle og vedlikeholde datamodeller, datasett og semantiske modeller i dbt og Power BI Utvikle og videreutvikle dashboards og analysegrunnlag tilpasset ulike fagområders behov Sikre høy datakvalitet gjennom testing, dokumentasjon og kontinuerlig forbedring Samarbeide med dataanalytikere og fagmiljøer for å forstå og konkretisere behov for data og analyse Bidra til standardisering, gjenbruk og videreutvikling av beste praksis for Power BI-løsninger Hvem ser vi etter? Vi ser etter deg som har bachelor- eller mastergrad innen et kvantitativt fagområde, som informatikk, matematikk, statistikk eller tilsvarende, og som har noen års erfaring med datamodellering, analyse eller dataplattformer. Kanskje jobber du i dag som Analytics Engineer, Data Analyst, BI Developer eller Data Engineer, eller i en lignende rolle med fokus på analyse og datamodellering. Du liker å skape struktur i komplekse datasett og motiveres av å utvikle løsninger som gjør data enklere å bruke for ulike fagmiljøer i selskapet. Samtidig trives du med å samarbeide med ulike fagmiljøer for å forstå behov og omsette dem til gode dataløsninger. For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du har: Minimum 3 års erfaring med analyse, datamodellering eller dataplattformer Erfaring med SQL, Power BI, og gjerne dbt og Git Erfaring med å utvikle og vedlikeholde dataløsninger i produksjon God forståelse for datakvalitet, testing og versjonskontroll Evne til å omsette behov og problemstillinger til robuste og gjenbrukbare datasett Vi tror også at du er analytisk, nysgjerrig og opptatt av kvalitet. Du liker å lære nye ting, deler kunnskap med andre og trives med å jobbe på tvers av ulike fagområder. Har du erfaring med Snowflake, Python, GitLab eller CI/CD-pipelines er det en fordel, men det viktigste er at du er nysgjerrig, lærevillig og motivert for å utvikle deg sammen med teamet. Hva tilbyr vi? Hos Stingray får du muligheten til å jobbe med store datamengder og problemstillinger som har direkte betydning for utviklingen av en mer bærekraftig havbruksnæring. Du blir en del av et kompetent og tverrfaglig miljø der data, teknologi og biologisk innsikt møtes for å skape verdi både internt og for kundene våre. Rollen gir stor påvirkningskraft på hvordan data modelleres, tilgjengeliggjøres og brukes på tvers av organisasjonen, Arbeidsmiljøet preges av samarbeid, høy faglig kompetanse og korte beslutningsveier. Vi gir våre ansatte tillit, ansvar og mulighet til å påvirke både teknologi og arbeidsmetoder. Vi legger også stor vekt på det sosiale, med samlinger, arrangementer, turer, kantineordning og treningsmuligheter, inkludert eget treningsrom. Team Stingray har sitt utspring under overflaten, der menneskene, lidenskapen og ulikhetene knytter oss sammen. StingrayPodden er et resultat av de mange historiene som fortjener en arena hvor humor, energi og engasjement kommer opp fra dypet. Følg podkasten vår på Spotify! Er du vår nye Analytics Engineer? Da oppfordrer vi deg til å søke. Kom som du er til Team Stingray - vi ser frem til å høre fra deg! For spørsmål om stillingen kan du kontakte Mads Rismoen (Recruiter) på tlf. +47 902 33 917. items.desc: Miejsce pracy: Balice, małopolskie (ref. ME 2) Responsibilities Plan, schedule and prioritize manufacturing engineering projects according to program and customer timing. Define manufacturing process and equipment concepts to meet quality, safety, capacity and cost requirements. Lead equipment specification, sourcing, purchase, installation and commissioning. Develop and implement new manufacturing technologies, automation and process improvements. Apply Lean Manufacturing principles to optimize process flow, cycle time, capacity and waste. Develop and maintain manufacturing documentation, including Process Flow, PFMEA, Control Plan and Standard Work. Create and maintain the Bill of Process (BOP) and manufacturing process standards. Support production ramp-up and ensure required quality, capacity and process performance. Analyze manufacturing data to identify losses, bottlenecks and improvement opportunities. Cooperate with cross-functional and global teams, equipment suppliers and plant Manufacturing Engineering. Qualifications: Required (R) Engineering Degree, preferably in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Fluent in English; additional languages are an asset. Experience with high-volume manual and automated assembly processes, preferably in automotive manufacturing. Understanding of manufacturing processes, machine design and industrial automation. Experience with equipment implementation, commissioning and production ramp-up. Knowledge of PFMEA, SPC, MSA, Control Plan and process capability. Strong problem-solving and root-cause analysis skills. Good knowledge of Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement principles. Strong analytical skills and ability to work with manufacturing data. Good MS Office skills, especially Excel and PowerPoint. Willingness and availability to travel internationally, including Mexico (up to 30%). Preferred (P) PLC programming and industrial automation experience. Robot programming or robotic systems integration. Experience using AI-based tools to support engineering analysis, problem solving and process improvement.

items.desc: Short description (Role) Join our Poznań team and help deliver the final building in the city's most recognized and highly successful office campuses. Nowy Rynek C is one of three active development projects currently underway within Skanska Commercial Development Europe and continues to attract strong interest from tenants. With construction now underway, it offers an excellent opportunity to become part of a project that is already shaping the local office market . In this role, you will work closely with the Project Director and the entire Project Team to turn ambitious plans into reality and help deliver a building that will remain part of Poznań’s landscape for years to come. Working with us, you will have a chance to: support the delivery of Nowy Rynek C through its remaining development stages, working closely with the Project Director to help deliver the project on time and within budget; contribute to project planning, cost control, schedule coordination and stakeholder relationship management; oversee construction works and help ensure compliance with quality, safety and environmental standards; coordinate tenant fit-out activities in close cooperation with the Leasing Team; collaborate with municipal authorities, subcontractors, consultants and inspection teams; maintain and manage project documentation, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and quality; participate in negotiations and the selection of key subcontractors together with Skanska SA; cooperate with our Environmental, Digitalization and Innovation teams to support certification processes and implement innovative solutions, including AI tools, BIM 360 and smart-building What We Expect from You and What We Offer You: What you'll bring: Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture or a related field; At least 3 years of experience in construction or real estate development, including residential, office or retail projects; a good understanding of construction and investment processes, budgeting and relevant regulations; Ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and contractors; Strong communication, analytical and organizational skills; native-level proficiency in both spoken and written Polish; English proficiency at B2 level or higher. What you'll find with us: The opportunity to work on project which is part of Poznań’s landmark office investment – Nowy Rynek; the chance to join a project gaining strong momentum and gain experience across different stages of delivery, from core and shell works to preparing spaces for future tenants; exposure to modern building technologies and innovative solutions within one of our most sustainable current projects, including geothermal boreholes, ground-source heat pumps and a fossil-free heating and cooling system designed to enable the building to operate independently of the district heating network; close cooperation with experienced professionals across different disciplines; a collaborative culture where people share knowledge, support one another’s development and work together toward common goals; the opportunity to make a visible and lasting contribution to Poznań’s urban landscape. About this opportunity Starting in January 2027 (or earlier, depending on availability), this full-time opportunity is expected to last at least nine months. You'll join our Poznań team at an exciting stage of the project, with the chance to make a meaningful contribution and further develop your expertise. While the role is primarily connected to our Poznań location, we're open to discussing flexible working arrangements based on project needs and individual circumstances. We know that talented people bring different experiences, strengths and career aspirations, which is why we're open to shaping the final scope, title and ways of working around the right person. items.desc: Company Description Sopra Steria is one of the largest players in the tech industry in Europe, known for its consulting, digital services and software development. We operate in nearly 30 countries in the world, hiring more than 55,000 employees. The Polish branch, as the Global Delivery Center, operates in Katowice since 2007 and has been growing ever since. Currently, our team consists of around 1,000 specialists. Within the Digital Platform Services department, our teams specialize in areas such as cloud, operating systems, virtualization, databases, backup or storage, as well as networking and security. We also have 1st line support consultants who speak French and English, but also Italian, Spanish, Portuguese and German. The Application Services department is responsible for areas such as software development, data engineering, testing services, CRM, ITSM and ERP platform integrations, as well as application management for customers in Scandinavia, Benelux, France, Germany, Switzerland and the UK. Job Description We are looking for a Solution Architect to join Sopra Steria Apps Services team on an international Program for a leader in the aerospace sector. You will support the implementation of a new approach for Safety Assessment within the new program and focus on defining and governing the architecture of the selected engineering solutions, supporting tool evaluations, and preparing High-Level Design Documentation. You will collaborate with business stakeholders, engineering teams, and solution providers to establish architecture principles, constraints, and standards that ensure a robust, scalable, maintainable, and compliant solution. Note that we can only offer cooperation to people who are located in Poland and have EU citizenship. Responsibilities: Develop, maintain, and govern High-Level Design Documents (HLDD). Define and validate the end-to-end technical and solution architecture for engineering and safety assessment platforms. Define and document architectural constraints, design principles, standards, and governance applicable to the selected toolchain. Establish architecture guidelines and best practices to ensure consistency, scalability, interoperability, maintainability, and long-term sustainability. Perform architecture modelling and maintain relevant views using Enterprise Architect (Sparx EA). Evaluate candidate tools from architecture, integration, compliance, and operability perspectives. Facilitate architecture reviews and support evidence-based technical decision-making. Collaborate with business, engineering, IT, and solution-provider stakeholders to translate business needs into technical solutions. Identify technical risks, dependencies, constraints, and mitigation actions. Support the architecture roadmap and the controlled evolution of the selected digital engineering solution. Qualifications Must have requirements: Solution and technical architecture design High-Level Design Documentation (HLDD) Architecture governance, reviews, standards, and design principles Enterprise Architect (Sparx EA) Requirements engineering, interface definition, and data-flow modelling Scalability, maintainability, interoperability, security, and compliance-by-design Technical risk and dependency assessment Business and technical requirement analysis Tool evaluation and solution selection Stakeholder management and workshop facilitation Architecture roadmap development Technical decision support and documentation Experience working in complex or regulated engineering environments Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills Ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders Collaborative, pragmatic, and outcome-oriented working style Attention to detail and commitment to documentation quality Fluent English B2/C1. Being open to occasional business trips abroad and visits in our office in Katowice or Gdańsk. Nice to have requirements: Safety engineering and safety assessment processes Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) and digital engineering ecosystems Model-based engineering concepts Additional Information What we offer: BENEFITS (UoP): Luxmed, Medicover Sport, Worksmile, educational platforms, languages learning platform, referral bonus, life insurance, certifications (paid by the company), conferences, Tech Lunches, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud), local kindergarten. DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES (B2B): Tech Lunches, Worksmile, possibility to join our Communities (Project Management, Architecture, Security, Process Management, Leadership, AI and Cloud). ADDITION: free parking, fresh fruits, workation. In case of questions, please contact the HR team. items.desc: Jesteśmy liderem w zakresie generalnego wykonawstwa obiektów logistycznych, przemysłowych i technologicznych w Polsce. Oferujemy kompleksowe rozwiązania w zakresie doradztwa, projektowania, produkcji i realizacji. Działamy od ponad 26 lat i w tym czasie zrealizowaliśmy ponad 850 inwestycji o łącznej powierzchni ok. 6 mln m². Realizujemy projekty na rynku polskim i europejskim. Stawiamy na nowoczesne i zrównoważone budownictwo – jesteśmy jednostką certyfikującą BREEAM, działamy zgodnie z metodyką BIM, posiadamy certyfikaty ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 9001. Zatrudniamy najwyższej klasy kadrę inżynierską z ekspertyzą w zakresie nowoczesnego budownictwa. Nasza siedziba główna znajduje się we Wrocławiu. Posiadamy oddziały w Warszawie, Krakowie, Poznaniu, Szczecinie i Gdyni. Miejsce pracy: Szczecin Region: zachodniopomorskie Numer referencyjny: 10.2026|Łódź, Kraków, Poznań, Szczecin Opis stanowiska Wdrażanie i prowadzenie BIM na przypisanych kontraktach zgodnie z wymaganiami Inwestora (EIR/AIR) i Planem Realizacji BIM (BEP), w tym udział w przygotowaniu i aktualizacji BEP wykonawczego. Bieżące wsparcie kierownictwa budowy i inżynierów w pracy z modelami: wyciąganie informacji, przekroje, zestawienia ilościowe, weryfikacja rozwiązań przed realizacją robót. Weryfikacja modeli i dokumentacji wykonawczej (jakość, zgodność z BEP, wykrywanie kolizji) oraz obieg uwag z projektantami i podwykonawcami w formacie BCF. Administrowanie środowiskiem CDE na kontrakcie: struktura, uprawnienia, obieg dokumentów, statusy, wdrażanie nowych użytkowników. Prowadzenie zastosowań BIM w realizacji: 4D (powiązanie z harmonogramem), wsparcie przedmiarów i rozliczeń (5D), monitorowanie postępu robót, zarządzanie usterkami i odbiorami w narzędziach mobilnych. Koordynacja dostaw modeli od podwykonawców. Przygotowanie i weryfikacja modeli powykonawczych (As-Built) oraz danych do przekazania Inwestorowi i obszarowi Gwarancji i FM. Szkolenia personelu budowy i podwykonawców z narzędzi BIM/CDE. Udział w spotkaniach koordynacyjnych z Inwestorem w zakresie BIM i raportowanie postępu realizacji wymagań BIM. Przekazywanie doświadczeń z kontraktów do Centrum Kompetencji AECO (lessons learned, propozycje usprawnień standardów). Wymagania Wykształcenie wyższe techniczne: budownictwo, architektura, inżynieria środowiska lub pokrewne. Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w budownictwie, w tym min. 1–2 lata pracy z BIM na etapie realizacji (budowa lub biuro). Doświadczenie na budowie na stanowisku inżynierskim (inżynier budowy, kierownik robót, koordynator) - mocno preferowane. Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi do przeglądu i koordynacji modeli (np. Navisworks, Solibri, BIMcollab) oraz podstaw modelowania (Revit lub analogiczne). Doświadczenie z platformą CDE (np. Autodesk Construction Cloud, Dalux, Trimble Connect). Znajomość otwartych standardów (IFC, BCF) oraz ISO 19650. Umiejętność czytania dokumentacji wielobranżowej i rozumienie procesu budowlanego. Gotowość do pracy głównie na budowach. Prawo jazdy kat. B. Język angielski na poziomie umożliwiającym pracę z dokumentacją. Umiejętność „tłumaczenia” BIM na język budowy, z praktycznymi korzyściami zamiast teorii. Asertywność wobec podwykonawców i projektantów przy egzekwowaniu wymagań Mile widziane Doświadczenie z 4D (Synchro, Navisworks) i przedmiarami z modelu. Praca z chmurami punktów, skanowaniem laserowym lub dronami przy kontroli postępu. Doświadczenie w tworzeniu modeli powykonawczych. Studia podyplomowe lub certyfikaty BIM. Podstawy automatyzacji (Dynamo, Power BI, skrypty). Oferujemy Stabilne zatrudnienie w strukturach firmy – zapewniamy ciągłość projektów i możliwość długofalowego rozwoju w ramach organizacji, będącej liderem w zakresie generalnego wykonawstwa obiektów logistycznych, przemysłowych i technologicznych w Polsce. Udział w realizacji dużych i prestiżowych projektów – zrealizowaliśmy ponad 850 inwestycji o łącznej powierzchni ponad 6 mln m². Realną przestrzeń do rozwoju kompetencji i własnej ścieżki zawodowej – oferujemy możliwości awansu w strukturach firmy oraz wsparcie w podnoszeniu kompetencji zawodowych (szkolenia techniczne, managerskie i inne). Nowoczesne narzędzia pracy i technologie (BIM, cyfryzacja procesów, rozwiązania oparte na AI) – tworzymy środowisko pracy i rozwoju, które wyznacza standardy nowoczesnego budownictwa. Pracę w oparciu o wysokie standardy jakości i bezpieczeństwa – ISO 9001, 14001, 45001 oraz zasady etyki i compliance. Troskę o zdrowie i dobre samopoczucie Twoje i Twoich bliskich – oferujemy pakiety prywatnej opieki medycznej, ubezpieczenie na życie, platformę wsparcia psychologicznego, dofinansowanie wypoczynku, programy i inicjatywy sportowe.

items.desc: Would you like to join a global, growing company that innovates for a more sustainable tomorrow? UPM could be the team for you. Besides enabling both businesses and consumers make more sustainable choices, we strive to create a positive UPM experience for all our employees around the world. The position focuses on analytics and is process-oriented, with emphasis on delivering high-quality outputs with limited support from senior colleagues. Within this scope, the role will assist the Account team in project coordination, PMO operations, and portfolio management. Basic real estate experience a plus. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work independently, manage multiple deadlines, and follow structured reporting processes. Familiarity with reporting and project management tools such as AdaptiveWork, Smartsheet, SharePoint, Power BI, Excel, or similar platforms is a plus. Interest in reporting automation, process improvement, and data management. Inclusive & Supportive Culture: Strong commitment to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion across multiple employee resource groups and initiatives. Global Perspective: 60 nationalities and 40 languages represented, offering rich cultural exchange and collaboration opportunities. items.title: DevOps Engineer
items.card: The Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in Warsaw (hybrid/remote) and help manage, design, and scale the AWS-based infrastructure supporting Batmaid and PFA. You will build automations and tooling that make our engineering teams more effective, drive improvements across our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across all environments.
items.desc: About Us We are on a mission to make looking after your home effortless, and to clean up an industry that has too often left its workforce in the shadows. Batgroup is the company behind Batmaid , our English-speaking brand, and PFA / Putzfrau.ch , our German-speaking brand: a portfolio spanning direct cleaning, recruitment, and fiduciary services that has made us Switzerland's number one home cleaning company, with more than 4,000 cleaning professionals and a growing footprint across Europe. Our purpose goes beyond business. It is about people. Every cleaner who works with us deserves declared, insured, and properly protected employment, on permanent contracts governed by the sector's Collective Bargaining Agreement, with real access to pensions, sickness cover, and paid leave. By taking on the multi-billion-franc cleaning black market, we level the playing field, bring fairness to a sector that badly needs it, and give customers professionals they can genuinely trust in their homes. That is our fight, and it is why we rally behind #fightblackmarket. Technology is how we win it. We build the platforms, apps, and services that let thousands of customers book a trusted cleaning in a few clicks, and that let thousands of cleaners work with dignity and security. That is where you come in. The Role We are looking for a skilled DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team in Warsaw (hybrid/remote) and help manage, design, and scale the AWS-based infrastructure supporting Batmaid and PFA. You will build automations and tooling that make our engineering teams more effective, drive improvements across our CI/CD pipelines, and ensure high availability, security, and performance across all environments. AI-assisted development is simply part of how we work. The team uses modern AI tooling, including a company-provided Claude Code subscription, to move faster through routine tasks, freeing up time and attention for what actually matters: solid architecture, sound problem-solving, and reliable infrastructure. We are pragmatic about it: we reach for these tools where they genuinely add value, and we keep human judgement firmly in charge. What you will do Maintain and manage our AWS-based infrastructure. Design, maintain, and extend robust CI/CD pipelines. Build automations and tooling that make engineering teams more productive. Monitor and optimize the performance, availability, and security of our environments. Drive continuous improvements across our cloud security posture, deployment processes, and system scalability. The Embedded Competence Center at NTT DATA Romania brings together experts in embedded systems, firmware development, and hardware–software integration, delivering robust and high-performance solutions for complex, safety-critical environments. With strong expertise in C/C++, AUTOSAR, real-time operating systems, and communication protocols, we design scalable embedded architectures, integrate software seamlessly with hardware, and ensure compliance with industry standards. Across the industries we support — from Automotive and Industrial Automation to Smart Devices and IoT — we transform reliable embedded technology into a foundation for innovative, dependable products. As a System Integration Test Engineer , you will be responsible for the integration, testing and validation of complex embedded automotive systems. You will work closely with System Engineering, Software Development and Integration teams , translating system requirements and architecture into effective test scenarios, executing tests on HIL environments and contributing to test automation. The role requires previous hands-on experience in embedded systems testing, system integration or automotive validation , ideally with dSPACE, IBM Rhapsody and automotive communication protocols . Location: Craiova, Romania – minimum 80% on-site (requiered) What you'll be doing Analyze and understand system requirements, system architecture and functional models, including models defined in IBM Rhapsody. Derive test specifications, test scenarios and test cases based on system requirements and architecture. Develop and maintain automated test cases using dSPACE AutomationDesk. Execute and monitor tests using dSPACE AutomationDesk / ControlDesk and HIL environments. Perform automated, manual and exploratory testing, including basic vehicle-level checks such as smoke tests. Analyze system behavior and identify appropriate test boundaries, interfaces and coverage. Analyze test results, investigate deviations and report defects using ALM and requirements management tools such as DOORS NextGen and EWM. Set up, configure and maintain HIL test environments, including HW/SW simulations. Connect and configure ECUs, restbus simulations, measurement devices and test benches. Perform measurements and collect technical evidence using oscilloscopes, signal traces, logs and other instrumentation. Support root-cause analysis by correlating test results, communication signals and system behavior. Collaborate within Agile development teams, providing testing input during sprint planning, reviews and other development activities. Work closely with internal and external project teams to ensure efficient integration and high-quality delivery. Provide on-site testing and integration support when required. Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, test coverage and automation. What you'll bring along Previous professional experience in System Testing, System Integration, Verification & Validation or Embedded Software Testing, preferably within the automotive industry. Good understanding of electronics, embedded systems and automotive ECUs. Hands-on experience with HIL testing and system-level validation. Experience with dSPACE AutomationDesk and/or ControlDesk is highly desirable. Experience with IBM Rhapsody, system modeling and interpretation of system architecture diagrams is considered a strong advantage. Good understanding of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, Automotive Ethernet and/or FlexRay. Experience with requirements management and ALM tools, preferably DOORS NextGen and EWM. Ability to understand system requirements and translate them into structured and traceable test cases. Experience working in Agile development environments. ISTQB certification is considered an advantage. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, with a structured approach to identifying and investigating system-level issues. Proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with an interest in continuously improving testing processes and automation. Good communication and collaboration skills. Good command of English. El principal objetivo del grupo de los más de 1.000 auditores de EY en España es el de aportar valor basándose en la visión de la auditoría como herramienta de gestión para la Dirección, identificando las necesidades y objetivos de los clientes, así como los consiguientes riesgos financieros, además de los factores críticos de éxito para la empresa. Realizarás, entre otras, las siguientes funciones : Entender el entorno de TI de las compañías que auditamos : Identificar la plataforma tecnológica (entornos, aplicaciones, bases de datos…) relacionada con los estados financieros de las empresas mediante entrevistas con los diferentes responsables del departamento de tecnología y análisis de la documentación proporcionada. Con capacidad para gestionar equipos. Buscamos perfiles con una clara orientación al cliente, acostumbrado a la gestión de proyectos, con inquietudes tecnológicas y con ganas de aportar valor a nuestro equipo. Valorables certificaciones CISA (Certified Information Systems Auditor), CISM (Certified Information Security Management) y otras certificaciones similares. Conocimientos de estándares y normas como COBIT, COSO, NIST, ISO 27001, ISO 22301 ¿Qué valor añadido te podemos aportar? Un gran ambiente de trabajo, tanto dentro como fuera de la oficina. Oportunidades internacionales y red de contactos global. Formación continua: acceso a trainings y certificaciones. Salario competitivo y plan de remuneración flexible. Posibilidad de teletrabajo, desde, dónde y cómo quieras. Posibilidad de implicarte en proyectos de voluntariado profesional. items.desc: Job Description: An opportunity for an MRO Network Quality Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defense and Space , Getafe (Madrid). The selected candidate will join the Quality Inspection Team . The jobholder is responsible, in the framework of MRO Network (Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul) to perform Quality activities associated to the MRO process wherever the Network performs maintenance activities. RESPONSIBILITIES: Support the operation of MRO Network Working Parties (WP): Aircraft hand-over from the customer, if necessary In situ verification of work performed on aircraft, jointly with Quality inspectors and mechanics as required. Follow-up of the MRO activity jointly with MRO Network personnel, gathering the necessary documentation (i.e. component CoCs, Form 1, etc.) ensuring it is complete and correct in accordance to requirements. Preparation of the Aircraft delivery documentation and hand-back of the aircraft to the customer after the MRO activities (including Maintenance Report, Certificates of Conformity, Peram F1 or EASA F1). Ensure the right management of maintenance records and Quality KPIs measurement and improvement. Contribute to maintain MRO Network Maintenance approval through the integrity of the Quality System in front of Official regulations/requirements (Part 145, Peram 145). Ensure compliance with maintenance normative/regulation. Represent the Quality function with customer quality representative. Represent the Quality function for external audits from Customer or Authorities. SKILLS: Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline. - Experience: More than 3 years of experience in aircraft maintenance. Languages: High level of English. Availability to travel. (travel approx. 180 days per year around the world) WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits: Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year. Attractive salary. Hybrid model of working when possible. Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location. Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives. Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment. Option to access special rates in products & benefits. This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth. Company: Airbus Defence and Space SAU Employment Type: Permanent - Experience Level: Professional Job Family: Quality Inspection <JF-QU-QC> By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief. Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Job Description Job Ref ID: JR0086646 YOUR MISSION Business teams at Glovo need data they can trust to make decisions — and that trust doesn't happen by accident. As part of the Marketplace Experience (MX) Data team, your mission over the next 12–18 months is to help build it: solid SQL foundations, well-documented data models, and validated outputs, while growing into someone who can own a data product from start to finish. THE JOURNEY Support the development of reliable datasets, data models and analytical assets used by business and technical teams. Work with senior Analytics Engineers to translate business requirements into simple, well-defined data solutions. Write, test and maintain SQL transformations with a strong focus on quality, readability and documentation. Validate data outputs and ensure they are accurate, understandable and fit for purpose. Use AI tools where relevant to support your day-to-day work, always validating outputs before relying on them. Contribute to internal knowledge bases, documentation and best practices that help teams use data effectively. Collaborate with Business stakeholders, Product Managers and other Data teams to understand pain points and turn them into better data products. Grow into an autonomous Analytics Engineer capable of owning small data products end to end. WHAT YOU WILL BRING TO THE RIDE Must haves: 1–2 years of hands-on experience in Analytics Engineering, Data Analytics, BI, Data Engineering or a similar technical data role. Strong SQL foundations, with the ability to independently write, debug and optimise analytical queries. Solid understanding of data modelling fundamentals (joins, granularity, fact/dimension tables, entities, data quality, downstream consumption). Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Gemini or similar), understanding where they add value, where they fail, and how to validate their outputs. Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to break down ambiguous problems into clear steps. Fluent English, with the ability to explain technical topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Nice to haves: Proficiency in Python or another programming language, and hands-on experience with Git and collaborative engineering practices. Exposure to modern data stack tools (BigQuery, dbt, Looker) and understanding of APIs, data pipelines or workflow automation concepts. Interest in AI-enabled data products, responsible AI, data governance or the evolution of Analytics Engineering. Relevant internship, bootcamp, academic or personal project, or previous experience in a fast-paced product/tech/marketplace environment. items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Development Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48364 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Tasks You design and develop components of the Observability Suite as sovereign cloud services, focusing on the integration of the Grafana LGTM stack (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir). You extend our system architecture by identifying and implementing relevant open-source projects (e.g., OpenTelemetry, Prometheus) to capture logs, metrics, and traces. You develop Kubernetes operators to automate the life cycle of cloud services You develop and maintain REST APIs that allow our customers to programmatically access and control their monitoring and alerting lifecycles. You take ownership in an agile "You Build It - You Run It" environment, acting as a bridge between development and SRE. You conduct complex root cause analyses using logs, tracing and metrics - eat your own dogfood - identifying bottlenecks & issues and implementing sustainable fixes. Your Profile You have deep enthusiasm for Software Engineering, Cloud-Native Observability and SRE You actively own the entire software development lifecycle, go and k8s being your bread and butter - k8s operators preferably also a part of your arsenal You are experienced with - or eager to master - the Grafana ecosystem You understand the observability needs in today's cloud environment services and know how to instrument them effectively. You enjoy discovering new technologies (e.g. OpenTelemetry) and are excited about sharing your knowledge with the community and the team. You don't just look at dashboards; you understand the underlying data structures and how to optimize them for high-cardinality environments.

items.desc: ABOUT THE JOB The “Infrastructure” Domain is part of the Corporate & Institutional Banking Information Technology & Operations (CIB ITO) of BNP Paribas, it is in charge to manage a key part of the infrastructure such the core of the servers, databases, storage, backup, middleware, citrix farms, and hypervisor for virtual infrastructure. Within this domain, Middleware WEB administration has a relevant role to contribute to keeping the high availability environments performant and running to ensure WEB applications are always available. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES This position is focus on the management of WEB products for all CIB countries offering assistance to all regions as part of Follow the Sun support model. Due to large number of products to manage and the high number of servers where they are deployed worldwide, to be able to build and manage automations is a key point. Vulnerability and obsolescence remediation, proactive improvements and action plan for incidents are part of the day to day of this position. To work following ITIL methodology is part of the daily basis in this and the rest of IT areas. PROFILE & SKILLS Requirements: Hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science (preferable). Possess 3-5 years of expertise in WEB technologies such as Apache, Tomcat, WAS, or Weblogic. Demonstrate experience working in high availability environments. Show advanced user skills in Linux environments. Communicate fluently in English (B2/C) (Mandatory). ITIL Foundation certificate (desirable). French language skills (highly valued). Skills: Apply scripting capabilities for automation tasks. Work collaboratively within a self-managed, team-oriented environment. Maintain a customer service-oriented mindset. Deliver strategic priorities under strict timelines. Demonstrate an analytical mindset and initiative. WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS? We are BNP Paribas, a leading European bank with a global reach. Operating in 65 countries with over 178,000 professionals, we maintain leadership positions in Corporate & Institutional Banking and International Financial Services. We support our clients through financing, investment, and savings solutions to help them achieve their goals. Our Spain IT Production organization consists of CIB ITO & ITG IT Platforms. We provide IT Production services to clients in EMEA, ensuring a secure, performant, and reliable digital market evolution. In Spain, our platform of over 400 experts provides full-stack support services to ensure efficient and standardized production. OUR PERKS Training programs and career plans. Internal mobility opportunities, nationally and internationally. Diversity and Inclusion Committee (PRIDE, We Generations, and MixCity). Corporate volunteering program (1 Million Hours 2 Help). Flexible compensation plan. Hybrid telecommuting model (50%). 32 vacation days. Diversity, equality and inclusion BNP Paribas Ready to make a difference? APPLY NOW! Next steps: How does our recruitment process work? We will assess the knowledge and experience highlighted in your CV to validate your fit for the role. The Human Resources team will contact you to confirm key details about the position. After this initial contact, interviews will be conducted with the relevant business area. We will get in touch with you to communicate the final decision of the process. Explore more opportunities at BNP Paribas Careers!

items.desc: YoBrands, part of The Rank Group, is a leading online gaming operator in the Spanish & Portuguese markets with an expanding online and offline portfolio focused on bingo, casino and sports betting with 4 leading brands: Enracha, YoCasino, YoBingo and YoSports Our goals are to provide entertainment and community to our customers with our websites and apps so that they can access our products from their mobile phones, tablets while communicating with one another. We offer our own bingo and slots software and more than 2000 games from the best game providers. We also offer live shows such as El Show De YoBingo and YoSports TV! With offices based in Barcelona, Ceuta & Malta we always strive to bring joy and security to our customers. Additionally, we will be launching soon in other regulated markets! The Digital Graphic Designer will be responsible for analysing and improving YoBrands’ existing offsite acquisition-focused channels and comms as well as for designing new ones on demand. This role will also be responsible for creating inspiring and captivating visuals... for on- and offsite promotional campaigns, CRM, social media, programmatic, affiliates and other channels for our brands for the Spanish and upcoming Portuguese market. Main Accountabilities & Responsibilities: As a Digital Graphic Designer, you should: Participate in meetings and stand-ups reporting changes and progress. Act as a guardian of the brands and ensure consistent design quality. Collaborate with product, marketing, CRM, TECH and other teams to deliver brand-consistent Customer Journeys through the designs you provide. Prioritize workload according to business goals and ensure deadlines are met. Work with the Commercial team on promotional concepts and produce high-quality designs. Design, maintain and optimize our brands’ acquisition channels such as Social Media, Landing Pages, Blogs, and Newsletters. Develop all types of graphic content (in multiple formats) across all channels and brands: Graphic support with the promotional visuals such as banners, ads, landing page assets, internal marketing, video, and social media content. Collaborate in the creation and optimization of Brand Manuals & Guidelines. Collaborate in the improvement and animation of our brand mascot (Blender & AI) Relevant characteristics: Proven digital design experience. Excellent knowledge of market leading design programs. 3D design skills (will be an asset). Task management skills. Self-managed working on their own. Desire to learn and to propose new ideas. Curiosity. What’s needed for success – Experience & Qualifications: Technical skills and hands on experience on as many of the following: Experience creating and optimizing images with AI tools (e.g., Magnific, Firefly, Adobe AI tools), applying them to marketing and brand campaigns. Solid knowledge of task tracking and project management tools (e.g., Jira, Trello, Asana) Adobe CC (Photoshop, Illustrator, etc.) Knowledge of Premiere or After Effects or other animation tools WordPress and/or other CMS knowledge Basic HTML/CSS knowledge Ability to multitask and to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Fluent in Spanish with good English knowledge Knowledge of Portuguese (oral and written) will be considered a strong asset for supporting our upcoming market expansion. Having some experience working with: Experience working in cross-functional teams Familiarity with Figma (or similar collaborative design tools) Personal Qualities: High standards of quality, pixel-perfect attention to detail, and a focus on continuous improvement. Problem solver, logical thinker and able to work autonomously. Team player and good stakeholder-management abilities. Demonstrates sense of passion and pride about own work and teamwork. Positive attitude and adapts well to change. Inspires passion and excitement around shared goals, promoting an environment of achievement. Willingness to learn new technologies and ways of working. Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changes with a proactive attitude. What will you get in return? As a Digital Graphic Designer with us, you will benefit from: Challenging design projects: the opportunity to tackle complex briefs across diverse products and campaigns that push your skills and expand your portfolio. From digital campaigns to animation and 3D design, with room to experiment and bring bold ideas to life. Collaboration with cross-functional teams: work closely with Marketing, CRM, Product and other teams, broadening your skills and impact. Process improvement impact: play a key role in streamlining workflows and elevating design standards across multiple brands. Professional growth: develop new skills, explore emerging tools and gain visibility in a fast-paced, international environment. Join us to unlock benefits and opportunities that will boost your career journey in a vibrant, inclusive and fulfilling work environment – so you can #BeYourself Wellbeing@Rank is important... items.desc: Lund University was founded in 1666 and is repeatedly ranked among the world’s top universities. The University has around 46 000 students and 8 500 staff based in Lund, Helsingborg and Malmö. We are united in our efforts to understand, explain and improve our world and the human condition. Lund University welcomes applicants with diverse backgrounds and experiences. We regard equality, equal opportunities and diversity as a strength and an asset. MAX IV is looking for a RF Technician to join the RF Group. Your team The RF Group at MAX IV is responsible for the operation, maintenance and development of several high-power radio-frequency systems that are essential for the MAX IV accelerators. The systems include pulsed S-band RF systems as well as continuous-wave VHF/UHF systems, together with associated high-voltage modulators, diagnostics, instrumentation and control systems. Would you like to work hands-on with advanced accelerator technology at one of the brightest light sources in the world? About the role You will work with the operation, maintenance, repair and installation of RF, electronic and high-voltage equipment used throughout the MAX IV accelerator facility. The position has a strong practical focus and involves troubleshooting, repairing, modifying and maintaining specialised technical equipment. The work includes electronics, electrical systems, cabling and, where needed, basic mechanical fabrication and modification of parts. You will work closely with RF engineers and other technical staff to ensure high reliability and availability of the accelerator RF systems. MAX IV is preparing for MAX 4U, a major upgrade of the 3 GeV storage ring. As part of the RF Group, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the technical work associated with this upgrade, including installation, modification and commissioning of RF-related equipment. Your main work tasks will be Maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of RF, electronic and high-voltage equipment. Maintenance and repair of high-voltage modulators. Electrical and electronic assembly work. Precision soldering and repair of electronic equipment and circuit boards. Manufacturing, installation and repair of cables and cable assemblies. Installation and modification of RF equipment, electronics and associated infrastructure. Preventive maintenance and inspection of technical systems. Documentation of maintenance, repairs and technical modifications. Participation in fault finding and corrective maintenance during accelerator operation. Collaboration with RF engineers in system upgrades, improvements and new installations. Participate in technical installations, modifications and commissioning activities related to future accelerator upgrades, including MAX 4U. To be successful in this role you need to have the following qualifications Relevant technical education in electronics, electrical engineering, RF technology or a related technical field, or equivalent professional experience. Good practical skills in electronics and electrical work. Experience with soldering and assembly of electronic equipment. Ability to read and understand electrical schematics and technical documentation. Experience in troubleshooting and repairing electrical or electronic equipment. A structured and safety-conscious way of working. Good command of spoken and written English. Good communication and teamwork skills. Experience with high-voltage equipment. Experience with high-power electronics. Experience with cable manufacturing, connectors and RF cabling. Experience in the fields below is considered a merit RF systems or RF equipment. Pulsed power systems or modulators. Industrial electronics. Electrical cabinets and installations. Measurement equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters and signal generators. Mechanical workshop skills, such as using a milling machine, drill press and other common workshop tools. Basic mechanical fabrication, modification and fitting of components. Maintenance of complex scientific, industrial or accelerator equipment. Experience from accelerator facilities or synchrotron light sources is an advantage, but not a requirement. About you We are looking for someone who enjoys practical technical work and takes pride in solving problems and keeping complex equipment operational. You are systematic, thorough and safety-conscious, and you are comfortable working both independently and together with engineers and technicians. You are curious and willing to learn new systems and technologies, and you enjoy turning technical problems into practical solutions. What we offer When you join our MAX IV team, you step into a world of cutting-edge science. We make the invisible visible by supporting scientists from all over the world and enabling scientific results for the benefit of society. items.desc: De flesta organisationer har redan startat sina AI-piloter. Frågan är inte längre om de ska investera, utan var, och hur de ser till att värdet faktiskt realiseras. Det är där vi arbetar. Om Influence Influence är ett managementkonsultbolag som kombinerar strategi med förmågan att genomföra den. Vi mäter kvaliteten på en strategi i vad som händer sedan. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder, med genuin omtanke och modet att säga det som behöver sägas, så att varje uppdrag lämnar efter sig en skarpare organisation och inte ett beroende av oss. Vi är en del av Newground, en allians av specialistbolag under ett gemensamt tak. Det ger oss djup inom AI, data och teknik när vi behöver det, och kollektiv intelligens som grund för allt vi gör. Om rollen Vi är varken ett utbildningsteam för AI eller en systemintegratör. Vi hjälper ledningsgrupper att fatta bättre beslut: var de ska satsa, vad de ska låta bli, hur de går från experiment till skala och hur strategi, organisation och arbetssätt måste förändras för att värdet ska bli verkligt. Du arbetar direkt med kundernas seniora beslutsfattare. Du prioriterar möjligheter, bedömer om organisationen faktiskt kan realisera dem, formar transformationsroadmaps, designar operating models och styrning, och leder kunder från enskilda initiativ till effekt i hela verksamheten. Du är bryggan mellan affärsledning och tekniska specialister. Du förstår AI och teknik tillräckligt väl för att ifrågasätta antaganden, leverantörslöften och orealistiska use cases, men din styrka ligger i affärsmässigt omdöme och förändring. Du är rösten i rummet som utmanar önsketänkande, och du gör det på ett sätt som bygger förtroende. Du bygger också affär. Att utveckla kundrelationer, forma nya uppdrag och driva vårt erbjudande inom Tech-Driven Reinvention framåt är en central del av rollen. Vem du är 5–10 års erfarenhet från management consulting eller en strategisk transformationsroll Du förstår AI, data och teknik ur ett affärsperspektiv och är trygg i att utmana tekniska antaganden utan att själv äga leveransen Du har drivit verklig förändring, inte bara strategi på papper: nya operating models, arbetssätt, governance eller förmågebyggande Du är van vid komplexa organisationer och har trovärdighet hos ledningsgrupper Du kan skilja det som är strategiskt attraktivt från det en organisation faktiskt kan genomföra Du balanserar tydlig riktning uppifrån med experimenterande och ägarskap nära verksamheten Du skapar samsyn mellan affär och teknik, och du har kommersiellt driv Du är flytande i svenska och engelska Erfarenhet av AI- eller data governance, portföljstyrning, digital- eller mjukvarustrategi eller storskalig transformation är meriterande. Varför Influence Du får vara med och bygga vårt erbjudande inom Tech-Driven Reinvention, inte bara leverera det. Du arbetar med några av de mest avgörande frågorna ledningsgrupper står inför just nu, med stora och medelstora bolag inom retail, industri och tjänstesektorn, och med Newgrounds specialister vid din sida. Och du gör det i en kultur som folk stannar för. Vi lever efter det vi säger: great minds, genuine hearts, sustainable results. Vi går igenom ansökningar löpande. Välkommen med din. Influence. For a wiser tomorrow.
