items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a motivated and dynamic Research Nurse to support the delivery of high‑quality clinical research and trials across Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust. As a Research Nurse, you will play a vital role in supporting the development and delivery of both commercial and academic research studies across a range of specialities. Working with strong leadership skills, you will collaborate closely with colleagues within the Research Team and the Medical and Surgical Division to build and sustain a diverse portfolio of clinical trials and research studies. You will actively facilitate the implementation of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) , ensuring that all research activity across the division consistently meets these standards. As a research‑active organisation, LTHTR is committed to giving patients access to innovative treatments, improving clinical outcomes, and supporting colleagues to develop their research delivery skills. Ensure the safe planning, delivery and evaluation of care for patients participating in clinical trials and research studies Act as a clinical expert in research delivery, ensuring patient safety is paramount at all times Communicate effectively and confidently with multidisciplinary teams , sponsors, external partners and patients Demonstrate excellent organisational skills , attention to detail and accurate data management Uphold Good Clinical Practice (GCP) principles across all research activity Support the development of a strong research culture within the Trust Lancashire Teaching Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (LTHTr) is one of the largest and busiest acute Trusts in the North West, providing high‑quality care to the communities of Lancashire and South Cumbria. We are proud of our strong research culture and our ambition to become a recognised Centre of Excellence, particularly in women’s health and maternity research. As part of our Research & Innovation (R&I) team, you will join a supportive and dynamic department committed to building research capacity, improving patient outcomes, and reducing health inequalities. We work closely with regional partners, national research networks, and academic institutions, including Tommy’s Research Centre and local universities, to ensure our patients have access to cutting‑edge studies and innovative care pathways. LTHTr is dedicated to supporting the development of our staff. You will have access to training, mentorship, and opportunities to expand your clinical and academic skills. Our Trust values compassion, teamwork, and continuous improvement, and we foster an environment where staff feel empowered, respected, and encouraged to contribute to meaningful change. Joining us means becoming part of an organisation that is passionate about making a real difference—both to the patients we serve and to the future of women’s health research across our region. The post holder will support the Research and Innovation department to provide high‑quality, compassionate and patient‑focused care for people taking part in research within the Lancashire Clinical Research Facility and across clinical services. They will make sure care is planned, delivered and reviewed in line with Trust values, national standards, Good Clinical Practice and evidence‑based guidance. The role involves leading and coordinating safe research care, reducing risks, keeping clear and accurate records, and ensuring patients are treated with dignity, involved in decisions and kept safe. The post holder will act as a positive role model, supervising and supporting staff and students, helping with recruitment, training, appraisals and performance management, and promoting a respectful and inclusive working culture. They will also help manage the clinical environment and resources, support governance activities such as audits, incidents and complaints, develop and follow Standard Operating Procedures, promote equality, health education and wellbeing, and support the set‑up and delivery of commercial and academic clinical trials alongside Principal Investigators and multidisciplinary teams, ensuring all research meets regulatory requirements and high quality standards.

This 12-month fixed-term post offers a fully funded training year with Derby University (hybrid learning), combining academic study with practical experience to develop the skills and knowledge required to support children and young people experiencing mild to moderate mental health difficulties. Working as part of a supportive, multidisciplinary team, you will play an important role in delivering evidence-based interventions within educational settings, helping to improve emotional wellbeing and mental health outcomes for children and young people. You will receive comprehensive training, regular clinical supervision, and dedicated support throughout your development journey. This is an excellent opportunity for individuals who are passionate about improving the mental health of children and young people, keen to work collaboratively with schools and families, and committed to developing a rewarding career within NHS mental health services. If you have any questions about the course or the role itself, please contact Gina Legg gina.legg@nhs.net You will play a vital role in promoting mental health awareness and providing support to students within your designated educational settings. You will work closely with teachers, parents, and healthcare professionals to deliver targeted interventions. You will collaborate with education staff to create a supportive environment for all students through the delivery of Whole School Approach activities promoting positive mental health. Collaborate with Staff: Work alongside teachers and school staff to identify students in need of mental health support and develop tailored intervention plans through our consultation model. Promote Well-being: Organise and participate in school-wide mental health initiatives and delivery of Whole School Approach activities such as assemblies, workshops, and drop-ins. Create and distribute resources on mental health topics for students, parents, and staff. Professional Development: Completion of fully funded Postgraduate Diploma to become an accredited Education Mental Health Practitioner (University TBC). Lincolnshire Partnership NHS Foundation Trust provides mental health services and a number of learning disability, autism and social care services in the county of Lincolnshire. Employing around 2,900 staff, and serving a population of over 768,400, our people lie at the heart of everything we do. You could be part of a Trust rated by staff as one of the best mental health and learning disability trusts in England. We firmly believe the key to high quality care is a contented workforce. This is reflected in our Care Quality Commission rating of ‘outstanding’ for well-led and ‘good’ overall. In the most recent National NHS Staff Survey, our staff rated us as the number one trust nationally for staff morale and one of the top scoring NHS Trusts in the Midlands for being compassionate and inclusive. We’re really proud of this! We offer options for flexible working and provide a wide range of training and promotion opportunities in all professions. We support and celebrate diversity, have active staff networks groups and are always looking at what more we can do to support our staff. Whether you’re taking the first exciting steps in your career, itching for a new challenge or searching for a better place to raise a family, Lincolnshire has a range of rewarding health and social care careers in a county that’s friendly, fascinating, affordable and brimming with everything you need to live a happy life . Visit beinlincolnshire.com to find out more . Please refer to Job Description and Person Specification for full details of duties. Helping children and young people within these settings who present with more severe problems to rapidly access more specialist services. Supporting and facilitating staff in education settings to identify and where appropriate manage issues related to mental health and wellbeing. Working with and within education environments to afford better access to specialist mental health services. And to use the acquired skills, knowledge and abilities to deliver a service based within education settings that builds on and reinforces but does not replace those initiatives that already exist within these environments.

items.desc: We are pleased to be able to offer an exciting opportunity to join the Primary Care and Partnerships team within the Lewes Neighbourhood Mental Health Team (NMHT) as a Mental Health Practitioner (MHP) This role will be part of a team of Mental Health Practitioners working into the newly formed NMHT's. You will be part of the core team working alongside the Specialist Adult Service, Specialist Older Adult Service and VCSE Partners. You will be closely aligned and work with colleagues within GP practices as well as Health in Mind (NHS Talking Therapies- NHS TT). The MHP role will provide a critical function in triaging referrals into the service as well as those in NHS TT, providing timely and consistent assessments, brief interventions and onward referral as required. Liaison with key stakeholders and third sector organisations also forms part of this role. This post offers the Trust's £2,000 Golden Hello or Relocation Incentive for Band 6 Nurses & Practitioners, (pro rata and subject to terms and conditions; please see attached Protocol Document for full details). It is essential that you are a registered Mental Health Professional (Mental Health Nurse, Social Worker or Occupational Therapist). Your role will include carrying out assessments, brief interventions, triage, onward referrals to Secondary or Urgent Care Services (if this is needed) and signposting advice. The successful applicant should have excellent clinical skills in assessment, risk assessment and as well as strong communication skills. You will be working closely with a range of professional groups, including Mental Health Practitioners based within GP surgeries, NMHT colleagues, partner organisations, VCSE providers, and other aligned services within the Neighbourhood as well as NHS Talking Therapies Teams. items.desc: About us At Xelix, we work with some of the world’s largest companies to automate and strengthen their financial controls. Our AI solutions redefine how Accounts Payable teams operate – moving from manual processes to automated, intelligent workflows. Xelix is a fast-paced scale-up – things move fast and expectations are high. We raised our Series B with Insight Partners in June 2025 and are expanding aggressively. We have a team of over 150 talented people pulling together to achieve our goals. Everyone is trusted to take ownership, move fast and have a meaningful impact. We prioritise personal and professional growth, keep things fun, and love to celebrate a milestone together. In this role you’ll grow, be challenged and help shape the future of Xelix. If you’re excited about building something special with us, we’d love to hear from you. About the role We’re hiring a Data Engineer to join our growing Platform Team and help shape the data foundations behind our products. As our customer base and data volumes grow, you’ll make sure our production data architecture, pipelines and storage remain reliable, scalable and cost-effective. This is a hands-on 1role focused on the systems that power our products, rather than internal BI or building a company-wide data warehouse. You’ll improve data models and database performance, help us choose the right storage and processing tools for each workload, and strengthen data quality and retention practices. Projects could include moving large and non-operational data out of PostgreSQL, improving pipeline orchestration with Prefect, and evolving our search and analytical capabilities with technologies such as OpenSearch and column databases. You’ll bring the experience and judgement to assess our current architecture independently, constructively challenge established practices, identify the most valuable improvements, and take them from proposal through to production. Working closely with product engineers, AI engineers and DevOps, you’ll combine practical delivery with longer-term architectural thinking. Whether you’re an experienced mid-level engineer ready for broader ownership or already operating at senior level, this is an opportunity to take a dedicated data engineering role with a meaningful impact on how Xelix scales. At senior level, you’ll lead data architecture decisions across teams and own the roadmap for improving our production data systems. What you'll be doing Improve our production data architecture. Build reliable pipelines with tools such as Prefect. Optimise PostgreSQL performance and data models. Choose the right storage, search and processing tools. Improve data quality and retention practices. Deliver changes alongside product, AI and DevOps teams. Strengthen data access, retention and auditability in partnership with security, compliance and engineering teams. What you’ll bring Professional experience owning the architecture of production data systems in AWS and their improvements. Experience with data access controls, retention and auditability requirements in regulated environments (SOC 1, SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001 or similar). Good judgement on storage and processing trade-offs. Clear communication and a hands-on, collaborative approach. A focus on reliability, data quality and security. Strong SQL, PostgreSQL and data modelling skills. Experience with NoSQL databases (like MongoDB, DocumentDB or DynamoDB) and warehousing solutions (like DuckDB, ClickHouse, Redshift) Solid Python and data pipeline engineering skills. Confidence using AI tools for development, investigation and documentation, with sound judgement about their value and limitations. Our mission is to be a centre of excellence in the provision of high-quality professional support and assistance for people experiencing alcohol or other drug dependency issues. Brynawel is committed to providing high quality, evidence-based recovery interventions and care. We are a learning partnership which promotes staff training, development and competence. Our Clinical Governance committee oversees governance within the organisation. We promote staff training, development and competence. Job purpose: As an Aftercare and Resettlement Coordinator you will utilise your communication, organisational and networking skills to provide support and discharge planning for clients. The post holder should be able to demonstrate a high level of personal and professional accountability, leading in the operational delivery of after care services and taking responsibility for the development of new ideas, initiatives and ways of working within the team. The post holder will be responsible and accountable to the Head of Therapy Place of work: Brynawel Rehab, LLanharry Rd,Llanharan, though travel will be required across Wales as required. Role: Aftercare & Resettlement Coordinator Work as a member of the multidisciplinary team, using highly developed communication and relational skills to interact positively with residents, families, professionals, and community partners in order to support recovery, wellbeing, and successful community reintegration. The role will include: Supporting residents using a strengths-based, trauma-informed, recovery-oriented approach. Delivering and supporting structured workshops, psychoeducational sessions, and recovery-focused interventions in line with Brynawel’s therapeutic programme. Using approaches including motivational interviewing, relational practice, relapse prevention, emotional regulation support, and recovery capital development. Supporting residents to identify their strengths, personal goals, values, interests, and aspirations, and assisting them to create realistic recovery and resettlement plans. Working collaboratively with residents to develop personalised progression plans that support long-term recovery, independence, and quality of life following discharge. Supporting residents to build recovery capital across personal, social, community, and practical domains. Assisting residents to access appropriate services including housing, benefits, debt management, education, training, employment, volunteering, healthcare, wellbeing services, and peer support networks. Creating effective links with community organisations and external providers that can offer meaningful recovery-oriented opportunities and activities. Supporting residents to attend initial appointments, where appropriate, to reduce barriers to engagement and increase confidence in accessing support. Supporting residents during transition periods including discharge planning, graded community exposure, community leave preparation, and aftercare engagement. Working in a neurodiverse-friendly and psychologically informed manner, adapting communication and support approaches to meet individual learning, cognitive, emotional, and sensory needs. Promoting inclusion, dignity, empowerment, and resident participation in all aspects of care and recovery planning. Contributing to the development of a safe, therapeutic, and recovery-focused community environment within Brynawel. Maintaining clear, accurate, and timely records in accordance with organisational policies, professional standards, and confidentiality requirements. Completing all data collection and outcome monitoring requirements within the service, including contributing to recovery outcome reporting and evaluation processes. Using clinical records, resident feedback, and outcome measures to support reflective practice and continuous service improvement. Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, reviews, supervision, reflective practice, and ongoing professional development. Contributing to reports, audits, governance processes, and quality improvement initiatives as required. Ensuring confidentiality is always maintained in line with organisational policy, safeguarding responsibilities, and professional standards. About the Project Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London’s transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039. This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys. Therefore, Indra will become TfL’s strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world’s largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points. Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. The project also envisages, in partnership with TfL, the implementation of new technologies to develop the system, make it more efficient and automate key processes; in short, to jointly create the next generation of the ticketing system for London. This is a key practical role with a particular focus on calf rearing and youngstock, alongside supporting the day-to-day management, health and welfare of the wider dairy herd. Our award-winning farm is a centre of excellence for agricultural education and innovation, supporting a 300-head pedigree Holstein and Ayrshire dairy herd, sheep, and arable enterprises. With cutting-edge facilities including a GEA rapid exit parlour, Lely A5 robotic milkers, and a Lely Vector feeding system, we are proud to be at the forefront of UK land-based education and farming innovation. About the role We are looking for an enthusiastic Dairy Herdsperson to help implement our dairy strategy, taking lead responsibility for calf rearing and maintaining the highest standards of animal husbandry from birth. You will support daily livestock and milk production activities while taking primary ownership of youngstock health, welfare and growth. You will manage calf feeding and rearing in line with agreed protocols, monitor and record calf health and growth, and carry out routine youngstock treatments including disbudding, vaccinations and the administration of veterinary medicines. You will also support wider herd duties including milk production across robotic and manual systems, group allocations, foot bathing and trimming, veterinary treatments, and maintaining dairy infrastructure and equipment. Alongside your practical farm responsibilities, you will work with academic teams and students, demonstrating industry best practice and helping learners develop their practical knowledge and skills. Accurate record keeping is an important part of the role, including monitoring youngstock performance, lameness, fertility and milk quality, and contributing to weekly management discussions. Key responsibilities: Lead calf rearing and youngstock care, taking ownership of calf health, welfare and growth. Manage calf feeding, weighing and health monitoring in line with agreed protocols and youngstock performance measures. Carry out routine youngstock and herd treatments safely, including disbudding, vaccinations, veterinary medicines, foot bathing/trimming and AI activities. Support daily herd management and milk production across robotic and manual milking systems, maintaining excellent hygiene and animal welfare standards. Maintain accurate herd and youngstock records and ensure compliance with legislative requirements, Red Tractor standards, Arla regulations and the Arla Every Calf policy. Support students during practical activities, demonstrating industry best practice and sharing knowledge in a supportive manner. The successful candidate will have: Practical experience in dairy cattle care, including milking and general husbandry. Knowledge of herd health practices such as AI, foot trimming, and administering treatments. An ability to maintain accurate records and follow strict protocols. Strong commitment to animal welfare and compliance with industry standards. Familiarity with modern dairy technology (e.g., robotic milking) and willingness to support student learning. A willingness to engage actively and enthusiastically within the dairy team and to work flexibly as business needs change. A keen interest in working with educational staff and students and sharing skills and knowledge. items.desc: Department: School of Education, Language and Psychology Location: York Salary: £17.98- £20.74 per hour (exclusive of holiday pay) Closing Date: Sunday 01 November 2026 at midnight Interview Date: Wednesday 18 November 2026 Reference: 146-26 Casual (hours will be offered on an ad-hoc basis in accordance with the University's resource requirements) Salary: £17.98- £20.74 per hour (exclusive of holiday pay). Holiday pay is accrued at 12.07% in addition to the hourly rate. Location: York I ntroduction to YSJ university Situated in the heart of the historic city of York, and with the addition of our London Campus, York St John University has a long and proud tradition as a distinguished higher education provider. Our success is founded on the quality of academic teaching and research, our thriving campus environments, our professional and pastoral support, and our values of an inclusive, innovative and ambitious community with a strong sense of belonging. The Project Developed in the 1960s by Matthew Lipman, Philosophy for Children (P4C) provides a structured approach to developing children’s philosophical thinking through dialogue. Its aim is not to make children into philosophers, but to help them think more effectively by developing reasoning, judgement, and critical thinking skills (Lipman, 2017). The rapid integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into daily life presents both opportunities and challenges, including cognitive, ethical, and environmental concerns. As AI becomes more prevalent, critical thinking is essential to enable children to make informed decisions about its use (Shahresani, 2025). The role is linked to a small-scale project seeks to explore how P4C can support the development of critical thinking about AI. Using a mixed-methods approach, it builds on previous research showing that primary-aged children demonstrate creativity and criticality in philosophical dialogue (Elbra-Ramsay, 2025). Data will be collected through pre- and post-project questionnaires and qualitative group interviews. The Role We are seeking a Research Assistant (RA) who can work alongside the researcher to collect and analyse data from the project. The children’s perceptions will be collected through a pre and post questionnaire and a number of group interviews, all of which will take place in a local school. The researcher will be involved in administering and collating the questionnaire data, transcribing interview data and conducting analysis of both. They will need to ensure adherence to methodological and ethical requirements, and maintain project documentation and data. Required skills and experience This is a temporary, research-focused job for someone who has already earned a doctoral degree like a PhD. The successful applicant will also require a DBS. Candidates require experience in quantitative and qualitative research methods. They should have proficiency in standard IT applications (Outlook, OneDrive, Word, Excel), strong communication skills and a high level of attention to detail. Experience of working as an academic research assistant (paid or voluntary) would be an advantage. Previous experience working with children in a school setting is also preferable. The role is a maximum of 30 hours in total (over the period of the project). Additional information For informal enquiries please contact Dr Caroline Elbra-Ramsay at c.elbraramsay@yorksj.ac.uk . The selection process will include a brief interview (you are not required to give a presentation).

items.desc: Hungry for a challenge? That’s good, because at Just Eat Takeaway.com (JET) we have abundant opportunity or, as we say, everything is on the table. We are a leading global online food delivery marketplace. Our tech ecosystem connects millions of active customers with hundreds of thousands of connected partners in countries across the globe. Our mission? To empower every food moment around the world, whether it’s through customer service, coding or couriers. About this role: As a Product Designer within the Customer pillar, you'll be part of a UX team looking after the apps and websites our customers use to order their food globally. You’ll work with an empowered cross-functional team that prioritises using research and data to help understand the problem space, before moving through the design process to deliver engaging and user-friendly solutions. We are specifically looking for an AI-forward designer who leverages modern AI tools as a force multiplier—moving rapidly from concept to functional artifacts to accelerate visual exploration, prototyping, and delivery. We want to discover what our users will love as soon as we can. We like to explore user problems in-depth, speak with users regularly, and embrace modern, AI-assisted workflows to help us understand and meet user needs faster. You'll be part of a passionate UX team of 80+ UX designers, UI designers, product designers, service designers, researchers and writers across 7 countries. These are some of the key ingredients to the role: Focus on key user problems and come up with innovative solutions to those problems. Quickly yet thoroughly create process flows, user journeys, wireframes, visual design mock-ups, and AI-accelerated prototypes as needed to effectively conceptualise and communicate detailed interaction behaviours. Work across the entire product lifecycle from concept to delivery; creating documentation, wireframes, hi- & lo-fi prototypes, and pixel-perfect UI. Confidently integrate AI tools into your day-to-day workflow for rapid visual exploration, generative prototyping, and streamlining production tasks across web and mobile platforms. Collaborate with engineering & product management to build experiences and present your work to stakeholders. Collaborate on research alongside UX researchers, conducting usability studies and utilizing AI tools where appropriate to assist with synthesis and insights. What will you bring to the table? Experience in a product design role delivering UX&D work as part of a multi-disciplinary, cross-functional team. Hands-on experience designing and delivering user experiences across mobile app platforms (iOS/Android) or responsive web. Solid design fundamentals (layout, typography, color), high-fidelity prototyping skills (Figma, Axure, etc.), and familiarity working with established design systems. AI curiosity & practice: Hands-on experience or genuine enthusiasm for integrating AI tools (Figma AI tools, AI-prototyping, AI-assisted research synthesis, etc.) into your design workflow as a force multiplier to iterate faster and work smarter. Familiarity with collaborative design processes, including workshop facilitation, design sprints, and working alongside User Research. Good business awareness with the ability to articulate design decisions clearly to product managers, engineering teams, and stakeholders. A proactive approach to taking ownership, creatively solving problems, and contributing directly to business objectives. At JET, this is on the menu: Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth and about celebrating every aspect of our JETers. Thanks to them we stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else is cooking? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET morsels. Are you ready to take your seat? Apply now!

items.desc: At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business. Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere. Introduction to the Team Expedia Technology teams partner with our Product teams to create innovative products, services, and tools that deliver high-quality experiences for travelers, partners, and employees. A singular technology platform powered by data, machine learning, and AI provides secure, differentiated, and personalised experiences that build loyalty and traveler satisfaction. The Content AI team develops machine learning capabilities that improve the quality, relevance, and usefulness of content-focused products and services across Expedia Group. Working within the Product & Technology Machine Learning Science and Engineering organisation, you will translate research and experimentation into reliable, scalable production outcomes. The team works across content understanding, review intelligence, search relevance, ranking, recommendations, content moderation, image-based AI applications, and Generative AI experiences used by millions of travelers worldwide. In This Role, You Will Develop, evaluate, and improve machine learning models and algorithms for Content AI applications. Design and implement end-to-end machine learning solutions, including data preparation, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and continuous optimisation. Apply statistical analysis, experimentation, and data-driven decision-making to assess model performance and guide technical direction. Collaborate with engineers, product managers, applied scientists, and domain experts to translate ambiguous business problems into scalable ML solutions. Contribute to system design, low-level design, API development, and data modelling for production machine learning systems. Build and operate production solutions using technologies such as Python, TensorFlow, PyTorch, Redis, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud-native infrastructure. Design and deploy scalable batch and real-time ML pipelines supporting customer-facing applications. Develop and operationalise LLM applications, RAG systems, and Generative AI capabilities for content understanding, summarisation, classification, and recommendation use cases. Build evaluation frameworks and observability solutions to monitor model quality, reliability, latency, drift, and business impact. Evaluate trade-offs between model quality, scalability, latency, and infrastructure cost when developing AI-powered products. Partner with engineering teams to deploy and scale machine learning systems in production. Produce clear technical documentation and share expertise through mentorship, design reviews, and technical leadership. Experience And Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field; or Equivalent related professional experience. 5+ years of industry experience developing machine learning solutions in production environments. items.desc: Rothschild & Co Rothschild & Co est un groupe international de services financiers de premier plan, contrôlé par la famille depuis sept générations et au centre des marchés financiers depuis plus de 200 ans. Notre expertise, notre savoir-faire et notre réseau mondial nous permettent de proposer une vision unique qui bénéficie à l’activité et la richesse de nos clients et de nos parties prenantes, en respectant notre planète. Nos équipes de 4 200 spécialistes du conseil financier présents sur le terrain dans plus de 40 pays, apportent une vision internationale unique à travers quatre activités de premier plan – Global Advisory, Wealth Management, Asset Management et Five Arrows. En notre qualité de groupe familial fondé sur les relations humaines, nous attachons une importance particulière au recrutement et au développement de carrière de nos collaborateurs afin qu'ils puissent s'épanouir dans leur parcours professionnel. Contexte Au sein du périmètre Wealth & Asset Management, le Centre d’Expertise Intelligence Artificielle accompagne le développement de solutions innovantes au service des métiers de la banque privée et de la gestion d’actifs. L’équipe intervient sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des cas d’usage IA, depuis l’identification des opportunités jusqu’à l’expérimentation, la validation et le déploiement de solutions concrètes. Dans un environnement international et exigeant, le CoE IA joue un rôle clé pour accélérer l’adoption de l’intelligence artificielle générative, tout en garantissant un cadre d’usage maîtrisé, sécurisé et conforme aux standards d’un groupe financier de premier plan. Vous rejoindrez une équipe pluridisciplinaire travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les métiers, les équipes Data, les équipes plateformes, la sécurité et la conformité afin de transformer les besoins opérationnels en solutions IA utiles, robustes et industrialisables. Rôle En tant que Data Scientist spécialisé en intelligence artificielle générative, vous contribuerez à la conception, à l’évaluation et à l’industrialisation de solutions IA à forte valeur ajoutée pour les métiers du Wealth & Asset Management. Vous interviendrez depuis la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la validation des modèles et prototypes, en lien avec des profils techniques et fonctionnels variés. Missions principales Concevoir, développer et tester des solutions d’intelligence artificielle générative répondant à des besoins métiers concrets : assistants conversationnels, systèmes de recherche augmentée par génération, outils d’extraction documentaire, workflows d’analyse ou dispositifs d’aide à la décision. Préparer, structurer et analyser les données nécessaires aux cas d’usage IA, en veillant à leur qualité, leur pertinence, leur traçabilité et leur conformité. Définir et mettre en œuvre les dispositifs d’évaluation des modèles et des réponses générées : tests fonctionnels, mesure de performance, analyse des risques d’hallucination, robustesse et pertinence métier. Contribuer, en collaboration avec les équipes Data Engineering et plateformes, à l’industrialisation des solutions IA : intégration, automatisation des déploiements, monitoring, observabilité, gestion des environnements et préparation au passage en production. Documenter les modèles, les jeux de données, les choix d’architecture, les limites connues et les résultats d’évaluation afin de garantir la traçabilité et la bonne gouvernance des solutions. Accompagner les utilisateurs métiers dans la qualification des besoins, la formalisation des cas d’usage, l’interprétation des résultats et l’adoption des solutions IA. Participer à la veille technologique, aux expérimentations, aux preuves de concept et à l’identification de nouvelles opportunités d’usage de l’intelligence artificielle générative. Compétences attendues Expérience confirmée en data science, idéalement acquise dans un environnement bancaire, financier, de conseil ou dans un contexte fortement régulé. Solide maîtrise de Python et des principales librairies de data science, machine learning et traitement du langage naturel. Bonne compréhension des modèles de machine learning classiques et des principes statistiques associés : classification, régression, clustering, séries temporelles, NLP. Expérience ou bonne compréhension des architectures d’intelligence artificielle générative : grands modèles de langage, recherche augmentée par génération, prompt engineering, évaluation de prompts, extraction d’informations, orchestration de chaînes ou workflows IA. Connaissance des mécanismes d’optimisation des modèles de langage, tels que finetuning, quantization, distillation ou techniques équivalentes, appréciée pour des usages industriels. Bonne compréhension des fondamentaux du Deep Learning et des systèmes d’IA agentiques. Expérience avec Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry ou des environnements équivalents de développement et d’évaluation de solutions IA. Connaissance d’Azure Document Intelligence, Microsoft …

items.desc: Op deze pagina: Dit ga je doen Dit krijg je Dit bieden we nog meer Dit vragen wij Hier kom je te werken Bijzonderheden Over de functiegroep Stel gerust je vraag Dit ga je doen Bij Justis zet je kunstmatige intelligentie in voor een veiliger Nederland. Met technologie bescherm je mensen en organisaties beter tegen misbruik en fraude. Kennis over AI die nergens standaard is, ontwikkel en verdiep je dagelijks. Bij besluiten die er voor burgers en bedrijven toe doen, telt jouw werk mee. Zo groei je als AI-specialist en vergroot je je impact op de publieke zaak. Als AI Engineer ontwerp en bouw je AI-toepassingen die processen bij Justis slimmer maken. Eerst ontwikkel je kennischatbots en documentanalyse op basis van RAG-architecturen. Daarna groeit je werk door naar de opbouw van een datalake en een MLOps-omgeving. Je bent de eerste AI-engineer in het team. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen bouwt. Je denkt ook mee over keuzes, zet werkwijzen op en signaleert risico's voordat ze een probleem worden. Je werkt samen met dataspecialisten, architecten en productowners. Nieuwe technieken onderzoek je zelf, en de proof-of-concepts die daaruit volgen zet je om in productiewaardige toepassingen. Dat oplossingen voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving rond algoritmen en kunstmatige intelligentie, daar zorg je zelf voor. Niet omdat het moet, maar omdat je begrijpt wat er op het spel staat voor burgers en bedrijven. Overzichtelijke documentatie van je werk zorgt dat andere teams gebruik kunnen maken van jouw modellen en inzichten. Ontwikkelingen in de AI-wereld volg je op de voet. Voortdurend toets je of nieuwe technieken bruikbaar zijn voor Justis. Over de opzet van nieuwe AI-proeftuinen en de keuze van geschikte technologieën denk je actief mee. Je rapporteert hiërarchisch aan het Afdelingshoofd IV-Data. Ontwerpt, bouwt en test AI-modellen voor primaire en ondersteunende processen; Toetst AI-oplossingen op kwaliteit, veiligheid en rechtmatigheid; Werkt samen met architecten, dataspecialisten en productowners aan complexe AI-vraagstukken. Dit krijg je Schaal 12 €4.818 - €7.094 (bruto) Arbeidsovereenkomst voor bepaalde tijd met uitzicht op onbepaalde tijd 1 jaar 36 uur Het salaris is gebaseerd op een werkweek van 36 uur. Dit bieden we nog meer De arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Justis zijn uitstekend. Naast je salaris volgens de CAO Rijk krijg je een Individueel Keuzebudget (IKB), 16,5% van jouw bruto jaarsalaris. Met het IKB maak jij de keuzes die bij jou passen en kun je een deel van je arbeidsvoorwaarden zelf samenstellen. Je kunt er bijvoorbeeld voor kiezen om een deel van je maandinkomen te laten uitbetalen wanneer jij dat wenst. Ook kun je dit budget omzetten in verlof en andersom of besteden aan fiscaal vriendelijke doelen. Justis hecht sterk aan persoonlijke groei en loopbaanontwikkeling en biedt daarvoor tal van mogelijkheden. Dit vragen wij Je voelt je thuis in deze rol als je graag puzzelt op technische vraagstukken zonder pasklaar antwoord. Technische diepgang combineer je met gevoel voor de praktijk. Bij elke technische keuze stel je vanzelf de vraag of een oplossing rechtmatig, uitlegbaar en controleerbaar is. Ingewikkelde AI-concepten leg je helder uit aan collega's zonder technische achtergrond. Nieuwsgierig als je bent naar nieuwe ontwikkelingen, deel je die kennis graag met je team. Met collega's uit andere vakgebieden, zoals architecten en beleidsmedewerkers, leg je makkelijk contact. Je hebt een afgeronde opleiding op wo-niveau, bijvoorbeeld in data science, kunstmatige intelligentie of informatica; Minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring binnen een complexe organisatie; Aantoonbare ervaring met het ontwikkelen van AI-modellen en machine learning-toepassingen; Je beheerst programmeertalen zoals Python en hebt ervaring met RAG-architecturen en taalmodellen; Kennis van de Algemene Verordening Gegevensbescherming en andere wet- en regelgeving rond AI; Ervaring met werken in teams van uiteenlopende disciplines, zoals architecten en productowners; Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands, want je licht je adviezen mondeling en schriftelijk toe. Hier kom je te werken Meer over jouw toekomstige plek in de organisatie Je komt te werken bij de afdeling IV-Data van de directie IVD&C (Informatievoorziening, Data & Compliance). De afdeling is volop in opbouw. Je stapt in als ervaren medewerker in een klein team. Dat team groeit de komende anderhalf jaar door naar twintig tot dertig collega's. Dat betekent dat je niet alleen je eigen werk doet. Je denkt ook mee over hoe de afdeling zich ontwikkelt. Jouw ervaring telt mee in de keuzes die we maken. Het werk heeft twee kanten. Je ondersteunt de huidige operatie en helpt die te verbeteren. Tegelijk draag je bij aan een grote digitale transformatie. Justis vernieuwt de komende vijf jaar vrijwel de gehele informatievoorziening. We werken agile, in korte cycli met ruimte om bij te sturen. Daarbij houden we aandacht voor wat er echt toe doet. Mission Le pôle Data & IA accompagne les équipes produit d'Isagri dans l'industrialisation de leurs usages de la donnée et de l'intelligence artificielle. items.desc: L’IA, chez nous, ne s’arrête pas au POC. Chez Hubvisory, tu ne livres pas une démo qui tourne sur un portable : tu conçois, tu industrialises et tu déploies des solutions IA qui vivent en production chez des grands comptes. En tant qu’AI Engineer, tu es responsable de la conception technique, de la mise en production et de la fiabilité de ce qu’on construit. Ce que tu fais concrètement : Tu construis des architectures IA sur mesure. LLM, RAG, fine-tuning, agents : tu choisis les briques, tu assumes les arbitrages techniques et tu les expliques. Pas d’empilement d’outils à la mode, des choix justifiés par un cas d’usage qualifié. Tu emmènes tes modèles jusqu’en production. Déploiement, monitoring, latence, coûts, robustesse dans le temps. C’est là que le métier se joue vraiment, et c’est ce qu’on attend de toi du premier jour au dernier. Tu passes du prototype à l’échelle. POC, MVP, pipelines industriels : tu sais quand il faut aller vite et quand il faut consolider, en gardant l’enjeu business en ligne de mire. Tu travailles au contact direct du métier. Product Managers, équipes Data, MLOps, et surtout le client. Tu expliques ce que fait le modèle, ce qu’il ne fait pas, et pourquoi. Tu fais monter les autres. Acculturation IA des équipes internes et des équipes clientes, partage de ce que tu as appris en atelier, contribution à la practice Agents IA. Tu participes à la vie d’Hubvisory. Tu consolides ta posture de consultant.e et tu évolues, selon tes aspirations, vers des rôles de référent.e technique, Lead IA ou Architecte Gen-AI. 👉 Pourquoi rejoindre Hubvisory ? Hubvisory est le seul cabinet en France focalisé exclusivement sur le Product Management et l’IA. Pas de practice data généraliste, pas de conseil en transformation sur tous les sujets. Plus de 10% de notre chiffre d’affaires vient déjà de missions 100% IA : tu travailles sur des sujets réels, pas sur des sujets de plaquette. Une practice dédiée aux Agents IA, avec des pairs qui font le même métier que toi. Tu ne seras pas l’unique profil technique au milieu de consultants qui n’ont pas le vocabulaire. Un cadre qui récompense la progression, pas l’ancienneté : Campus de deux semaines à l’arrivée, buddy dédié, mentorat de proximité, revalorisations bi-annuelles. Des valeurs fortes : depuis 2016, Hubvisory grandit autour de l’ambition, l’expertise, la curiosité, la méritocratie et l’exigence bienveillante. Le package : 42.000-48.000€ fixe brut, revalorisations bi-annuelles, intéressement jusqu’à 22% des profits redistribué de façon égalitaire. 👉 Le profil que nous recherchons Tu as une vraie expérience de l’IA générative en conditions réelles : LLM, RAG, création d’agents. Tu as déjà mis un modèle en production et tu sais décrire ce qui s’est passé entre « ça marche en local » et « ça tourne chez le client ». Côté technique : Python, APIs, déploiement cloud et conteneurisation. Le ML classique est un atout, la GenAI est le socle. Anglais courant obligatoire. Trois qualités qui font la différence ici : la capacité à vulgariser face à un interlocuteur non technique, une curiosité entretenue (on te demandera ton dernier effet « waouh » en entretien) et de la débrouillardise sur des sujets sans mode d’emploi. Comment se déroule le processus de recrutement ? Étape 1 : Échange avec un RH pour valider l’adéquation entre ton projet et notre modèle Étape 2 : Entretien technique GenAI avec un AI Engineer de la practice Étape 3 : Validation de tes soft skills avec un entretien avec un VP Étape 4 : Échange téléphonique avec un RH pour la proposition d’embauche Quelle que soit l’issue de ton process, tu reçois un retour de notre part sous 7 jours maximum ! Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping. Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. items.desc: Job Description Shape the Future of Data-Driven Decision Making as our Data Scientist (m/f/d) At Limehome, data is one of our biggest competitive advantages. As a Data Scientist, you'll turn complex business challenges into scalable statistical and machine learning solutions that help us make smarter decisions across pricing, operations, product, and beyond. Working closely with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, Business Intelligence, and other stakeholders, you'll combine advanced statistical thinking with commercial acumen to create measurable business impact while continuously raising the bar for data-driven decision-making. How You’ll Be Hosting With Heart Design, develop, and continuously improve our core pricing algorithms—our highest-impact analytical products—to maximize revenue, occupancy, and long-term profitability. Design, develop, and evaluate advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms to solve complex business challenges and enable smarter decision-making. Apply rigorous statistical methodologies to quantify uncertainty, estimate business impact, and generate reliable recommendations for decision-making. Design experiments and define evaluation frameworks to measure the effectiveness of new products, pricing strategies, and business initiatives. Analyze large and complex datasets to uncover opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer experience. Partner with Revenue Management, Product, Engineering, and BI to translate business questions into scalable analytical solutions and collaborate with Data Engineering to productionize, deploy, and monitor machine learning models. Stay at the forefront of AI, ML, and decision science to elevate our analytical capabilities, while clearly communicating complex findings to both technical and non-technical audiences. Job Requirements What you need to shoot for the stars: Degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a quantitative field combined with 3+ years of hands-on experience applying machine learning/statistics to real-world business problems. Strong foundation in probability theory, statistical inference, regression analysis, Bayesian statistics, experimentation, causal inference, and predictive modelling. Proven experience developing, validating, and improving machine learning models in business environments. Strong programming and modelling skills in Python and experience with modern data science libraries. Excellent SQL skills and experience working with large analytical datasets. Experience designing experiments and evaluating business initiatives, balancing statistical rigor with pragmatic decision-making to deliver simple, high-value solutions over unnecessary complexity. Strong commercial mindset with a passion for exploring new analytical methods/AI tech and translating complex findings into measurable business recommendations. Fluency in English with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills alongside the ability to explain complex concepts to audiences with varying technical backgrounds. Our Limehomies love traveling so we want to give them the chance to work from inspiring new locations regularly. You’ll apply your core technical skills and innovative thinking to tackle complex challenges, identify opportunities, and help shape data-driven decision-making across the London Market. You’ll operate across a wide variety of business functions, managing multiple priorities and delivering both ad hoc analysis and predictive/prescriptive models. Your work will contribute directly to building Hiscox’s data culture and enabling evidence-based decisions in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Communicating the business value of your analytical solutions to stakeholders will be a key part of your role. You’ll be part of an award-winning team, recognised for its pioneering collaboration with Google to deliver the market’s first AI-enhanced lead underwriting solution. This achievement reflects the team’s commitment to innovation, impact, and excellence in applying data science to real-world insurance challenges. As a Data Scientist, you’ll work within a wider technical team whose efforts span multiple business functions, bringing a multi-disciplinary approach to problem solving and analysis. This is an ideal role for someone who is passionate about using analytics to influence decisions and is keen to continue learning and delivering value through data. You’ll be expected to conceptualise new approaches, communicate your vision to stakeholders, and see ideas through to implementation. Key Responsibilities Leveraging industry standards, emerging methodologies and empirical research to develop critical inputs to business information and helping business leaders develop innovative approaches to driving their business. Working on the end-to-end data solution including understanding complex business challenges, designing solutions, working with large and small data sets (including 3rd party and internal data of a wide variety), using cutting-edge machine learning or Generative AI techniques Work collaboratively with data scientists and other technical disciplines including product and business teams Work closely with other members of the data and analytics community at Hiscox, contributing to delivering value though the use of a range of analytics techniques. Person Specification Degree in a STEM or closely related field or equivalent experience. A further degree is a plus. Practical data science experience, applying analytical techniques to solve business problems and deliver valuable insights. Experience of data science in finance or insurance is advantageous but not required. Experience conducting data analysis, experimentation, and model development to address business challenges. Comfortable using generative AI technologies, including AI-assisted coding tools, to accelerate research, development, and problem-solving, while maintaining a thorough understanding of the methods, code, and outputs produced. Able to critically review, validate, and take ownership of AI-assisted work, ensuring solutions are accurate, explainable, and fit for purpose, while working effectively both independently and as part of a team. Skills Experience using statistical analysis, machine learning, generativeAI, and data science techniques to identify trends, generate insights, and support business decision-making. Experience with analytical tools, programming languages, and databases, such as Python and SQL. Working knowledge of generative AI techniques and technologies, including large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering techniques, AI-assisted coding tools, and agentic AI workflows. Interest in a broad range of data science, machine learning, and AI techniques, with an eagerness to learn about emerging technologies and industry best practice. A strong grounding in statistical concepts and their practical application. Experience working both independently and collaboratively within small, cross-functional teams to deliver analytics and data science projects. Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate technical concepts and insights clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Willingness to learn and apply engineering best practices, including version control, testing, code review, and reproducible development workflows. Exposure to cloud platforms such as Google Cloud Platform (GCP) is advantageous but not essential. Knowledge of the insurance industry is beneficial but not required. Work with amazing people and be part of a unique culture

Are you a customer-obsessed leader with deep expertise in Data, Analytics, and Artificial
Intelligence? 
Do you have the strategic vision and business acumen to shape multi-year AI transformation programs for the world's largest enterprises? 
Do you thrive at the intersection of technology and complex business challenges? Experience working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML, GenAI, Analytics, Database, and/or Storage
Experience in Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting
Join AWS Specialists & Partners for Industries (ASPI) organization within the Data & AI Specialists team for
Automotive & Manufacturing as a Senior Data & AI Go To Market Specialist, requiring exceptional non-formal leadership, cross-functional orchestration, and
strategic impact at the most senior customer and AWS leadership levels.
The ASPI organization is responsible for driving revenue and accelerating adoption of cloud
and partner services across our most strategic global customers. We work backwards from
our customers’ most complex and business-critical challenges to develop and execute go-to-
market plans that transform ideas into scalable, high-impact businesses. ASPI teams include
business development specialists and specialized solution architects. 
As part of ASPI, you will contribute across the full lifecycle of AWS customer initiatives – from shaping new service and solution concepts to accelerating adoption of established offerings. We pride
ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional customer outcomes, and collaborating
seamlessly across AWS as #OneTeam
Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will define and drive the Data & AI go-to-market strategy for the most complex and strategically significant customers in the Automotive & Manufacturing industry.
You will work across the full AWS Analytics and Generative AI & ML services portfolio and
partner ecosystem solutions to develop multi-year transformation roadmaps that deliver
measurable business outcomes at enterprise scale.
You will engage directly with C-suite executives, Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers, and
senior business leaders at strategic enterprise customers to influence their data and AI
strategy. 
As a Principal-level individual contributor, you will operate with significant autonomy, set direction for cross-functional teams without formal authority, and represent AWS in the most critical customer and partner discussions.
As the ideal candidate, you bring an exceptional combination of deep domain expertise in
Data & AI technologies and world-class business development skills. You have a proven
track record of building and executing complex, multi-year strategic programs that generate
significant pipeline and revenue. 
You excel at leading through influence in highly matrixed environments, orchestrating diverse teams of specialists, solution architects, account managers, partner organizations, and AWS leadership to deliver outcomes that no single
individual could achieve alone.

- Knowledge of publisher ad tech stacks and/or advertising technology
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience selling enterprise software or cloud-based applications
- Experience explaining complex technical concepts to various business and technical audiences
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience interpreting data and making business recommendations
- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements

Ești pregătit(ă) să ai un impact real asupra fiabilității și performanței producției farmaceutice? În rolul de Inginer Mentenanță/Maitenance Engineer, vei avea un rol important în asigurarea funcționării sigure, eficiente și continue a echipamentelor de producție din aria Drug Product (DP). Vei lucra cu o gamă variată de echipamente de producție, inclusiv linii de ambalare, mașini de comprimat, granulatoare, uscătoare în pat fluidizat, site, mașini de umplere a flacoanelor, mașini de acoperire, echipamente de încapsulare și mașini de compactare. Vei coordona activitățile de mentenanță preventivă, vei susține programele de calificare și calibrare a echipamentelor și vei oferi suport tehnic tehnicienilor de mentenanță pentru rezolvarea problemelor complexe ale echipamentelor. Colaborând îndeaproape cu echipe multidisciplinare, vei gestiona, de asemenea, procesele de mentenanță și materialele în SAP și vei contribui la inițiative de îmbunătățire continuă care susțin excelența operațională, calitatea produselor și fiabilitatea proceselor de producție. 
 Job Description 
 Responsabilitățile dvs. cheie: 
 Elaborarea și implementarea planurilor de mentenanță preventivă pentru asigurarea fiabilității echipamentelor și continuității operaționale.
 Diagnosticarea problemelor echipamentelor, identificarea cauzelor principale și implementarea acțiunilor corective eficiente.
 Oferirea de suport tehnic și îndrumare tehnicienilor de mentenanță în cadrul intervențiilor complexe.
 Asigurarea mentenanței echipamentelor de ambalare, comprimare, granulare, uscare, umplere, acoperire, încapsulare și compactare.
 Gestionarea datelor de mentenanță preventivă și a materialelor în SAP, asigurând acuratețea înregistrărilor.
 Coordonarea activităților de calificare, calibrare și verificare periodică a echipamentelor, în conformitate cu cerințele aplicabile.
 Susținerea proiectelor de modernizare, investiții și îmbunătățire continuă din cadrul operațiunilor de producție.
 Asigurarea desfășurării activităților de mentenanță în conformitate cu standardele de calitate, siguranță, mediu și Bună Practică de Fabricație.
 Ce veți aduce rolului: 
 Studii superioare în inginerie, automatizări, electromecanică, mecanică sau într-un domeniu tehnic similar.

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve. 
 The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster.

She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities

 Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. 
 Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community. 
 Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner. 
 By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. 
 The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs. 
 Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and service.

 Complies, along with the team, with all Roche Corporate Business principles, Code of Conduct, policies and practices. 
 Maintains awareness of the company’s requirements to fully report adverse events and other reportable drug safety and product complain information. 
 Mindset & Behaviors 
 The PJP demonstrates personal purpose around improving the patient journey, as well as strong passion to create value and impact on the ecosystem. They think from an Enterprise level, beyond boundaries and borders, in order to bring best possible outcomes to both the local health environment, and more broadly, across Roche globally.

 Display of integrity in everything (i.e. open, honest, ethical and genuine) 
 Enabler mindset leveraging the internal and external networks to create value, sharing back and scaling.

items.desc:
At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? As a member of our PMU team at our Munich office, you will have the great opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and encourage millions of Apple’s customers every day! We are looking for an AMS Verification Engineer who will enable us to verify our next generation of PMUs, in close collaboration with the design teams. You will become part of a hands-on development team that cultivates perfection, creativity and innovation. The responsibilities include contributing to the top level verification of our PMUs. A number of IP specific features as well as interaction between IPs will also be part of the expected verification scope.
- In this role, you will take care of ensuring high quality silicon for IC chips and IPs. The workflow starts with careful review of specifications followed by crafting of a verification plan. Then the verification is executed according to plan to support tape-out. 
- Develop efficient and sustainable state-of-the-art verification test benches.
- Analyse and model analog behavior (Verilog-AMS modeling).
- Verify pre-silicon sub-/systems in the top level environment, with main respect to Analog/Mixed Signal macros: regressions, failure debug and tape-out.
- Ensure specification compliance and correct functionality of attributes defined in the verification plan.
- Develop detailed test and coverage plans based on IC specifications.
- Develop verification methodology suitable for the IP, ensuring scalability and portability.
- Develop verification environment, including stimuli, checkers, assertions, and coverage.
- Have a collaborative approach to communicate status and results to multiple disciplines.
- Sign-off mixed signal designs in preparation for tape-out.
Bachelors, Masters or PhD in EE or related field, or equivalent work experience.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with the ability to collaborate with diverse teams and take on diverse challenges with international teams.
Outstanding sense and drive for quality of deliverables.
Ability to work well on a team, take ownership and motivate self and others.
Fluent English skills.
Advanced knowledge of mixed signal verification.
Few years of experience in industry for production integrated circuits.
Experience with developments in hardware descriptive languages: Verilog, System-Verilog, and/or Verilog-AMS code.
A background that includes scripting or programming languages is preferred. These include, but are not limited to, TCL, Skill, Python, and/or PERL.
Familiar with analog behavioural models.
Familiar with verification methodologies and tools: simulators, waveform viewers, execution automation, coverage collection, experience developing scalable and portable test cases.
Possess sufficient analog IC background to identify failure possibilities, work through first order debug, and analyse analog verification results.
Knowledge of analog concurrent assertion and static analyses checks is a plus.
Understanding of both power management and related auxiliary circuitry: switching converters, linear converters, reference circuitry, band-gaps, data converters, and clock generators.

 Validate manufacturing processes and ensure compliance with product and process requirements. 
 Communicate technical information clearly and effectively across teams. 
 Support a culture of safety, quality, collaboration, and operational excellence.

 CNC or NC machining 
 Fiberglass or filament-wound composite materials 
 Manufacturing process development and troubleshooting 
 Tooling or fixture development

 Preferred experience: 
 Soldering, joining, or assembly processes 
 Electrical or electromechanical manufacturing environments 
 Solid-state electrical components 
 Manufacturing process improvement and quality initiatives

 Ability to analyze problems, identify root causes, and implement practical solutions. 
 Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a Domain Architect for Data & Analytics (d/f/m) to join our Architecture Delivery team within the Digital Organization.
 You will be part of a team defining and designing architecture in the frame of our digital roadmap. Within the Operations & Data Domain Architecture team, you will be involved in the strategy definition and in the architecture design activities for complex & strategic digital solutions. You will have the opportunity to contribute in various technological & functional areas:
 With Operation Solutions PSL, supporting initiatives & transformation for Procurement, Manufacturing Engineering, Production, Quality, Logistic.
 With Data & Analytics PSL, supporting initiatives for Artifical Intelligence, Analytics, Data Regulatory Compliance, Data Integration, Robotic Intelligent Automation.
 Your location 
 Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. You are into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your challenges: 
 Acts as visionary to proactively assist in defining the direction for future domain-specific IT Products & Services and validates product designs.
 As a key player, collaborates with all other digital and business stakeholders to deliver high quality solutions using innovative technologies.
 Participates in all phases of the solution development life cycle including research and design, development, testing, implementation and support.
 Aligns architecture strategy with the organization's business goals and long-term strategic planning for the organization's Information systems.
 Design the technical/functional architecture of the application following standard architecture frameworks (TOGAF, Archimate), aligned with security requirements and using modelisation tools & methodology.
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Masters' degree Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
 Extensive experience as IT/Solution Architect (functional/technical) including the ability to take into consideration demanding requirements in terms of security, compliance, robustness, scalability and availability.
 Strong experience in one or more of the following technical fields: Advanced Analytics & AI, data centric platforms, Cloud Architecture, IT Infrastructure, network
 Experience in at least one of those domains Operations, Analytics, Data Regulatory Compliance, Data Management, Artificial Intelligence 
 Experimented in architecture modeling tools & methodologies (Eg: Sparx Enterprise Architect, Archimate, TOGAF) 
 Advanced level in German & English is mandatory

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Wir suchen aktuell eine*n 
 Spezialist*in / Referent*in Gefahrgut, Gefahrstoff und Sprengstoffrecht (d/m/w) 
 zur Verstärkung unseres Teams am Standort Hamburg-Fuhlsbüttel. 
 Als Teil unseres Logistik Operations Teams in Hamburg gestaltest du die betriebliche Sicherheit und die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorschriften maßgeblich mit. 
In dieser zentralen Rolle verantwortest du die regelkonforme Handhabung, Auditierung und das Risikomanagement von deklarierten Gefahrstoffen und Gefahrgütern an unseren Standorten in Hamburg. Du fungierst als Ansprechperson nach § 20 SprengG und bildest die Schnittstelle zwischen operativen Teams, Regulierungsbehörden und globalen Umweltfunktionen. Unser Büro liegt in direkter Nähe zum Hamburger Flughafen und bietet dir täglich einen inspirierenden Blick auf unsere Airbus-Flugzeuge in Aktion. 
 Diese Position ist auch in Teilzeit mit einem entsprechend angepassten Aufgabenprofil besetzbar. 
 WAS WIR DIR BIETEN 
 Hier ist eine Auswahl der Vorteile, die wir unseren Mitarbeitenden bieten (lokale Zusatzleistungen können variieren): 
 Attraktive Vergütung: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehaltspaket nach Tarif Standards 
 Work-Life-Balance : Hybrid Working, flexible Arbeitszeiten, Elternzeit sowie Angebote für Jobsharing 
 Persönliche Weiterentwicklung: Individuelle Entwicklungspläne, ein umfangreiches Lern- und Weiterbildungsangebot sowie vielfältige interne Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten 
 Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden: Betriebliche Krankenversicherung und vielfältige Well-being-Programme
 DEINE AUFGABEN UND VERANTWORTLICHKEITEN 
 Du übernimmst die operative Gefahrgutabwicklung inklusive Identifikation, Klassifizierung, Dokumentation, Verpackung, Markierung und Kennzeichnung gefährlicher Güter (ADR/GGVSEB, IMDG-Code/GGVSee, ICAO-TI/IATA-DGR) als beauftragte Person nach § 9 OWiG / Gefahrgutreferent*in. 
 Du überprüfst und optimierst kontinuierlich betriebliche Prozesse sowie die Lagerbereiche für Gefahrgüter und Gefahrstoffe (insbesondere nach TRGS 510 und angrenzenden Regelwerken). 
 Du entwickelst, aktualisierst und hältst Notfall- und Sicherheitskonzepte in den Bereichen Gefahrgut, Gefahrstoffe und Sprengstoff aufrecht. 
 Du beaufsichtigst die Tätigkeiten der eigenen Mitarbeitenden im Arbeitsbereich und überwachst die Abläufe externer Dienstleistender. 
 Du verwaltest, erfasst und aktualisierst Sicherheitsdatenblätter (SDB/SDS) sowie UN38.3-Testzusammenfassungen und -berichte. 
 Du überwachst und pflegst das Gefahrstoffkataster, die Gefahrstoffbestände sowie die Gefahrgutdaten im SAP-System. 
 Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle und stehst im engen Austausch mit dem Gefahrgutbeauftragten, der EHS-Abteilung, externen Dienstleistenden, Kundschaft, Auditierenden sowie Zollbehörden (u. a. bei zollamtlichen Überprüfungen zu ODS / Ozon-abbauenden Stoffen). 
 Du wirkst aktiv an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten mit und unterstützt diese.
 ERFORDERLICHE KENNTNISSE UND QUALIFIKATIONEN 
 Du verfügst über ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Logistik, Supply Chain Management, Chemical/Environmental Engineering oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung mit nachgewiesenen Qualifikationen im Gefahrgut- und Gefahrstoffbereich. 
 Du bringst fundierte und erprobte Berufserfahrung im Gefahrgut- und Gefahrstoffbereich mit, inklusive praktischer Erfahrung als beauftragte Person nach § 9 OWiG oder als Gefahrgutreferent*in. 
 Du besitzt einen Befähigungsschein nach § 20 SprengG. 
 Du weist einen Schulungsnachweis als Gefahrgutbeauftragte Person vor ODER verfügst über vertiefte Kenntnisse nach ADR/GGVSEB und IMDG-Code/GGVSee. 
 Du bringst vertiefte Fachkenntnisse bezüglich ICAO-TI/IATA-DGR (CBTA Modul A/B für alle Klassen) sowie fundiertes Wissen über europäische und deutsche Regelwerke mit (ADR, SprengG, GHS/CLP, REACh, ODS/Halon-Lizenzen, TRGS 510). 
 Du zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise aus und überzeugst durch deine Kommunikationskompetenz sowie ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit im internationalen Umfeld. 
 Du bringst verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift mit.
 Satair setzt sich aktiv für eine Kultur der Vielfalt und Inklusion ein – geprägt von kontinuierlichem Lernen, einer offenen Feedbackkultur („Speak up, listen up“) sowie von Integrität und gegenseitigem Respekt. Daher begrüßen wir jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von sozialer oder kultureller Herkunft, Geschlecht, Alter, Behinderung, sexueller Orientierung oder Religion.
 ÜBER SATAIR 
 Satair ist ein Unternehmen von Airbus Services und bietet erstklassige Lösungen für das Materialmanagement im Ersatzteilgeschäft der Luftfahrtbranche. Wir sind stolz darauf, rund um die Uhr eine hervorragende Kundenerfahrung zu bieten, Innovationen voranzutreiben und den digitalen sowie nachhaltigen Wandel in der Luftfahrt mitzugestalten. 
 Mit unserer globalen funktionalen Organisation, die sich über 12 Standorte weltweit erstreckt, und einem Team von mehr als 2.000 Mitarbeitenden, …

 Une offre de stage intitulée « Etude des colles époxy UV pour les processus d’assemblage des composants aéronautiques électriques et optiques (h/f) » vient de s'ouvrir au sein d' Airbus Commercial sur son site de Colomiers.  Faire un état de l’art afin de monter en compétences et en connaissances sur les différentes colles epoxy UV
 Analyser les paramètres et les moyens d'implémentation de ces technologies dans notre domaine d'application et sur nos produits
 Définir et réaliser des essais pour évaluer différents produits
 Construire la roadmap technologique et composant utilisant ces briques technologiques
 Votre tuteur ou tutrice vous accompagnera tout au long de votre stage, vous aidant à développer vos compétences et à atteindre vos objectifs professionnels.
