 Les compétences liés à l’utilisation et mise en oeuvre de matériaux dans le domaine aéronautique
 Définition, écriture et réalisation d’essais et rapports d’essais

 Les compétences liées à l’installation électrique et optique dans le domaine aéronautique

Job Description: 
 In order to support dynamics parts availability for H135 and H135 programs, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a 
 Dynamics parts Supply - H135 & H145 Responsible (d/f/m) 
 You will be part of the Customer Support organization, responsible for managing stock, backorders, and supplier performance, as well as ensuring the accuracy and availability of estimated delivery dates for elementary parts. This function directly supports dynamic spares and MRO (Maintenance, Repair, and Overhaul) activities for the H135 and H145 programs—an essential role in supporting the overhaul and repair of dynamic assemblies. 
 You will serve as the primary point of contact for the Dynamic Spares Supply team in Donauwörth and join the Rotor and Transmission Center of Excellence (CoE) community. 
 In this role, you will provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility into parts availability, enabling them to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels. 
 Your location 
 At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Oversee spare parts performance for Dynamics elementary components across the H135 and H145 programs. 
 Act as the primary point of contact between Donauwörth, Airbus Helicopters Technik , Airbus Helicopters Inc. (AHI), Kawasaki, and external suppliers. 
 Improve forecast accuracy and worldwide parts management to give suppliers clear visibility on S&OP capacity horizons and potential shortages. 
 Provide MRO workshops and Front Office teams with clear visibility on parts availability to effectively plan their activities and optimize stock levels. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Supply Chain & Logistics Expertise: Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or Engineering, with hands-on experience in stock management, inventory optimization, and backorder reduction (aerospace/MRO environment preferred). 
 Supplier Management & S&OP: Proven track record in supplier performance management and Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) to drive forecast accuracy, maintain accurate estimated delivery dates (EDDs), and anticipate shortage horizons. 
 Cross-Functional & International Stakeholder Management: Strong interpersonal and communication skills to act as a seamless interface between multi-site teams (Donauwörth, Airbus Helicopters Technik, AHI, Kawasaki), external suppliers, and internal MRO/Front Office stakeholders. 
 Analytical Tools & ERP Proficiency: Strong analytical background with solid experience using ERP systems (preferably SAP MM/PP) and data analytics tools for reporting, stock monitoring, and planning. 
 Language Requirements: Business fluent in English (written and spoken); professional working proficiency in German is highly desirable given the local site environment and daily operational interfaces. 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Job Description: 
 Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Aircraft Performance Engineer (f/m) to join our Low Speed Performance & Airworthiness department based in Toulouse , France. 
 You will be part of a team developing and certifying performance models on all Airbus commercial products. As part of the Low Speed Performance & Airworthiness team, you will be involved in analyzing aircraft performance aiming at demonstrating performance compliance with operations and certification. 
 Your working environment: 
 Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 
 How we care for you: 
 Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis.

 Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
 Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 
 At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 
 Your challenges: 
 Develop and certify aircraft performance reference models, ensuring their representativeness throughout the aircraft lifecycle. 
 Guide overall aircraft and system designs by delivering performance assessments for developments and continuous improvements. 
 Establish performance certification strategies with certification authorities and lead compliance files. 
 Deliver software, documentation, and operational models associated with the Airplane Flight Manual (AFM). 
 Support in-service operations and aircraft deliveries, analyze operational events, and define airworthiness corrective actions. 
 Your boarding pass: 
 Degree in Engineering with an aerospace background or specialization 
 Solid technical knowledge of flight physics 
 Knowledge of aircraft certification processes and regulatory requirements would be an advantage 
 Proficiency or working knowledge of Python would be an advantage 
 Fluency in both English and French (negotiation level required) 
 Eligibility for security clearance by competent authorities

 Benefits: 
 Salary: £24,246
 35 hours per week // Flexible working hours // Hybrid working options available depending on the role // Half day Fridays! // 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
 About us: 
 Do you like connecting with people in different organizations? Are you interested in developing wing structures for the future environmentally sustainable aircraft?
 The Airbus Engineering Wing Repairs organization (SRM) is part of the wider repairs organization giving “Follow the Sun” support to keep our fleet of aircraft flying with customers around the world. There are teams around the world to support this, but this role will be based in Filton, Bristol.
 Wing Repairs (SRM) covers the whole of the Airbus commercial fleet, from the remaining A300’s flying to the latest A350. The Wing Repairs organization also collaborates in the design of the latest aircraft to ensure designs are repairable, along with research into the latest manufacturing methods such as additive layer to create repair parts.
 You will work with a team of highly experienced Engineers across a variety of disciplines to gain experience of Repair Design, Static Stress and Fatigue & Damage Tolerance.
 What you will be doing: 
 As an Intern Engineer you will develop the core skills needed in the wing business and your future development.
 Static Stress analysis, from first principles to Fine Element Modelling;
 Fatigue and Damage Tolerance;
 Design – CATIA tools, configuration management and Digital Mock Up;
 Digitalisation - automating processes using coding skills.
 Project Management through working with Repair teams on a variety of projects;
 Business and Financial knowledge;
 Leadership Skills through working on projects with a broad range of people, and nationalities;
 Customer focus through working with our Customer Service organization. 
 Requirements: 
 Our placements are open to Undergraduates only . Therefore it is mandatory for candidates to be an undergraduate for the whole duration of the placement. Please inform your graduation date on your application. 
 *Your application should include a CV along with a Cover Letter outlining your motivation and suitability for the role.* 
 Successful candidates will be able to demonstrate the following:
 Studying or Studied a degree in Aeronautical or Mechanical Engineering;
 Good knowledge of coding and data analysis techniques;
 Passionate about Aerospace and the challenges of the civil aircraft market;
 Are sensitive to clients needs and can develop good client relationships;
 Naturally curious and excited to explore;
 Excited to work in a dynamic and changing environment;
 Proficient oral and written communication skills;
 Collaborate well within a team.
 SECURITY CLEARANCE: You will be subject to a BPSS (Baseline Personnel Security Standard) check. You may also need to gain UK SC-level Security Clearance or Export Control, depending on the role.

 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - 
 Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast.

As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects.

 Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions.

 Completed studies in computer science or similar 
 3 to 5 years experience in the field of information systems 
 System administration knowledge on OCP servers and Windows Server/SQL servers 
 Knowledge of programming and scripting languages (Java, Perl, Python, PowerShell) 
 Use Agile Safe principles (continuous delivery, iterative approach, PoCs, MVPs, Industrialization). 
 You are highly motivated and have excellent communication skills. 
 Open minded for collaborative ways of working in a transnational business environment. 
 Fluent Spanish, as well as advanced English language skill.

 Ability to solve complex issues, good at problem statement analysis and solution design thinking

Job Description: 
 In order to support our Cabin Test Center, Airbus Operations is looking for a
 VIE - Test Engineer (d/f/m) for Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) of Aircraft Cabin Systems (d/f/m) 
 You are a highly motivated graduate and want to get to know the work of a Test Engineer for Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) of Aircraft Cabin Systems ? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Cabin Integration Test Center as a Volunteer for International Experience.
 Location: Hamburg Finkenwerder 
 Start: 01.01.2027 / As soon as possible 
 Duration: 24 months 
 Definition VIE 
 The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) program is an international program sponsored by the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Employment, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. We are looking for highly motivated graduates aged 18 to 28 years, who are citizens of the European Union (all E.U. nationals, plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein). Candidates meeting these criteria and interested in a VIE, please register before your 28th birthday on the website www.civiweb.com . For graduates who would be interested in a career with Airbus, this could be the start of a rewarding future in a dynamic and forward-thinking sector.
 Your location 
 You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.
 Your benefits 
 Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime). 
 Mobile working after agreement with the department. 
 International environment with the opportunity to network globally. 
 Work with modern/diversified technologies. 
 At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings. 
 Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 You will perform EMC measurements and electrical tests in accordance with common aviation industry standards (RTCA/DO-160 Section 15–25, ABD0100.1.2, ABD0100.1.8.1 u.ä.), as well as document and evaluate the results. 
 Your duties will also include optimizing test procedures and measuring equipment, as well as maintaining quality assurance measures. 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Education: University degree (Master's level or equivalent) in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, or a related field. 
 Methodological Skills: Experience in project management and quality management. 
 Languages: Business-fluent communication skills in English, German is a plus. 
 Soft Skills: Strong teamwork abilities, an open mindset, high self-motivation, and adaptability to change. 
 Execution: Ability to handle stress and manage multiple priorities effectively while meeting promised deadlines. 
 Practical experience in EMC Measurements is a plus 
 Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, letters of reference.

items.desc:
We are seeking a thoughtful and proactive User Experience (UX) Designer to join EMBL-EBI’s Digital Experience (DX) team at EMBL-EBI on a fixed-term maternity cover contract. 
 In this role, you will help us explore and apply emerging technologies and design digital solutions that enhance how users discover, access and interact with EMBL-EBI’s information and services. 
 Working as part of the DX team, you will contribute across the design lifecycle, from research and discovery to prototyping, delivery and continuous improvement. You will connect user needs with practical solutions and support the team in shaping intuitive, accessible and engaging digital experiences. 
 By shaping connected, accessible services around users’ needs, the DX team helps bring EMBL-EBI’s mission to life: making life science data freely available and helping scientific discovery move forward. 
 Your key responsibilities will include: 
 Planning and conducting user interviews, usability tests, workshops and feedback sessions. 
 Turning qualitative and quantitative evidence into clear insights and priorities. 
 Creating user flows, information architectures, wireframes, prototypes and accessible interface designs. 
 Simplify complex workflows and data-rich experiences without losing essential detail. 
 Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams throughout discovery and delivery stages. 
 Contributing to design systems, reusable patterns and clear UX documentation. 
 Championing accessibility, inclusive design and evidence-informed decision-making. 
 Using AI and other emerging tools thoughtfully within the design process to support exploration, prototyping and iteration, while critically evaluating their outputs, limitations and impact on users. 
 You will bring: 
 Professional experience in UX or product design, ideally in a scientific, technical or data-intensive environment. 
 A portfolio demonstrating user research, interaction design, prototyping and delivered outcomes. 
 Experience of planning, conducting and synthesising user research and usability testing. 
 Strong skills in Figma or comparable design and prototyping tools. 
 Practical knowledge of accessibility and WCAG standards. 
 The ability to communicate design decisions clearly and work effectively with technical and non-technical colleagues. 
 A collaborative, organised and adaptable approach; you will be confident to approach learning new and unfamiliar concepts 
 You may also have: 
 An interest in, or experience with, responsible AI-enabled design and research methods. 
 Experience contributing to design systems, reusable components or shared UX standards. 
 Experience designing data-rich products or services for specialist and international audiences. 
 Knowledge of analytics, front-end technologies or Agile and Lean UX practices. 
 What success looks like: 
 Success means delivering clear research insights, tested designs and accessible interfaces that teams can confidently build. You will strengthen collaboration between UX and engineering, improve consistency across the digital portfolio and help create trustworthy services that embrace the possibilities of an AI-enabled future while remaining grounded in real user needs. 
 Contract length: 12-month fixed-term Staff Member contract to c over maternity leave. As a result, preference will be given to candidates who are available to start in December 2026 or January 2027. 
 Please note that, due to the duration of the appointment, relocation support is not available for this position. 
 Salary: Grade 5 - Monthly salary from £3,452.05 after tax, plus generous benefits and financial allowances based on individual circumstances. Excluding 12.99% personal pension and insurance contributions. 
 Next steps: This vacancy has a scheduled closing date of Wednesday, 11th November , and we welcome your application as soon as possible. 
 Please submit the up-to-date CV and supporting cover letter outlining your transferable skills and experience and motivation for applying. 
 *** We plan to advertise the role for up to four weeks, with a scheduled closing date of Wednesday, 11th November . However, if we receive a strong field of applications within the first two weeks, we may close the vacancy earlier. The advert will remain open for a minimum of two weeks, making Wednesday, 28th October the earliest possible closing date. We therefore encourage you to apply as soon as possible. ***

At EMBL-EBI you can apply your talent and passion to accelerate science and tackle some of humankind's greatest challenges.  Rejoignez la révolution technologique du véhicule autonome et connecté au sein de Valeo ! 
 Leader mondial des aides à la conduite, Valeo réinvente la vie à bord du véhicule et révolutionne l’expérience de conduite. Des solutions de connectivité et de commande intérieure aux systèmes de détection, notre Division Valeo Brain vise à rendre la mobilité plus sûre et plus intuitive.

 Le département Optique recrute un ou une Ingénieur(e) Optronique , pour nous accompagner dans la définition de l'architecture et des performances des systèmes de caméras intérieures permettant d’améliorer la sécurité automobile, notamment :
 Le Système de Surveillance du Conducteur qui détecte chez le conducteur s’il est distrait ou somnolent ;
 Le Système de Surveillance de l’habitacle qui adapte le véhicule aux caractéristiques des occupants et à leur posture, pour proposer des réglages individualisés.
 Vos missions : 
 Participer à la définition l'architecture de la caméra (distance focale, capteur, illumination, etc.) et déterminer les performances à l'aide de la MTF et du rapport signal/bruit (SNR)
 Simuler les performances de la caméra avec Excel, Matlab ou Python
 Spécifier la lentille de caméra, analyser cette lentille, puis accompagner les fournisseurs afin d'obtenir la solution la plus adaptée aux besoins
 Réaliser des simulations de séquences à l'aide du logiciel SPEOS
 Définir, choisir et valider les meilleurs capteurs et sources lumineuses infrarouges en collaboration avec les fournisseurs concernés
 Réaliser le set-up de test
 Réaliser des mesures sur les caméras et valider les prototypes en laboratoire
 À propos de vous : 
 Titulaire d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+5 en optique, systèmes optroniques ou domaine équivalent, vous justifiez d'une première expérience professionnelle vous ayant permis de développer des compétences techniques en optronique (colorimétrie, photométrie/radiométrie, capteurs, etc.). 
 Au cours de votre parcours, vous avez assuré le suivi technique de fournisseurs, réalisé des campagnes de mesures et de caractérisation sur des caméras, ainsi que participé à la validation de prototypes en laboratoire. 
 Nos avantages : 
 Plan d’actionnariat, Action Logement 
 Présence d’un comité social & économique (CSE) 
 Télétravail partiel possible (2 jours par semaine) 
 Restaurant d’entreprise

 Pour rejoindre un leader technologique et industriel, pionnier français dans l’innovation automobile 
 Pour une carrière dynamique avec des possibilités de mobilité nationale ou internationale, adaptée à vos aspirations 
 Pour contribuer au développement d’une mobilité plus propre, plus sûre et plus intelligente 
 Valeo accorde une grande importance à la diversité, qu’elle soit culturelle, intergénérationnelle, de genre ou qu’elle concerne les personnes en situation de handicap.

The
items.desc:
Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 Being an integrated element of Production Quality, as Incoming Inspector in Helsings Production environment you are responsible for the Quality Assurance Gate on supplied goods into our warehouse by verification of conformity, as well outbound quality aspects on customer deliverables or supplier returns in close relation with our Logistic, Supply Chain - and further Production-Quality functions.
 The day-to-day
 Execute incoming goods inspection based on applicable specifications and secure required documentation
 Maintain and process reporting of non-conform material including conform handling and marking
 Contribute to and drive root cause corrective action and improvement activities
 Oversight and control of blocked / quarantined material in your area including scrap control
 Ensure process compliance to internal QMS, EN9100 and others applicable standards
 You should apply if you 
 Can show up with a professional education in electronics, mechanics or mechatronics with min. 3 years of quality assurance experience in electronics (machinery or plant engineering, automotive), experience in warehouse inbound QA is of advantage
 Demonstrate applied and proven experience on inspection methods by visual means or via the use of standard test / measurement equipment and able to read, understand, and apply technical documents ( Engineering drawings / Inspection procedures )
 Have the experience in maintaining IT Software applications like MS Office, QA SW if applicable. SAP experience is of advantage.
 Can work independently as well in a team and subordinate him/herself with the ability to assert oneself and respect other positions
 Maintain a process oriented attitude and mindset with flexibility and creativity to achieve given goals
 Carry good communication skills in English, German of advantage
 Are willing to work in a two-shift system
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points. 
 Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 
 Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns 
 The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world 
 Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward 
 In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts 
 We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about 
 What we offer 
 You will receive attractive compensation as well as a company pension scheme
 We cover the majority of the costs for your Deutschlandticket
 Stay fit and balanced thanks to sports subsidies and professional mental health support (Nilo)
 Recommend us to others and secure first-class bonuses for successful hires
 Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are …

items.desc:

 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 
 The role 
 As Mechanical Engineer, Kinematic Systems and Mechanisms, you will own the design, analysis and validation of high-performance moving systems for Helsing's drone platforms, from deployment mechanisms and folding structures through to landing gears and robotic joints. Working across kinematic synthesis, multi-body dynamics, precision engineering and hands-on prototype iteration, you will translate complex mechanical requirements into flight-worthy, testable hardware. 
 The day-to-day
 Own mechanism architecture from concept through to validated hardware, performing kinematic synthesis, multi-body dynamics analysis, torque and force profiling and FEA to ensure every moving system meets structural, performance and weight requirements before design is committed 
 Select and integrate electro-mechanical actuators, precision bearings, gearboxes, linkages and structural joints, applying advanced GD&T to ASME Y14.5 or ISO 1101 standards to control backlash, alignment and thermal expansion across complex moving assemblies 
 Build and iterate functional mechanism prototypes hands-on, evaluating kinematic behaviour and structural integrity under operationally relevant conditions, and design lifetime and fatigue test campaigns that validate analytical models and drive technical maturation 
 Produce robust 3D models, 2D manufacturing drawings, kinematic analysis reports and design documentation that meet aerospace quality standards, ensuring full traceability from requirement through to verified design output 
 Collaborate with systems, structures and avionics teams across design reviews and integration milestones, ensuring kinematic assemblies interface correctly with the broader airframe and that mechanism reliability is maintained across the full range of environmental and operational conditions 
 You should apply if you 
 Have designed and delivered complex kinematic mechanisms and moving systems for aerospace, drone or similarly demanding applications, with demonstrated proficiency in multi-body dynamics tools such as MSC Adams, MotionSolve or SolidWorks Motion alongside FEA for structural validation 
 Are proficient in 3D and 2D CAD and PLM workflows using SolidWorks/PDM or Siemens NX/Teamcenter, and can apply advanced GD&T and statistical tolerance stack-up analysis to control precision and fit in complex moving assemblies 
 Have selected and integrated precision mechanical components, including bearings, gearboxes, ball screws and high-strength fasteners, with a working knowledge of aerospace-grade materials and manufacturing processes including CNC machining, composites and additive manufacturing 
 Have set up test rigs and executed functional, environmental and lifetime test campaigns on kinematic systems, using physical test data to correlate and refine analytical models 
 Act decisively with minimal guidance, own outcomes end-to-end and initiate solutions without waiting for direction

Wir pflegen eine offene und transparente Kultur, die gesunde Debatten über den Einsatz von Technologie in der Verteidigung, ihre Vorteile und ihre ethischen Implikationen begrüßt. 
 Die Rolle 
 Der Schichtleiter in der Produktion unterstützt den Produktionsleiter bei der Führung eines Teams von Produktionsmitarbeitenden, um einen reibungslosen Produktionsablauf zu gewährleisten. Zu seinen Aufgaben gehören die Motivation des Teams, die Einhaltung hoher Qualitätsstandards und die Erreichung der Produktionsziele. Der Schichtleiter arbeitet mit den Mitarbeitern bei ihren täglichen Montageaufgaben zusammen und stellt sicher, dass die Prozesse den Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden.
 Darüber hinaus ermittelt er den Schulungsbedarf innerhalb des Teams und koordiniert diese Maßnahmen mit dem Produktionsleiter. Die ständige Kommunikation mit Abteilungen wie Logistik und Qualitätsmanagement ist für die Einhaltung der Produktionsprozesse von entscheidender Bedeutung. Darüber hinaus erstellt diese Position regelmäßig Berichte über Leistungsindikatoren und Qualitätsstandards aus der Schicht und meldet diese an die Produktionsleitung. Die Einhaltung aller Sicherheits- und Umweltvorschriften im Montagebereich ist ein wichtiger Aspekt dieser Position.
 Dein Alltag 
 Unterstützung bei den täglichen Montageaktivitäten und laufenden Betriebsabläufen.
 Leitung und Motivation eines Teams von Montagearbeitern, um einen reibungslosen Produktionsablauf zu gewährleisten.
 Überwachung und Unterstützung der täglichen Montageaktivitäten mit Fokus auf Effizienz und Qualität.
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitätsstandards im Montagebereich.
 Ermittlung des Schulungsbedarfs innerhalb des Teams und Organisation geeigneter Schulungen.
 Aufrechterhaltung einer aktiven Kommunikation mit anderen Abteilungen wie Logistik und Qualitätsmanagement zur Optimierung der Produktionsprozesse.
 Erstellung regelmäßiger Berichte über wichtige Leistungsindikatoren und Qualitätsstandards für das Management.
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung aller relevanten Sicherheits- und Umweltvorschriften im Montagebereich.
 Du solltest dich bewerben, wenn du folgendes mitbringst 
 Eine erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung und/ oder Weiterbildung, und zusätzlich Erfahrung im Produktions- und Montageumfeld.
 Erste Führungserfahrung in einer ähnliche Rolle, oder erste Erfahrung mti den genannten Aufgaben im Produktionsumfeld.
 Verständnis von Produktionsprozessen und Qualitätsanforderungen.
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Organisationsfähigkeiten.
 Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
 Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit.
 Hinweis: Wir arbeiten an einer Schnittstelle, an der Frauen sowie andere Minderheitengruppen systematisch unterrepräsentiert sind. Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung, auch wenn Du nicht alle aufgelisteten Qualifikationen erfüllen kannst; Fähigkeiten und Einfluss können nicht in wenigen Aufzählungspunkten zusammengefasst werden. 
 Komm zu Helsing 
 Deine Arbeit bei Helsing zählt. Du leistest einen direkten Beitrag zur Sicherheit demokratischer Länder und trägst dazu bei, dass hohe ethische Standards eingehalten werden. 
 Unsere Produkte erfüllen höchste Anforderungen an Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Sicherheit. Deshalb ist sorgfältiges, verantwortungsbewusstes Arbeiten bei uns besonders wichtig. 
 Helsing ist Teil einer zukunftsorientierten Branche, die sich dynamisch weiterentwickelt. Wir wachsen schnell und wurden bereits für mehrere bedeutende Aufträge ausgewählt. 
 Bei uns zählt jede Meinung: Wir fördern eine offene, respektvolle Arbeitskultur und setzen auf eigenverantwortliches Handeln, Teamgeist und kontinuierliche Verbesserung.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Developer Advocate. In this role, you’ll play a core part in improving our developer experience, particularly our documentation and example projects. You’ll dive deep into where users are getting stuck and ship what they need to succeed.

You’ll also help drive acquisition of our technical, self-serve customers by creating and presenting engaging content online and in-person, especially at developer meetups and conferences across the globe.

This role is perfect for someone who can create compelling technical content and is energized by connecting with developers face-to-face.




REQUIREMENTS

 - You love attending, organizing, and speaking at developer events.

 - You're able to tailor messaging for different audiences and build strong networks with developers, startup accelerators, and VCs alike.

 - A strong full-stack engineering skillset with extensive experience working with AI tools.

 - The ability to come up with great ideas for tutorials, build working demos, and create high-quality blog posts, videos and talks.

 - A passion for writing engaging technical content.

 - A product-minded approach to content: you understand metrics, speak to users, decide what to build/write based on needs, and double down on what works.


LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in Bangalore, Dublin, London, New York, San Francisco, Tokyo, and Warsaw.

#LI-Remote

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.desc:
Location: Praha, Czechia 
Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. 
Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. A total of 15 teams work on projects for government agencies, banking, mobile services and the Internet Of Things (IoT) technology. At the core of our business is the development of software which we configure and embed in a multitude of different devices and form factors. These include many kinds of payment cards, SIM cards, travel passes, secure eBanking devices, authentication tokens, machine identification modules (MIM), and secure ID documents including ePassports, eID and eHealth cards, as well as eDriving licenses. Because of the international environment surrounding us every day, it comes as no surprise that English is our official corporate language. 
 At Thales , we empower businesses and governments worldwide by delivering high-value, business-critical secure services.
 As an L1 Support & Operations Officer , you are the front face of technical support and incident management for our global hosted and managed services. Operating as part of an international 24x7 Network Operations Center (NOC) team, you will perform continuous service monitoring, system health checks, and quick issue resolutions to ensure we meet and exceed customer Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
 If you thrive in a dynamic technical environment, love troubleshooting Linux and database systems, and want to learn cutting-edge security and telecom solutions—this is the opportunity for you!
 Key Responsibilities
 Request & Incident Management
 Act as the primary contact for incoming technical requests and incidents using our GTO ticketing system.
 Maintain professional, clear, and proactive communication with global customers.
 Participate in 24x7 NOC shift rotations to ensure continuous service availability.
 First-Line Technical Support
 Perform initial diagnostics and search internal knowledge bases to deliver accurate solutions.
 Resolve recurring issues or smoothly escalate high-criticality incidents to Level 2 (L2) Support.
 Support L2 engineers with root-cause analysis and problem management.
 Service Monitoring & Alert Operations
 Monitor active system alerts across distributed infrastructure.
 Validate triggers, follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) / working instructions, and ensure complete issue resolution.
 Escalate complex system anomalies to L2 teams when required.
 Routine Operations & Service Transition
 Execute routine system maintenance, data provisioning, and preventive checks.
 Generate regular service delivery reports for Service Delivery Managers (SDMs).
 Partner with project delivery teams during new customer handovers to review documentation and test monitoring tools.
 Requirements & Qualificat
 Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
 Experience: 1+ years in technical support, NOC, or IT system operations.
 Systems: Solid understanding of Linux system administration and command-line management.
 Databases: Hands-on experience executing queries and retrieving reports from MySQL and Oracle databases.
 Networking & Web: Core understanding of networking concepts and WebLogic.
 Shift Readiness: Strong flexibility to work in 24x7 shift rotations .
 Great to Have
 Experience in the Telecom domain.
 Prior hands-on experience with standard ticketing platforms (e.g., Jira, ServiceNow, Remedy, GTO).
 What We Offer
 Continuous Learning: Ongoing training on state-of-the-art security, cloud, and hosted service architectures.
 Global Exposure: Direct experience working alongside international technical teams across the globe.
 Career Growth: Clear progression pathways into L2 Operations, Systems Engineering, and Service Delivery.
At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

items.desc:
Lieu : Massy, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
L’activité Systèmes terrestres et aériens basé sur le site de Massy est leader dans les systèmes de commandement et de contrôle des opérations aériennes et les systèmes radars de défense aérienne. 
 Au sein d’une équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous participerez au développement de nos systèmes avec d’autres partenaires industriels français et internationaux en prenant en compte les contraintes de performance, de sécurité et de sureté et concourrez ainsi à garantir la souveraineté de l’espace aérien de nos clients.
 En nous rejoignant, vous :
 capturerez et traduirez le besoin opérationnel de nos clients en spécifications et modèles en co-ingénierie avec les autres métiers
 partagerez vos connaissances DSA au sein de l’équipe d’ingénierie
 contribuerez aux choix d’architectures de nos solutions
 participerez à l’évaluation et au suivi des coûts/jalons/qualité de nos activités
 apporterez votre support aux équipes de développement matériel, algorithmique, IHM et logiciel et aux équipes de test
 pourrez participer aux phases d’ingénierie avale (intégration, validation) de nos systèmes
 contribuerez à la mise en œuvre et à la mise en service des systèmes, en contact avec le client
 pourrez apporter votre support aux réponses aux appels d’offres sur nos systèmes futurs
 contribuerez à l’amélioration de la discipline Ingénierie Système en menant des actions de transformation
 Autonome, constructif et responsable, vous mettrez en valeurs vos capacités à :
 organiser vos activités
 anticiper les risques et proposer des opportunités en étant force de proposition
 vous intégrer dans un collectif, en faisant preuve d’ouverture d’esprit et d’écoute
 rechercher l’amélioration continue de vous-même et de votre équipe
 Vous aurez la possibilité d’évoluer vers d’autres activités d’ingénierie ou toute autre opportunité au sein du Groupe Thales.
 Votre profil 
 Vous avez une solide expérience en matière d’ingénierie système et de modélisation ? 
 Vous êtes familier avec le domaine de la Défense et plus particulièrement du Commandement dans le cadre de la Défense Sol-Air (DSA) intégrée aux Opérations Aériennes et vous souhaitez contribuer à développer nos futurs systèmes dans ce domaine ? 
 Dynamique, vous n’hésitez pas à communiquer avec les équipes qui vous entourent ? 
 Alors rejoignez notre équipe d’ingénierie solutions ! 
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER 
 For the SMU Team (sensor management unit) we are looking for a software engineer (C/C++) with strong analytical skills and effective communication abilities. You will not only be a developer writing software but also be involved in integrations and troubleshooting, primarily ensuring the software operates correctly across various radar systems. In this role, you will act as a connector across disciplines and work within a close-knit team.
 About Thales 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that are part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds up to thousands of kilometers.
 Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for software development of the optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is carried out in multidisciplinary teams collaborating with specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.
 About the job 
 Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes various domains such as controlling the radar systems, organizing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console.
 The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the toolchain, and the Agile process.
 About you 
 Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales.
 The requirement is a completed Master’s degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (minimum 2 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus. 
 You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment.
 Screening Criteria 
 Minimum of 2+ years of experience in C++ software development
 Experience with Real-Time Software development
 Proficiency with Linux operating systems
 Experience working as part of a large software development organization
 Effective team player 
 Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven 
 Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent 
 Reskilling is possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience
 Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification
 Language: Native or near-native Dutch (C1/C2), combined with professional English 
 What's in it for you 
 A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas.
 Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills.
 A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance.
 You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it.
 A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness.
 40 days paid-time-off per year.
 Interested?
 Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest.
 To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment.
 A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures.
 Diversity Statement 
 We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s …

 YOUR CAREER AT THALES

 Room for and attention to personal development

items.desc:
Lieu : Laval, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Au sein des Pays de la Loire, notre site est spécialisé dans l'intégration des équipements d’identification intégrés sur des plateformes aéronautiques et de systèmes de communication naval, l’activité du site, principalement industrielle, couvre tout le cycle de vie du produit, de la phase de conception jusqu’au support client. 
 Vous intégrez le département Ingénierie IFF et TACAN au sein du Centre de Compétences Ingénierie et Radio Solutions (IRS) du site de Laval en tant qu’Ingénieur Système Produits Radar secondaire IFF.
 Vous intervenez sur le développement de nouvelles solutions et participez à l’analyse fonctionnelle en tenant compte des besoins clients et des objectifs liés à la politique produit. Vous avez une vision de l’ensemble des métiers qui développent les constituants des équipements (logiciel, matériel et FPGA, traitement du signal etc…).
 Plus précisément, en phase de spécification, vous :
 Définissez les caractéristiques fonctionnelles du radar (bilan énergétique, séquencements, définition algorithmique de traitement) et réalisez des analyses en supports de justification par modélisation et simulations,
 Proposez des évolutions du système, réalisez les traitements algorithmiques ad-hoc et participez à l’innovation,
 Participer à l’intégration progressive des traitements d’intelligence artificielle dans les chaînes de traitement.
 En collaboration avec l’architecte système, vous participez à la définition et aux évolutions de l’architecture des produits.
 En phase de validation du système vous :
 Identifiez et résolvez les problèmes remontés par les équipes intégration,
 Analysez les données radar en développant des outils spécifiques si besoin, et validez les algorithmes,
 Supportez les projets lors de présentations clients, revues et démonstrations.
 Votre profil 
 De formation Ingénieur/Bac +5, vous justifiez d’une première expérience en IVVQ ou en Ingénierie Systèmes sur des systèmes complexes et avez déjà évolué dans un environnement multi-métiers ?
 Vous bénéficiez de compétences en
 Python et en Environnement d’intégration continue,
 Traitement du signal,
 Technologies radio fréquence
 Technologies Matérielles et Logicielles
 FPGA ?
 Vos pairs reconnaissent votre capacité à travailler en équipe comme en autonomie, votre curiosité, votre rigueur, votre esprit de synthèse et votre aisance rédactionnelle ?
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

items.desc:
As a Project Engineer for the High-Luminosity LHC , you will join the Project Office (DO) within the Accelerators and Technology (ATS) Sector.
 In the frame of HL-LHC installations during the Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) your work will focus on the follow up of de-installation and installation activities in support to the HL Activity coordinators and ensuring proper update of 3D models in as built status.
 Your responsibilities: 
 Daily follow up of the ongoing activities in the worksites, tracking progress according to schedule and identify schedule issues and technical divergences.
 Report to HL Activity coordinators and propose mitigation actions for schedule issues and technical divergences.
 Actively contribute to the installation schedule updates and changes considering the field work progress.
 Take part in the onsite organisation meeting, preparing material for it, providing support to the HL Activity coordinators.
 Analyse the impacts of submitted Engineering Change Requests (ECR) to the installation schedule and on project budget.
 Validate equipment integration and ensure the 3D models are updated accordingly.
 Supporting the Work Packages for the de-installation and installation procedure preparation and contributing to the Installation Readiness Reviews required for starting of major installation phases.
 Take part in HL Technical coordination team activities for organising meetings, editing reports, updating SharePoint pages, etc.
 Your profile: 
 Experience with project control and scheduling.
 Experience with multi-stakeholder negotiations.
 Experience with working in the field.
 Skills: 
 Familiarity with MS project.
 Familiarity with CATIA V5 or equivalent.
 Basic knowledge of 3D modelling.
 Spoken and written both English and French.
 Eligibility criteria: 
 You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State .
 By the application deadline, you have a maximum of two years of professional experience since graduation in Mechanical/Electrical/Industrial Engineering (or a related field) and your highest educational qualification is either a Bachelor's or Master's degree .
 You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.
 Applicants without University degree are not eligible.
 Applicants with a PhD are not eligible.

Job closing date: 05.11.2026 at 23:59 CET. 
 Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.
 Working hours: 40 hours per week
 Job flexibility: Fully Onsite
 Target start date: 01-January-2027
 This position involves:
 Work in Radiation Areas.
 Interventions in underground installations.
 A valid driving licence.
 Stand-by duty, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.
 Job reference: ATS-DO-2026-244-GRAE
 Field of work: Facilities & Infrastructure Management
 Benchmark job: 200040 - Electromechanical Engineer
 Global Benefits 
 A monthly net stipend of either 5266 or 5793 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
 Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
 Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
 A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
 Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
 On-the-job and formal training including language classes.
 Overview of CERN - Discover a world where the impossible is made possible! 
 At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.
 Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.
 If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! TAKE PART! 
 More information about us, here: careers.cern

items.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. 
 We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.
 You will:
 - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
 - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
 - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
 - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
 - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality
 Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga
 Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
 Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
 Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.
 Experience working with a remote team
 Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.
 Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .
 Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:
 Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/
 Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.
 Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.
 Double-check email addresses. All communication …

items.desc:
Huawei's Ohm Research Center (Nuremberg) is responsible for Advanced Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning. 
 Huawei Digital Power is a business unit within Huawei that provides Enterprise & Industry customers, products and solutions like clean power generation, transportation electrification, site power facilities, data center facilities, and embedded power. Huawei Digital Power is committed to integrate Digital and Power Electronics technologies to provide customers with high-quality, energy-efficient, green, and low-carbon power electronics products, facilitating their business success 
 The Power Conversion Technology Laboratory within Huawei’s Ohms Research Center in Nuremberg is responsible for Advanced Digital Power Technology Research, Architecture Evolution Design and Strategic Technology Planning, and plays an important role in the Huawei Digital Power business in the design and development of power converters and control systems for applications such as PV Solar & Battery Energy Storage Field, Data Centers, Electric Vehicle, and Embedded Power Supply. 
 Join us as an 
 Technical Expert - System Architecture for Large-Scale PV & BESS (m/f/d) 
 to contribute to the research and development of next-generation large-scale PV and battery energy storage systems at Huawei Power Conversion Technology Laboratory. The position focuses on system architecture, PV-storage coupling, medium-voltage transformer stations and system cost optimization. 
 Your mission 
 · You will lead architecture studies for next-generation large-scale PV and BESS systems, covering string and centralized inverter solutions, Hybrid plants and various large-scale implementations. 
 · You will develop decoupled PV and BESS architectures using dedicated PV inverters and battery PCS, and define the optimal coupling approach at DC, LVAC or MVAC level. 
 · You will define integrated solutions for PV inverters, PCS, transformers, MV switchgear, battery systems and PPC/EMS. 
 · You will formulate key requirements for inverter-transformer and PCS-transformer stations, including voltage, power rating, impedance, losses, cooling, protection and interfaces. 
 · You will drive system cost reduction through architecture simplification, equipment consolidation, optimized power-block sizing and reduced transformer and MV station costs. 
 · You will evaluate technical trade-offs among efficiency, cost, availability, scalability, grid compliance and operational flexibility. 
 · You will collaborate with internal teams, universities and industry partners to validate new system concepts and generate intellectual property 
 Your areas of expertise : 
 · You hold a PhD or Master’s degree in electrical engineering, power electronics, power systems or a related discipline. 
 · You have proven industrial experience in large-scale PV, BESS or hybrid power plant system design. 
 · You are familiar with string and centralized inverter architectures and centralized and distributed PCS solutions. 
 · You have practical experience with MV transformer stations and integrated inverter/PCS-transformer solutions. 
 · You understand transformer selection and cost drivers, including power rating, voltage level, winding configuration, impedance, losses, cooling and integration with MV switchgear. 
 · You have experience in system-level cost optimization and can translate architecture decisions into subsystem requirements. 
 · Experience with PV-storage coupling, PPC/EMS, grid-forming storage and system modelling is highly desirable. You are self-driven, innovative and fluent in written and spoken English. 
 By applying to this position, you agree with our Recruitment Privacy Statement. You can read in full our privacy policy here .
 Your rewards of working here 
 · Our culture is characterized by innovative power and team spirit as well as the intensive exchange of knowledge and experience within our global network. 
 · To keep your development ongoing, you will find a broad range of training opportunities. Many online and face-to-face training programs incl. language courses in German and Mandarin. 
 · Our diverse and welcoming environment is shaped by different backgrounds and around 40 individual nationalities. 
 · Self-responsible work in a competent, motivated and constantly growing team. 
 · Please send your application and CV (incl. cover letter and reference letters) in English. 
 Huawei is a leading global information and communications technology (ICT) solutions provider. Our ICT solutions, products and services are used in more than 170 countries and regions, serving over one-third of the world's population. With 208,000 employees, Huawei is committed to develop the future information society and build a Better Connected World.

items.desc:
The Product Development organization in Aachen is looking for motivated and curious students who want to enlarge hands-on experience in a collaborative, diverse and high-performing team working at the forefront of telecommunications and Artificial Intelligence. 
 Besides working with the local team, you will also interact and collaborate with colleagues around the world. 
 As a Student Helper, you will support the team in developing and validating modern product development solutions while exploring how Artificial Intelligence can transform software engineering processes and ease integration and verification workflows.  High performing networks are critical for 5G and 6G going forward. Ericsson is a 5G market leader and actively driving the 6G innovation.  At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 
 When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.

 YOUR ROLE 
 The candidates work comprises planning, execution, surveillance, data analysis, and reporting of package/wafer level for Electrical Wafer Sorting/Final Test for Reliability supporting on prototypes of discrete power technologies under development (SiC, IGBT, GaN) and on the Bench Characterization of power device (oxides-like SiO2 thermal and deposited oxides, IMD, PMD) and T84 structures. He/She will be involved in the early evaluation of device physics of MOSFETs. He/She will contribute to the single steps of technology qualification validating the Electrical Static performances and identifying, in case of out of spec, the weaknesses helping on the resolving technology issues arised.

 Master degree in physics, material science or electrical/physical engineering. 
 2 years of experience

 Skills in computer programming and numerical modeling are highly appreciated.

At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today. 
 When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 115 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 50,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world. 
 Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential. 
 Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you. 
 A propos de vos missions 
 Rattaché aux fonctions centrales de l’entreprise, vous serez intégré.e à l’équipe Industrial Engineering sur un site de production, avec pour mission de contribuer à l’amélioration de la performance des différentes zones grâce à des solutions avancées de planification et de pilotage de la production.
 Dans un environnement industriel exigeant et en constante évolution, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la définition, le déploiement et l’optimisation des outils de planification de la production.
 Votre objectif sera d’améliorer la performance opérationnelle, de soutenir le déploiement de solutions de Full Fab Scheduling sur les différentes zones de production, et de contribuer à préparer les futures solutions pour relever les défis à venir.
 Définir, déployer et accompagner la solution de scheduling sur les différentes zones de fabrication, en veillant à ce que chaque type de machine suive des règles d’optimisation spécifiques, en collaboration avec DTIT, les équipes de production et la Manufacturing.
 Coordonner avec les zones de production la définition de la liste des règles à intégrer dans le "scheduleur", les prioriser, déployer et optimiser les différents scheduleurs, et suivre le respect de l’exécution.
 Être l’interface avec l’éditeur du logiciel, rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles pour les différents scheduleurs, formuler les demandes d’évolution, suivre leur avancement, tester les fonctionnalités et corriger les problèmes si nécessaire.
 Participer activement aux réunions de production afin de mieux comprendre les besoins et de proposer des améliorations.
 Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de production et les Industrial Engineers pour optimiser au quotidien les scheduleurs et ajuster les paramètres locaux en fonction des objectifs et de la stratégie du site, afin d’améliorer la performance globale de la fabrication.
 Analyser la performance des systèmes de dispatching et de scheduling afin d’améliorer des indicateurs clés tels que l’activité, la qualité, l’OEE, le temps de cycle et les coûts.
 Travailler en coordination avec les autres sites de l’entreprise et l’équipe projet centrale pour déployer la solution globale.

 Structurer la documentation, animer des sessions de formation et contribuer au développement des compétences des équipes postées.
 Participer aux initiatives d’amélioration continue et d’innovation technologique au service de la performance industrielle, en partenariat avec les éditeurs de solutions.

 Diplômé.e d'un Master en génie industriel, systèmes de production, ingénierie, ou dans un domaine similaire.

 Bonne compréhension des indicateurs de performance industrielle tels que l’OEE, le temps de cycle, le débit, la qualité et les coûts.
