items.desc: Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions. Scania Industrial Batteries is part of Scania’s ambition to accelerate the transition to sustainable transport and industrial solutions. The business focuses on developing and commercializing battery systems for industrial applications, leveraging Scania’s expertise in electrification, energy efficiency, and lifecycle sustainability. As part of Ventures and New Business we works closely with customers and partners to deliver innovative battery solutions that support the decarbonization of industries beyond traditional transport, helping create new growth opportunities while contributing to a more sustainable future. Role Summary As a Manufacturing Digital Systems Engineer you will be responsible for the development, integration, maintenance, and continuous improvement of digital manufacturing systems that support production, quality, and traceability. Working closely with Process, Test, and Automation Engineers, you will translate manufacturing needs into reliable software solutions, covering areas such as manufacturing traceability, equipment connectivity, data management, test applications, and production analytics. From solution design and validation through deployment and ongoing support, you will play a key role in driving digitalization, improving manufacturing performance, and exploring AI-assisted tools to enhance operational efficiency and quality. Job Responsibilities Key responsibilities in this role: Develop, maintain, and continuously improve manufacturing applications and digital systems supporting production, quality, and traceability. Integrate new production and test stations by developing software interfaces, equipment connectivity, and data acquisition solutions. Collaborate with Process, Test, and Automation Engineering teams to translate manufacturing requirements into reliable software solutions. Develop applications using C#/.NET, SQL Server, and related technologies to support manufacturing operations. Manage manufacturing data, ensuring accurate product traceability, production records, and test-result tracking. Create reports, dashboards, and data visualization tools to support production performance monitoring and quality improvement initiatives. Develop and maintain integrations between manufacturing systems and enterprise platforms such as MES, ERP, and test data management systems. Ensure software quality through testing, debugging, documentation, version control, and controlled deployment processes. Evaluate and implement AI-assisted tools and capabilities to enhance manufacturing applications and operational efficiency. Drive continuous improvement by standardizing software components, integration methods, and development best practices. Who You Are Degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. Experience developing and maintaining software applications in a manufacturing or industrial environment. Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET and SQL Server . Experience integrating software with production equipment, industrial controllers, automated test systems, or measurement devices. Knowledge of SQL databases, APIs, and industrial communication protocols. Experience with software testing, debugging, deployment, version control, and application lifecycle management. Experience with manufacturing traceability, MES, or production data systems is an advantage. Experience from automotive, battery, electronics, or other quality-critical manufacturing environments is preferred. Professional working proficiency in English. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds – your unique experience and perspectives is valuable to us. This Is Us Electrification is essential to decarbonizing the world, and it needs to happen faster and at scale. At Scania Industrial Batteries, we’re not just responding to change; we’re leading it. Since joining Scania in April 2025 as a newly acquired company, we combine engineering excellence with visionary innovation. We develop high-performance, modular battery systems for demanding off-highway applications, helping industries such as mining, construction, and marine operate more sustainably. Our success is built on collaboration, resilience, and reliability. We challenge conventional thinking, embrace change, and deliver solutions our customers can trust. If you’re passionate about driving electrification and shaping the future with scalable battery systems built for the toughest environments on land and sea, this is the place for you. Join us and help lead the change toward a cleaner, more sustainable world! Scania Industrial …

items.desc: Twice a year, we welcome a new group of interns. Some start with a bootcamp to get up to speed on our stack; others jump straight into a project. Either way, you'll work on real client or internal products, with a mentor beside you and a team you can ask anything. Notify me We will let you know when the recruitment process starts. Real products, a mentor beside you, and a team you can ask anything. We run internships hoping people will stay. Many do – some of them are still here a few years later, now mentoring interns of their own. The internship is where a lot of our engineers started, and we run every edition with that in mind. A few highlights from previous editions The internship has a history here. What you'll actually work on Web and mobile work that ships. We focus on web and mobile projects, divided into two categories: client projects – mostly US startups, but also corporate ones – and internal, often open-source products. Our main technologies are TypeScript, JavaScript, React, and React Native; on the backend, Node.js, Python with Django, and Elixir. Client projects Client work gives you the chance to build products for teams around the world, from early-stage startups to larger organizations. Internal and open-source products Internal work lets you contribute to the open-source tools and products that Software Mansion is known for. How the internship works Real work, from day one. Interns are part of the team from day one and work on real projects – client or internal – alongside our specialists. We recruit to the company, not to specific projects – we'll try to match your preferences, but the assignment depends on our needs when you join. Who we're looking for Smart, curious people with a strong engineering mindset. The internship is open to everyone. You don't need work experience, and it doesn't matter which year of study you're in or whether you're a student at all. What matters is how you present your skills during the recruitment process. We look for smart, curious people with a strong engineering mindset rather than specific skills. However, there are a few requirements that you'll need to meet. Core programming basics: algorithms and data structures, databases, networking, operating systems, web basics, and Git. Polish and English at B2 level or higher. Availability to work mainly from our Kraków office – occasional remote days are fine. Knowing our technologies helps, but if you don't – you'll pick them up during the internship. If you'd like to find out how our recruitment process works, feel free to visit our blog. In their words What former interns remember. A few people who started their Software Mansion story with an internship. “I was treated like a real teammate from day one, with trust, real ownership, and work that actually mattered. What stuck with me most is the confidence to jump in, take responsibility, and trust that I can figure things out along the way.” Szymon Szołdra Winter 2022 “Starting out as an intern here was the best way to get real React Native experience from day one. Being able to work alongside and learn from devs who contribute to core RN libraries was an absolute highlight. That hands-on guidance made all the difference for where I am today.” Bartek Szar Summer 2023 “What stood out most to me was the trust I received from day one, giving me the opportunity to work on real projects that people actually use every day. At the same time, I never felt left on my own, as my mentor and colleagues were always eager to help me navigate any challenges. Ultimately, the vibrant culture and engaging activities created a welcoming environment where I always felt truly comfortable in the office.” Piotr Rzadkowski Summer 2023 “The range of work surprised me (in a good way) – one week I'd be doing a landing page, the next a much bigger system, plus things like big conference sites along the way. But the real thing I took from the internship is the people. It's hard to stay in place when everyone around you is clearly trying to get better at what they do.” Szymon Halski Winter 2026 “The internship at SWM was an incredible experience for me. Even without any prior experience in RN, I was able to start earning money while developing my skills by reading documentation and building mobile apps. It was great to watch the product evolve with each passing day of the internship and to feel that I had an impact on it.” Dawid Jagieła Summer 2016 “I think the internship at SWM was one of the most valuable experiences for my career. I got to own a real project from start to finish, worked closely with the client and had real autonomy from day one. The team was very welcoming and the vibe in the office was chill and supportive. Five years later, I'm still here, which I think says everything about the foundation that experience created. ” Kasia Płoskonka Summer 2021 “From day one, I was working with top experts and had an amazing mentor by my side. Uwaga: W naszych procesach rekrutacyjnych nie korzystamy z AI. Każda aplikacja jest dokładnie analizowana przez menedżera zatrudniającego i/lub rekrutera, aby zapewnić rzetelną i spersonalizowaną ocenę. Jeśli w trakcie procesu rekrutacyjnego potrzebujesz jakichkolwiek dostosowań ze względu na niepełnosprawność lub inne okoliczności, poinformuj nas o tym podczas aplikowania. O Fortum Fortum to nordyckie przedsiębiorstwo energetyczne. Niezawodnie wytwarzamy i dostarczamy energię naszym klientom oraz do nordyckiego systemu energetycznego, jednocześnie wspierając przemysł w rozwoju i dekarbonizacji procesów. Nasza podstawowa działalność obejmuje wysokojakościowe i efektywne wytwarzanie energii o niskiej emisji dwutlenku węgla, usługi dla klientów oraz ciepło systemowe i chłodnictwo. Już 99% energii produkowanej w Fortum pochodzi z odnawialnych lub jądrowych źródeł, co daje nam jedne z najniższych emisji CO2 w Europie. Kierujemy się ambitnymi, zatwierdzonymi przez SBTi celami redukcji emisji na drodze do osiągnięcia zerowej emisji netto do 2040 roku. Jesteśmy bezpiecznym i inspirującym miejscem pracy dla około 4 500 naszych pracowników. items.title: Junior Software Engineer (C++), Authentication Team - Splunk
items.card: Your Impact As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will contribute to designing, building, and improving identity services that support authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement secure and scalable features, maintain existing components, and learn best practices in distributed systems.
items.desc: Meet the Team The Platform Identity builds the secure foundation that enables millions of users to access the Splunk and Cisco ecosystem seamlessly and safely. Our mission is to deliver a centralized Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform that is scalable, resilient, and intelligent. We collaborate closely with product, security, and infrastructure teams to unify identity across the entire portfolio. If you’re passionate about learning modern identity technologies, solving meaningful engineering challenges, and growing your skills in a supportive environment, this team is the perfect place to start your journey. Your Impact As a Junior Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will contribute to designing, building, and improving identity services that support authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will work closely with senior engineers to implement secure and scalable features, maintain existing components, and learn best practices in distributed systems. You will have opportunities to explore identity protocols, contribute to API development, and get hands-on experience with modern security and IAM technologies. Success in this role means demonstrating curiosity, growth, solid technical fundamentals, and the ability to collaborate effectively with your team. Minimum Qualifications Academic or early professional experience in software development (internships, projects, open-source contributions, or equivalent). Basic understanding of authentication or authorization concepts (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0 are a plus, but not mandatory). Fundamental programming skills inC++ and/or Go (university coursework or project experience acceptable). Understanding of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms, networking basics). Eagerness to learn secure, distributed systems and identity technologies. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to AI/ML concepts or coursework. Familiarity with cloud services or IAM concepts (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) at a basic level. Knowledge of directory services (LDAP or Active Directory) or willingness to learn. Participation in open-source projects, coding competitions, or personal technical projects. Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Monitorowaniem jakości danych w kluczowych systemach, identyfikowaniem niezgodności, duplikatów oraz braków w danych i wspieraniem działań naprawczych. Dokumentowaniem przepływów danych i procesów zarządzania danymi oraz tworzeniem i utrzymywaniem słowników danych (Data Dictionary). Przygotowywaniem raportów, analiz i dashboardów w Power BI wspierających podejmowanie decyzji biznesowych. Wykorzystywaniem narzędzi AI, takich jak Microsoft Copilot czy Claude, do usprawniania pracy z danymi. Automatyzacją powtarzalnych procesów przy użyciu Power Automate i podobnych rozwiązań. CZEGO OD CIEBIE OCZEKUJEMY? Wykształcenia wyższego oraz rozwiniętych umiejętności analitycznych i dbałości o szczegóły. Umiejętności identyfikowania anomalii, niespójności i problemów jakościowych w danych oraz wyciągania trafnych wniosków. Znajomości podstaw zarządzania danymi, w tym takich obszarów jak Data Governance, Data Lineage, Data Dictionary oraz cykl życia danych. Umiejętności mapowania przepływu danych pomiędzy systemami i dokumentowania procesów związanych z danymi. (to już bardzo zaawansowane, usunęłabym to) Praktycznej znajomości narzędzi AI oraz umiejętności tworzenia skutecznych promptów i wykorzystywania AI do analizy danych i raportowania. Komunikatywności i umiejętności współpracy z interesariuszami biznesowymi. Dobrej znajomości języka angielskiego w mowie i piśmie. Dobrej znajomości programu Excel. Mile widziane: Doświadczenie w tworzeniu raportów i dashboardów w Power BI. Znajomość Power Automate lub innych narzędzi do automatyzacji procesów. Podstawowa znajomość modelowania danych, relacji między tabelami oraz języka DAX. items.card: Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will design, build, and operate the core identity services that power authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will architect scalable and secure APIs, unify identity systems, and serve as a subject matter expert on modern identity protocols. Your work will directly strengthen platform security,
items.desc: Meet the Team The Platform Identity builds the secure foundation that enables millions of users to access the Splunk and Cisco ecosystem seamlessly and safely. Our mission is to deliver a centralized Identity and Access Management (IAM) platform that is scalable, resilient, and intelligent. We are a highly collaborative engineering group working across product, security, and infrastructure teams to unify identity across the entire portfolio. If you’re inspired by large-scale engineering challenges and shaping the future of secure user experiences, you’ll feel right at home with us. Your Impact As a Software Engineer on the Platform Identity, you will design, build, and operate the core identity services that power authentication, authorization, and user lifecycle management across Splunk and Cisco products. You will architect scalable and secure APIs, unify identity systems, and serve as a subject matter expert on modern identity protocols. Your work will directly strengthen platform security, improve customer trust, and influence our long-term identity strategy. You will also explore opportunities to use AI/ML to increase automation and enhance identity protection. Success in this role means delivering reliable services, driving technical excellence, and collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams to ship impactful solutions. Minimum Qualifications Significant professional experience in software engineering delivering scalable, production-grade services. Hands-on expertise with identity protocols such as SAML, OpenID Connect (OIDC), and OAuth 2.0. Experience designing and implementing authorization models (RBAC, ABAC). Strong programming skills in C++ OR/AND Go. Experience building secure, distributed, and fault-tolerant systems. Preferred Qualifications Experience applying AI/ML techniques in the identity, security, or platform engineering space. Familiarity with cloud provider IAM services (AWS IAM, Azure AD, Google Cloud Identity). Knowledge of directory services such as LDAP or Active Directory. Contributions to open-source IAM projects or communities. Strong cross-functional communication skills and ability to partner with product, security, and engineering teams. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

The scope covers a wide array of tasks, including portfolio management delegate oversight, product lifecycle oversight, and production of relevant internal and external reporting while remaining abreast with fast evolving EU regulatory framework. Summary of our opportunity Intermediate Capital Group (ICG) is an FTSE-100 listed alternative asset manager with over 30 years' history, managing over $100bn of assets and investing across the capital structure. The Risk & Controls Function team consists of professionals based in London, Luxembourg and Poland. The Control Functions (Risk, Compliance and Internal Audit) team operates across London, the US, Luxembourg and Poland. Reporting to the Luxembourg-based team, this role will primarily support product lifecycle oversight and delegated portfolio manager oversight. The scope includes new product approvals, post-NPA activities and sign-off, material fund changes and liquidations, together with the initial due diligence and ongoing monitoring of delegated portfolio managers. The role will also support the integration of ESG and sustainability considerations across these processes and the preparation of reporting to the Executive Committee and Board of Managers. The role requires intellectual breadth and agility, strong organisational and analytical capabilities, and the ability to coordinate with internal departments and external service providers. The successful candidate will have a problem-solving mindset, good communication and partnering skills, and the ability to work effectively with colleagues based in London, Luxembourg and Warsaw. Coordinating post-NPA activities, including tracking the completion of contracts, actions and formal sign-off requirements. Maintaining ongoing oversight of AIFM products throughout their lifecycle and supporting appropriate reporting and escalation to the governing bodies. Supporting the governance and oversight of material fund changes, restructurings and liquidation events in collaboration with Operations, Fund Legal and other relevant stakeholders. Supporting the integration of ESG and sustainability considerations across the NPA, product lifecycle and portfolio manager oversight processes. Supporting the performance of ongoing monitoring - due diligence of delegated portfolio managers in accordance with the applicable oversight framework. Maintaining portfolio manager oversight schedules, due diligence records and monitoring templates, and supporting the escalation and reporting of material observations. Contributing to the simplification, standardisation and continuous improvement of processes, templates, governance records and reporting. Identifying opportunities to use technology, including approved AI-enabled tools, to improve process efficiency while maintaining appropriate governance and controls. items.desc: Strategia, Zgodność i Zarządzanie (Governance & Compliance) Współpraca z Dyrekcją przy budowaniu kultury i strategii bezpieczeństwa oraz adaptacji standardów korporacyjnych, w tym frameworku NIST. Zapewnienie zgodności organizacji z kluczowymi regulacjami rynkowymi i europejskimi (m.in. NIS2, CRA, RODO). Opracowywanie polityk bezpieczeństwa, definiowanie i raportowanie wskaźników KPI do Zarządu oraz facylitacja komitetów sterujących ds. bezpieczeństwa. Zarządzanie Ryzykiem i Architektura (Security by Design) Opracowywanie i bieżąca aktualizacja mapy ryzyk cybernetycznych oraz realizacja adekwatnych mechanizmów kontrolnych (Kontrola N2). Eksperckie wsparcie działu projektowego gwarantujące integrację wymagań bezpieczeństwa od wczesnych faz koncepcyjnych (Security by Design), w tym weryfikacja architektury i nadzór nad zlecanymi testami penetracyjnymi. Operacje i Zabezpieczenia Techniczne (SecOps & Protection) Projektowanie, wdrażanie oraz utrzymywanie platform zabezpieczających infrastrukturę, w szczególności rozwiązań klasy EDR/XDR, mechanizmów uwierzytelniania wieloskładnikowego (MFA) oraz firewalli. Ciągła weryfikacja efektywności zabezpieczeń w ramach całej floty urządzeń (serwery, stacje robocze, urządzenia mobilne, aplikacje). Kompleksowa realizacja procesu Vulnerability Management – od detekcji podatności, przez rekomendacje mitygacyjne, po nadzór nad wdrożeniem poprawek we współpracy z działem IT. Monitorowanie i Reagowanie na Incydenty (Detection & Incident Response) Analiza alertów z systemów bezpieczeństwa oraz koordynacja działań zewnętrznego centrum operacyjnego (SOC) w celu zapewnienia ciągłości monitoringu w trybie HNO (obsługa i reagowanie poza standardowymi godzinami pracy). Kompleksowe zarządzanie incydentami bezpieczeństwa: identyfikacja, mitygacja zagrożeń oraz opracowywanie działań naprawczych w ramach procedury RETEX (analiza poakcyjna typu lessons learned). Optymalizacja procedur reagowania na incydenty oraz projektowanie i koordynacja cyklicznych ćwiczeń kryzysowych. Budowanie Świadomości (Awareness) Kształtowanie świadomości zagrożeń poprzez realizację rocznych planów szkoleniowych dla całej organizacji, w tym koordynację symulacji phishingowych oraz modułów e-learningowych. Transfer wiedzy i prowadzenie specjalistycznych warsztatów podnoszących kompetencje z zakresu bezpieczeństwa dla zespołów IT 170 zł - 200 zł an hour Ekspert ds. Cyberbezpieczeństwa (GRC & SecOps) Zaangażowanie: Pełny wymiar Cel roli: Kompleksowe zarządzanie obszarem cyberbezpieczeństwa w organizacji. Współpraca obejmuje pełne spektrum działań – od kreowania strategii i zapewnienia zgodności prawnej, po wdrażanie zabezpieczeń technicznych, monitorowanie zagrożeń oraz reagowanie na incydenty. Realizacja powyższych obszarów ma na celu zbudowanie proaktywnego modelu ochrony organizacji, minimalizację ryzyka cybernetycznego oraz zagwarantowanie najwyższych standardów bezpieczeństwa, adekwatnych do surowych wymogów regulacyjnych i operacyjnych. Rola stanowi centralny punkt kompetencyjny, łączący architekturę bezpieczeństwa z bieżącym reagowaniem na ewoluujące zagrożenia. items.desc: Location WARSAW, Poland Category Information Technology Job Id R000160815 Job Type Full time Experienced Professionals Job Location WARSAW PLANT & GO Job Description The Trade Promotion & Analytics (TP&A) organization is embarking on a mission-critical initiative to consolidate our diverse enterprise data landscape into a single, unified data foundation. To achieve this, we are seeking a skilled, hands-on Data Engineer (Databricks) to join our team in Warsaw. In this role, you will be at the core of designing and implementing a cohesive relational and analytical data model by integrating data across multiple systems. You will combine hands-on engineering—building robust, scalable pipelines in Databricks and Azure —with technical stewardship, serving as the subject matter expert and reviewer for external vendor developers. Your work will directly empower global teams with faster, more reliable insights and establish the data backbone for future analytics. If you have strong technical depth in Python, SQL, Databricks , and data modeling, and enjoy driving high-quality engineering standards, we would love to connect with you. Key Responsibilities 1. Hands-On Development & Implementation (40%) Design, build, test, and deploy automated data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes on our Azure and Databricks platform. Write clean, maintainable, production-ready code in Python and PySpark for data transformations, integrations, and aggregations. Develop, tune, and optimize complex SQL queries to ensure high performance and efficient pipeline execution. Ensure end-to-end data quality, consistency, and reliability across all production data flows. 2. Data Modeling & Engineering Design (30%) Actively contribute to designing and implementing a harmonized relational and analytical data model that serves as the single source of truth for downstream analytics. Analyze existing multi-source data models and schemas to understand data flows, entity relationships, constraints, and business logic. Collaborate closely with Data Analysts and business stakeholders to translate analytical requirements into robust, scalable data structures. Ensure data modeling consistency, best practices, and thorough architectural documentation across data assets. 3. Technical Delivery & Vendor Oversight (30%) Act as the technical point of contact, SME, and quality gatekeeper for deliverables developed by external vendor engineers. Perform structured code reviews and pull request (PR) approvals to ensure compliance with P&G coding, testing, and security standards. Partner with the Product Owner to track delivery milestones, technical trade-offs, and early mitigation of technical debt. Promote best engineering practices, continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD), and shared team standards. Job Qualifications Technical Ownership & Guidance: Demonstrated experience conducting code reviews, establishing best practices, and providing technical guidance to junior peers or external vendor developers. Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to project stakeholders. Data Modeling: Expert-level understanding and hands-on experience with relational data modeling, data warehousing concepts (e.g., star/snowflake schemas), and database design. SQL Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including writing complex queries, performance tuning, and working with advanced functions across different database systems. Python & PySpark: Advanced programming skills in Python for data manipulation (e.g., Pandas) and proven, hands-on experience developing solutions with PySpark in a distributed computing environment. Cloud & Big Data : Strong, practical experience with the Azure data stack (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics) and the Databricks platform. Analytical Mindset: Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with a demonstrated ability to deconstruct complex business and data problems. We offer P&G-sized projects and access to world leading IT partners and technologies from Day 1. Wide range of self-development possibilities (training and certifications paths). Competitive starting salary and benefits program (private health care, P&G stock, saving plans, sport cards). Regular salary increases and possible promotions - in line with your results and performance. Opportunity to change role every few years to be in the best place for you and best for P&G. Hier wirst du für das, was du bist, wertgeschätzt, akzeptiert und respektiert. Dies schafft ein Umfeld, in dem du sowohl persönlich als auch beruflich wachsen kannst. Die Position Health care is changing: Radical innovation, increased openness to change, increasing patient empowerment, multiple sources of medical information, and pressure on public spending. As a result of all this, the needs of our stakeholders continue to evolve. The Patient Journey Partner (PJP) is at the center of the new Roche organization, turning upside down the role we play in society - from mostly offering world-class medicines towards much more partnering, innovating and leading generative disruption. By doing so the PJP will be directly accountable to deliver better outcomes for patients, their community, the ecosystem and the organisation, faster. The PJP is an empowered leader and the local face of Roche. She or he partners closely with all stakeholders directly touching the patient journey (in a given therapeutic or disease area), gaining a deep understanding of their needs in order to connect Roche’s capabilities to co-create meaningful solutions. Key Responsibilities The PJP focuses on the importance of bringing the outside in, working with partners to uncover all potential opportunities to transform outcomes for patients, faster. They also bring the inside out, to bring Roche expertise, science and knowledge to the ecosystem. Acts as trusted partner and is the primary (but non-exclusive) point of contact between stakeholders and Roche; the PJP shares the patient and stakeholder community needs internally, prioritizes and secures resources, and drives solutions that deliver outcomes faster. Partners with patient journey stakeholders to remove roadblocks and unlock possibilities to deliver value for patients and the community. Stewards Roche’s products through their lifecycle and supports their appropriate use, which includes sharing their merits with HCPs in a truthful and balanced manner. By overseeing the patient journey in its entirety, the PJP acts as a system thinker with the ability to identify shared purpose among stakeholders and leverages this to co-create solutions with stakeholders in the ecosystem. The role is empowered to pull in expertise and resources locally and from the network as needed, including in collaboration with other PJPs. Ensuring great experiences whenever stakeholders in the ecosystem engage with Roche employees, products and service. Roche Mandatory Responsibilities Respects and implements the values of the company: Integrity, Courage and Passion. Complies, along with the team, with all Roche Corporate Business principles, Code of Conduct, policies and practices. Maintains awareness of the company’s requirements to fully report adverse events and other reportable drug safety and product complain information. items.desc: Job Reference 459_26_CS_CTHPC_RE1 Position LLVM Software Engineer (RE1) Closing Date Saturday, 24 October, 2026 Reference: 459_26_CS_CTHPC_RE1 Job title: LLVM Software Engineer (RE1) About BSC The Barcelona Supercomputing Center - Centro Nacional de Supercomputación (BSC-CNS) is the leading supercomputing center in Spain. The mission of BSC is to research, develop and manage information technologies in order to facilitate scientific progress. BSC combines HPC service provision and R&D into both computer and computational science (life, earth and engineering sciences) under one roof, and currently has over 1000 staff from 60 countries. Look at the BSC experience: BSC-CNS YouTube Channel Let's stay connected with BSC Folks! We promote Equity, Diversity and Inclusion, fostering an environment where each and every one of us is appreciated for who we are, regardless of our differences. We are looking for a software engineer that wants to push forward this ecosystem by implementing support for vector support code generation and other features that can speed-up typical HPC applications when running on RISC-V. Key Duties Improve the code generation for the RISC-V Vector Extension to make the most of the available instruction set when it comes to segmented memory accesses. Collaborate with upstream LLVM/Clang to the extent possible and contribute if there is interest in the LLVM community for the implemented features. Requirements Education Bachelor or Master degree in Computer Science. Essential Knowledge and Professional Experience Good skills in C++. Experience in compiler development. Knowledge of LLVM and Clang codebases Additional Knowledge and Professional Experience Good knowledge of Linux low level interfaces would be a plus. items.desc: G+D makes the lives of billions of people around the world more secure. We shape trust in the digital age with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. We have been a reliable partner for our customers for over 170 years with our innovative solutions for SecurityTech! We are an international technology group and traditional family business with over 14,000 employees in 40 countries. Creating Confidence is our path to success. Trust is the basis of our collaboration within G+D. We are the reliable partner for all challenges resulting from the Internet of Things. We offer a complete connectivity portfolio for mobile network operators, automotive manufacturers, technology companies such as chip and module manufacturers as well as transport and logistics providers. Our portfolio includes highly secure solutions in the area of connectivity & IoT, from classic SIM, eSIM and iSIM, to the associated embedded operating systems and life cycle management, through to services for global connectivity and IoT solutions. Do you want to actively shape the digital transformation with us? Every time someone unlocks a smartphone, activates an eSIM, connects a smartwatch, starts a connected car, or uses an IoT device, G+D technology is working behind the scenes.Giesecke+Devrient (G+D) is a global technology company that develops solutions for security in the physical and digital worlds. Every day, billions of people rely on our technologies for secure connectivity, digital identities, payments, and data protection.At G+D Mobile Security, we have been working on secure connectivity for decades. We delivered the world's first commercial SIM card in 1991 and have continued to develop technologies that support mobile communications around the world. Today, our solutions include SIM, eSIM, IoT, and digital identity technologies used by billions of connected devices.We're looking for a talented and motivated Embedded Software Engineer to join our Research & Development team in Barcelona. What You'll Work On Have you ever wondered how smartphones, connected cars, smartwatches, industrial sensors, and other IoT devices connect securely to mobile networks?As an Embedded Software Engineer, you'll design, implement, and optimize embedded software for secure, high-performance systems. You'll work on solutions that enable reliable communication between people, devices, and machines around the world.Our Barcelona R&D center develops solutions used by some of the world's leading smartphone manufacturers, automotive companies, and IoT companies. You'll work closely with software engineers, system architects, testers, and product owners in an international environment.Your work will contribute directly to the reliability, scalability, and security of our products. Our Culture At G+D, we believe that good technology starts with good teamwork. We work in an open and collaborative environment where people share ideas, take ownership, and learn from each other.You'll be part of an international team with different backgrounds and expertise, working together on challenging engineering projects. items.desc: The Institute The Centre for Genomic Regulation (CRG) is an international biomedical research institute of excellence, based in Barcelona, Spain, with more than 400 scientists from 44 countries. Opportunities for conference attendance and career development are available. Professional experience Must have Understanding of experimental design and statistical concepts relevant to high-throughput sequencing data Experience analysing omics data, such as RNA-seq, WGS/WES, or single-cell sequencing data Ability to interpret analysis results in a biological context and identify potential technical or analytical biases Proficiency in R and/or Python, with working knowledge of Bash Experience developing, implementing, or maintaining bioinformatics pipelines Experience with workflow management systems such as Nextflow, Snakemake, or similar Experience with Git for version control and collaborative development Comfortable working in Linux/Unix and high-performance computing (HPC) environments Understanding of reproducibility and good practices in scientific computing Basic experience with container technologies such as Docker or Singularity/Apptainer Experience collaborating with researchers to define analytical approaches and interpret results. Experience providing training and user support Nice to have Experience with software maintenance, testing, and troubleshooting Experience preparing technical documentation and standard operating procedures (SOPs) Familiarity with CI/CD practices Experience supporting technical personnel and operational workflows in a genomics or sequencing technology environment Experience evaluating, benchmarking, or implementing new sequencing technologies or bioinformatics method Education and training PhD or MSc in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, or related field Languages Proficiency in spoken and written English Competences Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities and work independently. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to make independent technical decisions. Clear written and verbal communication skills. Collaborative and service-oriented working style. Ability to communicate effectively with people from different scientific and technical backgrounds, including experimental biologists, laboratory technicians, researchers, software developers, and bioinformaticians. Ability to translate scientific and technical requirements into practical bioinformatics solutions. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive. The Role 1. Implantación de Plataformas Cloud Participar en la implantación de arquitecturas híbridas y multicloud, integrando servicios cloud con entornos on-premises conforme a los diseños definidos por los Cloud Architects. Implementar Enterprise Landing Zones, redes, identidades y servicios compartidos sobre AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. Desplegar plataformas Cloud AI-Ready, habilitando los servicios de datos, infraestructura y capacidades necesarias para soportar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning, de acuerdo con la arquitectura definida. Automatizar el despliegue de infraestructura mediante Terraform y herramientas CI/CD. Participar en proyectos de migración, modernización e integración de aplicaciones hacia la nube. 2. Ejecución Técnica y Soporte a Proyectos Desarrollar las configuraciones técnicas e integraciones necesarias para el despliegue de plataformas y servicios cloud. Participar en revisiones técnicas, validaciones de arquitectura y actividades de integración, aportando conocimiento práctico sobre los servicios del hyperscaler. Proporcionar soporte técnico especializado a los equipos de delivery durante las fases de implantación, migración y puesta en producción. Colaborar en la validación técnica de las soluciones implantadas, asegurando su alineamiento con la arquitectura definida y las mejores prácticas establecidas. Generar la documentación técnica y los entregables del proyecto, colaborando con el Cloud Architect y los equipos técnicos para garantizar la correcta implantación y transferencia de conocimientos. 3. Automatización y Mejora Continua Desarrollar y mantener módulos reutilizables de Infrastructure as Code. Desarrollar scripts y automatizaciones que faciliten el despliegue, configuración e integración de servicios cloud. Participar en la evolución de pipelines DevOps y procesos CI/CD. Colaborar en la definición y aplicación de estándares técnicos, buenas prácticas y activos reutilizables de la práctica Cloud. Who You Are Conocimientos Técnicos Esenciales: Experiencia Cloud demostrable: 2-4 años trabajando con AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud. Infraestructura: Conocimientos de redes, VPC/VNet, DNS, VPN, balanceadores, almacenamiento y sistemas Linux/Windows. Infrastructure as Code: Experiencia práctica con Terraform (CloudFormation, ARM o Bicep valorable). Containers: Conocimientos de Kubernetes, OpenShift y plataformas de contenedores. DevOps: Experiencia con Git, CI/CD y herramientas de automatización. Scripting: Python, Bash o PowerShell. Observabilidad: Conocimientos de Logging, Monitoring y herramientas de observabilidad. Conocimientos de plataformas de datos e Inteligencia Artificial en la nube (Azure AI, Amazon Bedrock, Google Vertex AI o equivalentes), así como de arquitecturas AI-Ready y servicios gestionados para IA Generativa y Machine Learning. Seguridad: Conocimientos de IAM, controles de seguridad cloud y buenas prácticas de hardening. Habilidades y Mentalidad Clave (Soft Skills): Capacidad para trabajar en equipos multidisciplinares. Orientación a la automatización y mejora continua. Mentalidad analítica y resolución de problemas. Buenas capacidades de comunicación con equipos técnicos. Capacidad para aprender nuevas tecnologías cloud de forma continua. Proactividad y orientación al cliente. Cualificaciones Deseables: Certificaciones Associate o Profesionales de AWS, Azure o Google Cloud. Experiencia en Terraform. Conocimientos de Enterprise Landing Zones. Experiencia en proyectos de migración cloud. Grado en Informática, Ingeniería de Telecomunicaciones o experiencia equivalente. Being You The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. items.desc: We power people’s progress. At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact. We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale. Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day. Meet the team! Preply’s Copy team works across Brand, CRM, and Product. As Preply grows, we need better ways to understand demand, manage priorities and help our writers deliver consistently at scale. As our Copy Operations Specialist, you will build and improve the operating system for copy at Preply: the workflows, tools, data, and AI-enabled processes that make work visible and keep it moving. We’re looking for a practical problem-solver. Working closely with the Copy team and cross-functional partners, you’ll turn ideas into useful shared systems and help shape what effective AI-enabled work looks like at Preply. What you’ll be doing Help improve how copy work flows Build and maintain a clear, shared view of copy demand, priorities and capacity across the team by bringing together relevant information from tools such as Jira, Slack and squad boards. Improve copy intake so requests arriving in different formats become clear, actionable briefs. Coordinate the team’s weekly prioritization process, highlighting conflicting priorities, dependencies and capacity risks. Identify repetitive coordination tasks that could be simplified or automated, including follow-ups around deadlines, reviews, and handovers. Gather feedback and improve these processes as the volume and complexity of work increase. Apply AI and automation to operations and performance Identify opportunities to reduce operational friction and improve planning, quality, speed, consistency, and learning. Design, test and introduce AI-enabled workflows for areas such as briefing, workflow management, reporting and insight. items.desc: Defend the critical technology that keeps the world moving safely. For over 160 years, Siemens Mobility has been a global leader, innovating transportation solutions that move the world. We lead the way in Rolling Stock, Rail Automation & Electrification, Turnkey Systems, Intelligent Traffic Systems, and comprehensive Related Services. Through digitalization, we empower operators worldwide to create intelligent infrastructure, enhance passenger experience, and ensure unparalleled availability. Join us in transforming Mobility Management, Turnkey Projects, Electrification, Mainline & Urban Transport, and Customer Services. If you're ready to make a real impact on a more connected and sustainable future, your journey starts here. Your mission in our team As an Engineering Cybersecurity Specialist , you will protect the operational technology (OT) and industrial systems that drive global railway infrastructure. You will coordinate cybersecurity across the entire project lifecycle, ensuring our signalling solutions are secure by design while balancing safety, high availability, and operational continuity. You’ll make a difference by Provide support to commercial and bid teams when required, while remaining primarily focused on project execution. This includes analysing opportunities and customer specifications, identifying key cybersecurity needs and risks, and contributing to preliminary proposals aligned with tender requirements and Siemens’ technological approach. Prepare, maintain, and implement the project-specific Cybersecurity Management Plan, applying and tailoring the principles, processes, and technical guidance of the IEC 62443 series, CENELEC TS 50701, and IEC 63452, as applicable. Perform or contribute to the Threat and Risk Analysis based on the project architecture, operational context, applicable requirements, and identified threats and vulnerabilities, and maintain it throughout the project lifecycle. Collect and analyse cybersecurity requirements originating from customer specifications, applicable standards and regulations in the countries where projects are delivered, and Siemens’ internal policies and requirements. Harmonise these inputs into a coherent, traceable, and technically feasible set of requirements, allocate them to systems, subsystems, components, suppliers, and partners, and incorporate them into the solution delivered to the customer. Work with customer and Siemens stakeholders to reconcile priorities, resolve gaps or conflicts, and align the final customer’s cybersecurity expectations with Siemens’ technological proposal. Contribute to system and solution architecture, defining and implementing appropriate security controls and defence-in-depth concepts, including zones and conduits, network segmentation, hardening, access control, physical security considerations, and secure configuration standards. Support the selection and secure integration of Siemens and third-party products, technologies, suppliers, customer-specific mechanisms, and shared infrastructure services. Address operational security capabilities such as intrusion detection, security monitoring, malware protection, vulnerability management, and security patch management, considering safety, availability, and lifecycle constraints. Act as the cybersecurity interface for project management, system and subsystem engineering, R&D, testing, installation, suppliers, partners, and customers, providing clear guidance and supporting security-related decisions. Plan, coordinate, and support cybersecurity verification and validation activities—including security requirement verification, vulnerability assessments, and penetration testing—evaluate findings against the Threat and Risk Analysis, and define or follow up corrective and risk-mitigation actions. Support installation, commissioning, operation, maintenance, and cybersecurity handover by providing guidance and awareness, and by clearly communicating relevant documentation, residual risks, operational measures, and responsibilities. Monitor and follow up security vulnerabilities and incidents affecting the system or project, coordinating their assessment, treatment, documentation, and communication with the appropriate stakeholders. Your success is grounded in A Degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Cybersecurity, or equivalent practical expertise. Solid experience (typically 3+ years) in cybersecurity engineering, OT security, or system engineering within critical infrastructure. A deep understanding of defence-in-depth, network segmentation, vulnerability management, and secure system integration. The ability to balance strict cybersecurity objectives with the safety, legacy, and lifecycle constraints of railway operations. A proactive, analytical mindset with the ability to take ownership of complex challenges and communicate solutions clearly. Fluency in English (C1) and the willingness to travel internationally when required. …

items.desc: Join an exciting journey to build and scale a global Media Data Foundation for a leading global organization based in Europe. This platform brings together paid media, digital analytics and marketing performance data from dozens of advertising and measurement platforms. It unlocks reliable media reporting, marketing ROI measurement and data-driven investment decisions across markets. As a Middle Data Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and implementing the platform's architecture. The focus is on hands-on technical execution and collaboration with cross-functional teams. Your work will turn raw media and marketing data into trusted, harmonised data products used by marketing, media and analytics teams around the world. You will use modern tools to solve complex challenges, working alongside skilled architects, engineers and business stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Hands-On Development: Build, maintain and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, transformation and delivery of media data (Meta, Google Ads, DV360, TikTok, The Trade Desk, GA4, CM360 and others). Create and implement scalable solutions to handle many data sources, frequent API and schema changes, and high volumes of data. Data Modeling & Warehousing: Design and maintain efficient, harmonised data models for cross-platform media reporting in Snowflake. Lead the move of transformation logic to dbt, including orchestration, testing, documentation and CI/CD. Collaboration: Partner with Solution Architects to translate high-level designs into detailed implementation plans. Work closely with Technical Product Owners, media agencies and market teams to align data solutions with business needs. Platform Development: Enable data readiness for media dashboards (Power BI), marketing mix modelling / ROI analytics and campaign taxonomy governance. Implement robust frameworks to monitor data freshness, completeness, quality and pipeline performance, with automated alerting. Security & Compliance: Implement robust access controls and data protection across the pipeline and for data shared with internal and external consumers. Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA) and internal data governance policies (data product tiers, tagging, naming standards). Monitor and address potential vulnerabilities, including service account and secret management, ensuring the platform follows security best practices. Requirements: 2+ years of experience showing technical expertise and critical thinking in data engineering. Hands-on experience with dbt and strong Python programming skills. Proficiency in Snowflake and strong expertise in data modeling are essential. Demonstrated experience with marketing, media or advertising data (ad platform APIs, campaign hierarchies, web analytics) is required. In-depth understanding of security and governance in Snowflake: RBAC, secure views, data sharing, masking and row access policies, object tagging. Ability to design, implement and promote solution patterns and standards for complex, multi-source data platforms. Familiarity with multiple cloud platforms (Azure or GCP preferred, with a focus on Azure, including ADF). Experience with ETL/ELT and data integration tools (Adverity, Fivetran or similar) and batch orchestration. Competence in SQL, relational database design and efficient methods for data retrieval and preparation at scale. Proven ability to collect and process raw data at scale, including scripting, REST API integration and SQL querying. Experience with BI tools (Power BI preferred) and supporting reporting consumers. Experience working in global environments and collaborating with virtual teams and external agencies. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Economics or a related discipline. RESPONSIBILITIES Our domain is involved in a wide variety of programs, like military tactical transports (CN-235, C-295, A400M, FMTC), Airbus derivatives and tankers (A330 MRTT, A321-AEW), fighters (EF-2000, FCAS), UAVs (Eurodrone, Sirtap) and technological programs. The main activities that are done in these programs are: Loads models building for flight and ground loads. Management of 6DOF simulation codes for manoeuvre and gust conditions. Load analysis for design, fatigue, 1g, failure cases and operational loads, including trade-offs for sensitivity studies. Nodal loads generation for FEM (NASTRAN). Clearances of flight and ground loads to achieve "Permits to Fly" of prototypes. Specification, tracking and analysis of Flight Tests, regarding loads measurements, with post-flight adjustment of load models if needed. Continuous software development and maintenance of methods and tools for loads calculation. Writing certification documents and presentation to Airworthiness Authorities. Continuous airworthiness support and fleet analysis. Continuous support to aircraft preliminary design. SKILLS To perform the above passionate tasks, the members of our team have: A great entushiasm and predilection for technical work. A multidisciplinary profile and great learning capacity. Good analytical and synthesis capabilities. Ability to make decisions and present alternatives. Great teamwork skills. Advanced level of English. WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants. On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office. items.desc: Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. How we work at Aircall : We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here. Software Engineer – Graduate (6-month Professional Practice Contract), Multiple teams, Conversational Intelligence, Authentication, Agent Productivity, Data Platform, Commerce Platform Madrid Office, hybrid (3 days per week in the office) This is an entry-level role under a 6-month Spanish contrato formativo para la obtención de la práctica profesional (training contract for professional practice). It's designed for recent graduates who want their first real software engineering experience in a product team shipping to production. At the end of the 6 months, depending on performance and business needs, there is an opportunity to join the team on a permanent contract. From day one you'll have: A dedicated mentor from the team who meets with you regularly and guides your growth. An Individual Training Plan with a clear month-by-month path: you start by learning our product, codebase and practices, move on to supervised tasks, and finish by owning features end to end. A mid-term and a final review to track your progress, and a certificate of professional practice when the contract ends. What you'll do Build, test and ship backend features in TypeScript/Node.js (and some Python) running on AWS. Write clean, tested and maintainable code, and take part in code reviews. Learn to monitor and operate services in production: logs, metrics, alerts and incident follow-up. Work with product managers, designers and engineers to understand the problems our users face. Get hands-on with AI/LLM-powered features in a real production setting. By the end of the program, own a feature end to end, from design to production. What we're looking for A degree that qualifies you for the role (university degree, Master's or Higher VET / FP Grado Superior ) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Telecommunications or a related field, completed within the last 3 years . You haven't previously had more than 6 months of professional practice contracts in Spain for this degree. Solid programming fundamentals in at least one language (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, Go…), from your studies, personal projects, internships or hackathons. Basic knowledge of Git, REST APIs and databases. Curiosity, eagerness to learn and openness to feedback. Good communication skills in English (our working language). Nice to have Exposure to cloud services (AWS, GCP or Azure), Docker or CI/CD. Projects involving LLMs, NLP or speech technologies. Some frontend experience (React). Our tech stack TypeScript/Node.js, Python, REST and GraphQL APIs, React, AWS (Serverless, EKS), PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, OpenSearch, Redis. You don't need to know all of them; you'll learn them here. Why join us? items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there! Responsibilities In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis. You will: Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+. Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs. Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous. Experience working with a remote team Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications. Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks . items.desc: Göteborgs universitet möter samhällets utmaningar med mångsidig kunskap. 37 000 studenter och 6 000 medarbetare gör universitetet till en stor och inspirerande arbetsplats, flödande av kunskap och idéer. Stark forskning och attraktiva utbildningar lockar forskare och studenter från hela världen. Göteborgs universitet är miljöcertifierat och arbetar aktivt för hållbar utveckling. Med ny kunskap och nya perspektiv bidrar universitetet till en bättre framtid. Universitetet arbetar aktivt för en arbetsmiljö med jämställda förhållanden och sätter värde på de kvalitéer mångfald tillför verksamheten. Handelshögskolan har, med sina drygt 3 700 helårsstudenter, 470 anställda, 160 internationella partneruniversitet, sina huvudämnen - ekonomi och juridik - och fyra institutioner en unik bredd. Unik är också skolans nära samverkan med näringsliv och offentlig sektor. Handelshögskolan är ackrediterad av EQUIS, AACSB och AMBA och är därmed den enda handelshögskola i Sverige som är Triple Crown-ackrediterad. Företagsekonomiska institutionen är den största institutionen vid Handelshögskolan och bedriver omfattande forskning och utbildning på grund- och avancerad nivå och forskarutbildning inom ämnena företagsekonomi och ekonomisk geografi. Institutionen har cirka 150 anställda och är uppdelad i fyra sektioner: Industriell och finansiell ekonomi & Logistik, Management & Organisation, Marknadsföring samt Redovisning. Arbetsuppgifter Arbetsuppgifterna omfattar att stödja forskare och lärare i användningen av AI-baserade analysmiljöer, lokala språkmodeller och GU IT beräkningsresurser. I uppdraget ingår att utveckla, uppdatera och undervisa i en kurs där studenter lär sig använda Python för datahantering och analys, inklusive praktiska moment där studenter arbetar med GU IT beräkningsytor och lokala språkmodeller. Arbetet innefattar även stöd till forskare genom att identifiera relevanta tekniska lösningar, förstå metod- och analysbehov ur ett ekonomiskt och forskningsmässigt perspektiv och bidra till att översätta dessa behov till fungerande arbetsflöden i dialog med Bitlab och GU IT. En viktig del av arbetet är att löpande följa den tekniska utvecklingen inom AI, programmering, dataanalys och beräkningsmiljöer samt bedöma hur nya verktyg och metoder kan användas i Handelshögskolans forskning och undervisning. Kvalifikationer För uppdraget söker vi i första hand en person med utbildning på avancerad nivå inom ett ekonomiskt ämnesområde, särskilt redovisning, finans eller nationalekonomi, kombinerat med en stark profil inom dataanalys och programmering. Även närliggande ekonomiska utbildningar kan vara relevanta om de innefattar en tydlig kvantitativ och teknisk inriktning. Särskilt meriterande är dokumenterad erfarenhet av Pythonbaserad datahantering och analys, exempelvis genom avancerade kurser, självständiga projekt eller examensarbete. Den sökande bör ha god förståelse för kvantitativa metoder och regressionsanalys samt erfarenhet av eller intresse för textanalys, maskininlärning, AI-baserade analysmiljöer och lokala språkmodeller. Erfarenhet av att praktiskt tillämpa programmering och dataanalys på ekonomiska frågeställningar, exempelvis inom ramen för en masteruppsats, forskningsprojekt eller liknande arbete, är särskilt meriterande. Vi värdesätter förmågan att förstå ekonomiska forskningsfrågor och att koppla samman ämneskunskap och metodbehov med lämpliga tekniska lösningar. Stor vikt läggs vid analytisk förmåga, tekniskt intresse, pedagogisk förmåga och vilja att snabbt sätta sig in i nya verktyg och arbetsflöden. Den sökande bör trivas i gränslandet mellan ekonomi, forskning och teknik och kunna kommunicera med forskare, lärare, studenter och teknisk personal. Förmågan att omsätta ekonomiska och forskningsmässiga behov till praktiska lösningar för forskning och undervisning är central för rollen. Anställning Anställningen är 100 % av heltid med placering under företagsekonomiska institutionen. Start för anställning är 1 januari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse. Anställningen är tidsbegränsad till och med 2027-12-31. Sista dag kan komma att förskjutas beroende på startdatum. items.desc: Vill du jobba i staten och bidra till en väl fungerande arbetsmarknad? Vi på Inspektionen för arbetslöshetsförsäkringen (IAF) arbetar för att några av Sveriges viktigaste trygghetssystem ska fungera på rätt sätt. Det gör vi i huvudsak genom tillsyn och uppföljning av arbetslöshetsförsäkringen och av sanktioner inom aktivitetsstödet, utvecklingsersättningen och etableringsersättningen, för att de som söker ersättning ska behandlas rättssäkert av arbetslöshetskassorna, Arbetsförmedlingen och Försäkringskassan. Analysenheten söker nu en digital utredare som vill kombinera utredningsarbete med programmering, AI och digital utveckling. Du kommer att bidra till att utveckla metoder och verktyg för tillsyn och granskning. Du arbetar tillsammans med kollegor med olika specialistkompetenser och får goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling samt att delta i verksamhetens utveckling. Vårt kontor, där alla medarbetare har egna rum, ligger i centrala Katrineholm. Det finns bra förbindelser till bland annat Stockholm, Eskilstuna, Västerås och Norrköping. Vi erbjuder goda möjligheter till distansarbete och möjlighet att arbeta under restiden för dig som pendlar. På myndigheten arbetar medarbetare med bakgrund inom bland annat statsvetenskap, nationalekonomi, juridik och statistik. Läs mer om oss på https://www.iaf.se/jobba-hos-oss/. Arbetsuppgifter Som digital utredare kombinerar du utredningsarbete med teknisk kompetens. Du arbetar med tillsyn och granskning och bidrar till att utveckla IAF: s förmåga att granska digitala och automatiserade processer och system. Du kommer bland annat att: utveckla interna digitala verktyg och metoder för tillsyn och granskning genomföra analyser av stora datamaterial, exempelvis med hjälp av textanalys, programmering, generativ AI och maskininlärning delta i och leda projektgrupper vid granskningar analysera och värdera resultat samt dra slutsatser utifrån genomförda granskningar strukturera och skriva rapporter samt presentera resultat muntligt. Våra granskningar genomförs ofta i tvärprofessionella grupper med kompetenser från olika delar av IAF. Resultaten redovisas vanligtvis i rapporter och presenteras även muntligt för de verksamheter vi granskar och för regeringen. Kvalifikationer Vi söker dig som har relevant högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis systemvetenskap, datavetenskap, statistik, informatik eller annat område som arbetsgivaren bedömer som relevant. Du kan också ha förvärvat motsvarande kompetens genom arbetslivserfarenhet. Vi söker dig som har: goda kunskaper i programmering och erfarenhet av att använda programmering för analys eller utveckling kunskap om generativ AI och maskininlärning samt förståelse för hur teknikerna kan användas i praktiken god förståelse för hur digitala och automatiserade system är uppbyggda och fungerar förmåga att analysera stora och komplexa informationsmängder mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska, både i tal och skrift. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av: att utveckla digitala verktyg eller applikationer textanalys, NLP (naturlig språkbehandling) eller andra metoder för att analysera stora mängder text att arbeta med eller granska automatiserade besluts- eller handläggningssystem AI- eller maskininlärningsprojekt i praktisk verksamhet utrednings-, analys- eller granskningsarbete arbete inom offentlig sektor. Personliga kompetenser För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha följande personliga kompetenser: Samarbetsförmåga: Du är lyhörd, kommunicerar tydligt och respektfullt samt hanterar olika perspektiv på ett konstruktivt sätt. Du bidrar till ett gott samarbete med andra. Utvecklingsorientering: Du är öppen för nya idéer, metoder och arbetssätt. Du ser möjligheter till förbättringar och tar initiativ till att omsätta idéer i praktiken. Pedagogisk insikt: Du har förmåga att förklara tekniskt komplexa frågor på ett tydligt och begripligt sätt. Du anpassar hur du förmedlar information och kunskap utifrån mottagarens förutsättningar och förkunskaper. Problemlösande analysförmåga: Du har förmåga att analysera komplexa frågor, identifiera samband och bryta ner problem i hanterbara delar för att hitta lösningar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga kompetenser. Arbetstid/varaktighet Heltid. Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning. IAF tillämpar provanställning under längst sex månader. Vi ger dig en timmes friskvård i veckan och friskvårdsersättning. Vi erbjuder också trevliga friskvårdsaktiviteter tillsammans med dina arbetskamrater. Anställningsinformation Tillträde snarast, efter överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning.

items.desc: Job Description Pagero has recently joined Thomson Reuters. Together, we are building the world’s largest, open business network. With our cloud-based network, customers can reach any business, anywhere in the world – no matter how many borders their operations may cross. We take care of the technical and regulatory requirements across the entire order-to-cash, purchase-to-pay and freight processes, to give customers data accuracy and security, transparency, and real-time visibility. All this through a single connection. We are seeking a highly skilled Identity & Access Management (IAM) Engineer to join our global IAM team as we undertake a complete transformation of our identity landscape — a cornerstone of our enterprise security posture. In this role, you will be responsible for administering secure and scalable Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) , Access Governance , MSFT EntraID , and SSO/Federation solutions. You will drive operational excellence across IAM platforms, with a focus on continuous improvement, automation, and high availability. Governance , and LDAP directories Configure and troubleshoot Single Sign-On (SSO) for enterprise applications using SAML, OAuth, Kerberos, and NTLM Implement OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OAuth 2.0 solutions using MEMORITY tools Manage and maintain MEMORITY Directory Server , including cluster management and timely replication of configuration changes across Test and Production environments Administer and performance-tune MEMORITY/MSFT EntraID to support high-traffic enterprise workloads Deploy and support highly available, scalable MEMORITY infrastructure on AWS and on-premises , enabling SSO and federation for internal access Configure MEMORITY Access servers, Gateways, and Agents to protect enterprise resources Manage federation services between SiteMinder and MemorityFederate for SAML and WS-FED based application migrations Work with multiple Memority Federate adapters including HTML Form, x509, Kerberos, OpenToken, Memority ID, and Composite adapters Coordinate with server hosting and MemorityFederate vendor teams to resolve hardware and software issues Lead vulnerability mitigation and patch management activities, including version upgrades Prepare comprehensive documentation and operational runbooks for the Operations team Act as first-level escalation support for IAM operational teams and other IT security functions Drive development of automation and integration capabilities within IAM solutions Required Qualifications You’re a fit for the role of IAM Engineer if you have the following required qualifications: 3+ years of experience designing, develop Memority, and implementing IAM security technologies including MEMORITY, Entra, Active Directory, Access Governance, and LDAP Strong hands-on experience with SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC), Kerberos, NTLM, LDAP, and RADIUS Proven experience integrating, develop Memority, and automating MFA and authentication protocols Deep understanding of Identity domains: Authentication, Authorization, Access Management, and Attestation Experience with Memority Federate including adapter configuration, Service Provider/Identity Provider connections, metadata API security concepts, including integration with Open AM, SiteMinder, OAuth 2.0, JWT tokens, and certificate-based authentication Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and an understanding of dynamic computing's impact on Identity Proven ability to deliver Proof of Concepts (POCs) for identity and API security integrations Preferred Qualifications Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills in complex, large-scale enterprise environments Experience designing and engineering identity solutions in a large global enterprise #LI-EH2 What’s in it For You?
