Investigate data flow and communication between systems to ensure correct orchestration and messaging. • Design and execute integration test scenarios covering real-world use cases (e.g., remote commands, vehicle status, OTA, eCall, and remote diagnostics). • Support defect analysis and troubleshooting, bridging the gap between frontend, backend, and vehicle teams to drive complex cross-functional issues to closure. • Collaborate closely with backend developers, vehicle teams, and app teams in an international environment. Verify API behaviors, message flows, and communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, HTTP/HTTPS, Protobuf). • Prepare test reports, validation documentation, and quality assessments for release readiness. Requirements & Technical Proficiency • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. • Minimum 3 years of experience in integration testing, joint debugging, or system validation, preferably in the telematics or connected vehicle domain. Deep understanding of connected car business logic and architecture (TSP / TCAM / Mobile App interaction flow). • Proficient in database operations, with the ability to write SQL queries independently (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Oracle) for data verification and troubleshooting. • Proven experience in log analysis and issue investigation across distributed systems (e.g., tracing a remote command failure from App, TSP, Vehicle). • Solid knowledge of networking and communication protocols: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, MQTT, or other messaging queues. Familiarity with API testing tools (e.g., Postman, JMeter, curl) and log management tools (e.g., ELK stack, Kibana). Preferred Qualifications• Experience within OEM or Tier-1 automotive telematics projects (e.g., handling T-Box/TCU registration, activation, or TSP lifecycle management). • Familiarity with common backend business error codes and exception handling mechanisms. • Basic scripting skills (Python, Shell) for log parsing, data preparation, or test automation support. Experience with cloud-based backend systems (e.g., AWS, Azure) and microservices architecture. Personal attributes• Strong analytical mindset with a structured, end-to-end problem-solving approach. • Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to effectively drive joint- debugging sessions across different technical teams. • Proactive, self-driven, and highly quality-oriented. Fluent in English (written and spoken) for daily collaboration in international teams. With over 330 years of heritage and a passion for pioneering technology, we design and deliver world-class products and solutions for forest, park, garden and construction care. From robotic lawn mowers to cutting-edge chainsaws and sustainable battery systems, we’re shaping the future, and we want you to be part of it. We are now looking for a Supply & Inventory Planner for the Husqvarna Forest & Garden division within the Global Supply Chain Planning organization. This is a temporary position supporting the team during the peak season from November 2026 to June 2027 . About the team Global Supply Chain Planning is part of the Husqvarna Forest & Garden Global Operations organization. We have a global governance structure ensuring planning and inventory meet both business targets and customer expectations. Our organization is responsible for creating demand, inventory and supply plans, as well as monitoring the execution of these plans. Additionally, we coordinate the flow of goods from factories and suppliers to sales companies and distributors. We serve as the central hub for communication between sales companies/distributors and factories/suppliers, covering forecasts, orders, delivery information and invoicing. The team operates within a dynamic global Collaborative Business Planning (CBP) framework and collaborates extensively with stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product Management and Operations. About the role As a Supply & Inventory Planner for finished goods, you play a key role in the interface between our factories/suppliers and sales companies/distributors. We are at an exciting stage of development and are looking for someone who can support us on this journey. Success in this role relies on a deep understanding of forecasting and planning best practices, strong analytical and statistical capabilities, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills. Your responsibilities will include: Secure delivery performance according to targets to meet customer expectations. Provide forecasts and orders to factories/suppliers on a regular basis and monitor delivery performance. Maintain close contact with factories/suppliers and communicate supply plans and deviations to relevant stakeholders. Ensure fair supply allocation according to agreed principles during bottleneck situations. Collaborate closely with Sales and ensure the latest delivery information is available. Manage inventory levels. Coordinate product phase-in and phase-out activities. Ensure accurate reporting and monitor KPIs. Drive continuous process improvements. An important part of the role is maintaining close collaboration with stakeholders across Sales, Planning and Product Management to understand market developments, trends and other relevant information that supports accurate supply planning while securing company objectives and customer expectations. About you You are service-minded, structured and analytical, with the ability to balance details while maintaining a broader business perspective. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and are flexible in responding to changing customer demands. You take initiative, work proactively and are committed to delivering high-quality results on time. As the role involves building long-term relationships and collaborating with international colleagues and customers across Husqvarna Group, strong communication and collaboration skills are essential. Your skills and background: University degree in a relevant field, ongoing studies, and/or equivalent work experience. Understanding of supply chain processes. Fluent English, both written and spoken. Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365. Advanced Excel and Power BI skills are considered an advantage. Experience working with SAP and planning systems such as Logility or APO is beneficial. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage. Location This position is based at our site in Huskvarna . How we work We believe the best ideas happen when we're connected. We spend most of our time together in the office, creating space for collaboration, creativity, and fast decision-making. This is consistent across all our global offices and helps us maintain a strong culture, support learning and development, and ensure everyone has access to the people and resources they need to thrive. items.desc: About Justera Group Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden. About the Role: We are seeking a highly experienced Enterprise Architect specializing in Data & Information Modeling to support a strategic data transformation initiative within a leading organization in the construction and engineering sector. The organization is accelerating its journey toward becoming a truly data-driven business by making critical business data accessible through its analytics and AI platform. The initiative aims to strengthen data accessibility, improve decision-making, and enable advanced analytics and AI-driven business capabilities across the organization. As an Enterprise Architect, you will play a key role in shaping the organization's information architecture, developing robust information models, and ensuring that business requirements are translated into a consistent and well-governed data foundation. This role requires a strong combination of enterprise architecture expertise, information modeling capabilities, and the ability to collaborate effectively with both business and technical stakeholders. Key Responsibilities: Analyze business and analytical data requirements and translate them into structured information models. Define, develop, and maintain conceptual and logical information models across multiple business domains. Identify information gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities for improvement across existing systems, data sources, and business processes. Establish alignment between information models, enterprise architecture principles, business terminology, and governance standards. Support the integration and harmonization of data from multiple domains to enable advanced analytics and AI use cases. Collaborate with stakeholders across Business Analytics, Data Management, Integration, Solution Architecture, and other relevant functions. Facilitate workshops and discussions to establish common business concepts, information domains, and data requirements. Contribute to enterprise-wide architecture initiatives and cross-functional data transformation programs. Support information governance, prioritization, ownership, metadata management, and data quality practices. Ensure that information architecture supports strategic business objectives and the organization's long-term data ambitions. Requirements: Information Architecture – Level 4 Ability to define and maintain enterprise-wide information structures, domains, business concepts, and relationships between information assets. Experience establishing consistent information architecture across multiple business areas. Information Modeling – Level 4 Extensive experience designing and maintaining conceptual and logical information models. Proven ability to harmonize information structures across domains and translate business requirements into clear, structured models. Enterprise Architecture – Level 4 Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles and the ability to align information architecture with business strategy and the wider architectural landscape. Experience contributing to enterprise-level architecture decisions and transformation initiatives. Data Governance & Information Management – Level 4 Experience applying data governance principles, information ownership, metadata management, data quality practices, and information standards. Ability to promote consistency, transparency, and accountability in enterprise information management. Data Architecture – Level 3 Understanding of data structures, source systems, integrations, and data flows. Knowledge of the architectural requirements of analytics and AI platforms. items.desc: Do you want to drive new business opportunities based on cutting edge technology? At CPAC Systems, you will combine technical curiosity with commercial drive and build customer relationships that help shape the next generation of machines and vehicles. At CPAC Systems, we work with electrification, automation, and connected solutions that make our customers’ products smarter, safer, and more efficient. We bring the entire product development process together under one roof, with close collaboration across disciplines and short decision paths. We are now looking for a Business Developer to join our Industry & Integration team. You will play a key role in growing existing accounts and developing new business, with a particular focus on agriculture, mining, heavy material handling and other industrial vehicle segments. Your role You will drive business from the first conversation and identified need through to agreements and long-term growth. You will own a portfolio of OEM customers, meaning manufacturers of products such as machines and vehicles, and Tier 1 suppliers. You will build relationships across engineering, product management, procurement, and senior management. By understanding your customers’ operations, technology, and future plans, you will identify where we can create value. Together with our engineers and project managers, you will turn those needs into solutions and business opportunities across hardware, software, and services. The role combines long-term account development with active prospecting. You will report to the Sales Director, Industry & Integration, and represent CPAC Systems at customer meetings, trade fairs, and industry events. You will primarily work from our office in Mölndal, with the flexibility to work remotely one day per week. The role includes travel to customers, trade fairs, and industry events. Key responsibilities Grow our key accounts. Develop long-term account plans, run regular business reviews, and identify opportunities for upselling, new projects, and continued collaboration. Develop new business. Identify and approach new OEM customers, primarily in agriculture and construction machinery, while exploring opportunities in other relevant industries. Lead commercial negotiations. Prepare proposals, negotiate pricing and terms, and secure profitable agreements, renewals, and long-term supply commitments. Demonstrate customer value. Build business cases and ROI calculations that show the value of our technology, and structure paid pilots and proofs of concept. Connect customers and technology. Work with engineering, project management, and operations to support deliveries that meet expectations on cost, quality, and timing. Bring market insights into CPAC. Follow customer roadmaps, technology shifts, and competitors, and contribute these insights to product and business development. Keep sales activities structured. Maintain account plans and opportunities in CRM, prepare sales forecasts, and track account growth. You will share knowledge and experience with your colleagues and use AI tools to support activities such as account research, meeting preparation, and customer communication. Who are you? You combine commercial drive with a genuine interest in technology and your customers’ operations. You have a solid technical understanding, stay curious, and keep up with new developments. You want to understand how your customers’ machines and products work, the challenges they face, and how our solutions can help. You spot opportunities when a customer develops a new platform, updates a product, or needs to solve a technical challenge. You take initiative, open doors, and move business forward. At the same time, you know that lasting partnerships are built on trust, listening, and delivering on your promises. You are confident in negotiations and can explain the value of a technical solution to both engineers and commercial decision-makers. Qualifications At least five years of experience in business development, technical sales, or Key Account Management. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field. Experience leading complex negotiations with multiple decision-makers and closing deals. An understanding of embedded hardware and software, with the ability to explain the value of technology based on customer needs. Fluency in English. Nice to have Experience selling to OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers. An established network of contacts at OEMs in relevant markets. Experience selling electronics, embedded systems, or industrial technology. Experience working with a CRM tool. Experience working with customers in agriculture or construction machinery. Fluency in Swedish. Why CPAC? At CPAC, you will work close to both the technology and the people behind it. You will collaborate with experienced colleagues, follow solutions from idea to finished product, and see how they are used in real machines and vehicles. We have a flat organisation where …

We foster R&D with industry and support the construction of sustainable infrastructure. Within EuroTube, we are building a research branch in Life Cycle Engineering. We help partners and clients understand and reduce the environmental impact of their products and systems, from the first design choices to end of life. Our work centers on three services: ISO 14044-compliant LCA studies, customized life cycle tools, and prospective LCA (pLCA) with scenario modeling. We work alongside research and industrial partners in and outside Switzerland. The role We are looking for an engineer with a genuine interest in sustainability to join us as a Life Cycle Engineer. You will build and run life cycle models in Python, contribute to funded research projects, and help turn results into clear insights for partners and clients. It is a hands-on role at the intersection of engineering, data, and sustainability research. About the roles: IVCC is recruiting for two Technical Officer positions to provide technical coordination and scientific support across IVCC projects, supporting the coordination of technical activities, information management, research findings and technical documentation. Technical Officer, Spatial Emanator pillar This role coordinates technical resources and provides technical support to IVCC projects, with a primary focus on assisting the Spatial Emanator pillar team and additional support across outdoor transmission and active ingredient discovery activities. Experience working with strategic stakeholders, including scientists, industry, CROs, academia, foundations, governments and/or NGOs. Experience with routine stakeholder and partner interactions. Good oral and written communication skills in English. Ability to work effectively as part of a cross-functional team. Strong planning, organisation and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage tasks and deadlines. Strong attention to detail and a quality mindset when working with documentation and data. Ability to work independently within agreed priorities, seek guidance and escalate issues where appropriate. Strong relationship management skills. Problem-solving and improvement-focused approach. Interest in the interface between science, product development and innovation delivery in an international setting. Commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion and safeguarding. items.desc: Description We’re looking for a mid-level DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and help us build, automate, and scale the AWS infrastructure that underpins our products. You’ll work closely with development, platform, and security teams to improve deployment velocity, system reliability, and operational visibility. This is a hands-on role for someone who is comfortable owning infrastructure as code, maintaining CI/CD pipelines, and championing automation and observability across the software delivery lifecycle. We place a high value on clear, well-maintained documentation, and you’ll be expected to document your work to a standard that helps the whole team. You’ll have enough autonomy to make meaningful technical decisions, with the support of a senior team to grow into. Key Responsibilities Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions) to enable fast, safe, and repeatable deployments. Manage and evolve AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform & Terragrunt). Operate and scale containerised workloads on EKS, alongside serverless workloads on Lambda. Design, secure, and maintain AWS networking — VPCs, subnets, security groups, routing, and load balancing. Manage relational databases on RDS and Aurora, including performance, backups, and resilience. Handle secrets and sensitive configuration securely using AWS Secrets Manager. Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid incident response (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, ELK, Datadog). Collaborate with development teams to improve deployment practices, environment consistency, and developer experience. Contribute to security and compliance efforts — secrets management, patching, access control, and secure-by-default configurations. Take part in our support and on-call arrangements and help shape them as they mature. Automate manual and repetitive operational tasks through scripting and tooling. Produce and maintain clear, accurate documentation — architecture diagrams, runbooks, onboarding guides, and operational procedures — and champion a culture where knowledge is written down and shared rather than siloed. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise Essential Skills & Experience 3+ years in a DevOps, SRE, Platform, or infrastructure-focused engineering role. Solid hands-on experience with AWS. Practical experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally EKS. Experience building and deploying serverless functions with AWS Lambda. Good working knowledge of AWS networking — VPCs, subnets, security groups, routing, and load balancing. Experience operating relational databases on RDS and/or Aurora. Experience managing secrets with AWS Secrets Manager (or equivalent). Proficiency with Docker and containerised workflows. Practical experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Terragrunt. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions. Strong scripting ability in at least one language (Bash, Python, or Go). Good understanding of Linux systems administration and networking fundamentals. Familiarity with monitoring and observability tooling. Comfortable working with Git and modern version control workflows. A genuine commitment to good documentation — able to write clear, concise runbooks and technical docs that others can follow. Willingness to take part in an on-call rotation and contribute to a maturing support function. Desirable Relevant certifications (e.g. AWS Associate/Professional, CKA/CKAD, Terraform Associate). Experience with service mesh, GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux), or progressive delivery. Exposure to security and compliance frameworks (ISO 27001, SOC 2, or similar). Experience with database backup/DR strategies and Aurora failover. Experience establishing or improving on-call and incident management processes. Experience introducing or improving documentation practices (e.g. docs-as-code). Understanding of cost optimisation and FinOps practices. Job Benefits Hybrid working arrangements 26 days holiday (plus 8 public holidays) Enhanced family friendly benefits Private medical insurance Onsite gym A supportive and collaborative work culture About Restrata Restrata was originally founded as the technology arm of one of the world’s largest security services companies, providing design, prepare and respond solutions in high threat areas over many decades. We witnessed first-hand the extreme pain of data siloes and system-hopping and the negative impact on response efforts that endangered lives, put business assets at risk and disrupted continuity. This deep industry expertise led us to build resilienceOS, one end-to-end platform built from the ground up to unify your data, gain insights and take action to protect what matters.

Flexibility for on-site work - full on-site (5 days) preferred, though hybrid possible if simulation-heavy. * Professional development opportunities and hands-on training in verification, validation, and computational modelling. * Collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven culture with a focus on quality and continuous improvement.

items.desc: Proximie is on a mission to improve healthcare by transforming the world’s operating rooms into connected ecosystems of people, devices, and data. Our Intelligence Suite transforms operating room (OR) performance, keeping teams in sync and workflows on track to maximise throughput. Simultaneously our computer vision and AI capabilities capture real-time data and detect surgical events – improving quality of data outputs. The result: ORs are optimised like never before – with predictive analytics and automated notifications ensuring patients and staff are in the right place at the right time. Once practitioners are in the OR, our Surgical Suite enables real-time remote access and creates a secure video record of every procedure; improving training, education, and collaboration. It is an intuitive asset which helps instil a culture of continuous learning, accelerates the adoption of cutting-edge medical devices, and enhances surgical performance across the entire global workforce – improving outcomes and saving lives. Proximie was commercialised in 2019 and is available in over 500 facilities globally. Check out our Founder and CEO Nadine’s Origins Story here: https://www.proximie.com/about-us/ Position Overview With hospitals and health systems around the world increasingly adopting Proximie’s Surgical Suite and Intelligence Suite, we are seeking a skilled and agile Data Integration Engineer to spearhead the integration of our platform with customer Electronic Health Record (EHR) systems. This is a pivotal, high-ownership role responsible for driving healthcare data integration across the UK and META. You will be instrumental in enabling scalable, secure, and reliable data exchange between Proximie and its partners, accelerating clinical insights, enhancing workflows, and delivering operational efficiency at scale. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in healthcare data integration and industry standards (including HL7), with the ability to independently analyze and interpret complex data sets. Success in this position requires exceptional communication skills, technical leadership, and the agility to thrive in a fast-paced, global, and highly collaborative environment. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain HL7 interfaces (ADT, ORU, ORM, etc.) to support real-time and batch data exchange with customer EHR systems. Rapidly stand-up file-based and HL7-based integrations to meet customer onboarding timelines and scalability needs. Develop and manage ETL pipelines for transforming and validating clinical data from diverse sources. Collaborate with customer IT teams to define integration requirements, troubleshoot issues, and ensure successful deployment. Perform data analysis and validation to ensure completeness, accuracy, and consistency of exchanged data. Work closely with internal product, engineering, and customer success teams to align integration efforts with platform capabilities and customer goals. Document integration workflows, data mappings, and technical specifications for internal and external stakeholders. Requirements 3+ years of experience in healthcare data integration, preferably with EHR systems (Epic, Cerner, Meditech, etc.). Strong hands-on experience with HL7 v2.x messaging standards and interface engines (e.g., Mirth Connect, Rhapsody, Cloverleaf). Proficiency in ETL tools and scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) for data transformation and validation. Familiarity with healthcare data standards (FHIR, CDA, CCD) and privacy regulations (HIPAA, GDPR). Ability to analyze complex data sets and troubleshoot integration issues independently. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, especially in customer-facing technical discussions. Experience working in fast-paced, agile environments with cross-functional teams. Experience integrating with cloud-based platforms and APIs is highly desirable. Knowledge of surgical workflows and clinical documentation practices is highly desirable. Nice to Haves Familiarity with software engineering practices, including version control (e.g. Git), deployment processes, and release workflows — enabling effective collaboration with engineering teams and a smoother path from integration development to production. Proximie is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. items.desc: Job Description Trainee Client Executive – Small Law Segment The Trainee Client Executive plays a vital role in protecting and growing CoCounsel's footprint across small law firms in England & Wales by focusing on retention and adoption within the existing customer base. This is an entry-level, developmental role designed to build a strong foundation in account management, customer engagement, and legal technology, with a clear progression path toward Sales Executive or Client Executive positions. The role's primary purpose is to ensure existing subscribers get maximum value from their Thomson Reuters subscriptions — CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Practical Law — by proactively supporting their use of digital self-serve tools, training resources, and account management functions. In doing so, the Trainee Client Executive directly protects retention and identifies signals of risk or opportunity, feeding qualified leads through to the Sales Executive for conversion into upsell or cross-sell revenue. Key Responsibilities Customer Retention & Relationship Management Own a portfolio of existing small law firm accounts, building relationships with day-to-day users and firm decision-makers to understand how they are using their subscriptions. Proactively check in with customers at key points in their lifecycle (post-onboarding, mid- term, pre-renewal) to ensure satisfaction and reduce churn risk. Monitor account health and usage data to identify early warning signs of disengagement, escalating at-risk accounts appropriately. Digital Adoption & Self-Serve Support Guide customers to the full range of digital support available to subscribers, helping them manage their accounts and make the most of CoCounsel, Westlaw, and Practical Law. Signpost and encourage use of self-serve training and help resources so customers can independently resolve queries and deepen product usage — reflecting the reality that the platform works with existing Thomson Reuters subscriptions to Westlaw and Practical Law, providing immediate access to trusted legal content, with no complex setup process or months-long training period required. Help customers navigate account administration tasks (e.g. user management, billing queries, access issues), directing more complex cases to the appropriate specialist team. Track and encourage engagement with practice-area training resources and workflows relevant to each customer's area of law. Opportunity Spotting & Sales Handoff Identify signals of upsell, cross-sell, or expansion potential within existing accounts (e.g. requests for more seats, interest in additional Westlaw/Practical Law content, growing usage patterns) and pass qualified opportunities to the Sales Executive in a timely, well- documented way. Required Qualifications Customer-facing experience: Up to 1 year in any role where you dealt directly with customers or clients, such as customer service, a contact centre, retail, hospitality, an internship or a work placement. Strong communication skills: You can explain things clearly and professionally by phone, video call and email, and you adjust your style for different audiences, from day-to-day users to firm partners. Active listening and curiosity: You ask good questions to find out how customers use their products, what's getting in their way and what they need. Organisation and time management: You can manage a portfolio of accounts, plan proactive check-ins at key points in the customer lifecycle, and juggle competing priorities without letting follow-ups slip. Comfort with technology: You pick up new software quickly, feel confident guiding others through digital tools and self-serve resources, and can use Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Teams). Basic analytical skills: You can read simple usage and account health data, spot trends or warning signs, and act on what you find. Problem-solving and judgement: You can resolve routine account queries (user management, access issues, billing questions) and recognise when to pass more complex cases to a specialist team. Eagerness to learn: You want to develop, welcome coaching and feedback, and are keen to build a career in account management, customer success or sales. Teamwork: You work well with colleagues across Sales, Support and Customer Success. Right to work: You are eligible to work in the UK. Preferred Qualifications Legal sector exposure: Experience or study related to law, such as an LLB, GDL/PGDL, SQE preparation, or work as a paralegal or legal assistant. Alternatively, a general understanding of how small and high-street law firms in England & Wales operate. Interest in AI and legal technology: Experience with or a real interest in generative AI tools (such as CoCounsel) and how they are changing legal work. Software-as-a-service (SaaS) or subscription experience: Exposure to account management, customer success, inside sales or renewals in a software or information services business. items.desc: Job number MED06035 Faculties Faculty of Medicine Departments Department of Immunology and Inflammation Salary or Salary range £45,399 - £48,876 per annum Location/campus Hammersmith Campus - On site only Contract type work pattern Full time - Fixed term Posting End Date 4 Nov 2026 About the role We are looking for a talented Research Assistant to work on an exciting project exploring the underlying cause of the hepatotoxicity induced by an antibody drug conjugate Inotuzumab Ozogamicin, used to treat leukaemia. Our service is part of a system‑wide collaborative across Nottinghamshire Healthcare, NUH, Sherwood Forest Hospitals, Doncaster & Bassetlaw Teaching Hospitals and CityCare, ensuring seamless care across acute and community settings. We support pathways including frailty, respiratory and admission avoidance. As a Band 6 Senior Community Practitioner, you will provide timely assessments, person‑centred care and advanced clinical decision‑making in patients’ homes, working both autonomously and within an established MDT. This role offers opportunities to develop advanced assessment skills, contribute to innovative virtual care models and play a key part in system transformation. Maintain accurate documentation on SystmOne and uphold professional standards, governance, and patient safety. Our System Ready model works around the person: psychologically and trauma-informed practice; practitioners embedded in GP practices and neighbourhoods; and integrated working across health, social care and the voluntary sector. items.desc: Gloucestershire Health and Care NHS Foundation Trust are looking for experienced GPs to join the Integrated Urgent Care Service (IUCS). The overall aim of the Integrated Urgent Care Service is to provide a consult and complete model of care for people needing urgent care. The key features of the service include NHS 111, Clinical Assessment Service and Out of Hours services (face-to-face base and home visiting). The NHS 111 service will be provided by Health Advisors and Clinical Advisors hosted by our partner organisation, IC24. Where a senior clinical review is indicated, this will be completed within the Clinical Assessment Service, which will be jointly delivered by GHC Senior Clinical Leads based at Edward Jenner Court, Gloucester and remotely by IC24 CAS clinicians. The post holder will act as the Senior Clinical Lead for CAS and be part of the rota covering the service 24/7. This role is offered on a permanent basis. We currently have a range of hours and shifts available during the week and at weekends, between 08:00-00:00. These can be offered as a fixed pattern. Please note that enhancements are offered, please see attached, for out of hours working and any CAS Senior Lead hours attract 3% if salaried before the enhancements are then added. For any bank hours you will see the different rates attached for the two types of roles. The qualification, training & experience requirements for the role are underlined in the Job Description/Person Specification. The postholder will work collaboratively with the service team and have oversight of all clinical queues across the IUCS pathway to direct patients without delay to the correct parts of the urgent care system utilising the Gloucestershire Directory of Service. The Senior Clinical Lead will provide support and guidance to all colleagues across the service ensuring everyone is confident and supported to work to the top of their license. As a GP working within the service they will use their clinical expertise and professional knowledge to assess and manage patients as part of clinical telephone triage, working as part of a multi-disciplinary team to deliver high quality and patient centred service when in hours General Practice is closed. Where required and available, the CAS will have access to direct booking into the Out of Hours bases and Home visiting service and work closely with other community services within GHC such as Minor Injury and Illness Units, Rapid Response and Evening and Overnight District Nursing. The CAS will provide an enhanced assessment supported by the NHS Pathways Clinical Consultation Support (PaCCS) module to identify clinical need/risk. It will also oversee and take actions relating to any abnormal urgent pathology results communicated by Gloucestershire Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust (GHFT) Pathology Service during the OOH period. We have a skilled and dedicated workforce of over 5000 colleagues working in a diverse range of services over 55 sites and within people’s homes. We strive to enable a welcoming workplace culture that builds and celebrates civility, inclusivity and diversity, while providing a sense of belonging and trust. Annual staff surveys, regular Pulse surveys and other engagement opportunities provide our people with lots of opportunity to tell us about their experiences of working with us. In the latest staff survey, 61% of colleagues gave us their views. It was great to hear that: 72% of colleagues would recommend the Trust as a place to work, ranking us 1st for Provider Trusts in the South West region on this question. 76% would recommend the standard of care provided in our services if a friend or relative needed treatment, also ranking us 1st in the South West region. 81% said that care of patients and service users is the Trust’s priority, compared with an average in comparable NHS Trusts in England of 64%. This high-level overview shows we are in a healthy position, with higher scores than average for comparable organisations, alongside a great response rate, indicating good staff engagement. However, we also know we have plenty of room for improvement in many areas. To that end, we continue to prioritise and invest in our commitment to genuinely becoming a Great Place to Work with consistent top-quartile performance in the annual staff survey and Pulse surveys. items.desc: Are you passionate about developing nursing practice? Do you love helping others reach their full potential? If so we want to hear from you! An exciting opportunity has arisen within The Private Care Division at the Royal Marsden, for a part time (30h/week) band 7 Clinical Practice Educator in medical and surgical oncology field. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. items.desc: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 11 The Team: Product Platform Design (PPD) is responsible for the design, build, and evolution of SPDJI’s core product platforms that support index creation, calculation, rebalance, analytics, and distribution. PPD operates using a product-led, service-based delivery model and is organised into value streams aligned to major business domains. The team works closely with Index Management, R&D, Operations, and Technology to deliver scalable, reusable platforms that support the full index lifecycle across asset classes. This role sits within the Equity value stream and will focus on the data functionality embedded within T3, SPDJI’s core equity index calculation platform. T3 supports key parts of the index lifecycle, including corporate actions, data capture, validation, transformation, and rebalance implementation. The team is evolving its platforms to improve automation, simplify legacy processes, and align with the broader Data Platforms strategy where appropriate. This creates an opportunity for a Product Owner / Business Analyst who can connect business needs, data dependencies, operational workflows, and technology delivery in a practical and structured way. The Impact: We are recruiting a Technical Product Owner – Equity Calculation on a 12 month fixed term contract to help shape and deliver enhancements across equity index calculation and related data capabilities. This is a hybrid Product Owner / Business Analyst role, working closely with the Value Stream Lead and agile delivery teams to define priorities, translate requirements, and support delivery of platform improvements. The successful candidate will play a significant role in improving efficiency within the equity index calculation domain by using product ownership, business analysis, and analytical judgement to simplify complex workflows, improve data quality, and support more scalable platform delivery. This role requires someone who can work with incomplete or evolving information, identify practical options, and communicate complex topics clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. The individual will also be expected to build strong relationships across PPD, Index Management, R&D, Operations, Technology, and Data Platform teams, influencing peers and immediate leadership to achieve defined goals. Responsibilities: Partner with the Value Stream Lead on roadmap input, prioritisation, and delivery planning. Gather, analyse, and translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, and clear acceptance criteria. Own and manage the agile team backlog in Azure DevOps (ADO), ensuring work is clearly defined, prioritised, and ready for delivery. Work closely with Index Management, R&D, Operations, Technology, and Data Platform teams to understand requirements, dependencies, and delivery impacts. Act as a translator between business and technology teams, tailoring communication for different audiences and simplifying complex information. Support agile ceremonies, including refinement, planning, reviews, and retrospectives. Perform hands-on user acceptance testing (UAT) to confirm delivered functionality meets business requirements. Assess embedded and legacy data processes within T3 and identify opportunities to improve automation, reduce manual effort, and simplify operational workflows. items.card: The Role AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. items.desc: Our Mission At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails , and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved. We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility. The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it . We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for. Our team previously scaled Tessian ( cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel , acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben , Abs , Sabrina , and Rebe . Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here . The Role AI is changing what "technical support" means at a fast-growing SaaS company. The old model was reactive: wait for a ticket, dig through logs, escalate up a chain until someone senior enough could unblock it. Increasingly, the first pass on an integration failure or a broken workflow can be directed rather than done line by line by hand: AI can trace through logs, draft hypotheses, and suggest fixes fast. The job shifts with it. Instead of grinding through every stack trace yourself, you direct AI to accelerate the investigation and apply what AI can't: judgment on whether a fix is safe to ship into a live enterprise environment, whether the root cause is actually fixed or just patched, and whether this is a one-off or a pattern worth escalating to Product. As Omnea's Technical Solutions Engineer, you're the senior technical presence sitting between Customer, Product, and Engineering. You own Omnea's most complex customer-facing technical problems end to end - gnarly integrations, cross-system issues, escalations nobody else can crack. You're the person the team calls in when something's on fire, and you're just as comfortable stepping into a customer's implementation when it gets technical. This is a foundational hire. You'll set the technical bar for how Omnea supports enterprise customers, and help define how the function grows from here. What You'll Do Own the hardest technical problems: Lead investigation and resolution of Omnea's most complex customer issues - integrations, configuration edge cases, cross-system bugs. Direct AI to accelerate the first pass, then apply the judgment AI can't: is this safe to ship, is the root cause actually fixed. Be the SWAT team between Customer, Product, and Engineering: Act as the senior escalation point when an issue is beyond what the Customer team can resolve alone, and the technical voice in the room when Product and Engineering need to understand what's really happening on the ground. Get technical inside implementations: Step into live implementations when they hit technical complexity - tricky integrations, custom logic, unusual data flows - and work directly with the implementation team to get them unstuck. Feed the product roadmap: Spot patterns across the issues you resolve and turn them into clear, well-scoped input for Product and Engineering, so the same problem doesn't need solving twice. Build the standards as you go: Document what you learn, build the tooling and playbooks for triaging and resolving complex technical issues, and raise the bar for technical quality as the team grows around you. What's Different About This Role You'll spend more time directing AI through the first pass of an investigation than manually tracing every log line yourself. AI narrows down the likely cause fast; your job is confirming it's right and safe to act on. Writing a sharp, specific brief for what you want AI to investigate or fix is now a core skill, not a nice-to-have. Judgment on production risk matters more, not less: AI can suggest a fix in minutes, but you decide whether it's safe for a live enterprise environment. Detailed Description We are seeking a Heavy Mineral Technician to support geological research through the preparation and processing of rock and sediment samples in our mineral separation laboratory at Heriot-Watt University. The successful candidate will carry out sample preparation, separate heavy minerals for subsequent analysis, and support the day-to-day operation of the laboratory. The role requires a careful, methodical approach, strong organisational skills and a commitment to safe laboratory working. Applicants should hold a BSc in geoscience or a related scientific discipline that includes practical laboratory work. Training will be provided in specialist mineral separation techniques and the completion and use of Control of Substances Hazardous to Health (COSHH) assessment forms. Key Duties and Responsibilities The successful candidate will: Receive, label, catalogue and store geological samples, maintaining accurate records throughout processing. Prepare rock and sediment samples using appropriate methods, including drying, disaggregation, crushing and sieving. Separate and recover heavy mineral fractions using heavy-liquid and magnetic separation techniques, following training and approved procedures. Use a microscope to examine mineral separates and pick grains where required. Prepare, label and store mineral fractions for subsequent mineralogical and geochronological analysis. Maintain detailed records of processing methods, sample weights, mineral yields and any deviations from standard procedures. Prevent cross-contamination through careful sample handling and thorough cleaning of equipment. Handle, store and dispose of chemicals and laboratory waste in accordance with approved procedures. Assist with preparing and updating COSHH forms, risk assessments and laboratory procedures, with appropriate training and supervision. Undertake routine equipment checks, maintain laboratory cleanliness and report faults or safety concerns. Monitor consumables and chemical stocks, identifying replenishment needs. Coordinate sample-processing priorities with researchers and technical staff to meet project deadlines. Person Specification Essential A BSc in geology, geoscience, mineralogy, chemistry or a related scientific discipline, including practical laboratory training. Practical experience of laboratory work gained through a degree, research project or employment. An understanding of safe laboratory practice, including the importance of chemical safety, appropriate protective equipment and following risk assessments. Ability to follow detailed procedures accurately and maintain consistent standards during repetitive sample-processing tasks. Strong attention to detail, particularly in sample labelling, record keeping and contamination prevention. Good organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple samples at different processing stages. Confidence using spreadsheets and digital systems to maintain laboratory records. Ability to work independently following training, recognise problems and seek guidance when required. Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively with researchers, students and technical colleagues. Willingness to undertake training in mineral separation methods, COSHH assessments and equipment operation. Desirable Experience working in a geological or mineral separation laboratory. Experience preparing rock or sediment samples, including crushing, disaggregation or sieving. Familiarity with heavy-liquid or magnetic separation techniques. Knowledge of mineralogy and the physical properties used to separate minerals. Experience using a binocular microscope for mineral identification or grain picking. Experience preparing mineral separates for automated mineralogy or geochronology. Familiarity with COSHH documentation, chemical inventories and laboratory waste management. Experience carrying out routine equipment checks and maintaining laboratory supplies. Training and Development Training will be tailored to the successful candidate's experience and will cover specialist sample preparation and mineral separation methods, safe chemical handling, equipment operation, quality control and COSHH documentation. Previous experience of heavy mineral separation is desirable but is not essential. items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 RF Test Engineer
 Location: Valencia
 Reports to: Laboratory Lead & Test Architect
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Hybrid
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 As an RF Test Engineer, you’ll capture real signals from real hardware and build the system that plays them back through a channel simulator. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.
 Our processing, on the ground today and on board from Gen 2, is only as good as the signals we test it against. Today we have some synthetic I/Q, a few captures and a lot of assumptions. You’ll help us build a library of real emitter signals with known truth, plus a way to replay them as a satellite would hear them, with LEO Doppler, delay, path loss and interference, coherently across several satellites at once.
 You’ll be one of the first engineers in the lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Capture real emissions: bring emitters into the lab (marine radars, AIS and ADS-B transponders, satcom terminals, partner-supplied equipment), operate them in a controlled, screened setup, and record them at the right bandwidth, dynamic range and timing accuracy. Extend this to field and airborne collection.
 Characterise captures: turn raw recordings into library entries with I/Q in a documented format (SigMF or equivalent), measured parameters (PRI, pulse width, scan, chirp, hopping, modulation), metadata and truth, so someone who wasn’t there can reuse them.
 Build the generate and playback chain: specify, integrate and calibrate the RF record and playback system (SDRs, vector signal generators, arbitrary waveform generators and multi-channel playback), from a single emitter up to a dense scene.
 Build the channel simulator path: apply per-satellite delay, Doppler, Doppler rate, path loss, multipath and interference to recorded and synthetic signals, phase-coherently across channels and driven by geometry from the simulation software.
 Develop test hardware and software: fixtures, RF interconnect, switching, attenuation and calibration paths, plus the Python code that controls and automates your instruments, so every measurement runs as a script.
 Feed the end-to-end loop: inject signals into the flatsat, receivers and processing chain, work with the simulation team so RF stimulus and simulated truth line up in time and frequency, and support algorithm validation campaigns.
 Keep operations lawful and safe: work with the regulator, site safety and partners on screened operation, test identities (MMSI, ICAO address) and RF exposure limits for everything that transmits.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Hands-on RF measurement and signal capture experience with spectrum and real-time signal analysers, vector signal generators, SDRs and oscilloscopes, and the judgement to spot a clipped, aliased or contaminated capture
 Experience building or integrating an RF record and playback, signal generation or hardware-in-the-loop test system
 Solid DSP fundamentals: sampling, I/Q, filtering, channelisation, Doppler and timing effects, and how each shows up in a recording
 Python (or equivalent) for instrument control, automation and analysis, with comfort in SCPI/VISA and SDR APIs
 Calibration discipline: reference planes, path loss and phase characterisation, and an uncertainty you can defend
 Clear written and spoken English
 Nice to haves: 
 Radar, ELINT, ESM or EW background, especially with pulsed and frequency-agile emitters
 Experience with channel emulators or fading simulators (for example PROPSIM or Vertex) or a home-built equivalent, and satellite or LEO link simulation
 Multi-channel phase-coherent systems, precision timing (GPSDO, PPS, White Rabbit) or TDOA/FDOA test
 GNU Radio, MATLAB, UHD, VITA 49, SigMF
 Microwave work above 18 GHz, anechoic and screened-room operation, …

 Why this role matters: 
 As our Lab Test Engineer, you’ll plan, run, automate and document the lab’s tests across simulation, signal capture, playback and hardware in the loop, so results are repeatable and trusted. ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability. We simulate the constellation and its emitters end to end, capture real signals from real hardware, and generate and play back signals through a channel simulator for end-to-end runs and algorithm validation.
 A lab that only its builders can operate becomes shelfware. Specialists will build the simulation, the capture system and the playback chain, and you’ll turn those into tests that run reliably, on schedule, with traceable results. The role covers the full breadth of the lab: setting up hardware, running campaigns, automating procedures, keeping equipment calibrated and inventoried, and producing evidence that engineers and customers can rely on.
 You’ll have an early seat in a new lab, with direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Plan and run tests across all three lab missions: end-to-end simulation runs, emitter capture sessions, playback and channel simulator campaigns, flatsat and receiver tests, and algorithm validation.
 Write procedures and automate them: turn manual setups into scripted, repeatable test sequences, and add them to regression so each software or firmware build is checked.
 Set up and maintain the lab: instruments, SDRs, cabling, fixtures, the screened enclosure and emitter bays, network and compute. Track calibration, configuration and inventory so every result records what produced it.
 Manage test data: keep recordings, run outputs and metadata organised, searchable and backed up, with the provenance to reproduce a result.
 Analyse and report: compare results to expectations and to previous runs, flag regressions and anomalies, write concise test reports, and log issues with the evidence needed to fix them.
 Support campaigns in the field and in the air, customer and partner demonstrations, and the reproduction of on-orbit anomalies on the ground.
 Run the lab safely: RF safety, ESD, equipment handling, access control and the handling rules for controlled material.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Hands-on test experience in an electronics, RF, space or comparable hardware lab: test setups, procedures, execution and reporting
 Comfort with lab instruments (oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, signal generators, power supplies) and basic RF practice (connectors, attenuators, cable loss)
 Scripting for test automation and data analysis, typically Python
 An organised and rigorous way of working: you write things down, version them, and can reproduce last month’s result
 Clear written English
 Nice to haves: 
 Satellite AIT, flatsat or hardware-in-the-loop testing
 SDR experience, RF capture or signal analysis
 Test automation frameworks, CI pipelines, instrument control (SCPI/VISA)
 Test data management, databases, dashboards
 Verification under a formal process (ECSS or similar)
 Experience setting up a lab from scratch: equipment selection, layout, safety, calibration programme
 Spanish, for working with local suppliers and facilities
 Eligibility for national security clearance (an advantage)
 What success looks like 
 6 months: lab equipment is inventoried, calibrated and configuration-tracked, and capture and playback sessions run from written procedures, with data stored and findable.
 12 months: core tests are automated and running in regression, test reports are produced routinely, and you’ve supported the first field campaign.
 24 months: the lab runs as a service. Other teams book and run tests with …

ICEYE is building a space-based RF constellation covering 100 MHz to 30 GHz alongside its SAR fleet, and the Experimentation Lab in Valencia is where we develop, simulate and validate that capability.

The answers need a simulation framework that models the constellation and the emitters end to end, generates the signals each satellite would see, and scores what comes out against a known truth. It doesn’t exist yet. You’ll build it, and it will become a tool used by engineers, analysts and customer-facing staff.
 You’ll work daily with the lab, signal processing and ground segment teams, and you’ll have direct influence on how ICEYE builds and proves this capability.
 Who We Are

 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night.  Model the constellation: orbit propagation, cluster geometry, attitude and pointing, antenna beams, access and contact windows, with spacing and timing as swept variables.
 Model the emitters and the theatre: emitters as state machines with real antenna patterns, scan behaviour, modes and duty cycles, placed at order-of-battle density. Start from the lab’s real captures and extend synthetically.

 Make it a platform: versioned scenarios, seeded and reproducible runs, provenance on every result, tests, CI, documentation and an interface that non-authors can use.
 Answer real questions: capacity, revisit and performance studies for the payload, product and sales teams, and architecture trades for future generations.
 What we’re looking for

 Experience building a simulation or model of a physical system that others used, and validating it against measurement or real data
 Numerical and scientific computing: NumPy/SciPy or equivalent, vectorisation, performance awareness

items.desc:
Your mission at Voi 
 For the Fleet Specialist position, you’ll have the opportunity to work across two main operational areas, with tasks allocated by the line manager based on business needs.
 In our mechanical team , you’ll focus on the maintenance and repair of our vehicles, keeping our scooters in excellent condition and providing crucial support to colleagues in the field.
 In our in‑field team , you’ll use our vans to carry out different tasks around the London area, ensuring our operations run safely, smoothly and reliably for our riders.
 Depending on daily priorities and workload, your line manager will assign you to one area or the other, giving you variety in your day‑to‑day while making sure we cover the most important operational needs. Here are some of the tasks awaiting you as a Fleet Specialist: 
 Ensuring the logistics of collecting and deploying Voi scooters ⚙️
 Searching for and collecting damaged scooters 🛴
 Replacing batteries so vehicles are always ready to ride 🔋
 Performing quick on‑site repairs of scooters 🔧
 Diagnosing and repairing broken vehicles 🔧
 Recycling and dismantling vehicles that cannot be repaired ♻️
 Assisting with the acceptance, packaging and preparation of new vehicles and batteries arriving at the warehouse 🔍
 Supporting our on‑site team as needed – for example, identifying damaged vehicles, clearing parking spaces or setting up fallen vehicles 🤝 You’ll work closely with a supportive team that shares knowledge and helps each other out.
 What you’ll need to embark 
 Mandatory requirement – You must hold a full UK driving licence for at least 12 months, with no more than 6 points and no major offences, to meet our e‑van insurance requirements. Licence checks will be conducted during the recruitment process. As part of the role, you will drive one of our company e‑vans. 
 Good knowledge of your city and feeling comfortable driving there.
 A responsible team player who can manage tasks independently and also enjoys working together with others.
 Willingness to share knowledge, support colleagues and contribute to a positive, respectful team culture.
 A practical, solution‑oriented mindset – you like getting things done and helping the team reach its goals.
 Comfortable navigating the city in a van in different weather and traffic conditions.
 Ability to stay calm and courteous in stressful situations (e.g. poor parking, traffic).
 A physical condition that allows you to safely handle and move scooters and batteries, using the equipment and support provided. PLEASE NOTE: You may be required to go through a DBS Check for this role. 
 Job conditions 
 Working shifts : Friday - Tuesday 08:00-16:00 
 Working hours: 37.5 hours per week
 Contract type: 6‑month fixed‑term contract
 Why Voi? 
 Working at Voi is more than just a job; it’s a personal Voiage where you can grow professionally and be part of a diverse team and culture committed to making a positive impact on society.
 At Voi, you’ll:
 Join Europe’s leading micromobility company and one of the fastest‑growing scale‑ups
 Make a direct impact on our success and contribute to the development of the micromobility industry in London.
 Collaborate with inspiring, motivated and diverse colleagues who share a common goal
 Be part of the micromobility revolution and help create sustainable cities that are cleaner, quieter and less polluted.
 We’re committed to fair, transparent and ethical recruitment practices. All recruitment costs are covered by Voi – no recruitment fees or related costs are ever charged to workers at any stage of the hiring process. We work only with recruitment partners who share our commitment to ethical practices and regularly review our processes to protect workers’ rights and promote a safe and respectful experience for all candidates. We’re also committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We particularly welcome applications from women and other under‑represented groups in logistics, operations and technical roles.
 Are you ready to embark on the Voiage with us?

 In der Privatkundenbank begleiten wir unsere Kund:innen ganzheitlich in allen Finanzfragen – über alle Lebensphasen hinweg. Dabei orientieren wir uns an den sich wandelnden Bedürfnissen unserer Kund:innen: Persönliche Beratung bildet den Kern unseres Angebots und geht Hand in Hand mit leistungsstarken, kontinuierlich weiterentwickelten digitalen Services. Unser Anspruch ist es, mit modernen Filialkonzepten, flexiblen Zugangswegen und innovativen Technologien ein nahtloses Kundenerlebnis zu schaffen. 
 Das erwartet Dich bei uns
 Du bist der erste Eindruck:  Mit Deinem Lächeln und Deiner Kompetenz empfängst Du Kund:innen am Schalter und in der SB-Zone. 
 Du übernimmst Verantwortung:  Kassengeschäfte? Erledigst Du zuverlässig. Kundenanliegen? Klärst Du direkt oder leitest sie gezielt weiter. 
 Du bringst Digitales näher:  Du zeigst, wie einfach Mobile- und Online-Banking funktionieren – und machst unsere digitalen Services erlebbar. 
 Du gewinnst neue Kund:innen:  Mit Deiner offenen Art und Deinem Gespür für Menschen baust Du Beziehungen auf. 
 Du hältst den Laden am Laufen:  Ob Materialbestellung oder Wartebereich – Du denkst mit und gestaltest mit. 
 Du sorgst für Zufriedenheit:  Du hörst zu, findest Lösungen und machst aus Feedback echte Chancen. 
 Das bringst Du mit
 Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbarer beruflicher Hintergrund 
 Interesse und Leidenschaft für modernes Banking (Multikanal-Lösungen, Mobile Banking-Apps, SB-Geräte) 
 Freude am Kundenkontakt und daran, Menschen mit exzellentem Service zu überzeugen 
 Souveränes Auftreten und eine selbstbewusste Persönlichkeit, die Vertrauen schafft 
 Teamgeist, Engagement und Flexibilität, um gemeinsam im dynamischen Arbeitsalltag erfolgreich zu sein 
 Das bieten wir Dir
 #JoinOurTeam – Unsere Mitarbeiter:innen sind die treibende Kraft hinter unserem Erfolg und damit unser höchstes Gut. Weil wir uns unserer Verantwortung als Arbeitgeber bewusst sind, wurden wir erneut als Top Employer ausgezeichnet. Werde auch Du Teil unseres Teams.
 #UnleashYourPotential – Bei uns gestaltest Du Deine Weiterbildung eigenständig und individuell. Mit umfangreichen Qualifizierungsmaßnahmen, strategischen und zukunftsorientierten Entwicklungsprogrammen oder individuellem Mentoring geben wir Deiner Karriere eine Perspektive. 
 #ThinkEuropean – Wir zählen nicht nur zu den größten Finanzinstituten Deutschlands, sondern sind als Teil der UniCredit auch international tätig und erfolgreich. Bei uns erwartet Dich ein paneuropäisches Unternehmen mit regionaler Verbundenheit sowie spannende Karrierechancen in den aufregendsten Städten der Welt.
 #DesignYourWorkingLife – Digitalisierung und Flexibilität prägen unsere moderne Arbeitswelt. Gestalte Deinen Arbeitsalltag so, wie er am besten zu Dir passt: Ob im Office, remote in ganz Deutschland oder aus dem EU-Ausland. Du möchtest länger verreisen? Dann nimm ein Sabbatical und entdecke mit uns die Möglichkeiten von New Work.
 #EnjoyTheBest – Nutze als Mitarbeiter:in das beste Premiumkonto Deutschlands kostenfrei. 
 #CareNowForLater – Wir sorgen auch in Zukunft für Dich. Denn neben monatlichen Gehaltszahlungen ist die Altersvorsorge ein Thema, mit dem Du Dich nicht erst zu Beginn der Rente beschäftigen solltest. Deshalb unterstützen wir vom ersten Tag an Deine finanzielle Vorsorge für den Ruhestand.
 #DontStopMoving – Nutze die Flexibilität von Wellhub: Deutschlandweit steht Dir ein umfassendes Netzwerk an Sport-, Freizeit- und Wellnesseinrichtungen zur Verfügung. Darüber hinaus profitierst Du von einem internationalen Partnernetz, das Dir Zugang zu Angeboten rund um den Globus ermöglicht. Weil Bewegung für uns nicht nur Gesundheit, sondern auch Nachhaltigkeit bedeutet, bieten wir Dir zudem die Möglichkeit, ein JobRad zu attraktiven Konditionen zu leasen und das Deutschlandticket zu vergünstigten Bedingungen zu nutzen. So unterstützen wir Dich bei einem aktiven Lifestyle und fördern gleichzeitig eine umweltfreundliche, kosteneffiziente Mobilität.
 #RelaxInNature – Berge oder See? Du hast die Qual der Wahl, denn die Gästehäuser unseres Partners Food & More bieten beides! Während Dich auf der Markbachjochhütte in Österreich auf 1.500 …

 Schimbă lumea de mâine alături de noi. 
 Unitatea noastră de business Automation (DI AUT) este unul dintre liderii mondiali în furnizarea de produse, sisteme, soluții și servicii în domeniul Motion Control. Aceasta include aproximativ 20.000 de angajați și patru segmente de activitate. Prin locațiile sale globale de producție, cercetare și dezvoltare (R&D) și servicii, MC este aproape de clienții săi și este activă într-o gamă largă de industrii. În cadrul grupului nostru de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiilor de automatizare, în industria auto și în zona de intralogistică. 
 In prezent cautam un Packaging Specialist care sa se alature echipei de logistica. 
 Responsabilitatea principala va fi asigurraea managementului operational end-to-end al ambalajelor returnabile si nereutilizabile, cu focus pe disponibilitate, circulatie, stocuri, calitate, cost si trasabilitate. Administreaza procesele si datele in BinMan, coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare si actioneaza ca punct central de contact pentru clienti, furnizori, transportatori si functiile interne. Contribuie la standardizarea, digitalizarea si imbunatatirea continua a circuitului de ambalaje, pentru sustinerea productiei si a livrarilor. 
 Descrierea postului: 
 • Administreaza operativ BinMan si asigura utilizarea corecta a sistemului, inclusiv actualizarea datelor, monitorizarea miscarilor, reconcilierea soldurilor si tratarea abaterilor. 
 • Monitorizeaza disponibilitatea, circulatia, stocurile, timpii de ciclu, pierderile si deteriorarile ambalajelor; initiaza masuri corective si escaladeaza riscurile care pot afecta productia sau livrarile. 
 • Coordoneaza activitatea furnizorului de spalare: planificare, prioritati, capacitate, volume, timpi de procesare, calitate, trasabilitate si respectarea nivelului de serviciu agreat. 
 • Verifica rezultatele spalarii si conditionarii ambalajelor, gestioneaza deviatiile de calitate si urmareste implementarea actiunilor corective impreuna cu furnizorul si functiile interne relevante. 
 • Coordoneaza operational relatia cu clientii si furnizorii pentru cerinte, disponibilitate, livrari/retururi, diferente de sold, reclamatii, pierderi, deteriorari si reguli de utilizare a ambalajelor.

 • Coordoneaza fluxurile de transport asociate ambalajelor si confirma executia acestora pe baza planificarii si a documentelor disponibile. 
 • Mentine si verifica instructiunile, retetele si datele de ambalare; initiaza crearea sau modificarea acestora impreuna cu functiile responsabile si sustine standardizarea conceptelor de ambalare. 
 • Defineste si urmareste indicatori operationali relevanti: disponibilitate, acuratete stoc, timp de ciclu, restante, pierderi/deteriorari, calitate spalare, cost si nivel de serviciu. 
 • Pregateste rapoarte periodice si analize, conduce revizuiri operationale cu partenerii si documenteaza deciziile, responsabilitatile si termenele. 
 • Participa la proiecte de optimizare, relabeling, transfer, introducere de ambalaje noi, reducere de cost, digitalizare si sustenabilitate. 
 • Asigura respectarea standardelor interne, a instructiunilor de lucru, a cerintelor de calitate, EHS, curatenie, reutilizare si reducere a deseurilor. 
 • Instruieste utilizatorii si partenerii privind procesele de packaging si BinMan si actioneaza ca punct de escaladare operationala in aria sa de responsabilitate.

 • Sisteme: SAP si BinMan sau sisteme logistice comparabile; Microsoft Office, in special Excel si PowerPoint. 
 • Capabilitati: analiza de date si raportare, management KPI, standardizare de proces, rezolvare structurata a problemelor si imbunatatire continua. 
 • Limbi straine: limba engleza minimum nivel B1-B2 pentru colaborare operationala si corespondenta. 
 • Responsabilitate: acuratetea datelor, disciplina procesului, monitorizarea performantelor, coordonarea partenerilor si escaladarea la timp a riscurilor.

 Participate in design and development of core heat transfer solver capabilities in Simcenter STAR-CCM+

 Supporting maintenance of our existing capability (bug fixing, code refactoring, etc.)

 Required Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience:
 Candidates applying for this position are required to have the following skills and experience: 
 A Master’s or PhD degree in engineering or physical science discipline, ideally focusing on the heat transfer applications in the context of fluid and thermal transport problems 
 1-5 years of total experience 
 Experience in commercial CFD software development, or in non-commercial CFD software development 
 Expertise in implementing different heat transfer models 
 Expertise in object-oriented C++ software development 
 Expertise in development of complex software applications using modern design patterns and principles 
 Preferred Knowledge/Skills, Education, and Experience 
 In addition, preference will be given to candidates with the following skills and experience: 
 Expertise in areas of physical science: fluid flow, multiphase, or combustion

 Siemens Software, a business unit of the Siemens Digital Industries, is a leading global provider of software solutions to drive the digital transformation of industry, creating new opportunities for manufacturers to realize innovation.
 About the role: 
 The Build and Dependency Management Engineer is a technical role within a global, multi-site DevOps organization. This role exists because build and dependency management requires dedicated, specialized ownership that cannot be absorbed by general DevOps or product development roles alone.

 Support and improve CI infrastructure (Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent)
 Maintain and configure CI-related software on build nodes (Windows and Linux)
 · Dependency Management 
 Own the dependency lifecycle: acquisition, versioning, caching, and distribution of third-party and internal libraries
 Collaborate on dependency orchestration tooling and services (e.g., Conan, Artifactory, or equivalent)
 Support legal clearing and compliance workflows for third-party dependencies
 · Compliance & Quality Tooling 
 Support and improve automation for compliance-related tooling: SAST, binary analysis, threat response analysis, and similar
 Maintain product installers and packaging infrastructure
 · Cross-Team Alignment 
 Collaborate with product development teams to understand build and dependency needs
 Align with DevOps, platform, and product teams on ownership boundaries and best practices
 Participate in stakeholder discussions to evaluate and improve build lifecycle processes

items.desc: 🚀 #WEAREALTIA ALTIA is a multidisciplinary team focused on delivering advanced data-driven solutions that generate measurable impact and enable smarter decision-making. Working across international environments, we combine analytics, artificial intelligence, and business expertise to transform data into strategic value. Our mission is to help organizations evolve through innovation, scalable data platforms, and high-quality analytical solutions, fostering continuous learning, collaboration, and technological excellence. We are looking for an Advanced Data Scientist & Remote Sensing AI Engineer with high-level expertise in Earth observation (EO), geospatial big data, cloud/HPC architectures, and Machine Learning / Deep Learning for wildfire monitoring and risk assessment to join our team in supporting international research and decision-support platforms (such as EFFIS and GWIS). The role involves the spatial, temporal, and statistical integration of Earth observation data, meteorological feeds, and environmental streams with internal wildfire databases.
