items.desc: Our Mission Rebuild how the world works, to make institutions work better for the people they serve. About Brain Co. Brain Co. builds AI-native operating systems for large, regulated institutions. Each system is built for a specific industry, powered by agents that push real workflows forward. Underneath it all is Atlas, our proprietary platform that keeps customers in control, secure by design, and never locked into one model. Why Now Brain Co. is entering its next phase of production deployments on a national scale with an elite team built from Palantir, Google, Meta, and Nvidia, and a growing footprint across government, insurance, health, and financial services. Joining now means shaping both the company and a new category of applied AI. Every project here ships to production and is expected to create measurable customer value and impact. You'll work alongside exceptional peers on some of the hardest problems in applied AI. It’s the kind of work you'll still be proud of in ten years from now. Machine Learning Engineer, Applied AI About The Role So much of the work society depends on is still slower and harder than it should be. Permits take months. Claims sit unresolved. And AI hasn't changed that — because the bottleneck isn't the models. It's the institutional context AI needs to do the work: rules, history, relationships, and judgment scattered across people, documents, and legacy systems. BrainCo exists to fix that. We build agent-native operating systems for the institutions society depends on, and our products are the first of their kind in the world — we were the first, anywhere, to fully automate construction permitting, and we're now doing the same across insurance and other industries. There is no playbook here, because no one has built this before. As a Machine Learning Engineer on Applied AI, your work begins where the demo ends: getting a model to look impressive is the easy part; making it a production decision system an institution stakes its process on is the job. The problems come in every shape — custom vision model pipelines that check blueprints against building codes at 95%+ accuracy, agents that untangle policy stacks to reveal coverage gaps, systems that predict from clinical records whether a patient is on their care path — and you'll own them end-to-end, from ambiguous customer problem to the eval that catches a whole class of errors. This is frontier ML applied where it's hardest and matters most. The problems are underspecified, the documents are brutal, the accuracy bar is institutional-grade — and the feedback loops are real, because our systems move real workflows forward every day. Who We're Looking For You understand how machine learning actually works — not just the tooling, but the philosophy underneath: what a loss function really optimizes, how generalization breaks under distribution shift, why evaluation is where systems quietly go wrong. And you live at the bleeding edge of modern AI, with hard-won instincts for squeezing the most out of LLMs and agentic systems — prompting, fine-tuning, tool use, and reasoning. That combination is the job: you know when a fine-tuned segmentation model beats a VLM, when a rule engine beats both, and how to compose all three into a system more accurate than any single model. You treat frontier models as components to be measured, pushed, and engineered — never as magic. Most of all, you're energized by building things that have never existed, and comfortable when the problem, the data, and the definition of success all have to be invented at once. The Problems You'll Work On Composite AI systems and credit assignment. Our most demanding systems chain vision transformers, segmentation models, VLM reasoning, and rule engines. When the pipeline is wrong, which component failed? One of the most interesting open problems in applied ML. Document understanding beyond the frontier. Blueprints, site plans, policy stacks, contracts, clinical records — dense, multimodal documents that break off-the-shelf models. You'll build models that actually read them. Agents that learn from real work. Our deployments generate verified, ground-truth outcomes on every decision — reward signals most labs can only simulate. You'll help design the data, evals, and training loops to build and fine-tune agents on them. Evaluation as a product discipline. When a regulator has to trust your system, evals are the product. You'll build eval suites and failure-mode taxonomies rigorous enough to earn institutional sign-off. Institutional Intelligence that compounds. Every verified correction improves the system twice: the corrected fact percolates to every application, and the system that builds the intelligence learns to build it better. You'll work on both loops. In This Role, You Will Turn ambiguity into shipped systems — from no problem statement, no labeled data, and no agreed definition of success, to well-posed ML problems and production deployments. Own AI …

Concevoir, développer et optimiser des modèles de Machine Learning répondant à des problématiques de détection, prédiction et classification. Évaluer les performances des modèles à travers des approches de backtesting, de validation statistique et de suivi des indicateurs de performance. Développer des approches d'ensemble (ensemble learning) et des stratégies combinant plusieurs modèles afin d'améliorer la précision et la robustesse des résultats. Réaliser des études exploratoires et analytiques à partir de jeux de données complexes. Mettre en place des tableaux de bord et indicateurs de suivi sous Power BI afin de faciliter la prise de décision. Concevoir et industrialiser des produits Data intégrant des traitements automatisés et des algorithmes d'intelligence artificielle. Développer des modèles de traitement du langage naturel (NLP) pour l'analyse de données textuelles. Contribuer à la conception, à l'évaluation et à l'optimisation de solutions basées sur l'IA générative, les grands modèles de langage (LLM) et les architectures RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation). Assurer l'interprétabilité et l'explicabilité des modèles à l'aide des méthodologies adaptées. Collaborer avec les équipes techniques et métiers afin d'identifier les opportunités de création de valeur par la donnée. Présenter les résultats des analyses et formuler des recommandations auprès des parties prenantes. Participer à la documentation, à la maintenance et à l'amélioration continue des solutions développées. Veiller au respect des normes de qualité des données, de sécurité et de conformité réglementaire, notamment en matière de protection des données personnelles. PROFIL RECHERCHÉ Le candidat dispose d'une expérience en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle. Il maîtrise l'ensemble de la chaîne de traitement de la donnée, depuis l'acquisition et la préparation des données jusqu'au déploiement et au suivi des modèles en production. Le profil recherché évolue dans les environnements suivants : Développement en Python pour la Data Science et le Machine Learning. Utilisation avancée de SQL pour l'exploration et la transformation de données. Expérience des environnements Google Cloud Platform (GCP), notamment BigQuery. Maîtrise des bibliothèques de Machine Learning et de Data Science (Scikit-Learn, Pandas, NumPy ou équivalent). Expérience en Deep Learning et traitement automatique du langage naturel (NLP). Connaissance des architectures Transformer et des modèles de type BERT, Flan-T5 ou modèles équivalents. Expérience sur les solutions d'IA générative, grands modèles de langage (LLM) et pipelines RAG. Maîtrise de Power BI pour la visualisation et le monitoring des données. Bonne connaissance des techniques d'évaluation, de monitoring et d'interprétabilité des modèles. items.desc: Möbius is een adviesbureau dat organisaties binnen verschillende sectoren helpt om de beste oplossingen te ontwerpen en te implementeren. Onze +140 collega's zijn actief in België en Nederland en begeleiden al meer dan 28 jaar een diversiteit aan organisaties. Met een sterke focus op de nieuwste technologische ontwikkelingen ondersteunen we bedrijven in hun transformatie naar data-gedreven en AI-gebaseerde organisaties — van generatieve AI-oplossingen die repetitieve taken automatiseren, tot klassieke machine learning-modellen die complexe patronen blootleggen. Om deze transformatieve oplossingen te realiseren en onze impact verder uit te breiden, zijn we op zoek naar een gemotiveerde AI Engineer . Deze rol is in de eerste plaats technisch, maar je verliest de business nooit uit het oog. Jouw rol Je vertrekt vanuit een businessprobleem: denk hierbij aan een stapel documenten die manueel wordt verwerkt, een klantendienst die verdrinkt in mails, een proces dat te veel tijd kost, … en vertaalt dat naar de meest passende architectuur. Vervolgens ontwikkel je de AI-oplossing: soms is dat een oplossing op maat , soms een schaalbaar platform dat over meerdere klanten of use cases heen werkt. Jij maakt die keuze bewust en onderbouwd. In de praktijk betekent dit: Samenwerken met klanten en interne teams om hun behoeften en processen goed te begrijpen en te (helpen) vertalen naar concrete AI- en ML-oplossingen. AI-applicaties ontwerpen en ontwikkelen , met een sterke focus op Large Language Models (LLM’s) en Generative AI . Je past technieken zoals prompt engineering en RAG toe om betrouwbare, pragmatische en performante oplossingen te bouwen die aansluiten bij de specifieke klantbehoeften en use-cases. Oplossingen ontwikkelen met Python en relevante AI/ML-frameworks (bv. Scikit-learn, TensorFlow en PyTorch), en AI-functionaliteit integreren in bredere applicaties en processen, onder andere via API’s. Technische architecturen voor AI/ML-oplossingen ontwerpen , waarbij je bewuste keuzes maakt rond modulaire componenten, integraties, schaalbaarheid, betrouwbaarheid, veiligheid, beheersbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie. Je denkt daarbij niet alleen na over wat technisch werkt , maar ook over wat passend en duurzaam is voor de specifieke use-case. Vanuit die architectuur robuuste en schaalbare AI/ML-pipelines bouwen en vervolgens in productie brengen : van proof-of-concept tot een betrouwbare deployment in cloudomgevingen zoals Azure - kortom: MLOps van A tot Z. GenAI met klassieke Machine Learning-technieken combineren wanneer dat relevant is (vb. classificatie, regressie, clustering of tijdreeksanalyse). Je kiest daarbij de techniek die het best past bij het probleem , in plaats van AI of LLM’s als doel op zich te zien. Wij bieden jou 💸 Een aantrekkelijk salarispakket inclusief extra voordelen (zoals een elektrische bedrijfswagen, laptop, verzekeringen, sport- en welzijnsinitiatieven, enz.) 💪🏼 De kans om zelfstandig aan toonaangevende projecten te werken, waarbij je je talenten kunt tonen en ontwikkelen 🎓 Uitgebreide opleidingsmogelijkheden om een expert in jouw vakgebied te worden en om steeds up-to-date te blijven met de nieuwste AI-trends 👥 Een ondernemende en innovatieve bedrijfscultuur waar klantgerichtheid, kennisdeling en collegialiteit centraal staan 👩🏼 💻 Werken binnen een modern holacracy framework dat zelforganisatie en wendbaarheid stimuleert 💬 Een cultuur van continue feedback , gericht op persoonlijke en professionele groei 🕦 Flexibele werktijden , inspirerende kantoren en de mogelijkheid om vanuit je eigen thuiskantoor te werken 💡 Inspirerende en uitdagende events gedurende het hele jaar Ontdek op hier hoe deze job er in praktijk kan uitzien en solliciteer via LinkedIn, onze website of via jobs@mobius.eu Tot binnenkort!

items.desc: At a glance Are you a pioneering data scientist who likes to think outside-the-box? Would you like to drive new data science solutions to tackle financial fraud? Do you want to work with cutting-edge technologies to catch criminals? Your job As a data scientist, in the Grid Channel Security, you will work together with fraud experts, data scientists, machine learning engineers and data analysts to safeguard our customers from criminals. This includes threats such as phishing, account takeover, lost or stolen debit cards, e-commerce fraud, and more. Your role will encompass analysing diverse data sources to get actionable insights. This analysis will include, but not limited to, understanding fraud trends across various payment channels, evaluating the potential of different data fields to enhance our fraud detection, experimenting with different modelling approaches and enhancements, recognizing seasonal patterns, and creating reliable forecasts. Your contributions will extend beyond immediate solutions, serving as a catalyst for ongoing improvements in our fraud detection capabilities through model experimentation and the integration of new data elements. In addition to your focused problem-solving efforts, you will be collaborating with others to brainstorm how data science solutions can help us stay one step ahead of criminals in the ongoing cat-and-mouse game. ABN AMRO is a future driven bank that is working continuously on unlocking the power of data: you will be part of this transformation! Working environment Grid Channel Security within Corporate Information Security Office (CISO) is responsible for the prevention and detection of payment fraud, and deciding the policy and strategy in the area of fraud. The Fraud Monitoring team that you are going to be part of, is a motivated multidisciplinary group of approximately 25 colleagues working with a focus on protecting customers. We work in a hybrid way and our day to day work is organized by the agile and scrum principles. CISO is recognised as having an informal work atmosphere where everyone has a heart for their job and is prepared to help others. Your profile We are looking for a data scientist with strong technical and problem-solving skills, as well as a collaborative mindset. We strongly emphasize that there are no "lone wolves" on our team. You should care deeply about helping your colleagues, mentoring, and coaching where possible, while maintaining a learning mindset. Required Qualifications and technical skills: A master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative field (e.g., Computer Science, Statistics, Econometrics, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, etc.). 5 years of independent machine learning development experience, including exploratory data analysis, model experimentation, and collaborating with engineers for model deployment in real-world applications. Demonstrated professional experience developing ML models in a big data environment (e.g., Spark, distributed computing frameworks). Strong working knowledge of Python, SQL, and Spark. Familiarity with MLOps concepts such as lineage, reproducibility, and model monitoring, and experience with tools like MLFlow. An understanding of the full data science lifecycle and an ability to make trade-off decisions around key concepts such as sampling, cross-validation, model evaluation metrics, and feature engineering. Experience working in a professional software development environment, such as appropriate use of Git, code reviews, code packaging, and orchestration of jobs. Strong technical communication skills; capable of presenting data science work to either business or highly technical stakeholders. You should see the value in technical documentation. Project management skills: you understand how to scope modelling projects. You have experience working in an Agile environment. Preferred team values: A demonstrated ability to innovate and think creatively to solve complex technical puzzles. You display persistence and intellectual curiosity to ensure that not only is work complete, but the problem at hand is truly solved. You are proactive in solving problems; reaching outing to stakeholders as and when necessary, ask for reviews or brainstorming sessions with your team, suggesting new ideas to solve existing problems. In addition to meeting the above requirements, please write a one-page cover letter describing how your experience meetings the required qualifications and describe a few scenarios where you have demonstrated our teams' values. We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility …

items.desc: Welcome to Data Intellect , we thrive on solving complex data challenges in high-stakes environments. We’re a team of engineers, problem-solvers and collaborators who believe in pushing boundaries, not egos. Job Description We build AI systems that go into production. Our clients are Tier 1 banks and hedge funds with real data volumes and real regulatory pressure and they hire us because we can put working software in front of them quickly. This role is for an engineer who has already built agentic AI systems and wants to do more. You will design and build agents that call tools, query client data, reason over it and hand back something a user can act on. Some of that runs against cloud model APIs, some of it runs on local models inside a client's network because the data cannot leave the building. You need to be comfortable with both. You will work directly with client engineers and stakeholders, as an AI specialist. Building reusable accelerators so the next engagement starts further along than the last one Qualifications Essential 5+ years' commercial experience in a Software Engineering role, with a proven track record of designing, building, testing and deploying production-quality software Demonstrable experience building AI agents that use LLMs, cloud hosted or local. We will want to talk in detail about something you have built, why you built it that way and what broke Fluent use of AI-assisted coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or similar) in day to day development Strong software engineering fundamentals: version control, testing, code review, CI/CD and an understanding of what makes code someone else can maintain Strong written and spoken communication. You can write a clear client-facing document and hold your own in a technical conversation with a client Able to work with minimal supervision. You take a problem, ask the right questions early and come back with progress rather than waiting to be unblocked Genuine interest in where agentic AI is going, evidenced by what you read, build or contribute to outside of what your last employer asked of you Desirable Claude Certified Architect (Foundations or Professional), or an equivalent credential from another vendor. If you have not done one, we will support you through it Background in financial services, market data or another regulated, data-heavy domain Experience with MCP server development Experience with time series or analytical databases (kdb+/KDB-X, ClickHouse, Oracle) Python, Java and TypeScript Experience deploying models on-premise or in a locked-down cloud environment Who does well here People who are honest about what they do not know. People who put in the work. Consultancy has peaks and clients notice who shows up during them People who can hold a relationship as well as a codebase. Much of our repeat work comes from a client trusting a specific engineer. People who collaborate well and share what they learn, rather than keeping the clever bit to themselves. Additional Information What’s on offer: Direct involvement in shaping our AI practice rather than slotting into someone else's Exposure to senior stakeholders at recognisable clients from early on Work alongside a supportive team and across our global offices Continuous L&D opportunities, training and certifications A modern, flexible working environment Competitive salary and benefits The chance to make a real impact on how Data Intellect grows Healthcare cover - Benenden Health, including 24/7 GP & Mental Health Helpline. Generous referral scheme - we love to see referrals coming through and referring a friend means cash for you! Regular social events, prizes and giveaways - our talented social committee work hard all year round to provide exciting events across all regions and they’re open to suggestions. items.desc: 🖇️Sobre Diverger. Somos una compañía tecnológica de más de 100 profesionales y 14 años de trayectoria. Integramos IA y sistemas de agentes en el ciclo completo de desarrollo de software de sectores como banca, retail, energía, industria y telecomunicaciones. Lo hacemos con un método propio, Exponential Programming, y somos partner de Anthropic y Google . Tenemos oficinas en Madrid y A Coruña y una cultura de trabajo remoto. En Diverger la IA no se aprende en un curso, se aprende entregando software con ella. Buscamos personas entusiastas en aplicar las herramientas de IA en el desarrollo de software, con base en deep learning, entre 1 y 3 años programando, que quieran aprender a construir con agentes en equipos que ya lo hacen para grandes compañías. No te pedimos que llegues sabiéndolo. Te pedimos fundamentos y criterio para aprovecharlo. 🔛Qué harás: Desarrollar y mantener servicios en Python y, según el proyecto, podrás tocar otros lenguajes: Java, .Net, JavaScript/TypeScript... Integrar modelos de lenguaje en aplicaciones reales. Llamadas a APIs de modelos, recuperación de información sobre la documentación del cliente y evaluación de resultados. Trabajar a diario con asistentes y agentes de código siguiendo Exponential Programming , nuestro método de desarrollo con IA. Escribir tests, revisar el código de otras personas y dejar documentado lo que construyes. Proponer cómo medir si lo que se construye con IA funciona de verdad. Llevar a la comunidad interna de IA lo que aprendas en tu proyecto. ✨Lo imprescindible: Entre 2 y 3 años desarrollando software. Las prácticas largas, proyectos personales y los proyectos de investigación cuentan. Formación universitaria con un máster o una especialización, un TFG o un TFM en IA. Si vienes de otra disciplina y te especializaste después, cuéntanoslo. En nuestro equipo de IA hay quien llegó por ese camino. Python con soltura. Has escrito código que otras personas usan o mantienen. Base real en Java, React, Next o en JavaScript/TypeScript. Con uno de ellos basta. Fundamentos de LLM que sepas explicar con tus palabras. Cómo se entrena y se evalúa un modelo, qué mide una métrica y cuándo engaña. Inglés suficiente para leer documentación técnica y trabajar con equipos internacionales. 😊Cuéntanos al menos una de estas cosas: Un proyecto, TFG o TFM en el que fuiste más allá de lo que te pedían, y qué decidiste por tu cuenta. Algo que construiste sin que nadie te lo encargara. Un repositorio, una demo, un artículo. Una competición, un hackathon o una publicación, y qué te llevaste aunque no ganaras. Una disciplina que llegaste a dominar viniendo de otra. Un resultado académico que refleje constancia más que un buen día. 🪄Cómo trabajamos en equipo: Aquí el conocimiento no se guarda. Revisamos el código (HITL, HOTL, …),, contamos en la c omunidad de IA y en otros foros especializados , lo que funciona y lo que no. Quién sabe más, dedica tiempo a quien empieza. Invertimos en el desarrollo de cada persona y esperamos que quien entra quiera hacer lo mismo por el equipo. Valoramos, sin que sea requisito: Haber usado APIs de modelos como Claude, Gemini o GPT, o modelos open source, en proyectos reales, un proyecto académico o personal. Nociones de RAG, embeddings o bases de datos vectoriales. Conocimientos de sistemas multiagente y harness. Git, Docker, CI/CD y algo de cloud en AWS, Azure o GCP. SQL y modelado de datos. Cómo vas a crecer: Itinerario formativo interno de IA y Exponential Programming aplicado en proyecto desde el primer día. Acceso a las certificaciones oficiales de Anthropic. Un Technical Leader de referencia en tu proyecto. Una comunidad interna de IA donde se comparten casos reales, tendencias, estado del arte, etc. 💡 Lo que te espera en Diverger 🎯 Meritocracia real: tu salario refleja lo que aportas 📚 Formación (Codely, Udemy, certis Google & MS, workshops internos) 🧠 Comunidad técnica + mentoría + equipo de IA que te acompaña 🌍 100% remoto (oficinas en Madrid y Coruña si te apetece) 🕒 Flexibilidad horaria total ☀️ Jornada intensiva en julio y agosto 🏖️ 23 días de vacaciones + 24 y 31 diciembre 💳 Retribución flexible (transporte, comida, guardería, seguro…) 💬 Comunicación transparente y cultura horizontal 📈 Plan de carrera y revisiones anuales 🧘 Red de apoyo interna: no caminas solx 💜 ¿Por qué Diverger? Porque creemos que un buen proyecto no se define únicamente por su stack tecnológico, sino también por las personas con las que trabajas y por todo lo que puedes aprender y aportar. Aquí encontrarás: 🚀 Proyectos estables y con retos reales. 🧠 IA generativa aplicada al desarrollo. 🤝 Cultura horizontal y colaborativa. 💡 Espacio para aportar criterio técnico. En Diverger respiramos un entorno diverso y en el que todas las personas tengan igualdad de condiciones. Crecemos por nuestro compromiso, nuestra exigencia y nuestra pasión por lo que hacemos sin importar la mochila con la que viajemos. items.desc: Purpose As an AI Engineer in the IP Development team, you will be responsible for driving the effective use of AI across our software development lifecycle. Your focus will be on identifying where AI can improve delivery, quality, and user experience, and turning those opportunities into practical, scalable solutions. You will work closely with Engineering Managers, the Principal Developer, Software Architect, and Product teams to embed AI into both how we build products and how our platforms operate. This includes enhancing existing capabilities (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation), improving prompt design and reliability, and exploring new use cases that deliver real value. You will also play a key role in enabling the wider team, helping developers, designers, and product teams adopt AI tools and approaches in a way that is effective, responsible, and aligned to our engineering standards. Role Responsibilities Identify and deliver practical AI use cases across the development lifecycle (e.g. planning, design, development, testing, and support) Design, build, and improve AI-enabled features within our platforms, including RAG-based solutions and LLM integrations Develop and refine prompts, workflows, and evaluation approaches to improve reliability, accuracy, and usefulness of AI outputs Work closely with Engineering and Architecture to ensure AI solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with platform design Collaborate with Product teams to identify opportunities where AI can enhance user experience or unlock new capabilities Support the integration of AI services and tooling (e.g. model APIs, orchestration layers, vector stores) into existing systems Help define and evolve best practices for using AI within the team, including quality, security, and governance considerations Enable and upskill the wider team by sharing knowledge, running sessions, and supporting hands-on adoption of AI tools Evaluate emerging tools and technologies, balancing experimentation with practical implementation Contribute to improving team efficiency through the use of AI-assisted development tools and workflows Monitor and assess the effectiveness of AI implementations, iterating based on feedback and outcomes Where appropriate, support the safe and responsible use of AI, including data handling, prompt safety, and output validation Person Specification & Skills Experience working with AI/ML technologies, particularly LLMs and modern AI tooling Practical experience building or integrating AI-enabled applications (e.g. RAG, chat interfaces, AI-assisted workflows) Strong understanding of prompt design, evaluation, and techniques to improve output quality and consistency Experience working with APIs and integrating external services into applications Familiarity with concepts such as vector databases, embeddings, and information retrieval Understanding of software development practices and how AI fits into the development lifecycle Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, product, and design teams Strong problem-solving items.desc: About Mendix (a Siemens Company) At Mendix, we're on a mission to fundamentally reinvent how applications are created. We believe in abstracting the development process, empowering everyone involved in an enterprise's digital future – from business analysts to software engineers and even CEOs – to meaningfully participate. Our goal is to create better applications faster and shape the future of software development itself. Curious about the incredible solutions global organizations are building with our platform? Check out our Customer Stories! Join Our Innovative Team Are you passionate about the cutting edge of technology and eager to make a real impact? We're looking for a talented Staff Software Engineer to join our dynamic team and help us build the future of Generative AI. In this role, you'll be instrumental in developing the tools, frameworks, and services that empower developers to create powerful solutions using Generative AI. Your work will span everything from tooling and evaluations to building solutions for accessing Large Language Model (LLM) providers. You'll directly influence the quality of our GenAI offerings and, in turn, enhance the lives of our customers and developers. Imagine a future where our AI tooling helps developers create higher-quality applications, faster – you'll be a key part of making that a reality! You're The Engineer We're Looking For If You Have Strong Programming Skills: Proficiency in Python or TypeScript, with a keen interest in frameworks and backend solutions. Operational Expertise: Experience in an operations role, preferably with hands-on experience in AWS and Kubernetes (K8s). Generative AI Knowledge: A genuine interest in and demonstrated knowledge of the modern AI landscape, including but not limited to Context Engineering, the full RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) lifecycle, and best MLOps practices. Passion for Technology: A deep passion for technology, coupled with strong problem-solving and analytical skills. Agile Mindset: The ability to break down complex challenges into manageable parts and construct solutions with short, iterative feedback cycles. Ownership & Collaboration: A strong sense of ownership over your work, a commitment to helping your team succeed, and a love for thriving in a collaborative environment where teamwork is celebrated. Why Us? At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce We value your unique identity and perspective. items.desc: Septeo est un acteur de référence du software en Europe , présent à l’international et reconnu parmi le top 5 des éditeurs de logiciels sectoriels en France . En forte croissance et en transformation permanente, le groupe s’impose comme un acteur clé de l’édition logicielle grâce à la force de son collectif : des équipes déterminées, audacieuses et engagées. Chez Septeo, l’intelligence artificielle est placée au cœur de notre évolution . Nous la concevons comme un levier de performance durable, de collaboration et d’innovation, intégrée de manière responsable dans les pratiques du quotidien et démocratisé sur l’ensemble de nos métiers. L'ambition est claire : “make intelligent software for Europe”. Notre culture repose sur des valeurs fortes : être, faire et transformer ensemble . Elle n’est pas figée; elle se vit chaque jour dans nos actions et nos décisions, à travers un équilibre entre performance, responsabilité et plaisir. Cette ambition s’incarne dans ce que nous faisons au quotidien : concevoir des logiciels qui accompagnent les moments de vie essentiels, au service de millions de citoyens. Être présent derrière ces instants clés est une responsabilité forte. C’est la nôtre. Et peut-être bientôt la votre. Rejoindre Septeo, c’est intégrer une aventure collective à dimension internationale , porter la transformation du groupe dans un environnement en mouvement rapide, et faire de l’IA un levier concret de création de valeur, aujourd’hui comme demain. Deze organisatie investeert sterk in technologie en innovatie om haar dienstverlening continu te verbeteren. Binnen een stabiele en hoogtechnologische omgeving krijg je de kans om mee te bouwen aan betrouwbare dataoplossingen en innovatieve toepassingen die een concrete meerwaarde bieden voor de organisatie. Je zal deel uitmaken van een team waar je meewerkt aan de verdere uitbouw van het data-ecosysteem . Je ontwerpt, bouwt en onderhoudt robuuste datapipelines en dataproducten die data uit verschillende bronnen ontsluiten, verwerken en beschikbaar maken voor analyse en rapportering . Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's uit data, IT en de business om databehoeften te vertalen naar kwalitatieve en schaalbare oplossingen. Naast klassieke data engineering krijg je ook de kans om mee te werken aan innovatieve AI-toepassingen . Denk hierbij aan het voorbereiden en ontsluiten van data voor toepassingen op basis van generatieve AI , waaronder Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) en vector search. Je waakt over de kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en herbruikbaarheid van de data en denkt actief mee over hoe nieuwe technologieën de organisatie vooruit kunnen helpen. Meer info? e.dhooge@madison.be Profiel Je behaalde een relevant bachelor- of masterdiploma Je hebt relevante ervaring als Data Engineer Je hebt een goede kennis van Python en SQL en ervaring met het bouwen en onderhouden van datapipelines Je hebt inzicht in datamodellering , ETL/ELT-processen en datakwaliteit Ervaring met technologieën zoals SQL Server, PostgreSQL of Delta Lake is een plus Je heb ervaring in moderne AI-toepassingen en hebt kennis van concepten zoals RAG, embeddings, vector search en documentverwerking Je werkt graag samen met collega's uit verschillende teams en vertaalt technische uitdagingen naar betrouwbare dataoplossingen Je volgt nieuwe ontwikkelingen binnen data engineering en AI met interesse op Aanbod Een competitief loon, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen ( bedrijfswagen of mobiliteitsbudget , nettovergoeding, hospitalisatieverzekering voor jou en je gezin, groepsverzekering, ecocheques...) items.desc: Location: London (Chancery Lane) Working pattern: Full time, hybrid (circa 2/3 days in office) About The Role Accordience Group is the parent company of four specialist communications agencies - Grayling, CDR, Red Consultancy, and Cirkle - operating across 30+ offices worldwide. We are building custom AI tools across the group. We have strong demand and clear ideas; we need someone to turn them into working products that our agencies and clients can use. This is a hands-on builder's role. You'll spend most of your time shipping - agents, internal tools, automations, reporting workflows, and the occasional client-facing MVP. You'll scope work with stakeholders, then own delivery end-to-end. The role may also involve working directly with clients to help embed AI within their communications functions. What You'll Do Build and ship custom internal AI tools, agents, and automations that the agencies use day to day Automate reporting, monitoring, and workflow tasks across the group Prototype and build MVPs of client-facing AI products, working alongside the AI team Work with internal teams and, where appropriate, clients to embed AI within communications workflows and functions Scope use cases with stakeholders across the agencies and translate them into working solutions Work directly with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) and managed AI services on AWS and Azure Deploy serverless functions, wire up APIs, data sources, auth, and light front-ends around what you build Use workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make) for the jobs that don't need code Maintain and improve the tools you ship - and the ones already in flight Work with Group IT to stay inside approved platforms and security standards What We're Looking For You've shaped real things, you can show us what they do, and you can explain why you made the choices you made. We’re also open to recent graduates with a degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering or a related field, ideally with some relevant work experience or internship experience. You'll have: Hands-on experience building agents, workflows, or automations - ideally inside a company rather than just side projects Comfort with Python and scripting, and the ability to wire things together via REST APIs, webhooks, auth, and permissions Direct experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) - prompts, tool use, agent design Hands-on with at least one cloud (AWS or Azure): deploying serverless functions (Lambda / Azure Functions), using managed AI services (Bedrock, Azure OpenAI), basic storage and auth Working knowledge of workflow automation platforms (n8n, Make, or equivalent) Enough front-end (HTML, React, CSS/Tailwind, or similar) to build a usable interface around what you've built Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, T-SQL / SQL Server, or similar), including enough to query, structure, and connect data sources Experience with authentication and access management patterns (e.g. OAuth/OIDC; Auth0, Microsoft Entra ID, or equivalent) Git/GitHub and good repo hygiene A pragmatic, ship-it mindset - you'd rather get a v1 in front of users than perfect a v0 in private Strong communication skills, especially with non-technical teams Useful but not essential: Multi-cloud exposure (AWS and Azure) Retrieval / RAG patterns - vector stores (Pinecone, pgvector), Azure AI Search, or similar Airtable or similar as a structured data layer Background in marketing services, PR, or communications Experience working with a Group IT or governance function Experience working directly with clients or embedded teams in a forward-deployed / solutions engineering capacity How To Apply To apply, send us: Your CV A few lines on similar work you've done and what you took from it A link or demo of something you have built OR a short take on how you would build this: weekly client coverage, pulled and summarised for sentiment and themes, into a shared doc every Monday morning

items.desc:
Who we are
 About Stripe
 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 
 About the team
 Storage Integrations, part of Money Movement Integrations, builds and operates the connections between Stripe and our banking and financial technology partners. Our systems help businesses receive, hold, and move money through Stripe’s financial accounts and treasury products. We turn differences between financial partners into reliable capabilities that other Stripe teams can build on.
 In this role you’ll work with engineering, product, and financial operations partners across Stripe. We build new integrations, extend existing ones to support new use cases, and develop shared components that make each integration easier to build and operate.
 What you’ll do
 You’ll work primarily on backend systems, with end-to-end ownership across partner integrations, shared infrastructure, and product APIs and workflows. Full-stack work here means following a feature across these layers to deliver a usable capability. You’ll coordinate designs and reviews with the teams that own each layer.
 You’ll identify problems worth solving, scope and deliver projects with limited oversight, and help keep the systems you build reliable in production. Along the way, you’ll learn how money moves through financial networks and grow your impact across Stripe’s Money as a Service organization, with support from teammates and partner teams.
 Responsibilities
 Design, build, and maintain integrations with banks and financial technology partners, and extend existing integrations to support new money movement capabilities
 Own projects from understanding user needs and writing technical designs through implementation, testing, rollout, and production support
 Work across integration, platform, and product layers to make new capabilities available through consistent APIs and workflows, coordinating designs and reviews with the teams that own those systems
 Develop reusable components and tooling that reduce duplicated work across integrations and make future development and maintenance simpler
 Build for financial correctness, security, and reliability through automated tests, monitoring, and safe handling of failures

Role and responsibilities In this role,
items.desc:
Introduction to the job 
 ASML relies on complex digital, industrial, and product environments to enable innovation at scale. Within Ethical Hacking Services, we perform independent, authorized security assessments to help protect ASML's products, services, intellectual property, operations and data.
 As an Ethical hacker, you will perform penetration tests and security assessments across applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments. We value the diverse expertise within the team, and if you have a solid background in areas such as product security, OT/ICS, adversary simulation, AI, or emerging technologies, you will have the opportunity to apply those skills on specialized engagements.
 Role and responsibilities 
 In this role, you will:
 Plan and conduct authorized security assessments across a diverse range of technologies, systems, and environments
 Lead intake: clarify objectives, identify dependencies, define scope, select an appropriate test approach, and agree with rules of engagement with relevant stakeholders
 Produce clear technical reports and executive-ready summaries that explain evidence, impact, root cause and practical remediation options
 Present findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders, align corrective actions, and perform re-assessments to verify remediation effectiveness
 Collaborate with developers, engineers, and security stakeholders to identify, prioritize, and remediate security risks, while maintaining the independence and objectivity of security assessments
 Improve testing methodologies, automation, knowledge assets, tooling and service processes; share lessons learned and contribute to team capability development. Share security knowledge and real-world insights by creating and delivering awareness content, training, and workshops that promote a strong security culture across the organization.
 Education and experience 
 We are looking for experienced pentesters who can work independently, make sound technical judgments, and communicate risks clearly.
 3+ years of experience in penetration testing, ethical hacking, or a closely related offensive security role
 Familiarity with testing web applications, thick clients, VDIs, APIs, web services, AI, and performing source code reviews in multiple programming languages
 Threat modeling and architecture reviews with software solutions is a plus
 Experience testing GenAI applications and LLM models
 A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering or a related technical discipline is preferred; equivalent professional experience is also valued
 Preferred certifications: Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP), GIAC Penetration Tester (GPEN) or comparable hands-on penetration testing certification; Offensive Security Web Expert (OSWE), GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) or comparable application security certification; Certified Red Team Operator (CRTO), Certified Red Team Professional (CRTP) or comparable red teaming / adversary emulation certification; relevant SANS, cloud, mobile, OT/ICS or product security training and certifications
 Skills 
 Depth in one or more core domains: web, infrastructure, cloud security testing
 Programming experience in one or more languages
 Ability to validate findings manually, reason over attack paths, and avoid overreliance on automated tooling
 Good time management skills; the ability to commit and adhere to time-sensitive deliverables
 Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
 Ability to conduct scoping and closure meeting calls, be the main point of contact, lead report generation activities, and be the main interface with stakeholders on security assessments
 Nice to have: AI/LLM security testing, OT/ICS security, product security, reverse engineering, hardware security, source-code review, exploit development, or adversary emulation
 Other information 
 Some work may require onsite presence, cross-time-zone coordination, or limited travel.
 This is a pipeline vacancy, and we welcome applications from candidates across different seniority levels, including junior, mid-level, and senior profiles.
 The position is open to candidates residing in the Netherlands or the European Union, with eligibility to work in the relevant location.
 Inclusion and diversity 
 ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

items.desc:
Apple's Security Engineering & Architecture organization is responsible for the security of all Apple products. Passionate about safeguarding our users, we believe that the best defense requires a great offense. When it comes to securing more than a billion devices running the world's most sophisticated operating systems, that means finding vulnerabilities first. Can you make a difference on this scale? Join our extraordinary team of security researchers and help protect all Apple users.
Our team is dedicated to safeguarding Apple products, encompassing everything from the microarchitecture to applications like Safari, Mail, and Messages. Our responsibilities include evaluating the security of iOS and macOS (kernel and user-land), boot ROMs, firmware, and hardware. By collaborating with a diverse range of teams and vendors, your influence will be felt across Apple’s products, including the iPhone, iPad, Mac, and Apple TV. As a team member, your primary role will involve conducting vulnerability research on Apple software, firmware, and hardware components. Analyzing and exploiting vulnerabilities is a crucial aspect of this position. This role demands individuals with robust technical skills and a genuine passion for securing systems by demonstrating their vulnerabilities. If you resonate with these qualities, we would be delighted to hear from you.
Proven experience in vulnerability research and binary exploitation
Excellent understanding of common vulnerability classes and exploitation techniques
Creative & effective problem-solving and analytical skills
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Excellent knowledge of the security architecture of at least one complex operating system.
Knowledge of macOS/iOS is nice-to-have, but not required.
Experience with reverse-engineering tools (IDA Pro, Ghidra, etc.) and techniques
Familiarity with tool development, using programming languages such as C, C++, Python, Swift, Objective-C

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Technicien Alignement et Assemblage Mécanique (f/h) pour rejoindre notre Département Assemblage, Intégration et Tests (AIT) Satellite basé à Toulouse , France. 
 Vos missions : 
 Vous ferez partie d'une équipe qui fabrique et teste des satellites de pointe . Au sein de l' équipe Assemblage et Intégration Mécanique , vous déroulerez les opérations d'assemblage, de positionnement géométrique de haute précision et de tests d'appendices (antennes, panneaux solaires) en salle blanche, tout en assurant un rôle de référent technique auprès des opérateurs de l'atelier. 
 OBLIGATOIRE : 
 Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues. 
 Le candidat doit posséder la nationalité française conformément à l’IGI 1300 du 9 Août 2021 (paragraphe 1.2.2.1). 
 Vos responsabilités : 
 Réalisation et encadrement technique des opérations : Exécuter avec maîtrise les opérations mécaniques et les réglages d'alignement de précision, préparer et installer les outillages de support sol (Grounded Support / GS) et veiller au strict respect des règles de propreté 5S et de sécurité. En tant que référent technicien alignement et mécanique de l'équipe, vous assurez la compréhension et le dépannage technique des activités par les équipes. 
 Analyse technique et gestion des non-conformités : Analyser et valider les calculs de calage et mesures géométriques dans l'espace, réaliser la première validation des résultats d'alignement et participer au Traitement Local des Anomalies (TLA) en concertation avec l'ingénierie. Vous serez l'interface privilégiée des fonctions ingénierie de fabrication (Manufacturing Engineering). 
 Coordination opérationnelle et transmission des savoirs : Assurer le passage rigoureux des consignes d'équipe, appuyer la coordination des activités de votre plage horaire, et animer les actions de tutorat ainsi que la création et l'animation de formations techniques pour les opérateurs. 
 Support méthodes et amélioration continue : Contribuer à la rédaction de la documentation technique d'atelier (ordres de réparation, relevés d'opérations, demandes de modification de procédure) et proposer des plans d'amélioration continue pour garantir la performance opérationnelle (pilotage de chantiers Kaizen, développement et optimisation des outillages). 
 Votre profil : 
 Expérience professionnelle : 3 ans d'expérience minimum en alignement mécanique de précision, contrôle métrologique ou intégration mécanique sur structures complexes. 
 Expertise technique : Solides compétences en mécanique générale, bonne perception de la géométrie dans l'espace et lecture de plans complexes. 
 Rigueur & Méthode : Esprit d'analyse, démarche qualité appliquée et maîtrise de la traçabilité documentaire d'atelier. 
 Relationnel & Pédagogie : Bonnes capacités de communication, esprit d'équipe et aptitude avérée à la transmission du savoir-faire technique (tutorat). 
 Langues : Anglais technique lu. 
 Conditions particulières : 
 Aptitude au travail en équipes alternantes (horaires décalés type 2x8/3x8 et travail le week-end)
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Pour en savoir plus sur nos activités et découvrir notre environnement de travail, regardez nos vidéos :
 “How a satellite is built” : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fft0IWOwx9s 
 “Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) for Communication Satellite in Airbus Defence and Space” : https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CCh3b2al7Dg 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites.
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et d’autres services.
 Bien-être / santé : couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage.
 Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale).

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Our Mission: 
 Airbus DS Maintenance Programs Department main mission is to ensure the Airworthiness Authorities approval of the Scheduled Maintenance Requirements for A400M aircraft, A330 MRTT and C-295 aircraft (transport, humanitarian and maritime patrol versions).
 This is done through the MRB process and the MSG-3 methodology.
 We are in direct contact with Operators and Airworthiness Authorities as part of Maintenance Working Groups, were we present the MSG-3 analysis that are the source data for the Maintenance Review Board Report – MRBR (the MRBR is part of the Instruction for Continued Airworthiness – ICA, required by FAR/CS 25.1529 regulation in order to obtain the aircraft certification).
 Your main activities: 
 - You will perform ZONAL&EWIS&L/HIRF MSG-3 analyses in order to identify Scheduled Maintenance Requirements for A400M, A330 MRTT/FSTA, C-295 and other aircraft under our responsibility. You will also present these MSG-3 analyses in front of operators and authorities (mainly EASA and INTA/CQC).
 - You will provide technical support to our customers related to scheduled maintenance requirements under your responsibility, with special attention to ASAC Services.
 - Collaborate between Maintenance Programs department disciplines (Systems, Structure, Zonal, MPD) when required.
 - Maintenance Planning Document production.
 - Analyse aircraft design changes/modifications and In-Service Eng. Documentation (SB´s, OIT, AOT, ..) regarding the impact on the MSG-3 analyses, MRBR and MPD.
 - Collaborate and support to other Services, Engineering and Manufacturing areas.
 - Perform In-service customer maintenance inspection reports analysis for intervals evolutions/escalations exercises for the Maintenance Review Board Report (MRBR).
 - Development of solutions and customization of Operator's Maintenance Programs.
 - Contribution to Customer satisfaction by optimizing tasks intervals and providing support to technical queries.
 - Organize and coordinate sub-contracted activities when needed.
 - Collaboration in those Smartforces & Innovation/Digitalization projects related with maintenance planning.
 Your Working Place: 
 You will join a young enthusiastic team, willing to share a great technical knowledge. You will work in a dynamic environment, having the opportunity to discover different aircraft programs: A330 MRTT, A400M, C295/CN-235 and Aerostructures.
 You will have the opportunity to strengthen your technical and interpersonal skills.
 Based on Getafe with some opportunities to travel to other Airbus DS and customer facilities.
 Skills: 
 Educated to engineering degree level,
 Knowledge in aircraft maintenance is highly recommended,
 Knowledge in Maintenance Planning Document and CAMO,
 Knowledge in aircraft wiring/EWIS and L/HIRF protections are highly recommended,
 Knowledge in aircraft configuration management,
 Knowledge in software programming and data analysis tools,
 Good presentation skills, both oral and written,
 Ability to cope with highly demanding environment,
 Good co-ordination and relational skills to deal with Customers, Suppliers and other Airbus Defence and Space departments,
 Tenacious, adaptable and flexible,
 Language Skills: negotiation level of English.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence and Space sucht einen 
 Mechanical Systems Integration Engineer (d/m/w) 
 Werden Sie Teil unseres engagierten Teams bei Airbus Defence and Space und gestalten Sie die mechanischen Systeme der militärischen Luftfahrt von morgen. In dieser Position begleiten Sie zukunftsweisende Flugzeug-Modifikationen von der Konstruktion bis zur Zulassung und wachsen schrittweise in Ihre Verantwortung hinein. Mit Ihrer Arbeit leisten Sie einen direkten Beitrag zu unserem globalen Airbus-Purpose: „We pioneer sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world.“ 
 Diese Rolle ist auch mit reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit und einem angepassten Aufgabenbereich möglich. 
 Der Standort 
 Bremen ist eine charmante, geschichtsträchtige Stadt im Nordwesten von Deutschland. Sie ist nicht nur eine der grünsten Städte des Landes, sondern bietet auch wunderbare Sehenswürdigkeiten, eine reiche Kultur, urbanes Flair und kulinarische Köstlichkeiten. Die Stadt ist auch ein großartiger Ort für Küstenliebhaber, da sie nur eine Autostunde von der Nordseeküste entfernt liegt. 
 Unsere Benefits 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für Sie (und Ihre Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, teils standortnaher Kindergarten 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Sie entwickeln präzise 2D- und 3D-Schemata für komplexe mechanische Systeme. 
 Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche Steuerung, Prüfung und Validierung von anspruchsvollen 3D-Installationen im Flugzeug. 
 Sie erstellen, prüfen und geben Fertigungsanweisungen termingerecht und qualitätsgesichert frei. 
 Als technische Prüfinstanz stellen Sie die strikte Einhaltung aller relevanten Luftfahrt- sowie Zulassungsregeln sicher. 
 Sie entwerfen innovative Reparaturlösungen sowie Design-Modifikationen für globale Nachrüstprogramme und die laufende Produktion der A400M. 
 Sie entwickeln neue, innovative Lösungen für die technischen Herausforderungen von morgen. 
 Sie erhalten den Kontakt zu etablierten Zulieferern oder bauen neue Kontakte auf. 
 Fähigkeiten und Qualifikationen 
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine abgeschlossene Weiterbildung zum staatlich geprüften Techniker (d/m/w) in einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung. 
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Konstruktion, Entwicklung oder der mechanischen Systemintegration innerhalb der Luftfahrtindustrie. 
 Kenntnisse im Umgang mit CATIA V5 
 Sie sind kommunikationsstark, arbeiten hochgradig kooperativ und schätzen die partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit in internationalen Teams, um komplexe technische Fragestellungen strukturiert und lösungsorientiert zu meistern. 
 Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse für die reibungslose Koordination mit lokalen und globalen Schnittstellen. 
 Sie verfügen über erste Erfahrung im Umgang mit internen und externen Zulieferern und Kunden.

Job Description: 
 Zur Unterstützung der Abteilung " DHS/ Comms HW & Architects" sucht Airbus Defence and Space einen Data Handling System Engineer (d/m/w). 
 Du wirst Teil unserer transnationalen Abteilung, die die zentrale On-Board Computer und Massenspeicher der Raumfahrzeuge entwickelt. Wir verantworten das Data Handling System (DHS) für prestigeträchtige Missionen in den Bereichen Erdbeobachtung, Wissenschaft, Exploration sowie Telekommunikation und Navigation. Als Architekt bist du die zentrale technische Instanz, die elektrische Hardware, Software und komplexe Protokolle zu einem funktionierenden Gesamtsystem zusammenführt. 
 Diese Stelle ist auch mit reduzierter Wochenarbeitszeit und angepasstem Aufgabenbereich möglich. 
 Dein Standort 
 Am Airbus-Standort in Immenstaad am Bodensee arbeitest du dort, wo die Zukunft von Connected Intelligence, Space und Air Power entsteht. In einer Umgebung, die Weitblick bietet, gestaltest du technologische Innovationen über Domänen hinweg. 
 Unser Standort lebt vom Dialog: Auf dem Campus triffst du auf ein einzigartiges Netzwerk aus Experten für Satellitentechnik, militärische Luftfahrt, Cyber-Security, Künstliche Intelligenz sowie Combat Cloud und Ground Support von morgen. Auch unsere Zusammenarbeit ist geprägt von Dynamik – in agilen Teams widmen wir uns den komplexesten Fragestellungen, von KI-gestützter Erdbeobachtung bis zur sicheren Cloud-Architektur. Wer technologische Exzellenz und interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit sucht, findet hier das ideale Umfeld. 
 Unsere Benefits für dich 
 Faire Vergütung & Extras: Attraktive Vergütung und individuelle Zusatzleistungen, z. B. betriebliche Vorsorgemodelle, Mobilitätsangebote (bspw. Fahrradleasing) oder Mitarbeitervorteile bei kooperierenden Unternehmen gemäß unseren jeweils gültigen Richtlinien. 
 Zeit für dich (und deine Angehörigen): 30 Tage Jahresurlaub gem. Tarifvertrag (35h/Woche); Vereinbarkeit von Familie & Beruf (Gleitzeit, mobiles Arbeiten, Teilzeit, Jobsharing, Sabbatical) 
 Weiterkommen leicht gemacht: Ausgezeichnete Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und internationale, konzernweite Entwicklungsperspektiven 
 Wohlfühlen am Arbeitsplatz: Betriebsarzt; umfassendes Gesundheitsangebot (Sportkurse, Präventionsangebote, uvm.), Kantine und Cafeteria, Kindertagesstätte am Standort 
 Vielfalt verbindet: Arbeiten in einem diversen Umfeld, mit mehr als 140 Nationalitäten, in dem Austausch, Unterstützung und Vielfalt gelebt wird 
 Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten 
 Technische Schnittstelle & Architektur: Du fungierst als primärer Ansprechpartner für den Chief Engineer, Kunden, Zulieferer und andere Fachbereiche (Software, Payload, Electrical, Mechanik, Thermal) für alle On-Board Data Handling (OBDH) Subsystem-Themen. 
 Design & Anforderungsmanagement: Du führst Trade-off-Studien durch und definierst die Hardware-Architektur des Data Handling Systems, inklusive Datenraten, Prozessorgeschwindigkeiten und elektrischen Schnittstellen. 
 Supplier Management: Du erstellst Spezifikationen für DH-Equipment, unterstützt die Fertigung beim Lieferanten (Co-Engineering) und leitest Design-Boards sowie Acceptance-Reviews. 
 Schnittstellen-Kompatibilität: Du definierst die Datenflüsse zwischen Plattform und Payload (Massenspeicher, Kryptoeinheiten) sowie das Housekeeping (TM/TC) und erstellst/verwaltest die entsprechenden Budgets (Bus Traffic, CPU-Last). 
 Verifikation & Launch: Du erstellst Testspezifikationen, unterstützt das AIT-Team bei der Systemintegration und begleitest die Launch- sowie In-Orbit-Testaktivitäten direkt vor Ort oder remote. 
 Subsystem Management: Du managst das Subsystem eigenverantwortlich für eine OTOCOQ Lieferung, Integration & Verifikation. Du unterstützt das Satellitenprojekt in kommerziellen Belangen durch deine technische Expertise und bei der Zeit- und Kostenplanung 
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik , Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. 
 Fundierte Erfahrung in der Architektur von Data Handling Hardware-Subsystemen . 
 Tiefgehende Kenntnisse gängiger Weltraum-Standards (z. B. ECSS, CCSDS). 
 Langjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Data Handling oder komplexer eingebetteter Systeme. 
 Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse ; D eutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil für die Arbeit am Standort. 
 Keine 100%ige Übereinstimmung? Kein Grund zur Sorge! Airbus unterstützt deine persönliche Entwicklung mit maßgeschneiderten Entwicklungslösungen.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 In order to support the development of high fidelity Aircraft Simulators , Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a 
 DevOPs Engineer Simulation (d/f/m) 
 Our simulations are basically distributed realtime systems built by a set of common as well as simulator-specific software building blocks. For the development of the different simulation models and software, but also for the state-of-the-art operation of our own IT infrastructure, we are heavily relying on DevOps means and CI/CD principles. 
 To take our tools and pipelines to the next level, provide our developer community a modern development environment, and allow efficient integration in our distributed and multi-classification software development context, we are currently looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Engineer. You will work in an international team of passionate DevOps Engineers, IT Infrastructure Engineers, and IT Administrators at our site in Manching, Germany. 
 You have the chance to directly shape the definition and evolution of our CI/CD infrastructure and its application into our different simulation projects. Being part of our DevOps and Infrastructure Team means that you fully buy into a "Service Ownership" culture. You empower, support, and consult our Software as well as lead, coach, and inspire other DevOps Engineers to take our products to the next level. 
 Your location 
 Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Specify, design, and develop DevOps solutions and tools for our IT-infrastructure, as well as various Software Development Environments 
 Setup and maintain Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) Pipelines 
 Consult and support our various software development teams to boost their development processes and operations to higher efficiency by applying CI/CD principles and means 
 Continuously revise and improve the capabilities and reliability of our department-owned as well as corporate-managed IT-infrastructure with a focus on DevOps Tooling 
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Computer Science or a related discipline 
 1+ years of professional experience in DevOps and CI/CD Automation Development 
 Proven expertise in setting up, maintaining, and evolving robust CI/CD pipelines utilizing tools such as Jenkins/GitLab for Continuous Integration and Ansible, Puppet, and/or OPSI for Infrastructure Provisioning and Continuous Deployment 
 Experience in the operation and design of Enterprise-level IT Infrastructure, with a strong focus on IaC principles, dynamic Provisioning, and Immutable Systems. This includes proficiency with the HashiCorp Toolstack (Terraform, Packer, Vault) and the drive to automate processes 
 Solid Multi-Distro Linux skills and expertise in Scripting/Programming languages (Python, Ansible, Groovy, Bash, C++ or similar). Experience with virtualization (Proxmox, KVM), container-based infrastructure (Docker, Kubernetes), and storage solutions (Ceph, ZFS, Samba) is essential 
 Additional experience with full-stack Software Development and related technologies (Git, Nexus, Artifactory). Experience working within air-gapped and/or secrecy-ready IT environments (e.g., Data-Diodes, BSI Grundschutz, encryption) is a significant advantage 
 Excellent English proficiency (negotiation level) is required, coupled with a proactive, customer-oriented attitude 
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Robotics Team

The Robotics team is responsible for bridging the gap from our model to our vehicle platforms, in order to let the model focus on making driving decisions. We aim to provide high quality data to the model for making such decisions, whilst abstracting away platform-specific aspects. We combine specialisms across the robotics domain, blending strong theoretical foundations with solid engineering practice to span the spectrum from research to production.



🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Develop, integrate, tune, and validate control, trajectory-generation, and action-processing algorithms across different vehicle platforms, operating modes, and challenging driving conditions, ensuring robust real-world performance

 - Maintain and evolve our controls software architecture that connects AI Driver outputs to real-time vehicle actuation and feedback

 - Implement and maintain production-quality, latency-sensitive control software in C++ for deployment to prototype, reference and production vehicles

 - Use simulation, closed-loop evaluation and on-road testing to characterize controller behaviour, diagnose performance issues and validate improvements

 - Work with teams across Wayve to define controller interfaces, integrate with adjacent systems and enable new vehicle platforms and product features




🧩 What you’ll be working on:

In this role you will develop and improve the vehicle trajectory and motion controllers that translate the Wayve AI Driver outputs into safe, smooth and robust vehicle motion across different vehicle platforms and applications (both ADAS and AV).  You’ll tackle cutting-edge challenges: developing principled controls approaches,  implementing real time systems, testing in complex scenarios and refining our evaluation pipelines. This is a great chance to make an impact on the AV industry and grow alongside a focused team of passionate experts at the forefront of autonomous driving technology.




🙌 You should apply if you have:

 - Strong fundamentals in control theory, with depth in one or more of optimization, model-predictive control, numerical methods or dynamical systems

 - Practical experience developing, tuning and validating control or motion systems on real world physical systems

 - Strong software engineering skills, with experience building reliable production-quality systems in C++

 - Experience with latency-sensitive or real-time software

 - Ability to reason about and debug system-level behaviour in complex robotic systems across software and hardware

 - Applied experience with model predictive control, trajectory optimization, motion planning etc.

 - Direct experience with mobile robotics or autonomous vehicle systems

 - Experience in the automotive industry, including ADAS or vehicle controls

 - Experience with safety-critical systems, validation, and relevant industry standards (e.g. ISO 26262)

 - Applied machine learning experience, or experience developing systems that integrate with ML components

 - 



🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Location: Amsterdam, Netherlands 
 Meer dan 85.000 collega's wereldwijd werken dagelijks bij Thales om de wereld veiliger te maken. In Nederland werken er bij Thales 2.500 mensen, waarvan ongeveer 250 bij Thales SIX NL in Amsterdam. Bij Thales in Amsterdam leveren we wereldwijd geavanceerde, betrouwbare netwerk- en beveiligingsoplossingen onder de naam "SOTAS". Onze systemen garanderen optimale communicatie, zelfs onder extreme omstandigheden, waardoor cruciale beslissingen mogelijk zijn
 De afdeling Manufacturing Engineering & Quality Control binnen de Industrie tak van Thales SIX NL bestaat uit 6 medewerkers die zich richten op de productievoorbereiding, het onderhouden van tooling en werkinstructies als ook het dagelijks controleren van de kwaliteit van onze producten en productieprocessen
 .
 Binnen het ME&QC team is door groei in de werkzaamheden de volgende vacature ontstaan:
 Quality Engineer 
 Een cruciale rol binnen de afdeling is die van de QC (Quality Control) engineer. Deze professional richt zich specifiek op First Article Inspection (FAI) en de productovername van onze productieprocessen. De Quality Engineer neemt actief deel aan verbeterprogramma’s die zijn gebaseerd op de Lean Six Sigma-methodiek, waarmee wij continu streven naar stroomlijning en optimalisatie van onze processen.
 Door de nadruk te leggen op de overname in de fabriek zorgen wij ervoor dat alleen producten van de hoogste kwaliteit onze productie verlaten. Met een scherp oog controleert de QC engineer of de geproduceerde artikelen voldoen aan de strenge eisen en kwaliteitsnormen.
 De belangrijkste taken zijn:
 · Kwaliteit van eindproduct valideren.
 · Kwaliteit van inkomende goederen controleren.
 · Indien nodig een NCR (Non-Conformity Report) opstellen.
 · Initiatieven voor kwaliteitsverbeteringen inbrengen.
 · Uitvoeren van FAI (First Article Inspections) op nieuwe productiebatches.
 Waarom ben jij een goede match
 Je beschikt over minimaal een MBO of HBO diploma werktuigbouwkunde of vergelijkbaar.
 Minimaal 5+ jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke functie in kwaliteitscontrole binnen een productieomgeving.
 Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig, en probleemoplossend.
 Je hebt inmiddels praktische ervaring opgebouwd als QC engineer en weet wat FAI en Lean Six Sigma inhoudt.

 Une expertise significative en traitement du signal , appliquée au développement de solutions algorithmiques.
 De solides connaissances en estimation, filtrage, association de données et gestion des incertitudes. 
 Une maîtrise indispensable de Python et C++ , pour le développement et la mise en œuvre d'algorithmes.
