Lieu : Brest, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Brest abrite nos activités de services numériques ainsi que l'expertise de Thales en matière de développement, d'intégration et de maintenance pour des systèmes de patrouille et de surveillance maritimes, de guerre électronique, de systèmes sonars et de lutte sous-marine aéroportée ainsi que nos activités de services numériques. 
 Au sein du Centre de Compétences Guerre Électronique (CC GE), vous êtes Architecte Système Front End pour le produit RESM Numérique, au profit des produits de la Business Line Intelligence Surveillance et Reconnaissance (ISR).
 Vous êtes responsable de l’élaboration, de la stabilisation et du maintien de l'architecture de la Solution pour les Offres et Projets tout au long cycle de vie en coopération avec le responsable Projet d'Ingénierie Systèmes.
 En cela vos missions sont les suivantes :
 Vous élaborez, stabilisez et maintenez l’architecture des solutions en collaboration avec les équipes hardware, firmware et software.
 Vous établissez l’architecture de la solution par compromis entre les attentes des parties prenantes, les solutions techniques, les coûts, les risques et les délais.
 Vous contribuez à la définition du cycle de développement (incréments fonctionnels) et à l’approche de co-ingéniérie sur tout le cycle.
 Vous contribuez à la mise en œuvre du process outillé en co-ingéniérie et dans une démarche de développement tiré par les chaînes fonctionnelles
 Vous vous assurez lors du développement de la prise en compte et de la bonne compréhension des exigences allouées aux différents articles en développement
 Vous vous assurez de l’évaluation de performance et des paramètres critiques durant le développement.
 Votre profil
 Votre priorité est de piloter l’architecture de solutions complexes en guerre électronique ?
 Vous avez l’ambition d’innover dans un contexte naval stratégique ?
 Vous avez envie de collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires sur des produits « Game Changer » ?
 Vous disposez d’un diplôme d’ingénieur grande école ou universitaire en électronique et avez une expérience réussie en ingénierie systèmes (Spécification, Conception et IVVQ), idéalement dans le domaine de la Guerre Electronique, du radar ou de systèmes complexes équivalents/
 Ainsi vous possédez :
 Une Connaissance de la guerre électronique navale,
 Des compétences en Ingénierie de solutions et organisation de projet,
 Une Maîtrise des architectures fonctionnelles et physiques,
 Des Compétences en hyperfréquence, traitement du signal et traitement de données,
 Vous Maîtrisez aussi l’anglais technique.
 Esprit d’analyse, rigueur, sens de l’innovation, esprit collaboratif sont des atouts que l’on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous ! Intégrez une équipe engagée dans le développement de solutions de pointe pour la défense navale.
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous ! 
Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

 Définir des architectures fonctionnelles et logicielles (définition algorithmique de traitement radar).

 Formaliser la spécification sous DOORS et l’architecture pour développer la solution ou le produit.

 Apporter votre expertise aux équipes d’intégration radar en identifiant et résolvant les problèmes remontés par celles-ci.
 Participer à la validation matérielle, logicielle et système.
 Développer vos propres outils d’analyse.
 Être un support aux projets, lors de présentations clients, revues, démonstrations.

 Vous disposé d’une formation de niveau BAC+5 en ingénierie.
 Des connaissances en traitement du signal et en traitement de données (filtre de Kalman, transformée de Fourier, filtrage, etc.) sont indispensables pour assurer votre réussite en poste.
 Une expérience dans le domaine du radar serait un véritable atout.

items.desc:
Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance 
 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.
 Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways.
 Why Join Us? 
 As an AI Harness Engineer, you’re not just building integrations for AI —you’re developing new and innovative ways to connect people to local AI, and how that AI will become a fixture in our lives. You will push QVAC to new levels, using P2P technology to enable limitless scale, making you essential to the company’s success in the competitive local AI assistant market. 
 Responsibilities s 
 Deliver new features and bug fixes with a focus on reliability, performance, and user satisfaction 
 Design and develop new tools and modules, enabling new AI capabilities while ensuring success of a wide variety of model types and sizes 
 Maintain high codebase quality through consistent coding standards, code reviews, and automated testing 
 Implement and develop P2P technology for use with local AI 
 5+ years building production software, with deep experience in P2P systems, AI/LLM tooling, or both. 
 Hands-on experience building agent harnesses, including tool calling, agent loops, context management, and structured outputs. 
 Experience building evals and test infrastructure for non-deterministic systems. 
 Strong JavaScript/TypeScript, with experience modelling complex state, from sync protocols to agent loops 
 Open-source contributions to P2P, networking, or AI tooling projects 
 Experience designing for failure, including network partitions, model errors, timeouts, and retries

 About the job 
 We’re looking for an Automation QA Engineer with strong automation skills who also takes ownership of manual testing for our desktop and mobile applications. 
 Responsibilities 
 Build and maintain desktop and mobile test automation for critical user flows. 
 Integrate tests into CI/CD pipelines and keep them fast and reliable. 
 Investigate failures, fix flaky tests, and manage test data and environments 
 Report clear, reproducible bugs and verify fixes 
 Work with developers and product on testability and acceptance criteria 
 Perform hands-on functional, exploratory, and regression testing of new features 
 Choose manual or automated coverage based on risk; maintain regression suites. 
 Mandatory: 
 4+ years in QA automation, plus hands-on manual and exploratory testing experience. 
 Strong programming skills in TypeScript/JavaScript. 
 Experience running tests in CI/CD pipelines (for example, GitHub Actions). 
 Hands-on experience with Playwright for desktop or web, and WebdriverIO + Appium for mobile. 
 Experience testing Electron and/or React Native apps, including on real iOS and Android devices. 
 Experience using AI tools in QA and critically reviewing their output. Testing AI-powered applications is a plus. 
 Important information for candidates 
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: 
 Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ 
 Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. 
 Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms. 
 Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ tether.to or @ tether.io 
 We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately. 
 When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction.
 Innovate with Tether 
 Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services.
 But that’s just the beginning:
 Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities.
 Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing.
 Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity.

 Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry.
 If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
We have launched Keet Mobile on iOS and Android, bringing our full P2P technology stack to everyone. Keet Mobile is not your average app: it’s heavy lifting is performed by a custom JS runtime specially designed for peer-to-peer usage (in fact, it reuses 100% of Keet Desktop’s code!). The UI logic, on the other hand, is 100% React Native, giving us flexibility and the ability to iterate quickly. 
 We believe this pattern opens the door to huge possibilities in the future, and we need your help getting there!
 Responsibilities 
 In this role, you will develop and maintain Keet Mobile, our peer-to-peer chat and calling app for iOS and Android. Keet Mobile is built with React Native and Expo, and its P2P core runs on the device itself in a Bare worklet. You'll own features end to end, from UI/UX implementation to using the P2P core apis.
 You will:
 - Build and polish features across chat, voice and video calls, media sharing, device pairing and identity backup
 - Integrate native platform capabilities such as push notifications, camera, bio-metrics and background tasks on both iOS and Android
 - Profile and optimise performance on real devices, including startup time, long chats, media handling, battery and network use
 - Write unit and end-to-end tests, and help keep releases stable through CI and crash reporting
 - Work closely with the core P2P, design and product teams, and review code with a high bar for quality
 Significant experience with React Native, Redux for state management and Redux-Saga
 Highly proficient in JavaScript and ES6+.
 Experienced with WebSockets, RESTful based APIs.
 Knowledge in native languages (Swift/Kotlin) and familiarity with native build tools (Xcode/Android Studio) is advantageous.
 Experience working with a remote team
 Interested in modernizing and optimizing different mobile or web applications.
 Bonus points if you have any built something amazing on any p2p frameworks .

 In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime.  Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications.
 Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar).
 Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code.
 Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications.
 Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems.
 Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes).
 Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication.
 Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management.
 Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc).

 Are you curious about how AI, software and smart engineering can shape the future of mobile networks? We are now looking for software developers and test engineers to join our RAN Services teams in Linköping. Whether you are starting your career or bring many years of experience, you will work with skilled colleagues on technology that connects people and businesses around the world.
 Over time, this role also offers the possibility to grow toward technical leadership or broader leadership responsibilities.

• Explore and contribute to AI/ML-enabled features that may be implemented in the product.
• Collaborate with other system engineers, architects, testers and product owners to turn requirements into working solutions.
• Contribute to code reviews, technical documentation, continuous improvement and modern development practices.

 • Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as C/C++, Python, or Go.
• Experience in software design, development, debugging, integration, and verification.
• Familiarity with common software development tools and practices, including Git, Gerrit, Jenkins, and CI/CD pipelines.
• Foundational understanding of AI and machine learning concepts.
• Ability to use AI-assisted development tools critically and responsibly.
• Experience working in Linux-based development environments.
• An interest in technology, our products and the role they play in future communication networks.
• Basic understanding of project management principles and agile development methodologies.
• M.Sc or B.Sc education in Computer Science or the equivalent level of knowledge

Join our Team
 About the opportunity 
At Ericsson, we turn bold technology ideas into the communication solutions that connect the world. We are looking for dedicated and skilled System Designers who are passionate about inventing, realizing and evaluating the technologies shaping the future of mobile communication.
You will join Technology Testbeds within AI & Technology Foresight, part of Business Area Networks. We explore state-of-the-art technologies and concepts in practice before they become products.
Our work sits at the intersection of research and product development. We build prototypes using advanced hardware and software design tools, create opportunities for patents, influence technology roadmap decisions and bridge the gap between research and product realization. Our focus areas include radio design, signal processing, AI/ML, software, emerging technologies and compute platforms.
 What you will do 
• Contribute to projects covering concept and algorithm design, software architecture and distributed-system design.
• Work with systems that combine real-time and asynchronous behaviour.
• Design platforms ranging from hardware-near software to scalable, high-level software.
• Focus on one or more areas while understanding and contributing across the complete system.
• Quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changing requirements.
• Build, integrate and demonstrate complete systems, not just individual components.
• Lead and participate in technical studies, design activities and integration efforts.
• Invent, develop and apply new concepts and algorithms.
• Collaborate across disciplines to turn complex ideas into elegant, working solutions.
 Skills you bring 
• A PhD, or an MSc with a few years of relevant work experience, in telecommunications, software, signal processing, data science or a related field.
• A proven ability to solve challenging problems using engineering, technology and creativity.
• Strong analytical thinking, curiosity and the ability to learn quickly.
• A passion for elegant and simple solutions to complex technical challenges.
• The aptitude to lead technical work and influence direction.
• Effective collaboration, clear communication of technical concepts and a commitment to knowledge sharing.
• A quality-focused approach to problem-solving.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Our team plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices and silicon, from Arm-based laptops to gaming consoles. We maintain the health of the Windows application ecosystem, ensuring that every Windows OS release remains compatible with the vast breadth of applications that customers, enterprises, and partners rely on every day. As part of Windows Silicon & Systems Integration, we are responsible for the quality and compatibility of both in-market devices and new hardware, spanning multiple form factors, silicon vendors, and customer segments. In recent years the OS underwent significant rejuvenation, and we continue to evolve the platform to support new devices and AI features. We are expanding our team to ensure we succeed - there has never been a better time to come and work on Windows. 
 As a Software Engineer in our team in Dublin, your work will impact on all development teams globally that write features for Windows. You will deliver solutions that ensure critical app compatibility issues, introduced by the Windows development process, never get exposed to customers. You will strive to constantly improve our results by leveraging AI and analyzing data to answer business questions and guide our engineering decisions. 
 This opportunity will allow you to: 
 Play a fundamental role in defining and building products used by millions of people. 
 Work on AI solutions and be at the forefront of the AI revolution. 
 Work in a team that operates with a level of autonomy that enables you to have strategic impact and input on what we deliver, not unlike working in a start-up environment. 
 Invest in your professional development. Continuously learn on the job and access in person and online training. As part of Microsoft's culture of growth and development, you will participate in a monthly day of learning. 
 Experience new engineering challenges to grow and enhance your skills. 
 Work in a modern new workspace as part of a team that values results, flexibility, and fun. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 #IrelandWSSIJobs 
 Responsibilities 
 Develop innovative tools and solutions to discover regressions before they are merged into the vast OS codebase, using the latest technology in software engineering, AI and data analytics to do so. 
 Contribute feature work to our automation framework which is used by our organization to author test content. 
 Work on enhancing the test authoring experience by developing AI solutions and leveraging cutting edge MCP’s. 
 Collaborate closely with engineers based in Dublin, Redmond, Nairobi and beyond to tackle compatibility issues in Windows. 
 Qualifications 
 Required Qualifications: 
 Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or related technical discipline with proven experience coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python OR equivalent experience. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience working with and building AI solutions is highly desired. 
 Solid problem-solving skills and ability to deal with ambiguity comfortably. 
 Passion for customers, product quality and drive for results. 
 Leadership and communication skills are key to this role. 
 Software Engineering IC2 - The typical base pay range for this role across Ireland is € 49,500.00 - € 83,900.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation.

Overview 
 Windows + Devices (W+D) is hiring Software Engineers in Dublin across two teams that share a commitment to making Windows a trusted, intelligent, and reliable platform for customers, enterprises, and partners worldwide.
 The Modern AI Trust platform engineering team is transforming what trust means to Microsoft and our customers. The team builds innovative, AI-driven solutions that enable product agility, enterprise-scale automation, intelligent decision systems, trustworthy development, and responsible AI use. As a frontier organization developing solutions for the next generation of Windows, the team is focused on retaining and strengthening the trust of our customers and partners.
 The Windows Silicon & Systems Integration (WSSI) Compat team plays a critical role in the development and delivery of Windows across a broad range of devices and silicon, from Arm-based laptops to gaming consoles. The team maintains the health of the Windows application ecosystem, ensuring that every Windows release remains compatible with the broad range of applications customers depend on. Its work spans in-market and new hardware across multiple form factors, silicon vendors, and customer segments, while supporting the continued evolution of Windows for new devices and AI capabilities.

Depending on your team placement, you may build AI-powered platforms and automation that strengthen trust across the Windows development lifecycle, or deliver solutions that detect and prevent critical application compatibility issues before they reach customers. Across both teams, you will tackle complex engineering problems, use AI and large-scale data to generate insights, guide engineering decisions, and continuously improve the quality and reliability of Windows.
 This opportunity will allow you to:
 · Play a fundamental role in defining and building products used by millions of people.
 · Develop innovative AI-powered solutions and help shape the next generation of Windows.
 · Solve complex engineering challenges using large-scale data and cutting-edge technologies.

items.desc:
Do you have a soft spot for motorcycles and a knack for making sure things run smoothly? This role is all about keeping our two-wheeled fleet in tip-top operational shape.
 This isn't a hands-on mechanical role, but it's a critical back-office position that ensures every vehicle sent for service moves efficiently through the repair network. You'll be the meticulous guardian of data and timelines, playing a key part in getting these machines back on the road in optimal condition. Your work directly supports the high standards of service our customers expect.
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Track all motorized vehicles sent to repair centers from dispatch through resolution. You'll have a clear oversight of every step.
 Verify data accuracy in our systems, ensuring all information is complete and compliant. Your attention to detail keeps our records impeccable.
 Approve repair tickets once all validations are complete, maintaining smooth workflow.
 Monitor repair progress with follow-up reviews, ensuring ongoing information accuracy and proper case progression.
 Proactively monitor repair timelines , identifying cases that exceed standard resolution times. You'll be the one to spot potential delays.
 Escalate and alert relevant stakeholders when a vehicle remains in the repair process for more than four weeks, ensuring timely intervention.
 Maintain clear documentation and provide status updates as required, ensuring transparent and consistent communication.
 If you're an organized, detail-oriented individual who values precision and operational excellence, and has a quiet appreciation for the world of motorized vehicles, this role offers a stable and impactful way to contribute. You'll be a vital part of the system that keeps these machines moving, even when they're off the road for service.
Required Qualifications: 
 Proven experience in logistics coordination, administrative support, or back-office operations – ideally in automotive, fleet management, or similar industries where precision and process adherence are critical.
 Exceptional attention to detail and quality assurance mindset – you catch discrepancies others miss and take pride in maintaining accurate records and data integrity.
 Proficiency with data management systems and databases – comfortable navigating multiple platforms, entering data accurately, and generating reports.
 Strong organizational and time management skills – capable of tracking multiple cases simultaneously and prioritizing escalations effectively.
 Excellent written and verbal communication abilities – fluent in English at C1 level, with the ability to document clearly and communicate status updates professionally.
 Demonstrated ability to monitor processes and identify deviations – proactive in spotting delays, inconsistencies, or compliance issues before they escalate.
 Working hours : 8-16, 9-17 y 10-18. Monday to Friday. 
 Key Competencies: 
 Meticulous data verification and validation
 Process monitoring and timeline management
 Problem identification and escalation protocols
 Documentation and record-keeping excellence
 Operational efficiency and workflow optimization

 eBike gyártás termékfejlesztési oldalról történő támogatása

items.desc: ISS STOXX empowers investors and companies to build for long-term and sustainable growth by providing high-quality data, analytics, and insight. We are committed to positively impacting the environment and society through our market-leading solutions and leading by example. Our clients have long turned to ISS STOXX to apply their corporate governance views, identify environmental, social, and governance risks, and manage their global proxy voting needs. Need a refresher on what Corporate Governance and Proxy Voting are? Corporate governance is the system by which companies are directed and controlled. Boards of directors are responsible for the governance of their companies. The shareholders’ role in governance is developing continuously with investors increasingly acting as responsible stewards and taking into account a wide range of ESG topics. This may include considerations such as the appointment of directors, approving executive remuneration schemes, M&A, and equity issuances. Shareholders are invited by public companies they have shares in to vote on a wide range of topics during annual general meetings and special meetings. They can delegate their voting power to a representative, who will then be considered a proxy . Here at ISS STOXX, we provide the research, insight and recommendations for our clients to make informed voting decisions. ISS STOXX's Global Proxy Distribution ("GPD") business provides outsourcing solutions for custodian banks, wealth managers and other intermediaries to facilitate proxy voting services to their investor clients. These solutions Our services leverage deep corporate governance expertise, global scale and presence, state of the art data architecture, and a flexible approach to help banks and intermediaries differentiate their offerings, comply with regulation, and reduce risk and cost. Enter the world of corporate governance and responsible investment and jumpstart your career by gaining exposure to the fundamental affairs of businesses and economies on a global scale. What you will do Out of our ISS STOXX office in Brussels, the Client Service & Consultants team provides a single, turnkey solution to managing proxy distribution for custodian banks, getting instructions delivered to the market with the possibility of an integrated proxy research and voting solution for institutional investor clients. We are seeking talented and self-motivated trainees to provide operational support to the GPD Client Service & Consultants team during the peak European ‘’proxy voting season’’, i.e., when most listed companies convene their annual shareholder meetings. Proxy Season brings a fast paced, challenging working environment, so this position will suit a candidate who is a quick learner, organized and motivated to work under tight deadlines. Take active ownership of operational support for clients, including ballot and vote management, account maintenance, and vote report production. Follow-up on the successful vote execution with the clients. Manage regular direct contact (email and phone) with issuing companies, agent banks and clients. Deal with routine tasks, such as creating/inactivating accounts in our voting platform, creating/inactivating users to grant clients an access to our voting platform, support clients with basic queries/issues and investigate issues with internal teams to provide appropriate solutions/answers to clients. Support the team in maintaining up-to-date procedures, databases, and client profiles regularly. items.desc: The eScience Center at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) develops and operates large-scale IT infrastructure dedicated to research in all fields. The center is a leading national provider of supercomputing resources and facilities, often provided in close collaboration with other Danish universities. Our mission is to support research via the development of advanced IT infrastructure and by providing support and expertise to researchers. The key areas of the center are High Performance Computing (HPC), Cloud Services, Data Analytics, and Data Management Services. We assist a large research community, educational and government institutions, as well as commercial companies. The center has developed a user-friendly and advanced private cloud system called UCloud , which is the foundation for the DeiC national system for interactive HPC and cloud computing. We continuously tackle new technological challenges as part of our ongoing systems development. The SDU eScience Center offers a research-like environment where we encourage the study of innovative solutions and personal growth. We firmly believe in open-source and web technology as means to reach our goals. We are currently looking to fill a position within the infrastructure team. We are looking for candidates with experience in Linux systems administration and a strong desire and ability to learn. The successful candidate will work closely with the current senior systems administrator, who has a long-time expertise in scientific research, programming, and Linux systems administration. While this position does offer flexibility and the possibility of remote work, the candidate is expected to be on-site in Odense the majority of the time. Job description : We seek candidates with experience in the following areas. Linux systems administration High Performance Computing (hardware and software) Kubernetes (on-prem) Automated deployment (e.g. via Ansible) Advanced networking (ethernet and infiniband) Enterprise storage systems Cloud computing Systems development and integration Experience in at least two of the above areas is required, and candidates with previous experience in high-performance computing, Linux systems administration, and Kubernetes will be strongly preferred. Tasks under the infrastructure team include, but are not limited to, configuration of hardware, network, and software; automated deployment using Ansible; configuration of virtualized and container-based environments, such as Kubernetes; operating and maintaining distributed storage systems, such as Ceph WekaIO, and Quantum ActiveScale; configuration of Linux systems and common services. Required qualifications: Proven experience in at least two of the areas in the job description. Strong background in Linux systems. Programming skills (e.g. in Go, Python, bash, …). Proven ability to work productively both independently and as part of an interdisciplinary team balancing divergent objectives involving research, code development, systems administration, and consulting with scientists. Other relevant qualifications (not required): MSc or PhD in a relevant field of science or engineering. Experience with common DevOps practices (such as Git and GitHub, continuous integration and deployment, software documentation). items.desc: Category: Research Location: Ganløse, Capital Region of Denmark, DK Obesity pharmacology 2 Global Research Research & Development Ganløse, Denmark Join a research environment where your work directly supports the discovery of future therapies for obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular disease. As an Advanced Laboratory Technician, you will plan, conduct and report preclinical large animal studies, generating high-quality data that helps move research programs forward. Working closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians, you will contribute to studies that are critical to our research pipeline and our ambition to drive scientific innovation. The role is primarily based in Ganløse, however working cross functional means that some activities and meetings will take place in Måløv. Your new role As an Advanced Laboratory Technician, you will take end-to-end ownership of in vivo pharmacology studies preferably in large animals, working closely with scientists to deliver high-quality experimental outcomes that support our drug discovery projects Your main responsibilities will be: Plan, conduct and report preclinical pharmacology studies, primarily in large animal models, supporting research within obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular disease. Perform a range of in vivo procedures, including dosing, blood sampling, tissue collection and surgical procedures, while ensuring high scientific and ethical standards. Generate high-quality data and documentation that support decision-making across research projects. Collaborate closely with scientists and fellow laboratory technicians to plan studies, share knowledge and achieve project goals. Maintain accurate study documentation and data records using electronic laboratory systems. Contribute to a safe, efficient and collaborative laboratory environment while supporting continuous improvements in ways of working. Your new department You will join a collaborative team of 10 laboratory technicians working closely together in our large animal research facility. Teamwork is an essential part of everyday work, from study planning to execution, and colleagues rely on one another to ensure high-quality research outcomes. The team is part of Obesity and Comorbidities Pharmacology and supports research across obesity, diabetes and cardiovascular disease. Working alongside multidisciplinary project teams, you will contribute to studies that help generate the insights needed to advance future therapies. Your skills and qualifications We are looking for a laboratory technician who enjoys hands-on research and thrives in a collaborative environment. You bring experience from in vivo studies and are motivated by contributing to high-quality science that supports the discovery of future therapies. To succeed in this role, you have: A Laboratory Technician degree or a similar qualification within biomedical sciences, pharmacology or a related field. Hands-on experience working with in vivo studies. Experience performing in vivo procedures and handling experimental data and study documentation. Familiarity with electronic laboratory documentation systems. Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different disciplines. Experience working with large animal models is considered an advantage. You work in a structured and quality-focused manner and take pride in delivering reliable results. You enjoy working closely with colleagues, sharing knowledge and supporting team success. As a person, you are pragmatic, approachable and eager to learn, with a strong sense of responsibility and respect for the ethical standards required in animal research. You are equally comfortable contributing to established ways of working and identifying opportunities to improve processes and laboratory practices. Working at Novo Every day we seek the solutions that defeat serious chronic diseases. To do this, we approach our work with determination, constant curiosity and a commitment to finding better ways forward. For over 100 years, this dedication has driven us to build a company focused on lasting change for long-term health. One where diverse thinking, shared purpose and mutual respect come together to create extraordinary results. When you join us, you're not just starting a job – you're becoming part of a story that spans generations. What we offer There is, of course, more on offer here than the uniqueness of our culture and the extraordinary results we produce. Being part of a global healthcare company means opportunities to learn and develop are all around us, while our benefits are designed with your career and life stage in mind. items.desc: We are seeking a (part-time) trainee to support the Coordination Unit of the Finnish University Partnership for International Development (UniPID). The trainee will mostly work remotely at the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland on the Joensuu campus. Please find more information below and submit your application by 28 October 2026. UniPID is seeking a trainee to support the Coordination Unit, particularly in communications and the implementation of events. UniPID coordinates and participates in a number of externally funded projects. These projects serve to support the Finnish research community in their collaborative partnerships with counterparts in the Global South. About UniPID The Finnish University Partnership for International Development (UniPID) is a network of 10 Finnish universities, established in 2002 to strengthen the capacity of its member universities to enhance global responsibility and Global South perspectives in their education, research, and societal engagement. UniPID also promotes equitable and inclusive global partnerships that advance sustainable development. UniPID is coordinated by the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland. Tasks The trainee will assist UniPID’s Coordination Unit in communications and the organisation of events. The main duties of the trainee are described below. Communication: Assisting in the coordination of communications. This may include managing social media channels, drafting newsletters, and planning and implementing communications materials on the activities of the network and its projects in order to reach Finnish and international audiences. Organising virtual and on-site events: assisting in the planning and organisation of events and meetings, including participant registration and management, technical support and reporting. In addition to the above-mentioned tasks, there will be tasks associated with the Development Days 2027 Conference (DevDays2027), which is organised by the Finnish Society for Development Research (FSDR) in collaboration with UniPID and other stakeholders. The Development Days is Finland’s largest annual international conference dedicated to development research, practice, and activism. The conference will feature a broad spectrum of topics through working groups and panel discussions. The responsibilities will include: Event organisation: Assisting with the planning and organisation of DevDays2027, managing conference registration, drafting the conference programme, aiding with travel arrangements, assisting in budget-related matters, and providing other technical support. Communication: Designing a communication strategy and actions for DevDays2027, updating the webpage, handling email communications, among others. Head of conference secretariat: Responsibility for heading the conference secretariat, including forming and leading a team of conference volunteers. Position details The trainee will mostly work remotely at the Coordination Unit of UniPID in the Faculty of Social Sciences and Business Studies of the University of Eastern Finland. The traineeship is a part-time position and will commence in November 2026 and continue until the end of April 2027. The starting date will be agreed upon on a case-by-case basis. A trial period is applied to new members of the university’s staff. The trainee will receive supervision from both UniPID and FSDR. The trainee is required to have a university internship subsidy. For more information on subsidy practices, see the Aarresaari website. The trainee’s salary will be EUR 750 per month for a part-time (50%) position. Our requirements and expectations We encourage Master’s level students from UniPID member universities who are entitled to the internship subsidy of their home university to apply. We expect you to be eager to learn new things, be interested in scientific and development cooperation, have good skills in the English language, have good written and oral communication skills and have good teamwork and organisational skills. How to apply Submit your electronic application no later than 28 October 2026 by 24:00 (midnight) Finnish time (UTC +2) with the following attachments in English: a CV a short motivation letter a transcript of records Also indicate the preferred starting date and duration of the traineeship. We value authenticity, so please make sure that your motivation letter reflects your own thoughts and experiences. Applications created by using AI are often generic in nature and fail to reflect the applicant’s personal motivation. Please note that if your application appears to be AI-generated, this may have a negative impact on its assessment. Further information Reach out to Director of UniPID Kaisa Kurki by emailing to kaisa.kurki@uef.fi or calling +358 50 330 6154 between 13–14 and 19–20 October, or to FSDR representative, FSDR Chair Bonn Juego, bonn.juego@jyu.fi, …

items.desc: About us We are EnduroSat! A fast-growing space scale-up at the forefront of satellite innovation, specializing in advanced software-flexible satellites for commercial, governmental, and scientific endeavors. This is more than a job, it's a mission We are making space universally accessible and redefining the possible We get things done We take ownership of what we do and we work hard to make a difference We are fearless Transparency is our only way forward. We dare to address and resolve issues head-on We learn from our mistakes We deliver, take informed risks, and evolve to achieve our goals. We compare with the best version of ourselves What is the role? As a Radiation Engineer at EnduroSat, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and durability of our Space systems. You will work on existing missions by conducting radiation analyses on ongoing projects. Additionally, as our missions become increasingly complex, involving satellite deployments to environments with more challenging radiation conditions, you will proactively plan and implement strategies to enhance radiation resilience. Your expertise will contribute to the success of groundbreaking missions that push the boundaries of Space exploration. Some of your daily tasks will include: Conducting radiation analyses on new and ongoing satellite projects Carrying out simulations, radiation tests research, and customer report presentation Preparing and carrying out radiation tests (TID & SEE) Maintaining EnduroSat’s list of EEE components up to date with the latest test information Communicating with customers on the environmental challenges of their mission What do we look for? Comprehensive understanding of sources and effects of radiation on EEE devices Familiarity with radiation simulation tools (OMERE, SPENVIS, FasTrad, NOVICE) Knowledge of electronics systems, sufficient to prepare and carry out PCBA and EEE components tests Open to knowledge sharing Understanding the importance of last-mile delivery Quick learner, proactive, self-starter Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude Passionate about Space How to stand out? You’re a problem solver: our missions are fast-paced, and meticulous testing of every single EEE component is not the goal. We need someone who can find the best strategy within a given timeframe! Experience in performing tests at a TID and/or SEE facility is a major plus Why EnduroSat? Fast-paced and delivery-focused culture We work with well-defined quarterly based objectives, that allow us to fast track the progression of our work and improve as we go Tough engineering challenges & hard-core R&D You will be able to work on unique space technology and build next-gen innovations, while mentored by world-recognized space experts Constant learning and progression Own your personal growth by navigating through our career progression framework and educational programs Chance to join our space educational program Meet international space experts and improve your knowledge and skillset with our hands-on educational program At EnduroSat, we embrace diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone is treated with fairness and respect. Le pôle "préparation gestion de crise et sûreté à l'international" (PGCSI) assure la mission de pilotage de la continuité d’activité du Groupe, incluant la préparation à la gestion de crise et sa mise en cohérence avec les différentes filiales du groupe. Le pôle « préparation gestion de crise groupe » engage une phase de renforcement de sa doctrine de Continuité d’activité au plus près des métiers, au service tant des agents que des voyageurs. Dans le cadre de ce renforcement, l’identification précoce des signaux constitue un enjeu majeur pour les capacités d’anticipation et de gestion de crise de la RATP. Dans cette perspective, l’Intelligence Artificielle représente un des leviers. Ainsi, le/la chargé.e de mission aura la principale mission de poursuivre la réflexion sur l’usage de l’Intelligence Artificielle et de l’analyse du ressenti voyageur, appliqués à la gestion de crise. Le/la chargé.e de mission accompagne également le PGCSI sur ses tâches quotidiennes (accompagnement des métiers dans la création de leurs PCA, adaptation de la doctrine continuité d’activité à la norme 22 301…). 01. items.desc: About us We are EnduroSat! A fast-growing space scale-up at the forefront of satellite innovation, specializing in advanced software-flexible satellites for commercial, governmental, and scientific endeavors. This is more than a job, it's a mission We are making space universally accessible and redefining the possible We get things done We take ownership of what we do and we work hard to make a difference We are fearless Transparency is our only way forward. We dare to address and resolve issues head-on We learn from our mistakes We deliver, take informed risks, and evolve to achieve our goals. We compare with the best version of ourselves What is the role? As a Radiation Engineer at EnduroSat, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the reliability and durability of our Space systems. You will work on existing missions by conducting radiation analyses on ongoing projects. Additionally, as our missions become increasingly complex, involving satellite deployments to environments with more challenging radiation conditions, you will proactively plan and implement strategies to enhance radiation resilience. Your expertise will contribute to the success of groundbreaking missions that push the boundaries of Space exploration. Some of your daily tasks will include: Conducting radiation analyses on new and ongoing satellite projects Carrying out simulations, radiation tests research, and customer report presentation Preparing and carrying out radiation tests (TID & SEE) Maintaining EnduroSat’s list of EEE components up to date with the latest test information Communicating with customers on the environmental challenges of their mission What do we look for? Comprehensive understanding of sources and effects of radiation on EEE devices Familiarity with radiation simulation tools (OMERE, SPENVIS, FasTrad, NOVICE) Knowledge of electronics systems, sufficient to prepare and carry out PCBA and EEE components tests Open to knowledge sharing Understanding the importance of last-mile delivery Quick learner, proactive, self-starter Excellent communication skills and a positive attitude Passionate about Space How to stand out? You’re a problem solver: our missions are fast-paced, and meticulous testing of every single EEE component is not the goal. We need someone who can find the best strategy within a given timeframe! Experience in performing tests at a TID and/or SEE facility is a major plus Why EnduroSat? Fast-paced and delivery-focused culture We work with well-defined quarterly based objectives, that allow us to fast track the progression of our work and improve as we go Tough engineering challenges & hard-core R&D You will be able to work on unique space technology and build next-gen innovations, while mentored by world-recognized space experts Constant learning and progression Own your personal growth by navigating through our career progression framework and educational programs Chance to join our space educational program Meet international space experts and improve your knowledge and skillset with our hands-on educational program At EnduroSat, we embrace diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment where everyone is treated with fairness and respect. We are committed to equal employment opportunities without discrimination against any employee or job applicant on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Additionally, this position is suitable for people with disabilities in accordance with the People with Disabilities National Regulation Act, ensuring accessibility and accommodation in the workplace. items.desc: About Us / Who you will join: 130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it. Allianz Consulting is where strategy becomes action. As the internal consulting unit of the Allianz Group, we partner with operating entities worldwide to drive transformation across digital, sustainability, and operational excellence - and here, you grow fast and take ownership early. Joining Allianz Consulting means working in a fully international environment alongside other talented people who enjoy sharing their knowledge and experiences, having increased personal responsibilities and working under a flat management hierarchy. Allianz Consulting has a reputation for focusing on growing its talent and on-the-job training from the very first day to ensure strong career development and preparation for future opportunities within the Allianz Group. About the Team The Insurance Transformation team partners with senior Allianz Group leaders on their most consequential strategic priorities. We define growth and productivity levers, harmonize business models, and translate strategic ambitions, such as the Group's AI agenda, into a prioritized transformation roadmap. We then drive its delivery by designing target operating models, redesigning end-to-end processes, and governing Group-wide transformation programs through to measurable results. Role Overview As a Consultant you contribute to strategy and transformation engagements for senior Allianz stakeholders, taking responsibility for specific analyses and deliverables within a workstream. You start from strategy, building the fact base, benchmarks and business planning inputs that help senior leaders set priorities and understand how Allianz competes and operates in a changing market. You then move to design and delivery, supporting process improvement and operating model work and keeping project governance documents, timelines and communications up to date. Along the way you learn the consulting toolkit hands-on and grow towards owning modules of your own. Key Responsibilities Contribute to complex strategic and transformation projects that reshape how Allianz operates, taking responsibility for specific analyses and deliverables, from strategic rationale, business case inputs and financial modeling (including for potential acquisitions) to operating model and process design, and for their quality and timeliness Support the project governance, preparing steering committee materials, delivery and impact reporting, risk and dependency logs, project timelines and communications, and board presentations for senior management Work with client teams day to day, gather and structure information and build strong working relationships with your counterparts Keep your workstream lead informed on progress and roadblocks, ask the right questions early and propose options when something is unclear Conduct external benchmarking, selected due diligence and research on industry trends and market conditions, identify improvement opportunities across the insurance value chain and their top-down impact, and turn the findings into clear, well-structured analyses and storylines Contribute to business development and client pitches under the guidance of an Engagement Manager, preparing research, analyses and presentation material Help increase Allianz Consulting expertise within our strategic areas of development and contribute to internal projects, knowledge sharing and team events Communicate clearly with stakeholders at all levels and support the team in maintaining strong client partnerships throughout the project lifecycle Key requirements / What we hope you bring University degree in Business Administration, Economics, Engineering or a comparable field, or equivalent experience 2+ years of experience in strategy or management consulting, ideally with exposure to business transformation strategy development and rollouts or MA transactions and due diligences Working knowledge of AI and generative AI (GenAI) tools, the habit of using them in your daily work and curiosity about how AI changes business transformation Exposure to large-scale projects or program management offices An affinity for solving problems and a pronounced capacity for analytical and structured thinking Curiosity for or knowledge of insurance and …

items.desc: Software Configuration Coater / Bonder Sternenfels bei Pforzheim Vollzeit unbefristet Große Ideen beginnen oft klein – manchmal kleiner als ein Staubkorn. Mikrochips sind die treibende Kraft hinter den Werkzeugen und Geräten, auf die wir uns täglich verlassen. Wir ermöglichen ihre Herstellung durch skalierbare, hochpräzise Lösungen in Lithografie, Wafer-Bonding und Packaging. Mit über 75 Jahren Erfahrung und weltweiter Präsenz sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner, der Verlässlichkeit und Innovationskraft verbindet. Dabei leitet uns die Überzeugung, dass Innovation nicht nur durch Technologie entsteht, sondern durch Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam Grenzen überwinden. Sie brennen für Softwareentwicklung und haben Spaß daran, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen? We are looking for an experienced industrial/manufacturing engineer with exposure to working in a complex multi-process environment to join our team in Limerick. The successful candidate will be a part of the Limerick Operations and Technology team working in our best-in-class wafer manufacturing clean-rooms. The role involves working with our Engineering and Operations teams to improve complex wafer level processes and systems, and to identify opportunities for productivity improvements. Designing production processes that maximize efficiency and reduce waste. Designing control systems to minimize cost and production issues. Develop production standards across operations. Mapping of inventory flow & optimizing flow / pull within and between manufacturing cells. Design of manufacturing layouts for efficiency Application of Visual factory concepts The Candidate: The ideal candidate must be self-motivated, dynamic, meticulous, proactive, prepared to take the initiative, drive change, and exhibit the following skills: Honours Degree in industrial engineering or related field required. Advanced knowledge of production machinery, processes, and standards, semiconductor manufacturing experience an advantage. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Troubleshooting skills and attention to detail. Documentation and organization skills. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Quick learning capability. Strong sense of work ethics. items.desc: We are a global innovation factory that integrates strategy, design & technology , supporting companies' growth from vision to execution in a “purple way.” We help organizations implement new business models, technology roadmaps, digital strategies & products , powered by our B2B software assets. Today a large part of that work is about AI: helping companies move from experimentation to real adoption, embedding it into how their people work every day. We firmly believe that people are the real energy that can shape innovation . Brilliant solutions can only be found through a unique mix of technology, human genius, and future vision. Being part of GELLIFY means joining the Purple People , a team where values such as resourcefulness, sharing, and constant improvement lead the way. A team made up of 260+ GELLIFYers , with 6 offices around the world , from Italy to Spain to the Middle East. Want to discover the new frontiers of AI, technology, innovation, and digitalization ? We look forward to having you on board to begin this journey together. Let's make the world more Purple ! Opportunities We would like to get in touch with motivated and passionate professionals who want to know more about us and explore future opportunities with GELLIFY and make a difference. If you are interested in job opportunities as Innovation Analyst in the Change Management and AI adoption field , read the details below and apply! Your Duties & Responsibilities As part of the team, you will contribute by: Providing the right business solution through direct contact with the clients. Planning and executing business analysis (marketing strategy, organizational structure, processes) and designing and implementing organizational models and ways of working that incorporate AI. Collecting information about the client's business through interviews, surveys, workshops, reports, and process observation — identifying improvement opportunities and GenAI use cases along the way. Analyzing and interpreting data to identify weaknesses and their causes, and mapping and classifying the resulting use cases by business function, expected impact, benefit, ROI and implementation complexity. Formulating recommendations and solutions through a structured problem-solving approach, considering the client's needs, capabilities, and limitations, and supporting the client in prioritizing them into a roadmap, with concise reports and clear deliverables. Organizing and managing specific tasks related to business projects and adoption programs. Conducting meetings effectively, creating clear and impactful presentations. Fluency in Italian and English is required. Requirements Bachelor's or master’s degree in economics , Management, or Engineering. At least 2-5 years of experience , gained in leading management consulting firms or modernly structured companies. Daily use of GenAI assistants — primarily Claude and Microsoft Copilot — with working knowledge of the broader tool landscape (e.g. ChatGPT, Gemini, NotebookLM, no-code automation tools). Experience as a PMO in complex contexts . Experience in the delivery of process improvement & change & adoption programs. Aptitude for creative problem-solving . Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills (oral and documentations) . Nice to have: experience facilitating training sessions or workshops with business users. Desired Soft Skills Curiosity to continuously improve in designing and implementing solutions. Ability to view new challenges as opportunities to analyze and study. Motivation to understand our clients’ businesses , their requirements, and deliver results. Passion for continuous learning and achieving personal goals. A hands-on, experimental attitude toward new tools: you try things before forming an opinion. Locations: Milan, Casalecchio di Reno (BO) with flexible work arrangements. items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Network Security Engineer da inserire in un team tecnico dedicato alla gestione, alla manutenzione e all'evoluzione dell'infrastruttura di rete e sicurezza . La risorsa si occuperà principalmente di implementazione delle modifiche di sicurezza, troubleshooting e gestione operativa dell'infrastruttura, con particolare focus sulle tecnologie Fortinet . Sarà inoltre coinvolta nelle attività di deployment di nuovi apparati e nell'attivazione di nuove sedi, collaborando con gli altri team tecnici per la risoluzione delle problematiche e l'evoluzione delle soluzioni esistenti. Responsabilità Implementare le modifiche relative alla sicurezza dell'infrastruttura di rete, garantendone la corretta esecuzione. Effettuare attività di troubleshooting su problematiche di rete, con particolare attenzione agli aspetti di sicurezza. Gestire la manutenzione dell'infrastruttura per assicurarne il corretto funzionamento e la continuità operativa. Occuparsi del deployment di nuovi apparati di rete e sicurezza, nonché delle attività di implementazione necessarie all'attivazione di nuove sedi. Supportare la progettazione e l'implementazione di nuove soluzioni di sicurezza e di interventi evolutivi significativi sull'infrastruttura esistente. Collaborare con gli altri team tecnici nelle attività di implementazione, troubleshooting e risoluzione delle problematiche. Contribuire alle attività di controllo e monitoraggio dell'infrastruttura di rete. Requisiti richiesti Conoscenza dei principali concetti e protocolli di Routing & Switching , tra cui STP, PVST e BGP . Esperienza comprovata nella gestione di firewall Fortinet , con particolare riferimento agli apparati FortiGate 100F, 200G/F, 80F, 501E, 1800F e 1100E . Buona conoscenza delle soluzioni di gestione centralizzata degli apparati di sicurezza, in particolare FortiManager, FortiAnalyzer e FortiClient . Esperienza pratica in ambito networking, routing e switching. Conoscenza delle attività di controllo e monitoraggio delle infrastrutture di rete. Competenza nella sicurezza delle piattaforme Cloud, in particolare Amazon AWS e Microsoft Azure , con focus sulla protezione di reti e infrastrutture multi-cloud. La posizione
items.desc: Dal 2005 Kiratech accompagna aziende di diverse dimensioni nell'adozione e nell'evoluzione di tecnologie Cloud Native, AI, Platform Engineering e Security. Come membro della Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) e partner dei principali Cloud Provider e vendor tecnologici dell'ecosistema Cloud Native, offriamo consulenza, formazione e servizi professionali con un approccio orientato a progettazione, automazione, osservabilità e miglioramento continuo delle piattaforme dei clienti. Il nostro obiettivo è ascoltare le richieste dei clienti per guidarli verso una maggiore efficienza e produttività, facendo dell'IT un acceleratore del business. Lavoriamo su progetti concreti e innovativi in ambiti che spaziano dal Platform Engineering alla sicurezza, fino all'automazione e all'adozione di modelli AI. Kiratech fa per te se cerchi: un'azienda in cui l'attenzione alla persona è fondamentale la possibilità di lavorare fianco a fianco con esperti del settore e di sviluppare competenze pratiche e concrete un team coeso e collaborativo un modo di lavorare per obiettivi Descrizione del profilo Kiratech è alla ricerca di una/un Cloud Native Engineer da inserire nel team Professional Services. La figura ha già maturato una prima esperienza (indicativamente di circa un anno) con tecnologie e pratiche Cloud Native e desidera consolidarla su progetti presso clienti enterprise. Come parte di un team di progetto, la persona contribuirà attivamente all'adozione di tecnologie e pratiche Cloud Native presso i clienti Kiratech e avrà la responsabilità, nel contesto dei progetti assegnati, di assicurare il raggiungimento degli obiettivi tecnici delle soluzioni richieste. Una/un Cloud Native Engineer in Kiratech comprende le esigenze finali del cliente e tende verso soluzioni olistiche e sostenibili, adotta in modo appropriato le metodologie di Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering e DevOps e punta al miglioramento continuo. La posizione è aperta anche a profili con minima esperienza nel ruolo ma con background tecnico, o a neolaureate/i che vogliano intraprendere una carriera stimolante nel settore Cloud Native. Attività principali Le attività principali includono la realizzazione di infrastrutture e piattaforme Cloud Native con strumenti di Infrastructure as Code, la containerizzazione e il deploy di applicazioni su Kubernetes, la configurazione di servizi Kubernetes gestiti sui principali Cloud Provider, l'implementazione di pipeline CI/CD e di flussi di Cloud Native Continuous Delivery, l'analisi di problematiche tecniche con la proposta di soluzioni al team di progetto e la documentazione del lavoro svolto. Chi cerchiamo Cerchiamo una persona con conoscenza ed esperienza concreta sulle tecnologie e pratiche Cloud Native, con un approccio creativo e propositivo rispetto alle complessità progettuali, capace di analizzare problematiche tecniche, proporre soluzioni e comunicarle in modo efficace al team di progetto. Percorso di crescita Il percorso prevede affiancamento con colleghe e colleghi senior del team Professional Services, formazione tecnica continua e un piano di carriera definito e supportato da certificazioni. La crescita porterà progressivamente a una maggiore autonomia sui progetti, alla responsabilità tecnica di un workstream e al ruolo di Cloud Native Engineer Senior. Requirements Il profilo ideale possiede: Infrastructure as Code: esperienza (circa 1 anno) con i principali strumenti, ad esempio Terraform, Ansible o CloudFormation Containerizzazione: esperienza (circa 1 anno) con strumenti come Docker, Kubernetes o Podman Cloud Provider: almeno 1 anno di esperienza con uno o più tra AWS, Azure e Google Cloud, in particolare su servizi di Kubernetes gestito (ad esempio EKS, AKS, Tanzu) CI/CD: conoscenza delle metodologie di Continuous Integration e Continuous Delivery e degli strumenti associati (ad esempio Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), anche in ambito Cloud Native Continuous Delivery (ad esempio Keptn, Flux, Argo, Tekton) Orientamento al cliente: esperienza consulenziale o comunque di gestione del cliente, con buone competenze di technical project management Capacità di analisi e problem solving: sai affrontare un problema tecnico con metodo, proporre soluzioni e documentare quanto svolto Collaborazione e comunicazione: lavori bene in team, condividi informazioni in modo chiaro e accogli feedback Costituiscono titolo preferenziale certificazioni o esperienza dimostrabile in uno o più dei seguenti ambiti : Competenze sistemistiche Linux Cloud Native networking (ad esempio services, ingress controller) Cloud Native storage (ad esempio Container Storage Interface, controller, servizi di storage dei principali Cloud Provider e loro uso in Kubernetes) Strumenti di monitoring e logging, ad esempio Prometheus, Grafana, Loki o ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) Strumenti di CI/CD come Jenkins o GitLab CI/CD Certificazioni Cloud Provider: AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft …

items.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) | Festanstellung oder Freelance | Holzkirchen / Remote
items.card: Aufgaben Was du machst Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion. Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können. Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch
items.desc: Standort: Holzkirchen (Dienstsitz), hybrid oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands Art: Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder freiberufliche Zusammenarbeit, jeweils mit Perspektive auf eine langfristige Partnerschaft Warum diese Rolle Wir bauen Software, mit der echte Unternehmen arbeiten. Du wirst Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen und schnellen Teams, in dem du als Product Owner die Produktvision und die Umsetzung von Anfang bis Ende verantwortest, statt ein Backlog abzuarbeiten, das jemand anderes vorgekaut hat. Du arbeitest eng mit erfahrenen Engineers zusammen, steuerst KI-gestützte Entwicklungsabläufe und bringst Features innerhalb weniger Wochen vom Konzept in die Produktion. Diese Rolle ist für jemanden, der in Systemen, Nutzen für die Anwender und operativer Klarheit denkt, nicht nur in Jira-Status. Ehrlich gesagt: KI im Jahr 2026 Wir entwickeln schnell mit modernen KI-Werkzeugen (Cursor, Claude, Copilot usw.). Als unser Product Owner musst du selbst keinen Produktivcode schreiben, aber du musst verstehen, wie KI-native Entwicklung Lieferzyklen, Aufwandsschätzung und Scoping verändert. Die KI-Werkzeuge können Code schreiben, aber sie wissen nicht, was unsere Kunden wirklich brauchen, wie Abläufe über Unternehmen hinweg zusammenhängen oder welche Kompromisse für unsere Architektur sinnvoll sind. Genau für dieses Urteilsvermögen suchen wir dich. Die Messlatte ist nicht „Kannst du eine User-Story-Vorlage ausfüllen?“. Die Messlatte ist: Kannst du eine unübersichtliche betriebliche Realität in glasklare Produktanforderungen übersetzen, konsequent priorisieren und Entwickler wie KI-Assistenten effizient dahin lenken, das Richtige zu bauen? Aufgaben Was du machst Du verantwortest Roadmap und Backlog: Du definierst, schneidest und priorisierst Features vom Konzept bis zur Produktion. Du übersetzt übergeordnete Geschäftsziele in präzise, umsetzbare Anforderungen und Datenmodelle, mit denen unser Engineering-Team und unsere KI-Werkzeuge arbeiten können. Du sorgst für reibungslose Kommunikation zwischen Stakeholdern, Entwicklern und Anwendern, auf Deutsch und Englisch. Du steuerst Sprints, räumst Hindernisse aus dem Weg und hältst das Tempo hoch, ohne unnötige Bürokratie. Du prüfst ausgelieferte Features gegen die Akzeptanzkriterien und achtest auf hohe Qualität, gute UX und echten geschäftlichen Nutzen. Du entwickelst unsere Produktprozesse mit unserem Wachstum weiter, hältst Feedbackschleifen kurz und die Developer Experience reibungslos. Unser Stack und unsere Arbeitsweise Methodik: agil, Lean Product Development, kurze Iterationen, wenig Bürokratie Technologie: TypeScript, Python, React, Next.js, Supabase, Postgres, Cloudflare KI-native Werkzeuge: Cursor, Copilot und Claude Code als fester Bestandteil unserer Entwicklung Kommunikation: verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch Du musst nicht programmieren, aber du sprichst fließend „Tech“ und verstehst, wie moderne Software unter der Haube gebaut wird. Anforderungen Was wir suchen Must-haves Nachweisbare Erfahrung als Product Owner, Technical Project Manager oder Product Lead in der Softwareentwicklung. Fließendes Deutsch (mindestens C1) in Wort und Schrift sowie sehr gutes Englisch (mindestens C1), unverzichtbar für die Abstimmung mit Kunden, Stakeholdern und dem Team. Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis: Du kennst moderne Web-Stacks, Datenbanken (Postgres) und APIs und weißt, wie Softwarearchitektur funktioniert. Vertrautheit mit KI-gestützter Softwareentwicklung und ihren Auswirkungen auf Produktplanung und Tempo. Leidenschaft für Klarheit: Du schreibst knappe Spezifikationen, Edge Cases und Akzeptanzkriterien, die keine Fragen offenlassen. Selbstständige, pragmatische und proaktive Arbeitsweise. Nice-to-haves Hintergrund in Softwareentwicklung oder Informatik. Erfahrung in Start-ups oder in schnellen, erfahrenen Produktteams. Praxis mit modernen Kollaborations- und Projektwerkzeugen (Linear, Notion, GitHub Projects). Uns sind dein Urteilsvermögen beim Strukturieren und dein Umsetzungstempo deutlich wichtiger als die Länge deines Lebenslaufs. Benefits So arbeiten wir Kleines, erfahrenes Team: direkte Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Gründern und Engineers. Deine Entscheidungen zählen vom ersten Tag an. Flexibel: hybrid oder remote innerhalb Deutschlands, Dienstsitz ist Holzkirchen. Wichtig ist uns verlässliche Erreichbarkeit zu den üblichen Geschäftszeiten. You default to building scalable, repeatable solutions rather than one-off fixes Grow your way At Mollie, growth is personal. We believe everyone should have the chance to develop their skills, explore new challenges and shape their career on their own terms. You’ll get regular feedback and performance reviews to support your development, with fair and transparent salary reviews along the way. No matter if you’re aiming for promotion, exploring a different career path or building new skills, you’ll be supported with the tools, trust and opportunities to grow your way.
