items.desc: SOL S.p.A. is an Italian multinational operating in the technical, industrial, and medical gas sector. Founded in 1927 and listed on the Milan Stock Exchange since 1998, the Group boasts more than 7,600 employees, a consolidated turnover exceeding 1.7 billion Euros, and offices and production facilities across 33 countries in Europe, India, Brazil, Turkey, Morocco, China, and Ecuador. For more information: https://www.solgroup.com/it Open Innovation & On-Site Business Product Specialist: Based within the Technical Gas Innovation Department (Technological Marketing Service), the successful candidate, serving as Open Innovation & On-Site Business Product Specialist, will identify market needs, develop emerging technologies, and turn them into new business opportunities within energy transition and decarbonization. This role involves working in close synergy with startups, research centers, strategic partners, and the Group’s commercial network. In parallel, the candidate will develop SOL’s global market for on-site technical gas production, promoting it as a key solution for decarbonizing industrial processes. Main Responsibilities and Activities Market Analysis and Trends: Monitor the technological landscape by attending industry trade fairs, tracking decarbonization projects, and analyzing incentive schemes (e.g., European funding, PNRR, etc.), identifying new business opportunities and the development of products and services. Scouting and Startup Collaboration: Identify and evaluate innovative technologies through partnerships with startups, research centers, and technology partners, analyzing their industrial applicability and guiding their integration into SOL’s offer portfolio. Sales Enablement: Develop sales tools such as technical notes, promotional material, and guidelines for the sales force based on successfully completed projects and Proofs of Concept (POCs). On-Site Plant Business Development: Conduct market and competitor analyses to identify new opportunities, defining and promoting the value proposition for on-site gas production. On-Site Technical-Commercial Support: Work alongside the SOL sales network and industrial clients by preparing technical and economic feasibility analyses as well as providing application consultancy. Engineering and Integration: Collaborate in synergy with the on-site technical service department to oversee the engineering and tailored optimization phase of the systems. Requirements Technical & Field Skills Educational Background: Bachelor's or Master's Degree in scientific disciplines (a degree in Chemical or Energy Engineering is preferred). Execution & Mobility: Availability for frequent business trips both nationally and abroad at plants, job sites, and partner/startup locations. Industry Skills: Aptitude for analyzing chemical/industrial processes and a strong curiosity about the technological innovation landscape. Language Skills: Excellent knowledge of English (essential for managing international projects). Knowledge of a second language is a plus. Professional Experience: Relevant experience (even brief) in business development and product management within an Open Innovation context is appreciated. Soft Skills Ability to adapt and test innovative ideas within practical, operational industrial contexts. Strong interpersonal skills to interact seamlessly with startups/researchers as well as with customers and commercial teams. Ability to independently plan and execute travel activities and project monitoring. Aptitude for multidisciplinary and international teamwork. What We Offer Classification and Salary: Contract aimed at permanent employment under the Italian Chemical Industry National Collective Bargaining Agreement (CCNL), with a Gross Annual Salary (RAL) ranging between €32,000 and €40,000 (excluding travel allowances and bonuses). Welfare and Healthcare: Supplementary healthcare insurance and industry pension fund (Faschim/Fonchim). Company Canteen. Professional Development: A dynamic and stimulating role combining strategic innovation (Open Innovation) with practical field validation. Work Environment: Joining a dynamic, solid, and future-oriented context within an Italian organization with a strong international outlook. The final job classification and gross salary will be tailored to the candidate's actual experience in compliance with the pay scale minimums specified by the reference CCNL. The compensation package will be defined based on the required qualifications and competencies demonstrated during interviews, strictly adhering to objective, meritocratic, and gender-neutral criteria. Work Location: SOL Group HQ – Monza, Italy. This job advertisement is addressed to candidates of all genders (Italian Legislative Decree 198/2006).

items.desc: Are you ready to move your career forward and help shape our company’s and customers’ futures? If you aspire to challenge yourself, work with the best in the industry and join a successful team where you can make a meaningful contribution, then we invite you to join us at Ketjen Corporation, a provider of advanced catalyst solutions to leading producers in the petrochemical, refining, and specialty chemicals industries. Together, we can create a legacy marked by innovation, excitement, and energy. As a Technician III, you will be part of the Clean Fuels Technology R&D team, where you play a key role in developing and improving innovative products and processes. You will execute experiments, support research projects, and contribute to the safe and reliable operation of our laboratory and pilot plant facilities. You will work on a wide variety of technologies, ranging from advanced catalyst systems for the petrochemical industry to innovative inorganic materials for industrial applications. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine laboratory work, pilot plant operations, and process development in a dynamic R&D environment What you will do: Plan, prepare, and independently execute laboratory and pilot plant experiments within assigned R&D projects. Translate research questions, technical challenges, and targeted literature findings into practical experimental plans, test methods, and equipment configurations. Set up, operate, monitor, troubleshoot, and adapt laboratory and pilot plant equipment to deliver safe, reliable, and high-quality experimental results. Integrate Ketjen's HSE standards into daily work by proactively identifying hazards, implementing appropriate controls, and ensuring safe execution of laboratory and research activities Maintain pilot equipment and associated facilities, including quality checks, modifications, QHSE requirements, and accurate technical documentation. Proactively collaborate with technicians, scientists, engineers, and project teams, fostering open communication and knowledge sharing to achieve project goals. Record experimental conditions, observations, results, and conclusions accurately and timely in LIMS and other data management systems. Organizing, analyzing, and statistically validating experimental data to generate robust technical conclusions. Support scale-up and plant trials by assessing implementation requirements, preparing equipment and test activities, and evaluating relevant process and QHSE implications. Work closely with technicians, scientists, engineers, and project leads to align objectives, solve experimental challenges, share findings, and improve research programs. Build and maintain detailed technical knowledge of HPC catalyst production routes, including key process parameters, unit operations, raw materials, and their impact on product performance Adapt readily between small-scale laboratory work, pilot plant operation, scale-up activities, and support for trial production as project priorities evolve. What you will bring : HBO working and thinking level in chemical technology, process technology, applied chemistry, or a comparable technical discipline, with 1–3 years of relevant practical experience. Demonstrated affinity with hands-on experimental work and the safe operation of laboratory, analytical, and pilot plant equipment. Strong safety awareness and a disciplined approach to HSE requirements, risk assessment, housekeeping, and accurate execution of experimental procedures. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build, maintain and leverage effective relationships and networks across colleagues, stakeholders and customers; Proficient in written Dutch and English, enabling accurate documentation, technical reporting and effective communication of (sub)project results and conclusions; Flexibility, with the ability to effectively manage changing priorities and a diverse range of activities. Affinity to work with various equipment from analysis to pilot equipment. Practical knowledge of experimental methods, measurement techniques, sampling, and procedures relevant to catalyst or process development. Effective presentation and communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical approaches, results and recommendations to colleagues and project teams; Solution-oriented thinking: showing creativity and initiative in solving problems in all phases of a project. Affinity with software such as: Microsoft Office, PI vision, Sample Manager or other LIMS, ELN, etc Benefits of Joining Ketjen Competitive compensation Comprehensive benefits package A diverse array of resources to support you professionally and personally. Apply today and help Ketjen unleash the POTENTIAL of advanced chemistry for industries that power the world.

items.desc: As Junior Data Engineer, you’ll help build data products for the air‑cargo logistics industry by turning your academic knowledge into practical solutions, working closely with data engineers, software engineers, analysts, and consultants to solve real operational challenges. Who we are We are Rotate. We help key players across the global air cargo and logistics industry make better commercial and strategic decisions. We provide cloud-based software and analytics, world-leading market data, and data-driven strategy consulting. Our clients include top-tier airlines, airports, freight forwarders, governments, shippers, investors, and other industry stakeholders. Founded in 2022 by a core team of former aviation strategy consultants, Rotate has grown rapidly. We now have offices in the Netherlands and Malaysia and a diverse team of around 50 professionals, including strategy consultants, data scientists, software developers, and data engineers. Demand for our work continues to grow strongly, and we are therefore looking for talented data engineers to strengthen our team. What you’ll do Rotate provides a online SaaS platform containing 3 main products, each of these products is developed and maintained by a core team with a mixed skillset. As a junior data engineer you will join a product team which is a collection of data engineers, software developers, customer succes consultants and business people with every skillset that is needed to keep a complex b2b system going. Your tasks are to: maintain and improve current data pipelines onboard new clients and data sets extend and improve the current functionality of the tools work with current and new clients to help understand the usage of the tool work in a scrum team responsible for keeping a SaaS product going understand data and how it effects operations and processing In the team you will learn the ins and outs of the air cargo industry. Next to domain knowledge you will also work on your own skillset as a data engineer with the guidance of a senior data engineer next to you. Why work at Rotate? At Rotate, you’ll join a fast-moving team that’s tackling an endless stream of fascinating problems in an industry that’s essential to the global economy. We build high-impact products and strategies using modern technologies, and we’re committed to tailoring your personal and professional growth as we scale. Our performance management and learning programs are all about helping you grow, with coaching and mentorship on a daily basis. In addition to excellent compensation, you’ll get to: Build things that matter. Solve complex problems in a critical industry. Advise clients on their most fundamental strategic questions, or partner with airlines to co-develop data-driven SaaS products with the latest technology stack. Drive efficiency and sustainability in global supply chains. Write your own story. Feel like an entrepreneur within a well-funded company and established team. Help us build Rotate and share in our joint success. Partner with us to tailor your development and career ambition. Live unforgettable experiences. Get exposed to different cultures, go on unforgettable offsites, experience the highs and lows of scale-up life…and if you’re keen, travel the world and eat sushi in Tokyo! Your qualifications We’re looking for curious, motivated self‑starters who are eager to learn, experiment, and grow into the role of a data engineer. You enjoy solving problems, asking questions, and taking ownership of your work, even if you’re still figuring things out. You thrive in a supportive, flexible environment where you can make a real impact while developing your skills. We’d love to hear from you if you have: A completed university in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Econometrics, Aerospace engineering or a related field Some hands‑on experience with Python , through career, internships, projects, coursework, or personal experiments A basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or distributed systems, and the motivation to deepen your knowledge Interest in DevOps concepts such as CI/CD, cloud platforms, or containerization (experience is a plus, not a requirement) A proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset: you like breaking down problems and trying things out Strong communication skills: you can explain your thinking and enjoy collaborating with both technical and business colleagues Fluency in English (additional languages are a bonus) Curiosity about AWS, Kubernetes, monitoring, or data processing workflows, with the willingness to learn these on the job Genuine interest in the aviation industry Where is Rotate located? items.desc: Function ICT Job type Hybrid Working hours 36 - 40 Job Summary In many process analyst roles, the job ends when the model is done. Here, that's where it starts. Are you someone who can look at the data behind a process and understand how it actually performs? Do you challenge assumptions and use data to identify opportunities for improvement? Then you'll recognize yourself in this role. At Kiwa, understanding how processes perform in practice is essential to creating consistency and driving improvement across more than 30 countries. As part of Kiwa's global ERP transformation, we are building one standard way of working. The modelling gives us the foundation. The data tells us where to go next. If this sounds like the way you approach process improvement, this could be the role for you! About the role As a Business Process Analyst, you'll model Kiwa's business processes and work with stakeholders across the globe to keep them accurate and useful. You'll join a team of six analysts within the BPM team. Together we map and govern Kiwa's processes across multiple countries. Your main focus will be Lead-to-Cash. Most of your time goes into modelling. During rollouts, you'll facilitate workshops and build BPMN models, working closely with process owners and functional consultants to make sure what we document reflects what actually happens. Between rollouts, you'll keep those models current and support the countries that use them. Where process mining data is available, you'll use it to check the models against reality and spot where processes slow down or deviate. It adds a useful second lens to the modelling work, and it'll grow as the practice matures. So you'll need to be comfortable talking to senior stakeholders in different countries, and structured enough to turn those conversations into clear, consistent models. Affinity with data analysis is a plus. What you'll do: Model business processes in BPMN 2.0, from value chain down to task level; Run as-is and to-be analyses and identify where processes can improve; Analyse process mining data to assess how processes perform in practice; Turn that analysis into clear visuals and recommendations that people act on; Maintain process documentation in our central repository and keep it consistent across countries;Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather and validate process information; Support impact assessments for process changes with local entities; Work with project teams and functional consultants during country rollouts; Help us further develop the BPM framework, governance and performance measurement. Do you have what it takes? For this role, we are looking for someone who enjoys combining process thinking with data-driven analysis. You are comfortable moving between process modelling and stakeholder discussions, and you know how to turn insights into actionable recommendations. You communicate effectively with stakeholders at different levels and feel at ease working in an international environment. In addition, you bring: A Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent working and thinking level); At least 3 to 5 years of experience as a business process analyst, process consultant or similar; Hands-on experience with BPMN 2.0 modelling; Experience with a process repository like Mavim, ARIS or Signavio; Experience with data analysis and visualisation, for example in Power BI; The ability to translate process data into something useful: insights, recommendations, a clear story; Experience managing stakeholders at different levels in an international organisation; Fluency in English; fluency in Dutch is considered an advantage; Based in the Netherlands and allowed to work here. What sets you apart: Experience with process mining tools; Knowledge of Lead-to-Cash processes; Experience with ERP transformations, preferably D365; Lean or Six Sigma knowledge; A habit of combining what you see in the process with what the numbers tell you; Experience in TIC or in organisations with a similar multi-country structure. What can you expect from us in return? A role where your work has a direct impact on how Kiwa organizes its processes across more than 30 countries. You'll join a team that takes process governance seriously and is building capabilities that will last well beyond the Flow! programme. When it comes to our terms and conditions, we offer a salary range of EURO 56.229 - 77.315 annually including holiday allowance on a fulltime basis with further space to grow. Placement within this range will depend on your experience, skills and overall fit for the role. We offer a contract for 36 to 40 hours per week, with hybrid working arrangements that allow you to balance office hours with remote work, supporting your work-life balance. Further, you will receive 33 days of annual holiday leave entitlement (with the possibility to buy 5 extra leave days per year), a good pension scheme and participation in Kiwa's profit-sharing scheme. items.desc: Technical System Designer Translate requirements and acceptance criteria into technical designs that define system behavior, data flows, inter-system contracts, component responsibilities, and error handling. Analyze existing code and application behavior to validate proposed solutions and make effective use of proven mechanisms. Design solutions in collaboration with business analysts, solution architects, developers, and application administrators, and support the team during implementation. Conduct targeted analysis of application and IT infrastructure performance, identify the causes of issues, and recommend optimizations. Evaluate new technologies and IT tools, prepare recommendations, and contribute to decisions about their adoption within the system. Help strengthen data and system security by designing secure solutions, identifying risks, and coordinating actions with the relevant teams. Use AI tools in practice to analyze, design, and document changes, while critically verifying their output. Work with other departments to understand their technology needs and agree on the scope of changes. Work in an Agile team, solve technical problems, and continuously improve ways of working. Document design decisions and communicate the scope of changes, risks, and solution quality to stakeholders. Help shape the system’s development strategy by identifying architectural needs, proposing directions for change, and contributing to decision-making. what do you bring? At least 3 years of experience in the technical design of IT systems or significant architectural changes. At least 2 years of hands-on commercial software development experience, with the ability to read code and trace the actual flow of a request through a system. Ability to translate acceptance criteria into a feasible technical design that aligns with the system architecture. Experience analyzing existing code and designing extensions to established mechanisms. Practical knowledge of frontend and backend web application architecture, including data flows between them, REST/JSON contract design, and integration with other systems. Ability to design flexible, configurable solutions and assess the impact of changes on related processes. Experience diagnosing technical and performance issues and recommending application and infrastructure optimizations. Knowledge of authentication, authorization, and data protection principles in application design. Hands-on experience using AI tools for code analysis, design, implementation, testing, or documentation, and the ability to critically evaluate their output. Ability to clearly document technical decisions and collaborate with analysts, developers, architects, and other stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with microservices architecture and containerized applications. Familiarity with tools for documenting and testing APIs and creating flow diagrams. Knowledge of the AI SDLC and principles for safely integrating AI into the software development lifecycle. items.desc: Meet the team Join the Compensation team, an integral part of People Care. We are dedicated to designing and delivering equitable, competitive, and innovative compensation programs that support our global workforce. Our team collaborates closely with business leaders and HR partners to ensure our pay practices align with our organizational strategy and values. We foster a culture of continuous learning, curiosity, and data-driven decision-making to enhance the employee experience. Your impact As a Compensation Analyst, you will play a vital role in analyzing and administering compensation programs that attract and retain top talent. You will leverage your analytical skills to evaluate market data, assess internal equity, and support the annual compensation review cycles. By partnering with stakeholders across the organization, you will help translate complex data into actionable insights, ensuring our compensation strategies remain competitive and compliant. Your attention to detail and problem-solving abilities will directly contribute to the operational excellence of the People Care organization. Minimum qualifications Professional: Bachelors + 0 years of previous experience, or equivalent related work experience | Support& Trainee: 4 years of related experience Demonstrated experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify trends. Proficiency in Advanced Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and data modeling techniques. Proven ability to communicate complex information clearly and effectively to diverse audiences. Strong attention to detail to ensure accuracy in compensation modeling, data entry, and reporting. Preferred qualifications Prior experience working within a global compensation, total rewards, or human resources team. Demonstrated problem-solving skills with a track record of improving processes or resolving analytical challenges. A strong sense of curiosity and a proactive approach to researching market trends and best practices. Familiarity with Workday and Service Now Knowledge of regional compensation regulations and compliance standards. Why Cisco? At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

items.desc: Company Description NielsenIQ is a global measurement and data analytics company that provides the most complete and trusted view available of consumers and markets worldwide. We provide consumer packaged goods manufacturers/fast-moving consumer goods and retailers with accurate, actionable information and insights and a complete picture of the complex and changing marketplace that companies need to innovate and grow. Our approach marries proprietary NielsenIQ data with other data sources to help clients around the world understand what’s happening now, what’s happening next, and how to best act on this knowledge. Job Description As a Data Operations Analyst, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy, quality, and timely delivery of data to our clients. This position focuses on transforming, validating, and monitoring data workflows while maintaining high standards of data integrity. In this role, you will ensure the smooth execution of transportation orders, collaborate with customers, carriers, and customs agencies, and deliver a high standard of service throughout the entire logistics process. Key Responsibilities: Manage import air freight forwarding shipments from start to finish. Verify shipment requirements and ensure the accuracy of transport documentation. Maintain accurate data in operational systems (including CargoWise) and ensure timely document archiving. Coordinate activities with all parties involved in the logistics chain, including carriers, handling agents, and customs agencies. Identify and report potential risks and additional costs related to shipment execution. Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers and business partners. Initiate and implement improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency. What You Will Bring To The Role: Good command of English, enabling effective communication in a business environment. Minimum 1 year of experience in air freight forwarding. Knowledge of import air freight processes. Familiarity with transportation and logistics documentation. Practical knowledge of Incoterms. Strong relationship-building skills with customers and business partners. Ability to work independently, with attention to detail and a high level of accountability. Good knowledge of the MS Office package. Willingness to learn and pursue further professional development. What We Offer Stable employment based on a permanent employment contract within an international organization. Opportunities for professional growth and development in international logistics and freight forwarding. Participation in managing transportation projects for global customers. A friendly working environment and support from an experienced team. Independence in your work, with the opportunity to propose and implement process improvements. items.desc: About the Role Imagine this. You are building and improving the simulation tools that help our engineers understand how advanced warhead designs perform against complex targets before physical testing takes place. As a Junior Terminal Ballistics Simulation Engineer , you will join our Kinetics Team in Madrid and contribute directly to the development, validation and improvement of simulation models used to evaluate terminal ballistic performance against hardened structures. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone at the beginning of their career who wants to build strong expertise in computational mechanics and terminal ballistics while working on real defense systems. You will work alongside experienced engineers, gradually taking ownership of simulation activities and turning complex physical problems into reliable engineering models. At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations. Requirements What You'll Do Develop, maintain and continuously improve terminal ballistic simulation models focused on warhead effects against hardened structures. Build, run, validate and optimize computational models using engineering software such as NX, IMPETUS or similar CAE tools. Work closely with engineers within the Kinetics Team to translate design requirements and physical scenarios into accurate computational models. Analyze simulation results, identify trends and contribute to improving model accuracy, robustness and computational efficiency. Compare simulation predictions with available analytical, experimental or test data to support model validation. Document simulation methodologies, assumptions, results and conclusions to ensure clear technical traceability. Support engineering investigations and design decisions through simulation and data-driven analysis. Contribute ideas to improve simulation workflows, methodologies and engineering processes. What You'll Need Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering or a related technical discipline. Academic or practical experience in computational mechanics, impact mechanics, terminal ballistics, penetration mechanics or related areas. Experience with finite element analysis and computational simulation through academic projects, research or professional experience. Knowledge of NX, IMPETUS or similar nonlinear explicit simulation software is highly desirable. Good understanding of solid mechanics, dynamic loading and material behavior. Ability to interpret simulation results and connect computational outputs with real physical behavior. Programming or scripting experience for simulation automation or data processing is a plus. Strong analytical thinking and a hands-on approach to solving engineering problems. Fluent in English both speaking and writing. Who You Are You are curious about how advanced engineering problems are solved through simulation and enjoy transforming complex physics into reliable computational models. You take ownership of your work, enjoy learning from experienced engineers and are motivated by seeing your analyses contribute to real products. You thrive in a collaborative environment where innovation moves quickly, and you are excited by the opportunity to work on cutting-edge aerospace and defense technologies while continuously developing your technical expertise.

items.desc: Description We are seeking a highly capable and hands-on Threat Hunter to join a passionate and motivated, industry-leading team focused on identifying sophisticated adversaries through hypothesis-driven analysis and automation. You will be responsible for proactively hunting and analysing advanced threats across the customers environment using our proprietary hunting framework, ensuring our threat models and threat hunts are tightly aligned to the customer. As a Threat Hunter, you will actively search for cyber threats that evade traditional security solutions. Your role will involve conducting in-depth intelligence-led, hypothesis-driven analysis of TTPs and behaviours, and working cross-functionally with the Security Operations Centre Analysts, Global Detection Engineers, Privacy Team and Engineering Team to mitigate risks. Key Responsibilities Use NCC Group’s HITS Framework, threat intelligence, MITRE ATT&CK, and risk models to form hypotheses and validate them through structured hunts. Leverage GitLab, Sigma, Jupyter Notebooks and other tools to automate hunts, visualise results, and create reusable artifacts for future investigations and detections. Collaborate with detection engineering to convert threat hunt findings into high fidelity detection content. Utilising both NCC Groups internal threat intelligence feeds and open-source threat intelligence, use these to operationalise detections for emerging threats. Support the mapping of threat models to monitoring use cases in partnership with teams across the business. Document and maintain a robust repository for hunting methodologies, tooling, and findings to enable continuous improvement and team scaling. Provide regular reports and presentations to stakeholders, with clear articulation of threats, methods, and risk impact. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise The ideal candidate is a highly skilled and proactive Threat Hunter with a strong background in hypothesis-driven hunting, adversary TTP analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. They have hands-on experience in Threat Hunting, Red Team, Blue Team, or Incident Response roles, with a deep understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework and a proven ability to detect and investigate advanced threats beyond signature-based solutions. Experienced using one or more of Splunk, Microsoft, CrowdStrike and SentinelOne SIEM and EDR stacks. Experience translating threat intelligence into actionable insights and working alongside detection engineers and security analysts to operationalise findings. They should be driven by curiosity and methodical thinking, constantly seeking to improve visibility and detection coverage across complex environments—including hybrid or cloud-native architectures like AWS, Azure, or GCP. They will be comfortable presenting findings to stakeholders and documenting methodologies. They thrive in fast-moving, varied and dynamic environments and are passionate about staying ahead of evolving threats. Minimum Requirements Experience within a Threat Hunter, Red Team, Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Malware Analysisor Blue Team role. Solid understanding of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, TTP analysis, and adversary emulation. Deep familiarity with hypothesis-driven threat hunting frameworks and methodologies. Ability to work autonomously while collaborating across security, engineering, and business teams. Strong scripting/query language skills (e.g., Python, KQL, SQL, PowerShell). Desirable Requirements Hands-on experience using Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, automation, and visualization in a security context. Knowledge of cloud products and log events such as Azure, Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud Platform. Familiarity with data science and machine learning techniques in security analysis. Background in building automated hunting pipelines and/or detection-as-code. Desirable Certifications GCFA OSCP GDAT GCIH Or similar certifications, not required but certainly desirable. Job Benefits Flexible Working : Balance your work and personal life with our flexible working options. Generous Holiday Allowance : Enjoy 25 days of holiday, plus bank holidays, with the option to buy up to 5 additional days of annual leave. Medicash & Critical Illness Scheme Financial & Investment Benefits : Enjoy peace of mind with our Pension, Life Assurance, and Share Save Scheme. Community & Volunteering Programmes : Make a difference in your community with our volunteering opportunities. Green Car Scheme: Drive green and save money with our eco-friendly car scheme. Cycle Schem e: Stay fit and healthy with our cycle-to-work scheme. Special Time Off : Take time off for those big moments in life, like getting married/entering into a civil partnership, becoming a grandparent, and welcoming home a new pet. items.desc: About Qualifyze, Founded in 2019, Qualifyze is a leading company in supply chain compliance management in the Life Sciences industry, trusted by over 1,500 pharmaceutical and healthcare companies globally. Our digital suite of solutions connects manufacturers, suppliers, and a global network of more than 250 auditors and quality experts. With a track record of over 4,500 audits across 85+ countries and the largest and most accurate supplier network and data analytics tools, Qualifyze stands as the all-in-one partner for quality compliance and supply chain risk mitigation in the Life Sciences sector. Role Overview: As Team Lead Analytics , you will guide the analytics domain within our Business Intelligence team while remaining hands-on with data models and our semantic layer . Your mission is to build and maintain the path from raw data to trusted, self-service insights through robust dbt models , a rich semantic model , a well-structured Looker ecosystem, reliable investor metrics , and enriched CRM data for commercial teams. This is a player-coach role split equally between team leadership (prioritization, coaching, stakeholder alignment) and direct technical contributions ( dbt , semantic modeling , and Looker ). Main responsibilities: The team member shall perform the present tasks inherent to such position, including, but not limited to, the following: Team Leadership & Delivery : Lead the Analytics vertical (analytics engineering, business analysis, CRM data) by setting priorities, coaching team members, fostering clear ownership, and ensuring high-quality delivery. You will be responsible for fostering engagement, performance, and growth. Data Modeling & Semantic Layer : Own the data modeling layer end-to-end by designing, building, and reviewing dbt models across a medallion architecture, while enriching the semantic model to keep Looker (LookML, explores, views) consistent, reliable, and optimized for self-service reporting. Data Governance & CRM Operations : Govern investor reporting metrics, defining, reconciling, and ensuring every number reported to leadership and investors is accurate, traceable, and reproducible, while steering CRM data enrichment to ensure cleaned customer and supplier records sync reliably with the data warehouse for commercial teams. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment : Act as the bridge to the business partnering with business analysts to gather and prioritize stakeholder requirements, balance Looker self-service tools against ad hoc analysis, and translate business needs into data models, explores, and reports, while partnering with Data Engineering on ingestion, pipeline reliability, warehouse architecture, and formal data contracts. Engineering Standards & Continuous Improvement : Uphold technical excellence by establishing code/design reviews, dbt tests, CI/CD, data quality monitoring, and operational runbooks, while acting as a catalyst to simplify, consolidate, or retire legacy models and introduce efficient tooling. Main requirements: Several years of experience as an Analytics Engineer , with strong foundations in data modelling, SQL, and the modern data stack. Proven experience building and maintaining dbt models and transformation pipelines , including testing, documentation, CI, and Git-based workflows; ideally within a medallion architecture. Strong understanding of dimensional modelling, semantic layers, and metric governance is required. Experience defining and governing business metrics and reporting , with a strong focus on accuracy, reconciliation, and traceability; investor or board reporting experience is a plus. Familiarity with CRM systems such as HubSpot or Salesforce, and with how CRM data is modelled, enriched, and synced with a data warehouse Strong business acumen and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate business questions into clear technical requirements, explain trade-offs to non-technical audiences, and collaborate across technical and business teams. Demonstrated readiness for a player-coach role , ideally with experience leading a small data team, setting priorities, mentoring colleagues, and remaining hands-on through technical and design decisions, code reviews, and continuous improvement. Nice to have: Experience with Looker (LookML, explores, and semantic-layer maintenance) or a comparable self-service BI tool, and working knowledge of Python for analytics workflows Soft skills - Level M4: Strategic Thinking: Translates the roadmap agreed with the Head of the team into concrete priorities and deliverables for ICs. Leadership & Mentorship: Coaches and develops team members; fostering ownership within the team. items.desc: Är du en serviceminded person som drivs av att hjälpa andra för att få flyt i vardagen, samtidigt som du vill bidra till ett hållbart samhälle? Nu söker vi en assisterande projektledare till RISE Processum AB, som under perioden november 2026 till augusti 2027 vill stötta projektledning och kommunikationsarbete. Att kommunicera resultat och nytta med den forskning och de projekt RISE Processum AB driver är en del av att jobba med vårt övergripande uppdrag att stärka näringslivets konkurrenskraft och en hållbar omställning. Nu söker vi en assisterande projektledare som ska stötta med service och kommunikation samt praktiskt genomförande av kommunikationsinsatser i några av våra viktiga projekt och satsningar inom området bioraffinaderi och innovationsklustret Processum Biorefinery Cluster. Om rollen Organisatoriskt ingår du i gruppen Innovationssystem, men i rollen som assisterande projektledare, arbetar du nära och stöttar projektledare, forskare och samarbetspartners även från övriga delar av RISE. Du har också ett nära samarbete med kommunikationsenheten på Bioekonomidivisionen samt kommunikationsspecialister inom RISE. Du planerar event, besök och möten och stöttar upp och säkerställer att genomförandet går så smidigt och sömlöst som möjligt. Vidare planerar, genomför och utvärderar du kommunikationsinsatser med särskilt fokus på projektets behov och målgrupper. Arbetet inkluderar uppföljning och utvärdering av genomförda insatser samt återkoppling av resultat till verksamheten. Vidare arbetar du med att underhålla och utveckla hemsida och olika digitala kanaler, nyhetsbrev, event, frontdesk och PR. I rollen ingår det även att ha kontakt med RISE externa byråer för samarbete kring större kommunikationsinsatser. Som assisterande projektledare RISE Processum AB ingår du även i en kommunikationsgrupp som arbetar strategiskt med att synliggöra varumärket High Coast Innovation Park. Du är även en del av redaktionsrådet för LinkedInkanalen Bioeconomy at RISE. Här arbetar du tillsammans med gruppen för att lyfta bioekonomi samt bioraffinaderiområdet brett över hela RISE. Placeringsort är Örnsköldsvik. Vem är du? Som person är du nyfiken och drivs av att förstå och förklara komplexa frågor. items.desc: We're redefining what a data consultancy can be and achieve. Epical is a pure-play data consultancy company with services and expertise to support and enable the management, utilization, and protection of our clients' data. We're not just experts in data; we're trust-makers who empower our clients to exceed expectations. Join our Digital Trust team and help organizations build secure, modern, and trustworthy digital identity capabilities while fostering a culture of empathy, accountability, and curiosity. We are looking for an IAM Domain Architect to join our Digital Trust team and play a key role in shaping the future of identity and access management for our clients. What is this role all about? As an IAM Domain Architect, you will lead the design of Identity and Access Management architectures for our clients. You will work closely with business stakeholders, security teams, and technical specialists to translate business requirements into secure and scalable identity solutions. Your work may include IAM strategy development, architecture design, governance models, solution roadmaps, and guiding implementation projects across identity lifecycle management, access governance, authentication, authorization, and privileged access management. As a trusted advisor, you will help clients navigate complex identity challenges and support their journey towards modern identity and Zero Trust security models. We're looking for professionals who don't just design solutions but drive strategic identity initiatives and lead them to success. This is a full-time position with the flexibility to work from home or any of our offices across Sweden or Finland (Stockholm, Gothenburg, Malmö, Västerås, Örebro, Skövde, Espoo, Tampere, Lahti and Kuopio). What are we looking for? To succeed in this role, you should have: Deep expertise within the IAM domain Experience designing enterprise IAM architectures and roadmaps Understanding of identity lifecycle management, authentication, authorization, and access governance Experience translating business requirements into secure and scalable IAM solutions Ability to engage with both technical and business stakeholders Experience working in complex enterprise environments Professional working proficiency in English Fluency in either Swedish or Finnish, as many of our customer engagements are conducted in local languages Merited skills Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, SailPoint, Saviynt, OpenText, Omada, Ping Identity, CyberArk, or similar solutions Understanding of Zero Trust principles Experience in cloud environments (Azure, AWS, or GCP) Knowledge of Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), and Identity Threat Detection & Response (ITDR) Relevant certifications Previous consulting or advisory experience Additionally, we value curiosity, strong communication skills, and the ability to take ownership of architecture initiatives in complex and highly regulated environments. Why join Epical? At Epical, trust and collaboration are at the heart of everything we do. Here's what you can expect as a part of our team: Work-life balance: Flexible remote working options and an environment that prioritizes your well-being. Stimulating assignments: Work on exciting projects with large enterprise clients in complex environments. Comprehensive benefits: Enjoy a competitive compensation package, training opportunities, and certifications to support your success. A strong IAM community: Collaborate with experienced IAM specialists, architects, and security professionals across the Nordics. A mission-driven organization: Be part of a company dedicated to creating a fairer world by leveraging digital identity responsibly. We look forward to receiving your application and getting to know you better! Contact details If you have any questions about the role or would like to learn more about Epical, please reach out to jessica.keranen@epicalgroup.com. Epical is a Nordic data consultancy driven to create a world built on trust. With approximately 400 experts, we go beyond the expected in Digital Trust, Data & Analytics, and Integrations.

items.desc: What we do at Blykalla Blykalla is a global leader in advanced nuclear technology, commercialising the next generation of clean, reliable energy through its lead-cooled reactor, the SEALER. By combining decades of specialised research with world-class partners, Blykalla is building the backbone of the global AI and industrial economy. For more information, visit https://www.blykalla.com. What you’ll get to do We're seeking a Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer to join our Nuclear Engineering & Safety team, working from Stockholm or Oskarshamn. In this role, you will work on experiments with the aim of validating thermal-hydraulics system codes for use in the design and safety analysis of our lead-cooled fast reactors. More specifically, you will Coordinate, specify and analyze experiments to be run in our ARTS (Advanced Reactor Testing Site) facility in Oskarshamn. Act as a technical lead for engineers and technicians working on both the experiments and the simulation codes. Contribute to our validation program for thermal hydraulics system codes and associated methodologies. Stay current with advances in thermal hydraulics, computational methods, and regulatory requirements. Who you’ll get to work with The thermal-hydraulics validation engineer sits in the Nuclear Engineering & Safety team within Blykalla, and reports to the manager of Nuclear Engineering & Safety. We are a diverse team that is passionate about our work and our company. You can choose to work from any of our offices in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (at Simpevarp). In case of work from the Stockholm office, frequent (monthly) travel to the ARTS site is expected. Who you are You will be part of a highly skilled team with a can-do attitude. We value personal chemistry and strive to create a workplace where you enjoy coming to. There are however a few things that we think will help for you to succeed in this role, these are: Master's degree in physics, engineering or a related field Hands-on experience in designing, commissioning, and performing thermal-hydraulic experiments, including instrumentation and data analysis Familiarity with building validation envelopes for system codes used in nuclear safety analysis such as BISON (BWR), TRACE, RELAP, APROS or similar as well as for CFD tools Solid understanding of the physics and phenomena involved in thermal hydraulics simulations A structured way of working, together with excellent problem-solving and technical writing skills Fluency in English, spoken and written Meritorious skills: Working experience in safety analysis of PWR, BWR or advanced reactors Working experience from liquid metal applications Experience in supporting nuclear licensing activities or in regulatory interaction Fluency in Swedish, spoken and written If you are not sure that you are 100% qualified, but are up to the challenge, we encourage you to apply. Location This position is for our office in Stockholm, Oskarshamn or ARTS (Simpevarp) So, what do you think? Don't miss the chance to be at the forefront of revolutionizing nuclear power. Join our team as Senior Thermal-Hydraulics Code Validation Engineer and help shape the energy landscape of tomorrow. Apply today with your resume and a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience and achievements. We are proud to foster an inclusive workplace free from discrimination. We strongly believe that diversity of experience, perspectives, and background will lead to a better environment for our employees and a better product. This is something we value deeply, and we encourage everyone to be a part of changing the way the world thinks about power supply! Reference & Background Checks As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates. We may also conduct reference checks to gain a well-rounded understanding of your professional experience, performance, and ways of working. This includes both references provided by you and, where relevant, conversations with other professional contacts who have worked closely with you. We strive to be transparent about our reference-checking process and handle all personal data in accordance with applicable data protection regulations. Any additional references will be sought with professional judgment and only when considered relevant to the role. Salary Range: SEK 57 000 - 95 000 / month, depending on experience and qualifications. We offer competitive compensation aligned with our internal salary framework and growth potential in the role. We do not accept applications via email. We are not open to external help from recruitment agencies. Note on AI Use: Blykalla may use AI technology to assist with certain administrative aspects of the hiring process, such as note-taking, interview documentation, and reporting. Du hast bist zahlenaffin, kannst gut mit Geld umgehen und fühlst dich wohl am Computer. Du hast eine Leidenschaft für die Heimeinrichtung und die Marke IKEA und freuen sich darauf, die IKEA-Produktpalette und die Serviceoptionen im Detail kennenzulernen. Du fühlst dich sicher im Umgang mit der englischen Sprache, so dass du immer von internationalen Kunden angesprochen werden kannst. Sehr attraktive Sozialleistungen 15% Personalrabatt auf deinen Einkauf – und das in jedem IKEA Einrichtungshaus Du kommst mit dem ÖV? Wir bezahlen zwischen 85% bis 100% des Jahresabonnements Kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeiten Unlimitierter Zugang zur LinkedIn-Learning-Plattform Günstige und gesunde Mahlzeiten in der Kantine (CHF 4,50 für Fleisch- und CHF 3,50 für Vegi-Gerichte) Bonuszahlungen für alle Mitarbeitenden Bei IKEA gibt es viele unterschiedliche Möglichkeiten sich weiterzuentwickeln. Wir fördern und bestärken unsere Mitarbeitenden darin, verschiedene Aufgaben auszuprobieren, zwischen den Funktionen zu wechseln oder ins Ausland zu gehen. Bitte reiche deine komplette Bewerbung online ein und sei dir bewusst, dass wir Unterlagen per E-Mail oder über die Post nicht berücksichtigen können. Das wäre es von uns. Das waren jetzt sehr viele Infos. Wir würden uns freuen, mehr über dich zu erfahren. Klicke doch einfach auf «Jetzt bewerben» und los geht’s. Wir prüfen Bewerbungen laufend und stellen den Bewerbungsprozess ein, sobald wir die richtige Person gefunden haben. Bitte bewirb dich also so schnell wie möglich. Warum du uns mögen wirst Aus den tiefen Wäldern Schwedens haben wir unsere Kultur und unsere Werte bis in die ganze Welt verbreitet. Das Herz unseres Sortiments sind unsere schönen Einrichtungsprodukte und –lösungen; hergestellt mit Rücksicht auf unseren Planeten erreichen sie Millionen Kund*innen. Das Herz unseres Geschäftes sind unsere großartigen Mitarbeiter*innen, die für Vielfalt auf allen Ebenen stehen und Leidenschaft für das Leben Zuhause haben. Wir alle bringen unsere Einzigartigkeit ein und möchten gemeinsam wachsen und uns weiterentwickeln. Unsere Vision, "den vielen Menschen einen besseren Alltag schaffen", inspiriert und leitet uns in allem was wir tun. Das ist IKEA. Was wir alle gemeinsam haben Wir leben unsere Werte Wir können wir selbst sein und schätzen dabei die Vielfalt Leidenschaft in Einrichtung Leistungsbereitschaft und Freude am Lernen Spaß an der Arbeit!

items.desc: The Royal Marsden is a world-leading cancer centre, recognised for excellence in patient care, research, innovation and education. We are proud of our reputation for advancing cancer treatment and improving patient outcomes. An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Genetic Technologist to join the Molecular Diagnostics team within the Clinical Genomics department. Based in the Centre for Molecular Pathology, the department is part of one of seven national Genomic Laboratory Hubs delivering cancer genomic testing in England and supporting personalised cancer treatment through molecular diagnostics, clinical trials and research. The successful candidate will contribute to a timely and efficient ISO 15189-accredited Clinical Genomics Service. Duties include molecular diagnostic testing and analysis, validation of new techniques, support for new assays including NGS and ddPCR technologies, and associated administrative tasks. You will also support quality assurance, equipment maintenance, data management and staff training while working independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. Applicants must hold a relevant BSc degree in Biological Sciences, Genetics or a related subject, with postgraduate experience in molecular diagnostic techniques. Science Council (RSci) registration is desirable but not essential. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your career within a specialist genomics service at the forefront of cancer diagnostics and personalised medicine. The post holder will undertake technical, analytical and administrative duties required to support the scientific teams in the provision of an effective and high quality molecular diagnostics service to patients. This will require detailed theoretical and practical knowledge. They will be responsible for carrying out analytical molecular diagnostics investigations. There will be occasions when the post holder takes sole responsibility for their work. The range of tests available will be in continuous development and the post-holder will be responsible for the validation and verification of new techniques and tests, including the provision of NGS and ddPCR for molecular diagnostics in haematological and solid tumours. They will collaborate and plan complex activities with other members of the team to achieve an effective and reliable service. The post holder will be expected to assist in training of new staff members and visitors as well as to contribute to IT development and data management relating to the technical aspects of the molecular service In addition the post holder will be required to support activities such as quality, including compliance with laboratory accreditation standards, equipment maintenance and participate in the departments training programme. The Royal Marsden NHS Foundation Trust is a world-leading cancer centre. Our role is to offer our patients the best cancer care available anywhere in the world, and to continue to make a global contribution to finding better ways of diagnosing and treating cancer. We employ over 4,500 staff in a diverse range of careers including nursing, medical, science, radiography, pharmacy, occupational therapy, finance and administrative services. We have two hospitals – one in Chelsea, London, and one in Sutton, Surrey – as well as a Medical Daycare Unit in Kingston Hospital. At The Royal Marsden, we deal with cancer every day, so we understand how valuable life is. When people entrust their lives to us, they have the right to demand the very best. That's why the pursuit of excellence lies at the heart of everything we do. At the heart of the hospital is our dedicated team. Full-time, fixed term until 31 August 2028. Applications are invited for the post of Research Administrator within the Department of Economics supporting the Leverhulme International Professorship led by the Principal Investigator (PI), Professor David Levine. This is a project funded by the Leverhulme Trust and the main goal is to study social mechanisms and their allocations. The project will involve economists, psychologists, and computer scientists at Royal Holloway. It commenced on 1 September 2023 and will run for 60 months. items.desc: How you'll help us live our purpose We've been helping our members save for their future and buy their own home since 1875. Join us and you'll play a big role in helping us to put home ownership within reach of more people, generation after generation. It's a purpose that drives everything we do. And you can play your part too - join our Prudential & Enterprise Risk team as a Model Validation Specialist on either a permanent or 18-month fixed term basis. This is an opportunity to use your quantitative expertise to support the independent validation and oversight of our financial and credit risk models and deterministic quantitative methods. Working with the Model Validation Lead and wider Prudential Risk team, you'll help ensure models are conceptually sound, appropriately implemented and compliant with internal policies and external regulations. How you'll make a difference You'll deliver independent validation reviews of key models and deterministic quantitative methods through analysis, testing and evidence gathering. You'll assess model design, data, assumptions, implementation and outputs, identify limitations and potential improvements, validate model changes and mitigants, and help ensure documentation meets internal standards and regulatory expectations. You'll prepare clear review documentation and committee materials, maintain constructive communication with model owners, and work collaboratively across Prudential and Enterprise Risk, Risk, Finance and Internal Audit. You'll also support the model risk management framework, help develop analytical and challenger solutions using tools such as Python and AI or machine learning, contribute to climate risk modelling and scenario analysis, and keep abreast of regulatory developments and industry good practice. What will you bring to the role? Experience of model validation and/or model development within financial services, covering relevant credit or financial risk models across the model lifecycle. Knowledge of model classes such as residential mortgage IRB models (PD, LGD and EAD), scorecards, IFRS 9, affordability, forecasting, stress testing, market risk, capital, liquidity or pricing. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with the ability to structure problems, assess evidence and draw clear conclusions from data. Practical programming and data-handling experience using Python, SQL, SAS, R or a similar tool. An understanding of model risk drivers, statistical techniques, model performance metrics and validation approaches, with the ability to assess model design, data, assumptions, implementation and outputs. The ability to work independently with support from the Model Validation Lead, manage multiple reviews, priorities and deadlines, and recognise when issues need escalation. Strong written and verbal communication skills, enabling you to explain technical issues and validation conclusions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders and document work to a high standard. A well-organised and collaborative approach, strong attention to detail, professional curiosity, integrity, and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement. items.desc: About IP House At IP House, we empower brands, legal professionals, and rights holders to manage and protect intellectual property—both online and offline—on a truly global scale. Through cutting-edge technology and deep cross-border expertise, we deliver scalable, end-to-end solutions for IP portfolio management, enforcement, and content and brand protection. With over 700 experts operating across five continents, we are trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands to combat counterfeiting, piracy, and IP infringement at scale. From digital platforms to physical marketplaces, we help clients safeguard what matters most—everywhere it matters. Overview of the Role: The IT Administrator manages day-to-day IT operations for IP House’s highly distributed workforce and will work as part of a team with IT Administrators in different regions to together provide coverage across time zones. Working alongside our managed service provider (MSP), the IT Administrator handles escalations, manages the employee technology lifecycle, administers our Microsoft 365 environment and other business applications, and carries out recurring security and compliance work. Participation in a shared on-call rotation is required. While there is some opportunity for remote work, the IT Administrator is expected to be on-site in our Derby, UK office. Essential Duties and Responsibilities: Own employee onboarding and offboarding with HR, coordinating accounts, access, and equipment with remote employees across time zones Serve as the escalation point and day-to-day contact for our MSP, holding them accountable to agreed service levels Administer Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune, and other business systems; including access control, MFA, SSO Management of Windows and macOS end-user devices, as well as shared technology resources and networks Procure, deploy, inventory, and retire hardware, and manage warranty repairs Monitor security alerts and apply best practices to protect client and company data Complete recurring compliance work such as partner and client security assessments, audit evidence, and incident response testing, and keep IT policies and documentation current Identify opportunities for improvement and work with team to standardize and improve IT processes Manage licenses, subscriptions, and IT spend, and research new tools and vendors What You’ll Bring: Associate or bachelor’s degree in IT or a related field, or equivalent experience At least 3 years of IT administration experience, ideally supporting a distributed workforce Hands-on experience with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and Intune Proficiency supporting both Windows and macOS users Working knowledge of networking and security fundamentals (e.g., DNS, VPNs, firewalls, MFA, SSO) Experience working with MSPs and other IT vendors Strong problem-solving, organizational, and communication skills, with the ability to work across time zones Microsoft certifications, Azure or AWS experience, or PowerShell scripting are a plus Ability to lift IT equipment up to 50 pounds and support occasional after-hours or weekend work We hire qualified candidates who are legally eligible to work in the UK. However, we are not able to sponsor visas . Why IP House: IP House is redefining how the world combats illicit trade and intellectual property theft—delivering scalable, end-to-end solutions that empower global brands and rights holders through innovation, strategic expertise, and a relentless commitment to global enforcement. Achieving this ambitious mission requires the collaboration of an exceptionally talented team. We believe our people are the foundation of everything we do—and we invest accordingly. From day one, we foster a culture rooted in continuous learning, professional growth, and shared excellence. We also understand that meaningful work begins with a strong foundation. That’s why we offer a flexible work environment and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and financial security of our employees and their families. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape a fast-scaling organization with a strong reputation for results—and room to grow with it. Join us in safeguarding the brands, content, and innovations that shape our world. IP House is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to fostering a respectful, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

items.desc: Description Location: Cambridge, UK – This position offers flexible working options, including predominantly remote work. Are you passionate about automation that doesn’t just save clicks, but changes how an entire engineering organisation builds software? As an Automation Engineer, you'll build the development and testing platform automation harnesses that answer that question for Jagex. Working as part of a centralised Delivery Engineering team, you'll produce, maintain and evolve the shared testing infrastructure and development tooling that engineering teams rely on, from local development environments through to CI build and deployment. You'll work closely with other Automation Engineers and with the engineering teams you support, reducing reliance on manual effort and maximising efficiency gains through automated tooling, so product quality stays consistent and functional and non-functional requirements are met. What you’ll be doing: Build and scale automation capabilities as part of a centralised Delivery Engineering team, giving software and operations engineering teams across Jagex the tooling they need to work faster and more consistently. Deliver automated development and test harness capabilities at every stage of the software development lifecycle, embedding an automation first approach that cuts down manual effort across the business. Embed with engineering teams to build white and black box automated testing frameworks across functional and non-functional areas, so quality is proven at every layer, not just on the surface. Improve and upgrade our automation execution frameworks and introduce modern tooling, keeping Jagex ahead of industry best practice rather than catching up to it. Champion modern automation practices and toolsets within engineering teams, exposing them to automation capabilities they haven't had before. Get to know the codebases, flows and services behind the teams you support, understanding how components interact so the automation you build genuinely fits how they work. Provide reporting and visualisation that gives engineering teams clear sight of software quality, health and KPIs, helping them avoid over or under optimising their systems. What we’re looking for: Proven experience designing, developing and maintaining automation platforms, frameworks and tooling within a modern software engineering environment, with strong programming skills in one or more of C#, Java, Python, Go or TypeScript. Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks across functional, integration, API, UI, performance and non-functional testing, grounded in strong testing and quality engineering principles. Strong working knowledge of CI/CD practices (such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity or Azure DevOps), infrastructure as code and configuration management tools (such as Terraform or Ansible), and containerisation and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. Are you passionate about automation that doesn’t just save clicks, but changes how an entire engineering organisation builds software? As an Automation Engineer, you'll build the development and testing platform automation harnesses that answer that question for Jagex. Working as part of a centralised Delivery Engineering team, you'll produce, maintain and evolve the shared testing infrastructure and development tooling that engineering teams rely on, from local development environments through to CI build and deployment. You'll work closely with other Automation Engineers and with the engineering teams you support, reducing reliance on manual effort and maximising efficiency gains through automated tooling, so product quality stays consistent and functional and non-functional requirements are met. What you’ll be doing: Build and scale automation capabilities as part of a centralised Delivery Engineering team, giving software and operations engineering teams across Jagex the tooling they need to work faster and more consistently. Deliver automated development and test harness capabilities at every stage of the software development lifecycle, embedding an automation first approach that cuts down manual effort across the business. Embed with engineering teams to build white and black box automated testing frameworks across functional and non-functional areas, so quality is proven at every layer, not just on the surface. Improve and upgrade our automation execution frameworks and introduce modern tooling, keeping Jagex ahead of industry best practice rather than catching up to it. Champion modern automation practices and toolsets within engineering teams, exposing them to automation capabilities they haven't had before. Get to know the codebases, flows and services behind the teams you support, understanding how components interact so the automation you build genuinely fits how they work. Provide reporting and visualisation that gives engineering teams clear sight of software quality, health and KPIs, helping them avoid over or under optimising their systems. Follow Jagex's architecture principles and development standards, and take part in cross-team discussions that shape how automation and tooling craft evolves across the business. What we’re looking for: Proven experience designing, developing and maintaining automation platforms, frameworks and tooling within a modern software engineering environment, with strong programming skills in one or more of C#, Java, Python, Go or TypeScript. Demonstrable experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks across functional, integration, API, UI, performance and non-functional testing, grounded in strong testing and quality engineering principles. Strong working knowledge of CI/CD practices (such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity or Azure DevOps), infrastructure as code and configuration management tools (such as Terraform or Ansible), and containerisation and orchestration technologies including Docker and Kubernetes. Good understanding of software architecture, distributed systems and microservices, with experience creating developer tooling or shared engineering platforms that improve engineering productivity. Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or Google Cloud Platform, and experience implementing quality metrics, reporting dashboards and visualisation tools to measure software quality. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with proven ability to identify manual processes and replace them with efficient automated solutions. Flexible working hours. 25 days annual leave + Bank holidays & the option to buy/sell holidays + so much more! Gather integration requirements from stakeholders and translate them into robust, well-documented technical designs. Drive data architecture and design decisions, including data modelling, layering and historisation. Help evaluate and shape the future direction of our data platform, bringing knowledge of modern architectures and tools such as Microsoft Fabric. Identify data quality issues arising through integrations and pipelines and work with key stakeholders internally and externally to resolve them. Apply good engineering practice, including source control, testing and documentation. Provide technical oversight of SQL development within the team, stepping in when needed. Work closely with the Director of Data Services and other stakeholders to implement the company's data management and governance strategy. items.desc: We are looking for a motivated and personable Corporate Business Officer to join our team. The postholder will provide comprehensive administrative, coordination, and business support across the Corporate Governance and Executive PA Team, helping to maintain the highest standards of business and ensuring the Trust is compliant with the regulatory framework. They will provide comprehensive support to the Board of Directors, Council of Governors, and Committees to ensure efficient and effective running. The postholder is expected to work under the direction of the Corporate Business Manager, whilst taking initiative and prioritising their own workload to ensure deadlines are met. They will work closely with the Executive PAs, Corporate Governance Team, Chair, Governors, Non-Executive Directors, Executive Directors, and partner organisations. The post holder must be able to embrace working in a dynamic and demanding office environment, while maintaining a high level of focus and attention to detail on specific tasks. Corporate Governance Support Provide administrative support to help maintain standards of good corporate governance and compliance with internal policies and external frameworks; Support the planning, organisation and administration of meetings, including scheduling, room/virtual meeting setup, paper collation and distribution; Undertake accuracy and completeness checks of reports prior to submissions; Support co-ordination of the Trust’s formal response to relevant consultations and inquires; Assist with requests and returns for external regulators and auditors in relation to corporate matters in an accurate and timely manner. Royal Surrey is a compassionate and collaborative acute and community Trust. Recognising that our 5,000 colleagues are our greatest strength, we offer a comprehensive health and wellbeing programme alongside a strong commitment to developing your career. Our diverse and welcoming Royal Surrey family ensures you feel valued from your initial interview and throughout your time with us. We are clinically led and provide joined-up care by bridging hospital and community services, alongside delivering regional specialist cancer care. Our main acute hospital site is in Guildford, with community sites at Milford, Haslemere and Cranleigh, and services delivered in patients’ homes across Guildford and Waverley. We work in partnership with Ashford & St Peter’s Hospitals NHS Foundation Trust through a collaborative Group Model, supporting joined-up services, workforce flexibility and development opportunities. The Care Quality Commission (CQC) has rated us as Outstanding. We are proud of our achievements and continue to invest in our people and infrastructure. To learn more about life at Royal Surrey, please watch our short video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=R96pMboIYdo Adverts may close early, so you are encouraged to apply as soon as possible. For a detailed overview of responsibilities associated with the role, please refer to the attached JD.

As a key member of the team, you will be actively involved in the production of Land Quality deliverables, working closely with professionals from other disciplines to deliver the best outcomes for our clients. Field Work & Data Collection: Participate in site investigations (soil, groundwater, gas monitoring), collecting samples and logging data accurately. Professional Development: Seek opportunities to broaden your technical knowledge through project work, training, and mentoring, and actively engage in personal development plans. Suitable candidates are likely to have the following qualifications and experience, though again we understand that not everyone will meet every single requirement. Education: Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Environmental Science, Geoscience, Chemistry, Engineering, or a related discipline. A Master’s degree is advantageous but not essential. Up to five years’ experience in relevant consultant or contractor land quality/contaminated land roles. Technical Aptitude: Good technical understanding of relevant environmental legislation, site investigation techniques and risk assessment principles. Teamwork & Communication: Ability to work effectively in a team setting, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Motivation & Growth Mindset: an enthusiasm to progress their career in land quality and remediation, including willingness to travel to different project sites. Other: A valid UK driving licence (or ability to obtain one in the near future) is beneficial. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen to join our Family Health Division as a Sub-Speciality Appointment Coordinator, based at Liverpool Women's Hospital. This post is a fixed term post to cover longterm sickness cover for a 6 month period. The Sub-Specialty Co-Ordinator will have excellent communication skills with patients and all levels of staff including senior managers and clinicians and will possess the ability to identify capacity/demand issues within their sub-specialty and help to offer solutions to tackle this. We believe that this, along with a strong dedication to research and innovation, makes us the specialist health provider of choice in Europe for women, babies and families. Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.
