items.desc: We have an exciting opportunity for a 12 month secondment within the CAMHS Enhanced Treatment Service (ETS). We are looking for a Band 6 CAMHS practitioner and welcome applications from nurses or other allied health professionals. About the team: ETS is for young people aged 12-18 who are presenting with a serious mental illness. We offer an alternative pathway for young people who have been admitted for inpatient treatment, as well as offering a supported discharge package for young people leaving hospital. We aim to reduce A&E presentations and hospital admissions and offer the least restrictive interventions to provide consistent access to rapid, effective interventions, support and recovery – including crisis services. This includes better use of resources and investing to develop more local, community-based services and support. The service has both an outreach, and community day service model. This varied role offers excellent opportunities to gain experience and therapeutic skills in a variety of different settings. As a team we are passionate about learning and staff development and wellbeing. The post will be based at the Maudsley Hospital in Camberwell and will be moving to the new PEARs Building when it opens at the Maudsley Site. We are looking to appoint someone who is confident, responsive and has a passion for young-person and family-centred improvements; you will be enthusiastic and resilient and be able to respond to young people’s needs flexibly. To assume a Care-Coordinator role, involving the personal responsibility and professional accountability for a caseload as part of the Enhanced Treatment Service, co-ordinating care, communicating with other professionals involved in the care and ensuring regular CPA reviews are held as required Recognising and addressing concerns about the physical health needs of service users with long term conditions (e.g. diabetes, asthma etc.); escalating these concerns as necessary to senior members of the multi-disciplinary Recognising and responding appropriately to risk incidents, urgent situations, emergencies or crisis including “self-harm and suicide prevention” with particular regard to the risks in community settings, in line with Trust policies and training Understanding and implementing safeguarding procedures in a community setting; recognise, report and investigate safeguarding issues and raise safeguarding alerts if you suspect that a service user and/or carer has been exposed to harm or Administering and monitoring the side effects of medication according to NMC professional Demonstrate leadership skills within the clinical context of the community, showing particular awareness of the challenges facing staff working in a community setting and supporting junior staff as appropriate About the location: Our Trust headquarters is located at Denmark Hill less than 5 minutes from the train station (zone 2). We also provide services and operate across other locations, such as London boroughs of Croydon, Lambeth, Lewisham and Southwark. items.desc: We are looking for a dynamic, innovative and enthusiastic individual to join our Advanced Clinical Practitioner team here at Northumbria Healthcare working within the Emergency Department It will be expected that through completion of MSc Advanced Clinical Practice and supportive experiential learning, that the post holder will show high levels of autonomy across the four pillars of practice including clinical practice, leadership, education and research/audit. The ACP will be pivotal in developing the wider Emergency Department. Please note we reserve the right to close this vacancy prior to the closing date once the required number of suitable applications have been received. This post falls within the provisions of Agenda for Change Annex 20 - Development of Professional Roles, whereby upon completion of an agreed set of competencies you may move onto the next pay band without the need for an application for a post at a higher level. For further information on Annex 20, please see: http://www.nhsemployers.org/tchandbook/annex-16-to-20/annex-20-development-of-professional-roles Successful candidates will be supported to complete a 3 year, part time MSc programme in Advanced clinical Practice while working clinically in the department. They will be supported by an Emergency Department Consultant as a Clinical Supervisor to enable them to: Use advanced knowledge and skills in to undertake comprehensive clinical assessments, make decisions based on clinical reasoning and initiate, evaluate and modify a range of interventions. Provide professional senior clinical leadership and support within the specialty multi professional team and across service boundaries. Support the wider team to build capacity and capability through work-based and interprofessional learning, and the application of learning to practice. Act as a role model, educator, supervisor, coach and mentor. You will work on a wide variety of bespoke engineering projects, helping to design specialist vacuum chambers, mechanical assemblies and integrated vacuum systems for customers across a range of industries. You do not need previous experience in vacuum engineering. We are looking for someone with a strong foundation in mechanical design, excellent CAD skills and a genuine interest in developing their technical knowledge. Working alongside our experienced Technical Solutions Manager and Workshop Engineers, you will have the opportunity to expand your expertise in specialist vacuum technology. Responsibilities Developing 3D CAD models and detailed 2D engineering drawings for bespoke mechanical equipment. Turning technical requirements and initial concepts into practical, manufacturable designs. Designing fabricated components, mechanical assemblies, chambers and supporting structures. Preparing accurate Bills of Materials, manufacturing drawings and technical documentation. Assessing design feasibility, material suitability, tolerances and assembly requirements. Supporting technical design reviews to identify potential manufacturing or performance issues. Working closely with our Workshop team to resolve design challenges during manufacture. Providing technical design input to quotations and customer proposals. Supporting design validation, testing and continuous product improvement. Developing specialist knowledge of vacuum engineering systems, components and applications. Requirements Essential Ideally 1-3 years of experience in mechanical CAD design or a similar engineering role. Proficiency in 3D CAD software, ideally Autodesk Inventor, SolidWorks or equivalent. Experience producing detailed 2D manufacturing drawings. Understanding of mechanical engineering principles, materials and manufacturing processes. Experience designing fabricated and machined components. Ability to develop practical engineering solutions rather than simply reproduce existing designs. Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Confidence working with engineers and workshop personnel. Willingness to develop new technical skills and learn about vacuum technology Desirable Experience in stainless steel fabrication, welded assemblies or sheet metal design. Knowledge of engineering tolerances, GD&T and relevant drawing standards. Experience producing designs for specialist machinery, pressure equipment or process systems. Familiarity with Bills of Materials and engineering change control. Previous exposure to vacuum technology or fluid/process engineering. Join us to leverage your CAD expertise in a role that challenges your creativity, sharpens your technical skills, and makes a tangible impact on innovative projects! You will be supported in developing specialist knowledge of vacuum engineering, including vacuum chamber design, seals, fittings, pumping systems and materials. About AVE Applied Vacuum Engineering (1977) Ltd is an established specialist engineering company based in Thornbury, Bristol. We design, manufacture, supply and service vacuum equipment and bespoke engineering systems for a diverse range of industrial applications. As we continue to develop our technical capabilities, we are looking for enthusiastic engineers who want to contribute to our long-term success. Interested? items.desc: The Warrell Unit at Saint Mary’s Hospital is a major tertiary referral centre for Urogynaecology and pelvic floor disorders, serving women from across Greater Manchester, the North West and beyond. The Unit is one of the largest specialist Urogynaecology services in the country and has a longstanding national and international profile in pelvic floor medicine, reconstructive surgery, clinical research, education, and training. The Unit is also an established RCOG Urogynaecology subspecialty training centre, with a strong tradition of advanced postgraduate training, clinical fellowships, and research. Bull is also thousands of engineers, researchers and passionate tech people shaping the future of high‑performance computing, AI, and quantum technologies. Every day, our teams push the boundaries of what is technologically possible – from next‑generation HPC architectures to exascale supercomputers – supported by world‑class R&D, more than 1,600 patents, and unique end‑to‑end capabilities spanning hardware design, software engineering, data science and quantum research. We are a people‑centric, innovation‑driven company, where collaboration spans Europe, the Americas and India. We share a common vision of a responsible and sustainable innovation that delivers concrete impact for our customers. Role Overview We are looking for an HPC System & Storage Engineer to support the deployment, administration, and optimization of large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) environments. In this role, you will work with advanced compute, storage, networking, and automation technologies to ensure the performance, reliability, and scalability of complex infrastructure platforms. You will collaborate with international teams and customers, contributing to the successful delivery and operation of cutting-edge HPC solutions. Requirement Must be eligible to obtain the required UK Security Clearance. Comfortable working in a multicultural and international environment. Willingness to travel internationally when required to support customer engagements and project deployments. Key Responsibilities Deploy, configure, and maintain large-scale HPC infrastructure environments. Administer Linux-based systems and ensure their availability, security, and performance. Manage and support enterprise storage platforms and distributed file systems. Support Kubernetes-based platforms and containerized workloads. Automate operational tasks and infrastructure deployments using Ansible and related tools. Monitor system health, performance, and capacity using monitoring and observability solutions. Troubleshoot and resolve complex infrastructure, storage, and networking issues. Support datacenter operations, upgrades, migrations, and technology refresh activities. Collaborate with engineering teams and customers throughout the project lifecycle. Develop and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and best practices. Support customer deployments and production environments. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and operational excellence. What You Bring Experience administering Linux environments, preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux and/or Debian-based distributions. Good understanding of large-scale datacenter, HPC, or cloud infrastructure environments. Knowledge of server hardware architecture and enterprise infrastructure technologies. Experience with distributed and parallel file systems such as Lustre, NFS, or IBM Storage Scale (GPFS). Understanding of storage technologies including RAID, HDD, SSD, NVMe, object storage, and enterprise storage solutions. Familiarity with Kubernetes and container technologies. Experience with automation tools such as Ansible and monitoring solutions such as Grafana. Strong knowledge of Ethernet, TCP/IP networking, and high-performance interconnect technologies such as InfiniBand, Omni-Path, or BX. Nice to Have Experience with enterprise storage solutions such as NetApp or DDN. Knowledge of tape storage technologies, including HPSS. Experience supporting large-scale environments with thousands of compute nodes. Understanding of datacenter facilities, including power, cooling, racks, and cabling. Location United Kingdom Benefits Working on advanced HPC and digital infrastructure projects. Continuous learning and technical skill development. Career growth within a global technology organisation. Participation in internal initiatives and community-focused activities. #Bull Here, your ideas, your curiosity and your technical excellence directly shape the next era of advanced computing - unlocking enterprise value, accelerating scientific progress and driving positive impact for society.

Working at the heart of the chip implementation flow, you will drive critical physical design activities from floorplanning and power implementation through place-and-route, timing closure, physical verification, and final tape-out. items.desc: About the job As a Physical Design Engineer, you will play a key role in transforming advanced semiconductor designs into high-performance, manufacturable silicon products. Working at the heart of the chip implementation flow, you will drive critical physical design activities from floorplanning and power implementation through place-and-route, timing closure, physical verification, and final tape-out. This is a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology, solve complex engineering challenges, and influence the development of next-generation low-power semiconductor solutions. You will collaborate closely with talented design, architecture, verification, and silicon teams while helping shape future methodologies, automation flows, and AI-assisted design practices. If you are passionate about delivering high-quality silicon, enjoy tackling difficult technical problems, and want to see your work make its way into real-world products, this is the role for you! Key responsibilities Floorplanning activities, including macro placement, partitioning, and voltage area definition Develop and implement robust power distribution networks Execute Place & Route activities, including clock tree synthesis (CTS), congestion optimization, signal integrity improvements, and timing closure Perform comprehensive physical verification and signoff activities, ensuring designs meet foundry requirements and are ready for successful tape-out Analyze and optimize power integrity through IR-drop, electromigration, and reliability assessments, identifying and resolving issues that could impact silicon performance or long-term product reliability Drive ECOs and late-stage design optimizations, implementing efficient fixes while maintaining schedule commitments and achieving timing closure across all operating modes and corners. Support silicon bring-up and tape-out activities by providing physical design expertise, debugging implementation issues Contribute to the development and enhancement of physical design flows, automation scripts, and implementation methodologies to improve productivity, quality, and design scalability across future projects Key Qualifications BSc/MSc in Electronics Engineering or similar Several years of experience in chip implementation Experience of relevant Synopsys and Cadence IC implementation and signoff tools Contribution to flow development and setup Knowledge of scripting languages like TCL, Perl, Python or similar Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve design productivity (e.g. AI-driven EDA flows, code/script generation, debug assistance) Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English Personal Skills The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and takes pride in delivering high-quality silicon. With a structured and analytical mindset, you can navigate intricate physical design issues, balance competing priorities, and maintain focus on achieving demanding performance, power, area, and schedule targets. You enjoy digging into root causes, finding efficient solutions, and continuously improving design methodologies, flows, and tools. You combine independent ownership with a collaborative mindset, enabling you to drive tasks forward while contributing to a highly skilled and supportive team environment. Curious by nature, you embrace new technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools, and are motivated by the opportunity to learn, innovate, and help shape the next generation of cutting-edge semiconductor products. Working for Nordic Working at Nordic, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, and our world-leading innovation. We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn. Benefits Competitive salary with short- and long-term incentive plan Flexible working hours Medical insurance Family-friendly policies, insurances, and benefits Practical details Location: Bristol, UK | Stockholm, Sweden | Tampere, Finland Please note that this position might be subject to a background check.

This is a full time 10 Programmed Activity (PA) post. Applicants for this post must have extensive experience in general medical, surgical (including neonatal), cardiac and neurosurgical, Paediatric High Dependency. items.desc: Hybrid Working - office attendance at our Nottingham office required. CWCS Managed Hosting is a rapidly growing IT company based in Nottingham. We have thousands of customers in the UK and overseas using our shared web hosting, dedicated servers, colocation and cloud hosting services. We have an excellent reputation and deliver great customer service, high quality technical support and enterprise-grade hosting products. Due to our continued growth we are looking to add to our excellent 3rd Line Team. The role includes on-call responsibilities, which are shared across other members of the team. As part of CWCS you will help to deliver service to meet our customer’s expectation, and in line with SLAs, ensuring that quality is delivered at every opportunity. You must have a passion for technical issues, a keen eye for detail, and patience to investigate an issue and deliver a resolution in a timely fashion. Our Trustpilot reviews are indicative of our results so far, service means everything to our customers and our purpose is to always offer a level of service that goes above and beyond. General Responsibilities The 3rd Line team are critical in delivering services to our customers, being responsible for the management of key accounts, maintaining security best practice, supporting our 2nd line team, and working with the Sales departments on proposals. You will take on different functions within the team, split across three areas: Escalations – Help deliver resolutions to tickets that have been escalated from our 2nd line team, and dealing with high priority customers directly. Maintenance – Carrying out server maintenance on customer’s operating systems and hardware. Proactive maintenance is critical to managing customer’s perceptions of our support. Research and Development/Training – Research new technologies and processes that help to automate our systems and deliver a consistent level of service. You will also be expected to continually train so that your knowledge helps the business deliver on its goals. Summary These functions have many components within them, a small example of are: Server provisioning, custom scripts, and migrations, ensuring they are completed on time and on budget. Monitor the network and resolve issues appropriately. Oversee the regular auditing and patching of core and customer systems. Perform routine audits of systems and software. Build relationships with key managed customers. Train junior members of the technical operations centre. Develop knowledgebase documentation. Research, develop and implement new products and services. The successful candidate will be able to demonstrate a commitment to quality and information systems standards and a strong technical aptitude and ability to research and resolve complex issues. You should also be able to understand the interaction between hardware and software. Confidence of working with networks, and being able to diagnose faults is also crucial. Other areas of knowledge that would be required: Experience of KVM hypervisors (Proxmox, Ceph) system administration and maintenance. Linux and Windows administrative knowledge. Virtualisation and virtual machine management. Familiarity with open source tools. Networking concept. Diagnostic skills, and lateral thinking. Basic database administration including MySQL (MariaDB) and MSSQL. Ability to learn new technologies. A Linux or Microsoft certification would be advantageous.  We are seeking a Security Governance, Controls & Third-Party Security Specialist to support our Group Security function. In this role, you will contribute to the
 definition, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Group Security governance framework, ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements,
 security standards, and business priorities. You will play a key role in overseeing security controls, managing Third-Party Security activities, supporting
 regulatory initiatives, and strengthening the overall security posture across the Group.
 What you'll be doing
 Define, maintain, and evolve Security policies, standards, guidelines, and governance frameworks across the Group
 Coordinate and monitor Security controls, KPIs, and governance processes to ensure effectiveness and compliance
 Support the management of Third-Party Security assessments, contractual security requirements, and security exception processes
 Perform security posture assessments, maturity evaluations, and gap analyses against internal policies and external regulations
 Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Audit, Legal, Data Protection, Digital and business stakeholders to ensure alignment on security activities
 Support regulatory inspections, audits, consultations, and requests from supervisory authorities and institutions
 Monitor remediation activities related to audit findings, regulatory observations, and security assessments
 Provide analysis, reporting, and insights on security posture, controls effectiveness, and security governance metrics
 Support the definition and evolution of Group Security standards, models, architectures, baselines and guidelines, fostering their consistent adoption
 across the organization
 What you'll need to succeed
 Degree in Cyber Security, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
 Experience in Security Governance, Information Security, Cyber Risk Management, Third-Party Security, or related areas
 Knowledge of security frameworks, security controls, risk management methodologies, and governance processes
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate regulatory and business requirements into actionable security initiatives
 Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders in complex and regulated environments
 Strong communication and presentation skills
 Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate activities across different teams
 Proficiency in English (written and spoken)
 Nice to have:
 Familiarity with regulatory frameworks and security standards (e.g. DORA, NIS2, EBA Guidelines, ISO 27001, NIST)
 Knowledge of Audit, Compliance, Data Protection, and Operational Risk processes
 Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, or equivalent
 Experience in Security Portfolio Management, Security Controls Monitoring, or Security Assurance activities
 What you'll get in return
 #MakeInnovationHappen: Chance to make an impact in terms of transformation

 #ComeAsYouAre: Working within a global team
 #UnlockYourPotential: Play a role of autonomy with high visibility and exposure

 Pro pobočku Litoměřice hledáme seniorního osobního bankéř/ku jako pravou ruku manažera/ky.

 Budete pravou rukou manažera/ky - budete pomáhat zajišťovat chod pobočky a plnění nastavených cílů. 
 Péče o svěřené portfolio klientů a jeho aktivní rozšiřování. 
 Budování a rozvíjení dlouhodobých vztahů s klienty a obchodními partnery.

 Pomoc klientmů při financování jejich plánů a hleádní optimálních úvěrových řešení.

 Maturitu – středoškolské vzdělání ukončené maturitní zkouškou je základ. 
 Komunikaci a proaktivitu – mimo péči o stávající klienty vás čeká i akvizice nových klientů.
 Znalost češtiny – komunikace s klienty vyžaduje perfektní jazyk, další jazyk je výhodou, ale ne nutností.
 Touhu na sobě dále pracovat a dosahovat výsledků – to je klíčem k úspěchu.

 Osvojené prodejní dovednosti – umět identifikovat potřeby klientů, najít vhodné řešení a dotáhnout obchodní příležitosti do úspěšného konce.
 Splněné certifikace od ČBA.

items.desc: What this role is about? Your expertise in applied machine learning and data analysis will be critical in creating intelligent and transformative AI applications. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to conceptualize, design, test, and deploy AI projects that drive innovation and provide value in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence. Join us and be a part of shaping the future of AI. The role needs a combination of business focus, strong analytical/statistical and problem-solving skills. With a deep understanding of the business levers, she/he will collaborate with other business functions, data analysts, data engineers and data strategists to specify and drive data opportunities, as well as work with other AI providers to develop the necessary A.I. capabilities, provide actionable insights and recommendations. items.desc: Job Description Irás trabalhar diretamente com o Head of AI Engineering e com o Lead AI Engineer. Os projetos são reais e já estão em movimento. Não irás manter código legacy. Irás construir coisas que não existem — agentes que raciocinam, pipelines que decidem, sistemas que antecipam. E vais garantir que os dados em que essas coisas assentam são sólidos, soberanos e confiáveis. Responsabilidades Desenhar e manter a arquitetura de dados da AI Engineering — como os dados chegam, como são armazenados, como são versionados, quem tem acesso; Garantir soberania: dados críticos não saem do perímetro; Curar e estruturar dados messy de múltiplas fontes; Construir pipelines de ingestão, transformação e qualidade — dados limpos antes de chegarem ao modelo; Estruturar dados para reasoning: knowledge graphs, embeddings, RAG, context injection; Arquitetar, desenhar e construir sistemas inteligentes sobre LLMs para domínios específicos; Desenhar de que forma a máquina pensa: arquiteturas cognitivas, knowledge representation, prompt architecture, tool ecosystems, contexto e memória; Orquestrar modelos — frontier, open-source, fine-tuned — com raciocínio fundamentado sobre custo, latência, qualidade e privacidade; Prototipar rápido (dias, não meses) e levar PoCs a produto; Failure design — cérebros alucinam, perdem contexto, ficam confusos. Desenhar guardrails, fallback, graceful degradation; Eval mindset — como sabes que o cérebro melhorou? Desenhar evals, red-teaming, testar edge cases, medir qualidade de reasoning — não só accuracy. Qualifications Formação em Engenharia Informática, Engenharia de Sistemas, Matemática, Física ou área técnica equivalente; 3 ou mais anos de experiência, com pelo menos 2 em sistemas de AI/ML em produção (produtos que funcionam com utilizadores reais) Arquitetura de dados para AI — estruturar uma data layer soberana: ingestão, storage, qualidade, versionamento, acesso. Não é nice-to-have, é o ponto de partida; Domínio sólido de pelo menos uma linguagem de backend (Python, Go, Rust ou equivalente), agentes, integração e pipelines complexos; Experiência real com LLMs em produção: tool-calling, structured outputs, context management, gestão de custo e latência; Arquitetura de agentes: sistemas com raciocínio multi-step, memória, tool ecosystems, fallback; Orquestração de modelos — quando usar frontier vs open-source vs fine-tuned, com trade-offs claros; Infraestrutura AI: GPUs, model serving (vLLM, TGI ou equivalente), inference pipelines, compute cloud vs on-prem; Integração de dados de múltiplas fontes; Curiosidade genuína; Pensamento sistémico e crítico; Conforto com ambiguidade; Comunicação clara para perfis não técnicos; Português (obrigatório) + inglês técnico. Também Valorizamos LLMOps — model versioning, monitoring, deployment, eval pipelines; GCP, Docker; Background em domínios complexos: defesa, espaço, energia, infraestrutura crítica. Additional Information Ambiente de trabalho descontraído, equipas dinâmicas e multidisciplinares. Facilitamos e promovemos um estilo de vida equilibrado e saudável, articulando o trabalho com a vida pessoal. Seguro de saúde. Parcerias com ginásios, Nutrium, entre outros. Até três dias de férias adicionais. Dia de aniversário livre.

items.desc: V Air Bank budujeme ucelené AI oddělení, které bude fungovat jako centrum expertizy pro umělou inteligenci napříč bankou. Budete u řešení pro zákaznickou komunikaci, automatizací pro kolegy i služeb pracujících s hovory nebo dokumenty. Zároveň budete mít možnost ovlivnit, jak budeme AI řešení v bance navrhovat, ověřovat a rozvíjet. Co vás u nás čeká? RAG, data a modely Budete zlepšovat RAG pipeline – od práce s dokumenty a jejich dělením až po relevanci výsledků, které model dostává k dispozici. Tam, kde to bude dávat smysl, připravíte data pro fine-tuning a pomůžete vybrat vhodný model. Ověřování nových možností Nové nápady si rychle ověříte v PoC. Výstupem bude jasné doporučení, zda má řešení smysl dál rozvíjet, a technický návrh pro jeho realizaci. Prompty a jejich ladění Budete navrhovat, testovat a průběžně upravovat prompty pro AI komponenty. Řešit budete například system prompty, ukázkové příklady i volbu vhodného přístupu pro konkrétní úlohu. Evaluace a kontrola kvality Připravíte evaluační sady a nastavíte metriky, podle kterých budeme hodnotit kvalitu odpovědí, klasifikace nebo extrakce dat. Budete porovnávat varianty modelů i promptů a hlídat, aby se kvalita řešení v čase nezhoršovala. Spolupráce napříč týmy Budete spolupracovat s AI vývojáři, tech leady a podle zaměření také s businessovými týmy. Zároveň budete součástí širší komunity AI specialistů, se kterými budete sdílet zkušenosti, konzultovat řešení a vzájemně se challengovat. Budete mít prostor vyprofilovat se v konkrétní oblasti. Jak si vás představujeme? Máte praktickou zkušenost s vývojem řešení nad LLM – nestačí jen používání AI nástrojů. Umíte navrhnout prompt, vyhodnotit jeho výstupy a podle výsledků ho dál upravovat. . Umíte připravit evaluaci AI řešení a pracovat s metrikami, testovacími sadami nebo automatizovanými kontrolními testy. Máte praktickou zkušenost s RAG a rozumíte tomu, co ovlivňuje kvalitu výsledků – například práci s dokumenty, chunking, embeddings nebo retrieval. Dokážete rychle postavit PoC a vyhodnotit, zda je konkrétní AI use case technicky proveditelný. Zvládáte základy Pythonu pro automatizaci a skriptování. Máte zkušenost s LLM API nebo nástroji pro evaluaci AI řešení. Dokážete se doptat na businessové zadání, převést ho do konkrétního technického řešení a srozumitelně vysvětlit jeho možnosti i limity. Na co se u nás můžete těšit Tým lidí, který se rád pravidelně setkává v kanceláři – ale zároveň chápeme, že někdy je potřeba pracovat z domova, stačí se domluvit se svým šéfem. Pracujeme pro banku, která si cení otevřenosti, odvahy, jednoduchosti a přátelství. Krásných 5 týdnů dovolené + 5 dní volna za rok na cokoliv. Kvalitní zdravotní péči v síti prémiových klinik Canadian Medical/EUC Premium zdarma. Příspěvek na penzijní připojištění či doplňkové penzijní spoření ve výši 2 000 Kč měsíčně. A mnohem více – stačí se na setkání zeptat. Jak bude probíhat výběrové řízení Ozve se vám Dáša z Péče o zaměstnance a společně si upřesníte vzájemná očekávání. Pokud to oběma stranám bude dávat smysl, domluvíte si první kolo online s Petrem, vedoucím týmu. Druhé kolo proběhne osobně a potkáte se i s týmem. A potom už bude záležet jen na vás, jestli si navzájem sednete a dáme tomu zelenou. Těšíme se na vás!

items.desc: L'entreprise structure sa capacité d'ingénierie IA : passer d'usages isolés à un socle outillé, mesuré et réutilisable par les équipes de développement. Ce poste porte la fabrication de ce socle: agents, pipelines de récupération, harnesses d'évaluation. L'outillage est construit au contact des cas d'usage réels, avec les équipes qui les portent, puis capitalisé pour que les suivants aillent plus vite. Vous ne consommez pas une stack IA, vous la fabriquez. Ce que vous construisez: Les agents et harnesses qui outillent les développeurs au quotidien : orchestration, tool use, gestion du contexte, points de reprise humains. Les pipelines de récupération : stratégies d'indexation, découpage, recherche hybride, re-ranking - avec un jugement clair sur les cas où le RAG naïf casse. L' instrumentation et l'évaluation : tracing et scoring sous Langfuse, jeux d'évaluation construits en même temps que les features, pas après. Les composants réutilisables qui émergent de chaque cas d'usage et alimentent la bibliothèque interne. Le prompting structuré traité comme du code : versionné, testé, mesuré. Le profil Indispensable : Avoir déjà emmené un système à base de LLM du prototype à la production, avec des métriques de qualité qui tiennent. Python et TypeScript de façon fluide, Bash sans hésiter. Une pratique réelle de l'observabilité LLM (Langfuse ou équivalent) et de la conception de jeux d'évaluation sur des domaines que vous ne connaissez pas d'avance. Du recul sur la fiabilité des flux agentiques : ce qui casse, à quel endroit, et comment on le détecte. Apprécié : Expérience de transfert de compétence vers des équipes non spécialistes. Contribution open source ou publications techniques. Lieu du poste : Télétravail hybride (Annecy (74))

Du wirkst an der Architektur von KI-Systemen mit: Datenflüsse, Retrieval, Prompting, Tool-Anbindung und Schnittstellen zu bestehenden Produkten. Du wählst passende Modelle aus (kommerziell und Open Source) und bewertest sie nach Qualität, Kosten, Latenz und Datenschutz. Du passt Modelle bei Bedarf an, z. B. durch Fine-Tuning, Embedding-Optimierung oder Distillation. Du baust Evaluations-Pipelines und Testsets, mit denen wir die Qualität von KI-Funktionen messbar und reproduzierbar machen. Du bringst Lösungen in Produktion und betreibst sie: APIs, Deployment, Monitoring, Observability und Kostenkontrolle (MLOps/LLMOps). Du optimierst Performance und Skalierung, etwa durch Caching, Batching oder die Wahl der Inferenz-Infrastruktur. Du sorgst für Sicherheit und Compliance, z. B. Schutz vor Prompt Injection, sicherer Umgang mit Kundendaten und Anforderungen des EU AI Act. Du verfolgst neue Entwicklungen im KI-Bereich, testest sie in Prototypen und bringst deine Ideen ins Team ein. Deine Aufgaben – Nähe zum Produkt Du bringst deine technische Sicht in Refinements ein und schätzt Aufwände ab. Du lernst Kundenanforderungen kennen, z. B. in Terminen mit Fachbereichen. Du hilfst mit, den Nutzen von KI-Funktionen nach dem Release zu messen. items.title: Ingénieur Cybersécurité IA / AI Security Engineer
items.card: Contexte Au sein d’une équipe Cyberdéfense d’un grand groupe international, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Cybersécurité spécialisé dans les sujets IA et IA générative . L’objectif est de renforcer l’expertise de l’équipe sur les nouveaux risques liés à l’utilisation et au développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle : LLM, assistants, agents, RAG, modèles internes ou services IA proposés par les grands
items.desc: Contexte Au sein d’une équipe Cyberdéfense d’un grand groupe international, nous recherchons un Ingénieur Cybersécurité spécialisé dans les sujets IA et IA générative . L’objectif est de renforcer l’expertise de l’équipe sur les nouveaux risques liés à l’utilisation et au développement de solutions d’intelligence artificielle : LLM, assistants, agents, RAG, modèles internes ou services IA proposés par les grands Cloud Providers. Nous recherchons avant tout un vrai passionné de cybersécurité et d’IA , capable de comprendre comment fonctionnent ces technologies, de les tester, de les détourner et d’identifier concrètement leurs vulnérabilités. Ce poste n’est pas un rôle de gouvernance pure : il nécessite une vraie capacité à mettre les mains dans la technique . Tes missions Devenir le référent technique Cyberdéfense sur les sujets liés à l’IA et à l’IA générative. Évaluer la sécurité des nouvelles solutions IA utilisées ou développées par les équipes du groupe. Réaliser des analyses techniques et des tests de sécurité sur les LLM, applications GenAI et systèmes intégrant de l’IA. Identifier et tester les vulnérabilités spécifiques aux systèmes IA : prompt injection ; indirect prompt injection ; fuite ou extraction de données ; contournement des mécanismes de protection ; compromission des outils ou agents connectés ; risques liés aux architectures RAG ; exposition de données sensibles ; attaques sur les modèles et leurs chaînes d’approvisionnement. Participer à des démarches de Red Teaming appliquées à l’IA. Challenger les architectures IA avant leur mise en production. Accompagner les développeurs, Data Scientists, équipes Data / IA, architectes et Product Teams sur les bonnes pratiques de sécurité. Contribuer à la sécurisation des API, modèles, pipelines et composants utilisés dans les applications IA. Analyser et challenger les services IA proposés par les grands fournisseurs Cloud et éditeurs. Définir et tester des mécanismes de protection et de contrôle adaptés aux usages IA. Participer à l’analyse et au suivi des incidents de sécurité liés à ces environnements. Piloter ou challenger les audits et pentests réalisés par des partenaires spécialisés. Assurer une veille technologique et offensive très forte sur les nouvelles attaques, outils et recherches autour de la sécurité de l’IA. Tester de nouveaux outils, frameworks et techniques afin d’évaluer leur intérêt pour l’équipe Cyberdéfense. Profil candidat: Nous cherchons avant tout quelqu’un qui expérimente . Tu suis les évolutions des LLM, tu testes les nouveaux modèles, tu comprends leurs possibilités mais aussi leurs faiblesses et tu t’intéresses aux techniques permettant de les attaquer ou de les protéger. Tu possèdes parallèlement de solides bases en cybersécurité et es capable de replacer les problématiques IA dans un contexte plus large : sécurité applicative, Cloud, API, développement, données, identité et infrastructure. Une expérience professionnelle très longue sur la sécurité de l’IA n’est pas indispensable : le domaine évolue extrêmement rapidement. En revanche, une pratique personnelle ou professionnelle concrète des technologies IA est essentielle . Compétences recherchées Indispensables : Solides fondamentaux en cybersécurité technique. Très bonne compréhension du fonctionnement des LLM et des applications basées sur l’IA générative. Expérience concrète avec des API et modèles IA. Capacité à développer ou prototyper, notamment en Python. Bonne compréhension de la sécurité applicative et des API. Connaissance des principes de pentest et de sécurité offensive. Capacité à réaliser des tests techniques et à analyser le comportement d’un système. Bonne compréhension des architectures Cloud modernes. Forte curiosité technique et goût pour l’expérimentation. Des connaissances sur les sujets suivants seront particulièrement appréciées : LLM et modèles génératifs ; RAG ; agents IA et tool calling ; prompt injection et jailbreak ; LLM Red Teaming ; OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications ; sécurité des API ; sécurisation des données utilisées par les modèles ; modèles Open Source ; Azure OpenAI / AWS Bedrock / Google Vertex AI ou équivalents ; frameworks et bibliothèques permettant de construire des applications IA ; évaluation et testing automatisé de modèles ou d’applications GenAI.

items.desc: V Air Bank vzniká malý AI tým, který se věnuje vývoji interních nástrojů a produktů s reálným dopadem na fungování banky. Naše práce pomáhá ostatním týmům i byznysovým částem reagovat na aktuální potřeby a priority. Nečeká vás jeden dlouhodobě daný produkt, ale pestrá práce na různých řešeních – od transkripce hovorů přes RAG chatboty, centrální správu MCP, klasifikační use cases až po autonomní agentní systémy. Pokud vás baví technologie, spolupráce a chcete stavět praktické aplikace nad AI, rádi vás poznáme. Co vás u nás čeká Vývoj interních AI nástrojů – budete navrhovat a vyvíjet produkční aplikace nad LLM (např. RAG pipeline, extrakce dat z dokumentů, kategorizace a sumarizace komunikace nebo hlasové transkripční systémy), typicky v Pythonu (FastAPI), Javě nebo Go. Práce na konkrétních scénářích využití AI – řešení reálných technických trade-offů, jako je kvalita retrievalu vs. latence, náklady LLM volání ve škále, návrh chunking a embedding strategií nebo práce s halucinacemi a validací výstupů. Práce v integračním prostředí – nasazení a provoz aplikací v Kubernetes/Podman a práce s databázemi jako OracleDB, využití Azure platformy (včetně OpenAI modelů) Zakázky od dalších týmů – část práce bude přicházet přímo od kolegů z banky, se kterými budete řešení navrhovat, dodávat a podílet se na jeho provozu. Spolupráce v malém technickém týmu – budete v úzkém kontaktu s team lídrem, testerem a dalšími vývojáři, využijete nástroje jako Gerrit, Jenkins nebo MCP servery. Jak si vás představujeme Máte alespoň 2 roky zkušeností s vývojem v Javě nebo Pythonu – s oběma se u nás postupně potkáte. Pokud jste zatím nepracovali s Go, nevadí – důležitá je chuť učit se nové věci. Dokážete přemýšlet nad architekturou řešení jako celkem a rozumíte tomu, jak do sebe jednotlivé části zapadají. Máte zkušenost nebo silný zájem o práci s LLM a jejich praktickým využitím. Neztratíte se v integračním kontextu (např. Azure, kontejnery, CI/CD nástroje) a víte, co takové prostředí obnáší. Jste týmový hráč, baví vás technická diskuze a chcete se dál rozvíjet a posouvat společně s ostatními. Na co se u nás můžete těšit Tým lidí, který se rád pravidelně setkává v kanceláři – ale zároveň chápeme, že někdy je potřeba pracovat z domova, stačí se domluvit se svým šéfem. Pracujeme pro banku, která si cení otevřenosti, odvahy, jednoduchosti a přátelství. Krásných 5 týdnů dovolené + 5 dní volna za rok na cokoliv. Kvalitní zdravotní péči v síti prémiových klinik Canadian Medical/EUC Premium zdarma. Příspěvek na penzijní připojištění či doplňkové penzijní spoření ve výši 2 000 Kč měsíčně. A mnohem více – stačí se na setkání zeptat. Jak bude probíhat výběrové řízení Zní to jako role pro vás? Pošlete nám svůj životopis. Ozve se vám Dáša z Péče o zaměstnance, domluvíte si online pohovor s našimi šéfy a poté setkání s týmem. Těšíme se na vás!

Job Description Votre terrain de jeu : En tant que Applied Gen AI Engineer , vous concevez et développez nos futures solutions d’IA générative au cœur de nos équipes. Acteur·rice clé de la phase d'idéation jusqu'au déploiement à l'échelle, vous vous appuyez sur des cycles courts pour délivrer rapidement de la valeur et valider nos cas d'usage terrain. Ce rôle exige une grande autonomie technique et une culture du concret. Vous ne ferez pas que coder des interfaces ou appeler des API : vous relierez l'ingénierie logicielle de pointe et les capacités des LLMs pour transformer des concepts ambigus en systèmes de production fluides, performants et hautement sécurisés. Mesure du succès : Votre impact se mesurera à la vélocité de livraison des MVP, à la robustesse et à la scalabilité des architectures IA déployées, ainsi qu'à votre capacité à vulgariser des concepts complexes pour onboarder avec succès nos clients et nos équipes. Votre quotidien avec nous Piloter le cycle de vie technique (0 → 1) : Concevoir, architecturer et déployer des applications d’IA générative de bout en bout en mode Agile / Lean Startup. Bâtir des interfaces et API d'excellence : Développer des interfaces utilisateurs (UX) fluides et intuitives (React, Vue, Angular) connectées à des microservices et API backend (Python, Node.js) robustes, scalables et sécurisés. Orchestrer l'IA de production : Sélectionner et intégrer les meilleurs fournisseurs de LLM du marché (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Mistral AI, ...). Concevoir des workflows et des agents IA avancés et optimiser la recherche d'information via des bases de données vectorielles. Industrialiser et déployer sur le Cloud : Intégrer les services des grands fournisseurs Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) comme des acteurs souverains (Scaleway, OVHcloud…), et maintenir les pipelines CI/CD pour automatiser et sécuriser les déploiements. Être un catalyseur technologique : Participer activement aux revues de code, mener une veille constante sur l'état de l'art, et animer des sessions de partage pour élever collectivement le niveau de l'équipe. Traduire et accompagner : Simplifier et vulgariser les concepts d'IA auprès de nos clients, et contribuer à l'onboarding technique des équipes partenaires. Qualifications Vous êtes notre perle rare si... Vous avez l'expérience du terrain : Vous justifiez de minimum 3 à 4 ans d’expérience en développement Full-Stack, avec une pratique éprouvée. Vous maîtrisez l'ingénierie logicielle moderne : Vous êtes un développeur fullstack accompli, aussi à l'aise côté Backend (Python ou Node.js) que côté Frontend en typescript. Vous comprenez l'écosystème IA & Data : Vous avez une connaissance pratique des LLMs, des architectures RAG, des frameworks d'orchestration et des bases de données vectorielles ou relationnelles. Vous avez le réflexe Cloud & DevOps : Vous êtes familier des environnements Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) et des logiques de CI/CD. Vous avez l'esprit "Produit & MVP" : Vous savez naviguer dans l'ambiguïté, itérer vite, et privilégiez la valeur utilisateur à la sur-ingénierie. Vous êtes un excellent communicant : Doté d'une forte sensibilité UX, vous savez vulgariser l'IA et parlez couramment français et anglais. Additional Information La vie chez Devoteam AI Apps Mission & Impact : Participez activement à la transformation des entreprises grâce à l’IA générative et apportez des solutions innovantes à des enjeux concrets. Croissance & Certification : Profitez d’un accompagnement personnalisé, de formations continues et de certifications (Fournisseurs LLM, Hyperscalers) pour rester à la pointe de la technologie. items.desc: What Stackfix does We build production AI systems inside real businesses. Examples: A factory processes orders by hand. A distributor loses deals because quotes take days. An international law firm has people copying data between systems. We turn this manual work into production software that improves throughput, accuracy, and margin. The role You will own AI builds end-to-end for clients. You will: Sit with operators on-site and map how work actually happens Build and ship working software Integrate with whatever the client already runs Own the system after it goes live About us Paddy (https://www.linkedin.com/in/paddystobbs) worked at Google, and later founded Jukedeck, a neural-networks-for-music company, which TikTok acquired. Tom (https://www.linkedin.com/in/tomdekan) founded and sold an HR software company in 2023, and has 9+ years building AI systems, including using GPT2 when it was released. We are backed by Seedcamp, Chalfen Ventures, and angels from DeepMind. Tech stack We use boring software wherever possible: our aim is to minimize complexity. The stack varies per customer. Our default stack is: Python Django HTMX / Alpine.js / Typescript Postgres Who this role is for We care about systems you have built, not job titles. You should apply if: You have 4+ years building production software You are strong in Python You like talking to users You can reason clearly about reliability, evals, data quality, and edge cases You care whether software creates measurable value We also look for evidence of sustained excellence. The domain matters less than the pattern: high standards, long attention span, and visible output. Examples: Paddy (CEO) was previously a professional singer. Tom (CTO) played waterpolo for GB. Who this role is not for Please don’t apply if: You want a remote-first role You don’t want to understand how a client makes money You dislike talking to customers You want a narrow backend role or frontend role This is for someone who wants work to be one of the main places they grow. We optimise for autonomy, quality, and sustained output, not long hours. What you get Ownership. You will own client builds from discovery to production. Direct commercial exposure. You will see how companies make money, where they leak margin, and where software creates value. Founder-level learning. You will work directly with Paddy and Tom, two exited founders, and see how we sell, scope, negotiate, build, hire, and run the company. Meaningful upside. £90,000-£120,000/year salary + equity + a new MacBook Pro + subscriptions to any AI models you need + a central private office in Holborn. Interview Process Intro chat, 15 minutes - Fit, background, and what you are looking for. Technical screen, 60mins - A programming task (<60mins) and discuss it. Technical interview. - A realistic engineering discussion. No trick questions or leet code questions. In-person working session, 2-3 hours, in Holborn - A realistic problem based on the kind of work we do. No whiteboard theatre. No unpaid client delivery. Offer

items.desc: About The Role The ecommerce landscape is evolving rapidly, requiring strong analytical capabilities to turn data into actionable insights. At Versuni, we believe data plays a critical role in driving better decisions, improving performance, and enabling sustainable growth. We are looking for a driven and analytical Data Scientist to join our team. In this role, you will take ownership of key analytical and data science initiatives, applying statistical techniques and machine learning to solve business problems and influence decision-making. You will work closely with cross-functional teams and play a key role in delivering impactful data solutions. If you enjoy owning problems end-to-end, uncovering insights, and driving business impact through data, this role is for you. The Impact You’ll Make Data Analysis & Problem Solving: Own end-to-end analytical projects, from problem definition to delivery of insights and recommendations. Translate business questions into structured analytical approaches and measurable outputs. Perform deep-dive analyses to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Data Visualization & Storytelling Design and build dashboards and reports (e.g., Power BI) that enable stakeholders to track and act on key metrics. Communicate insights clearly through compelling visualizations and narratives that drive decisions. Machine Learning & Modelling Develop, deploy, and refine predictive models (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, forecasting). Evaluate model performance and iterate to improve accuracy and business relevance. Take ownership of models in production, including monitoring and maintenance. Data Collection, Preparation & Management Own data collection and preparation processes, ensuring data quality, consistency, and reliability. Work with large datasets and shape them into usable formats for analysis and modelling. Business Collaboration Partner closely with teams such as Ecommerce, Marketing, Product, and Operations to identify opportunities and deliver data-driven solutions. Analyse ecommerce performance across the funnel (traffic, conversion, retention, revenue) to drive optimization. Translate analytical outputs into actionable recommendations that influence business outcomes. Tools & Technologies Use Python, R, SQL, and visualization tools to deliver scalable analytical solutions. Work with cloud and data platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Databricks) to operationalize analyses. Continuous Improvement Proactively identify opportunities to improve data processes, models, and methodologies. Stay current with emerging tools and techniques in data science. The Skills And Knowledge You’ll Bring Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or related field. 5+ years’ experience in data science, ecommerce analytics, or similar roles; in global/multi-market environments preferred. Proven ability to independently own and deliver analytical or data science projects. Proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and modeling. Strong SQL skills with the ability to query large, complex datasets. Experience in machine learning, statistical modeling, predictive analytics, and data mining. Knowledge of Databricks for data engineering is a plus Experience in data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or similar). Strong problem-solving skills and ability to translate business needs into data solutions Effective communication skills with the ability to influence stakeholders through data. Ben je een hbo- of wo-student in de laatste fase van een AI-gerelateerde studie en klaar om jouw kennis toe te passen in de praktijk? Dan is deze stage bij het ministerie van Financiën iets voor jou!
items.desc: Op deze pagina: Dit ga je doen Dit krijg je Dit vragen wij Hier kom je te werken Bijzonderheden Stel gerust je vraag Dit ga je doen Wil jij werken aan échte AI-vraagstukken op een unieke plek binnen de Rijksoverheid? Ben je een hbo- of wo-student in de laatste fase van een AI-gerelateerde studie en klaar om jouw kennis toe te passen in de praktijk? Dan is deze stage bij het ministerie van Financiën iets voor jou! Jouw stage Tijdens deze stage ga je aan de slag met uiteenlopende vraagstukken rondom Artificial Intelligence (AI) binnen het ministerie van Financiën. Je werkt mee aan innovatieve projecten die de efficiëntie en besluitvorming binnen het ministerie versterken. Als AI-student bij het innovatieteam voer je twee soorten werkzaamheden uit: Onderzoek: een verdiepende opdracht binnen de organisatie op gebied van twee verschillende sporen. Lopende innovatiezaken: bijdragen aan het dagelijkse werk van het team. Onderzoek Je onderzoekt een actueel vraagstuk binnen onze organisatie, in nauwe samenwerking met de stakeholders van innovatie. Deze stakeholders hebben zelf ook een direct belang bij de uitkomst van jouw opdracht. Je doorloopt daarbij een traject van onderzoeken, valideren en ontwikkelen, met als resultaat een prototype of artefact dat wij daadwerkelijk kunnen inzetten om het probleem op te lossen. Spoor 1: Kennissysteem (HR-chatbot / IT-chatbot) Het onderzoeken en ontwikkelen van een kennissysteem waarbij AI medewerkers helpt om informatie te vinden. Welke methode is het meest geschikt voor het teruggeven van specifieke informatie (mini-RAG, kennisbank, of anders)? Hoe ontwerpen we het systeem zodat het schaalbaar kan worden toegepast binnen de organisatie? Spoor 2: FinDocs (geautomatiseerd template-invulsysteem) Het onderzoeken en doorontwikkelen van FinDocs, ons geautomatiseerde systeem voor het invullen van templates. Evaluatie van de volledige FinDocs-flow, van input tot output Hoe moet de RAG geoptimaliseerd worden op basis van de huidige inzichten? Redesign van de workflow Optimalisatie van de system prompt Ontwerp van een vraag- en antwoordstap die herhaling van informatie voorkomt Lopende innovatiezaken Daarnaast ondersteun je het team met werkzaamheden zoals het ontwikkelen van AI-toepassingen, het doen van onderzoek met gebruikers, inbreng in teamoverleggen en het begeleiden van AI-innovaties. In overleg verkennen we welke vaardigheden je daarnaast wilt ontwikkelen, welke onderwerpen je interessant vindt, en waar jouw skills het beste ingezet kunnen worden om innovatie binnen de organisatie te versterken. Over het team Dienstenmanagement Tijdens jouw stage maak je onderdeel uit van het team Dienstenmanagement. Wij verzorgen de reguliere digitale werkomgeving voor de circa 3000 medewerkers van het ministerie van Financiën. In ons team werken drie collega’s aan innovatiemanagement en onderzoeken daarbij nieuwe technologische toepassingen en hoe deze toepassingen ons werk slimmer, efficienter en toekomstbestendig kunnen maken. Zo blijven we aansluiten bij wat onze collega’s én de burgers van ons verwachten. Ons team is inhoudelijk deskundig en ervaren. We houden van een open sfeer en vinden het belangrijk dat er ruimte is om elkaar om hulp te vragen. Samen maken we van jouw stage een succes! Alvast kennismaken? Meld je aan voor Stagedag op 21 oktober: Live event: Stagedag bij het ministerie van Financiën - Werken voor Nederland Dit krijg je €800 Afstudeerstage / scriptie 1 feb 2027 - 29 aug 2027 32 - 40 uur Dit vragen wij Je bevindt je in de afrondende fase van een hbo- of wo-opleiding in een AI-gerelateerd vakgebied, zoals Artificial Intelligence, Data Science of Computer Science. Je hebt programmeerkennis (bijvoorbeeld Python) Je hebt een sterke interesse in de ontwikkeling, toepassing en impact van AI-technologieën en bent nieuwsgierig naar de mogelijkheden van AI. Je werkt zelfstandig, neemt initiatief, ziet kansen en onderneemt snel actie. Je bent minimaal 32 uur per week beschikbaar voor een periode van 6 tot 12 maanden. Over jouw startdatum kan overlegd worden, bij voorkeur start je zo snel mogelijk. Jouw stage kan gecombineerd worden met een afstudeerproject of scriptie en kan ook worden ingericht als een meeloopstage. Bij voorkeur combineer je jouw stage met een onderzoek, afstudeerproject of scriptie. Tijdens je stage krijg je de ruimte om hier volop aan te werken, naast je dagelijkse werkzaamheden. Samen kiezen we een onderzoeksonderwerp dat aansluit bij jouw studie én ons werkveld. Mogelijke onderwerpen? Denk aan AI-innovaties op gebieden zoals automatische transcriptie, slimme zoekfunctionaliteiten, en andere innovaties die ons werk slimmer maken. Hier kom je te werken Over Ministerie van Financiën Samen werken aan een financieel gezond Nederland Het werk van het ministerie van Financiën gaat over meer dan cijfers en geld alleen. Het gaat over mensen zoals jij en ik. Mensen met verwachtingen, zorgen, vragen, dromen en plannen. We rekenen bijvoorbeeld allemaal op financiering …

items.desc: Vil du bygge generativ AI-løsninger som faktisk tas i bruk og skaper målbar verdi? BearingPoint ser etter erfarne generative AI engineers som vil mer enn å eksperimentere med modeller og prompts. Hos oss jobber du med komplekse, forretningskritiske problemstillinger der generativ og agentisk AI brukes i kjerneprosesser. Ende-til-ende fra idé og design, til produksjon og reell adopsjon. Allerede i 2023 bygget vi et ende-til-ende AI-produkt som sparte tusenvis av timer for Plan Norge. Siden den gang har vi levert flere tilsvarende løsninger der hvor AI automatiserer og forsterker måten kundene våre jobber på. Nå bygger vi videre, og vil ha med flere på laget. Hva slags kundeproblemer jobber vi med? Vi jobber med fremoverlente kunder og deres mest krevende utfordringer. Typisk kjennetegnes prosjektene av: Bruk av resonnerende språkmodeller i kjerneprosesser, ikke bare støttefunksjoner. Fokus på agentiske løsninger som automatiserer eller augmenter prosesser med målbar forretningsverdi. Ofte krav til robusthet, evaluering og governance Strategiske valg og rådgivning fra idé til produksjon I mange prosjekter er teknologi bare halve arbeidet. Like viktig er forståelse av prosesser, brukerbehov og hvordan organisasjonen faktisk tar i bruk teknologien og løsningen. Hva går rollen ut på? Som Generative AI Engineer får du en sentral rolle i både tekniske og faglige valg. Du vil: Bygge agentiske løsninger med alt det innebærer av context, prompt, agent og harness engineering, gjerne med orkestreringsrammeverk som LangGraph. Jobbe tett med domeneekserter og sluttbrukere for å sikre at vi løser riktige problemer Ta ansvar for løsningsdesign, fra arkitektur til produksjonssetting Bygge helhetlige løsninger med både nødvendig arkitektur, backend og gode brukerflater (UI) Planlegge og gjennomføre grundig evaluering, inkludert testing og automatiserte oppsett som «LLM-as-a-judge» Hvem ser vi etter? Denne rollen passer best for deg som allerede har solid erfaring med generativ AI i praksis. Du kjenner deg selv igjen i flere av disse punktene: Du har genuin interesse for generativ AI og motivasjon for å holde deg oppdatert på hva som skjer på fagfeltet Du har bygget og satt generative AI-løsninger i produksjon Du trives i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, bruker og forretning Du tenker helhetlig rundt arkitektur, evaluering og drift Du evner å sette deg raskt inn i komplekse domener og prosesser Du liker å jobbe tett med kunder og ta ansvar for at løsningen faktisk gir verdi Du har god kompetanse i Python Du har flytende norskkunnskaper (B2), både muntlig og skriftlig Mastergrad innenfor relevante fagfelt Hva kan vi tilby? Hos oss blir du del av et stort og modent Data & AI-miljø i Oslo, med over 70 kollegaer som jobber rendyrket med data, analyse og AI. Generativ AI er ikke et sideprosjekt, men en egen satsing med aktive prosjekter. Du får: Reell mulighet til å påvirke retning og faglig utvikling i et voksende fagmiljø innenfor generativ AI. Et arbeidsmiljø bestående av et mangfold av engasjerte, jordnære og dyktige folk som spiller hverandre gode. Et miljø hvor ditt engasjement og initiativ verdsettes. Du får spillerom og støtte til å utvikle nye ideer og områder. Individuell coaching og oppfølging fra meget erfarne kolleger som ønsker at du skal lykkes. Muligheten til å utvikle deg faglig og profesjonelt. I tillegg til kurs og sertifiseringer, har vi et bredt spekter av faggrupper. Flat struktur og godt samarbeid på tvers av fagområder. Kollektiv bonusordning og fravær av spisse albuer. Fleksible arbeidstider med mulighet for hjemmekontor, så lenge kunders og kollegers behov ivaretas. Et stort og variert tilbud av sosiale arrangementer og sportslige aktiviteter. Vi er et privateid selskap med flat struktur og lite politikk. Hos oss er du ikke låst i én bransje, én rolle eller én teknologi. Nysgjerrig? Vi vet at et jobbskifte ikke er noe man gjør lett. Kanskje er du egentlig ganske fornøyd der du sitter, men litt nysgjerrig på hvordan andre faktisk jobber med generativ AI i praksis. Ta gjerne en uforpliktende prat med oss. Vi forteller mer om prosjektene våre, hvordan vi jobber i hverdagen og om BearingPoint kan være et sted som passer for deg, nå eller senere. Du kan også lese mer om BearingPoint og vårt Data Science-team på vår karriereside!

items.desc: Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités Data & IA, nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer pour l'un de nos clients pour concevoir, développer et industrialiser des solutions d’intelligence artificielle, y compris GenAI, avec une expertise forte de la mise en production et du suivi en production. Vos missions : Industrialisation des solutions IA : accompagner le passage du POC à la production, en garantissant la fiabilité, la performance et la scalabilité des solutions développées. Cela comprend le déploiement en préproduction puis en production, le go-live et l’hypercare, ainsi que la rédaction du runbook et de la documentation d’onboarding. MLOps et gestion du cycle de vie des modèles : mettre en place les processus de déploiement, de monitoring, de versioning et de maintenance des modèles de Machine Learning. Cela comprend les pipelines CI/CD GitHub (identité de déploiement OIDC, CI sur pull requests, CD, smoke tests post-déploiement), le versioning, les notes de version, le rollback, le scan de secrets et l’audit des dépendances. Déploiement Cloud (Databricks) : concevoir et déployer des solutions IA sur Databricks (apps, jobs, Lakebase, secret scopes, service principal), avec une configuration par environnement, des sauvegardes, la gestion des accès et les connexions aux sources de données (Snowflake, SharePoint). Conteneurisation : utiliser Docker pour faciliter le déploiement et la gestion des applications (frontend, backend, base PostgreSQL, télémétrie). Data Engineering : s’appuyer sur les pipelines de données existants et assurer la disponibilité des données pour les modèles IA, notamment grâce à des jobs de rafraîchissement planifiés avec alertes d’échec et contrôles de fraîcheur. Le Data Engineering amont reste porté par le client. Observabilité, optimisation et amélioration continue : suivre les performances des solutions en production, identifier les axes d’amélioration et garantir leur qualité. Cela comprend OpenTelemetry sur MLflow, le tracing MLflow (tags, hash de prompt, tokens), les logs JSON, l’audit log, l’alerting, les SLO de latence et un dashboard d’usage et de coûts (LLM, Databricks, Snowflake). Évaluation de la qualité des réponses : constituer un jeu de référence versionné et des scorers (exactitude numérique, groundedness, usage des outils), exécuter les évaluations avec mlflow.genai.evaluate et un jeu de red team (injection de prompt), mettre en place un contrôle d’évaluation avant chaque mise en production, collecter le feedback utilisateur et animer la revue hebdomadaire des mauvaises réponses. Sécurité et fiabilité en production : appliquer les rôles et périmètres de données, les limites de requêtes et les règles de rétention des données ; participer aux tests de charge, aux smoke tests Playwright, à la recette et à la revue de sécurité. Collaboration technique : travailler avec les AI Developers, Data Scientists, Data Engineers et équipes Cloud pour assurer une intégration efficace des modèles dans les systèmes existants. Compétences appréciées Connaissance d’AWS, Kubernetes et Spark. Expérience avec Snowflake et GitHub Enterprise Server (GHES). Pratique des tests de charge, des tests end-to-end (Playwright) et de la sécurité applicative (SAST, audit de dépendances). Environnement technique MLOps · Machine Learning · Databricks (Apps, Jobs, Lakebase, MLflow) · CI/CD GitHub (OIDC, GHES) · Monitoring et observabilité (OpenTelemetry, MLflow) · Docker · SQL · PostgreSQL · Python · Snowflake · Model Versioning · LLM / RAG / Agents

items.desc: This job in a nutshell AI is becoming increasingly important to how we work, develop our capabilities, and deliver value to clients. As a Learning & Development AI Specialist at Deloitte, you help colleagues build the skills to use AI effectively and translate developments in AI and business needs into a coherent, up-to-date learning offering. You connect strategy and portfolio decisions with execution: from identifying the skills people need to shape learning experiences and measuring their impact. You work closely with stakeholders in Technology & Transformation (T&T) and Strategy, Risk & Transactions (SR&T), L&D colleagues, and AI experts. Benefits You’ll receive a profit-sharing bonus, on top of your fixed salary. Continuous professional growth. Join our development program. A work-from-home office setup allowance to make sure you have everything you need for an ergonomically designed workstation and internet allowance. Work part-time (32 hours a week) or full-time (40 hours a week). Flexible and hybrid working, in accordance with team and client commitments. 26 days of paid annual leave, and the opportunity to purchase additional leave. A good mobility scheme: the choice of various options such as a lease car, travel by public transport, a cash option or a combination of these. A laptop and iPhone. The iPhone can also be used for personal purposes. A time for time arrangement that creates flexibility for personal moments that matter. A good pension scheme with a personal contribution of only 2%. An opportunity to take part in our collective health insurance scheme. An opportunity to benefit from tax-efficient facilities such as company fitness, a bicycle scheme or the opportunity to lease a bicycle. The opportunity to use 55 hours of babysitting service per calendar year if your child is 12 years old or younger. A flexible budget, which you can use to make choices in flexible benefits, for example purchasing extra leave days or financing a bicycle plan. Various leave options tailored to meet your individual needs, from parental leave (also for rainbow families) to the flexibility of exchanging three national holidays for non-national holidays. Be the true you You combine expertise in learning and development with a strong interest in AI and an understanding of business needs. You can structure complex issues, bring together stakeholders with different perspectives, and turn priorities into tangible outcomes. You are equally comfortable providing strategic advice and driving practical execution. For this role, you ideally bring: a completed higher professional or university degree (HBO or WO), preferably in Educational Sciences, Human Resource Management, Change Management, Work and Organisational Psychology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Science or a related field; relevant experience in Learning & Development, preferably including the development of learning strategies, learning portfolios and learning journeys; demonstrated experience analysing learning needs and skill gaps and assessing the effectiveness of learning interventions; strong stakeholder management, advisory and project management skills in a complex environment, with the ability to build engagement and support the adoption of new ways of working; a demonstrable interest and knowledge in AI developments and the ability to translate their applications into learning and development; excellent spoken and written English; Dutch is an advantage. **You must currently be based in the Netherlands to be considered for this position.** **You can apply for this vacancy until 30 October 2026 .** What impact will you make? In this role, you support T&T and SR&T in strengthening AI capabilities, while also identifying opportunities to apply and scale effective AI learning solutions more broadly across Deloitte. You will be reporting to the T&T L&D Manager. Rather than solely coordinating learning content, you take ownership of the connections between learning strategy, portfolio, skills, execution and impact. Working with the relevant stakeholders, you ensure that the AI learning offering remains relevant and addresses the needs of employees and the business. How do you do this? In this role, you are responsible for five interconnected areas: AI Learning Strategy & Portfolio Translate business and AI developments into learning priorities and own the AI learning roadmap. items.desc: About the project: Build the backend of a custom AI platform from scratch for a US general contractor modernizing its federal bidding process. You’ll work directly with an architect and AI expert, influence foundational technical decisions, and gain hands-on experience with document processing, LLM orchestration, RAG pipelines, and multi-tenant data. The platform will turn solicitations from SAM.gov into structured insights, evaluate opportunities against company certifications and past performance, and support proposal drafting and submission. Your work will power a Go/No-Go engine that helps teams decide which bids to pursue. A new team member will be in charge of: Building the backend foundation: project setup, authentication, role-based permissions, and an immutable audit log. Implementing solicitation intake from SAM.gov, PDF/DOC/HTML parsing, and OCR with per-field confidence scores. Building LLM orchestration for structured extraction, retries, fallbacks, citation tracking, and cost control. Developing bid scoring against certifications and past performance, with Word, PDF, and Excel exports for Go/No-Go reviews. Preparing the platform for production: OWASP baseline security, secrets management, CI/CD in the client’s AWS environment, and runbooks and documentation for handover. Does this relate to you? 4+ years of backend development with Node.js and TypeScript, using Fastify, NestJS, or Express in production. Experience with PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, and pgvector for RAG. Production experience integrating Anthropic, OpenAI, or Amazon Bedrock, including structured outputs, retries, RAG, and managing cost and latency. Experience with AWS ECS/Fargate, S3, RDS, CloudFront, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines. Experience with PDF parsing, OCR, and REST/OAuth integrations, including public APIs. items.desc: I am partnered with one of the leading wealth management firms who are looking for an Azure focused AI Solutions Engineer who can lead their further business development of retrieval-augmented generation whilst having ownership of stakeholder communication. This is a very unique opportunity for a mid level engineer who has been playing around with RAG, AI assisted development, Azure OpenAPI and more in order to achieve business relevant solutions. It is important you would have done this whilst in a commercial setting as it showcases ability to know where AI should be used, how it should be implemented and which business areas would develop most from it. It is also an opportunity to be at the forefront of the AI revolution at this firm with the work including taking prototypes into production and communicating with the business in order to achieve this seamlessly across its' many departments and products. These products include working across their portfolio desks, risk, compliance, cybersecurity and everything else in between. Skills/Requirements: 3+ years experience in software engineering, solutions engineering or any relevant role Exposure to commercially working with RAG, GenAI and LLM APIs is essential Experience with testing in AI environments and best practices around this It is a bonus if the experience comes from Azure Cloud environments Understanding of financial services including its' regulations and compliance aspects Offering: Looking to offer between 60-100k across 2 roles with different experience levels + Bonus + Benefits 3 days hybrid in Central London Opportunity to transform AI processes and lead from the front This is an opportunity that enables you to work directly with the heads of the business and therefore require strong communication skills. Moreover, there is no VISA sponsorship for this role unfortunately. If interested, feel free to apply or email me at tomasz@virtuetech.io as to why you think you'd be a good fit.
