items.desc:
Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS&T and delivers global-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. The team manages identity, device security, and anti-abuse platforms — covering everything from manufacturing and repairs to software updates and activations. ETS also oversees supply chain, manufacturing, and partner integration platforms, protecting data on more than 2.5 billion devices worldwide. And when Apple prepares for a global product launch, ETS owns the systems that ramp factory production — managing serial numbers, network credentials, and verified software. The Insight team runs one of Apple's most critical Big Data ecosystems — a multi-petabyte, highly-available infrastructure that underpins manufacturing operations for every Apple product, globally. Every iPhone, iPad, and Mac has touched our systems. We are establishing a new EMEA operational team in Cork, not only as an extension of our US/India/China operations, but also a team with its own identity, perspective, and contribution to how Insight runs at global scale. This is a new regional team being built from the ground up, and the people who join early will help shape what it becomes. We are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who has operated in the European high-tech landscape, who brings the rigor and perspective that comes from that environment, and who wants to shape the practices of a new team. As one of the first few SREs in Cork, you will have real influence over how this team works, what it builds, and how it contributes to Apple's manufacturing infrastructure worldwide.
You will operate and improve services within a very large-scale, highly-available Big Data ecosystem supporting Exabytes level of data with sustained, rapid growth. Your work directly enables the engineering and operations teams that build every Apple product. Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of services and infrastructure within the Insight ecosystem — with a build-to-manage mindset applied to design, deployment, and ongoing operations Build and advance AIOps capabilities across the ecosystem — developing ML-driven alerting, anomaly detection, LLM-assisted operational tooling, and automated incident triage that measurably improve observability and response Instrument services for deep observability: dashboards, meaningful alerts, runbooks, and clearly defined SLOs and SLIs that give the team and stakeholders an accurate view of ecosystem health Drive automation that reduces operational toil and improves ecosystem stability — key measures of success include ecosystem uptime, release quality, toil reduction, and sustained advancement of SRE practice Partner with incident management to drive effective incident response and conduct thorough post-incident reviews; translate findings into architectural and operational improvements that prevent recurrence Contribute to infrastructure-as-code practices and platform architecture decisions that shape the long-term direction of the Insight ecosystem Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams across Apple's global manufacturing services, communicating effectively across time zones and cultures Help define the culture, working practices, and technical standards of the new EMEA operational team — build strong in-region relationships with business partners and represent the team's perspective within the wider Insight organization Mentor and support team members as the Cork operational team grows
Experience in SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering with strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively across geographies
Linux systems proficiency — comfortable troubleshooting at the systems level including processes, networking, file systems, and performance diagnostics
Programming and automation experience in Python, Go, or Bash, combined with practical exposure to AI/ML applied to IT operations — anomaly detection, intelligent alerting, or LLM-driven tooling
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, with an understanding of compute, storage, networking, and IAM in production environments
Kubernetes, CI/CD, and networking fundamentals — practical experience with container orchestration and deployments, pipeline tooling (ArgoCD, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or similar), and a grasp of HTTP, DNS, TCP/IP, and how traffic flows through distributed systems
Experience operating systems instrumented with Grafana, Prometheus, Kibana, or equivalent, alongside practical IaC skills using Terraform, Pulumi, or Crossplane
SRE principles applied in practice: error budgets, SLOs, SLIs, toil measurement and reduction
Experience with relational databases in production environments — MySQL or PostgreSQL
BS or MS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent technical discipline; equivalent professional experience will be fully considered

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Embedded Software Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid). 
 Our world is changing. And so are we. From our commitment to zero-carbon flight (#ZEROe) to cleaning up space, sustainability is at the heart of our purpose. So what's your next change?
 Our team, “Airborne Connectivity” is part of the engineering function in Airbus Defence and Space, designing and developing products, hardware and software, providing connectivity and communications capabilities to our customers. These products are integrated as part of the solutions provided by two out of the three main programme lines in Airbus Defence and Space, Secure Communications in Connected Intelligence, and all military airborne platforms in Military Air Systems (Eurofighter, C295, MRTT, SIRTAP, Eurodrone, etc.)
 Be part of the future by making the next generation of high-integrity airborne real-time systems, paving the way for innovation in smart connectivity, distributed networking, and artificial intelligence adoption. You will take part in a high performance team that is involved in the complete lifecycle of the embedded software product, from building the SW requirements, to the final testing and target computer implementation. You should be able to lead and take responsibility on design/architectural decisions, as well as leading the development of specific projects.
 TRAVEL REQUIRED : Occasional travel within national and international areas (around 3-day trip).
 HOW YOU WILL CONTRIBUTE TO THE TEAM : 
 Work across all the levels of embedded software development according to specific SW standards (SW requirements, SW design, SW coding, SW verification, SW configuration, SW documentation release, SW change management and support to SW QA).
 Partner with product & program managers, system engineers and validation teams to drive software products.
 Participate in the planning and scope for the team projects.
 Support product owners and project managers to deliver high quality software on time.
 Promote innovation across the department.
 ABOUT YOU : 
 Required skills and qualifications:
 Educated in software, IT, telecommunication, industrial engineering degree or a related discipline.
 Expertise on real-time and/or embedded software development.
 Expertise on defining SW requirements.
 Expertise on C/C++ and/or Ada programming languages and low-level development.
 Expertise on software verification.
 +3 years of experience
 Fluent level of English and Spanish.
 Preferred skills and qualifications:
 Knowledge of SW airworthiness certification processes: DO-178C, EFA Standards.
 Awareness of cyber-security concepts and accreditation processes ( Common Criteria ).
 Experience on: system & SW design tools ( SysML, UML ), integrated development environment ( GPS, AdaMulti, Eclipse ), verification tools ( Vector Cast, AdaTest95 ).
 Interest and ability to conciliate multiple perspectives regarding products, projects and processes.
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year.
 Attractive salary.
 Hybrid model of working when possible, promoting the work-life balance.
 Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
 Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
 Option to access special rates in products & benefits.
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 The duties and responsibilities of the Onboard Safety-Critical Senior Firmware and Software Engineer for the Department of Air Refueling & Cargo Loading Software will be the following:
 To be responsible for the Firmware Requirements Specification for the Onboard Safety Critical Computing Platforms developed inside the AR Domain.
 To be responsible for the Software Requirements Specification for the Onboard Safety Critical Computing Platforms developed inside the AR Domain.
 To be responsible for the Hardware/Firmware/Software Integration Testing for the Onboard Safety Critical Computers developed inside the AR Domain.
 To be responsible for the development of the Firmware DO-254 DAL A/B for the Onboard Computers developed under the responsibility of the Air Refueling domain, and to be involved in its verification (testing, reviews and analysis).
 To share the responsibility of the Hardware Certification Process of such Firmware in front of the Certification Authorities in order to demonstrate the compliance with the RTCA DO-254 DAL A/B Objectives.

Job Description: 
 Testia SAS - Technicien en Contrôle Non Destructif et pilotage d'une affaire et équipe certifié PT2 et/ou ET2 et/ou UT2 - (H/F) - Marignane 
Testia, filiale du groupe Airbus, est une entreprise internationale spécialisée dans l’intégrité et les inspections d’aérostructures et le contrôle non destructif aéronautique.
 Grâce à son réseau mondial, avec des agences en Europe, en Amérique du Nord et en Asie, Testia peut fournir ses services à l’international et apporter des solutions globales aux besoins de l’industrie.
 Avec un catalogue unique de services et de produits CND, Testia est votre partenaire complet pour le CND aéronautique. Nous offrons une large gamme d’ équipements et de produits pour des analyses rapides et efficaces des structures, composants et assemblages. Testia est également centre de formation dans toutes les méthodes de CND, tous niveaux confondus, et propose aussi des services d’ inspection , de consulting, et d’engineering .
 Actuellement, nous sommes à la recherche d’un.e :
 Technicien en Contrôle Non Destructif et pilotage d'une affaire et équipe certifié PT2 et/ou ET2 et/ou UT2 - (H/F) - Marignane 
 Contexte de la mission : 
 Dans le cadre de l’expansion de ses activités de contrôle non destructif et plus particulièrement dans le domaine de la fabrication aéronautique, Testia recherche un.e technicien expérimenté.e afin de piloter une/des équipes d’inspecteurs CND sur un ou divers pôles.

 Vous rejoindrez une équipe à taille humaine, dont les valeurs principales sont la convivialité, la solidarité et la transmission du savoir.
 Selon vos souhaits d’évolution et grâce à nos nombreux projets variés, vous pourrez acquérir de la polyvalence sur d’autres activités et évoluer dans l'entreprise.

 Du arbeitest in der größten Produktionsstätte für zivile Flugzeuge in Hamburg. Durch die Lage am südlichen Elbufer besteht die Möglichkeit, mit der Fähre zu pendeln. Erlebe in deiner Freizeit das besondere Flair Hamburgs, wo pulsierende Weltstadtkultur auf nautisches Erbe trifft.

Deine Werkstudentenstelle befindet sich auf dem Werk in Finkenwerder und du kannst vormittags und ab mittags mit der Fähre von Teufelsbrück zum Airbus Fähranleger und zurück zur Uni fahren. Alternativ nimmst du die Fähre bis Finkenwerder und fährst dann ca. 15 Minuten mit dem Fahrrad zum Haupteingang. ​
 Deine Vorteile 
 Internationales Umfeld mit der Möglichkeit, Kontakte in die ganze Welt zu knüpfen. 
 Arbeit mit modernen/abwechslungsreichen Technologien. 
 Wir bei Airbus sehen dich als vollwertiges Teammitglied, du stehst im engen Austausch mit den Schnittstellen und bist Teil unserer wöchentlichen Teamrunden. 
 Möglichkeit zur Teilnahme an der Generation Airbus Community zur Erweiterung des eigenen Netzwerks.

 Kopplung von Umwelt- und Flottendaten: Integration globaler Reanalysedaten (z. B. Copernicus-Atmosphärendaten) in die Simulation zur Korrelation von regionalen Staubbelastungen mit dem real beobachteten Druckanstieg im Flugbetrieb.

 Prädiktive Instandhaltungsstrategien: Übertragung der gewonnenen Simulationsergebnisse auf weitere Systemarchitekturen zur Optimierung von Filterwechselintervallen und Restlebensdauer-Prognosen. 
 Erforderliche Kenntnisse und Qualifikationen 
 Eingeschriebener Vollzeitstudent (d/m/w) im Bereich Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren Studienrichtung. 
 Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Thermodynamik und Strömungslehre. 
 Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse. 
 Bitte lade folgende Unterlagen hoch: Anschreiben, Lebenslauf, relevante Zeugnisse, Immatrikulationsbescheinigung.

items.desc:
Lieu : Cannes, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Notre savoir-faire technologique
 Notre attention portée à l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un environnement inclusif et bienveillant
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu (Thales Solidarity, indice CAC 40 ESG…)
 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique. 
 Sur le site de Thales Alenia Space Cannes , au sein de la Direction Ingénierie Telecom, vous rejoindrez l’équipe AOCS/AM d’une trentaine de personnes sur les activités de Recherche & Développement et les avant-projets. 
 Dans le cadre du développement et de la validation des fonctions de guidage et navigation à des fins de rendez-vous orbital , Thales Alenia Space recherche un stagiaire pour concevoir, modéliser et développer une fonction permettant la simulation de l’absence de gravité sur le banc robotique , afin d’étudier plus en détail les effets des phases de contact transitoires entre 2 objets lors des opérations de RDV en orbite.
 Le stage consistera à identifier les besoins de simulation , ainsi que les caractéristiques d’utilisation du banc robotique , composé d’un bras collaboratif. Il s’agira de conceptualiser, modéliser et concevoir un algorithme permettant de contrôler le Cobot afin de simuler le comportement relatif d’un objet soumis à une stimulation externe à 0g. Enfin, le candidat réalisera une série de tests et validations selon les scénarios ciblés. Cette algorithme devra être conçu et pensé pour être facilement amélioré par la suite.
 Vos principales missions seront les suivantes : 
 Recueillir les besoins et prendre connaissance des scenarios à couvrir
 Prendre en main le système cobotique (limitations, commandalibilité, opérabilité…)
 Analyser mathématiquement la problématique et conceptualiser des fonctions et des équations à mettre en œuvre
 Modéliser la solution et simulation si nécessaire
 Coder et mettre en place une IHM adaptée avec manuel utilisateur et traçabilité.
 Tester et valider sur le banc avec le moyen CORY et mise en œuvre sur un cas concret.
 Votre profil 
 Stage – Ingénieur Simulateur 0g pour banc robotique de RDV en orbite – (H/F) 
 Votre priorité est de rejoindre un groupe industriel innovant et découvrir le monde du spatial ?

ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Core Platform builds the foundations every other team at ElevenLabs builds on: how users, workspaces and permissions work across our products. Our systems sit on the path of every request and are relied on by millions of users and by enterprise customers, so correctness, security and safe rollout matter as much as speed.

We are hiring full stack engineers (backend leaning) for two focus areas. Depending on the team you join, your responsibilities might include:

Workspaces & User Management (serving external customers)

 - Building and improving the building blocks customers touch directly: API keys, login experience, analytics, admin tooling, workspace security and more

 - Working closely with Sales, FDEs and customer teams to turn enterprise and self-serve feedback into the right improvements, and helping large customers with complex organisational structures.

 - Shipping customer-facing features end to end, from backend services to the admin and settings UI.

Permissions & Resources (serving ElevenLabs engineering teams)

 - Designing and building generic resource and permissioning services that product teams use to build features safely and quickly.

 - Solving hard, largely greenfield problems at scale, for example how a customer with a million agents assigns and manages access.

 - Working across product teams to understand their needs, and driving adoption with changes that don't require every team to rework their code.

In both teams you will:

 - Scope work as part of a large existing system: understand what exists, what could go wrong on rollout, whether a migration is needed, and how downstream teams are affected.

 - Roll out changes safely and with minimal disruption to existing users, teams or systems.

 - Debug and operate what you build, working from customer reports, logs and code.

 - Own features from scoping to completion, with the support of experienced engineers who are happy to mentor.


REQUIREMENTS

We do not require any formal experience, certifications, or degrees. Instead, we are seeking engineers who can show they have solved impressively hard problems, through past projects or GitHub contributions. We do require:

 - Expertise in Python.

 - A strong background in backend development, with comfort working across the stack where the work needs it.

items.desc:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. 

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.



We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in DACH. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across DACH.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

 - Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

 - Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

 - Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

 - Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

 - Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

 - Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

 - Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

 - Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

 - Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise

 - Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

 - Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

 - Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

 - Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

 - Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

 - Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For

 - 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

 - Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

 - Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

 - Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft Frontier Company implements Microsoft’s vision of an AI-first organization where people, processes, and technology are reimagined to unlock business value through innovation and productivity. Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) contributes by enabling customers adopt that vision though secure cloud foundations, AI transformation, modern workforce solutions, and industry-aligned innovation at scale. 
 As a Solution Architect in the Europe North Area, you will focus on understanding customer business drivers and their underlying technical requirements, act as a trusted advisor partnering with others to develop AI-first approaches, innovative solutions, and engineering standards in order to set our sales and delivery teams up for success. 
 Responsibilities 
 Business Development 
 Serve as delivery contact point and collaborates with peers and other teams for specific countries (e.g., Sales, account-aligned team) to plan and scale the business with existing high-stake or strategic customers, by articulating/developing value propositions and IP-reuse to drive innovation and AI-enabled transformation. Channel resulting opportunities to accelerate transformation and navigate the Frontier organization. 
 Pre-Sales Support 
 Collaborates in the pre-sale process with internal stakeholders (e.g., Architect, Industry Advisors, Pursuit Lead, Consulting Account Executive, CSU/STU teams) by providing technical guidance, translating business requirements, re-using IP to help shape the deal and influence budgetary estimates. Lead Solution Review Meeting (SRM). Develops proposals or statement of work (SOW). Directly engages customers and internal teams to influence closing the deal. 
Provides input on risks and staffing and skill requirements for delivery to Deal Approvers, Resource Deployment, and/or Project Managers.  
 Technical Delivery 
 Participates in project planning in projects by collaborating with other subject matter experts in identifying the current and future business value of planned solutions. Assesses technical and business risks in programs and develops mitigations. Manages their schedule and communicates with project leads. Generates and delivers Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).   
 Provides oversight and leadership on work streams or a partner team to implement solutions. Follows Industry Solutions processes in the implementation process and aligns solutions with the intent of the architecture and meeting customer/partner business goals.   
 Manages complex escalations, analyzes situations, and coordinates appropriate resources to resolve issues by following delivery practices, considering cost implications, and engaging in conversations with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., Customer Service and Support, Project Manager, Solution Architect, Product Group) as needed.  
 Proactively manages executive-level customer/partner/stakeholder relationships to identify and contribute to the drivers of satisfaction and dissatisfaction, determine the root cause, and establish recovery actions to improve the experience. Works with account team to ensure One Microsoft approach. Shares lessons learned with workgroup and consultant community.  
 AI-First Delivery 
 Drive excellence in delivery through standardized, repeatable delivery driving quality, speed and margin outcomes. Develop and enhance the AI first model. Treat AI as the default coworker, not an optional tool 
 Practice Development  
 Generates new and/or improvements to existing intellectual property. Connects gaps and patterns across business and technology areas to drive changes. Identifies which ideas should be culled, with consideration for scale across customers. Drives the re-use of intellectual property and recommends practices in both pre-sales and delivery. Participates and contributes to internal/external communities.   
 Trusted Advisor  
Develops a network of internal/external relationships with senior-level decision makers to build influence in addressing problems/blockers and facilitating additional views on the matter of interest. Acts as an advisor to external stakeholders. Provides direction to facilitate relationships between others. Stays up to date on Microsoft’s technologies, products, and services in order to communicate Microsoft's mission, strategy, and capabilities. When appropriate, develops a strategic relationship with key stakeholders within the customer portfolio, often as part of a steering committee, to ensure service delivery is on track and major issues are being anticipated, identified, and managed.  
Uses evidence-based arguments that articulate complex concepts in a simple manner to respectfully challenge Microsoft and customers/partners when a decision or course of action will not produce optimal results. Leverages strategic expertise to encourage alternative approaches where applicable. Serves as the "technical conscience" to challenge the status quo and unrealistic expectations. …

items.desc:
For us, it’s about high-tech manufacturing. For you, it’s about professional pride. 
 Join us on the road to shaping the future of mobility, where excellent teamwork meets advanced technology! At our plant in Debrecen, we don’t just assemble cars; we make dreams of modern driving a reality, launching the production of the fully electric Neue Klasse models. We are looking for colleagues who want to be part of the renewal of the BMW brand.
 As an Electrical Maintenance Technician at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you will play a key role in ensuring that the robotic production lines operate optimally. Through preventive maintenance, you’ll eliminate potential issues before they arise.
 Learn more about the maintenance area and the team: BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Karrier | Munkakörök | Karbantartás 
 What awaits you? 
 Work environment – a highly automated production line equipped with robots, where you’ll play a major role in setup and operation.
 Team – As part of a team of 8-10 members, you’ll participate in executing maintenance tasks.
 Troubleshooting – you’ll handle breakdowns, ensuring rapid restart of production equipment after unexpected downtime, and preventing future stoppages.
 Collaboration – you’ll collaborate with production team leaders and process technicians on maintenance, troubleshooting, and resolving production process issues.
 Maintenance – you’ll perform maintenance tasks, optimize production equipment, PLC programs, robots, and conveyor systems to prevent technical failures that could halt production.
 What should you bring along? 
 Education – A secondary-level qualification in electrical engineering, electronics, automation, or mechatronics.

 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet - Magasan automatizált, robotokkal ellátott gyártósoron dolgozol egy tiszta és rendezett munkakörnyezetben. 
 Minőség-ellenőrzés- Munkád során biztosítod a járművek külső felületeinek hibátlan állapotát, hogy azok megfeleljenek a BMW minőségi dokumentumaiban és a Minőségi Ellenőrzési tervekben foglalt követelményeknek.

 Gépek és berendezések használata- Végzel vizuális és tapintási ellenőrzéseket, beleértve a maszkolási és előkészítési feladatokat a festőműhelyben. 
 Folyamatminőség-ellenőrzés és beállítások elvégzése - Ellenőrzöd a folyamatok minőségét, és elvégzed a szükséges beállításokat a tervek és munkafolyamatok alapján. 
 Jegyzőkönyvek készítése - Dokumentálod elektronikusan a javítási tevékenységeket. 
 Folyamatos továbbképzés- Részt veszel a kiterjedt oktatási programunkban, amely felkészít a munkavégzésre. 
 Folyamatok optimalizálása- Fejleszted a gyártás minőségét, javaslatokat teszel a gyártás támogatása érdekében. 
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Iskolai végzettség- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel. 
 Munkatapasztalat- Rendelkezel legalább 1 éves tapasztalattal a festéssel és felületi sérülésekkel kapcsolatos hibák azonosításában és javításában az autókarosszérián. 
 Munkarend - Kész vagy több műszakban dolgozni. 
 Nyelvtudás - Anyanyelvi szinten beszélsz magyarul, egyéb idegen nyelvtudás nem szükséges. 
 Mérések elvégzése- Rendelkezel tapasztalattal a geometria, mérések és gépi forgácsolás területén, valamint használod a csiszoláshoz vagy polírozáshoz szükséges eszközöket és gépeket, különösen az autóiparban. Előnyt jelent, ha ismered a hegesztési eszközök használatát. 
 Precizitás és csapatmunka - Aprólékos figyelmet fordítasz a munkádra, miközben hatékonyan együttműködsz és kommunikálsz a csapattagokkal.

 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll:

 Bónusz - Vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónuszok. 
 Cafeteria - Éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással.

 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások - Magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban. 
 Magán egészségbiztosítás - Próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást.

 Kedvezményes étkezés - Napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében.

 Mint a BMW Group Gyár Debrecen Termelési Műszakvezető munkatársa az Energia Modul területén , kulcsfontosságú szerepet töltesz be abban, hogy a legújabb, hatodik generációs energia moduljainkba minden egyes alkatrész tökéletesen legyen beszerelve, ezzel garantálva, hogy a Neue Klasse modelljeink nagyobb hatótávval rendelkezzenek és jelentősen csökkenjen a töltési idejük. 
 Mi vár rád? 
 Munkakörnyezet – magasan automatizált, robotokkal ellátott gyártósor - melyeket a munkatársaink állítanak be, üzemeltetnek és tartanak karban a szükséges minőség biztosítása érdekében. 
 Csapat – 40-50 fős termelési csapat területvezetőjeként a csoportvezetőiddel együttműködve támogatod a csapatod az energia modul feladatainak végrehajtásában. Gondoskodsz a csapattagok képzéséről és mentorálásáról. 
 Vezetsz és inspirálsz - irányítod, képzed és fejleszted a csapatod, hogy kiemelkedő teljesítményt érjenek el, miközben támogató környezetet teremtesz. 
 Kézben tartod a termelést – felelős vagy a termelés irányításáért, a termékminőségért, mennyiségért és a karbantartási költségekért. 
 Biztosítod a megfelelőséget - gondoskodsz arról, hogy a megfelelő folyamatok végrehajtásra kerüljenek a jogi és belső követelményeknek megfelelően, beleértve a biztonságos munkavégzést, balesetek megelőzését, környezetvédelmet, tisztaságot és az ergonómiát. 
 Együttműködsz a társosztályokkal - kulcsszereplő vagy a belső partnerekkel való közös munkában, hogy biztosítsd a rendelkezésre állás megfelelő szintjét és megelőzd a technikai leállásokat. 
 Megtervezed a sikert - részt veszel a technológiai módosítások tervezésében és az új gyártóhelyszínek optimalizálásában. 
 Mit várunk tőled? 
 Iskolai végzettség – műszaki végzettséggel rendelkezel (diploma nem elvárás) gépész, villamos, mechatronikai, vegyipari vagy bármely gyártással kapcsolatos területen. 
 Munkatapasztalat – több éves termelés vezetői tapasztalatot szereztél hasonló pozíciókban, nagy műszaki tisztaságot igénylő munkakörnyezetben. 
 Munkarend – kész vagy 3 műszakban dolgozni. 
 Nyelvtudás – folyékony magyar nyelvtudással és középfokú angol nyelvismerettel rendelkezel. 
 Vezetői készségek - kiemelkedő vezetői tulajdonságok és készségek jellemeznek. 
 Mit kínálunk? 
 Célunk, hogy munkatársainkat motiváljuk és teljesítményüket elismerjük , ezért juttatási csomagunk az alapbéren felül az alábbi elemekből áll: 
 Bónusz - Vállalati és személyes eredmények alapján számított bónusz 
 Cafeteria - éves cafeteria keretösszeg havi folyósítással. 
 Munkába járás támogatása - ingyenes, a műszakbeosztáshoz igazított, közvetlen busz és vasút járatok a régió nagyvárosaiból. Gépkocsi használat esetén költségtérítés a munkába járáshoz. 
 Helyi képzések - szakmai és nyelvi képzések a debreceni gyárban. 
 Egészségügyi szolgáltatások - magas szintű egészségügyi szolgáltatások, fizikoterápia és gyógytorna lehetőség a debreceni gyárban található egészség központban. 
 Magán egészségbiztosítás - próbaidő után minden munkatársunk számára elérhető egészségbiztosítás, amely magában foglal járóbeteg szakellátást, labor- és diagnosztikai vizsgálatokat, ambuláns és egynapos sebészetet, szűrővizsgálatokat, betegszállítást. 
 Baleset és Életbiztosítás - munkaidőben és azon kívül is bekövetkező eseményekre csoportos baleset és életbiztosítás. 
 Kedvezményes étkezés - napi egyszeri támogatott árú melegétel a vállalati étkezdében. 
 Munkavállalói autóbérlési program 
 Tudj meg többet juttatásainkról ezen a linken: https://www.bmwgroup.jobs/hu/hu/about-us/our-benefits.html

 A BMW Group Gyár Debrecennél nagy hangsúlyt fektetünk az egyenlő bánásmódra és az esélyegyenlőségre. Toborzási és kiválasztási döntéseink a jelentkezők személyiségén, tapasztalatán és képességein alapulnak.

items.desc:
With its brands BMW, MINI and Motorrad the BMW Group is one of the world’s most successful premium manufacturers of automobiles and motorcycles as well as a provider of premium services for individual mobility. The engine for the intensity and attraction of our products and services is the passion of our employees.The CRM & Digital Specialist is responsible for developing and implementing strategies to enhance the customer experience across various digital touchpoints and platforms. This role requires a deep understanding of customer behavior, digital marketing best practices, and the ability to leverage data and analytics to optimize the customer journey.
 What awaits you? 
 Understanding sales targets, target groups, and brand values on a model level.
 Analyzing market and customer behavior development via repoting to derive the right measures in alignment with all involved functions along the customer journey, especially Marketing, Sales, and Customer Support.
 Acting as the central role in the triangle of market/agencies/Digital Hub in the field of website management.
 Designing, implementing and optimizing 1:1 campaigns
 Detailed monitoring of processes regarding CIM and improving performance by analysing various marketing KPIs.
 Steering, implementing, and improving Digital Commerce and Digital Channels projects.
 Overseeing initiatives such as Digital Vehicle Sales, the myBMW App, CCR Monitoring, the online stock locator, the digital checkout solution, and the vehicle booking service.
 Monitoring and supporting the dealer in managing of customer complaints as part of One Voice and customer surveys in order to achieve Bonus relevant targets and increase customer satisfaction.
 What should you bring along? 
 Bachelor's degree in Marketing or a related field.
 At least 3 years’ experience in Marketing or CRM/CIM.
 Experience in the automotive industry or luxury goods is considered an asset.
 Strong project management background.
 Passion for understanding and improving the customer experience.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
 Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce, Tableau, and marketing automation software is a plus.
 Highly motivated, assertive, autonomous, and possessing integrity.
 Strong motivation, assertiveness, sovereignty, integrity.
 Fluent in English and Greek language.
 What do we offer you? 
 With us, you are guaranteed to find challenging and versatile opportunities to actively shape the sustainable mobility of the future. In addition to the motivating working environment in our dynamic teams, we offer a wide range of benefits:
 Competitive benefits package including private health insurance.
 Competitive remuneration package including fixed bonus scheme.
 A flexible working environment.
 Are you interested?If the answer is yes, then do not miss the opportunity to apply and #shareyourpassion!✨ After the screening of all the CVs received, we will only contact the candidates who meet the requirements of the job to arrange an interview. All applications are considered strictly confidential.

items.desc:
Our Future is in Cars. Your Future is in Expertise. 
 Join us on the road to the future of mobility, where exceptional teamwork meets cutting-edge technology. At our plant, we don't just assemble cars; we turn dreams of modern driving into reality. Innovation, precision, and a strong team spirit drive us. We're committed to ensuring that every car we produce is of exceptional quality, aiming to create vehicles that offer an unparalleled driving experience. We focus on every detail, build on the passion for new ideas, and the power of collaboration. We are looking for colleagues who share our dedication. Your expertise, skills, motivation, and individuality will propel us forward. 
 As a Reworker at BMW Group Plant Debrecen, you play a key role in revolutionizing the way we think about driving. 
 What awaits you? 
 Work Environment – You work on a highly automated production line equipped with robots, which are set up, operated, and maintained by our team to ensure top-level quality. 
 Quality Control – You are responsible for ensuring that the vehicle’s exterior surfaces are flawless and meet BMW’s quality standards and inspection plans. 
 Troubleshooting and Diagnostics - You identify and correct paint and surface defects on the car bodies, ensuring they meet visual and tactile standards. 
 Use of Equipment and Tools – You carry out visual and tactile inspections, including masking and surface preparation tasks in the paint shop. 
 Process Quality Control & Adjustments – You mointor process quality and make necessary adjustments based on the plans and workflows. 
 Documentation – You document repair activities electronically following BMW's standards. 
 Continuous Training – You participate in our comprehensive training program to ensure you’re fully prepared for your role. 
 Process Optimization – You contribute to improving production quality and are encouraged to share suggestions that support continuous improvement. 
 What should you bring along? 
 Educational Background - You have successfully completed secondary vocational education. 
 Work Experience – You have at least 1 year of experience identifying and correcting paint and surface defects on automotive bodywork. 
 Work Schedule - You are willing to work in multi-shift operations. 
 Technical Knowledge – You have experience in geometry, measurements, and machining, and are familiar with tools and equipment used for sanding or polishing, especially in the automotive sector. Knowledge of welding tools is an advantage. 
 Precision & Teamwork – You demonstrate strong attention to detail and work effectively in a team environment with clear communication. 
 What do we offer? 
 Our goal is to motivate our employees and recognize their performance, which is why our benefits package includes the following elements in addition to the base salary: 
 Bonus - performance-based bonus calculated based on corporate and personal results. 
 Cafeteria - annual cafeteria allowance paid out monthly. 
 Commuting Support - free, direct bus and train services from major cities in the region, aligned with shift schedules. Travel cost reimbursement for personal car usage is provided at the legally prescribed rate. 
 Healthcare Services - high-quality healthcare services, physiotherapy, and therapeutic exercise option is available at the on-site health center. 
 Private Health Insurance - after probation time, all associates entitled for health insurance, which contains outpatient care, laboratory- and diagnostics tests, outpatient and one-day surgery, screening tests, patient transport. 
 Accident and Life Insurance - in work and out of work group accident and life insurance. 
 Subsidized Meals - one daily discounted hot meal at the company cafeteria. 
 Learn more about our benefits via this link: BMW Group Plant Debrecen Careers | About us | What we offer 
 At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. 
 Learn more here . 
 Build the future with us! 
 If you have any further questions, please contact our recruitment partner at +36 52 331 717 on weekdays between 8:00 AM and 4:30 PM. 
 Type of employment: 
 Full-time, permanent employment.

In the Apprentice
items.desc:
START WITH WHAT INSPIRES YOU. 
 We believe in creating an environment where you, our placement student, can learn and develop during your time with us and where you are given your own areas of responsibility from the start. Our experts and mentors will treat you as part of the team from day one, encouraging you to bring your own ideas to the table and giving you the opportunity to show what you can really do.
 Rolls-Royce Motor Cars is part of the BMW Group and its Goodwood manufacturing plant sits in the heart of the West Sussex countryside. The maxim of Sir Henry Royce, ‘take the best that exists and make it better’, permeates in everything we do at Rolls-Royce. As a student, you will have hands on experience from day one, gaining practical insights into the corporate operations of a world-class automotive manufacturer.
 Rolls-Royce Motor Cars, Goodwood – Future Talent Events Placement Year (July 2027)
 The Rolls-Royce Future Talent team is responsible for steering the training and development needs of all Intern, Graduates and Apprentices within our Goodwood office.
 In the Apprentice Training area, you will be part of the team to support with all aspects of apprentice onboarding, apprentice marketing and school events. You will develop and organise apprentice engagement activities. Over the course of the year, you will build the skills needed to plan and run apprentice events including recruitment Assessment Centres and Welcome Evenings.
 This is a fantastic opportunity, if you are excited about developing people, to gain first-hand knowledge, take responsibility for and further enhance the learning opportunities offered by the world’s leading premium automotive manufacturer.
 What awaits you? 
 Learn the spectrum of laboratory research in an agile environment.
 Develop testing plans with us, accompany us in carrying out and evaluating complex investigations and problem analyses in the areas of metals/non-metals as well as chemistry and process materials.
 Work on topics of the future and participate to shape them with us.
 Use the knowledge you have learned to interpret the results, generate recommendations and solutions, and learn to create test reports.
 Support in the development of test methods and the continuous improvement of existing test methods and get the opportunity to make a decisive contribution to the production of the future.
 Through daily contact with a wide range of process partners, you gain deep insights into various areas of the company and help shape them.
 Enjoy cross-site collaboration and communication with the plants and other TWA/laboratory locations.
 What should you bring along? 
 Study of materials science, chemistry, surface technology, plastics technology, mechanical engineering or scientifically based education and experience that are relevant to the professional role.
 Proven experience in a laboratory environment and practical experience with material analysis in the laboratory is desirable.
 Broad knowledge of production processes and BMW wider business to support technical knowledge is desirable.
 Analytical thinking, ability to work in a team, IT skills and a structured way of working.
 In-depth knowledge of problem resolution techniques and / or project management.
 Knowledge of Health and Safety and Environmental impacts.
 Valid UK driving license.
 What can you look forward to? 
 Great Pay – A competitive annual salary, 27 days holiday per annum (pro rata to your contract) and an attractive pension scheme.
 Rewarding Work-Life Balance 
 Exciting Additional Benefits – You will have the opportunity to enjoy other employee benefits, a subsidised on-site restaurant and access to our Advantages scheme which gives you a range of offers and discounts.
 What do you need to do now? 
 If you apply, the next stages of the recruiting process include an online assessment centre and then a face to face interview with the hiring manager.
 Please note: 
 To be eligible for this position, you must be returning to your studies, for a minimum of 6 months, after completion of this placement. You must be able to provide proof of your legal right to work in the UK. 
 We are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and job applicants will receive equal treatment regardless of disability, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, gender, sex or sexual orientation.
 At the BMW Group, we place great importance on equal treatment and equal opportunities. Our recruiting decisions are based on the personality, experience, and skills of the applicants. 
 Closing date for applications: Sunday 18th October 2026. 
 Any further questions? Email us on Recruitment-UK@bmwgroup.com

items.desc: Job Description Role Description This is not a consulting role. It is not a project delivery role. It is not a research position. A Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to make complex AI platforms work in real, messy organizational environments. You own outcomes: time-to-value, adoption, reliability, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes. The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated: AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role. Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry. Key Responsibilities Lead enterprise AI platform deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments — Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir — owning the full programme from architecture through adoption Own programme-level delivery outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability across multiple concurrent workstreams, with commercial metrics attached Lead rapid experimentation at pace: drive ambiguous business problems to working production systems in days or weeks across complex enterprise environments Architect and govern enterprise AI solutions across the full technology stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and multi-system workflow integration at programme scale Shape AI reinvention strategy for client CTO, CFO, and CISO: build value architecture, ROI backlogs, use case prioritisation frameworks, and multi-year AI adoption roadmaps Define and publish reusable reinvention blueprints, patterns, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the FDE practice Lead architecture design sessions, executive workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and C-suite leadership teams Codify delivery learnings, failure patterns, and engineering standards that shape the FDE practice and enable the next generation of forward deployed engineers Qualification Basic Qualifications Engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless). Deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments. Experience with AI platforms — OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models — including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines. Experience leading software engineering teams: overseeing delivery, allocating resources across workstreams, and owning the professional development of direct reports" Demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership in a client-embedded environment, internal projects, vendor labs, or team-only deployments do not qualify Proven ability to articulate business value: can quantify the impact of deployments in terms a CFO would recognize and act on Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders, CTO, CFO, or CISO level Non-linear profiles are expected and welcomed, assessment is based on demonstrated deployment experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching People lead responsibilities: experience managing, developing, and performance-managing a team of engineers; setting individual development plans and conducting career conversations # LI-MP Locations London Birmingham Additional Information Equal Employment Opportunity Statement All employment decisions shall be made without regard to age, race, creed, color, religion, sex, national origin, ancestry, disability status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, citizenship status or any other basis as protected by federal, state, or local law. items.desc: Graz, Austria Full-time Application and Product Development Onsite Tieto Tech Consulting Job Description If you enjoy exploring how systems behave, turning findings into improvements and combining manual testing with automation, you can help us build digital solutions people can rely on. We are looking for a Test Engineer who wants to be part of Tieto Tech Consulting. Tieto Tech Consulting works as a true partner, solving customers’ toughest technology challenges and delivering reliable outcomes that drive measurable results. By merging data, cloud, AI and design with deep industry expertise, we create impactful yet intuitive digital solutions that empower people and move businesses forward. With a global team of 8,000 colleagues and a team of 300 colleagues in DACH, we are constantly striving to develop and grow. Our customers trust in our solutions, which is why we are continuously looking for new talents. In this role, you will contribute across the testing lifecycle, from hands-on exploratory and manual testing to automation, API testing and CI/CD integration. You will work with colleagues across disciplines and help us explore practical ways to use AI in quality assurance. When joining Tieto Tech Consulting as a Test Engineer, you will design, perform and document manual tests with a clear focus on user needs and software quality develop, maintain and execute automated end-to-end tests across system and interface boundaries carry out interface and API tests and translate findings into clear, actionable insights integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and contribute to reliable delivery processes explore meaningful uses of AI in testing Who we are looking for Hands-on experience in software testing (manual and automated) An ISTQB Foundation Level certification; ISTQB Advanced Level is an advantage A structured and precise approach, combined with initiative, ownership and a pragmatic hands-on mindset Experience with performance and load testing as well as container and cloud environments (OpenShift, Azure) Experience with testing of event streams including message validation, producers/consumers, ordering and idempotency as well as non-functional testing: failover & disaster scenarios, monitoring & alerting verification Test Environment Management & Service Virtualization (Mocking, Stubbing) Excellent German skills at C1 level for customer and team communication Curiosity about technology and a genuine enthusiasm for testing You approach quality with curiosity and care, communicate openly, and enjoy solving problems together with others. With a structured, hands-on mindset, you take ownership while remaining eager to learn and share knowledge. We offer A culture built on trust, collaboration and continuous learning Flexible hybrid working models and modern ways of working Continuous professional development, knowledge sharing and international career opportunities A laptop and smartphone for private use, health programs, team events, food vouchers, excellent public-transport connections, a contribution towards the Austrian Klimaticket, fresh fruit and further local benefits The opportunity to work with experienced colleagues on meaningful projects while contributing your own ideas from day one The monthly gross salary for this full-time position starts EUR 3.954,00 in accordance with the Austrian IT collective agreement (ST1 “Regelstufe”). The final package will reflect your qualifications, relevant experience and current market standards. Did we get you inspired? Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, even if you do not meet every listed point. We value different perspectives, experiences and career paths, and would be happy to explore together whether this role and our team are a good match for you. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply when the opportunity feels right. If you have questions about the role or need reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please contact our recruitment team at careers.austria@tieto.com. Please be informed that we can’t accept applications via e-mail. We look forward to hearing from you. Locations: Vienna, Linz, Graz Additional Information At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity. items.desc: Scope of the Role Exosens/Advanced Imaging (Xenics NV) specializes in the research, development and industrialization of opto-electronic products: IR sensors, image intensifier tubes, camera platforms for visible light, night vision, industrial inspection, thermal inspection etc. The Product Release Group is a critical part of the R&D department. The group investigates a wide range of state-of-the-art image sensor and camera projects targeting a large variety of markets and applications and ensures the deliveries of the R%D design teams are ready-for- transfer to production and ready-for-sales, allowing a trustworthy transfer to the production department (manufacturing, supply chain, …). The team will work in close collaboration with many different teams including sensor, firmware, software, mechanical and optical design teams inside R&D, production and some key customers. The Product Release Group transfers the released products to Operations, for further industrialization and production. The Product Release Group consists of two sub teams: (i) Test and Measurement, and (ii) Systems Engineering. The Test and Measurement team is responsible for testing and fully qualifying the products made by the development groups in R&D. This activity includes scripting to facilitate and automate the tests. The team ensures that test and calibration approaches are available for small-scale production, including the definition of measurement methods, calibration procedures, and validation strategies required to demonstrate product performance. The Production Engineering group in the Operations department is responsible for industrializing, scaling, and optimizing these test and calibration solutions for volume manufacturing. The Systems Engineering activities ensure product readiness, ensuring complete validation, documentation and manufacturability demonstration, enabling a smooth transfer to production. (enabling transfer to production, allowing the Product Engineering Group inside the Operations Department to prepare production lines, initiate scaling and support production), 2nd line support in case design problems are identified in production or in the field, and management of Special Engineering Requests. The Product Release Team is the contact point for design-related issues reported by production or customers (issues caused by design flaws or by discrepancies with the product specifications) that cannot be handled by support or operations. The team troubleshoots issues, identifies root causes, and implements corrective actions or design modifications when the original product design is at fault. They also coordinate design improvements with the R&D teams to prevent recurrence. While the Product Release Team ensures the product design is corrected and robust, manufacturing processes, production yield, line capacity, and operational performance remain the responsibility of Production Engineering. We are looking for a (Senior) Systems Engineer for the Product Release Team to (i) assume ownership of an assigned group of products, (ii) ensure product are fully validated, documented, and ready for transfer to Operations and Production Engineering., and (iii) to become the go-to person in case of design issues identified by other departments. Objectives of the role As (Senior) Systems Engineer, your main responsibilities are Take in the designs/prototypes/… from the R&D design teams and ensure the product readiness (fully qualified, fully documented, ready for production. Successfully transferring the released products to the Operations department. Become a system-level expert in one or more products, as to ensure 2nd line troubleshooting (in case Operations identifies problems encountered in operations as due to design issues) Quality support to the FAEs As (Senior) Systems Engineer, you will Ensure product readiness for operations Ensure a formal “Definition of Done” is defined and agreed by the stakeholders at the beginning of the process Ensure the “definition of done is met before the transfer Documentation ready Fully tested (functional, environmental, reliability), including sensitivity analysis (the testing itself is to be done by T&M, the systems engineer will be involved to at least cross-check the test results). Troubleshooting instructions available Scripts where needed QCout guidelines (a subset of the troubleshooting instructions) Optionally QCin guidelines, especially if the components are sensitive Work description ready – focus on het “product”, so the description is for “small” volume” manufacturing, and the recipients are the production engineers who must translate this into a production line, and possibly scale the approach Description of calibration/… methods including scripts aimed at demonstrating the product All steps clear, e.g. how to calibrate/... the cameras Scripts available where needed (not adjusted for large volumes) Small number of units (2 or 3) made by the product release team to write …

items.desc: ABOUT POWER FACTORS Power Factors is a software and solutions provider leading the next generation of clean energy with Unity, one of the most extensive and widely deployed renewable energy management suites (REMS) in the market. With over 300 GW of wind, solar, and energy storage assets managed worldwide across more than 600 customers and 18,000 sites, Power Factors manages 25% of the world’s renewable energy data.* Power Factors’ Unity REMS supports the entire energy value chain, from monitoring and controls to market analytics. The company’s suite of open, data-driven applications empowers renewable energy stakeholders to collaborate, automate critical workflows, and make more informed decisions to maximize asset returns. Energy stakeholders receive end-to-end support, including solutions for SCADA & PPC, centralized monitoring, performance management, commercial asset management, and field service management. With deep domain expertise, AI-powered insights are delivered at scale so businesses can optimize assets, unlock growth, and make smarter decisions as the world rapidly transitions to clean energy. Power Factors fights climate change with code. Outside China and India ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for an Operations Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will be responsible for resolving issues in our production environment, triaging escalations, and proactively monitoring the systems and sub-systems that support our application services. You'll work as part of a tight-knit team with broad experience across the tech stack—each team member brings unique skills, and we all thrive as versatile technology generalists. WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING Maintain a thorough understanding of supported products and environments Create and maintain documentation for operational procedures and resolution of system alerts Perform change management for service and product configurations, provisioning, and commissioning Proactively monitor complex application and production environments Respond to system alerts via monitoring systems (email, mobile, etc.) Perform root cause analysis in collaboration with cross-functional engineering teams Take full ownership of reported issues from initiation through resolution Work closely with development teams to understand the application environment Collaborate with product management to understand application scope and impact Balance day-to-day operational responsibilities with longer-term operational projects Work with technologies such as Cassandra, MQTT, Docker, and Kubernetes WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL We believe you enjoy working in a purpose-driven organization and thrive in a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment. You’re resourceful, detail-oriented, and motivated by continuous learning and collaboration. Here's what we're looking for: Minimum of 2 years of experience in a similar role Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix environments Scripting proficiency in Bash and familiarity with common shell utilities Solid understanding of SQL, relational schema, joins, and sub-queries General understanding of networking concepts Proficiency in Python, Git, and Kubernetes Familiarity with Jira is a plus Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and Greek Collaborative mindset; able to work cross-functionally with technical and non-technical teams Attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to multitask and prioritize Willingness to support operations during off-business hours remotely, if needed LIFE @ POWER FACTORS We are an agile software development company – big enough to make an impact, but small enough to move quickly and adapt in a rapidly evolving industry. We are a team of bold and ingenious talents driven by results and a shared passion for building a better, cleaner world. We value fierce yet humble people who thrive in collaborative environments and bring creativity, flexibility, and dedication to their work. Sound like you? Join us. WHY JOIN US By joining the Power Factors team, you’ll be part of a dynamic group of innovative and driven individuals dedicated to making a positive impact. Every day, your work will directly contribute to advancing clean energy solutions and supporting global sustainability initiatives. Our culture runs deep and shows up in how we work together — committed, conscientious, and collaborative. With many opportunities for professional growth, Power Factors is here to support your development as we lead the charge in transforming the energy industry. WE ARE AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER Power Factors is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to engaging a diverse workforce and sustaining an inclusive culture. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

items.desc: Ready for a challenge? Then Just Eat Takeaway.com might be the place for you. We’re a leading global online delivery platform, and our vision is to empower everyday convenience. Whether it’s a Friday-night feast, a post-gym poke bowl, or grabbing some groceries, our tech platform connects tens of millions of customers with hundreds of thousands of restaurant, grocery and convenience partners across the globe. About this role We are seeking an enthusiastic Data Engineer to join our Partner and Sales data team. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in designing scalable solutions for the efficient use of big data within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) projects. Together with the team, you will be responsible for building and optimizing robust data pipelines and further scaling the measurement datasets to turn them into actionable insights - including pipelines that serve as the foundation for machine learning and AI use cases. Please note that this position is located in Amsterdam (3 days a week from our Amsterdam office and 2 days working from home) These are some of the key components to the position: Design, develop, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and a semantic layer on GCP, leveraging Airflow for orchestration and dbt for transformation and modeling. Design and implement dimensional data models (star and snowflake schemas) to organize and optimize data for analysis and reporting. Build AI-ready data pipelines and feature datasets supporting machine learning and analytical AI use cases. Leverage advanced SQL and Python to transform, optimize, and analyze large datasets across partner and sales domains. Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across the stack — operating within and contributing to established DQ frameworks, SLAs, and alerting systems. Collaborate closely with analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into robust data solutions. What will you bring to the team? Experience in data engineering or similar roles, with a track record of delivering production-grade data pipelines. Strong SQL and data modelling skills, including dimensional modelling concepts, paired with Python proficiency for building and automating data workflows. Hands-on experience with tools such as Airflow and dbt, and comfort with Git and CI/CD principles. Solid knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and its data-native services. Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered developer tooling and an interest in building data foundations that enable AI and ML use cases. A collaborative, solutions-oriented mindset with strong communication skills and a sharp eye for data reliability. At JET, this is how we play Our teams forge connections internally and work with some of the best-known brands on the planet, giving us truly international impact in a dynamic environment. Being the best at what we do isn’t just about delivering on our strategy. It's a competition for something incredibly valuable – our customers' choice. Every time a customer decides where to order, they're picking a side. At the heart of the JET Customer League are our values and behaviours. They guide every interaction, every decision, every innovation. These are the actions we need to perform consistently and brilliantly, to surpass the competition and earn our customers’ loyalty, again and again. Fun, fast-paced and supportive, the JET culture is about movement, growth, helping one another to succeed and celebrating wins. By truly living our values and embodying our behaviours, we’re building a customer-first culture which enables us to stay one step ahead of the competition. Inclusion, Diversity & Belonging No matter who you are, what you look like, who you love, or where you are from, you can find your place at Just Eat Takeaway.com. We’re committed to creating an inclusive culture, encouraging diversity of people and thinking, in which all employees feel they truly belong and can bring their most colourful selves to work every day. What else are we delivering? Want to know more about our JETers, culture or company? Have a look at our career site where you can find people's stories, blogs, podcasts and more JET journeys. Are you ready to join the team? Apply now! Recruiter LinkedIN tag: #LI-AO1
