items.card: Job Description As part of the team you will have the following responsibilities: Support ESA in completing the definition and final selection of the most appropriate operating model for the PM&C Academy; Support the implementation of approaches for the Awareness, Foundation, and Advanced learning levels, taking into account organisational, operational, logistical and resource considerations; Analyse the Academy
items.desc: Company Description HE Space is a successful international space company, specialised in providing managed services and human resources to the international space sector for over 40 years. We hire space experts all over Europe across the whole spectrum of space-related activities, from engineering to science, software development, operations, marketing, finance and administration. Our employees contribute towards a wide range of groundbreaking space programmes including Galileo and Copernicus, ExoMars, Iris2, ESA BASS, ESA GSPT, LISA Pathfinder, Euclid, the Ariane and Vega launchers as well as the International Space Station. HE Space has joined forces with CS Group and Sopra Steria to lead the engineering and digital space market in Europe and to provide highly skilled consulting. We are passionate about people and invest in you to support the development of the European space industry. Job Description As part of the team you will have the following responsibilities: Support ESA in completing the definition and final selection of the most appropriate operating model for the PM&C Academy; Support the implementation of approaches for the Awareness, Foundation, and Advanced learning levels, taking into account organisational, operational, logistical and resource considerations; Analyse the Academy objectives, governance framework, learning architecture and implementation roadmap established by ESA; Assess existing ESA learning and capability-development initiatives, relevant organisational practices, and available supporting infrastructure; Develop and document a minimum of two and up to three alternative operating models for the implementation and operation of the PM&C Academy; For each model, define and assess, as applicable: Training scheduling principles and delivery cadence; Delivery approach for Awareness, Foundation, and Advanced training levels; Roles and responsibilities of the involved stakeholders; Use of on-site, online and hybrid learning formats; Participant enrolment and administration mechanisms; Identify, document and assess the advantages, disadvantages, risks and opportunities associated with each model; Estimate the effort required from ESA and other stakeholders for each proposed model, including workforce implications, organisational impacts and operational support requirements; Develop objective comparison criteria enabling ESA to evaluate the proposed alternatives and perform trade-offs between the identified options; Support ESA during the evaluation and selection process and document the selected delivery model and associated implementation approach; Support the planning and coordination of Academy implementation activities across the different deployment waves; Prepare and maintain the Academy training schedule and associated delivery plans; Manage participant registration and enrolment processes; Coordinate communications with participants, trainers and stakeholders in preparation for training events; Support the organisation of launch and go-live activities for the different Academy deployment waves; Coordinate training logistics for: On-site training sessions; Online training sessions; Hybrid learning activities; Coordinate the deployment and availability of training resources, facilities and tools; Interface with ESA stakeholders, trainers and subject-matter experts to ensure readiness for training delivery; Support the collection and consolidation of attendance data and training participation metrics; Support monitoring and evaluation activities associated with Academy deployment. Qualifications Masters in Education or a relevant discipline; Minimum 4 years of relevant experience; Expertise in adult learning methodologies, instructional design, curriculum development, and the design and implementation of professional learning programmes and academy frameworks; Experience in the design, development and implementation of project management; Excellent communication skills; Fluency in English is mandatory; knowledge of another European language is an advantage. Additional Information This job is located in Noordwijk, Netherlands. If you think you have what it takes for this job, please send your CV (in English and in Word or PDF) quoting job NL-HP-26183 . An exciting and dynamic international working environment awaits you! Inclusive and committed employer, our company works every day to combat all forms of discrimination and promote a respectful working environment. That's why, committed to gender diversity and overall inclusivity, we encourage all applications and profiles. Last apply date: 01/11/2026!

items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients. Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities. What You’ll Do Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

items.desc: About the job As a Physical Design Engineer, you will play a key role in transforming advanced semiconductor designs into high-performance, manufacturable silicon products. Working at the heart of the chip implementation flow, you will drive critical physical design activities from floorplanning and power implementation through place-and-route, timing closure, physical verification, and final tape-out. This is a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology, solve complex engineering challenges, and influence the development of next-generation low-power semiconductor solutions. You will collaborate closely with talented design, architecture, verification, and silicon teams while helping shape future methodologies, automation flows, and AI-assisted design practices. If you are passionate about delivering high-quality silicon, enjoy tackling difficult technical problems, and want to see your work make its way into real-world products, this is the role for you! Key responsibilities Floorplanning activities, including macro placement, partitioning, and voltage area definition Develop and implement robust power distribution networks Execute Place & Route activities, including clock tree synthesis (CTS), congestion optimization, signal integrity improvements, and timing closure Perform comprehensive physical verification and signoff activities, ensuring designs meet foundry requirements and are ready for successful tape-out Analyze and optimize power integrity through IR-drop, electromigration, and reliability assessments, identifying and resolving issues that could impact silicon performance or long-term product reliability Drive ECOs and late-stage design optimizations, implementing efficient fixes while maintaining schedule commitments and achieving timing closure across all operating modes and corners. Support silicon bring-up and tape-out activities by providing physical design expertise, debugging implementation issues Contribute to the development and enhancement of physical design flows, automation scripts, and implementation methodologies to improve productivity, quality, and design scalability across future projects Key Qualifications BSc/MSc in Electronics Engineering or similar Several years of experience in chip implementation Experience of relevant Synopsys and Cadence IC implementation and signoff tools Contribution to flow development and setup Knowledge of scripting languages like TCL, Perl, Python or similar Experience using AI-assisted tools to improve design productivity (e.g. AI-driven EDA flows, code/script generation, debug assistance) Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English Personal Skills The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented engineer who thrives on solving complex technical challenges and takes pride in delivering high-quality silicon. With a structured and analytical mindset, you can navigate intricate physical design issues, balance competing priorities, and maintain focus on achieving demanding performance, power, area, and schedule targets. You enjoy digging into root causes, finding efficient solutions, and continuously improving design methodologies, flows, and tools. You combine independent ownership with a collaborative mindset, enabling you to drive tasks forward while contributing to a highly skilled and supportive team environment. Curious by nature, you embrace new technologies, including AI-assisted engineering tools, and are motivated by the opportunity to learn, innovate, and help shape the next generation of cutting-edge semiconductor products. Working for Nordic Working at Nordic, you will be inspired and supported to develop yourself. Our teams enjoy a professional and informal working environment. We value and encourage the continuous development of skills and expertise to the highest levels. We are proud of our Norwegian heritage, our highly skilled international workforce, and our world-leading innovation. We offer a variety of tasks and projects, and the possibility to work alongside some of the world’s most renowned experts within their field. We encourage our employees to question the established and innovate while expecting professionalism, commitment, and the will to learn. Benefits Competitive salary with short- and long-term incentive plan Flexible working hours Medical insurance Family-friendly policies, insurances, and benefits Practical details Location: Bristol, UK | Stockholm, Sweden | Tampere, Finland Please note that this position might be subject to a background check.

items.desc: VEHICLE SOURCING SPECIALIST – SELF-EMPLOYED Car Seekers As we look to expand and develop the vehicle sourcing side of Car Seekers , we are looking for 2 Vehicle Sourcing Specialists to join our strong, passionate and ambitious team. We're looking for people who can help us grow our sourcing network, bring new customers into the business and provide an excellent service to both their own customers and enquiries generated through Car Seekers. This is an exciting self-employed opportunity for someone who is passionate about cars, confident dealing with people and motivated by the opportunity to generate their own income. Whether you already have experience within vehicle sales, sourcing or the motor trade, or you're looking for an opportunity to build a career within the industry, we'd like to hear from you. Although this is a self-employed position, you won't be left to simply go it alone. You'll have the backing of Car Seekers, access to our premises, systems, sourcing platforms, customer enquiries and existing infrastructure, while having the flexibility to manage your own workload and develop your own customer base. WHAT IS VEHICLE SOURCING? Rather than simply selling vehicles already sitting on our forecourt, our sourcing service starts with what the customer actually wants . A customer may come to us looking for a particular make, model, specification, colour, budget or monthly payment. Your job is to understand their requirements, search the market, identify suitable vehicles and ultimately find them their perfect car . You'll manage that customer's journey from the initial conversation right through to the vehicle being sourced, prepared and handed over. THE ROLE As a Vehicle Sourcing Specialist, you will be responsible for: Responding to vehicle sourcing enquiries generated through Car Seekers. Developing and generating your own customer base and enquiries . Speaking with customers to establish exactly what vehicle they're looking for. Understanding their budget, specification and finance requirements. Searching the market and sourcing suitable vehicles. Presenting vehicle and finance options to customers. Negotiating and progressing potential vehicle purchases. Maintaining regular communication with customers throughout the process. Coordinating the preparation of vehicles once purchased. Liaising with our in-house workshop and cosmetic preparation providers. Managing the process through to the eventual customer handover. Delivering the 5-star customer experience that we expect at Car Seekers. SOCIAL MEDIA – AN IMPORTANT PART OF THE ROLE A good, positive and active social media presence is essential for this opportunity. We want our Vehicle Sourcing Specialists to build their own network of customers alongside handling enquiries generated directly through Car Seekers. Social media is a major part of achieving this. You'll be expected to actively and consistently use social media to promote: Vehicles you have sourced Vehicles available through Car Seekers Successful customer handovers The Car Seekers vehicle sourcing service Yourself as a Vehicle Sourcing Specialist You don't need thousands of followers or an existing automotive social media account. What matters is that you're comfortable being active online, engaging with people, promoting what you do and representing both yourself and the Car Seekers brand in a positive and professional way. If you're somebody who doesn't want to use social media or actively generate their own opportunities, this probably isn't the right role for you. SELF-EMPLOYED & FLEXIBLE WORKING This is a self-employed, commission-based position . Your earnings will be based on the vehicles you successfully sell, meaning your earning potential is uncapped . The more customers you develop, enquiries you generate and vehicles you successfully source and sell, the greater your earning potential. You'll also have flexibility in where you work. You can work: From the Car Seekers premises From home/remotely Or use a combination of both There is no requirement to work weekends . Our business does operate at weekends and you may choose to deal with customers or progress opportunities during these times, but weekend working is not compulsory as part of this self-employed opportunity. WHAT CAR SEEKERS PROVIDES Although you're self-employed, you'll have access to the infrastructure and resources of an established vehicle sales and sourcing business. We will provide: Access to all required vehicle sourcing and motor trade platforms Computer/laptop Office telephone Your own office/workspace at our premises Access to Car Seekers-generated sourcing enquiries Access to our established vehicle sourcing network Access to our in-house workshop Access to our vehicle cosmetic preparation network Training on our systems, processes and sourcing procedures Support from the existing Car Seekers team An established brand and business to operate alongside You'll therefore have the freedom and earning …

items.desc: Fuse Energy is an energy startup on a mission to make energy abundant and affordable, fast. We combine first-principles thinking with cutting-edge technology to build a radically better energy system. We've raised over $200M from top-tier investors including Balderton, Lakestar, Accel, Creandum, Lowercarbon, Ribbit, 20VC, Hummingbird and Collaborative Fund, alongside strategic angels including Nico Rosberg and GPs behind Meta, Revolut, Spotify and Uber. We're building a fully integrated energy company: developing our own solar, batteries and other generation projects, building our own hardware, improving and developing grid infrastructure, trading power in real time, using AI across the business, and installing distributed energy in homes. By selling directly to consumers we cut out the middleman, lower costs and pass the savings on to our customers. We’re currently searching for a Data Centre Design Engineer to join the team. In this role you will design the mechanical and electrical backbone of the next generation of AI data centres, working on high-density GPU infrastructure where the engineering challenges are among the hardest in the industry. You’ll own detailed design from the Basis of Design through to commissioning and handover, and build reference and modular designs that let us deploy rapidly and repeatedly across UK and international markets. We’re a fast-moving team that values hands-on builders over bureaucracy. If you want to see your work energised on site, not just on paper, this is the role. Responsibilities Lead detailed design of our data centre projects (mechanical or electrical, depending on background), including layouts, schematics, calculations, schedules and construction drawings Develop the Basis of Design and set our design standards, adapting them to local codes, utility requirements, site conditions and customer specifications across UK and international markets Challenge conventional approaches and develop innovative solutions for high-density GPU infrastructure that shorten time to compute Build reference designs, modular designs and engineering guides that make deployment rapid and repeatable Manage design changes, tracking decisions, open issues and impacts through to resolution Support site works, commissioning and handover as needed Requirements Experience in mechanical or electrical design in data centre or critical facilities environments, with working knowledge of the relevant systems (e.g. cooling, chillers and PUE/WUE for mechanical; MV/LV distribution, UPS, switchgear, generators and earthing for electrical) Experience across data centre design and construction stages, with an understanding of resilience and Tier levels Proven ability to produce detailed design, including calculations, schematics, single-line diagrams and construction drawings; AutoCAD/Revit, BIM and energy modelling or CFD experience desirable Familiarity with on-site construction, installation or commissioning work is desirable Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical or Electrical Engineering or a related discipline (or equivalent experience); chartered status is a plus Benefits Competitive salary and eligibility for equity Biannual bonus scheme Fully expensed tech to match your needs Private health insurance Breakfast and dinner allowance for office-based employees As we hire globally, benefits vary by location.

 Schimbă lumea de mâine împreună cu noi. 
 Unitatea noastră de afaceri Siemens Motion Control (DI MC) este unul dintre liderii mondiali în furnizarea de produse, sisteme, soluții și servicii în domeniul controlului mișcării. Aceasta include aproximativ 20.000 de angajați și patru segmente de business. Cu locații globale de producție, cercetare și dezvoltare (R&D) și servicii, MC este aproape de clienții săi și activă într-o gamă largă de industrii. 
 În rețeaua noastră de fabrici, Siemens AG dezvoltă și produce motoare electrice pentru piața globală. Clienții noștri țintă activează în domeniul tehnologiei de automatizare, în industria auto și în domeniul intra-logisticii. Pentru a susține creșterea noastră de succes, vom extinde locațiile noastre într-un mod direcționat în următorii ani. Digitalizarea și simulările ne sprijină în planificarea viitorului și în implementare. 
 In prezent cautam noi colegi pe rolul de Process Engineer care sa se alature echipei de Productie. 
 Atributii principale: 
 Asigură suport, conform cu legile și regulamentul în vigoare, în aria de producție pentru: executarea proceselor în condiții sigure, realizarea modificărilor/schimbărilor/optimizărilor echipamentelor, îndeplinirea condițiilor de calitate pentru procese, realizarea estimărilor de cost și a documentației aferente în cazul modificărilor/schimbărilor/optimizărilor echipamentelor și/sau dispozitivelor. 
 Îmbunătățire continuă a procesului din punct de vedere respectare termene, calitate și cost 
 Atributii specifice: 
 Responsabil pentru procesele din aria de lucru / centrul de cost aferent 
 Coordonează activitățile interne pentru furnizorii externi (ex: Optimizări, Programarea echipamentelor) 
 Estimări de costuri pentru optimizarea echipamentelor&proceselor 
 Supraveghează și îmbunătățește productivitatea, calitatea și profitabilitatea 
 Realizează și întreține documentele de producție și formularele standard (masters file), in SAP 
 Control activ pentru procesul de imbunătățire continuă în cadrul centrului de cost afererent 
 Realizarea (planificarea) și implementarea echipamentelor și respective a documentație aferente (echipament, dispozitiv, documentație și utilități) 
 Realizează și optimizează procesul de lucru (Process flow) & Kanban-ele din aria de producție 
 Analizează și rezolvă problemele de process/echipament 
 Responsabil pentru costurile de producție 
 Participă la ședințele de PFMEA 
 Cerinte 
 Studii tehnice de specialitate finalizate 
 Experienta min 3 ani 
 Cunoștințe bune de MS – office și SAP/R3 
 Cunostiinte ISO 9001, 
 Limba engleza avansat, germana avantaj 
 Abilitati de leaderschip 
 Ce iti oferim: 
 Pe lângă oportunități de muncă atractive, punem un accent deosebit pe un echilibru sănătos între viața profesională și cea personală; învățarea continuă și dezvoltarea angajaților noștri sunt foarte importante pentru noi – credem că acestea sunt cheia succesului nostru.

items.title: Data Scientist
items.card: About The Role You own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects with minimal guidance. You are a reliable, autonomous contributor with deep expertise in at least one of Samba’s core domains, identity and audience modeling, and the technical range to build production-ready solutions using modern machine learning (ML) and AI methods. You work closely with peers, product, and engineering. What You’ll Do
items.desc: Samba connects the advertising industry. Today, a trillion dollars of media flows through platforms that don’t talk to each other, and each one measures its own results. We built the independent alternative: consented first-party data and AI that give the world’s biggest advertisers, publishers, and platforms one clear view across all of it. The next era of advertising will run on AI agents, and those agents will need data they can trust. We’re building that foundation, and the agents that act on it. Join us and help build what the industry runs on. About The Role You own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects with minimal guidance. You are a reliable, autonomous contributor with deep expertise in at least one of Samba’s core domains, identity and audience modeling, and the technical range to build production-ready solutions using modern machine learning (ML) and AI methods. You work closely with peers, product, and engineering. What You’ll Do Own Delivery: Own end-to-end delivery of significant data science projects, from problem scoping and approach design through to production deployment. Decide and Document: Make sound, independent decisions on methodology, model selection, and evaluation, and document them in technical solution documents covering problem statement, approach, metrics, and timeline. Lead Solution Design: Lead solution design for your own initiatives, breaking epics into well-scoped user stories with clear acceptance criteria and applying DataOps and MLOps practices such as experiment tracking and model monitoring. Build ML Workflows: Implement advanced ML and AI-powered workflows, including entity resolution, probabilistic record linkage, embedding-based matching, semantic similarity, and large language model (LLM)-augmented pipelines. Build Shared Tools: Develop and maintain reusable tools, libraries, and documentation that raise team efficiency and technical standards, and give constructive, specific code review feedback. Partner Across Teams: Collaborate with product, engineering, and operations, translating business requirements into technical specifications, partnering with data engineering on scalable pipeline design, and joining cross-functional design reviews. What You Bring Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience; Master’s strongly preferred. 2+ years of hands-on data science experience, with a demonstrated ability to own and deliver complex, multi-sprint projects independently. Advanced Python (or another programming language) with production-quality code, testing, and documentation; strong SQL and PySpark for billion-row datasets. Databricks workflows, Delta Lake, and job orchestration (nice to have), plus working knowledge of Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Solid command of core ML (regression, classification, clustering, model evaluation, experimental design) on complex, high-volume data, with MLOps practices including experiment tracking and reproducible model deployment. Exposure to modern AI methods: retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems, LLM-augmented models, vector databases, and semantic search. A strong communicator and team player who turns technical work into clear documentation, user stories, and cross-functional conversations, and who can mentor junior data scientists and contribute to team standards. Samba is an equal opportunity employer. Your personal information We collect personal information directly from you when you apply. Where the law permits, we may also receive it from third parties, such as through background, employment, or reference checks. For details, see Samba’s Applicant Privacy Policy. For EU residents, Samba Inc. is the data controller. Use of AI in hiring We may use AI tools to help review applications, analyze resumes, or assess responses. These tools support our recruiting team. People make every hiring decision. To learn more about how we process your data, please reach out.

items.desc: About The Company Vbeyond is a leading technology solutions provider specializing in innovative cybersecurity, data analytics, and digital transformation services. With a commitment to delivering cutting-edge solutions, Vbeyond empowers organizations to safeguard their digital assets, optimize operations, and drive strategic growth. Our team of experts leverages advanced technologies and industry best practices to address complex security challenges and enable our clients to stay ahead of evolving cyber threats. Vbeyond prides itself on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment that encourages continuous learning and professional development. About The Role We are seeking an experienced Security Data Scientist to join our cybersecurity team at Vbeyond. In this role, you will be responsible for applying advanced analytics, data science, and machine learning techniques to address complex cybersecurity problems. Your primary focus will be on developing security analytics and Security Knowledge Graph capabilities to enhance threat detection, risk prioritization, and security decision-making processes. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the forefront of cybersecurity analytics, contributing to innovative solutions that protect our clients' digital environments. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a strong background in data science, machine learning, and cybersecurity. A minimum of 8+ years of relevant professional experience is required, along with advanced knowledge of statistical modeling, feature engineering, and analytical methods. Proficiency in Python and SQL, along with experience in developing threat detection and anomaly detection models, is essential. Candidates should have hands-on experience working with security telemetry, threat intelligence data, and graph analytics. Certifications such as data science, machine learning, or cloud AI certifications, along with security certifications like CISSP or Security+, are highly desirable. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills are also critical for success in this role. Responsibilities Develop and implement machine learning and statistical models aimed at threat detection, anomaly detection, and security risk analytics. Design features and analytical methods utilizing security telemetry, threat intelligence, and enterprise data sources. Build and leverage Security Knowledge Graphs to connect entities, events, vulnerabilities, and attack paths, enhancing contextual understanding of security incidents. Evaluate model performance, including accuracy, bias, explainability, robustness, and operational effectiveness, to ensure reliable deployment. Collaborate with security analysts and engineering teams to productionize analytical use cases, ensuring seamless integration into security operations. Conduct exploratory data analysis and communicate insights through clear visualizations and compelling narratives to facilitate strategic decision-making. Establish and maintain data science standards, experimentation methodologies, and model monitoring practices to ensure ongoing reliability and performance. Support the responsible and secure use of AI within cybersecurity operations, adhering to ethical standards and best practices. Benefits Vbeyond offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the well-being and professional growth of our employees. This includes competitive salary packages, health insurance, retirement plans, and paid time off. We also provide opportunities for continuous learning through training programs, certifications, and participation in industry conferences. Our collaborative work environment encourages innovation and knowledge sharing, fostering a culture where employees can thrive and make meaningful contributions. Additionally, Vbeyond emphasizes work-life balance and flexible working arrangements to accommodate individual needs. Equal Opportunity Vbeyond is committed to creating an inclusive environment where diversity is valued and all employees are treated with respect and fairness. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, ethnicity, gender, age, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and excellence, and we actively promote a culture of equity and inclusion throughout our organization.

items.desc: Helping ideas grow ¿Te apasiona impulsar el cambio y dar forma al futuro a través de la innovación? En FI Group, buscamos mentes estratégicas y con visión de futuro que prosperen resolviendo problemas complejos y convirtiendo las ideas en soluciones efectivas. FI Group es una consultora con más de 25 años de experiencia en la financiación de proyectos de innovación y desarrollo. Se caracteriza por un equipo profesional, cercano y ágil, comprometido con la innovación y el crecimiento sostenible. Recientemente, FI Group se ha integrado en EPSA Group, una consultora europea líder en rendimiento financiero, operativo y medioambiental, presente en 40 países con más de 5.000 profesionales. Esta integración permite a FI Group acceder a una red global de 1.800 expertos en 20 países, apoyando a más de 19.000 clientes. El objetivo conjunto es convertirse en el líder mundial en financiación de la innovación y contribuir al progreso tecnológico, económico y medioambiental. En FI Group by Epsa estamos buscando un/a Consultor/a de Automatización e IA Aplicada . ¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? Analizar necesidades de negocio y diseñar soluciones tecnológicas que permitan automatizar procesos intensivos en gestión documental y tratamiento de información. Extraer, estructurar y cruzar datos procedentes de documentos, bases de datos, ficheros Excel y otras fuentes corporativas. Desarrollar soluciones en Python para automatizar procesos de captura, transformación, validación y explotación de datos. Implementar soluciones basadas en OCR, IA Generativa y modelos de lenguaje para extracción de información, clasificación documental, análisis de contenido y generación de informes. Diseñar flujos de automatización e integración entre aplicaciones, bases de datos, herramientas documentales y servicios de IA. Realizar procesos de captura automatizada de información mediante APIs, conectores o web scraping cuando sea necesario. Identificar oportunidades de mejora operativa y proponer soluciones que reduzcan tareas manuales, mejoren la calidad de la información y generen impacto en negocio. Dar soporte técnico y funcional a los equipos de negocio en la adopción de nuevas herramientas y automatizaciones. ¿Qué buscamos? Requisitos imprescindibles Experiencia en automatización de procesos, tratamiento de datos y resolución de problemas de negocio mediante tecnología. Dominio de Python para procesamiento de datos, automatización, integración con APIs y desarrollo de soluciones basadas en IA. Experiencia en extracción y explotación de información procedente de documentos y fuentes de datos heterogéneas. Conocimiento de IA Generativa y modelos de lenguaje como OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Azure OpenAI o similares. Capacidad para diseñar scripts, aplicaciones y flujos de automatización orientados a negocio. Perfil analítico, resolutivo y orientado a la eficiencia operativa. Valoraremos especialmente: Experiencia en OCR e inteligencia documental. Conocimientos de RAG, embeddings, búsqueda semántica o agentes de IA. Experiencia con Power Automate, n8n u otras herramientas de automatización. Experiencia en web scraping y captura automatizada de información. Uso de herramientas de desarrollo asistido por IA como Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot o similar. ¿Qué beneficios tendrás? Queremos que estés a gusto y ser más que un trabajo para ti. Para hacerlo posible tenemos un pack de beneficios sociales adaptados a tus necesidades: 🌟 Un ambiente de trabajo vibrante y colaborativo, rodeado de un equipo joven y dinámico que apoya tu crecimiento profesional. 🚀 Únete a una empresa líder en el mercado en continua expansión, con emocionantes oportunidades de desarrollo profesional. 🕓 Disfruta de un horario flexible, con jornadas reducidas los viernes y durante el verano. 🎓 Planes integrales de capacitación y desarrollo para ayudarte a desarrollar tus habilidades y avanzar en su carrera. Conciliación y flexibilidad. Modelo de trabajo híbrido, jornada flexible cada día y jornada intensiva los viernes y en verano. 🍽️ Bolsa de retribución flexible: Elige si quieres utilizarlo para ticket restaurant, ayuda transporte, ayuda guardería o seguro médico. 💼 Paquete de compensación altamente competitivo, alineado con tu experiencia y tu contribución. ¿Interesado/a? ¡Nos encantaría conocerte! ¡Aplica ahora o no dudes en ponerte en contacto con nosotros directamente si tienes alguna pregunta! F. Iniciativas España I+D+i, S.L.U le informa que sus datos han sido incorporados a un fichero automatizado con la finalidad de avanzar en los procesos de selección. Los datos recogidos son almacenados bajo la confidencialidad y las medidas de seguridad legalmente establecidas. Igualmente deseamos informarle que podrá ejercer sus derechos a través del siguiente correo electrónico: rgpd@fi-group.com Para conocer nuestra política de privacidad en mayor detalle pinche https://es.fi-group.com/politica-de-privacidad/

items.desc: Fundada hace 16 años por Stanford Alumni, Bravo se ha convertido en un actor destacado en el panorama financiero, ofreciendo soluciones crediticias a consumidores sobreapalancados que se encuentran en dificultades. Tenemos operaciones en seis países diversos: México, Colombia, España, Italia, Portugal y Brasil. Nuestro viaje se define por un compromiso incesante de capacitar a las personas para que paguen sus deudas y recuperen la libertad financiera. Nuestro compromiso con la excelencia y el trabajo duro nos ha llevado a un historial de crecimiento sostenido de dos dígitos durante la última década, posicionándonos como líderes en la industria. A partir de 2023, gestionamos más de 600 millones de euros de deuda de clientes, brindando a las personas la orientación que necesitan para pagar sus deudas de manera efectiva. Seguimos estableciendo objetivos ambiciosos para el futuro mientras buscamos crecer más de 3 veces en los próximos cinco años ampliando nuestros mercados actuales y expandiéndonos a otras geografías. ¿A quién buscamos? Queremos gente apasionada por los datos, los nuevos retos y que disfrute resolviendo problemas complejos de negocio. Buscamos personas curiosas, organizadas, atentas al detalle, proactivas y con alta tolerancia a la frustración , capaces de hablar tanto con el equipo técnico como con la dirección. Formación: Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Ciencia de Datos, Ingeniería (Industrial, Informática, Telecomunicaciones), Economía o carreras afines con fuerte base cuantitativa. Herramientas clave: Dominio de SQL y fundamentos de programación en Python o R . Soltura en herramientas de visualización ( Power BI, Tableau o similares ) y un uso avanzado de Excel. Mindset: Interés genuino en aprender sobre modelado estadístico, Machine Learning y automatización de flujos de trabajo. La experiencia previa es valorable, pero no indispensable. ¡Lo que más nos importa es tu curiosidad analítica y que nos muestres lo que sabes hacer (proyectos propios, GitHub, competiciones de Kaggle o tu TFG)! ¿Qué harás? Extracción y limpieza de datos (ETL): Recopilarás, estructurarás y validarás la calidad de la información comercial proveniente de distintas fuentes para prepararla para su análisis. Análisis Exploratorio: Buscarás patrones, correlaciones y tendencias ocultas en los datos para responder a preguntas estratégicas del negocio (ej. ¿por qué un producto funciona mejor en una zona que en otra? ). Data Storytelling: Traducirás modelos y análisis complejos en conclusiones visuales, claras y accionables para la Gerencia y Dirección. Ecosistema de BI: Diseñarás, automatizarás y mantendrás vivos los dashboards de control del área, garantizando que el dato sea único y fiable. Innovación analítica: Propondrás mejoras en los procesos de reporting y lanzarás pequeñas pruebas de concepto de analítica avanzada (ej. modelos de segmentación de clientes o predicción de ventas). ¿Qué ofrecemos? Nuestro horario es de L-V de 10.00 a 19.00 y estamos ubicados en una de las mejores zonas de Madrid (Calle Velázquez) para que disfrutes también de todo lo que ofrece el barrio (tiendas, cafeterías, restaurantes, bares...). Tendrás un contrato indefinido a tiempo completo y oportunidades de crecimiento dentro del equipo. Al incorporarte a nuestra empresa optarás a grandes beneficios como acceso a Wellhub, disponer inmediatamente del salario generado a través de Payflow y descuentos con otras de nuestras empresas partners en alimentación, formación, descuentos en compras, etc. Adicionalmente podrás disfrutar del día a día de nuestro ambiente joven, multicultural y dinámico en el que aprender y crecer en tu camino profesional. También contarás con una formación especializada para enseñarte todo lo que necesitas para el puesto de trabajo, y además nos encantará que te apuntes a todas nuestras actividades como los famosos afterwork, equipo de fútbol, celebración de fiestas y eventos en la ofi o incluso las que tú quieras implementar! ¡En Bravo estamos emocionados de recibir tu candidatura y descubrir cómo puedes contribuir a nuestro crecimiento!

items.desc: DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk. Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets. We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus. We are looking for a Quantitative Trading Analyst (QTA) to join a volatility-focused trading team. This role is ideal for candidates with 1–2 years of experience in trading, quantitative research, market making, or systematic strategies who are interested in applying quantitative thinking to volatility markets. Prior experience across a variety of asset classes is welcome — including equities, rates, credit and FX. What You’ll Do Analyze, improve and implement trading strategies Develop and maintain quantitative models, analytics, and trading tools Analyze large datasets to identify market opportunities, inefficiencies, and risk exposures Actively manage live market trading algorithms Provide liquidity in options via systematic algos and voice in IDB markets Conduct research into volatility dynamics, pricing, and market microstructure Collaborate with technology teams to improve trading infrastructure and automation Support new product and market expansion initiatives across asset classes What We’re Looking For 1–2 years of experience in trading, quantitative analysis, research, or a related role Strong academic background in mathematics, physics, computer science, engineering, or a similarly quantitative discipline Excellent quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills Strong understanding of probability, statistics, and market behavior Proficiency in Python; experience with SQL, R, or C++ is a plus Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in financial markets and volatility products Ability to work in a fast-paced, collaborative environment Strong communication skills and attention to detail Experience working with derivatives or volatility products Familiarity with options pricing, Greeks, or volatility surface analysis Experience handling large market datasets or building research pipelines For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice. California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice. []

items.desc: SIX is building a dedicated Tech & Data capability within the Marketing & Communications (CMC) department, with the ambition to measure and steer marketing investment end-to-end: marketing mix modelling, multi-touch attribution and ROMI, operated in-house on the enterprise Databricks platform. Reporting to the Head Tech & Data Marketing & Communications, the Marketing Data Scientist owns the models themselves. The capability is built together with an implementation partner — this role is embedded in the modelling workstream from the first sprint and takes over the run: refresh, calibration, evolution. From day one it also shapes the methodological route, choosing where transparent contribution rules suffice and where advanced modelling earns its complexity. This is an opportunity for an applied data scientist who wants ownership of a full modelling stack in production, in a B2B environment with long sales cycles, buying committees, and a regulated context that takes explainability seriously. What You Will Do Build and operate marketing mix models (Bayesian / econometric) quantifying channel and brand contribution across business units Build and operate account-level multi-touch attribution (MTA) models designed for long B2B cycles, buying committees and in-flight opportunities Design and run incrementality and geo-lift experiments; use them to calibrate and challenge the models Develop personalization, propensity and further applied-AI models feeding segmentation, targeting and next-best-action use cases Own model refresh, monitoring, calibration, documentation and explainability to finance-grade and regulatory standards Work hands-on in the ML environment (MLflow, model serving, AI endpoints); embed with the implementation partner's model squad and own the handover Translate model outputs into scenario planning and budget optimisation together with the CMC Measurement & Insights Lead What You Bring A strong applied data-science background: Bayesian methods or econometrics, causal inference, time-series modelling Hands-on experience with marketing mix modelling and/or attribution modelling in production; B2B context a plus Solid engineering craft: Python, PySpark and ML lifecycle tooling on Databricks or a comparable platform Experience designing experiments: control groups, geo tests, incrementality measurement The discipline to document and explain models to non-technical stakeholders in a regulated environment The judgement to keep it simple where simple wins — transparent rules first, complexity where it demonstrably adds value Experience embedding AI agents into business processes — designing, building and evaluating agentic workflows (e.g. on Databricks AI gateway and endpoints) beyond classic modelling What We Offer Hybrid model up to 40% working from home Private Medical care and life insurance Meal, transportation and electricity allowance Sport card Cinema tickets, Benefit System points Up to 20 days working from abroad / Day for U Access to technical and language learning platforms

items.desc: Data & AI Consultant ﻿ Ben jij toe aan een nieuwe stap in je carrière? Een waar je jouw opgedane ervaring in Business Analyse bij complexe vraagstukken inzet? Denk je nu twee keer ‘Ja!’? Dan zoeken we jou. Doel van de functie Jij vertaalt data naar impact. En AI naar iets dat werkt. Als Data & AI Consultant (medior) voer je zelfstandig analysetrajecten en AI-trajecten uit bij uiteenlopende klanten. Je combineert technische kennis van Python, SQL en Power BI met een scherp gevoel voor de businessvraag achter de data. En je weet wanneer een AI-agent het antwoord is — en wanneer een goed dashboard gewoon sneller klaar is. Je bent aanspreekbaar op kwaliteit en resultaat, begeleidt junior collega’s waar nodig en helpt het team vakinhoudelijk vooruit. Wat ga je doen? Data-analyse en datapipelines • Je voert end-to-end analysetrajecten uit: van de vraag achter de vraag tot analyse, interpretatie en aanbeveling. • Je ontwerpt en bouwt de pipeline eronder: bronnen ontsluiten via een API, transformeren in Python en SQL, en het geheel laten draaien — lokaal of op een server. • Je bouwt datamodellen en KPI-structuren die aansluiten op de doelen van de klant, en legt definities zo vast dat iedereen hetzelfde bedoelt. AI-agents die echt meedraaien • Je bouwt AI-agents die vragen beantwoorden uit de systemen van de klant, documenten doorzoeken of terugkerend werk overnemen. • Je koppelt die agents aan echte bronnen — een ERP, een financieel pakket, een documentbibliotheek — en bewaakt wat ze wel en niet mogen zien. • Je controleert de kwaliteit van de antwoorden. Een AI die er soms naast zit is geen collega, maar een risico. Dashboards waar mensen op sturen • Je bouwt schaalbare dashboards in Power BI en vertaalt complexe datastructuren naar beelden waar een MT een besluit op durft te nemen. • Je werkt mee aan ClearInsights, ons eigen dashboardproduct. • Je adviseert klanten over de inrichting van hun BI-omgeving en rapportagestructuur. Klant en team • Je bent het aanspreekpunt binnen jouw trajecten en stuurt actief op verwachtingen. • Je faciliteert werksessies en presenteert je bevindingen aan mensen die geen SQL schrijven. • Je deelt wat je leert: tijdens een Helder Lunchmoment, in de kennisbank, of gewoon naast de koffieautomaat. Wat breng jij mee? Vakinhoudelijk • Minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in data-analyse of BI. • Sterke beheersing van Python (Pandas, NumPy) en SQL. • Je ontwerpt en bouwt zelfstandig een datapipeline: bronnen ontsluiten via een API of via MCP, data transformeren, en het geheel laten draaien. Lokaal of op een server. • Je bouwt zelfstandig dashboards in Power BI. • Ervaring met datamodellering en data governance. • Nieuwsgierigheid naar AI. Heb je al iets gebouwd met taalmodellen? Mooi. Heb je vooral veel vragen? Ook prima — als je maar wilt weten hoe het onder de motorkap werkt. • Uitstekend Nederlands en goed Engels, mondeling en schriftelijk. Persoonlijk • Analytisch scherp én communicatief sterk. • Zelfstandig en resultaatgericht: jij levert af. • Klantgericht: je snapt de businessvraag vóórdat je de data induikt. • Je snapt bedrijfsprocessen en ziet waar data en organisatiestrategie elkaar raken. • Proactief: je ziet kansen zonder dat iemand erom vraagt. • Kritisch en nauwkeurig. Zeker bij AI, waar een antwoord er overtuigend uit kan zien en toch fout is. • Samenwerkingsgericht, met oog voor het grotere plaatje. 5. Opleiding en werkervaring Vereist • Hbo+- of wo-opleiding in Data Science, Business Intelligence, Informatica, Econometrie, Bedrijfskunde, Informatiekunde of een verwante richting. • Minimaal 2 jaar aantoonbare ervaring in een data-analyse- of BI-rol, bij voorkeur in een consultancy- of klantgerichte omgeving. • Je hebt zelf een datapipeline of dataproduct gebouwd dat daadwerkelijk in productie draaide — niet alleen op je laptop. • Je voert zelfstandig end-to-end trajecten uit en presenteert de uitkomsten aan stakeholders. Pré • Ervaring met AI-toepassingen: taalmodellen aansturen via een API of via MCP, prompts ontwerpen, of een agent koppelen aan bedrijfsdata ( retrieval : de agent zoekt eerst het juiste stuk informatie op en beantwoordt daarna pas de vraag). • Ervaring met het opzetten en beheren van je eigen server. Een VPS bij Hetzner of vergelijkbaar, Linux, Docker, een reverse proxy, certificaten en backups. Wij draaien onze eigen omgevingen precies zo. Wie dat zelf een keer heeft opgezet, weet meteen waarom dat scheelt in kosten én in wat je mag beloven over waar data staat. • Ervaring met Azure, AWS of Google Cloud data-diensten (Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, BigQuery en vergelijkbaar). • Kennis van ETL-processen, datapijplijnen of datawarehousing. • Certificering in Power BI (PL-300) of een verwante Microsoft-certificering, zoals DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) of DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer). • Ervaring met Agile of Scrum in data- of IT-projecten. Wat biedt SkyClear jou? • Een zelfstandige rol met directe impact bij gevarieerde, uitdagende klanten. • Je bouwt …

items.desc: Être militaire, c’est servir l’État, au sein des Armées, en portant l’uniforme. Cela implique discipline, disponibilité et loyauté. Le sens de l’adaptation et le goût de l’effort sont des qualités indispensables. Être officier, c’est être en situation de responsabilité, en particulier auprès du personnel placé sous ses ordres. Cela suppose d’avoir le sens de l’humain et une certaine forme d’exigence vis-à-vis de soi-même. CDE/BNUM TOULOUSE Le Commandement de l’Espace (CDE) a été créé le 3 septembre 2019 pour améliorer l’efficacité opérationnelle, la cohérence, la visibilité et la simplicité de l’organisation et de la gouvernance du spatial de défense au sein du ministère des Armées. Il présente la particularité d’être à la fois un commandement de l’armée de l’Air et de l’Espace et un commandement interarmées. Il comprend à ce titre du personnel de l’armée de l’Air et de l’Espace, de l’Armée de terre, de la Marine Nationale, de la direction générale de l’armement (DGA) et du service du commissariat des armées (SCA). Le CDE reçoit ses directives fonctionnelles du chef d’état-major des armées (CEMA) pour les opérations et la politique spatiale militaire, notamment les capacités spatiales militaires, les coopérations internationales, tandis que le chef d’état-major de l’armée de l’Air et de l’Espace (CEMAAE) en exerce le commandement organique. Porteur de l’expertise spatiale militaire du ministère, le CDE conseille le CEMA ainsi que tous les organismes du ministère ou extérieurs au ministère sur les questions spatiales militaires. En coopération avec de nombreux acteurs, il contribue ainsi à la définition de la politique spatiale militaire et la met en œuvre. Il conduit par ailleurs les opérations spatiales militaires. Jeune commandement original dans sa forme et ses responsabilités, le CDE incarne la mise en œuvre de la stratégie spatiale de défense, sous la double autorité du CEMA et du CEMAAE, et joue un rôle essentiel dans la montée en puissance du spatial de défense, avec l’ensemble des acteurs au premier rang desquels le Centre National d'Etudes Spatiales (CNES).Les postes disponibles concernent les CDE, CDAOA et CTAAE. POSTE Les bureaux du numérique sont les relais du quotidien auprès des métiers de l’Armée de l’Air et de l’Espace. En tant que data analyst vous serez un appui de proximité auprès des métiers et des opérationnels. Vous travaillerez en lien avec le centre spécialiste de la donnée de Mont-de-Marsan qui concentre les expertises techniques sur la donnée (data scientist, engineer, architecte, etc.) notamment pour le développement des projets complexes. Vos missions au sein des équipes : Collaborer avec des profils métiers pour définir les besoins en matière d’analyse de données et d’IA. Rédiger des spécifications techniques et fonctionnelles. Collaborer avec les référents des systèmes d’information et les data owners pour recueillir les données et faire le lien avec les objets métier. Développer et maintenir des rapports issus de croisements de données de sources diverses, et des tableaux de bord d’aide à la décision. Assurer la gestion du changement et accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles technologies et processus. Contribuer à la vigilance sur la sécurité des données et à la gouvernance des données. Lors du développement d’un projet data, au sein d’une équipe data pluridisciplinaire : Participer aux phases de modélisation de données et de développement des chaînes de traitement. Contribuer à la mise en place de modèles de Machine Learning / IA. Mettre en place des tests unitaires et des processus de supervision des chaînes de traitement. Suivre et évaluer les résultats des projets numériques et apporter les ajustements nécessaires. CONDITIONS PARTICULIÈRES : Vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la donnée. DIPLÔME – FORMATION : Vous justifiez d’un bac+5 ou équivalent dans le domaine de l’informatique, des systèmes d’information ou de la donnée. COMPÉTENCES SPÉCIFIQUES REQUISES : Expertise en BI et maîtrise d’un outil de data visualisation (Tableau, Qlikview, PowerBI) Maîtrise des tests et méthodes statistiques (segmentation, régression, forêt aléatoire…) ; Maîtrise des langages SQL et python ; la connaissance d’un outil de webapp est un plus. Expérience sur des plateformes d’analyse de données et ETL (idéalement Talend, Dataiku, Qlik) ; Connaissance des systèmes Unix / Linux ; Connaissance des exigences en matière de sécurité des données et pratiques de gouvernance QUALITÉS RECHERCHÉES : Vous êtes autonome, proactif, disponible et rigoureux ; Vous êtes proche des métiers et vous vous intéressez au contenu métier des données et aux processus qu’elles reflètent ; Vous êtes curieux et savez faire preuve de créativité ; Vous avez le sens de la synthèse et de la visualisation de données ; Vous êtes capable de travailler aussi bien avec les métiers qu’avec les équipes techniques spécialisées data. Det gör myndigheten genom att utveckla och stödja samhällets arbete med att främja hälsa, förebygga ohälsa och skydda mot hälsohot. Vår vision är en folkhälsa som stärker samhällets utveckling. Vi söker nu två utredare. Vill du analysera data som gör skillnad för folkhälsan? Då har du möjlighet att använda din kompetens hos oss. Läs mer och ansök redan idag! Vad ska du jobba med? Som utredare hos oss ger du statistiskt stöd till projekt inom hela myndigheten. Du jobbar tillsammans med ett tiotal andra statistiker och har möjlighet att diskutera praktiska och metodmässiga frågeställningar med dina kollegor på veckovisa möten med statistikerna. De analyser du kommer arbeta med baseras huvudsakligen på registerdata och stora enkätundersökningar I arbetet ingår att förbereda data, välja lämpliga analysmetoder, genomföra och validera analyser samt sammanställa och presentera resultat. Du har också möjlighet till kompetensutveckling inom statistikområdet. Utöver detta ingår även andra sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter för utredare på myndigheten, såsom administration och att delta i möten. Vem söker vi? Krav För Anställningen Avslutad högskoleutbildning på kandidatnivå med inriktning mot statistik, matematisk statistik eller biostatistik, alternativt annan utbildning som myndigheten bedömer relevant. Minst två års erfarenhet av självständig programmering i R, efter avslutade studier. Goda kunskaper i svenska samt engelska, i såväl tal som skrift. Mycket Stor Vikt Läggs Vid Utöver det ser vi dessa kompetenser, förmågor och erfarenheter som viktiga för att du ska trivas hos oss: Minst två års praktisk erfarenhet av statistiskt analysarbete inom biostatistik, epidemiologi, folkhälsa eller medicinsk forskning, efter avslutade studier. Kunskap i SAS-programmering. Erfarenhet av att analysera och hantera data från svenska hälsodataregister och befolkningsregister Personliga egenskaper såsom att vara ansvarstagande, noggrann och serviceinriktad. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga, ett helhetsperspektiv och ett gott bemötande. Stor Vikt Läggs Vid Erfarenhet av arbete vid myndighet inom hälso- och sjukvårdsområdet. Erfarenhet av statistiskt arbete i tvärvetenskapliga sammanhang. Vikt Läggs Vid Erfarenhet av handledning eller statistiskt metodstöd inom biostatistik eller närliggande område. Erfarenhet av att arbeta med Git och GitLab. Erfarenhet av att jobba med enkätundersökningar och vanliga metoder för analys av undersökningar till exempel viktning av resultat med hjälp av kalibreringsvikter. Vad gör enheten? Enheten för analys arbetar med analyser och prognoser för att bidra till ett mer effektivt folkhälsoarbete. Enheten ansvarar för att utveckla metoder och ge stöd inom statistik, hälsoekonomi och modellering. Enheten ger stöd till hela myndigheten inom statistisk analys och hälsoekonomiska utvärderingar. I detta ingår att stödja andra enheter i planering och genomförande av projekt och analyser. Vi ansvarar för att utveckla, driva och ge stöd i modellering av både smittsamma och icke-smittsamma sjukdomar. Med modellering menas att med hjälp av matematiska modeller beskriva hur en smitta sprider sig eller att skriva fram utvecklingen av icke smittsamma sjukdomar i befolkningen givet olika antaganden om utvecklingen av riskfaktorer. Hur är det att jobba på Folkhälsomyndigheten? Vi erbjuder utvecklande arbetsuppgifter där du kan påverka och göra skillnad. Oavsett vad du jobbar med är du med och bidrar till samhällsnytta. Det gör du tillsammans med engagerade och kompetenta kollegor i stimulerande samarbeten. Folkhälsomyndigheten är en arbetsplats som strävar efter att ge lika möjligheter till alla och att vara fri från diskriminering. Myndigheten har sin verksamhet i Solna och Östersund. Anställningen är ett heltidsvikariat med tillträde så snart som möjligt. Ett av vikariaten pågår till och med 2027-05-14 och det andra till och med 2027-12-31. items.desc: Job Description Shape the future with data! We are building a truly insight-driven organization where data and AI power smarter decisions across the business. Join our team to turn complex data into meaningful insights and help drive impact for patients, customers and the organization. Join us as a Business Insights Analyst Welcome in our team Our Data & AI team is at the heart of a leading global pharmaceutical company’s new Business & Commercial Operations organization, enabling the business to become truly insight-driven and future-ready. We bring together data, advanced analytics, and AI capabilities to transform complex information into actionable insights that directly shape business strategy and decision-making. About The Role As a Business Insights Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in this transformation, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to unlock the full value of data in a highly dynamic and regulated pharmaceutical environment. From commercial performance to customer and patient understanding, you will help translate complex healthcare and market data into clear, meaningful insights that drive impact across our organization. You will join a dynamic and collaborative team that combines deep analytical expertise, strong business understanding and an innovative mindset, working at the intersection of data, technology and business to accelerate growth, support better decision-making and ultimately improve patient outcomes. This role requires close collaboration with internal stakeholders across commercial, digital, medical, market access, finance and operations teams, as well as coordination with external research and data partners where applicable. Tasks And Responsibilities Include But Are Not Limited To Generate actionable insights from internal and external data sources to support strategic planning and operational decision-making. Act as a thought partner to cross-functional teams by identifying trends, risks and opportunities. Deliver integrated insights into marketing effectiveness, brand performance, sales force effectiveness and omnichannel engagement. Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders through dashboards, reports and presentations. Contribute to forecasting accuracy and business planning through trend analysis, predictive modeling and forward-looking insights. Provide insights into customer, patient and health pathways to identify opportunities to improve engagement, experience and outcomes. Lead or support qualitative and quantitative market research and tracking initiatives to deepen customer understanding. Support experimentation and learning by evaluating initiatives, communicating findings and recommending actions to stakeholders. Your profile Bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Statistics, Data Science or a related field. Minimum 3-5 years’ experience in business analysis, data analysis or a similar role. Full professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required. French or Dutch is a plus. Experience with the Pharma industry is considered as a plus. Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Excel, Qlik Sense or Tableau. Knowledge of statistical analysis, with Python or R considered a strong advantage. items.desc: About The Role As a Macro Analyst at IMC in Amsterdam, you will build the quantitative tools and analysis behind the team’s macro research. Your work will focus on Python, data, maintaining the scenario record and backtesting research ideas, helping translate macro-event scenarios into inputs for the European equity index volatility curve. Working closely with traders, senior analysts and the Lead Macro Analyst, you will connect your analysis to the desk’s exposure and evaluate your calls against market outcomes. Alongside building and testing, you will contribute to event coverage during European trading hours and relevant out-of-hours futures sessions. As you demonstrate an edge through your work, there is scope to develop into position taking and longer-horizon research. Your Core Responsibilities Build and own Python tools and data workflows for macro research, scenario analysis and backtesting; Maintain a structured record of event scenarios, their underlying assumptions and subsequent outcomes, making the research available for testing and review; Backtest research ideas, signals and models, using statistical analysis to assess their performance and identify areas for improvement; Develop and update quantitative analysis for macro-event scenarios, working with traders and senior analysts to translate the results into inputs for the volatility curve; Understand the desk’s exposure to the events you cover, including whether it is long or short an event, and use that context when discussing the implications of your analysis; Score your own calls against actual outcomes and use the findings to improve the tools, models and scenario analysis you contribute. Your Skills And Experience 2–4 years of experience in quantitative research or a trading-focused analytical role, ideally within a macro hedge fund pod or at a competing trading firm; Hands-on Python skills, with experience preparing and analyzing data and applying statistics to research questions; Experience building analytical tools and backtesting research ideas; having built signals or models used in live trading is an advantage; Good understanding of macroeconomic drivers and equity index markets, including familiarity with options and volatility; A disciplined approach to recording assumptions and evaluating results, with the ability to connect your analysis to trading exposure and refine your views through evidence and feedback. About Us IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.

You transform raw data into actionable intelligence that informs business decisions and process optimization. You extract and compile data
items.desc: About IONOS At IONOS, we don't just manage servers – we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure – from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools. What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit. Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us. Your responsibilities As a Dunning & Collection Analyst, you are responsible for extracting, analyzing, and interpreting complex data from multiple sources to uncover patterns, trends, and insights that drive strategic improvements in our collection processes and recovery rates. You transform raw data into actionable intelligence that informs business decisions and process optimization. You extract and compile data from various systems and databases to create comprehensive datasets for analysis, utilizing SQL queries and advanced Excel techniques to ensure data accuracy and completeness. You perform in-depth statistical and exploratory analysis to identify patterns, trends, anomalies, and correlations in customer payment behavior, delinquency rates, collection effectiveness, and dunning performance across different customer segments. You develop and maintain dashboards and reporting frameworks that track key performance indicators (collection rates, days sales outstanding, recovery efficiency, dunning success rates) and provide visibility into performance drivers. You conduct root cause analysis on collection challenges and payment failures, drilling down into data to understand why certain customer segments, payment methods, or dunning strategies underperform. You segment customers and cohorts based on payment behavior, risk profiles, and response patterns to enable targeted collection strategies and personalized dunning approaches. You propose data-driven solutions based on your findings—from process improvements and policy changes to tool enhancements—and provide quantified business cases to support implementation. You collaborate with collection teams, finance, and IT to validate findings, ensure data quality, and drive implementation of recommended improvements, monitoring impact through post-implementation analysis. You maintain comprehensive documentation of your methodologies, data sources, analysis logic, and assumptions to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across teams. Your profile You have completed a degree program in data science, mathematics, statistics, business analytics, business administration, economics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent professional experience. You possess expert-level SQL skills with the ability to write complex queries to extract, transform, and aggregate data from relational databases. You are highly proficient in MS Excel, including advanced functions, pivot tables, data modeling, and the ability to handle and analyze large datasets efficiently. You have hands-on experience with business intelligence tools or data visualization platforms (Power BI, Looker, BI Cubes or similar) to create compelling dashboards and reports. You have practical experience analyzing financial data, specifically in areas such as accounts receivable, collection processes, payment behavior, or credit risk management. You possess strong statistical thinking and are comfortable with descriptive and exploratory analysis, hypothesis testing, trend analysis, and correlation studies. You have a sharp analytical mind with exceptional attention to detail, a natural curiosity to dig deeper into data, and the ability to challenge assumptions. You excel at translating complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights and compelling business narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences. You are results-oriented, proactive, self-directed, and take ownership of your analyses from conception through implementation and measurement. You have strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple analyses simultaneously, setting priorities effectively and delivering within deadlines. You speak English fluently If you don't check all the boxes above, don't worry—we're looking for the right mindset, analytical drive, and willingness to learn. Your passion for uncovering insights from data matters more than ticking every requirement. Application Note We value diversity and welcome all applications – regardless of, for example, gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion, disability, age as well as sexual orientation and identity, physical characteristics, marital status or any other irrelevant factor subject to applicable law.

items.desc: Så kom og bliv en del af vores Koncernstatistikteam og vær med til at levere statistik af høj kvalitet på et vigtigt samfundsmæssigt område. Velkommen til din nye arbejdsplads I Kontoret for Forretningsanalyse og Udvikling (KFU) arbejder vi blandt andet med data, analyser og initiativer inden for forretningsudvikling og sikkerhed. Opgaverne spænder fra analysearbejde på baggrund af dataindsamling på tværs af styrelsens sagsbehandling til arbejde på kontrol- og sikkerhedsområdet. Koncernstatistik producerer og videreformidler både nyudviklet og tilbagevendende statistik for hele Udlændinge- og Integrationsministeriets (UIM) område – til Folketinget, regeringen, den brede offentlighed og en række andre nationale og internationale interessenter. Vi udarbejder datagrundlaget til sagsstyring og ledelsesinformation i de forskellige myndigheder i UIMs koncern og udvikler desuden Udlændingestyrelsens egen BI løsning (Microsoft PowerBI). “Arbejdet i Statistikteamet er præget af højt tempo og mange forskelligartede opgaver, ofte med korte frister. Det giver en varieret arbejdsdag, hvor man kommer omkring mange forskellige problemstillinger. Jeg sætter særligt pris på det tværfaglige samarbejde med fagkontorerne og muligheden for at arbejde selvstændigt med opgaverne.” - Marcus, fuldmægtig Dine arbejdsopgaver Du kan forvente en spændende hverdag, hvor dine arbejdsopgaver bl.a. vil være at: udarbejde statistikker i bred forstand, besvare høringer fra Folketinget og forespørgsler generelt indgå i samarbejder om at udarbejde forskellige statistikprodukter arbejde med SQL-programmering og Excel indgå i projekter, hvor din viden om data- og statistikmiljøet er vigtige input have en stor kontaktflade til bl.a. ledelsen i fagkontorerne og i projektgrupper både i teamet, kontoret, og på tværs af styrelsen Dine opgaver tilrettelægges ud fra dine kompetencer og teamets behov, som udvikler sig løbende. Det er en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med databehandling og statistik, herunder SQL-programmering og Excel. Måske interesserer du dig også for projektledelse og BI, men det vigtigste er, at du har blik for at se mønstre, fejlfinde og undersøge, hvorfor data og statistik ser ud som det gør, ligesom du kan overskue og nysgerrigt går til store datamængder. Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music? The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun. These components can be domain independent (e.g., generic data quality tools over trillions of rows of data) or domain specific (e.g., classification models for surveillance or testing framework for Global Markets processes).
