items.desc: Wil jij met data écht impact maken op veiligheid? Zie jij achter cijfers niet alleen resultaten, maar vooral verhalen, patronen en kansen om te verbeteren? Dan is dit jouw kans. Maak het mogelijk Als HSE Data Analist help je BAM om een volgende stap te zetten in datagedreven veiligheid. Je brengt data uit verschillende systemen en onderdelen van de organisatie samen, verhoogt de kwaliteit van onze inzichten en helpt ons vooruit te kijken. Niet alleen door te rapporteren over wat er is gebeurd, maar juist door te ontdekken wat we kunnen leren van signalen en patronen. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met nieuwsgierigheid en weet jouw inzichten helder over te brengen. Zo maak jij van data een verhaal dat bijdraagt aan betere beslissingen en een veiligere werkomgeving. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het verzamelen, structureren en analyseren van HSE-data uit verschillende systemen en bronnen, inclusief het bewaken en verbeteren van de datakwaliteit. Het verbeteren en verder automatiseren van rapportages over veiligheidsprestaties en het continu verbeteren van processen, analyses en de inzet van data binnen HSE. Het signaleren van trends, patronen en afwijkingen en deze vertalen naar concrete inzichten die bijdragen aan betere besluitvorming en verbetering. Het onderzoeken en ontwikkelen van nieuwe inzichten door AI, innovatie, voorspellende analyses en het verbinden van verschillende databronnen en signalen binnen de organisatie. Het samenwerken met diverse stakeholders om data- en informatiebehoeften scherp te krijgen en een gestructureerde, procesmatige manier van werken te stimuleren. Je krijgt daarbij volop ruimte om te leren, te experimenteren en nieuwe technologieën toe te passen. Zo help jij BAM niet alleen beter te begrijpen hoe we vandaag presteren, maar ook te ontdekken hoe we morgen slimmer en veiliger kunnen werken. Jouw team Je komt terecht in een hecht en deskundig team binnen HSE Centraal. Vanuit onze standplaats in Bunnik werken we samen aan een veilige en gezonde werkomgeving binnen BAM. HSE Centraal ondersteunt de organisatie met kennis, expertise en innovatie op het gebied van Health, Safety & Environment. Als HSE Data Analist werk je nauw samen met collega's binnen HSE én bouw je actief een netwerk op met stakeholders door de hele organisatie. Wij bieden jou Een salaris tussen € 4.530,- en € 5.200,- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur), exclusief 8% vakantiegeld; Goede secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de Bouw & Infra-cao, zoals 25 vakantiedagen, 15 roostervrije dagen en 3 kortverzuimdagen per kalenderjaar; Een reiskostenvergoeding, laptop en iPhone; Een persoonlijk ontwikkelpad met trainingen via BAM Learning; andere cursussen en opleidingen zijn bespreekbaar; Hybride werken met passende regelingen voor een goede werk-privébalans; Fijne extra’s, zoals gemiddeld 40% sportkorting en voordeel op o.a. privéverzekeringen, Microsoft Office en de Lease-A-Bike regeling. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent analytisch sterk, nieuwsgierig en ziet data als een middel om verandering en verbetering mogelijk te maken. Je werkt zorgvuldig en gestructureerd, maar durft ook nieuwe wegen te verkennen. Daarnaast heb je: Een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding in bijvoorbeeld Informatietechnologie, Data Science, Wiskunde of een andere technische richting met een sterke focus op data-analyse; Affiniteit met AI, innovatie, voorspellende analyses, datakwaliteit en automatisering, gecombineerd met het vermogen om complexe data te vertalen naar begrijpelijke inzichten en het verhaal achter de cijfers helder over te brengen. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands in woord en geschrift; Een proactieve, nieuwsgierige en leergierige houding, met een mindset gericht op continu leren, verbeteren en vernieuwen; Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en procesmatige manier van werken, gecombineerd met de bereidheid om verder te kijken dan de cijfers en te begrijpen wat er achter de data schuilgaat; Het talent om gemakkelijk verbinding te maken, een netwerk op te bouwen en met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken en de juiste vragen te stellen. Je hoeft nog geen specialist te zijn op het gebied van veiligheid; belangrijker is dat je nieuwsgierig bent en graag in gesprek gaat met verschillende mensen. Over BAM Als een van de grootste bouwbedrijven in Europa gaan we verder dan het ontwikkelen van essentiële infrastructuur en het opleveren van hoogwaardige gebouwen. We bouwen aan een duurzame toekomst. Bij ons draait het niet alleen om werk, maar ook om jou. Wij geloven dat iedereen de ruimte moet krijgen om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Daarom verwelkomen we mensen met diverse achtergronden en werken we aan een omgeving waar iedereen zich gewaardeerd voelt. Het sollicitatieproces Solliciteren kan eenvoudig via de knop op deze pagina. Het overleggen van een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) maakt onderdeel uit van de procedure.

Integrate, model, and prepare relevant geo-, environmental, and specialized data, ensuring high data quality and consistency. Analyze technical and business requirements, translating them into sustainable data models, interfaces, and application solutions. Create analyses, reports, and decision-support tools to enhance product development, risk assessment, and valuation models. Identify and evaluate new methods and technologies in geodata, analytics, automation, and digital applications, integrating them into existing systems. Document concepts, data models, data flows, interfaces, and technical solutions to ensure clarity and maintainability. Lead and support prototyping, testing, and deployment of digital solutions, working closely with internal teams and external partners to ensure successful implementation and knowledge transfer. Benefits Competitive salary based on the collective agreements for the private insurance industry. Flexible working hours with opportunities for personal and professional development. Flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, a supportive team environment, and comprehensive onboarding. Secure employment in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technology, supporting mobile working arrangements. Additional benefits such as company pension schemes, childcare support, bicycle leasing programs for work and leisure, and more. items.desc: Position: LNG Market Analyst Location: Spain / Geneva Reporting: Head of LNG Position Overview We are looking for an analytical and commercially minded LNG Market Analyst to support our LNG trading activities through market research, fundamental analysis, market intelligence and data-driven insights. The successful candidate will monitor global LNG markets, identify key market drivers and developments, and translate market data into actionable insights to support trading and commercial decisions. Key Responsibilities Monitor and analyze global LNG markets, including supply, demand, trade flows, pricing and market fundamentals. Track LNG production, liquefaction utilization, outages, maintenance and new project developments across key producing regions. Analyze LNG demand, imports, storage levels, regasification activity and weather-related demand drivers across major consuming markets. Monitor LNG vessel movements, shipping routes, freight rates and global trade flows to identify changes in market dynamics. Follow key LNG pricing benchmarks and related markets, including JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and WTI and assess their impact on LNG economics. Conduct fundamental and quantitative analysis to identify market trends, opportunities and potential risks. Prepare regular market reports, dashboards, forecasts and presentations for the trading and management teams. Support traders with timely market intelligence and analysis of relevant market events and developments. Develop and maintain market databases, models and analytical tools using reliable internal and external data sources. Monitor geopolitical, regulatory, macroeconomic and infrastructure developments that may impact LNG markets and global trade flows. Analyze regional price spreads, arbitrage opportunities and market correlations. Work closely with LNG traders, commercial teams and other stakeholders to understand business requirements and provide relevant analytical support. Contribute to the development and improvement of market analysis methodologies, forecasting tools and reporting processes. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Business, Energy or a related field. minimum 2 years of relevant experience in LNG, energy, commodities, oil & gas, market analysis, trading or a closely related field. Strong understanding of global LNG market fundamentals, pricing mechanisms and international LNG trade flows. Familiarity with major LNG markets, including the US, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Strong analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to interpret large and complex datasets. Advanced Excel skills and strong proficiency in data analysis. Experience with Power BI, Python, SQL or other data analysis/visualization tools is an advantage. Strong research skills and the ability to assess information from multiple market and data sources. Ability to translate complex market information into clear and commercially relevant insights. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work in a fast-paced, international and commercially driven environment. Preferred Qualifications Previous exposure to an LNG trading desk or commodity trading environment. Experience analyzing LNG pricing, shipping economics, vessel movements or physical commodity flows. Knowledge of LNG contracts, pricing formulas, destination flexibility and arbitrage dynamics. Experience with market data and intelligence platforms such as S&P Global Commodity Insights, Argus, LSEG, Bloomberg, Kpler or similar platforms. Basic understanding of LNG shipping, liquefaction, regasification and terminal infrastructure.

items.desc: Amazon Amazon is Earth's most customer-centric company, a global leader in e-commerce, cloud computing, digital streaming, online advertising, and artificial intelligence. At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That’s the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it. The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network. Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job. Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region’s gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners. We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch. Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement. Key job responsibilities Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network. Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap. Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region’s gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand. Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact. Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact. Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership. Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption. Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time About The Team The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon’s EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business Preferred Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Economics or Business Administration Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. items.desc: About Sekoia.io repense la cybersécurité pour la rendre encore plus pertinente , efficace et accessible . L'un des principaux défis que nous relevons est d'analyser et de comprendre en permanence les menaces émergentes afin de définir des stratégies appropriées et d'avoir la capacité de les exécuter à grande échelle. En combinant la technologie et une équipe pluridisciplinaire de passionnés de Threat Intelligence, Sekoia.io a un fort impact sur la cybersécurité avec une approche qui brise les silos , qu'ils soient technologiques, organisationnels ou culturels. Job Description Sekoia is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development. As Finance Data Analyst , you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance and working closely with Data Engineering , you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams. You will map data sources , clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands-on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end-to-end. Your role will be to challenge data quality and assumptions , document what is missing, and help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information. In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation. Systems In Scope Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering: Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool) Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool) Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data. Your Missions Map and structure Finance data Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering. Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources. Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting. Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend. Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering. Turn data into reliable analysis Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems. Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets. Escadron des systèmes d’information opérationnels et de cyberdéfense Mont-de-Marsan Les missions de l’Escadron des systèmes d’information opérationnels et de cyberdéfense 62.430 s’articulent autour de 4 pôles : la réalisation de systèmes d’informations opérationnels, y compris embarqués sur aéronef, le soutien de systèmes d’information opérationnels déployés sur les théâtres d’opération, la cyberdéfense, et la valorisation des données Air par une approche orientée Big Data. POSTE Vous êtes chargé de : Recueillir et analyser les besoins pour les traduire en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques, en identifiant les sources de données pertinentes et en rédigeant la documentation associée ; Développer les pipelines de données et les transformations au sein du datawarehouse, gérer les historiques et les référentiels, et créer les rapports, tableaux de bord et indicateurs de performance ; Enrichir un entrepôt de données décisionnel et concevoir les datamarts associés, tout en optimisant les processus de développement. CONDITIONS PARTICULIÈRES : Vous justifiez d’une expérience dans le développement informatique, le traitement de données, la réalisation et supervision de pipelines de données ou le développement d’applications de data visualisation. DIPLÔME – FORMATION : Vous êtes titulaire d’un BUT Science des données - Parcours visualisation, conception d'outils décisionnels ou bien d’un diplôme de niveau Bac+2 ou équivalent en informatique, développement logiciel, systèmes d’information, traitement de données ou dans un domaine connexe. COMPÉTENCES SPÉCIFIQUES REQUISES : Vous possédez plusieurs des compétences suivantes : Maîtrise de SQL pour interroger, manipuler et optimiser les bases de données relationnelles (requêtes complexes, jointures, sous-requêtes, fonctions de fenêtre) ; Connaissance des principes de modélisation décisionnelle (schémas en étoile, data warehouse, data marts) ; Maîtrise de l'ETL Talend pour concevoir, orchestrer et industrialiser des pipelines de données, incluant la gestion des historiques et des référentiels ; Compétences en outils de visualisation de données (ex : Qlik Sense) pour créer des tableaux de bord interactifs, des visualisations dynamiques et des indicateurs de performance (KPI) à partir de données structurées. items.desc: Ben jij klaar om jouw IT-passie en data-expertise naar een hoger niveau te tillen? Ons dynamische IT-Services team biedt jou de kans om jezelf te ontwikkelen en mee te bouwen aan onze discipline als Junior Business & IT consultant. Ontdek en werk met diverse klanten in de Brainportregio en groei mee in een jong, gedreven team! Een dag als Junior Business & IT Consultant bij Joanknecht Als Junior Business & IT consultant begint je dag met een kop koffie en een teamoverleg. Samen met je collega’s bespreek je de voortgang van lopende projecten en de uitdagingen die jullie tegenkomen. Vandaag staat een bezoek aan een klant, een grote productieorganisatie in de Brainportregio, op de planning samen met een ervaren collega. Je gaat daar in gesprek met de IT-manager en enkele operationele medewerkers. Ze hebben veel data, maar gebruiken deze nog niet optimaal. Je luistert naar hun vraagstukken en begint met het verzamelen van informatie om een passende oplossing te bedenken. Terug op kantoor bespreek je deze informatie met je team. Samen brainstormen jullie over mogelijke oplossingen. Je stelt voor om een dashboard te ontwikkelen in Microsoft PowerBI, waarmee de klant inzicht krijgt in hun productieprocessen en financiële data. Na een vers bereidde lunch door onze Hospitality collega’s, ga je aan de slag met het bouwen van een dashboard voor een andere klant, een financiële dienstverlener. Je duikt in PowerBI en begint met het ontwerpen en modelleren van het dashboard. Je zorgt ervoor dat de data op een overzichtelijke manier wordt gepresenteerd en dat de klant eenvoudig analyses kan uitvoeren. Na het bouwen van het dashboard test je samen met een Finance & IT Consultant de functionaliteit en betrouwbaarheid via financiële analyses. Hierna pas je waar nodig aan zodat je er zeker van bent dat de oplossing betrouwbaar is en voldoet aan de wensen van de klant. Aan het einde van de dag werk je nog voor een derde klant, een logistiek bedrijf, waarbij de oplevering van een ander dashboard bijna rond is. Samen met je team doe je de laatste controle en aanpassingen. Jullie willen er zeker van zijn dat alles perfect werkt voordat het eindproduct wordt opgeleverd. Je sluit de dag met een goed gevoel af, morgen staan er weer andere leuke uitdagingen op de planning! Wat bieden wij? Toegang tot de Joanknecht Academy voor workshops, specialistische trainingen en opleidingen bij hogescholen en universiteiten. Je werkt voor een gevarieerde klantenkring in de Brainport regio, van familiebedrijven tot internationale organisaties. De mogelijkheid om tijdens werktijd als vrijwilliger bij te dragen aan maatschappelijke projecten via de Joanknecht Foundation. items.desc: The Position: Data Analyst We are seeking a Systems & Data Analyst to join the Quality function, providing independent insight into programme performance across the Hinkley Point C project. This role will be responsible for transforming complex data into meaningful intelligence, enabling informed decision-making and driving continuous improvement across quality and operational performance. The successful candidate will act as a key reporting and analytics specialist, developing Power BI dashboards, improving data quality, and delivering performance insights that support programme objectives within a large-scale, highly regulated project environment. Some of the main responsibilities of the Data Analyst will include: Design, develop and maintain advanced Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions to support performance management across the programme. Analyse large and complex datasets to identify key trends, performance issues, risks and opportunities. Produce accurate and insightful management information to support operational and strategic decision-making. Develop and maintain data models, reporting structures and visualisations that improve understanding of programme performance. Support the extraction, transformation and loading (ETL) of data from multiple sources to ensure consistency and reliability of reporting outputs. Investigate performance trends and root causes, providing recommendations to improve business outcomes and operational effectiveness. Work closely with stakeholders to gather reporting requirements and translate business needs into effective analytical solutions. Promote data quality, reporting standards and governance practices to establish trusted and reliable management information. Support continuous improvement initiatives through the provision of performance analytics and business intelligence expertise. This is an excellent opportunity for a data-driven professional who can move beyond producing reports to deliver genuine business insight. The role offers the chance to influence programme performance and contribute to the successful delivery of one of the UK's largest and most complex infrastructure projects. Preferred Profile Alongside a commitment to our values of Care & Compassion, Performance, Team Spirit, and Inclusiveness, we are looking for individuals who can bring the following: Demonstrable experience developing advanced Power BI dashboards and business intelligence solutions. Strong data analysis, reporting and data visualisation skills. Experience managing and interpreting large, complex datasets from multiple sources. Knowledge of ETL processes, data modelling and reporting architecture. Proven ability to identify trends, investigate root causes and provide actionable recommendations. Strong stakeholder engagement, communication and requirements gathering skills. Degree qualified in a numerate discipline, such as Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering or Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience. Experience within major infrastructure, engineering, construction or capital project environments is desirable. Project management qualifications or training, such as APM PMQ or PRINCE2, would be advantageous. Experience supporting Quality, Project Controls, Performance Management or Programme Delivery functions would be beneficial. Experience working within a highly regulated industry, such as nuclear, defence, energy or transportation, is highly desirable. NaN

items.desc: Location: Antwerp and Herentals, Belgium | Yusen Logistics About Yusen Logistics Yusen Logistics is working to become the world’s preferred supply chain logistics company. Our complete offer is designed to forge better connec-tions between businesses, customers and communities – through innovative supply chain management, freight forwarding, warehousing and distribution services. As a company we’re dedicated to a culture of continuous improvement, ensuring everyone who works with us is committed, connected and creative in making us the world’s preferred choice. www.yusen-logistics.com/ Role Overview At Yusen Logistics we’re seeking to grow our Data Team with the appointment of two Business Intelligence (BI) Developers! In this role you will design, build and support business intelligence solutions that enable data‑driven decision‑making across Yusen Logistics Healthcare. You will work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting and insight requirements, translating these into reliable dashboards, reports and analytical outputs. The role has end‑to‑end responsibility for BI solutions, including development, delivery and ongoing support. In addition to BI delivery, the role may contribute to data engineering activities where required, including supporting data pipelines, transformations and datasets that underpin BI solutions. The role also contributes to the ongoing improvement of BI and data practices, with alignment to wider Yusen data approaches over time. This position reports to the Data Solutions Manager, Yusen Logistics. Key Responsibilities Design, build and support business intelligence solutions, including dashboards, reports and analytical datasets, that enable data driven decision making. Gather, prepare and transform data from internal and external sources to support BI and reporting requirements. Analyse data to identify trends, patterns and performance drivers, translating these into clear and actionable insights. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting and insight needs, translating requirements into effective BI solutions. Support data pipelines, transformations and datasets that underpin BI solutions, contributing to data engineering activities where required. Deliver BI and related data changes through structured, backlog driven delivery, balancing new development with BAU support. Apply data quality checks and validation, and document BI solutions, data logic and assumptions to support ongoing use and support. Contribute to continuous improvement of BI solutions, data processes and ways of working. What You Will Bring To The Role 2–4 years’ experience in a BI Developer, Data Analyst or data‑focused reporting role, delivering dashboards, reports and analytical outputs in a business environment. Strong understanding of business intelligence and reporting concepts, including data modelling for analytics. Proficiency in SQL for querying, transforming and analysing data and experience working with structured data. Hands‑on experience developing BI solutions using Power BI, including dashboards and datasets. Familiarity with data integration, data cleansing and validation concepts. Working knowledge of data pipelines and how BI tools consume and depend on underlying data. Experience contributing to data preparation, transformation or modelling activities that support BI solutions. Experience supporting BI solutions in production, including issue investigation and enhancement. Experience working in iterative, delivery‑focused teams (e.g. agile or sprint‑based delivery). Experience working with Microsoft Azure‑based data platforms and BI tools such as Databricks and Fabric/Power BI. Fluent proficiency in English (written and spoken). Why Join Us? At Yusen Logistics you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects, work alongside talented professionals, and grow your career in an environment that values innovation, accountability, and collaboration. At Yusen Logistics, we understand the value of utilising AI and other technologies to support the application process. However, we encourage candidates to use these tools to enhance their application rather than replace their own effort and authenticity. During the interview process, we expect responses to reflect your own experience, thinking and capabilities. Yusen Logistics is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates and make our recruitment decisions based solely on skills, experience and potential. Diversity enables us to create an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and grow.

Automate recurring reporting, reconciliations, and analytical workflows where automation can deliver meaningful efficiency gains. Strong documentation and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with both Finance and technical stakeholders. Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, and the ability to communicate complex findings clearly. Ability to work independently, prioritize competing requests, and deliver practical solutions in a changing business environment. Previous exposure to sensitive HR or payroll data and an understanding of the confidentiality requirements involved. items.desc: Are you technically curious, hands-on, and comfortable exploring new ideas? At Intralox, one of the world’s leading innovators in conveyance solutions, we are looking for an Advanced R&D Engineer to join our R&D team in Eindhoven and play a key role in turning emerging technologies into practical products and customer solutions. Why this role matters Our Advanced R&D team explores new and emerging technologies that can shape the next generation of Intralox solutions. We work across disciplines including magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, and mechatronics. Rather than focusing on one established product or repeating the same assignments, the team investigates varied applications and develops net-new technology. Curiosity, experimentation, collaboration, and practical problem-solving are central to how we work. As an Advanced R&D Engineer, you will explore promising technologies and translate them into prototypes, concepts, and integrated solutions. Based in Eindhoven, you will work closely with local technical colleagues and collaborate with Advanced R&D team members in the US. You will have the freedom to move between different technologies and applications, combining sound engineering principles with hands-on experimentation to solve real customer challenges. What You’ll Do Explore new and emerging technologies to identify opportunities for innovative products and customer solutions. Develop and evaluate prototypes to turn early-stage ideas into technically viable concepts. Design, build, and test concepts involving magnetics, motors, actuators, sensing, vision, robotics, or related technologies. Apply simulation and engineering analysis to improve design decisions and reduce technical risk. Use rapid-prototyping methods, including 3D printing, to accelerate learning and concept validation. Investigate supplier technologies and assess their potential for use in future Intralox applications. Combine multiple technologies into integrated solutions that address practical customer needs. Consider machining, injection molding, and other production methods to improve the manufacturability of proposed designs. Document and communicate technical findings so that colleagues across locations can build on your work. Collaborate with engineers in Europe and the US to connect global expertise and advance shared R&D initiatives. Participate in occasional customer visits, installations, and technical collaboration sessions in Europe and the US. What You Bring A bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree in mechatronics, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, robotics, applied physics, or a related technical discipline. At least five years of relevant experience in industrial engineering, product development, advanced R&D, or a comparable applied-technology environment. An understanding of manufacturability, including machining, injection molding, and other relevant production processes. Hands-on experience developing, prototyping, testing, or validating physical products and technical concepts. The ability to connect theoretical engineering principles with practical implementation and customer needs. The flexibility to work across unfamiliar technologies and pivot between different applications and development challenges. A curious, open-minded, and collaborative approach, with the confidence to work effectively when requirements or solutions are not yet fully defined. Willingness to work from our Eindhoven office at least three days per week and to travel occasionally. Nice-to-have: Experience in one or more of the following areas: magnetic drives, motors, actuators, sensing, vision systems, robotics, mechatronics, simulation, or 3D printing. If you don’t meet every requirement but are excited about the role, we still encourage you to apply. Why Intralox? International environment with opportunities to grow your career globally. A supportive, high-performing team that values collaboration. A workplace driven by ideas, innovation, and ownership. A financially strong, market-leading brand. Performance-based profit sharing. 25 holiday days + 6 ATV days. Excellent benefits package including a mobility card for business and personal use, pension scheme and contributions to health & life insurance. Building great things together Intralox is a global leader in innovative conveyance solutions, with more than 3,000 employees across 20+ countries. Our company develops advanced solutions such as high-precision die bonding, fiber alignment, and laser soldering systems, which are critical for manufacturing cutting-edge photonic devices like LiDAR sensors, high-speed data transceivers, and silicon photonics. Our company-wide goal is to set up top-notch technology that facilitates our customers from around the world in building tomorrow’s optoelectronic devices. You analyse image data and process parameters, systematically investigate the root causes of technical issues and implement suitable improvements. Working closely with Mechanical Design, Automation, Production and Project Management, you develop innovative technical solutions. items.desc: We are currently looking for a Scientist - Underwater Communications to join the team in The Hague . Ever wanted to help build a wireless "underwater internet" with a team of talented colleagues? Or to plan and evaluate missions with underwater drones? Then this role as an underwater communications scientist is for you. In today's uncertain geopolitical climate, safeguarding our society matters more than ever. Joining means playing an active part in building a safer world, both in the Netherlands and across Europe, closely collaborating with Dutch Defence organisations. The work centres on research and development of autonomous underwater systems. Typical applications include finding sea mines with autonomous underwater and surface drones, stand-off anti-submarine warfare, wireless underwater (network) communication, and protecting critical infrastructure on the seabed. The team builds state-of-the-art acoustic sensor systems, along with advanced data-processing algorithms for communication, visualisation and information extraction, all aimed at creating situational awareness. Responsibilities As an underwater communications scientist, you will contribute to several projects, delivering innovative solutions for clients in the defence and security sector. Every project has its own team that you collaborate with closely, and as no two projects are the same, there is plenty of room to keep growing. Depending on your background and interests, your work could include: Improving algorithms for underwater acoustic and optical communication across the different layers of the OSI model. Researching how to optimise communication within networks of autonomous (underwater) nodes and drones. Designing, preparing and running experiments, using realistic simulations as well as measurements in the lab or at sea. Reporting and presenting your results to clients and colleagues. Do you thrive in a team and want a job that benefits society? This role offers variety and supports your growth as a scientist. Requirements Besides being enthusiastic about the work, you recognise yourself in the following: You have at least a Master's degree in electrical engineering and/or computer science. You have experience or a specialization in telecommunications and signal processing, including experience with algorithm development. You have knowledge of modulations, network protocols and architectures. You preferably already have several years of experience in doing (applied) research. You are proactive and assertive; You feel responsible for the end result and ensure that business gets done. You communicate clearly and convincingly in English, both orally and in writing. Dutch is an advantage. You are also able to work in an international and military context, such as in European or NATO projects. You are open to new ideas, eager to learn, and help others learn in turn. Privacy Notice: In order to apply for this vacancy you must submit your personal information to Science [&] Technology. Science [&] Technology will collect, use, and process your personal information as mentioned in our Privacy Policy. Our policy and processing of your personal information are compliant with the GDPR. Please note that if you do not hear back from us within 10 days of your application, you may assume that we have selected another candidate we would like to interview for this position. We do our best to get back to you individually, however, due to a high volume of responses, it can be that we have not been able to reject your application in person. We kindly request that recruitment agencies do not contact us regarding this vacancy. We are not seeking assistance and will not be liable for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited CVs or candidate introductions. Any candidates submitted by agencies without prior written agreement will be considered our direct applicants and may be employed without obligation or fee.

Ein wichtiger Schwerpunkt Ihrer Arbeit ist die Entwicklung von Domänenspezifischen Sprachen und unterstützenden Werkzeugen als Schnittstellen zur Verbesserung der Nutzbarkeit der eingesetzten Codes, Modellen und Daten, sowie der Produktivität der Endnutzer, der Wiederverwendbarkeit von Code und Daten, und damit zur Vermeidung von unnötigen Berechnungen. Sie führen Methodenforschung durch und nehmen aktiv in der Planung, Implementierung und Erprobung der neuen Features, sowie bei der Behebung von Fehlern (Bugfixes), teil. Eine weitere Aufgabe ist die kontinuierliche Pflege der Software-Repositorien und der Datenbanken. Darüber hinaus veröffentlichen Sie die Ergebnisse Ihrer Methodenforschung auf Konferenzen und in Seminaren. Sie unterstützen die Anwender beim Einsatz der neu entwickelten Werkzeuge in ihren Projekten und organisieren gelegentlich Tutorials für sie. Karriere und Entwicklung : Wir unterstützen Sie mit einer strukturierten Einarbeitung, vielfältigen Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und individueller Förderung. So stärken wir Ihr persönliches Wachstum. items.desc: Das Fraunhofer FHR in Wachtberg bei Bonn ist Teil der Fraunhofer-Gesellschaft und eines der führenden und größten europäischen Forschungsinstitute auf dem Gebiet der Hochfrequenzphysik und Radartechnik. Der Bereich „Radar zu Weltraumlageerfassung“ (RWL) entwickelt vor dem Hintergrund der zunehmenden Bedrohung von Satelliten Radarsysteme und Verfahren Weltraumlageerfassung. In zwei Abteilungen vereinen sich unsere Expertisen in den Teilbereichen Radararchitekturen und Verfahren zur Weltraumbeobachtung, als auch Radarsysteme und operationeller Betrieb. Zur Unterstützung der Arbeiten betreibt der Bereich mit dem TIRA (Tracking and Imaging Radar) eine der weltweit leistungsfähigsten Großradaranlagen. Die Abteilung „Radararchitekturen & Verfahren zur Weltraumbeobachtung“ (RVW) im Bereich RWL befasst sich mit Forschungsthemen zur Aufklärung und Überwachung von Objekten im erdnahen Weltraum mit Radar. Dazu entwerfen wir innovative Verfahren zur Detektion, Ortung, Bahngewinnung und Radarabbildung bis hin zu Methoden zur Analyse und Identifizierung von Weltraumobjekten. Zum experimentellen Nachweis und zur Anwendung dieser Verfahren entwickeln wir Instrumente für unsere Großradaranlage TIRA und Systemarchitekturen für zukünftige Radarsysteme. Der erdnahe Weltraum wird zunehmend genutzt – Weltraumschrott wird zur wachsenden Gefahr für Raumfahrtmissionen. Das hochsensitive TIRA-System eignet sich besonders zur Erfassung kleiner Raumfahrtrückstände. In einer von der ESA geförderten Aktivität entwickeln wir derzeit einen innovativen Prozessor zur Charakterisierung zentimetergroßer Objekte im LEO-Orbit. Ihre Aufgabe: Sie entwickeln und validieren Algorithmen zur zuverlässigen Detektion und Charakterisierung von Weltraumschrott – gestützt durch reale Messkampagnen. items.desc: Summary Development Scientist opportunity within an innovative diagnostics and medical technology business. Play a key role in progressing products from development through to commercial readiness. Ideal for a commercially minded scientist with experience within biotech, diagnostics or MedTech environments. Our Client Mackie Myers are partnering with an innovative life sciences company developing next-generation diagnostic technologies designed to improve healthcare accessibility and patient outcomes. Having successfully established a strong technical foundation and advanced its product portfolio, the business is entering an exciting phase of development and commercialisation. They are now seeking a Development Scientist to support the progression of novel diagnostic products towards market launch. The Role This position will play a critical role within the product development team, focusing on the transition of technologies from research into commercially viable products. Working within a multidisciplinary scientific environment, you will design and execute development programmes, analyse data and contribute to the advancement of innovative diagnostic technologies. The successful candidate will bring a strong understanding of product development and be motivated by delivering scientific outcomes that ultimately support commercial success. Main Duties The successful candidate will support the development and commercialisation of next-generation diagnostic products. Design and execute development experiments to support product advancement. Optimise assays, protocols and development workflows. Analyse experimental data and provide evidence-based recommendations. Support the progression of technologies from research through to commercialisation. Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across assay development, molecular biology and product development functions. The Successful Candidate Degree or higher qualification in a Life Science discipline. Industry experience within biotechnology, diagnostics, medical devices or a related sector. Experience working within a product development environment. Strong experimental design, troubleshooting and data analysis capabilities. Experience with biological systems and ideally protein-based technologies. Self-motivated, commercially aware and comfortable taking ownership of development projects. Passion for translating scientific innovation into real-world products. What's on Offer? Opportunity to join a growing and innovative diagnostics organisation. Involvement in products progressing towards commercial launch. Exposure to cutting-edge diagnostic and medical device technologies. Collaborative and multidisciplinary scientific environment. Significant opportunity for professional growth and development. Comprehensive benefits package. Based in Little Chesterford on the Essex/Cambridgeshire border. items.desc: Vill du undersöka de cellulära mekanismer som ligger bakom långvarig smärta? Vi välkomnar ansökningar till en tjänst som forskningsspecialist i professor Camilla Svenssons forskargrupp, med fokus på att klarlägga cellulära och molekylära mekanismer i det perifera nervsystemet vid kroniska smärttillstånd. Tjänsten är placerad vid Institutionen för fysiologi och farmakologi vid Karolinska Institutet, som erbjuder en kollegial, internationell och dynamisk forskningsmiljö. Vi erbjuder en spännande, öppen och samarbetsinriktad forskningsmiljö där du kan bidra till translationell forskning med stark klinisk relevans. Din roll Den forskningsspecialist som ansluter till gruppen kommer att undersöka cellulära och molekylära mekanismer som bidrar till långvarig smärta vid fibromyalgi, med särskilt fokus på experimentella modeller för antikroppsmedierade och neuroimmuna mekanismer. En stor del av arbetet kommer att bestå av prekliniska experimentella studier, inklusive hantering av försöksdjur, beteendeanalyser av smärtrelaterade fenotyper, administrering av experimentella behandlingar och mikrokirurgiska ingrepp. Tjänsten kräver därför god praktisk erfarenhet av försöksdjursarbete samt förmåga att självständigt planera och genomföra tekniskt krävande in vivo-studier. Arbetet omfattar även insamling och bearbetning av vävnad för efterföljande analyser med immunhistokemi, högupplöst avbildning och molekylära metoder. Studierna kommer att användas för att karakterisera förändringar i perifera vävnader och nervsystemet samt för att klarlägga hur autoantikroppar, immunceller och neuronala signalvägar bidrar till långvarig smärta. Forskningsspecialisten kommer att arbeta nära andra experimentella forskare, kliniker, beräkningsbiologer och biostatistiker i en tvärvetenskaplig miljö med målet att identifiera mekanismer som ligger bakom fibromyalgi och kronisk smärta. Din profil Du är en kreativ, engagerad och entusiastisk lagspelare med doktorsexamen inom neurovetenskap, fysiologi, immunologi, biomedicinsk vetenskap eller ett annat relevant område. Du har en gedigen bakgrund inom experimentell neurovetenskap, smärtforskning, neurobiologi, neuroimmunologi eller närliggande områden. Dokumenterad praktisk erfarenhet av försöksdjursarbete, inklusive djurhantering, beteendetester och mikrokirurgiska ingrepp, är ett krav. Erfarenhet av att självständigt planera och genomföra tekniskt krävande in vivo-experiment är mycket meriterande. Praktisk erfarenhet av insamling och bearbetning av vävnad, immunhistokemi/immunocytokemi, mikroskopi och molekylära analyser är också viktig. Erfarenhet av experimentella smärtmodeller, administrering av experimentella behandlingar, kvantitativ bildanalys eller analys av vävnader från det perifera nervsystemet är meriterande. Du kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för att planera, genomföra och dokumentera experimentellt arbete, samtidigt som du bidrar effektivt i ett tvärvetenskapligt team. Du har mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på engelska och kommunicerar väl i vetenskapliga diskussioner, presentationer och texter. Starka rekommendationer från tidigare handledare eller mentorer förväntas. Vad erbjuder vi? Vi erbjuder en ettårig anställning som forskningsspecialist. Du kommer att arbeta i en kreativ, inspirerande och dynamisk forskningsmiljö och ingå i en forskargrupp som bedriver translationell smärtforskning, med det långsiktiga målet att identifiera cellulära och molekylära mekanismer bakom kronisk smärta och förbättra livskvaliteten för personer som lever med fibromyalgi. Anställningen är placerad vid Karolinska Institutet. Mer information finns här: Karolinska Institutet – forskning om molekylära smärtmekanismer. Karolinska Institutet är ett av världens ledande medicinska universitet. Vår vision är att driva utvecklingen av kunskap om livet och verka för en bättre hälsa för alla. Vid Karolinska Institutet bedriver vi medicinsk forskning i framkant och erbjuder det bredaste utbudet av medicinska utbildningar i Sverige. Placering: Solna Ansökan Ansökan ska innehålla följande handlingar på engelska, men det går också bra att ansöka på svenska: Ett fullständigt curriculum vitae, inklusive datum för disputation, avhandlingens titel, tidigare akademiska anställningar, akademiska utmärkelser och kommittéuppdrag En fullständig publikationslista En sammanfattning av pågående arbete (högst en sida) Ett personligt brev Vid bedömningen av de sökande kommer vi att lägga stor vikt vid personlig utveckling, utbildning, tekniska och vetenskapliga färdigheter, tidigare forskningserfarenhet samt personliga egenskaper. Ansökan ska göras via rekryteringssystemet Varbi. KI tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt våra kollektivavtal RALS och RALS-T.

items.desc:
Join the AWS EMEA Telecom team as a Solutions Architect — You will work directly in customer non-production sandbox environments to create working prototypes, proof-of-concepts, and AI-driven solutions that prove AWS value faster than traditional advisory engagements, eliminating the traditional handoff between advisory and implementation.
You will be the primary technical partner for major European telecommunications operators, leading with Agentic AI and AI-assisted software development as the primary value proposition while building directly alongside customer engineering teams.
Key job responsibilities
This is a builder-first technical role that combines the strategic advisory expertise of a Solutions Architect with hands-on software engineering capabilities.
Build working prototypes in customer non-production sandbox environments using AI-augmented development tools — delivering tangible, demonstrable value early in the engagement
Pair-program with customer teams, embedding directly with their engineers during time-boxed sprints to accelerate AI adoption and cloud-native development
Write high-quality sample code for proof-of-concepts, demos, and sample applications spanning generative AI architectures, agentic systems, and telco-specific workloads (operations support system modernization, network cloudification, contact centre AI)
Design and deploy infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (AWS CDK, Terraform, CloudFormation) in customer sandbox environments, demonstrating scalability and security patterns
Strategic Advisory
Own the end-to-end technical relationship with Tier-1 European telco groups, acting as trusted advisor to technical decision makers
Shape AI and cloud strategy for major operators — translating complex technical capabilities into business-outcome narratives
Lead architecture design for Agentic AI initiatives including multi-agent orchestration, foundation model integration, and enterprise AI platforms
Drive AI-assisted software development lifecycle strategy, positioning AWS developer tools for software transformation at scale across large engineering organizations
Revenue and Opportunity Acceleration
Accelerate deal cycles by removing technical blockers through hands-on building — measurably reducing opportunity cycle time
Identify and launch new opportunities discovered during customer engagements
Increase service adoption per customer through tangible demonstrations of multi-service integration
Customer Development Engineer Operating Principles
Demonstrate value through building AND advisory — lead with building to show tangible value
Act as an extension of customers through hands-on co-development in their environments
Outcome-focused — identify, develop, and realise business opportunities through tangible proof points
Security first, speed second — but both are possible — AI-augmented development compresses timelines without compromising security or architectural integrity
Technical accuracy over short-term revenue — recommend the right solution for customer context, even if it results in lower immediate revenue
Scale innovation through reusable solutions — build once, share broadly via accelerators and reference architectures
About the team

Job Description: 
 Are you a highly motivated graduate in aerospace or mechanical engineering with a strong interest in data analytics and system modelling? Apply now to join us! 
The Environmental Control System of passenger aircraft is an essential component which provides air supply, thermal control and cabin pressurization for the crew and passengers. With the availability of system models as well as operational in-service data, we are looking for a VIE to evaluate and analyze operational ECS data across various aircraft platforms in order to extract meaningful insights and operational understanding.
 We look forward to you supporting us in the Air Generation and Fuel Cell department as a Volunteer for International Experience (VIE)!
 Location: Hamburg
 Start: As soon as possible
 Duration: 2 years
 Definition VIE
 The Volunteer for International Experience (VIE) program is an international program sponsored by the French Ministry of Economy, Finance and Employment, open to Airbus to offer young professionals the opportunity to have valuable paid work experience abroad in a technical or business function. We are looking for highly motivated graduates aged 18 to 28 years, who are citizens of the European Union (all E.U. nationals, plus Norway, Iceland and Liechtenstein). Candidates meeting these criteria and interested in a VIE, please register before your 28th birthday on the website www.civiweb.com . For graduates who would be interested in a career with Airbus, this could be the start of a rewarding future in a dynamic and forward-thinking sector.
 Your location
 You will be working at the largest German production site for civil aircraft located in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets (aero-) nautic legacy.
 Your benefits
 Work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime),
 Mobile working after agreement with the department,
 Traveling within Europe is possible after consultation and agreement from the department,
 International environment with the opportunity to network globally,
 Work with modern/diversified technologies,
 Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.
 Your tasks and responsibilities
 Gather and analyze operational data from aircraft systems to identify trends and anomalies,
 Develop and implement dashboards and comprehensive reports to visualize system status for technical and non-technical stakeholders,
 Refine and optimize system models by comparing theoretical simulations with real-world flight data,
 Develop scripts to automate data processing workflows and increase efficiency in analyzing recurring operational patterns,
 Support root cause analysis for technical anomalies in the fleet to continuously improve system reliability,
 Document technical findings and present results in team meetings to facilitate knowledge sharing,
 Conduct benchmarking analyses across different aircraft platforms to derive best practices and optimization potential.
 Desired skills and qualifications
 Graduate with a university degree in the area of Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or similar field of study,
 Background in thermodynamics and aircraft systems,
 Good knowledge of data analytics & visualisation methods & tools,
 Programming skills in Python are required,
 Knowledge in simulation software Dymola / Modelica is beneficial,
 Fluent in English.

items.desc:
About the Team

OpenAI’s User Operations team shepherds our customers’ adoption of AI and ensures that our customers' product experience is nothing short of exceptional. We are building the very first post-AGI support team. We resolve complex issues, provide technical guidance, and support customers in maximizing value and adoption from deploying our products. We work closely with Sales, Technical Success, Product, Engineering and others, to deliver the best possible experience to our customers at scale. OpenAI's customers represent a range of diverse backgrounds and maturity, from early-stage startups to established global enterprises.

 

About the Role

We’re looking for dedicated, experienced, and deeply curious individuals to help solve some of the most complex challenges faced by our customers while building the future of post-AGI support alongside us. In this role, you’ll work directly with customers through support tickets and live calls, troubleshooting high-impact issues and resolving novel, often ambiguous technical problems in one of the fastest-moving environments in technology. As AI adoption rapidly accelerates, the work you do will directly support mission-critical systems being built on OpenAI’s platform, serving as a critical line of defense for customers operating at massive scale.

Beyond resolving technical issues, you’ll help define what world-class support looks like in an AGI-driven future. You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to improve systems, reduce bugs, and elevate the customer experience, while leveraging automation, agents, and our own AI technology to transform how support operates at scale.

 

You’ll be responsible for:

 - Working directly with customers to troubleshoot and resolve their most complex technical issues, including API failures, integration challenges, authentication errors, and production incidents. Providing end-to-end ownership through debugging logs, analyzing system behavior, reproducing issues, and delivering expert guidance.

 - Becoming a trusted expert on OpenAI’s products and platform, serving as a go-to resource for complex technical issues.

 - Serving as a critical escalation point and line of defense for complex technical issues, partnering closely with customers and Engineering teams to troubleshoot, resolve, and proactively prevent recurring problems while leveraging scripting and emerging AI capabilities to improve internal tooling and automate operational workflows

 - Taking learnings from resolving customer issues and creating our approach to scaling these solutions, partnering with Product and Go-To-Market teams.

 - Driving operational excellence by identifying opportunities for automation and AI-powered workflows, implementing scalable improvements that increase team efficiency, reducing manual effort, and elevating the overall support experience.

 - Providing occasional holiday and weekend support on call coverage, as needed, to support business and customer needs.

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a System Architect to build the engine behind our full-funnel lifecycle programs across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments. This is not a marketing technologist role — we're not looking for someone to maintain the stack. We're looking for someone to design the machine that runs on it.

The core challenge: today, every new industry, segment, or language means another fork — another campaign tree, another set of manual sequences to maintain. Your job is to make those parameters instead. You'll architect a lifecycle system where launching a new vertical in a new market is a configuration change, not a rebuild, and where onboarding, nurture, upsell, and ABM programs compose from shared logic rather than duplicated effort.

You'll be both architect and operator — defining the data model and segmentation logic underneath the journeys, then shipping them. You'll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth, and Data, and you'll scope engineering support rather than queue behind it. This is a build year: you're inventing the system, not inheriting one.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Architect a parameterised lifecycle system where new industries, segments, and languages are configuration, not new campaign trees

 - Design and launch onboarding, nurture, and upsell campaigns across Creator, Enterprise, and Developer segments

 - Prototype and ship your own integrations and logic; you scope engineering help, you don't queue behind it

 - Own lifecycle touchpoints across channels with clear, measurable goals

 - Build multilingual nurture flows that scale globally, maintaining message quality and performance

 - Set up and manage robust A/B testing plans and track performance across the full funnel

 - Own the reporting framework for lifecycle marketing; define success metrics and communicate learnings

 - Build ABM infrastructure for targeted, account-level nurture and retention programs

 - Partner with the design and engineering teams to deploy campaigns that require light integration or tech support

 - Bring structure and governance to lifecycle strategy—ensuring data hygiene, segmentation accuracy, and QA rigor




WHO YOU ARE

items.desc:
¡Hola! 
 Soy Mariana, recruiter de esta posición. Viajar es una de mis mayores alegrías, y lo que lo hace aún más especial es poder vivir esas experiencias con mi familia y nuestra querida gata Rosita. 
 Quizás somos la décima oferta que lees hoy, en el sofá con Netflix de fondo, o en pleno proceso de cambios… y todas te parecen iguales. 
 ¡Te seré clara, en Zurich no somos perfectos, pero molamos bastante! Y si quieres saber por qué, sigue leyendo. 
 Antes de nada, GRACIAS por interesarte en nuestra compañía. Sabemos que la búsqueda de nuevas oportunidades suele ser un reto, pero… ¡no te preocupes que todo llega! 
 ¡Vayamos al grano! Intentaré resumirte en 2 puntos nuestro ADN: 
 Nos encanta el voluntariado, pero preferimos ser activistas del cambio . ¿Cómo? Poniendo nuestro foco en jóvenes que están en riesgo de exclusión social o luchando contra el cambio climático con acciones como la reforestación de bosques en Madrid y en el Parque de Doñana. En 2025 hicimos más de 28.000 horas de activismo. 
 En Zurich, lo decimos alto y claro: estamos orgullosos de nuestros colores y creemos que un equipo diverso marca la diferencia. Aquí no hablamos de discapacidad, hablamos de habilidad. Que puedas ser tú mismo/a es nuestra prioridad , sin armarios que se interpongan entre nosotros y sin techos de cristal. El 50% de nuestros puestos de responsabilidad están ocupados por mujeres (incluido el Comité de Dirección). 
 ¿Sabes que producimos nuestros propios podcasts sobre identidad sexual? Estamos construyendo una compañía en la que todas las personas son bienvenidas. 
 Y te preguntarás: Marian ¿cómo será mi día a día con la camiseta azul? Me encanta que me hagas esta pregunta (yo también me la hice en su momento): 
 Tu objetivo será el de liderar y gestionar un panel de corredores asignados a tu zona, bajo criterios de crecimiento y rentabilidad en el equipo de la DT Sur / Canarias. 
 Gestionarás una red de corredores, garantizando el crecimiento rentable del negocio de Particulares, Empresas y Vida en Málaga. 
 Tendrás la posibilidad de impulsar ideas para potenciar este desarrollo, dinamizando y motivando a la red de corredores asignados, ejecutando iniciativas para alcanzar los objetivos marcados. 
 Aportarás una visión integral del negocio, detectando oportunidades para el desarrollo del mismo, estando al corriente de las nuevas necesidades del mercado y de los competidores de la zona. 
 A estas alturas, te estarás preguntando, ¿Cómo sé si encajo? 
 No te preocupes, no te voy a pedir que salves el planeta ni que cumplas el 100% de los requisitos. 
 Valoraremos si tienes experiencia demostrable gestionando y liderando grandes cuentas de clientes. 
 Si te motiva trabajar con una red de corredores, orientado al cliente y con una proactividad comercial. 
 No es indispensable, pero si has trabajado en entornos digitales es un plus más que bienvenido. 
 Tendremos en cuenta que te motiven las herramientas de trabajo colaborativo (ej: Teams, PowerBI, etc). 
 Ahora mismo, o estás con la emoción de cuando un pantalón te entra perfecto o estás pensando: “esto no es para mí” (si no es para ti, no pasa nada, ya nos volveremos a encontrar en el futuro). Puedes hacer de celestina compartiendo mi contacto con quien creas que pueda encajar. 
 En Zurich somos muy disfrutones , nos gusta vivir la vida. Ya me contarás cómo podemos hacerte feliz, pero a mí me encanta poder conciliar mi trabajo con mi vida personal. Aquí la flexibilidad horaria y la desconexión digital son reales. 
 #PorSerDeZurich , puedes escoger los beneficios que mejor se adaptan a tus necesidades. Ya sabemos que, para gustos, los colores. 
 Te ofrecemos un modelo híbrido mega flexible para trabajar. 
 Confiamos en la filosofía de aprender haciendo para que puedas moverte a otras áreas a nivel local o internacional gracias a nuestro programa “Talento en Movimiento”. Y para que sigas con tu desarrollo y crecimiento: clases de inglés, formación y programa de mentoring personalizado. 
 Queremos romperte los esquemas de la retribución flexible. Con nuestra bolsa de beneficios, podrás elegir lo que mejor se amolde a ti y a tus necesidades: seguro médico, guardería, formación, tickets restaurante... ¡y mucho más! 
 Nos gusta dibujar sonrisas y en Zurich sabemos que es más fácil de lo que parece, por eso somos activistas. ¿Y por qué no dedicar un día entero a la causa que más te motive? 
 Referral bonus si nos recomiendas algún talento como tú. No buscamos a nadie perfecto, pero si conoces a alguien que mola, compártele mi contacto, me encantará conocerle. 
 ¡Si tienes espíritu deportivo, en Zurich vamos a por el oro! Maratones, carreras, descuentos en gimnasio y mucho más. 3,2,1… ¡calienta que salimos! 
 ¿Eres más de playa o de montaña? Tendrás 25 días de vacaciones, más el día del seguro y el día de tu cumpleaños para que disfrutes de lo que más te gusta. Pero que no te engañen, desconexión de verdad. Porque sí, todos nos merecemos un descansito y disfrutar de la vida, …

items.desc:
Overview 
 Help shape solutions and make a lasting difference in AI Business Solutions - AI Workforce. In this role, you put advanced artificial intelligence directly in front of leaders at Portugal’s largest institutions and ensure it works in their real environments. You work across a broad portfolio instead of a single product or account, giving you a breadth of scenarios and impact you would not see in many other roles. You are also joining early in the lifecycle of new capabilities, helping customers adopt them while others are still reading about what is possible.
 As the Solution Engineer for Copilot and Agents, you are the technical counterpart in a one-to-one partnership with a sales specialist, jointly accountable for landing transformative solutions. You design and validate end-to-end solutions that make Microsoft the default artificial intelligence interface for information workers, helping organizations standardize on trusted platforms and reduce unmanaged technology. You show customers how to turn strategy into working solutions in the rooms where buying decisions and long-term architectures are defined.
 At Microsoft, our mission to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more guides how we partner with customers to deliver trusted, impactful solutions. With a growth‑mindset culture, we innovate responsibly and measure success by shared progress, people, teams, and customers. Join us to do meaningful work that changes the world and helps shape what’s next for everyone.
 Responsibilities 
 Use deep understanding of customer context, solution portfolio, and industry trends to build credibility with customers and act as a trusted advisor on their security and artificial intelligence needs.Lead technical discussions, architectural design sessions, and proof-of-concept engagements to demonstrate Microsoft solutions, secure technical wins, and ensure successful integration into complex customer environments.Engage in partner sell-with motions by serving as a liaison between partners and internal teams, coordinating partner resources, and supporting partner technical capacity by identifying skill or resource gaps and providing feedback to internal teams.Capture core competitive and market insights from customer and partner engagements and deliver them back to product, engineering, and account teams to shape win strategies, consumption plans, and customer success outcomes.Leverage internal resources, technical communities, and readiness opportunities to continuously grow domain expertise and share knowledge with virtual teams across the organization.
 Qualifications 
 Required/Minimum Qualifications 
 Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND substantial technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field AND proven technical pre-sales or technical consulting experience.
 Preferred Qualifications
 Substantial technical pre-sales, technical consulting, or technology delivery, or related experience OR equivalent experience.
 Proven experience with cloud and hybrid, or on premises infrastructures, architecture designs, migrations, industry standards, and/or technology management.
 Certification in relevant technologies or disciplines (e.g., Office 365, Power BI, Azure Architect and Development exams, Cloud Platform Technologies, Information Security, Architecture).
 Solution Engineering IC4 - The typical base pay range for this role across Portugal is € 43,300.00 - € 74,300.00 per year. Certain roles may be eligible for benefits and other compensation. 
 Find additional benefits and pay information here:
 https://careers.microsoft.com/v2/global/en/corporate-pay/portugal-corporate-pay.html 
 This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

items.desc:

 Overview 
 Entrerai nel team dei Digital Business Partner e contribuirai alla realizzazione di iniziative rilevanti in ambito Compliance Financial Markets e Investment Banking. Ti occuperai con proattività, autonomia e propensione al risultato di favorire e coordinare il confronto attivo fra tutti gli stakeholder (referenti di business, funzioni di controllo e team IT), creando solide relazioni, al fine di individuare le modalità più efficaci ed efficienti per il raggiungimento degli obiettivi del Piano Industriale. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Contribuire al monitoraggio delle evoluzioni di mercato e delle normative nel settore di interesse, supportando la mappatura delle gap rispetto all'as-is 
 Coordinare le funzioni business, controllo, IT e operations nella gestione delle richieste e/o examination da parte delle Autorità (Consob, NFA, ...) 
 Partecipare attivamente alla formalizzazione delle esigenze progettuali e alla individuazione delle modalità migliori per la relativa realizzazione; 
 Gestire stream progettuali, monitorando avanzamento, tempi, costi e qualità dei deliverable, supportando l'indirizzamento delle issue e relative escalation e sviluppando insieme alle strutture di riferimento soluzioni che garantiscano la messa a terra delle iniziative ed il raggiungimento degli obiettivi 
 Assicurare il confronto nel continuo fra i diversi stakeholder utente e IT, garantendo allineamento tra esigenze, costi, vincoli normativi e soluzioni 
 Contribuire alla raccolta e formalizzazione dei requisiti di business e normativi, verificando la relativa documentazione 
 Analizzare impatti operativi, normativi e tecnologici, garantendo la coerenza tra requisiti, modelli operativi e architettura target 
 Supportare attivamente i test, il monitoraggio e il rilascio delle soluzioni realizzate 
 Predisporre la documentazione di progetto, supportando la preparazione dei principali momenti di aggiornamento sulle attività progettuali (riunioni rilevanti, SAL, Steering, ...) 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Esperienza di 3-5 anni in progetti digitali, organizzativi, regolamentari nel settore Banking con focus in ambito Compliance Financial Markets e Investment Banking 
 Laurea preferibilmente in discipline economiche o scientifiche 
 Conoscenza approfondita di Financial Markets, Investment Banking e Regulatory Reporting 
 Esperienza in attività di analisi, raccolta requisiti e predisposizione documentazione di progetto 
 Gestione degli economics di progetto in ottica Total Cost of Ownership 
 Conoscenza della lingua inglese almeno livello B2 secondo scala CEFR 
 Project Management, governance progettuale e analisi rischi e impatti 
 Conoscenza/utilizzo di strumenti AI 
 Predisposizione alla sperimentazione nel continuo e all'evoluzione di processi, soluzioni e modus operandi, facendo anche leva sulle potenzialità abilitate dall'AI 
 Eccellente conoscenza Microsoft Office 
 Partecipazione a progettualità interdisciplinari complesse 
 Conoscenza principali normative in ambito Capital Markets (MiFID II, MiFIR, EMIR, SFTR, MAR, Investor Protection e Product Governance, Dodd Frank Act - Swap Dealer).

 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 €
