 Overview 
 Entrerai in un team dedicato a progetti di Digital Asset e Tokenizzazione, occupandoti di soluzioni per emissione, custodia e regolamento di asset tokenizzati. Lavorerai su piattaforme DLT, custody, smart contract Ethereum e Polygon, contribuendo alla progettazione e all'evoluzione di soluzioni innovative. Avrai l'opportunità di approfondire temi regolatori come MiCAR, DORA e DLT Pilot Regime e collaborerai con Risk, Compliance e Architettura. 
 Quali saranno le tue attività 
 Progettare e implementare applicazioni software per piattaforme di Digital Asset (Java/Python), con componenti di interazione con reti DLT (nodi, smart contract, wallet) 
 Analizzare in autonomia i flussi di emissione, custodia e regolamento di asset tokenizzati, individuando criticità tecniche e di processo 
 Valutare la fattibilità tecnologica ed economica di soluzioni di custody e tokenizzazione (Omnibus Wallet, asset segregation, key management) 
 Progettare specifiche per applicativi a supporto di Travel Rule, KYC/AML e monitoraggio on-chain (es. Chainalysis, Notabene) 
 Formalizzare proposte di evoluzione dell'architettura delle piattaforme Digital Asset, in coerenza con MiCAR e DORA 
 Supportare code review, standard di sicurezza (audit smart contract) e pratiche di sviluppo del team 
 Chi stiamo cercando 
 Se hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: 
 Almeno 3 anni di esperienza nello sviluppo software 
 Laurea ad indirizzo informatico-scientifico (Informatica, Matematica, Fisica, Ing. Informatica) 
 Ottima padronanza dell'inglese e degli strumenti Office 365 
 Conoscenza avanzata di Java (Spring) e/o Python, con esperienza di integrazione con reti blockchain 
 Conoscenza di tecnologie DLT/Blockchain (Ethereum, Polygon, reti permissioned) e relativi meccanismi (account abstraction, gas fee, custody) 
 Conoscenza di smart contract (Solidity o equivalenti) e best practice di audit e sicurezza 
 Familiarità con i principi normativi MiCAR, DLT Pilot Regime e DORA applicati ai sistemi IT 
 Conoscenza di Git, sistemi a gestione eventi (Kafka, Nifi, Flink), DB SQL/NoSQL e GCP 
 Esperienza con strumenti Agile (JIRA) e capacità di mentoring verso profili junior 
 Costituisce titolo preferenziale aver svolto percorsi di studio e/o lavoro in ambito internazionale. 
 Cosa ti offriamo 
 Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 40.000 € 
 Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo 
 Elementi complementari disciplinati dal Contratto Collettivo Nazionale Credito e accordi aziendali di secondo livello 
 Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone 
 Ampia offerta formativa tramite la Corporate Academy dedicata allo sviluppo continuo delle competenze professionali, manageriali e trasversali a tutti i livelli 
 Possibilità di aderire al lavoro flessibile e alla settimana corta 4x9 
 Sistema moderno e integrato di welfare aziendale ( link ) 
 Copertura sanitaria e previdenza complementare a decorrere dall’assunzione 
 Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo 
 Chi siamo 
 Siamo leader in Italia e uno dei principali gruppi bancari in Europa. Unisciti a noi e fai parte della nostra storia di successo! Con oltre 20 milioni di clienti in Italia e all'estero siamo un vero e proprio motore di crescita sostenibile con un forte impegno per l'ambiente e un impatto tangibile sulla società. 
 Le persone sono al centro, ce ne prendiamo cura impegnandoci nel creare una cultura inclusiva all'interno del Gruppo in cui tutti si sentano protagonisti e valorizzati. 
 L’Area Chief Data, A.I. & Technology Officer è la realtà IT del Gruppo che coniuga l’agilità di una fintech con la solidità di un grande gruppo; avrai l'opportunità di lavorare in un contesto innovativo con tecnologie all’avanguardia e con forte spinta alla trasformazione digitale. 
 Unisciti alla nostra realtà internazionale. Il futuro non si aspetta, si sceglie! 
 #sharingfuture 
 Garantiamo un ambiente inclusivo e di pari opportunità. Considereremo tutte le candidature a prescindere da razza, religione, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, stato civile, età, disabilità o qualsiasi altra categoria protetta nel rispetto dei D.lgs. 198/2006, 215/03 e 216/03. 
 Per la valutazione delle candidature, i dati saranno utilizzati da Intesa Sanpaolo S.p.A. come Data Controller. Ti invitiamo a prendere visione dell’ Informativa Privacy dedicata.

VÚB banka je druhá najväčšia banka na Slovensku a súčasť medzinárodnej skupiny Intesa Sanpaolo – jednej z popredných bankových skupín v Európe. V prvom rade sme komunita zanietených ľudí, ktorí veria v prostredie, kde má každý priestor rásť a rozvíjať svoj potenciál. Našou najväčšou hodnotou sú práve naši ľudia. Firemnú kultúru staviame na rešpekte, empatii a dôvere – vďaka čomu sa naši zamestnanci cítia oceňovaní a podporovaní. Ako prvá banka na Slovensku, ktorá získala medzinárodný titul TOP Employer, sme nastavili nový štandard pracovného prostredia. Ponúkame flexibilný spôsob práce – kde to povaha pozície umožňuje, zamestnanci si sami volia, kedy pracujú z domu a kedy z kancelárie. Technológie vnímame ako kľúč k budúcnosti – neustále hľadáme digitálne riešenia, ktoré zjednodušujú prácu a posúvajú nás vpred. Podporujeme vzdelávanie – nielen v oblasti odbornosti, ale aj osobnostného rastu a rozvoja ľudského potenciálu. Uvedomujeme si význam duševného zdravia – preto ponúkame komplexné programy a benefity, ktoré pomáhajú našim kolegom udržiavať psychickú pohodu a rovnováhu. U nás robíme maximum pre to, aby sme vytvárali zdravé, moderné a spokojné pracovné prostredie. Ak chcete byť našou súčasťou, určite sa nám ozvite. 
 Platové podmienky 
 1 650 EUR/mesiac
 Štartovacia základná mzda je 1 450 EUR + mesačné provízie a kvartálne odmeny. Priemerná mesačná provízia po úspešnom adapte sa pohybuje vo výške 200 EUR a závisí od Tvojej šikovnosti, či to bude viac. Kvartálne odmeny sa priemerne pohybujú vo výške 700 EUR v závislosti od plnenia individuálnych aj pobočkových cieľov. Po 6 mesiacoch Ťa čaká jednorázový adaptačný bonus vo výške 50% Tvojej nástupnej základnej mzdy.
 Účel a náplň práce 
 Čo od vás očakávame 
 Ak Ťa zaujíma svet bankovníctva, si komunikatívny/komunikatívna a máš prax v práci s hotovosťou, si skvelý typ na bankára/bankárku vo VÚB!
 Čakajú Ťa u nás možnosti kariérneho rastu aj zaujímavé finančné ohodnotenie.
 Okrem iného, máme pre Teba pripravených množstvo benefitov a ak o nich chceš vedieť viac, scrolluj ďalej.
 Vítame u nás skúsených bankárov, ale ak ešte bankovú prax nemáš, nevadí. U nás vo VÚB Ťa na to pripravíme celkom od začiatku.
 ČO TI DÁME NA ÚVOD?
Vďaka silnej podpore manažérov pobočky, nápomocným kolegom a priateľskému prístupu našich lektorov sa:
 postupne začneš orientovať vo VUB bankových produktoch a službách,
 naučíš pracovať s klientom a zlepšíš svoju komunikáciu a schopnosť argumentovať, čo sa Ti zíde aj v osobnom živote.
 PREČO SA TI PRÁCA VO VÚBKE BUDE PÁČIŤ?
 Budeš pracovať v jednej z najväčších a najvýznamnejších bánk na Slovensku.
 Na pobočke ste jeden tím – obchodné plány plníte spoločne a vzájomne sa podporujete.
 Rozširuješ si odbornosť a získavaš skúsenosti, ktoré využiješ v Tvojej kariére.
 Pri práci s klientom sa zlepšuješ v mnohých oblastiach, ktoré oceníš aj v osobnom živote.
 TVOJOU ÚLOHOU AKO PORADCU KLIENTA BUDE:
 podieľať sa na podpore predaja a spolupracovať s tímom,
 hľadať príležitosti pre predaj všetkých bankových produktov a služieb,
 poskytovať informácie a odborné poradenstvo klientom,
 vykonávať pokladničné a zmenárenské operácie,
 vykonávať servisné klientske operácie, zodpovedne pracovať s hotovosťou,
 podieľať sa na administratívnych činnostiach,
 neustále sa vzdelávať o novinkách vo svete financií a odborne rásť.
 Čo môžete očakávať vy od nás 
 Ako zamestnanec/zamestnankyňa získavaš benefity, ktoré porastú tak, ako budeš rásť spolu s nami. Čím dlhšie u nás budeš pracovať, tým viac výhod získaš!
 Odmenu za výkon. Raz ročne získaš bonus, ktorého výška závisí od splnenia firemných aj Tvojich individuálnych cieľov.
 Stravné plne hradené zamestnávateľom bez doplatku zamestnanca.
 Až do 10 dní plateného voľna nad rámec zákona každý rok.
 Kredit vo VÚB Cafetérii až do výšky 300 eur, ktorý rastie s počtom odpracovaných rokov.
 Až do 100 eur mesačne ako príspevok na doplnkové dôchodkové sporenie (III. pilier).
 Zvýhodnené produkty a služby VÚB banky.
 190 eur ročne ako príspevok na obliekanie.
 Chcete objaviť všetky fantastické výhody, ktoré svojim zamestnancom VÚBka ponúka? Mrknite na našu kariérnu stránku a preskúmajte širokú škálu našich benefitov! 
 Požadované skúsenosti 
 Pozícii vyhovujú uchádzači so vzdelaním:
 stredoškolské s maturitou
 Požadované zručnosti, kvalifikácia a znalosti 
 Si pre nás vhodným kandidátom/kandidátkou ak:
 máš minimálne SŠ vzdelanie s maturitou,
 Ťa baví komunikovať,
 si priateľský/á a vieš pracovať individuálne aj v tíme,
 máš v sebe ducha obchodníka,
 si dôveryhodnou a bezúhonnou osobou,
 chceš hľadať to najvhodnejšie riešenie pre klientov,
 si ochotný/á na sebe pracovať a rozvíjať sa.
 ... všetko ostatné Ťa naučíme my :)
 Informácie o výberovom konaní
Ak Ťa tento popis zaujal a chceš sa stať naším novým VÚBkárom, stačí už len kliknúť na „Reagovať na ponuku" a my sa Ti ozveme. Všetko dôležité o práci vo VÚB si povieme na osobnom/online stretnutí.
Tešíme sa na Teba !

items.desc:
Join our global Cybersecurity Central Coordination team and help turn Information Security governance into effective action across Continental regions, locations and business functions. As Cybersecurity Central Coordinator , you will translate policies, standards and regulatory requirements into coordinated activities and measurable outcomes.
You will connect central, regional and local Cybersecurity stakeholders, strengthen security awareness and compliance, and create transparency on risks, incidents and improvement measures.
 YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: 
 • Coordinate Cybersecurity activities across assigned regions, locations and business functions.
• Support the implementation of Information Security policies, standards and service-management processes.
• Monitor Cybersecurity services and agreed service levels and follow up on delivery issues.
• Maintain dashboards and reports covering compliance, risks, incidents and improvement actions.
• Coordinate remediation of audit findings and support risk assessments and security controls.
• Contribute to Information Security roadmaps, standards, solution concepts and operating-model improvements.
• Support Cybersecurity projects by tracking milestones, dependencies, risks and actions.
• Facilitate stakeholder collaboration, knowledge sharing, awareness, training and phishing-resilience activities.
• Support provider, portfolio and sourcing activities and assess relevant market and technology trends.
• University degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a comparable qualification.
• +3 years of experience in Cybersecurity or Information Security.
• Strong knowledge of Cybersecurity governance, processes, service management and risk management.
• More than 3 years experience in coordinating cross-functional and international stakeholders.
• Experience in project or process coordination and collaboration with service providers.
• Ability to translate legal, regulatory and business requirements into practical actions.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills.
• Business-fluent English and excellent communication skills.
• Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC or ISO 27001 are an advantage.

We bring together data, advanced analytics, and AI capabilities to transform complex information into actionable insights that directly shape business strategy and decision-making. About the role As a Business Insights Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in this transformation, partnering closely with cross-functional teams to unlock the full value of data in a highly dynamic and regulated pharmaceutical environment. From commercial performance to customer and patient understanding, you will help translate complex healthcare and market data into clear, meaningful insights that drive impact across our organization. Translate complex analyses into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders through dashboards, reports and presentations. Contribute to forecasting accuracy and business planning through trend analysis, predictive modeling and forward-looking insights. Provide insights into customer, patient and health pathways to identify opportunities to improve engagement, experience and outcomes. Lead or support qualitative and quantitative market research and tracking initiatives to deepen customer understanding. Support experimentation and learning by evaluating initiatives, communicating findings and recommending actions to stakeholders. Proficiency with data analysis and visualization tools such as SQL, Power BI, Excel, Qlik Sense or Tableau. Knowledge of statistical analysis, with Python or R considered a strong advantage. Experience leveraging AI tools such as Copilot, Gemini is considered as a strong advantage. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail, with the ability to organize, interpret and communicate complex data accurately. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate insights for non-technical audiences. Experience working with cross-functional teams and managing multiple stakeholders effectively. Ability to turn data into clear, business-relevant insights and recommendations; experience with market research, behavioral science and data privacy/governance is an advantage. We’re all about connecting the dots in architectures, and to do that we push the limits of technology and continuously challenge ourselves and our clients. Within our practice we have established a dedicated team of passionate Low Code enthusiasts. Starting small a few years ago, our team has experienced rapid growth and continues to expand. We have a strong focus on OutSystems and Microsoft Power Platform and are proud to offer our clients the most cutting-edge Low Code platforms available in the market. Be part of our success story and contribute to transforming the way we serve our clients with powerful Low Code solutions! Your Responsibilities: Executing projects with a focus on quality Incorporating architectural and technical best practices Collaborating with clients to comprehend and fulfill requirements YOUR PROFILE You have 2 to 3 years of experience developing OutSystems mobile and reactive web applications (Associate Reactive Web Developer certification required). You have a good understanding of OutSystems development best practices, including integrations and APIs. You are familiar with application lifecycle aspects such as quality, CI/CD, and solution design. Team-oriented, proactive, and analytical, with a customer-focused mindset. A flex plan where you can buy extra days off, update your insurance or buy home office supplies. 32 vacation days + Bank holidays. items.desc: Locations : Stockholm | Copenhagen V | Oslo | Helsinki Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do We are looking for a hands-on Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Nordic People Analytics function, within Strategic Projects & Analytics, supporting our four Nordic markets. This role focuses on understanding our data landscape, extracting and transforming relevant data, building visualizations and dashboards, and delivering ad hoc analyses that help our leadership, People teams and key stakeholders gain sharper insights from data and make better decisions. A smaller part of your role will be to help functions experiment and adopt AI tools to work more effectively and future-proof. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of our data landscape – including datasets, how they connect, their purposes, information flows, and how it relates to actual business processes. Explore and quality-test our data in Snowflake, using SQL to validate fields, reconcile numbers, investigate data issues – and confirm / align with the functions owning the data and processes. Build and maintain reliable data pipelines at consumption / transformation layer, e.g. by extracting, transforming and validating Snowflake data for new Tableau dashboards. Design, build and continuously improve Tableau / BI dashboards that are used across Nordics. Translate stakeholder questions into concrete data needs and insightful analyses across markets and topics, e.g. headcount, hiring, attrition, engagement and much more. Act as the go-to technical contact for colleagues who need data support, and help them explore and prototype AI tools like Claude and Agents to keep functions at the forefront. What You'll Bring You are likely someone who combines strong technical skills with analytical curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a drive to improve how things work. You enjoy getting into details, understanding how data connects and flows, solving problems alone and with others, and enabling the organization through data and analytics, while staying at the forefront by developing yourself and others. Core Skills and Competencies: Structured Analytics and Technical Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to structure problems, investigate data, understand how it relates, and develop practical solutions. Curiosity and Learning Agility: Genuine interest in understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, exploring new technologies and continuously improving. Ownership and Execution: Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines and plans. Accuracy and Attention to Detail: You take pride in data quality, consistency and building solutions others can trust, with ability to explain and stand behind work and results. Stakeholder Focus: Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into useful, practical analytics solutions, working closely with stakeholders. Able to communicate findings clearly in meetings, presentations, dashboards and written communication. Business Understanding: Ability connect data and analytics to underlying business processes, understand what drives the numbers and identify opportunities for improvement. Qualifications and Experience: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development; also considering Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or related fields. Experience: Recent graduate or up to 3 years of experience in analytics, data (engineering), or a related field. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort learning Snowflake; Excel; hands-on experience with data, Tableau, Tableau Prep, BI tools, and AI is advantageous. Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage Above all, we value strong technical foundations, analytical curiosity, ownership, and potential over experience with specific tools or technologies. Who You'll Work With You will join our Nordic Analytics team, working primarily within People Analytics in our People …

items.desc: CDI Depuis plus de 20 ans, LabSoft accompagne les projets de transformation numérique de ses clients avec engagement, proximité et expertise. Présente à Toulouse, Paris, sur l'Arc Atlantique et en Tunisie, notre entreprise compte aujourd'hui plus de 200 collaborateurs. En 2025, LabSoft franchit une nouvelle étape avec l'intégration de Bigso, experte en solutions réseaux et sécurité. Ce rapprochement stratégique renforce notre position sur le marché de la cybersécurité, et nous permet de proposer une offre complète : pilotage de projets IT, développement logiciel, services managés et infrastructures sécurisées. Nos domaines d'intervention couvrent les secteurs : Aéronautique, spatial, défense Mobilité, transport, collectivités Banque, assurance, finance Secteur public Mais LabSoft, c'est une ESN mais pas que... C'est : Un laboratoire d'innovation, avec notre LabFactory, centre de services informatiques industrialisés et orientés performance Un pôle R&D, LabSearch, dédié aux nouvelles technologies Un acteur engagé sur le plan sociétal et environnemental : médaille Ecovadis Or, bilan carbone annuel, et des actions concrètes pour réduire notre impact Nos valeurs ? Humain – Collectif – Service – Expertise – Créatif – Libre Elles façonnent notre culture d'entreprise et nourrissent nos engagements au quotidien. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Parce que chez LabSoft, nous croyons en : Une proximité managériale réelle L'épanouissement individuel et collectif Le développement des compétences via un plan de formation structuré et un accès à la plateforme Udemy Une vie d'entreprise dynamique et participative, portée par notre initiative "LabSoft Building – Ensemble construisons demain" : Afterworks mensuels Prises de parole collaboratives Moments conviviaux pour créer du lien Vous avez envie de vous investir dans des projets porteurs, au sein d'une structure agile et réactive ? LabSoft est fait pour vous. À vous de jouer ! Dans le cadre d'un nouveau projet visant à industrialiser des solutions Data & IA pour mieux anticiper les fluctuations de la demande, identifier leurs causes et fiabiliser la prise de décision industrielle, nous recherchons un(e) Développeur GCP. Vous interviendrez au sein d'un environnement technique complexe, reposant sur l'exploitation et la consolidation de données issues notamment de SAP, Skywise et d'autres sources. Intégré(e) à une équipe pluridisciplinaire composée de Data Scientists, développeurs, Business Analysts et architectes, vous contribuerez à la conception, au développement et à l'industrialisation des composants Data & IA du projet. À ce titre, vos principales missions seront les suivantes : Développer et maintenir des services et pipelines de données sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP) ; Intégrer, transformer et exploiter les données issues de SAP, Skywise et d'autres systèmes ; Participer au développement de solutions d'analyse des causes de volatilité de la demande (Root Cause Analysis) ; Contribuer aux cas d'usage de conformité SAP, notamment l'analyse de règles, l'identification de non-conformités et la proposition d'actions préventives ; Développer et intégrer des services liés à l'intelligence artificielle, notamment des assistants IA et interfaces conversationnelles ; Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des API permettant l'interopérabilité entre GCP, Skywise et les systèmes tiers ; Garantir la qualité du code, la réalisation des tests et la documentation technique ; Participer aux phases de recette, de déploiement et d'industrialisation des solutions ; Collaborer avec les équipes techniques et métiers dans un environnement Agile ; Contribuer aux revues techniques et au partage des connaissances au sein de l'équipe. VOTRE PROFIL : Issu(e) d'une formation Bac+5 / école d'ingénieur en informatique, développement logiciel ou Data, vous justifiez d'une expérience confirmée en développement sur Google Cloud Platform (GCP), idéalement acquise dans un environnement industriel complexe. Vous disposez : D'une excellente maîtrise de Python et SQL ; D'une expérience confirmée dans le développement de pipelines Data sur GCP ; D'une bonne maîtrise de BigQuery et des bibliothèques et API Python associées ; D'une expérience en conception, développement et intégration d'API ; D'une bonne connaissance de Git et des pratiques de développement collaboratif ; D'une maîtrise des principes CI/CD, des tests automatisés et de l'industrialisation des applications ; D'une bonne compréhension des architectures Data Cloud et des problématiques d'intégration de données ; D'une capacité à travailler en collaboration avec des Data Scientists, architectes et équipes métiers ; D'un anglais professionnel, à l'écrit comme à l'oral. Une expérience préalable au sein de l'environnement IT Airbus est fortement souhaitée, afin de faciliter la compréhension des systèmes, des processus internes et des contraintes techniques. Une connaissance de SAP, Skywise ainsi qu'une première expérience sur des projets intégrant des composants …

items.desc: Description de l'entreprise Meritis est un cabinet de conseil, pilotage et développement IT fondé en 2007 présent à Paris, Sophia-Antipolis, Aix-en-Provence, Montpellier, Toulouse, Nantes... Et bientôt sur de nouveaux territoires ! Notre mission ? Connecter les meilleurs talents aux entreprises pour leur donner un temps d’avance. Nous accompagnons nos clients dans l’intégralité de leurs besoins en transformation numérique à travers de nombreux domaines d’expertises : Software Engineering, Finance, Pilotage de projets, Devops, Data, Cloud, Cybersécurité ou encore Agilité. Intervenant aussi bien dans les secteurs de la Banque, de l'Assurance, des Télécommunications que de l'Industrie ou des Transports, aujourd'hui 40% des entreprises du CAC40 sont clientes Meritis. Fort de nos valeurs d’exigence, d’humilité, de bienveillance et de proximité, nous comptons aujourd’hui plus de 900 collaborateurs. Nous mettons un point d’honneur à être proche de nos collaborateurs et à les accompagner de manière individualisée quelles que soient leurs fonctions dans l’entreprise. Certifiée Great Place To Work depuis 2013, notre conception du bien-être au travail va bien au-delà d'un simple label, ce sont nos collaborateurs qui en parlent le mieux : Description du poste Dans le cadre de la modernisation du backend, le socle du processing de données est ré-écrit sur une technologie BigData, ce qui permet d'élargir l'offre de services proposée aux utilisateurs. Dans ce cadre, la mission consiste à : Contribuer à l'analyse des besoins des différents métiers : analyse de données, BI, Big Data. Contribuer à la définition des solutions dans l'environnement applicatif (Cloud Platform / Spark Data processing). Récupérer les données sur les assets à partir d'une base de données RedShift. Traiter les données afin de garantir une qualité de données optimale. Exploiter les données et faire des restitutions dans les datasets / datamarts. Appliquer les mises en forme et agrégations sur les données. Etablir des comparaisons entre les données et des restitutions pertinentes selon les besoins métiers. Qualifications Vous êtes titulaire d’un diplôme d’ingénieur ou universitaire Bac+5, Vous avez à partir de 3 ans d’expérience, Vous aimez travailler dans un environnement agile et novateur et êtes passionné.e de Big Data, Avoir travaillé au moins sur Azure, AWS ou GCP Vous maîtrisez un langage de programmation : Python ou Java Vous maîtrisez les outils Big Data suivants : Spark, Scala, Hadoop Do you speak english ? Informations supplémentaires Devenir collaborateur Meritis c’est : Des parcours professionnels sur mesure (évolution de carrière, formations adaptées, mentoring…) ; Avoir le choix de sa mission et un accompagnement personnalisé tout au long de votre carrière ; Evoluer dans un environnement où l’apprentissage est favorisé : formations certifiantes, e-learning, meetUp, concours de code, parcours d’évolutions etc ; Faire partie de communautés d’experts qui partagent leurs savoirs et expériences au sein de nos centres de compétences ; Un environnement convivial avec de nombreux événements festifs (soirée annuelle, séminaires & teambuiding, déjeuners et afterworks…) ; Meritis est engagée dans la Responsabilité Sociétale des Entreprises. Nous valorisons notre impact positif sur la société et l'environnement. Notre démarche RSE guide chacune de nos actions pour promouvoir l'équité, la durabilité et le bien-être de nos collaborateurs. Rejoignez-nous pour être partie prenante de cette démarche responsable, où chacun de nos talents contribue à construire un avenir meilleur. Nos différences sont nos atouts. C’est pourquoi Meritis s'implique en faveur de la diversité et de la non-discrimination. Tous nos métiers sont accessibles aux personnes en situation de handicap.

Rejoignez AVISIA et participez à des projets Data à forte valeur ajoutée ! Créée en 2007, AVISIA est une société de conseil spécialisée en Data, Intelligence Artificielle et Digital . Avec plus de 320 collaborateurs et collaboratrices répartis dans 5 agences en France, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la valorisation de leurs données et le développement de solutions innovantes, de la stratégie jusqu’à la mise en production. Nos équipes interviennent sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur de la donnée, en associant expertise technique, compréhension des enjeux métiers et proximité humaine. Notre objectif : transformer les données en leviers de performance et aider nos clients à prendre des décisions éclairées. Nous intervenons auprès de clients issus de secteurs d’activité variés, notamment le Luxe, le Retail, les Télécoms, la Banque, l’Assurance et l’Industrie . Cette diversité vous permettra de découvrir différents environnements métiers et de travailler sur des problématiques aussi bien techniques qu’opérationnelles, autour de la Business Intelligence, de l’analyse de données, du reporting, de la Data Visualisation et de la connaissance client. Nos missions en Data Analytics Chez AVISIA, nous vous proposons des missions qui allient analyse de données, expertise technique et compréhension des enjeux business . SPI Group vous offre l’opportunité de relever un nouveau défi en tant que Chef de projet robotique F/H. Depuis 40 ans, SPI Group est un partenaire de confiance pour des clients nationaux et internationaux . Bien plus qu’un prestataire logistique, nous proposons une offre globale et innovante , allant de la conception des lignes de production au conditionnement final des produits . Nos services incluent également le développement d’emballages et de machines , ainsi que la logistique intégrée et l’entreposage . Nos atouts ? Mission SPI Group souhaite anticiper l'arrivée de la robotique humanoïde et de la Physical AI dans ses activités industrielles et logistiques. La technologie étant encore émergente, l'objectif est d'identifier les bons partenaires, de tester les solutions les plus prometteuses et de construire une compétence interne capable de les industrialiser. Vos missions : Assurer une veille technologique sur les humanoïdes, la robotique, la vision et l'intelligence artificielle. Identifier, évaluer et sélectionner les constructeurs, intégrateurs et partenaires technologiques les plus pertinents. Identifier et prioriser les cas d’usage sur les sites SPI : logistique, manutention, conditionnement, alimentation machines, picking, etc. Piloter l'intégration et les tests du premier humanoïde en conditions industrielles réelles. Construire progressivement les standards et compétences internes permettant le déploiement et le pilotage d'une flotte d’ humanoïdes. Profil Nous recherchons un profil orienté terrain et faisant preuve d'une capacité d'autonomie reconnue en matière de gestion de projet robotique. Au delà de vos compétences techniques, c'est aussi votre savoir être qui fera la différence : Curieux, pragmatique et structuré Capacité à challenger des technologies émergente Capacité à mener une collaboration interservices (fournisseurs, production et direction) La maitrise de l'anglais est indispensable.

En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Caisse d'épargne Rhône Alpes recherche actuellement des profils : Banque régionale et coopérative, la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes est présente sur 5 départements : l’Ain, le Rhône, l’Isère, la Savoie et la Haute-Savoie. Avec ses 3000 collaborateurs, elle accompagne ses clients particuliers, professionnels, entreprises, collectivités, associations tout au long des étapes clés de leur vie. Employeur majeur de la région, notre banque a effectué près de 300 recrutements en CDI en 2025. Elle investit activement dans la formation pour accompagner la transformation des métiers de la banque et offrir des parcours professionnels multiples et motivants. 

 Banque régionale et coopérative, la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes est un acteur économique incontournable de la région. Elle accompagne l’ensemble de ses clients et contribue au développement durable de son territoire. Son engagement social et solidaire se traduit concrètement à travers des actions fortes en faveur de l’égalité des chances, de l’inclusion et de la diversité. Dans une démarche d’amélioration continue de l’expérience collaborateur, la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes obtient, dès sa première participation, la certification Great Place To Work®, référence mondiale en matière de qualité de vie au travail. Cette distinction vient reconnaître l’engagement collectif des équipes ainsi que les actions menées pour favoriser un environnement de travail positif, au service de la performance. Poste et missions La Direction de l’Audit interne bénéficie d’un double rattachement, au Président du Directoire et à l’Inspecteur général du Groupe BPCE. Au sein de la Direction, vous intégrez une équipe de 21 collaborateurs basés à Lyon, à la Tour Incity. Les missions de la direction s’inscrivent dans le dispositif de contrôle interne au troisième et dernier niveau, conformément à la réglementation bancaire. Le principal objectif vise à s’assurer d’une bonne maîtrise de l’ensemble des risques et d’apporter des solutions y compris en termes de conseil aux différentes problématiques. Le modèle de la direction de l’audit de la CERA a été construit pour permettre l’acquisition de compétences multi-dimensionnelles durant ce parcours d’excellence à l’instar de ce que l’on retrouve dans les inspections générales de banques. Ce métier est depuis quelques années en évolution permanente. A l’instar des inspections générales des banques, l’audit interne de la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes a entamé sa transformation digitale et a commencé à déployer des outils de Data science et de DataViz. En effet, ces outils revêtent de nombreux avantages pour les auditeurs, tels que : permettre d’étendre les tests par échantillon à de l’exhaustif, de fiabiliser des reportings internes, d’apporter une meilleure robustesse dans les analyses et les constats élaborés, tout en assurant une meilleure productivité, ou encore d’élaborer des modèles prédictifs afin de mieux anticiper les risques à venir. C’est pourquoi la Direction de l’audit est à la recherche d’un Data Analyst (F/H) afin de renforcer l’équipe Data qui aura pour missions : De contribuer à l’implantation de nouveaux outils de gestion de données, D’extraire, de fiabiliser, de croiser et d’analyser les données requises pour les différentes missions, D’élaborer des synthèses et de restituer les résultats, De participer à la montée en compétences de l’ensemble de l’équipe d’audit sur le domaine de la data, D’interagir avec les équipes DATA de la Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes et des entités du groupe BPCE Profil et compétences requises Curieux, adaptable aux environnements changeants et intéressé par la maîtrise des risques, vous démontrez une double capacité de travail en équipe et en autonomie. Vous disposez également d’une capacité d’analyse, d’un esprit de synthèse et d’un intérêt pour les métiers de la banque et du secteur financier. Compétences techniques : Logiciels de gestion de base de données, Maîtrise des techniques d’analyse de données, Développements en SQL, Connaissance d’outils comme Alteryx, powerBI, Connaissance du langage Python. Ce poste requiert confidentialité, capacité et rigueur d’initiative, mais aussi curiosité, capacité de synthèse et esprit d’équipe. Informations complémentaires Poste basé à Lyon. La Caisse d’Epargne Rhône Alpes s’engage en faveur de l’accueil et de l’intégration des personnes en situation de handicap.

Vous intégrerez une direction composée de 150 agents majoritairement techniciens et ingénieurs, dans les différents domaines du numérique (études, développements, systèmes, bases de données, réseaux, sécurité, SIG, protection et valorisation des données, …). A titre indicatif, le Système d'Information de la Ville de Marseille est composé d'environ 450 applications, 6 000 postes de travail, 280 sites municipaux interconnectés, 1 600 serveurs hébergés … Missions Votre rôle consistera à : Recueillir et analyser les besoins des directions métiers, traduire les usages en modèles de données, tableaux de bord et restitutions décisionnelles ; Concevoir et faire évoluer l'architecture BI : entrepôts de données et datamarts, modèles dimensionnels, couches sémantiques, flux ETL/ELT et solutions de restitution ; Développer, industrialiser et documenter les rapports, tableaux de bord et analyses, en favorisant des usages en libre-service maîtrisés et une expérience utilisateur adaptée ; Garantir la qualité, la cohérence et la sécurité des données et des indicateurs : règles de gestion, référentiels, traçabilité, catalogage, gestion des habilitations et documentation ; Valoriser les données de la collectivité pour l'aide à la décision, le pilotage des politiques publiques et les dispositifs d'observatoire territorial ; Contribuer au maintien en conditions opérationnelles du SI décisionnel, à l'optimisation des performances, au suivi des évolutions et à l'accompagnement des utilisateurs ; Assurer une veille technologique et sectorielle sur les architectures décisionnelles, la visualisation, l'analyse et la valorisation des données ; Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes techniques de la DSI, les directions métiers et l'Administratrice Générale des Données afin d'assurer la cohérence des solutions, le partage des expertises et la bonne prise en compte des besoins. Votre profil Nous avons hâte de vous connaître ! Titulaire d'un diplôme Bac + 5 dans le domaine des systèmes d'informations, de la data, vous disposez d'une expérience dans la conception et la mise en œuvre de solutions BI et d'analyse de données. Vous maîtrisez SQL, la modélisation dimensionnelle, les architectures d'entrepôt de données et de datamarts, ainsi que les outils d'intégration ETL/ELT et de restitution décisionnelle. La maîtrise d'une plateforme BI telle que SAP BO, Digdash, ou équivalent, de ses modèles sémantiques et de ses langages de calcul constitue un attendu important. Vous savez construire des indicateurs fiables, produire des analyses lisibles et optimiser les modèles, les requêtes et les rafraîchissements. items.desc: ABOUT QUINCE Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. THE ROLE Cashmere Engineer Specialist Dehaired Fiber Quality Control Oversee the quality of dehaired cashmere fiber entering the supply chain, ensuring it meets Grade A specifications for micron, length, purity, and vegetable matter content. Establish and enforce clear acceptance criteria for dehaired fiber, including maximum coarse hair content and minimum yield thresholds. Inspect and approve incoming dehaired fiber lots before release to spinning mills, flagging any non-conforming material for return or rework. Partner with dehairing facilities to optimize processes that maximize Grade A output while minimizing fiber damage or waste. Grade A Standards Enforcement Define what constitutes Grade A cashmere for the organization. Conduct regular audits of dehairing suppliers to ensure consistent adherence to Grade A specifications. Work upstream with sourcing and herder cooperatives to improve raw fiber quality before dehairing, reducing Grade A rejection rates. Finished Yarn Quality Assurance Evaluate finished cashmere yarns against required quality standards, including evenness, tensile strength, twist consistency, and surface cleanliness. Test yarns for critical attributes such as pilling potential, colorfastness, and handfeel before approval for knitting production. Identify and reject yarn lots that fail to meet quality thresholds, documenting defects and communicating findings to spinning mills. Cashmere Material Library Build and maintain a physical and digital cashmere material library, cataloging dehaired fiber lots and finished yarns by key attributes (micron, origin, color, lot number, test results). Organize the library to support cross-functional teams (R&D, Product Development, Sourcing, Production) in referencing past and current materials for development and troubleshooting. Include reference standards for Grade A fiber and approved yarn constructions to serve as benchmarks for quality comparisons. Update the library regularly with new fiber lots, yarn developments, and supplier samples, ensuring traceability from raw material to finished yarn. Root Cause & Corrective Actions Investigate quality failures in finished yarns—such as neps, slubs, weak spots, or inconsistent dye uptake—to determine if the root cause lies in dehaired fiber, spinning, or finishing. Collaborate with dehairing and spinning partners to implement corrective actions and prevent repeat issues. Track quality trends across fiber lots and yarn batches to identify recurring supplier or process weaknesses. items.desc: Your main goal at Profound As a Strategic Client Partner, you're a project manager with a strategic edge. Your number 1 goal is to lead a portfolio of clients from strategy to delivery: you own the scope, planning, budget and stakeholder management, and grow the relationship as the client's single point of contact at Profound. Are you ready to Make it Happen? Your main responsibilities will include Project management — You own the scope, planning, budget and stakeholder management for every project in your portfolio. You lead the multidisciplinary team behind it, and keep quality, budget and deadlines on track. Strategic direction — You steer the strategy process together with the Creative Strategist. You translate client goals into sharp briefs, then present and defend the strategy to the client. Client leadership — You are the client's trusted, single point of contact. You spot opportunities before the client asks, and turn that trust into growth. Creative and technical direction — You give conceptual direction to the creative team and steer development work. You explain technical choices to clients in plain language. AI-powered ways of working — You use AI to speed up planning, briefing and reporting. That frees up your time for strategy and relationship building. What you already bring to the table 4+ years of experience in a strategic, creative-lead or senior client role at an agency. A background as an entrepreneur or senior PM with strong strategic and commercial instinct works too. Strong strategic and business writing skills. You're comfortable presenting to, and challenging, clients at C-suite level. Working knowledge of web, app and software development. Enough to brief, judge and explain it. Fluent in Papiamentu and English. Dutch and/or Spanish is a plus. Hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Familiarity with Curaçao or the wider Caribbean market. Must be located in Curaçao. About Profound Work is a big part of life. At Profound we believe that's why it should always be fun and interesting. Our Caribbean roots are the source of our upbeat culture in which you're able to make an impact internationally. Our values reflect fun, drive, and inclusion, making this a great place to demonstrate your passion. We provide work with impact and meaning and encourage personal growth, mental health and initiative. Our mission is to help mankind forward through profound digital experiences. If you share that mission, you're just the person we're looking for! Sounds like you? We are curious to get to know you! If you see yourself working for Profound, please provide us with a surprising and convincing application and send us your portfolio. Our Human Experience Manager will get in touch with you after that. Job Type: Full-time Pay: From €2.500,00 per month Work Location: In person

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Able to lift 40 lbs. without assistance Job Description As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. DESCRIPTION: Join our Norwegian team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute to critical scientific research and innovation. As a Field Service Engineer III, you'll provide expert installation, maintenance, and repair services for sophisticated analytical and microscopy equipment. Working with advanced technology, you'll deliver outstanding technical support while building strong relationships with customers across research institutions, universities, and industrial facilities. You'll resolve complex issues, conduct installations, system certification, preventive maintenance, and train users to ensure optimal system performance. This role offers excellent opportunities for professional growth and development within an organization dedicated to serving science. You will be supporting our customers in Norway and the Nordic areas for Chromatography and Mass Spectrometry. This role is field based, supporting customers across all of the Nordic countries, but with a primary focus on Norway. Working as part of the dedicated Norwegian team supporting Life Science Mass Spectrometry and Chrome productline including HPLC IC, GC, GCMS, ICP and ICPMS you will take part in providing marked-leading on-site services exceeding customer’s expectations every single day. What will you do? Support and enable customers by providing troubleshooting, installation, Preventative Maintenance (PM), repair services and qualification services in a professional and timely manner Provide the highest quality level of telephone and remote support Actively promote our contract products Achieve customer satisfaction through positive and professional interaction and bring up any issues to solve critical tasks in the fastest way possible Manage the company’s assets provided, such as stock/inventory of Parts, Computer, Telephone, general Tools, Software, Company Car, Manuals etc. Co-ordinate with a variety of internal partners for service planning/scheduling (Dispatching, Team Leader etc.) Provide accurate and timely reporting of all activities (e.g. Field Service Reports, Expense Reports, etc.) Collaborate with the Sales team regarding lead generation, customer activities and updates Job Requirements Professional background or relevant degree in Electronics, Chemistry, or as a Laboratory Technician. Hands-on experience with analytical instruments, preferably HPLC, IC, GC, and LCMS. Experience servicing analytical equipment or equivalent experience as an Application Specialist is an advantage. Experience working in research laboratories or similar environments is an advantage. Self-driven, with excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively across all levels, functions, and regions. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Proficiency in a Scandinavian language is desirable but not required. Good understanding of Scandinavian culture is an advantage. Strong IT skills. Valid driver's license and willingness to travel up to 50-75% within the assigned territory. Ability to travel across Europe and the US for technical training Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated organizational abilities, with the capability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously. Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration within the team. Commitment to following safety protocols and quality standards. Ability to respond to customer needs at short notice. Ability to effectively train and support customers in the operation of analytical equipment. We Offer A career with an international company making a global impact. A diverse and rewarding role as part of an engaged, customer-centric team. Continuous learning and professional development opportunities. Collaboration with talented colleagues across multiple business areas. The opportunity to work alongside some of the best teams in the industry, from internationally recognized scientists to cutting-edge process and production teams, as well as highly creative business and marketing professionals. A competitive benefits package, including pension and healthcare.

items.desc: Locations : Stockholm | Copenhagen V | Oslo | Helsinki Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do We are looking for a hands-on Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Nordic People Analytics function, within Strategic Projects & Analytics, supporting our four Nordic markets. This role focuses on understanding our data landscape, extracting and transforming relevant data, building visualizations and dashboards, and delivering ad hoc analyses that help our leadership, People teams and key stakeholders gain sharper insights from data and make better decisions. A smaller part of your role will be to help functions experiment and adopt AI tools to work more effectively and future-proof. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of our data landscape – including datasets, how they connect, their purposes, information flows, and how it relates to actual business processes. Explore and quality-test our data in Snowflake, using SQL to validate fields, reconcile numbers, investigate data issues – and confirm / align with the functions owning the data and processes. Build and maintain reliable data pipelines at consumption / transformation layer, e.g. by extracting, transforming and validating Snowflake data for new Tableau dashboards. Design, build and continuously improve Tableau / BI dashboards that are used across Nordics. Translate stakeholder questions into concrete data needs and insightful analyses across markets and topics, e.g. headcount, hiring, attrition, engagement and much more. Act as the go-to technical contact for colleagues who need data support, and help them explore and prototype AI tools like Claude and Agents to keep functions at the forefront. What You'll Bring You are likely someone who combines strong technical skills with analytical curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a drive to improve how things work. You enjoy getting into details, understanding how data connects and flows, solving problems alone and with others, and enabling the organization through data and analytics, while staying at the forefront by developing yourself and others. Core Skills and Competencies: Structured Analytics and Technical Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to structure problems, investigate data, understand how it relates, and develop practical solutions. Curiosity and Learning Agility: Genuine interest in understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, exploring new technologies and continuously improving. Ownership and Execution: Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines and plans. Accuracy and Attention to Detail: You take pride in data quality, consistency and building solutions others can trust, with ability to explain and stand behind work and results. Stakeholder Focus: Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into useful, practical analytics solutions, working closely with stakeholders. Able to communicate findings clearly in meetings, presentations, dashboards and written communication. Business Understanding: Ability connect data and analytics to underlying business processes, understand what drives the numbers and identify opportunities for improvement. Qualifications and Experience: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development; also considering Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or related fields. Experience: Recent graduate or up to 3 years of experience in analytics, data (engineering), or a related field. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort learning Snowflake; Excel; hands-on experience with data, Tableau, Tableau Prep, BI tools, and AI is advantageous. Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage Above all, we value strong technical foundations, analytical curiosity, ownership, and potential over experience with specific tools or technologies. items.desc: Systemutvikler Utvikler for neste generasjons IMINT-plattform Stillingstittel Systemutvikler Ansettelse Fast Startdato Avdeling Etterretningstjenesten Sted Oslo Søknadsfrist 5. nov. 2026 Etterretningstjenesten – Viten om verden for vern av Norge Etterretningstjenesten har som oppdrag å samle inn informasjon og varsle om forhold i utlandet som kan true Norge og norske interesser. Vi søker nå etter utviklere til vårt IMINT-miljø. Som medarbeider i Etterretningstjenesten vil du bidra i vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag, samt være en del av et miljø kjennetegnet av høy kompetanse og sterkt engasjement for fagfeltet. IMINT (Imagery Intelligence) handler om å trekke kritiske observasjoner og analyser ut fra bilder. Her får du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom satellittbilder, maskinlæring og store datamengder. I vårt utviklerteam jobber vi med en moderne stack som inkluderer blant annet Angular, NodeJs, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Python og GDAL, samt computer vision. For å møte økende behov og videreutvikle våre systemer, ser vi etter deg som enten er en sterk fullstack-utvikler, eller som har spisskompetanse og lidenskap for spesifikke deler av stacken. Vi tilbyr en spennende og variert hverdag i et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter. Vi oppfordrer både nyutdannede og erfarne utviklere til å søke. Vi er avhengige av mangfold i perspektiver og erfaringer for å løse våre oppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi å rekruttere medarbeidere fra ulike bakgrunner, med ulike livserfaringer til å jobbe hos oss. Kvinner oppfordres til å søke stillingen. Arbeidsoppgaver Hovedoppgaven din blir å utvikle og innovere systemene og verktøyene våre for bildeanalyse, som er helt avgjørende for våre IMINT-analytikere. Dette innebærer: Utvikling og videreutvikling av løsninger for prosessering og databehandling Utvikle funksjonalitet for å fremvise og interagere med data innenfor IMINT og remote sensing Kvalifikasjoner Stillingen har følgende krav som må innfris for å bli vurdert som aktuell søker: Overingeniør: Bachelorgrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (cand.-grader, tidl. Ingeniørutdanninger o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet Senioringeniør: Mastergrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (hovedfag, profesjonsstudier o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet For begge: God teknisk innsikt og sikkerhetsforståelse God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk Erfaring innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: Programmering med Typescript, Rust og/eller Python Moderne webutvikling med fortrinnsvis Angular, React, Vue eller Svelte Moderne backend-rammeverk og patterns SQL og databaser som f.eks. Postgres I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har: Erfaring med moderne DevOps/CICD/Kubernetes Erfaring med teamarbeid innenfor programmering/utvikling Erfaring og kunnskap innenfor remote sensing Særskilte krav for stilling i Etterretningstjenesten: Søkere må tilfredsstille kravene til høyeste sikkerhetsklarering. For ansettelse i Etterretningstjenesten kan man ikke ha annet enn norsk statsborgerskap ved ansettelsestidspunktet. Stillingen er underlagt beordringsplikt, jf. forsvarsloven og forsvarstilsatteforskriften, som innebærer at du kan beordres til internasjonale operasjoner. Dette skjer normalt på grunnlag av villighet. Beordringsplikt medfører krav til medisinsk og fysisk skikkethet og grunnleggende engelskkunnskaper. Dersom du ikke oppfyller kravene har du mulighet til å søke dispensasjon. Personlige egenskaper Personlig egnethet for en stilling i Etterretningstjenesten vil bli ilagt stor vekt: Holdninger og pålitelighet: Etterretningstjenesten krever høy faglig- og personlig integritet, pålitelighet og lojalitet av sine medarbeidere. Lærelyst og planmessighet: Vi søker personer som ivrer for sitt fagfelt, og som møter arbeidsdagen med lærelyst og et ønske om å levere. Samspill og samarbeid: I Etterretningstjenesten er vi opptatt av å ha et godt arbeidsmiljø. God lagånd, respekt og toleranse i møte med andre er av stor betydning. Stressmestring: Det er en forutsetning at våre medarbeidere har evnen til å stå i periodevis stor arbeidsbelastning. I tillegg ønsker vi at du: Er initiativrik Er kreativ Er sikkerhetsbevissthet Vi tilbyr Hos oss får du en spennende og samfunnsviktig jobb hvor du vil kunne utgjøre en forskjell. Etterretningstjenesten er opptatt av å øke kompetansen hos de ansatte, og det vil satses både på deg som person og din faginteresse. Våre ansatte har fleksitid, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden, samt gunstige lån- og pensjonsordninger gjennom Statens pensjonskasse. Du vil få en årslønn innenfor spennet kr 690 000 – 830 000 i stillingen som overingeniør (kode: 1087) eller kr 785 000 - 980 000 i stillingen som senioringeniør (1181) iht. gjeldende Hovedtariffavtale. items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients. Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities. What You’ll Do Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

items.desc: Locations : Stockholm | Copenhagen V | Oslo | Helsinki Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do We are looking for a hands-on Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Nordic People Analytics function, within Strategic Projects & Analytics, supporting our four Nordic markets. This role focuses on understanding our data landscape, extracting and transforming relevant data, building visualizations and dashboards, and delivering ad hoc analyses that help our leadership, People teams and key stakeholders gain sharper insights from data and make better decisions. A smaller part of your role will be to help functions experiment and adopt AI tools to work more effectively and future-proof. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of our data landscape – including datasets, how they connect, their purposes, information flows, and how it relates to actual business processes. Explore and quality-test our data in Snowflake, using SQL to validate fields, reconcile numbers, investigate data issues – and confirm / align with the functions owning the data and processes. Build and maintain reliable data pipelines at consumption / transformation layer, e.g. by extracting, transforming and validating Snowflake data for new Tableau dashboards. Design, build and continuously improve Tableau / BI dashboards that are used across Nordics. Translate stakeholder questions into concrete data needs and insightful analyses across markets and topics, e.g. headcount, hiring, attrition, engagement and much more. Act as the go-to technical contact for colleagues who need data support, and help them explore and prototype AI tools like Claude and Agents to keep functions at the forefront. What You'll Bring You are likely someone who combines strong technical skills with analytical curiosity, structured problem-solving, and a drive to improve how things work. You enjoy getting into details, understanding how data connects and flows, solving problems alone and with others, and enabling the organization through data and analytics, while staying at the forefront by developing yourself and others. Core Skills and Competencies: Structured Analytics and Technical Problem-Solving: Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to structure problems, investigate data, understand how it relates, and develop practical solutions. Curiosity and Learning Agility: Genuine interest in understanding how things work, questioning assumptions, exploring new technologies and continuously improving. Ownership and Execution: Proactive, independent and reliable, with the ability to manage priorities and deliver high-quality work to agreed timelines and plans. Accuracy and Attention to Detail: You take pride in data quality, consistency and building solutions others can trust, with ability to explain and stand behind work and results. Stakeholder Focus: Understand stakeholder needs and translate them into useful, practical analytics solutions, working closely with stakeholders. Able to communicate findings clearly in meetings, presentations, dashboards and written communication. Business Understanding: Ability connect data and analytics to underlying business processes, understand what drives the numbers and identify opportunities for improvement. Qualifications and Experience: Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data, Engineering, Computer Science, Software Development; also considering Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or related fields. Experience: Recent graduate or up to 3 years of experience in analytics, data (engineering), or a related field. Technical Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of SQL and comfort learning Snowflake; Excel; hands-on experience with data, Tableau, Tableau Prep, BI tools, and AI is advantageous. Languages: Fluent in English; proficiency in a Nordic language is an advantage Above all, we value strong technical foundations, analytical curiosity, ownership, and potential over experience with specific tools or technologies. Vi söker en systemutvecklare med fokus på integrationer till ett av våra team på kontoret i Norrköping. Här får du möjlighet att forma hur vi bygger arkitektur och integrationer, driva strategier och riktlinjer och bidra till att leverera med kvalitet och effekt. Är du vår nästa stjärnspelare? Vad betyder det att vara en stjärnspelare på Stadium? Stadiums mission är att inspirera till ett aktivt liv för alla. För att lyckas med det behöver vi medarbetare som brinner för det de gör och som vill bidra till något större. Som systemutvecklare inom Stadium Tech arbetar du affärsnära med teknik i framkant. Vi jobbar enligt DevOps, Agile och Lean – och vi tror inte på en beställarorganisation. Hos oss är du med hela vägen: från att förstå behov och idé, till att designa, bygga och förbättra lösningen över tid. Vi tror att de bästa lösningarna skapas tillsammans – genom dialog, samarbete och ett kontinuerligt lärande. Här får du både professionell och personlig utveckling i ett engagerat och innovativt team. AI är en integrerad del av hur vi bygger framtidens lösningar. Vi använder AI för att accelerera utveckling, höja kvalitet och öka värdet vi skapar för våra kunder. Därför söker vi dig som är nyfiken, experimenterar och aktivt vill utveckla både dig själv och vårt arbetssätt med hjälp av AI. Läs mer om vårt lag och vårt erbjudande på vår karriärsida https://karriar.stadium.se, på Instagram, eller vår LinkedIn. Klicka på länken här för att på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium. Vad innebär det att vara systemutvecklare på Stadium? Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team med utvecklare, solution specialists, solution lead och affärsrepresentanter. Du kommer arbeta nära samtliga deltagare i teamet och får därigenom en stor förståelse för vår affär och har stor möjlighet att påverka utförande, arkitektur och lösning. Du blir en del av ett tvärfunktionellt team med utvecklare, solution specialists, solution lead och affärsrepresentanter. Du arbetar nära både teamet och verksamheten och får en djup förståelse för affären Du är med hela vägen från idé till implementation och vidareutveckling Du utvecklar, förvaltar och äger integrationer Du bidrar till att sätta strategi, principer och riktlinjer för hur vi bygger integrationer Du driver förbättringar och delar kunskap inom teamet och organisationen Vi söker dig som trivs i en miljö där samarbete, dialog och gemensamt ansvar står i centrum – och där du själv aktivt bidrar till att driva arbetet framåt. Kvalifikationer Vem är du? Du är en erfaren systemutvecklare som gillar att ta ansvar, samarbeta och arbeta nära affären. Vi tror att du: Har flera års erfarenhet av systemutveckling och integrationsutveckling Är van att omsätta affärsbehov till hållbara tekniska lösningar Trivs i ett nära samarbete med både team och verksamhet Tar egna initiativ och driver arbetet framåt Har erfarenhet av t.ex. Function Apps, Logic Apps, API:er, Client ID och token-hantering Har erfarenhet av JavaScript/TypeScript Har relevant eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande erfarenhet För att lyckas i rollen ser vi också att du: Ser AI som en självklar del av din verktygslåda och aktivt använder det för att arbeta smartare och mer effektivt Är nyfiken, håller dig uppdaterad inom ny teknik och vill fortsätta utvecklas Bidrar till att förbättra både lösningar och arbetssätt Delar kunskap och stärker teamets gemensamma kompetens Erfarenhet från retail är meriterande. Teknik Vi arbetar med en modern och flexibel tech stack, där du som utvecklare är med och påverkar hur vi bygger framåt: Node.js .NET JavaScript/ TypeScript React Next.js Tailwind CSS Azure Microservices Kubernetes Event-driven architecture ElasticSearch CI/CD Varaktighet Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med tillträde efter överenskommelse.
