items.card: Your role As a Geophysicist within our Mineral Exploration team, you will bridge the gap between advanced data processing and practical field operations. Your responsibilities naturally follow the seasons—dedicating summer periods to dynamic fieldwork and ground data acquisition and focusing during the winter months on comprehensive data processing, 3D modelling, interpretation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.
items.desc: Combine geophysical analysis with hands-on fieldwork and contribute to mineral exploration in a varied role with excellent opportunities to grow. The sustainable transformation begins with us We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally. Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us? Your role As a Geophysicist within our Mineral Exploration team, you will bridge the gap between advanced data processing and practical field operations. Your responsibilities naturally follow the seasons—dedicating summer periods to dynamic fieldwork and ground data acquisition and focusing during the winter months on comprehensive data processing, 3D modelling, interpretation, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Your main responsibilities will include: Data Processing & Interpretation: Process, model, and interpret multidisciplinary geophysical data to delineate targets and refine geological models. Field Acquisition: Lead and participate in hands-on geophysical surveys and data collection campaigns across active exploration sites. Exploration Strategy: Provide critical geophysical insight to optimize drilling programs and advance mineral exploration initiatives. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with exploration geologists and specialists across LKAB, including geotechnics and mining operations. Project Participation: Engage flexibly in a wide variety of project stages as organizational needs and strategic exploration priorities evolve. You will work both independently and together with others. Close collaboration with fellow geophysicists, geologists and field technicians is essential for success in this role, as exploration projects rely on combining different areas of expertise and perspectives. The varied assignments and opportunities to participate in different projects provide excellent potential to develop within your professional field. What you bring We are looking for a geophysicist who thrives in a dynamic environment where fieldwork, data interpretation and collaboration go hand in hand. You have a structured and solution-oriented way of working, communicate your findings clearly and can translate complex data into valuable insights. You enjoy working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and contribute to a collaborative team environment. You are reflective and thoughtful in your decision-making, with an ability to balance technical opportunities with responsible use of resources to create sustainable and effective exploration solutions. We are looking for someone who has: Education: Higher university degree in geophysics. Strong background in physics. Experience in mineral exploration: Candidates with several years of relevant experience in mineral exploration will be given preference. However, all applications will be considered and reviewed based on the overall qualifications and experience of the candidate. Good spoken and written english Valid B driving licence for manual transmission vehicles It is an advantadge if you have: Geophysical Software: Proficiency in industry-standard software packages such as Oasis montaj (Seequent), Mira Geoscience, Leapfrog Geo, Maxwell, ModelVision,GeoTools. Electromagnetic Methods: Practical and theoretical experience with EM methods, with particular emphasis on Magnetotellurics (MT / AMT). Proficiency in Swedish, or a genuine willingness to learn. What we offer In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden: Relocation support for you and your family. Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs. LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture. The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days. Additional information We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. items.desc: This post will be based at the University of Cambridge in the Department of Psychiatry and work as a Pre-doctoral Research Assistant to support three National Institute for Health & Care Research (NIHR) funded projects for 29.6 hours per week until the end of December 2027. It will support 3 projects WAIT LESS https://arc-eoe.nihr.ac.uk/research-implementation/research-themes/inclusive-involvement-research-mental-health-over-life-0, the calibration and validation of Artemis A https://arc-eoe.nihr.ac.uk/research-implementation/research-themes/mental-health-and-wellbeing/calibration-and-utility-artemis and the Attend Well Study. WAIT LESS is now progressing on to a feasibility trial of a new digital intervention for young people with depression on the CAMHS waiting list at two NHS trusts. The post will also be joining the validation of the Artemis A computer adaptive testing algorithm against clinical research diagnosis and seeing how profiles change with treatment in clinical samples from various parts of the UK. They will be based in Cambridge but liaise with colleagues at trusts in Norwich, Berkshire, Liverpool, Manchester and London. This list might expand as other partners come on board. The work requires knowledge and experience of psychometrics, analysis of large quantitative datasets, clinical trials and evaluations. The successful applicant will also support the delivery of the Attend Well study, particularly organising and running the Young People's PPI panel, supporting participant recruitment and assisting with data collection and other research activities. We welcome applicants who would like to use this opportunity to develop further research proposals fellowship applications or other grants from the work completed. The Child and Adolescent Resilience and Mental Health Research group undertakes applied epidemiology, as well as intervention development and evaluation. The successful applicant will be at a junior level but will have the opportunity to supporting placement students. We are particularly interested in someone with experience of psychometric analysis and quantitative methods. The methods applied by the team include secondary analysis of large epidemiological datasets, mixed qualitative and quantitative observational studies, economic evaluation systematic reviews, and randomized controlled trials. The research is inherently translational and multi-disciplinary, and involves strong links with psychology, pediatrics, education, epidemiology, trial specialists, statisticians, health economics and basic scientists. Though we are looking for an applicant at a junior level, we envisage that they will eventually become involved in all aspects of this work. Applicants will have a bachelor's degree in psychology psychology, or equivalent, a strong knowledge of assessment and outcome measures in relation to children and young people's mental health. Experience of working with administrative data would be desirable but is not essential. For further details, please read the further particulars, please provide at least 3 references, a CV and covering letter indicating how you meet the criteria for this post. Informal enquiries may be directed to Professor Tamsin Ford via ChARM@medschl.cam.ac.uk If you have any queries regarding the application process please contact Simon Gurry, HR Coordinator (hradminpsychiatry@medschl.cam.ac.uk). Deadline for applications is 27th October 2026, with interviews TBC Fixed-term: The funds for this post are available until 31 December 2027 in the first instance. The covering letter should outline how you match the criteria for the post and why you are applying for this role. If you upload any additional documents which have not been requested, we will not be able to consider these as part of your application. The foundations of all of our work is relationship-based and strengths-based practice and we pride ourselves on doing this well. As a Senior Social Worker/Advanced Practitioner in the team, you will hold a caseload of complex work, but also support the team in other ways, including practice educating students, co-working, and mentoring less experienced colleagues, and chairing planning meetings and Strategy Discussions. You will work closely with the Team Manager and the other AP's in the team to manage the balance of the different parts of the role flexibly, so that it suits you, your colleagues, and the families you support. Are registered with Social Work England. What's in it for me? We are proud to offer an environment that is supportive and rewarding, working as part of a team who are passionate about the work they do to improve the lives of people in Somerset. At Somerset Council, we are proud to support our frontline workers with access to innovative AI technology. items.card: The role is based at our Fourth Way office in Avonmouth, with hybrid working available following an initial training period. What you’ll get to work on You’ll have the chance to: Build and improve Power BI reports and dashboards that help colleagues make informed decisions. Work directly with stakeholders to understand the problem they’re trying to solve, not simply take a reporting request. Develop data models,
items.desc: Help us turn data into decisions At Nisbets, we want to make it easier for colleagues to find, trust and use the data they need to make good decisions. As our Data & BI Developer, you’ll have the opportunity to make a real difference to how we use data across the business. Working with colleagues across IT, Finance and other teams, you’ll take business questions and turn them into clear, useful insight through Power BI and our wider data estate. The underlying JD specifically combines analysis and report development with data quality, governance and user enablement. You won’t just be building dashboards. You’ll help improve existing reporting, reduce duplication, strengthen data quality and make our BI solutions easier for people to understand, maintain and trust. Where you’ll work The role is based at our Fourth Way office in Avonmouth, with hybrid working available following an initial training period. What you’ll get to work on You’ll have the chance to: Build and improve Power BI reports and dashboards that help colleagues make informed decisions. Work directly with stakeholders to understand the problem they’re trying to solve, not simply take a reporting request. Develop data models, measures and calculations using Power Query and DAX. Use SQL to explore, validate and reconcile data from business systems and the data warehouse. Find useful trends, exceptions and opportunities within data from a variety of sources. Improve data quality and help resolve recurring issues at source. Simplify and consolidate reporting, reducing duplication and improving consistency. Help shape better standards for reporting, governance, security and deployment. What you’ll bring We don’t expect you to know everything, but you’ll need a strong foundation in: Power BI, Power Query and DAX. SQL and relational databases. Data warehousing and dimensional data modelling, including star schemas, facts and dimensions. Turning business requirements into practical reporting and insight. Analysing and validating data, with a strong focus on accuracy. Communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical colleagues. Experience of Finance or commercially focused reporting, ETL/SSIS, Power Automate or AI-enabled analytics would be useful, but isn’t essential. About Us Nisbets is committed to providing equality of opportunity for all colleagues. We aim to ensure our workplaces are free from discrimination and that not only colleagues but also our potential future colleagues are treated fairly and with dignity and respect. Therefore, please inform us of any reasonable adjustments that we may need to make to the application or interview process. Here at Nisbets, we aim high and we dream big. From a one-man operation in 1983, to the UK’s market leader today – it’s always been our determination to hit whatever goal we set ourselves, no matter how big. And we’ve done it time and time again. We’re looking for experts. Passionate, forward thinkers who obsess about our customers as much as we do. We need strivers, trailblazers and problem solvers who are as determined to grow, develop and succeed as we are. We’re determined to take the next step. But we need your help to do it. It’s all about you. If you’re looking for a forward-thinking business on which to leave your mark; where your work is valued; Where you’ll test your skills and then develop them further than you thought you could - Nisbets is for you. You’ll be pushing the boundaries with us, day in day out. You’ll work in a fast-paced, ever changing environment. You’ll collaborate with a wide range of other experts around the business, bringing big ideas to life, and play a leading role in taking our journey to the next level. We are a business with heart. From the small indie diner to the Michelin-star restaurant, Nisbets deliver the equipment they need to excel. If you join our team you’ll be working in a family-owned business that isn’t afraid to let you grow. That understands the value of innovation. And that puts our impact on the environment, our commitment to ethical trading and our determination to being a fully transparent business at the forefront of all we do. Ready to take the next step with us? Apply today.

items.desc: Programme Full Time Graduate Career Path Technology Location Manchester Start Date September-2027 Programme Description What does this team do? Audit matters to everyone, even if you've never heard the word before. When a company shares its financial results, people need to know those numbers are accurate. That's where audit comes in. We check company financial reports independently, so the public, investors and businesses can trust what they're seeing. It's a job that protects people, and it genuinely makes a difference. Delivery of our audit work increasingly relies on the understanding of large datasets, complex models, and the reporting produced from them. Our Technology & Data team empowers our Audit & Assurance teams by providing the expertise to analyse, interpret and validate the data and models we receive from the businesses we audit. This enhances audit quality and efficiency across all industries and systems, transforming the future of audit. What skills and academic qualifications do I need? You’ll need to have obtained or be studying towards a minimum 2:1 in any degree discipline and have graduated by September 2027 for the Autumn 2027 intake. We have identified 10 core skills that are essential to all of our roles in Early Careers. To learn more about these skills and their detailed descriptions, please visit the 'Discover What We Look For' section in our Candidate Zone. What kind of work will I do? Upon joining, you will receive comprehensive training designed to equip you with the skills necessary to tackle complex challenges for our diverse client portfolio. Throughout your career at Deloitte, you will be working with some of the largest listed and privately-owned firms in banking, insurance, and various corporate sectors. This role offers opportunities to push boundaries and develop skills for a rewarding career, within a dynamic and supportive environment. You will be challenged to think critically, solve complex problems, and contribute meaningfully to the success of our clients and our firm. Where will I work? At Deloitte we recognise how important face-to-face interaction is for your development in a new role. We also understand that our people need flexibility, which is why we operate a hybrid system, with a combination of office and home working. If you’re in a client-facing role, you might be expected to attend client sites on certain days, while your meetings will be a mix of online and in-person events. Please note your final assessment and induction will also be in-person, to give you the opportunity to network and build relationships. All our workspaces are accessible. However, if you require further flexibility due to a health condition or caring responsibilities, please discuss this with our team. You can find further information on our parent and carer policies here. What’s in it for me? You’ll join a world-class training scheme in a full-time permanent role, with a market-leading salary, benefits and a professional qualification that supports your long-term career. This is underpinned by our shared sense of purpose: We challenge and we rise to the challenge: We’ll support you to achieve your potential through an outstanding training scheme, an internationally recognised professional qualification and ongoing investment in your development throughout your career. We include everyone: You’ll be part of an inclusive culture where different perspectives are valued, learning is shared and you can build a strong professional network. We do the right thing: You’ll do work with purpose in a place where you can be yourself, grow professionally and personally, and make an impact that underpins the public interest and confidence in financial reporting. How will I develop? Skills We invest heavily in your development, building both your technical expertise and essential soft skills such as communication, critical thinking, decision-making, resilience, project management, and leadership. This comprehensive approach ensures you develop into a successful business professional, equipped to navigate challenges and thrive throughout your career, with a strong technical foundation. Professional Qualifications As part of your graduate opportunity, you will be required to study towards the globally recognised Certificate in Finance, Accounting and Business (CFAB) qualification. This will significantly expand your knowledge and expertise, giving you the confidence to excel in our audit practice. Whilst professional exams can be challenging, and will require a commitment from you, we in turn commit to providing you with the right support network to help you succeed. You will be given funded top-quality tuition, with a mix of classroom and self-managed learning sessions, a dedicated early careers coach, a People Leader and access to support from our professional education team. The qualification consists of six multiple-choice exams, you will be entitled to a maximum of two attempts at each exam. …

As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. Business development – utilising a combination of the organisation’s broader pre-existing relationships, company relationships and your own network. Developing business and investment case. Developing client proposals. What you'll love about working here? Our hybrid-first way of working means we embed flexible working in all that we do, and all UK employees are eligible to request flexible working arrangements. Your Wellbeing You’d be joining an organisation that puts your wellbeing at the top of its priorities, with a range of health & wellbeing communities and regular listening surveys.  Tudj meg többet a cégünkről: www.siemens.hu/mobility 
 A projektről: A Rail9000 rendszer feladata a vasúti közlekedés irányítása és felügyelete, pontos és megbízható vonatközlekedés biztosítása az utasok számára, magas szintű automatizálási funkciók és útmutatás nyújtása az üzemeltetők részére, valamint jelentéskészítési és karbantartási támogatás. E célok elérése érdekében felhasználja a különböző külső rendszerektől kapott információkat, feldolgozza azokat és megfelelő válaszokat biztosít. Moduláris kialakításának köszönhetően a Rail9000 nagyfokú skálázhatóságot és rugalmasságot kínál mind a hardveres, mind a szoftveres architektúrában.
 A csapat tagjaként az alábbi feladatok várnak rád: 
 Szoftvermodulok fejlesztése a követelmények alapján az EN50716 szabvány szerint Java és Groovy nyelven.
 Együttműködés egy nemzetközi (spanyol) fejlesztőcsapattal.
 A kód előállításához szükséges tesztek, kód review-k és dokumentációk készítése.
 Kódminőség biztosítása automatizált teszteléssel és CI/CD folyamatok használatával.
 Te vagy az ideális jelölt, ha: 
 Felsőfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel műszaki területen.
 Minimum 5 év tapasztalatod van komplex Java (21) alapú szoftverrendszerek fejlesztésében.
 Kiválóan kommunikálsz angolul szóban és írásban egyaránt.
 Erős kommunikációs készséggel és aprólékos, szervezett hozzáállással rendelkezel.
 A pályázásod során előnyt jelenthet, amennyiben: 
 Van tapasztalatod vasúti biztosítóberendezési rendszerek fejlesztésében.
 Jártas vagy az alábbiak valamelyikében is: Groovy, Gradle, GitLab, SonarQube, Azure DevOps, Jira, Kotlin, EN50716 szabvány.

 Idealerweise hast du auch schon Erfahrung im Bereich Leistungselektronik gesammelt.

 Du bist ein echter Teamplayer und hast eine hohe Einsatzbereitschaft, dich auch in neue Themen reinzudenken.
 Deine Arbeitsweise ist sorgfältig, zuverlässig, flexibel und selbstständig strukturiert.

 We are looking for someone who is passionate about developing high-performance and/or highly-secured Java applications! 
 Sqills, part of Siemens Mobility business unit Software, is a leading technology company focused on providing innovative solutions for the public transport industry. With a commitment to excellence, we are dedicated to improving the passenger experience and increasing operational efficiency for our clients across the globe.
 We share one common goal: enhancing the passenger experience with our combined power for the future of Mobility. 
 As an experienced Java Developer, you have a wide range of opportunities. Are you looking for a job with plenty of ways to challenge and improve yourself? Do you value working for a company that supports your professional development and offers working on a mission-critical SaaS suite?
 That, and more, is what we offer you. We are looking for Java Developers who want to work with the latest techniques and want to continue to challenge themselves.
 Siemens is operating a Software Development Center in Spain, Valencia targeting Intelligent Solutions for the future of Mobility. We want YOU to join our team
 Our approach: 
 This position is for one of our DevOps team. DevOps teams develop and maintain microservices that are part of S3 Passenger, our ticket and seat-reservation backend system. Some microservices are high-performing and others need extra security because they handle payment data for instance.
 But the team’s responsibility does not stop there. They also develop other applications in Java and are in charge of our own CI/CD development pipelines and other tooling that help support our daily responsibilities. In addition to Java, the team may also code in Kotlin and Go.
 At our teams have the freedom to spend time exploring new technologies that they can use to improve the performance of their microservices. We strive to do so continuously.
 Sqills uses Terraform, Kubernetes, and a number of other tools to manage the infrastructure (Infrastructure as Code). Our infrastructure is a combination of traditional services, AWS Lambda, and managed services such as DynamoDB, RDS, AmazonMQ, CloudWatch, and ELB.
 We monitor services in production using OpenTelemetry, New Relic, and PagerDuty. We also have a custom-built frontend that integrates these monitoring tools and visualises fully distributed traces to help us analyse errors in our microservice landscape.
 Secure development, architecture, performance, and resiliency are the cornerstones common to the different teams. This ensures that our software will continue to meet and exceed expectations in the future.
 We are always looking to improve our code, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and quality. We share all workloads within the team and try to make the best use of everyone's strengths. We love to share our knowledge and help each other achieve our goals.
 Your key responsibilities: 
 - Collaborating on software used to find and book seats for major international travel brands like Eurostar, Renfe, and SNCF.

 - Improving development pipelines or helping analyse new feature requests.
 - Continuously refactoring code to improve its quality and performance.

 Provádět elektrická měření a analyzovat výsledky.

 Vzdělání v elektrotechnice nebo příbuzném technickém oboru. 
 Základní znalosti analogové nebo digitální elektroniky. 
 Chuť učit se nové věci a hledat technická řešení. 
 Technickou zvídavost a samostatnost. 
 Nadšení pro vývoj a technologie. 
 Schopnost komunikovat v angličtině.

 Možnost učit se od zkušených vývojářů. 
 Přístup k moderně vybaveným laboratořím. 
 Zapojení do vývoje produktů od myšlenky až po sériovou výrobu. 
 Práci s moderními nástroji včetně AI asistentů pro technický vývoj. 
 Kariérní růst v oblasti elektroniky, EMC nebo systémového návrhu. 
 Přátelský tým a stabilní zázemí společnosti Siemens.

items.desc: L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 850 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Aujourd’hui, l’ambition du groupe est de se positionner comme le leader de l’IA appliquée au développement logiciel, c’est pourquoi nous avons lancé la practice AI Modernisation. Au sein de cette practice, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la modernisation de leurs systèmes legacy. Grâce à une IA maîtrisée et une méthode éprouvée, nous allons 3 fois plus vite sur le delivery de ces projets critiques. La practice accompagne principalement des scale-ups comme Qonto ou Doctolib et des grands groupes comme Carrefour, Pernod Ricard, Les Mousquetaires, Urgo, Cdiscount ou Edenred. Si tu veux rejoindre le futur de la tech, tu es au bon endroit ! Ton équipe : Tu rejoindras une communauté tech de plus de 120 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes, avec lesquels tu pourras échanger, apprendre et progresser au quotidien. Chez Theodo, les techs travaillent en équipes projet, constituées en fonction des besoins de chaque client. Tu feras partie d’une équipe de Theodoers à taille humaine (4 à 5 personnes), réunissant Software Engineers, Tech Lead et Product Manager. Ensemble, vous collaborerez étroitement avec le client, avec des échanges réguliers pour partager vos avancées, approfondir la compréhension de son problème et faire évoluer le produit au plus près des besoins de ses utilisateurs. Tes futures missions : En tant que Software Engineer Fullstack chez Theodo , ta mission sera de concevoir et développer des produits digitaux utiles, performants et durables pour répondre aux problématiques de nos clients et de leurs utilisateurs. Tout au long de tes projets, tu seras accompagné pour monter en compétences et apprendre à écrire du code de qualité, à comprendre les enjeux produit et à intervenir sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie d’une application, de la conception au déploiement. Ce que tu vas apprendre en tant que Software Engineer chez Theodo : Comprendre le problème de ton client et y répondre avec un produit performant, maintenable et orienté valeur, en intervenant sur tout le cycle de production, de la conception au déploiement. Produire du code de qualité dans les délais, en intégrant tests, refactoring et standards techniques de l’équipe, quelle que soit la technologie utilisée. Mener des investigations techniques, débugger efficacement et corriger les défauts de manière pérenne, dans tout type d’environnement. Analyser en profondeur des problèmes dans le code pour développer son esprit de résolution de problèmes Travailler avec un LLM pour accélérer les développements Les problématiques et les technos sont très différentes d’un projet à l’autre, voici quelques exemples : HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d’une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L’objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l’IA, nous passons d’une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5. Pernod Ricard : souhaitait moderniser une application interne utilisée pour gérer leur campagnes marketing, des millions d’euros en jeu. items.desc: About the Role: Positioned within Global Data Science & AI team, the Data Scientist contributes to solving complex business challenges through innovative analytics and AI-driven approaches, with a strong focus on production and scalability. The position supports the Data & AI function in shaping strategic decisions across the business and across multiple categories and geographies. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-value projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies and methodologies, transforming data into actionable insights that guide Ferrero’s growth. Based at the Alba offices , the role offers the possibility of working remotely up to two days per week. Main Responsibilities: As a Data Scientist, you will analyze diverse datasets, including internal and external sources related to Operations processes and build advanced statistical and AI-driven models to solve business questions across categories and geographies. In this role, you will develop, test, and deploy models leveraging traditional Machine Learning models as well as Generative AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques to deliver contextual insights and decision support. You will also design robust data cleaning and classification procedures ensuring data integrity for modeling and reporting. To gain efficiency for ongoing work, you will script automation workflows for analytical pipelines and explore AI-driven automation for data preparation, processing and model validation. You will create interactive dashboards in Power BI and , in some cases, develop self-service UI solutions enabling stakeholders to run models independently. Finally, you will continuously innovate, share knowledge, and integrate emerging technologies to enhance organizational capabilities by collaborating within a team of data scientists and cross-functional partners. About You: You hold a master's degree in a quantitative field such as Mathematics, Econometrics, Statistics, Engineering, or an equivalent discipline, and have gained solid experience in Advanced Analytics , with expertise in modelling techniques and advanced statistical concepts combined with familiarity with modern AI approaches. Knowledge of manufacturing operations, supply chain, and product quality environments would further strengthen your profile. You are proficient in programming languages such as Python and have experience working with platforms like Power BI, Azure, Spark, and Scala . Familiarity with Databricks and MLOps principles will enable you to contribute effectively across the analytics lifecycle. Analytical skills, creativity, and a test-and-learn mindset will help you thrive in this role. You are fluent in English and able to manage business stakeholders effectively, interpreting analytical outputs from a business perspective. Ready to turn data into impact? Apply now and join Ferrero’s global analytics journey. What We Offer: The role is classified at Level 1° under the National Collective Agreement for the Food Industry (CCNL Industria Alimentare). The guaranteed minimum base annual gross salary established by the CCNL for the applicable level is €43.249. The compensation package also includes an annual variable component with a target of up to 5% of base salary. The overall compensation will be determined based on the experience, skills, and qualifications of the selected candidate. Careers with caring built in - discover our benefits here. About Ferrero: Ferrero began its journey in the small town of Alba in Piedmont, Italy, in 1946. Today, it is one of the world’s largest sweet-packaged food companies, with many iconic brands sold in countries all over the world. Find out more about Ferrero at ferrero.com. DE&I at Ferrero: Ferrero is committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture in which all employees feel welcomed and appreciated and have the same opportunities. We believe all our people are equally talented in their own way. In nurturing the curiosity and natural abilities of our employees, we provide them, generation after generation, the means to succeed personally and professionally, enabling them to craft their journey at Ferrero. The diversity of our talents is what makes our work environment multicultural, innovative, and highly rewarding. Find out more here.

items.desc: Work Schedule Standard (Mon-Fri) Environmental Conditions Office As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our mission to life every day: enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources they need to achieve their career goals while developing solutions to some of the world’s toughest challenges, from protecting the environment and keeping food safe to helping find cures for cancer. How will you make an impact? Join our AI & Advanced Analytics team as an AI/ML Development Engineer , focusing on knowledge graph and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems built on biological data. Together with the team, you will apply advanced analytics, machine learning and AI to support proteomics discoveries across our R&D organization. You’ll help develop and deploy AI solutions that contribute to novel products, improve operational efficiency and support better decision-making. What will you do? You will develop AI and graph-based capabilities in partnership with scientists and software engineers. You’ll help turn research needs into practical RAG systems and production solutions, while supporting adoption of our AI platform and graph data structures. Key Responsibilities Include Build next-generation graph databases to support AI applications and productivity, including biomedical agents, protein folding and antibody affinity, and next-generation sequencing analysis. Gather requirements from scientists who need RAG-augmented systems. Develop proof of concepts for RAG systems and bring them into production in collaboration with software engineers. Promote and monitor the use of our AI platform and graph data structures. Partner with R&D scientists to identify requirements and develop features for production systems. How will you get here? You are a strong problem solver with attention to detail and a value-driven approach to your work. You communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders and are motivated to improve efficiency and optimize development and delivery. We are looking for someone who has A PhD or master’s degree in data science, computer science, statistics, mathematics or a related quantitative field, combined with relevant industry experience. At least three years of industry experience in software engineering, artificial intelligence, data engineering, computational biology or machine learning. Hands-on experience building and scaling platforms with graph databases. Strong programming experience with languages and frameworks such as Python, C++, Rust, Cypher, SPARQL and SQL. Experience developing and running large language models (LLMs) and creating enterprise RAG solutions. Experience with production workloads on cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience using Jira and GitHub. Strong communication skills, including the ability to present technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. The Following Experience Is Considered An Advantage Familiarity with big data technologies such as Spark or Databricks. A background in proteomics. Knowledge of Databricks. Location This position is based in Uppsala, Sweden. Office work is required three days per week.

items.desc: Chevron is accepting online applications for the Quantitative Analyst position through 27 October 2026 at 11:59 p.m. Responsibilities for this position may include but are not limited to: As a Quantitative Analyst, you will work alongside experienced analysts, structurers, and commercial professionals to develop quantitative models, support commercial decision-making, and help optimize Chevron's global commodities portfolio. Develop, validate, maintain, and enhance quantitative models and analytical tools used to value commodity transactions and support portfolio optimization activities. Apply quantitative techniques to evaluate commercial opportunities, assess risk, and identify key value drivers within commodity contracts and portfolio positions. Support the analysis of embedded optionality, pricing structures, and risk exposures across a wide range of commodity transactions. Assist in the development and improvement of analytics platforms and software used by commercial teams. Produce high-quality, well-documented code and contribute to ongoing enhancements of existing modelling frameworks. Conduct quantitative and data-driven analysis to support commercial decision-making. Collaborate with colleagues across trading, structuring, analytics, risk management, and commercial teams located in multiple regions globally. Continuously develop expertise in quantitative methods, programming, optimization techniques, and energy markets. Required Qualifications Master's degree (or expected completion prior to joining) in a quantitative discipline such as Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Statistics, Computer Science, Quantitative Finance, Operations Research, or a related field. Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving skills. Understanding of mathematical modelling, probability, statistics, optimization, or financial mathematics gained through academic coursework, research, internships, or personal projects. Proficiency in Python or other programming languages such as C++, Java, R, or MATLAB. Demonstrated ability to learn and apply technical concepts to solve complex problems. Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Ability to work effectively in collaborative, multicultural, and cross-functional teams. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work. Experience using AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) to enhance productivity, code quality, and software development workflows Preferred Qualifications Previous internship, research, academic project, or extracurricular experience involving modelling, optimization, data science, machine learning, quantitative finance, or software development. Exposure to financial markets, commodities, energy markets, or trading concepts through coursework, internships, research projects, or personal interest. Familiarity with numerical methods, simulation techniques, statistical analysis, or optimization algorithms. Experience using version control systems such as Git. Interest in energy markets and the commercial drivers of the global energy industry. Relocation Options: Relocation will not be considered. International Considerations Expatriate assignments will not be considered. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position. items.desc: About the Company My client is leading a quantitative hedge fund which engages in systematic, process-driven proprietary trading. The firm builds automated trading strategies aimed at capturing market inefficiencies across various markets and asset classes from a few milliseconds to longer term both pure arbitrage or statistical in nature. The team has an extensive history of successfully running quantitative trading strategies for more than a decade and spun out as a hedge fund. They operate at the intersection of trading, quantitative modelling, and technology and roles are therefore highly interdisciplinary. They trade on state-of-the-art infrastructure to handle their large trading volumes with offices globally. About the Role Overview of Position: Research and implement strategies within the firm’s automated trading framework. Analyze large data sets using advanced statistical methods to identify trading opportunities. Develop a strong understanding of market structure of various exchanges and asset classes. Responsibilities Primary focus throughout the day is on researching and implementing trading ideas. Before market open, check that all required data and related processes are ready for the trading day. During market hours, sporadically monitor behavior and performance of strategies. Qualifications Quantitative background - includes degrees in Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, Financial Engineering, Operations Research, Computer Science and Physics. Required Skills Programming proficiency with at least one major programming or scripting language (e.g. C++, Java, Python). Strong communication skills and ability to work well with colleagues across multiple regions. Ability to work well under pressure.

items.desc: À propos d’Emeria Emeria est le leader mondial des services et technologies immobilières, offrant des prestations aux particuliers et aux entreprises. Emeria accompagne les clients résidentiels et commerciaux à chaque étape de leur parcours immobilier avec une gamme complète de services compétitifs : acquisition, location, gestion de copropriété et transactions. Le Groupe opère principalement en Europe, dans 8 pays, avec une stratégie de multi-marques (Foncia, Constatimmo, Esset…). A propos de l’équipe Analytics L’équipe Analytics fait partie du pôle Data, en charge de l’IA et de la data du groupe Emeria. Elle centralise et pilote l’ensemble des données du groupe – ERP, outils métiers, filiales internationales – pour produire les dashboards et analyses qui éclairent les décisions stratégiques. L’équipe fonctionne comme une start-up dans le groupe : esprit agile, autonomie forte, collaboration étroite avec les métiers, et une vraie culture du partage et de la curiosité. Tes missions En tant qu'Analytics Engineer, tu es au cœur de la transformation de la donnée : de son ingestion dans notre plateforme Data (Snowflake) jusqu’à la création de dashboards clairs et percutants, accessibles à plus de 10 000 collaborateurs. Ton objectif ? Transformer la donnée brute en insights actionnables, pour que chaque décision dans l’entreprise repose sur des faits concrets et à jour. Tes missions sont notamment les suivantes : Tu es le Business Partner Data des équipes métiers : Comprendre et traduire les besoins : tu collabores avec les équipes métiers (Immobilier, Finance, Marketing, Comptabilité…) pour comprendre leurs enjeux, formaliser leurs besoins et les transformer en solutions data concrètes. Donner du sens aux chiffres : tu ne te contentes pas de produire des dashboards, tu comprends ce qu’ils racontent. Tu mets en perspective les données, tu identifies les tendances et tu aides les équipes à prendre les bonnes décisions. Industrialiser les analyses : pas d’analyses « one shot » ici. Chaque dashboard, chaque extraction est pensée pour être réutilisable et scalable. Tu centralises les besoins, tu optimises les existants et tu rends chaque insight accessible à tous, tout le temps. Collaborer avec les équipes techniques : tu travailles main dans la main avec les Data Scientists, DevOps et autres experts pour garantir la fiabilité, la performance et la qualité des données. Tu conçois et fais vivre les modèles de données : Tu es garant(e) de la solidité et de la fiabilité de notre architecture data. Tu construis, fais évoluer et optimises les modèles qui alimentent nos dashboards et outils analytiques, pour que chaque donnée serve vraiment à quelque chose. Construire & faire tourner la machine : Build → tu conçois de nouveaux pipelines, dashboards et outils data pour répondre aux besoins métiers et soutenir la croissance du groupe. Run → tu assures la maintenance, corriges les éventuels bugs, analyses les incidents et fais évoluer les pipelines existants pour qu’ils restent performants et fiables. Modéliser intelligemment la donnée : tu structures et optimises les modèles de données pour le reporting et l’analyse. Tu penses architecture avant tout : comment stocker la donnée de manière efficace, durable et exploitable, tout en conservant l’historique nécessaire à une analyse fine. Garantir la qualité et la fiabilité : tu veilles à ce que chaque chiffre communiqué soit juste. Tu mets en place les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance et de contrôle qualité pour assurer l’intégrité de la donnée dans toute l’entreprise. Rester à la pointe : tu assures une veille technologique continue pour identifier les nouvelles tendances et améliorer nos process, nos outils et nos pratiques. Profil Tu as au moins 1 à 2 ans d’expérience en tant qu’Analytics Engineer ou Data Analyst, et tu maîtrises les bases de la donnée de bout en bout. À l’aise avec les problématiques d’industrialisation de code, tu sais modéliser la donnée et construire des pipelines robustes (DBT ou équivalent). Tu es force de proposition : tu identifies les points d’amélioration et n’hésites pas à challenger l’existant. Autonome et débrouillard(e), tu vas chercher l’info, tu explores la data et tu plonges volontiers dans le code pour comprendre ce qu’il s’y passe. La communication, c’est ton autre super-pouvoir : tu sais vulgariser un sujet technique pour le rendre clair et accessible à tous. Curieux(se) de nature, tu t’intéresses aux enjeux business et tu poses toujours les bonnes questions pour donner du sens aux chiffres. Tu maîtrises le SQL sur le bout des doigts et un outil de visualisation (Tableau est un vrai plus). Ton esprit analytique et logique te permet de structurer ta pensée et d’aller droit au but. Clair(e), concis(e), pédagogue : tu sais partager tes connaissances et rendre la donnée compréhensible, même pour un public non technique. Excellente maîtrise de l’analyse et de la modélisation de données : tu comprends comment transformer des chiffres en leviers …

As part of our recruitment process, identity verification will be conducted through inspection of your ID card. Join our Data & AI team and help financial institutions unlock the value of their data. Think data strategy and governance, AI adoption, regulatory and compliance initiatives, operating model transformations, data-driven customer experiences, and much more. We are Projective Group, we help some of the world's leading financial institutions solve their most complex challenges across Payments, Risk & Compliance, Data and Transformation. Assess data landscapes and business challenges, translating them into practical recommendations and solutions. Facilitate workshops and collaborate with stakeholders across business and technology teams. Support the design and implementation of data governance, data quality and AI readiness initiatives. Help clients build the operating models, governance structures and capabilities needed to scale data and AI successfully. Use SQL and other tools to assess data, identify improvement opportunities and support data-based decision-making. Present findings, recommendations and project progress to stakeholders in a clear and professional way. Excellent communication skills and comfortable to work with different stakeholders. An interest in data, AI, business transformation and financial services. Experience working with SQL or other data analysis tools. A structured and pragmatic approach to problem-solving. The ability to learn quickly and take ownership of your work. Nice to have Exposure to financial services, banking or insurance. Experience with Collibra, Microsoft Purview, Alation or similar platforms. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks such as GDPR, DORA or BCBS239. Understanding of data governance, data quality or AI governance concepts. Basic Python knowledge. What can you expect from us? Your package is complemented by a daily net allowance, meal vouchers and eco vouchers. A flexible FIP budget for bike leasing, multimedia, or mobility expenses. A company car with charging setup. Prefer something else? Switch it up with a mobility budget, your call. €5.000 annual training budget to boost your growth. You choose how to invest it. A yearly company bonus, with additional referral and sales incentives. A hybrid work setup with flexible hours and part-time remote options. Regular fun events (from game nights to padel tournaments and everything in between) and a yearly group offsite abroad. A modern office in Diegem featuring a stocked bar, darts, a pinball machine and pool table. An international setting with plenty of growth opportunities, serving top clients in the financial sector. A scale-up spirit with a can-do mentality, all within a solid and established corporate framework. For more information, visit projectivegroup.com. items.desc: Data Analyst / Data Visualisation Consultant Who We Are NORRIQ is a leading international consulting firm headquartered in Denmark and Belgium, with 350+ consultants driving business transformation through technology. items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica , la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos Data Engineer con 1,5 a 3 años de experiencia , habiendo trabajado en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida de proyectos de Data. Formarás parte de un equipo dentro de una gran compañía de telecomunicaciones, donde tu trabajo impacta directamente en las decisiones diarias de áreas clave. Serás el enlace técnico entre los datos y el negocio, encargándote del ciclo completo del dato: desde la ingesta y la creación de pipelines en Databricks hasta la construcción de dashboards y análisis en Power BI. Trabajarás con una metodología ágil (Scrum) sobre un entorno en Azure , asumiendo tanto evolutivos como la optimización constante de la plataforma, en una cultura de confianza donde cada propuesta de mejora cuenta y cada dato sustenta una decisión estratégica. Buscamos personas que, al igual que nosotros, no se conformen con las pruebas de concepto, sino que se impliquen en la puesta en producción real de los procesos de Data. A nivel técnico: Muy buen nivel de PysPark y Spark. Experiencia en la realización de ETL con Spark. Experiencia trabajando con cliente y recopilando requisitos de negocio con buenas habilidades de comunicación . Conocimiento en el uso de entornos de Azure (Databricks y Data Factory). Familiarizado con componentes de desarrollo : ciclo de vida del software, testing, calidad del código, repositorios/versionado de código (preferiblemente git). Importante tener un buen nivel de inglés , nuestros proyectos serán para clientes internacionales. Será un plus: Tener experiencia en DevOps y experiencia en metodologías Agile. Conocimientos en Power BI. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas. Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid , la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly! Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com Do you want to be Mática ? Be Mática!

Le sens de l’adaptation et le goût de l’effort sont des qualités indispensables. Être officier, c’est être en situation de responsabilité, en particulier auprès du personnel placé sous ses ordres. Cela suppose d’avoir le sens de l’humain et une certaine forme d’exigence vis-à-vis de soi-même. CDAOA/CEM/BNUM Base aérienne 942 – Lyon-Mt-Verdun Le Bureau du Numérique et des SIC (BNUM) est responsable de la gouvernance des SIC utilisés par le CDAOA pour assurer ses deux principales missions que sont : la PPS (posture permanente de sureté) qui consiste à protéger l’espace aérien national et sa deuxième mission : la planification, programmation et conduite des opérations aériennes conventionnelles. Le BNUM apporte son soutien aux unités opérationnelles en pilotant la cartographie des SIC utilisés, la rationalisation des moyens, la centralisation des expressions de besoin, le conseil en solution technique, les homologations en cyber sécurité, la transformation numérique et l’innovation. POSTE Vos missions au sein des équipes : Collaborer avec des profils métiers pour définir les besoins en matière d’analyse de données et d’IA. Rédiger des spécifications techniques et fonctionnelles. Collaborer avec les référents des systèmes d’information et les data owners pour recueillir les données et faire le lien avec les objets métier. Développer et maintenir des rapports issus de croisements de données de sources diverses, et des tableaux de bord d’aide à la décision. Assurer la gestion du changement et accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouvelles technologies et processus. Contribuer à la vigilance sur la sécurité des données et à la gouvernance des données. Lors du développement d’un projet data, au sein d’une équipe data pluridisciplinaire : Participer aux phases de modélisation de données et de développement des chaînes de traitement. Contribuer à la mise en place de modèles de Machine Learning / IA. Mettre en place des tests unitaires et des processus de supervision des chaînes de traitement. Suivre et évaluer les résultats des projets numériques et apporter les ajustements nécessaires. CONDITIONS PARTICULIÈRES : Vous justifiez d’une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine de la donnée. DIPLÔME – FORMATION : Vous justifiez d’un bac+5 ou équivalent dans le domaine de l’informatique, des systèmes d’information ou de la donnée. COMPÉTENCES SPÉCIFIQUES REQUISES : Expertise en BI et maîtrise d’un outil de data visualisation (Tableau, Qlikview, PowerBI) Maîtrise des tests et méthodes statistiques (segmentation, régression, forêt aléatoire…) ; Maîtrise des langages SQL et python ; la connaissance d’un outil de webapp est un plus. Expérience sur des plateformes d’analyse de données et ETL (idéalement Talend, Dataiku, Qlik) ; Connaissance des systèmes Unix / Linux ; Connaissance des exigences en matière de sécurité des données et pratiques de gouvernance QUALITÉS RECHERCHÉES : Vous êtes autonome, proactif, disponible et rigoureux ; Vous êtes proche des métiers et vous vous intéressez au contenu métier des données et aux processus qu’elles reflètent ; Vous êtes curieux et savez faire preuve de créativité ; Vous avez le sens de la synthèse et de la visualisation de données ; Vous êtes capable de travailler aussi bien avec les métiers qu’avec les équipes techniques spécialisées data. items.desc: ¿Quiénes somos? Somos una compañía tecnológica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, IA Generativa, Analytics, Gobierno del Dato, Cloud y arquitecturas Event Driven, pero sobre todo somos un equipo con conocimiento, criterio y muchas ganas de hacer las cosas bien. Trabajamos con talento altamente especializado, esté donde esté, y apostamos por una forma de crecer basada en la confianza, la autonomía y la participación. Nos mueve la excelencia tecnológica , la orientación a negocio y el sentido común, pero también el entusiasmo, la creatividad y la convicción de que la tecnología necesita alma, propósito y personas capaces de convertir la complejidad en soluciones reales. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. ¿Qué buscamos? Buscamos Data Engineer con 1,5 a 3 años de experiencia , habiendo trabajado en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida de proyectos de Data. Formarás parte de un equipo dentro de una gran compañía de telecomunicaciones, donde tu trabajo impacta directamente en las decisiones diarias de áreas clave. Serás el enlace técnico entre los datos y el negocio, encargándote del ciclo completo del dato: desde la ingesta y la creación de pipelines en Databricks hasta la construcción de dashboards y análisis en Power BI. Trabajarás con una metodología ágil (Scrum) sobre un entorno en Azure , asumiendo tanto evolutivos como la optimización constante de la plataforma, en una cultura de confianza donde cada propuesta de mejora cuenta y cada dato sustenta una decisión estratégica. Buscamos personas que, al igual que nosotros, no se conformen con las pruebas de concepto, sino que se impliquen en la puesta en producción real de los procesos de Data. A nivel técnico: Muy buen nivel de PysPark y Spark. Experiencia en la realización de ETL con Spark. Experiencia trabajando con cliente y recopilando requisitos de negocio con buenas habilidades de comunicación . Conocimiento en el uso de entornos de Azure (Databricks y Data Factory). Familiarizado con componentes de desarrollo : ciclo de vida del software, testing, calidad del código, repositorios/versionado de código (preferiblemente git). Importante tener un buen nivel de inglés , nuestros proyectos serán para clientes internacionales. Será un plus: Tener experiencia en DevOps y experiencia en metodologías Agile. Conocimientos en Power BI. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Pertenecer a una empresa a la vanguardia tecnológica y centrada en las Personas, ponemos al trabajador en el centro de todo lo que hacemos. Creemos en una cultura horizontal, sin egos, en un entorno donde se valoran tanto las ideas como las personas. Contrato indefinido y salario entre los 28.000 y 34.000 euros brutos/año de entrada, ajustado según tu experiencia (nuestro plan de carrera incluye 2 revisiones anuales). También tendrás a tu disposición un plan de formación especializado, participación en la propiedad y los beneficios de Mática: Wetaca gratuito en la oficina dos días a la semana, horario flexible con facilidades para trabajar desde donde quieras, seguro de salud, retribución flexible con Cobee, además de las vacaciones habituales, ofrecemos una semana extra en Navidad y tres días adicionales en Semana Santa. También recibirás un divertido Welcome Kit con portátil (podrás escoger entre varios modelos Mac o Windows), móvil, botella personalizada, auriculares bluetooth y golosinas. Cuando estés en nuestra oficina, en el centro de Barcelona o Madrid , la fruta, los cafés y los refrescos corren a cuenta de Mática. ¡Ah! Y si eres amante de los animales, te gustará saber esto: ¡nuestras oficinas son Pet-friendly! Si te interesa, escríbenos por LinkedIn o envía tu CV a seleccion@maticapartners.com Do you want to be Mática ? Be Mática!

items.title: Conversation Designer
items.card: Responsibilities Conversation Design & Configuration Design and configure end-to-end chatbot and voice bot conversations, covering both standard user journeys and edge cases Define intents, entities, fallback strategies and other key building blocks of conversational AI systems Translate business requirements into technically feasible conversation designs, together with stakeholders, Data/AI and Digital Channels
items.desc: Intro We’re building talent pools to connect with professionals in our field of expertise within Marketing & Digital. Because we work with a large set of fast-moving companies looking for the right talent, we connect with experts continuously. To match the right talent with the right client at the right time, we’re looking for junior, medior and senior professionals in this field. We’re looking for Conversational (AI) Designers to design, build and continuously improve chatbot and voice bot experiences for our clients. You’ll combine conversation design, strong content skills and technical understanding to create conversations that feel natural, work across channels and deliver real value for both users and the business. Because we have a broad range of clients, you could work in Telecom, Energy, Banking & Insurance, Media or scale-up environments. Responsibilities Conversation Design & Configuration Design and configure end-to-end chatbot and voice bot conversations, covering both standard user journeys and edge cases Define intents, entities, fallback strategies and other key building blocks of conversational AI systems Translate business requirements into technically feasible conversation designs, together with stakeholders, Data/AI and Digital Channels teams Voice Experience Design Extend chat journeys into voice experiences, adapting dialogue to spoken interaction (pacing, turn-taking, latency, interruptions) Define and maintain a consistent voice persona, tone of voice and brand identity across text and voice channels Content & Multilingual Adaptation Structure and manage conversational content in a scalable, reusable way Adapt content across Dutch, French and English Build and maintain content libraries, design patterns and conversational guidelines Analytics, Testing & Continuous Improvement Analyse performance data and conversation logs to find root causes and improvement opportunities Run usability tests and quality evaluations, including the quality and relevance of GenAI-generated responses Define guardrails and quality standards so responses stay accurate, accessible and compliant Knowledge Sharing Share best practices with fellow conversation designers and support less experienced colleagues and stakeholders Help drive the adoption of conversational AI, GenAI and voice within the organisation Experience & Competences As mentioned above, we’re looking for junior, medior and senior profiles in conversation design and conversational AI Hands-on experience designing chatbot and/or voice bot conversations; a portfolio showing technical or GenAI-driven conversational work is a strong asset Good understanding of NLU fundamentals (intents, entities, training data) and human-AI interaction principles for text and voice Familiarity with voice design principles such as turn-taking, latency, barge-in, silence and the differences between spoken and written dialogue Experience with tools such as Figma, Rasa (Studio), Dialogflow, Copilot Studio or similar platforms, and comfortable working with LLM tooling Data-minded: you use analytics, logs and feedback to improve conversations Experience in Agile/Scrum environments is a plus Native-level Dutch or French, strong knowledge of the other national language, and strong English Curious, pragmatic and eager to keep up with fast-evolving AI technology Offer Working at Eolis means working in a project-based environment where our goal is to build long-term collaborations with both employees and freelancers. We offer stable projects that come with flexibility and variety: one project could bring you into a large, structured banking or telecom environment, while the next lands you in a dynamic SaaS or scale-up setting!

We work with some of the biggest organisations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations. Unit8's mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and "engineering for good" causes. What You'll Do As a core member of our agile project teams, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining robust data solutions and infrastructure. You will work on cutting-edge data and AI topics, leveraging the full potential of the Foundry platform to solve real-world business problems for our clients. Your responsibilities will include: Developing, deploying, and troubleshooting complex data pipelines and processing systems using a variety of open-source and closed-source technologies, with a strong focus on Foundry . Driving optimization, testing, and tooling to ensure exceptional data quality. Collaborating with other software engineers, ML experts, and stakeholders in a cross-functional agile environment. Working in multi-functional agile teams to continuously experiment, iterate and deliver on new product objectives. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: * Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. * Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . * Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). * Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. * Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team (up to 10% of your time). What We Offer The opportunity to shape the expansion of one of the leading Swiss data & AI consultancies. A competitive compensation package, including a base salary and a yearly bonus based on both individual and company performance. Above-the-norm flexibility regarding when and from where you work. Work on cutting-edge data, AI & analytics topics that have a real impact across industries. Dedicated time and budget for continuous learning, training, and pro-bono projects. Frequent cross-office/company-wide events (off-site or online) as well as a quarterly budget for team activities.

items.desc: De organisatie: Voor een organisatie in de regio Utrecht zoek ik een Medior Data Engineer die graag met moderne technieken werken en het leuk vinden om mee te bouwen aan de energietransitie. Het gaat hier om een interne rol. Je hoeft dus niet naar klanten te reizen. Deze organisatie telt ongeveer 700 medewerkers en ontwikkelt software en dataoplossingen voor de energiesector. Denk aan het verwerken van energiedata, het inzichtelijk maken van netbelasting en het ontwikkelen van rapportages voor netbeheerders. Technisch behoorlijk interessant, zeker gezien de hoeveelheid data en de complexiteit van de vraagstukken. Binnen de data afdeling werken zes teams, ieder met een eigen focus. Je komt terecht in een team van vier tot acht collega's, waarin engineering en analyse samenkomen. Je werkt onder andere samen met een Product Owner, Scrum Master en Product Manager. De collega's zijn gemiddeld rond de 35 jaar en de sfeer is informeel. Je vindt hier mensen die veel met hun vak bezig zijn, graag kennis delen en samen mooie oplossingen willen bouwen. Er wordt gestructureerd gewerkt met een duidelijke roadmap, maar er is zeker ruimte voor eigen ideeën. De functie: Als Medior Data Engineer werk je met Snowflake, dbt en Python aan het ontwerpen, ontwikkelen en verbeteren van dataproducten. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige ontwikkelproces, van de eerste vraag tot een werkende oplossing. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het ontwerpen en bouwen van data pipelines en ETL processen. Het ontwikkelen en optimaliseren van datamodellen. Het verwerken van energiedata voor analyses, rapportages en specifieke dataverzoeken. Het verbeteren van bestaande dataproducten en de technische inrichting daarvan. Het meedenken over nieuwe oplossingen en technische keuzes binnen het dataplatform. Het is een brede functie waarin je zelf ontwikkelt, maar ook regelmatig met collega's spart over hoe iets slimmer of beter kan. Gevraagd profiel: We zoeken een Data Engineer die technisch goed onderlegd is en ook buiten zijn eigen werkzaamheden verder kijkt. Iemand die het vak echt interessant vindt, ontwikkelingen volgt en makkelijk met collega's schakelt. Verder vragen we: Een afgeronde hbo of wo opleiding. Minimaal drie jaar relevante ervaring als Data Engineer. Aantoonbare ervaring met Snowflake, dbt en Python. Goede kennis van SQL, ETL processen en datamodellering. Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal en sterke communicatieve vaardigheden. Ervaring met samenwerken binnen multidisciplinaire teams en een gestructureerde ontwikkelomgeving. Kennis van Kimball datamodellering is een pré. Hetzelfde geldt voor ervaring binnen de energiesector. Arbeidsvoorwaarden: Salaris tussen €4.300 en €5.900 bruto per maand. Een werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur. Hybride werken, met slechts twee kantoordagen per week. Een mobiliteitsbudget met de mogelijkheid tot een leaseauto. Een vaste interne functie, zonder consultancy of klantbezoeken. Volop mogelijkheden voor opleidingen en technische verdieping. Interesse in deze vacature? Neem dan contact op met Marco Veldman via marco@careervalue.nl of bel of WhatsApp naar +31 (0)6 18 26 71 24.

items.desc: Als Medior Data Engineer bij VisionBI houd je je bezig met het bouwen van moderne en innovatieve state of the art dataoplossingen voor onze klanten binnen het Microsoft ecosysteem. O.a. de nieuwste Azure Services, kennen voor jou dan ook weinig tot geen geheimen meer. Je laat je graag uitdagen om samen met de klant tot de beste technische oplossing te komen. Je ziet het belang van goede communicatie en samenwerking binnen een team en werkt dan ook veelal Agile/Scrum om samen met jouw team te komen tot de juiste oplossing. Je werkt over het algemeen in een van de scrum teams bij de klant. Een dagelijkse standup is voor jou natuurlijk gesneden koek. Even de koppen bij elkaar en bespreken waar het team in de huidige sprint mee bezig is en eventueel tegen aanloopt. De ideale werkweek betekent voor jou dat je gemiddeld twee dagen op de klant locatie werkt en de resterende dagen desgewenst vanuit ons kantoor in De Meern of gewoon remote. Ook al zien we elkaar niet elke dag, het VisionBI team staat altijd voor je klaar! Dit ga je nog meer doen Naast dat je als Medior Data Engineer aan uiteenlopende projecten voor VisionBI klanten werkt, volg je natuurlijk de snel opvolgende technische ontwikkelingen binnen de Datawereld op de voet. Je handen jeuken dan ook om deze kennis snel toe te kunnen en mogen passen bij de realisatie van datalakes, datawarehouses en lakehouses. Omgevingen waarin strakke rapportages en analyses van de hoogste kwaliteit worden geleverd. Samen met het projectteam codeer, automatiseer en onderzoek je de nieuwste en best passende oplossingen voor CI/CD-gedreven data pipelines, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van relevante en innovatieve oplossingen met behulp van Azure- of Snowflake technologieën. Hoe essentieel het ook is, je beperkt jezelf niet tot alleen de development kant van zaken. Het oog wil natuurlijk ook wat, dus enige gevoel voor dashboarding en het daarmee gepaard gaande user experience (UX) is een pré. Je bezit een heldere kijk op data development, ziet dan ook snel verbindingen tussen verschillende omgevingen en technologieën. Als vakidioot, nerd, goeroe, ____ (vul zelf maar in), geef je graag advies met betrekking tot design patterns over verschillende technologieën heen. Als vakidioot werk je graag in teamverband samen met andere vakidioten. Wat je meebrengt Het liefst heb je een op IT & Data gerichte HBO of WO opleiding afgerond. Na het afronden van jouw opleiding heb je 2 tot 4 jaar relevante werkervaring. Stap je net de universiteit buiten, laat je dan niet afschrikken en geef een gil. Ook onze opleidingsmogelijkheden zullen de start van jouw carrière een mooie kick-start geven. Wat bieden wij jou? • Enthousiaste en zeer kundige nieuwe collega’s! • Mobiliteitsplan - erop uit. • Een telefoonabonnement - hallo wie is daar? • Een laptop - in de schoot geworpen. • Collectieve pensioenregeling - we worden allemaal ouder. • 25 vakantiedagen – even lekker weg. • Gave VisionBI-uitjes – overal en nergens. • Focus op kennisdeling en verbreding – Je staat toch niet stil? • Royale opleidingsmogelijkheden - jouw carrière in de lift. • Ruime flexibiliteit waar het gaat om remote werken – lekker nieuwerwets. • Mis je nog iets? - Het zou kunnen ;) Wat vragen wij van jou? • Een afgeronde HBO of WO opleiding in een technische richting, • Gerichte werkervaring (>2 jaar) • Goede zelfkennis, weten wat je kunt en wat je nog wenst te leren • Jouw passie is een combinatie van data én de mens • Analytisch sterk ontwikkelde vaardigheden • Pragmatisch, maar altijd kritisch op kwaliteit • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse (must) en Engelse taal • Uitstekend ontwikkelde sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden. – Samenkomen en praten vinden we fijn Jouw technische vaardigheden: • Python – uiteraard • Microsoft Fabric • Azure Services, zoals bijvoorbeeld: Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, Stream Analytics, Cosmos DB. • Azure DevOps • Apache, zoals bijvoorbeeld: Spark, Hive, Airflow, Kafka. • Snowflake DWH • Power BI • Data persistency met de gebruikelijke relationele SQL databases • Andere gerelateerde kennis die je hier niet ziet staan? ….laat het ons weten! Waarom VisionBI? Dagelijks zorgen we dat onze klanten beschikken over goed draaiende datawarehouses en slimme BI oplossingen. Wij houden ervan om innovatief te zijn. We vernieuwen, ontwikkelen en zoeken altijd de uitdaging op. Dat geldt natuurlijk ook voor jou. Ook jou dagen we graag uit. Kom jij met nieuwe ideeën om ons en jezelf verder te laten groeien? Wil je écht iets anders? Dan is VisionBI de plek voor jou om te werken. Daarnaast brengen we je ook helemaal up to speed met maandelijkse kennissessies. Hiervoor hebben wij het Center of Excellence opgericht. Wij doen ons werk goed, waardoor klanten steeds meer aan ons vragen. Daarom zijn we op zoek naar ambitieuze en gedreven Data Engineers, Business Intelligence en Analytics consultants op verschillende ervaringsniveaus. Onze manier van werken • We bieden iedereen een persoonlijke opleidingsplan …
