Con REPA, la manutenzione quotidiana delle apparecchiature per la ristorazione non è mai stata così semplice. REPA è la divisione europea di Parts Town Unlimited. Descrizione del lavoro Per il potenziamento del nostro team Data, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Data Analyst desideroso/a di intraprendere un percorso di crescita nell'ambito di Data & Analytics. Entrando a far parte del team, avrai l'opportunità di sviluppare competenze nell'analisi e nella gestione dei dati, collaborando con diverse funzioni aziendali e utilizzando strumenti di Business Intelligence, automazione e Intelligenza Artificiale . Contribuirai al miglioramento della qualità dei dati e dei processi aziendali, analizzando le cause delle problematiche ricorrenti e partecipando a progetti strategici e collaborando all'implementazione di soluzioni innovative. Nello Specifico Ti Occuperai Di verificare l'accuratezza, la coerenza e la completezza dei dati elaborati dai sistemi aziendali; analizzare e correggere eventuali anomalie o incongruenze, contribuendo al miglioramento continuo della qualità del dato; supportare le attività di caricamento, manutenzione e organizzazione dei dati; collaborare con interlocutori di diverse funzioni aziendali per individuare opportunità di ottimizzazione dei processi e miglioramento della qualità dei dati; utilizzare strumenti digitali e soluzioni di Intelligenza Artificiale, come Microsoft Copilot e ChatGPT, per ottimizzare le attività operative. Qualifiche Sei La Persona Giusta Se Possiedi Laurea triennale o magistrale in Data Analytics, Informatica, Ingegneria, Economia, Matematica, Statistica o discipline affini. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese, sia scritta che parlata. Forte attitudine all'analisi, attenzione ai dettagli e approccio metodico alla risoluzione dei problemi. Interesse per il mondo dei dati, della Business Intelligence e delle nuove tecnologie. Saranno considerate un plus la conoscenza di Microsoft Excel, SQL e database relazionali, la familiarità con Power BI o altri strumenti di Business Intelligence e Data Visualization, nonché esperienze, anche universitarie o di stage, in progetti di analisi, gestione o valorizzazione dei dati. Offriamo un contratto di apprendistato professionalizzante della durata di 36 mesi, accompagnato da un percorso strutturato di formazione e di crescita professionale che prevede una progressione di inquadramento dal 5° al 4° fino al 3° livello del CCNL Commercio. Informazioni aggiuntive Se deciderai di unirti a noi, troverai un’atmosfera informale, un clima positivo e un contesto internazionale. Potrai beneficiare di orari di lavoro flessibili, della possibilità di lavorare da remoto e dell’accesso alla nostra mensa interna. Ogni giorno avrai l’opportunità di collaborare con colleghi di diverse nazionalità, arricchendo così il tuo percorso professionale.

items.desc:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time. 
 In addition to great shows and movies, our membership now includes exclusive access to a growing portfolio of high-quality games. The Game Lifecycle Engineering team builds the systems, tools and capabilities that make Netflix the easiest place for anyone to create, launch, and operate high‑quality games at scale. Our work supports the entire lifecycle of games, from onboard to sunset, at Netflix scale. 
 This role is key to how we build the tools and experiences that game developers rely on - from developer-facing web applications to cross-platform desktop tooling. You'll help build and set direction for how the tools and the shared services behind them come together into a cohesive developer experience. You will excel if you are comfortable with the ambiguity that comes with innovation, can deliver scalable technical solutions, remove technical debt, influence and make strategic decisions for long-term effectiveness, and approach problems with a curiosity-driven lens. 
 Our ideal candidate is a full-stack engineer, who collaborates across teams extremely well, thinks beyond implementation details, can empathize with fellow developers, challenges assumptions, and helps shape the "why" behind what we build. They should bring a strong perspective on product direction, code reuse, and design, not just execution, and be comfortable working at the intersection of user experience, design, and modern web application development across both web and desktop. 
 What will you do: 
 Drive new technical solutions across teams, from system design to deployment. 
 Make impact across all layers of the software stack: backend services, insights systems, UI component libraries, documentation, or integration with other applications. 
 Revamp and update existing tools and services for integration into developer workflows. 
 Work with other software engineering teams, product management, and stakeholders across Netflix to gather insights, identify opportunities, and define solutions that will scope and shape our decisions. 
 Operate in a cross-functional and dynamic environment where you will collaborate and learn with stunning colleagues from a variety of technical domains and backgrounds to achieve the common goal of entertaining the world. 
 Participate in our support and on-call rotation and lead the incident reviews. 
 What are we looking for: 
 Proven professional experience with a track record of owning complex features from ideation to deployment. 
 Back-end excellence: expertise in building the backends behind the UI and designing clean, well-documented APIs that integrate with platform services. Familiarity with a backend language like Java, Go, or Python is a plus. 
 Robust front-end engineering: proficiency in frontend with a deep understanding of state management and the ability to build reusable component libraries that ensure consistency across tools. Experience working with design systems is a plus. 
 You're comfortable operating what you build, not just shipping it. 
 Adaptability: proven ability to master in-house frameworks and services, finding ways to leverage and extend them to create high-leverage solutions. 
 Curiosity and selflessness: bridging the gap between teams, prioritizing outcomes and impact in an ambiguous environment. 
 Passion for developer experience: you care about the engineers who use what you build, and you can take a feature from idea to a well-designed, intuitive UI, that works well with agents. 
 Experience with AI, AI coding tools and agents in day-to-day development/activites. 
 Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner. 
 We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

items.level: Layout/Mask Design ICT3 – Layout/Mask Design ICT4
items.desc:
Will you help us design future generations of revolutionary Apple products? The Silicon Engineering team is seeking an Analog Layout Engineer with a strong foundation in custom analog layout and a real passion for building new technologies. At Apple, we work every single day to craft products that enrich people’s lives. Do you love working on challenges that no one has solved yet? Do you like changing the game? We have an opportunity for a visionary Layout Engineer. As a member of our dynamic group, you will have the rare and rewarding opportunity to craft upcoming products that will delight and inspire millions of Apple’s customers every single day. You will be responsible for the Layout and verification of Analog IP and the support of top-level layout of Power Management products for battery operated portable devices. You will work with the most modern power management processes which enable best in class Apple processors and the latest Apple modems to get the power they need to deploy their full performances.
- Detailed transistor level layout of analog circuit blocks 
- Block level and top-level layout through full verification flow including DRC, LVS, PERC, EM/IR and DFM checking 
- Co-work with designers on block level and top-level floor-planning including area and effort estimation 
- Execute peer reviews for critical and major layout blocks 
- Layout according to DFM rules 
- Top-level layout integration and verification 
- Schedule management and tracking
Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering or related field, alternatively equivalent work experience
Fluency in English language
Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work with multi-functional teams
Several years of experience in custom analog layout with extensive knowledge on planar and preferably non-planar CMOS technologies
Capability to lead other layout engineers for top-level integration.
Knowledgeable on layout techniques for device matching, power routing and minimising parasitics
You understand issues of RC delay, electromigration, and cross capacitance
Experience with Power Management circuit layout would be an asset
Must recognise failure prone circuit and layout structures, dedicatedly work with circuit designer for best approach to problems

items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Equity is a big part of how we reward the people building ElevenLabs, and the programme is growing fast across many countries. You'll own the day-to-day running of it: keeping our cap table accurate and audit-ready, and making sure every grant, exercise and leaver is handled correctly and on time.

You'll work with Finance, Legal and People to turn board-approved decisions into clean records and clear communication. That includes issuing grants, supporting 409A and local valuations, and answering employee questions about their equity.

We're looking for someone who is meticulous about the numbers and who treats employees as customers. You'll find ways to automate the repetitive work, using AI wherever it makes things faster and more reliable.




REQUIREMENTS

 - Hands-on experience administering equity in a cap table or stock plan platform such as Carta, including grants, vesting, exercises, terminations, settlements and reconciliations.

 - Experience administering equity across multiple jurisdictions, including tracking globally mobile participants and coordinating with Tax and Payroll.

 - Strong understanding of stock options, RSUs, vesting schedules and employee lifecycle changes, with working knowledge of relevant tax-advantaged schemes such as US ISOs and UK EMI or CSOP plans.

 - Experience reconciling equity data with People, Talent, Payroll and Accounting records.

 - Understanding of stock-based compensation accounting sufficient to provide reliable data and support Finance with US GAAP and local reporting requirements.

 - Experience building and documenting equity processes and controls, managing deadlines independently and resolving discrepancies.

 - Clear communication skills, sound judgement when handling confidential information and a strong focus on employee support.

Bonus:

 - Experience at a fast-growing startup, familiarity with 409A processes, or a record of automating equity workflows.

 - Certification (e.g. CEP or similar)

 - Experience with IPO process or having supported transition from private to public





LOCATION

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Central Europe or Eastern US timezones. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York and Warsaw.

Join a dynamic, international and cross-functional team environment. Experience in mouse primary neuron cultures and/or human iPSC-derived neurons are considered strong plus. Ability to analyze large-scale protein and RNA expression datasets using computational tools and statistical methods is considered a plus. Ability to quickly learn new techniques when required. Fluent written and spoken English is a must; French is desirable, but not required. If you do not meet all these conditions, we will not be able to consider your application.

This approach, plus the technical expertise and years of experience, ensures that we, also for civil works, belong to the absolute top.Are you (almost) graduated in accountancy or an economic field and do you want to make a solid start in project controlling? As a Project Cost Controller on our sites in Wallonia, you receive responsibility and trust from day one within a stable and substantively strong role. You build expertise at the heart of our projects and make a real impact on site. Your Role A job at the crossroads of finance and site reality. As a Project Cost Controller , you work from your office on site and closely follow up the financial processes, right in the middle of the project. You are often on the road and present on site, which ensures a lot of variety and a job full of action.You are the financial point of contact on site: colleagues rely on you for financial questions and decisions. You dive deep into budgets, costs and forecasts, identify deviations and clearly map risks and opportunities. You work independently, but at the same time you are a fixed link within the site team and see the impact of your work every day.Your main tasks and responsibilities: You prepare the budget control and financial reporting for your sites and draw up sharp forecasts, including updates of the order portfolio. You are jointly responsible for the follow-up of all costs and revenues of the assigned project and prepare reports of the results. You take responsibility for the correctness of the figures on a monthly basis and adjust where necessary. You report at regular intervals and in a structured and objective manner to management/the executive board, so that timely adjustments can be made to achieve the financial and strategic objectives. You provide project managers and site managers with insight into the (current and future) financial results of the project/department and support them when financial issues arise. You stay up to date with developments within controlling, keep your knowledge up to date and think along with the team to take controlling to a higher level. You work from our sites in Wallonia, build new expertise with each project and can count on an attractive salary package with extra-legal benefits. What you need You have a master’s degree in an economic field (Applied Economics, Commercial Engineer, Business Sciences) or a bachelor’s degree in Accountancy. You take responsibility independently, but at the same time work smoothly together with site and project management as a fixed link within the site team. You like a job full of action and variety and can express yourself professionally in French, Dutch and English.You start on sites in Wallonia, where you quickly build experience at the heart of our projects. A healthy work-life balance (flexible working hours and occasional work from home). An open-ended contract with 42 paid vacations (20 statutory, 12 ADV and 10 public holidays). An attractive salary with thirteenth month and double vacation pay included: Meal vouchers and eco vouchers. Possibility to participate in the Flex Reward program including bicycle and car leasing including fuel card in Belgium. Intervention of public transport and bicycle allowance. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in business development and a proven track record of designing and implementing innovative solutions that drive business growth. We are dedicated partner for global players in our segments – Unikie supplies technology solutions and services to several global Fortune 500 companies in EMEA and America. Implanté au cœur des territoires équipés de très grandes infrastructures de recherche, le CEA dispose d'un large éventail de partenaires académiques et industriels en France, en Europe et à l'international. items.desc: La cybersécurité est un enjeu stratégique pour toutes les organisations. Et pour vous ? Rejoindre notre communauté Cybersécurité, c'est intervenir sur l'ensemble des enjeux de protection des systèmes d'information : gouvernance, architecture, sécurité opérationnelle, identité numérique ou réponse à incident. Vous développerez votre expertise au sein d'une communauté reconnue qui partage les meilleures pratiques pour relever les défis de demain. Rejoignez notre centre d’excellence en innovation à Montpellier, un environnement où l’intelligence artificielle, les technologies émergentes, la création de nouvelles solutions et l’innovation sont au cœur de notre stratégie. Contribuez à transformer l'expérience digitale de nos clients en explorant des domaines en constante évolution, tels que le numérique responsable, le marketing digital, l'UX, la RPA, la data, le développement web et mobile, l’API management, ainsi que la cybersécurité. Stack Technique / Environnement Projet Linux ; Bash / Python ; Docker ; Kubernetes; Container Security, Network Security, GitLab CI/CD / Jenkins ; Terraform ; Ansible ; SAST / DAST / SCA ; Cloud ; OWASP; Monitoring, gestion des logs et alerting ; Git; Azure / AWS / GCP Security Fonctions et responsabilités Concevoir, déployer et maintenir des chaînes CI/CD sécurisées et automatisées. Intégrer les contrôles de sécurité SAST, DAST et SCA au sein des pipelines CI/CD. Automatiser l’analyse des vulnérabilités du code, des dépendances et des images de conteneurs. Mettre en œuvre des mécanismes de gestion sécurisée des secrets et des accès. Concevoir et maintenir des infrastructures automatisées selon les principes Infrastructure as Code. Réaliser des revues de sécurité des architectures cloud, conteneurisées et hybrides. Sécuriser les environnements conteneurisés et leurs processus de déploiement. Définir et automatiser les contrôles de conformité et de sécurité des infrastructures. Participer à l'évaluation de la posture de sécurité des environnements Linux, réseaux, systèmes et plateformes DevOps. Participer au durcissement des systèmes, des conteneurs et des environnements d’exécution. Mettre en place des mécanismes de supervision, de journalisation et d’alerting liés à la sécurité. Analyser les vulnérabilités détectées, qualifier les risques techniques et contribuer à leur remédiation. Automatiser les opérations récurrentes de déploiement, de configuration et de sécurisation. Participer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques DevSecOps et des processus de développement sécurisé. Accompagner les équipes de développement et d’exploitation dans l’intégration de la sécurité dès les premières étapes du cycle de développement. Contribuer à la définition et au maintien de standards techniques de sécurité et d’automatisation. En nous rejoignant, vous bénéficiez notamment des avantages suivants : Offre complète de formations : techniques, métiers, développement personnel Qualité de vie au travail : jusqu’à 3 jours de télétravail par semaine, 27 jours de congés payés, RTT, congés ancienneté et enfant malade, programme santé & bien-être Avantages sociaux : régime d’achats d’actions, participation, PEE, Compte Epargne Temps Et bien d'autres encore !. Qualités requises pour réussir dans ce rôle De formation Bac+5 (école d’Ingénieurs ou Université), vous avez une expérience d’au moins 4 ans dans le domaine de la cybersécurité. Vos compétences sont les suivantes : Maîtriser les environnements Linux et le scripting Bash/Python. Maîtriser la conteneurisation avec Docker et l’orchestration avec Kubernetes. Utiliser des outils CI/CD tels que GitLab CI/CD ou Jenkins. Maîtriser l’Infrastructure as Code avec Terraform et l’automatisation avec Ansible. Utiliser des outils d’analyse de sécurité SAST, DAST et SCA. Maîtriser les principes de gestion des secrets et des accès dans les environnements DevOps. Comprendre les mécanismes de sécurité des environnements Cloud. Comprendre les principes de sécurisation des containers et des couches réseaux. Maîtriser les principes de sécurité applicative et les vulnérabilités OWASP. Utiliser des solutions de monitoring, de gestion des logs et d’alerting. Maîtriser Git et les workflows de gestion de versions. Nous sommes engagés en faveur d’un recrutement inclusif, fondé sur l’égalité des chances et la non-discrimination. Cet engagement est reconnu par le Label Recrutement Inclusif, décerné par JobinLive. Ensemble, en tant que propriétaires, mettons notre savoir-faire à l’œuvre. La vie chez CGI est ancrée dans l’actionnariat, le travail d’équipe, le respect et un sentiment d’appartenance. Chez nous, vous pourrez exploiter votre plein potentiel parce que… Nous vous invitons à devenir propriétaire dès le jour 1 alors que nous travaillons ensemble à faire de notre rêve …

items.desc: Delair Delair, leader mondial du drone professionnel, fournit des données basées sur l’imagerie aérienne pour aider les industriels dans leur processus de décision. Spécialiste de la fabrication de drones et du traitement des données collectées, Delair met à disposition des professionnels des solutions complètes depuis l’acquisition de données jusqu’à leur analyse opérationnelle. En intégrant Delair, vous participerez bien plus qu’à la commercialisation de drones industriels dans le monde entier. Nous croyons que le drone professionnel est part intégrante de la révolution numérique en cours et nous participons à son développement afin qu’il devienne incontournable dans les décisions stratégiques de demain. C'est dans l'excellence technique et ce processus d'innovation perpétuel que nous nous reconnaissons. Nous encourageons par conséquent les idées novatrices et permettons à la créativité de s'exprimer. Etes-vous prêt à rejoindre l'aventure et à participer à son développement ? Vos missions Rattaché à l’équipe Innovation sur les essaims de drones (basée à Grenoble), vous occupez un poste charnière et polyvalent à l’interface avec l’équipe en charge du développement de la station sol (basée à Toulouse). Votre mission principale consiste à élaborer les fonctions d’interface utilisateur permettant d’exploiter les essaims de drone. A ce titre, vous spécifiez, concevez et contribuez au développement des interfaces utilisateurs en lien avec les équipes Station Sol. Selon votre domaine d’expertise, vous pourrez également contribuer à l’élaboration des briques algorithmiques de perception, navigation et guidage des essaims ainsi qu’au développement de solutions de simulation. À ce titre, vos principales responsabilités seront les suivantes : Conception & Architecture UI/UX : Définir les fonctions d’interaction homme machine pour les essaims de drone. Participer à la définition de l’architecture logicielle des applications UI, concevoir les mockups (UX/UI). Implémentation & Prototypage UI : Développer en autonomie les prototypes et nouvelles fonctionnalités de l'interface utilisateur dédiée aux essaims de drones, dans le respect de l'architecture logicielle établie. Intégration & Spécifications Essaims : Être le/la garant(e) des spécifications UI dédiées aux essaims de drones et assurer l'interface avec les briques logicielles bas niveau (C/C++). Contribution aux briques Robotique : Apporter votre expertise technique (automatique, SLAM, planification, simulation, IA, etc.) aux projets globaux de l'équipe Innovation de Grenoble. Expérimentation Terrain : Participer activement aux campagnes d'essais réels pour tester, valider et éprouver l'ensemble de vos développements sur le terrain. Votre profil Issu(e) d’une formation de niveau Bac+5 ou Doctorat en robotique, vision par ordinateur ou intelligence artificielle appliquée à la robotique, vous disposez d’un profil scientifique et technique polyvalent, alliant la maîtrise du développement d’interfaces modernes à une connaissance approfondie des concepts avancés en robotique autonome. Vous maîtrisez le développement d’interfaces homme-machine (IHM), appliquez les bonnes pratiques en matière de développement UI/UX et vous épanouissez dans des environnements technologiques complexes et pluridisciplinaires. Cœur de compétences UI & Logiciel : Développement UI : Solide expertise en conception et développement UI/UX (mockup, architecture et développement d'interfaces complexes et JavaScript). Systèmes & Langages : Python, C/C++, JS, React Appétence Terrain : Un goût prononcé pour l'expérimentation réelle et la validation technique sur le terrain. Expertise Robotique requise : En tant que membre à part entière de l'équipe Innovation, vous devez impérativement maîtriser au moins l'un des domaines suivants pour contribuer aux travaux sur les essaims : Automatique & Contrôle : Modélisation dynamique, contrôle-commande de drones, MPC (Model Predictive Control). Localisation : SLAM visuel ou autre Optimisation & coordination de missions : Optimisation opérationnelle, planification de trajectoire. IA appliquée : IA pour la commande de systèmes robotiques et/ou la perception (vision). Simulation : environnement graphique, émulation de capteurs, SITL. NB : le poste requiert l'obtention d'une habilitation de sécurité délivrée par les autorités compétentes.

items.desc: Contexte de la missionDans le cadre du déploiement d?une solution transverse à l?échelle d?un groupe international, plusieurs entités doivent être intégrées et connectées à une plateforme commune. L?intégrateur technique intervient à chaque étape de l?onboarding des nouvelles entités, de l?analyse des flux existants jusqu?à la mise en production. Il garantit la bonne configuration des environnements, la fiabilité des échanges de données et la sécurisation des démarrages. L?objectif est également de standardiser et d?industrialiser les procédures d?intégration afin de faciliter les déploiements futurs. Missions principales1. Cadrage technique Analyser les systèmes d?information locaux et les supports techniques existants. Cartographier les flux d?échanges entre les systèmes locaux et la plateforme cible. Identifier les dépendances, les contraintes techniques et les éventuels points de blocage. 2. Intégration et configuration Coordonner ou réaliser les opérations de reprise de données et de mapping technique, en lien avec les équipes Data et Métier. Configurer et déployer la solution sur les environnements de test et de préproduction. Vérifier la conformité des échanges et la qualité des données intégrées. 3. Tests et mise en production Accompagner les tests d?intégration de bout en bout (E2E). Analyser et préqualifier les anomalies, puis coordonner leur résolution avec les équipes concernées. Préparer et sécuriser les plans de bascule technique. Assurer le support technique renforcé après le démarrage et accompagner les équipes locales pendant la phase d?hypercare. 4. Documentation et industrialisation Rédiger et maintenir les guides et checklists d?intégration technique. Documenter les spécificités de chaque entité intégrée. Préparer le transfert vers les équipes RUN et Support. Capitaliser sur les retours d?expérience afin de fiabiliser et d?accélérer les prochains déploiements. Profil candidat: Nous recherchons un intégrateur technique disposant d?une expérience concrète dans l?intégration de systèmes d?information, la gestion des flux de données et les mises en production dans des environnements complexes. Compétences techniques requisesArchitecture et intégration : architectures orientées services (SOA), microservices, API REST/SOAP, webhooks et mécanismes de messagerie ou bus d?événements. Flux et données : maîtrise des formats JSON, XML et CSV ; SQL avancé pour l?analyse, le contrôle et la validation des données. Diagnostic technique : lecture de logs, analyse et débogage de flux, utilisation d?outils tels que Postman ou cURL. Tests et mise en production : tests d?intégration, qualification des anomalies, préparation des bascules et accompagnement post-démarrage. Compétences appréciéesConnaissance des technologies de messagerie telles que Kafka ou RabbitMQ. Expérience sur un environnement Cloud (GCP, AWS ou Azure). Utilisation de Git et compréhension des pipelines CI/CD. Connaissance d?outils de supervision et de monitoring : Datadog, Kibana/Elastic, Splunk ou équivalents. Expérience de déploiement de solutions ERP, Supply Chain ou Retail dans des contextes multi-pays ou multi-entités. Savoir-êtreExcellentes capacités de communication avec des interlocuteurs techniques et métier. Pédagogie et capacité à accompagner des équipes locales. Rigueur dans le suivi des étapes d?intégration, des plannings et des procédures. Autonomie, proactivité et capacité à anticiper les risques. Sens du service et adaptabilité face à des environnements techniques et organisationnels variés. Anglais professionnel requis, à l?écrit comme à l?oral, dans un contexte international. Livrables attendusEnvironnements techniques configurés et connectés conformément aux exigences. Flux d?échanges intégrés, testés et validés. Plans de bascule et chronogrammes de mise en production documentés. Kits, guides et checklists d?onboarding technique actualisés. Documentation des spécificités de chaque entité et éléments nécessaires au transfert vers le RUN/Support. Objectif de la missionGarantir une intégration technique fiable et reproductible des différentes entités, sécuriser les mises en production et contribuer à l?industrialisation du processus d?onboarding à l?échelle du groupe.

items.desc: We are MOTOR Ai . Our mission is to make Level 4 autonomous driving a reality in Germany and beyond. By combining state-of-the-art AI with the expertise of our multidisciplinary team, we are poised to introduce the first solution of its kind in Germany that is eligible for certification on European roads. Since 2017, we have been steadfastly pursuing a single goal: to shape a future that is already in motion. What you will do Test our automated vehicles on public roads and in controlled areas, including manoeuvres, edge cases and regression checks after new software releases Prepare test sessions (software release, vehicle status, data recording) and turn logs and observations into structured reports Triage findings, identify root causes and hand them over as clear, reproducible tickets Create test plans and test cases, keep requirements traceable and check that they are testable Help improve our testing process, tooling and automation, using AI tools along the way What we are looking for 3+ years of experience in automotive or robotics testing, ideally hands-on with full vehicles Solid knowledge of vehicle systems and dynamics as well as a system-level understanding of ADAS/AD An analytical mindset and the ability to write precise, reproducible findings Experience with Jira, test management tools (e.g. DOORS) and AI tools; Python, ROS or vehicle data logging is a plus Fluent English; German is a plus Valid driving licence (class B), extensive driving experience and flexibility for field work A can-do attitude and the drive to deliver great results as a team Benefits Focus on people: Our strength lies in our diversity. We respect each other for who we are Genuine team spirit: working in teams that drive change forward - no matter how complex and extensive the projects are Your professional development is important to us - that's why we cover the costs of further education and training Flexible working hours - with room for the realities of life (parenthood, caregiving responsibilities, voluntary work, etc.) Whether it's fashion, beauty, travel or culture - you'll receive numerous discounts through our partner Corporate Benefits Social relevance: We work on solutions that have game-changing qualities Subsidy for public transport tickets Excellent transport links: attractive location in Wedding with very good public transport connections Excited about our vision and ideas? Do you see real value in autonomous driving for everyone? Then apply to MOTOR Ai and become an active part of a safe, explainable future of mobility. We particularly welcome applications from women and explicitly encourage them to apply for this position. At our new premises, we place great importance on getting to know one another and working together to drive our vision forward. Our international team is growing and working together on this exciting mission. Face-to-face collaboration is the key to success, which is why we have decided not to become a fully remote company. We ask recruitment consultancies and agencies not to submit candidate profiles without our prior express request. Any candidate profiles submitted without a prior written placement agreement signed by both parties shall be deemed to have been submitted unsolicited. No entitlement to placement fees or other charges shall arise from their use or from the subsequent recruitment of the candidate.

We are looking for someone who is curious, proactive, and excited to learn every aspect of building a data-driven software product, from data ingestion, transformation, and modelling to APIs, databases, deployment, and architecture decisions. items.desc: Control Systems Engineer | Munters Corporation Join Munters and Help Shape the Future of Data Center Cooling Munters is a global leader in climate solutions for mission-critical applications. Our Ireland team designs and manufactures advanced cooling technologies that help data centers operate more efficiently, reliably, and sustainably. We are looking for a Control Systems Engineer to join our Research & Development team and help develop the next generation of high-efficiency cooling and heat-rejection systems. This is a hands-on opportunity for an engineer who enjoys combining software, automation, controls, and real-world equipment to solve challenging engineering problems. What You'll Do Design and develop industrial control strategies using Function Block Diagram (FBD) programming. Develop and test control software for data center cooling equipment. Integrate and test controls on prototype systems in the R&D laboratory. Work with mechanical and electrical engineers to define equipment sequences and operating modes. Develop and tune PID and cascaded control loops . Configure sensors, actuators, variable-speed drives, controllers, and automation hardware. Support testing, data collection, and analysis of control-system performance. Troubleshoot software, electrical, and system-level control issues. Maintain software documentation, version control, and revision history. Support the transition of successful R&D solutions into production. Contribute to product testing, commissioning, and continuous improvement. What We're Looking For Degree in Control Systems Engineering, Mechatronics, Software Engineering, Automation Engineering , or a related discipline. 3+ years of experience developing software or controls for industrial systems. Experience with HVAC, refrigeration, cooling, process control, or industrial automation. Strong experience with Function Block Diagram programming . Understanding of control systems, PID tuning, equipment sequencing, and system dynamics. Experience with industrial sensors, programmable controllers, and automation hardware. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Comfortable working hands-on with prototype equipment. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Nice to Have Experience with: Carel controls Automated Logic Controls (ALC) Siemens controllers BACnet or Modbus Data center cooling Refrigeration or thermal management Prototype development and product validation Software version control and structured release processes Why Join Munters? You'll have the opportunity to work on innovative cooling technology for the rapidly growing data center industry , where your work directly impacts energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability. You'll also gain exposure to the full product-development lifecycle—from concept and software development through prototype testing, validation, and production . Munters is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued. We encourage qualified candidates to apply, even if you don't meet every listed qualification.

Nurturing critical wisdom for the sake of the world Why should you join Minerva? The salary and benefits are competitive; the people you'll work with are authentic, thoughtful, driven, and human; but the reason we chose Minerva is our strong belief in the company's mission: if we want to change the world, it's imperative that we improve education everywhere. As our first step to achieving that goal, we built Minerva University from the ground up, refining and improving every aspect of a traditional university. Minerva University boasts an unbiased admissions process (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/admissions/), seminars instead of lectures (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/), and a global experience over 4 years (https://www.minerva.edu/undergraduate/students-life/); and has been named the most innovative university in the world - three times (https://www.minerva.edu/announcements/minerva-university-most-innovative-university-wuri-2024/). Our methodology, which emphasizes active class participation, deliberate practice, and other empirically-proven methods, is enabled by Minerva Forum. Built to address the central educational challenges of the modern era, Minerva Forum embodies the leading research on the science of learning to enable the rapid development of sophisticated, durable skills-based programs. The role We're looking for a product designer who can make complex software clear and usable, and carry a design from understanding the problem through implementation and review. You'll work closely with another designer, engineers, and product and technology leadership to make complex software clear and usable. We're looking for someone who enjoys hands-on design, asks thoughtful questions, and can explain the reasoning behind their work. We welcome junior, mid-level, and senior candidates. Junior designers will work on defined projects with guidance and regular review from an experienced designer. Mid-level designers will independently carry defined product work through implementation. Senior designers will take broader ownership of ambiguous problems and patterns shared across the product. What you'll do Understand the workflow. Learn what users are trying to accomplish, where the current experience breaks down, and which parts of the problem matter most. Use conversations, support feedback, research and usage data to inform your work. Design coherent experiences. Map flows and create designs and prototypes in Figma. Work with teammates to identify what each user role needs, including permissions, empty states, errors, and other important edge cases. Make the interface clear. Design layouts, hierarchy, responsive behavior and accessible interactions. Write useful labels, instructions, warnings and confirmations. Work with the existing design system. Reuse established components where they fit, identify when a new pattern is needed, and work with engineering to keep Figma and the implemented product consistent. Make practical tradeoffs. Explore options and explain their strengths and limitations. Work with experienced teammates to understand technical constraints, agree on scope, and choose an approach the team can build. Make your work easy to build and review. Keep designs, intended behavior, edge cases and decision notes clear enough that teammates can follow them without a live walkthrough. Seek critique early and use it to improve the work. Follow the design into the product. Review implementations with teammates, identify confusing or broken interactions, and help resolve them. Learn how design decisions translate into the shipped product. Learn from real use. Look for places where people get stuck or behave differently than expected, and bring those findings back into the next design decision. What you'll bring Examples of software design work that show your contribution, reasoning, and ability to use feedback. These may come from professional work, internships, coursework, or substantial personal projects. For experienced candidates, we'll also look for shipped work and collaboration with engineers. A portfolio that shows interaction design, visual clarity and thoughtful handling of complex workflows. We want to understand the constraints, decisions and iterations behind the screens. Working knowledge of Figma, including components and prototyping, and a willingness to develop your skills within an established design system. More experienced candidates should be comfortable using these tools independently. An understanding of accessibility and responsive web design, and an interest in learning the details that help people complete tasks successfully. items.desc: About the team MongoDB Technical Services Engineers will combine exceptional problem solving and communication skills with deep technical experience to advise customers and solve complex MongoDB problems. What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity? Our efforts enable life-changing discoveries that are transforming human health through the early detection and diagnosis of diseases and new treatment options for patients. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible. Junior Field Service Engineer: Italy (Campania or Puglia) Location: Field-based, Italy | Based in either Campania or Puglia Travel: Up to 80% (A valid driving license in essential) Start your engineering career somewhere your work can make a difference. Are you an early-career engineer looking for an opportunity to turn your technical knowledge into hands-on experience? At Illumina, every role has the opportunity to contribute to something bigger. Our work helps equip researchers and clinicians with technology that supports scientific discovery and progress in human health. Just as importantly for someone starting their career, development happens through meaningful work, new challenges, collaboration and learning from expertise across the business. We’re looking for a Junior Field Service Engineer to join our team in Italy. This is an entry-level opportunity for someone with strong engineering fundamentals, curiosity and enthusiasm for problem-solving who wants to develop their skills in a customer-facing, field-based environment. You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. Bring your technical foundation, curiosity and willingness to learn. What you’ll do You’ll work directly with our customers and collaborate with colleagues across Service & Support, Applications, Sales, Marketing, Customer Service and Quality. Your responsibilities will include: Supporting the installation, maintenance, repair and upgrade of Illumina instrument systems Troubleshooting technical issues and providing on-site assistance to customers Helping coordinate service requests and working towards effective, timely resolutions Supporting new instrument installations, including facility inspections and instrument validation Maintaining appropriate service-parts inventory to support successful customer interventions Working with sales and marketing colleagues around new system placements, upgrades and contract renewals Building strong relationships with customers and internal partners Participating in departmental projects while building your technical knowledge and experience This could be a great next step if you… We want to emphasise that this is a junior, entry-level engineering position . Rather than looking for someone who has already mastered every aspect of field service engineering, we’re interested in candidates who bring a strong technical foundation and the motivation to develop. You may have recently completed your MSc degree within a relevant Engineering field , OR you may have completed a BSc degree with some relevant field experience. items.desc: About this position TNO is the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research. As an independent research institute, TNO connects science and industry to accelerate innovation and translate knowledge into practical, scalable solutions. By combining in-depth technical expertise with a strong application focus, TNO supports companies and governments in addressing complex technological and societal challenges. Within integrated photonics and advanced chip packaging, TNO brings together expertise through the Photonic Integration Technology Center (PITC) and the Chip Integration Technology Center (CITC). This creates a multidisciplinary environment in which photonic design, micro-assembly, semiconductor processing and packaging technologies converge to turn promising concepts into robust industrial solutions. What will be your role? As a Process Engineer Photonics Packaging, you develop and optimize assembly processes that connect photonic integrated circuits to optical, electrical, mechanical and thermal interfaces. You translate new integration concepts into reproducible and scalable process flows and validate them through structured experimental work. You work hands-on in the laboratory, collaborating with scientists, design engineers, equipment specialists, and industrial partners. Your activities cover the entire development cycle: from process definition and tooling concepts to assembly, characterization, data analysis, and documentation. Your contribution helps bridge the gap between early-stage photonic packaging concepts and production-ready solutions. Key responsibilities: Developing, optimizing and documenting assembly and integration processes for photonic devices, sub-assemblies and modules; Setting up and executing processes such as high-precision die placement, adhesive bonding, flip-chip assembly, soldering, wire bonding, fiber or optical interface attachment, and passive or active alignment; Designing and conducting experiments, including Design of Experiments (DoE), to gain insight into process windows and improve accuracy, yield, reliability and scalability; Collaborating with industrial partners and customers on national and international R&D projects and clearly reporting progress and results; Supporting knowledge transfer from R&D development to pilot-scale manufacturing and sharing expertise within multidisciplinary project teams. What we expect from you You are a hands-on and structured engineer who enjoys transforming complex integration challenges into stable processes. You work accurately, take responsibility for laboratory activities, and communicate effectively with colleagues and external partners. What you bring: A BSc or MSc degree in mechanical engineering, applied physics, electrical engineering, or a related discipline; At least three years of relevant experience in photonics packaging, semiconductor assembly, micro-assembly, precision engineering or a similar high-tech manufacturing environment; Experience with structured process development, experimental design, data analysis and technical problem solving; Affinity with optical and electrical testing, metrology, inspection, and process qualification; The ability to read technical drawings and translate product requirements and tolerances into suitable process and tooling concepts; Strong communication skills in English, both written and verbal. What you'll get in return Challenging and varied work with a real impact. And plenty of opportunities as, at TNO, you are in charge of shaping your career. We offer a gross monthly salary between (based on your knowledge and experience), 8% holiday pay, a 13th month bonus of 8.33% and a flex budget (5.58% + € 180). In addition, you will be given every opportunity to develop yourself. TNO offers optional employee benefits, enabling you to tailor your benefits package to match your personal situation. You may also expect: An extremely professional, innovative working environment where colleagues are leading experts in their field. The opportunity to attend courses, workshops and conferences, and to receive training and coaching based on your needs. 33 days annual leave plus a flexible holiday that can be used on a cultural, religious, or otherwise important day of your choosing (on a full-time basis). An employer working towards a respectful, inclusive, and equitable work environment where every employee can flourish, with various initiatives such as Jong TNO, numerous expertise based guilds, Rainbow Community and Round Tables on diverse inclusion topics. We offer a comprehensive and flexible mobility plan that also includes full compensation for public transportation for commuting and business travel. Great social events with your team and other TNO colleagues. That’s how you will get to know a lot of people really quickly. Flexible working hours, the possibility to work parttime (32 or 36 hours) and the possibility of working from home. Extensive relocation package for …

This role is based remotely as a full-time employee in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands, or Sweden. We are also open to contractors in Eastern Europe and Portugal. The Opportunity We're looking for an engineering-minded owner of the systems our Sales, Marketing and Revenue Operations teams run on: CRM, marketing automation, CPQ and the tools around them. This is not a ticket-queue role. Business teams will bring you solutions ("add a field", "build me a report"). Your job is to find the problem behind the request and see how a change affects every connected system. Then fix it once, ideally so the next person can do it themselves without filing a request. You'll have an internal engineering team to lean on, and you'll use AI tools daily to build faster. Responsibilities Own the GTM systems as one connected whole: know how CRM, CPQ, marketing automation and sales-engagement tools share data, and design every change with that in view. Turn requests into problems: ask what the business is trying to solve, propose options, explain trade-offs, and say "no" or "not like that" when it's the right call. Remove recurring manual work: measure the effort, then replace it with automation or self-service tools that business users run themselves. Build automations, small tools and integrations, choosing the simplest approach that will hold up. Keep the data model lean and trustworthy: retire unused fields and legacy workarounds, and enforce data quality where data enters rather than cleaning it up later. Keep integrations reliable: use native connectors where they do the job; where something custom is needed, respect API limits, add error handling and monitoring, and keep sandbox and production consistent. Collaborate with our internal engineering team as necessary. Use AI tools to build, investigate issues, and speed up routine work. Provide EMEA-hours support for the GTM stack, and use what you see there to pick the next fix. Document changes and follow change management from sandbox to production. Current Sales/Marketing Tech Stack: Salesforce, Dealhub CPQ, Hubspot, ZoomInfo, Gong Professional, Gong Engage, Gong Forecasting, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Dripify, Ringlead Qualifications 3+ years hands-on with Salesforce Sales Cloud (advanced Flow, data and security model), plus HubSpot and/or DealHub CPQ. Working knowledge of Apex, SOQL and REST APIs, and able to write scripts in Python or JavaScript. A track record of replacing manual processes with automation or self-service, with before-and-after examples. Systems thinking: good judgment about where logic and data should live across connected systems. Understanding of lead-to-quote-to-close and the marketing funnel (lead lifecycle, attribution). Comfortable using AI coding and automation tools every day. Clear communicator who can push back on requests with reasons, and works well with business users and engineers. Fluent English, additional languages are a plus. Ability to work in the country of residence (we do not provide visa sponsorship). Nice to have: Salesforce Platform App Builder or Platform Developer I certification; Git/SFDX; depth in Gong, ZoomInfo or HubSpot; cloud platform experience; experience with an integration platform or event-driven systems. Perform electrical and functional validation measurements across Process, Voltage, and Temperature (PVT) conditions. Conduct power correlation exercises and performance testing. Troubleshoot technical issues and provide expert customer support when required. Drive continuous improvements in validation methods, processes, and product quality. Knowledge of electrical and functional validation methods. Experience with test scripting, test program customization, and debugging. Understanding of PVT validation, power correlation, and performance testing. Experience with IC bring-up, manual debugging, and technical investigations. Ability to define test requirements and develop validation plans for new devices. Strong troubleshooting and analytical problem-solving skills. Good communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a global team. Customer-oriented mindset and commitment to continuous improvement and product quality. What We Offer: A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

items.desc: Om oss På Techrytera AB börjar rekryteringen med dig. Vi är ett bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag med spetskompetens och ett tydligt fokus inom IT och Engineering. Med vår branschkunskap och nära dialog med både kandidater och kunder skapar vi träffsäkra matchningar där rätt kompetens möter rätt behov. Vi tror att en riktigt bra matchning inte bara handlar om en rollbeskrivning – utan om dina erfarenheter, din potential och vad du faktiskt vill utvecklas inom. Därför utgår vi alltid från individen. Genom att förstå din bakgrund, dina drivkrafter och dina ambitioner kan vi koppla ihop dig med uppdrag och roller hos våra kunder där du får rätt förutsättningar att utvecklas och göra skillnad. Vårt mål är att bygga långsiktiga och meningsfulla samarbeten – både för dig som kandidat och för våra kunder. Arbetsbeskrivning Vi söker en senior systemutvecklare till ett tvärfunktionellt team som arbetar med utveckling, modernisering och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska system. Uppdraget omfattar utveckling av nya funktioner, modernisering av befintliga lösningar samt effektivisering av verksamhetsprocesser. Rollen har fokus på Java och Angular och innebär stort eget ansvar för teknisk utveckling, arkitektur, design och hållbara lösningar. Du arbetar nära verksamheten och samarbetar med utvecklare, testare, kravanalytiker och andra funktioner. Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter Utveckla, vidareutveckla och förvalta befintliga system. Ta fram tekniska lösningar och bidra till arkitektur- och designbeslut. Utveckla och underhålla utvecklingsmiljöer. Testa och leverera enligt agila arbetssätt. Självständigt driva aktiviteter och leveranser. Bidra till kunskapsdelning, dokumentation och teknisk kvalitet. Samverka med andra team och stötta mindre erfarna utvecklare. Obligatoriska krav Konsulten ska ha: Minst 10 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av Java under de senaste 12 åren. Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Java EE under de senaste 7 åren. Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Spring Framework. Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Angular och TypeScript. Dokumenterad erfarenhet av Node.js. Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Oracle eller MySQL. Minst 2 års erfarenhet av Maven, Liquibase eller Jenkins. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av Git. Minst 1 års erfarenhet av JMS. Minst 2 års erfarenhet av Java Swing. Minst 3 års erfarenhet av agilt utvecklingsarbete. God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska i tal och skrift. Meriterande Erfarenhet av komplexa verksamhetskritiska system. Kunskap om offentliga verksamhetsprocesser eller erfarenhet från närliggande myndighetsverksamhet. Uppdragsperiod Start: 26 december 2026 eller snarast efter godkänd kontroll. Slut: 26 december 2027. Förlängningsoption: Till 26 december 2028. Ansökan När du söker via Techrytera AB söker du inte bara ett jobb – du påbörjar en dialog om din fortsatta karriär. Vi vill lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och dina ambitioner för att kunna matcha dig med rätt möjligheter hos våra kunder. Låter det intressant? Skicka in din ansökan eller hör av dig till oss så berättar vi mer. Vi ser fram emot att hitta nästa steg i din karriär tillsammans med dig.

items.desc: Application Deadline: Nov. 1, 2026 Multiple locations On-site Job Description Shape the future technology landscape at Tre Tre is strengthening its architecture function to support major transformation initiatives across Sweden and Denmark. We are modernising our technology landscape, investing in cloud, AI, digital capabilities and long-term architecture to support future growth. As part of this journey, we're looking for an experienced Enterprise Architect, Business Transformation & Portfolio who wants to help shape the future of one of the Nordic region's leading telecom operators. You will connect business strategy, technology direction and investment decisions, helping Tre make better choices about what to standardise, modernise, consolidate, buy, build or retire. This is not an architecture approval role. Your purpose is to create clarity, make complex choices visible and help the organisation make better decisions earlier. About our architecture community At Tre, architecture is evolving into a stronger advisory capability with greater influence across business and technology. Our architects help create clarity, guide strategic decisions and connect long-term direction with practical execution. As our Enterprise Architect, you will work closely with Domain Architects, Technology Architects, engineering teams and senior leaders to shape the future technology landscape across Sweden and Denmark. This is an opportunity to join a growing architecture community with increasing impact on technology strategy, transformation initiatives and business outcomes. About the role As our Enterprise Architect, Business Transformation & Portfolio , you will help define Tre's long-term technology direction and ensure that strategic business goals translate into sustainable architecture decisions. You will work across business domains, technology platforms and transformation initiatives, connecting business capabilities, systems and investments into a coherent enterprise landscape. Working closely with business and technology leaders, Domain Architects, Technology Architects and portfolio stakeholders, you will help shape target architectures, strategic roadmaps and key investment decisions while establishing Tre's Enterprise Architecture capability. Your focus extends beyond individual programmes. You will help drive portfolio coherence, simplification and long-term technology direction across Sweden and Denmark. What you'll do In this role, you will: Define and evolve the enterprise target architecture across Sweden and Denmark. Connect business capabilities, strategic objectives, applications, platforms and investment decisions. Drive portfolio-level decisions regarding standardisation, modernisation, sourcing and legacy retirement. Identify cross-domain dependencies, risks and decisions that require enterprise-wide alignment. Establish architecture direction for major transformation initiatives. Support leadership with recommendations and decision material for strategic business and technology investments. Develop enterprise roadmaps, transition plans, architecture principles and decision records. You can look forward to: A central role in shaping the future technology landscape of a leading Nordic telecom operator. The opportunity to influence strategic investment, platform and transformation decisions. Working across Sweden and Denmark within a federated architecture model. Close collaboration with business leaders, architects and engineering teams. Major transformation initiatives involving customer experience, telecom platforms, cloud, AI and modern software delivery. Joining a growing architecture function with increasing influence on strategic business and technology decisions. Mats describes himself as a leader: "I believe great architects create clarity rather than complexity. We provide advisory and 'marriage counseling' for IT and Business. I value curiosity, accountability and collaboration, and I encourage people to challenge established ways of working when there is a better path forward. My role as a leader is to provide direction, remove obstacles and create an environment where people can have real impact and grow in their area of expertise." Work with great people Julia Maxén Team Manager "I want my team to have the best conditions to excel in their roles. By empowering each member to perform at their best, we not only grow stronger as a team but also drive Tre forward to new heights" Henrik Sundvall Digital Project Lead "The absolute best thing about being a project manager at Tre is that I get to work broadly with colleagues from all parts of the organization and learn new things every day. I have the freedom to be myself – and be appreciated for it!" Jayasri Battola Developer "The great work culture and the technology made me choose Tre. Working alongside great people in mixed team setups, with both experienced and new talents, along with the latest and greatest tools and technologies like …

items.desc: Combine geophysical analysis with hands-on fieldwork and contribute to mineral exploration in a varied role with excellent opportunities to grow. Ort: Kiruna Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning Ansök senast: 2026-11-08 The sustainable transformation begins with us We are facing our greatest challenge yet – ensuring that Sweden and Europe have what it takes to transform. So that we can live the lives we want, both today and tomorrow. In the same way that we strive to improve the future, we are committed to developing everyone who joins us on this journey, both personally and professionally. Would you like to be part of laying the foundation for the way we live – and for the world around us? Your role As a Geophysicist within our Mineral Exploration team, you will bridge the gap between advanced data processing and practical field operations. Your responsibilities naturally follow the seasons—dedicating summer periods to dynamic fieldwork and ground data acquisition and focusing during the winter months on comprehensive data processing, 3D modelling, interpretation, and interdisciplinary collaboration. Your main responsibilities will include: Data Processing & Interpretation:Process, model, and interpret multidisciplinary geophysical data to delineate targets and refine geological models. Field Acquisition:Lead and participate in hands-on geophysical surveys and data collection campaigns across active exploration sites. Exploration Strategy: Provide critical geophysical insight to optimize drilling programs and advance mineral exploration initiatives. Cross-FunctionalCollaboration:Work closely with exploration geologists and specialists across LKAB, including geotechnics and mining operations. Project Participation : Engage flexibly in a wide variety of project stages as organizational needs and strategic exploration priorities evolve. You will work both independently and together with others. Close collaboration with fellow geophysicists, geologists and field technicians is essential for success in this role, as exploration projects rely on combining different areas of expertise and perspectives . The varied assignments and opportunities to participate in different projects provide excellent potential to develop within your professional field. What you bring We are looking for a geophysicist who thrives in a dynamic environment where fieldwork, data interpretation and collaboration go hand in hand. You have a structured and solution-oriented way of working, communicate your findings clearly and can translate complex data into valuable insights. You enjoy working closely with colleagues from different disciplines and contribute to a collaborative team environment. You are reflective and thoughtful in your decision-making, with an ability to balance technical opportunities with responsible use of resources to create sustainable and effective exploration solutions. We are looking for someone who has: Education: Higher university degree in geophysics. Strong background in physics. Experience in mineral exploration: Candidates with several years of relevant experience in mineral exploration will be given preference. However, all applications will be considered and reviewed based on the overall qualifications and experience of the candidate. Good spoken and written english Valid B driving licence for manual transmission vehicles It is an advantadge if you have: Geophysical Software:Proficiency in industry-standard software packages such as Oasis montaj (Seequent), Mira Geoscience, Leapfrog Geo, Maxwell, ModelVision,GeoTools. Electromagnetic Methods: Practical and theoretical experience with EM methods, with particular emphasis on Magnetotellurics (MT / AMT). Proficiency in Swedish, or a genuine willingness to learn. What we offer In addition to the general benefits we offer — which you can find a bit further down — we can also offer the following to those who do not currently live in Sweden: Relocation support for you and your family. Excellent conditions for settling in. We guide you through the official procedures necessary to settle in the country if you come from outside Sweden. We also provide temporary accommodation for a reasonable period and help you find a permanent place to live according to your personal needs. LKAB helps you learn Swedish, a tool for a better understanding of Swedish culture. The Swedish vacation law entitles all employees to five weeks of vacation per year, and four consecutive weeks during June, July, or August. Your contract may include extra vacation days. Additional information We strive for a fair and objective recruitment process. Therefore, we usually do not request cover letters. Instead, we ask you to answer questions related to the specific position you are applying for. Your responses help us understand your skills and experience, so please take the time to answer as clearly and thoroughly as possible. items.card: Role overview The Minecraft team is expanding to help realize our dream of a better Minecraft experience. As a member of this team, you will help create gameplay features that allow our incredible community to realize their creations using mechanics and technologies you helped create. You will also contribute to improving the performance and stability of the game as a whole. You'll join a cross-functional team and
items.desc: Mojang Studios is best known as the creators of Minecraft, but we're also on a mission – to build a better world through the power of play. Why play? Well, play is at the heart of everything we do. It's the blocky backbone of our games, the core of our development philosophy, and even the origin of our name. From the relentless experimentation of our endlessly inspiring community to the classrooms where Minecraft has become an essential teaching tool, play is the bedrock of our existence. Role overview The Minecraft team is expanding to help realize our dream of a better Minecraft experience. As a member of this team, you will help create gameplay features that allow our incredible community to realize their creations using mechanics and technologies you helped create. You will also contribute to improving the performance and stability of the game as a whole. You'll join a cross-functional team and collaborate with engineers, designers, artists and colleagues in quality assurance, all contributing to a game enjoyed by over 100,000,000 players worldwide. We have big dreams for the future of Minecraft and need you to help make them happen. Minecraft is developed across Java and Bedrock, and our team works with both editions. You do not need to know every part of Minecraft when you join. We are looking for someone with a good foundation in Java, an interest in gameplay development and a willingness to learn and solve problems together with others. You will have room to contribute your own perspective while learning from and sharing knowledge with people across different disciplines. This is a full-time role based in Stockholm with a hybrid working model, where we work from the office three days a week. Please note that we are currently only considering candidates based in Sweden. As a Game Engineer in the Minecraft Gameplay team, you will: Implement, test and iterate on new and existing gameplay features for upcoming Minecraft updates. Work with game designers, artists, quality assurance and other developers to turn ideas into experiences for our players. Contribute to technical and design discussions throughout the development of a feature. Investigate and resolve issues in gameplay features and their underlying systems. Help improve the quality, performance and stability of the game. Participate in code reviews and share knowledge with other members of the team. To succeed in this role, we believe you will need: At least 3-5 years of experience developing software in Java. Experience implementing, debugging and testing software features. An understanding of common software engineering practices. Ability to communicate and collaborate in English. Helpful experience: Experience with gameplay development. Experience with modern C++. Experience working with large or established codebases. An interest in Minecraft and its gameplay. If the role sounds interesting but your experience does not match everything listed above, we still encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and perspectives, and we are interested in what you could bring to the team and how you would grow in the role. Mojang Studios Mojang Studios is a Microsoft-owned game developer. The company was founded in Stockholm, Sweden and has offices around the world, including Stockholm, Redmond, Tokyo, London, and Shanghai. We're always working on new and exciting ways to expand the Minecraft universe. Our community is global and incredibly diverse. We keep this in mind when developing anything, as we want people to feel included in Minecraft. And in recruiting, our goal is to make Mojang Studios as diverse as our community. We got started as a tiny indie developer, and part of our culture still reflects that heritage. But we're also proud to belong to Xbox Game Studios, which creates unique opportunities to grow and develop. To help us achieve amazing things, we have built an equally amazing studio space. Situated right on the water by Söder Mälarstrand, it's filled to the brim with all the tools, toys and caffeine required to create world-class entertainment. But in the end, it's the people of Mojang Studios that make this place truly special. When you join, you'll find yourself in the company of incredibly bright, warm, and creative individuals – all united and working toward a single goal. Come help us reach it! Important note on resumes Please make sure that all the information in your resume is accurate because we will conduct a thorough background check. Any discrepancies will lower your chances of getting to the next interview stage and we'd hate to miss out on an awesome candidate! Double check that any gap years are reflected in your history, and that your education and work experience are completely accurate. Good luck!

items.desc: Market Support & Training Specialist Location Nänikon, Canton of Zurich, Switzerland Date posted October 13, 2026 Job ID 23441 Our Opening and Your Responsibilities Our strategic business unit AutoChem within the Laboratory Division supports leading pharmaceutical, chemical, and CDMO/CRMO companies in process development and scale-up. With our technologies for synthesis, sampling and reaction analysis, together with our established iC Suite Software, we enable informed decision-making in research and production. For our site in Nänikon-Greifensee, we are currently looking for a motivated Market Support & Training Specialist 100% (all genders) . In this role, you will be responsible for: Providing worldwide technical support for the RXE/CSS product portfolio, including hardware, software, accessories, consumables, and services. Investigating and resolving technical issues through remote support, laboratory testing, and collaboration with global stakeholders. Supporting software deployment, configuration, licensing, connectivity, and cloud-based solutions, including iC Software. Supporting timely resolution of case escalations, quality issues, and returns. Developing troubleshooting resources, knowledge databases, and digital access tools. Developing and delivering technical training for Field Service Engineers and support teams, including training materials for global product launches. Testing and ensuring equipment readiness ahead of technical trainings and demonstrations. Supporting New Product Development and Introduction (NPDI) projects to ensure service readiness at launch. Collaborating with R&D, Software, Service, Digital Business Solutions, and Product Management to improve products, processes, and customer experience. Translating field experience and customer feedback into product, software, and service improvements. What You Need to Succeed The following qualifications are required for this position: Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, IT, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of experience in technical support, service, training, laboratory instrumentation, or a comparable technical role. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills across hardware and software environment. Hands-on interest in scientific instrumentation, software platforms, and connected laboratory solutions. Strong communication and presentation skills with an interest in technical training and knowledge sharing. Collaborative, customer-focused, and self-motivated working style. Experience with software deployment, licensing, IT infrastructure, cloud solutions, or SaaS is an advantage. Willingness to travel internationally (15–20%). Fluent in English (oral and written); German language skills are a plus. Our Offer to You We offer: Flexible working hours (depending on the role), a hybrid work model, and a wide portfolio of training opportunities A 40-hour work week with at least 25 vacation days per year, plus 4 to 7 additional days off between bank holidays Free parking and direct access to public transport Healthy lunches cooked onsite at our own METTLER TOLEDO restaurant, with special prices for employees A range of additional attractive benefits, including employee discounts at select area businesses You can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and achieve your career goals. Have we raised your interest? Then we look forward to receiving your complete application at our Job portal. Please note that we do not accept any application documents via e-mail, only applications submitted on our job platform due to our data protection guidelines. Furthermore, we do currently not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this role. If you have any question, please do not hesitate to contact our Talent Acquisition Team ta-ch@mt.com. About Mettler Toledo METTLER TOLEDO is a global leader in precision instruments and services. We are renowned for innovation and quality across laboratory, process analytics, industrial, product inspection, and retailing applications. Our sales and service network is one of the most extensive in the industry. Our products are sold in more than 140 countries, and we have a direct presence in approximately 40 countries.
