Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM, with an hour for lunch Salary: £40,000 a year, plus workplace pension Holiday: 28 days a year, including bank holidays Closing date: Friday 30 October 2026 ABOUT US Property Masterz is an independent estate and letting agency on Ilford Lane. We've been looking after landlords, tenants, buyers and sellers across East London since 2010, and we handle lettings, sales and full property management. Our website, app and portal listings currently run on a third-party agency platform, and a lot of our day-to-day record keeping is still done by hand and held on local computers and paper files. We want to bring our systems in-house so we control our own data, can offer proper online services to clients, and can keep the records our compliance work depends on in one secure place. This is a new role, and you'd be the person leading that work. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Website and property search Build and look after our public website and its property search: filters for area, price, bedrooms, property type and let or sale, map search, saved searches and email alerts. Keep listings, photos, floor plans and EPCs in step between the website and our property records. Add translated pages for our overseas landlords and investors, with prices shown in other currencies and viewings and calls booked in their own time zone. Look after site speed, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA) and the technical side of SEO. Client portals Build secure online portals so landlords can see statements, documents and the status of their properties, and tenants can report repairs, see rent records and download tenancy documents. Applicants should be able to register, book viewings and follow their referencing. Set up proper sign-in with multi-factor authentication, role-based access and a full audit trail. Add an AI-assisted chat and reply assistant to the website and portals, using an approved AI service, so common enquiries get a quick first answer. Set limits on what it can see and say, pass anything about a specific tenancy, money or complaint to a member of staff, and keep a record of what it sent. Portal listings Build and maintain the connection between our property records and the property portals we list on (currently Zoopla and OnTheMarket), working through each portal's approved feed route, so new listings, price changes and withdrawals go out from one place. Monitor rejected listings and feed errors, and route portal enquiries into our systems. The lettings and sales team will keep writing the listings; this role looks after the technical side. Records, compliance and audit systems Design and build a secure central records system to replace our paper and locally kept files: tenant complaints and enquiries, tenancy agreements, electricity and gas records, and the licences and certificates held for each property. Our office team will keep entering the records; you build and secure the system they use. Plan and carry out the move of our existing records from office computers and paper files into a secure cloud environment (the office team will scan the paper originals): choose and set up the hosting, structure and import the data, check nothing is lost, and put access control, encryption and backups in place. Build a compliance register that tracks expiry dates (gas safety, electrical safety, EPCs, deposit protection and licences) and reminds the team in good time. Review the system's audit and access logs regularly, investigate anything unusual, and produce audit reports for management and compliance checks. Keep the records behind our anti-money laundering checks, Right to Rent checks and client money handling secure and within UK GDPR retention rules. Security and data protection Our systems hold client ID documents, financial records and tenancy data, so security runs through everything in this role. You'll follow secure development practice (OWASP Top 10 and ASVS), with code review and dependency and vulnerability scanning. Protect personal data under UK GDPR and the Data Protection Act 2018: encryption, retention rules, access control, and spotting and responding to breaches. Look after hosting, domains, SSL certificates and backups, test that we can actually recover, and take the company through Cyber Essentials certification. Write clear documentation and show the team how to use the new systems safely. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR A degree in computer science, software engineering, IT or a related subject, or equivalent experience. Practical experience building and deploying web applications, such as property or business portals, search features or admin systems, using Python (FastAPI or Django), JavaScript and a SQL database such as PostgreSQL. Hands-on knowledge of web application security: authentication, access control, …

These customers include government agencies, state-owned companies, educational institutions, healthcare and non-profit organisations. Our Public Sector teams help customers build a deeper understanding of hyper-scale cloud technology and application architectures, and they have the consultative skills required to drive deliver successful outcomes. As an AWS Solutions Architect, you will have ownership of the technical relationship with customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability, operational efficiency and best-practice architectures. Internally, you will be an advocate acting on behalf of the customer to help drive continual improvements to the AWS platform, sharing their needs and wants to inform the roadmap of AWS features and services. You will also help shape the future of the Solutions Architecture organisation by helping to hire, coach and mentor others. In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to implement or document cloud-native reference architectures with the AWS Solutions Architect community. You will participate in the creation and sharing of recommended practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelise and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences). If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while investigating the impossible, come build the future with us. We seek candidates from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work. Amazon cares about employee health and well-being, both on and off the job. AWS employee benefits include flexible working, private medical insurance (includes family), and a free employee assistance programme. At Amazon we pride ourselves in making a difference in the world, in a unique Amazon way. We have opportunities available for employees to volunteer to help out their local communities through Amazon in the Community and supporting events such as Hour of Code. At AWS, we’re dedicated to providing an inclusive and accepting environment, from the first day you join us. We believe that broader representation of talent allows us to continue innovating for our customers. About the team Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness. Mentorship and Career Growth We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional. items.desc: The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Background: We aim to make our programs a model for the highest global standards and to cultivate power and lasting change not just for our clients but for all people affected by humanitarian crises. To achieve that vision, the IRC’s Technical Excellence (TE) group, located within the Crisis Response, Recovery and Development (CRRD) Department, provides technical assistance to IRC’s country program staff and shares what we learn to influence policy and practice. IRC’s Technical Excellence team is comprised of seven teams which have deep expertise in their respective fields: Education, Economic Wellbeing, Governance, Health, Violence Prevention and Response, MEAL, and Grants & Operations. Measurement, Evaluation, Technology, Accountability, and Learning at the IRC The METAL Unit is responsible for supporting CRRD to have a culture of strong data and evidence use through stewardship of the Data & Performance Ecosystem, and for coordinating successful piloting and uptake of innovative technology solutions. The METAL Unit provides specialized support across four pillars to strengthen program effectiveness, improve decision-making, and enhance organizational learning. This is a hybrid position open to candidates based in New York, US, Kenya and UK. Other Limited IRC Locations may also be considered. Successful candidates will be hired on a local employment contract and according to local salary scale. Job Overview The METAL Quality Assurance Analyst will be part of the METAL team which is responsible for delivering products that support day-to-day implementation of CRRD Programs as well as the collection, management, visualization of KPIs relevant to higher-level decision-making. The QA Analyst is a team member responsible for developing, testing, implementing, and supporting CRRD’s data toolkits, for which the tech stack includes CommCare, Microsoft Power BI, and Microsoft SQL server Azure-based data warehouse. The Data Toolkits are essential for CRRD’s data collection, management and analysis so it is critical for the success of the team that the QA Analyst have strong skills related to testing data transformation and visualization. Working in partnership with staff at various levels and locations, the QA Analyst will perform a key role in testing, assuring quality, and improving Data Toolkits with a successful rollout. Should demonstrate a solid focus on responsive application design and an understanding of the diverse subject areas involved in developing user-centric and impactful applications. Position key attributes are multi-tasking, detail orientation, fast learning, and self-organizing. The candidate is required to not only test the technology products, but also to identify, create, and implement complex use case scenarios; take a lead in efforts to find requirement/specification gaps and work very closely with business teams/analysts to seek answers. Find a balance between keeping high-quality standards without overly exerting on the release timeline. Build a good working relationship between development and product management teams. Be able to turn around testing and regression testing within timelines without compromising on quality. This role reports to the Product Manager. Program Technology. The QA Analyst will work closely with METAL Developers. They will have a technical line to the Senior Manager, Quality Assurance and maintain regular contact with the QA team to ensure that METAL is following the best practices of the wider organization. Work with the project management team closely to ensure that testing processes are implemented and followed by all core team members. Co-deliver the Oliver McGowan Mandatory Training on Learning Disability and Autism alongside accredited Facilitating Trainers, ensuring training is delivered in accordance with national programme standards. items.desc: Beneath every major project lies a story waiting to be told. The sediments, soils and buried landscapes that geoarchaeology helps us understand are irreplaceable, and the consultants who can read them, record them and communicate their meaning play a vital role in how we deliver projects responsibly. At Stantec, we are growing our geoarchaeology capability, and we are looking for an early-career Geoarchaeological Consultant to join us as part of a wider archaeology and heritage team of over 30 professionals. This is a role with a genuine structured pathway, real mentorship and the kind of varied, hands-on experience that builds a strong foundation for a long career in geoarchaeological consultancy. About The Role You will support the delivery of geoarchaeological consultancy services across assessment, reporting, fieldwork and data interpretation, working under the guidance of our Geoarchaeology Lead as you develop towards independent practice. On the assessment and reporting side, you will compile and review geological, geomorphological, geotechnical, archaeological and environmental datasets, undertake background research, assist in the preparation of Geoarchaeological Potential Assessments and Desk-Based Assessments, and contribute to the development of conceptual and site-specific deposit models. You will prepare figures, GIS outputs, plans and tables, and draft factual and interpretative sections of technical reports. In the field, you will attend site visits and ground investigations, record and describe sediments, soils and stratigraphic sequences, compile field records and photographs, and support the monitoring of ground investigation and archaeological works as your training and authorisation develop. You will also contribute to data management and digital outputs, including GIS-based project information, digital mapping and deposit models, and will have the opportunity to get involved in developing digital and AI-enabled approaches to geoarchaeological assessment. A full UK driving licence is required, or must be obtained during your probationary period. Your Impact The geoarchaeological work you contribute to here will help ensure that buried landscapes and archaeological deposits are properly understood, appropriately assessed and sensitively managed across some of the UK’s most significant infrastructure programmes. That is work with real meaning, and it starts from day one. As your skills and confidence grow, so will the independence and complexity of what you take on. The progression pathway here is clear, supported and genuinely invested in, and we are committed to helping you become a confident, capable geoarchaeological practitioner. About You You hold an undergraduate degree in Archaeology, Geography, Geology, Earth Sciences or a related discipline, with a Master’s in Geoarchaeology, Environmental Archaeology, Quaternary Science, Geomorphology or a related subject preferred though not essential. You bring a dissertation, research, placement, or field experience in geoarchaeology, environmental archaeology, Quaternary science, or sedimentary analysis, and a genuine, demonstrable interest in buried landscape reconstruction and Quaternary environments. You are organised, curious and keen to learn. You take care with your work, engage enthusiastically with mentoring and knowledge-sharing, and are excited by the opportunity to develop practical skills in sediment description, stratigraphic interpretation and deposit modelling within a professional consultancy environment. Why Join Us We put people first: We’re proud of our friendly, inclusive and collaborative environment where everyone feels valued and driven to succeed. We are driven to achieve: Named in the top 50 companies to work by Glassdoor 2025. Recognised by Corporate Knights as one of the world’s top 10 most sustainable companies in 2025. Named ‘Best Place to Work’ and ‘International Consulting Firm of the Year’ at the NCE Awards 2024. items.card: About the role We're hiring our first Product Designer. Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. items.desc: Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world. Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not. Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report. We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it. It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX. We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon. Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date. About the role We're hiring our first Product Designer. Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO. We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon. What you'll work on Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help: Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does. Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet. Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't. What you'll do Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all. Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states. Prototype fast, in code when it helps. Work next to engineers while they build, so the details come out right. Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving. Build the design system that lets engineers ship great work without waiting on you. Who you are Minimum 3 years designing products that were shipped. A portfolio that shows the messy middle, not just the final screens. You sweat the mobile details: touch targets, offline, errors. You have opinions on where AI helps and where it gets in the way. You'd happily put on a hard hat to understand a problem. Bonus if you've designed for industrial or field work, or prototype in code. Interview process Intro call. Portfolio deep dive with Ish and an engineer: one project, including what went wrong. Interview with a cofounder: Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO and CPO). Onsite: a real Scope design problem, worked on with the team, then a short presentation. Offer! What we offer £70k to £100k base + significant equity, so you have a stake in what you are building Full visa sponsorship, giving us access to global talent and an international, diverse team Tools to do your job, including a brand new MacBook and Scope merch Generous above-market annual leave allowance Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental Employee pension through NEST Flexible parental leave (including adoption leave) Healthy meal-prep lunch and dinners, a fully stocked fridge, and team lunches on Fridays Regular events including off-sites We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but this is the kind of problem you want to work on, we strongly encourage you to apply.

items.desc:
Role highlights: 
 Quality Control Technician - Mechanical
 Location: Greece
 Department: Stock Management
 Reports to: Manager, Stock Management
 Employment type: Permanent
 Workplace model: Office
 Employment is subject to applicable security screening (incl. SUPO, where required)
 Why this role matters: 
 This role is responsible for performing, visual, and mechanical inspections and quality checks to ensure that all hardware used in ICEYE satellite missions meets defined quality standards throughout the product lifecycle.
 The Quality Control Technician supports the implementation of inspection plans by conducting inspections during receiving, ensuring that all components and subsystems conform to requirements prior to shipment.
 The role is embedded within the production and AIT environment, working closely with Production, AIT Engineering, Mission Assurance, and Supply Chain teams to identify defects early, prevent quality escapes, and maintain compliance with space-grade standards.
 Who We Are 
 ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth.
 ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system.
 ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future.
 Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
 Your day-to-day responsibilities 
 Conduct visual, and mechanical inspections and quality checks during receiving operations on mechanical, composite and electronic parts, commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) items, and subsystems in accordance with inspection sheets and/or inspection plans;
 Update material status in the ERP/MES system in accordance with inspection results;
 Report non-conformances (NCs), support root cause analysis (RCA) activities, and contribute to the implementation of corrective and preventive actions across production and the supply chain;
 Prepare timely and accurate reports on outstanding issues related to inspected parts and subsystems;
 Review and provide feedback on inspection sheets and/or control plans;
 Maintain and follow quarantine and scrapping procedures;
 Ensure inspection tools and equipment are properly calibrated and maintained;
 Monitor inspection, logistics, production, storage, and laboratory environments to ensure compliance with safety and quality standards;
 Contribute to continuous process improvement initiatives within the company.
 What we’re looking for 
 Must haves: 
 Degree or diploma in Mechanics, Quality Control, Manufacturing, or related field
 Minimum 2 years of experience in quality control roles within aerospace, defense, or high-reliability manufacturing environments. Hands-on experience inspecting mechanical parts.
 Use of inspection tools (e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges, torque tools)
 Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, specifications, and inspection plans
 Awareness of manufacturing and assembly processes
 Knowledge of measurement principles and calibration requirements
 Conversational level of spoken and written English
 Nice to haves: 
 Hands on experience inspecting composite parts
 Knowledge of composite manufacturing processes
 Application Process 
 Screening
 Initial Interview
 On-site Task
 Final Interview
 Working at ICEYE 
 At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win.
 How We Work (Our Values) 
 Make the impossible possible : We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way.
 Be curious : Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions.
 See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others.
 Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions.
 Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift.
 Have fun : What we do matters—and it should be enjoyable. …

 Who are we? 
 Here at Siemens Grid Software, our mission is to accelerate and secure the energy transition in a sustainable and profitable way. And for that we need you! We are paving the way for autonomous grid management empowering grid operators to accelerate their digital transformation easier, faster, and at scale.
 By leaving behind traditional ways of tackling the net zero challenge and embracing the powerful capabilities of software and digital technology, we turn the complexity of grids into competitive advantage. No matter where power comes from or where it goes, we make sure it makes its way at every step.
 Find out how Siemens Grid Software is decoding the future of energy .
 Join our team, get inspired, and help us re-imagine the world! Transform the everyday with us! 
 We are seeking a Power Systems Consultant to develop models for power systems elements (such as conventional and renewable generating plants, voltage support devices, etc.), perform model validation, perform large-scale simulations of electrical transmission systems for clients such as power producers, independent system operators, and transmission providers to develop solutions for safe and reliable power system operations. Job responsibilities will include the application of power systems planning principles, simulation and analysis of power system steady state, dynamic, and transient behaviors, development of mathematical models for reliability assessment of electrical networks, and delivery of on-site technical consulting/training services.
 This is a remote position based in the Contiguous U.S. 
 You’ll make an impact as you: 
 Drive execution of your assignments, deliver quality results on time and within budget through regular status reporting to satisfy the needs of our customers. The assignments can include steady-state, dynamic and transient analyses of electrical power transmission systems, modeling of renewable and conventional generation facilities and other elements of power systems, relay protection modeling, microgrid studies etc.
 Create draft reports and presentations with study results for review by senior staff and managers.
 Demonstrate strong analytical and critical thinking skills with a growth mindset as you participate in training and mentoring opportunities.
 You’ll win us over by having the following qualifications: 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Electrical Engineering with a focus in Power and Energy Systems and practical experience in using advanced power system analysis tools.
 We will consider candidates with at least one year of relevant professional experience including engineering internships.
 Knowledge of transmission system planning or operations with experience analyzing power flow, transient stability, and/or electromagnetic transients.
 Advanced degree MAY be substituted for experience.
 Ability to travel 10%

 Knowledge of PSSE, PSLF, PowerWorld, TARA, PSCAD and/or Python is a plus.

Sqills, part of Siemens Mobility Business Unit Software, is a leading technology company focused on providing innovative solutions for the public transport industry. With a commitment to excellence, we are dedicated to improving the passenger experience and increasing the operational efficiency for our clients across the globe.
 We are operating a Software Development Center in Aveiro, targeting Intelligent Solutions for the future of Mobility. We want you to join our team in the capacity of: Rust Developer (m/f/d) .
 As a DevOps team, we determine travel options and calculate prices in milliseconds to ensure customers get from point A to point Z in the best way possible. We use Rust to keep our systems fast and reliable. The team consists of 8 people based across the Netherlands and Portugal. Our teams have the freedom to choose the languages and tools they work with. Currently, we run a Rust backend paired with a React frontend, deployed on Kubernetes. Source control and CI/CD is hosted on GitLab. We monitor production services using OpenTelemetry, New Relic, and PagerDuty. We value initiative and encourage you to use your freedom to refine our components, tooling, and overall ways of working across the company. Secure development, architecture, performance, and resiliency are the cornerstones common to the different teams. This ensures that our software will continue to meet and exceed expectations in the future. 
 What will you do? 
 Along with the rest of the DevOps teams, you work on the software used to find & book seats in trains and buses of major international brands. The work here is multifaceted: one moment you are deep in the code optimizing the processing of many asynchronous requests for a high availability/high performance component. The next moment, you are building a management (web) interface for configuring the pricing system. We are always looking to improve our code, with an emphasis on performance, reliability, and quality. We share all workloads within the team and try to make the best use of everyone's strengths.

 Experience with Rust, Java/Kotlin, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.

items.desc: A LIRE ATTENTIVEMENT AVANT DE POSTULER ⬇ 🏠 2 jours de télétravail / semaine - 📍 Lyon (03) - 🛠 Expérience de 5 ans minimum Vous êtes Data Scientist expérimenté.e et souhaitez travailler sur des problématiques qui combinent analyse statistique, traitement de données massives et industrialisation ? Nous recherchons un.e Data Scientist capable d’intervenir de bout en bout : de la compréhension du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production de traitements de données, avec un enjeu particulier autour de Python, PySpark et des données spatiales avec GeoPandas. Votre rôle Vous travaillerez directement avec les experts métiers pour comprendre leurs problématiques, identifier les données pertinentes et construire les traitements permettant d’y répondre. Concrètement, vous serez amené.e à : participer aux ateliers avec les experts métiers pour recueillir et préciser leurs besoins rechercher les données pertinentes et réaliser les analyses exploratoires concevoir et développer les traitements de données mener des études statistiques développer, lorsque le besoin le nécessite, des modèles de Machine Learning restituer vos analyses sous forme de rapports d’étude ou de tableaux de bord porter des codes d’expérimentation ou d’étude vers PySpark afin de permettre leur industrialisation. Vous contribuerez également à la veille sur les méthodes et outils de Data Science, ainsi qu’au partage des bonnes pratiques. Un rôle qui ne s’arrête pas à la modélisation Le poste comporte une dimension importante de cadrage et d’industrialisation. Vous pourrez intervenir directement auprès des métiers, sans participation systématique d’un Product Owner ou d’un Product Manager. Vous devrez donc être à l’aise pour recueillir un besoin, animer des ateliers et traduire les problématiques rencontrées en solutions data. Vous participerez également à la rédaction des documents de cadrage et pourrez proposer des architectures de traitements et des modèles de données destinés à la production. Profil candidat: Environnement technique Vous travaillerez principalement avec : Python - PySpark - Hadoop - PostgreSQL - Power BI - GitLab - GitLab CI/CD - Jira - Confluence Côté Python, l’environnement comprend notamment : Pandas - Polars - Scikit-learn -Matplotlib - XGBoost - Pandera - GeoPandas Les compétences indispensables pour cette mission Trois critères sont particulièrement importants : Une expérience confirmée en Data Science Vous justifiez de plus de 5 ans d’expérience en Data Science et avez déjà travaillé sur plusieurs dimensions du métier : recueil des besoins, analyse statistique, Machine Learning et traitement de données massives pouvant représenter plusieurs dizaines de millions de lignes. Une expertise Python avec une forte composante géospatiale Vous maîtrisez Python et ses principales librairies de Data Science. Une expérience concrète de GeoPandas et de traitements spatiaux lourds, portant sur plusieurs dizaines de millions de géométries, est indispensable. Vous avez également déjà développé des traitements avec PySpark. Une expérience de l’industrialisation Vous avez déjà industrialisé des traitements Data Science lourds et êtes capable de contribuer aux choix d’architecture concernant les traitements et les modèles de données. Cette expérience doit notamment concerner au moins l’un des types de données suivants : données spatiales, textuelles, séries temporelles ou graphes. Ce qui sera également apprécié Une expérience sur l’un ou plusieurs de ces sujets constituera un plus : modélisation Machine Learning appliquée aux séries temporelles données modélisées sous forme de graphes MLOps connaissance du secteur de l’énergie. Vous êtes également à l’aise pour présenter vos analyses de manière pédagogique, notamment à travers des tableaux de bord Power BI, et pour animer des groupes de travail autour des organisations et processus métiers. Si vous vous reconnaissez dans ce rôle et disposez notamment de l’expérience attendue en Data Science, Python/GeoPandas, PySpark et industrialisation de traitements lourds, échangeons sur la mission. Si vous êtes prêt.e à relever ce défi et à contribuer à des projets stimulants, n'hésitez pas à postuler dès maintenant ! 🚀

items.desc: Background The Organization for Security and Co-operation in Europe (OSCE) adopts a comprehensive approach to security, that encompasses politico-military, economic and environmental, and human aspects. It therefore addresses a wide range of security-related concerns, including arms control, confidence- and security-building measures, human rights, combating human trafficking, national minorities, democratization, policing strategies, counter-terrorism and economic and environmental activities. All 57 participating States enjoy equal status, and decisions are taken by consensus on a politically, but not legally binding basis. The OSCE Secretariat in Vienna assists the Chairpersonship in its activities, and provides operational and administrative support to the field operations and, as appropriate, to other institutions. The Conflict Prevention Centre (CPC) supports and co-ordinates the OSCE's activities in the field, providing analysis and policy advice to the Secretary General and the Chairpersonship, leading work on all aspects of the conflict cycle, and supporting the various formats dealing with protracted conflicts. The CPC also serves as the focal point in the Secretariat for co-ordinating and developing the OSCE's role in the politico-military dimension. Within the CPC, the FSC and Operations Support Service covers a broad variety of tasks, including operational planning for the set-up, reorganization and closure of field operations; analysis related to early warning, early action, conflict prevention, crisis management, conflict resolution, post-conflict rehabilitation and peacebuilding; identification of lessons and best practices; mediation support; operational liaison with other international organizations; and maintaining a Situation/Communications Room (SitRoom). The Operations Support Unit in CPC provides strategic and operational advice and analysis related to the conflict cycle, as well as planning and support on operational issues, with a special focus on field operations and field-based crisis response efforts. It identifies lessons and best practices to strengthen and innovate operational capacities and to preserve institutional memory in this area. For more detailed information on the structure and work of the Secretariat, please see: http://www.osce.org/secretariat Objective Of Assignment The OSCE is seeking an AI-Data Analyst to analyze whether historical patterns in open-source datasets available in the SitRoom database can be used for systematic, data-driven early warning. The CPC SitRoom database includes nearly one million curated open-source news articles and their potential for systematic conflict trend analysis remains unexplored. Duration Of Assignment The initial duration of the assignment is until 31 March 2027. Further extensions will be subject to financial and operational requirements. Tasks And Responsibilities Under the overall supervision of the Chief, Operations Support Unit, the consultant will be tasked with the following duties: Ingest, profile and process the full SitRoom open-source news database made available by the OSCE, ensuring that the full archive can be transformed into analysis-ready daily feature tables suitable for early-warning analysis; Apply and refine Machine Learning algorithms on the full SitRoom open-source dataset; Develop and test the case-specific indicator generation method, using pre-defined periods and/or rolling prominence analysis to identify terms, actors, places, themes or narratives that become unusually prominent in a given case; Re-run historical validation and back-testing on selected OSCE-relevant cases, subject to data availability, and document the performance, limitations and transferability of the model; Develop a working prototype application that can generate analyst-facing outputs, including a summary report or exportable results; Prepare user documentation, technical documentation and handover materials enabling OSCE staff to understand, test and further develop the prototype; Develop a forecasting model for early warning trend analysis based on the SitRoom OSINT database. Deliverables For more detailed information on the structure and work of the Secretariat, please see: http://www.osce.org/secretariat Necessary Qualifications First-level university degree in business analytics, data science, statistics, computer science, economics, political science, international relations, security studies, conflict studies or another relevant field; Demonstrated experience applying data analytics, statistical modelling and/or machine-learning methods to complex real-world datasets; Demonstrated experience with Python-based data analysis, including data processing, feature engineering, model development and visualization; Practical experience with Natural Language Processing (NLP) or text analytics, including one or more of the following: keyword-based feature extraction, topic modelling, sentiment analysis, named-entity recognition or …

items.desc: Description At Amazon we believe that every day is still day one. A day to take the first step, look forward to new challenges, and make your ideas come to life. That's the energy and passion behind Amazon, and today is your day to be part of it. The Process Improvement Specialist in Global Operational Excellence (GOX) owns the expansion of proven EU Operational Excellence solutions into new Amazon regions. You sit within the EU organisation and work hand in hand with regional Operations teams. You are the bridge that takes tools, mechanisms and data-driven solutions already delivering results in the EU, then adapts, extends and rolls them out across a new network. Your core loop is straightforward: understand what the region needs, partner with technology teams to expand the solution to meet that need, then support the local ACES team in rolling it out on the ground. You will listen to operators and leaders to surface real problems, translate those needs into clear requirements for tech partners, and enable local teams to adopt the solution and sustain it without constant central support. Stakeholder management is the largest part of this job. Analytics is the backbone. You will mine and interpret large-scale operational datasets to find where a region's gaps are, quantify the opportunity behind each solution, and validate through rigorous pre and post analysis that expanded tools actually move the metrics that matter. You will write SQL against large data warehouses (Andes/Redshift, Athena) and use visualisation tools (QuickSight, Tableau, Power BI) to make insights self-service for stakeholders, connecting systemic root causes to shop-floor impact and customer delivery outcomes. You are not expected to own production data engineering, but you should be comfortable pulling, transforming and analysing data independently, framing operational challenges as structured analytical problems, and holding deep technical conversations with engineering and analytics partners. We are looking for a process improvement leader who enjoys operational analytics and cross-region collaboration, and who can turn a good idea in one geography into a scaled, sustained, data-backed capability in another. You want to find out what a region does not know yet, equip its stakeholders and ACES teams with the right solutions, and make adoption last beyond launch. Please note: this role is based in the EU and can be located at any EU node. It requires up to 35% travel, primarily within the EU, with occasional travel to partner regions to support rollouts and stakeholder engagement. Key job responsibilities Act as the primary bridge between EU GOX solutions and regional Operations teams, owning the end-to-end expansion of EU tools and mechanisms into a new network. Engage deeply with regional Ops stakeholders at all levels to understand their needs, pain points and priorities, and translate them into a clear, data-backed solution roadmap. Perform data mining and analysis across multiple systems (Redshift, Athena and other warehouses) to identify the region's gaps, quantify the opportunity, and prioritize which EU solutions to expand. Write advanced SQL (window functions, CTEs, query optimization) to perform root cause analysis and connect systemic issues to shop-floor and customer delivery impact. Build and maintain dashboards and self-service analytical tools (QuickSight, automated reports) that let regional stakeholders detect problems ahead of customer impact. Develop assessments, readouts and reports that communicate rollout progress, adoption and quantified business impact to regional and EU senior leadership. Identify and manage the risks, dependencies and cross-region differences (regulatory, network, systems) that affect successful adoption. Build a repeatable, data-backed playbook for expanding EU solutions into new regions that scales to additional workstreams over time About The Team The Global Operational Excellence (GOX) team drives operational improvements across Amazon's EU fulfillment network and beyond, working at the intersection of technology and operations to optimize how inventory is placed, moved and delivered. GOX builds the standards, tools and daily management mechanisms that turn performance into a managed system rather than a daily fire-fight. This role extends solutions proven in the EU into new regions, equipping local Operations teams to deliver flawless fulfillment: on time, at speed and at the lowest cost. Basic Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Math, Engineering, Science or Business Preferred Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification in Engineering, Supply Chain, Economics or Business Administration Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. …

items.desc: Des de Commonsense seleccionem un/a Analista de mercat energètics per Bassols Energia, empresa del sector energètic de la província de Girona. La teva missió: La teva missió serà contribuir a optimitzar la posició de la cartera als mercats energètics, a través de l'anàlisi quantitativa de dades, preus i tendències de mercat, participant en la definició de les estratègies de compra i pricing. Les teves responsabilitats Fer el seguiment diari dels mercats energètics i analitzar-ne l'evolució. Gestionar les previsions de consum i les ordres de compra als mercats. Analitzar dades, preus i tendències per a la definició de pricing i estratègies de compra. Participar en l'anàlisi dels mercats futurs i en la gestió de la posició energètica. Analitzar la cartera de clients i les seves necessitats energètiques futures. Participar en l'elaboració i actualització del compte de resultats i reporting del departament. Col·laborar amb diferents interlocutors interns i externs, com brokers, empreses de software i altres agents del sector. Participar en la revisió i millora dels models, eines i processos d'anàlisi. Què oferim? Incorporació a un projecte estable i amb recorregut dins del sector energètic. Treball presencial a la província de Girona, amb 1 dia de teletreball a la setmana i possibilitat de valorar-ne un segon en funció de la situació. Horari de dilluns a dijous amb flexibilitat d'entrada i sortida, dins d'una jornada de 8:00 a 17:00 h, amb 45 minuts per dinar. Divendres amb jornada intensiva de 8 a 15 h. Jornada intensiva de 8:00 a 15:00 h durant el període d'estiu (del 15 de juny al 15 de setembre). Un entorn de treball proper, amb molt bon ambient i treball en equip. Formació interna i externa continuada, amb possibilitat de realitzar formacions especialitzades en el sector. Descomptes especials en la tarifa elèctrica. Possibilitats de creixement i especialització dins del negoci energètic. Si ets una persona molt analítica, t'agrada treballar amb dades i vols desenvolupar la teva carrera en un sector amb futur, ens agradarà conèixer-te! Què busquem? Busquem una persona amb una elevada capacitat analítica, inquietud per entendre els mercats i les dades i ganes de desenvolupar-se dins del sector energètic. Formació en Enginyeria, especialment en l'àmbit de l'energia, tot i que també valorarem perfils de Matemàtiques, Física, Economia, Estadística o altres disciplines. Experiència professional en àrees com energia, pricing, controlling, finances, anàlisi de dades o similars. Capacitat d'anàlisi i facilitat per treballar amb grans volums de dades. Domini d'Excel i facilitat per treballar amb eines d'anàlisi i bon nivell d'anglès. Pensament crític, capacitat de resolució i orientació a la millora contínua i la innovació. Capacitat per treballar de manera autònoma i, alhora, clara orientació al treball en equip. Es valorarà el coneixement del mercat elèctric i dels seus principals agents.

Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. As part of the Ligand Discovery department, you will join a multidisciplinary team developing next-generation antibody-based affinity ligands for the purification of biologics. In this role, you will apply your expertise in protein engineering, molecular biology and biochemistry to develop and characterize antibody fragments with defined binding properties. Working closely with colleagues across R&D, you will design, execute and interpret experiments that contribute to the development of innovative affinity ligands. In addition, you will take ownership of defined scientific workstreams, identify technical challenges, propose practical solutions, and contribute to project discussions and scientific decision-making. You will contribute to the development of new products from early discovery through development while working in a collaborative and innovative environment. Apply computational protein engineering, structural modeling, bioinformatics, and AI-enabled software tools to support ligand design and optimization. Screen and characterize antibody fragments using protein-display technologies such as phage display or yeast display. Analyze and integrate large experimental, sequence, and screening datasets to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and guide iterative engineering cycles Contribute to project planning, coordinate experimental activities, and track progress within assigned workstreams. Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across R&D. Share knowledge and support colleagues and junior team members where appropriate. Stay informed about scientific and technological developments and evaluate new approaches that can strengthen our antibody-engineering platform. REQUIREMENTS: Minimum Requirements / Qualifications: MSc or PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry or a related life-sciences discipline. BSc candidates with extensive experience in antibody engineering may also be considered. Relevant experience in protein engineering, preferably within the biotechnology industry or applied academic research. Experience independently planning, executing and interpreting scientific experiments. Strong attention to detail and commitment to laboratory safety protocols Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive, hands-on approach. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Molecular cloning and protein expression in microbial expression systems. Proficiency with data analysis software and statistical tools Immunological assays, such as ELISA. Experience with with automated liquid handling systems and high-throughput workflows. Experience with protein purification using FPLC.

items.desc: IQM is a global leader in superconducting quantum computing. We design and build full-stack quantum computers and provide both on-premises systems and cloud access to our technology worldwide. Our customers include leading high-performance computing centers, research institutions, universities, and enterprises who rely on IQM’s integrated hardware and software solutions. Today, IQM has over 300 employees across offices in Finland, Germany, France, Spain, Poland, South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Taiwan, and the US. (www.meetiqm.com). At IQM, we are pioneering the next generation of quantum computers. Our experimental and theoretical teams work hand-in-hand, allowing us to extract maximum value from our unique, large-scale quantum hardware. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a Quantum Error Correction Experimentation Engineer to join our QEC team . In this role, you will contribute to the implementation, execution, and analysis of quantum error correction (QEC) experiments on superconducting quantum processors . Your work will help demonstrate and improve QEC capabilities on real hardware and directly support IQM’s roadmap toward scalable, fault-tolerant quantum computing . This role combines experimental quantum computing, error modelling, and software development , offering the opportunity to work at the intersection of quantum hardware and software while contributing to key technical decisions that shape the future of our quantum computers. What will you be doing? Working across a diverse range of food systems, you will generate scientific insights, validate product performance, and translate complex data into meaningful recommendations for colleagues and customers. This is an exciting opportunity to collaborate with global RD&A teams across Europe and APMEA while contributing to innovative technologies that help customers deliver safer, more sustainable food products. Key responsibilities Design, manage, and execute microbiological studies across a variety of food applications. Conduct antimicrobial screening, microbial challenge studies, and shelf-life evaluations. Validate the effectiveness of Kerry's clean-label and conventional food protection solutions. Analyse experimental data and convert findings into clear, actionable recommendations and value propositions. Benchmark Kerry technologies against competitive solutions. Coordinate external challenge studies, including planning, material management, data analysis, and reporting. Present scientific findings to customers and internal stakeholders, including RD&A, Business Development, Product Management, and Sales teams. Collaborate closely with international RD&A colleagues to strengthen Kerry's expertise in food safety and preservation. Qualifications and skills MSc or PhD in Food Microbiology, Food Safety, or a related scientific discipline. Experience in food microbiology, preservation, food safety, or related research environments. Strong understanding of spoilage organisms, pathogens, and factors influencing microbial growth. Experience designing and interpreting scientific studies and experimental data. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences. A collaborative mindset and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously. Fluency in English; additional languages would be advantageous.

items.desc: Présentation INRAE L’Institut national de recherche pour l’agriculture, l’alimentation et l’environnement (INRAE) est un établissement public de recherche rassemblant une communauté de travail de 12 000 personnes, avec 272 unités de recherche, de service et expérimentales, implantées dans 18 centres sur toute la France. INRAE se positionne parmi les tout premiers leaders mondiaux en sciences agricoles et alimentaires, en sciences du végétal et de l’animal. Ses recherches visent à construire des solutions pour des agricultures multi-performantes, une alimentation de qualité et une gestion durable des ressources et des écosystèmes. Environnement de travail, missions et activités Contexte scientifique et objectifs du postdoc La démographie est essentielle pour comprendre comment des organismes longévifs comme les arbres répondent au changement climatique. Les populations d’arbres intègrent les effets du climat sur un cycle de vie long et complexe, de la production de graines et l’installation jusqu’à des décennies de croissance et de survie, et leur dynamique est fortement contrôlée par la compétition asymétrique pour la lumière. Évaluer comment la fitness varie avec le climat demande donc d’intégrer l’ensemble du cycle démographique et de tenir compte de la densité-dépendance. Ce cycle complexe rend aussi leur réponse lente et décalée dans le temps : les adultes peuvent persister longtemps après que les conditions sont devenues défavorables. Évaluer l’impact du changement climatique sur les populations d’arbres demande de relier les effets du climat sur chaque taux vital à la dynamique des populations, plutôt que de s’appuyer sur des taux démographiques isolés. Des compensations démographiques entre taux vitaux peuvent en effet atténuer l’effet d’un taux donné à l’échelle de la population (Yang et al. 2022 Ecol Lett). La contribution des différents taux vitaux et stades de vie à la performance des populations peut aussi différer fortement (Schultz et al. 2022 Ecol Lett) et varier le long de l’aire climatique des espèces. La démographie est tout aussi centrale pour comprendre comment l’adaptation locale influence les réponses des arbres au climat. Chez les arbres, l’adaptation locale est généralement mise en évidence sur une seule partie du cycle de vie, comme la survie ou la croissance des semis en jardin commun, ou la croissance radiale des adultes en dendrochronologie. Ses conséquences pour la persistance des populations dépendent de la façon dont cette partie s’intègre dans l’ensemble du cycle de vie et de son poids dans la croissance de la population. Alors, que les sécheresses et canicules sont récemment devenue des facteurs majeur de mortalité des arbres en Europe (Senf et al. 2020 Nat Commun), évaluer la réponse démographique des essences et leur adaptation locale sur l’ensemble de leur cycle de vie est une question centrale pour les gestionnaires. Jusqu’ici, les données d’inventaire utilisées pour calibrer les modèles démographiques couvraient peu d’épisodes de sécheresse extrême. Les campagnes répétées des inventaires forestiers nationaux (IFN) européens incluent désormais les événements climatiques extrêmes récentes, ce qui permet de quantifier leurs conséquences démographiques à l’échelle du continent. L’objectif de ce postdoc est de construire une représentation cohérente du cycle démographique des arbres avec le modèle de dynamique forestière Matreex, en améliorant la façon dont le modèle représente les effets du climat et des extrêmes climatiques sur la mortalité et la régénération. Matreex est un modèle de projection intégrale structuré en taille, densité-dépendant et multi-espèces, ajusté sur les données des IFN européens et développé sous forme de package R à INRAE Grenoble (Kunstler et al. 2021 J Ecol ; Guyennon et al. 2023 Glob Ecol Biogeogr ; Jaunatre et al. 2026 JOSS). Le ou la postdoc recalibrera le modèle avec les données IFN récentes et améliorera son module de régénération. Le modèle servira ensuite de base pour comprendre les réponses des populations au changement climatique, identifier les paramètres démographiques les plus sensibles et évaluer leurs liens avec l’adaptation locale. Le poste s’inscrit dans le projet MALADAP-TREE (PEPR FORESTT), qui évalue le risque de maladaptation au changement climatique des cinq principales essences de montagne en France (hêtre, sapin pectiné, épicéa commun, pin sylvestre, mélèze d’Europe) en combinant démographie, dendroécologie, jardins communs et génomique. Objectifs Scientifiques et Hypothèses L’objectif Principal Est D’améliorer La Façon Dont Matreex Rend Compte Des Effets Du Climat Sur La Mortalité Et La Régénération, à Partir De Données IFN Récentes Couvrant Les Derniers Extrêmes Climatiques Et De Données Plus Détaillées Sur La Régénération. Les Principales Tâches Du Ou De La Postdoc Sont Mettre à jour et harmoniser les données de calibration avec les campagnes répétées récentes des IFN européens (France, Espagne, Allemagne, Suisse, Suède, …

The team develops technologies and products that solve complex real-world challenges across diverse markets, including environmental sensing, semiconductor manufacturing and industrial equipment. Working
items.desc: Company Description TTP is an employee-owned technology and product development consultancy, with a 40-year track record of helping ambitious clients solve complex technical challenges and bring innovative, commercially successful solutions to market. We invent, design, and manufacture impactful products and technologies across a wide range of industries – including healthcare, life science, energy, and communications – and at the intersection of biology, physical science and engineering. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Job Description We’re looking for an Applied Mathematician or Analytical Physicist with strong analytical instincts, physical intuition and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving to join our Industrials team. The team develops technologies and products that solve complex real-world challenges across diverse markets, including environmental sensing, semiconductor manufacturing and industrial equipment. Working across multiple disciplines, we combine scientific analysis, physical modelling and engineering to understand problems at a fundamental level and turn that understanding into better products and technologies. As an Applied Mathematician at TTP, you’ll get to the heart of complex challenges, identify the underlying physical processes and translate them into mathematical models that help guide the way forward. You’ll use first-principles reasoning to challenge assumptions, identify the effects that really matter and make sense of complexity through well-judged simplifications. The variety is a big part of what makes the role exciting. You could be modelling multiphase flows in complex systems, simulating cutting-edge optoelectronic and photonic technologies, or exploring the feasibility of a novel process and helping guide the scale-up of a prototype design. Each project brings a different challenge, so you’ll need to switch context efficiently, get up to speed quickly in unfamiliar fields and manage several projects in parallel. Your work will span a broad range of modelling approaches, from analytical calculations and simplified models using MATLAB or custom Python code to detailed numerical simulations, including 3D multiphysics modelling and computational fluid dynamics using tools such as COMSOL. Projects may progress from simple analytical models to more sophisticated simulations. We value insight and sound judgement as much as analytical rigour. Working at pace, often with incomplete information, you’ll need to know when to investigate further and when a sufficiently good model is enough to make a decision. You’ll also be able to communicate your findings clearly, explaining the implications and uncertainties of your analysis to colleagues and clients, and turning complex results into practical recommendations. With great facilities, bright and collaborative colleagues and the freedom to innovate, your future at TTP is what you make it. We value ambition, leadership and technical excellence, and provide a fantastic environment in which to develop your career. Qualifications We’re looking for an analytical, curious problem-solver who enjoys applying mathematics and physical intuition to complex, real-world challenges. You’ll Ideally Bring A PhD in applied mathematics, physics or a related discipline. Excellent mathematical reasoning, with the ability to translate real-world problems into mathematical models from first principles. Experience developing and using computational models and simulations of physical systems, from simplified analytical approaches to more detailed numerical models. Experience with tools such as MATLAB and/or COMSOL, alongside programming skills in Python or another relevant language to develop your own models and analysis tools. The ability to quickly understand unfamiliar technical problems, identify the key physical processes and adapt your approach across different scientific and engineering domains. A pragmatic approach to analysis, balancing mathematical rigour with the need to reach useful conclusions and make decisions at pace. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis clearly and translate results into actionable insights for multidisciplinary teams and clients. Additional Information Benefits TTP is an employee-owned business, based at TTP Campus in Melbourn, just 10 miles south of Cambridge. Our purpose-built, sustainable offices and laboratories are set in green surroundings, creating an inspiring environment for innovation. Our working culture encourages entrepreneurship, shared ideas and technical collaboration, while providing you with the freedom to do your best work. Our employee benefits include: Annual profit-related bonus 25 days holiday Employer pension contribution of 10% of salary Free, nutritious lunch in our on-site restaurant Private medical insurance for employees …

items.desc: Institutionen för medicinsk biokemi och mikrobiologi (IMBIM) vid Uppsala universitet utgör en bred internationell miljö för forskning och undervisning. Vid IMBIM bedrivs grundforskning inom biokemi, cell- och molekylärbiologi, tumörbiologi, jämförande genetik, funktionell genomik, immunologi, bakteriologi, och virologi. Institutionens forskning är huvudsakligen grundläggande, men har i sin tillämpning tydlig koppling och betydelse för hälsa och sjukdom hos såväl djur som människor. En närmare beskrivning finns på Forskning – Institutionen för medicinsk biokemi och mikrobiologi – Uppsala universitet. Forskargruppen Medical Inflammation Research (MIR), under ledning av professor Rikard Holmdahl vid Institutionen för medicinsk biokemi och mikrobiologi (IMBIM), Uppsala universitet, bedriver forskning med målet att förbättra människors hälsa genom att identifiera regulatoriska mekanismer vid autoimmuna sjukdomar. Som en del av denna forskning har flera viktiga genetiska polymorfismer som är förknippade med autoimmuna sjukdomar identifierats i experimentella djurmodeller, och unika musstammar har utvecklats. Vi söker en erfaren forskare som ska leda och samordna projekt med fokus på att driva forskning, utveckling och validering av humaniserade musmodeller. Du kommer att få möjlighet att samarbeta med ledande experter, arbeta med avancerade forskningsresurser och bidra till nya vetenskapliga upptäckter som kan bidra till framtida behandlingar av autoimmuna sjukdomar. Arbetsuppgifter Du kommer att arbeta med att samla in och sammanställa befintlig vetenskaplig evidens samt generera nya data för att karakterisera den humaniserade musmodellen för viktiga aktörer inom reumatologisk forskning. Arbetet omfattar även att undersöka modellens bredare användningsområden inom andra forskningsområden samt att ansvara för och administrera djurmodellplattformen för andra forskare. Du kommer att leda planering, genomförande och rapportering av in vivo- och in vitro-experiment för att karakterisera och validera humaniserade musstammar. Modellerna ska användas för att utvärdera effekten av potentiella immunterapier och generera mekanistisk kunskap om behandlingar riktade mot autoimmuna sjukdomar och andra tillstånd. Arbetet syftar även till att besvara centrala vetenskapliga frågeställningar som kan bidra till utvecklingen av framtida behandlingar av autoimmuna sjukdomar. Arbetet omfattar immunologisk forskning, inklusive in vivo-experiment, immunologiska analyser, flödescytometri och expressionsanalyser. I rollen ingår även att utveckla experimentella projektförslag för andra användare av plattformen, med målet att attrahera nya forskningssamarbeten, vetenskapligt intresse och externa finansieringsmöjligheter. Du förväntas också bidra till vetenskapliga publikationer samt delta i handledning av masterstudenter och undervisning. Kvalifikationer Doktorsexamen inom biokemi, bioteknik, immunologi eller närliggande område eller en utländsk examen som bedöms motsvara en doktorsexamen. Behörighetskravet ska vara uppfyllt senast vid tidpunkten för beslut om anställning. Flerårig erfarenhet av arbete med djurmodeller. Relevant avancerad forskningserfarenhet av hantering och avel av möss, genotypning och in vivoexperimentella studier, inklusive kirurgiska ingrepp, samt erfarenhet av sjukdomsmodeller och laboratoriearbete inom cellbiologi. Goda kunskaper inom genetik, immunologi och biokemi. Erfarenhet av biostatistisk analys, flödescytometri, antikroppsbaserade immunologiska analyser samt in vivo-modeller för autoimmuna sjukdomar. Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Proactive and self-motivated, with the ability to work independently and use initiative. Attention to detail and a methodical approach to work. Adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing business and customer requirements. items.desc: Acadian Asset Management is a global, systematic investment manager at the forefront of data-driven investing since 1986. Headquartered in Boston, with locations in Singapore, London, and Sydney, we manage over $232 billion on behalf of leading institutions worldwide—including pension funds, endowments, foundations, and sovereign wealth funds. We harness advanced technology, rich datasets, and multidisciplinary expertise to help clients navigate complex markets and uncover insights that may be overlooked by traditional approaches. What sets Acadian apart is our people. We foster a collaborative, intellectually curious environment where ideas are tested, diverse perspectives are welcomed, and innovation thrives. We’re united by a shared purpose: delivering effective client outcomes and supporting one another in work that’s both challenging and rewarding. We offer a flexible hybrid work environment, strong benefits, and a casual but focused office culture—all designed to support the meaningful, collaborative work that defines Acadian. Position Overview We are seeking an ESG Quant Analyst - Stewardship Specialist to join the Responsible Investing team in London. Unlike a traditional stewardship role, this position sits within a quantitative investment environment and will help drive Acadian's ESG research by combining direct company engagements with the development of scalable research tools and datasets. The ideal candidate will be intellectually curious, highly analytical, and equally enjoy working with large datasets as engaging with company management teams. They will thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and be excited by the opportunity to apply AI techniques. Acadian supports a hybrid work environment; employees are on-site in the London office 3 days a week. What You'll Do Coordinate and lead engagement activities with investee companies across assigned regions, incorporate client-specific stewardship priorities, monitor controversies, and speak directly to companies. Capture company intelligence through engagements, support quantitative ESG assessments of portfolio holdings, maintain engagement records and databases, and produce high-quality case studies, quarterly updates, and stewardship reporting for both internal and external audiences. Share engagement insights regularly with portfolio managers, researchers and sustainability specialists to support the development of proprietary signals, analytics, and spur new ESG research ideas. Leverage Python and AI tools to acquire, clean, transform, and analyse large structured and unstructured datasets and contribute to the development of AI-enabled stewardship tools. We’re Looking For Teammates With Bachelor's degree with 1-2 years of experience on the buy-side or sell-side. Demonstrated aptitude for programming (Python and SQL), conducting exploratory data analysis, and extracting insights from large datasets. Experience with generative AI tools including OpenAI and Claude code. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical concepts into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences. Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones. A demonstrated commitment to continuous learning, including a willingness to pursue relevant professional qualifications such as the CFA Sustainable Investing Certificate. To apply for this position or view Acadian’s open roles, please visit the Careers section of our website at: https://www.acadian-asset.com/careers/open-positions. We will contact only selected candidates. If you are a candidate with a disability, or are assisting a candidate with a disability, and require an accommodation to apply for one of our jobs, please email us at recruiting@acadian-asset.com. items.desc: At a glance Based on our purpose 'Banking for better, for generations to come', we are committed to a sustainable, stable and secure financial system. Detecting financial crime is therefore high on our agenda. This is not new to you, because you follow the news, are broadly interested and socially involved. You want the right thing for customers, society and the bank. That's what you go for! The Financial Economic Crime (FEC) Data Domain is responsible for enabling & accelerating DFC processes through high quality Data Products. We work on data onboarding, data modelling, data quality to translate data towards business value. Our aim is to work towards a centralized, rationalized, high quality data landscape to facilitate the wide range of DFC processes. Your job As a Business Consultant in the Data Product Team within the FEC Data Domain, you will play a pivotal role in delivering end-to-end data solutions to generate value for DFC and data consumers across the organization. We are looking for someone who can combine data management expertise with curiosity, analytical thinking and strong communication skills. The role requires a person who is comfortable diving into details, understanding complex data landscapes, asking critical questions and helping bridge the gap between business and technology. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Understanding the data needs and related requirements of new regulatory requirements and build Data Products to meet those. Help to understand and implement how data used and generated by GenAI solutions, can be captured in consumable data products. Collaborating with 1st and 2nd line parties, Data Scientists and on- and offshore IT Engineers to develop data solutions within cross-functional teams. These solutions should create business value and align with ABN AMRO’s and DFC’s overarching priorities. Promoting and embedding the FEC Data Domains Mission and Vision across relevant stakeholder groups. Lead data onboarding & data modeling and monitor & improve data quality. Working environment The FEC Data Domain is responsible for developing and managing data solutions while enabling use cases in the field of Detecting Financial Crime. As the data owner for all DFC-related processes, the team is accountable for Data Modeling, Data Engineering, Data Quality and all Data Management activities. Next to various stakeholders that are consuming our Data Products, you will work closely with a highly skilled team of Data Consultants, Data Engineers, Data Architects and the Data Product Owner of the FEC Data Domain, both onshore and offshore. Collaboration is key, as many teams are involved in managing data effectively. As an employee within DFC, you will join a dynamic, developing environment where we work together toward a shared vision and objectives. You’ll play an active role in building a new department and have the freedom to bring out the best in yourself alongside enthusiastic colleagues. At DFC, personal and professional growth is highly valued. Your profile You hold an HBO/WO Master’s degree. 2-5 years of relevant work experience, preferably within financial services or consultancy. You possess strong analytical skills, allowing you to quickly grasp complex topics and identify connections. You have experience with collaboration and managing/coordinating data projects. Experience with data modeling is a plus. Experience with Databricks or equivalent is a plus. Basic understanding of Data Management principles is a plus. You demonstrate “data savviness” and are capable of performing queries and analyzing data independently. You have a natural curiosity to understand the business context behind data requirements. You embrace the Agile way of working and are comfortable with the Scrum methodology. We are offering We believe it is important to be a good employer. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36-hour work week, including holiday allowanceand a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. An annual public transport pass with free public transportation throughout the Netherlands for both business and private use. You can find more information …
