items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

items.desc: Cloud Data Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN) , headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following position in the Department of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as soon as possible: Cloud Data Infrastructure Engineer (m/f/d) (Part-Time: 25%) Location: Frankfurt Employment scope: 25% Part-Time Type of contract: Fixed Term Contract for 1 year Remuneration: Collective agreement of the state Hesse (TV-H) / E13 The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level. The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine. The position is within the Geobiodiversity Information and Data Management team of the Senckenberg Data and Modelling Center (SDMC) and contributes to a project funded by the European Union, TETTRIX – TETTRIs neXt level for the taxonomy of tomorrow . The team works at the interface of biodiversity informatics, ecological modelling, and data management, focusing on integrating, analysing, and making biodiversity data accessible for research and conservation. The TETTRIX project aims to strengthen taxonomic capacity for biodiversity research by developing, validating, and scaling innovative tools, workflows, services, and training pathways, while addressing critical knowledge and capacity gaps across Europe. Within the TETTRIX project, the position will contribute to and consult on developing a web-based open-access tool on Species Distribution Modelling (SDM) for reproducible data and modelling workflows and transform biodiversity data into actionable knowledge for biodiversity monitoring and conservation. Your tasks Design and implement the data infrastructure of the Open Modular SDM Platform: a columnar lakehouse (Parquet, DuckDB, Dask on AWS Batch) over the full GBIF corpus (~3.9 billion occurrence records) and OBIS (~207 million records). Architect and operate the hybrid setup with the AWS side (S3 data lake, elastic batch compute, optional GPU profile), working with the institute’s internal serving layer (PostgreSQL/PostGIS, tiles, API) in cooperation with central IT. Build the batch pipelines: monthly full-corpus rebuild, per-species extraction and SDM training jobs; workflow orchestration (Nextflow/Snakemake), containerisation. Build an H3-based aggregation and map-tile generation pipeline. Manage cloud costs, infrastructure documentation and handover. Advise the project team on infrastructure and hosting decisions. Your profile Several years of professional experience designing and operating cloud data platforms (AWS: S3, Batch, Spot Instances; infrastructure as code). Hands-on experience with columnar / lakehouse technologies (Parquet, DuckDB, Spark or Dask) on datasets in the billion-record range. Strong PostgreSQL, including PostGIS. Experience with large-scale geospatial processing: spatial indexing (e.g. H3 hexagonal grids) and map-tile pipelines. Experience working with biodiversity occurrence data (GBIF, OBIS) and environmental layers (e.g. Bio-ORACLE). Knowledge of Python, Docker, Git/CI. Very good command of English. Desirable skills Familiarity with species distribution modelling and associated statistical/machine-learning approaches (e.g. GLM/GAM, MaxEnt, Random Forest). A track record in reproducible scientific computing or open-source projects. We offer access to an international network of scientists, policymakers and research organizations an attractive job within the inspired and dynamic working environment of an internationally recognized research institution flexible working hours – mobile working options – employee ID card with free admission to Senckenberg museums – annual special payment – collectively agreed vacation entitlement – company pension plan Senckenberg is committed to diversity. This role is ideal for a quality professional with strong attention to detail who excels in procedural execution and compliance. Support continuous improvement initiatives through data collection and execution of defined actions. Quality System & Compliance Support the Quality Management System in accordance with ISO 9001 and, where applicable, ISO 13485 and ISO17025. Job Summary As a result of our continued growth, we're hiring Domain Consultant / Solutions Engineer at Idira [CyberArk], to support our team in Germany. You will be at the forefront of demonstrating the value of our identity security solutions to both prospective and existing Enterprise customers. In this role, you will showcase how Idira [CyberArk] secures critical assets across hybrid cloud environments, distributed workforces, and emerging AI-driven workloads through product demos, presentations, and Proof of Concepts (POCs). You will leverage your technical expertise and sales acumen to guide clients through the technology evaluation phase. Working closely with the sales team, you will act as the primary technical resource, serving as the key technical advisor and advocate for Idira’s solutions, ensuring that clients understand the business, technical, and compliance benefits. Success in this role depends on clearly communicating complex technical concepts to both business and technical stakeholders. You thrive in a dynamic environment and continuously develop your skills as the complexity of our work steadily increases. In this challenging and hands-on role, you will work on a wide range of robot automation solutions for customers as well as internal cell and experimental setups. You will be responsible for a broad spectrum of tasks. Your focus will be on the basic CAD design, procurement and manufacturing (e.g., 3D printing) of system components, mechanical/pneumatic assembly, and electrical installation of robot cells or laboratory setups. Furthermore, you will be responsible for the smooth operation of our laboratory facilities by performing regular maintenance regarding functionality and safety, managing warehouse logistics, and handling organizational tasks such as shipping, procurement, inventory management, and purchasing. By taking on these important daily responsibilities, you will make a significant contribution to the team's success. How your work moves the mission forward Working closely with mechanical engineers, product managers, software developers and researchers to design, maintain and refine our automation systems for electronic manufacturing from the ground up. Manufacturing mechanical and electrical assemblies for fast, innovative R&D robot automation cells. This includes visualizing concepts, creating CAD designs, and producing prototypes. Perform electrical tests and troubleshoot faults in existing automation cells. Manage daily laboratory maintenance, warehouse logistics and hardware-related office tasks (shipping, procurement, inventory and purchasing) to create a highly efficient working environment. Independent and timely completion of projects Reading and executing hardware specifications and circuit diagrams for assembling and wiring industrial control cabinets, robot peripherals, and HMI/PLC hardware Procurement and integration of best-in-class technology products into automation work cells Document and communicate your work clearly and understandably to internal stakeholders. Representation of the local laboratory manager in their absence. Role: Field Service Engineer - Electron Microscopy Location: Cork, Limerick and Dublin How will you make an impact? Do you want to join a company known as a fast paced global leader in serving science? Are you passionate about making a difference and providing professional service for high-tech equipment? This is a great opportunity to work in a global company dedicated to improving the human condition and advancing research in industry. Typically requires a BEng or preferably a MEng degree in Mechanical or Electronic Engineering or other applicable experience in a high-tech environment. Analytical trouble shooting and problem solving abilities Excellent hand-eye coordination and manual dexterity Excellent communication skills in English, verbal and written. Independent, service-minded individual who can converse with customers at a very all academic levels Highly organised, self-sufficient and motivated individual who is adept at administration Knowledge of Electron Microscopes is an advantage Clean Driving license required

The Lab Technician is responsible for contributing to the overall running of the Process Sciences Laboratory and working across site as part of a diverse and interdisciplinary team to build capability and knowledge in the manufacture of biologics . Requirements Primary Responsibilities: Support readiness and execution activities for end-to end process operations for scale down models for Fed Batch Manufacturing satellites, technical study support and analytical testing. Support equipment maintenance and cleaning, solution preparation and lab administration tasks to assist a team of scientists in daily delivery of experiments. Conduct all work activities with a strict adherence to the safety and compliance culture on site. Support the authoring of safety documentation, work instructions and standard operating procedures. Work as part of a dedicated laboratory team where flexibility and teamwork are a key requirement. This role is a site-based role and due to nature of the work in the Process Science Lab, some weekend work may be required. Preferred Experience and Skills: A Level 8 qualification in a science or engineering discipline desired. Level 7 with relevant experience will be considered. A minimum of 1-2 years’ experience in a relevant field. Strong understanding of GMP, regulatory expectations, data integrity, and quality systems relevant to laboratory and manufacturing support activities. Familiarity with lab operations and experience of lab administration is preferred. Understanding of Upstream and Downstream Unit Operations for biologics manufacturing and Analytical testing is preferred. Effective communicator with the ability to think logically and be proactive under pressure and work as part of a diverse cross-functional team.

Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. items.desc: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ABOUT THE ROLE: As part of the Network Software and Services for AI (nssAI) team at SpaceXSI, you'll build cutting-edge software, services, and frameworks to empower our Network Development Engineers. Working hands-on, you'll tackle all facets of network management—metric collection, configuration, zero-touch provisioning, monitoring, and auto-remediation—driving automation-first solutions for SpaceXSI's production and ancillary networks. Expect to develop extensible tools, streamline complex processes, and ensure rock-solid reliability to support SpaceXSI's mission of accelerating human scientific discovery through AI. RESPONSIBILITIES: Building software and tools with extensive metrics coverage for some of the world's largest GPU supercomputing network fabrics used for AI training and serving customer inference queries. Implement IaC best practices, enhancing deployment pipelines, and ensuring robust, secure service delivery across our production environments. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Deep experience collaborating with network engineers daily using extensive knowledge of network topologies, physical and logical, and network protocols. Expert knowledge and proven history with designing scalable and reliable software from the ground up that can build and orchestrate tens of thousands of network devices at lightning speeds. Ability to thrive in ambiguity, creating metrics that will help prioritize the focus of the team and your own. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: €80,000 - 150,000 EUR Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast. What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver. OUR CULTURE Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before. We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place. Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. items.desc: Over de functie Als Software Quality Engineer ben je de kritische blik binnen het Scrum-team. Je ontwikkelcollega’s kijken of iets werkt. Jij kijkt verder: welke edge cases zijn er, wat gebeurt er onder druk, en waar zitten de risico’s? Je test handmatig, voert stresstests uit en zoekt gericht naar fouten voordat de klant ze vindt. Voor testautomatisering wordt Playwright gebruikt. Jij zet automatische tests op, onderhoudt ze en breidt ze verder uit. Je houdt de CI/CD-pipelines en testresultaten in de gaten en denkt actief mee over de teststrategie, de scenario’s en de testdata. Er is veel ruimte om het testen slimmer en efficiënter te maken. Heb je een idee voor een nieuwe tool of aanpak? Dan krijg je de vrijheid om die uit te proberen. Dat geldt ook voor het inzetten van AI-tools om je werk te ondersteunen. Jouw kwaliteiten Je bent van nature nieuwsgierig en een beetje wantrouwig als het om software gaat, in de goede zin van het woord. Je ziet details die anderen missen, je wacht niet af maar verbetert processen uit jezelf, en je vindt het leuk om nieuwe tools uit te proberen. Wat je meebrengt: HBO- of WO-werk- en denkniveau Ervaring met testautomatisering, bij voorkeur met Playwright Kennis van C# / .NET en JavaScript Analytisch sterk, oog voor detail en proactief Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal Pré: ervaring met browser-testrecordingtools die naar Playwright exporteren Pré: kennis van E2E-testautomatisering voor mobiele applicaties De voordelen Goed werk verdient een goed pakket. Wat je krijgt: Salaris tussen €2.600 en €5.500 op basis van je kennis en ervaring 25 vakantiedagen Reiskostenvergoeding Goede pensioenregeling Flexibele werktijden Afwisselend thuiswerken en werken op kantoor 32 tot 40 uur per week Een afwisselende functie met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en groei Naast het werk is er volop aandacht voor gezelligheid. Met wekelijkse borrels, gevierde verjaardagen en regelmatig een uitje leer je je collega’s snel kennen, ook buiten de sprints om. Leer de organisatie kennen De tuinbouwsector is een van de meest innovatieve sectoren van Nederland. Achter de kassen draait een complexe organisatie van mensen, planning en processen. Om dat goed te regelen is software nodig die betrouwbaar werkt, elke dag weer. Deze organisatie ontwikkelt arbeidsregistratiesoftware voor tuinbouwbedrijven en werkt daarnaast aan moderne cloudoplossingen. Het is een organisatie waar de lijnen kort zijn en waar je elkaar kent. De teams voor development, customer support en sales werken nauw samen. Iedere twee weken laat het ontwikkelteam aan het hele bedrijf zien wat er is gebouwd. Zo weet iedereen waar de anderen mee bezig zijn en voelt het echt als één team. Je werkt op een mooi kantoor in het Westland en kunt afwisselend thuiswerken. Er is ruimte voor eigen initiatief en voor groei in je vakgebied. Ook naast het werk is er genoeg te doen: wekelijkse borrels, verjaardagen die gevierd worden en regelmatig een bedrijfsuitje. Klinkt goed? Ben jij geïnteresseerd in bovenstaand profiel? Good Company ziet graag jouw sollicitatie tegemoet! Solliciteer via onze website op de vacature van Software Quality Engineer.

Translate client, product, and operational needs into clear requirements, user stories, interfaces, and maintainable technical solutions. Create and maintain automated unit, integration, and system tests; support laboratory simulation, prototype integration, and equipment validation. Apply version control, configuration management, CI/CD, cybersecurity, observability, and quality practices appropriate to industrial and cloud software. Qualifications and experience Bachelor's or master's degree in software engineering, computer science, automation, cybernetics, or a related discipline. Understanding of object-oriented design, software architecture, testing, debugging, concurrency, interfaces, and reliable coding practices. items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 1.11.2026 Mulighet for hjemmekontor Delvis hjemmekontor Arbeidsspråk Norsk Sektor Privat Vil du bruke regulatorisk kompetanse og dataanalyse til å videreutvikle løsninger for bankenes myndighetsrapportering? I SpareBank 1 Utvikling søker vi nå en dataanalytiker med en kombinasjon av teknisk og regulatorisk kompetanser som vil være med på å modernisere og videreutvikle løsningene som brukes til myndighetsrapportering og kapitalberegning i SpareBank 1-bankene. Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å arbeide i skjæringspunktet mellom teknologi, data og komplekse forretningsbehov. Du vil få mulighet til å fordype deg i både bank- og risikodomenet, samtidig som du arbeider med datamodellering, store datamengder og moderne datateknologi. Om oss Du blir ansatt i Kredittrisikoområde og jobber i Team Risk. Teamet har ansvar for løsninger innen kapitalberegning og regulatorisk rapportering, blant annet COREP, FINREP og ORBOF. Vi står foran en omfattende modernisering. Eksisterende kode og løsninger skal videreutvikles og flyttes til en moderne dataplattform, samtidig som vi skal håndtere nye regulatoriske krav og utvikle fremtidens datamodeller. Du vil blant annet: analysere og strukturere krav til regulatorisk rapportering videreutvikle og modernisere kode og dataløsninger for sammenstilling av kredittrisikodata identifisere nødvendige datakilder og etablere gode koblinger mellom kildedata, forretningslogikk og rapporteringskrav utvikle og forvalte datamodeller for COREP-, FINREP- og ORBOF-rapportering bidra til implementering av nye regulatoriske krav og rapporteringstaksonomier utvikle og forbedre datakvalitetskontroller, analyser og avstemminger bidra til å dokumentere robuste og etterprøvbare dataleveranser samarbeide tett med regulatoriske spesialister, økonomi- og risikomiljøer i bankene og andre data engineers Hvem er du? Vi tror du vil trives i rollen hvis du liker å sette deg inn i komplekse problemstillinger, forstå hvordan data henger sammen og omsette krav til løsninger som fungerer i praksis. Vi ser etter deg som har: erfaring med eller kjennskap til regulatorisk rapportering for banker – COREP, FINREP, ORBOF Kjennskap til regulatoriske krav for banker (CRR3, IFRS9), EBA-taksonomier, rapporteringsmaler og datadefinisjoner god kompetanse innen SQL og datamodellering erfaring med å analysere og bearbeide store datasett, samt evne til å forstå sammenhengen mellom kildedata, forretningsregler og rapporteringsbehov evne til å formidle tekniske problemstillinger, krav og testresultater til både tekniske og ikke-tekniske fagmiljøer relevant høyere utdanning, gjerne innen teknologi, økonomi, matematikk eller tilsvarende. Relevant erfaring kan kompensere for formell utdanning Det er en fordel om du har erfaring med eller kjennskap til ett eller flere av følgende områder: bankregnskap, utlån, kapitalberegning eller kredittrisiko bank, finans eller revisjon av regulatorisk rapportering Snowflake, dbt, Python, Git eller tilsvarende teknologier Men, hvorfor skal du velge oss? Her får du arbeide i en kombinasjon som ikke finnes så mange andre steder: moderne datateknologi, komplekse regulatoriske problemstillinger og løsninger som skal fungere på tvers av selvstendige banker. Vi kan tilby en spennende stilling med gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling. Du vil få jobbe med dyktige og ambisiøse kollegaer, og bli en del av et sterkt faglig miljø som jobber smidig og målrettet. Du får jobbe i fine lokaler i sentrum av Oslo, med innendørs sykkelparkering og nytt treningsrom med gruppetimer og garderober. Vi er selvsagt konkurransedyktige på lønn og har gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger. Vi har også sommertid, og flere fine firmahytter. Når det er sagt – vi hverken tror eller håper du velger oss kun på grunn av dette. Vi håper du vil jobbe hos oss fordi du verdsetter en arbeidsplass hvor samarbeid, kompetanse, deling og tillit danner grunnmuren i arbeidshverdagen. Slik blir vi bedre sammen! En del av noe større SpareBank 1 Utvikling gir personer, bedrifter og lokalsamfunn over hele landet trygghet, forutsigbarhet og nærhet til økonomien deres gjennom digitale løsninger som begeistrer. Vi er SpareBank 1-alliansens felles utviklingsselskap som gir bankene fart og styrke innen digital innovasjon og faglig tyngde på tvers av en rekke kritiske områder. Gjennom over 60 tverrfaglige team jobber vi tett sammen for å dele kunnskap og gjøre hverandre gode. Nysgjerrig? Dersom du ønsker å bli litt mer kjent med oss eller stillingen før du søker, eller hvis du har noen spørsmål, er du hjertelig velkommen til å ta kontakt med Karina Folvik, leder modernisering og videreutvikling, karina.folvik@sparebank1.no. Du kan også lære mer om hvem vi er og hvordan vi jobber på karrieresiden vår eller på LinkedIn, Instagram eller Medium. Hos oss er det enkelt å søke - du trenger bare å laste opp en CV og skrive noen ord om hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe hos oss. Vi ønsker å fortsette å representere …

items.desc: Fast stilling Heltid Oslo Søknadsfrist 05.11.2026 Arbeidsspråk Norsk Sektor Offentlig Utvikler for neste generasjons IMINT-plattform Etterretningstjenesten – Viten om verden for vern av Norge Etterretningstjenesten har som oppdrag å samle inn informasjon og varsle om forhold i utlandet som kan true Norge og norske interesser. Vi søker nå etter utviklere til vårt IMINT-miljø. Som medarbeider i Etterretningstjenesten vil du bidra i vårt viktige samfunnsoppdrag, samt være en del av et miljø kjennetegnet av høy kompetanse og sterkt engasjement for fagfeltet. IMINT (Imagery Intelligence) handler om å trekke kritiske observasjoner og analyser ut fra bilder. Her får du jobbe i skjæringspunktet mellom satellittbilder, maskinlæring og store datamengder. I vårt utviklerteam jobber vi med en moderne stack som inkluderer blant annet Angular, NodeJs, Postgres, RabbitMQ, Kubernetes, Python og GDAL, samt computer vision. For å møte økende behov og videreutvikle våre systemer, ser vi etter deg som enten er en sterk fullstack-utvikler, eller som har spisskompetanse og lidenskap for spesifikke deler av stacken. Vi tilbyr en spennende og variert hverdag i et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med gode utviklingsmuligheter. Vi oppfordrer både nyutdannede og erfarne utviklere til å søke. Vi er avhengige av mangfold i perspektiver og erfaringer for å løse våre oppdrag. Derfor ønsker vi å rekruttere medarbeidere fra ulike bakgrunner, med ulike livserfaringer til å jobbe hos oss. Kvinner oppfordres til å søke stillingen. Arbeidsoppgaver Hovedoppgaven din blir å utvikle og innovere systemene og verktøyene våre for bildeanalyse, som er helt avgjørende for våre IMINT-analytikere. Dette innebærer: Utvikling og videreutvikling av løsninger for prosessering og databehandling Utvikle funksjonalitet for å fremvise og interagere med data innenfor IMINT og remote sensing Kvalifikasjoner Stillingen har følgende krav som må innfris for å bli vurdert som aktuell søker: Overingeniør: Bachelorgrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (cand.-grader, tidl. Ingeniørutdanninger o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet Senioringeniør: Mastergrad eller utdanning på tilsvarende nivå (hovedfag, profesjonsstudier o.l.) eller omfang innen relevant fagområde. Flerårig relevant erfaring med god resultatoppnåelse vil kunne kompensere for utdanningskravet For begge: God teknisk innsikt og sikkerhetsforståelse God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk Erfaring innenfor ett eller flere av disse områdene: Programmering med Typescript, Rust og/eller Python Moderne webutvikling med fortrinnsvis Angular, React, Vue eller Svelte Moderne backend-rammeverk og patterns SQL og databaser som f.eks. Postgres I tillegg er det ønskelig om du har: Erfaring med moderne DevOps/CICD/Kubernetes Erfaring med teamarbeid innenfor programmering/utvikling Erfaring og kunnskap innenfor remote sensing Særskilte krav for stilling i Etterretningstjenesten: Søkere må tilfredsstille kravene til høyeste sikkerhetsklarering. For ansettelse i Etterretningstjenesten kan man ikke ha annet enn norsk statsborgerskap ved ansettelsestidspunktet. Stillingen er underlagt beordringsplikt, jf. forsvarsloven og forsvarstilsatteforskriften, som innebærer at du kan beordres til internasjonale operasjoner. Dette skjer normalt på grunnlag av villighet. Beordringsplikt medfører krav til medisinsk og fysisk skikkethet og grunnleggende engelskkunnskaper. Dersom du ikke oppfyller kravene har du mulighet til å søke dispensasjon. Personlige egenskaper Personlig egnethet for en stilling i Etterretningstjenesten vil bli ilagt stor vekt: Holdninger og pålitelighet: Etterretningstjenesten krever høy faglig- og personlig integritet, pålitelighet og lojalitet av sine medarbeidere. Lærelyst og planmessighet: Vi søker personer som ivrer for sitt fagfelt, og som møter arbeidsdagen med lærelyst og et ønske om å levere. Samspill og samarbeid: I Etterretningstjenesten er vi opptatt av å ha et godt arbeidsmiljø. God lagånd, respekt og toleranse i møte med andre er av stor betydning. Stressmestring: Det er en forutsetning at våre medarbeidere har evnen til å stå i periodevis stor arbeidsbelastning. I tillegg ønsker vi at du: Er initiativrik Er kreativ Er sikkerhetsbevissthet Vi tilbyr Hos oss får du en spennende og samfunnsviktig jobb hvor du vil kunne utgjøre en forskjell. Etterretningstjenesten er opptatt av å øke kompetansen hos de ansatte, og det vil satses både på deg som person og din faginteresse. Våre ansatte har fleksitid, mulighet for trening i arbeidstiden, samt gunstige lån- og pensjonsordninger gjennom Statens pensjonskasse. Du vil få en årslønn innenfor spennet kr 690 000 – 830 000 i stillingen som overingeniør (kode: 1087) eller kr 785 000 - 980 000 i stillingen som senioringeniør (1181) iht. gjeldende Hovedtariffavtale. items.desc: DevOps Engineer — Junior+ / Mid-Level We’re looking for a DevOps Engineer with hands-on experience to join our team and gradually take ownership of day-to-day operational tasks. You’ll work alongside experienced DevOps engineers on CI/CD, application deployments, troubleshooting, monitoring, and automation. We expect you to handle routine tasks independently, with guidance and review available for unfamiliar or more complex work. Required skills 1. Linux and networking Practical Linux administration experience: processes, services, permissions, packages, and logs. Ability to troubleshoot common CPU, memory, and disk usage issues. Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS fundamentals, routing, and load balancing. Ability to investigate service availability and connectivity issues. 2. Bash and Git Ability to read, maintain, and write Bash scripts for automation, including error handling. Practical experience with Git: branches, merge requests, and resolving conflicts. 3. Docker and Kubernetes Ability to write Dockerfiles, build and run container images, and work with environment variables, volumes, and container networking. Hands-on experience deploying applications to Kubernetes using Deployments, Services, Ingress, ConfigMaps, and Secrets. Understanding of health probes, resource requests, and limits. Ability to troubleshoot application startup and runtime issues using logs and Kubernetes events. 4. CI/CD Experience with at least one CI/CD platform: GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, or Jenkins. Ability to independently modify existing build and deployment pipelines and troubleshoot failures. Understanding of pipeline variables, secrets, and artifacts. 5. Monitoring and troubleshooting Practical experience with Prometheus and Grafana: finding relevant metrics, investigating alerts, and updating existing dashboards. Ability to find and analyse application logs. Nice to have GitOps principles and Argo CD Helm Terraform or Ansible Python scripting Experience with AWS, Azure, or GCP Centralised logging tools such as Loki or ELK/EFK Kubernetes NetworkPolicies How we work We value ownership of routine tasks, a systematic approach to troubleshooting, and care when making changes. You should be comfortable verifying results, understanding how to roll back a change, documenting solutions, and asking for help when needed. As you become familiar with our infrastructure, you’ll take on more complex tasks and broader responsibilities, with support from the team. Project Description Gradually take ownership of operational tasks Maintain and improve existing CI/CD pipelines, troubleshoot build and deployment failures. Deploy and configure applications in Kubernetes using established workflows. Investigate infrastructure and application issues, escalating complex cases with relevant findings. Maintain monitoring dashboards and alerting rules, review metrics and logs to identify issues. Automate repetitive tasks using Bash and other tools. Perform routine Linux administration and infrastructure maintenance. Support development teams with deployment and environment issues. Document procedures, troubleshooting steps, and infrastructure changes. Validate changes and prepare rollback steps, following the team’s review and release processes. Personnel specialist: Svetlana Gavaga Email: sgavaga@ibagroup.eu

items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients. Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities. What You’ll Do Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

items.desc: Fullstack Developer (Java & Angular) ABOUT THE JOB Join our high-impact AI team within BNP Paribas’s Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) division, where we develop and scale a cutting-edge software platform powering the entire corporate credit chain - from origination to monitoring. Used by thousands of employees across 50+ countries since 2019, our platform is a critical backbone for global credit operations. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Developing software solutions that align with the multi‑year product roadmap and meet defined project requirements. Collaborating with cross‑functional teams to shape features that best satisfy end‑user expectations and business objectives. Ensuring high‑quality deliverables through comprehensive test coverage, code reviews, and adherence to established coding standards. Producing reliable effort estimates, creating realistic work plans and providing proactive status updates to stakeholders. Demonstrating supportive, friendly attitude ; actively mentoring peers and contributing to collective technical expertise . PROFILE & SKILLS Proven commercial experience ( 4 years) in either backend or frontend development, with solid exposure to the complementary “weaker side”. Backend: Java 8/17, Spring Boot, Hibernate (Oracle PL/SQL), Liquibase, Frontend Angular 19/20, nx, micro‑frontend architecture, Jest, NgRx DevOps & CI/CD Knowledge: Continuous Integration & Deployment pipelines using Bitbucket, Jenkins, SonarQube. Container orchestration and monitoring: Kubernetes, ELK stack. Collaborative, team‑player attitude. Fluent English (written and spoken). WHAT WE OFFER: Hybrid work mode, 50% working from home within a month Equivalent for remote work expenses (120 PLN per month) Stable employment in the international company Fully paid private medical care for employee Pre-paid lunch card Employee Pension Plan Co-financed Multisport Card MyBenefit Cafeteria Platform Life insurance Car parking availability in the office building Trainings and development opportunities Starts on a fixed‑term contract; later possibility to change to permanent. WHY JOIN BNP PARIBAS? We are BNP Paribas S.A. (Branch in Poland), a part of BNP Paribas Group with 200years of experience in banking. Since 2008, we are at the heart of Warsaw, and now we are also in Krakow. As Corporate and Institutional Banking(CIB), we offer financial solutions for corporate and institutional clients in a number of locations globally. Our Securities Services business line is a multi-asset servicing specialist. We are an exciting, dynamic, and growing operations centre; therefore, we are looking for candidates who are willing to be a vital part of the expansion of BNP Paribas’ operational scope in Poland. It’s our values that drive us forward and are a cornerstone of our business. We rely on our strengths, which include stability, responsibility, expertise, and being a good place to work. READY TO MAKE A DIFFERENCE? RECRUITMENT PROCESS HR screening call – 15 min Technical interviews – with the hiring manager + future teammates Final interview with HR Offer & onboarding Recruitment process may differ depending on the position. If the offer sounds interesting to you - please be invited to apply with your resume in English.

items.desc: We are looking for a Junior Software Developer (React / Supabase)! Do you love programming, solving real problems, and experimenting with new technologies? At MindPal , we’re building intelligent systems that power products across energy, education, and HR-tech — all from our office in Gliwice . We’re looking for a Junior Software Developer with at least 1 year of commercial experience , who enjoys writing code, exploring new technologies, and turning ideas into working solutions. You don’t need to know everything yet — we value curiosity, a problem-solving mindset, and the motivation to grow. Cooperation Details: Type of contract: Contract of Mandate ( Umowa zlecenie ). Location: On-site, Gliwice. Compensation: 31.40–40.00 PLN gross/hour. Scope of cooperation: Develop and maintain application features using React, TypeScript, and Vite . Work with Supabase , including PostgreSQL, authentication, and storage. Develop backend logic using Supabase Edge Functions and TypeScript. Integrate external services through REST APIs . Explore AI-powered tools and automation to improve the development process. What We Value: 1+ year of commercial experience in software development. Good understanding of JavaScript/TypeScript and React fundamentals. Understanding of SQL, relational databases, and PostgreSQL fundamentals. Familiarity with REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and Git. Experience with Supabase, Firebase, Node.js, or serverless functions is a plus. Communicative English and Polish at B2 level (written and spoken). What We Offer: Long-term cooperation with opportunities to grow across frontend and backend development. The opportunity to work on-site at our office in Gliwice . Real projects for international clients using modern technologies. Access to AI-powered tools and automation supporting efficient project delivery. A collaborative team environment focused on knowledge-sharing, development, and ownership. Sounds like you? You don’t need to be an expert in every technology we use. Bring your curiosity, willingness to learn, and passion for building things — we’ll help you grow from there!

items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Project Controller (m/f/d), you will support all commercial aspects regarding driving large and complex Energy projects in various business models. You will be working together with the Commercial Project Manager and the project execution team to ensure a high project execution quality. Your daily work will include lots of collaboration with technical project managers, partners, and other team members. How You’ll Make an Impact Support the commercial project execution of contracts with customers, regional companies, consortium partners, sub-suppliers, and other Siemens Energy entities, in close collaboration with the Commercial Project Management. Support in the forecast and reporting. Support commercial activities that are conducted in accordance with Siemens Energy guidelines. Regular discussions and maintenance of the current cost calculation with project management. Handling of sub-supplier and contractor purchase orders, accurately check, timing and cost accuracy of supplier invoices, as well as cost controlling for the project. Support with all other financial and commercial aspects of the project such as tax issues, hiring out of personnel, bank guarantees, insurance claims etc. Support project execution teams with various administrative tasks, travel expense reports etc. What You Bring: Bachelor’s degree in business administration. At least 2 years of working in the commercial/finance area - preferably projects business. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic, and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network is dedicated to delivering testing services that contribute to the health and safety of society and the planet, and to its corporate responsibility to protect the environment and ensure diversity, equity, and inclusion across its companies around the world. Job Description Master Data & Data Quality Create, maintain and enrich master data records. Ensure data quality, consistency and compliance with global standards. Analyze data quality trends and identify areas requiring improvement. Support data governance initiatives and standardization projects. Participate in implementation of AI-driven solutions supporting Master Data operations. Find out more on our Careers page: https://careers.eurofins.com/ Company description : Eurofins Scientific is an international network of independent life sciences companies, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. The Eurofins network of companies believes that it is a global leader in food, environment, pharmaceutical and cosmetic product testing and in discovery pharmacology, forensics, advanced material sciences and agroscience contract research services. It is also one of the market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, and in the support of clinical studies, as well as in biopharma contract development and manufacturing. It also has a rapidly developing presence in highly specialised and molecular clinical diagnostic testing and in-vitro diagnostic products. In under 40 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 65,000 employees across a decentralised and entrepreneurial network of over 950 laboratories in over 1,000 independent companies across 57 countries. Eurofins companies offer a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products. The Eurofins network generated EUR 7.296 billion revenues in FY 2025, and has been one of the fastest growing listed European companies for almost three decades.

items.desc: Ready to take on meaningful challenges and shape the next generation of mobility? Joining OPmobility means stepping into a global group with a purpose to keep people and goods moving safely, smarter, and sustainably everywhere. Supplier Risk Management Assets Professional Europe ensures visibility of supplier-owned production assets and coordinates their transfer between supplier sites to support project needs, mitigate supplier risks, and maintain production continuity. This role is based in our office in Kraków, Poland. Key Responsibilities: Control and maintain European scope for inventory audits Conduct onsite and remote inventory audits to identify assets leased by OPM to the Tier 2 suppliers. Activities to cover: data collection, photo documentation, tools tagging Maintain up to date data base of assets inventory in TEMPO including 3D models of tools and pictures confirming inventory results Fulfil KPI's related with inventory audits Support asset relocations between suppliers production sites Support and lead tools adaptation at supplier plant Participate to the try-outs at the supplier, evaluate the mold robustness Support technical assessment of the tools before and after relocations Sign transfer protocol for relocated tools Stay in close communication with Supply Chain, Operations and Quality for topics related with asset inventory and relocation processes Must have requirements Willingness to travel to supplier locations for on site assets inventory above 50% of time; Basic technical knowledge regarding assets; Good knowledge of tools and solution to define processes optimizations, automatization and efficiency increase Communicative English Attituded focused on delivering results in challenging environment Other requirements Experience in area of Purchasing / Assets Inventory / Tools & Processes; At least 2 years of automotive experience Shopfloor or technical experience nice to have; Knowledge of MS Excel; PowerBI, Power Automate, AI tools and analytical thinking are nice to have What we offer: Competitive salary Employment Stability Private Life Insurance Social Fund Healthcare (Luxmed) Other Social Services (Cafeteria system, e.g. Multisport card) Transport allowance Home office (2 days per week) Flexible working hours Company events 26 days of vacation. At OPmobility, people truly matter. We are committed to building inclusive teams, promoting diversity and equality, and ensuring that every application is considered fairly - because the future of mobility is built by diverse perspectives, bold ideas, and people who dare to move forward. Innovation is therefore not a buzzword, but a natural part of everyday work. You’ll grow in an international environment where cutting-edge technologies, industrial excellence, and real-world impact come together to tackle the challenges of tomorrow’s automotive industry. Founded in 1946 by Pierre Burelle, OPmobility, known until 2024 as Plastic Omnium, has transformed itself into a player in sustainable and connected mobility. Today, OPmobility develops technological solutions across four areas of expertise: exterior and lighting systems, the integration of complex modules, technologies related to energy storage, hydrogen and electrification, and a division dedicated to the development of embedded software and digital solutions. With €11.5 billion in revenue in 2025, 152 factories, 40 R&D centers, and nearly 38,100 employees across 28 countries, OPmobility combines global scale with local impact. All driven by a shared ambition to accelerate the automotive energy transition. Date: Oct 13, 2026 Location: Krakow, PL Krakow, PL Job Requisition ID: 391592

items.desc: Job Title Customer Order Specialist Job Description Join our Order Management team in a hybrid role that combines end‑to‑end order management with hands‑on support for automation and digital solutions . This is a pivotal position supporting our partners , where you will help deliver critical Patient Monitoring solutions to hospitals across the region. You are responsible for End‑to‑end Order Management for the Nordics region, ensuring accurate and timely execution of customer orders Proactive monitoring and follow‑up of orders and customer requests, providing clear and timely updates on order status Managing credit notes, billing disputes , and related financial order corrections Processing and coordinating warranty claims and product returns Providing direct customer support and acting as a trusted operational partner for customers Supporting Key Account Managers with daily order‑related and operational activities Monitoring and supporting automated order processes Analyzing order data and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify trends and improvement opportunities Driving continuous improvement initiatives to optimize processes, reduce exceptions, and enhance customer experience Collaborating cross‑functionally with Sales, Logistics, Planning, Production, Finance, and Automation teams to ensure smooth order execution You are part of the Hospital Patient Monitoring (HPM) Order Management team , working in a fast‑paced, collaborative, and international environment. The team focuses on efficiency, automation, and customer satisfaction while supporting critical healthcare deliveries across the region. To succeed in this role, you’ll need University degree 1-2 years of experience within Supply Chain (especially Order Management), logistics , sales support, customer service or a related field Fluent English Experience with SAP (preferred) or another ERP system Excellent MS Excel skills (including pivot tables) and strong proficiency in other Microsoft Office applications Openness to working with AI‑enabled tools, automation, and digital solutions , and a willingness to adopt new technologies A proactive problem‑solver mindset with strong analytical and data‑driven thinking Strong communication and stakeholder management skills Ability to prioritize effectively, work under pressure , and maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail Good communication skills Compensation & benefits Doing meaningful work should come with fair, transparent rewards. The base salary range for this role is PLN 71,200.00 – PLN 94,933.33. We determine pay within the range using objective factors, like the skills the role requires, your relevant experience and the responsibility you'll have in this role, alongside internal equity and local market considerations. This role is eligible for 10% short term incentive, with your rewards linked to company results. Learn more about our business , discover our rich and exciting history and learn more about our purpose . If you’re interested in this role and have many, but not all, of the experiences needed, we encourage you to apply. You may still be the right candidate for this or other opportunities at Philips. Learn more about our culture of impact with care . #LI-EU #LI-HYBRID

items.desc: Project description Join one of our leading investment banking clients as an IT Risk and Controls Expert. You will play a pivotal role in strengthening the organization's cybersecurity programme by evaluating security controls, identifying and assessing information security (IS) risks, and providing expert guidance to support risk-based decision-making and continuous improvement. Responsibilities Cybersecurity: Manage cybersecurity-related activities, including the identification, assessment, and mitigation of information security (IS) risks. Security Assessments: Conduct security assessments of internal projects and third-party service providers to evaluate control effectiveness and compliance with security requirements. Security Consulting: Provide security advisory services to stakeholders, offering guidance on security controls, risk treatment options, and policy requirements in business-friendly language. Project Management: Coordinate and manage security-related projects and initiatives, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with cybersecurity objectives. Third-Party Risk Management: Drive discussions regarding identified risks, communicate potential business impacts, and provide guidance on appropriate remediation actions. Skills Must have Demonstrable experience in Information Security (IS), Cybersecurity, IT Risk Management, or a related field. Experience operating within financial services, investment banking, or other regulated environments. Familiarity with industry frameworks and standards such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS Controls, or COBIT. Strong understanding of information security principles, risk management methodologies, and control frameworks. Experience providing security advisory and consulting services to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to drive risk remediation discussions and influence stakeholders to achieve security objectives. Proven experience in cybersecurity risk management, security assessments, and control effectiveness reviews. Strong knowledge of cloud security concepts and cloud-related risk management practices. Experience assessing third-party service providers and managing associated security risks. Ability to provide clear, risk-based security advice and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels. Strong communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable business recommendations. Excellent analytical and problem-solving capabilities, coupled with a practical approach to risk management. Nice to have Familiarity with ISO 27001, NIST CSF, CIS Controls, or similar security frameworks. Knowledge of AWS, Azure, or GCP security capabilities and cloud governance practices. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CCSK, or CCSP. Other Languages English: C2 Proficient Seniority Senior Krakow, Poland Req. Podstawą działalności pozostaje hurtowa dystrybucja farmaceutyków, realizowana dzięki nowoczesnym i wysoko wyspecjalizowanym centrom dystrybucyjnym, zapewniającym niezawodność dostaw. Równocześnie rozwijamy komplementarne obszary w ochronie zdrowia, stawiając na nowoczesne technologie, telemedycynę oraz oferując kompleksowe rozwiązania reklamowe i marketingowe dla rynku farmaceutycznego. items.desc: Bridgestone Americas, Inc. (BSAM) z siedzibą w Nashville, Tennessee, i Bridgestone Europe, Middle East and Africa (BSEMEA) z siedzibą w Brukseli, Belgia, działają wspólnie jako strategiczny region „Bridgestone West”. Ten region obsługuje strategiczne potrzeby biznesowe zespołów w obu Amerykach, Europie, na Bliskim Wschodzie i w Afryce. BSAM i BSEMEA są spółkami zależnymi Bridgestone Corporation, z główną siedzibą w Japonii. Bridgestone i jego spółki zależne opracowują, produkują i sprzedają szeroką gamę produktów i rozwiązań Bridgestone, Firestone i marek stowarzyszonych, aby sprostać potrzebom szerokiego grona klientów i branż. Bridgestone Poznań , Sygnatariusz Karty Różnorodności, jest jedną z najnowocześniejszych fabryk koncernu na świecie. Zatrudnia ponad 1700 pracowników i produkuje ponad 500 rodzajów zaawansowanych technologicznie opon, z których korzystają najwięksi producenci samochodów na świecie, w tym marki premium i prestige. Więcej informacji o Bridgestone Poznań można znaleźć na stronie http://bridgestone-poznan.pl/ W związku z powstałym wakatem poszukujemy osób na stanowisko: MAGAZYNIER / MAGAZYNIERKA miejsce pracy: Bridgestone Poznań Jeśli jesteś gotowy(-wa) do pracy fizycznej w systemie zmianowym, jeśli lubisz pracę w zespole, jeśli posiadasz prawo jazdy kat B, jeśli posiadasz uprawnienia do obsługi wózków widłowych – będzie to dodatkowy atut! Nasza oferta dla Ciebie, to: stabilne warunki zatrudnienia w oparciu o umowę o pracę, atrakcyjne wynagrodzenie - średnia miesięczna płaca to około 6800-7500 PLN brutto, system premii miesięcznych, w którym nagradzamy za osiągnięcia, prywatna opieka medyczna współfinanasowana przez pracodawcę, ubezpieczenie grupowe współfinanasowane przez pracodawcę, świadczenia świąteczne i wakacyjne, Pracowniczy Program Emerytalny finansowany przez pracodawcę, szkolenia pozwalające na podnoszenie kwalifikacji, w tym m.in. możliwość zdobycia uprawnień UDT do obsługi wózków widłowych po okresie próbnym, dofinansowanie do karty sportowej oraz startów w zawodach sportowych, zniżki na usługi telekomunikacyjne, dofinansowanie posiłków w zakładowej kantynie oraz świeże owoce, program rekomendacji pracowniczych. Co będziesz robić – główne obowiązki: przyjęciu palet z oponami do magazynu – praca na wózku widłowym typu reach truck, kompletacji opon zgodnie z zamówieniami naszych klientów – praca na wózku widłowym typu reach truck, ręcznym załadunku opon z palet na samochód z wykorzystaniem wózka widłowego czołowego. Czego potrzebujesz, aby objąć to stanowisko – nasze wymagania: wykształcenie minimum zawodowe, motywacja do pracy w magazynie, gotowość do pracy fizycznej w systemie dwuzmianowym czterobrygadowym (12/12) lub trzyzmianowym od poniedziałku do piątku, dobra świadomość BHP, zorientowanie na jakość, dobra współpraca w zespole, znajomość języka polskiego na poziomie średniozaawansowanym w mowie i piśmie, doświadczenie w pracy w magazynie, doświadczenie w pracy zmianowej, posiadanie ważnych dokumentów uprawniających do legalnego zatrudnienia w Polsce (np. wiza, karta pobytu lub inne odpowiednie dokumenty). Dodatkowym atutem będzie posiadanie uprawnień na wózki widłowe. Następne kroki w procesie: Wszystkie aplikacje zostaną rozpatrzone. Nasz zespół HR skontaktuje się z osobami, które chcielibyśmy zaprosić do kolejnego etapu rekrutacji. Nie wahaj się i aplikuj klikając przycisk Aplikuj/Aplikuj teraz Czekamy na Twoją wiadomość! Jesteśmy zobowiązani do stworzenia jeszcze bardziej inkluzywnej kultury, która promuje równość, obejmuje indywidualność i pomaga naszym coraz bardziej zróżnicowanym członkom zespołu, klientom i społecznościom rozwijać się, zapewniając równe szanse w zatrudnieniu. Oznacza to, że wszyscy kandydaci do pracy i pracownicy będą traktowani na równi i nie będziemy dyskryminować ze względu na płeć, stan cywilny, pochodzenie etniczne, kolor skóry, obywatelstwo, pochodzenie narodowe, niepełnosprawność, orientację seksualną, religię ani wiek. Jesteśmy pracodawcą zapewniającym równe szanse i uwzględniającym indywidualne potrzeby kandydatów, aby umożliwić wszystkim udział w procesie rekrutacyjnym na równych zasadach. Prosimy o poinformowanie nas, jeśli mają Państwo szczególne wymagania dotyczące zaproszenia na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną, bądź też kwestie, które chcieliby Państwo, abyśmy wzięli pod uwagę przy rozpatrywaniu Państwa aplikacji. Klikając przycisk Aplikuj/Aplikuj teraz potwierdzasz, że zapoznałeś się z Informacją o ochronie prywatności , akceptujesz jej treść i rozumiesz, że poprzez dobrowolne podanie danych innych niż imię (imiona) i nazwisko, data urodzenia; wskazane przez Ciebie dane kontaktowe jak również wykształcenie, kwalifikacje zawodowe, przebieg dotychczasowego zatrudnienia – w zakresie niezbędnym do oceny Twoich kompetencji na dane stanowisko będące przedmiotem rekrutacji, wyrażasz dobrowolną zgodę na ich przetwarzanie przez Bridgestone Poznań Sp. z o.o. w celu realizacji procesu rekrutacyjnego, na który aplikujesz. items.desc: Project description We are DXC Luxoft Financial Services - an award-winning provider of technology solutions, dedicated to the Financial Services sector. Join our international team and become a member of our open minded, progressive and professional team of financial services consultants. In this role you will be working on projects for biggest investment banks across the globe. On top of attractive salary and benefits package, we will invest into your professional training, and allow you to grow your professional career. Responsibilities This initiative focuses on: Upgrading legacy applications to modern Spring Boot versions (2.x 3.x) Decommissioning and replacing Hazelcast across distributed systems Refactoring applications to align with modern, cloud-ready, stateless architectures Enhancing integration with event-driven systems using Apache Kafka Supporting applications connected to Murex batch and real-time processing flows This is a high-impact program in a low-latency financial environment, where system stability, performance, and correctness are critical. We are seeking a Java developer who can design and build with minimum supervision solutions for our team. The person needs to be knowledgeable on modern software development practices including Scrums, be up to date with the latest Java tools and frameworks and be able to work with the existing team to deliver solutions. The ideal candidate will be diligent, tenacious and delivery focused with a track record of building high quality solutions that are resilient and maintainable. Use of cloud technology is increasing, so experience working with AWS would be beneficial. Design and implement solutions for: Spring Boot & Hazelcast upgrades (including major version transitions) Analyze existing distributed system usage (caching, clustering, locking) Refactor applications toward stateless, scalable microservices Implement and optimize integrations using Kafka-based event-driven architecture Collaborate with QA, DevOps, and architecture teams on migration and rollout strategy Ensure high standards of performance, resilience, and fault tolerance Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and production support Post-project opportunity: Following successful delivery of this modernization initiative, team members are planned to be reassigned to other strategic programs within the client’s long-term roadmap, offering continued growth and exposure to new initiatives. Experience managing dependencies using Maven and/or Gradle. Experience upgrading Java libraries, frameworks and third-party dependencies. Experience identifying, investigating and remediating software security vulnerabilities. Good understanding of secure coding practices and common application security risks. Strong debugging, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. Experience working with Git and CI/CD pipelines. Experience working with established or legacy Java applications. Experience assessing the impact of upgrades and remediation changes on existing systems. Experience with unit and integration testing. Nice to have Experience working with Calypso. Making sure there is enough food, fiber, and infrastructure for our rapidly growing world is what we're all about at John Deere. And it's why we're investing in our people and our technology like never before! Here the world's brightest minds are tackling the world's biggest challenges. If you believe one person can make the world a better place, we'll put you to work. RIGHT NOW. John Deere Bank S.A. is the European Headquarters for John Deere Financial and maintains branch offices in the UK, Spain, Germany, and Poland. The primary activity is providing financial services to customers and dealers who want to finance John Deere equipment. In our financial department, you can expect an international team with a global presence in a highly collaborating network using benchmark processes and systems (e.g., SAP ERP) to support the business objectives. Our teams are working in an innovative environment where new ideas (e.g., artificial intelligence) and continuous process improvements are appreciated and promoted. Review and control credit documentation for incoming credit applications. Monitor the customer financing repayment (Cash collection, Past due management, Write-off). Process customer claims. Fluency in English is essential. University degree preferably in a finance- or business-related field or equivalent work experience. Great communication, customer service skills and customer centricity. Ability to master customer interactions, handle complaints and keep calm in stressful situations. Private medical care, life insurance, a sports card, meal allowance, language courses, a social fund budget, and various additional fun events in our office. Free access to our e-learning platform, featuring over 1,000 courses. Please attach an English version of your CV. John Deere is an equal opportunity employer.
