items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency. Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule. Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin. No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work. Excellent cultural fit as per …

items.desc: Posting Description: Are you looking for a role where you can combine data analysis, client interaction and project coordination while helping organizations make better compensation decisions? As a Client Success Coordinator, you will support clients throughout their journey of participating in Aon's Radford McLagan Compensation Database (RMCD) , the world's leading source of benchmark compensation data. You will work closely with clients to ensure compensation data is collected, validated and transformed into important insights that support workforce and reward decisions. As organizations face growing challenges in attracting, retaining and motivating talent, high-quality compensation data and market intelligence have become more important than ever. In this role, you will play a key part in helping clients successfully navigate compensation surveys, data submissions and benchmarking processes. This is a hybrid role with the flexibility to work both virtually and from our Krakow office. Aon is in the business of better decisions At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organization, we are united through trust as one inclusive team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed. What the day will look like: You will work closely with clients and internal teams to support the collection, validation and integration of compensation data, ensuring a smooth client experience and high-quality data delivery. Support clients throughout compensation data collection, submission, mapping and integration activities. Validate and analyse compensation and survey data, ensuring accuracy, completeness and alignment with RMCD methodology. Provide guidance on data requirements, timelines, reporting and survey participation processes. Partner with clients and internal stakeholders to resolve data, reporting and implementation-related questions. Build strong client relationships while supporting successful project delivery and a positive client experience. Contribute to reporting, benchmarking and continuous improvement initiatives across Data Solutions operations. How this opportunity is different: In the role of Client Success Coordinator, you will develop an outstanding blend of analytical and client-facing skills. The role combines compensation data management, stakeholder engagement and problem-solving, providing exposure to clients, industry-leading compensation data and colleagues across multiple functions and geographies. Skills and experience that will lead to success: Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data in Excel and other business tools. Ability to collect, validate, reconcile and interpret data while maintaining a high level of accuracy. Good interpersonal skills with the ability to explain technical and data-related concepts to different audiences. Experience in compensation, HR data, survey operations, data implementation or a client-facing environment would be an advantage. Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining attention to detail. A proactive and problem-solving attitude with a curiosity about data quality and process improvement. Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and confidence using AI-enabled technology and data tools. #li-gk3 #LI-Hybrid #healthandemployeeben

items.desc: Labcorp is a global leader in laboratory services, providing the insights and answers that help healthcare providers, patients, researchers, pharmaceutical companies and health systems make confident decisions and improve outcomes. Through our unparalleled science, data, technology and laboratory network, we advance diagnostics, accelerate innovation and help address some of the world’s most important health challenges. As we shape the future of healthcare, we are leveraging advanced technologies, intelligent digital solutions and data-driven innovation across our operations to enhance how work gets done and deliver greater value to customers and patients. With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives. Labcorp is seeking a remote Clinical Data Risk & Solutions Analyst (Global Monitor) to join our team in Poland. Job Responsibilities: Accountable for the monitoring and reporting of clinical study laboratory metrics. Ability to extract information from multiple data sources, converting the raw data into meaningful and actionable insights, and presenting key findings to all stakeholders (internal and external). Performing risk assessments on low complexity studies in coordination with the Global Study Manager and the Study Design Lead prior to study start and proposing monitoring solutions to mitigate the identified risks. Utilizing analytics/visualizations to review study laboratory data for your assigned studies to identify issues and to ensure risks are proactively addressed. Liaise with Developers to ensure development of monitoring tools are completed to the client’s specifications Ensure regular communication with your key stakeholders. Support Risk Management Plan creation and ongoing maintenance through monitoring and analysis Participate actively to Labcorp development through continuous process improvements. Be able to act efficiently in an environment with dynamic timelines and priorities. Participate in functional meetings and provide input, keeping processes up to date. Comply with internal strategy. Support a culture of continuous improvement, quality and productivity. Minimum Qualifications: University degree in science 3 or more years of experience in clinical project management or clinical data analysis 1 or more years of experience in the life science, healthcare or pharmaceutical industry Preferred Qualifications: PhD degree in science 3 or more years of experience in Excel 1 or more years of experience in client management Additional Job Standards: Fluency in English Curious, data driven analytical thinker High quality standards, attention to detail Strong motivation, flexibility and creativity Big picture thinker who suggests changes to process, identifies risks and potential opportunities for data improvement Strong problem-solving and customer service skills Comfort with ambiguity and fast switching across studies/portfolios as priorities change Able to operate with minimal guidance while owning deliverables end-to-end Proven ability to effectively communicate ideas/concepts and to motivate/influence others to accomplish challenging shared goals and objectives. Dedication for learning and self-improvement Robust self-organization; at-ease with managing conflicting priorities Ability to create and motivate a team around project deliverables Labcorp manages one of the largest networks of clinical laboratories in the world. In the Clinical Data Risk & Solutions Analyst (Global Monitor) role, you will be assigned a portfolio of clinical studies. When a new study starts, the Global Monitor works with the internal teams to identify study risks and develop mitigation plans. Global Monitors also look for issues in the study data and suggest actions internally and/or externally to rectify and prevent those issues and maintain study health. Additionally, you will be responsible for putting in place customized, study specific monitoring packages for studies based on study needs or in which clients are requesting additional oversight by Labcorp to ensure all their samples will be processed correctly. To do this, you will need to understand which laboratory samples are at risk for not being resulted on time, to choose which of our monitoring offerings is best suited for the study needs, and then to write clear monitoring instructions that will be handed off to another part of the team. Overall, the Global Monitor must be in compliance with the CCLS Global Project Management strategy and deliver outstanding performance and customer satisfaction. Labcorp is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer: Labcorp strives for inclusion and belonging in the workforce and does not tolerate harassment or discrimination of any kind. items.desc: Job Title Junior Data Quality Assistant Job Description Summary The Junior Data Operations is a key operational role supporting the Business Development Services function for the Netherland market. This role will be responsible for ensuring the accurate capture, quality, and efficient use of real estate data, making sure the information used by business, analysis, and reporting teams is precise, consistent, and scalable. This position plays an important role in strengthening the data foundation needed to support decision-making across the Netherlands business. The ideal candidate will be highly organized, detail-oriented, and eager to grow within the world of data by learning to scale data processes through automation and reporting. This role will work closely with research analysts, consultants, and business teams to ensure data is properly used and interpreted. Job Description Key Responsibilities: Data Management & Quality Collect information from internal and external sources (real estate portals, public records, technical reports, internal systems). Update and maintain databases on assets, prices, yields, occupancy, and other market KPIs for the Belux market. Run data quality controls (consistency, duplicates, formatting, temporal coherence) and identify areas for improvement. Prepare and structure datasets for analysis, studies, and specific projects. Support with cleansing and enhancing the dataset to assist with analysis requirements and enhanced analytics. Identify and catalogue new data sets that could support our analytical ambitions Ensure market data is ready ahead of reporting deadlines. Automation & Data Exploitation Identify repetitive data entry tasks and propose improvements or automations to optimize processes. Create and maintain SQL queries for data extraction, validation, and cross-referencing between different sources. Support basic data modeling for reporting and analysis. Collaborate on the creation and maintenance of Power BI dashboards, both operational and KPI-tracking. Support data reconciliations between systems and sources (source vs. reporting). Documentation & Collaboration Document data capture, validation, automation, and data flow processes. Work closely with research analysts and business teams to ensure correct use and interpretation of data. Participate in continuous improvement initiatives and data process standardization. Key Requirements Fluent in English. Dutch language skills are beneficial but not required. 1 to 3 years of experience in data management, data entry, reporting, or similar functions. Common MS Office applications to excellent levels including SharePoint and OneDrive. Strong command of Excel (formulas, pivot tables, data validation; Power Query is a plus). Analytical mindset, focus on data quality, and strong attention to detail. Basic knowledge of SQL (SELECT, JOIN, filters). Experience with or interest in Power BI (datasets, simple models, visualizations). Interest in process automation and operational optimization. Basic understanding of data concepts: tables, relationships, KPIs, data flows. Prior experience in real estate, consulting, or data-related environments is a plus, not a requirement. A self-starter mindset, and a passion for making business improvements. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Cushman & Wakefield is an equal opportunity / affirmative action employer. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to ethnicity, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, religion, marital status, or any other legally protected characteristic. Cushman & Wakefield is committed to equity in employment, and our goal is to have a diverse, inclusive and barrier-free workplace. If you are a person with a disability and need any other accessible accommodations during the hiring process, you are invited to bring this to the Talent Acquisition Advisor’s attention once they have made contact. INCO: “Cushman & Wakefield”

items.card: you will lead the transition of forecasting tools and activities for all European markets into the Europe Hub, ensuring seamless integration and improved accuracy. This role is vital to Flora Food Group's ability to make data-driven decisions that support better food production and business growth across diverse markets. You will enable stronger financial planning and reporting, directly impacting how we serve
items.desc: The Practical Detail Location: Katowice Working Model: Hybrid Why this role matters In your first year, you will lead the transition of forecasting tools and activities for all European markets into the Europe Hub, ensuring seamless integration and improved accuracy. This role is vital to Flora Food Group's ability to make data-driven decisions that support better food production and business growth across diverse markets. You will enable stronger financial planning and reporting, directly impacting how we serve kitchens and consumers with reliable, nutritious, and delicious products. Your work will help shape the future of our financial operations in a complex and evolving region. What you'll do Lead the month-end close process, ensuring timely and accurate financial reporting. Manage rolling forecasts to provide up-to-date insights for business planning. Produce ad hoc reports that support decision-making across multiple markets. Transition forecasting tools and activities from various European markets into the Europe Hub. Collaborate with stakeholders across five key markets and several smaller ones to adapt and implement effective financial solutions. Performance You will own the accuracy and timeliness of financial forecasts and reports, driving improvements in business decision quality. Success will be measured by the smooth transition of forecasting activities into the Europe Hub and the reliability of financial data supporting strategic growth. Your data-driven approach will help rebuild and strengthen processes in a challenging environment, contributing to operational excellence. Care This role reports to the Europe CFO and works closely with finance teams across Central and South Eastern Europe, including Greece, Poland, Slovakia, Czechia, Hungary, Romania, Serbia, and Croatia. You will foster collaboration and accountability in a team rebuilding phase, ensuring sustainable financial practices that support long-term business health. Your leadership will help create a stable foundation for future growth while respecting the diverse needs of each market. Passion You bring a genuine interest in how financial insights enable better food production and distribution. Your curiosity about improving forecasting and reporting processes reflects a commitment to reliability and functionality in every decision. You will be part of a team that values innovation and precision, contributing to Flora Food Group's mission to deliver better food to kitchens and tables across Europe. About you You have strong Excel skills and are comfortable working independently in a complex, multi-market environment. You thrive in situations that require adaptability and stakeholder management across diverse cultures. Your experience includes financial reporting, forecasting, and analysis, with a focus on delivering clear, actionable insights. You are ready to rebuild and improve processes in a team undergoing change, bringing resilience and a solutions-oriented mindset. You take pride in working for a company with over 150 years of expertise in food, and you understand that excellent work in every function is what allows Flora Food Group to put better food on tables around the world. You bring the same rigour and care to your discipline that our teams bring to every product, because how we work is as important as what we make. Where this could lead to This role typically leads to becoming a finance business partner for local teams, expanding your influence and responsibility within the region. Over time, you will deepen your strategic impact by shaping financial planning and decision-making at a broader level. What's next If this opportunity sounds exciting, we'd love to hear from you. Apply before: 27-Oct-2026 For questions about the role, please contact: Marie Mantel marie.mantel@florafg.com We understand your resume might not be up to date and recommend that you apply with what you have or your LinkedIn Profile. Flora Food Group is dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workplace, we understand that you might not meet all the requirements stated in the description, but we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the right candidate for this role or other roles. Flora Food Group is an employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and equal opportunities for all. We recruit based only on values, qualifications, performance, skills, behaviours, experience, and knowledge. We ensure job advertisements are free from unintentional bias. No personal characteristics should be a barrier to joining Flora Food Group. We prohibit discrimination and harassment based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or other personal characteristics.

items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: Descrição da empresa O Grupo Bosch tem mais de 400 000 colaboradores em todo o mundo, presentes em 60 países, e temos orgulho em ter um impacto na vida das pessoas e em trabalhar para um futuro mais sustentável. Na cidade de Aveiro, a Bosch possui uma das suas maiores unidades de produção da divisão Bosch Home Comfort, bem como um Centro de Investigação e Desenvolvimento de novas e melhoradas soluções de aquecimento para o segmento residencial. Com mais de 1400 colaboradores, focados na inovação, sustentabilidade e colaboração, a Bosch Aveiro reúne especialistas em diversas áreas, desde a engenharia mecânica à conectividade e soluções de software, passando pela industrialização e qualidade. Na Bosch, moldamos o futuro ao criarmos produtos e serviços de alta qualidade que geram entusiasmo e melhoram a vida das pessoas. A promessa que fazemos aos nossos colaboradores é sólida: crescemos juntos, desfrutamos do que fazemos e inspiramo-nos uns aos outros. Junta-te a nós e sente a diferença de mentalidades, culturas, gerações, identidades e perspetivas. Todos devem trazer a sua autenticidade e trabalhar juntos com respeito. A Bosch é um empregador que valoriza a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Acolhemos candidaturas de pessoas com deficiências e incapacidades, podemos providenciar adaptações razoáveis no decurso do processo de recrutamento e no desempenho da atividade profissional. A inclusão de todos e a garantia de igualdade de oportunidades permite-nos atingir o nosso verdadeiro potencial. Descrição do emprego O teu contributo para algo maior : Apoiar de perto a liderança na identificação, desenvolvimento de talentos e avaliação de desempenho da equipa de eletricistas, garantindo a sua motivação e máxima eficiência de trabalho. Propor, participar e implementar ações de melhoria contínua ao nível de sistemas de automação industrial, elevando a disponibilidade operacional de equipamentos de produção críticos. Desenvolver estudos técnicos de engenharia focados na modernização, automação, controle e integração de software em instalações industriais em operação. Garantir a conformidade interna do departamento e liderar os processos de inventário de ativos. Assegurar a implementação rigorosa dos procedimentos de qualidade central, garantindo que todos os softwares estejam devidamente documentados, controlados e rastreáveis. Elaborar documentação técnica de suporte para garantir intervenções rápidas de manutenção. Suportar o desenvolvimento de conteúdos formativos com o objetivo de reforçar e elevar o nível de conhecimentos técnicos das equipas de manutenção. Supervisionar o arquivo de dados industriais de máquinas e equipamentos (softwares, receitas e parâmetros), viabilizando uma rápida reposição de cópias de segurança ( backups/restore ). Validar e aprovar a introdução de novos equipamentos fabris sob a ótica da manutenção, garantindo a estrita normalização de peças, módulos e componentes. Prestar suporte técnico especializado de segunda linha na resolução de problemas complexos de equipamentos de fábrica, com forte base documental. Qualificações O que te diferencia: Educação: Formação académica superior (Licenciatura ou Mestrado) em Engenharia de Computadores e Telemática, Engenharia de Automação Industrial, Engenharia Computacional ou áreas similares. Experiência: Experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software aplicado à indústria, automação industrial ou em funções de engenharia de manutenção de sistemas digitais. Know-how: Conhecimentos de programação em Visual Studio C# , .NET Framework, Python . Conhecimentos teóricos ou práticos em sistemas de Visão Artificial ( Computer Vision ) e modelos de Machine Learning . Experiência de trabalho e manipulação de Bases de Dados (SQL ou similares). Idiomas: Bons conhecimentos de Inglês (falado e escrito). Trabalho e Método: Orientação para a melhoria contínua, facilidade de planeamento sistemático, espírito de equipa e foco na resolução de problemas com rigor metodológico. items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Romania As a System Product Owner within Thales, you will act as the primary interface between product stakeholders and the engineering team, ensuring that development activities remain aligned with product objectives, customer needs, technical constraints and delivery commitments. 1. Product Vision & Stakeholder Alignment Contribute to the product vision and roadmap in alignment with the CPO, Initiative Owner and relevant stakeholders. Understand customer and operational needs and translate them into clear functional and technical objectives. Ensure alignment between system-level requirements, product priorities and engineering activities. Act as the main functional and technical point of contact for the team, facilitating access to relevant experts when required.Collect and incorporate feedback from stakeholders, demonstrations and operational users. 2. Backlog Management & Requirements Decomposition Own, maintain and prioritise the Team Backlog based on inputs from the CPO and Initiative Owner. Support the decomposition of Initiatives into Epics, Epics into Features, and Features into coherent, actionable User Stories. Ensure completeness, consistency and traceability of requirements across the development lifecycle. Define and review User Stories and Acceptance Criteria in collaboration with engineering teams. Accept or reject completed User Stories based on agreed Acceptance Criteria and Definition of Done. 3. Collaborate with the Scrum Master to facilitate co-engineering activities, backlog refinement and Agile ceremonies. Participate in team and Agile Release Train (ART) events, including planning, reviews and demonstrations. Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment and the evolution of the Architectural Runway. Identify and address functional dependencies, risks and impediments impacting delivery. Promote Built-In Quality and ensure delivered solutions meet functional requirements and customer expectations. 4. Budget Ownership & Delivery Performance Manage and monitor allocated budgets at Epic and Feature levels within Jira. Ensure development scope and associated budgets remain aligned with agreed commitments. Monitor functional and financial progress using EVM indicators and relevant delivery KPIs.Analyse deviations between planned and actual progress, identifying scope, cost and schedule impacts. Conduct regular end-of-sprint reviews with the Initiative Owner to assess progress, budget consumption and potential scope adjustments. Report delivery performance, financial status, risks and deviations to the IO, CPO and RTE.Contribute to corrective actions and prioritisation decisions to maintain delivery predictability. 5. Continuous Improvement & Feedback Facilitate product and system demonstrations to gather feedback from internal and external stakeholders. Incorporate lessons learned, customer feedback and operational insights into backlog priorities. Promote continuous improvement in requirements quality, engineering collaboration and delivery practices. Contribute to improving team autonomy, knowledge sharing and overall product quality. PROFILE You hold a Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or a related technical field. You have significant experience in Systems Engineering, Software Engineering or complex technical product development. You have previous experience in Product Ownership, technical project management or system-level product development, ideally within an Agile environment. You have a strong understanding of customer needs and the ability to translate them into clear technical and functional requirements. You demonstrate strong analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to manage complex systems and competing priorities. You are an effective communicator, able to engage and align engineering teams, product stakeholders and management. You are autonomous, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of technical and functional decisions within your scope. You demonstrate a collaborative mindset, a customer-oriented approach and a commitment to continuous improvement. Ability to analyse complex systems, understand dependencies between components and assess the impact of technical decisions. Knowledge of Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), UML and system modelling practices. items.desc: AI Solutions Engineer Hands-on AI research, engineering, integration and delivery GRSee is building an internal AI capability focused on turning practical business needs into working AI-enabled solutions. We are looking for a hands-on AI Solutions Engineer who enjoys learning, experimenting, building and taking solutions from initial investigation through production use. Role Overview The AI Solutions Engineer will work closely with the CAIO to investigate business problems, evaluate available technologies, prototype solutions, and implement them in real environments. Technical Skills Practical software development experience is required. Strong capability in at least one modern development language is expected; experience with the following is particularly relevant: · C# / .NET - preferred for GRSee internal development · Python - highly relevant and a strong alternative / complement; TypeScript / JavaScript experience may also be relevant for AI-enabled applications and integrations Experience with several of the following is desirable: · REST APIs, JSON and HTTP-based integrations · Databases and SQL · Backend services and lightweight web applications · Authentication and authorization concepts · Git / source control · Debugging, logging and error handling · Third-party APIs and SaaS integrations · Basic frontend or web development · Deployment and environment configuration Current Technological Stack Following GRSee current technological platforms: · Zoho CRM · Monday · Google Workspace · GCP & Azure & AWS · Word/Excel and Google Spreads sheets and Google Docs · Deel · Amplemarket (Marketing) · JotForm & Make AI, Automation and Integration Hands-on experience and active experimentation with modern AI systems is important for this role. items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: KittySpout / DoggySpout is looking for a hands-on CRO Lead to join our team! You will own every conversion test across our site, landing pages, paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. This is an all-in-one role: you set the strategy and you do the work – building the backlog, briefing and QA-ing tests, launching them and shipping the winners. We spend $2,000,000+ per month on Meta , so your tests reach significance fast. We are looking to hire someone with 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands. The ideal candidate has deep hands-on Intelligems experience, has built and tested paid-acquisition funnels, and can show the data behind tests that lifted conversion rate, AOV or revenue per visitor. The mission of this role Own every conversion test on both of our brands (site, landing pages, funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells) so each visitor is worth more every month. Success is a steady, well-run test program that lifts conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor across every page, funnel and offer. Who are we? KittySpout is a premium DTC brand selling stainless steel cat water fountains, filters and accessories. We sell across Shopify, Amazon and Chewy, and we're one of the fastest-growing brands in the pet space – $50M+ in annual revenue and scaling to $100M+. We recently launched DoggySpout, expanding into an entirely new vertical and customer base. We're a 100% remote, lean, senior team that moves fast, and every person here has a massive impact on the business. What is our culture like & who is a good fit? Culture-fit is our #1 factor when hiring! We have a genuine will-to-win. No work is beneath us if it moves us towards our goals. We use creativity to do more with less – and quickly. We use data to make decisions and live by four core values: Better Everyday – keep a live test on each brand, write down the learning from every result, and improve the test plan, QA checklist and agency process after every round. Speed Is King – move from idea to live test in days, call finished tests on time, ship winners the week they win, and flag a conversion drop the same day. Work Smart – AI and automation first. Use Claude to turn Clarity recordings, reviews and surveys into test ideas and draft test briefs; automate reporting and drop alerts. Overdeliver – catch a conversion problem before anyone asks, bring the cause and the fix, and reuse winning patterns across both brands without being told. If you want a stress-free corporate 9–5 job, this isn't it. If you want to challenge yourself and shape a fast-growing company, work directly with the founder, and play a big role in scaling it to $100M+... If you want to drive results with a group of passionate, smart, hardworking people, in an environment without politics or corporate chicanery, being hands-on and active – then you've come to the right place. Outcomes (what success looks like) 90-day targets for each outcome are agreed with you before your start date. Conversion rate and revenue per visitor rise on both brands – measured weekly by brand (Intelligems, Shopify) Paid-acquisition landing pages and funnels that convert – CVR and RPV per funnel (Intelligems, Northbeam) Continuous improvement across the website – tests live every week; winners shipped AOV and post-purchase upsell take rate rise – AOV (Shopify), upsell take rate (AfterSell) No conversion drop goes unnoticed – drops caught and raised the same day Key Objectives Own the CRO test plan and backlog for both brands, ranked by expected impact, so the biggest wins run first. Build, test and launch paid-acquisition funnels, on-site offers and post-purchase upsells. Brief, QA and launch tests every week – then call results honestly and ship the winners. Drive measurable lifts in conversion rate, AOV and revenue per visitor. Catch conversion drops the same day and bring the cause and the fix. Manage our CRO agency and decide with the Head of Growth when work moves in-house. Report CRO KPIs weekly and run the weekly CRO & Funnels meeting. Requirements Fully remote, full-time Fluent in English CRO Experience: 3–4+ years running CRO programs for Shopify DTC brands is a must. Proof of Results: A record of tests and funnels that lifted CVR, AOV or RPV – with the data to back it up. Funnels: Experience building and testing paid-acquisition funnels and landing pages. Tools: Deep hands-on Intelligems experience, plus AfterSell (or similar), Microsoft Clarity and Shopify analytics. You can set up and QA a test without help. Briefing & Agencies: Experience briefing developers and designers, and managing a CRO agency. Experiment Design: You write clear hypotheses, size tests properly and call results on an agreed significance rule. Offer Sense: You know how bundles, discounts, subscriptions and upsells change conversion, AOV and margin. No issue working overtime or on the weekends if needed. You are passionate about your work. Excellent cultural fit as per …

Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Architecture & Roadmap Development Participate in domain technical and business discussions related to future architecture direction for ICS/OT environments. Assist in the analysis, design, and development of secure infrastructure roadmaps, ensuring alignment between current and future state architectures. Gather and analyze data to deﬁne architectural requirements at the project level. Enforce the ICS/OT security architecture governance model and ensure adherence to standards across project delivery. Design and deploy secure ICS and IT/OT infrastructure solutions, ensuring compliance with IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and ISO27001/27002 standards. Research and evaluate emerging ICS/OT cybersecurity technologies and threat intelligence to enhance project outcomes. Coach and mentor project teams and customer stakeholders on ICS cybersecurity best practices. Cybersecurity in Project Implementation Act as a technical authority in the design and deployment of project infrastructure supporting ICS/OT systems (network segmentation, secure remote access, virtualization, backups, monitoring). Integrate and conﬁgure ICS/OT security tools (ﬁrewalls, intrusion detection, asset inventory, anomaly detection) into customer environments. Conduct vulnerability assessments, compliance checks, and security hardening activities within the scope of project delivery. Ensure all project activities are carried out in compliance with ICS-relevant standards (ISO9001, ISO27001, IEC 62443) and company processes. Translate business and operational requirements into secure technical solutions that strengthen cyber resilience for customer environments. Required Qualiﬁcations Bachelor’s Degree with signiﬁcant professional experience. Proven experience in ICS/OT cybersecurity engineering and implementation projects. Familiarity with applying ICS security frameworks (IEC 62443, NIST CSF, NERC CIP) in projects. System administration: Windows – core competency to install, conﬁgure, manage. Linux administration and security expertise. Network hardware: Cisco enterprise and industrial switches, VLAN, ACL, routing, VPN, and network segmentation for ICS environments. Security management: Enterprise ﬁrewalls (Cisco ASA, Fortinet, Palo Alto, or equivalent) – design, conﬁgure, deploy, with emphasis on OT perimeter defense and secure remote access. Windows / Active Directory Services – install, conﬁgure, manage. Virtualization: VMware vSphere clusters, with experience in HA, DRS, and backup APIs. Storage: Shared NAS/SAN network storage (HP 3PAR/MSA/EVA, EMC DataDomain). Backup Technologies (NetBackup, BackupExec, Veeam, Networker). Knowledge of anti-virus implementations (McAfee EPO, Bitdefender, Microsoft Forefront, etc.). Experience with IPAMs and password management solutions. Experience with monitoring, logging, and SIEM tools (Nagios, Graylog, Splunk, Claroty, Nozomi, Dragos). Strong cybersecurity foundation with demonstrated OT project delivery experience. Desired Characteristics Experience in support/incident management (L1/L2/L3) for ICS/OT security tools, incident response, and vulnerability remediation. Willingness to travel abroad for on-site project delivery (up to 50% of the time or more). Fluent in English. Degree or Diploma in Computer Science or equivalent knowledge or experience. Proven track record of problem analysis, identiﬁcation, and resolution. Excellent communication skills, discipline, accountability, and ﬂexibility in a project-driven environment. Strong understanding of ITIL and change management policies and procedures. Hands-on experience in technical roles within critical infrastructure or industrial environments. Understanding of architecture standards concepts and ability to apply them to project work . items.desc: Location: Bucharest, Ilfov, Romania Job ID: R0145315 Date Posted: 2026-10-13 Company Name: Hitachi Rail Romania Profession (Job Category): Engineering & Science Job Schedule: Full time Remote: No About Us A career at Hitachi Rail will help create a legacy. Job Description: The railway signaling expert will be responsible for the design, development, implementation, and maintenance of advanced railway signaling systems within Hitachi. This role ensures the safety, efficiency, and reliability of rail design through expert application of signaling principles and technologies. Job Responsibilities:** Design and develop innovative railway signaling solutions, including interlocking systems, automatic train control (ATC). Conduct detailed analysis of existing signaling infrastructure and identify areas for improvement and modernization. Prepare technical specifications, design documents for new and upgraded signaling systems. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including software engineers, hardware engineers, and project managers, to integrate signaling solutions with broader railway systems. Provide expert technical support and troubleshooting for signaling system issues during development, deployment, and operational phases. Stay abreast of emerging technologies, industry trends, and regulatory changes in railway signaling. Contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and best practices within Hitachi Participate in client meetings, presentations, and technical discussions to represent Hitachi's signaling expertise. Participate in site surveys and investigations to gather data and assess existing infrastructure. Job Qualifications:** Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Railway Systems Engineering, or a related field. In-depth knowledge of railway signaling principles, standards (e.g., CENELEC, Romanian national rules), and safety regulations. Proven experience with various signaling technologies such as interlocking systems, ATC and ETCS. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a meticulous attention to detail. Excellent communication, interpersonal, and teamwork abilities. Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. Project management exposure in railway infrastructure projects. Thank you for your interest in Hitachi Rail. If your application is of interest, we will be in contact. items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

items.desc: Location Calle Bergara 13 8002 Barcelona Employment Area IT - Infrastructure Level Experienced professionals Working Model Full-time Reference ID 48358 Schwarz Digits creates the technological foundation for digital sovereignty in Europe. As the IT and digital division of the Schwarz Group, we develop and manage the IT infrastructures for the retail divisions Lidl and Kaufland, as well as Schwarz Production and PreZero. At the same time, we operate as an independent provider in the external market to support companies across Europe in their digital transformation. We bundle our core services in the areas of Cloud, Cyber Security, Data & AI, Communication, and Workspace. Join us and contribute to digital sovereignty in Europe. With us, you will work at the intersection of agility and security: You will benefit from fast decision-making processes, enjoy genuine creative freedom in your projects, and be able to build upon the stable foundation of the Schwarz Group. Your Profile "Developer First" Mindset & Sensitivity to Developer Experience (DevEx): Understands that their primary users are dozens of software engineers across internal squads. Listens, understands, discusses, and prioritizes developer needs within product and technical contexts. Designs APIs, boilerplates, and platform solutions focused on reducing cognitive load, abstracting infrastructure complexity, and enabling team autonomy. "Platform Engineering" Vision: Investigates developer pain points across squads and delivers high-value self-service capabilities. Automates platform processes and provides clear, comprehensive documentation. Hands-On Approach & Pragmatism: Delivers practical, value-driven engineering solutions. Enjoys solving real operational bottlenecks while avoiding unnecessary abstractions or over-engineering. Communication & Autonomy: Communicates architectural decisions effectively, leads internal technical workshops, and writes high-quality integration guides. Proactively identifies bottlenecks in developer workflows and tools, implementing quick wins without requiring micromanagement. items.desc: Om Akademikerpoolen Akademikerpoolen är specialiserat på rekrytering, bemanning och uthyrning av akademisk kompetens till olika verksamheter, organisationer och företag. Vi matchar verksamheter med kvalificerade akademiker och konsulter utifrån kompetens, erfarenhet, verksamhetens behov och de förutsättningar som krävs för att skapa en långsiktigt bra matchning. Akademikerpoolen är en del av Beteendegruppen Sverige AB, en koncern med verksamheter inom bland annat kompetensförsörjning, organisationsutveckling, ledarskap och utbildning. Genom vår samlade kompetens har vi ett starkt fokus på människor, beteenden och organisationer, vilket också präglar vårt sätt att arbeta med rekrytering och konsultlösningar. Vi erbjuder kompetens inom ett brett spektrum av akademiska områden och arbetar både med rekrytering och konsultuppdrag. Vårt arbetssätt bygger på att förstå både verksamhetens behov och den kompetens som kandidaten erbjuder. Vi lägger därför stor vikt vid mer än utbildning och tidigare erfarenhet. Genom att förstå kandidatens kompetenser, arbetssätt, drivkrafter och förutsättningar kan vi skapa bättre matchningar mellan människor och organisationer. För dig som akademiker innebär Akademikerpoolen möjligheten att använda din kompetens i olika verksamheter och sammanhang, samtidigt som du får stöd från oss genom processen och under dina uppdrag. Vi har kollektivavtal, vilket ger dig som anställd konsult en trygg grund i din anställning och innebär att dina anställningsvillkor regleras inom ramen för ett kollektivavtal. Tillsammans med vårt stöd genom uppdragen vill vi skapa en trygg och professionell konsultupplevelse. Om jobbet Akademikerpoolen söker en erfaren frontendutvecklare till ett konsultuppdrag hos en kund inom fordonsindustrin. Vi söker dig som vill utveckla moderna, användarvänliga och tillgängliga webbgränssnitt och som trivs med att samarbeta i ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam. I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla och vidareutveckla digitala verktyg som används av kundens ingenjörer världen över. Du har en aktiv roll i att skapa responsiva, säkra och högpresterande användargränssnitt med fokus på användarupplevelse, kvalitet och långsiktig hållbarhet. Du arbetar nära andra utvecklare och kompetenser i teamet, delar med dig av din kunskap och bidrar till gemensamma lösningar. Rollen innebär både självständigt ansvar för komplexa utvecklingsuppgifter och deltagande i teamets löpande arbete, exempelvis testning, underhåll och support. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik, öppen för olika perspektiv och bekväm med att både ge och ta emot återkoppling. Arbetsuppgifter I rollen kommer du bland annat att: Utveckla och underhålla avancerade webbapplikationer med moderna frontendramverk. Bygga responsiva, tillgängliga och användarvänliga gränssnitt med JavaScript, TypeScript, React och/eller Angular. Arbeta med HTML och CSS för att skapa funktionella och högpresterande användargränssnitt. Utveckla och förbättra automatiserade flöden för byggnation, testning och driftsättning med exempelvis Azure och GitHub Actions. Säkerställa att lösningarna uppfyller krav på prestanda, tillgänglighet och säkerhet. Samarbeta med utvecklare och andra kompetenser i ett agilt, tvärfunktionellt team. Delta i tekniska diskussioner, kodgranskning, testning, underhåll och support. Bidra till kunskapsdelning och utveckling av teamets gemensamma arbetssätt. Vem söker vi? Vi söker dig som har minst fem års erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med TypeScript och React och/eller Angular. Du har god förståelse för modern webbutveckling och erfarenhet av att bygga och förvalta komplexa webbapplikationer. Du trivs med att ta ansvar för tekniska lösningar och kan samtidigt anpassa dig efter teamets gemensamma prioriteringar. Du har en akademisk examen inom datavetenskap, mjukvaruutveckling, IT eller ett närliggande område. Du har även erfarenhet av molntjänster, exempelvis Azure eller AWS, och kunskap om hur man utvecklar tillgängliga och prestandaeffektiva webbplatser. Krav: Minst fem års erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med TypeScript och React och/eller Angular. Akademisk examen inom datavetenskap, mjukvaruutveckling, IT eller motsvarande relevant område. Mycket goda kunskaper i JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML och CSS. Erfarenhet av moderna frontendramverk och utveckling av komplexa webbapplikationer. Erfarenhet av molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS. Kunskap om webbtillgänglighet, responsiv design och prestandaoptimering. Förståelse för säker webbutveckling och principer för säkerhet redan i designfasen. Erfarenhet av agila arbetssätt och samarbete i tvärfunktionella utvecklingsteam. Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, både muntligt och skriftligt. Om rollen Som
items.desc: IT-arkitekt till Keolis Bli go-to-personen för hur Keolis bygger morgondagens IT-lösningar! Keolis ansvarar för kollektivtrafik som varje dag förflyttar tusentals människor i Stockholm. Nu stärker vi teamet för Digital Infrastruktur och söker en IT-arkitekt med fokus på lösningsarkitektur, någon som vill knyta ihop helheten och vara med och forma hur vi designar och utvecklar våra lösningar framåt. Om rollen Som IT-arkitekt blir du navet när nya lösningar ska tas fram. Oavsett om det gäller en ny molntjänst, en integration eller en machine learning-modell för bussunderhåll är det du som leder samtalet kring designen: Var ska data bearbetas? Hur ska systemen kommunicera? Vad är mest hållbart utifrån säkerhet, skalbarhet och förvaltningsbarhet? Rollen är bred och tvärfunktionell. Du kommer att stötta leveransansvariga, plattformsingenjörer, utvecklings- och förvaltningsledare och data engineers i olika projekt och initiativ över hela IT. Du äger designen, medan leveransansvariga och plattformsingenjörer ansvarar för implementationen, men du är med hela vägen. Inledningsvis lägger du ungefär 60 % av tiden i projekt, där du hjälper till att bena ut krav och omsätta dem i konkret lösningsdesign, och 40 % på övergripande arkitekturarbete. I början blir fokus framför allt Azure och molnlösningar. På sikt vill vi lyfta blicken ytterligare med arkitekturprinciper, ramverk och en tydligare arkitekturstyrning. Här har du stora möjligheter att sätta din prägel på rollen! Dina ansvarsområden Ta fram lösningsdesign, arkitekturförslag och tekniska specifikationer för nya eller förändrade tjänster och system. Översätta verksamhetens behov och krav till tekniska lösningar med tydliga komponenter, dataflöden och integrationer. Designa hur system och plattformar ska kommunicera, inklusive API:er, datamodeller och informationsflöden i samråd med integrationsteamet. Ge teknisk rådgivning i projekt och stötta projektledare, team och beslutsfattare kring teknikval och lösningsdesign. Säkerställa att lösningar följer våra arkitekturprinciper, standarder samt säkerhets- och compliancekrav. Kartlägga verksamhetens förmågor mot befintliga system, identifiera gap och bidra till teknisk roadmap och kostnadsbedömningar. Vi söker dig som Har eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT eller annan relevant inriktning, gärna på universitetsnivå. Har 1–2 års erfarenhet av lösningsarkitekturarbete, formellt eller informellt. Har en teknisk bakgrund från en hands on-roll, till exempel inom plattform, cloud, infrastruktur eller utveckling. Har erfarenhet av molnmiljöer, helst Azure. Har du främst arbetat med AWS är du också välkommen, så länge du är nyfiken på Azure. Har god förståelse för hur integrationer, API:er och dataflöden hänger ihop Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från en konsult- eller leverantörsroll där du arbetat med rådgivning och implementation hos kund, kännedom om arkitekturramverk såsom Well-Architected Framework eller TOGAF, samt erfarenhet av dataplattformar, microservices eller machine learning ur ett arkitekturperspektiv. Vem är du? Du är nyfiken, kontaktsökande och initiativtagande. Du drivs av att förstå verksamheten och trivs med att röra dig mellan detalj och helhet och är den som ställer frågan ”har vi tänkt på det här?”. Du tycker om att få med alla på banan kring en lösning. Varför Keolis? Hos oss får du komma in i ett team med högt i tak, familjär kultur och stort utrymme att påverka. Här designar du inte bara en lösning för att sedan lämna över, du är med i helheten, från idé till genomförande, och får se resultatet av det du varit med och format. Vi befinner oss i en spännande fas där vi moderniserar vår infrastruktur och blickar framåt mot en ny tech-strategi, och rollen är ny i sin nuvarande form, vilket ger dig goda möjligheter att forma den. Placering Rollen är placerad på vårt huvudkontor på Kungsholmen i Stockholm. Vi arbetar hybrid och ser att du har möjlighet att vara på plats tre dagar i veckan. Ansökan Du ansöker genom att skicka in ditt CV. Personligt brev behövs inte. I urvalsprocessen använder vi arbetspsykologiska tester. Tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningstiden gått ut. Observera att tjänsten omfattas av en bakgrundskontroll som genomförs i slutskedet av rekryteringsprocessen efter ditt godkännande.

Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common.
