items.desc: The Department of Information Technology holds a leading position in both research and education at all levels. We are currently Uppsala University's third largest department, have around 350 employees, including 120 teachers and120 PhD students. Approximately 5,000 undergraduate students take one or more courses at the department each year. You can find more information about us on the Department of Information Technology website. We are now looking for students who would like to work as teaching assistants for period 3 and 4. Duties Participation in teaching in any of the courses listed below. Participation in teaching means, for example, participation in labs and tutorials/lessons, grading of assignments, answering students' questions, and supervision of student projects. Courses marked SVE are taught in Swedish and courses marked ENG are taught in English. The application is received via the Uppsala University's recruitment system. If you have specific questions regarding a course, please contact Niklas Wahlström. Period 3: 1RT317 Systems Analysis and Operations Research (SVE) 1RT485 Introduction to Computer Control Systems (ENG) 1RT490 Automatic Control I (SVE) 1RT700 Statistical Machine Learning (ENG) 1RT720 Deep Learning (ENG) Period 4: 1RT004 Safety and Security in Control systems (ENG) 1RT155 Modelling of Dynamic Systems (SVE) 1RT490 Automatic Control I (SVE) 1RT495 Automatic Control II (ENG) 1RT745 Reinforcement Learning (ENG) ( Note that the course 1RT490 is given in both period 3 and 4. Priority can be given to applicants who are able to teach in both periods ). If you haven’t been a teaching assistant before, the duties also include a mandatory introduction day. Requirements For employment as a teaching assistant, it is a requirement that you are admitted as a student at undergraduate or advanced level. Employment as a student assistant is regulated by the Higher Education Ordinance, Chapter 5. The applicant must show good study results, especially in the area of the course the applicant will assist with, as well as very good knowledge of Swedish (only for courses taught in Swedish) and good English communication skills, both spoken and written. Additional qualifications Previous experience from participating in teaching in courses at university level is particularly meritorious. Experience with relevant IT systems (Studium) is desirable as well as good knowledge of Uppsala University's organization. Application procedure The application must contain a letter in which the applicant briefly describes his / her experience in teaching, language and knowledge (e.g., study certificate). The application must also contain which courses the applicant is interested in and an estimate of the number of hours he/she wants to work (per course and period, and where the number of hours must be 30, 45, 60, 90 or 120). Also attach your transcript. About the employment The employment is a temporary position, until 4 April 2027 or 20 June 2027 depending on what period(s) you work, according to the Higher Education Ordinance chapter 5 § 12. Scope of employment is between 3 and 50 %. Starting date 4 January 2027 or 8 March 2027 or as agreed. Placement: Uppsala. For further information about the position, please contact: Niklas Wahlström (niklas.wahlstrom@it.uu.se) or Davide Vega D'aurelio (ugarekrytering-it@uu.se) . Please submit your application by the 26th of October 2026, UFV-PA 2026/3071. Are you considering moving to Sweden to work at Uppsala University? Find out more about what it´s like to work and live in Sweden. Uppsala University is a broad research university with a strong international position. The ultimate goal is to conduct education and research of the highest quality and relevance to make a difference in society. Our most important asset is all of our 7,500 employees and 53,000 students who, with curiosity and commitment, make Uppsala University one of Sweden’s most exciting workplaces. Read more about our benefits and what it is like to work at Uppsala Universityhttps://uu.se/om-uu/jobba-hos-oss/ The position may be subject to security vetting. If security vetting is conducted, the applicant must pass the vetting process to be eligible for employment. Please do not send offers of recruitment or advertising services. Submit your application through Uppsala University's recruitment system. items.desc: Job Title Linux Specialist, Lund Job Description Do you want to own infrastructure that powers both our IT environment and our product manufacturing? As our new Linux Specialist, you'll combine hands-on engineering with real technical ownership in a senior role, helping shape the platforms that keep Axis running securely and efficiently at our headquarters in Lund. Your future team You'll join IT OS Infrastructure Services, part of IT Infrastructure and Operations, and report to the Manager, IT OS Infrastructure Services. Our mission is to provide a stable, secure, and high-performing Windows and Linux environment that is the backbone of productivity at Axis. We balance technical innovation with a smooth user experience across platforms, so that every employee can work efficiently and securely, whatever their technical needs or location. We create value by automating processes, keeping operational disruptions to a minimum, and staying ahead of how the digital workplace is changing. What you'll do as Linux Specialist Our platforms support both our enterprise IT services and the infrastructure behind our manufacturing environment. Keeping them robust is key to delivering the quality Axis is known for. In this role, you'll: Develop and maintain secure, resilient Linux-based platforms that support Axis' IT environment and product manufacturing Take technical ownership of key security and infrastructure services, including certificate and secrets management, cryptographic infrastructure and DNS Build and improve automation using infrastructure as code and Git-based workflows, with tools such as GitHub Actions and Ansible/AWX Evaluate new technologies and solutions, and shape the architecture of our platforms Plan lifecycle management so our platforms stay current and fit for purpose Work closely with operations teams to make sure solutions are well documented and supported Who you are You're an experienced Linux infrastructure professional who combines deep technical knowledge with a broad understanding of what it takes to run stable operations. You're curious and motivated by solving complex technical challenges. You take ownership and drive improvements, with a genuine interest in standardization, automation, and modern infrastructure practices. You're structured and self-driven, yet collaborative, and you enjoy sharing what you know and helping both people and platforms grow. We'd love to hear that you have: Solid experience of Linux infrastructure and administration in enterprise environments Experience designing and managing secure, highly available infrastructure platforms Hands-on experience with automation, infrastructure as code and version-controlled workflows, including strong scripting skills Professional working proficiency in Swedish and English, spoken and written Bonus points for: Experience with security infrastructure, such as certificate and secrets management, cryptographic infrastructure or DNS What Axis has to offer We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact. Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide. As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance. Our Lund HQ Campus, including the impressive Grenden building, offers a dynamic environment with spaces crafted to encourage collaboration, whether through informal “fika” chats, formal meetings, or after-hours activities. Check it out: Axis HQ Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle. To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore: Axis Career Hub Life at Axis blog Engineering at Axis blog Innovation at Axis Ready to Act? Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications. We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today! Do you have any questions about the role? Contact Johanna Sprimont , Manager IT OS Infrastructure Services, at johanna.sprimont@axis.com Type of Employment Permanent Employment Posting End Date 2026-10-27 Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments. Notice will be provided before we take any action. About Axis Communications We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. items.desc: På Migrationsverket arbetar vi med en av vår tids stora samhällsfrågor – migrationen. Totalt är vi cirka 6 000 personer här, och vi har ett ovanligt viktigt jobb! Vi söker just nu systemutvecklare som vill arbeta i ett möjliggörande plattformsteam där fokus ligger på att bygga robusta tekniska lösningar och ge andra utvecklingsteam rätt förutsättningar att lyckas. Låter det intressant? Då hoppas vi att du läser vidare. Migrationsverket genomför just nu en långsiktig förflyttning från en högt integrerad arkitektur till en mer löst kopplad och skalbar arkitektur. Ditt uppdrag blir att vara en del av ett team som, tillsammans med övriga utvecklingsteam, driver denna transformation framåt – mot ett mer flexibelt, modernt och effektivt sätt att utveckla system och tjänster. Som kollega på Migrationsverket får du arbeta i en tekniskt utmanande miljö där vi kontinuerligt förbättrar våra lösningar och arbetssätt. Här kombineras samhällsnytta med modern systemutveckling – du bidrar till lösningar som gör verklig skillnad, samtidigt som du har en trygg och stabil anställning. Vad gör en systemutvecklare på Migrationsverket? Som systemutvecklare hos oss blir du en del av ett plattformsteam som arbetar tätt tillsammans med andra utvecklingsteam. Vi jobbar med hög grad av autonomi i teamen, moderna tekniker och ett kontinuerligt fokus på att leverera värde. Vi lägger stor vikt vid en stark teamkultur – vi delar kunskap, lär av varandra och värdesätter olika perspektiv. Vi arbetar agilt med stort fokus på automatisering och rör oss mot en löst kopplad, eventbaserad arkitektur. Just nu bygger vi också upp en modern, cloud native-plattform baserad på Kubernetes och Docker. Du kommer att, tillsammans med dina nya kollegor: utveckla verktyg, tekniker och ramverk som förenklar och effektiviserar utvecklingsarbetet – både för er själva och andra team skapa tekniska förutsättningar för stabila och kontinuerliga leveranser arbeta med test som en naturlig del av utvecklingsprocessen samarbeta nära teamens användare, förvaltning samt drift- och supportorganisation Vi har ett starkt fokus på ständiga förbättringar – både i hur vi arbetar och i det vi bygger. Här finns goda möjligheter att påverka tekniska val, arbetssätt och riktning. Du blir en del av en organisation där tekniska utmaningar möter samhällsviktiga behov – och där din kompetens gör konkret skillnad. Läs mer om att jobba med IT hos oss: Jobba med it Vem är du? Du trivs i team där samarbete är centralt och där man gemensamt tar ansvar för leveransen. Du är trygg i din kompetens, har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och ett starkt kvalitetstänk – både i din egen kod och i teamets leverans. Du har förmåga att se helheten, förstå olika behov och bidra till lösningar som fungerar i ett större sammanhang. Du som söker har högskole- eller universitetsstudier inom datavetenskap, programvaruteknik eller datateknik med kandidat- eller masterexamen, alternativt motsvarande erfarenhet minst 2 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling god kommunikativ förmåga och kan uttrycka dig väl i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet, särskilt din samarbetsförmåga, ansvarstagande och ditt omdöme i komplexa tekniska miljöer. Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med löst kopplade arkitekturer erfarenhet av event streaming, exempelvis Kafka erfarenhet av mikrotjänster och mikrotjänstarkitektur kunskap inom utveckling av plattformsprodukter och utvecklingsverktyg erfarenhet av containerplattformar (Kubernetes/Docker) erfarenhet av DevOps och agila arbetssätt erfarenhet av CI/CD Upplysningar Anställningsform: Tillsvidare Arbetstider: Kontorstider Placering: Linköping, viss flexibilitet mellan Migrationsverkets orter kan förekomma Möjlighet till distansarbete: Ja, delvis utifrån verksamhetens behov Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse Förmåner & villkor: Läs om våra anställningsförmåner här. Sista ansökningsdatum: Vi gör urval löpande men vill ha din ansökan senast den 25 Oktober 2026 Vill du veta mer Vill du veta mer om rollen och enheten finns kontaktuppgifter till ansvarig enhetschef längre ned. _________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Om rekryteringsprocessen För oss är det viktigt att all kompetens på arbetsmarknaden tillvaratas. Vi välkomnar därför alla sökande och strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och mångfald. Som statlig myndighet rekryterar vi efter förtjänst och skicklighet. På arbetsgivarverket.se kan du läsa mer om vad det innebär. Du behöver inte bifoga något personligt brev med din ansökan, men vi önskar att du svarar så tydlig ochutförligt som möjligt på urvalsfrågorna för att vi ska kunna göra en rättvis bedömning av din erfarenhet om du är kvalificerad att gå vidare i rekryteringen eller inte. I vissa rekryteringar använder vi också tester för att bedöma hur väl din skicklighet stämmer överens med tjänsten du söker. Vid en eventuell intervju kan du även få svara på …

items.desc: Vill du vara med och bygga system som gör skillnad – för elever, lärare och hela det svenska skolväsendet? Vi söker dig som är en erfaren och kvalitetsmedveten systemutvecklare, som trivs med teamarbete och vill ta ett helhetsansvar för lösningar - från analys och design till implementation, drift och vidareutveckling Hos oss arbetar du nära både teknik och verksamhet, i ett erfaret team där kvalitet, ansvar och långsiktighet är centralt. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid! Om jobbet I den här rollen är du del av ett tvärfunktionellt utvecklingsteam som utvecklar och förvaltar mjukvarusystem som stöttar Skolverket i arbetet med att utveckla och stödja skolväsendet. Det handlar både om system som används internt av Skolverkets medarbetare och om system som används externt av användargrupper som lärare, elever och skolpersonal runt om i Sverige. Systemen hanterar stora informationsmängder och är verksamhetskritiska, vilket ställer höga krav på stabilitet, tydlig struktur och genomtänkta lösningar. Arbetet innebär att du ofta behöver sätta dig in i befintliga lösningar, förstå hur de fungerar i praktiken och stegvis förbättra dem med fokus på kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet. Teamet arbetar enligt agila principer med fokus på samarbete, leverans och kontinuerlig förbättring. I teamet finns alla kompetenser som behövs för att ta ett tvärfunktionellt ansvar: utvecklare, testare, UX:are, produktägare och Scrum Master. I rollen kommer du bland annat att: bygga backendtjänster och REST-API:er i Java och Spring Boot, bygga användargränssnitt och e-tjänster i Angular, arbeta genom hela livscykeln: analys, implementation, test, drift och förbättring, driftsätta, övervaka och felsöka applikationer i OpenShift/Kubernetes med hjälp av OCI-containers, analysera och förbättra prestanda, stabilitet och kodkvalitet, bidra till DevOps-kulturen genom att utveckla teamets automatiseringar och byggprocesser, samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omsätta dessa i tekniska lösningar. Som systemutvecklare hos oss är du med och utvecklar digitala lösningar som bidrar till att stärka och utveckla Sveriges utbildningssystem. Du arbetar främst med kärnområdena ”skol- och utbildningsdata” och ”skolutveckling”. I skol- och utbildningsdata ingår bland annat system som hanterar stora datamängder och analys, exempelvis information om utbildningstillfällen, skolenheter och skolstatistik. I området skolutveckling ingår system som stödjer skolors utveckling genom fortbildning av skolpersonal samt stödsystem för att utveckla skolors kvalitetsarbete. * * * * * "Som en del i vårt team får du arbeta tillsammans med ett engagerat gäng som utvecklar samhällsviktiga system och tjänster för skolväsendet på nationell nivå." Robert Modén, enhetschef * * * * * Du arbetar på vårt moderna och rymliga kontor i Solna Business Park. Du kan också ha möjlighet att arbeta upp till 50% på distans. Om dig För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb I det här jobbet ska du ha akademisk utbildning inom systemutveckling, datateknik alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som vi bedömer som relevant, flerårig erfarenhet av systemutveckling av webbaserade system och webbtjänster i produktion, erfarenhet av både backend- och frontendutveckling (fullstack), mycket god erfarenhet av Javautveckling i Spring Boot och Spring Framework, erfarenhet av frontendutveckling med Angular eller motsvarande ramverk, erfarenhet av SQL och relationsdatabaser, exempelvis PostgreSQL, erfarenhet av utveckling och dokumentation av REST-API:er, erfarenhet av versionshantering med Git, erfarenhet av CI/CD samt erfarenhet av automatiserade bygg- och integrationsprocesser, erfarenhet av containerbaserade lösningar såsom Kubernetes eller OpenShift, erfarenhet av testautomatisering, goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska. Jobbeskrivning Vi söker nu en Kravanalytiker som vill vara med och skapa verklig förändring hos våra kunder inom bland annat offentlig sektor, energi och försvarsindustrin. I rollen ansvarar du för att fånga, analysera och dokumentera både funktionella och icke-funktionella krav genom exempelvis workshops, användarintervjuer, observationer och dokumentstudier. Du säkerställer att kraven är tydligt formulerade, utvecklingsbara och testbara samt bryter ned dem i hanterbara och värdeskapande leveranser med definierade acceptanskriterier. Arbetet sker i nära samarbete med användare, produktägare, verksamhetsexperter, arkitekter och utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa att kraven är tydliga, prioriterade, förankrade och väl förstådda av samtliga intressenter. Du ansvarar även för att upprätthålla spårbarhet genom hela utvecklingskedjan och säkerställa att krav kommuniceras och förankras mellan olika kravställare och intressentgrupper. Vidare bidrar du till kontinuerlig utveckling av teamets arbetssätt, dokumentation och kravprocesser. Du stödjer test- och kvalitetssäkringsarbetet genom kravvalidering och granskning av testfall samt fungerar som ett metodstöd inom kravhantering för verksamhetsspecialister och andra kravställare. Rollen innefattar även att utforma och vidareutveckla arbetsprocesser för mottagande organisation för att säkerställa effektiva och hållbara arbetssätt. Du kommer att ingå i ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som idag består av kravanalytiker, scrum master, systemutvecklare och testare. items.desc: Nordic Investin is recruiting a Junior Power BI and Fabric Developer on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve. You will take responsibility for work that connects Power BI, DAX and Microsoft Fabric, while ensuring that SQL and data visualisation receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate. The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design. How you will work You will work with engineers, analysts and domain specialists who look at the same information from different angles. The partner expects assumptions, datasets and evaluation methods to be visible. Solutions should be designed for repeatable delivery, monitored use and responsible change after deployment. This role calls for strong foundations, curiosity and the discipline to learn quickly. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process. What you will do Own the practical direction for self-service reporting built on governed data products. Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for Power BI and DAX. Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around Microsoft Fabric. Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting SQL. Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve data visualisation. Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team. What you will bring Relevant experience delivering self-service reporting built on governed data products in a demanding environment. Strong working knowledge of Power BI and DAX. Practical experience applying Microsoft Fabric and SQL. Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving data visualisation. Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership. Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information. Experience that would add value Experience from finance, sales or operational analytics teams. Exposure to stakeholder discovery in a cross-functional environment. Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations. A background that can succeed here Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of self-service reporting built on governed data products is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement. What makes the opportunity interesting The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on self-service reporting built on governed data products gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you. items.card: About the role: The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. You'll design and implement data quality frameworks across our Databricks and dbt environment. This includes
items.desc: As a Data Engineer focused on data quality in NOBA Bank Group, you'll make sure the data our bank relies on is accurate, consistent and trusted. You'll build the checks, tests and monitoring that catch problems early, and work with teams across the bank to fix them at the source. About the role: The Data & Analytics Engineering department brings together specialists in data infrastructure, analytics, and data management. Together we build a modern and reliable data foundation that supports decision making across the business. This role is in the Data Management & New Initiatives team. You'll design and implement data quality frameworks across our Databricks and dbt environment. This includes automated testing, validation rules, anomaly detection, and monitoring of data quality metrics. You'll partner with data owners, analysts, and engineers to define what "good data" means for each domain. You'll investigate quality issues, find root causes, and drive lasting fixes rather than quick patches. We use AI extensively in our daily work, from writing and reviewing code to documentation and analysis. You'll be encouraged to use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and to help us find new ways to apply them. This is a great opportunity to enjoy a high degree of self-responsibility and to expand your expertise into areas of your interest. You'll collaborate broadly and see the tangible results of your work. We offer a hybrid working model with two common in-office days. While we value flexibility, we also prioritize collaboration, team building, and enjoying fikas and after work gatherings together! Main tasks: Design and implement data quality checks and automated tests in Databricks and dbt pipelines Define, measure, and report on data quality metrics together with data owners and stakeholders Build monitoring and alerting to detect anomalies, schema changes, and freshness or completeness issues Investigate data quality incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement lasting fixes Contribute to data governance work such as data contracts, lineage, and documentation Use version control and CI/CD to integrate quality checks into the development workflow Use AI tools to speed up development, testing, and documentation, and explore how AI can support anomaly detection and quality monitoring Ensure security and compliance throughout the data lifecycle, in line with banking requirements Document processes and contribute to best practices We are looking for you who: Takes pride in data that people can trust. You have a sharp eye for detail and a curious, investigative mindset, and you enjoy digging into why something looks wrong and making sure it doesn't happen again. You're proactive and collaborative, you communicate clearly with both technical and business colleagues, and you approach challenges with a "can-do" mindset. You value a high degree of self-responsibility and are motivated to grow in the areas that interest you. You're open to using AI as part of how you work and stay curious about how it changes modern data engineering. items.desc: Nordic Investin is recruiting a Junior Threat Intelligence Analyst on behalf of one of our partner companies. You want architecture, delivery and production behaviour to agree, and you turn difficult constraints into systems that teams can operate and improve. The partner is strengthening its capability in actionable threat intelligence for security operations and risk teams. You will take responsibility for work that connects OSINT, threat frameworks and indicator analysis, while ensuring that reporting and scripting receive appropriate discipline. The objective is progress that colleagues can use and leaders can evaluate. The environment suits someone who tests assumptions early, documents trade-offs and treats operability as part of the design. How you will work You will work directly with the people who design, operate and depend on the systems being protected. Recommendations must identify the threat, the affected asset and a realistic implementation path. The partner values careful evidence, proportionate controls and clear escalation when risk cannot be removed immediately. This role calls for strong foundations, curiosity and the discipline to learn quickly. You will be expected to recognise when a decision needs wider expertise, make trade-offs visible and move work forward without creating unnecessary process. What you will do Own the practical direction for actionable threat intelligence for security operations and risk teams. Translate goals and constraints into a clear approach for OSINT and threat frameworks. Establish useful standards, routines or artefacts around indicator analysis. Coordinate stakeholders and dependencies affecting reporting. Use evidence and measurable outcomes to improve scripting. Strengthen knowledge sharing, decision quality and sustainable ownership across the team. What you will bring Relevant experience delivering actionable threat intelligence for security operations and risk teams in a demanding environment. Strong working knowledge of OSINT and threat frameworks. Practical experience applying indicator analysis and reporting. Ability to assess risk, priorities and trade-offs involving scripting. Evidence of clear stakeholder communication and dependable end-to-end ownership. Professional English and the judgement to work with sensitive or business-critical information. Experience that would add value Experience from security operations centres or managed security services. Exposure to case management in a cross-functional environment. Swedish language skills or experience working across Nordic organisations. A background that can succeed here Your background may be product engineering, platform work, enterprise technology or consulting. What matters is technical depth connected to user and business consequences. Direct experience of actionable threat intelligence for security operations and risk teams is valuable, while adjacent experience counts when it shows transferable judgement. What makes the opportunity interesting The attraction is meaningful ownership in an environment where sound judgement changes both the solution and the decisions around it. The focus on actionable threat intelligence for security operations and risk teams gives the role a clear mission and room to influence priorities and measures of success. The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the opportunity before asking you to make a decision. The recruitment conversation Nordic Investin will focus on decisions you have made: the context, alternatives, result and what you would change today. You will also have room to test whether the role and partner environment are right for you. How to apply Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note about a relevant system, platform or technical change you improved. Nordic Investin welcomes different routes into the profession and assesses evidence, judgement and potential alongside titles.

items.desc: About the role Imagine this. You're studying at Politecnico di Milano, building the skills to solve complex engineering challenges. Now imagine taking that knowledge beyond the classroom and applying it to real aerospace technologies, autonomous flight systems, and next-generation UAVs. At Destinus, we're looking to connect with ambitious Polimi students and graduates who want to turn ideas into real-world engineering solutions. Whether your interests lie in aerospace, robotics, artificial intelligence, propulsion, software, or mechanical design, you'll have the opportunity to explore how your skills can contribute to technologies pushing the boundaries of modern aviation and defense. Your academic experience has taught you to think critically, solve problems, and challenge conventional approaches. At Destinus, you'll see how those skills translate into real engineering projects, from early-stage development and simulation to prototyping, integration, and testing. What you’ll get the chance to do Apply your engineering knowledge from Politecnico di Milano to real aerospace and defense challenges. Contribute to the development of advanced UAV systems, including autonomy, guidance, control, propulsion, and mechanical design. Explore the full engineering process, from modelling and simulation to prototyping, testing, and validation. Work with technologies involving robotics, embedded systems, software development, artificial intelligence, or advanced manufacturing. Collaborate with experienced engineers across different disciplines and international teams. Bring fresh ideas, university projects, research experience, and technical curiosity into real engineering applications. Discover opportunities for internships, thesis projects, graduate positions, and early-career engineering roles. Requirements You’ll shine if you Currently studying at or recently graduated from Politecnico di Milano, ideally in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Automation and Control Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or related technical fields. A solid academic foundation in areas such as modelling, simulation, programming, control systems, system design, or mechanical engineering. An interest in aerospace technologies, autonomous systems, and real-world engineering applications. Curiosity to understand how complex systems work and the motivation to turn theoretical knowledge into practical solutions. Confidence working in English within an international environment. Experience with academic projects, student engineering teams, research activities, or personal technical projects is a plus. Who You Are You're curious, ambitious, and excited by engineering challenges that go beyond textbooks. You enjoy understanding how things work, experimenting with new ideas, and finding practical solutions to complex problems. Whether you're searching for an internship, a thesis opportunity, or your first professional role, you're ready to learn, contribute, and grow alongside engineers developing the next generation of autonomous flight technologies. You don't just want to study the future of aerospace. You want to help build it.

items.card: In this role as a Field Engineer at SKAN, you will be part of a great team with a strong sense of camaraderie that handles the maintenance, qualification, and calibration of our systems in the field. The range of systems spans from older models to state-of-the-art filling lines. Both the training provided by our SKAN Academy and your several years of professional experience as a Field Engineer will help you quickly
items.desc: Founded in 1968, SKAN is a pioneer in cleanroom equipment and the development of isolators for the pharmaceutical industry. Innovative products, tailor-made solutions and an effective service organization have made SKAN a market leader and a key partner to industry and research laboratories. Overview In this role as a Field Engineer at SKAN, you will be part of a great team with a strong sense of camaraderie that handles the maintenance, qualification, and calibration of our systems in the field. The range of systems spans from older models to state-of-the-art filling lines. Both the training provided by our SKAN Academy and your several years of professional experience as a Field Engineer will help you quickly find your footing in our environment. With a high degree of travel within Europe, you can expect exciting challenges, new cultures, and the opportunity to apply your expertise on an international scale. Assignments are on a weekly basis (Mon–Fri) and sometimes span two to three weeks. This position requires a high degree of flexibility in terms of time and a willingness to travel. Service assignments throughout Europe are scheduled according to customer needs and are subject to change on short notice. You must be willing to adapt flexibly to varying work schedules, travel durations, and last-minute schedule changes. Responsibilities Performing maintenance on our systems Qualification, re-qualification, and inspection of SKAN systems and products in the pharmaceutical sector GMP-compliant documentation of test reports Calibration and adjustment of sensors Filter integrity testing and ventilation qualification Replacement and repair of components as well as troubleshooting and repair services for isolators Hardskills Basic technical training and/or a higher technical degree (mechanical engineering, mechatronics, polymechanics, or similar) Several years of experience in a service engineering environment are highly advantageous Experience in a GMP environment or in the field of isolator technology is highly desirable but not required Very good English skills are required; knowledge of German is an advantage Due to travel requirements, residence in the Basel/Allschwil area or a willingness to relocate there is recommended Softskills Enjoy working in a team Precise and meticulous work style High level of personal responsibility Significant flexibility with regard to schedule and a strong willingness to adapt to last-minute changes in work assignments, as well as a high degree of flexibility regarding travel times, duration of assignments, and client assignments scheduled on short notice High flexibility due to occasional last-minute changes in the work schedule Confident and professional demeanor when interacting with customers Willingness to travel throughout Europe 75%–85% of the time We offer you An open and collaborative corporate culture Freedom to contribute and develop ideas Opportunities to participate in sports and social activities Professional development and continuous learning opportunities, especially at our SKAN Academy Comprehensive and career-focused onboarding Quick decision-making paths and flat hierarchies Transparent and open communication 5 weeks of vacation, with the option to take additional leave Additional information We look forward to receiving your complete application documents (CV, diplomas and employment references) via our career page. For this position, we are focusing on direct applications and are not working with external agencies. Any dossiers submitted by agencies will not be processed. For questions please contact Viviane Braxton.

items.desc: Join Tether and Shape the Future of Digital Finance At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains. By harnessing the power of blockchain technology, Tether enables you to store, send, and receive digital tokens instantly, securely, and globally, all at a fraction of the cost. Transparency is the bedrock of everything we do, ensuring trust in every transaction. Innovate with Tether Tether Finance: Our innovative product suite features the world’s most trusted stablecoin, USDT , relied upon by hundreds of millions worldwide, alongside pioneering digital asset tokenization services. But that’s just the beginning: Tether Power: Driving sustainable growth, our energy solutions optimize excess power for Bitcoin mining using eco-friendly practices in state-of-the-art, geo-diverse facilities. Tether Data: Fueling breakthroughs in AI and peer-to-peer technology, we reduce infrastructure costs and enhance global communications with cutting-edge solutions like KEET , our flagship app that redefines secure and private data sharing. Tether Education : Democratizing access to top-tier digital learning, we empower individuals to thrive in the digital and gig economies, driving global growth and opportunity. Tether Evolution : At the intersection of technology and human potential, we are pushing the boundaries of what is possible, crafting a future where innovation and human capabilities merge in powerful, unprecedented ways. Why Join Us? Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards. We’ve grown fast, stayed lean, and secured our place as a leader in the industry. If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you. Are you ready to be part of the future? About the job Our pioneering P2P development platform, built on our open-source technology stack, Pear, eliminates the need for traditional server infrastructure. Pear platform facilitates direct deployment of applications from the developer’s machine to the user, enabling seamless scalability and performance. By leveraging Node.js-based technology akin to BitTorrent, we create robust peer-to-peer connections and data replication systems that set the foundation for a decentralized web. Learn more about Pear: docs.pears.com Keet, our flagship P2P communications app, is the first step towards this new era. It exemplifies the potential of P2P technology in everyday applications, from messaging and file sharing to complex collaborative environments, all while maintaining user sovereignty over personal data. Learn more about Keet: keet.io Responsibilities In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining Keet Desktop, our cross-platform P2P communications application built with React and running on the Pear runtime. You'll work on everything from UI/UX implementation to performance optimization, helping shape the future of decentralized communication. Proven experience with React/Preact and modern JavaScript/TypeScript in production-scale applications. Strong competency in state management (Redux, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, or similar). Ability to write modular, maintainable, and well tested code. Solid skillset in testing & debugging complex frontend applications. Deep interest or experience with P2P technologies or distributed systems. Comfort working in a remote, globally distributed team; good communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with desktop application development (Electron, Tauri, or similar runtimes). Familiarity with video/audio APIs (WebRTC, media streams) and real-time communication. Demonstrated ability to optimize UI performance: rendering, memory management. Experience building cross platform applications (macOS, Windows, Linux, etc). Bonus: Past contributions to OSS projects, especially in P2P or decentralized tech. Important information for candidates Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles: Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/ Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website. Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. …

You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. items.desc: Who We Are Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a Swiss data and AI consulting company helping organisations in traditional industries solve complex challenges in areas such as operations, finance, manufacturing and R&D. We work at the intersection of technology and business, delivering data and AI solutions that create practical value for our clients. Our teams have delivered projects across industries including automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We are a Palantir partner and work with clients across the full data and AI journey, from understanding a business problem to building and deploying the solution. Unit8 has delivered more than 300 projects and grown to a team of 190+ talented people across ten office locations. Following our growth across Europe and our expansion into North America, we are now building our presence in the United Arab Emirates. We are looking for a Palantir Foundry Engineer to join us in Abu Dhabi. This role is based in the UAE and includes relocation from Switzerland with full immigration and relocation support. Requirements About the Role As one of the first members of Unit8’s team in the UAE, you will help deliver Foundry solutions for clients while contributing to the growth of our presence in the region. You will work directly with client teams to understand their data and operational challenges, then design and build solutions that address them. The role combines hands-on engineering with close collaboration across business and technical teams. You will also contribute your technical perspective during early client discussions and help shape practical approaches to new opportunities. What You’ll Do Design, build, deploy and maintain data solutions using Palantir Foundry. Develop and troubleshoot data pipelines and processing systems using Foundry and relevant open-source or proprietary technologies. Build and maintain Foundry components such as Ontologies, pipelines, and user-facing applications. Apply sound engineering practices for testing, data quality, performance, security and maintainability. Work with client stakeholders to understand requirements, clarify problems and translate business needs into technical solutions. Collaborate with engineers, data scientists, product owners and client teams in an agile environment. Contribute to technical discovery and solution scoping for prospective and ongoing engagements. Help establish Unit8’s engineering and delivery approach in the UAE, sharing knowledge with colleagues and supporting the growth of the local team. About You We are looking for an experienced Palantir Foundry Engineer with a passion for data and solving complex client challenges. You should be a skilled professional who has: Foundry Platform Knowledge Demonstrated experience with AIP, Workshop, Code repository, and Pipeline Builder . A solid understanding of security concepts within Foundry, including restricted views and markings. Knowledge of Ontology and Data connection . We're interested in the technical details of what you've built and how you approached the architecture of your Foundry use-cases. Programming Skills - proficiency in Python and PySpark . Data Skills (Nice-to-have) - knowledge of data modeling and basic concepts of data science (classification, clustering, regression). Professional Experience A minimum of 1 year of experience working with the Foundry platform, ideally within a larger company where you may have had a focused but deep exposure. Strong client-facing skills: You are comfortable interacting with both business and technical clients, giving presentations, and possess a strong problem-solving mindset. Other You are willing to travel to meet with our clients and the team Benefits What We Offer The opportunity to help establish Unit8’s presence in a new market. Hands-on work on client challenges with tangible business impact. Exposure to different industries, projects and technologies. A collaborative team environment with colleagues across Switzerland, Europe and North America. Mentorship and opportunities to develop your technical and consulting skills. Full immigration support for your move to the UAE. Relocation support, including accommodation and travel allowances. Opportunities to contribute to knowledge sharing and projects with a positive impact.

You will support formulation development, material preparation, spray trials, prototype production and preliminary laboratory testing. Ability to work independently as well as part of a small multidisciplinary team. Desirable experience: Polymer or formulation development. Biomaterials or medical materials. Coatings or spray technology. Microscopy or mechanical testing. Sample preparation and laboratory analysis. R&D or product development environments. At Unifeye you’ll be trusted to take ownership from day one, challenge conventional thinking and make a genuine impact on clients and on the growth of the business. The Role We’re looking for a Data Engineer with a background in application or web development to join our delivery team. You’ll help build data platforms and, importantly, applications on Databricks, including Databricks Apps that put data and AI directly in the hands of business users. This role suits someone who started out building software (web apps, front end, full stack or similar) and has moved, or is moving, into data engineering. If you think like a builder and enjoy turning ideas into real, usable products, your development background will be a real advantage here. You don’t need previous Databricks experience. We’ll support you with training and certification. What You’ll Do Help design and build applications on Databricks, including Databricks Apps, that bring data and AI to end users. Build and maintain data pipelines using Spark, PySpark and SQL. Work with Lakehouse architectures using Delta Lake and Medallion (Bronze, Silver, Gold) design principles. Develop integrations and ingestion from APIs, files and other data sources. Apply good engineering practice to data work: testing, version control, CI/CD and deployment automation. Collaborate with architects, AI specialists and client stakeholders to turn business requirements into working solutions. Share knowledge across the team and contribute to how we build. What We’re Looking For Essential Recent commercial experience in application or web development, e.g. TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Python, Node or similar. Some hands-on data engineering experience, or a clear move into data (professional work, projects or training). Good SQL skills, and an interest in data modelling and pipeline design. Solid software engineering fundamentals: Git, testing, CI/CD. Good communication skills and confidence working with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desirable Exposure to Spark, PySpark or Databricks. A Databricks certification, completed or in progress. Experience with AWS, Azure or GCP. Experience building internal tools, dashboards or data-driven applications. Exposure to AI or Generative AI applications. Client-facing or consulting experience. Why Join Unifeye? Work exclusively with Databricks technologies, alongside some of the UK’s most experienced Databricks specialists. Build real applications, not just pipelines, at the point where software and data meet. Close collaboration with Databricks teams. Continuous learning, with funded certification and career development. High levels of ownership and autonomy from day one. Competitive salary, bonus, generous benefits and flexible hybrid working. If you’re a developer who has fallen for data, or a data engineer who still loves building products, we’d love to hear from you.

items.desc: DESCRIPTION Amazon Ads is looking for a Front-End Engineer to join the Brand Innovation Lab (BIL), a multidisciplinary team that creates innovative advertising experiences for some of the world’s most recognized brands. In this role, you will turn proven advertising experiences into scalable, reliable, and production-ready solutions. You will evolve campaign-specific implementations into reusable components, templates, and frameworks that can support multiple advertisers, campaigns, and markets. You will deliver front-end features across the software development lifecycle, from technical design and implementation through testing, deployment, maintenance, and operational support. A key focus of the role is improving the quality and reliability of existing solutions by simplifying implementations, resolving recurring defects at their root cause, reducing technical debt, and making software easier for other teams to operate and extend. You will work closely with Design Technologists, UX Designers, Creative teams, Product and Program Managers, and partner engineering teams across Amazon Ads. Improve software quality, reliability, performance, accessibility, and security by identifying root causes of defects, implementing durable fixes, reducing technical debt, and applying engineering best practices. Partner with Design Technologists, UX, Product, and engineering teams to translate innovative customer experiences into technically scalable implementations and integrate them with APIs, shared services, and Amazon Ads platforms. Improve development and operational processes through automation, testing, code reviews, technical documentation, and maintainable engineering patterns that enable other teams to operate and extend the software. items.desc: About us At ExxonMobil, our vision is to lead in energy innovations that advance modern living while reducing emissions. As one of the world’s largest publicly traded energy and chemical companies, we are powered by a unique and diverse workforce fueled by the pride in what we do and what we stand for. The success of our Upstream, Product Solutions and Low Carbon Solutions businesses is the result of the talent, curiosity and drive of our people. They bring solutions every day to optimize our strategy in energy, chemicals, lubricants and lower-emissions technologies. We invite you to bring your ideas to ExxonMobil to help create sustainable solutions that improve quality of life and meet society’s evolving needs. Learn more about our What and our Why and how we can work together . ExxonMobil Global Trading is where we trade oil, natural gas, and energy products safely and responsibly around the world. We leverage our expertise in analytics, logistics, origination, and knowledge of energy markets to maximize the value of our global assets and deliver industry-leading results. This is an exciting time to join our growing trading team and be an integral part of ExxonMobil! What role will you play in our team We are now recruiting for our 2027 Placement Programme. We are seeking an exceptional individual who will spend between 3 and 6 months with our global Quantitative Analytics team in our Global Trading organization, commencing in April 2027. This team’s general responsibility is working day-to-day with traders, analysts, origination and business-development teams across global business lines to support trading, commercial, and project activities and studies. As part of our Placement Programme, you will be mentored by Senior Front-Office Quants and work very closely with our trading teams on our trade floor. What you will do You will apply your skills to accomplish the following: Develop a good understanding of the energy commodity markets. Participate in supporting market-based valuations of physical assets and structured deals. Develop quantitative derivatives pricing models and test performance across all regions. Developed comprehensive quantitative model documentation to support model validation activities. Deliver presentations to Trading desks and Quantitative Analytics teams on newly developed models, highlighting methodology, key results and performance. Whilst on placement with ExxonMobil you will have support and guidance from managers, supervisors and recent graduates to enable you to apply your degree knowledge and fulfil your potential. You will gain confidence and experience as an individual, learning new skills in a real trading environment. About you Be in the penultimate or final year of your Masters or PhD studies in Mathematical Finance, Computational Finance, Financial Engineering, or similar subject Have a good understanding about option theory, particularly stochastic calculus and option Greeks. Have a good understanding about AI/Machine Learning and in particular Neural Networks. Be familiar with Monte-Carlo simulations, stochastic dynamic programming, high dimension optimizations and ideally graph/network theory. Be fluent in a programming language such as Python (ideally), Java, C++, C. Be seeking to gain work experience on a paid 3- to 6-month placement, with start dates available from April 2027. Be able to demonstrate: Outstanding analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills A strong attention to details An interest in energy commodity and financial markets The ability to communicate, collaborate and work effectively with in an international team environment Leadership, resilience and independence capabilities What are the next steps? If you are Interested, we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. Applications will close on 31 December 2026 , and selected candidates will be invited to complete a two-stage assessment process . Behavioral assessment. Two technical, competency-based interviews (virtual over Zoom). If your application is not successful at any stage, we will let you know as soon as we can. ExxonMobil recognizes that recruiting and developing the right people is key to our success and so we look for applicants who demonstrate the right skills, attitudes, capability and potential. Our processes are designed to be robust, engaging and consistent. Alternate Location: Conditions of Employment Successful candidates will be made a conditional offer of employment. The conditions include, but are not limited to: a satisfactory criminal records disclosure; satisfactory employment references over five years (where applicable); verification of qualifications, including any professional accreditation stated in the application; completion of a pre-employment medical, including a test for illicit or unprescribed drugs in accordance with the Company's safety policies; and the legal right to work on the agreed commencement date. items.desc: Job Summary We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented SAS Programmer to join our data analytics team. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in SAS software to develop, implement, and optimize data processing solutions that drive insightful decision-making. Your work will be instrumental in managing large datasets, performing complex analyses, and supporting machine learning initiatives. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to innovative projects utilizing cutting-edge technologies such as big data platforms, AI, natural language processing, and cloud services. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain SAS programs for data extraction, transformation, and analysis across diverse datasets. Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to implement statistical models and machine learning algorithms using SAS and other tools like R or Python. Optimize data workflows for efficiency and scalability, incorporating big data technologies such as Hadoop and Spark. Integrate SAS solutions with cloud platforms like AWS to enhance data accessibility and processing capabilities. Conduct data mining activities to uncover actionable insights from complex datasets. Develop database schemas and design structures that support efficient data storage and retrieval. Write advanced SQL queries for data manipulation and reporting purposes, ensuring accuracy and consistency. Utilize scripting languages such as Bash (Unix shell) for automation of routine tasks and environment setup. Support natural language processing projects by applying relevant algorithms within SAS or Python environments. Document processes thoroughly to ensure reproducibility and compliance with organizational standards. Qualifications Proven experience in SAS programming within a data-driven environment, with strong knowledge of statistical analysis techniques. Proficiency in SQL for database querying and management. Familiarity with big data frameworks such as Hadoop and Spark for handling large-scale datasets. Experience with machine learning frameworks like TensorFlow or similar tools is highly desirable. Strong programming skills in Python, R, Java, C, or VBA are advantageous for integrating various analytical tools. Knowledge of cloud computing platforms such as AWS to support scalable data solutions. Understanding of database design principles to create efficient storage architectures. Experience with natural language processing (NLP) techniques for text analysis projects is a plus. Ability to work collaboratively across teams while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Join us to harness the power of big data, AI, and advanced analytics! Bring your passion for innovative technology solutions to a role where your skills will make a real impact on organizational success through sophisticated SAS programming combined with the latest in cloud computing, machine learning, and natural language processing techniques. We are now recruiting the below position. Pre-Construction Senior Project Manager Reporting & Analytics Location: Hybrid with travel to Suffolk, Ipswich and Leiston Contract: Permanent, full-time. Alongside our university-wide careers provision, we work in partnership with academic departments to provide specialist, tailored careers and employability support. This role sits within our dedicated careers provision for the UCL School of Management, one of the UK’s leading business and management schools. Home to more than 2,000 students from across the world, the School has particular strengths in innovation, technology, business analytics and entrepreneurship and is currently delivering an ambitious programme of growth. Our postgraduate students have ambitious career goals, with many looking to build careers across technology, data, AI, business analytics and marketing science. We are looking for a careers professional with strong knowledge of these areas who can help them understand the opportunities available, develop their skills and translate their academic experience into successful careers. About the role As Careers Consultant: Technology & Analytics Specialist, you will be our lead careers specialist for students interested in careers across Technology, Data Science, AI, Business Analytics and Marketing Science. You will work primarily with postgraduate students, joining a collaborative team of Careers Consultants and Employer Engagement professionals to design and deliver a comprehensive careers and professional development programme. Through workshops, group sessions, one-to-one coaching and application support, you will help students explore their options, develop their career management skills and prepare effectively for competitive recruitment processes. You will bring specialist insight into the technology and analytics labour market, helping students understand different career pathways and the skills employers are looking for. This could include careers such as Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Business Intelligence Analyst, Business Analyst, Product or Customer Insights Analyst, Quantitative Analyst and Analytics Consultant. A key part of the role will be keeping close to developments in the sector. You will use labour-market information, graduate outcomes and student insight to shape careers activity, while maintaining an up-to-date understanding of recruitment practices across technology, analytics, data and related areas. You will also build strong relationships with academic colleagues, employers and other stakeholders, working collaboratively to embed relevant employability support across the School. Our students are highly international and pursue careers across the UK and major global graduate markets, so you will also help them understand how recruitment practices and opportunities differ internationally. Please note this role is offered on a full-time basis with hybrid working available. As a student-facing role, attendance on campus (Canary Wharf School of Management) is required for currently a minimum of one day per week during term-time but may be more according to workload and business need. Job Ref: B06-00214 Closing Date: 3-11-2026 – 23:59 (UK time) Interviews: Interview are likely to take place onsite at our Canary Wharf office from mid-November About you You may already be working in university careers or employability and have developed specialist expertise supporting students pursuing careers in technology, data or analytics. Alternatively, you might bring experience from recruitment, talent development, coaching or industry and be looking for an opportunity to use that expertise to support the next generation of talent. You will have a strong understanding of careers and recruitment across Technology and Data/Analytics, gained either through professional experience in these areas or through substantial experience supporting similar cohorts within a university or business school. You will understand the rapidly evolving graduate market for areas such as AI, machine learning, big data and data science, and be able to explain how different roles fit across the analytics lifecycle – for example, the differences between a Data Scientist, Data Engineer and Business Analyst. Just as importantly, you will enjoy working with people. items.desc: We are looking for an Operations Administrator to help keep PPL running smoothly as we grow. This is a varied role combining systems and process administration, practical office coordination, and front-of-house support for colleagues and visitors. At its heart, the role is about creating the reliable foundations and responsive support that enable the wider team to do their best work and maximise PPL’s impact. About PPL PPL is a management consultancy with a difference. As a social enterprise and certified B Corp, we work with the NHS, local government and civil society to improve services and outcomes for people and communities across the UK. Our social purpose is central to our operating model. We donate over 50% of our profits to support charities and wider social impact and provide every member of the team 10 days of paid volunteering leave each year. It also shapes how we work: with care, integrity, high standards and a strong sense of responsibility to one another. We are in an ambitious period of growth. Our Shared Services team helps make that possible by creating a well-run, welcoming organisation where people have the systems, information and practical support they need to do great work. The opportunity This is an established role within our Shared Services team. You will work closely with our Operations Administrator (People) and colleagues across PPL to keep our day-to-day operations running smoothly and to improve the systems and processes that support our growth. The role combines practical, people-facing support with the administration that keeps an organisation running well. You will be a visible and approachable presence in our office, welcoming visitors and helping colleagues with day-to-day requests, while maintaining accurate systems and records, coordinating repeatable processes and resolving operational issues. Whether you are responding to someone in the moment or improving a process behind the scenes, the focus is the same: making it easier for others to do their best work and enabling PPL to maximise its impact. Because front-of-house support and closing the office are regular parts of the role, you will work from our Central London office five days a week. Core hours are 9.30am to 6.00pm, with some flexibility around these hours occasionally required to meet operational and front-of-house needs. What it is like to work in the team "Working in Operations Administration at PPL is such a welcoming and rewarding opportunity. The role gives you exposure to many different areas of the organisation and the chance to see how meaningful work across public health comes together. You are part of a genuinely supportive team, where people are always willing to help, share knowledge and encourage you to learn. PPL is also brilliant at supporting growth and development, helping you build a career path that works for both you and the team. I feel incredibly lucky to be part of the PPL team.” Erin, Operations Administrator (People) What you will do Support colleagues and visitors Provide a consistent and professional front-of-house presence, welcoming guests and responding to visitor queries. Help colleagues with practical requests and work with the wider Shared Services team to provide a responsive, joined-up service. Coordinate practical arrangements such as travel, accommodation, venues and office supplies. Take responsibility for closing the office each day and help ensure the workplace is welcoming and well run. Keep systems, information and processes reliable Maintain and administer organisational systems, making sure information is accurate, up to date and easy to use. Maintain organisational records and documentation, including operational and team information. Support structured administrative processes across Operations, Finance and HR, including payroll inputs, onboarding documentation and record management. Maintain useful action logs, checklists and guidance so that routine work is completed consistently. Solve problems and improve how we work Investigate operational issues, identify what is causing them and work with the right colleagues to resolve them. Spot recurring problems or unnecessary complexity and suggest practical ways to improve workflows. Develop and update clear standard operating procedures and internal guidance. Support audits, compliance checks and other repeatable operational activities. items.desc: App Developer - Stride Manchester (Hybrid) | Reporting to CTO Free StrideOne membership plus family and friends discount About Stride ‘Normal’ health is no longer good enough. Normal is code for tired, stressed, barely functioning and slowly declining, and calling that a life. We think everyone has a right to better than that. Stride is turning tracking your entire internal biology into a lifestyle, with a next generation preventative health membership. Every member builds a multi-omic health profile covering DNA, microbiome, blood biomarkers, epigenetics and oral health. That’s over 500 biomarkers, tested at least twice a year, so we can see direction of travel and not just a single point in time. Then we turn it into what to actually do: what to eat, how to train, what to supplement, what to watch, with a coach, dietitian or physiologist alongside you. Imagine an elite longevity concierge, at an everyday price, with no stuffy clinics to attend! The Role This is a zero-to-one build. Stride doesn’t have an app yet. Members currently log in through a web portal, and your job is to turn that into an installable app on iOS and Android, launched on both at the same time. What You’ll Be Doing: Build and ship Stride’s first app across iOS and Android, from architecture to App Store and Play Store approval Decide where native is essential (login, HealthKit, push, store compliance) and where web views do the job faster Integrate with our existing REST API and data model, and help shape the API as the app’s needs become clear Build engagement into the product: notifications, check-ins and reasons to come back every week The Biological Age Platform Build the member-facing experience of a genuinely novel, multi-source biological age score Turn huge volumes of biomarker and trend data into screens that inform without overwhelming Work with our scientific team so the app stays rigorous while staying simple Cross-functional Partnership Partner closely with our Product Designer, from first sketch to shipped feature Work with the CTO on technical and UX decisions, and with the founders on functionality Back your decisions with data. Nobody here is precious, and the best evidence wins Building with AI Use AI natively across scaffolding, code review, testing and documentation Bring the experience to know what you’re asking AI to build, and to spot when it gets it wrong How We’ll Know It’s Working Both apps live, approved and launched together Members opening the app weekly, not just when results arrive A codebase that’s simple, scalable and easy to adjust, with nothing more complex than it needs to be Features built with commercial outcomes in mind, not just technical elegance What You’ll Bring A track record of shipping consumer-facing apps that real users relied on, going back several years Experience taking an app from zero to live, ideally owning the build end to end Practical experience getting apps through App Store and Play Store review Experience presenting large amounts of data in a way that’s clear and engaging Fluency with AI tooling, built on fundamentals you learned before it existed Commercial awareness: you build for scale and adaptability, not for its own sake Comfort in a small, very fast-moving team where things change quickly and you’ll help shape the process Bonus points: A successful wellness, health or fitness app, native iOS or Android depth, cross-platform frameworks (Flutter, React Native), HealthKit or Health Connect integrations, data-heavy apps (fintech, trading, gaming), or being an early or first engineer at a startup. Why Stride Preventive health is where consumer health is heading, and your work helps people find out earlier, not too late Own the app outright, and shape the architecture rather than inheriting someone else’s decisions Work directly with an experienced CTO and a founder who took DNAfit through an eight-figure exit to Prenetics before a Nasdaq listing 25 days holiday plus bank holidays, pension, annual learning budget and your own kit

items.desc: The CYP Primary Care Mental Health Team is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Band 7 Senior Mental Health Therapeutic Practitioner to support children and young people experiencing mild to moderate emotional and mental health difficulties. The postholder will work across Primary Care Networks, GP surgeries, and community settings, providing mental health assessments, evidence-based interventions, consultations, and support for children, young people and their families. The role is central to the development of an integrated and accessible mental health pathway, promoting early intervention, prevention, and partnership working across health, education, social care and voluntary sector services. Deliver comprehensive mental health assessments and brief evidence-based interventions for children and young people with mild to moderate mental health needs. Hold and manage a clinical caseload, acting as lead professional where appropriate. Develop and deliver care plans, therapeutic interventions and psychoeducation for young people, parents and carers. Work autonomously within GP practices and Primary Care Networks to support early identification and intervention. Provide consultation, advice, training and support to primary care staff and partner agencies. Work collaboratively with schools, social care, voluntary sector organisations and wider CAMHS services to ensure joined-up care. Undertake risk assessment, risk management and safeguarding responsibilities. Contribute to service development, quality improvement initiatives, training programmes and evaluation of outcomes. Promote co-production and ensure the voices of children, young people and families inform service delivery. Central and North West London NHS Foundation Trust (CNWL) is committed to delivering high-quality, compassionate care and improving outcomes for children, young people and families. The CYP Primary Care Mental Health Team works in partnership with Primary Care Networks, CAMHS, schools, local authorities, voluntary sector organisations and wider community services to provide accessible early intervention mental health support. The service has been developed as part of the wider transformation of community mental health provision, ensuring children and young people can access timely support closer to home and reducing unnecessary escalation to specialist services. Our Trust values are: Compassion Respect Empowerment Partnership These values underpin everything we do and guide our work with children, young people, families and colleagues The successful candidate will: Clinical Responsibilities Undertake mental health assessments and formulate appropriate intervention plans. Deliver brief evidence-based psychological interventions, including CBT-informed, systemic and solution-focused approaches where qualified. Manage and prioritise a caseload of children and young people presenting with emotional and mental health difficulties. Undertake risk assessments and safeguarding activities in line with local and national policies. Monitor clinical outcomes and evaluate interventions. Promote self-management and resilience through therapeutic work and psychoeducation Consultation, Liaison and Partnership Working Act as an embedded mental health practitioner within Primary Care Networks and GP practices. Provide consultation, advice and support to GPs, care navigators and other professionals. Work closely with schools, social care, youth services, voluntary sector organisations and specialist CAMHS teams. Promote effective communication and coordinated multi-agency care for children and young people. Training and Supervision Deliver training and educational sessions to primary care and community professionals. Participate in and provide clinical supervision as appropriate. Support workforce development and the dissemination of best practice across the network Service Development and Quality Improvement Contribute to the ongoing development of the CYP Primary Care Mental Health Team model. Assist in the development of pathways, protocols and service improvements. Participate in audit, research, data collection and quality improvement projects. Support implementation of Trust and national clinical policies and standards. Professional Responsibilities Maintain accurate and timely clinical records. Adhere to professional standards, safeguarding requirements and Trust policies. Demonstrate CNWL values and act as a role model for collaborative, person-centred practice.

Get involved in clinical research, teaching and development. Provide expert advice and support regarding complex cases to clinical colleagues in primary and secondary care. Post holder will be providing assessment of patients suspected to have acute stroke when holding the hot phone including suitability for thrombolysis and mechanical thrombectomy.
