items.desc: About Immunara Immunara is an AI biology lab building biological superintelligence. We're developing biological foundation models that learn how human biology works, and AI agents that reason over biological data to accelerate scientific discovery. Understanding disease means connecting what happens across molecules, cells, tissues, organs and patients. Today, much of that knowledge is fragmented and captured in forms that AI cannot readily interpret or reason over. We believe AI can bring these pieces together to reveal biology that existing approaches cannot. Our Approach We're building foundation models trained on large, proprietary, multimodal human datasets to model disease and predict how biological systems respond to interventions. Alongside this, we're developing AI agents trained through reinforcement learning to reason over data and models, generate hypotheses and design experiments. Our ambition is to build AI systems that can understand and discover biology - radically improving how we develop new treatments. We've raised a large funding round from leading Silicon Valley investors to achieve this goal. About the role We’re looking for a Founding Operator with a scientific background, commercial instincts and a strong bias to action. Someone who can wear many hats and make things happen. You’ll work directly with the founders on whatever matters most to the business. One week, you might map the global biobank landscape, find the right decision-makers and run outreach. The next, you might refine our GTM strategy, build a customer deck, represent Immunara at an industry event, help close a candidate or fix an operational process that's slowing the team down. You'll move between strategy and execution constantly. What you'll do Build partnerships - Source biobanks, hospitals and research institutions. Find the right people, execute on outreach and drive opportunities forward with the founders and scientific team. GTM - Map markets, identify customers, test commercial hypotheses and turn research into a focused GTM strategy. Get into the details of who buys, what they need and how we reach them. Create materials that win business - Build sharp customer decks, partnership proposals, briefs and follow-up materials. Translate complex science and technology into a clear reason to work with us. Represent the company - Attend relevant conferences and industry events, build relationships and turn conversations into concrete next steps. Help build the team - Help source exceptional people, support outreach and interviews, and keep hiring processes moving. Make the company run better - Take charge of operational processes across the business. Remove bottlenecks and build systems that work as we grow. What we're looking for You understand the science. You have a background in biology, medicine, bioengineering or a related field. You can engage with scientific ideas and communicate credibly with technical people. You've operated in a fast-paced environment. You have experience at MBB, in investment banking or at a high-growth startup. You default to action. You can turn an incomplete brief into a sensible first move, you have high agency and are comfortable with ambiguity. You have high standards and low ego. You care about the quality of the work. No task is beneath you if it moves the company forward. You want responsibility. You’re looking for a steep learning curve, proximity to consequential decisions and the chance to build something substantial. What’s in it for you We want Immunara to the best place in the world to do ambitious AI biology work. Early hires will receive exceptional support and significant ownership. Benefits include: Competitive, top-of-market compensation. Significant equity package to share in the upside of building a category-defining company. Comprehensive private medical & dental coverage. A significant budget to purchase best-in-class equipment, research tooling, software, and the infrastructure you need to do your best work. Access to the compute and petabytes of proprietary biomedical data required to train ambitious models. Opportunities to attend leading AI, biology, and scientific conferences - fully-funded. Regular team meals, a stocked office, and a working environment designed for elite perfotmance. Flexible time off with no strict limits.

items.desc: he pharmacy department are delighted to be able to offer a vacancy for a Pharmacy Porter/Assistant where no two days will be the same! Why, you ask? There are a range of duties and responsibilities that you will receive training in. You could be providing a top up of medicine stock to our hospital wards one day and then dealing with our external customers the next processing their orders. In this role, you will need to be enthusiastic, motivated and demonstrate a desire to contribute towards developing our services. It would be an advantage if you had previous pharmacy or stores experience, however full training and support will be provided. Our core working hours are Monday to Friday (8am until 7pm), with weekends and bank holidays managed on a rota basis (9am until 6pm). All shifts are 7.5 hours with a 30-minute unpaid lunch break. For those applying for this part time role, please be aware that this requires committing to the same days each week Monday to Friday for a full 7.5 hour shift. Successful applicants will be funded to complete the Buttercups Level 2 – Support Staff Course for Pharmacy Assistants. Please be aware that large parts of this role involve working in our pharmacy stores warehouse and involves significant manual handling of products. These require onwards delivery to wards and departments throughout the hospital so our patients have access to the medicines they need. There is also a requirement to use both hand and electric pallet trucks. This post is an ideal stepping stone for those looking to progress in pharmacy. We have regular opportunities for you to develop yourself in this role particularly as our services continue to expand. So what will you be working on on a day to day basis? Your main duties within this role will include providing an effective medicine supply service to wards/departments across the Trust and to external customers such as Lancashire and South Cumbria NHS Trust , Ambulance stations, Private hospitals and other NHS hospitals. You will process, pick, pack and deliver all pharmacy orders for the Trust and even be responding to any robot issues. Your days won't ever be boring! You will support training and development of other staff; maintaining quality and standards by contributing to the development and implementation of new services, processes and procedures to deliver services in line with professional, local and national directives. Further information can be found in the job description and if you would like to know more prior to interview, why not get in touch and come and visit us. We are more than happy for you to spend some time with us so that you can see what we do. If you are considering applying then please contact us for more information, we can also arrange a visit for a tour of our department! We have 10,000 fantastic people working hard to deliver quality services to our patients. Whatever your role, you help look after 370,000 people in our local area & give specialist care to 1.5 million people across Lancashire & Cumbria. Working with us gives you the knowledge and sense of pride that every activity you do genuinely does make a difference to support our patients & staff, ensuring we keep thriving & delivering outstanding healthcare right across our local towns. You’ll have access to varied development opportunities, learn new skills, meet fab people & do things you’d never have done. You’ll make an impact, be challenged to think differently, be bold & help innovate to keep improving things. Everything we do centres around patient care which means your role is pivotal and something really to be proud of. Join our dedicated Wound Centre Service, delivering high-quality, patient-centred care to housebound patients with complex wounds across East Kent. The service works closely with Community Nursing teams to provide integrated care and ensure patients receive the right treatment at the right time. Interventions commonly include wound management for leg ulcers and post-operative wounds, lower limb and Doppler assessments, VAC therapy, maggot therapy, and health promotion for patients living with long-term conditions. Your responsibilities will include changing wound dressings, catheter care, undertaking holistic assessments and delivering clinical interventions within your scope of practice. You will work in partnership with patients to develop integrated care plans that support their health goals and promote self-management wherever possible. The role also includes supporting the supervision and development of junior colleagues, Healthcare Assistants and students, helping to maintain high standards of care across the service. Working collaboratively with community and primary care teams, you will contribute to safe, effective and compassionate care that makes a real difference to patients across East Kent. items.desc: Job Description At Sage, we're redefining how solution design works in an AI-first world. We're building a new Solution Design capability within Domain Services, creating a profession that combines the strongest elements of business analysis, solution design and detailed product ownership. As a Solution Designer, you'll play a central role in shaping how ideas become scalable, reliable solutions that power products used by businesses around the world. Working at the intersection of Product, Engineering and Architecture, you'll take agreed product outcomes and transform them into clear, coherent, traceable solutions that teams can build with confidence. You'll lead discovery, model complex business and technical processes, maintain living specifications and ensure solutions remain aligned from concept through to delivery. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing team at an early stage, helping define new ways of working, influence best practice and shape the future of solution design at Sage. *** Please note that this role is hybrid and will require you to work 3 days a week from our Newcastle office. *** Key Responsibilities What You'll Be Doing Lead detailed discovery activities to build a deep understanding of customer needs, business processes, constraints, dependencies and outcomes. Translate product intent into clear, end-to-end logical solutions covering journeys, workflows, services, business rules, integrations, APIs, data flows and operational considerations. Facilitate collaboration across Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Compliance, Support and other specialist teams. Create and maintain detailed, versioned specifications, acceptance criteria and decision records that provide a trusted source of truth throughout delivery. Identify risks, assumptions, dependencies and impacts early, helping teams make informed decisions. Ensure accessibility, operational readiness, support requirements, audit needs and failure scenarios are considered from the outset. Work closely with engineering teams throughout development, evolving specifications as new learning emerges. Use AI-powered tools to accelerate discovery, analysis, modelling and documentation while maintaining accountability for accuracy, quality and decision-making. Contribute reusable patterns, knowledge assets and best practices that strengthen the wider Solution Design community. What We're Looking For We're open to candidates from a variety of backgrounds. You may have worked as a Business Analyst, Solution Designer, Product Owner, Service Designer or in a similar role where you've been responsible for turning complex requirements into clear, deliverable solutions. You'll likely bring: Experience leading analysis and discovery activities from initial concept through to successful delivery. Strong facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bring diverse viewpoints together and create shared understanding. Experience creating detailed specifications, requirements, workflows, process models and acceptance criteria. The ability to model end-to-end solutions across processes, services, integrations, data flows and operational considerations. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to navigate ambiguity and make evidence-based recommendations. Experience working closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers and other cross-functional stakeholders. Understanding of APIs, integrations, logical data design and service-oriented solutions. The ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. An appreciation for accessibility, operational readiness, supportability, compliance and risk management. A collaborative mindset and a willingness to challenge constructively, ask questions and continuously improve ways of working. Nice to Have Experience working in fintech, banking, payments, financial services, tax, compliance or related domains. Experience working on platform capabilities, shared services or backend-focused products and services. Exposure to migration programmes, large-scale integrations or data-intensive initiatives. Experience using AI-assisted tools to support discovery, analysis, modelling or documentation activities. Knowledge of SaaS, cloud-based platforms or enterprise software environments. Why Join Us This is a chance to join a growing team at a pivotal moment. You'll help shape an evolving profession, influence how solution design is practised in an AI-first environment and work on complex platform capabilities that support products across Sage. items.desc: At Amentum, we're not just solving problems; we're engineering the future. Our team is driven by an unyielding commitment to innovation, integrity, and collaboration, tackling some of the most significant challenges in science, security, and sustainability. If you're passionate about making a real impact and want to be part of a community that values ethical excellence, this is the place where your ambition can thrive. Here, we believe that success comes from continuously pushing boundaries and working together to deliver on our promises. We embrace challenges with confidence and are dedicated to creating a secure and vibrant future for all. We’ll inspire and empower you to deliver your best work so you can evolve, grow and succeed – today and into tomorrow. We offer an exciting range of opportunities to develop your career within a supportive team who always strive to do the right thing for our people, clients and communities. People are our greatest asset, and we offer a competitive package to retain and attract the best talent. In addition to the benefits you’d expect, UK employees also receive free single medical cover and digital GP service, family-friendly benefits such as enhanced parental leave pay and free membership of employee assistance and parental programmes, plus reimbursement towards relevant professional development and memberships. Work-life balance and flexibility is a key focus area for us. We’re happy to discuss hybrid, part-time and flexible working hours, patterns and locations to suit you and our business. About the Opportunity We are looking for a motivated Junior Geophysicist with at least two years of professional experience to join our Subsurface Solutions team within the Earth and Environmental Operations Area. You will bridge the gap between complex data collection and practical engineering solutions, supporting environmental, defence and energy projects. This is a hybrid role involving hands-on field data acquisition, advanced processing, and technical reporting. You will be working within a multidisciplinary team with specialities in low strength sedimentary rock, high strength rock and Quaternary geology, and in disciplines ranging from hydrogeology, land quality, geotechnical engineering, engineering geology and geoscience related safety case work. Much of the work we undertake involves siting, site characterisation, site descriptive models and understanding subsurface conditions and hazards. In addition, you will be encouraged to work with the wider Amentum community to further strengthen the team’s capabilities. You will also gain experience in complex bid preparation, project management and technical planning. As a result, we are looking for people who have the passion and drive to be involved with major projects with strong adaptability, prioritisation and teamworking skills. Whilst much of our work is focussed on exciting projects that form part of Amentum’s Energy, Environment and Defence businesses. We would be interested in candidates with experience in carbon capture and storage (CCS) and geothermal energy, which could compliment future growth opportunities. What You’ll Do: Field Data Acquisition: Lead and support geophysical surveys using in-house survey equipment such as ERI, GPR, EM and HVSR. Site Investigation: Assist in the design of survey programmes to identify subsurface risks like voids, utilities, or varying bedrock depth and integrate findings with geotechnical and geoenvironmental teams planning intrusive investigations. Support the design of third party onshore surveys such as MASW, 2D reflection and refraction, wireline and cross-hole seismic, providing field supervision. Support the design of third party near-shore marine surveys such as SBP, Magnetometer, 2D reflection and refraction, providing field supervision (offshore certification and training provided). Data Processing and interpretation: Utilise industry-standard software (e.g. Res2DInv, Geolitix) to process raw field data into actionable models. Assist with the interpretation of 2D and 3D seismic datasets (IHS Kingdom). Conduct structural analysis and fault mapping using geophysical, borehole, and field data and integrate with other datasets to support subsurface evaluations. Develop an understanding of the underlying requirements of our clients, and how we can meet those requirements. Reporting: Technical writing of factual and interpretive reports, ensuring high-quality visualisations and clear recommendations. Safety & Logistics: Manage field equipment maintenance and uphold strict Health & Safety standards on-site. What We’re Looking For Education: A degree in Geophysics, Geology, or Civil Engineering (MSc preferred). Experience: 2+ years in a commercial engineering or environmental geophysics environment. Technical Skills: Proficiency in GIS (ArcGIS/QGIS) and geophysical processing software. Field Readiness: Willingness to travel to remote sites across the UK and overseas when …

items.desc: Are you passionate about supporting individuals to achieve their employment goals? Do you believe in the transformative power of work and its impact on health and wellbeing? If so, we want to hear from you! We are looking for dedicated Employment Specialists to join our team and deliver the Individual Placement Support (IPS) model, helping people with mental health conditions find and sustain meaningful employment. What we’re looking for: A commitment to empowering individuals to reach their full potential. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Experience in employment support (preferred but not essential). Knowledge of the local job market and the ability to build relationships with employers. A positive, proactive, and compassionate attitude. A strengths-based perspective, focusing on clients’ abilities. If you’re ready to make a lasting impact and help change lives through employment, we’d love to hear from you! Please note, the role requires travel for meetings with colleagues, service users and local employers. We have vacancies across Liverpool, Sefton, St Helens, Warrington Interviews planned for 19th and 20th November 2026 The Employment Specialist will join an Individual Placement and Support Team (IPS) working under the direction of the IPS Employment Services Manager to deliver IPS as part of the holistic recovery plan for mental health service users. The post holder will work directly with employers to secure employment opportunities for people who have experienced mental health problems, and subsequently provide ongoing support depending on employee’s and employer’s needs. The aim will be to enable people who have experienced mental health problems to gain and retain paid employment. The Employment Specialists will be responsible for: Work closely with individuals to identify their skills, aspirations, and career goals. Build strong partnerships with local employers to promote the service and secure employment opportunities. Collaborate with healthcare professionals and community organisations to provide integrated support. Offer coaching, advice, and guidance to help individuals navigate recruitment processes and thrive in their new roles. Champion the IPS model, demonstrating a person-centred, strengths-based approach to employment support. Mersey Care is one of the largest trusts providing physical health and mental health services in the North West, serving more than 1.4 million people across our region and are also commissioned for services that cover the North West, North Wales and the Midlands. We offer specialist inpatient and community services that support physical and mental health and specialist inpatient mental health, learning disability, addiction and brain injury services. Mersey Care is one of only three trusts in the UK that offer high secure mental health facilities. At the heart of all we do is our commitment to ‘perfect care’ – care that is safe, effective, positively experienced, timely, equitable and efficient. We support our staff to do the best job they can and work alongside service users, their families, and carers to design and develop future services together. We’re currently delivering a programme of organisational and service transformation to significantly improve the quality of the services we provide and safely reduce cost as we do so. Flexible working requests will be considered for all roles. The Employment Specialist will be expected to deliver the IPS approach, working directly with all relevant stakeholders. The Employment Specialist will maintain a professional relationship with the service users of the IPS service, key internal and external stakeholders, with particular attention to confidentiality and the maintenance of professional boundaries. To adhere to mandatory administrative and data capture protocols when recording the progress of individuals. To keep accurate and complete records of casework, using the appropriate electronic clinical notes systems. To act independently, using own judgement, knowledge and initiative to develop and understanding of the needs and potential career aspirations of job seekers. To sensitively gather information, to develop a shared vocational profile and an agreed Job Notion or Curriculum Vitae, for each individual job seeker. On occasion complex, sensitive and contentious information will need to be provided and/or received. To deal with sometimes emotional and distressing behaviour and difficult situations and circumstances. To commence rapid job search within 30 days of receiving a referral for a service user, whilst utilising local support networks to help them overcome their barriers to employment. To research the labour market and spend time getting to know local employers in order to negotiate job opportunities that meet everyone’s strengths, needs, abilities and preferences. The ITSM & Integration Architect provides technical leadership and assurance across ITSM platforms, data integrations and technical solutions within large-scale service transition and transformation programmes. The role ensures solutions meet customer requirements, align with DXC standards and support successful transition and ongoing operations. Working across complex, multi-vendor environments, the architect validates designs, assesses data and environment readiness, resolves technical challenges and supports transition quality gates and exit criteria, including Walk-in Take Over (WITO) scenarios. Key Responsibilities Architecture & Technical Assurance Review and validate ITSM configurations across enterprise platforms such as ServiceNow and BMC Remedy and other ITSM platforms, including workflows, business rules, SLAs, reporting and integrations. Assess integration architectures covering APIs, middleware, data mapping, transformation and orchestration, ensuring solutions are robust, scalable and supportable. Validate data quality, migration readiness, environments and tooling; identify technical gaps, risks and dependencies, and drive remediation. Validate configuration data and service relationships, ensuring alignment with the agreed configuration management model and consistency across source and target systems. Assess non-functional requirements, including performance, availability, scalability, resilience and recoverability. Troubleshoot complex technical issues and recommend improvements to solution quality and maintainability. Configuration, Testing & Technical Governance Ensure ITSM configurations and integration components are built, tested and documented against approved designs and DXC standards. Review test results and evidence, ensuring defects are resolved or formally managed before transition acceptance. Assess integration security, including authentication, authorisation, certificates and secure data exchange, in line with applicable security requirements. Validate data migration and reconciliation outcomes to ensure data integrity and consistency between source and target systems. Maintain accurate, version-controlled technical artefacts and configuration records within a controlled repository, ensuring traceability, compliance and audit readiness. Validate release and environment management arrangements, ensuring controlled configuration changes and deployments across relevant environments. Transition & Operational Readiness Act as the technical authority for ITSM and integration decisions, resolving ambiguities and coordinating issue resolution across workstreams. Collaborate with customers, architects, subject matter experts and delivery teams to manage dependencies, address risks and maintain technical alignment. Support transition governance, quality gates, exit criteria and account take-on, including WITO scenarios. Brief technical teams on transition protocols and standards, provide technical assurance and support transition sign-off. Ensure integrations are operationally supportable, with appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, error handling and failure recovery mechanisms. Ensure operational handover includes complete documentation, known issues, outstanding risks, support ownership and guidance. Capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in technical standards, integration design and transition delivery. items.desc: The Company Morgan Motor Company has been handcrafting sports cars since 1909 and is one of the world's pre-eminent coachbuilders. Pioneering its unique blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern technology, every Morgan is handmade to order. The historic home of Morgan is at Pickersleigh Road in Malvern Link, Worcestershire. Morgan sports cars are hand crafted using three core elements: ash, aluminium, and leather. Every car is entirely unique, built to the highest standards by passionate craftsmen and women, whose skills are handed down through generations and perfected over a lifetime, bringing together heritage, innovation, and cutting-edge technology. The role We are looking for a dedicated and quality-driven Mechanical Fitter to join our Chassis Department. This role is crucial to the assembly of our handcrafted vehicles, involving the precise installation of key mechanical components to produce complete rolling chassis. Working primarily independently within a structured team environment, you’ll be responsible for assembling core mechanical systems and ensuring vehicles are built to the highest standards of quality and craftsmanship. items.desc: We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works. We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI. We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly. Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients. We operate from within a working GP practice in East London We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe Our Principles Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1: Care deeply Work hard Be your word Trust in radical truth and transparency Do your life's best work Find the fun Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook. The role We're hiring a mid-level Product Designer to work directly with our CEO to own the design of the Bookable Navigator Inbox: this is the place where GP practice teams receive, triage and act on every patient request. It's used all day by receptionists, care navigators and clinicians, and every rough edge costs them precious time with patients. To be clear: this isn't a senior or leadership role. It's for a designer who has spend 3-5 years shipping within fast-paced product teams and wants to accelerate their career. You'll have a lot of ownership, be expected to stay close to users, and work closely with engineering. If you are hungry, want to work hard, and want a role of a lifetime, we'd love to hear from you. What you'll do Get close to users Talk to practice staff regularly: run interviews, sit in on real shifts, and watch how the Inbox gets used Research and scope product tickets before they reach engineering, so we build the right thing Become the user: dogfood the product until you know its friction better than anyone Use data Dig into product metrics to find where people get stuck, then turn that into design work Measure whether what you shipped actually made things better Design and ship Take ideas from scrappy MVP through to polished, high-fidelity design Make things simple, beautiful and usable, for people working under real time pressure Work side by side with engineers, from first sketch to what goes live Use AI tools like Claude every day to research, prototype and move faster About you You've cut your teeth on at least two great products, shipped and used by real people You've worked in a product team, and you've worked at a startup You're obsessed with UI and think about design constantly, down to the spacing on a button You're excited about talking to users and getting close to the problem You have the fire to improve: you seek out feedback and want to get much better quickly You're comfortable with numbers and can make a case from data You already use AI tools in your workflow Bonus: the best candidates will think like a product manager. You ask why before how, can scope a problem down to what matters, and have opinions about what to build next. We'll explore this in the interview process. Progression As AI changes how software gets built, the line between design and product is blurring, and this role sits right on the edges. You'll start owning the Inbox experience, and grow towards owning product decisions end to end. We want people who could one day found their own company. Here you'll get the reps to do it: real users, real problems in the NHS, and the freedom to work directly with our CEO to shape what we build. The details Salary: competitive, plus equity Location: London (Stratford), in the office 4 days a week with 1 day (Wed) working from home A bit about us We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world. Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception. 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. items.desc: Our Values In line with our One Coventry Values, we want to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organisation that encourages diversity in all respects, including diversity of thinking. We particularly welcome applicants from minority ethnic, LGBT+, disabled and neurodiverse communities to make a real difference to our residents so that equity and respect remains at the heart of everything we do. Our Values are: Open and fair: We are fair, open, and transparent. Nurture and develop: We help and encourage everyone to be their best and do their best. Engage and empower: We talk and listen to others, working together as one. Create and innovate: We embrace new ways of working to continuously improve. Own and be accountable: We work together to deliver the best services for our residents. Value and respect: We put diversity and inclusion at the heart of all we do. The Community Resilience Team may be small, but our ambition is big. We work at the heart of Coventry’s vibrant communities, partnering with both City Council services and the voluntary sector to create new, innovative ways to support local people. We’re growing our team to meet increasing demand across Coventry’s communities, and we're excited to offer a full‑time permanent role. Our work is varied, meaningful, and deeply rooted in the city. From supporting food hubs and social supermarkets to helping develop community libraries and growing our network of engaged community volunteers, local connectors, and community partners, no two days are ever the same. Want to see what we’re about? items.desc: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. ABOUT THE ROLE: We're seeking an exceptional iOS engineer to join a small, high-impact team dedicated to creating the world's most valuable AI application, judged by the impact it delivers to users. You'll shape cutting-edge mobile experiences, blending technical mastery with product brilliance. RESPONSIBILITIES: Dream up and craft delightful, intuitive user experiences that redefine how people interact with AI on mobile. Obsess over every pixel, animation, and interaction, ensuring the experience feels magical and seamless. Build blazing-fast, highly performant systems where every millisecond counts. Drive technical and product decisions, collaborating with AI researchers and engineers to deploy state-of-the-art models globally. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS: Expert in Swift, with deep knowledge of SwiftUI and UIKit. Proficient in performance optimization—memory, CPU, GPU—using low-level tools to deliver blazing-fast systems. Experienced in designing and shipping intuitive, pixel-perfect mobile UIs that redefine how users interact with AI. Skilled in concurrency and reactive programming (Combine) for responsive, real-time apps. Built high-throughput integrations with APIs (REST, gRPC) or AI model outputs, ensuring seamless data flow. Capable of owning complex features end-to-end, from architecture to App Store deployment, with a focus on speed and scalability. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE: Deep expertise in the Apple ecosystem and related development tools. Rust for working with our backend components. AVFoundation for real-time audio processing. Track record of shipping standout apps or standout features within apps. Deep expertise in iOS development, particularly with Swift. We seek individuals who operate at the highest levels of their craft. Excel at delivering results swiftly, often in a fraction of the time others require. Speed is a core value at SpaceXSI—we must act decisively to succeed. Sharp product sense, with an ability to empathize with users, anticipate their needs, and translate that into features that delight and deliver value. COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS: £107,000 - £262,000 GBP Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive healthcare and dental coverage, cash plan, income protection, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. Strong interest in commercial activities. Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written. Ability to build strong relationships with customers; strong customer-oriented attitude.

items.desc: About CIR The Centre for Information Resilience (CIR) is an independent organisation dedicated to exposing human rights violations and threats to democracy. We achieve this through open source research, digital investigations, capacity-building with local partners, and collaboration with media to amplify our impact. CIR was born out of a determination to expose those spreading harm – online and offline – around the world, particularly in areas of violent conflict, such as Ukraine, Sudan and Myanmar. Our projects are at the forefront of efforts to investigate and document human rights abuses, war crimes, harms targeting women and minorities, and influence operations. We work closely with multilateral and national justice accountability bodies. Role details: Contract Type : Contractor Closing date : 26th October 2026 at 23:55pm Contract length : ASAP until 31st March 2027 Hours needed for this role: Full time, 19-20 days a month. Part time roles may also be considered. Location : Remote About the Project CIR specialises in rigorous, ethical, and impact-driven research on technology-facilitated gender-based violence (TFGBV), sexual and gender-based violence (SGBV), and conflict-related sexual violence (CRSV), translating evidence into accountability, advocacy, and practical interventions. For this project, CIR’s is seeking to recruit an open-source researcher to investigate how gender norms and identity can be weaponised to escalate conflicts. We are seeking someone with experience in conducting narrative and network analysis in the MENA region, including analysing online narratives surges to verified online incidents, to test whether and how gendered identity content precedes, accompanies or follows escalation. Main Responsibilities Employ open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools, techniques, and methodologies to conduct research into the MENA information environment. Use SOCMINT tools to conduct audience analysis and gather audience insight. Analysing and documenting evidence of Ethnic, Religious and Gendered Hate speech, coordinated Inauthentic behaviour and other violations of platform terms and conditions and standards. Contribute to CIR’s investigations into how gender and identity are exploited on social media in relation to ongoing conflicts in the MENA region. Input information into the project’s databases and code that data to pre-set information fields as required. Ensure that all data is preserved and archived according to project and organisational standards. Work with other investigators to analyse data from multiple sources and create comprehensive analytical reports on gendered hate speech and narratives, trends, and dynamics. Support the design and production of high-quality reports that effectively explain insights and the evidence and methodology underpinning them. Requirements Essential Criteria: Proven experience with open-source intelligence (OSINT) and social media analysis (SOCMINT) tools and techniques. Expertise in monitoring of ethnic, religious and gendered hate speech. Expertise in narrative tracking and social media research techniques. Proven experience with the development of GESI framework and lexicons. Ability to write short- and long-form reports using concise, clear and accurate language. Flexibility and capacity to adapt to fast-paced changing, and sometimes high-pressure, environments. Proactivity and willingness to work, learn from, and collaborate with members of the project team and the wider CIR. Desirable skills Experience on conflicts in the MENA region Ability to speak and/or integrate multiple languages Use of network mapping and data visualisation tools Recruitment Process To apply, please submit your CV and complete the application form questions. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to interview, which can be conducted remotely unless specified otherwise. CIR is an equal opportunities employer. If you require adjustments or additional support to complete this process, please let us know in your application. A candidate’s guide to artificial intelligence (AI) in recruitment at CIR CIR does not use artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision-making tools at any stage of its recruitment process. All applications are reviewed, and decisions are made, by trained members of staff. When applying for a role, please do use AI for: Plan your ideas and thoughts Check the spelling and grammar of your CV and cover letter Research CIR Generate mock interview questions for you to practice before your interview Use AI as a support tool, not as a substitute for your own thinking or judgement Don’t use AI to Invent or misrepresent your skills and experience Complete any tests provided by CIR Assist you during an interview to help answer the questions being asked by the panel Declaration : By submitting this application, you confirm this represents your own work and experience. items.desc: À propos Rejoignez Allphins, une start-up insurtech dynamique qui redéfinit la gestion des risques dans l'industrie de la (ré)assurance grâce à une technologie innovante. En tant que Data Scientist - Analytics, vous aurez l'opportunité de jouer un rôle clé dans notre croissance rapide et notre expansion internationale. Notre parcours a commencé en 2019, au Lloyd's Lab, le principal accélérateur InsurTech de Londres, et à Station F, Paris, où notre équipe de data scientists, de software engineers et de chefs de produit a développé les solutions révolutionnaires d'Allphins pour les réassureurs. Notre solution est une plateforme SaaS permettant aux (ré)assureurs de comprendre efficacement leurs risques beaucoup plus rapidement et avec plus de précision que jamais auparavant, favorisant une prise de décision éclairée lors de la souscription. Aujourd'hui, nous sommes une équipe internationale, rentable et en pleine croissance, avec une présence au Royaume-Uni, aux États-Unis, en Allemagne, en France et en Suisse. Nous servons plus de 30 réassureurs à travers le monde dans tous les principaux secteurs commerciaux et spécialisés — y compris la propriété, l'énergie, le maritime, le risque politique, la responsabilité civile, la cybernétique, l'aviation et le terrorisme. Notre objectif est de résoudre les défis les plus pressants des (ré)assureurs pour une expansion rapide, avec l'ambition de devenir le leader mondial de la gestion des risques commerciaux et spécialisés. Nous valorisons la créativité, l'ingénierie pragmatique et la collaboration transparente pour offrir des produits de pointe qui répondent aux défis réels du monde professionnel. Nous recrutons un(e) Data Scientist – Analytics . Vous serez rattaché(e) à l’équipe technique et travaillerez au quotidien pour l’équipe Exposure Management, aux côtés de nos experts métier. Votre rôle consiste à collecter, transformer, enrichir et analyser les données de nos clients, en vous appuyant largement sur l’IA et les LLM, pour qu’ils prennent leurs décisions sur des données fiables. items.desc: About Decathlon Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way. Our digital teams in Lille, Paris (and more…) which bring together more than 5000 collaborators are united to build and scale digital products with the aim to always deliver the best value to our users. With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction. Job Description Our PRISM (Supply Chain) is looking for an AI Engineer based in Paris. As an AI Engineer dedicated to agent deployment, you will be at the heart of a tight-knit technical team. Your will play a critical role in the industrialization, deployment and monitoring of our Agent capabilities. You will closely work with digital teams (Data, Product, Engineering) to architect the deployment infrastructure, design intelligence routing, and build secure infrastructure allowing our agents to interact natively with our corporate data and legacy systems. Responsibilities Design and deploy solid foundations that will allow our AI agents to be hosted, run, and interact smoothly with our systems during production release. Design robust pipelines enabling multi-step asynchronous agentic execution (e.g., transactional ingestion and writing flows), by implementing distributed resilience patterns. Integrate agentic orchestration SDKs (notably Google Vertex AI Agent SDK / ADK), bypassing "black box" limitations of managed frameworks. Efficiently orchestrate agents in production while ensuring proper information processing, routing to the most suitable models, and guaranteeing optimal cost and token usage management. Also ensure quality and speed of task execution. Strictly define the scope of action for each agent. You guarantee they only access data and actions for which they are formally authorized, respecting our confidentiality rules, while ensuring data security. Build advanced performance measurement and tracking pipelines to trace agent reflections and decisions from end to end in order to debug logic in production. Work with the team to define relevant and consistent data evaluation metrics relative to the defined functional specificities and metrics. Hard Skills Robust backend design (Python), operational mastery of containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and pipelines (CI/CD, automated testing, observability, log management) to ensure robust production releases. Production-focused Python expertise, mastery of deployment platforms (Vertex AI Agent Builder, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform) and client/server integration protocols like the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Experience optimizing context windows for massive frontier models. Request routing to models suitable for the selected solutions. Ability to build test frameworks for LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, Golden Datasets), mastery of deterministic metrics and strict validation of output formats (JSON schema enforcement). Practical experience with Agentic RAG, Semantic Caching to reduce latency and API costs, or using prompt optimization frameworks (e.g., DSPy) Applied experience in supply chain, retail technology, or model deployment via Databricks / MLFlow Soft Skills Excellent communication and collaboration skills. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Adaptability and willingness to learn new technologies and methodologies and share them. Ability to translate complex technical concepts into understandable terms for non-technical stakeholders. Ability to understand user challenges and associated needs. Qualifications Senior Profile: You have solid experience (Machine Learning Engineering) with a strong focus on production infrastructure release. Ability to leverage managed solutions (Vertex AI) while knowing how to "dive into code" to debug distributed architectures, develop custom connectors, and bypass framework limitations. Demonstrated ability to evolve in shifting technical environments. Operational skills on GCP and understanding of containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes) to autonomously deploy the Agentic layer. Technical Environment Agent orchestration: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, Vertex AI Agent Builder Infrastructure & Cloud: GCP (Google Cloud Platform), Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines. AI & Integration Protocols: Model Context Protocol (MCP), LLMs (Gemini), LLM routing & memory management. Security & Access: Google Cloud Model Armor. Execution Engine: Databricks, AWS EKS, Sagemaker Payload: Python, Spark, Scikit-Learn, Tensorflow / Pytorch, Pyspark CICD: Github Actions Serving: Docker, Protobuf, gRPC Model registry, Model Tracking: MLFlow Orchestration: Airflow Documentation / code: Git, Confluence Data Visualisation: Tableau What We Offer …

items.desc: Word de beste versie van je zelf als Medior AI Data Scientist Als Medior AI Data Scientist bij Sogeti zet je data en AI om in oplossingen die organisaties vooruithelpen. Je combineert analytische scherpte met de praktische toepassing van machine learning en Generative AI. Van de eerste klantvraag en een experiment tot implementatie en verbetering: jij blijft betrokken en maakt zichtbaar wat jouw oplossing oplevert. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je met Data Scientists, AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers en consultants. Je onderzoekt, bouwt en leert samen. Denk aan een voorspelmodel, documentanalyse of een kennisassistent met bedrijfsinformatie. Je krijgt ruimte om jouw vakkennis te verdiepen en die met collega's te delen. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Jij combineert een kritische blik op data met de drive om AI-oplossingen daadwerkelijk in productie te brengen. Je vertaalt businessvraagstukken naar concrete AI-usecases, hypotheses en meetbare doelen en onderzoekt welke data en aanpak het beste passen bij het gewenste resultaat. Daarbij analyseer en verrijk je data, ontwikkel je datasets voor training en evaluatie en houd je oog voor kwaliteit, privacy en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Je bouwt modellen, prototypes en end-to-end AI-oplossingen in Python en combineert daarbij machine learning, Generative AI en Agentic AI. Denk aan toepassingen zoals RAG, documentverwerking, kennisassistenten en AI-agents die systemen en databronnen met elkaar verbinden. Je evalueert prestaties, onderzoekt foutpatronen, bias en betrouwbaarheid en zorgt ervoor dat oplossingen aantoonbare waarde leveren. Samen met Data Engineers en AI/ML Engineers realiseer je datapipelines, integraties en deployments. Ook na livegang blijf je betrokken: je monitort resultaten, verwerkt gebruikersfeedback en vertaalt nieuwe inzichten naar verbeteringen en doorontwikkeling van AI-oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Het vertalen van businessvraagstukken naar AI-usecases, hypotheses en meetbare resultaten. Ontwikkelen van machine learning-, Generative AI- en Agentic AI-oplossingen. Bouwen van end-to-end AI-oplossingen, van experiment en prototype tot productie. Het evalueren van modellen op kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid, bias en businesswaarde. Samenwerken met Data Engineers en AI/ML Engineers aan datapipelines, integraties en deployments. Monitoren, verbeteren en doorontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen na livegang. Je verdiept je in AI, Advanced Analytics en MLOps en ontwikkelt je verder in consultancy en communicatie. Je groeit op een manier die bij jou past, als inhoudelijk specialist of richting lead consultant. Je kunt collega's begeleiden en bijdragen aan nieuwe AI-diensten. Zo bouw je aan jouw expertise en aan die van je team. Jouw talenten en ervaring Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en 2 tot 4 jaar ervaring als AI Data Scientist of in een vergelijkbare toegepaste AI-rol. Je hebt een stevige basis in statistiek, machine learning en data-analyse. Je onderbouwt modelkeuzes en herkent overfitting, vertekening en informatielekken tussen train- en testdata. Werkt met Python voor dataverwerking en modelontwikkeling, gebruikt versiebeheer en maakt experimenten reproduceerbaar en code testbaar. Je hebt ML- of AI-oplossingen gebouwd voor concrete vraagstukken, wilt Generative AI toepassen en werkt met engineers aan implementatie in moderne data- of cloudomgevingen. Neemt eigenaarschap, maakt resultaten en beperkingen begrijpelijk voor stakeholders en beheerst de Nederlandse taal op C1-niveau. Ervaring met LLMs, RAG, embeddings, AI-agents, GenAI-evaluaties, scikit-learn, PyTorch, …

items.desc: Ubicación: Las Rozas, Madrid (Calle Jacinto Benavente) Modalidad: Híbrida, con asistencia a oficina 1 día a la semana. Descripción del puesto Desde Tecdata Engineering buscamos un/a Machine Learning Engineer especializado/a en Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Python y MLOps para incorporarse a un proyecto de Grupo DIA. Buscamos un perfil técnico con experiencia en el desarrollo de modelos predictivos, procesamiento de grandes volúmenes de datos e industrialización de soluciones de Machine Learning en entornos productivos. La persona seleccionada participará en el diseño, desarrollo y optimización de pipelines de datos y modelos, garantizando su escalabilidad, eficiencia y mantenibilidad. Funciones principales Diseñar, desarrollar y optimizar soluciones de Machine Learning sobre Google Cloud Platform. Trabajar con Vertex AI para la creación de pipelines, gestión del ciclo de vida de los modelos, Model Registry, Workbench y despliegues en producción. Desarrollar código avanzado en Python siguiendo buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software, modularidad, desacoplamiento y testing. Diseñar y entrenar modelos predictivos con algoritmos como LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost u otros similares. Procesar y analizar grandes volúmenes de datos, trabajando con datasets de millones de registros. Construir y mantener pipelines automatizados de entrenamiento e inferencia, optimizando los procesos ETL/ELT. Industrializar modelos mediante prácticas MLOps, incluyendo versionado, reproducibilidad, automatización y monitorización. Implementar procesos CI/CD y gestionar entornos de ejecución mediante Docker y herramientas como GitHub Actions o GitLab CI. Optimizar el rendimiento de consultas y procesos de datos utilizando BigQuery. Colaborar con equipos técnicos aplicando metodologías de desarrollo, revisiones de código y control de versiones. Requisitos imprescindibles Experiencia sólida y demostrable con Google Cloud Platform (GCP), especialmente Vertex AI y BigQuery. Nivel avanzado de Python, con experiencia en desarrollo de código modular, testeable y preparado para ejecuciones concurrentes. Experiencia desarrollando modelos de Machine Learning con algoritmos como LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost o similares. Experiencia trabajando con grandes volúmenes de datos y optimizando tiempos de entrenamiento e inferencia. Experiencia en MLOps, llevando modelos desde entornos experimentales hasta producción. Conocimientos prácticos de Docker, CI/CD y automatización de despliegues. Experiencia construyendo pipelines de datos eficientes para procesos de entrenamiento e inferencia. Buenas prácticas de ingeniería de software: Git, testing automatizado, code reviews y gestión de dependencias. Requisitos valorables Experiencia en forecasting y series temporales, especialmente en previsión de demanda con un elevado número de productos o entidades. Conocimientos sobre estacionalidad, promociones, eventos y estrategias de cold-start para nuevos productos. Experiencia con arquitecturas modernas de Deep Learning para series temporales: Temporal Fusion Transformer (TFT), TiDE, PatchTST, TimesFM, Chronos o Transformers. Conocimientos de IA Generativa, LLMOps, RAG, agentes, evaluación de modelos y observabilidad. Experiencia optimizando hiperparámetros con Optuna, Ray Tune o herramientas similares. Conocimientos de paralelización del entrenamiento, optimización de inferencia y reducción de costes computacionales.

items.desc: L'entreprise Rejoignez CTC Groupe, un acteur international de référence au service de l'innovation et des savoir-faire d'excellence ! Chez CTC, nous bâtissons aux côtés de nos industries et clients un avenir empreint de compétitivité et de durabilité. Partenaire incontournable sur les marchés de la mode, du luxe, du sport, des équipements de protection individuelle et des métiers de l'environnement, nous accompagnons avec passion nos clients dans le développement de leur performance en France et à l’international, en leur apportant des solutions globales innovantes, un savoir-faire d’excellence et un soutien personnalisé. Fort d’une expertise développée depuis 1899, CTC Groupe, 485 personnes et 42M€ de ressources, a su passer de l'expertise technologique à la commercialisation de services à forte valeur ajoutée. Le groupe est aujourd’hui présent en Italie, en Chine et au Vietnam. En intégrant notre équipe, vous contribuerez activement au développement des performances de la filière cuir maroquinerie chaussure et ganterie en France et à l'international. Contexte Dans un environnement concurrentiel où la capacité d'innovation est essentielle pour se différencier, les entreprises de notre filière (Cuir, Chaussure, Maroquinerie, Ganterie et Tannerie) doivent intensifier leurs efforts en recherche et développement. CTC les accompagne en développant des solutions innovantes, adaptées aux contraintes économiques du secteur. CTC dispose d'un patrimoine de connaissances riche de plus de 25 ans de travaux R&D et d'expertise métier. Pour le valoriser, CTC souhaite développer des assistants IA capables de répondre en langage naturel à partir de ses connaissances techniques. Une première preuve de concept a déjà été réalisé et CTC souhaite maintenant déployer une solution industrielle avec l’appui d’un prestataire spécialisé. Dans le cadre d'un remplacement de congé maternité, nous recherchons une Chef-fe de projet IA & Data pour assurer la continuité de ces projets. Description Du Poste Rattachée au département Technologie Informatique de la direction Innovation, vous reprendrez le pilotage des projets d'assistants IA en cours. Vous travaillerez en lien avec les experts métiers et R&D, et les prestataires. Activités Assurer la continuité et le suivi des projets en cours (planning, coordination, reporting, budget) Formaliser les besoins et les traduire en spécifications pour le prestataire Piloter le prestataire : suivi des livrables, des délais et de la qualité, points d'avancement Coordonner, avec les experts, l'inventaire, la sélection et la préparation des données et documents qui alimenteront les assistants Définir la stratégie de centralisation de la donnée Challenger les choix techniques du prestataire pour obtenir la solution la plus adaptée à nos besoins Construire et organiser les campagnes de tests avec les experts métier Veiller aux enjeux de confidentialité et de droits d'accès aux données Documenter les travaux pour faciliter la passation au retour de la titulaire du poste Participer à la valorisation des projets (articles, webinaires) Profil recherché Profil Bac+5 en école d'informatique ou d'ingénieur, spécialisation IA / data. Expérience en gestion de projet informatique, idéalement avec un pilotage de prestataires. items.desc: Les missions : Dans le cadre du développement des systèmes d’assistance pour les engins miniers, vous contribuerez à l’élaboration des stratégies de perception de l’environnement. Vos principales missions seront : Réaliser des études de faisabilité pour le système de perception d’environnement autour d’une pelle minière (détection d’obstacles : engin minier, piéton / localisation pelle / cartographie terrain). Développer les modules logiciels d’acquisition, calibration, fusion et traitement de données provenant des capteurs de perception (Lidar, Radar, Camera). Identifier les technologies et approches les plus adaptées à une application minière et aux besoins définis. Définir et réaliser des tests avec des outils de simulation ou sur machines, en usine et sur site pour valider les concepts. Réaliser des cahiers des charges de composants ou fonctions logicielles et assurer le lien avec les fournisseurs. Analyser les données remontées par les machines sur le terrain. Rédiger la documentation associée aux développements. Le profil recherché : Ingénieur en mécatronique, orienté Computer Vision, avec une expérience de 5 ans minimum dans le développement de systèmes mécatroniques, de perception pour l’automatisation d’engins mobiles. Avoir de bonnes connaissances en systèmes de perception (Caméras, Radars, Lidars, …). Maîtriser Python, C++ et ROS/ ROS 2. Être autonome, rigoureux et avoir un bon sens pratique. Faire preuve d’ouverture d’esprit, avoir un bon sens relationnel et avoir l’esprit d’équipe. Maîtriser l’anglais. items.desc: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation team at Mapbox develops and operates web services powering virtually all of Mapbox’s strategic navigation initiatives in consumer, automotive, and logistics verticals. We are a highly multidisciplinary organization, with work spanning distributed systems on AWS to geospatial localization, traffic telemetry, and mapping. Collectively we are revolutionizing in-car experiences with technology to build fast, industry-leading maps and navigation for any vehicle. We’ve launched products such as MapGPT, Mapbox for EV, and we’re enhancing the visual experience of in-vehicle navigation with 3D styling with our new Mapbox Standard through web and mobile SDKs. Mapbox has worked with automotive partners — including BMW, Toyota, and GM — to bring the best aspects of mobile app development into in-vehicle navigation and infotainment. Mapbox Blog: Introducing 3D Live Navigation Mapbox Blog: Route Notifications Improve Driver Safety Mapbox Newsroom: AI Features in New Navigation SDK As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You’ll Do As a Machine Learning Engineer III on the Routing Cost team, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of highly trafficked recommendation systems for our routing cost engine. Your technical contributions will include: Lead the engineering team(s) to execute end-to-end feature implementation within the larger navigation organization (~80 engineers). Design and build new ML and data pipelines, as well as optimizing existing ML and data pipelines. Build tools for automated quality assurance and data exploration. Leverage geospatial algorithms to optimize pipelines, as well as creating automated tuning and outlier detection algorithms. Partner with data scientists to make improvements to our models for determining patterns in movement and/or traffic. Mentor colleagues and participate in code and design reviews. Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends. What We Believe Are Important Traits For This Role 8-10+ years of backend and ML experience: Extensive hands-on experience showcasing expertise and a strong track record in the engineering field. Technical knowledge: Extensive experience with Python, distributed processing pipelines (Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Dask), and very large datasets – statistical analysis, data quality control, optimizing storage. Cloud proficiency: Extensive experience with cloud and infrastructure services, including, as well as deploying and managing infrastructure in cloud environments. Operational excellence: You drive a culture of quality and continuous improvement in your organization. Strong passion for clean code and robust architecture, with a drive to elevate engineering practices and design standards across the team. Ownership & execution: Own the technical vision, lead the strategy and guide the team to execute towards building the future of our routing cost engine. Customer focus: You care deeply about your customers and their problems, and you work tirelessly to innovate on their behalf. Growth mindset: Have the humility to accept mistakes, learn and grow from them. Mentorship: Experience mentoring and leading engineering teams developing skill sets and career growth. Strong written and vocal communication skills: You can talk and write about complex ideas concisely to a wide audience. You are able to lead and resolve org-wide technical discussions and are able to collaborate and include input from cross-functional teams (security, devops, data, compliance and product). Data informed mindset: You believe in the value of data informed decision making and strive to measure things that are not straight forward but essential. You also have the right instincts to make speedy decisions in the absence of perfect & comprehensive data What We Value In addition to our core values, which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through …

items.card: Aufgaben und suchen Dich als: Distinguished Engineer – Software & AI Products (w/m/d) In unseren Teams Software Engineering und DevSecOps entwickeln und betreiben wir einen umfangreichen Software-Stack für kritische Kommunikationsnetze, basierend auf Microservices-Architekturen, Cloud-basierten Plattformen und containerisierten Lösungen. Im Fokus stehen die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen und die Integration von KI
items.desc: Ab sofort in Berlin, Hannover, Bonn Deine Familie, Deine Freunde und Du verlassen sich rund um die Uhr auf Rettungskräfte und Einrichtungen der Regierung. Eure Helferinnen und Helfer sorgen 24/7 für Eure Sicherheit und wir sorgen mit Leidenschaft und Einsatz rund um die Uhr dafür, dass sie es können! Wir betreiben seit über 10 Jahren Kommunikations-Netzwerke für den Digitalfunk BOS und die Netze des Bundes. Unser Motto: helfen helfen! Sei dabei! Wir wachsen mit unseren Aufgaben und suchen Dich als: Distinguished Engineer – Software & AI Products (w/m/d) In unseren Teams Software Engineering und DevSecOps entwickeln und betreiben wir einen umfangreichen Software-Stack für kritische Kommunikationsnetze, basierend auf Microservices-Architekturen, Cloud-basierten Plattformen und containerisierten Lösungen. Im Fokus stehen die Verarbeitung großer Datenmengen und die Integration von KI und Machine Learning in unsere Produkte. Als Distinguished Engineer bist Du die technische Instanz zwischen Engineering und Unternehmensführung: Du schreibst nicht selbst den Code, verstehst ihn aber im Detail und vertrittst technische Strategien überzeugend vor der obersten Führungsebene. Aufgaben Du treibst die Entwicklung von Microservices-Architekturen, Cloud-basierten Plattformen und containerisierten Lösungen voran und verantwortest die technologische Roadmap. Du gestaltest skalierbare, hochverfügbare und sichere Systeme für heterogene Datenquellen und die Integration von KI/ML-Lösungen. Du bereitest strategische Technologieentscheidungen (z. B. Architektur, Make-or-Buy, Partner) vor und vertrittst sie gegenüber den Entscheidern. Du bereitest komplexe Zusammenhänge als Entscheidungsvorlagen für die Unternehmensführung auf und bewertest Investitionen und Risiken. Du förderst eine Kultur der technischen Exzellenz in der ALDB. Profil Studium der Informatik oder vergleichbar, oder Du überzeugst uns, dass es auch anders geht Fundierte Erfahrung in Architektur und Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme sowie in einer technischen Führungsrolle Tiefgreifende Kenntnisse in Microservices, Kubernetes, Cloud, CI/CD, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, REST, Datenpipelines sowie gängigen Technologien wie Java, Python, TypeScript und React Gute Kenntnisse im Bereich KI/ML und Erfahrung mit Systemen in hochsicheren, abgeschotteten Umgebungen (air-gapped) Strategisches Denken, wirtschaftliches Verständnis und souveränes Auftreten auf oberster Führungsebene Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Wir bieten Sicherer Arbeitsplatz : Gesellschaftlich relevante Mission · Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt · Betriebliche Altersvorsorge · Interessante Herausforderungen Work-Life-Balance : Flexible und mobile Arbeits-Modelle, die zu Deinem Leben passen Attraktive Zusatzleistungen : Job-Rad · Job-Ticket · Firmenfitness · u. v. m. Langfristige Perspektive : Zahlreiche Chancen für Deine persönliche Entwicklung · Regelmäßige Trainings · Zukunftsorientiertes Umfeld Angenehme Arbeitsatmosphäre : Tolle Kolleginnen und Kollegen · Offene Kommunikation · Hervorragendes Arbeitsklima und Teamgeist Important note Please be advised that a valid work permit for Germany is required for non-EU citizens. Unfortunately, applications without a valid work permit and sufficient German language skills may not be considered. LNKD1_DE

items.desc: AI & Automation Analyst Location: Greater Manchester (hybrid working) Salary: New role - dependent on experience Are you working in Application Support, Business Systems or Technical Business Analysis and looking for an opportunity to move into AI and Automation? Well Street are proud to be exclusively partnering a major European organisation in an exciting part of their growth journey to recruit an AI Analyst. Our client is at an exciting stage of its technology journey. Having invested in AI and automation tools, the business is now looking for someone who can help turn that investment into meaningful improvements in how people work. This isn't a traditional AI Developer position. We're looking for someone who enjoys understanding how businesses operate, solving problems and finding smarter ways of doing things using technology. You'll work closely with the IT Director and teams across the business, identifying opportunities to improve processes, reduce manual tasks and introduce practical AI and automation solutions. It's an opportunity to take ownership, experiment with new technologies and play an important role in shaping how AI is adopted across the organisation. What you'll be doing Working with colleagues across Finance, Operations, Sales, Marketing and Customer Service to understand how they work and identify opportunities for improvement. Reviewing existing business applications, workflows and processes to identify inefficiencies and repetitive tasks. Designing and building practical automation and AI-enabled solutions that make everyday activities easier and more efficient. Supporting the adoption of AI tools, helping colleagues understand how they can use them effectively. Working with data across business applications, including ERP, CRM and Excel, to improve reporting, accuracy and accessibility. Using tools such as SQL, Python, APIs and automation platforms to connect systems, manipulate data and streamline processes. Developing reports and dashboards, including Power BI, to help teams make better-informed decisions. Testing, documenting and improving solutions to ensure they're reliable, secure and easy to use. Becoming a key point of contact for colleagues looking to explore how AI and automation could improve their work. What we're looking for We're open to candidates from a range of technical backgrounds, particularly Application Support, Business Systems, Technical Business Analysis or Automation. More important than your job title is your ability to understand problems, work with people and use technology to develop practical solutions. Ideally, you'll bring: Around 2–5 years' experience in Application Support, Business Systems, Business Analysis, Data Analysis or a similar technical role. Experience supporting or working with business applications such as ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to understand how technology supports business processes. Some hands-on experience with scripting, SQL, Python, APIs or workflow automation. Practical experience experimenting with or applying AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot or similar in a business environment. Confidence working directly with non-technical colleagues to understand requirements and explain solutions. An interest in improving processes rather than simply maintaining existing systems. A proactive attitude, curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies. Experience with Power BI, automation platforms or integrating AI into business workflows would be advantageous, but you don't need to be an expert in everything. Interested? If you're a technically minded problem-solver who enjoys finding better ways of doing things and wants to build a career in AI and automation, we'd love to hear from you. You don't need to have AI in your current job title. We're equally interested in people who've taken the initiative to automate processes, improve systems or experiment with new technologies in their existing roles. Please ‘apply within’ or email your CV to Charlie@well-street.co.uk .

Since then, we’ve grown from 3 to 700+ people, gained unicorn status, raised ~£140M over three funding rounds, turned profitable, insured millions of drivers and lent millions in car loans. But we’re only just getting started. Our goal is to become one of the largest financial services providers in the world. Over the next 10 years we’ll grow exponentially, not only by scaling our existing products, but also by building new ones. To achieve our goals we need incredibly ambitious, commercially driven people who never settle for ‘good enough’. Marshmallowers are hungry for autonomy and ownership, and would rather improve than coast. Everyone raises standards and has an impact, with a focus on collective success over self-interest. We’ve created an environment where curious, tenacious people win and grow together. If that sounds motivating, this could be the place for you. London (hybrid, 2-3 days in office) Pricing at Marshmallow This role will sit in the Pricing Team, reporting into the Pricing Data Science Manager. The team is responsible for managing our loss ratio, underwriting footprint, broker optimisation and growth targets, proving integral to driving the business forwards. But you’ve probably read that all before! So what’s new? We work in a very different way to most pricing teams that you might be familiar with. Everyone in Pricing has the potential to make significant contribution to the business, taking ownership, moving fast, innovating and delivering changes to our rates at high frequency. We don’t just churn out GLMs all day. We build & deploy exceptional in-house pricing data science models using the latest modelling techniques. You’ll work alongside other Pricing Data Scientists & Analysts pushing innovative pricing projects, whilst also being able to work with the wider Data Science community on modelling customer behaviour, fraud & MLENG enhancements. We work alongside a bunch of amazing engineers who ensure we can implement our decisions quickly. We also have access to huge amounts of data. We don’t just mean your standard policy, claims and quote data. Our engineers spend their lives building APIs to third parties so that we know more about our customers than any of our competitors. All of this means that you’ll have access to as much data as you can handle, the freedom to be creative, the backing of senior leaders to make decisions, and the ability to see your ideas implemented rapidly. And on top of all of that, we’re a pretty fun group to hang around with! What You’ll Be Doing Developing a deep understanding of Marshmallow’s quote, policy and claims data and use this to derive insights that can be used to enhance our pricing. Own one of the strategic initiatives of the pricing team, such as supporting our expansion plans or protecting our renewing customers. Conducting claims analysis and claims modelling using SQL and Python. Conducting price optimisation analysis/modelling using Python. Building and deploying models in APIs for use in real time pricing. Identify new sources of external data that enable us to refine our view of claims risk, and conduct analysis to quantify their value. Working directly with our Engineering & MLENG functions to implement pricing proposals. Providing pricing support for the launch of multiple new products. Who are you? Proactive: You drive growth by identifying & delivering new opportunities Modeller: You use your DS expertise to build innovative best in class models Commercial: You directly use your models as tools to deliver timely real world impact Curious: You aren’t satisfied with ‘That’s just how it is’; you immediately investigate further Owner: You don’t just pull existing levers - you own end to end transformation in your area Opinionated: You generate your own opinions & pitch to others in an open & honest way Explainer: You can communicate complicated concepts in a simple way to non-experts Networker: You build and maintain strong relationships throughout the business What skills are we looking for from you? Ability to interrogate data and conduct pricing analysis within SQL & Python/R Ability to build GLMs, GBMs and other claims models within Python/R At least 3 years of experience working in a data driven (ideally commercial) role Perks of the job Bonus scheme designed to reward high performance Private medical insurance with Vitality, mental health support with Oliva Personal learning budget and 2 dedicated L&D days a year Monthly flexible benefits budget to spend as you choose 25 days holiday plus bank holidays 4 weeks Work From Anywhere per year We are able to offer visa sponsorship for this position. The platforms process extremely large collections of structured and unstructured research data.
