Design and develop engineering components for retrieval-augmented generation systems, including query interpretation, document chunking, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, and semantic search. Manage prompt libraries, guardrails, and structured outputs for large language model integrations. Design and implement machine learning pipelines that integrate search engines, vector databases, and graph databases. items.desc: Contexte de la mission Au sein de l'équipe Assistant IA de la R&D de SII Sud-Ouest, vous contribuerez à des projets d’innovation visant à améliorer les outils et méthodes utilisés par les équipes d’ingénierie intervenant dans des environnements techniques exigeants tels que l’automobile, l’aéronautique ou le spatial. Ce stage porte sur le développement d’un assistant de traduction de code intégrant des exigences élevées en matière de sécurité des données. Le stage proposé se concentre sur la poursuite du développement d’un assistant sur un cas précis afin d'améliorer ses performances et de démontrer sa pertinence auprès des utilisateurs finaux. Une seconde phase pourra étudier une généralisation de l'outil. Missions Analyser et formaliser les besoins des utilisateurs afin de définir précisément les objectifs fonctionnels et techniques de l’assistant Réaliser un état de l’art des solutions existantes en traduction de code, intelligence artificielle générative et assistants de développement Définir une méthodologie d’expérimentation permettant d’évaluer la qualité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des résultats produits Concevoir, développer et améliorer les composants de l’assistant de traduction de code à partir de technologies d’intelligence artificielle Mettre en place des protocoles de tests et des indicateurs de performance pour mesurer la pertinence des solutions proposées Analyser de manière critique les résultats obtenus et identifier les axes d’amélioration technique et fonctionnelle. Documenter les travaux réalisés, assurer la traçabilité des expérimentations et capitaliser les connaissances acquises. Collaborer quotidiennement avec des équipes de data science et de développement logiciel dans un environnement de recherche appliquée Participer à l’étude de l’extension de la solution vers d’autres cas d’usage et contextes technologiques Formation Bac+5 en école d’ingénieur ou cursus universitaire avec une spécialisation en informatique, intelligence artificielle ou domaine connexe Bonnes compétences en développement logiciel (Python, Java, C/C++ ou technologies équivalentes) et maîtrise des fondamentaux de l’ingénierie logicielle Connaissances en intelligence artificielle, machine learning, modèles de langage ou traitement automatique des données Capacité à structurer une démarche d’analyse, à évaluer des résultats expérimentaux et à produire des synthèses exploitables Aisance rédactionnelle pour produire des documents techniques, rapports d’étude et livrables de capitalisation Capacité à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires dans un contexte de recherche et d’innovation Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®. Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !

items.desc: PUESTO: Investigador predoctoral en Realidad Virtual e Inteligencia Artificial para neurorrehabilitación Descripción del puesto En el Grupo de Investigación Neurorehabilitation & Brain Research Group del Instituto HumanTech de la Universitat Politècnica de Valencia (UPV) buscamos incorporar un investigador/a predoctoral que esté interesado en realizar la tesis en el uso de entornos virtuales gamificados y adaptativos mediante técnicas de inteligencia artificial para la rehabilitación tras un ictus. El investigador/a se unirá al proyecto RAISE (Rehabilitation and assessment using Artificial Intelligence-enhanced Simulated Environments), cuyo objetivo es resolver problemas específicos en el marco de la salud y la rehabilitación asistida por tecnología. El investigador/a tendrá como cometido principal el entrenamiento de entornos virtuales, creados previamente en Unity, utilizando aprendizaje por refuerzo (Reinforcement Learning) u otras técnicas de Inteligencia Artificial. El objetivo es que estos entornos realicen un ajuste dinámico de la dificultad para adaptarse en tiempo real al estado y nivel de habilidad de los pacientes. Buscamos una persona con interés en la inteligencia artificial, el desarrollo de entornos virtuales, el análisis de datos, y con capacidad de trabajar autónomamente dentro de nuestro grupo de investigación, referente internacional en proyectos de investigación en el ámbito de la neurorrehabilitación. Tareas a desarrollar Desarrollo y adaptación de entornos virtuales y gamificados utilizando el motor gráfico Unity. Diseño e implementación de algoritmos de inteligencia artificial, especialmente de aprendizaje por refuerzo (Reinforcement Learning), para ajustar dinámicamente la dificultad del juego. Entrenamiento de agentes computacionales dentro de arquitecturas multi-agente donde el entorno aprenda a adaptar sus parámetros en función del rendimiento del jugador para mantener una tasa de éxito objetivo. Integración de los modelos predictivos y de clasificación de IA con los datos de rendimiento e interacción del usuario extraídos desde los dispositivos de realidad virtual. Redacción de comunicaciones científicas en revistas y congresos especializados. Gestión documental de la actividad investigadora y desarrollo de justificaciones técnicas. Participación en actividades investigadoras de otros proyectos en marcha Conocimientos y experiencia Máster: Máster de carácter Científico Técnico. Idealmente con titulación en Ingeniería Informática, Desarrollo de Videojuegos, Ingeniería Biomédica o de Telecomunicación. Dominio del Idioma Inglés. Se valorarán los siguientes conocimientos Experiencia demostrable en el motor gráfico Unity y fluidez en programación orientada a objetos (C#). Conocimientos sólidos de métodos estadísticos y machine/deep learning, con especial énfasis en Reinforcement Learning. Programación en Python y/u otros lenguajes científicos (R, Matlab, etc.). Conocimiento del método científico, experiencia en análisis de datos experimentales y comunicación de resultados en artículos científicos. Skills Capacidad de trabajo en equipo. Liderazgo. Habilidades de comunicación. Capacidad de organización. Proactividad, capacidad para aportar y mejorar los procesos existentes. Capacidad de análisis, síntesis y redacción. Se valorará muy positivamente: Haber participado en proyectos de I+D relacionados con las áreas de la inteligencia artificial, desarrollo de entornos virtuales, y el análisis de datos. Haber realizado publicaciones científicas tanto en revistas y congresos científicos. Qué ofrecemos: Contrato a 3 años, con salario de 21.000 € brutos anuales. Contrato predoctoral con posibilidad de impartir docencia en la UPV. Jornada flexible con posibilidad de un día de teletrabajo. Condiciones laborales óptimas: 1 mes de vacaciones en agosto, 1 semana en Navidad y 1 semana en Semana Santa, al menos 6 días de libre disposición al año, horario reducido que permite la conciliación de la vida laboral y personal. Oportunidad ideal para ser parte de uno de los mejores laboratorios del mundo en aplicación de nuevas tecnologías para la medida del comportamiento humano. Entorno innovador, uso de últimas tecnologías, participación en proyectos nacionales y europeos con empresas y organismos de alto nivel. Además, la UPV pone a disposición de sus trabajadores gimnasio y guardería a precios ultra reducidos, centro de salud y otras instalaciones gratuitas.

items.desc: Contexte de la mission Au sein du Pôle R&D, nous participons au développement d’outils pour un numérique plus responsable et plus durable. Vous intégrerez le pôle R&D Transport du Futur de SII Sud-Ouest et travaillerez en collaboration avec une équipe pluridisciplinaire sur un projet qui vise à explorer le potentiel de l’IA dans la planification opérationnelle et notamment la prise en compte rapide des aléas et imprévus. L’objectif de ce stage est de faire un état de l’art et de participer aux premiers travaux exploratoires sur un nouveau projet de R&D concernant l’IA et la planification. Missions Réaliser un état de l’art sur les Graph Neural Networks (GNN), la planification opérationnelle, les processus métier BPM/BPMN et les interactions entre ces domaines Étudier les approches existantes permettant d’intégrer l’intelligence artificielle dans des problématiques de planification et d’optimisation industrielle Concevoir et mettre en place des ateliers synthétiques servant de base aux premiers travaux expérimentaux sur la gestion de situations de crise Développer des algorithmes d’IA capables de transformer automatiquement des modèles BPMN en modèles de programmation par contraintes Participer à l’optimisation des algorithmes développés afin d’améliorer leurs performances et leur capacité d’adaptation aux imprévus Concevoir des cas d’usage représentatifs et élaborer des scénarios de démonstration sous forme de Proof of Concept (PoC) Collaborer avec des spécialistes en intelligence artificielle et en Industrie 4.0 pour valider les approches retenues et analyser les résultats obtenus Produire des livrables techniques, documenter les expérimentations réalisées et présenter les conclusions des travaux de recherche En dernière année d’école d’ingénieur/université avec une spécialisation en intelligence artificielle, recherche opérationnelle, data science ou génie industriel Maîtrise des fondamentaux en modélisation, analyse de données, optimisation ou apprentissage automatique Connaissance d’outils et langages tels que Python, bibliothèques de data science et environnements de prototypage Capacité à structurer une démarche d’analyse pour traiter des problématiques techniques complexes Intérêt marqué pour l’expérimentation, l’évaluation comparative de solutions et l’innovation technologique Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires Qualité rédactionnelle permettant de formaliser clairement les résultats, analyses et recommandations Qui sommes-nous ? Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together ! Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif. En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante. Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !

items.desc: Je hebt al een paar jaar ervaring met het bouwen van AI-oplossingen en automatiseringen. Je weet hoe je iets technisch werkend krijgt, maar wilt ook steeds meer betrokken zijn bij het vraagstuk erachter. Waarom bouwen we dit eigenlijk? Hoe kan een proces slimmer? En hoe zorg je dat een oplossing daadwerkelijk gebruikt wordt? Bij TTI werk je aan uitdagende projecten voor organisaties als Philips, ABN AMRO en Nationale-Nederlanden. Je onderzoekt hoe werkprocessen beter kunnen, adviseert over de aanpak en bouwt zelf de oplossing. Zo krijg je de ruimte om zowel technisch als in je rol als consultant verder te groeien. En die ontwikkeling stopt niet bij je projecten. Met ons unieke ontwikkelprogramma, persoonlijke coaching en GROW Days investeren we ook in jouw professionele en persoonlijke groei. Zodat je niet alleen beter wordt in wat je doet, maar jezelf ook op andere vlakken blijft uitdagen. 1️⃣ Wat je gaat doen Je werkt aan complexe projecten waarbij je organisaties helpt hun werkprocessen slimmer in te richten met AI en automatisering. Je onderzoekt hoe teams werken, brengt verschillende belangen en behoeften in kaart en vertaalt die naar een duidelijke aanpak. Vervolgens ontwerp en bouw je zelf de oplossing, bijvoorbeeld met AI-agents, automatiseringen en koppelingen tussen systemen. Je hebt veel contact met stakeholders en weet hen mee te nemen in je aanpak. Je kunt technische keuzes helder uitleggen, je ideeën goed onderbouwen en mensen overtuigen van de waarde van je oplossing. Je werkt zelfstandig aan projecten of samen met collega's, waarbij je ook junior talenten kunt begeleiden. Uiteindelijk zorg je ervoor dat wat je bouwt niet alleen technisch werkt, maar ook daadwerkelijk gebruikt wordt. 2️⃣ Uniek ontwikkelprogramma Bij The Talent Institute vinden we het belangrijk dat je blijft groeien. Niet alleen in je vak, maar ook persoonlijk. Daarom krijg je naast je projecten alle ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Persoonlijke coaching: iedere maand een één-op-één gesprek met een professionele coach. GROW Days: vier keer per jaar twee dagen waarin je uit je dagelijkse routine stapt, nieuwe ervaringen opdoet en werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Samen leren: experimenteren met nieuwe AI-technologie, kennis delen en sparren met collega's. Eigen ontwikkeling: €1.000 studiebudget per jaar om te investeren in wat jij wilt leren. Wat krijg je van ons? Salaris en zekerheid Salaris tussen €4500 en €5000 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van je ervaring en wat je aantoonbaar kunt; Jaarlijkse salarisverhoging tot 15%; Vast contract met doorgroeimogelijkheden; Pensioenregeling. Vrijheid en flexibiliteit 25 vakantiedagen om op te laden; Een maand betaald sabbatical na drie jaar; Vier weken per jaar werken vanaf een plek naar keuze; En verder VrijMiBo's, zomer- en skitrips; Kantoordagen op woensdag en vrijdag om collega's te zien, de rest van de week flexibel. Een fietsenplan, vers fruit en snacks op kantoor. Onze ideale kandidaat We zoeken iemand die al ervaring heeft met het bouwen van AI-oplossingen en die het leuk vindt om zowel technisch als inhoudelijk verantwoordelijkheid te nemen. Je hebt 2 tot 4 jaar relevante werkervaring. Je hebt AI-oplossingen of automatiseringen gebouwd die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Je werkt met automatiseringsplatforms zoals n8n, Make of Copilot Studio, hebt ervaring met model-API's en kunt zelf code schrijven in Python. Je begrijpt hoe dataopslag en retrieval werken, bijvoorbeeld met databases en vector stores. Je kunt een vraagstuk analyseren, een oplossing bedenken en die zelfstandig realiseren. Je vindt het leuk om met verschillende stakeholders samen te werken en begrijpt hoe organisaties werken. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en Engels en woont in de Randstad. Mooi meegenomen: Ervaring met de Microsoft-omgeving. Ervaring binnen grote organisaties of een consultancyomgeving. Je hebt eerder teams geholpen om nieuwe technologie in gebruik te nemen. Herken je jezelf in deze rol, maar vink je niet alles af? Geen probleem. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, hoe je denkt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

items.desc: Unternehmensbeschreibung Bei uns ist KI kein Nebenprojekt, sondern Kern des Geschäftsmodells. Wir sind AdVenture Marketing aus Wien und besetzen Stellen für Partnerunternehmen in Österreich, Deutschland und der Schweiz. Dafür setzen wir auf eigene, selbst entwickelte Systeme, die jeden Tag im Einsatz sind. Du arbeitest bei uns also nicht an Folien und Pilotprojekten, sondern an Software, die echte Ergebnisse liefert. Wir sind ein Team aus 30 Leuten mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung, in dem Entscheidungen in Tagen fallen, nicht in Quartalen. Jetzt bauen wir den nächsten Schritt: unser eigenes Agentur-OS. Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Rollenbeschreibung Stell dir vor, ein Kunde unterschreibt und alles danach läuft von selbst. Das ist dein Job. Du baust Projekte, die sich selbst managen, und schaffst Copy-Paste in unserem Alltag ab. Dafür arbeitest du eng mit unseren Teams zusammen, findest heraus, wo Zeit verloren geht, und machst daraus automatisierte Abläufe. Du entwickelst KI-Agenten und LLM-Integrationen, verbindest unsere Systeme über APIs zu einem durchgängigen Ganzen und sorgst dafür, dass alles stabil läuft. Was du baust, ist ab dem nächsten Tag im Einsatz, und du bekommst sofort Feedback, ob es funktioniert. Du zeigst dem Team, was KI in der Praxis leisten kann, und nimmst alle beim Umgang damit mit. Einen fertigen Toolstack geben wir dir nicht vor: Du entscheidest, womit du baust. Die Vollzeitstelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen, überwiegend vor Ort in unserem Büro in 1030 Wien. Qualifikationen Du hast schon gebaut: Eigene KI- oder Automatisierungslösungen, egal ob mit Make, n8n oder eigenem Code. Zeig uns, was du umgesetzt hast, das zählt mehr als jedes Zeugnis. Du kannst entwickeln: Fundierte Erfahrung in Softwareentwicklung und Integration, idealerweise mit LLMs, KI-Agenten, APIs, Webhooks und Cloud-Plattformen. Du denkst in Prozessen: Du erkennst schnell, wo Abläufe haken, und findest pragmatische Lösungen statt perfekter Konzepte. Du nimmst Leute mit: Du erklärst Technik so, dass auch Kolleg:innen ohne IT-Hintergrund verstehen, warum dein System ihnen hilft. Du hast das Fundament: Studium in Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Ausbildung, alternativ entsprechende Praxiserfahrung. Du packst an: Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise, Lust auf Gestaltungsspielraum, sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse. Was wir dir bieten Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust unser Agentur-OS von Grund auf mit und prägst, wie wir in Zukunft arbeiten. Sichtbarer Impact: Keine Pilotprojekte für die Schublade. Was du baust, ist am nächsten Tag im Einsatz. Deine Tools: Kein vorgegebener Stack. Deine Ideen bekommen die Werkzeuge, die sie brauchen. Kurze Wege: Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung, Entscheidungen in Tagen statt Quartalen. Starkes Team: 30 Kolleg:innen, die Lust haben, mit dir neue Wege zu gehen. Gehalt: Wir bieten dir ein Jahresbruttogehalt ab 65.000 € auf Vollzeitbasis. Das ist unser Einstieg, nicht die Obergrenze: Wenn du echten Impact bringst, zahlen wir dir um einiges mehr.

items.desc: About us GCHQ is an intelligence and cyber security agency with a mission to keep the UK safe. We use cutting-edge technology, ingenuity and partnerships to identify, analyse and disrupt threats. Working alongside our intelligence partners, MI5 and MI6, we protect the UK from terrorism, cyber-attacks and espionage. At GCHQ, you’ll take on varied and fascinating work in a supportive and inclusive environment where teamwork is at the heart of everything we do. The role GCHQ is offering an exciting opportunity to join a growing operational area responsible for the interception and exploitation of global communications in support of the UK Government, the UK military and our allies. You will initially join our Communications Exploitation development team, where you will be supported in developing the skills needed to exploit global communications. Through a combination of on-the-job-training, innovative experimentation and prototyping, you’ll help deliver real-world mission outcomes. If you have a passion for technology and are keen to build a career using innovative engineering to support GCHQ’s mission, this role could be for you. As a Exploitation Engineer, you’ll work as part of an Agile team to design, develop and deploy technical solutions that support mission requirements. Using a combination of software, firmware and hardware engineering, you’ll contribute across the full engineering lifecycle, from understanding user needs to development, testing and deployment. Many of the challenges you’ll encounter will be complex, with no obvious solution. You’ll therefore undertake research, prototyping and experimentation to develop innovative approaches that meet operational needs. You’ll also work closely with operators to ensure technologies you develop can be deployed effectively across global networks and military platforms. Typical work within the Communications Exploitation development team includes researching emerging communications technologies, developing software and signal-processing capabilities, applying AI to complex challenges, and designing bespoke hardware and RF solutions. You’ll use a variety of modern programming languages, tools and frameworks, including JavaScript, Java, C++, Python, Rust, Go and .NET. Depending on the work you undertake, you may also use technologies such as Kubernetes, MATLAB, VHDL and FPGA-based platforms to develop and deploy operational capabilities. You’ll work with a broad range of technologies while developing your expertise through practical experience and collaboration. As part of our Communications Exploitation development team, you’ll work alongside colleagues, the military and international partners to deliver solutions that support UK interests at home and overseas. If you’re successful in securing a Exploitation Engineer role, please note that occasional travel to another GCHQ site may be required. Where overnight stays are necessary, GCHQ will fully cover travel and accommodation expenses. Salary: £41,714, made up of a base salary of £35,134, a concessionary payment of £2,758, and a skills payment of up to £3,822 from day one, reflecting the skills and experience you demonstrate during the selection process. Plus, a £2,000 recruitment bonus. Flexible working: We recognise the importance of a healthy work-life balance and offer a range of flexible working arrangements, including part-time and compressed hours. Where business needs allow, we can also offer flexibility around start and finish times. Due to the nature of the role, homeworking isn’t available. About you We’re looking for people with a passion for technology and engineering. You’ll have studied a STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics) subject, such as Physics, Software Engineering or Electronic Engineering, gained through a diploma, foundation degree, apprenticeship or equivalent programme. A completed qualification isn’t essential. What’s most important is curiosity, enthusiasm for learning and an interest in developing your technical skills. You may have gained practical experience through university projects, placements, apprenticeships, personal projects or hobbies. We’re particularly interested in how you’ve applied your knowledge to solve problems, develop solutions and explore new ideas. You’ll have experience of at least one modern programming language or framework, such as C++, Go, Java, JavaScript, .NET, Node.js, Python or Rust. Experience working with technologies such as Kubernetes would be valuable. In addition, you’ll have an understanding of at least one of the following areas: digital signal processing, telecommunications and signal protocols, RF engineering, or FPGA and VHDL. Experience using AI to support software development, code generation or problem-solving would be beneficial. items.desc: Research & Breeding PhD Rijk Zwaan is at the forefront of applying advanced computational and molecular approaches in plant breeding. To strengthen our capabilities in improving complex traits, we are looking for a Systems Biology Scientist to join our team in Fijnaart. Your job at Rijk Zwaan: As a Systems Biology Scientist, you will develop and apply systems-level models to understand the molecular networks that underpin complex traits in crops. You will work at the interface of genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics and advanced computational modeling, translating large-scale data into actionable biological insight for research and breeding. You will collaborate closely with experts in computational biology, bioinformaticians, ICT, plant biology and external research partners. Keeping both short- and long-term research objectives in mind, you will explore, adapt and implement novel systems biology and AI-driven approaches to build and apply tools that support data-driven trait development. In this role, you will: Develop and apply gene regulatory and molecular network models for complex trait analysis in various crops. Contribute to developing machine interpretable network storage system. Integrate multi-omics data (e.g. genomics, transcriptomics, proteomics) to model multigene traits relevant for variety development Apply systems biology and AI-based approaches to identify key regulators and intervention points (protein and DNA level) Translate modeling results into hypotheses and insights for testing in breeding and research programs Contribute to the internal vision on data-driven studies to boost regulatory network analysis Join external collaborative projects on behalf of Rijk Zwaan and internalize the outcomes Where will you be working? Rijk Zwaan is an international family-owned company with a people-oriented culture. Rijk Zwaan is at the beginning of the food chain. We develop vegetable and fruit varieties and sell seeds to growers and other chain partners all over the world. We make an important contribution to the world food supply. This position is within Biotechnology department under Computational Biology team, an interdisciplinary and international team of researchers passionate about biocomplexity, genetics, data analysis and AI applications in breeding research. The team works closely with domain experts in trait biology, bioinformatics and genomics technology development, and actively participates in long-term strategic research collaborations. Your contribution: You are curious, analytical and motivated to work on complex biological questions. You enjoy interdisciplinary collaboration and can communicate complex concepts in a clear and structured way. You combine strong quantitative skills with biological insight and enjoy translating models into impact. In addition, we can find the following on your CV: PhD in Systems Biology, Computational Biology or Bioinformatics Proven experience in experimental setup and modeling gene regulatory or molecular networks in plants Strong background in multi-omics data integration and analysis Familiarity with AI or machine learning approaches in genomics is an advantage Experience working in interdisciplinary and/or collaborative research projects Strong programming and data analysis skills (e.g. Python, R or similar) What can you expect from us? The basics are, of course, well taken care of. We are happy to offer you: A permanent contract right away for a minimum of 30 hours per week A good salary based on job level and experience 25 vacation days, one vitality day, and the option to purchase additional days Training opportunities through the Rijk Zwaan Academy At Rijk Zwaan it’s not just about good employment conditions, but also about your growth, health and enjoyment at work. You’ll see this reflected in, among other things An introductory lunch with management and other new colleagues Fresh soup, fruit and/or salads “Rondjes Rijk Zwaan” introduction program – get to know our culture, departments and history Development discussions instead of performance reviews Rijk Zwaan Fit with activities such as running and bootcamp, plus discounts on your gym membership Activities to participate in, ranging from BBQ to photography workshops.

items.desc: Bring unseren Robotern Bewusstsein bei Physische KI kann nicht nur mit Daten aus dem Internet trainiert werden. Roboter müssen Fähigkeiten in der echten Welt lernen – indem sie beobachten, mit ihrer Umgebung interagieren und echte Aufgaben ausführen. Genau darum geht es bei NEURA Gym : Ein weltweites Netzwerk von Trainingszentren, in denen Roboter industrielle Aufgaben direkt von erfahrenen Menschen lernen, die diese Prozesse in- und auswendig kennen. Als Data Operator arbeitest du direkt mit den verschiedenen Robotern von NEURA Robotics (unter anderem mit dem modernen humanoiden Roboter 4NE1 ). Du hilfst dabei, reale Daten zu sammeln, mit denen unsere KI trainiert wird. Durch Teleoperation, Tests und das Einrichten der Roboter trägst du dazu bei, dass unsere Roboter immer intelligenter und leistungsfähiger werden. Das machst du Du steuerst die Roboter von NEURA per Teleoperation und führst echte Aufgaben aus. Du trägst Motion-Capture-Equipment und führst vorgegebene Bewegungen und Abläufe nach Projektvorgaben aus. Du führst strukturierte Datensammlungen durch, damit hochwertige Trainingsdaten für unsere KI entstehen. Du richtest Roboter ein, kalibrierst sie und bereitest sie für Tests und Demos vor. Du beobachtest die Leistung der Roboter, arbeitest eng mit den Servicetechnikern vor Ort zusammen, löst Probleme und dokumentierst deine Beobachtungen. Du arbeitest mit KI- und Robotik-Ingenieuren zusammen, um unsere Roboter weiter zu verbessern. Warum NEURA Robotics? Du arbeitest jeden Tag direkt mit modernsten Robotern. Du hilfst dabei, die KI für die nächste Generation von Robotern zu trainieren. Du sammelst praktische Erfahrung mit Robotik-Hardware und Teleoperation. Du wirst Teil eines schnell wachsenden Teams, das die Zukunft intelligenter Roboter mitgestaltet. Du passt gut zu uns, wenn du... gerne in einer schnellen Produktionsumgebung arbeitest, auch im Schichtbetrieb. eine praktische Ausbildung oder Erfahrung in Bereichen wie Mechanik, Elektrik, Automobil oder etwas Ähnlichem hast. zuverlässig, flexibel und lernbereit bist. Erfahrung mit Robotik oder Automatisierung hast – ist super, aber kein Muss. Englisch sprichst. Deutsch ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung. Körperliche Voraussetzungen Du kannst längere Zeit stehen und dich bewegen. Du hast eine gute Hand-Augen-Koordination und arbeitest präzise. Du kannst wiederkehrende Teleoperationsaufgaben konzentriert und sorgfältig ausführen.

Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. Location/Division Specific Information: Olink, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, is dedicated to advancing the understanding of human disease through proteomics. Olink panels provide innovative, high-quality solutions for human protein biomarker discovery, enabling researchers to measure thousands of proteins simultaneously from just a few microliters of blood. Using highly specific and thoroughly validated assays with a wide dynamic range, Olink’s technology overcomes traditional limitations in protein analysis and supports deeper insights into human biology and disease. The role is based in Uppsala, and you will be reporting to the Manager, Analytical Development. In this role, you play a key role in developing analytical tools and concepts for QC. items.desc: JOB TITLE Ingénieur Biophysique – R&I Peau (H/F/X) - Aulnay-sous-Bois, France Bonjour, nous sommes L’Oréal. Nous ne nous contentons pas de créer des marques, nous façonnons la manière dont le monde vit la beauté (et cela demande de nombreux métiers passionnants). Intrigué(e) ? Continuez votre lecture, cette opportunité est peut-être celle que vous attendiez. A Day in the Life Au sein de notre laboratoire de Biophysique de la Peau à Aulnay-sous-Bois, récemment intégré au département Biologie Translationnelle (regroupant les équipes Biophysique, Clinique, OMICS, Digital et Imagerie,), vous jouerez un rôle clé dans l'objectivation de la performance de nos innovations. En tant qu'expert(e) scientifique, vous contribuerez à repousser les limites de la connaissance de la peau pour définir et valider de nouvelles cibles biologiques et tester la performance des produits. Vos Responsabilités Principales Seront Les Suivantes Caractérisation et Connaissance de la Peau : Étudier les propriétés physiques et biologiques de la peau : concevoir des protocoles pour analyser la structure de la barrière cutanée (cohésion et composants clés du stratum corneum). Comprendre la peau et évaluer l'impact des produits : étudier les différents états de la peau (saine, sèche, dermatite atopique...) et mesurer l'effet d'actifs ou de formules sur divers modèles (ex-vivo, peaux reconstruites, ou sur volontaires). Faire le pont entre la physique et la biologie : relier les mesures physiques et de surface (topographie, rugosité, brillance, tribologie, mécanique, signatures spectrales, imagerie…) à la réalité biologique de la peau pour donner du sens aux données. Innovation Méthodologique & Co-développement Instrumental : Concevoir et déployer des approches expérimentales et des protocoles d'évaluation inédits pour caractériser les propriétés physiques et mécaniques de la peau in-vivo et ex-vivo. Piloter, en synergie avec des partenaires internes et externes (académiques, start-ups, fournisseurs), le co-développement de nouveaux appareils de mesure et définir de nouveaux descripteurs physiques de la peau. Analyse de Données, Modélisation & IA : Développer et optimiser des pipelines automatisés d'analyse de données et d'images (via Python) pour valoriser les signaux et cartographies issus de nos instruments de biophysique (topographie, mécanique). Collaborer avec l'équipe Digital pour exploiter les approches de Machine Learning, modéliser des systèmes complexes et établir des corrélations prédictives (notamment liens sensoriel / mesures instrumentales in vitro) ainsi qu'avec les dimensions OMICS et cliniques. Valorisation scientifique : Vous communiquerez vos résultats aux équipes partenaires et participerez à la valorisation scientifique des innovations du laboratoire. We Are Looking For Nous recherchons une personne dotée d'une forte curiosité scientifique et d'un esprit novateur. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, votre capacité à collaborer et à transformer des concepts complexes en solutions pratiques sera déterminante. Pour Réussir Dans Ce Poste, Vous Avez Une solide formation interdisciplinaire (Master ou Doctorat) en biophysique, physique, sciences des matériaux, physico-chimie ou dans un domaine connexe. Une solide expérience en mesures physiques/mécaniques, caractérisation de surfaces (profilométrie/topographie, rhéologie ou tribologie) et analyse de données. Une aisance en recherche bibliographique pour être à la pointe de la recherche sur la biophysique de la peau et les nouvelles techniques. Biophysics : Une maîtrise des principes physiques appliqués aux systèmes biologiques. Data Analytics : Une aisance dans l'analyse de données complexes pour en tirer des conclusions pertinentes. Scientific Valorization : La compétence pour communiquer des résultats scientifiques de manière claire et impactante. Scientific Foresight & Tech Intelligence : La capacité à identifier et évaluer les nouvelles technologies et opportunités scientifiques. What’s In It For You Un environnement où vous sortirez de votre zone de confort pour grandir au-delà de votre potentiel (ici, vous serez encouragé(e) à essayer de nouvelles choses et à prendre des risques !) De réelles responsabilités dès le premier jour, vous ne resterez pas sur la touche chez L'Oréal. Un environnement où les personnes de toutes ethnies, origines sociales, âges, religions, genres, orientations sexuelles, ainsi que les personnes en situation de handicap, sont acceptées, peuvent s'exprimer, s'épanouir et sont célébrées ! Un lieu où vous pouvez contribuer à quelque chose de plus grand ! Beaucoup de nos marques soutiennent des causes sociétales/environnementales pour faire une différence concrète. Who We Are Présent dans 150 pays sur cinq continents, L'Oréal se consacre depuis plus d'un siècle à une seule vocation : "Créer la beauté qui fait avancer le monde". Le Groupe est aujourd'hui le leader mondial de l'industrie avec un chiffre d'affaires consolidé de 42 milliards d'euros. …

items.desc: RWE Generation UK Start date on 28th June 2027, full time, fixed term (13 months) Are you interested in a placement with one of the UK’s largest energy producers? Our Gas Asset Management group has an exciting industrial placement opportunity and is looking for a motivated team member with excellent interpersonal skills! RWE Generation’s Gas Asset Management group supports our portfolio of gas fired power stations across Europe. Our Information & Analytics placement role will allow you to work within this group, focussing on the development and use of expert systems for monitoring and optimisation of our power station assets. Members of the team have developed these expert systems and models through the Digitalisation at RWE Generation programme, creating products such as the Maintenance & Asset Reliability Assistant (Mara) and the Centralised Performance Monitoring (CPM) Dashboard. We embrace our responsibility towards the environment and are committed to continually improving our performance for both generation and the environment. About The Role Be part of the development and operation of expert digital systems, such as Mara and CPM. These digital tools are designed to make the best use of our data and transform our business. Develop your understanding of applying the latest digital tools and analytical techniques to real use cases to improve business performance. Be involved with developing and using data analytics and visualisation tools, such as creating failure models for the power station equipment. Support experienced colleagues in the Generation and IT areas, including the monitoring of data quality, then applying your skills, and learning new ones. You will attend courses, workshops and on the job training for your personal development. You may also have the opportunity to spend time with other disciplines across the Asset Management function, learning about the challenges of managing a pan-European portfolio business. Job Requirements And Experience Ideally, you are pursuing a degree in an Engineering discipline (preferably Mechanical or Chemical/Process), with an interest in the energy industry and knowledge of engineering fundamentals such as thermodynamics. A strong aptitude in data science and analytical methods is essential. You will be using the latest analytical and visualisation tools, such as Seeq, PI Vision, and programming languages such as Python. Your Benefits An attractive salary. Il tuo ruolo e le tue prospettive Entra a far parte del nostro network internazionale di talenti Technology in ambito Data & AI. Lavorerai con tecnologie innovative su progetti entusiasmanti, liberando la potenza dei dati e dell'intelligenza artificiale per trasformare i processi di business. In particolare, potrai: Progettare e implementare modelli di dati specifici che aiutino a prendere decisioni aziendali migliori e più rapide attraverso l’analisi di una combinazione di dati esterni e interni; Modellare dati, creare pipeline di dati, implementare data lake, utilizzando framework di programmazione scalabili; Implementare procedure statistiche di qualità dei dati e applicare analisi iterative per supportare i data scientist nella preparazione e visualizzazione dei dati, generando valore aziendale; Definire gli standard di gestione dei dati e delle politiche di gestione, quali, ad esempio, l'anonimizzazione. Se vuoi fare della tua passione una carriera e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: Hai terminato o stai per terminare un percorso di studi in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o Statistica; Sei una persona creativa, impari in fretta e ami pensare fuori dal coro; Vuoi approfondire tematiche quali Data Architecture, Data Warehouse, Data Modeling, Data Integration, Data Transformation, Data Visualization, Big Data Technologies (Cloudera, AWS, Azure, Google, Snowflake), Spark, Python, Kafka, etc. Hai una buona conoscenza della lingua Inglese Scopri di più su di noi Accenture è una società leader a livello mondiale nel settore dei servizi professionali che aiuta aziende, governi e organizzazioni a costruire il loro nucleo digitale, ottimizzare le operazioni, accelerare la crescita dei ricavi e migliorare i servizi ai cittadini, creando valore tangibile rapidamente e su larga scala. items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission Dans le cadre de projets Big Data menés par Davidson pour ses clients dans des secteurs variés (Gaming, Luxe, Télécoms, Finance, etc.), tu interviendras en tant que développeur(se) pour travailler sur des plateformes existantes ou en cours de construction. Tes Activités Porteront Sur Veille technologique Création d’architectures logicielles permettant l’optimisation des calculs et ressources Développement en Python (R ponctuellement), JS Participation au chiffrage des solutions (poker planning) et priorisation (backlog) Manipulation de grandes quantités de données, mettant en difficulté les méthodes traditionnelles de calcul Debug, corrections d’incidents Support et conseils aux utilisateurs Réalisation de formations et présentations (meetups) Compétences requises ou à acquérir De formation BAC+5, tu as déjà une première expérience réussie en dev’ Maîtrise des technologies et environnement Python, R ou Java, Scala, Hadoop Première expérience réussie dans le développement informatique / Big Data Expérience en agilité Aptitudes / Savoir-être Rigueur Créativité Qualités de communication Travail en équipe Anglais Description du pôle Métiers de la donnée La donnée est aujourd’hui un actif stratégique au cœur de la transformation digitale des entreprises et à la base de la création de multiples nouveaux services. Davidson dispose d’une expertise unique autour de la donnée qui lui permet d’intervenir de bout-en-bout pour ses clients, qu’ils soient data-driven ou cherchent « simplement » à valoriser leurs données. Nos Métiers Accompagnement à la mise en place d’une stratégie données Architecture Big Data Data visualisation Data science Notre Environnement Technique Infrastructures & Stockage : Cloud (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform), Cloudera, MapReduce, Hortonworks, mongoDB, Hadoop, Cassandra, Splunk, Redis, CouchDB Traitement de données : Spark, Scala, Kafka, Logstach, Elasticsearch, Hive, Storm, Flink Analytics : R, Python, SPSS&SAS, TensorFlow, Sickit learn Dataviz : grafana, dataiku, kibana, Tableau, Qlik, Outil propre JS Devops & containers : Docker, puppet, Jenkins, Sonar, Openshift, Kubernetes, Ansible Domaines : Machine Learning, Deep Learning

items.desc: Who You'll Work With Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. Your colleagues—at all levels—will invest deeply in your development, just as much as they invest in delivering exceptional results for clients. Every day, you'll receive apprenticeship, coaching, and exposure that will accelerate your growth in ways you won’t find anywhere else. When you join us, you will have: Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development. The real magic happens when you take the input from others to heart and embrace the fast-paced learning experience, owning your journey. A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions. You’ll make a tangible impact by offering innovative ideas and practical solutions, all while upholding our unwavering commitment to ethics and integrity. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family. Your Impact You'll analyze trends and opportunities across the battery value chain - including cell manufacturing, cathode and anode materials, and battery technologies. You'll build proprietary market models and decision tools, and collaborate with cell makers, OEMs, suppliers and investors to deliver strategic insights. You'll bring a deep understanding of the battery ecosystem - from raw materials and cell chemistry to gigafactory operations and market dynamics - and a passion for translating data into strategic recommendations. You should be comfortable using AI tools and basic coding to enhance workflows and modeling. You will be part of the firm's think tank for innovation and decision support across the battery value chain. We help business leaders and policymakers solve critical challenges to accelerate the global shift to electrification and a low-carbon economy. Working closely with our global network of battery experts, you'll help shape client strategies with data-backed perspectives on technologies, market outlooks, value pools, and cost and value-chain transparency across geographies. You'll join one of our hubs – Munich, Brussels or Amsterdam - as part of the broader Battery Accelerator Team, with 250+ members, working closely with internal experts with relevant industry experience and academic expertise. Your Qualifications and Skills Master's degree in (electro-)chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical/materials engineering, electrical/mechanical engineering, or a related analytical field preferred Academic background and/or first professional experience in batteries, electrification, energy storage or the battery value chain highly valued Strong interest in battery technologies and a commitment to developing subject-matter expertise to support McKinsey teams and clients Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint required; experience in a programming language (e.g., Python) and data management or visualization tools (e.g., SQL, Tableau, Power BI) is a strong plus Comfort using AI tools and automation to streamline analysis and accelerate development of client-facing assets Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a problem-solving mindset Ability to work confidently with senior stakeholders in fast-paced and sometimes ambiguous environments Strong process management skills; capable of coordinating multiple workstreams independently Excellent verbal and written English communication skills; additional language skills are a plus (e.g., Mandarin, German, Korean)

items.desc: bout the Role We are seeking four detail-oriented and analytical Product Analysts to support our Data & Risk product family on an extendable 12-month contract basis. This is a flexible, hands-on role spanning two closely connected areas of work: 1. Product analysis, quality and validation for Data Enrichment products; and 2. Data labeling and AI/model quality validation for Machine Learning capabilities. The Product Analysts will move between these areas as business priorities require. They will help ensure that merchant and transaction data is accurately classified, product outputs meet expected quality standards, customer and operational feedback is translated into actionable insight, and product teams can make confident, data-informed decisions. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys structured problem-solving, analysing data and system behaviour, identifying quality issues, and working closely with product, engineering, data science, and operations stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Product Analysis and Quality Support Support the Merchant Information product team in analysing product performance, quality signals, customer feedback, and operational data. Query, structure, and analyse data to identify patterns, recurring issues, inconsistencies, and opportunities for product improvement. Create clear visualisations, reports, and summaries that help stakeholders understand performance, quality, progress, and priority areas. Support product discovery and delivery by clarifying requirements, documenting expected behaviour, and translating feedback into structured findings. Assist with testing, validation, and quality assurance activities, including validating product behaviour during releases, migrations, and changes to data-processing logic. Investigate discrepancies between expected and actual product outputs and work with relevant teams to define and track resolution actions. Maintain lightweight documentation of findings, quality assessments, test outcomes, decisions, and follow-up actions. Data Labeling and AI Quality Validation Label and classify transaction and merchant data used to train and improve machine learning and AI models. Review and quality assure labeled datasets to ensure accuracy, consistency, completeness, and adherence to defined guidelines. Validate AI-generated labels and model outputs, identifying misclassifications, edge cases, data-quality issues, and improvement opportunities. Analyse model and classification performance using appropriate measures, including precision, recall, accuracy, F1 score, and confusion matrices. Support validation activities for machine learning models and AI-assisted workflows, including models hosted on platforms such as Google Vertex AI. Work with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to improve labeling guidelines, training-data quality, validation processes, and model performance. Contribute to the evolution of internal tools, quality frameworks, validation processes, and operating practices as labeling workflows become increasingly automated. Required Skills and Experience 1–3 years of relevant experience in a product analyst, data analyst, data quality, QA, product operations, data labeling, or similar role in a technology-driven environment. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with exceptional attention to detail and consistency. Comfortable working with data using tools such as SQL, spreadsheets, dashboards, or similar analytical tooling. Experience working with large datasets, data-quality processes, testing, validation, or business-rule assessment. Ability to investigate issues end-to-end, identify patterns and root causes, and communicate findings clearly. Understanding of core machine-learning concepts and workflows, including the importance of high-quality training data and model validation. Familiarity with classification problems and/or data annotation, labeling, or taxonomy-based workflows. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and to manage changing priorities. Preferred Skills and Experience Experience analysing transaction data, merchant data, categorisation systems, or other financial-data classification problems. Experience with data labeling, annotation, model validation, or AI-assisted labeling workflows. Familiarity with model-evaluation concepts and metrics, including precision, recall, F1 score, accuracy, and confusion matrices. Experience supporting AI, machine-learning, MLOps, or data-platform environments. Familiarity with Google Vertex AI or comparable machine-learning platforms. Experience using SQL to investigate data issues and support product or quality analysis. Experience with test planning, regression testing, migration validation, or release-quality activities. Experience turning customer feedback or operational issues into structured analysis and product recommendations. What You Will …

items.desc: About Raven Raven is a proprietary crypto market-making and high-frequency trading firm. We trade spot, perpetuals, and prediction markets with dedicated low-latency infrastructure across eight major trading regions. We hire competitive individuals and natural problem solvers with a record of ranking at something hard, whether competitive programming, games, or mathematics, who treat an unfamiliar problem as a challenge rather than an obstacle. We can teach markets; we cannot teach drive. We build our own stack end to end, from connectivity and pricing through execution, monitoring, and research data. THE ROLE We are not a sportsbook. We do not price a margin and wait for retail flow. We quote into exchange-style markets where the counterparty may be sharper than we are, and we profit only when our probabilities beat the price. This is the whole job. Every contract settles at zero or one, the market price is already a forecast, and your edge is being better calibrated, faster to react, or willing to make a market where no one else will. What You'll Own Event models. Team and player state turned into a probability distribution, built from ratings, lineups, pace, venue and weather effects, and referee quirks. A stable of models rather than one grand unified theory, and you know exactly where each one stops working Quoting and market making. Two-sided prices on discrete outcomes, with spread and size that reflect how confident the model actually is, and inventory managed across outcomes that must sum to one News, latency, and in-play. Injuries, lineups, red cards, and delayed starts, met with state-dependent live repricing and suspension logic that withdraws quotes before adverse selection sets in Resolution risk. What a contract actually settles on, in the rules text and not the spirit. Real PnL, not legal boilerplate Risk and sizing. Position sizing that survives a bad week, correlation across events that look independent and are not, and exposure you understand before it is a problem Who We're Looking For Demonstrated skill forecasting real-world events for money, supported by quantitative evidence, from a betting syndicate, professional or semi-professional betting, a research seat graded on calibration, or sportsbook trading if you can demonstrate the transition described below You think in probabilities and know when you are wrong. You can explain how you would validate a model, what would count as evidence against it, and which of your own models you have retired Strong applied statistics, including Bayesian inference, hierarchical models, time-varying team strength, and enough machine learning to know when it is the wrong tool Data instincts. Odds histories, lineups, injuries, and results are messy and revised after the fact, and you catch the look-ahead bias before it flatters a backtest If you are from a sportsbook, the transition that matters is from pricing recreational flow to competing against a market. We look for evidence you can tell the difference Fluent English Crypto and exchange microstructure are a plus No degree required. Experience is what matters LOGISTICS Sofia (Bulgaria) or Milan (Italy), with no preference between them. Whichever city the right person is in In office, not remote Crypto trades around the clock. You will share a sane on-call rotation with the team that owns these systems

items.desc: Твоята роля накратко Ние сме водеща небанкова финансова институция, специализирана в потребителското кредитиране за физически лица. Наш основен двигател са бързите решения и иновациите, а в сърцето на всичко това стоят данните. Ако искаш да работиш с динамичен кредитен портфейл и да разгадаваш истинското потребителско поведение на хиляди клиенти, тази роля е за теб! Тук ще пишеш SQL, ще изграждаш справки и ще търсиш логиката зад числата. При нас AI и автоматизацията не са просто модерен текст за привличане на кандидати. Ти ще участваш активно в автоматизирането на реални бизнес процеси с най-новите AI инструменти и workflow платформи. Това е посоката, в която ще растеш заедно с нас! Какво ще правиш? • Анализ с мисъл: Ще пишеш SQL заявки, за да извличаш данни за нашия портфейл. Ще анализираш рисковите индикатори, събираемостта и продажбите, като помагаш да разберем как се държат потребителите ни. • Ясна отчетност: Ще изготвяш периодични справки за отдел "Риск" и ще подготвяш графики и презентации, които помагат на мениджмънта да взема стратегически решения. • Работа с регистри: Ще координираш важна информация към външни регистри (като ЦКР и др.) и ще следиш данните ни винаги да са точни и актуални. • AI & Автоматизация: Ще участваш в оптимизирането и изграждането на по-умни и бързи работни процеси, използвайки изкуствен интелект и съвременни платформи за автоматизация. Какво търсим? • SQL суперсили: Умееш да пишеш и четеш заявки (join-ове, агрегации, подзаявки). Това е нашето основно изискване. • Отличен MS Excel: Формули, pivot таблици и графики са твой верен помощник в ежедневието. • Аналитичен ум: Не спираш до сухите числа, а търсиш историята зад тях – защо потребителите се държат по определен начин. • Внимание към детайла: Прецизността е критична, когато работим с финансови данни. • Образование и опит: Имаш висше образование (или завършваш последен курс) в сфера Математика, Статистика, ИТ или Финанси. Опитът от 0 до 3 години е плюс – ако ни покажеш, че разбираш от SQL, останалото ще те научим да правиш при нас! • Комуникация: Добро ниво на английски език и способност да организираш задачите си в срок. Ще е предимство, ако имаш: • Интерес или малък опит с AI инструменти (ChatGPT, Claude, MS Copilot). • Познания по n8n или друга платформа за автоматизация. • Опит с инструменти за визуализация (Power BI, Tableau). Какво предлагаме ние? • Реална FinTech практика с AI: Ще работиш по истински проекти с изкуствен интелект, които влизат директно в продукция – без учебни или "демо" задачи. • Подкрепа от първия ден: Ще преминеш през въвеждащо обучение и ще имаш личен ментор от екипа, за да навлезеш бързо във финансовата сфера. • Работна среда и баланс: Позицията е изцяло в офис със стандартно работно време от понеделник до петък (09:00 ч. – 18:00 ч.). Ще имаш възможност за 1 ден дистанционна работа седмично след първоначалния период на въвеждане. Ако припознаваш себе си в тези редове и имаш желание да се развиваш във финансовия сектор, стани част от нашия екип! Как да кандидатстваш? Изпрати ни своята автобиография до 13.11.2026 г.

If you get energy from working for an internationally growing company and want to be part of making a difference, you may be our new team
items.desc: Are you excited by the intersection of people, data, and AI? Join us in shaping the future of People Analytics through modern analytics engineering, meaningful workforce insights, and data-driven decision-making. About The Role Covering for the People Analytics and Data Strategy Engineer (“Data Analyst”), you will play a key role in taking the People & Culture data experience to the next level and support Urban Partners in reaching our ambitious goal of building the urban future, together. If you get energy from working for an internationally growing company and want to be part of making a difference, you may be our new team member! In our People & Culture Team, we are a group of 16 colleagues covering 8 countries working together to support the business stakeholders in embodying our purpose and vision of making a difference for cities and people. You will have extensive interaction with team members and colleagues across the organization, promising exposure to a diverse range of expertise. We can guarantee a dynamic environment with skilled colleagues, offering opportunities for learning, collaboration, and personal growth. You will be a part of a powerhouse of brilliant and caring people raising the bar for the industry. Your workplace will be at our headquarters located in Copenhagen, Nordhavn. As an international team, we regularly engage with colleagues across borders, fostering a global perspective and collaborative spirit. In this role, you will be reporting to our Head of Reward, located in Copenhagen. The majority of this role will be carried out from our office with some flexibility. This is a parental leave cover role on a fixed-term contract until end July 2027. Please note: we are unable to sponsor visa or work permit applications for this position. Applicants are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary right to work in Denmark prior to applying. Key Responsibilities Over the past year, we've been experimenting with what People Analytics looks like when you treat it more like modern analytics engineering than traditional HR reporting. We have built our own analytics layer in Microsoft Fabric around an SCD2 master dataset of our employee population, with a Python semantic library on top. The setup supports workforce reporting used across senior management, the Board, financial planning, sustainability reporting and investor materials. The role spans three closely connected areas: recurring workforce reporting, traditional People Analytics, and Reward. That means you'll work with everything from headcount and attrition analysis to the compensation review, pay transparency and ad hoc workforce questions. We've also designed the environment to work closely with modern AI assistants. LLMs are used to understand existing code, explore data, debug problems and help extend the analytical layer. We think this combination of structured data, reusable analytical logic and AI-assisted development represents an interesting direction for how People Analytics can work. As Data Analyst, it is not simply a role where you “just” run existing reports and scripts. You'll inherit a working analytical system, learn how it fits together, keep it running reliably, and extend it when new business questions arise. At the center of the setup is a master employee-history dataset combining the SCD2 states of our core HiBob data into one resolved timeline. It allows us to reconstruct the workforce at historical points in time, covering approximately 20 years of employee history, with many core business rules already built into the data. On top of this sits a Python semantic library with reusable building blocks for employee populations, joiners and leavers, turnover breakdowns, workforce bridges and much more. Python notebooks use these components to produce recurring and ad hoc outputs including HTML reports, PowerPoint materials and Excel files. The important part is not simply knowing how to run these tools. It is understanding the logic behind them, spotting when something does not look right, and knowing how far an answer needs to be taken before it creates business value. These Will Be Some Of Your Key Tasks Deliver key parts of the Reward cycle, including the 2027 salary review and gender pay gap and pay transparency reporting Support the data agenda for People & Culture, with the help of your People Lead Monitor data quality and investigate inconsistencies before they reach reporting. Run recurring workforce reporting covering headcount, FTE movement, joiners, leavers and attrition Support FP&A, Sustainability and Capital Formation with workforce data and analysis. Work on broader People Analytics questions, including workforce trends, organizational development and ad hoc analysis for senior stakeholders Answer new workforce questions as they arise Make careful extensions to the Python semantic library and reporting notebooks when needed Work with the BI team when source data or pipeline changes affect …

items.desc: Locations : Stockholm | Copenhagen V | Oslo | Helsinki Who We Are Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact. To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive. What You'll Do We are looking for a hands-on Nordic Data & Analytics Specialist to join our Nordic People Analytics function, within Strategic Projects & Analytics, supporting our four Nordic markets. This role focuses on understanding our data landscape, extracting and transforming relevant data, building visualizations and dashboards, and delivering ad hoc analyses that help our leadership, People teams and key stakeholders gain sharper insights from data and make better decisions. A smaller part of your role will be to help functions experiment and adopt AI tools to work more effectively and future-proof. Key Responsibilities Develop a deep understanding of our data landscape – including datasets, how they connect, their purposes, information flows, and how it relates to actual business processes. Explore and quality-test our data in Snowflake, using SQL to validate fields, reconcile numbers, investigate data issues – and confirm / align with the functions owning the data and processes. Build and maintain reliable data pipelines at consumption / transformation layer, e.g. by extracting, transforming and validating Snowflake data for new Tableau dashboards. Design, build and continuously improve Tableau / BI dashboards that are used across Nordics. Translate stakeholder questions into concrete data needs and insightful analyses across markets and topics, e.g. headcount, hiring, attrition, engagement and much more. Act as the go-to technical contact for colleagues who need data support, and help them explore and prototype AI tools like Claude and Agents to keep functions at the forefront. items.desc: Vill du vara med och förverkliga pensionsdrömmar? Investera i din framtid hos oss – Start september 2027 Som trainee på SPP/Storebrand är du med i ett 18-månadersprogram med tre rotationer inom olika områden i bolaget och koncernen. Det innebär att du arbetar i ett team med spännande uppgifter under sex månader och byter sedan avdelning och tar dig an nya utmaningar där. Efter traineeperioden kommer du tillsammans med ansvariga ledare och din toppledarsponsor att hitta nästa steg i din karriär hos SPP/Storebrand. Ett nästa steg för din framtid. Vad innebär det att vara koncerntrainee? 🚀 Ditt lärande och din utveckling är vår huvudfokus. Det är därför vi säger att detta är ett traineeprogram med tillväxtgaranti. Som koncerntrainee på SPP/Storebrand får du möjlighet att utforska olika arbetsuppgifter och på så sätt identifiera dina styrkor. Du kommer att följas upp under programmets gång av vår programansvariga och din toppledarsponsor samt få god vägledning av duktiga ledare och engagerade kollegor. Genom perioden deltar du även i vårt utvecklingsprogram tillsammans med dina nordiska traineekollegor. Här kommer du, förutom att bygga mycket kompetens inom fintech, även få möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom bland annat ledarskap, relationsbyggande och agil arbetsmetodik. Huvudsaklig arbetsort är Stockholm, samtidigt kommer flera av utbildningstillfällena vara i Oslo på Storebrands huvudkontor och dessutom anordnas en studieresa och andra sociala aktiviteter. Det här kan du får jobba med: Delta i projekt och framtagning av strategier i samarbete med ledare och specialister. Analysera kunddata och trender för att identifiera och driva igenom nya affärsmöjligheter. Vara en del av ett tvärvetenskapligt och autonomt digitalt team som utvecklar sömlösa digitala kundlösningar och automatiserar och förenklar affärsprocesser med hjälp av nyskapande teknologi. Utveckla framtidsinriktade tjänster och arbeta med frågor inom digital tjänsteutveckling, data, AI, cybersäkerhet och molntjänster. Vara en förändringsagent och en inflytelserik rådgivare på SPP och Storebrand. Vem är du? 👋 Du är nyfiken på hur teknologi, hållbarhet, innovation och finans kan skapa nya möjligheter och vill vara med och bidra till en trygg och hållbar framtid genom SPP/Storebrands verksamhet. Utveckling, lärande och problemlösning är naturliga drivkrafter för dig. Att arbeta i tvärfunktionella team för att skapa värdefulla produkter och tjänster för våra kunder känns inspirerande. Har du dessutom ett intresse för att kombinera kommersiellt tänkande med strategiskt och analytiskt arbete kan detta vara rätt traineeprogram för dig. Vi söker dig som: Har en masterexamen inom civilingenjör, teknologi, informationsteknologi, datateknik, tjänstedesign, industriell ekonomi, innovation, ekonomi, finans eller organisationsutveckling. Har goda akademiska resultat. Är flytande i svenska tal och skrift, men det är viktigt att du också har goda kommunikativa färdigheter på engelska. Har 0-3 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, där deltidsjobb, socialt arbete eller ideellt arbete är ett plus. Vi ser gärna att du inte är främmande att använda AI som hjälpmedel. Vi tror samtidigt att du är nyfiken på hur AI och automatisering kan användas för att skapa effektivare arbetssätt och bättre lösningar för verksamheten du stöttar. Varför välja SPP/Storebrand? 💚 Vi är kända för vårt hållbarhetsarbete och strävar efter att vara en viktig samhällsaktör. För oss handlar allt vi gör om att skapa en framtid att glädja sig åt. Detta gäller de tjänster vi erbjuder våra kunder, de företag vi investerar i och inte minst våra egna medarbetare. Hos oss får du utrymme att ta plats och få din åsikt hörd. Vi söker ju trots allt dig som vill vara med och forma framtidens SPP och Storebrand. Vi tror på värdet av att ha olika perspektiv och bakgrunder i vår organisation och arbetar därför aktivt för att skapa en social miljö som präglas av jämställdhet, inkludering och mångfald. Vi har fått utmärkelser av detta arbete, bland annat har vi fått pris för jämn könsfördelning i företaget (SHE-indexpriset) och vårt långsiktiga arbete kring mångfald och inkludering (Annas jämställdhets- och mångfaldspris). Som anställd hos SPP får du ta del av förmånliga försäkringar, såsom tjänstepension och sjukvårdsförsäkring, samt en extra avsättning till pensionen varje år. Du får också tillgång till friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerad lunch, förstärkt föräldrapenning och gym. m.m. Dessutom får du arbeta i helt nyrenoverade lokaler precis intill Stockholms centralstation där vi tillämpar en hybrid arbetsvardag med kontoret som primär arbetsplats. Vi värnar om din hälsa och balans mellan arbete och fritid, och erbjuder dig en stimulerande och glädjefylld arbetsmiljö. Tycker du att detta låter spännande? Ansök! Du är varmt välkommen att skicka in din ansökan senast 1 november . I din ansökan vill vi ha ditt CV samt nödvändiga dokument såsom betyg, men i stället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig svara på …

items.desc: Innovation Data and Product Consultant Office of Innovation – Systems & Services – Insights & Evidence function – Stockholm, Sweden & Remote, with possible travel 12 months UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence. At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling. UNICEF is a place where careers are built. We offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package. Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF. For every child, the right to Data How can you make a difference? Purpose of Assignment To provide hands-on, specialized expertise in data and systems integration, application and workflow development, automation and applied AI to the UNICEF Office of Innovation (OOI). The Consultant will play a critical role in advancing OOI’s Insights & Evidence function by designing and deploying data tools, analytics, knowledge systems, and intelligent workflows that help UNICEF better leverage data and knowledge for innovation. Scope of Work We are looking for Innovation Data and Product Consultant to join the Insights and Evidence team at UNICEF's Office of Innovation (OOI). You will help OOI better leverage data and knowledge to support innovation, by developing systems and applications and using innovative analytical methods, including AI and large language models, so that timely insights reach the colleagues and decision-makers who need them across UNICEF and, where relevant, the wider humanitarian and development community. The role covers the full cycle from problem exploration to deployment and adoption, including helping users build the know-how and confidence to use these tools and solutions effectively. You will work under the guidance of the Knowledge Management and Data Analytics Lead, in close collaboration with OOI's Systems & Services and Solutions sections and other UNICEF offices. The work combines strong technical execution with thoughtful product design grounded in systems thinking and Human-Centered Design (HCD) principles. The aim is to bring leading product and data/AI engineering practices from industry into the UNICEF context, while keeping solutions cost-effective, lean and appropriate for the contexts in which UNICEF works. We work in a build-test-learn way, moving quickly from ideas to minimum viable products and iterating based on real-world use. It will suit a versatile builder who enjoys moving between data, technology and product design to develop practical solutions to complex problems. Core Areas And Ways Of Working User research and product discovery Apply systems thinking and HCD methods to deeply understand user pain points and use cases for data, knowledge and AI solutions. Gather reliable evidence to test assumptions and articulate design decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Data systems and products Design and build data models, databases, pipelines and data entry workflows that connect different sources into a reliable base of information. Develop dashboards, applications and other data and knowledge products for OOI, UNICEF and partners, including solutions tailored to specific Country Offices and innovation teams. Automation and AI Build and automate workflows for capturing, processing, and using data and knowledge, including through AI. Apply LLMs, text analytics, and other AI techniques to analyze large volumes of unstructured text such as reports and documents. User adoption Implement tailored approaches to help teams adopt and integrate data and knowledge solutions into their daily work. Produce user guides and demos and run hands-on sessions that support effective user adoption. All work is deliverable-based , supporting defined initiatives and outputs rather than ongoing staff functions. This is a home-based role, ideally with good overlap with Stockholm (CET) working hours. If you would like to know more about this consultancy, please review the complete Terms of Reference here: ToRTMC0006924.pdf To qualify as an advocate for every child you will have...
