items.desc: AI Product Engineer (Full-stack) Vil du arbejde med AI, softwareudvikling og nogle af de mest spændende teknologier på markedet? Hos Cendo bygger vi AI voice agents til enterprise virksomheder og vores teknologi er allerede en del af hverdagen på mere end 200 lokationer. Nu søger vi dig, der vil være med til at bygge næste generation af vores produkter. Siden 2024 er vi vokset til en af Skandinaviens hurtigst voksende leverandører af AI voice agenter, med en stærk kundebase i bilbranchen. Gennem dybe integrationer til branchesystemer er vores AI agenter en integreret del af kundernes daglige drift og skaber værdi langt ud over selve telefonsamtalen. Vi er i dag et team på seks personer og søger vores syvende kollega, som vil få en central rolle i udviklingen og implementeringen af vores AI-løsninger. Som AI Product Engineer kommer du til at arbejde med både nye og eksisterende kunder samt videreudviklingen af vores egen platform. Rollen er primært fokuseret på softwareudvikling, herunder backend, integrationer og AI agenter, men indebærer også arbejde på tværs af vores teknologier. Du får ansvar for dine egne projekter og forventes at kunne arbejde selvstændigt, men vil samtidig have tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens founders og det øvrige team. Stillingen er på fuldtid med arbejdsplads i Københavnsområdet. Vi arbejder som udgangspunkt fra kontoret, men der er fleksibilitet til at arbejde hjemmefra efter aftale. Dine vigtigste arbejdsopgaver Udvikle og implementere AI voice agenter til nye kunder Udvikle backend-funktionalitet og integrationer til eksterne systemer Arbejde med telefoni, LLM'er og andre AI-teknologier Videreudvikle vores egen platform samt chatbot- og livechatløsninger Vedligeholde, optimere og videreudvikle eksisterende kundeløsninger Bidrage til den tekniske udvikling af nye produkter Hvem er du? Du har nogle års erfaring med softwareudvikling og et solidt teknisk fundament. Du trives med at arbejde selvstændigt, tage ansvar for dine opgaver og finde gode løsninger på tekniske udfordringer. Vi ser gerne, at du har erfaring med Python, backend udvikling, API-integrationer og databaser samt er komfortabel med at arbejde på tværs af en full-stack-løsning. Vores teknologier omfatter blandt andet Python, SQL, Microsoft Azure, telefoni og RAG, men vi forventer ikke, at du har erfaring med dem alle på forhånd. Det vigtigste er, at du har et solidt teknisk fundament, hurtigt kan sætte dig ind i nye systemer og har lyst til at arbejde med AI. Du er nysgerrig på ny teknologi og interesserer dig for, hvordan den kan bruges til at udvikle bedre produkter. Vi søger en kollega, som ikke kun løser de opgaver, der bliver stillet, men også har lyst til at bidrage med egne idéer og præge den tekniske udvikling. Du skal kunne flydende dansk. Hvis du kan norsk og svensk er det en fordel, da vi har kollegaer og kunder på alle tre markeder. Det tilbyder vi Mulighed for at blive en del af en virksomhed i kraftig vækst med store internationale ambitioner Arbejde med de nyeste AI teknologier og udvikle løsninger, der allerede anvendes af mange store virksomheder Stor selvstændighed og ansvar for egne projekter Reel indflydelse på vores produkter og tekniske udvikling Fokuseret team med korte beslutningsveje og tæt samarbejde med stifterne Gode muligheder for faglig udvikling og for at lære nye teknologier Fleksibilitet i hverdagen og løn efter kvalifikationer Sådan søger du Hvis stillingen lyder som noget for dig, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send os dit CV og en kort motiveret ansøgning. Du er også velkommen til at vedlægge din GitHub-profil eller eksempler på projekter, du har arbejdet med. Vi vurderer ansøgninger og inviterer relevante kandidater til samtale løbende.

items.desc: Location : Amsterdam (hybrid) Employment type : full-time (40 h/week) Seniority level : Senior Consultant (corresponding to a minimum of 5 years of work experience) Visa sponsorship : possible only for candidates <30 years of age A little bit about us Riverflex was founded in Amsterdam and London in 2018 and has grown into a global team of consultants united by one mission: to help courageous leaders drive intelligent transformation. We integrate three service pillars - strategy & transformation consulting that Creates Change, talent services that Build Teams, and business-accelerating AI products that Augment Intelligence. We are not a traditional consultancy. We work at C-level with blue-chip companies on the programmes that actually matter, and we are building our Technology Risk practice at exactly the moment the market needs it most. Your role as Applied AI Specialist You'll be an AI Business Specialist in our consulting practice, working hands-on inside the Applied AI consulting team. The person who walks into a client's finance, ops, CX or sales function, understands how the work actually gets done today, and helps redesign it around AI primitives - skills, memory, plugins, connectors, harnesses, agents. You sit at the intersection of business, product, and technology, but you lead with the build. You're a builder first – typically from an engineering, science or technical product background – who has moved, or is moving, into client-facing, product-minded work. Think of it as roughly 60% forward-deployed engineer, 40% strategist. You prototype your own solutions using AI-assisted coding tools and no-code platforms - wiring up connectors, drafting specifications, and testing what works before handing it to engineering to harden. The job is translating between what a customer actually needs and what the AI system has to look like to deliver it. This is partly an AI engineering role, but not one about running high-traffic, mission-critical systems at scale. For this reason, an engineering background is highly preferred but not a must. It is also not a strategy slide-deck role. And it is not a team-management role. Your job is to bring deep specialist craft and ship things, not to run people. What you’ll do Four core mandates, roughly equal weight in year one. Implement AI for clients. Lead Applied AI workstreams on flagship engagements with major European retailers and financial services clients. You'll run discovery, help design the AI Operating System for the function in scope, and ship the first wave of skills, agents and integrations alongside the client team, often turning what you heard in discovery into a working prototype or proposal within a day or two. Outcomes - measurable productivity uplift, redesigned workflows - not slide decks that die in PowerPoint. Implement AI internally at Riverflex. We eat our own cooking. Our internal AI capability platform, our delivery process, the way we run the firm - you'll help redesign our ways of working around AI and ship the building blocks. This is also where most of our reusable IP gets created, and where you'll build your own muscle on the tools before deploying them at clients. Lift the craft of our Applied AI consulting team through your specialist expertise. You're the specialist plugged into client engagements, internal labs and capability sessions. You bring patterns, skills and shipped examples; you coach colleagues through real work; you contribute what you build into our reusable library. The team's craft level rises because you're in it – and you'll sharpen your own consulting craft working alongside our senior consultants. Help build our AI coaching and change propositions. We have new propositions launching across AI coaching, team-building in the era of AI, and AI-native operating models. You'll be hands-on in the productisation: building materials, running early engagements, and feeding learnings back into the offer. The thesis is that 90% of AI value sits in workflow integration - you're part of how we prove it on the ground. Who you are 5+ years of hands-on experience in engineering, data/science, technical product or another builder role, of which at least 2 in AI. An AI engineering background is a plus, not a must. We're equally open to candidates from a strategy or product background who have become substantially more hands-on in building over recent years. Client-facing experience embedded in a business context – consulting, solutions, forward-deployed or customer-facing product work. Formal consulting experience isn't required, but exposure to structured settings beyond early-stage startups is. Demonstrated ability to walk into a function, model how work gets done today, and redesign it. Hands-on experience developing and deploying applications with Claude Code, Copilot, OpenAI, Gemini, or other AI-powered IDEs. You have a solid understanding of "HOW" things are built and distributed to real users. Side and personal projects count …

items.desc:
Job Description: 
In order to support our Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a
 Mechanical System Installation Design Engineer (d/f/m) 
You will join the department Installation Mechanical Equipment and Fuel System, which is part of the Design and Integration organization within the Airbus Helicopters design office. The team is responsible for the development of parts and assemblies for the installation of external Outboard Equipment and the Fuel System. It supports the complete Airbus Helicopters product range, including commercial and governmental helicopters, as well as research demonstrators, throughout the complete helicopter life cycle (design, prototype and serial production, in-service support). The outboard equipment installation is done for the full scope of helicopter missions, including public transport, public services, emergency medical services, police and parapublic missions, Search and Rescue, military and VIP transport.
 The department is transnationally organized with team members in Marignane and Donauwörth. Team members work in modern agile project teams together with members of Airframe Design, Vehicle Systems, Electrical System and Stress departments, among others.
 Your location 
 At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield. 
 Our Benefits for You 
 Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines. 
 Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities. 
 Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives. 
 Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations. 
 Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA. 
 Your tasks and responsibilities 
 Designing and verifying Mechanical System Installations
 Performing concept studies
 Designing 3D parts in CATIA
 Creating and modifying 2D drawings
 Performing data management in tools such as SAP, Windchill, ENOVIA VPM
 Preparing documents for certification and qualification
 Defining and planning of development projects and Design Changes, including change analysis, identifying requirements, defining deliverables, workload estimation
 Defining of subcontracting work packages and doing follow-up on subcontractor activities
 Supporting manufacturing, including Non-Conformity Management (NCM) and support of the industrialization process
 Supporting technical customer support
 Supporting the Continuing Airworthiness process, including Major Incident investigations
 Desired skills and qualifications 
 Completed studies (Bachelor with additional qualification or Master) in the field of aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable course of study
Alternatively: three-year completed vocational training with qualified further training as a technician and related extended experience
 Advanced Proficiency within mechanical part design or fuel system component design, preferably using CATIA
 Preferably experience with technical Change Management processes and product data management with software tools such as ENOVIA VPM, SAP, Windchill or similar
 Working in an agile team, welcoming challenges, eager to take on responsibility, contribute to continuous improvement
 Deep understanding of prompt engineering and highly experienced in working with LLMs and image generators 
 Language skills: English - negotiation level, German and French - skills are a plus
 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 
 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

items.desc:
Lieu : Palaiseau, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Thales Research&Technology, notre centre de recherche dans les domaines matériels, et CortAIx Labs, notre centre de recherche en IA et digital ont pour mission de proposer des innovations de ruptures, de maintenir et d’accroitre l’avance technologique et d’en assurer la compétitivité pour le groupe. 
 Vous intégrerez le laboratoire TeM2IS (Laboratoire des Technologies, Modélisations et Matériaux pour mIcro & nano Systèmes) qui compte 20 permanents, mais aussi des doctorants, apprentis et stagiaires.
 Le laboratoire apporte une importante contribution au développement des technologies émergentes aux échelles micro- et nano-métriques. A ce titre, il a notamment la responsabilité de concevoir, d'évaluer, de développer de nouveaux composants et démonstrateurs, de nouveaux procédés technologiques, de nouvelles méthodologies de caractérisation, de nouveaux matériaux, Ainsi, il propose des axes de pour anticiper les futurs besoins du groupe Thales.
 Vous serez en charge de :
 Participer activement au développement de procédés technologiques innovants, à la conception, la réalisation et à la caractérisation de dispositifs et démonstrateurs optiques et photoniques novateurs.
 Participer aux études amonts, et assurer la vieille scientifique et technologique des axes de recherche du laboratoire
 Proposer des solutions innovantes pour de nouveaux concepts de dispositifs, de nouveaux matériaux intelligents et de nouvelles techniques de caractérisation
 Apporter votre expertise approfondie dans le domaine de la fabrication de composants optiques et photoniques, des métasurfaces, et de la synthèse des matériaux en couches minces et des métamatériaux,
 Instruire les dossiers d’investissement pour de nouveaux équipements. 
 Prendre en charge les développements technologiques nécessaires aux activités de l'axe de recherche optique et photonique et contribuer à la montée en maturité (TRL) et à la capitalisation de ces procédés.
 Proposer de nouvelles collaborations ou de nouveaux projets collaboratifs et les gérer du montage au pilotage.
 Contribuer au développement des interactions du Laboratoire, sur ses domaines d'intérêts, avec les acteurs clés de la communauté scientifique (PME, académiques et autres instituts de recherche, entités du groupe Thales).
 Contribuer à la valorisation et la capitalisation des activités du Laboratoire par la rédaction de publications et de propositions de brevet d'invention.
 Participer à la mise à jour des ''roadmaps'' technologique du Laboratoire.
 Proposer de nouveaux sujets de stages de fin d'études et de thèses et assurer ou participer à l’encadrement industriel de doctorants Cifre.
 Votre profil 
 Ingénieur de recherche en micro et nano-technologies, en composants optiques, métamatériaux et nanophotonique (H/F) 
 Votre priorité est de contribuer au monde de la recherche en industrie?
 Vous avez envie de découvrir Thales et son centre de recherche?
 Vous disposez de d’une thèse de doctorat en composants optiques, optoélectroniques, photoniques et justifiez de 10 ans d’expérience dans le même domaine et avez de l'expérience sur :
 Micro et nano fabrication de composants optiques, optoélectroniques et métasurfaces
 Nanophotonique et nanotechnologies et principes fondamentaux des techniques de micro et nano structuration 2D et 3D des surfaces et des métamatériaux
 Connaissances générales en optique, électromagnétisme, physique et chimie du solide, en sciences des matériaux et en technologies d’élaboration et de caractérisation de matériaux ainsi qu’en montage et coordination de projets collaboratifs
 Anglais et Français (niveau C1 attendu)
 Esprit d’équipe, capacité de synthèse, capacités rédactionnelles et excellente communication sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnait ?
 Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !
Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our Test Engineer Teams

We’re seeking an exceptional Test Engineer to join our Germany-based team focused on localising and advancing Wayve’s autonomous driving technology for the German market. This is a unique opportunity to play a hands-on role in shaping our AV capabilities in Germany from the ground up.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Test Engineer, you'll independently own the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack. You'll build robust, reusable test automation, drive failures to root cause across engineering boundaries, and steadily raise the bar on coverage, reliability, and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system  including sensing and model-behaviour testing as the company and your experience evolve. The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement across multiple engineering domains.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration, and system levels, across software and hardware boundaries.

 - Automate open-loop and closed-loop replay based Tests, reliability and fault-injection tests to support verification, release, coverage expansion, and debug workflows.

 - Lead root-cause investigations for failures found during test campaigns, collaborating across hardware, software, and infrastructure teams.

 - Optimise buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable, and repeatable execution.

 - Integrate third-party verification tools including JAMA (requirements), MC/DC (coverage), and MISRA (style compliance); manage artefacts via Artifactory and Azure.

 - Define and track KPIs and quality metrics for system testing, supporting data-driven validation and release decisions.

 - Uncover software and hardware bugs through increased test coverage and report findings through JIRA.

 - Identify and implement infrastructure improvements that enhance test coverage, failure traceability, and compliance reporting.

 - Review, create, and adhere to Risk Assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

 

🙌 You should apply if



ESSENTIAL SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software, or mechatronic systems, with a track record of delivering test automation independently.

 - Experience with L2+ hands-off, L3, or L4 automated driving systems.

 - Knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols (e.g., Euro NCAP -AEB, LSS/LKA, ADAS scenarios), DCAS regulatory testing (UN R171), and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards (ISO/SAE 21434, UN R155).

 - Experience with HiL testing and tooling using CAN, Ethernet, GMSL, dSPACE, Vector, Xylon, or similar.

 - Strong proficiency in Python, including developing automation test frameworks with pytest.

 - Proven ability in interface-level testing, including hardware/software interactions and embedded interfaces.

 - Experience integrating software quality assurance tools and standards (ASPICE, SOTIF, ISO 26262, JAMA, X-RAY).

 - Knowledge of open- and closed-loop HiL replay using dSPACE or other emulators.

 - Proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling (e.g., GitLab CI, Buildkite, Bazel).

 - Experience with test automation dashboards, logging, and reporting infrastructure (e.g., Grafana, Looker, Datadog, JIRA).

 - Experience developing or testing automotive software across embedded and system levels.

 - Strong cross-functional communication skills; able to work collaboratively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps, and product teams.


DESIRABLE SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Experience with autonomous vehicle systems, ADAS, or related technologies..

 - Strong Python Automation and knowledge of dSPACE open and closed Loop HIL based replay Testing

 - Experience contributing to continuous improvement of test methods, safety procedures, or operational efficiency.

 - Awareness of data management and version control systems (e.g., Git, Buildkite, or similar).

 - Familiarity with agentic AI coding tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) and a demonstrated ability to use them to accelerate and optimise test development, debugging, and automation workflows.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

items.desc:
​
 This is a fixed-term appointment with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years. 
 Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands with a resident assignment to ESAC, Villanueva de la Cañada, Spain.
 Description 
 The Directorate of Human and Robotic Exploration Programmes (D/HRE) is a programme directorate within the ESA matrix structure. Through a partnership between humans and robots, D/HRE is dedicated to exploring destinations in space where humans are already living and working —– or will live and work in the future —– for the purpose of scientific research, economic development, international cooperation and public inspiration.
 The Science Operations Department (SCI-S), within ESA’s Directorate of Science (D/SCI), hosts the scientists and engineers who oversee the space missions from study to the end of operations, develops the science operation systems for the missions and operates the missions in space, and archives and curates their data during operations and beyond. The Department provides support to D/HRE in the curation, archiving and dissemination of data from its planetary missions, such as the Rosalind Franklin Mission (RFM) and other Mars or lunar experiments. Its main objective is to maximise the scientific output of the missions for the benefit of humankind. 
 You will be assigned as Archive Scientist for ESA planetary missions under the direct responsibility of the Chief Exploration Scientist reporting functionally to the Head of the Science Archives Development and Operations Section, also known as the ESAC Science Data Centre (ESDC) in the Data Science and Archives Division within the Science Operations Department (SCI-S). 
 You will have further functional reporting lines within the mission(s) you support, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor.
 Duties 
 You will be responsible for the definition and specification of the scientific archive for the supported ESA planetary missions, initially the ESA ExoMars RFM and Comet Interceptor, and for the follow-up and monitoring of its implementation and operation with the goal of maximising the scientific return of the missions. You will work in close collaboration with the planetary mission project scientists, the other mission archive scientists, the ESDC Software and Data Systems Architect and the members of the Planetary Science Archive User Group.
 As Archive Scientist, your specific responsibilities will include: 
 ownership of use cases and drivers for the mission archives, including:
 interfacing with the Project Scientist, the Science Operations Centre (SOC) team, other archive science leads and other archive scientists, as well as the external stakeholders, such as the instrument teams and the mission scientific community, to provide the science use cases that drive the mission archive and determine the priorities for implementation;
 providing scientific support and steering the development and operations of the archives for the supported ESA planetary missions, providing the ESDC development team with an archive user requirements document as a baseline for implementation;
 chairing and coordinating a mission-level Data Archive Working Group (DAWG);
 monitoring the implementation, testing and expected performance of the archive based on use cases gathered by the mission team and derived requirements; in particular, defining and performing the end user acceptance testing of the different archive versions prior to their release to the scientific community;
 with the help of the instrument operations scientists, supervising and coordinating the definition and provision of science data products and any higher-level data products from the community or instrument teams as needed, including liaising on submission schedules and content;
 liaising with any internal and external providers to ensure the completeness of all levels of data products with maximum science quality, contributing to the optimisation and refinement of the archive products when possible;
 encouraging and contributing to the science exploitation of the missions’ data products through archive usage;
 participating in archive scientist meetings and user groups and sharing ideas and proposals for the strategy and promotion of the ESA science archives;
 supporting the scientific community with archive- and data product-related matters.
 As a scientist in the Department, you will be required to actively pursue personal scientific research, publishing articles using archival data, and to actively participate in the Department’s research activities.
 Technical competencies 
 Experience in science data management and archiving systems
 Experience working with planetary science data in a research setting, preferably including data from surface/in situ planetary missions
 Experience in coordinating the scientific community and managing multiple …

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 3000 experts across 30 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work - designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalize intelligence. Intelligent systems are only as dependable as the data beneath them. Reliable pipelines, trusted data products, governed access, and meaningful enterprise context allow analytics, applications, models, and agents to operate consistently in production. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates . Industrial discipline connects the two. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with practical judgment. items.desc: We are looking for one or two highly motivated research assistants for 4-month period to investigate how a long non-coding RNA (lncRNA) variant of ASCC3 regulates transcriptional recovery following DNA damage, in the Svejstrup lab, DNRF Center of Excellence, Center for Gene Expression (CGEN), Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM), Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Staring date: January 1, 2027 Previous work from the Svejstrup group identified two gene products of ASCC3 implicated in this response: a protein, encoded by the long mRNA transcript, that suppresses transcription during the late stages of the UV-induced global shutdown; and a short mRNA transcript that acts as a regulatory lncRNA, suppressing the ASCC3 protein's function and enabling transcriptional recovery. The project will be focused on understanding how the ASCC3 lncRNA regulates RNAPII-mediated transcription and its recovery after DNA damage, using CRISPR/Cas9 technologies to generate and manipulate ASCC3 transcript variants, combined with state-of-the-art transcription profiling approaches such as TTchem-seq and RNA-seq. items.desc: À Amiens, Beauvais, Rennes et Rouen, UniLaSalle, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche, propose des formations d’ingénieurs post-bac en 5 ans, une formation vétérinaire post-bac en 6 ans (depuis septembre 2022), des bachelors ainsi que des masters dans les domaines de l’agriculture, de l’agroalimentaire, de l’alimentation-santé, de l’environnement, des géosciences, des énergies et du numérique. Labellisé EESPIG (Établissement d'Enseignement Supérieur Privé d'Intérêt Général), UniLaSalle est membre de la Conférence des Grandes Écoles et ses formations d’ingénieur sont habilitées par la CTI (Commission des Titres d'Ingénieur). UniLaSalle fait partie du réseau d’enseignement mondial La Salle constitué de 72 universités et s’appuie sur 260 universités partenaires à l’étranger. L’Institut compte aujourd’hui 4 000 élèves, accompagnés par 632 salariés dont 180 enseignants chercheurs, 40 doctorants et 27 000 alumni. Inauguré en 1995 sous le nom ESIEE Amiens, le campus est situé en bord de Somme et se distingue par son architecture originale. Depuis le 1er octobre 2020, il a rejoint le groupe UniLaSalle et compte 59 salariés. Il accueille environ 650 étudiants chaque année et les forme sur les thématiques de l’énergie et du numérique. Dans le cadre d’une création de poste et afin de renforcer l'unité de recherche GENUMER, nous recherchons un Doctorant en CDD de 36 mois pour le campus d'Amiens (80), poste à pourvoir dès que possible . 1.1 Contexte général La transformation numérique des industries de bioprocédés constitue un levier stratégique majeur pour améliorer la productivité, la qualité et la durabilité des productions issues du vivant. La conduite de fermentations met en jeu des populations cellulaires vivantes dont l’état physiologique évolue dynamiquement, rendant le comportement des lignes de production intrinsèquement non-linéaire, variable et sensible à de multiples facteurs interdépendants. De nombreuses installations demeurent aujourd’hui pilotées de manière largement empirique, sur la base de recettes figées et de l’expérience des opérateurs, sans exploitation systématique de la richesse informationnelle contenue dans les données de production. Dans ce contexte, le concept de jumeau numérique, réplique virtuelle d’une installation physique continuellement alimentée par les données du réel, s’impose comme une rupture technologique permettant de simuler, prédire et optimiser le comportement d’une ligne de production en temps réel. Deux grandes familles d’approches structurent historiquement la modélisation des bioprocédés. Les modèles déterministes (mécanistes), fondés sur la description des mécanismes biologiques et des bilans de matière, offrent robustesse et interprétabilité, mais reposent sur des hypothèses simplificatrices et des paramètres difficiles à identifier en conditions réelles. À l’inverse, les modèles issus de l’apprentissage automatique captent des relations complexes directement à partir des données, au prix d’une moindre interprétabilité et d’un besoin important en données représentatives. C’est à l’interface de ces paradigmes que se situe l’approche hybride, cœur scientifique du présent projet : la modélisation hybride semi-paramétrique combine un socle mécaniste, garant de la cohérence physique, avec des composantes d’apprentissage chargées de représenter les phénomènes mal connus. 1.2 Contexte industriel BIOCODEX, acteur industriel de la filière des bioprocédés, produit par fermentation des principes actifs d’intérêt pharmaceutique. Les travaux préparatoires de la Chaire VALBIOS ont mis en évidence deux lignes de production, la ligne SB et une seconde ligne, composées chacune de plusieurs opérations unitaires et présentant des niveaux de maturité et de disponibilité de données très contrastés. La première correspond à une ligne établie, stable et répétable, offrant un cadre favorable à la modélisation, mais dont les données de production restent aujourd’hui peu numérisées et historisées. La seconde correspond à une ligne moins répétable, dont l’historique de production est encore limité et qui est appelée à connaître d’importantes évolutions technologiques : elle constitue un contexte exploratoire pour lequel l’enjeu prioritaire est la maîtrise et l’anticipation des dérives à partir d’un faible nombre d’observations. Pour préserver la confidentialité, les caractéristiques détaillées de ces lignes ne sont pas exposées ici et seront précisées dans le cadre des instances de gouvernance de la Chaire. La question des données est ainsi centrale et transversale aux deux lignes : données faiblement numérisées, données non historisées de manière systématique, et données partiellement détenues par des tiers. Ces problématiques convergent vers un même besoin, la construction d’un data lake structuré capable d’agréger des données hétérogènes, de les normaliser et de les rendre exploitables. items.desc: Founding Engineer Role can be based remotely in the EEA or hybrid in our London or Munich offices. Fixed software is the wrong shape for logistics, because every team runs its processes differently. Tare is our solution. Combining agentic AI with deterministic logic means Tare fits to any customer but runs the same way every single time. We have just closed our pre-seed funding round with a top European VC and we are now looking for a founding engineer to build Tare with us. About Tarebase We're Dom and Felix, the two co-founders of Tarebase. Dom is a former SVP at a global unicorn, overseeing tens of millions in global carrier spend, with deep logistics domain experience from Amazon, Nestle and EY. Felix was a founding engineer at Raycast and has spent more than two decades building software systems. We've raised pre-seed funding from a top-tier European VC and are building our MVP together with early design partners, who will become our first customers. As our first employee, you'd have a real say in both the product and the engineering decisions behind it. Logistics is difficult to run well, and experienced people are hard to hire. Smaller businesses often pay too much for shipping, struggle to give customers a good delivery experience, and can't match larger competitors' technology or hiring budgets. The software available to them is often expensive, dated or too cumbersome. We want to make logistics less of a burden so these businesses can spend more time selling their products.They're the customers we want to build for: Europe alone has around 26 million SMEs, employing more than 100 million people. Just putting a chat interface and GPT-wrapper on top of the problem is not what we're building. We're combining extraction and analysis, workflow automation, agentic and compiled AI with deterministic, verifiable logic. Recent advances in AI make more of this possible, but building a system that does it reliably is still hard. We're looking for someone who wants to advance the state of the art in this area with us. About you The description below is an ideal, not a checklist. If you don't tick every box but feel ready for the challenges of being the first engineer at an early-stage startup, we'd still like to hear from you. What matters most to us is that you're motivated, committed, willing to stick with hard problems, and someone we can count on. You have a strong technical background and a track record of building and shipping software systems, whether that's cloud backends, web applications, AI-supported systems or a mix of these. You enjoy working across engineering and product. You think like a product engineer: you care about UX/UI, and you want direct contact with customers and the people who use what you build. You'll work mostly in Rust and TypeScript, across the full stack: data engineering, AI, backend, frontend, infrastructure and deployment. We especially value experience with either language from before AI coding tools and a solid understanding of its ecosystem so you can make considered choices. We also value experience operating distributed systems and data-intensive systems in the cloud, including multi-tenant environments and the scaling and security challenges they bring, databases, and durable execution runtimes. You use coding agents effectively, but stay close to the code. You know their limitations in a large codebase, review and challenge their work, and take testing, debugging, refactoring and documentation seriously. You can design useful tests and evaluations, manage complexity, and tell when something is genuinely ready to ship. You also enjoy digging into challenging problems. You keep up with what current models, agent harnesses and research make possible, and you can judge what actually works for a given use case. You know how to build agents and AI workflows into a product and use evaluations, validation and deterministic logic to make what they produce consistent and verifiable. You're comfortable extracting structure from messy documents and care a lot about data quality. You experiment, measure the results, question your assumptions, and keep going until you've found a solution that really holds up. You can turn that work into shipped software, taking a product idea or technical direction through design and implementation without waiting for someone to assign you a ticket. We work remotely, so clear communication and follow-through matter a lot to us. We value people who manage their own work, can be counted on, and raise important issues early. It's fine to use tools for spelling or translation, but we want to hear your voice. Our process The process should take a few weeks from start to finish depending on your availability. items.desc: The Team: Cundall's Data, Digital team enables digital innovation, data-led working, automation and responsible adoption of artificial intelligence across our global engineering consultancy. We have an exciting opportunity for a Power Platform & Copilot Platform Architect to join our growing capability. The role may be based in Poland or Romania, with the working arrangement agreed in line with Cundall's local employment and office requirements. The Role: We are looking for an experienced Power Platform & Copilot Platform Architect to own and develop Cundall's enterprise Microsoft Power Platform and Copilot Studio capability. You will provide the technical architecture, environment strategy, governance, application lifecycle management and integration framework required to safely scale Power Apps, Power Automate and AI agents across the organisation. This is not solely an application development role. You will act as the technical bridge between experimentation and supported production services, helping teams progress promising ideas into secure, scalable, maintainable and monitored business solutions. You will work closely with Data & Digital, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Azure and Cloud, Information Security, Data Protection, AI Governance and business stakeholders across Cundall. Responsibilities: Own and develop the enterprise architecture for Power Platform and Copilot Studio, including environments, Dataverse, Power Apps, Power Automate, connectors and supporting services Define and maintain environment strategies covering personal maker, sandbox, development, test, pilot and production use, including appropriate security boundaries and production segregation Administer and govern the Copilot and agent platform, maintaining visibility of ownership, purpose, environment, users, data sources, connectors, authentication, dependencies, usage, cost and review status Establish lifecycle controls for apps, flows and agents from experimentation through pilot, production, monitoring, change and retirement Define and operate application lifecycle management practices using solutions, source control, deployment pipelines, managed deployments, environment variables, approvals, release records and rollback arrangements Design and assure integrations using approved APIs, custom connectors, Dataverse, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure services and other enterprise systems Implement and maintain governance and security controls, including data loss prevention policies, connector classification, permissions, Entra groups, security roles, service identities, secrets management, auditability and external sharing controls Work with Information Security, Data Protection, Enterprise Architecture and AI Governance colleagues to translate policy and risk requirements into practical platform guardrails and technical patterns Monitor platform health, failures, performance, capacity, licensing and consumption across Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, AI Builder and relevant Azure services Identify and address orphaned, duplicated, unused, unsupported, non-compliant or over-privileged apps, flows, agents and connections Support Cundall's Production Gateway with technical assessments, architecture documentation, security evidence, test results, operational ownership, monitoring and support readiness Create reusable components, templates, naming conventions, solution patterns and guidance for Explorers, Builders and citizen makers Provide hands-on development and troubleshooting for strategic or complex solutions, while coaching colleagues and promoting maintainable delivery Maintain inventories, technical standards, runbooks and decision records sufficient for audit, support, handover and service continuity Assess emerging Microsoft Copilot, agent and Power Platform capabilities and recommend their controlled adoption where they offer clear value The Skills: Substantial hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Copilot Studio, Dataverse, Power Fx, Power Platform solutions and the Power Platform Admin Center Strong understanding of enterprise Power Platform architecture, environment management, governance, security, licensing, capacity and operational administration Proven capability in application lifecycle management and DevOps, including Git or equivalent source control, CI/CD pipelines, managed solutions, release processes, environment variables and rollback Ability to design and build integrations using REST APIs, JSON, OAuth, custom connectors, Microsoft Graph and enterprise data sources Working knowledge of PowerShell and sufficient pro-code capability to extend the platform and support enterprise-scale solutions Practical Azure knowledge covering Entra ID, app registrations, enterprise applications, service principals, managed identities, Key Vault, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Application Insights, Storage and Azure SQL Sound knowledge of data policies, connector controls, …

items.desc: Job Description Bring It Your SAP Customer Experience foundation covers Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, SAP Commerce, or Emarsys. You understand customer processes from lead-to-order to case management, and connect CX to enterprise systems. Your structured approach and clear communication make you effective with both technical and business stakeholders. Build It You will support full-lifecycle CX implementations, from fit-gap workshops and solution design through to go-live. You translate business requirements into specifications, assist with SAP CX integrations, and support system testing. You contribute to end-user training and build reusable templates and lessons learned for the practice. Belong This team advises enterprise customers on some of their most significant CX transformation programmes. You work in cross-functional squads with integration, data, and quality specialists across multiple global engagements. SAP supports your growth through CX certification pathways and a practice built on shared knowledge. Cloud Architecture · Customer Relationship Management · Complex Problem Solving · Collaboration · Cloud Strategy · Cloud Security Infrastructure · Service Management · Effective Communication · Technology Roadmaps · Issue Management · Cloud Infrastructure · Operational Risk Management · Observability · AI-Assisted Architecture Decisions · AI-Threat Detection · Context Engineering · AI Output Quality Assurance · Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice · AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping · AI Adoption Capability Additional Information About SAP With a global network of customers, partners, employees, and thought leaders, SAP helps the world run better and improves people’s lives. As a leader in enterprise applications and business AI, SAP stands at the nexus of business and technology. For over 50 years, organizations have trusted SAP to bring out their best by uniting business-critical operations spanning finance, procurement, HR, supply chain, and customer experience. We win with inclusion SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone, regardless of background, feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world. SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or complete your application, please send an email with your request to the Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com. For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy and childbirth), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements. Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor. Compensation Range Transparency SAP believes pay transparency is essential to fostering an honest, supportive, and inclusive culture and is an important part of our commitment to pay equity. The salary range for this position is included in the job posting. The actual compensation offered to the successful candidate will fall within that range and will depend on factors such as education, skills, experience, location, and scope of the role, as determined through the selection process. Where applicable, SAP may also provide variable incentive opportunities and additional benefits, subject to the terms of the relevant plans and policies. Any variable incentive amount is target-based, with actual payouts dependent on company and individual performance. You can find a summary of benefits and eligibility requirements on SAP's Benefits and Rewards site. items.desc: Job ID: 3558009 T Hub - SAP BTP Architect (m/f/d) Warsaw Professional Application deadline: 30.12.2027 Regular (Part Time Possible) T-Hub Polska Your Task Design and own scalable, enterprise-grade solutions on SAP BTP. Define architecture standards aligned with Clean Core and cloud-native principles. Architect and integrate solutions based on SAP CAP, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP AI, and SAP Cloud ALM. Drive architecture decisions related to scalability, resilience, security, and operational excellence. Establish monitoring and operational processes for SAP BTP solutions using SAP Cloud ALM. Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into solution designs. Provide technical leadership, mentoring, and architectural guidance to development teams. Your Profile 4-6+ years of SAP project experience. 2-3+ years focused on SAP BTP in an architect or senior developer role. Proven experience in at least two of the following areas: SAP CAP, SAP AI, SAP Build. Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English (written and spoken) is required. Strong hands-on experience with SAP BTP architecture, including Cloud Foundry, Kyma, security concepts (XSUAA, IAS/IPS), account model, and entitlements. Ability to design scalable and enterprise-grade solutions aligned with Clean Core and multi-cloud strategies. Understanding of cloud-native architectures, microservices, containers, Kubernetes, CI/CD, GitOps, and DevOps practices. Experience with SAP CAP development, including CDS modeling, Node.js/Java services, OData/REST APIs, multitenancy, and deployment on SAP BTP. Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud, including HDI containers and SQLScript fundamentals. Experience with SAP AI Core, AI Launchpad, AI Foundation Services, and Generative AI Hub. Ability to embed AI capabilities into SAP BTP applications and leverage SAP HANA Vector Engine for AI-driven scenarios. Experience with SAP Cloud ALM, including health, integration, exception, job, automation, and real-user monitoring. Ability to establish and manage monitoring concepts for productive BTP environment Nice to Have Experience with SAP Build (Apps, Process Automation, Work Zone). Knowledge of SAP Build Code, Joule, and AI-assisted development. Experience with prompt engineering, LLMs, and Generative AI use cases in SAP environments. Knowledge of SAP security and identity management (IAS, IPS, Role Collections, Audit Logging). Experience working in Agile/SAFe environments. SAP BTP Solution Architect certification preferred. German language skills are considered a strong advantage. About Us T Hub Poland is a dynamic, forward-thinking division in T-Mobile Poland, where technology matters! It’s a place where best talents converge to ideate, prototype, and implement cutting-edge solutions in international projects held in Deutsche Telekom Group. As a part of Deutsche Telekom Group, we are building in Poland SAP Center of Excellence to support our T-Systems International Customers in Europe with SAP Analysis, Design and Rollout. Marynarska 12) Form of Employment: Contract of Employment Location: Warsaw/ hybrid model (office presense once per quarter) Have you ever asked yourself whether you'd rather work in a big-tech, software house or startup? With $6.9 billion in sales, a strong customer base and global reach spanning nearly 70 countries, we are uniquely positioned to deliver greater value to our customers and create new opportunities for our people. We are seeking a highly skilled Data Product's Engineer in Cluj-Napoca, Romania , with deep expertise in Snowflake and strong hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS. The ideal candidate will design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines that feed our Data Marketplace and enable the creation, publication, and consumption of certified Data Products across the enterprise. This role is central to our Data Marketplace strategy — ensuring data flows reliably from source systems through our silver, and gold layers, and is curated, governed, and made discoverable as reusable Data Products. Develop and publish certified Data Products — governed, documented, and reusable datasets made available through the Data Marketplace for self-service consumption by analysts, data scientists, and business users. Develop and optimize Snowflake objects including warehouses, schemas, tables, views, streams, tasks, and stored procedures to support Data Product pipelines. Optimize Snowflake performance through clustering, caching, micro-partitioning, and resource monitoring to ensure Data Products are delivered with reliability and speed. Define and enforce data contracts, SLAs, and quality standards for each Data Product published to the Marketplace. Ensure data lineage is traceable end-to-end from source systems through bronze/silver/gold layers to the final Data Product. Collaboration & Delivery Work closely with data analysts, data scientists, AI/ML teams, product teams, and business stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into well-defined Data Products. Partner with the Data Marketplace product owner to define the Data Product lifecycle (creation, certification, publication, deprecation). Lead code reviews, provide mentorship, and support best practices across the engineering team. Contribute to architectural decisions and participate in strategic data roadmap planning. Automation & DevOps Build CI/CD pipelines for Matillion job deployments and Snowflake object management. Develop reusable ETL frameworks, templates, and patterns to accelerate the creation of new Data Products. Implement monitoring, alerting, and operational excellence practices for data pipelines and Data Product health. Automate Data Product certification workflows, including quality gates and approval processes. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role. Strong expertise with Snowflake (SQL, performance tuning, data modeling, warehouse configuration, streams, tasks). Hands-on experience with Matillion on AWS (or comparable ETL/ELT tools such as Talend, Informatica, dbt, Azure Data Factory). Solid understanding of Data Product and Data Marketplace concepts (data contracts, data-as-a-product, self-service data consumption). Advanced SQL skills; ability to write complex queries and optimize them. Strong understanding of data modeling, dimensional models, star schemas, and data warehouse/data lake concepts (bronze/silver/gold architecture). Experience with cloud platforms, specifically AWS. Experience with Oracle Business Applications (ERP/EBS) as source systems is a plus. Proficiency in Python, Airflow, or other orchestration tools. Familiarity with Git, CI/CD, and general DevOps practices. Knowledge of data governance principles, metadata management, and data cataloging tools. items.desc: Company Description We’re Checkout.com . You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day. We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers. Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale. If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact. With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started. About the Role As an Associate in Strategic Finance, you'll focus on turning financial and commercial data into clear insight - enabling leadership to deeply understand our business and the drivers of performance. You’ll partner with Data Engineering, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders, and build analytical workflows to support fast and data-driven decision-making. What You’ll Be Doing Analyse commercial and business performance - evaluating the full P&L and measuring ROI in order to help the business assess where it is creating value. Translate ambiguous requests from leadership, Finance and cross-functional stakeholders into clear, decision-ready insights. Craft executive-style deliverables, which may include decks, models, written documents or AI-powered apps. Leverage AI tooling as a force multiplier to build and automate reusable analytical workflows that enable your stakeholders to quickly understand performance. Drive continuous reporting improvements, standardisation, and simplification whilst documenting definitions and limitations - leaving no room for approximation. Collaborate directly with Data Engineering and Data Science to support the development and enhancement of our core financial data models, and the context layer that enables AI agents to leverage that data. You will be empowered to work directly with Finance and Data partners to scope requirements and deliver initiatives end-to-end. What We Look For Essential Criteria You’ll have 3+ years of relevant experience in data-driven and analytical roles, and hold a bachelor’s or master’s degree in a quantitative or business discipline. Strong analytical thinking: you’re comfortable working with numbers, identifying the underlying patterns and drawing sound conclusions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills: you have the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels. Commercial curiosity: you want to dive into the details to understand how merchant, product, and commercial dynamics affect financial performance. Confidence with data tools: You have strong spreadsheet skills and experience with BI tooling and data platforms, or demonstrate a clear aptitude and willingness to learn. Python and SQL experience is a plus. Exceptional attention to detail: you rigorously validate data, pressure-test assumptions, and transparently communicate analytical limitations. You’ve used AI hands-on in a business environment to create new tooling or workflows. Additional Information Bring all of you to work We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one. Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands. We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here. It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable. Life at Checkout.com We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection. Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us. For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

items.desc: Are you ready to unlock your potential within a challenging, creative and fast paced work environment? Do you want to escape your current job role and work with people to build positive and productive lives, whatever their past? Now is the time to break into offender healthcare and develop your career. Oxleas NHS trust were awarded the South West prison contract in 2022 and currently have a portfolio of 19 prisons across the South of England. We are currently looking to expand our pool of bank workers by recruiting Pharmacy Technicians to work within the Prison service on a flexible basis. Our healthcare team have a real impact on promoting health and well-being to those in prison and we pride ourselves on using skills and strategies that instil hope for patients future resettlement back into the community. We directly deliver Mental Health, Physical Health, Pharmacy and Clinical Substance Misuse in an integrated healthcare delivery model to provide effective and responsive care to improve wellbeing and support better outcomes in the future. As a Pharmacy Technician, you will be providing a medicines management service to patients within the prison with the professional support of a prison service pharmacist. You will administer medicines to patients against a valid prescription, ensuring this is taken correctly, provide advice to patients about the appropriate use of medicines and promote healthy lifestyles to aid their rehabilitation. You will dispense prescriptions and stock items, whilst supervising assistants when in the dispensary. There will also be elements of stock control involved in your role, such as undertaking stock top-up services and reviewing expiry dates and storage facilities for all medicines, reporting any deficiencies to the prison service pharmacist. Wondering what it’s like to work within offender healthcare? “I really enjoy working in the Pharmacy Service for Oxleas, my role is extremely varied and I work within a very supportive team. I find my role rewarding as it is all about enabling patient’s rehabilitation and I enjoy interacting with patients daily and building relationships with them. Oxleas are a good employer and there are plenty of opportunities to be supported through qualifications and training which then allows you to progress through different bands within the team.” Amanda - Pharmacy Tech. Oxleas – About Us Oxleas offers a wide range of NHS healthcare services to people in community and secure environment settings. Our services include community health care such as district nursing and speech and language therapy, care for people with learning disabilities and mental health care such as psychiatry, nursing and therapies. Our multidisciplinary teams look after people of all ages and we work in close partnership with other parts of the NHS, local councils and the voluntary sector and through our new provider collaboratives. Our 4,300 members of staff work in many different settings including hospitals, clinics, prisons, secure hospitals, children’s centres, schools and people’s homes. We have over 125 sites in a variety of locations in the South of England. In London we operate within the Boroughs of Bexley, Bromley Greenwich and into Kent. We manage hospital sites including Queen Mary’s Hospital, Sidcup and Memorial Hospital, Woolwich, as well as the Bracton Centre, our medium secure unit for people with mental health needs. We are the largest NHS provider of prison health services providing healthcare to prisons within Devon, Dorset, Bristol, Wiltshire and Gloucestershire, Kent and South London. We are proud of the care we provide and our people. Our purpose is to improve lives by providing the best possible care to our patients and their families. To ensure high standards of work in the dispensary, in clinics and for when out on the wings and to ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are read and adhered to. items.desc: sennder is redefining road logistics. As Europe’s leading digital freight forwarder, we are building a smarter, faster, and more sustainable future for freight, powered by a single, unified platform that already runs our entire business. We are moving from a decade of growth through acquisition to a company that is outcome-driven, outward-focused, and AI-native by design. Logistics is one of the best possible use cases for AI, and unlike most of our peers, we own the full loop: the platform, the operations, and the data connecting them. That closed feedback loop is a compounding advantage most competitors can’t replicate. This role exists to turn that advantage into sennder’s sharpest edge in margin, cost, and service, because AI will give us that edge if we lead, or become a risk if we lag. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our highly talented ML team. This is an applied machine learning role focused on highly innovative, research-oriented topics. You will work on a diverse portfolio of high-impact projects, ranging from optimizing our established Recommendation engine & Pricing engine to building greenfield solutions. This role can be based out of our Berlin, Barcelona or Amsterdam office. To succeed, this role demands a strong focus on deep Data Science and statistical exploration (roughly 70% of your scope), paired with the foundational Machine Learning Engineering skills (~30%) required to transition prototypes into production-ready models. You will not just be implementing technical specifications; you will sit directly with end-users, operators, and Product Managers to deeply understand their workflows, granting you real decision-making power over the product's direction. You are expected to have a holistic approach to project deployment, acting as an end-to-end ML Engineer and taking full ownership from "Light MVP" R&D to production deployment. What You Will Do… Pricing Engine Optimization: Develop and iterate on bid estimation algorithms and margin-optimization models to power our dynamic pricing engine, directly driving company profitability. Carrier Forecasting: Build robust predictive models to forecast carrier behavior and market capacity, enabling our operational teams to secure the right trucks at the right price before the market shifts. Recommender Systems: Maintain and improve our existing recommender systems to seamlessly support our operational teams' day-to-day efficiency. Industry Innovation & Applied ML: Explore and validate new areas where machine learning can solve fundamental logistics challenges (such as freight routing and network optimization), turning open-ended industry problems into scalable, data-driven solutions. Product Discovery & Ideation: Partner closely with Product Managers to drive continuous product discovery, translating ambiguous operational pain points into clear, outcome-driven ML hypotheses and rapid prototypes. AI & LLM Integration: Leverage foundational models and AI agents both as daily accelerators for your own engineering workflows and as core components to build new internal products. We expect you to pragmatically evaluate trade-offs and always choose the right solution for the right problem—whether that is an LLM, a traditional ML model, or a simple heuristic. Platform Collaboration: Partner with our Data & AI Platform (MLOps) team to utilize and deploy models via our internal ML infrastructure. You will act as a key customer of this platform, providing continuous feedback and contributions to shape our global engineering standards. End-to-End Execution: Adopt a holistic approach to project deployment, maintaining an end-to-end attitude that covers the entire lifecycle from initial R&D and prototyping all the way through to production release and monitoring. What We Are Looking For… Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering. Data Science Fundamentals: Strong foundation in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and deep data exploration to validate assumptions and commercial viability before building complex models. You must possess a working knowledge of ML approaches to address basic regression and classification problems. ML Engineering: Experience deploying models to production environments, writing modular code, and understanding software engineering best practices. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Git. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), utilizing Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, and building interactive data apps/dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, PowerBI) to visualize outcomes for stakeholders. AI Proficiency: A solid understanding of how to set up, evaluate, and leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and related AI tools in a production setting. Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex & multifaceted logistical problems into data-driven solutions, prioritizing 'Outcome over Output'. Collaboration: Strong communication …

items.desc: Le Groupe Alainé, acteur majeur dans le secteur du transport et de la logistique, recherche un(e) Data Scientist basé(e) à Genève pour accompagner sa transformation digitale et renforcer sa stratégie d’intelligence artificielle (IA). LLM), les systèmes RAG, et Agentic. • Expérience en intégration d’IA dans des environnements MaaS/PaaS/SaaS, et forte compétence en développement et intégration d’API. • Maîtrise avancée de Python et des librairies de Data Science. items.card: The role You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). items.desc: Why Qogita Wholesale is a $50 trillion market still working the way it did in 1950. 90% of transactions happen offline, over calls, catalogues and trade shows, and a product passes through four or five layers of distributors and wholesalers before it reaches a store, with every party deciding on a fraction of the picture. By the time it hits the shelf, it costs roughly 40% more than the maker charged. That inefficiency tax runs into the trillions, and everyone pays it every time they buy anything. Qogita is building the operating system that replaces that chain: a single order book connecting the global market, the rails to move goods across borders, and a self-learning system that does every job once, against real-time data about the whole market. That puts data science at the core of the product. Forecasting reads what is actually selling in every market as it sells, a buyer's basket is assembled from every available seller and split across the optimal combination, and every trade writes a record that sharpens the next price, allocation and route. It is a hard problem, spanning physical goods, thirty national regimes in Europe alone and buyers who are increasingly agents, and it is already working: 95% of transactions involve no human touch, and the business is doubling every year. The role You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). You'll own end-to-end data science work across Qogita's wholesale marketplace: framing ambiguous commercial problems, building models that ship, and keeping them healthy in production. The Data Science team partners with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial to build the intelligence layer behind pricing, matching, demand, and product discovery. What You'll Do Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack: predictive models, ranking, demand forecasting, segmentation, pricing, experimentation, and LLM-powered features, depending on where the business need is greatest Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: problem framing, model design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML or statistical problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial Apply quantitative methods (regression, causal inference, classical ML, and deep learning where useful) to pricing, demand, liquidity, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment, and related marketplace problems Design and analyse experiments and A/B tests, owning statistical validity and turning results into recommendations teams can act on Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows: experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders What You'll Bring 3+ years as a data scientist, applied ML engineer, or quantitative analyst, with meaningful exposure across ML methods and statistical modelling A track record of owning models in production, not just building them: maintaining, monitoring, and iterating as live infrastructure Solid grounding in ML and stats fundamentals: probability, supervised and unsupervised learning, and measurement/validation discipline Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large transactional datasets and common DS/ML libraries (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or similar) Experience collaborating on MLOps-style workflows (experiment tracking, serving, monitoring) and shipping with engineers Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, CS, or related), or equivalent experience Nice to have (depth in one or more) Pricing and market economics: price theory, buyer behaviour, demand estimation, causal inference, experimentation with real commercial stakes Production LLM systems: RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt/fine-tuning trade-offs, transformers and major model families, LangChain or similar Marketplace or B2B dynamics; AWS/GCP/Azure ML infra; Airflow, Docker, dbt, Snowflake, Lightdash or similar Perks & Benefits Base salary: €60,000 to €90,000 (Amsterdam) / £60,000 to £90,000 (London) depending on experience 26 days of annual leave, plus 4 additional personal days Company performance-based bonus Attractive equity package Pension contributions Annual learning & development budget Office-led culture with hybrid flexibility Dog-friendly offices Home-office setup package Office socials and annual company-wide offsite Who we are Qogita [ Ko-gi-ta ] is a fast-growing European startup building the operating system for modern wholesale. items.desc: Senior AI Engineer – Stockholm (Hybrid) A fast‑growing digital product company is looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help shape how AI is used across the product and internal systems. The business has a strong customer base, a modern tech culture, and a track record of building simple, impactful digital experiences with a focus on quality, speed and user value. The engineering and product organisation is around 20 people, with a flat, collaborative culture and plenty of ownership. This role will be the first AI‑focused hire and will play a key part in exploring where AI can make a meaningful difference. About the roleYou’ll work closely with product, design and engineering to bring AI‑powered features into a large consumer-facing product. This includes automating parts of the customer journey, building internal tools, improving existing systems and shaping new ideas from concept to production. This is not a research role. You’ll spend most of your time designing, building and deploying real AI features that have direct impact on users and internal workflows. What you’ll be doing Building AI‑powered features into the product experience Designing systems that use LLMs and other AI technologies reliably in production Working across teams to turn ideas into working solutionsImproving backend systems and contributing to the broader platform Exploring where AI adds the most value without unnecessary complexity Owning projects from concept through to delivery You’ll work with a modern engineering setup that includes: Kotlin with Spring Boot on the backendNext.js and Vercel for web Native mobile apps in Swift and KotlinGraphQLMicroservice architecture AWS as the primary cloud platform, with some use of GCP You don’t need to know every technology listed, but strong engineering fundamentals are essential. What makes you a great fit 4+ years of professional software engineering experience Strong computer science fundamentals and good judgment in system design Hands‑on experience building AI or LLM‑driven features in a real product Comfortable working with ambiguity and shaping early ideas Able to collaborate well with product, design and engineering teams Motivated by solving real customer problems and shipping useful features Curious, pragmatic and eager to keep learning
