items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als Full-Stack AI Engineer Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om te groeien als professional, collega én mens. Je werkt met gelijkgestemden die technische diepgang combineren met initiatief, aanpassingsvermogen en samenwerking. Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, te leren en oplossingen vanuit de basis op te bouwen. Daarbij ontwikkel je jezelf in full-stack platformontwikkeling, GenAI en agentic AI. Samen werk je aan projecten die ertoe doen, waarin je proofs-of-concept vertaalt naar productieklare oplossingen en bijdraagt aan AI-toepassingen die veilig, verantwoord en schaalbaar worden ingezet. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Als Full-Stack AI Engineer (Agentic AI) ontwerp, bouw en implementeer je schaalbare GenAI-oplossingen en agentic AI-systemen. Je werkt end-to-end, van data-inname en technische ontwikkeling tot deployment, monitoring en continue verbetering. Met jouw ervaring in Python, cloud- en DevOps-praktijken ontwikkel je microservices, automatisering en herbruikbare bouwblokken voor complexe AI-workflows. Je werkt samen met Data Science-, Product- en Business-teams om requirements te vertalen naar technische oplossingen en communiceert helder met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Daarbij houd je rekening met security, dataveiligheid, gegevensbescherming, compliance, prestaties en kosten. Je deelt je expertise, begeleidt junior engineers en draagt bij aan een cultuur waarin leren, innovatie en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Werken aan schaalbare, verantwoorde en kosteneffectieve GenAI-oplossingen, agent-based orchestration en productieklare AI-toepassingen. Samenwerken met engineers, data scientists, productmanagers en businessstakeholders aan complexe technische vraagstukken en herbruikbare oplossingen. Persoonlijke begeleiding om je expertise, technische leiderschap, aanpassingsvermogen en vermogen om kennis te delen verder te ontwikkelen. Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma waarmee je blijft groeien in agentic AI, full-stack platformontwikkeling, cloud, DevOps en AI-workflows. Flexibele werkopties die ruimte bieden voor een gezonde werk-privébalans en duurzame prestaties. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op Een vast contract van 32, 36 of 40 uur met een beloningsbudget tot €8.200, bruto per maand incl. vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding; Je hebt 4 of meer jaren ervaring als Full-Stack Ai Engineer, Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan; We motiveren een actieve levenstijl daarom bieden wij daarbovenop een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike; 26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf Senior AI Engineer; Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer; Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen; Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. Jouw talenten en ervaring Je hebt minimaal acht jaar sterke hands-on ervaring met softwareontwikkeling en bent vaardig in Python. Je hebt minimaal één AI-product naar productie gebracht waarmee echte gebruikers hebben gewerkt, bij voorkeur een agentic of multi-step AI-systeem. Je hebt ervaring met full-stack platformontwikkeling en het vertalen van proofs-of-concept naar productieklare oplossingen. Je hebt praktische ervaring met agentic AI-frameworks zoals LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen of een vergelijkbaar framework. Je hebt ervaring met Azure-diensten zoals Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, Azure Functions en API Gateway. Je hebt ervaring met cloud- en DevOps-praktijken en met CI/CD, GitHub, Azure DevOps, Terraform, Bicep of Kong. Je communiceert helder met technische en niet-technische stakeholders en hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van junior engineers of het leiden van technische teams. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands (C1). Herken jij jezelf in onze manier van werken, maar beschik je (nog) niet over alle kennis? Reageer gerust: we kijken liever naar jouw mindset en groeipotentieel dan naar een perfecte checklist. Meer over Sogeti Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om de beste versie van jezelf te worden als professional, collega én mens. Je werkt in een warme community waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Then join us in shaping the next generation of AI-driven architectures for leading organizations worldwide. Design agentic platforms, autonomous delivery pipelines, and intelligent systems that translate enterprise knowledge into scalable business impact. Bring your unique strengths to our distinctive team – one that consistently supports each other. As part of the Boston Consulting Group, we drive innovation from the boardroom to the code. Shape the world of tomorrow You will contribute to the design of AI-driven target architectures – from LLM orchestration and agentic AI to harness engineering in autonomous software factories such as the “Agentic Software Factory” – and learn how to integrate these approaches into enterprise landscapes in a scalable way with measurable business impact You will develop rule sets, toolchains, evaluation frameworks and CI/CD integrations that govern the behavior of coding agents across the entire SDLC You will build modern software delivery approaches: from DevSecOps and CI/CD pipelines to automated testing and platform engineering in an enterprise context You will work directly with clients to translate business intent into precise, testable specifications that agents can execute You clearly and convincingly – to both technical teams and business stakeholders on the client side This Is How You Can Make a Difference You have completed (or are about to complete) a degree in computer science, business informatics, business mathematics, mathematics, AI engineering or a related field You have hands-on experience with AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, or similar) – for example through academic work, internships, university projects or personal experiments You understand concepts such as agent loops, evaluation and observability, MCP, deep agents, or AI-native architectures – and you are motivated to dive deeper Ideally, you have initial experience with agent evaluation, observability tools (e.g., Langfuse, LangSmith) or orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph) You enjoy tackling complex digital challenges and are enthusiastic about developing and communicating solutions You thrive in interdisciplinary teams and global environments and are flexible and willing to travel You are fluent in both German and English and can confidently understand and communicate complex topics in both languages How You Can Grow With Us We guarantee constant new development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment. You'll face challenges every day together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues. Individual training offers and a culture of open feedback will provide the framework you need to explore and perfect your own strengths. Our modern structures enable you to stay focused. This includes easy travel booking, our excellent back-office support and a comprehensive Knowledge Center. With our regular office Fridays and legendary events, we cultivate a strong and close team network from which you will also profit beyond your case work. To support your growth in the AI space, we provide state-of-the-art hard- and software infrastructure for AI-powered work, as well as a comprehensive AI enablement training program that equips you with the skills to thrive in an AI-driven world. Become part of our team BCG Platinion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and actively promotes diversity and inclusion. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of ethnic and social background, age, gender, sexual identity, religion, ideology or disability. Apply now with your CV, an informative project list and all relevant references via our online portal or contact Leonie Kutschera-Gross (+49 221 58958-555) if you have any questions. items.desc: The Role: We are looking for a Software Development AI Technical Expert to serve as the department’s designated AI specialist and lead the responsible evaluation, adoption and practical application of AI across Software Development and Software Quality Assurance. The role will research emerging AI technologies, support experimentation and pilot projects, and translate successful solutions into practical tools, standards and development practices. You will provide technical guidance on AI-enabled development, code quality, security, AI advocacy, capability building and impact measurement. You will work closely with Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams to develop practical, responsible and measurable AI-native ways of working that improve productivity, quality, security and innovation. The key responsibilities of the position include: Act as the subject-matter specialist for AI-enabled Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, maintaining current knowledge of large language models, AI development tools, AI agents and emerging technologies. Research and benchmark AI applications, tools, vendors and industry practices, assessing their relevance, maturity, limitations, security and potential value to the organisation. Provide expert advice on the practical and technical application of AI across the Software Development Lifecycle, from requirements and design through coding, testing, deployment and monitoring. Explore, prototype and evaluate AI capabilities and use cases, defining clear objectives, success criteria, evaluation methods and recommendations. Contribute to AI pilots from concept through implementation and evaluation, identifying lessons learned, adoption requirements and opportunities for scaling successful solutions. Support the transition of approved AI tools and practices into Software Development and Software Quality Assurance, including AI code assistants, automated code review, AI-supported testing and intelligent CI/CD practices. Develop guidance, standards and best practices for the responsible use of AI and AI-generated code, covering quality assurance, security, data protection, intellectual property, maintainability and human oversight. Establish and monitor measures of AI effectiveness and impact, including output quality, reliability, usability, developer experience, cycle time, defect rates, deployment frequency, test coverage and rework. Assess the AI maturity of Software Development and Software Quality Assurance teams and recommend practical actions to improve organisational capability. Support cultural change, knowledge-sharing and upskilling through playbooks, prompt libraries, FAQs, onboarding materials, reusable templates, case studies and communities of practice. Collaborate with stakeholders across IT, the Group and other departments to identify and assess AI opportunities aligned with business priorities, roadmaps and projects. Collaborate with AI representatives across the Group to share knowledge and support a coordinated approach to AI adoption. Maintain relationships with vendors, research communities and industry peers, bringing relevant developments and insights back to the organisation. Represent the Group, when requested, at conferences, external events and industry forums, contributing to presentations, demonstrations, articles and other technology-related activities. Main requirements: BSc/MSc in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. At least 7 years of experience in IT engineering roles, including experience in a managerial or leadership role within a Software Development team. Solid working knowledge of the modern AI landscape, including Large Language Models, AI agents, automation platforms, prompt engineering techniques and practical business applications. Demonstrated experience modernising or transforming software development lifecycles through AI tooling and automation. Deep understanding of modern SDLC practices, including CI/CD, DevOps and platform engineering, combined with hands-on experience with AI-powered development tools. Strong Machine Learning and AI background, with hands-on experience building, prototyping or deploying AI solutions. Experience contributing to governance frameworks covering quality assurance, security review or intellectual property considerations for AI-generated outputs. Solid understanding of IT engineering metrics and data-driven measurement of development performance. Exposure to AI or IT engineering maturity models and experience assessing team capabilities against defined frameworks. Experience evaluating technology vendors and AI tooling through trials, benchmarking and recommendations. Experience presenting to and working directly with senior or C-level stakeholders. Public speaking or conference presentation experience in AI or technology, with the ability to inspire technical and non-technical audiences. Innovative and curious …

items.desc: Lieu : Meudon, France Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays. Nos engagements, vos avantages Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée Un package de rémunération attractif Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu Votre quotidien En nous rejoignant à Meudon, vous rejoignez le siège social du Groupe Thales situé en bord de Seine et organisé en un véritable campus, regroupant notamment nos activités d’identité et de sécurité numériques. Mission Au sein de l'équipe IT Data & AI de CDI, vous contribuez au développement et à l'industrialisation de solutions basées sur l'IA générative et les technologies AI Agentic afin d'accélérer la transformation digitale des métiers. Vous travaillez au carrefour des enjeux technologiques et métier pour transformer des idées et cas d'usage en solutions concrètes, robustes et déployées à l'échelle de l'entreprise. Dans Ce Cadre, Vous Concevez et développez des solutions d'IA générative et agentique répondant à des besoins métiers à forte valeur ajoutée; Réalisez des prototypes ou MVP et accompagnez leur passage vers des solutions industrielles exploitables en production; Intégrez les solutions d'IA avec les applications, données et systèmes d'information existants à travers APIs, connecteurs et services cloud; Contribuez à la mise en œuvre des bonnes pratiques de développement (DevOps/CI/CD), de qualité logicielle, de sécurité et d'exploitation; Accompagnez les utilisateurs dans l'identification et la formalisation de cas d’usage et les former aux outils quand nécessaire.; Assurez une veille active sur les technologies IA et contribuez à l'amélioration continue des solutions déployées. Profil Titulaire d’une formation supérieure en ingénierie informatique ou équivalent, vous justifiez d’une expérience significative dans les systèmes d’information, la transformation digitale ou les technologies d’intelligence artificielle. Le profil recherché combine expertise technique, compréhension des enjeux business et forte appétence pour l'innovation. Bonne connaissance et expérience avec les outils d’IA Generative et agentic (Copilot, cowork, code assist, plateforme agentique etc); Maîtrisez les principes clés des architectures d’IA générative et agentique : RAG, MCP, orchestration d’agents, mémoire, points de contrôle humain; Pratique d’un outil d’orchestration tel que n8n, Mindflow, LangSmith ou équivalent, et capacité à choisir entre low-code, configuration et développement spécifique selon le besoin; Connaissance d’un langage de programmation; Familiarité avec les environnements Cloud (Azure souhaite), les méthodes Agile et les pratiques DevOps / CI-CD; Capacité à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés, à vulgariser des sujets techniques et à accompagner le changement auprès des utilisateurs; Curiosité, esprit d'initiative, sens du service et forte appétence pour les nouvelles technologies et l'innovation; Bon niveau d'anglais permettant d'évoluer dans un environnement international. Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !

items.desc: Your role at Dynatrace Dynatrace Documentation is a critical asset in driving user adoption of our unified observability, security, and AI platform. It guides users through Dynatrace's multi-faceted functionality and helps them extract real value from the platform. At Dynatrace, writers architect knowledge, curate output, and serve as the final accuracy and experience quality gate. They build AI-first documentation: structured, governed information architecture managed by domain and content experts, explicitly optimized for both human readers and AI consumers. In This Role, You Will Architect knowledge across complex, cross-domain product areas by defining content models, taxonomy, and lifecycle so the same source can serve human readers and AI consumers (copilots, search, support agents, LLMs). Curate AI-generated content and review work from other Information Developers for nuance, structural integrity, and accuracy — the things only human judgment can reliably catch — before content is trusted and served. Design prompts, build reusable templates and skills, and instruct agents that draft, validate, and surface gaps in the knowledge base. Apply Dynatrace's structured content principles, metadata schema, and chunking strategy so every content unit is modular, independently addressable, composable, and machine-readable. Retrievability is a first-class requirement. Partner directly with subject-matter experts, Development, Product Management, and AI teams to scope knowledge work, define what users need to know, and design the content and structure. Identify improvements to content models, taxonomy, and AI-pipeline quality, and contribute to evolving authoring standards across the team. Use your technical depth and writing craft to navigate complex use cases and produce concise, clear, accurate copy that non-technical users — and AI consumers — can grasp. Mentor less-experienced writers and Information Developers, and shape team-wide standards and authoring practices. Work in a docs-as-code process using a Markdown-based static site, VSCode, Git, and an evolving stack of agentic tooling (Claude plugins, docs MCP, AI content validators). Collaborate within a truly global R&D team with a presence across multiple continents. What Will Help You Succeed 5+ years of experience in technical writing, information development, or a closely related content-engineering discipline, with a track record of documenting B2B software products. Hands-on experience operating an AI-first authoring workflow: designing prompts, building reusable templates and skills, instructing agents, and curating AI-generated drafts for accuracy and consistency. Comfort being an architect, quality gate, and final approver rather than the sole author of every piece of content. Experience treating documentation as structured data: modular, semantically structured units optimized for both human readability and AI retrievability. Familiarity with frontmatter, metadata, chunking, and retrieval signals. Experience contributing to information architecture within a product domain: content models, taxonomy, and lifecycle considerations. Demonstrated ability to independently scope a knowledge project across complex, cross-domain product areas: interviewing SMEs, defining the content's scope, and designing its structure without being handed a brief. Strong editorial judgment when reviewing AI-generated drafts and peer work — catching nuance, structural integrity, and accuracy before content is served. Excellent written English, with the ability to produce clear, precise, and conversational writing that works for both human readers and AI consumption. Genuine curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning, especially as AI-first authoring evolves in real time. The ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders across an organization — from engineers to executives — including Development, Product Management, and AI teams. Experience working in an Agile software development environment. Proficiency with Markdown, Git, Jira, and the command line. Why you will love being a Dynatracer Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security. We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance. Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances. Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace. Compensation And Rewards We offer attractive compensation packages and stock purchase options with numerous benefits and advantages. Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to list a salary range for this position, which is € 61,000 up to € 76,000 gross per year based on full-time employment (38.5 h/week). We’ve listed the salary range for transparency, but if your experience and skills bring unique value, we’d still love to hear from you—please apply even if …

items.desc: At a glance Our AI team builds GenAI applications that go into production at one of the Netherlands' largest banks. Our scope is bankwide, whether it’s Voice agents handling thousands of contact center calls or AI lending assistants that support lenders in writing credit proposals in the Credits domain. AI lending assistants supporting lenders in writing credit proposals. Agentic workflows that actually make it to users. We don't stop at prototypes. We build, ship, measure, iterate, and do it fast. If you've got concrete experience developing backends and deploying infrastructure then this role puts you close to the architecture behind real production AI: secure deployments, resilient services, and infrastructure built for scale. Your job You design, build, and operate the backend services and infrastructure that power GenAI applications in production. You ensure that AI solutions are secure, scalable, and reliable in a real banking environment. You will work in multidisciplinary teams consisting of AI engineers, product managers, Business developers to translate use cases into robust technical AI solutions and architectures. This includes building APIs, integrating LLMs into backend systems, and deploying resilient infrastructure that can handle real-world usage at scale. You design the infrastructure and backend of multiple different projects and support them when changes are needed. Concretely, you will: Design and implement backend services and Azure cloud infrastructure for GenAI use cases, including Voice AI, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows. Build and maintain secure, scalable cloud infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines for production systems. Ensure reliability and performance through monitoring, logging, observability, and optimization. Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate GenAI capabilities into production-ready systems. Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable backend and infrastructure solutions. Own the full system lifecycle: design, build, deploy, operate, and continuously improve production systems. Contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and backend/infrastructure best practices. Working environment You'll be part of a 25+ person AI team inside ABN AMRO's Innovation department. We operate with a startup mindset within a bank that serves millions of customers and employs thousands of individuals, fast feedback loops, direct lines to business leadership, and real deployment at scale. Initiative is expected. Hybrid working. Your profile We don't hire on CV titles. We hire on what you've shipped. The team includes people who came through software engineering, data science, infra. What they share is proven AI expertise and a bias for building first and asking questions later. What you’ve done Built and deployed Python backend services or platforms that run in production Worked with cloud infrastructure (Azure required) Designed or maintained APIs and distributed systems that handle real-world usage Implemented CI/CD pipelines and automated deployments Shipped systems people actually relied on, and can clearly explain what worked, what didn’t, and why Experience integrating GenAI/LLM components is a plus, but not required How you work You take ownership from initial cloud architecture design to production deployment, and ensure systems continue to run smoothly. You move quickly from idea to working system without needing heavy direction. You are able to balance speed, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. You enjoy mentoring juniors and helping to grow their systems design & infrastructure knowledge and take them along in your decisions and trade-offs. You can clearly communicate technical decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. You are interested in GenAI and know how it fits into real production systems. You have built something outside of your day job (tooling, infra, side project) that shows initiative and craftsmanship. We offer We believe it is important to be a good employer. Joining us means stepping into a role with impact, supported by excellent employment conditions that foster your job satisfaction, development, and wellbeing. In addition, we offer: An attractive gross monthly salary based on a 36‑hour work week, including holiday allowance and a flexible benefit budget. An excellent pension scheme, ensuring that you are well prepared for the future. Flexibility in working: working from home is possible in consultation with your team and depending on your role. We will provide an ergonomic home office setup for you. Plenty of room for relaxation with five weeks of vacation per year, supplemented by two mandatory days off. You can also purchase up to four additional weeks of vacation annually. Five “Banking for better days”: extra days off that you can use for personal development or volunteer work. Personal development is key: you receive a development budget of €1,000 per year, …

items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in Belgium. As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. Accountabilities Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. Requirements Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team. Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day. Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing. Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads. A proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, adapt to evolving technologies, and continuously improve testing methodologies. Benefits Fully remote work: Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection, with the flexibility to choose your preferred time zone and working hours. Flexible …

Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021. Job Purpose We are seeking a talented and passionate AI Engineer to join our growing team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deploy AI solutions for our clients across various industries. You will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges using cutting-edge data, machine learning and AI technologies. What You’ll Do Design, develop and implement data-driven solutions tailored to client challenges, leveraging predictive models and AI technologies to deliver business value. Consult and guide clients by defining AI use cases, validating ideas through proof of concepts (POCs) and deploying scalable production-ready systems. Build and maintain end-to-end AI systems, with focus on scalability, observability and continuous optimization of model performance using MLOps principles. Develop multi-agent and AI workflows, built from scratch or using low-code tools, that reliably orchestrate data, tools, and context into production-grade solutions. Architect robust and modular backend services, applying SOLID principles to ensure maintainability, testability, and seamless integration of AI components into broader software ecosystems. Design, document, and develop RESTful or GraphQL APIs that serve as the interface between AI workflows and end-user applications. Work closely with back-end engineers, front-end developers, DevOps, strategists and clients, taking a leading role in aligning efforts and delivering impactful solutions. Communicate complex technical solutions clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including progress updates, demos and presentations. What You’ll Bring We are looking for an AI Engineer who combines strong technical foundations with the ability to bring AI systems from concept to scalable production. items.desc: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Evaluation Engineer based in Ireland. As a founding AI Evaluation Engineer, you will design and build the evaluation, testing, and observability infrastructure that ensures production-grade AI agents perform reliably, safely, and efficiently. You will develop automated testing systems for complex reasoning, multi-turn conversations, and agent interactions involving APIs, databases, and code execution. Working across AI engineering, software testing, and infrastructure, you will create scalable evaluation pipelines that go beyond traditional QA and manual prompt testing. You will establish robust regression testing, statistical evaluation methods, and adversarial scenarios to identify weaknesses before deployment. This is an opportunity to take ownership of an evaluation architecture from the ground up while working with modern AI technologies in a fully remote, globally distributed environment. Your work will directly contribute to the reliability, security, and continuous improvement of advanced AI systems. Accountabilities Design, build, and maintain automated CI/CD testing pipelines to validate AI agent behavior before deployment and throughout the development lifecycle. Develop and maintain golden datasets containing regression prompts, edge cases, and synthetic scenarios to measure agent accuracy, safety, performance, and latency. Implement fast, cost-effective, deterministic evaluation checks before introducing LLM-as-a-judge approaches, including JSON schema validation, regular expressions, API status checks, and embedding similarity. Create comprehensive test suites for multi-turn agent conversations, evaluating context retention, state consistency, reasoning behavior, and safeguards against infinite tool-calling loops. Design and implement adversarial testing scenarios to assess resilience against prompt injection, malformed inputs, unexpected tool responses, and other potential security vulnerabilities. Build statistical evaluation frameworks to measure non-deterministic AI behavior using pass rates across multiple runs, confidence intervals, and other quantitative reliability metrics. Integrate evaluation workflows into GitHub Actions or comparable CI systems using SDK-level execution and automated testing practices. Implement observability and tracing solutions using tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or equivalent platforms to monitor agent execution and diagnose failures. Optimize evaluation efficiency and cost through caching, mocking, and other techniques that reduce unnecessary LLM API calls. Validate structured outputs, including JSON schemas, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads, to ensure agents interact reliably with external systems. Evaluate and improve agent performance under load, accounting for variable response times and non-deterministic endpoint behavior. Independently design and own the evaluation architecture, establishing best practices, testing standards, and scalable processes for ongoing quality assurance. Requirements Strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript, particularly for API testing, headless execution, asynchronous programming, and automated testing systems. Hands-on experience building LLM evaluation pipelines, AI testing frameworks, or statistical testing systems capable of measuring performance across repeated runs. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments, particularly GitHub Actions or similar platforms, with SDK-level execution. Strong expertise in validating structured data and outputs, including JSON schema, OpenAPI specifications, and function-calling payloads. Familiarity with observability and tracing tools such as OpenTelemetry, LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave, or custom logging solutions. Ability to independently design, implement, and maintain an evaluation architecture from scratch, with a strong sense of ownership and technical judgment. Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate technical findings clearly in a distributed team. Availability to overlap with US Central Time business hours for at least three hours each day. Experience with code execution sandboxes or AI agent frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, or CrewAI. Strong understanding of embedding models, vector databases, and their applications in AI evaluation and similarity-based testing. Experience with load testing non-deterministic endpoints and assessing system behavior under varying workloads. A proactive, analytical approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently, adapt to evolving technologies, and continuously improve testing methodologies. items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 In Roche’s Pharmaceutical Research and Early Development organization (pRED), we make transformative medicines for patients in order to tackle some of the world’s toughest unmet healthcare needs. At pRED, we are united by our mission to transform science into medicines. Together, we create a culture defined by curiosity, responsibility, and humility, where our talented people are empowered and inspired to bring forward extraordinary life-changing innovation at speed. 
 Neuroscience & Rare Diseases (NRD), we are committed to realizing the vision of the Roche One Pharma Strategy in Neurology to preserve and restore what makes people who they are. Our research and early development activities center around large and rare indications within four major therapeutic network areas: Dementias, Multiple Sclerosis, Movement Disorders, and Neuromuscular & Neurodevelopmental Disorders. With strengths across diverse disciplines, Roche is uniquely positioned to lead in transforming science to medicines for patients with disorders of the nervous system. 
 We are looking for an experienced and passionate clinical scientist to join our team. You will bring 8+ years of experience in drug development and 5+ years the clinical scientist role in different neurological indications, including Alzheimer’s disease, neurodevelopmental disorders and multiple sclerosis. MD degree and medical monitoring experience in phase 1-2 clinical trials will be considered a major plus. 
 The Opportunity 
 Shape the future of global Phase 0–2 studies in Neuroscience and Rare Diseases, making a direct impact on patient care and innovative scientific research. 
 Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations and Medical Directors to plan, execute, and oversee clinical studies in a supportive, high-performance team environment. 
 Develop and write critical study documentation, including protocols and study reports, while guiding operational and regulatory strategies. 
 Drive clinical data review plans and oversee study conduct, ensuring data quality from collection through to analysis, interpretation, and decision-making. 
 Perform medical and safety data review in clinical studies and interact with study sites 
 Represent clinical science in study management, fostering a culture of excellence by training and supporting operations teams and study sites. 
 Partner with Data Management to design clinical forms and instructions, while continuously reviewing clinical and safety data to ensure patient wellbeing. 
 Advance scientific knowledge by collaborating with leading academics, contributing to publications, and representing our innovative research at global conferences. 
 Who You Are 
 You hold a PhD in Neuroscience and bring over 8 years of experience in drug development and 5 years of experience in supporting early clinical programs in neuroscience spanning across different indications 
 You hold an MD degree and have experience as medical monitor in phase 1-2 clinical trials 
 You possess strong analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven track record in clinical data review, analysis, and reporting data. 
 You have a solid understanding of clinical development processes, study design principles, and international clinical research and safety guidelines. 
 You are a collaborative, solution-oriented scientist who communicates effectively across teams, values diverse perspectives, and makes sound, independent decisions. 
 You have excellent written, oral communication, and presentation skills. 
 You are adaptable, able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment, and willing to travel occasionally to support study needs. 
 At Roche, we aim high to deliver life-changing healthcare solutions. If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact on patients and healthcare systems worldwide, this is the place for you. 
 Who we are
 A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
 Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

 At Tether, we’re not just building products, we’re pioneering a global financial revolution. Our cutting-edge solutions empower businesses—from exchanges and wallets to payment processors and ATMs—to seamlessly integrate reserve-backed tokens across blockchains.  Why Join Us? 
 Our team is a global talent powerhouse, working remotely from every corner of the world. If you’re passionate about making a mark in the fintech space, this is your opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds, pushing boundaries and setting new standards.  If you have excellent English communication skills and are ready to contribute to the most innovative platform on the planet, Tether is the place for you.
 Are you ready to be part of the future? 
 About the job 
 We are looking for Developer Productivity Engineer to help QVAC application teams develop, review, test, and deliver reliable software with less friction. Your focus will be our desktop and mobile applications and their shared runtime, AI harness, and skills packages. You will build and maintain developer tools, integrate AI agents into engineering workflows, and improve code quality and delivery automation. 
 This is a hands-on engineering role with room to shape the tooling roadmap. You will work with engineers to identify useful improvements and own them from implementation through adoption and ongoing support. Success means shorter feedback loops, dependable automation, and tools that developers trust and use. 
 Responsibilities 
 Evaluate, integrate, and maintain developer tools and AI agents, including the repository guidance and integrations they need to work effectively. 
 Build and operate agents in CI and scheduled workflows that investigate failures, propose fixes, and give engineers evidence they can act on. 
 Improve automated pull request reviews, evaluating finding accuracy and reducing noise for reviewers. 
 Develop code quality scripts and checks for complexity, function and file size, dependency cycles, and performance regressions. Work with package owners on practical thresholds and targeted refactoring. 
 Improve development environments, testing, and build and release workflows so engineers and agents can verify changes reliably. 
 Prioritize improvements with engineering teams, support adoption through documentation and onboarding, and measure effectiveness, reliability, and operating costs. 
 Example projects include agents that investigate CI failures, diagnose compatibility and performance regressions, and flag changes that affect package interfaces or architecture. You will choose and refine these workflows with the engineers who use them. 
 Experience building and maintaining developer tools or engineering automation used by others, with strong JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js skills. 
 Hands-on experience using and integrating AI coding tools or agents, with sound judgment about their limitations, output validation, and human review. 
 Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, and systematic debugging of build, test, or integration failures. 
 A strong approach to code quality: maintainable code, useful automated checks, and refactoring that preserves behavior. 
 Ability to work independently, collaborate with engineers, and communicate clearly in English within a remote, globally distributed team.

items.desc:
Job Description Summary 
 Job Description 
 Menedżerka/Menedżer ds. strategii AI 
Miejsce pracy: Bank BPH, Gdańsk/Warszawa 
 Forma zatrudnienia: umowa o pracę 
 Wymiar czasu pracy: pełny etat 
 W Banku BPH rozpoczynamy program rozwoju i wdrażania rozwiązań opartych na sztucznej inteligencji (AI). Naszym celem jest wykorzystanie nowoczesnych technologii do zwiększania efektywności operacyjnej, automatyzacji procesów oraz tworzenia nowych możliwości wspierających realizację celów biznesowych banku.
 Poszukujemy osoby, która odegra kluczową rolę w budowaniu kompetencji AI w organizacji – od współtworzenia strategii i architektury rozwiązań, przez organizację bezpiecznego środowiska eksperymentowania, aż po wdrażanie rozwiązań przynoszących mierzalne korzyści biznesowe.
 Stanowisko łączy kompetencje architekta rozwiązań AI oraz koordynatora inicjatyw realizowanych we współpracy z jednostkami biznesowymi, IT, funkcjami kontrolnymi i strukturami korporacyjnymi.
 Osoba zatrudniona na tym stanowisku będzie raportować bezpośrednio do Dyrektora IT i będzie miała realny wpływ na kształtowanie sposobu wykorzystania AI w banku.
 Kogo szukamy? 
 Szukamy osoby, która nie tylko zna technologie AI, ale przede wszystkim potrafi wykorzystać je do rozwiązywania rzeczywistych problemów biznesowych.
Rozumiejącej, że skuteczne wdrożenie AI wymaga połączenia technologii, bezpieczeństwa, zgodności regulacyjnej i współpracy z biznesem.
 Twój zakres odpowiedzialności 
 Strategia i rozwój AI 
 Udział w opracowaniu i realizacji strategii AI banku, we współpracy z partnerami doradczymi, biznesem i IT.
 Przekładanie strategii AI na konkretne inicjatywy, rozwiązania technologiczne i plan wdrożeń.
 Identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania AI do automatyzacji i optymalizacji procesów bankowych.
 Monitorowanie rozwoju technologii AI oraz rekomendowanie rozwiązań odpowiadających potrzebom banku.
 Architektura i technologia 
 Projektowanie i rozwijanie architektury rozwiązań AI
 Koordynowanie budowy i rozwoju wewnętrznej platformy AI Sandbox, umożliwiającej bezpieczne eksperymentowanie z modelami językowymi.
 Ocena, dobór i integracja modeli LLM oraz narzędzi do budowy chatbotów, asystentów AI, rozwiązań RAG i automatyzacji procesów.
 Projektowanie integracji AI z istniejącymi systemami i źródłami danych banku.
 Ocena wydajności, bezpieczeństwa, skalowalności i kosztów proponowanych rozwiązań.
 Współpraca z biznesem i realizacja inicjatyw 
 Wspieranie jednostek biznesowych w identyfikowaniu i definiowaniu zastosowań AI.
 Ocena wykonalności technicznej, potencjalnej wartości oraz ryzyk inicjatyw AI.
 Koordynowanie realizacji Proof of Concept (PoC), pilotaży i wdrożeń produkcyjnych.
 Współpraca z właścicielami biznesowymi przy definiowaniu kryteriów sukcesu i mierzeniu efektów wdrożeń.
 Budowanie standardów i dobrych praktyk umożliwiających efektywne wykorzystanie AI przez pracowników banku.
 Bezpieczeństwo, governance i zgodność regulacyjna 
 Współpraca z Compliance, Risk, IT Security i DPO przy tworzeniu oraz wdrażaniu zasad AI Governance.
 Zapewnianie uwzględnienia wymagań AI Act, DORA, RODO, regulacji bankowych i polityk wewnętrznych w projektowanych rozwiązaniach.
 Wspieranie klasyfikacji ryzyka zastosowań AI oraz definiowania wymagań bezpieczeństwa i kontroli.
 Udział w opracowaniu standardów dotyczących zarządzania modelami AI, ich testowania, monitorowania i cyklu życia.
 Wspieranie bezpiecznego przechodzenia od eksperymentów i PoC do rozwiązań produkcyjnych.
 Współpraca z korporacją i partnerami technologicznymi 
 Współpraca z korporacyjnymi zespołami odpowiedzialnymi za AI, architekturę i bezpieczeństwo.
 Identyfikowanie możliwości wykorzystania dostępnych w korporacji platform, modeli, narzędzi, kompetencji i dobrych praktyk.
 Ocena możliwości zastosowania rozwiązań korporacyjnych w banku, z uwzględnieniem lokalnych wymagań regulacyjnych.
 Współpraca z dostawcami technologii i partnerami zewnętrznymi.
 Nasze oczekiwania 
 Doświadczenie i kompetencje 
 Minimum 5 lat doświadczenia w IT, w tym praktyczne doświadczenie w projektowaniu lub wdrażaniu rozwiązań AI, ML lub Generative AI.
 Bardzo dobra znajomość architektury rozwiązań opartych na LLM, w tym RAG, embeddings, vector databases, AI agents oraz integracji API.

 Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań w środowiskach on-premise, kontenerowych lub hybrydowych.
 Znajomość zagadnień bezpieczeństwa danych, kontroli dostępu, integracji systemowych oraz architektury aplikacyjnej.
 Umiejętność przełożenia potrzeb biznesowych na rozwiązania technologiczne i koordynowania ich realizacji.
 Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu PoC i projektów technologicznych od koncepcji do wdrożenia.
 Umiejętność komunikacji i współpracy z biznesem, zespołami IT oraz kadrą zarządzającą.
 Bardzo dobra znajomość języka polskiego i angielskiego (w mowie i piśmie).

items.desc:
​
 This is a fixed-term appointment with an initial duration of 4 years. Depending upon performance and organisational needs, the appointment may be extended up to a possible maximum duration of 8 years. 
 Location 
ESTEC, Noordwijk, Netherlands 
 Description 
 Earth Observation (EO) Future Missions Optical Payload and Performance Engineer in the Optical Instruments Section, Future Missions and Instruments Division, Future Missions and Architecture Department, Directorate of Earth Observation Programmes.
 Reporting to the Head of the Optical Instruments Section, you will be responsible for the end-to-end definition, engineering, technology breadboarding and pre-development of optical payload systems for future EO missions, both for research missions (e.g. Earth Explorers, Missions of Opportunity and Scout missions) and operational missions (e.g. Copernicus and meteorology missions).
 The above payloads include EO multispectral imagers, imaging spectrometers and Fourier-Transform spectrometers, as well as active laser payloads for Earth surface and atmosphere sensing, covering the full wavelength range from ultraviolet to far infrared. 
 You will be involved in the study and pre-development of one or several of them. You will be appointed optical instrument lead for the preparation of future EO missions in Phase 0 or Phase A.
 Duties 
 Your duties will include:
 identifying and investigating new Earth observation principles, techniques and technologies in coordination with staff in this Department, in the Science, Applications and Climate Department and the Directorate of Technology, Engineering and Quality, including interfacing with research and technical groups, in particular with relevant Science Mission Advisory Groups;
 maintaining knowledge of relevant technology status and instrument development programmes inside and outside ESA, including developments undertaken by other space agencies in Europe and worldwide, as well as commercial initiatives such as those driven under NewSpace, in close collaboration with the Division’s Technology Coordination and Frequency Management Section;
 defining and assessing the performance and technological readiness of new EO optical payload systems in close collaboration with the staff of the Division’s Mission and System Studies Section, taking into account mission, system and programmatic objectives and requirements;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing industrial contracts for the study and risk-retirement of new optical payload systems, according to the agreed activity plan;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing risk-retirement activities through technology breadboarding and pre-development of optical payload systems for future EO missions (including Earth Explorer, Copernicus, meteorology) up to their completion, coordinating instrument pre-development activities with project teams when required;
 defining, negotiating, initiating and managing the development of ground-based or airborne instrument models, according to the maturity of the concepts and performance-demonstration needs;
 providing expert support to the Division for the optical payload aspects of missions undergoing evaluation or preparation, including for the evaluation of mission proposals, optical payload system support for Phase 0/A and mission architecture studies, and contributing to the preparation of technical and scientific dossiers on new EO research and operational missions;
 being the optical instrument lead for future EO missions in Phase 0 or Phase A;
 supporting InCubed proposal evaluation and ensuring the technical management of activities when related to EO optical payloads and technologies;
 defining, developing, maintaining and upgrading optical payload systems dimensioning and mission performance models and tools to assess new instrument concepts.
 Technical competencies 
 Knowledge of technical domains and related R&D space industry trends
 Knowledge of innovation-related processes
 Experience in spaceborne optical instrument development
 Experience in optical Earth observation mission and instrument performance modelling
 Knowledge of optical remote sensing techniques and understanding of Earth observation user needs

 Result Orientation
Operational Efficiency
Fostering Cooperation
Relationship Management
Continuous Improvement
Forward Thinking
For more information, please refer to ESA Core Behavioural Competencies guidebook 
 Education and professional experience 
 A master's degree in engineering or physics is required for this post together with five years of relevant professional experience.
 Additional requirements 
 At least five years of relevant experience in EO optical instrument preparation and/or development is required.
 Experience in the development of mission and instrument performance analysis models/tools for EO optical instruments is required.
 Experience in working in a team or project environment is required.

Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes Produit, Data, IT, Sécurité et DevOps afin de transformer les besoins métiers en solutions IA robustes et industrialisées. Missions principalesConcevoir et développer des solutions d?IA générative et agentique adaptées aux besoins métiers. Intégrer, configurer et optimiser des LLM, notamment Mistral. Concevoir et développer des agents autonomes et des systèmes multi-agents. Mettre en ?uvre des workflows et pipelines d?orchestration à l?aide de frameworks spécialisés. Optimiser les performances des modèles et des prompts : prompt engineering, few-shot learning et fine-tuning. Développer des mécanismes d?évaluation, de monitoring et de détection des hallucinations et des biais. Industrialiser et déployer les solutions IA en production en collaboration avec les équipes DevOps/MLOps. Mettre en place des pipelines CI/CD et contribuer à la conteneurisation et à l?orchestration des applications IA. Garantir la sécurité, la traçabilité et la conformité des solutions développées. Assurer la documentation technique et le suivi des évolutions des solutions mises en production. Compétences techniques requisesIA générative & LLM Maîtrise des LLM, notamment Mistral. Prompt engineering, few-shot learning et fine-tuning. Évaluation et optimisation des performances des modèles. IA agentique & orchestration Conception d?agents autonomes et d?architectures multi-agents. Maîtrise d?au moins un framework d?orchestration : LangChain, AutoGen ou CrewAI. Développement Excellente maîtrise de Python. Capacité à développer des pipelines techniques robustes et maintenables. MLOps / DevOps CI/CD, Docker et Kubernetes. Déploiement, supervision et monitoring de solutions IA en production. Expérience de l?industrialisation de modèles ou d?applications basés sur des LLM. Sécurité & conformité Sensibilité aux enjeux de sécurité et de gouvernance de l?IA. Connaissance du RGPD, de l?AI Act et des mécanismes de maîtrise des risques liés à l?IA. Profil candidat: Profil recherchéExpérience confirmée en développement de solutions d?IA générative et/ou agentique. Expérience concrète dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions basées sur des LLM. Une expérience en environnement bancaire ou dans un secteur fortement réglementé constitue un avantage. Anglais professionnel indispensable, pour évoluer dans un environnement potentiellement international. Autonomie, rigueur, esprit d?analyse et capacité à collaborer avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires. Objectif de la missionContribuer à la réalisation et à l?industrialisation de solutions d?IA générative et agentique à forte valeur ajoutée, sécurisées et adaptées aux exigences d?un environnement bancaire. Recrutement urgent : 5 consultants recherchés d?ici fin 2026.

items.desc: The University of Vienna is a community of almost 11,000 individuals, including approximately 7,700 academic staff members, who passionately pursue answers to the profound questions that shape our future. They represent individuals driven by curiosity and a relentless pursuit of excellence. With us, they find the space to try things out and unfold their potential. Are you inspired by their passion and determination? We are currently seeking a/an University assistant predoctoral 51 Faculty of Physics Job vacancy starting: 12/01/2026 | Working hours: 30.00 | Classification CBA: §48 VwGr. B1 Grundstufe (praedoc) Limited contract until: 11/30/2030 Job ID: 6265 Explore and teach at the University of Vienna, where more than 7,500 academics thrive on curiosity in continuous exploration and help us better understand our world. Does this sound like you? Then join our accomplished team! The Group Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics at the University of Vienna searches excellent candidates for the subgroup Low Dimensional Quantum Solids. The Group of Electronic Properties of Materials at the Faculty of Physics is a committed team of scientists with the main research focus on low dimensional quantum solids. We dedicate a great part of our research to the growth and spectroscopic analysis of pristine and doped carbon-based molecular structures to unravel their underlying electron transport and optical properties. We aim at understanding which parameters control their unique properties to subsequently engineer them to access their full application potential. Your personal sphere of influence: Your job will be focused on tailoring the electronic and optical properties of 1D and 2D nanostructures via advanced filling reactions and intercalation. Especially, the control of basic correlation effects, doping of interfaces and the concomitant understanding of their influence on charge transfer and hybridization are crucial. The group offers a vibrant and intellectually stimulating research environment where curiosity and scientific excellence thrive. You'll be part of a dynamic, collaborative community of researchers who are passionate about pushing the boundaries of materials science. Our atmosphere balances ambitious research goals with mutual support and collegiality, fostering both independent thinking and teamwork. We offer an active research culture with regular seminars, group discussions and knowledge exchange that keep you connected to the latest developments. We all value open communication, creative problem-solving, and a healthy work-life balance, creating an environment where you can grow both professionally and personally. International collaboration is at the heart of what we do, providing you with opportunities to build a global network while working alongside diverse, talented colleagues who share your enthusiasm for cutting-edge science. You will be associated to the MORE-TEM project and OVID laboratory as well as to the MATE platform. See more information on more-tem.univie.ac.at and ovid.univie.ac.at. Within these projects our group focuses strongly on the development of new techniques combining high spatial, energy & momentum (q)-resolution for nanospectroscopic analysis at all energy scales. This enables us to investigate dispersion and lifetime of primary excitations in nanomaterials such as 2D heterostructures and 1D nanotubes. This facilitates the control of quantum phases, like charge-density waves and superconductivity, to engineer new materials for energy (e.g. batteries, (opto-)electronic devices). Your future tasks: You actively participate in research, teaching & administration, which means: You will present your research plan to the faculty and complete a dissertation agreement within 12-18 months. This will be reviewed and adapted on an annual basis . You will work on and advance your dissertation and towards its completion in time toward successful completion with dedicated mentorship. We expect a large degree of independence paired with a high level of social awareness as the goal will only be achieved in a team. You will contribute to teaching activities (lab courses, exercise classes) both in teams and independently within the provisions of the collective bargaining agreement . You will fill some administrative tasks, contributing to the success and self-organization of the group for research, teaching and administration . You will continuously stay informed about the state of the art in your field . You will contribute to outreach by publications, conference presentations and public activities . You will engage with the broader scientific community through conferences and collaborative events . This is part of your personality: You must have a master's degree or diploma in physics, physical chemistry, materials science or a related field . You must have experience either in inelastic electron scattering (EELS), TEM or optical and Raman spectroscopy . You must have …

items.desc: We are looking for one or two highly motivated researcher interested in transcription regulation at the DNRF Center of Excellence, Center for Gene Expression (CGEN), within the Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM), at the Faculty of Health and Medical Sciences, University of Copenhagen. Starting date: 1st of January 2027 or after agreement. Information on the department can be found at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Our research CGEN is an interdisciplinary research center consisting of 6 research groups located in modern laboratories in the Mærsk Tower at the Panum Institute. Our mission is to use a cutting-edge ensemble of genetic, cell biological, biochemical, organismal, and modern ‘omic’-approaches to achieve a comprehensive understanding of the process of gene expression. CGEN performs ground-breaking research in a collaborative and ambitious environment, where young researchers are offered the best conditions to engage in bold and imaginative research. CGEN is also a center of learning, where PhDs and postdocs receive comprehensive insights in the cellular processes underlying gene expression, as well as a clear view of their medical importance and potential for a future research career. Information on CGEN and its individual groups can be found at: https://cgen.ku.dk/ and on ICMM at: https://icmm.ku.dk/english/ Your job The researcher’s responsibilities will primarily consist of: research, including publication/academic dissemination duties research-based teaching and mentorship, primarily in a laboratory setting. The project will be decided in consultation with the selected candidate(s) in accordance with ongoing research programmes within the individual groups. Broadly projects are focused on understanding the various aspects of the process of gene expression, ranging from the mechanisms of 3D chromatin organisation to transcription, mRNA processing, translation, and protein turnover. CGEN addresses fundamental questions in this broad field at the leading edge of science and aims to dramatically expand our knowledge of the processes, signals and factors allowing a gene to be transcribed while integrating with protein synthesis and protein turnover, so that the overall integrity of gene expression is maintained. Profile Six overall criteria apply for researcher appointments at the University of Copenhagen. The six criteria (research, teaching, societal impact, organisational contribution, external funding, and leadership) are considered a framework for the overall assessment of candidates. Find information about each criterion here: https://employment.ku.dk/faculty/criteria-for-recognising-merit. Furthermore, we are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following skills and experience: Essential experience and skills: You have a PhD in life science Research qualifications at the level that can be achieved by satisfactorily completing a period of employment as a postdoc but may also be obtained in other ways. Research-based teaching or mentorship. You are highly experienced in either biochemistry, molecular cell biology, genome-wide analysis, or quantitative imaging in mammalian cells You have previous experience within the field of transcription and/or co-transcriptional processing, ideally with a focus on RNAPII regulation You possess a high degree of independence, motivation, attention to detail and proactiveness. You have excellent time-management, self-organisation and teamwork skills We value a problem-solving mindset, strong communication skills, and a collaborative spirit. Desirable experience and skills: Experience with CRISPR/Cas9 genome editing and/or screening approaches Experience with techniques to profile nascent transcription, RNAPII occupancy, ribosome footprinting, etc. Experience with proteomics to characterise RNAPII elongation complexes The working language of the department is English and, consequently, the successful applicant must possess excellent skills in written and spoken English. An ability to communicate in Danish is preferable. Place of employment The place of employment is at the Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine, Panum, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories located in the Mærsk tower with access to state-of-the-art facilities for cell engineering, next-generation sequencing, flow cytometry, and mass spectrometry. Scientific environment The Department of Cellular and Molecular Medicine (ICMM) offers an ambitious scientific environment, with many different nationalities represented. ICMM aims to produce research with high international impact focusing on the functional cell, its genetic components and molecular cellular mechanisms in a medical context. Launched in 2023, INFINIT is a fast-growing fintech scale-up operating in multiple countries across Europe and Americas. At INFINIT we are on a mission to reshape the future of SMEs with AI at the forefront. Our all-in-one operating system has banking at its core, and empowers small business owners and their teams to seamlessly manage and optimize every aspect of their business with AI agents. By focussing on specific industries, INFINIT delivers tailored, high-value solutions, while building innovative AI products to further unlock significant growth opportunities for our customers. INFINIT operates globally, with ambitions to further expand its footprint to redefine the fintech landscape for SMEs worldwide. Join us on the INFINIT journey as we revolutionise the SME economy and drive meaningful impact through innovation The Role We are hiring a Software Engineer (B2B Lending & Payments) to take ownership of the financial infrastructure that powers how our clients finance their assets through INFINIT. We believe the most resilient lending and payment systems are built by engineers who operate at the intersection of deep technical mastery, genuine product judgment, and direct proximity to the client’s financing workflow. Second, ensuring that every payment executed throughout the loan lifecycle (interest accruals, supplier disbursements, reimbursement) is processed correctly, securely, and without exception. You will be the person the rest of the team pings when something in this domain breaks. What do you need to be successful in this role? Expert C# & .NET Engineering, mastery of the .NET ecosystem with a focus on building high-performance, distributed backend systems. You have a proven track record of shipping scalable, production-grade architectures where technical clarity and long-term maintainability are the default. Core banking & ledger logic , a strong professional background in regulated financial environments. You understand the mechanics of ledgers, loan origination, and payment execution and the cost of getting any of it wrong. Mission-critical ownership: Demonstrated ability to own features end-to-end. You don't just "write code"; you analyze customer financing workflows, define rigorous technical requirements, and take full accountability for the reliability of every transaction you process. Highly effective stakeholder communication , capable of seamlessly translating deep technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders (customers, product managers) and clearly translating business objectives into prioritized engineering tasks. Practical experience leveraging modern developer tools (such as agentic coding or advanced automation techniques) to achieve significantly accelerated development velocity while rigorously upholding code quality standards. Inspiring Mission : We are dedicated to revolutionizing business financing and making a positive impact on the European economy. Your work at INFINIT will have a lasting effect on businesses and communities. items.desc: Who we are: Sardine is the leading agentic risk platform for fighting financial crime. Our integrated solution unifies data across risk teams to help organizations stop fraud in real time, prevent AI-driven attacks, and automate fraud and AML operations. Sardine’s platform is strengthened by one of the fastest-growing fraud consortiums in the market, spanning more than 6 billion profiled devices, 800 million consumers, and 3 million businesses worldwide. Leading companies including FIS, GoDaddy, Intuit, Edward Jones, ZoomInfo, and Checkout.com rely on Sardine to secure and grow trust in their products. Our culture: We hire talented, self-motivated individuals with extreme ownership and high growth orientation. We value performance and not hours worked. We believe you shouldn't have to miss your family dinner, your kid's school play, friends get-together, or doctor's appointments for the sake of adhering to an arbitrary work schedule. We're a remote-first team spread across time zones, so no office to report to - work from wherever helps you do your best work. Just a couple of things to keep in mind: pay is based on where you're located, and you'll need to keep a home base in the country you're hired in. So while we love the "coffee shop today, mountains tomorrow" life, this isn't a passport-optional, work-from-anywhere-on-Earth kind of remote - think flexible within your country, not borderless. Location: Remote - Germany About the role: As a Full Stack Engineer at Sardine, you will bridge the gap between complex technical backend systems and user-friendly interfaces to help us stop fraud in its tracks. This is a dynamic, high-impact role. On average, you will be working 60% on backend development and 40% on frontend development but are willing to help out wherever is needed. You will build out data-intensive applications, including advanced graph systems used to uncover complex fraud rings. You will own features end-to-end at a massive scale, ultimately empowering fraud analysts to uncover and investigate suspicious transactions faster than ever before. What you’ll be doing: Own features end-to-end: Drive the product lifecycle from determining the initial problem space and user needs, to technical modeling, UX execution, and iterative improvements based on vague requirements. Translate complexity to usability: Build out complex technical systems into intuitive, user-friendly interfaces. Build fraud-fighting tools: Develop and optimize advanced graph systems to visualize fraud rings, and build performant search tools that help analysts rapidly identify suspicious transactions. Collaborate cross-functionally: Work tightly with Design, Data, Product, and Account Management teams to align engineering output with business and user needs. Ensure system health: Proactively diagnose, triage, and resolve bugs while writing highly efficient and performant code. What you’ll need: Core technical stack: Extensive experience writing efficient, production-ready code in TypeScript, Node.js, React, Go and other server programming languages. Scale and data expertise: Proven experience working with data-intensive applications, complex workflows, and big data at scale. Pipeline proficiency: Deep background in technical data modeling and building robust production data pipelines. High-growth adaptability: The ability to thrive, execute, and deliver consistently in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment. Independent execution: A proven track record of taking extreme ownership of ambiguous problems and independently turning them into polished, scalable features. Benefits we offer: Generous compensation in cash and equity Early exercise for all options, including pre-vested Work from anywhere: Remote-first Culture Flexible paid time off and Year-end break Health insurance, dental, and vision coverage for employees and dependents - US and Canada specific 4% matching in 401k / RRSP - US and Canada specific MacBook Pro delivered to your door One-time stipend to set up a home office — desk, chair, screen, etc. Monthly meal stipend Monthly social meet-up stipend Annual health and wellness stipend Annual Learning stipend Join a fast-growing company with world-class professionals from around the world.
