items.desc: The Opportunity From the moment you wake up until you go to bed, chances are that most of the media, ads, apps, websites and online shopping you interact with were touched by an Adobe product. Adobe Experience Platform (AEP) is the backbone that powers these experiences: it helps enterprises such as Verizon, Nike, AT&T and Disney centralize and standardize their customer data, build 360-degree customer profiles, and drive real-time personalized experiences. AEP processes terabytes to petabytes of data and serves billions of requests every day. We are expanding our Compute / Data Distiller team in Bucharest. The team owns two core AEP capabilities: Data Distiller – a SQL engine on top of the AEP data lake that lets customers run interactive, batch and scheduled queries, accelerated queries, templates and alerts, and connect BI tools through the PostgreSQL protocol, to derive datasets, audiences and insights. We are also building AI agents that generate and personalize SQL from natural language. Compute Gateway – the multi-cloud, multi-engine compute layer that orchestrates data processing workloads with policy-based routing and support for long-running applications and jobs. This position is for a key contributor who will help design modern data architectures and highly distributed cloud solutions, and take them all the way to production. What You'll Do Design, build and operate complex features in a large-scale, multi-cloud, microservices-based SaaS product. Own the outcome: lead application, framework and service design efforts, optimizing for quality, testability, scalability and performance. Work on query execution, Spark SQL and query optimization, and the orchestration of compute workloads across multiple engines and clouds. Prototype new approaches and deliver production solutions at scale; research new technologies and keep up with industry trends. Partner with Product Management, Design, Data Science and engineering teams across domains, including our US counterparts on a shared roadmap. Provide guidance in architecture, design and code reviews; mentor teammates and promote good engineering practices and continuous learning. Take part in on-call activities on a follow-the-sun rotation with the rest of the team. Contribute to open-source projects where relevant. What You Need to Succeed B.S. in Computer Science or equivalent engineering degree, and/or 3+ years of relevant experience building software systems. Strong programming skills in Java and/or Scala, with a solid grasp of OOP, functional programming and design patterns. Proven expertise with distributed data processing: Apache Spark (including Spark SQL), Databricks, Delta Lake or equivalent Lakehouse technologies. Good understanding of SQL, query engines and query optimization, table formats and schema evolution. Hands-on experience with performance optimization, large-scale cluster tuning and efficient big data architectures. Experience building scalable, resilient backend services and REST APIs. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS and/or Azure). Demonstrated experience delivering and operating a high-quality SaaS solution: testing, CI/CD, monitoring, infrastructure as code. Experience implementing observability best practices (monitoring, logging, tracing) in distributed systems. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, with an emphasis on using AI coding agents and the agentic ecosystem to boost productivity across the software lifecycle. A problem-solving mindset, able to diagnose root causes, plus a sharp eye for security issues and performance bottlenecks. Commitment to quality in both code and testing. Very good written and verbal communication skills in English. Nice to Have Experience with Kubernetes, Docker and infrastructure tooling (Terraform, ArgoCD). Experience with multiple compute engines or orchestration frameworks (e.g. Ray/Anyscale, Flink, YARN). Python, and experience building LLM-based agents or tools. Experience with Kafka, NoSQL databases (e.g. Cassandra, HBase) or Iceberg. Familiarity with PostgreSQL / JDBC protocols or BI tool integrations. Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Splunk, Prometheus, Grafana or New Relic. Experience with Agile / Scrum. Why Join Us Solve hard distributed-systems problems at petabyte scale for some of the world’s largest brands. Work with cutting-edge technology: Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, Ray and AI agents. Direct impact on the whole Adobe ecosystem, since AEP powers Adobe’s products. A growing team, a shared global roadmap and a follow-the-sun on-call model. About Adobe Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by …

items.desc: About Upsun (formerly Platform.sh) Upsun is the cloud application platform humans and robots love. It is built for today's hybrid teams, where AI agents write and test code and humans focus on solving the problems that really matter. Developers, DevOps engineers, and platform teams use Upsun to build, ship, and scale confidently without wrestling with backend infrastructure. We give you your time back. You get: Predictable performance, even at scale Secure, compliant environments by default Real-time observability and profiling built in Cloning, configuration, and provisioning in seconds AI-ready features that plug directly into your stack The name says it all. "Up" means uptime, reliability, and acceleration. "Sun" reflects our follow-the-sun-support, a 24x7, globally distributed support team keeping the lights on while you rest. Our core belief is that software should power brighter solutions and greater innovation. Upsunners are a remote, global workforce, and we thrive in a multicultural team. We are committed to open source and an open, welcoming environment. Our team spans the globe and the experience spectrum. What's our commonality, our cultural fabric? A curious spirit and a thirst for knowledge; an eagerness for innovative ideas and cultures. We believe we can build anything together in an environment that frees you to do your best work. Our values: We make a positive impact. ✨ We aim for the stars. We care for each other. Impact of a Software Engineer As a Software Engineer at Upsun, you will build and maintain the backend services behind our customers' billing. Billing is your main focus: invoices, taxes, usage reporting, and the integrations that connect our platform to the commercial systems behind it. These systems handle tens of millions in revenue each year across multiple products, entities, and currencies. Accuracy matters, and your work reaches customers directly. You will own components in this space and act as a key link between engineering, Finance, and Product. Every new offering Upsun launches needs a billing component, and you will help build it. Over time, you will become a long-term owner of the systems you build. You may also contribute to adjacent services such as project provisioning and account management. What to expect Build billing integrations: Develop and maintain backend services and API integrations in Go that connect our platform to external billing systems. Ship usage-based billing features: Build features such as usage tracking, estimates, usage alerts, and invoicing. Work with other engineering teams to understand how new features are measured and charged. Complete billing migrations: Help finish moving billing to external systems while keeping data accurate and customers unaffected. Troubleshoot and fix issues: Investigate and resolve billing issues raised by Support and Finance, from incorrect usage data to failed integrations. Protect customers and data: Contribute to anti-abuse measures and keep security in mind when working with sensitive customer and payment data. Work across teams: Partner with Finance, Product, and Support, and communicate clearly and asynchronously with a team spread across Europe, North America, and India. Build with good practice: Write tested, well-documented code, take part in pair programming and code review, and use AI-assisted tools thoughtfully in your workflow. What you bring Go development experience: 3+ years of professional backend development in Go. Relational databases: Hands-on experience working with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL/MariaDB. Third-party API integration: Experience integrating with external REST APIs, including handling errors, retries, and rate limits. Care for accuracy: Attention to detail in systems where a mistake can reach a customer's invoice, and an interest in concepts like idempotency and consistency in distributed systems. Testing and reliability: A habit of writing unit and integration tests, including for failure paths, and thinking about how your code behaves in production. Security awareness: An understanding of common security vulnerabilities and how to avoid them in backend services. Interest in billing: You enjoy working on billing and financial systems and want to make them your focus. Clear async communication: You write clearly and collaborate well across teams and time zones. Where we hire At Upsun, remote work isn't just a trend - it's our foundation. The freedom of remote work with the support of a diverse, global team has been our successful model for over a decade. Our culture celebrates flexibility and collaboration, and while we have team members in over 30 countries around the globe, we are currently focused on hiring for this role in Canada, France, Germany, Spain, and the United Kingdom . Although we're unable to provide visa sponsorship at this time, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates who are legally authorized to work in these countries. How …

items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role This is not a lab technician position. This is a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the entire experimental pipeline. The production team runs 150+ experiments per month across expression, BLI, SPR, thermostability, and enzyme activity. When something goes wrong (failed expression, anomalous binding data, instrument artifacts), this person diagnoses the root cause and fixes it. As the assay and instrumentation portfolio expands, this person translates new R&D methods into production-ready protocols, builds robust methods that junior technicians can execute reliably, and designs comprehensive controls that enable automated QC and data processing. This is a player-coach position. You will still run experiments personally, especially as you integrate into the lab, but you will also elevate the whole team's capabilities. What You'll Do Troubleshoot production failures across the full pipeline. A batch of proteins isn't expressing: is it the construct design, the expression system, or the media? BLI sensorgrams look noisy: is it the sensor tips, the sample prep, or an instrument issue? You figure it out, fix it, and make the cause easier to identify next time. Develop and document SOPs for new assays as the portfolio expands. Take methods from the R&D team and make them production-ready: robust, reproducible, and executable by junior technicians without hand-holding. Mentor a growing production team. Set quality standards, review data, train new hires, and build a culture where people flag problems early instead of hiding them. Work at the intersection of biology, automation, and QC. Collaborate with researchers, laboratory technicians, and automation engineers on protocol optimization for work cells, and with software on LabOS protocol integration. Own the relationship between assay science and throughput. The easy version of every assay doesn't scale, and the scalable version often sacrifices quality. You find the right tradeoff. What We're Looking For Deep hands-on expertise in protein production: expression (E. coli, mammalian, cell-free), purification (IMAC, SEC), and biophysical characterization (BLI and SPR at minimum). This isn't negotiable. You need to have done this work yourself, at volume. PhD in protein biochemistry, biophysics, or structural biology, plus 3-5 years in a production or development role at a CRO, foundry, or high-throughput lab. Academic postdocs count if the work was high-throughput and production-oriented. Experience with high-throughput workflows. You're comfortable with 96-well plates and liquid handlers, not just single-column purifications. You've optimized protocols for scale, not just for one perfect result. Mentorship mindset. You've managed or trained junior scientists before. You enjoy teaching and get satisfaction from watching your team grow. Troubleshooting instinct. When data looks wrong, your first impulse is to understand why, not to rerun the experiment and hope it works. Quality-obsessed but pragmatic. You care deeply about data quality, but you also understand that production has deadlines and sometimes "good enough" is the right call. Bridge between R&D and production. You can speak both languages: the exploratory mindset of research and the reproducibility demands of production. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP We review applications on a rolling basis. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

items.desc: We are seeking to appoint a Research Assistant (AI Scientist & Computational Cancer Biology) to join the Nuffield Department of Medicine, University of Oxford, working on an state of the art project funded by Advanced Research & Innovation Agency. Reporting to Dr Lennard Lee, Programme Director, the post holder will serve as a Cancer Vaccine Epitope Discovery & Future mRNA Manufacturing Research Assistant for the UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project. The UK Cancer Vaccine AI Scientist & Supercomputing Project is a government-supported national flagship research initiative hosted by the University of Oxford. The project brings together advanced immunology, automated laboratories, sovereign AI supercomputing, and AI Scientists to develop and manufacture safer, more precise and more effective personalised cancer vaccines. Experimental findings are rapidly fed back to the AI scientist, enabling increasingly accurate predictions and accelerating translation of scientific discoveries towards NHS patient benefit. You will provide experimental research support across cancer vaccine epitope discovery and the development of future approaches to personalised mRNA vaccine manufacturing. They will contribute to the experimental validation of AI-predicted cancer vaccine targets using immunological assays and support the development, manufacture and characterisation of experimental mRNA vaccine candidates. They will work closely with immunologists, computational scientists, AI researchers and autonomous laboratory scientists, helping connect AI-led target discovery with experimental validation and vaccine manufacturing. The project has been recognised as one of the UK’s leading strategic research initiatives, having been referenced within both the Government’s AI for Science Strategy and the 10-Year National Cancer Plan. It is supported by major UK research funders and government organisations, including ARIA, the Medical Research Council, UK Research and Innovation, Cancer Research UK and the Department for Science, Innovation and Technology, alongside a consortium of more than 2,500 scientists, clinicians, engineers, patient representatives and technology experts. The successful candidate will join a highly collaborative multidisciplinary team working at the interface of artificial intelligence, computational biology, cancer immunology, robotics, software engineering and clinical research, contributing to research that aims to establish new approaches for the discovery and development of personalised cancer vaccines. You will provide computational research support within the programme, working with large-scale cancer, genomic and immunological datasets and applying established and emerging artificial intelligence approaches to cancer vaccine research. They will use frontier and open-source AI models and agentic coding tools, contribute to the development and evaluation of AI models and scientific agents, and support computational analyses alongside cancer biologists, immunologists and AI researchers. The post holder will manage their own research and administrative activities within agreed guidelines and contribute to project planning, data analysis, research outputs and collaborative research. It is essential that you hold a degree in immunology, biomedical sciences, molecular biology, biochemistry, cancer biology or a related discipline and possess sufficient specialist knowledge of immunology, cancer biology, molecular biology or a related discipline to work within established research programmes. With experience analysing biological, genomic, biomedical or other large-scale research datasets using computational methods, you will have the ability to manage own research, laboratory and administrative activities within agreed guidelines. Practical experience of laboratory research, with experience in one or more relevant techniques such as mammalian cell culture, immunological assays, flow cytometry, fluorescence microscopy, sequencing or molecular biology is also essential. Applications for this vacancy should be made online and you will need to upload a supporting statement and CV. Your supporting statement must explain how you meet each of the selection criteria for the post using examples of your skills and experience. Please restrict your documentation to your CV and supporting statement only. Any other documents will be requested at a later date. This position is offered full time on a fixed term contract until 30 September 2030 and is funded by ARIA. Only applications received before 12 midday on Monday, 26 October 2026 will be considered. items.desc: About the Role: Grade Level (for internal use): 10 The Team: The Chemical Research & Analytics team is growing as it builds market intelligence and insight across the commodity chemicals sector. This team is in constant dialogue with the industry to understand market dynamics and create market outlooks for key petrochemicals. The team also connects with groups across S&P Global to understand linkages across the industry, from upstream energy cost impacts to policy and sustainability influences as well as macroeconomic drivers impacting demand. We interact with all major stakeholders including industry associations, producers, consumers, traders, transportation providers and financial institutions engaging with individuals up to and including board level executives. The Chemical Economics Handbook (CEH) team delivers comprehensive market intelligence on commodity and specialty chemicals. The team produces structured reports that integrate asset-level data, supply and demand balances, trade flows, and price analysis to provide a consistent and forward-looking view of industry fundamentals. CEH outputs are used by clients across the value chain—producers, consumers, and investors—to support strategic planning, investment decisions, benchmarking, and market monitoring. The Impact: This role will support the regional and global Methanol & Derivatives team in generating chemical market intelligence. There is a short and long-term cadence of market coverage and activities which will include: Analysis of chemical value chain market trends Collating industry statistics and internal data to provide market insights Regular update of supply/demand balances, trade flows, operating schedules and price forecasts Research into emerging markets, plants and technologies Modelling and supporting the transformation of data This role will also support the CEH commodity team, managing the timely, end‑to‑end delivery of comprehensive industry reports. The role involves developing in-depth chemical market reports for the Chemical Economics Handbook (CEH) and related services, combining rigorous research with structured analytical frameworks. The analyst is responsible for building independent market assessments based on both primary and secondary research, while actively liaising with internal experts to ensure robust and well-informed conclusions. Key responsibilities include analyzing supply–demand balances, evaluating market dynamics and industry trends, and assessing macroeconomic and sector-specific drivers to produce forward-looking, insight-driven assessments. What’s in it for you : This person will join a global, dynamic and internationally-orientated research team of established individuals with varied industrial experience. The analyst role will support the continued building of chemical expertise which will provide exposure to a wide range of petrochemical products, markets, technologies and industries. The role provides the opportunity to work alongside other skilled analysts, helping to form a consistent and comprehensive view of the global chemical markets. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to improve their analytical skills and knowledge by interacting with other commodities teams, and groups within the wider S&P Global organization. The successful candidate joins at a time of unprecedented change within the industry, with geopolitics, climate policies and volatile energy markets gaining ever-increasing importance in reporting and decision-making. The role provides opportunity to be at the forefront of this fast-changing landscape and help influence the way the industry navigates through these macro trends. This role comes at a time when the team is looking to leverage S&P Global’s wider expertise and experience in emerging technologies such as Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. The right candidate will be able to gain exposure to this, and influence the role that these technologies play in revolutionising the ways that we gather and deliver market intelligence. items.desc: About Winton Winton is a research-based investment management company with a specialist focus on statistical and mathematical inference in financial markets. The firm researches and trades quantitative investment strategies, which are implemented systematically via thousands of securities, spanning the world's major liquid asset classes. Founded in 1997 by David Harding, Winton today manages assets for some of the world’s largest institutional investors. We employ ambitious professionals who want to work collaboratively at the leading edge of investment management. We seek a highly skilled developer with strong computer science fundamentals to join our Quantitative Platform team. This team is responsible for developing the core platforms that underpin and provide data to the research and trading of our quantitative investment strategies, alongside tools, APIs, libraries, and user interfaces to support this. In this role you will work closely with our research and other technology teams to deliver high impact projects that improve our ability to predict and trade movements in global financial markets. Our Technology Operating in a cloud-first environment, we predominantly write our backend systems in C# but otherwise make pragmatic choices for each scenario. This often means Python with C++ employed in performance-sensitive cases. Our applications are written with containerisation in mind from the outset and deployed as a Docker image into Kubernetes on AWS where we can scale on-demand to satisfy burstable workloads. We make extensive use of Kafka for low-latency communication across applications and use a mixture of different technologies for storage, from S3 to relational databases. We utilise GitHub for source control and Jenkins for CI, though with an increasing interest in GitHub Actions. We constantly evaluate our stack to ensure we’re using the most appropriate technologies for the needs of our business and the efficient delivery of those requirements. Your responsibilities will include: Build and maintain a world-class platform that enables storage, transformation, and testing of data at scale by leveraging the latest open-source software, cloud, and distributed computing technologies. Gain a deep understanding of the requirements of our research teams to deliver business-critical functionality in a timely-manner. Collaborate with the team through active contribution in code reviews, knowledge-sharing, and design discussions. Write and maintain good quality, well-tested code across services, data storage and UI layers. What we're Looking For: A Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Physics or equivalent technical field. 2+ years of professional software development experience, including C#, Python or C++ Comfortable using agentic AI coding tools such as Claude Code and are genuinely keen to use them as a natural part of daily work Collaborative nature and ability to work in a team e.g., partnering with portfolio managers, quantitative researchers, and other technologists. Strong interest in keeping abreast of latest technologies and a measured approach for adopting them. Comfortable with problem solving across multiple technologies and business domains. What would Be Useful: Experience engineering systems for the cloud-based storage and processing of large datasets or using frameworks such as Spark and open standards like Parquet and Arrow. Experience working with other cloud and related technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes. Experience working as a software developer in the quantitative hedge fund space. Experience building web applications using front-end frameworks such as Angular. Equal Opportunity Workplace We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics.

Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin. 
 Part of something bigger 
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal.

items.desc: About the job CIBOS Innovation is looking for a hands-on AI / LLM Engineer to design, build, and ship production agentic AI systems — from architecture through deployment to operational tuning. You'll work across CIBOS's commercial products and EU-funded R&D projects, building LLM agents and retrieval systems that solve real business problems for real users, not just demos. This role suits someone who wants to own AI features end-to-end: design the agent, wire it into live APIs and data stores, ship it to production, and keep tuning it once it's live. Responsibilities • Design, build, and deploy LLM-based agents (e.g. LangGraph, ReAct-style tool-calling) that interact with live APIs, databases, and business systems • Build and maintain RAG and retrieval pipelines — vector embeddings, semantic search, similarity-based deduplication — for tasks like knowledge retrieval, document processing, and inbound-request triage • Design evaluation frameworks and deterministic scoring for agentic AI behavior, to benchmark and continuously improve system quality • Own AI features end-to-end: architecture, backend integration (APIs, SQL, async pipelines), deployment, and post-launch tuning • Integrate AI components into existing product and client systems (REST/SOAP APIs, SQL backing stores, message queues) • Collaborate with the product and engineering team to scope, prioritize, and ship AI-driven features across CIBOS's product lines and client projects • Produce clear technical documentation (specs, architecture notes) to communicate AI system design to technical and non-technical stakeholders • Stay current on emerging LLM/agentic-AI techniques and tooling, and bring relevant ones into CIBOS's stack Required Skills • BSc or Master's in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field • Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM agents or agentic workflows (tool-calling, ReAct-style patterns, frameworks such as LangGraph or equivalent) • Practical experience with RAG, vector embeddings, and similarity/retrieval systems • Experience working with LLM APIs (OpenAI or similar) and/or open-source LLMs • Solid backend engineering skills: Python, API development (e.g. FastAPI), SQL • Comfortable owning a feature from design through production deployment and iteration • Experience with Git and standard version control workflows • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to work independently and in a small, fast-moving team • Fluent in Greek and English, with strong technical communication skills Nice-to-have Skills • Experience designing evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for agentic AI systems • Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers for connecting agents to external tools and data sources • Familiarity with classical ML/forecasting (e.g. LightGBM, scikit-learn, TensorFlow) for hybrid AI + ML product features • Experience with OCR / document AI and human-in-the-loop review workflows • Knowledge of distributed/streaming technologies (Kafka, async processing) • Container experience (Docker; Kubernetes a plus) • Prior exposure to EU-funded research projects (Horizon Europe / H2020) or working in a research-adjacent environment • Modern software development practices (Agile/Scrum) About us CIBOS Innovation IKE is a deep-tech spin-off of ICCS/NTUA, founded in 2020 and based in Athens, Greece. We work across AI/ML, AR/VR, digital platforms, and edge computing, combining EU-funded research (Horizon Europe, H2020) with real commercial deployments — from AR/voice-guided warehouse picking to LLM-based digital assistants and IoT/digital-twin platforms. We're a small, senior team that takes products from research prototype to production, and we work closely with major research institutions and industry partners across Europe. What we offer • Competitive compensation [range 30-40K gross depending on skills and past experience in related fields] • Hybrid work arrangement, Athens-based • Laptop and standard equipment provided • Opportunity to own AI features end-to-end, from architecture to production • Exposure to both cutting-edge EU-funded research and real commercial deployments • Small, senior team — direct ownership and fast decision-making • A clear path of progression tailored to your skills and interests

Waarom jij het verschil maakt Jij bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI kan, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar wat het daadwerkelijk oplevert. Samen met je team ontwikkel je betrouwbare en bruikbare AI-oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkelt toepassingen met behulp van Python, large language models (LLMs) en eigen databronnen. Daarbij werk je aan moderne oplossingen op het gebied van Generative AI, zoals RAG-toepassingen, én aan Agentic AI-oplossingen waarbij agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders. Je test antwoorden en agentgedrag, onderzoekt fouten en hallucinaties en houdt rekening met aspecten als privacy, beveiliging, prestaties en kosten. items.desc: Stellen-ID: 155025 Bei HORNBACH bauen wir nicht nur Baumärkte, sondern erschaffen das digitale Fundament für das Heimwerken von morgen. In unserem AI Platform Team entwickeln wir eine zentrale KI-Plattform, die modernste Sprachmodelle (LLMs) mit unseren internen Daten und Prozessen verbindet. Wir suchen keine Theoretiker, sondern Macher, die Lust haben, in einem explorativen Umfeld innovative Lösungen zu bauen, die für unsere Kunden und Mitarbeiter einen echten Mehrwert schaffen. Das sind Deine Aufgaben: KI-Plattform skalieren: Du entwickelst unsere interne KI-Infrastruktur weiter und sorgst dafür, dass modernste Technologien nahtlos in die HORNBACH-Systemlandschaft integriert werden. Cloud Native Development: Du designst und implementierst robuste Microservices in Python, die nativ in der Google Cloud Platform (GCP) laufen. Intelligente Integration: Du schaffst die Verbindung zwischen LLMs und unseren Kernsystemen. Explorative Entwicklung: Du experimentierst mit neuen Ansätzen und Agentic Workflows, um komplexe Aufgabenstellungen automatisiert zu lösen. Agiles Arbeiten: Du arbeitest in schnellen Lernzyklen, baust Prototypen, testest Hypothesen und verbesserst stetig unsere produktiven Lösungen. Dabei bist Du im direkten Austausch mit unseren Stakeholdern. Das bringst Du mit: Tech-Stack: Du bist sattelfest in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python und bringst Erfahrung mit Cloud Native Architekturen (idealerweise GCP) mit. Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure ist ein Plus. KI-Expertise: Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis dafür, wie man LLMs über APIs effizient nutzt und durch kluges Engineering (z.B. RAG, Caching, Skills) in produktive Anwendungen überführt. Mindset: Du bist neugierig, technologieoffen und hast eine Leidenschaft für exploratives Arbeiten. Du liebst es, Dinge zu entwickeln, die vor Dir noch niemand entwickelt hat. Teamgeist: Du schätzt eine offene Feedbackkultur und arbeitest gerne auf Augenhöhe mit Kollegen zusammen, die technologische Exzellenz und menschliche Lockerheit verbinden. Arbeitsweise: Ein eng definiertes Skillset gibt es bei uns nicht – wir setzen auf Dein Potenzial, Deine Wissbegierde und Deinen Drive. Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C1, C2 oder Muttersprache); Englischkenntnisse runden Dein Profil ab.

These teams bring product management, design, and engineering together with the autonomy to move quickly, make decisions, and own outcomes from the earliest prototype through production and scale. This is a software engineering role within a permanent product team. It is not a consulting delivery, data engineering, product management, or forward-deployed engineering role. You Are : You are an exceptional AI-native software engineer who has built and shipped production products across the full stack. You combine strong engineering fundamentals with product judgment, systems thinking, and a high bar for quality. You are comfortable beginning with an ambiguous customer or business problem, shaping the technical approach, and turning it into software that real users rely on. AI is central to both what you build and how you build. You use coding agents and other AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow. You know how to decompose work, provide the right context and constraints, establish tests and evaluations, and review generated output with rigor. You use AI to increase your leverage while retaining full accountability for the architecture, security, reliability, and quality of the product. You are energized by zero-to-one work, small teams, high autonomy, and the opportunity to help define how a new product engineering organization should operate. Move comfortably between prototyping and production engineering, making thoughtful decisions about when to optimize for speed and when to invest for scale, security, and reliability. Build products that perform reliably against complex, real-world industry workflows rather than only in controlled demonstrations. Evaluate model and system behavior rigorously, understand failure modes, and improve the product through evidence. Work in an AI-native engineering model. Use coding agents and AI development tools extensively throughout the engineering lifecycle. Create the context, specifications, tests, development environments, CI pipelines, and evaluation systems that allow agents to produce high-quality work safely and efficiently. Direct multiple streams of agent-assisted work where appropriate, review outputs critically, and remain accountable for everything that reaches production. Set technical direction. Translate ambiguous product opportunities into clear technical approaches and executable plans. Make sound architecture decisions for new product areas and carry those decisions from prototype through production. Balance speed, simplicity, extensibility, security, cost, and operational reliability. Identify where the team should build, buy, integrate, or deliberately defer. items.desc: New Producers for Sustainable Energy (NP4SE) is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to prepare the data for, and test the accuracy of, two AI tools funded by Energy Corps. The role is part-time: about 65 days over 12 months, at a day rate of USD 300–400, depending on experience. You can be based outside the UK - in fact we welcome candidates based in the Global South. Background NP4SE is a charity that supports governments in 25 emerging oil and gas producing countries. With Energy Corps funding, we are building two tools to help small government teams oversee their resources with better information. The AI Advisory Desk draws on 14 years of NP4SE peer exchanges and expert analysis. It is retrieval-based: it answers from a closed, expert-weighted set of documents and does not train a model on them. Answers on high-risk topics go to a human expert before they reach the user. The emissions dashboard helps a national regulator check methane and greenhouse gas data reported by operators. It is cloud-hosted and, once tested, run by the government agency. The Machine Learning Engineer is responsible for the quality of the data going into both tools and for measuring whether their outputs are accurate. Scope of workAI Advisory Desk (about 20 days) • Clean and structure the foundation archive of about 500 documents, including text extraction from scanned files, and tag each with consistent metadata (maturity stage, resource type, discovery phase). • Run the transcription pipeline for practitioner exchanges recorded as audio or video, and check the transcripts before they enter the document set. • Apply the expert-weighting scheme so that senior practitioner material takes precedence in retrieval. • Design and run the accuracy tests: build a set of test questions from historical regulatory scenarios, record results, and review hallucination logs, reporting findings to the Lead Subject Matter Expert. • Agree written accuracy criteria with the Lead Subject Matter Expert for the escalation protocol. • Support the pilot with five partner countries, including logging errors and feedback. Emissions dashboard (about 45 days) • Build and maintain the uniform data coding maps so that operator submissions follow one reporting structure. • Process unstructured field logs and paper records into that structure, with the Technical Data Intern. • Review operator submissions for anomalies and flag them to the regulator's team. • Compare reported emissions against satellite and other open data sources, and agree the data interfaces with the AI Architect without taking part in the build. • Document the data pipeline so that the agency's staff can run it after handover. Across both tools • Keep data handling consistent with NP4SE's confidentiality commitments: no data from one country is visible to another, and no document leaves the closed environment. • Test the tools independently of the people who build them, and report results plainly, including failures, to the Lead Subject Matter Expert. The MLE does not do the strategic impact tracking. That belongs to the MEL Officer, so that performance reporting stays independent of the people building the tools. Profile We are looking for someone who has built and tested retrieval-based AI systems in a practical setting, ideally for a development organisation, a multilateral body or a government. Essential: • Several years of hands-on machine learning or data engineering experience, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems and ways of testing their accuracy. • Experience cleaning messy, mixed-format data: scanned documents, spreadsheets, transcripts. • Python, and comfort with open-source tools such as Dify and Whisper. • Careful about data protection. Has worked with confidential or government data and understands why it must stay in a closed environment. • Able to explain results, including errors, in plain language to non-technical colleagues. • Fluent in English. Able to work remotely with a small team across time zones. Useful: • Familiarity with oil, gas, energy or climate data, including emissions reporting. • Experience working with ministries or regulators in emerging economies. • French or Portuguese, since the dashboard is meant to be replicated in French- and Portuguese-speaking countries. Terms • Time and fee: about 65 days between appointment and September 2027 (about 20 for the Advisory Desk and 45 for the dashboard), at a day rate of USD 300-400 depending on experience. Days are called off by email against deliverables. • Location: remote, with occasional travel only if agreed in advance. • Supervision: the Lead Subject Matter Expert directs and reviews the work. The Executive Director manages the contract. • Engagement: consultancy agreement with NP4SE, including confidentiality terms. • Ownership of work: NP4SE will publish its methodology so that others can replicate it. The agreement will say what that means for code and data. How to apply Send a CV, …

 AI Security Engineer 
 The AI Security Engineer is a technical and consulting role focused on the design, development and production deployment of AI systems, both for client engagements and to support the organization's internal needs. The role complements the AI Security Advisor: where the latter drives strategy, governance and advisory, the AI Security Engineer focuses on execution. They build, ship and maintain the solutions, with clients and internally, embedding security best practices from design onward.
 The role combines a strong appetite for software engineering with curiosity for applied AI (LLMs, agents, RAG, MLOps) and the associated security challenges. A significant share of the activity is dedicated to client engagements: requirements gathering, design, prototyping, development, support to production rollout, and knowledge transfer. In parallel, the AI Security Engineer contributes to the organization's strategic internal initiatives (AI-enabled business tools, agentic automations for security, transverse RAG platforms), which also serve as a learning ground and as a basis for capitalizing on client engagements.

 Client engagements and consulting
 Deliver on client projects that require software engineering and the secure integration of AI components, with a level of autonomy adapted to the profile and to the engagement context.
 Take part in scoping workshops with clients: understanding the business need, translating it into a technical architecture, identifying security and compliance constraints.
 Design, prototype and develop the solutions delivered to clients: LLM integrations, RAG, agents, AI-driven automations, within the framework set by the AI Security Advisor.
 Support the client through to production: industrialization, secure deployment pipelines, knowledge transfer to the client's internal teams.
 Contribute to pre-sales activities: demos, PoCs, technical estimates, technical sections of RFP responses, alongside the sales teams and the AI Security Advisor.
 Represent the organization in front of clients with a strong level of communication, pedagogy and consulting posture.
 Capitalize after each engagement: lessons learned, reusable components, contributions to internal frameworks and standards.
 Development and industrialization of internal AI tools
 AI-enabled business tools : actively contribute to the development and evolution of internal solutions (for example in CRM, due diligence or decision support domains), embedding software quality and security best practices.
 Document processing pipelines : contribute to the development and maintenance of automated document processing tools, ensuring pipeline robustness and the protection of the data being handled.
 Agentic automations for security : develop agentic components for cybersecurity operations (notably SOC use cases), in close collaboration with the Cyber Defense teams and the AI Security Advisor.
 Design and develop internal tools based on RAG, agents and AI-driven automations to support the needs of IT, HR and other departments.
 Industrialize PoCs and PoVs produced by the AI team into robust, maintainable solutions.
 Document, test and maintain the delivered solutions over time.
 Embedding security in AI development
 Apply secure coding and application security best practices in the code produced, both internally and for clients.
 Secure AI deployment pipelines: CI/CD, secrets management, dependency control, API and cloud integrations.
 Implement defense mechanisms suited to AI systems: guardrails, input and output filtering, monitoring, control over the tools accessible to agents.
 Contribute, with the AI Security Advisor, to the operational implementation of reference frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF) within projects.
 Take part in threat modeling and code review activities on AI components, in collaboration with the AI Security Advisor.

 Keep up to date on tools, frameworks and best practices for AI development and the associated application security.
 Develop reusable libraries, scripts and components to accelerate future projects.
 Contribute to internal knowledge sharing: lessons learned, demos, documentation.
 Capitalize on project insights to feed the standards and frameworks driven by the AI Security Advisor.

items.desc: Who We Are Accenture Song is the world's largest tech-powered creative group — a fusion of creativity, technology, intelligence, and experience. Within Song, our practice helps iconic brands reinvent the products, services, and spaces that define their relationship with customers. We work across the full spectrum: from defining product strategy and crafting human-centred digital experiences to engineering the AI-powered platforms and design systems that bring them to life at scale. We are actively shaping what it means to design, build, and deliver AI-native products at enterprise scale, and we are looking for engineers who want to be at the centre of that reinvention. Cloud-Native Engineering & Delivery Scalable Systems: Apply containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures to ship AI-native systems that perform reliably at enterprise scale. Production Discipline: Own CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging. Deploy to production and take responsibility for what you ship. items.desc: Help build the data platform of tomorrow At Ravago, we believe data is the foundation for smart decision-making, innovation, and sustainable growth. That is why we continue to invest in a modern data ecosystem where quality, scalability, and future-proof thinking are at the core. For our growing Data & Analytics team, we are looking for a Senior Data Engineer who brings deep technical expertise, takes ownership, embraces architectural challenges, and is excited about the opportunities that AI can bring to modern data platforms. In this role, you will help shape an international data environment that consolidates multiple ERP systems, business units, and data sources into a single trusted source of truth. Your role: As a Senior Data Engineer, you play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing our modern data platform. You translate architectural vision into robust technical solutions and ensure that our data landscape is reliable, scalable, and ready to support reporting, analytics, and AI-driven use cases. You work closely with Data Architects, Analytics Engineers, BI Developers, and business stakeholders to transform complex data challenges into future-proof solutions. Your responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable data solutions within our modern data platform. Translate architectural guidelines into sustainable technical designs. Build robust dimensional data models following the Kimball methodology. Harmonize data from multiple source systems and ERP environments into a single conformed data layer. Develop high-performance data transformations using dbt and SQL. Build and maintain semantic layers supporting BI solutions, AI agents, and Snowflake Cortex-powered use cases. Optimize Snowflake environments for performance, scalability, and cost efficiency. Implement security standards such as role-based access control, row-level security, and data masking. Establish automated data quality controls and CI/CD processes. Drive innovation by exploring, testing, and evaluating emerging technologies and AI solutions, including Snowflake Cortex capabilities. Document solutions and actively share knowledge within the team. Mentor and coach colleagues on technical best practices. Your profile: We are looking for a senior-level Data Engineer who combines technical depth with a pragmatic and entrepreneurial mindset. Must-Haves Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer in complex enterprise-scale data environments. Demonstrated track record of delivering production-ready data solutions. Strong expertise in dimensional modeling (Kimball). Extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake. Strong knowledge of SQL and dbt. Experience with Snowflake Cortex and a strong interest in leveraging AI capabilities within modern data platforms. Experience with Git, code reviews, CI/CD pipelines, and automated testing. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a focus on quality. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts in a clear and understandable way. Experience working in structured, backlog-driven development environments. You Also Recognize Yourself In The Following You take ownership and think beyond individual tickets or short-term fixes. You enjoy working with reusable patterns and standards. You are naturally curious and actively follow new technological developments. You have a strong interest in AI and modern data architectures. You enjoy experimenting with new tools and translating insights into tangible improvements. You are a team player who inspires and supports colleagues. Nice to have: SAP S/4HANA knowledge. Experience with CDS Views or log-based replication. Python for scripting and tooling. Microsoft Fabric, OneLake, and Power BI. Apache Iceberg or other open table formats. Fivetran or HVR. Experience with AI-driven semantic layers such as Snowflake Cortex Analyst. Knowledge of legacy platforms such as Informatica PowerCenter, IBM InfoSphere, or DB2. What we offer: At Ravago, you will join an international and entrepreneurial organization where innovation, collaboration, and personal development are highly valued. We offer: A key role within a growing international organization The opportunity to build a modern data and AI landscape Collaboration with experienced professionals across Data, Analytics, and IT Plenty of room for initiative, ownership, and innovation A competitive salary package with attractive fringe benefits Learning and career growth opportunities within an international group A company culture built on involvement, respect, and entrepreneurship Join us and help shape the future of data, analytics, and AI at Ravago.

items.desc: Vos Challenges Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie des flux inter-applicatifs et des APIs exposées sur la plateforme, de la conception détaillée jusqu’à la réalisation, selon les principes de l’API-Led connectivity. En lien avec les architectes, la data, les métiers et les leads, vous transformez une solution cible en intégrations robustes, exploitables et conformes au besoin. Vous aurez pour mission de : Prendre en main les solutions d'intégration définies par les architectes et les décliner en c onception détaillée . Développer ou accompagner le développement des flux et APIs sur MuleSoft , en garantissant performance, sécurité, tolérance aux pannes et conformité à la spécification. Challenger la solution d'architecture proposée : en éprouver la faisabilité au regard des systèmes existants, des contraintes de conception détaillée et des exigences d'exploitation, et proposer des alternatives argumentées. Recueillir le besoin détaillé auprès des métiers et des équipes applicatives une fois le cadre de la solution posé : règles de gestion, cas particuliers, volumétries, exigences de fraîcheur et de qualité des données. Rédiger les spécifications fonctionnelles d étaillées (SFD) et les spécifications techniques détaillées (STD) : cinématique des échanges, contrats d'interface, mapping, règles de transformation et de réconciliation, gestion des rejets et des cas d'erreur. Décliner les patterns d'intégration retenus (synchrone / asynchrone, événementiel, batch) dans le cadre d'architecture posé, et remonter aux architectes les écarts ou points d'arbitrage identifiés en conception détaillée. Intégrer dans les spécifications les exigences de sécurité, d'exploitabilité et de supervision. Transmettre la conception aux développeurs, les accompagner pendant la réalisation et garantir la conformité du développement à la spécification. Contribuer à la standardisation : templates réutilisables (logs, gestion des erreurs, transformations), modèles de documents de conception, capitalisation sur les interfaces existantes. Définir la stratégie de tests e t les jeux de données, participer aux tests d'intégration, de robustesse et de performance, et contribuer à l'analyse des incidents. Analyser les impacts des demandes d'évolution sur les flux et les APIs existants. Votre Profil Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure Bac +4/5 en informatique (école d'ingénieur ou université), vous justifiez d 'au moins 4 ans d'expérience sur MuleSoft. Vous aimez le moment où une solution cible devient un document précis, sans zone d'ombre, à partir duquel un développeur peut construire. Votre expérience vous a permis de développer les compétences suivantes : Maîtrise de MuleSoft Anypoint Platform et de ses principaux connecteurs et composants. Maîtrise de DataWeave pour la définition et la validation des règles de transformation. Maîtrise du SQL et connaissance de SSIS ainsi que des langages de transformation usuels ( XSLT, XQUERY ...), pour l'analyse des données et des flux existants. items.desc: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the Electrical Auxiliary Systems of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global supply chain Team. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Electrical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes Power Control Center (Electrical/Instrumentation/Controls), Switchboards, Panel Boards, Switchgears, Low Voltage Transformers, Starting Frequency Converter, Static Excitation System, Batteries & Charging Systems, E-houses, Cables, and Bus Ducting. How You’ll Make an Impact Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and final product inspection during Factory Acceptance Test for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification of our electrical components. Create inspection reports and follow up with punch list Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified supplier non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary Supplier Performance: Track Supplier performance, create reports and take adequate measures to implement supplier quality improvement- or risk mitigation measures Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality tools landscape e.g. to create process transparency or generate performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome What You Bring A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above Knowledge and experience in auditing, with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred Familiarity with quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, and RCA Understanding of specific component technologies and standards (or equivalents) like NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and UL is an advantage Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time and strong communication skills in English About the Team Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet. Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation. Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo Our Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities. https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

items.desc: Vorresti iniziare la tua carriera professionale in un contesto multinazionale, altamente specializzato ed innovativo? Stiamo ricercando profili neolaureati in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini per il nostro team di consulenza in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence. Il/la candidato/a lavorerà su progetti di alto profilo in ambito Data & Artificial Intelligence, contribuendo all’analisi e valorizzazione dei dati, alla progettazione di soluzioni di Machine Learning e Intelligenza Artificiale e alla realizzazione di iniziative di trasformazione data-driven, con l’obiettivo di generare valore concreto per clienti e organizzazioni. Il tuo contributo in questo ruolo : Analizzare dataset complessi, individuando pattern, correlazioni e insight utili al business e ai processi decisionali. Contribuire alla preparazione, trasformazione e qualità dei dati necessari alle analisi e ai modelli. Supportare lo sviluppo e la sperimentazione di modelli di Machine Learning, AI generativa e soluzioni data-driven. Collaborare alla progettazione di prototipi e use case, traducendo problemi complessi in approcci quantitativi e implementabili. Lavorare con team multidisciplinari, contribuendo alla raccolta dei requisiti, alla validazione dei risultati e alla presentazione degli insight. Documentare analisi, modelli e risultati in modo chiaro, strutturato e riproducibile. Il Profilo ideale : Laurea magistrale, conseguita o in fase di conseguimento, in Fisica, Matematica, Statistica, Data Science, Ingegneria Matematica, Ingegneria Fisica o discipline quantitative affini. Solida preparazione in matematica, statistica, probabilità e metodi quantitativi. Conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione per l’analisi dei dati, preferibilmente Python. Capacità di affrontare problemi complessi con approccio analitico, strutturato e orientato alla sperimentazione. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Attitudine al lavoro in team, curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e interesse concreto per Data & Artificial Intelligence. Nice to have : Conoscenza di SQL e dei principali concetti di database e data processing. Esperienza, anche accademica, con librerie e framework di Machine Learning/Data Science. Conoscenza di base di Large Language Model, Generative AI o sistemi agentici. Familiarità con piattaforme cloud e strumenti per l’analisi o la visualizzazione dei dati. Tesi, project work, hackathon o progetti personali su dati, Machine Learning o Intelligenza Artificiale. Sede di lavoro Milano, Roma, Napoli, Bari. P ossibilità di modalità di lavoro Ibrida (Smart Working). Costruisci il tuo futuro con NTT DATA. Entra a far parte di un’azienda globale, leader nei servizi di business e tecnologici, che ascolta la tua voce e riconosce il valore del tuo lavoro. Collaborerai con clienti, partner e colleghi di tutto il mondo per creare soluzioni innovative capaci di avere un impatto reale sulla società. Qui potrai sviluppare nuove competenze e ampliare il tuo network. Siamo presenti in Italia con oltre 6000 dipendenti a Milano, Roma, Torino, Genova, Bologna, Treviso, Pisa, Padova, Napoli, Cosenza, Bari e Salerno. Make this the place where you grow. Unisciti a noi!

items.desc: Bouw mee aan AI-transformaties die écht landen AI is nieuw, maar veranderkunde niet. Als (Senior) Consultant AI Transformatie ondersteun je organisaties bij het ontwerpen en implementeren van (Agentic) AI in hun dienstverlening: van eerste use cases tot brede adoptie in de organisatie. Je werkt binnen adviesteams voor opdrachtgevers die weten dát AI hun business fundamenteel gaat veranderen, maar nog zoeken naar het hóé. Denk aan organisaties en bedrijven met een grote maatschappelijke opdracht, een complex IT-landschap en een sterke ambitie om sneller, beter en efficiënter te werken met behulp van AI. Je vertaalt AI-concepten naar begrijpelijke taal, ondersteunt bij procesherontwerp (met AI), helpt use cases scherp te krijgen en neemt mensen mee in de verandering. Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en niet bang om vragen te stellen, juist in een vakgebied dat zo snel beweegt als dit. Werken bij Eraneos betekent: Jouw (financiële) beloningen geregeld Bruto maandsalaris exclusief 8% vakantiegeld, afhankelijk van je werkervaring en op basis van een 40-urige werkweek: Consultant tussen €3.551,- en €5.086,-. Senior Consultant tussen €4.798,- en €6.718,-. Mobiliteitsopties: leaseauto en NS-Business Card, mobiliteitsbudget (eventueel te combineren met een OV Vrij-abonnement) of kilometervergoeding. Pensioenregeling met slechts 1,3% eigen bijdrage en een collectieve arbeidsongeschiktheidsverzekering. Een winstdeling. Je mag in onderling overleg één maand per jaar remote werken vanuit het buitenland. Mobiliteitsopties: NS-Business card of kilometervergoeding. Vrijheid in je werkplek: op kantoor, bij de klant of thuis. Naast 25 vakantiedagen, de mogelijkheid tot aan- en verkoop van (extra) dagen. Ruiloptie voor 2 nationale feestdagen om beter bij jouw persoonlijke voorkeuren aan te sluiten. Persoonlijke coaching en begeleiding om jouw carrière naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Internationale samenwerkingsmogelijkheden met onze experts in Denemarken, Duitsland, Oostenrijk, Spanje, het Verenigd Koninkrijk en Zwitserland. Collega’s en cultuur waar je blij van wordt Regelmatige Tech Talks, MeetUp events en inhouse Hackathons. Borrels, team uitjes, een zomerfestival en een groot eindejaarsfeest. Jaarlijkse sportactiviteiten zoals de Dam tot Damloop, een yogareteat, skireis en fietstrip. Veel aandacht voor vitaliteit in de vorm van lezingen en workshops. Werken binnen de AI Transformatie team van Organizational Excellence & Transformation Je maakt onderdeel uit van ons AI Transformatie-team, waar AI-adoptie en digitale transformatie centraal staan. We werken aan opdrachten waarin technologie, proces en organisatie samenkomen. Onze consultants zijn AI-savvy, technisch onderlegd en tegelijk sterk in verandermanagement en procesherontwerp. Samenwerking, eigen initiatief en resultaatgerichtheid staan bij ons hoog in het vaandel. Je krijgt volop ruimte om te leren van ervaren collega's, mee te draaien in uiteenlopende projecten en je eigen expertise op te bouwen binnen het AI-domein. Een greep uit jouw uitdagingen Ondersteunen bij AI-transformaties: van het in kaart brengen van processen en use cases tot het meewerken aan de implementatie en borging in de organisatie. Meewerken aan het vertalen van de AI-ambitie van opdrachtgevers naar concrete stappen — je helpt bij analyses, workshops en het uitwerken van scenario's. Bijdragen aan procesherontwerp: hoe landt AI, automatisering of een agentic applicatie op de juiste plek in het proces, ondersteunend aan de mens? Betrokken zijn bij verandermanagement in de praktijk: mensen meenemen in de verandering, workshops faciliteren en weerstand bespreekbaar maken. Samenwerken met business en IT om AI verantwoord en resultaatgericht in te bedden in de dienstverlening van onze opdrachtgevers. Actief bijdragen aan onze …

items.desc: As a QA Engineer, you are responsible for helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software by combining hands-on testing, risk-based quality assurance, and test automation. A key part of the role is expanding and maintaining automated test coverage for business-critical functionality, embedding quality controls into delivery pipelines, and helping teams release software with confidence. You will also perform exploratory and targeted manual testing, assess risk, identify defects, and provide independent assessments of quality and risk where human investigation adds value. You will join the Tech & Data department (more than 200 employees across the globe) and will be able to grow and evolve in a global and very dynamic structure providing products, services, and support to all SCOR Group worldwide. Quality Assurance & Testing You validate new functionality, bug fixes, and enhancements delivered by engineering teams through structured manual testing and exploratory testing. You assess changes using risk-based testing principles, prioritizing testing effort on the areas with the highest business impact and likelihood of failure. You identify, document, reproduce, and track defects while collaborating closely with developers to ensure timely resolution. You verify fixes, confirm regression impact, and provide clear release sign-off recommendations. You evaluate both expected behaviour and edge cases to ensure software performs reliably in real-world scenarios. Test Automation & Engineering You transform manual test scenarios into maintainable automated test suites that improve coverage and reduce repetitive manual effort. You contribute to the development and maintenance of automated testing frameworks and pipelines integrated into our software delivery process. You build and maintain automated end-to-end, integration, and regression tests using modern testing tools and engineering practices. You help improve testing scalability, reliability, and maintainability through continuous improvement of frameworks, tooling, and processes. Collaboration & Quality Ownership You partner with developers to build a culture where quality is a shared responsibility rather than a final checkpoint. You contribute to discussions on requirements, acceptance criteria, solution design, and testability before development begins. You help engineering teams improve testing practices, quality awareness, and risk identification throughout the SDLC. You communicate quality risks, testing outcomes, and release readiness clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Innovation & Continuous Improvement You stay informed about modern quality engineering approaches, including AI-assisted and agentic testing techniques. You contribute ideas that help the organization keep pace with accelerating software delivery while maintaining high quality standards. You help identify opportunities for improved automation, metrics, reporting, and quality processes. What Will Help You Succeed Experience performing structured software testing in Agile delivery environments. Experience designing and executing test cases, test scenarios, regression tests, and exploratory testing. Experience creating or maintaining automated tests using modern test automation frameworks. Experience with software development practices, source control, CI/CD pipelines, and modern software delivery workflows. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail and edge cases. Ability to balance thoroughness with pragmatism through risk-based testing. Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build productive relationships with developers and stakeholders. Technical Skills Experience with the following technologies or equivalent is expected: Playwright or similar test automation frameworks Selenium Modern CI/CD practices JavaScript GitHub Actions Atlassian Jira and Confluence Sentry Elastic / Kibana API testing Experience working with or testing solutions built using the following technologies is beneficial: Angular / Java Ruby on Rails Kubernetes Cloud-native applications Additional Experience We'd Love to See Experience within insurance, financial services, or other regulated industries. Experience with accessibility testing, performance testing and usability validation. Experience with AI-assisted testing or modern quality engineering practices. Experience contributing to testing strategies, quality metrics, dashboards, or QA process improvement initiatives. Personal Qualities Quality-focused with strong attention to detail. Curious and eager to learn new technologies and testing approaches. Comfortable working in a collaborative, cross-functional environment. Able to challenge assumptions constructively while maintaining strong working relationships. items.desc: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. We're entering the era of agentic science where AI models can now design novel proteins, propose hypotheses, and iterate on experimental results. But they can't run the experiments themselves - that's still a manual, months-long process. We're building the infrastructure that gives AI agents access to the physical world. We are one of the fastest growing biotech companies, trusted by leading biopharmas, frontier AI labs, and the techbio companies pushing the field forward. This is a rare chance to help advance some of the most important work happening in biotech today. Our automated lab is powered by a deep software + hardware stack: lab instruments worth millions of USD reverse-engineered into API-controllable hardware, dozens of devices orchestrated through complex workflows, full observability on everything that happens in the lab, processing pipelines for messy physical-world data, and AI systems that troubleshoot production results and accelerate assay development. We’re growing rapidly and are hiring for talented people to scale and support the massive demand for AI-driven wet lab experimentation. About the Role Our lab in Lausanne runs thousands of constructs a week through automated workcells, liquid handlers, and binding instruments. That only works if the instruments are calibrated, the buffers are made, the stock is where the system says it is, and the bench is ready when the scientists arrive. You are the person who makes sure it is. You'll own the day-to-day upkeep of our automation and instruments, run buffer and reagent production, keep the lab clean, safe, and stocked, and lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab. This is a hands-on, in-the-lab role, working closely with our Lab Manager, the Lab Operations team, and the scientists whose experiments depend on you getting it right. What You'll Do Run daily and weekly calibration of our Hamilton liquid handling systems. Calibrate and maintain key instruments, including the Echo and pH meters. Look after the SPR system: buffer bottle changes, rinsing, and routine upkeep. Take ownership of our automated workcells and keep them clean, organized, and calibrated. Prepare buffers, reagents, and reaction mixes according to established SOPs. Run weekly buffer production and handle ad-hoc requests from the team. Lead the rollout of new inventory management and lab operations processes across the lab, and help design and improve them as the lab scales. Organize fridges and storage, run inventory, and keep consumables, glassware, and bench supplies stocked so experiments never stall. Keep benches and shared spaces clean, clear, and ready for work every day. Manage hazardous and biohazardous waste disposal (including broken glass and sharps), waste sorting, recycling, and general waste removal in line with safety regulations. Run the lab dishwasher and make sure clean glassware is always available. Plan and document scheduled deep cleans and preventive maintenance. What We're Looking For Laboratory apprenticeship (CFC Laborant/in), BSc in a relevant field, or an equivalent lab technician qualification. Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. Precision in following and executing protocols and SOPs. A service mindset. You enjoy making other people's work easier. Comfortable with routine, with an eye for ways to improve it. Calm and reliable in a fast-paced, high-throughput environment. Experience with lab automation or liquid handling systems (Hamilton, Echo, or similar) is a plus. Experience with inventory or LIMS tools is a plus. Proficiency in English and French is a plus. Many of our vendors and delivery services operate in French. Details Location: Lausanne, Switzerland (on-site) Type: Full time Start date: ASAP We review applications on a rolling basis. Application deadline We are reviewing applicants on a rolling basis.

items.desc: We Are Sparta Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders. Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has. We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market. At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done. Your work has reach. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies. Fuel Oil Commodity Owner This role can be based in either London or Singapore. Fuel oil constantly surprises traders with its outsized moves. The question is whether you see it before everyone else does. Sparta is building the data platform that fuel oil and feedstocks traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex, and Fuel Oil is one of our most technical verticals. We're looking for someone to own it. This role is an opportunity to own a vertical, build your profile, and be genuinely central to the direction of the business. This role is an opportunity to own a vertical, build your profile, and be genuinely central to the direction of the business. We want someone who knows heavy product markets deeply and who is not afraid to build new things. Our Fuel Oil vertical already runs on market-leading tools and you will take them even further. The role reports to our Head of Commodities.
