items.desc: Are you ready to unlock your potential within a challenging, creative and fast paced work environment? Do you want to escape your current job role and work with people to build positive and productive lives, whatever their past? Now is the time to break into offender healthcare and develop your career. Oxleas NHS trust were awarded the South West prison contract in 2022 and currently have a portfolio of 19 prisons across the South of England. We are currently looking to expand our pool of bank workers by recruiting Pharmacy Technicians to work within the Prison service on a flexible basis. Our healthcare team have a real impact on promoting health and well-being to those in prison and we pride ourselves on using skills and strategies that instil hope for patients future resettlement back into the community. We directly deliver Mental Health, Physical Health, Pharmacy and Clinical Substance Misuse in an integrated healthcare delivery model to provide effective and responsive care to improve wellbeing and support better outcomes in the future. As a Pharmacy Technician, you will be providing a medicines management service to patients within the prison with the professional support of a prison service pharmacist. You will administer medicines to patients against a valid prescription, ensuring this is taken correctly, provide advice to patients about the appropriate use of medicines and promote healthy lifestyles to aid their rehabilitation. You will dispense prescriptions and stock items, whilst supervising assistants when in the dispensary. There will also be elements of stock control involved in your role, such as undertaking stock top-up services and reviewing expiry dates and storage facilities for all medicines, reporting any deficiencies to the prison service pharmacist. Wondering what it’s like to work within offender healthcare? “I really enjoy working in the Pharmacy Service for Oxleas, my role is extremely varied and I work within a very supportive team. I find my role rewarding as it is all about enabling patient’s rehabilitation and I enjoy interacting with patients daily and building relationships with them. Oxleas are a good employer and there are plenty of opportunities to be supported through qualifications and training which then allows you to progress through different bands within the team.” Amanda - Pharmacy Tech. Oxleas – About Us Oxleas offers a wide range of NHS healthcare services to people in community and secure environment settings. Our services include community health care such as district nursing and speech and language therapy, care for people with learning disabilities and mental health care such as psychiatry, nursing and therapies. Our multidisciplinary teams look after people of all ages and we work in close partnership with other parts of the NHS, local councils and the voluntary sector and through our new provider collaboratives. Our 4,300 members of staff work in many different settings including hospitals, clinics, prisons, secure hospitals, children’s centres, schools and people’s homes. We have over 125 sites in a variety of locations in the South of England. In London we operate within the Boroughs of Bexley, Bromley Greenwich and into Kent. We manage hospital sites including Queen Mary’s Hospital, Sidcup and Memorial Hospital, Woolwich, as well as the Bracton Centre, our medium secure unit for people with mental health needs. We are the largest NHS provider of prison health services providing healthcare to prisons within Devon, Dorset, Bristol, Wiltshire and Gloucestershire, Kent and South London. We are moving from a decade of growth through acquisition to a company that is outcome-driven, outward-focused, and AI-native by design. Logistics is one of the best possible use cases for AI, and unlike most of our peers, we own the full loop: the platform, the operations, and the data connecting them. That closed feedback loop is a compounding advantage most competitors can’t replicate. This role exists to turn that advantage into sennder’s sharpest edge in margin, cost, and service, because AI will give us that edge if we lead, or become a risk if we lag. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will join our highly talented ML team. This is an applied machine learning role focused on highly innovative, research-oriented topics. You will work on a diverse portfolio of high-impact projects, ranging from optimizing our established Recommendation engine & Pricing engine to building greenfield solutions. This role can be based out of our Berlin, Barcelona or Amsterdam office. To succeed, this role demands a strong focus on deep Data Science and statistical exploration (roughly 70% of your scope), paired with the foundational Machine Learning Engineering skills (~30%) required to transition prototypes into production-ready models. You will not just be implementing technical specifications; you will sit directly with end-users, operators, and Product Managers to deeply understand their workflows, granting you real decision-making power over the product's direction. You are expected to have a holistic approach to project deployment, acting as an end-to-end ML Engineer and taking full ownership from "Light MVP" R&D to production deployment. What You Will Do… Pricing Engine Optimization: Develop and iterate on bid estimation algorithms and margin-optimization models to power our dynamic pricing engine, directly driving company profitability. Carrier Forecasting: Build robust predictive models to forecast carrier behavior and market capacity, enabling our operational teams to secure the right trucks at the right price before the market shifts. Recommender Systems: Maintain and improve our existing recommender systems to seamlessly support our operational teams' day-to-day efficiency. Industry Innovation & Applied ML: Explore and validate new areas where machine learning can solve fundamental logistics challenges (such as freight routing and network optimization), turning open-ended industry problems into scalable, data-driven solutions. Product Discovery & Ideation: Partner closely with Product Managers to drive continuous product discovery, translating ambiguous operational pain points into clear, outcome-driven ML hypotheses and rapid prototypes. AI & LLM Integration: Leverage foundational models and AI agents both as daily accelerators for your own engineering workflows and as core components to build new internal products. We expect you to pragmatically evaluate trade-offs and always choose the right solution for the right problem—whether that is an LLM, a traditional ML model, or a simple heuristic. Platform Collaboration: Partner with our Data & AI Platform (MLOps) team to utilize and deploy models via our internal ML infrastructure. You will act as a key customer of this platform, providing continuous feedback and contributions to shape our global engineering standards. End-to-End Execution: Adopt a holistic approach to project deployment, maintaining an end-to-end attitude that covers the entire lifecycle from initial R&D and prototyping all the way through to production release and monitoring. What We Are Looking For… Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in Data Science or Machine Learning Engineering. Data Science Fundamentals: Strong foundation in statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, and deep data exploration to validate assumptions and commercial viability before building complex models. You must possess a working knowledge of ML approaches to address basic regression and classification problems. ML Engineering: Experience deploying models to production environments, writing modular code, and understanding software engineering best practices. Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and Git. Experience working with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake), utilizing Jupyter Notebooks for data exploration, and building interactive data apps/dashboards (e.g., Streamlit, PowerBI) to visualize outcomes for stakeholders. AI Proficiency: A solid understanding of how to set up, evaluate, and leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and related AI tools in a production setting. Business Acumen: Ability to translate complex & multifaceted logistical problems into data-driven solutions, prioritizing 'Outcome over Output'. Collaboration: Strong communication …

items.desc: Job Title: AI Engineer Location: London (Hybrid) About the company: Our client is an AI-driven fundraising technology company building a platform that connects exceptional founders with the right investors through intelligent matching, warm introductions, and relationship intelligence. The company aims to make fundraising more accessible by helping founders overcome network barriers and connect with investors based on fit, merit, and investment thesis. Its platform combines artificial intelligence, autonomous agents, relationship data, and CRM capabilities to streamline founder-investor connections across email, WhatsApp, phone, and web. With a strong focus on responsible AI, privacy, fairness, and transparency, our client is building a new category of fundraising infrastructure designed to improve access to capital and help promising founders move forward. Key requirements: • Building production AI agents (tool use, RAG, evals, guardrails) • Real-time voice AI (speech-to-text, text-to-speech, low latency) • Matching / relationship data, e.g. graph or vector models for connecting founders and investors • Security, trust & safety, and data privacy (GDPR), as we handle sensitive founder and investor data • 0 to 1 startup experience, very hands-on, and able to build and lead the first engineering team Nice to have: bias/fairness testing, CRM and data integrations, fintech or investor-tech background. Tasks: Translate real-world network behavior into structured data and intelligent, AI-driven workflows Own the product architecture from MVP to scale across email, WhatsApp, phone and web, on a secure, serverless cloud foundation Design AI systems with a strong focus on safety, fairness, privacy and transparency, ensuring recommendations and matching logic are responsible, explainable and free from harmful bias Implement best practices for AI governance, model evaluation and responsible data usage as the platform scales Understand user requirements and work with the CEO to build the technical strategy and roadmap Be hands on and build and lead the engineering team as the company grows Benefits Build a product that meaningfully changes who gets funded Shape a new category of AI product, one that lives where people already work and acts on their behalf, not behind another chat window Founding equity, high ownership, real impact Work directly with a founder who has built and raised VC capital before (Cellcraft, Series A in progress) Shape the technical and ethical foundations of the product from day one.

items.desc: As Agentic AI Engineer, you will design, build, and operationalize agentic AI capabilities to increase automation, improve data quality, and accelerate decision-making within medical imaging clinical trials. This role focuses on building AI agents that can reliably execute workflows such as intake and validation of imaging data, metadata reconciliation, protocol-driven checks, quality control support, and structured extraction from multi-modal artifacts (DICOM, non‑DICOM, reports, PDFs). In parallel, the role will help transform the company’s Product Development Life Cycle (PDLC) into an AI-driven lifecycle—enabling agentic workflows from Product Discovery (e.g., requirements synthesis, research, backlog shaping) to Delivery and Deployment (e.g., test generation, release readiness, documentation automation) through Production Operations (e.g., incident triage, observability insights, automated runbooks), while ensuring safety, compliance, traceability, and human oversight. Key Responsibilities Cross functional collaborations Partner with Product, Imaging Ops, Data Engineering, QA, Security, and Regulatory/Quality to identify high-value automation opportunities and define agentic AI use cases. Translate clinical-trial imaging workflows and PDLC processes into agent-ready task models (inputs, outputs, constraints, guardrails, acceptance criteria). Work with SMEs to define quality rubrics, evaluation datasets, and human review workflows to validate agent outputs. Support change management: help teams adopt agentic features with clear UX patterns, onboarding, and documentation. Technical ownership Promote engineering best practices for agentic systems: reliability, observability, evaluation, reproducibility, and secure-by-design patterns. Contribute to internal standards for: prompt/version control, agent tools/plugins, retrieval configuration, grounding/citations, and human-in-the-loop review. Participate in design reviews and provide guidance on selecting frameworks and architectures. Coach peers through code reviews, pairing, demos, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Algorithm and Software Development Build agentic workflows (multi-step reasoning + tool use) that support imaging trial processes such as: data intake and validation (DICOM/non‑DICOM), metadata consistency checks protocol-driven QC support and discrepancy detection data completeness checks and structured issue creation automated summarization of imaging packets and context generation for reviewers Implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns grounded in controlled knowledge sources (SOPs, protocols, specs, runbooks), with traceability. Develop evaluation harnesses for agent behavior: task success rate, hallucination/grounding checks, regression testing, and bias/failure-mode analysis. Contribute production-quality code (APIs, services, pipelines) with strong testing, documentation, and maintainability. Deployment and integration (MLOps) Package and deploy agentic services using approved cloud and SDLC patterns: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, secret management, and environment promotion. Implement guardrails and controls: access control, tool permissions, sandboxing, content filtering, rate limits, and audit logging. Build observability: traces, structured logs, evaluation telemetry, cost monitoring, and error analytics (agent runs, tool calls, retrieval hits, model performance). Ensure safe production operations: rollback strategies, feature flags, canary releases, and incident playbooks. Innovation & Research application Stay current on agentic AI patterns (planning, tool use, memory, multi-agent coordination, structured outputs) and evaluate feasibility for regulated workflows. Prototype and validate new capabilities quickly, then harden into production-ready features. Run experiments comparing models, prompts, retrieval strategies, and agent architectures; document results and recommendations. Identify opportunities to standardize and reuse agent components across clinical imaging workflows and PDLC automation. Other Carry out any other reasonable duties as requested. Functional Competencies (Technical knowledge/Skills) Strong software engineering skills (clean architecture, APIs, testing, code reviews). Solid grounding in RAG and knowledge grounding patterns (chunking, embeddings, retrieval quality, citations/traceability). Familiarity with MLOps / DevOps: CI/CD, monitoring, logging, secure deployment practices. Data handling fundamentals: schema design, data validation, data lineage, and auditability. Exposure to medical imaging concepts (DICOM, metadata, modality basics) and/or clinical trial workflows, preferred. Working knowledge of regulated software expectations (validation mindset, audit trails, traceability), preferred. Familiarity with privacy/security principles for sensitive data, preferred. Strong communication skills; can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Comfortable working across teams and …

items.desc: About the role At Cegeka & nexuzhealth we’re building the future of healthcare technology, and we’re now looking for an AI Product Engineer to help us take the next step. This is a pioneering role and our first hire of this kind. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape how AI is introduced across our healthcare products, working across multiple product and engineering teams.We’re looking for someone who has already moved beyond AI experiments and prototypes and knows what it takes to build, ship and operate AI features in a real commercial product environment. What will you do? Design, build and ship AI-powered features from idea to production Build LLM integrations, RAG pipelines and agentic AI workflows Develop AI agents and tool-based solutions Work with AI models and platforms such as Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock or comparable technologies Build evaluation frameworks and production monitoring Implement strong security, privacy and AI guardrails Optimize performance, reliability, latency and cost Create reusable AI components for different product teams Collaborate with engineers, product owners, designers and healthcare experts What do you bring? Strong Software Engineering / Software Development background Proven experience shipping AI features in a commercial SaaS or product environment Hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG and agentic AI Experience with AI agents, tool use, prompt design and structured outputs Experience working with AI models and AI platforms Experience with AI evaluation and production monitoring Strong understanding of security, privacy and cost efficiency Strong product mindset and understanding of the commercial impact of AI solutions Experience handling sensitive data securely Experience with Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock or similar platforms is a plus Experience in healthcare or another regulated environment is a plus Knowledge of HL7 FHIR, GDPR, EU AI Act or medical device regulation is a plus What We Offer 22 days of annual leave, plus an additional seniority day every 3 years Private medical insurance Monthly meal vouchers Flexible benefits budget of €25/month to use as you prefer Continuous learning and development with personalized growth paths and dedicated programs Flexible remote working, aligned with team goals and smart working principles Wellbeing initiatives supporting work-life balance, including webinars and internal programs A collaborative culture with regular team events, hangouts, and team-building activities Why join us? This isn’t about joining an established AI function and maintaining what already exists. You’ll be our first AI Product Engineer, giving you the opportunity to help define how we build and integrate AI into our products from the beginning. Most importantly, you’ll be working on AI with a meaningful purpose: building technology that supports clinicians, care providers and healthcare professionals in their daily work.

We focus on transforming complex business challenges into practical, production-grade technology that generates measurable impact. We emphasize co-development, working side by side with client teams to accelerate innovation and delivery. Team members join a fast-moving environment where applied AI, engineering excellence, and business outcomes intersect. Role description As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer at Quantrue, you will work directly with clients to design, build, and deploy AI-driven software solutions that address real-world business problems. On a day-to-day basis, you will collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to understand requirements, prototype and implement backend services, integrate AI components, and ensure systems are robust, scalable, and maintainable. You will contribute to end-to-end development, from data processing and model integration to API design, testing, and monitoring in production environments. You will also participate in architectural discussions and knowledge sharing to support sustainable, high-quality engineering practices. User of an agentic developer workbench (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, ...). Proficiency in programming, with experience delivering production-ready code. Python is a must. Experience in DevOps/MLOps practices, advanced Git. Experience working with AI/ML systems (e.g., integrating models, data pipelines, LangGraph). Familiarity with cloud platforms (such as AWS, GCP, Azure) and/or containerization/orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). Nice to have: solid understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles and their application in modern codebases. Soft skills: Ability to collaborate with non-technical stakeholders, translate business needs into technical solutions, and communicate clearly in English; Spanish proficiency is a plus. Comfort operating in client-facing environments, with a proactive mindset and willingness to work in a hybrid setup in Madrid. Recent graduates are welcome. Experience in consulting will be a plus. Primary location: Madrid (Spain). Job type: full time with a hybrid remote-office setting. Main contact: Jordi Serra - jserra@quantrue.com

items.desc: En MANGO vestimos de pasión todo lo que hacemos. Con origen en Barcelona y presencia en más de 120 países, inspiramos al mundo con creatividad, innovación y autenticidad. Nuestro equipo multicultural es el motor de nuestro éxito. nos enorgullece llevar la moda más allá, conectando nuestro estilo único con personas de todo el mundo. En Mango estamos evolucionando nuestro asistente conversacional que atiende a millones de clientes en 17 idiomas y 69 países. Nuestro asistente resuelve de forma autónoma la mayoría de interacciones de Atención al Cliente y genera un impacto directo en la experiencia de usuario y el negocio. También inspira a nuestras clientas recomendando prendas y outfits con nuestro algoritmo de recomendación Mango Stylist. Estamos construyendo una nueva generación del asistente sobre una arquitectura Agentic AI y buscamos un/a Agentic AI Engineer que sea protagonista de este salto tecnológico. NUESTRO EQUIPO Somos un equipo ágil y multidisciplinar: Tech Lead, Product Owner, software engineers y lingüistas computacionales. Tu misión será diseñar y desarrollar agentes autónomos de IA que resuelvan interacciones reales de clientes a escala, garantizando fiabilidad, escalabilidad y una experiencia de usuario excepcional. TU NUEVO PUESTO Diseñar y desarrollar agentes conversacionales con IA Generativa y arquitecturas multi-agente. Construir y mantener el backend del asistente en Python con FastAPI, desplegado en Google Cloud Platform (Kubernetes, Pub/Sub, Secret Manager, Vertex AI). Integrar el asistente con sistemas externos como Salesforce, APIs de Mango y canales como mango.com, app Mango, WhatsApp, Instagram y teléfono. Colaborar con lingüistas computacionales en la estrategia de prompts, guardrails y evaluaciones que garantizan respuestas fiables y alineadas con la marca Mango. Implementar y mantener pipelines de observabilidad y evaluación de LLMs para medir y mejorar la calidad de las respuestas Aplicar buenas prácticas de seguridad y privacidad en el desarrollo del asistente: detección y enmascaramiento de PII en conversaciones, gestión segura de secretos y cumplimiento con GDPR. SOBRE TÍ Formación en Ingeniería Informática o similar. Persona organizada, proactiva, orientada al cliente y con capacidad de trabajar en equipo. 3+ años de experiencia en desarrollo backend con Python. Experiencia con FastAPI y programación asíncrona en Python. Experiencia o alto interés demostrado en LLMs, IA Generativa o NLP. Experiencia integrando APIs externas y sistemas de terceros. Experiencia en Cloud (preferible GCP, aunque valoramos AWS o Azure). Conocimientos de seguridad aplicada a sistemas de IA: prompt injection, data leakage y privacidad de datos (GDPR/CCPA) DESEABLES/NICE TO HAVE Deseables / Nice to have Experiencia con arquitecturas agénticas (LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, MCP). Experiencia en asistentes virtuales o conversacionales. Conocimientos de NLU/NLP y evaluación de modelos de lenguaje. Experiencia con herramientas de observabilidad de LLMs (Langfuse, LangSmith o similares). Experiencia con herramientas de detección y enmascaramiento de PII o DLP (p. ej. Google Cloud DLP). Nivel de inglés alto. Únete a nosotros y sé parte de uno de los proyectos de Agentic AI más ambiciosos del sector retail, con impacto directo en millones de personas y la oportunidad de aprender y crecer en un equipo puntero. items.desc: Who We Are Accenture Song is the world's largest tech-powered creative group — a fusion of creativity, technology, intelligence, and experience. Within Song, our practice helps iconic brands reinvent the products, services, and spaces that define their relationship with customers. We work across the full spectrum: from defining product strategy and crafting human-centred digital experiences to engineering the AI-powered platforms and design systems that bring them to life at scale. We operate like a studio embedded inside a global consultancy: small, high-craft teams with a direct line between design decisions and shipped products. With 70 Song Studios and more than 4,000 designers and makers across six continents, our Design & Digital Products team brings together specialists in Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, Experience Design, and Content Design — all united by a belief that the best digital products make people's lives genuinely better. For us, AI is not a feature we bolt on — it is the operating model we build around. We are actively shaping what it means to design, build, and deliver AI-native products at enterprise scale, and we are looking for engineers who want to be at the centre of that reinvention. Who You Are You are an AI Native Product Engineer with demonstrated experience building cloud-native systems and shipping production-grade AI solutions. You combine hands-on engineering depth with the creativity and product intuition to shape solutions that make sense for real users and enterprises. You’re as comfortable writing production code as you are whiteboarding system designs, facilitating a client workshop, or mapping a product roadmap. You thrive in ambiguity and act as a bridge between vision and execution. You do not treat AI as a toolset to learn on the side. It is your primary medium. You architect around large language models, retrieval systems, and multi-agent orchestration the way previous generations of engineers built around microservices — with rigour, craft, and a clear eye on what will actually work in production. You translate complex AI behaviour into tangible user experiences that non-technical stakeholders can understand and trust. The Work You will embed directly with clients as a technologist, product thinker, and trusted engineering partner. Working within cross-functional Song studio teams — alongside Product Designers, Experience Designers, Product Managers, and Strategists — you will lead the engineering of AI-native digital products from concept through to production. You will shape not only what gets built but how it gets built, setting the technical standard for AI-native delivery within the practice. This is not a back-office role. You will be in the room with clients, translating AI possibilities into product realities, and in the codebase, making those realities work. AI-Native Product Engineering Product Orchestration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to frame problems, align priorities, and translate needs into orchestrated AI workflows. Agent Architecture & Engineering: Design and engineer enterprise-ready AI agents — including retrieval, orchestration, policy-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability. Human-AI Experience Engineering: Translate complex AI behaviours (confidence states, reasoning traces, agentic actions, fallback flows) into transparent, controllable, and accessible user experiences — in close collaboration with Experience Designers and Product Designers. AI Platform Integration: Build robust abstraction layers across AI providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, open-source models) to create portable, multi-provider pipelines that reduce client lock-in and maximise flexibility. AI Design System Contributions: Contribute to AI-native component libraries and design system patterns — error states, human-in-the-loop interactions, progressive disclosure of AI reasoning — ensuring consistency and scalability across client products. Cloud-Native Engineering & Delivery Scalable Systems: Apply containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures to ship AI-native systems that perform reliably at enterprise scale. Production Discipline: Own CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging. Deploy to production and take responsibility for what you ship. Rapid Prototyping: Build working prototypes and proof-of-concept systems that close the gap between design vision and technical reality — using AI tooling actively to accelerate your own delivery. Client Partnership & Practice Building Trusted Advisor: Serve as the primary technical voice in client engagements — framing problems, aligning technical trade-offs with business goals, and communicating clearly to both engineers and executive stakeholders. Workshop Facilitation: Lead design sprints, co-creation sessions, and code-with workshops. …

items.desc: Medical AI Data Engineer @ Tune Insight, Lausanne, Switzerland (On-site/Hybrid) About Us Tune Insight’s vision is to replace the data economy with an insight economy without compromising security and privacy. Raw sensitive data doesn’t move and is never revealed, enabling companies to collaborate and valorize their data and models while keeping control of their value. Tune Insight’s B2B encrypted computing platform is dedicated to clinical and pharmaceutical research, bridging the gap between patient data and life science breakthroughs. The Role We are looking for an AI Data Engineer with solid engineering skills and a thorough understanding of medical questions. This role sits at the intersection of applied AI engineering, healthcare informatics, and full-stack software development. The ideal candidate will have directly contributed to query systems over federated health data, and will bring deep, hands-on familiarity with international medical interoperability standards and ontologies — not as theoretical knowledge, but as implemented, production experience. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain an AI agents leveraging RAG and autonomous AI agents, enabling clinical researchers to query sensitive federated datasets using natural language Build and iterate on an interoperable query language to SQL generation pipeline , including schema-awareness layers, and query validation tailored to complex clinical data models Implement and maintain data harmonization pipelines conforming to the OMOP Common Data Model and HL7 FHIR standard, enabling interoperability across heterogeneous clinical datasets from multiple institutions Integrate and maintain medical ontology mappings across ICD-10, SNOMED CT, ATC, and RxNorm to ensure semantic consistency in federated patient data queries Develop and maintain full-stack platform features: from backend services, APIs, and query orchestration pipelines through to user-facing interfaces for clinical researchers and data scientists. What We Are Looking For AI/LLM Systems: Hands-on experience building production RAG pipelines and agentic AI workflows applied to clinical data querying. Medical Ontologies: Practical experience integrating a broad range of clinical ontologies and vocabularies into a query or data harmonization system, including but not limited to SNOMED CT, ATC, RxNorm, ICD-10, LOINC, and OMOP standard vocabularies. The candidate must demonstrate hands-on implementation experience managing concept mappings, hierarchies, and cross-ontology relationships. Backend Engineering: Solid Go development experience, including API design and data pipeline construction. Frontend Engineering : React development experience, including component design and building secure, clinical-facing user interfaces. Strong SQL expertise: Writing and optimizing complex queries and investigating, monitoring, and troubleshooting the performance of production databases such as PostgreSQL and Oracle. Preferred qualifications Experience working with relational databases and complex clinical data models. Proven ability to build and maintain production React interfaces, ideally within a data-intensive or analytics-focused application. Prior experience working within privacy-preserving, federated or distributed data environments where data cannot be moved or revealed in raw form is strongly preferred. Understanding of the engineering constraints this imposes on query design and data access is essential. Given the complexity and proprietary nature of our platform, we place significant weight on candidates who have sustained deep contributions to a single, specialized system over an extended period (18 months or more). Why Join Us? Meaningful Work : Your contribution to the infrastructure enables secure access to insights of patient data and enables life-saving research. Lausanne Hub : Work in the center of Europe’s Health Valley. Impact : In a team of <20, you aren't just a ticket-solver. You are building the foundation the company stands on. Challenging Problems: If you enjoy working at the boundary of AI, regulated health data, and distributed systems, you will not run out of hard problems here. This role is right for you if you: Thrive working across the full stack: from ontology mappings and data models to APIs to user interfaces 0-2 years working within a privacy-preserving or federated health data environment . Have a strong instinct for data quality and semantic correctness, especially in a clinical or medical context Appreciate challenging yourself out of your comfort zone and enjoy change. Are comfortable taking responsibility and being accountable for outcomes. Stay humble and open to feedback, especially when working with world-class experts.

In 2026, Action1 was recognized by Inc. 5000 as the fastest-growing founder-led cybersecurity company in America. The Role We are looking for a Applied AI Engineer to build and operate LLM-powered internal solutions, tools, automations, and customer-facing AI features end-to-end. Friendly and professional peers, eager to help and help you grow. A multitude of interesting challenges and opportunities.

Dabei identifizierst du relevante Use Cases, setzt Lösungen vom Prototyp bis zur produktiven Anwendung um und siehst, wie deine Arbeit Unternehmen, Industrien und Menschenleben transformiert. items.desc: About ION We are a Software Product Company with a global footprint in the FinTech sector. With more than 10,000 professionals across 40+ offices worldwide, we provide solutions combining trading and workflow automation , market data , and advanced business intelligence. Our Graduate Development Program is a three-year journey designed for recent graduates who look beyond the obvious, challenge existing processes, and are driven to automate and reinvent the way things work. The program is structured into 4 progressive phases, each with distinct learning objectives. Tasks evolve according to your abilities and interests, ensuring the experience is as individual as you are. From day one, you join ION on a full‑time permanent contract , carry real accountability on live projects, and be paired with senior professionals who guide your development throughout the entire journey. What You'll Do Across phases, you will gain hands-on experience with state-of-the-art methodologies and technologies in our agile product development environment. This role is designed to grow well rounded AI professionals, with a solid foundation in software engineering to bring models into production. Contributing directly to the development of ION's products, from requirements through to delivery Design, develop, train, evaluate and iterate on Machine Learning models and Generative AI solutions Work with Language Models (LLMs) and related techniques (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG, embeddings, fine-tuning, evaluation) Collaborating with cross-functional teams to build and ship innovative, high-impact products, solving complex technical problems and translating them into scalable, efficient solutions What We're Looking For Master's degree in a STEM discipline — obtained within the last year or currently in progress, with a strong academic record Programming experience in one or more of: Python, Typescript, JavaScript Strong communicator, collaborative by nature, and fluent in English (B2+) Based in Italy or willing to relocate; non-EU candidates must hold a valid EU work permit Gross Salary Range 34.000 - 38.000 EUR Pursuant to Italian Law (L.68/99), candidates registered on the disability list will be given priority. Only candidates meeting the selection criteria will be contacted. Please apply only if you currently hold full legal right to work in Italy.

In this role you will be part of a global team working on challenging, meaningful projects impacting core business activities. Since 1818, Bunge has been connecting farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed, and fuel to the world. Looking to the future, our ambition is to continuously reinvent ourselves, leveraging data to be at the forefront of analytics, technology and talent to accomplish our purpose in a better, faster and simpler way. Bunge is committed to operating and thriving in the digital world - creating world class agile teams where teammates are empowered and encouraged to collaborate and test and learn to succeed. At Bunge, people don't just come here to work, they come here to grow - solving challenges that directly impact the world with a diverse team of thinkers and doers. Bunge offers a strong compensation and benefits package, generous paid time off program, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity to progress. Our hybrid work environment provides a balance of in-office and remote work. Most importantly, in all we do we live our values: Act as One Team by fostering inclusion, collaboration, and respect Drive for Excellence by being agile, innovative and efficient Do What's Right by acting safely, ethically, and sustainably Overview: We are looking for a motivated and hands-on Data Quality & AI Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This role is focused on designing, developing, and deploying cloud-native solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with a strong emphasis on Python development, Generative AI, AI Agents, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and modern data platform capabilities. The successful candidate will contribute to the development of scalable Data Quality AI-powered solutions, automation frameworks, and cloud services that support our Data Mesh and Data Platform strategy. You will work closely with Data Engineers, Product Owners and Data Governance teams to build innovative solutions that improve productivity and data quality for better decision-making across the organization. This position is ideal for an engineer with strong software development skills who is eager to apply AI technologies, cloud engineering practices, and automation to solve real data quality challenges. Main Accountabilities: Contribute to data quality and governance initiatives by applying the next areas of responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable data quality applications, services, and automation frameworks using Python. Build and deploy Generative AI solutions, including AI assistants, copilots, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and intelligent automation workflows. Develop and maintain AI Agent and multi-agent orchestration solutions leveraging modern LLM frameworks and cloud-native services. Implement cloud infrastructure using Terraform and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) best practices. Develop and support data quality solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including services such as BigQuery, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, DataPlex, Vertex AI, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub, and Dataflow. Build APIs, integrations, and reusable libraries to support AI and data platform initiatives. Participate in evaluating and adopting emerging AI, LLM, and cloud technologies. Communicate technical concepts and solution designs effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. What You Bring: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. 2-4 years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or a related technical role. Strong programming skills in Python, including API development, automation, scripting, and application development; SQL, REST APIs, Git. Strong knowledge on Cloud & Infrastructure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, Cloud Functions, DevOps & Platform Engineering, CI/CD, Docker and IaaC. Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI applications, or AI-powered solutions. Experience building or contributing to AI Agent or agent orchestration frameworks is highly desirable. Familiarity with containerization and cloud-native deployment practices (Docker, Cloud Run, Kubernetes is a plus). Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with modern data platforms and analytical databases such as BigQuery. Exposure to data engineering concepts, data pipelines, and distributed data architectures is preferred. Basic understanding of data quality, observability, and data governance concepts is a plus. Use knowledge of Bunge’s business, structure and strategy to develop innovative solutions to improve results or eliminate problems. Build partnerships, appropriately influence to gain commitment, foster talent and coach others to grow in current or future roles. Drive …

items.desc: Why Qogita Wholesale is a $50 trillion market still working the way it did in 1950. 90% of transactions happen offline, over calls, catalogues and trade shows, and a product passes through four or five layers of distributors and wholesalers before it reaches a store, with every party deciding on a fraction of the picture. By the time it hits the shelf, it costs roughly 40% more than the maker charged. That inefficiency tax runs into the trillions, and everyone pays it every time they buy anything. Qogita is building the operating system that replaces that chain: a single order book connecting the global market, the rails to move goods across borders, and a self-learning system that does every job once, against real-time data about the whole market. That puts data science at the core of the product. Forecasting reads what is actually selling in every market as it sells, a buyer's basket is assembled from every available seller and split across the optimal combination, and every trade writes a record that sharpens the next price, allocation and route. It is a hard problem, spanning physical goods, thirty national regimes in Europe alone and buyers who are increasingly agents, and it is already working: 95% of transactions involve no human touch, and the business is doubling every year. The role You're a data scientist with strong quantitative and ML chops who can move between classical modelling, experimentation, and modern applied ML (including LLMs where they're the right tool). You'll own end-to-end data science work across Qogita's wholesale marketplace: framing ambiguous commercial problems, building models that ship, and keeping them healthy in production. The Data Science team partners with Product, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial to build the intelligence layer behind pricing, matching, demand, and product discovery. What You'll Do Build and deliver data science solutions across the stack: predictive models, ranking, demand forecasting, segmentation, pricing, experimentation, and LLM-powered features, depending on where the business need is greatest Take ownership of business-critical ML systems end-to-end: problem framing, model design, deployment, monitoring, and ongoing maintenance in production Translate ambiguous business problems into tractable ML or statistical problems with clear success criteria, working closely with Product and Commercial Apply quantitative methods (regression, causal inference, classical ML, and deep learning where useful) to pricing, demand, liquidity, supplier matching, catalogue enrichment, and related marketplace problems Design and analyse experiments and A/B tests, owning statistical validity and turning results into recommendations teams can act on Collaborate with Engineers to ship models via reproducible MLOps workflows: experiment tracking, model serving, alerting, and production monitoring Communicate model choices, limitations, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders What You'll Bring 3+ years as a data scientist, applied ML engineer, or quantitative analyst, with meaningful exposure across ML methods and statistical modelling A track record of owning models in production, not just building them: maintaining, monitoring, and iterating as live infrastructure Solid grounding in ML and stats fundamentals: probability, supervised and unsupervised learning, and measurement/validation discipline Strong Python and SQL; comfortable with large transactional datasets and common DS/ML libraries (e.g. pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch or similar) Experience collaborating on MLOps-style workflows (experiment tracking, serving, monitoring) and shipping with engineers Able to communicate uncertainty and model limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences Bachelor's or Master's in a quantitative field (Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Econometrics, Mathematics, CS, or related), or equivalent experience Nice to have (depth in one or more) Pricing and market economics: price theory, buyer behaviour, demand estimation, causal inference, experimentation with real commercial stakes Production LLM systems: RAG, evaluation frameworks, prompt/fine-tuning trade-offs, transformers and major model families, LangChain or similar Marketplace or B2B dynamics; items.desc:
Do you enjoy connecting the dots between project roadmaps and real results? As a Process Improvement Specialist II on the EU ACES PMO team, you will partner directly with Program Managers and organizational leaders to identify gaps between commitments and delivery plans, surface risks, and help teams hit their strategic goals. In this fixed-term role (eight months), you will make PMO services more efficient and make project and change management more straightforward for EU ACES and operations organizations across all miles. If you are a curious, self-starting problem solver who turns complexity into clarity, this is your chance to have a meaningful impact on how Amazon plans and delivers across Europe and the UK.
Key job responsibilities
- Partner with Program Managers and organizational leaders to review project roadmaps against commitments, identify gaps, and recommend practical paths to close them.
- Surface risks and report on opportunities to ACES leadership, providing clear visibility into project health and enabling timely decisions.
- Manage relationship with key stakeholders like Finance and partner PMO teams
- Coordinate across the PM network to unblock project progress, align priorities, and remove barriers that slow delivery.
- Contribute to the development of the PM community by sharing best practices, streamlining PMO processes, and supporting adoption of improved project and change management approaches.
- Leverage generative artificial intelligence tools where appropriate to augment productivity, evaluate outputs for quality, and apply responsible practices to accelerate analysis and documentation.
A day in the life

items.desc: Job Description Finance Data Platform Consultant Career level: Consultant (CL9) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Platform Transformation) Why this role Finance has always run on data infrastructure of some kind, but the modern data platform matters more to a finance function than it ever has, and this is where you learn to build one. You'll work on the finance data platforms our clients depend on: a governed foundation that holds the enterprise's financial data, integrates with the ERP estate producing it, and carries the reporting, analytics and AI the CFO's teams use. You'll be hands-on from the start: modelling data, building and testing the pipelines that feed the platform, and getting the numbers on it to agree with the ledger. You'll grow quickly, on real programmes, alongside people who architect this work for a living. Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients — and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients — stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control. "Every leader needs to think of themselves as a reinventor. … Being a reinventor is believing that every part of the enterprise and their product has to be reinvented using tech, data, AI—new ways of working, new ways of engaging." — Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO What you'll bring Working on the finance data platform. Hands-on experience of a modern cloud data platform (Snowflake, Databricks or Palantir Foundry, or something comparable) and a working grounding in how one is put together: the layers that take data from raw ingestion through a conformed core to the curated sets finance consumes, the data products built on top of them, and the access and security rules around them. You build and test what the design calls for. You write queries and transformations that are efficient as well as correct, because compute on these platforms is a cost the client pays for, and you can explain why a piece of finance data sits where it does. Integration with the ERP estate. Financial data originates in the ERP and the applications around it, and the integration is where most of the difficulty sits. You'll build and test the connections into that estate (SAP, Oracle or whatever a client runs) across subledgers and the general ledger, consolidation, close and reconciliation tooling. You work with ETL, ELT and API patterns, with both scheduled batch loads and change-data-capture feeds, and you handle the things source systems do in practice: master data that changes underneath you, late postings, restatements and reopened periods. You take reconciliation seriously. What the platform reports has to agree with what the ledger says, and building the tests and monitoring that prove it is often your job, as is catching a broken feed before it reaches a reporting pack. Enterprise structure and finance master data. An awareness of how a finance data model reflects the legal, management and reporting structure of the enterprise: chart of accounts, entities and ledgers, cost and profit centre hierarchies, and the finance master data underneath them. The same work runs on ERP programmes, where chart-of-accounts and finance master data design are core workstreams, so this is capability you can put to use on a platform build and on an ERP implementation alike. You'll work within the governance and lineage the design sets, document what you build, and keep a figure in a report traceable back to the transaction behind it. Analytics and reporting. This is what the platform is there to serve, and a good part of your work will sit here: building management reporting, the datasets behind self-service analytics, and the semantic and metrics definitions underneath both, so a measure such as margin or cost to serve means the same thing in every report that uses it. You'll build and test those models and reports, check the numbers behind them against the ledger, and work with the finance people who use them on what they need. AI on the platform. This is where financial data turns into decisions: predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, AI-generated commentary and agentic workflows among the use cases, along with the human-in-the-loop controls that keep finance in charge of what the models produce. You'll build the data behind them, and there is every opportunity to be part of those conversations and the design work as the use cases take shape. Experience of analytics or AI work in a finance setting is a real plus, not something we expect you to arrive with. Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and follow it through, and you support the team around you. You're comfortable in workshops and …

This is a highly data-driven role at the intersection of quantitative finance, Natural Language Processing (NLP), machine learning and AI . A key focus will be applying modern NLP and AI techniques to proprietary, unstructured and semi-structured financial information, transforming text-rich datasets into structured intelligence, predictive signals and commercially valuable data products. The successful candidate will combine rigorous quantitative and statistical skills with practical experience using NLP, machine learning and AI/LLM approaches to extract insight from complex financial content. Skills & Experience 5+ years’ experience in quantitative research, quantitative analysis or financial data science, ideally within a hedge fund, investment bank or similar financial markets environment. Alternatively, relevant experience within a fintech, financial-data or AI business. Proven experience deriving actionable or tradable signals from unstructured or semi-structured financial data . Strong practical experience in Natural Language Processing (NLP), machine learning and AI , particularly applied to text-based or alternative datasets. Experience with sentiment analysis, information extraction, text classification and/or LLM-based approaches to analysing financial information. Strong knowledge of statistical modelling, econometrics and time-series analysis. Strong programming skills, with Python preferred . Understanding of back-testing, statistical significance and out-of-sample validation. Experience with financial markets data; macro, fixed income, FX, commodities or credit experience is particularly relevant. Strong quantitative academic background, ideally mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, engineering or econometrics. Ability to communicate complex quantitative, NLP and AI methodologies to both technical and commercial audiences. Key Responsibilities Analyse proprietary historical and unstructured datasets to identify correlations with asset prices and potential tradable or predictive signals . Apply NLP and AI techniques to extract, classify and quantify information contained within large volumes of text-based financial content. Use machine learning, sentiment analysis and LLM/AI approaches to transform unstructured information into structured, machine-readable signals and analytics. Apply statistical and econometric techniques including time-series analysis, regression, cointegration and signal validation. Explore how modern AI and NLP methodologies can enhance existing datasets and create new quantitative data products and signals . Develop robust back-testing and out-of-sample validation frameworks. Improve the machine-readability, metadata and governance of proprietary datasets. Build reproducible research pipelines and establish quantitative data standards and best practices. Translate quantitative, NLP and AI research into commercial, client-facing datasets, signals and analytics products . Author technical research and white papers demonstrating methodologies, AI/NLP applications and findings.

Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen, um zu schauen, wie du uns als Projektreferent Neue Technologien (all people) unterstützen kannst! Die Versicherungsforen Leipzig unterstützen Unternehmen der Versicherungswirtschaft bei ihren Forschungs- und Entwicklungsvorhaben. Wir erforschen und analysieren neue Trends, erarbeiten daraus konkrete Anforderungen für Versicherungsunternehmen und entwickeln gemeinsam Lösungsansätze. Neben F&E-Projekten wie Studien, Marktanalysen oder Strategieberatung sind wir als Anbieter von Aus- und Weiterbildungsformaten wie Seminaren, Fachkonferenzen und Messekongressen bekannt. Mit dem GenAI Hub Leipzig bündeln wir unser Know-how zu generativer KI für die Branche. Das bewirkst du bei uns: Du beobachtest Werkzeuge und Modelle im Bereich GenAI, bereitest deine Erkenntnisse auf und leitest daraus die richtigen Schlüsse für Versicherer ab. Du konzipierst und hältst Schulungen, Workshops und Vorträge, vom Prompt-Engineering-Kurs über Impulsvorträge bis zur mehrtägigen Akademie, passend für Fachbereiche, Führungskräfte und Nachwuchs. Bei KI-Vorhaben berätst du Versicherungsunternehmen, definierst und priorisierst Anwendungsfälle, etwa in der KI-gestützten Dokumenten- und Prozessverarbeitung, und begleitest Ausschreibungen und die Anbieterauswahl. Auch technisch setzt du selbst um: Du entwickelst Demonstratoren und Lösungen, zum Beispiel Agentensysteme, LLM-Pipelines, Low-Code-Automatisierungen im Microsoft-Umfeld und Bewertungswerkzeuge, und prüfst gemeinsam mit uns, welche davon zu Produkten werden können. items.desc:
Fellow position 
 Location: Center for Advanced Biomaterials for Health Care (CABHC), Naples 
 Step into a world of endless possibilities, together let’s leave something for the future! 
 At IIT, we are committed to advancing human-centered Science and Technology to address the most urgent societal challenges of our era. We foster excellence in both fundamental and applied research, spanning fields such as neuroscience and cognition, humanoid technologies and robotics, artificial intelligence, nanotechnology, and material sciences, offering a truly interdisciplinary scientific experience. Our approach integrates cutting-edge tools and technology, empowering researchers to push the limits of knowledge and innovation. With us, your curiosity will know no bounds.
 We are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities and fostering diversity in all its forms, creating an inclusive environment. We value the unique experiences, knowledge, backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives of our people. By embracing diversity, we believe science can achieve its fullest potential.
 THE ROLE 
 You will be working in a multicultural and multi-disciplinary group, where junior and senior scientists collaborate, each with their expertise, to carry out a scientific activity with a shared research goal.
 The Bio-logic Research unit is coordinated by Prof. Paolo Netti . The research focuses on the development of advanced in vitro models to investigate the functional communication between the nervous system and peripheral tissues. The activity will contribute to the generation of interconnected biological models reproducing peripheral innervation and barrier tissue interfaces, with particular emphasis on their response to biochemical stimuli and selected compounds.
 Within the research team, your main responsibilities will be:
 Development and characterization of in vitro models integrating peripheral neuronal components with barrier tissue models
 Investigation of innervation and functional communication between neural and non-neural tissue compartments
 ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS 
 A MSc degree in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology , or related disciplines
 Documented experience with mammalian cell culture and advanced 3D in vitro models 
 Familiarity with multicellular, co-culture, or 3D culture systems for studying interactions between different cell or tissue compartments
 Knowledge of cellular and morphological characterization techniques, in particular histological analysis
 Experience with barrier tissue models or neuronal cultures or peripheral nervous system models is considered a plus
 Experience in the evaluation of cellular and tissue responses to biochemical compounds or external stimuli is highly considered
 Good command of spoken and written English
 ADDITIONAL SKILLS 
 Experience in disease modeling is considered a plus
 Interest in neural tissue engineering and neurodegenerative disease modeling
 Ability to work in a challenging and international environment
 Capacity to work autonomously and collaboratively in a highly interdisciplinary environment
 Possess Analytical Reasoning skills and a growth mindset
 COMPENSATION PACKAGE 
 A yearly gross salary of 30.000,00 euro
 Private health care coverage depending on your role and contract
 Candidates from abroad or Italian citizens who have carried scientific research activity permanently abroad and meet specific requirements, may be entitled to a deduction from taxable income of up to 90% from 6 to 13 years.
 This open position is financed by "Gemelli digitali per le malattie del sistema nervoso centrale e la Medicina personalizzata” (acronimo: GEMINI, hub capofila: RAISE S.c.a.r.l., hub congiunto: MNESYS S.c.a.r.l.) per la realizzazione dell’Azione 1.1.2 prevista dal Decreto Direttoriale n. 307 del 18/03/2025 nell’ambito del Programma Nazionale Ricerca, Innovazione e Competitività per la transizione verde e digitale 2021-2027 (PN-RIC 2021-2027) ammessa al finanziamento in data 03/03/2026 (Decreto Direttoriale n. 766 del 03/03/2026 e relativi allegati, cod. items.desc: At Orfium, we’re building the future of music rights and royalties through technology and data. We are looking for a skilled Software Backend Engineer to join our rapidly growing teams. By joining the Data Platform team, you will be the driving force behind the tools and infrastructure that empower every domain team across the company, enabling dozens of engineers and analysts to build, deploy, and manage their data products. This position heavily emphasizes cloud-based infrastructure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and modern software development best practices. This is a unique opportunity to grow your engineering skills while working with modern data tools like Airflow, DBT, Snowflake, and AWS, making it the perfect role for an engineer eager to champion DataOps principles and learn critical data engineering concepts. Responsibilities Platform Maintenance & Modernisation: Design, maintain, and enhance platform services and tooling focused on data replication, pipeline orchestration, and containerized transformations. Aiming on technical debt reduction while strengthening the reliability of shared services. Observability: Implement robust monitoring, logging, and alerting for our core infrastructure and data workflows. You will help ensure our platform stays highly reliable, observable, and easy to troubleshoot. AI & Agentic Workflows: Explore and integrate AI agents to automate routine operational tasks and enhance the platform's self-healing capabilities. GitOps & CI/CD: Help create seamless, self-service workflows via GitHub Actions, enabling other teams to safely deploy their own infrastructure. Enablement: Help domain teams adopt new platform capabilities as they roll out, and turn recurring support questions into documentation or tooling. Requirements 2-4 years of professional experience in backend software engineering, internal tooling, or platform development. Proficiency in object-oriented development with a strong preference for Python (experience in Ruby, Java, or C# also considered) Excellent understanding of Version Control (e.g., Git) and exposure to CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions). Experience with Infrastructure As Code concepts and tools (e.g., AWS CDK & Cloudformation,Terraform, Pulumi) Strong experience with cloud service providers (e.g. AWS, GCP, Azure) and Docker containerization. Hands-on SQL experience and an understanding of relational databases or modern cloud data warehouses. Understanding of Modern System Architectures, Design Patterns, Data Structures, and distributed systems. A proactive, collaborative mindset with a strong appetite for learning new technologies in the DataOps space. Nice to Have Experience with system observability, logging, and monitoring tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana). Experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT workflows, using tools like Airflow for orchestration and DBT for transformation and modeling. Hands-on experience with modern data warehousing platforms, ideally Snowflake (or Databricks). Familiarity with modern web frameworks (e.g., FastAPI, Django). Love for music. items.desc: We are a bank that develops innovative solutions. How we build them is changing: AI tools and agents now do much of the construction, and the scarce skill is framing the problem precisely, specifying the solution, directing the tools, and owning the result. We're looking for a Product Engineer to join our Technology, Product and Innovation division. You'll be an analytical thinker with an engineering mindset who turns ambiguous business problems into working, production-ready solutions. You'll do it largely by writing clear specifications and context that AI development tools execute against, within our internal AI development frameworks. You'll work mostly independently, taking problems from first question to production, and draw on a small group of experts when you need them. This is a fully on-site role based at our Athens office. A background in software engineering is essential, as this role is about specifying product features precisely, directing AI to build them, and taking accountability for what ships. What you will do Take a business problem from vague to precise: ask the right questions, uncover the real need, map the process, data and rules involved, and define what "done" looks like. Write clear, structured specifications (requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria, edge cases and failure scenarios) that AI tools and agents can execute reliably. Direct AI tools through prototyping, building, testing and documenting, and iterate quickly from idea to working proof. Validate outcomes rather than code: define test scenarios up front, confirm the solution behaves correctly against them, and recognize when results don't match intent. Anticipate the exceptions: unusual data, failure modes, integration issues and regulatory edge cases that the happy path never covers. Know when to escalate. Bring in security, architecture, platform or domain experts at the right moment instead of working around gaps. Take solutions through to production and keep improving them using real usage, data and feedback. Present your work with confidence: explain solutions, trade-offs and results to colleagues, senior stakeholders and wider audiences, in meetings, demos and internal forums. Work within our internal AI development frameworks, standards and guardrails, applying them consistently and feeding back what you learn so they improve. Collaborate closely with a small number of experts across product, risk, operations and engineering, while driving execution yourself. Adapt as priorities shift: pick up new projects, join new teams and hand over your work cleanly, with documentation others can build on, as projects change and team members rotate. Competitive compensation package; Annual bonus based on your performance and targets' achievement; Private health insurance for you and your family; Top of the Line tools and equipment; Career development and regular feedback to develop your skills; ‍ ️ Employee Wellness Program like Daily group sessions led by professional coaches Candidate Requirements: What we are looking for Essential A university degree in engineering. You understand how systems, data and integrations fit together and can reason about how they fail. Strong command of C# and .NET, plus solid SQL and data modelling. A firm grasp of system design: APIs, distributed systems, concurrency and security fundamentals. Testing discipline, CI/CD, and experience running systems in production, including observability and incident handling. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents, and a clear view of where they go wrong. Fluency in English, written and spoken. Excellent presentation and public speaking skills, with the confidence to present to groups and senior audiences. Strong social and interpersonal skills. You build relationships quickly and communicate comfortably with technical and non-technical colleagues alike. A track record of delivering complex solutions or projects from concept to production, in any technical or analytical setting. Thinking Strong analytical and structured-thinking skills. You break down ambiguous problems, test assumptions and make pragmatic decisions. Excellent written communication. You can express intent, logic and constraints precisely enough that someone, or something, else can execute them. Sound judgment on risk, quality and trade-offs, and the instinct to spot what's missing or wrong in a solution. Working style Evidence of working with AI tools or agentic workflows, and the ability to learn and operate quickly within a defined framework and its controls. High ownership and autonomy. You drive execution end to end without close direction. Strong teamwork. You work well with a few experts at a time, share knowledge openly and put the team's outcome ahead of individual credit. items.desc: About The Company ITOL Recruit is a renowned recruitment and training organization with over 15 years of experience in connecting talented professionals with leading companies across various industries. Committed to empowering individuals through comprehensive training programs, ITOL Recruit specializes in providing industry-recognized certifications, personalized career support, and job placement services. Their mission is to bridge the gap between emerging industry demands and skilled professionals, ensuring both candidates and employers benefit from tailored solutions. With a focus on technological advancements and market trends, ITOL Recruit has built a reputation for delivering high-quality training courses that prepare individuals for in-demand roles in fields such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data science, and more. About The Role The Trainee AI Engineer role at ITOL Recruit is designed for individuals seeking to launch or accelerate their careers in artificial intelligence and machine learning. This is a comprehensive training program that equips participants with the fundamental skills and practical experience needed to succeed as AI engineers. The program is ideal for career changers, recent graduates, or professionals looking to upskill in a high-demand industry. Upon successful completion of the training, candidates are guaranteed job placement, with potential starting salaries ranging from £28,000 to £45,000. The program emphasizes hands-on learning, real-world projects, and industry-recognized certifications, making it an excellent pathway into the rapidly evolving field of AI. Qualifications Candidates interested in this program should possess a strong interest in technology and problem-solving. While no prior experience in AI or programming is required, applicants should demonstrate motivation, curiosity, and a willingness to learn. Basic computer literacy and familiarity with digital tools are advantageous. Successful candidates typically have a high school diploma or equivalent; however, a background in mathematics, computer science, or related fields can be beneficial. The program is designed to be accessible to beginners, providing all necessary foundational knowledge and support throughout the training journey. Responsibilities During the training program, participants will undertake a series of structured learning modules and projects that cover essential AI concepts and skills. Responsibilities include engaging actively in online coursework, completing practical assignments, and participating in project work to develop real-world applications. Trainees will learn to build and deploy AI models, work with data collection and preprocessing, and utilize industry-standard tools such as Jupyter Notebooks, VS Code, and cloud platforms like AWS. Additionally, participants will develop expertise in Python programming, machine learning algorithms, prompt engineering, and ethical considerations in AI. The program culminates in capstone projects such as building AI-powered chatbots and sentiment analysis classifiers, which demonstrate their ability to apply learned skills in practical scenarios. Throughout the program, trainees are supported by dedicated tutors and career advisors to ensure they meet learning objectives and prepare for employment. Benefits Participants in the ITOL Recruit AI Traineeship enjoy a range of benefits designed to facilitate their career transition and professional growth. The program is fully online and self-paced, allowing learners to study flexibly around their existing commitments. Certification is included, with the Microsoft AI-900 certification recognized globally. Trainees receive one-on-one tutoring and recruitment support, enhancing their learning experience and job prospects. The program provides hands-on experience through real-world projects, preparing participants for immediate employment. Upon successful completion, candidates are eligible for a job guarantee, ensuring they either secure employment in the AI field or receive a full refund of their training fees. The starting salary potential is competitive, reflecting the high demand for AI professionals in the current job market. Equal Opportunity ITOL Recruit is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse environment. They believe that talent and potential are not limited by background, gender, ethnicity, or circumstances. The organization provides equal opportunity to all applicants and trainees, ensuring that everyone has access to quality training and employment opportunities. They promote a culture of fairness, respect, and support, aiming to empower individuals from all walks of life to succeed in the technology industry. ITOL Recruit adheres to all applicable anti-discrimination laws and continuously strives to create a welcoming environment for all members of their community.

Within it, Technology Transformation & Delivery is the control tower for complex execution: we deliver transformation at
items.desc: Job Description: Technology Transformation & Delivery Consultant Location: London, Manchester, Edinburgh Career Level: Consultant (ML9) About The Team Technology Strategy & Transformation leads at the intersection of business and technology, driving client value through AI, technology and data. Within it, Technology Transformation & Delivery is the control tower for complex execution: we deliver transformation at speed and scale for COO and CIO clients running technology modernisation, AI integration, data platform transformation and complex integration or divestment. Transformation Delivery: delivery leaders embedded in our clients' most complex programmes, providing execution leadership, risk management and value tracking from initiation to go-live. Transformation Office: establishing and running the governance, planning and controls framework that keeps a complex portfolio aligned, using AI-driven programme intelligence to surface risks early and give leadership accurate visibility of progress and value. The transformation office is being reinvented. Reporting assembled by hand is becoming automated; risk found in a weekly forum is being surfaced by models reading delivery data live; plans maintained manually are being tested against simulation. We are building the AI-led methods, playbooks and reinvention offices behind that shift. Consultants joining now will help build how we work, not just execute it. The role: You will be hands-on inside a client transformation office or delivery team, running the governance, planning, risk and reporting engine that keeps a large transformation on track. You will own discrete areas of a workstream with support from a Manager or Senior Manager, and you will be the person who makes the plan, the risk picture and the reporting credible. Where that work is currently manual, we expect you to be looking for how it shouldn't be. This role is industry agnostic at point of hire. You will work across Health & Public Services, Products, Resources, Financial Services and Communications, Media & Technology. Where you bring industry depth we will use it; where you don't, we will help you build it. The work Engagements vary and no two Consultants do the same job. The areas below run across the practice; you will typically focus on two or three at a time and build breadth as you move between clients. Transformation office delivery: running the operating rhythm of a programme or workstream, from planning cycles to governance forums. Risk and dependency management: owning the risk picture, driving resolution, and escalating with a recommendation rather than a flag. Programme intelligence and reporting: building automated reporting and dashboards that give leadership a live, trusted view of progress, risk and value. Integrated planning: maintaining plans across multiple workstreams and vendors, keeping cross-dependencies visible and current. Value tracking: measuring and reporting whether the value case is landing as the programme progresses. Change management and business readiness: supporting the organisation through the human side of transformation, from stakeholder engagement to adoption and embedding. AI-led ways of working: applying AI and automation to delivery — including agentic methods and Digital Twin design — and contributing to the industrialised accelerators the practice is building. Essential What we're looking for Delivery experience within a transformation office or programme environment, on technology-enabled transformation. Working knowledge of integrated planning, risk and issue management, governance and executive reporting. Strong analytical skills: comfortable finding the story in programme data and presenting it to a senior audience. Interest in how AI changes delivery, with evidence you have started applying it. Hands-on with at least one delivery or reporting toolset (Power BI, Power Platform, Azure DevOps, Jira, Clarity or similar). Confident communicator, comfortable operating in ambiguity. Desirable Agile, waterfall and hybrid delivery exposure. Building automated or low-code solutions to replace manual delivery processes. Business readiness, benefits tracking or process reengineering experience. Certification such as PRINCE2, MSP, P3O, APM, Scrum or SAFe. Consulting experience, or client-side delivery alongside a consulting partner. What We Offer A practice being rebuilt around AI-led delivery, with real scope to shape how it operates. Our most complex client programmes, and a clear path to Manager. Continuous learning, including Accenture's AI and delivery capability programmes. What’s In It For You At Accenture in addition to a competitive basic salary, you will also have an extensive benefits package, private medical insurance and 3 extra days leave per year for charitable work of your choice! Accenture reserves the right to close the role prior to this date should a suitable applicant be found.
