About this opportunity
 Ericsson’s Early Career Program is an 18-month journey for you who are recently graduated or have up to five years of relevant experience. Through three rotations, including one international and market exposure, you will tackle challenges that matter, work alongside people who expect you to contribute, question, and move things forward. 
The Excellerate track is designed to develop future leaders who are motivated by performance, pace, and commercial impact. You’ll rotate across Sales, Commercial Management, Sourcing, Strategy, Supply, Finance and more. Working on priorities that directly influence results and learning how different parts of the business connect to create value. 
This isn’t a programme where you sit on the sidelines. From day one, you’re hired into a role, trusted to contribute, supported to grow, and expected to make an impact. Find out more about the Early Career program here . Your journey within the Early Career Program will start as a NMS Sourcing Business Partner . 
 What you will do
 You will join the NMS Sourcing Expert Unit, part of Ericsson’s Network & Managed Services (NMS) Sourcing organization. The team brings together expertise in network and managed services sourcing and works with business teams, suppliers and market areas to develop competitive, cost-effective and compliant sourcing solutions. 
The team combines strategic sourcing with practical problem-solving and cross-functional collaboration. In this graduate role, you will help explore how AI and data can simplify work, improve processes and support better sourcing decisions.
 Identify and prioritize high-value AI use cases across cost and spend analysis, productification, process improvement and management reporting. 
 Assess how AI can connect data, insights and workflows to streamline activities and improve sourcing decisions 
 Work with stakeholders across Ericsson to test and responsibly implement selected AI solutions. 
 Develop practical AI concepts, prototypes, agentic workflows and reusable playbooks that can be scaled across the organization 
 Support the development of AI competence within Sourcing communities through demonstration, knowledge sharing, and hands-on enablement. 
The skills you bring: 
 A practical interest in generative AI, AI agents, automation and digital product development. 
 Experience or academic exposure to data analysis, process improvement, prototyping, prompt design or translating business needs into digital solutions. 
 Strong analytical skills and the ability to structure complex or ambiguous problems. 
 Open-minded, with a willingness to consider new perspectives and approaches. 
 Structured and able to organize ideas, information and tasks effectively. 
 Curious and explorative, with an interest in testing new possibilities. 
 Why join Ericsson? At Ericsson, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build solutions never seen before to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you won’t be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.
 What happens once you apply? Click Here to find all you need to know about what our typical hiring process looks like.Encouraging a diverse and inclusive organization is core to our values at Ericsson, that's why we champion it in everything we do. We truly believe that by collaborating with people with different experiences we drive innovation, which is essential for our future growth. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply and realize their full potential as part of our Ericsson team. Ericsson is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. learn more.

This is a role for people who do the
items.desc:
Overview 
 Microsoft Frontier Company is redefining how enterprises transform — bringing agentic AI, cloud-scale computing, data, simulation, and human expertise together so customers turn ambition into measurable business impact. As customers look to reinvent how work gets done — redesigning business processes, operating models, and human-agent ways of working across industries and functions — they need more than a platform. They need experts who can understand their business outcomes, reinvent new ways of working, and enable their employees to adopt that change at speed. 
 The AI Workforce Reinvention Architect will be the specialist on the ground with customers developing the new ways of working, deploying agents and AI to enable and reinforce those patterns, and empower customers to own the behavioral transformation as they evolve from AI experimentation to AI-native operations. In this role, you will own the end-to-end operations reinvention with the end results being a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a one-off program. You will embed AI-first ways of working into culture, processes, and performance systems, working directly with business, technology and HR leaders, along with Microsoft account teams, industry specialists, and engineers. 
 This is a role for people who do the higher-judgment human work that technology can inform but not perform. You will help customer reimage how people and agents work together – while shaping repeatable patterns specific to industries and functions. If you’re energized by making change stick rather than launching programs that fade, this role is for you. 
 In this role you bring a unique blend of technical, industry, and change management expertise. Your edge is translating a customer’s business outcomes into a tangible operating model, powered by agents, with a clear path for adoption. Customers feel confident investing in frontier transformation because they see a viable plan for their teams to transform in parallel. 
 Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond. 
 Responsibilities 
 Workforce Reinvention 
 Define new ways of working and employee roles based on the customer’s industry, function, and business outcomes/KPIs 
 Design and deploy agents and AI systems that empower and scale employees and teams to execute 
 Deliver retraining programmes ensuring no employee is left behind 
 Embed AI adoption into performance evaluations and onboarding processes 
 Protect employee privacy to maintain trust and stay on the right side of regulations 
 Strategic Change Leadership 
 Design and execute comprehensive operating model changes powered by AI with enterprise scale, structured as a continuous, always-on cycle rather than a fixed, one-off sequence 
 Conduct AI/Agent readiness assessments to identify organisational barriers and enablers 
 Develop AI literacy plans that position AI and agents as new ways of working, not tools 
 Establish and lead AI Council and Champion networks to drive grassroots adoption through the informal networks of trusted peers 
 Adoption Programme Delivery 
 Implement a structured adoption framework powered by workplace adoption analytics and role-based enablement 
 Coordinate communications, training, and champion efforts across thousands of users 
 Drive behavioural change by creating recognition rather than pushing content at them 
 Scale training globally: live sessions, on-demand tutorials, internal support communities 
 Stakeholder Engagement 
 Facilitate business and technology leadership workshops and roundtables to design for required impact and scale 
 Ensure cross-functional collaboration across IT, HR, operations, and business unit leadership on how work will change and their hands-on role 
 Build trust through responsible experimentation and transparent communication 
 Monitor usage statistics and qualitative feedback, adjusting programmes to maintain momentum, and measure success by whether change persists at 90, 180, and 360 days 
 Qualifications 
 Required/minimum qualifications 
 Master's OR Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science , Information Technology, Engineering, or related field AND several years of experience in technology solutions, practice development, architecture, consulting, and/or technology domain (e.g., Security) OR equivalent experience. 
 Solid experience in managing multiple projects or portfolios. 
 E xperience leading blended, multidisciplinary teams. 
 Additional or preferred qualifications 
 Solid experience in managing cross-functional teams 
 Demonstrated success leading change programmes across 5,000+ user populations 
 Experience with AI/ML adoption programmes or …

items.desc: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts. Job Category Enterprise Technology & Infrastructure Job Details About Salesforce Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce. About the Team The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce’s own business running. We operate Data 360, CRM Analytics, and Tableau, the data and analytics foundation for how Salesforce sells, serves, and makes decisions. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams. Keep it up. Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do. Make it stable. Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings. Run it well. Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent. Make it easy to get help. One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents. Be Customer Zero. Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering. items.desc: About us Omniscient delivers real-time intelligence that helps organisations and leaders make better decisions, faster. Our platform brings together public and internal data to help corporates, investors and public institutions detect risks, understand shifts in their environment and act with greater confidence. Combining intuitive dashboards with AI-powered analysis, Omniscient turns complex, fast-moving signals into clear, actionable intelligence, from reputation monitoring and geopolitical developments to competitive positioning and narrative change. We help decision-makers track what matters across their ecosystem, benchmark against peers, and stay ahead of emerging threats and opportunities. The role We are hiring a data scientist who ships: someone who takes NLP and LLM work from experiment to production, and owns it there. You will shape how Omniscient reads the world: how large volumes of multilingual signals are cleaned, classified, scored and enriched, and how our agents turn them into analysis an executive can act on. The role sits where research, product and engineering meet. The role is broad by design. Models, agents and data are the core, but a large share of the work is the full-stack and infrastructure that bring them to our users. We are a small team: when the fire is elsewhere, you go there. We need someone who builds reliably, thinks in systems, uses coding agents effectively, and helps the team ship faster without compromising quality. What you will do Product mindset. Understand what an executive or an analyst does with what the models produce. Turn a business need into a task you can measure. Own part of the PO or PM duties on the AI side. Models and scoring. Classification, sentiment, entity recognition and resolution, topic extraction, summarisation, translation and risk scoring, on multilingual text and increasingly on images and video. Pick the right approach for each job: prompting, fine-tuning, embeddings or classic ML. Agents. Design and improve our multi-agent layer: tools, context, orchestration. Connect new data sources and tools to the agents, including through MCP. Retrieval. Embeddings, chunking, indexing and retrieval quality. Give the agents context they can actually use. Evaluation. Build evaluation sets and harnesses. Measure quality, drift, hallucination and cost per call. We want to get to the point where nothing ships without a number, and you will lead that. Data. Explore, clean and label large, messy text datasets. Deduplicate, normalise, find the gaps. Work hand in hand with data engineering on pipelines and data quality. Full-stack development. Own the UX, the back end and all the supporting infrastructure that bring an agent or a model to life for our users. Research. Follow the literature, run experiments, write them up so the team can build on them. Work with academic partners when it helps. Cost. LLM spend is a first-class design constraint: the right model for each job, caching, batching, distillation. Production. Ship models and agents as services (C# and Python), monitor them, own them. You build it, you run it. You take your turn on call. Productivity. Use coding agents wisely. Write skills and routines. Automate what can be automated. Constantly strive to increase the productivity of the team. What we look for Applied NLP and ML. Strong fundamentals, with hands-on experience of modern LLM-based approaches: transformers, embeddings, fine-tuning, evaluation, retrieval-augmented workflows. Python and SQL. You write production code, not only notebooks, and a statically typed language does not scare you. Shipped and lived with it. At least one model or LLM feature taken into production and maintained afterwards. Research depth, a real plus. A PhD or research experience in NLP, machine learning, computational linguistics or applied mathematics, as long as you want to ship. A builder at heart. You have a genuine passion for shipping slick products. Here, that means crafting a new form of executive intelligence. Agentic development. We are an AI-powered organisation, laser-focused and built around efficiency and agentic workflows. You already build with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or similar) and they are central to how you work. You keep learning, look for better ways, automate your own work and share with your peers. We want people with the same drive to build fast and efficiently. Fundamentals over framework years. With agents, we need fewer specialists in one tool and more people with sharp concepts and the appetite to learn. We do not need eight years in each of our frameworks. Fluent professional English. You work with colleagues and clients in English without friction. French is a plus, not a requirement. Paris. Based in Paris or ready to move, and in the office at least three days a week. We know it’s a lot, and we don’t expect you to know everything: equivalent technologies and experiences count too. But learn, be afraid of nothing, …

items.desc: Location: remote, in a time zone that overlaps CET working hours. About us IOMETE is the sovereign data platform for the AI era. Enterprises run our data lakehouse, built on Apache Spark and Apache Iceberg, in their own trusted environment: on-premises, in their own cloud, or hybrid. It is built for regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare and government. Customer data never leaves the customer's trust perimeter, and the AI we build on it stays inside that perimeter too. Position overview We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated AI Software Engineer to join our team. We tackle a variety of exciting challenges, from connecting AI tools and models to the lakehouse to diagnosing Spark applications and troubleshooting failures. You'll build agents that run inside the customer's environment, on LLMs the customer provides or, later, on custom models we train for Spark tuning and troubleshooting. You'll also build the framework that defines those agents and the harness that runs, limits, traces and evaluates them. The AI team We are building the AI platform for the lakehouse — Lakehouse Intelligence. The team's roadmap includes, but is not limited to, the MCP Server for AI Agents, which lets AI tools query the lakehouse; the Model Gateway, through which IOMETE's AI features call models; agents for Spark application diagnosis, troubleshooting and onboarding; and SQL AI Functions, which run language models from inside a query. Down the road, you'll also get to fine-tune and build custom models for our platform's specific needs, small enough to run inside a customer's deployment. What you'll do Contribute to and maintain IOMETE's AI services, including the MCP Server for AI Agents, the Model Gateway, SQL AI Functions, and lakehouse-specific agents (such as Spark Application Diagnosis) and their harness. Build AI enablers: extend the IOMETE lakehouse and platform to support more AI-powered features, for example by making Spark job logs, query history and table metadata available to them. Be hands-on with Kubernetes, including the Helm charts that ship our AI services into each customer's deployment. Collaborate closely with external customer engineering teams to support integrations, troubleshoot complex issues and provide guidance for successful adoption of our platform. Participate in design discussions about agents, model access, evaluation, and overall systems architecture. Write the tests, docs and release notes for what you build. A feature is done when it has shipped with all of them. Review your teammates' work and provide feedback. What we're looking for 5+ years of professional experience in software engineering (we’re open to exceptional candidates with less experience who demonstrate deep systems knowledge and impact). Deep understanding of LLM-based systems in production – tool calling, structured output, retrieval, evaluation, and how they fail. Our AI features are written mostly in Python and Go. The data platform is built on the JVM, in Kotlin and Java, and new platform features are being built in Go. Production experience with any of these languages is a big plus, but we know strong engineers learn a new language fast. Familiarity with distributed systems and their challenges (e.g., data consistency, fault tolerance, scheduling). Fluency in English, both written and verbal — this role involves working with international customers and partners. Based in a time zone that overlaps Amsterdam working hours (CET/CEST). Preferred qualifications Hands-on experience across the AI stack: agents and their evaluation, tool protocols such as MCP, model routing and serving, and fine-tuning. Prior exposure to data platforms like Snowflake, Databricks, etc. Experience with Apache Spark (especially tuning Spark jobs), Apache Iceberg, or contributing to open-source compute engines. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes and Helm. What we offer Exciting projects and challenges. Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology. Ability to play a key role in shaping the direction, culture, and architecture of a young & growing engineering organization. Competitive compensation and stock options. items.desc: Why loveholidays? We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our trailblaze together culture is what drives our success, powered by our people and the way they work. Using progressive technology, we drive cutting-edge innovation and improve how our customers discover, book and experience their holidays. You’ll have the opportunity to accelerate your growth through meaningful challenges, new experiences and the freedom to shape your own path. You’ll create impact for our future by taking ownership, contributing to shared goals and helping shape what comes next, all as part of our enhanced international community of talented, collaborative and passionate teams. The Difference You’ll Make You’ll sit in the Applied AI who are part of the wider AI Centre of Excellence reporting to the Lead Applied AI Engineer. You’ll work closely with our business verticals, engineering, security, vendors and business stakeholders to build, administer and improve the AI-enabled systems and SaaS platforms that support our customers and colleagues. Together, the Centre of Excellence teams builds and operates applied and agentic AI workflows, SaaS services, integrations and data pipelines to deliver the business objectives of the supported verticals. You’ll contribute to production services from day one, developing your skills while improving reliability, automation and operational outcomes. The team sits within Business IT & AI Operations, providing the technical expertise, governance and operational ownership that help loveholidays scale intelligent automation and well-run business systems safely and effectively. Your Day-to-day Administer and continuously improve a rangeSaaS platforms and AI-enabled services, including configuration, access, environments, integrations and lifecycle management. Build and maintain applied and agentic AI workflows and automation pipelines that connect models, tools, business data, APIs and SaaS systems. Use Google ADK or similar frameworks to build, test and iterate on tool-using agents and AI-powered automations. Monitor service health, usage, cost and performance; lead testing, evaluation and incident triage to improve reliability and prevent recurring issues. Partner with product, engineering, security, vendors and business teams to translate needs into effective platform configurations, integrations and automations. Document configurations, dependencies and runbooks, applying secure change-management, governance and operational practices. Your Skillset SaaS Administration: Experience administering cloud-based business systems, including configuration, user access, environments, integrations, release management and vendor support. Applied AI & Agentic Workflows: Experience building agentic workflows that combine models, tools and business data, including orchestration, retrieval-augmented generation and evaluation. Familiarity with Google ADK or similar frameworks is desirable. API & Data Integration: Strong knowledge of REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven or scheduled pipelines for connecting SaaS platforms, AI services and backend systems. Familiarity with cloud environments, preferably Google Cloud Platform, CI/CD, observability, incident management and secure operational practices. The Interview Journey Intro with a member of the Talent Acquisition team - 30 mins 1st stage video interview with Lead Applied AI Engineer - 1 hour Applied AI and SaaS administration task Final stage with Director of Applied AI and senior stakeholders - 1 hour Perks Of Joining Us Company pension contributions at 5% Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum Ability to buy and sell annual leave Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers Our Commitment To Inclusion At loveholidays, we focus on creating an inclusive environment where everyone can contribute, grow and succeed. We value the different perspectives, experiences and ideas each person brings, because they help us work better together, challenge our thinking and make stronger decisions. As we continue to grow and evolve, we want everyone to feel supported and able to do their best work. We’re also committed to making our hiring process accessible, so please let our Talent Acquisition team know if you need any adjustments at any stage.

items.card: The Role: In this role you will work in the Platform team – a function for the deployment and evolution of the backend platform that underpins the core of the Xantura business. Key responsibilities: Own and advance a predictive modelling platform that scales across problem types and tenants, using it to design, implement, and iterate models (embedding-based sequence encoders, temporal survival models, gradient
items.desc: The Role: In this role you will work in the Platform team – a function for the deployment and evolution of the backend platform that underpins the core of the Xantura business. Key responsibilities: Own and advance a predictive modelling platform that scales across problem types and tenants, using it to design, implement, and iterate models (embedding-based sequence encoders, temporal survival models, gradient boosted decision trees) that predict key vulnerabilities in housing, health, and other social domains. Track developments in ML and frontier models, running structured experiments to bring promising techniques into production safely. Build robust evaluation pipelines, training datasets, and model infrastructure to support continuous improvement of natural language& predictive analytics. Ensure responsible AI deployment, embedding ethical and regulatory considerations into every stage of development. What are we looking for? Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related technical field – or equivalent practical experience. 3+ years of professional experience as an ML Engineer, or related role. Strong programming skills and production experience in Python. Experience building and maintaining data or ML pipelines with an orchestration tool such as Dagster (or Airflow, Prefect, etc.). Hands-on experience with common ML libraries and frameworks, e.g. PyTorch, scikit-learn, and gradient-boosting libraries such as XGBoost or LightGBM. Clear evidence of practical experience defining and deploying containerised systems, i.e.: Implementing APIs for internal services, e.g. via FastAPI; Deploying containerised systems to production, in particular via Kubernetes. In addition, the following would be an advantage: PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with a strong publication record in text analytics, representation learning, or applied predictive modelling. Working with vector databases and developing retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines – experience setting up/configuring vector DBs, as well as using, would be advantageous; Finding and productionising recent AI models (e.g. via Huggingface (transformers), OpenAI APIs); Building agentic systems (e.g. via LangChain, AutoGen, PydanticAI). Evidence of participating in Open-Source Software (OSS) development, public hackathons, or other sharable coding samples. Deep expertise in embedding-based architectures, including bi-encoders, cross encoders, etc. for long-horizon text or temporal prediction tasks. Practical experience building and serving production-ready, asynchronous APIs for embedding and/or other compute-intensive services. Proficiency in Python for building high-performance data and model pipelines, with strong software engineering discipline (testing, versioning, CI/CD). Good familiarity with the Azure ecosystem (Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Batch, Azure AI Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Azure Blob Storage, Azure Key Vault). Location This is a hybrid role based in our office in London. You would be expected to be able to work from the office at least 1-2 days per week. About Xantura At Xantura, we’re on a mission to reduce societal inequality by helping local authorities use data more effectively. Our AI-driven platform empowers frontline workers with the insights they need to prevent complex issues like homelessness or children being taken into care — before they happen. We make this possible by connecting siloed datasets, applying advanced machine learning to enrich the data, and using predictive analytics to identify those most at risk. Our platform then distills this into clear, actionable insights that help frontline staff intervene early and make a real difference. It’s an exciting time to join Xantura. We’re scaling quickly, bringing on new clients, strengthening our platform, and expanding into new areas. While we’re a technology company at heart, our true focus is on improving lives — and we’re looking for people who share that vision.

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als Medior AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je AI-oplossingen die dagelijks worden gebruikt. Je werkt op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering en ontwikkelt betrouwbare, schaalbare en uitlegbare toepassingen. Met jouw ervaring vertaal je klantvragen naar oplossingen die organisaties helpen beter te beslissen en te innoveren. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je samen met onder anderen Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers en Data Engineers. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en doorontwikkeling. Daarbij verdiep je je verder in Generative AI, Agentic AI, MLOps en Responsible AI. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Je kijkt kritisch naar wat AI daadwerkelijk oplevert en ontwikkelt samen met je team robuuste oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Daarbij houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Vertaal klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en robuuste oplossingen die in productie waarde leveren; Ontwikkel Generative AI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen, waaronder RAG-toepassingen; Bouw Agentic AI-oplossingen waarin agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders; Integreer AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en borg uitlegbaarheid en betrouwbaarheid; Test, monitor en verbeter antwoorden, agentgedrag, prestaties en kosten en onderzoek fouten en hallucinaties. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Je maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan. Je komt terecht in een hechte community met communitydagen, workshops, open podia en intervisiesessies. Je krijgt toegang tot inhouse trainingen in AI, MLOps, communicatie en leiderschap, afgestemd op jouw ambities. Je ontwikkelt je consultancyvaardigheden en deelt actief kennis met collega’s en klanten. Je groeit verder als inhoudelijk expert, lead engineer of richting thought leadership. Je werkt aan opdrachten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland, waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan innovatie en betere besluitvorming. Je kunt daarnaast rekenen op Een vast contract van 32, 36 of 40 uur met een beloningsbudget tot €7.100, bruto per maand incl. vakantiegeld en mobiliteitsvergoeding; Je kunt bij ons kiezen voor de manier van reizen die het beste bij je past zoals een leaseauto (elektrisch), kilometervergoeding en je krijgt een NS-Business Card, of een combinatie daarvan; We motiveren een actieve levenstijl daarom bieden wij daarbovenop een fietsleaseplan via Lease A Bike; 26 vakantiedagen met optie tot bijkopen, een onkostenvergoeding en een jaarlijkse bonus vanaf C-Grade; Met onze Benefits at Work krijg je kortingen bij webshops zoals bol.com, HEMA en Wehkamp, én voordeel op activiteiten, elektronica en meer; Een sterk inhouse L&D-programma, een onbeperkt opleidingsbudget en actieve vakinhoudelijke communities waar kennisdeling en groei centraal staan; Ruimte om bij te dragen aan een duurzamere toekomst via een duurzaamheidsbudget en flexregelingen; Aandacht voor (mentale) gezondheid, met initiatieven zoals OpenUp, ouderschapstrainingen, vitaliteitswebinars en een korting op je sportabonnement; Toegang tot inspirerende events zoals Women@Sogeti en SoPlay, waar tech en verbinding samenkomen. Jouw talenten en ervaring Je hebt hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau en 2 tot 4 jaar relevante ervaring als AI/ML Engineer of in een vergelijkbare data-rol. Je hebt sterke kennis van machine learning, LLM’s en software engineering en ervaring met prompt engineering. Je programmeert in Python, werkt met Git en kunt code schrijven, testen, documenteren en onderhouden. Je hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals PyTorch, TensorFlow en/of scikit-learn. Je werkt met API's, dataverwerking en moderne data- en cloudomgevingen en begrijpt MLOps en deployment. Je kunt technische keuzes, bijdragen en resultaten helder uitleggen aan technische en niet-technische stakeholders. Je bent communicatief vaardig, nieuwsgierig, neemt eigenaarschap en staat open voor feedback. Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift (C1-niveau). Meer over Sogeti Bij Sogeti krijg je de ruimte om de beste versie van jezelf te worden als professional, collega én mens. Je werkt in een warme community waar kennis delen vanzelfsprekend is. Dankzij onze sterke lokale aanwezigheid werk je aan projecten met echte impact, die je samen met jouw team tot een succes maakt! Bij Sogeti geloven we in diversiteit en inclusie: iedereen is welkom en mag zichzelf zijn. Klaar om impact te maken? Solliciteer als Medior AI Engineer Twijfel je of dit helemaal past? App ons, dan kijken we samen. Heb je vragen of wil je meer weten? Neem contact op met Klodin Shahroudi (Recruiter AI & A). items.desc: Deine Aufgaben Du sorgst dafür, dass KI-Anwendungsfälle im operativen Alltag komplexer Industrierisiken funktionieren. Du arbeitest in einem bereichsübergreifenden Team und bist für KI-Anwendungsfälle im Industriegeschäft (Underwriting und Schaden) über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg verantwortlich – von der Konzeption bis zur operativen Einführung. Du definierst Referenzdatensätze, validierst KI-Ergebnisse anhand realer Underwriting- und Schadensentscheidungen und stellst sicher, dass die geschäftlichen Anforderungen in die Modellentwicklung einfließen. Du entwickelst und optimierst eigenständig Prompts und RAG-Spezifikationen für GenAI-Agenten in Underwriting- und Schadenprozessen. Du überträgst Geschäftsregeln, Sonderfälle und Compliance-Anforderungen (inklusive regulatorischer Vorgaben wie dem EU AI Act) in strukturierte, sprintfähige Spezifikationen und unterstützt beim Backlog-Management. Du verantwortest das User Acceptance Testing (UAT) auf Business-Ebene, prüfst Modelle an der Realität und dokumentierst erkannte Schwächen sowie deren Geschäftsauswirkungen. Du förderst die KI-Nutzung, indem du Wirkung misst, Dashboards betreibst und Anwenderunterlagen erstellst. In technischen Workshops vertrittst du die Sicht des Underwriting- und Schadenbereichs und arbeitest eng mit Data Scientists und Engineers an der Lösungsfindung. Dein Profil Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der regulierten Branche, idealerweise in der Versicherung, am besten im Industrieversicherungsgeschäft. Abläufe wie Submission, Deckungslogik und Schadenbearbeitung kennst du aus eigener Erfahrung. Du bringst mindestens 2 Jahre fundierte Erfahrung im GenAI Prompting, Design von agentenbasierten Workflows und Modellrisikobewertung (inklusive Erklärbarkeit) mit. LLM-Prompts und RAG-Retrieval für Versicherungsdokumente kannst du eigenständig entwickeln, evaluieren und optimieren. Du hast bereits BA-Artefakte wie BPMN-Prozessdiagramme, Edge-Case-Listen, Akzeptanzkriterien und User Stories erstellt, die lieferfähig und methodisch fundiert sind (z.B. nach IIBA, IREB, CARS oder vergleichbar). Du bist geschult und erfahren in Problemanalyse und -lösung, sowie im strukturierten Denken und Planen, basierend auf Projektmanagement-Methoden wie Six Sigma oder Prince2. Du verstehst, wie du Anforderungen aus dem EU AI Act, regulatorische und interne Compliance-Vorgaben in praxistaugliche Designvorgaben für cloudbasierte GenAI-Lösungen überträgst – oder bist bereit, dich darin einzuarbeiten. Du hast internationale Projekterfahrung, sprichst fließend Englisch (C2) sowie mindestens gut Deutsch (B2) und fühlst dich sicher in Präsentationen und Diskussionen auf allen Ebenen, auch im Top-Management. Du kannst auch unter Zeitdruck und in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld sehr gut arbeiten. Flexible Arbeitszeiten Gleitzeitregelungen und flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle ermöglichen eine perfekte Work-Life-Balance – ganz wie es zu Dir passt. Gesundheitsmanagement Mit uns bleibst Du gesund – dank Präventionsmaßnahmen, einem breiten Sportangebot und verschiedenen Kooperationen. Mobiles Arbeiten Ob von zu Hause oder unterwegs – unser mobiles Arbeitsmodell (bis zu 60 % mobil) bietet Dir mehr Freiheit und Selbstständigkeit. Weiterbildung Wir stillen Deinen Wissensdurst – zum Beispiel mit Fortbildungen, fachspezifischen Seminaren oder einem berufsbegleitenden Studium.

items.card: You will join a supportive team where you get to shape these modern practices as we grow. Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below! WHO ARE YOU? Collaborative & Empathetic: You communicate clearly across distributed teams in fluent English, bring a supportive attitude to complex problems, and enjoy exploring solutions together. Continuous Learner: You take ownership of your professional growth,
items.desc: THE OPPORTUNITY IN A NUTSHELL You? A data engineer with around 2-3 years of relevant experience (indicative). Empathetic with the people you collaborate with, proactive about data quality, and creative in how you model solutions. You combine a solid technical foundation with curiosity and care deeply about making sure our data products are reliable, well-governed, and easy to consume. Role? Data Engineer joining CAM Classifieds & Transactions, responsible for designing, building, and evolving core analytical data products across our Classifieds and Transactions domains that underpin analytics, insights, and AI-driven workflows at Vend. Tech stack? Snowflake, SQL, dbt, Python. Company? Vend, home of FINN, Blocket, Tori, Oikotie, DBA & Bilbasen. Around 500 developers deploy code and models to production thousands of times a week. Our mission is simple: Smart choices made easy . We connect millions of people across the Nordics while making sustainable living effortless. Location? Join us in our Oslo or Stockholm office, with the flexibility to work 3 days per week remotely! Why us? Most data teams are still figuring out how to combine dbt modeling with modern AI agents. With CAM, we are building the shared analytical foundation for all of Vend, using AI-augmented dev workflows to reduce friction and power the flow connecting data, insights, and products. You will join a supportive team where you get to shape these modern practices as we grow. Sounds like your cup of tea? Check out the details below! WHO ARE YOU? Collaborative & Empathetic: You communicate clearly across distributed teams in fluent English, bring a supportive attitude to complex problems, and enjoy exploring solutions together. Continuous Learner: You take ownership of your professional growth, actively seek feedback, and look for opportunities to develop your technical skills. Hands-on with AI Tooling: You are curious about or already use modern dev tools (such as Claude Code, Copilot, or other LLM harnesses) in your daily dev cycles to accelerate code generation, refactoring, and metadata propagation. Data & Architectural Fundamentals: You understand layered data modeling, care about quality guardrails, consistent business logic, and modular schema design that scales across marketplace domains. Analytics Engineering Skills: You bring solid SQL skills and data modeling concepts, with practical experience or exposure (indicative 1–3+ years) to cloud data platforms (preferably Snowflake) and transformation frameworks (dbt strongly preferred; Python as a plus). Authentic Perspective: You bring open dialogue, constructive curiosity, and fresh ideas that help us continuously improve how we work. WHAT’S THE JOB LIKE? Day-to-day Work & Focus As a Data Engineer In CAM Classifieds & Transactions, You Will Help Build And Evolve Core Data Products That Power Critical Business Decisions And User Experiences Enterprise-wide We used to automate data transformations with manual pipeline setup. Now, we augment our engineering with reasoning and metadata-driven dbt workflows. You will work closely with peer engineers across Core Insight & Analytics, as well as analysts, product managers, and software engineers across Vend. With active support, mentorship, and guidance from senior engineers, you will contribute directly to our modern dbt and Snowflake architecture. Our team consists of 7 members including team lead and lead data engineer. We are an inclusive, collaborative team spread across the Nordics, and we meet up in person several times a year to work, play games, and have fun together! What does success look like? After 6 months: You feel confident and supported in building and maintaining dbt models on Snowflake, collaborating smoothly across neighboring teams, and utilizing AI dev tools like Claude Code in your daily workflow. After 1 year: You independently handle domain modeling tasks within Classifieds & Transactions, contribute meaningfully to our, and actively share ideas for process and quality improvements. The Road Ahead & Technology Evolution We are moving into a declarative, metadata-driven and AI-augmented dbt Cloud setup, and we plan to finish in 2027. Our ways of working will change with it. We expect this to make data much easier to access, and to let more people create data transformations and data products themselves. You will work alongside experienced engineers across to build the next-generation data stack, including data contracts, semantic models and automated engineering workflows. A few words from Kristin Hybertsen, Head of CAM Classifieds & Transactions "Hi, I am Kristin! The CAM teams are responsible for providing the shared analytical foundation for all of Vend. We sit inside Core Insight & Analytics alongside Analysts and Data Management, working in close sync with our sister teams in User & Behaviour and Finance & Operations. We build the data products that power insights and decision-making across our marketplaces. We are …

items.desc: AI agents are starting to reshape how customers discover, compare and buy. We help commerce leaders cut through the hype, make clear decisions and turn the right opportunities into commercial impact. We are looking for a curious, hands-on commerce consultant who enjoys turning complex questions into clear advice. Working directly with senior advisors, you'll analyse client challenges, test emerging technology and turn insights into decisions, opportunities and practical next steps. What you'll d o Work alongside senior advisors on client research, interviews and workshops; translate findings into clear recommendations and presentations for senior stakeholders. Analyse customer journeys, commerce capabilities and operating models, and develop evidence for business cases and transformation roadmaps. Experiment hands-on with AI agents, low-code tools and automations; build simple prototypes to test ideas and share what you learn. Work with commerce and technology specialists to assess feasibility and dependencies, and own defined deliverables across advisory and delivery engagements. Contribute to go-to-market activities: develop market insights and propositions, support pitches and proposals, help shape opportunities alongside senior advisors, and contribute to pipeline management. What You Bring 3-5 years' experience in digital commerce, gained in consulting, at an agency or on the client side. Strong analytical and advisory skills: you can structure ambiguous questions, work with data and turn findings into practical recommendations. Understanding of commerce technology, including platforms, product data, search, pricing, checkout, APIs and integrations, and curiosity about AI agents. You don't need to be a developer, but you've built something with AI tools yourself - a prototype, automation or side project, at work or independently. Tell us about it in your application. Job Description: 
 An opportunity for an Machine Learning Engineer has arisen within Airbus Helicopters (Albacete, Spain).
 WHY JOIN US? 
 📍 LIFE IN ALBACETE: QUALITY & CONVENIENCE - 
 Albacete is a dynamic, historic city in Spain, located in the region of Castilla-La Mancha. This modern urban center, known for its rich cultural heritage, and it is conveniently close to Madrid and the Mediterranean coast. 
 Forget long commutes. Albacete offers you the great advantage of a “15-minute city": safe, accessible, comfortable and perfectly connected. Enjoy a premium standard of living at a competitive cost, ensuring you have the perfect balance between your career and your personal life. 
 🚁 AIRBUS HELICOPTERS: GROW WITH US - We offer more than a job; we offer a community. Immerse yourself in a young, collaborative environment that feels like family. As a strategic Center of Excellence, we are a global leader in helicopter production, offering you endless potential to grow alongside our major projects. 
 ✨THE PROJECT: SHAPING THE FUTURE - Welcome to the Digital Campus , a pioneering ecosystem dedicated to industrial digitalization and innovation. This is more than just a workplace; it is a technological hub where we define the future of flight. 
 Bring your ideas to a dynamic, modern ecosystem and help us build the next generation of aerospace solutions. 
 About the Team & the Environment 
 You will join the Digital Innovation Team within Airbus Helicopters’ Transformation Department. Our mission is to bridge the gap between applied research and concrete business value, leveraging technologies like Artificial Intelligence, Advanced Analytics, and Mixed Reality. While you will be the core representative of our Digital Innovation team in Albacete, you will work in a deeply integrated, international environment with our hubs in Marignane (France) and Donauwörth (Germany). Being physically located alongside the Albacete IT teams, you will act as a strategic bridge to ensure our AI innovations are robustly integrated and scaled into enterprise systems. 
 The Role 
 We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to help bridge the gap between our Data Science Proof of Value (PoVs) and enterprise-scale production. This is not an exploratory Data Science or pure modeling role. We are looking for a robust hands-on software and ML engineer who understands IT infrastructure, CI/CD, and how to scale AI solutions securely. You will leverage your technical expertise to collaborate with local IT teams, helping to design practical, scalable solutions for deploying AI projects (e.g., ML models, GenAI/chatbots). Alongside this cross-functional integration work, you will also provide hands-on platform support and tooling for our internal Data Scientists. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Industrialization & CI/CD: Collaborate with IT teams to define and implement best practices for transitioning ML models from PoV to production on OpenShift (On-Premise) and GCP. Build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines to ensure code quality and secure deployments. 
 GenAI & AI Integration: Implement the technical integration of AI solutions (such as chatbots, LLMs, or predictive APIs) into existing business applications. This includes managing complex data ingestion pipelines for RAG architectures, using search engines, and working with vector and graph databases. 
 Monitoring & Resource Optimization: Set up dashboards to monitor model health, API performance, and detect data drift. Optimize compute resources (CPU/GPU) to ensure cost-efficiency across our infrastructure. 
 Platform Support & "Starter Kits": Streamline the work of our Data Science team by creating standardized, ready-to-use templates (Docker/Git) for new PoVs, maintaining optimized environments, and resolving complex dependency issues. 
 Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as a proactive technical liaison between the international Innovation team (prototyping) and the Albacete IT department (infrastructure). You will translate Data Science compute needs into IT architecture specifications and ensure our projects comply with strict cybersecurity standards. 
 Tech Stack You Will Use 
 Infrastructure: OpenShift AI (On-Premise) as a primary environment, with GCP for cloud deployments. 
 Containers & Orchestration: Docker, Kubernetes. 
 Databases & Search: PostgreSQL (including pgvector), Elasticsearch, and Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j). 
 Programming: Python (Advanced) and standard software engineering practices (OOP, APIs with FastAPI). 
 MLOps & CI/CD: MLflow, Git, GitLab CI/CD (or similar). 
 AI/Data Science Tools: Pandas, Scikit-Learn, Streamlit, GenAI integration frameworks (LangChain, etc.), and monitoring tools (Grafana/Kibana). 
 Who You Are 
 Experience: 3 to 4+ years of full-time, post-graduate industry experience in Machine Learning Engineering, MLOps, or Software Engineering. Please note: while we highly value internships, apprenticeships, and academic projects, this specific …

L’analyse d’images issues de la microscopie confocale et à champ large, en lien avec les marquages cellulaires et les zones de transduction. La participation à l’analyse de données transcriptomiques (bulk et single-cell RNA-seq) et de transcriptomique spatiale, en collaboration avec les plateformes et les équipes bioinformatiques. L’intégration des résultats d’imagerie et d’analyse génomique pour aider à cartographier les réseaux neuronaux modifiés suite à l’injection des vecteurs viraux. La documentation des analyses, la rédaction de protocoles, et la participation à la valorisation scientifique du projet (rapports, publications, présentations). Concevoir et développer des applications et outils logiciels dédiés à l'analyse d'images (interfaces utilisateur, plugins, scripts packagés), permettant aux biologistes de l'équipe d'exécuter les pipelines de façon autonome. L'Activité Prétraitement, segmentation et quantification d’images issues d’immunohistochimie et d’immunofluorescence sur tissu cérébral (modèles murins). Utilisation de logiciels tels que Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik, et outils de traitement par scripts personnalisés (Python ou R). Développement ou adaptation de workflows automatisés pour l’analyse d’images en grand volume (batch analysis), incluant la reconnaissance cellulaire, la mesure d’intensité et la cartographie des signaux. Contribution à l’analyse de données transcriptomiques et spatiales, en lien avec les résultats d’imagerie (compétences en visualisation, clustering, annotation cellulaire). Collaboration étroite avec les biologistes, virologues, et bioinformaticiens du laboratoire ainsi qu’avec la plateforme d’analyse de l’IGMM. Participation à l’interprétation biologique des données et à la formulation d’hypothèses sur les effets de la thérapie génique sur les circuits neuronaux. Documentation précise des workflows utilisés, mise en place de procédures reproductibles (versioning, traçabilité), et participation à la diffusion scientifique des résultats. Développement, test et maintenance d'applications d'analyse d'images (par ex. plugins Fiji/ImageJ, extensions QuPath, applications Python), incluant la gestion des versions (Git) et la rédaction de la documentation utilisateur. Votre Profil Compétences Formation et expérience Niveau de formation requis : Licence (bac+3) avec 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en analyse d'images biologiques. Maîtrise des outils d’analyse d’images (Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik…). Connaissances de base en programmation scientifique (Python, R). Capacité à gérer des workflows analytiques et à produire des rapports clairs et reproductibles. Maîtrise de l’anglais scientifique, à l’oral et à l’écrit Compétences attendues : Compétences techniques Maîtrise des outils d’analyse d’images microscopiques : Fiji/ImageJ, QuPath, Cellpose, ilastik. Compréhension des principes de microscopie fluorescence et confocale ; capacité à dialoguer avec des spécialistes de l’imagerie. Expérience dans le développement ou l’adaptation de workflows d’analyse semi-automatisés. Connaissances de base en programmation scientifique : Python ou R (ex. : gestion d’images, traitement de fichiers, visualisation de données). Une première exposition à l’analyse de données de transcriptomique (bulk/single-cell) ou spatiale est un atout. Capacité à produire une documentation technique claire, à assurer la traçabilité et la reproductibilité des analyses. Expérience en développement d'applications ou d'outils logiciels pour l'analyse d'images biologiques, de la conception à la mise à disposition des utilisateurs. Compétences transversales Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et autonomie dans la gestion de tâches techniques. Curiosité scientifique et volonté d’apprendre des outils et méthodes variés. Bon relationnel et aptitude à travailler en interface avec des biologistes, bioinformaticiens, ingénieurs en imagerie et personnels de plateformes. Capacité à s’adapter aux évolutions des besoins du projet (nouveaux outils, nouvelles données). Compétences en communication écrite et orale, en anglais (lecture de publications, rédaction de protocoles, échanges en consortium international). Your core ownership is emnify's outbound engine and data enrichment infrastructure: building the automated flows, AI agents, and integrated systems that help the revenue team find, prioritise, and engage the right accounts faster and more intelligently. Your impact Build and own emnify's lead enrichment infrastructure end-to-end: From signal sourcing through Clay, ZoomInfo, and first and second-party data providers, to clean, actionable data landing in Salesforce for the outbound team Drive pipeline coverage improvement : By deploying automated outbound workflows that surface the right accounts at the right time, connected across Salesforce, Amplemarket, and emnify's internal GTM platform Develop AI agents : Using Claude and Clay that automate research, qualification signals, and personalisation at scale — turning hours of manual SDR work into reliable, repeatable flows Own the integration layer between emnify's commercial stack : — Salesforce, n8n, Attention, Weflow, Amplemarket, Sales Navigator — so data flows cleanly and the revenue team spends time selling, not fixing Lead the build-out of emnify's company knowledge infrastructure : Working toward a machine-readable, agent-accessible source of truth that keeps commercial processes documented and up to date automatically What we expect A solid commercial foundation : You understand how leads move through a pipeline, what pipeline coverage actually means, why forecasting is hard in a consumption-based business, and why any of it matters for revenue Demonstrated experience building functioning enrichment flows : You have connected a CRM to data providers, built the logic, and shipped something that the sales team actually used Hands-on Clay experience : This is the core of the role and a genuine must-have; you should be able to walk us through a flow you have built in it Comfort with automation and integration tooling : n8n, Make, Zapier, or comparable; once you have worked with one, the others follow An AI-native approach to your work: You reach for Claude, agents, and LLM-powered tooling as a default, not an experiment Experience in a B2B environment : You understand the sales motion, the stakeholder dynamics, and why GTM tooling decisions have commercial consequences Confident enough to push back when a requested solution is the wrong one, and grounded enough to do it without making it a confrontation Coachability — we want someone who is excited to grow with us Your First 6 Months In your first few weeks, you will get hands-on with emnify's existing stack — Salesforce, n8n, Amplemarket, Attention, Clay — understand what has been built, where the gaps are, and where the biggest leverage sits for the outbound team. You will be spending time with the sales team to understand the commercial model, the ICP, and what good enrichment actually looks like for an IoT connectivity sale. By month two or three, you will have shipped your first meaningful enrichment flow end-to-end — connecting signal sources to Salesforce, improving data quality for outbound, and showing measurable improvement in pipeline coverage. You will also have a clear view of where AI agents can start replacing manual steps in the research and qualification process. By the halfway mark, you will own the enrichment and automation layer with real autonomy, be iterating based on what is working in the market, and have begun scoping emnify's company knowledge infrastructure — laying the groundwork for a system that keeps GTM processes accessible and up to date without constant manual upkeep. Why emnify emnify operates on a consumption-based model in a market — global IoT connectivity — that is still in its early innings of enterprise adoption, which means the GTM challenge here is genuinely complex and genuinely interesting. The company is profitable and growing, which gives you a stable platform to build from rather than a runway that is quietly ticking down. The go-to-market AI and automation infrastructure is still greenfield: a lot of the foundational work is yet to be done, which means real creative latitude and real visibility. You will be joining an experienced commercial team that is deeply bought into building this capability — leadership has done it before and knows what good looks like — and you will be part of a Berlin hub where you can collaborate in person rather than building in isolation. items.desc: We are a bank that develops innovative solutions. How we build them is changing: AI tools and agents now do much of the construction, and the scarce skill is framing the problem precisely, specifying the solution, directing the tools, and owning the result. We're looking for a Product Engineer to join our Technology, Product and Innovation division. You'll be an analytical thinker with an engineering mindset who turns ambiguous business problems into working, production-ready solutions. You'll do it largely by writing clear specifications and context that AI development tools execute against, within our internal AI development frameworks. You'll work mostly independently, taking problems from first question to production, and draw on a small group of experts when you need them. This is a fully on-site role based at our Athens office. A background in software engineering is essential, as this role is about specifying product features precisely, directing AI to build them, and taking accountability for what ships. What you will do Take a business problem from vague to precise: ask the right questions, uncover the real need, map the process, data and rules involved, and define what “done” looks like. Write clear, structured specifications (requirements, constraints, acceptance criteria, edge cases and failure scenarios) that AI tools and agents can execute reliably. Direct AI tools through prototyping, building, testing and documenting, and iterate quickly from idea to working proof. Validate outcomes rather than code: define test scenarios up front, confirm the solution behaves correctly against them, and recognize when results don't match intent. Anticipate the exceptions: unusual data, failure modes, integration issues and regulatory edge cases that the happy path never covers. Know when to escalate. Bring in security, architecture, platform or domain experts at the right moment instead of working around gaps. Take solutions through to production and keep improving them using real usage, data and feedback. Present your work with confidence: explain solutions, trade-offs and results to colleagues, senior stakeholders and wider audiences, in meetings, demos and internal forums. Work within our internal AI development frameworks, standards and guardrails, applying them consistently and feeding back what you learn so they improve. Collaborate closely with a small number of experts across product, risk, operations and engineering, while driving execution yourself. Adapt as priorities shift: pick up new projects, join new teams and hand over your work cleanly, with documentation others can build on, as projects change and team members rotate. Requirements What we are looking for Essential A university degree in engineering. You understand how systems, data and integrations fit together and can reason about how they fail. Strong command of C# and .NET, plus solid SQL and data modelling. A firm grasp of system design: APIs, distributed systems, concurrency and security fundamentals. Testing discipline, CI/CD, and experience running systems in production, including observability and incident handling. Daily, hands-on use of AI coding agents, and a clear view of where they go wrong. Fluency in English, written and spoken. Excellent presentation and public speaking skills, with the confidence to present to groups and senior audiences. Strong social and interpersonal skills. You build relationships quickly and communicate comfortably with technical and non-technical colleagues alike. A track record of delivering complex solutions or projects from concept to production, in any technical or analytical setting. Thinking Strong analytical and structured-thinking skills. You break down ambiguous problems, test assumptions and make pragmatic decisions. Excellent written communication. You can express intent, logic and constraints precisely enough that someone, or something, else can execute them. Sound judgment on risk, quality and trade-offs, and the instinct to spot what's missing or wrong in a solution. Working style Evidence of working with AI tools or agentic workflows, and the ability to learn and operate quickly within a defined framework and its controls. High ownership and autonomy. You drive execution end to end without close direction. Strong teamwork. You work well with a few experts at a time, share knowledge openly and put the team's outcome ahead of individual credit. Agility. You're comfortable when requirements start incomplete, projects change direction and teams rotate, and you get productive quickly with new colleagues and new problems. Curiosity about how AI is changing the way work gets done, balanced by discipline in following the framework. Nice to have: experience in banking, payments or other regulated environments; experience with data, integrations or process automation; prototypes or projects you built that went somewhere. How we work AI is how we build, not what we do. We are a bank, and we use …

Proactively incorporate new features and capabilities to maximise customer value. Be confident in developing custom training materials and leading delivery of training sessions to customers. Contribute to revenue through strong billable utilisation, accurate timesheet management, and effective client service delivery. What You Bring Core Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trusted customer relationships and explain complex concepts clearly. Proven ability to manage competing priorities, work autonomously, and drive projects forward in a primarily remote and asynchronous EMEA environment. Collaborative mindset and commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience. Comfortable working in a fast-changing, technology-driven environment. Preferred Experience: Familiarity with customer experience platforms such as Zendesk, Salesforce, ServiceNow, HubSpot, Intercom, Genesys, or similar. Experience in Employee Services. Design, build, and operate scalable platform infrastructure and automation that supports agentic AI development. With 25 years’ experience since our foundation in Norway, we’re already #1 in the Nordics; growing rapidly in the UK and we are already seeing some great success in the Netherlands since opening the entity in mid-2024, but our ambition is to become the clear European market-leader in the coming years Why we’re proud Recognised as an Innovation and Growth Leader in the 2025 EMEA Customer Experience Platforms Frost Radar 2024 CX Awards Winner, ‘Best Mid-Market Contact Center Platform’ Puzzel was recognised as the 'most innovative European-founded CCaaS provider' and top 3 globally by Frost & Sullivan in 2023 Best Practices Company of the Year 2023 Consistently high Glassdoor rating Puzzel places high importance on work-life balance and flexible working hours - as recognised by Flexa, placing 16th overall for work:life balance in 2025! We are working with Mercer on salary benchmarking, to ensure pay equality and market competitiveness Read more about us here . What you'll do Puzzel is investing in its security function. This role owns the security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate, and owns infrastructure vulnerability management across the company. This role focuses on designing, implementing, operating, and continuously improving security controls that protect our product. This role reports to the CISO. What you will own The security of our public cloud (Azure and AWS) and private data centre estate: network segmentation, firewall policy, system hardening and patching. Infrastructure vulnerability management end to end — scope, triage, remediation tracking and closure. Tenable is one of the tools you will use; owning the outcome matters more than owning the tool. Threat modelling and secure design input for infrastructure change, offered as support rather than imposed as a gate. What you must be able to do The following capabilities are essential in this role, and we will explore all at interview. Threat hunting Threat modelling Vulnerability management Networking We are looking for judgement, not tool administration. Running a scanner is the easy part of this job. The must haves Hands-on infrastructure security in private data centre environment Hands-on cloud security experience in Azure, AWS or both Deep network security expertise: Firewall, VLANs, segmentation, WAF, TLS/mTLS, VPN, workload and configuration security, and system hardening. Virtualisation platforms - VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix or similar. Kubernetes or equivalent orchestration. Application security testing and OWASP or similar frameworks. SOC and SIEM or any infrastructure security monitoring platforms. Cloud security posture management tooling. Vulnerability scanning tools, SAST, DAST and SCA (including, Tenable, Snyk or similar tools). Experience turning scanner and dependency findings into prioritized, tracked and closed work. The nice to haves Terraform, Bicep or similar tools for Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Proficiency in programming languages, such as, .NET, Python, Ruby. items.desc: Penetration Tester / Red Teamer About the Company The company is developing autonomous offensive-security agents designed to identify vulnerabilities and demonstrate how they can be exploited. Its mission is to bring together security research and engineering to transform how organisations test and secure their systems. The team combines practical offensive-security expertise with the development of AI-powered tools that can discover, validate and reproduce security vulnerabilities. About the Role The company is looking for a hands-on Penetration Tester / Red Teamer to conduct and support security testing in customer environments, validate findings identified by its AI agents, and help improve its product and research capabilities. This is a mid-level position for someone who enjoys practical offensive-security work and wants to take on more responsibility while working alongside experienced security researchers and engineers. You will investigate real vulnerabilities, test their exploitability and determine whether findings represent genuine, reproducible security issues. Practical ability is valued more highly than certifications. Key Responsibilities Conduct penetration tests across customer applications, APIs and infrastructure, with support on more complex engagements. Support red-team exercises by investigating attack paths, testing weaknesses and contributing to exploitation. Manually validate findings generated by AI agents, distinguishing reproducible vulnerabilities from false positives. Develop clear proof-of-concept exploits demonstrating exploitability, realistic impact and the conditions required for an attack. Produce concise technical reports containing evidence and practical remediation recommendations. Collaborate with engineers to improve agent behaviour, testing coverage and the quality of findings. Turn discoveries into scripts, repeatable test cases and research inputs. Work carefully within agreed testing scopes, communicate clearly and exercise sound judgement when working in customer environments. Requirements Hands-on experience in penetration testing, an internal offensive-security team or substantial bug-bounty research. A solid understanding of common vulnerabilities and the ability to exploit them manually, including access-control issues, authentication weaknesses and injection vulnerabilities. Confidence testing web applications and APIs, alongside experience with infrastructure or cloud environments. Familiarity with tools such as Burp Suite and Nmap, including the ability to assess and challenge their results. Ability to write or adapt Python scripts to automate tasks and support security testing. Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain findings, reproduce vulnerabilities and demonstrate their impact. Curiosity, persistence and a willingness to seek help when an unfamiliar problem requires a different approach. Desirable Experience Experience in any of the following areas would be advantageous: Active Directory. Privilege escalation. Cloud security. Adversary emulation. Exploit development. Public security research, useful tooling or technical write-ups. Candidates do not need experience in every area to apply. Certifications and AI Experience Certifications such as OSCP are welcome but not mandatory. The company is more interested in how candidates investigate targets, reason through vulnerabilities and demonstrate their impact. Previous AI experience is not required. An interest in how autonomous agents can support offensive-security work is welcomed. What the Company Offers The opportunity to influence the development of an AI-powered security product directly through practical testing. Close collaboration with engineers building autonomous security agents. Exposure to real customer environments and deeper technical investigations. Opportunities to develop offensive-security skills alongside experienced colleagues. Meaningful responsibility within a small team, with the opportunity to help shape the future of automated security testing. Pay: £60,000.00-£75,000.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in London

items.desc: Word de beste versie van jezelf als AI Engineer Als AI Engineer bij Sogeti bouw je mee aan AI-toepassingen die organisaties dagelijks gebruiken. Je hebt je eerste ervaring met AI opgedaan en wilt verder groeien in Generative AI en agentic AI. Samen met ervaren collega's ontwikkel je bijvoorbeeld een kennisassistent, een toepassing voor documentverwerking of een AI-agent die afgebakende taken uitvoert. Binnen onze Data & AI-community werk je op het snijvlak van data, AI en software engineering. Je blijft betrokken van de eerste klantvraag en het prototype tot integratie, productie en verbetering. Je leert door te bouwen, feedback te vragen en jouw ervaringen met vakgenoten te delen. Waarom jij het verschil maakt Jij bent nieuwsgierig naar wat AI kan, maar kijkt ook kritisch naar wat het daadwerkelijk oplevert. Samen met je team ontwikkel je betrouwbare en bruikbare AI-oplossingen die aansluiten op de vraagstukken van klanten. Je vertaalt klantbehoeften naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkelt toepassingen met behulp van Python, large language models (LLMs) en eigen databronnen. Daarbij werk je aan moderne oplossingen op het gebied van Generative AI, zoals RAG-toepassingen, én aan Agentic AI-oplossingen waarbij agents zelfstandig taken uitvoeren binnen vooraf bepaalde kaders. Gedurende het hele proces houd je oog voor kwaliteit, betrouwbaarheid en verantwoord AI-gebruik. Je test antwoorden en agentgedrag, onderzoekt fouten en hallucinaties en houdt rekening met aspecten als privacy, beveiliging, prestaties en kosten. Samen met je collega's werk je aan de integratie van AI in applicaties en bedrijfsprocessen en draag je bij aan het succesvol in productie brengen van oplossingen. Ook na livegang blijf je betrokken en gebruik je gebruikersfeedback, resultaten en inzichten om oplossingen continu verder te verbeteren. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Vertalen van klantvragen naar concrete AI-usecases en ontwikkeltaken; Het ontwikkelen van GenAI-oplossingen met LLM's, prompts en eigen databronnen; Bouwen van RAG- en Agentic AI-toepassingen; Testen en verbeteren van antwoorden, agentgedrag en betrouwbaarheid; Het integreren van AI-oplossingen via API's in applicaties en processen; Monitoren, optimaliseren en doorontwikkelen van oplossingen na livegang. Hiermee word je de beste versie van jezelf Maakt impact binnen de Data & AI-organisatie van Sogeti, waar vakmanschap, eigenaarschap en samenwerking centraal staan; Je werkt samen met ervaren AI Engineers die met je meedenken over code, ontwerp en verantwoorde AI; Jij komt terecht in een hechte community waarin kennisdeling centraal staat via communitydagen, workshops, open podia en intervisiesessies; Je verdiept je in GenAI, Agentic AI, MLOps en andere moderne AI-technologieën en leert hoe je deze betrouwbaar ontwikkelt, test en beheert; Je krijgt toegang tot inhouse trainingen op het gebied van AI, techniek, communicatie en leiderschap, afgestemd op jouw ambities; Ontwikkelt jouw consultancyvaardigheden en deelt actief kennis met collega's en klanten; Je werkt aan uitdagende opdrachten bij toonaangevende organisaties in Nederland, waar jouw werk zichtbaar bijdraagt aan innovatie en betere besluitvorming; Groeit stap voor stap door als AI Engineer, specialist, lead engineer of richting thought leadership; Je werkt in een omgeving waar plezier en professionaliteit hand in hand gaan. items.desc: Fixed term contract | Belval | 24 Months Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact. Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/ How will you contribute? You’ll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny. You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable. Code Development (60%): · Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query · Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic · Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions. · Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports · Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published Research & experimentation (25%): · Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts · Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance · Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels · Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions. System integration (15%): · Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output · Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now! Education · A PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a closely related field is required. · A background in Financial services domain is highly desirable. Experience and skills · Preferably at least 2 years of research or industry experience in relevant areas. Must Have: · Strong Python programming skills · Hands on in LLMs RAG implementation · Experience with at least one ML framework (scikit-learn, transformers, etc.) · Familiarity with data structures and algorithms · Git proficiency for collaborative development Highly valued: · Previous work with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar retrieval and agent orchestration frameworks, ideally in a compliance or audit context · Knowledge of multi agent workflow orchestration frameworks. · Experience with NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK, transformers) applied to structured extraction from regulatory or financial reporting documents · Understanding of information retrieval concepts (BM25, TF-IDF, relevance scoring) · Experience with React, Node.js or similar web frameworks · Knowledge of evaluation methodologies for ML systems · Track record of conducting application-driven AI research. · Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively in interdisciplinary and multi-partner research environments. · Understanding of NAV calculation methodology, fund accounting principles, or second-level control frameworks in asset management · Familiarity with CSSF or ESMA regulatory frameworks governing fund operations, pricing, and oversight obligations Language skills · Fluency in English both oral and written. · Other relevant languages are an asset.
