items.card: Your mission & challenges At NEURA Robotics, cognitive robots don't just execute commands. They perceive, reason, plan over long horizons, and act autonomously in the physical world. We're looking for an engineer who builds the systems that make that possible: the agent harnesses, planning loops, and orchestration layers that turn a language model into a reliable embodied agent. Agent architecture & harness design:
items.desc: Your mission & challenges At NEURA Robotics, cognitive robots don't just execute commands. They perceive, reason, plan over long horizons, and act autonomously in the physical world. We're looking for an engineer who builds the systems that make that possible: the agent harnesses, planning loops, and orchestration layers that turn a language model into a reliable embodied agent. Agent architecture & harness design: Design and build the core agent harness for our humanoid platform: the control loop, tool/skill interfaces, state and memory management, retries, and guardrails that keep long-running autonomous behavior reliable. Long-horizon planning & orchestration: Build systems that decompose high-level human intent into multi-step plans, orchestrate skills and sub-agents, track execution state, recover from errors, and escalate to human oversight when risk is high. Conversational AI for embodied interaction: Design the real-time voice stack: STT → LLM → TTS pipeline with robust turn-taking, barge-in handling, and addressee detection so the robot knows when it's being spoken to and responds naturally under real-world latency constraints. Backend & platform engineering: Build the production backend behind the agent: well-designed APIs and interfaces, distributed services connecting sub-agents to the main conversational agent, and edge-to-cloud deployment across the NEURA ecosystem. Evaluation & industrialization: Stand up evaluation harnesses and observability that measure whether agents actually complete tasks correctly, and drive promising prototypes through to industrialized, deployed systems. Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with hardware/software teams and external partners to take agentic capabilities from concept to reliable end-to-end product. What We Can Look Forward To A strong Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent depth shown through shipped work. Demonstrated experience building production agent systems with measurable impact: agents that plan, use tools, maintain state, and run reliably over long horizons, rather than single-turn prompt work. Deep, hands-on experience with agent frameworks and orchestration such as LangGraph, AgentCore, MCP, or custom orchestrators, and a clear sense of when to use an agent versus a deterministic workflow. Professional backend engineering experience: production services, API and interface design, distributed and microservice architectures, clean code, testing, and DevOps discipline. Cloud and edge-to-cloud experience, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD, and deploying and serving models and services in production. Strong grounding in LLMs, VLMs, and NLP. Excellent Python. Excellent English. German is a plus.

Jouw team en impact Je stapt in een nieuw AI-team dat volop in ontwikkeling is. Samen met collega's uit de business, data en IT bouw je aan AI-oplossingen die direct waarde toevoegen voor collega's én klanten. Je krijgt veel ruimte om kansen zelf te ontdekken, processen slimmer te maken en ideeën om te zetten in toepassingen die daadwerkelijk worden gebruikt. Zo draag je zichtbaar bij aan de verdere groei van AI binnen Technische Unie. Wij bieden Jouw ontwikkeling, gezondheid en veiligheid staan centraal. Als Top Employer (https://www.werkenbijtechnischeunie.nl/top-employer-2026/) bieden we veel goede arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals: Geniet van 40 verlofdagen (vakantie- én ATV-dagen op fulltime basis) én de optie om dagen te kopen of verkopen Variabele beloning en solide pensioenregeling Blijf vitaal met een vitaliteitsbudget, thuiswerkregeling, sportschoolkorting en gezondheidschecks Altijd blijven groeien met ons brede trainings- en opleidingsaanbod Heb jij het in je? Lef, durf en aanpassingsvermogen! Dat is de mentaliteit waarmee onze collega’s het verschil maken. Of je nu net begint of al wat ervaring meebrengt, bij Technische Unie krijg je de ruimte om te ontwikkelen op jouw manier. Iedereen brengt iets unieks mee. Juist die mix van verschillen maakt ons sterker als team. We geloven in een werksfeer waarin je jezelf kunt zijn, kunt groeien en elke dag iets nieuws kunt ontdekken. Met meer dan 2.000 collega’s bouwen we dagelijks aan een slimmer, duurzamer Nederland. We helpen onze klanten vooruit met een breed aanbod technische producten, diensten en een krachtige online omgeving die behoort tot de grootste B2B-platforms van Nederland. Maar het echte verschil maken we met elkaar, met mensen die energie, ideeën en lef meebrengen. Heb jij het in je? items.desc: xHeron is building the Service-as-Software company for short-term rental operators. We take responsibility for guest communication, team coordination and issue resolution, so customers can hand over the work without handing over their business. Today, we deliver that service through people, software and AI. We’re turning the expertise behind it into autonomous systems that understand situations, take action and follow through. Not another tool to supervise. A service that gets the job done. We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build the agentic capabilities at the heart of xHeron. You’ll help shape how our agents reason, act and learn, and build a company where AI doesn’t just support the work, but increasingly delivers it. Tasks We are looking for an AI Harness Engineer to build the software layer that turns language models into dependable operational systems. You will work on orchestration, context assembly, tool execution, state, permissions, evaluations, observability, failure recovery, and human handoffs. The goal is not merely to generate a good response. What You’ll Own Agent harness architecture: Build the control layer around models: task decomposition, state management, model and tool selection, execution loops, checkpoints, retries, stopping conditions, and human handoffs. Decision and execution behavior: Design how agents interpret situations, choose actions, manage uncertainty, and complete bounded operational tasks—not only how they generate text. Context and memory: Determine what an agent needs to know at each step. Build context assembly, retrieval, memory, evidence selection, and knowledge-maintenance strategies while managing relevance, latency, and cost. Tools and real-world effects: Connect agents to APIs and operational systems through explicit tool contracts, permissions, validation, idempotency, and confirmation that the intended effect actually occurred. Evaluation and regression testing: Build representative evaluation suites and automated tests for decision quality, tool use, task completion, safety, escalation behavior, and recurring failure patterns. Observability and failure analysis: Make agent behavior inspectable through structured traces, state, outcomes, and error classification. Diagnose failures across models, prompts, context, tools, and surrounding software. Continuous improvement: Use evaluations, production traces, operator feedback, and controlled experiments to improve prompts, context, tools, model choices, and agent architecture. Production ownership: Ship and operate production Python software alongside our CTO and engineering team. Work closely with systems engineering on integrations, authorization, durable state, recovery, and safe execution. Requirements What Makes You a Great Fit You are a strong software engineer who can design, build, test, and operate reliable production systems in Python. You have built a substantial LLM-powered, automation, workflow, or decision system: not only notebooks, chat interfaces, prompt experiments, or a basic retrieval pipeline. You understand the engineering layer around a model: orchestration, state, context, tools, structured outputs, permissions, retries, fallbacks, observability, and evaluations. You can connect intelligence to real work: selecting relevant evidence, making a bounded decision, invoking tools or APIs, and verifying that the intended result occurred. You design for partial failure and uncertainty. You think deliberately about when an agent should act, retry, wait, stop, ask for help, or escalate. You evaluate behavior systematically. You use representative cases, traces, outcome checks, comparisons, and regression tests rather than treating a plausible response as proof of success. You have shipped software that people or operational processes depend on and have worked through debugging, timeouts, inconsistent data, changing APIs, and production incidents. You can investigate ambiguous problems independently, define a useful system boundary, explain trade-offs clearly, and turn decisions into working software. You care about simplicity and control. You know when a deterministic workflow is better than an agent and when additional autonomy is justified by evidence. You bring useful expertise and an independent perspective. Strong adjacent experience in workflow engines, developer tooling, distributed systems, automation platforms, or integration-heavy backend software can be highly relevant when paired with credible LLM-system understanding. Around 2+ years of professional software-engineering experience is a useful guide, not a hard requirement. What matters is the technical depth of what you built, the decisions and production outcomes you owned, and your ability to learn unfamiliar systems. You May Not Be a Great Fit If Your LLM experience is mainly prompt engineering, chatbots, basic RAG, or connecting a model API to a user interface. Your background is primarily offline data analysis, model training, …

items.desc: About Galtea Galtea is building the evaluation platform for AI teams. We help companies ship better AI, faster, by making it easy to test, evaluate, and monitor AI agents and LLM-powered products at scale. We're backed by top-tier investors and working with some of the most sophisticated AI teams in Europe, including major financial institutions and tech companies. We're a small, high-conviction team. Every hire matters. The role As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you'll sit at the intersection of engineering and customer success, owning the technical relationship with our enterprise accounts from day one. You'll be the person who makes sure customers succeed. You'll onboard them, integrate their systems, understand their AI stack, and work directly with their engineering teams to get real value out of Galtea. You'll also build. When an account needs a metric that doesn't exist yet, a judge that doesn't hold up, or a simulator that doesn't behave like a real user, you open a pull request against our AI services and fix it. Reporting the gap is where the job starts. This is a role for someone who loves working with customers and loves getting their hands dirty technically. What you'll do — Own enterprise onboarding. Set up customers on the platform, guide them through their first evaluation runs, and help them integrate Galtea's SDK into their existing pipelines. — Be the technical point of contact for our enterprise accounts. Join customer calls, answer technical questions, debug issues, and build trust with their engineering teams. — Understand customer AI stacks. Learn how each customer is deploying their agents and LLMs, and advise on how to structure evaluations for their specific use cases. — Develop and improve our AI services. Custom metrics, LLM judges, conversation simulators, red-teaming scenarios. You build them for the account in front of you, then harden the ones that generalise so the next customer gets them for free. — Work AI-first on your own job. Coding agents, evaluation harnesses, generated test data, automated triage. One engineer covering four enterprise accounts only works if agents are doing the repetitive half, and we expect you to bring back the workflows that paid off so the rest of the team picks them up. — Bridge customers and product. Systematically capture customer feedback, reproduce issues, and communicate insights to the product team so we build the right things. Ship the fix yourself when it sits in your half of the stack. — Write internal documentation and playbooks. Help the team scale what you learn by creating repeatable processes for onboarding and support. — Collaborate with sales. Bring technical credibility into the room where deals get scoped and won. What we're looking for Must have — 2+ years of software/AI engineering or solutions engineering experience. — Strong Python skills. You can write scripts, read SDK code, and debug integrations comfortably. Your code is good enough to merge into a product other engineers maintain. — Deep understanding of the AI evaluation problem. You know why evaluating LLMs and AI agents is hard, and you have a point of view on how to do it well. — You already work with coding agents daily. You have opinions about where they earn their keep and where they waste your time. — Excellent communication. You can explain technical concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders. Spanish and English. — Customer-first mindset. You take ownership of customer problems and don't drop balls. Nice to have — Experience at an enterprise SaaS company or AI/ML tooling company. — Familiarity with MLOps, LLMOps, or AI evaluation concepts. — You've built LLM-powered components that run in production: judges, agents, RAG pipelines, not just consumed them. — Experience working with large financial institutions or heavily regulated industries. What we offer — A foundational role in a fast-growing AI infrastructure company. — Direct exposure to the most sophisticated AI engineering teams in Europe. — Competitive salary + equity (ESOP). — Hybrid setup in Barcelona. — Paid AI tooling and model credits, and the expectation that you use them. — A small, high-ownership team where your work has real impact from day one.

Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Transfer Pricing Teams wirst du mit einer guten Mischung aus Weitsicht und einem Blick fürs Detail unseren Kunden dabei helfen, alle Belange der Verrechnungspreisgestaltung optimal zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Transfer Pricing Strategien, weshalb wir uns immer über deine innovativen Ideen freuen. Bring dich in unser interdisziplinäres Team ein, nutze die neuesten digitalen Tools und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns innovative Lösungen. items.desc: We are growing. And we are looking for talented people. At Decskill, we believe that technological excellence is driven by human talent. We are an IT consulting company with more than 10 years of consolidated experience in the market, focused on building long-term relationships with both our clients and our people. Today, we are a community of over 800 professionals, working from Lisbon, Porto, and Madrid, contributing to impactful technology initiatives. As part of the Astek Group, we combine a strong local culture with a global presence, being active in around 23 countries across 4 continents. This allows us to offer an international context, diverse challenges, and long-term career opportunities, while staying close to our teams. We are looking for an AI Adoption & Change Management Specialist – Platform Expert ! Mission: Lead the adoption of AI and AI agents within Software Engineering teams, helping evolve their Ways of Working throughout the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). The role translates technological opportunities into practical changes in team processes, responsibilities, and skills, supporting adoption and evaluating results. The ideal candidate should understand the main concepts of AI applied to software development and be familiar with the different stages of the SDLC. The technical implementation of platforms, agents, and integrations will be carried out in partnership with engineering and technology teams. Responsibilities Understand current Ways of Working and identify opportunities to integrate AI into software engineering processes. Define principles and practices with teams for working with AI throughout the SDLC. Facilitate workflow reviews, helping teams determine where AI can support their work and how to integrate these changes into their daily routines. Collaborate with Engineering, Product, Architecture, Security, Testing, and Platform teams to prioritize opportunities and prepare pilot initiatives. Lead change management activities, including stakeholder analysis, communication, training, coaching, and champion engagement. Prepare leaders and teams for new ways of working, clarifying the impact on responsibilities, skills, and collaboration. Gather feedback from pilot initiatives, identify adoption challenges, and coordinate solutions with the relevant teams. Create reusable materials and practices, such as guidelines, reference workflows, and enablement plans. Define, together with the teams, how to monitor adoption, productivity, quality, and developer experience. Follow developments in AI and AI agents for software development and translate relevant advances into adoption opportunities. Track results and support continuous improvement based on quantitative metrics and team feedback. Requirements: Up to 15 years of experience in a relevant role for the service to be contracted. Bachelor's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. Solid experience in change management, organizational transformation, or technology adoption, ideally within engineering, IT, or software development environments. Functional understanding of the SDLC and key software engineering activities, from requirements and design to testing, security, and release. Conceptual knowledge of AI-assisted software development and AI agents, including their use cases, limitations, and implications for teams. Experience designing adoption, training, and communication initiatives, and supporting change after launch. Ability to facilitate workshops and discussions with diverse audiences, from developers and tech leads to managers and senior stakeholders. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly and adapt messages to different audiences. Ability to influence multidisciplinary teams and work effectively in a matrix organization. Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with a problem-solving mindset. Results-oriented approach, with the ability to monitor metrics and combine quantitative data with team feedback. Commitment to the quality of deliverables. Ability to work collaboratively with global teams. Fluency in Portuguese and English, both written and spoken. Experience working on strategic projects. Nice to have: Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Jira, and Confluence. Experience in Agile, DevOps, software engineering transformation, or developer experience initiatives. Experience creating communities of practice, champion networks, or training programs. Familiarity with security, quality, and governance practices applied to software development. Experience supporting organizational change in large, distributed, or international organizations. Knowledge of Spanish, both written and spoken. items.desc: Description The opportunity ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will join an established team and contribute to data science and AI work across varied client projects. Working with more experienced colleagues, you will prepare data, test analytical approaches, help develop prototypes and communicate what the results mean. You will gain exposure to the consulting process, learning how to turn complex client questions into practical analyses and communicate findings to a range of audiences. What You Will Do Work with data scientists and subject matter experts to understand project questions, available data and appropriate outputs. Clean, combine and explore datasets, write clear Python and document your assumptions and checks. Build and compare straightforward statistical or machine learning models, use suitable baselines and help evaluate accuracy, limitations and potential bias. Contribute to prototypes using methods suited to the problem, including language models where appropriate, and test outputs carefully before sharing them. Prepare charts, concise written findings and presentation material, explain your work to colleagues and, with support, to clients and subject matter experts. Use feedback and code review to improve your work, and contribute to reproducible project files and team knowledge sharing. What You Will Bring Hands-on experience applying data science through a project, research, internship or commercial work. Experience using Python gained through employment, an internship, research or substantial personal or academic projects. A grounding in statistics and common machine learning methods, such as regression or classification, and experience of training, testing and model evaluation. Care with data quality, documentation and clear, reproducible code, willingness to learn version control and collaborative development practices. Curiosity about real client problems, willingness to ask questions and ability to explain your thinking in clear written and spoken English. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative or social science field. Useful Additional Experience Exposure to public policy, government, research or evaluation. Hands-on exploration of large language models, including checking responses against source material, experience with AI agents is welcome but not required. Experience with Git, cloud services, data visualisation, collaborative projects or presenting technical work to a nontechnical audience. What You Can Expect You will learn from colleagues with a range of technical and subject expertise while contributing to complex, varied projects. We will support your career development through ongoing training, feedback and opportunities to deepen both your data science and consulting skills. As your experience grows, you will take on more responsibility in shaping and delivering solutions. Right to Work, Location & Sponsorship Role We welcome applications from candidates based anywhere in the world. For roles located in the UK, Belgium, Spain, or Germany , applicants must: Hold the right to work in the country where the role is based, or be eligible for visa sponsorship, which we may consider on a case-by-case basis, and Be physically present in that country by their first day of employment (or able to relocate beforehand). Unless stated otherwise, relocation support is not automatically provided. #Indeed Bot and Third-Party Applications Please note that this application must be submitted directly by the applicant for consideration. Failure to do so may result in the application being excluded for consideration. Applicants needing an accommodation for disability or religious purposes in connection with the application process should contact Candidateaccommodation@icf.com for assistance. About Us Working at ICF means applying a passion for meaningful work with intellectual rigor to help solve the leading issues of our day. Smart, compassionate, innovative, committed, ICF employees tackle unprecedented challenges to benefit people, businesses, and governments around the globe. We believe in collaboration, mutual respect, open communication, and opportunity for growth. We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building an inclusive workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are committed to creating a culture where we embrace our differences in ideas and identities. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. Learn more about what we do and our commitment to inclusion. items.desc: Job Description DXC ayuda a empresas globales a ejecutar sus sistemas y operaciones críticos para el negocio mientras moderniza la TI, optimiza las arquitecturas de datos y garantiza la seguridad y la escalabilidad en nubes públicas, privadas e híbridas. Las mayores compañías del mundo y organizaciones del sector público confían en DXC para desplegar servicios que impulsen nuevos niveles de rendimiento, competitividad y experiencia del cliente en todo su entorno de TI. Contamos con más de 125.000 personas en más de 70 países, en las que nuestros clientes confían la entrega de tecnologías transformadoras para garantizar el éxito, la seguridad y el bienestar de empresas y personas en todo el mundo. Creamos soluciones y generamos mejores resultados para los clientes a lo largo de todo su entorno de IT combinando fortalezas y experiencia a nivel global. Descubre más sobre cómo ofrecemos excelencia a clientes y compañeros en DXC.com. En España somos uno de los principales líderes del mercado de TI. Contamos con cerca de 8.000 profesionales, distribuidos en trece localizaciones, con centros de excelencia en tecnologías de última generación como Cloud, Inteligencia de Negocio, IA o Automatización entre otras, que dan servicio a más de 200 clientes de todas las industrias tanto del sector público como privado. Trabajamos con las principales empresas del país que confían en nosotros para guiar y administrar sus agendas digitales y así transformar sus negocios. Desarrollamos políticas activas de diversidad e inclusión laboral de personas con discapacidad y estamos orgullosos de contar con una representación del 49% aproximadamente de mujeres profesionales. En DXC estamos construyendo una plataforma agéntica de operación cloud: agentes de IA que ayudan a diagnosticar, gobernar y automatizar la operación de entornos cloud complejos, siempre con control humano y trazabilidad. Buscamos a la persona que convierta esas ideas en soluciones que funcionan en producción, trabajando codo con codo con el cliente y con un equipo de cloud pública de alta exigencia técnica. items.desc: ¿Te apasiona la tecnología, la innovación y crear soluciones con impacto real? En Raona ayudamos a las empresas a transformar la forma en la que trabajan a través de tecnología Microsoft, IA, automatización y Digital Workplace. Llevamos más de 20 años anticipándonos al futuro tecnológico y hoy somos un equipo internacional de más de 360 personas repartidas entre España, Andorra, Argentina y Colombia. Trabajamos con grandes compañías de múltiples sectores, desarrollando soluciones innovadoras que mejoran la experiencia de las personas, impulsan la productividad y generan impacto real en negocio. Pero más allá de la tecnología, hay algo que nos define especialmente: nuestra cultura. Apostamos por la autonomía, la flexibilidad, el aprendizaje continuo y un entorno cercano donde las ideas cuentan y las personas pueden crecer de verdad. Si buscas un lugar donde crecer, aportar y rodearte de gente con pasión por la tecnología, sigue leyendo 👇 La oportunidad 🚀 En Raona creemos que la IA no va solo de tecnología. Va de resolver problemas reales, generar impacto y transformar la forma de trabajar de las personas. Por eso buscamos incorporar un/a AI Solution Builder para unirse a nuestro equipo. Estamos buscando un perfil híbrido entre: negocio, producto y tecnología. Una persona capaz de entender los retos de nuestros clientes , identificar oportunidades de mejora y construir soluciones funcionales utilizando IA y herramientas de desarrollo asistido. No buscamos a alguien que documente requisitos para que otros desarrollen. Buscamos a alguien que entienda el problema, construya una primera solución funcional, la valide con los usuarios y la evolucione hasta generar valor real para el negocio. Participarás en proyectos innovadores, colaborando con equipos multidisciplinares y siendo parte activa en la definición de cómo la IA transformará la forma de trabajar de nuestros clientes y equipos. ¿Cuál será tu misión? Ayudar a convertir ideas, necesidades y retos de negocio en soluciones funcionales basadas en IA, trabajando de forma cercana con usuarios, stakeholders y equipos técnicos. Estas serán algunas de tus responsabilidades: Trabajar junto a áreas de negocio para identificar necesidades, oportunidades de mejora y retos estratégicos. Entender procesos, detectar casos de uso de alto impacto y ayudar a priorizarlos según su valor y viabilidad. Diseñar y construir prototipos, MVPs, agentes y soluciones funcionales utilizando herramientas de IA generativa y desarrollo asistido. Validar soluciones de forma rápida con usuarios y stakeholders, iterando continuamente a partir del feedback recibido. Integrar soluciones con APIs, datos y sistemas corporativos cuando sea necesario. Colaborar con equipos técnicos para evolucionar e industrializar las soluciones validadas. Documentar y comunicar decisiones funcionales, técnicas y de negocio. Compartir conocimiento, buenas prácticas y aprendizajes con clientes y equipos internos. Identificar nuevas oportunidades de aplicación de IA en procesos, productos y operaciones. Participar puntualmente en sesiones de demostración, workshops o iniciativas de innovación. Lo que buscamos en ti 🔍 Nos encantará conocerte si cuentas con: Experiencia trabajando con usuarios, áreas de negocio o stakeholders para entender necesidades y transformarlas en soluciones prácticas. Uso habitual de herramientas de IA generativa como Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot o similares. Capacidad para construir MVPs, prototipos o soluciones funcionales de forma autónoma. Conocimientos técnicos que te permitan trabajar con aplicaciones, APIs, datos y tecnologías modernas. Capacidad para desenvolverte en entornos ambiguos y convertir ideas en resultados tangibles. Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y colaboración. Mentalidad de aprendizaje continuo, experimentación y mejora constante. Sumarás puntos si además tienes experiencia en... Desarrollo de software y buenas prácticas de ingeniería. Construcción de agentes y asistentes basados en IA. Microsoft Copilot Studio. Power Platform y Dataverse. Microsoft Graph. Azure AI Services. Integración de APIs REST y sistemas de terceros. Prompt Engineering y arquitecturas RAG. Product Management, Product Ownership o metodologías Agile. Sectores complejos como banca, seguros, industria o servicios profesionales. ¿Qué tipo de perfil puede encajar? Valoramos perfiles con trayectorias diversas. Puede que vengas del mundo del desarrollo de software y hayas evolucionado hacia la construcción de soluciones de negocio con IA. O puede que vengas del mundo del producto, la innovación o la consultoría y hayas incorporado la IA como herramienta habitual para diseñar y validar soluciones. Lo más importante para nosotros es tu capacidad para convertir problemas reales en soluciones funcionales que generen impacto. items.desc: Binnen Flynth zetten we de volgende stappen in onze innovatieve reis: het inzetten van AI om processen slimmer, efficiënter en kwalitatiever te maken. Bouw jij hands-on mee! Wat ga je doen? Als AI Engineer werk je met de nieuwste technologieën, waaronder Microsoft Fabric en Microsoft Foundry. Je krijgt veel ruimte om te experimenteren, te leren en impact te maken. In deze rol werk je nauw samen met interne collega’s en externe AI-partners, waardoor je veel kunt leren van experts in het veld. Tegelijkertijd krijg je de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om zelf AI-oplossingen te ontwikkelen die écht verschil maken binnen Flynth. Denk aan het bouwen van AI-applicaties en -agents die werken met zowel gestructureerde als ongestructureerde data om processen te automatiseren, inzichten te versnellen en medewerkers te ondersteunen. Je top 6 werkzaamheden als AI Engineer: Ontwikkelen van AI-applicaties en -agents die bedrijfsprocessen ondersteunen of automatiseren; Bouwen en verfijnen van prompts voor LLM’s (zoals GPT), inclusief iteratief testen en optimaliseren; Samenwerken met externe AI-partners om kennis op te doen en oplossingen te implementeren; Bouwen en door ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen, in lijn met de moderne Azure architectuur van Flynth; Integreren van AI-oplossingen met zowel gestructureerde als ongestructureerde data; Evalueren en monitoren van output van modellen en algehele performance van AI-oplossingen Wat bieden wij jou? Een mooi salaris tussen de €3.356 en €5.632 met daar bovenop vakantietoeslag, een premievrijpensioen, 25 vakantiedagen én 56 flexuren. Winstdeling want we doen het samen bij Flynth, dus alle winst investeren we in onze medewerkers en organisatie. Optimaal verder ontwikkelen door een uitgebreide onboarding, studiefaciliteiten, een eigen performance coach en vrijheid in je werk. Vergoeding van je reiskosten en een thuiswerkvergoeding. Ingerichte thuiswerkplek zodat jij net zo comfortabel thuiswerkt als op kantoor. Laptop en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken. Wat breng je mee? Voor deze functie is het ten minste belangrijk dat jij: Beschikt over een afgeronde HBO opleiding en een sterke basis hebt in software en/of webdevelopment; Ervaring hebt met het ontwerpen van RAG- en/of multi-agent systemen. Ervaring hebt met agentic software engineering en Python. Je bent nieuwsgierig, creatief en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit. Je hebt een passie voor AI en LLMs maken al langere tijd een integraal deel uit van je leven. Het spreekt jou aan om te werken aan concrete oplossingen, waarbij je mag werken met externe toonaangevende partners op het gebied van AI. Je weet deze kennis te absorberen, te vertalen naar Flynth context en je collega's daarin mee te nemen. Daarom vinden we het belangrijk dat je communicatief vaardig bent, graag samenwerkt en initiatief durft te nemen. Bij ons kan jij elke dag met je passie bezig zijn! Jouw werkplek Je werkt in een energiek en ambitieus team waar samenwerking centraal staat. We werken volgens de Agile-methodiek, met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor initiatief. Je krijgt de kans om te werken aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten met impact op ondernemers in heel Nederland. Ook krijg je toegang tot moderne tooling en een innovatieve werkomgeving waarin experimenteren wordt aangemoedigd. Dit alles doen we hybride met de flexibiliteit om te werken op een van de kantoren in het land, thuis en wanneer je wilt. Online assessment Flynth vindt het waarborgen van een objectief en eerlijk selectieproces heel belangrijk. Daarom ontvang je direct na jouw sollicitatie een uitnodiging voor ons game-based assessment per e-mail. Door dit assessment kunnen we jouw talenten in kaart brengen, nog voordat we jouw CV en eventuele motivatie bekijken. Uiteraard krijg je zelf ook inzicht in de uitkomsten. Hierdoor bieden we elke kandidaat gelijke kansen. Let op, sollicitaties zullen pas in behandeling worden genomen na het afronden van het game-based assessment. Sollicitatieprocedure Solliciteer via de knop Heb je interesse in deze vacature? Gebruik het formulier om je gegevens achter te laten. Je krijgt direct een uitnodiging voor ons online assessment. Online assessment Je krijgt een uitnodiging om een online assessment te maken. Dit kan thuis op een moment dat voor jou uitkomt. Na afronding nemen we binnen 3 werkdagen contact op. JUST ADD AI (JAAI) hilft Unternehmen dabei, den aktuellsten Stand der KI-Technologie zu verstehen und auf ihr Geschäft anzuwenden. Der Fokus von JAAI liegt dabei auf der Programmierung von skalierbaren KI-Lösungen, die bei unseren Kunden sofort Mehrwerte schaffen. Um das Wachstum der Ausgründungen zu sichern, werden in den Tochtergesellschaften Beteiligungen vergeben und strategische Partner an Bord geholt. Das Arbeiten in der JAAI Group zeichnet sich durch eine offene Kommunikation aus. Probleme werden in Teams aus Top-Spezialisten der Bereiche KI-Agenten, Sprachverarbeitung (LLMs), Computervision, Big Data und Robotik, sowie aus erfahrenen IT-Managern und -Architekten, gemeinsam gelöst. Unsere Mission: „Unlock Human Talent“. KI öffnet durch die Automatisierung repetitiver und zeitraubender Tätigkeiten neue Freiräume für die Entfaltung des vollen Potentials menschlicher Talente.

items.desc: En LISDATA desarrollamos soluciones tecnológicas a medida en el ámbito de la Industria 4.0, el Big Data y la Inteligencia Artificial. Ayudamos a nuestros clientes a sacar el máximo partido a sus datos y a convertirlos en decisiones que impulsan su negocio. Para nosotros/as, las personas son el verdadero motor de la innovación. Por eso cuidamos una cultura cercana, en la que el talento, el bienestar y el desarrollo profesional ocupan un lugar central, un compromiso que fue reconocido en 2022 con el Premio a la Calidad en el Empleo en Cantabria. Queremos sumar a nuestro equipo Científicos/as de Datos con experiencia previa y ganas de afrontar nuevos retos. Trabajarás en una de nuestras oficinas de Cantabria, participando en el desarrollo de modelos analíticos y soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial para proyectos reales. ¿Qué harás en LIS? Colaborarás con el equipo de proyectos en la definición y desarrollo de soluciones de analítica avanzada e Inteligencia Artificial. Realizarás análisis exploratorios de datos para identificar patrones, variables relevantes y oportunidades de mejora. Diseñarás, entrenarás y evaluarás modelos de Machine Learning y Deep Learning utilizando Python y sus principales librerías. Trabajarás con bases de datos SQL y NoSQL para la extracción, preparación y explotación de la información. Participarás en la puesta en producción y el seguimiento de modelos en entornos cloud. Presentarás resultados de forma clara, apoyándote en herramientas de visualización y Business Intelligence. ¿Qué valoramos de ti? Imprescindible: Formación universitaria o máster en Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Matemáticas, Física, Analítica de Datos o similar. Si no tienes titulación universitaria pero cuentas con formación técnica acreditable en programación y bases de datos (FP, cursos, certificaciones…), también queremos conocerte. Experiencia en programación con Python y librerías como NumPy, Pandas y Matplotlib. Conocimientos avanzados de SQL (DML y DDL) en SQL Server, PostgreSQL y/o MongoDB. Conocimientos de analítica avanzada, análisis exploratorio de variables y técnicas de Machine Learning y Deep Learning. Valorable: Experiencia con librerías de ML/DL como Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch o YOLO. Conocimientos de PySpark y experiencia en entornos Databricks y Azure Blob Storage. Conocimientos de MLOps con Azure ML. Experiencia en procesamiento de lenguaje natural, LLMs y arquitecturas RAG. Certificaciones DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate) o AI-102 (Azure AI Engineer Associate). Experiencia con herramientas de Business Intelligence como Power BI, Qlik Sense o Tableau. Nivel de inglés mínimo B2. ¿Qué te ofrecemos? Plan de carrera personalizado, orientado a tu desarrollo profesional. Contrato indefinido a jornada completa. Flexibilidad horaria. 23 días hábiles de vacaciones. Jornada intensiva los viernes, en verano y durante la Navidad. Gimnasio gratuito. Si lo tuyo es descubrir lo que esconden los datos y llevarlo a la práctica, tu próximo reto te espera en LIS.

items.desc: Forward Deployed Engineer - Applied AI Up to £80,000 base + equity | London, with UK client travel Your first Forward Deployed Engineer role. AI that makes it into production. You’ve built software that people rely on. You’re comfortable in Python, have practical experience with AI and ML, and want to get closer to the problems your technology solves. Now you want more involvement: understanding the customer’s challenge, deciding what to build, shipping it and seeing the difference it makes. This is an opportunity to move into Forward Deployed Engineering at an early-stage AI company building agentic systems for wealth management. You’ll work closely with an experienced leadership team invested in developing you, with access to senior clients and real ownership of production systems. You don’t need to have held an FDE title before. You do need solid engineering foundations, curiosity and the confidence to take responsibility as you learn. Why this opportunity stands out Leadership you can learn from. Work directly with a leadership team that will help you develop your technical judgement, customer confidence and ability to take projects from an initial conversation through to production. Clients who will stretch you. Work with established wealth management firms, engaging with technology leaders, compliance teams and senior advisers. Learn how to turn complex, sometimes ambiguous requirements into systems people can trust. Substantial engineering challenges. Build AI agents for real workflows where accuracy, security and reliability matter. Your work will involve Python, models, evaluations, cloud infrastructure and the practical challenges of running AI in production. A say in the product. What you learn on client projects will feed directly into the core platform. You’ll help build reusable capabilities that make each deployment better than the last. Room to grow. Join while the business and its FDE function are still taking shape, with the opportunity to build your skills and take on broader responsibility as the company grows. What you’ll do You’ll work across customer, product and ML teams, helping take AI projects from an initial problem through to a working system. That will include: Working directly with clients to understand their workflows and define what a successful solution looks like. Building and deploying agentic AI systems for tasks such as document generation, client information capture, file reviews and compliance monitoring. Writing production Python across backend services, agents, data pipelines and evaluation tooling. Building test sets and evaluation metrics, measuring performance against real customer requirements and improving the results. Deploying into customers’ Azure environments, with attention to security, access and reliability. Turning lessons from client work into reusable components for the wider platform. Supporting the systems you ship, including participating in on-call support when customers need it. What you’ll bring You might currently be a software engineer, backend engineer, ML engineer or applied AI engineer. Your job title matters less than what you’ve built and how you approach problems. We’re looking for: Strong Python skills and experience building and maintaining production software. Practical AI or ML engineering experience , including evaluating and deploying systems beyond a prototype. Confidence working with cloud infrastructure. Azure is particularly useful; AWS or GCP experience is relevant too. Clear communication. You can explain technical decisions, ask useful questions and work through uncertainty with others. An interest in customer-facing engineering. You want to understand the business problem as well as the technology. Thoughtful views on AI agents , including retrieval, tool use, evaluation and guardrails. Experience with customers, financial services or another regulated sector would be useful, but isn’t essential. You don’t need to arrive knowing every tool in the stack. The technology Python, FastAPI, Pydantic, Azure, PostgreSQL, OpenAI and Anthropic models, agent evaluation frameworks, Microsoft 365 integrations and financial services CRM systems. What’s on offer Base salary up to £80,000, plus equity. Close access to an experienced leadership team committed to your development. The opportunity to build your FDE career through hands-on work with established clients. Ownership of meaningful engineering decisions and a direct contribution to the product. An early-stage environment with high trust and room to take initiative. London office presence, with travel to client sites across the UK. Interested? Apply with your CV and a short note about something you’ve built, the part you owned and why you’d like to move into Forward Deployed Engineering.

items.desc: Who We Are Accenture is a leading global provider of a broad range of professional services in strategy and consulting, interactive marketing, information technology and business operations services, with digital capabilities in all of these areas. With more than 800,000 employees worldwide, we serve clients in more than 120 countries. We have been operating in Slovakia since 1992 and employ more than 2,100 people in Bratislava and Košice. Accenture globally has ranked 4th on the Great Place to Work® World’s Best Workplaces™ . Are you a forward-thinking, analytical, and tech-savvy professional eager to build a career in consulting, strategy, and tech-driven business? Join our Strategy & Consulting team as a Business Analyst and work on multinational transformation programs for clients across industries such as Telecommunications, EU Institutions, Financial Services, and Utilities. Accenture works with around 75% of Fortune Global 500 companies , giving you exposure to large-scale projects across Europe and globally. On these projects, we work closely with our clients to support them in making data-driven decisions to move their business forward. Leveraging AI, cloud, automation, and other modern digital tools and systems, we develop and deliver leading transformations that combine business expertise with modern technologies. This role offers exposure to a wide spectrum of project types. Depending on the project, your work can range from analyzing and improving business processes, through structuring and solving complex business challenges, to working with data or supporting the delivery of technology-, Generative AI-, and Agentic AI-driven solutions. YOUR MISSION: Support strategic advisory to large and renowned companies, identifying and driving initiatives that help improve performance, enhance customer experience, or drive operational efficiency. Analyze business processes and data to support the design of solutions in areas such as customer relationship management, supply chain management, and finance. Contribute to the development of client-ready analyses, recommendations, and presentations within project teams. Contribute to initiatives where AI is embedded into business operations, such as Agentic AI solutions that automate and orchestrate workflows and Gen AI use cases that enhance insights, decision making, and productivity. Depending on the engagement, your tasks may include participating in stakeholder interviews or workshops, preparing functional requirements or user stories, mapping processes, supporting testing activities, or performing data analysis using modern tools. Work with consultants and client teams to gather inputs, clarify requirements, and support the delivery of project outcomes. WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU? items.desc: The opportunity Our client, an established international financial and professional services group, is looking for a hands-on Data, Analytics, AI & Power BI Manager to join its Data & Analytics function in Belfast. This is a genuine player-manager role. You will own the day-to-day running of the Power BI environment and the delivery of analytics, AI and dashboard solutions, while staying close to the build yourself: developing semantic models and reports, troubleshooting platform issues, building HTML dashboards and rapidly prototyping AI-enabled solutions. Alongside this you will lead a small team of BI analysts, developers and data engineers, and act as a trusted partner to senior leaders across Finance, Commercial and Operations. It is not a purely strategic or people-management position, so it suits someone who enjoys getting into the data as much as leading the delivery. Key responsibilities Business partnering Work with senior leaders to understand commercial and operational challenges and find where data, analytics and AI can add value. Turn ambiguous questions into clear requirements, prioritised use cases and evidence-based recommendations, and own a value-led backlog. Power BI platform and development Manage the Power BI environment day to day: workspaces, apps, gateways, refreshes, deployment pipelines, access, row-level security, monitoring and releases. Stay hands-on with semantic models, Power Query, DAX, reports and dashboards, and set standards for naming, version control, testing, documentation and performance. Work with Technology and Security on capacity, licensing, tenant settings and incidents, and enable governed self-service reporting. Analytics and insight Use SQL and modern tools to analyse financial, client, operational and CRM data, moving the business from descriptive reporting towards diagnostic and predictive analytics. Deliver use cases such as revenue and margin, client retention, forecasting, productivity, anomaly detection and data-quality investigation. HTML dashboards and AI Design and build responsive HTML dashboards and lightweight analytical apps (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, visualisation libraries) where they suit better than Power BI. Identify and prototype practical uses of generative AI, Copilot, AI agents and automation, such as natural-language data querying and automated management insight. Delivery and team leadership Lead analytics and AI use cases end to end, from discovery and prototype through to production, adoption and benefit tracking. Manage, coach and develop BI and analytics colleagues, allocating work and reviewing technical quality. Make sure data products are governed, secure and trusted, working closely with Data Governance, Data Engineering and Security. What you will bring Essential Significant experience in data, analytics or business intelligence, including ownership of end-to-end analytical delivery. Advanced, hands-on Power BI: Power BI Service, workspace and app management, semantic modelling, Power Query, DAX, performance tuning, security and deployment. Strong SQL and the ability to work independently with large, complex and imperfect datasets. Experience managing or coordinating analysts, BI developers or data engineers, including prioritisation and quality review. Practical experience building HTML / web-based dashboards using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Practical experience applying generative AI, LLMs, Copilot, AI agents or automation to business problems. Experience with modern cloud data platforms, ideally Microsoft Fabric and the wider Microsoft data stack. Confident stakeholder management and strong communication and data storytelling skills. Desirable Python, notebooks, dbt or similar transformation tooling. Forecasting, predictive modelling or machine learning experience. Good understanding of data governance, data quality, master data and enterprise data architecture. Background in financial services, professional services or another complex B2B environment.

items.desc: So sieht Dein Aufgabengebiet aus Du strukturierst und priorisierst komplexe analytische Fragestellungen mit strategischem und bereichsübergreifendem Business-Bezug. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf den Bereichen Commercial und Buying. Du berätst Business Leads und Daten Key User pro Team und übersetzt dabei Geschäftsfragen in klare Fragestellungen, Analyseansätze und Datenmodelle, arbeitest dabei eng mit Analytics und Data Engineers zusammen. Du führst Analysen mit SQL, Power BI, Excel und bei Bedarf Python durch und leitest daraus verständliche, belastbare Handlungsempfehlungen ab. Die Nutzung von Coding Agents ist dabei Kernprozess, inklusive umgebenden Werkzeugen wie Skills und MCP-Server. Du übernimmst die fachliche Verantwortung für Analyse-, KPI- und Reporting-Initiativen mit hohem Business Impact und entwickelst skalierbare Datenprodukte weiter. Du nimmst dabei für wichtige Produkte auch eine Product Owner Rolle ein, indem du aktiv Features auf Businessnutzen hinterfragst. Du unterstützt bei der Analyse businessbezogener Datenprobleme, bewertest deren fachliche Auswirkungen von Alternativen und unterstützt die Sicherstellung der Datenqualitätsstandards im Datenteam. Du entwickelst Business Analyse-Methoden, Standards und Self-Service-Strukturen maßgeblich weiter, beispielsweise durch flexiblere Dashboards, dokumentierte Metrik-Definitionen, neue Ansätze und KI-Werkzeuge wie Conversational Analytics oder Agentic PowerBI. Du stärkst mit fachlichem Coaching und Wissenstransfer die analytischen Fähigkeiten der Analysten-Kolleg:innen, Business Leads und Key Usern. Das bringst Du mit Du hast ein Studium oder eine Ausbildung im Bereich Data Analytics, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Statistik, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Alternativ verfügst Du über eine entsprechende praktische Qualifikation. Du verfügst über mindestens drei Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung als Business/Data/BI Analyst oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle. Du strukturierst komplexe Geschäftsfragen, entwickelst geeignete Analyseansätze und übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in klare Datenmodell-, KPI- und Reporting-Definitionen, die Du mit Fachbereichen und Engineers abstimmst. Daraus leitest Du konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für unterschiedliche Stakeholder ab. Du beherrschst SQL sicher und kannst auch komplexere Datenanalysen in einem Data-Warehouse-Umfeld wie BigQuery selbstständig durchführen. Optional kennst du Transformationsworks wie dbt zur Erstellung wiederverwendbarer SQL-Datenmodelle. Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in Power BI und hast Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung interaktiver Dashboards und skalierbarer Reporting-Lösungen. Optional hast du bereits den PowerBI-MCP Server genutzt und bist schon auf agentic-first Fertigung umgestiegen. Du kennst alle Methoden der deskriptiven Statistik und kannst Zusammenhänge, Unterschiede und Entwicklungen methodisch belastbar analysieren. Grundkenntnisse in der Inferenzstatistik sind ebenfalls vorhanden, um den Einsatz von Machine Learning Methoden einschätzen zu können Du besitzt ein solides Verständnis von Retail- und E-Commerce-Prozessen. Kenntnisse in artikelbezogenen Prozessen wie Einkauf, Wareneingang, Bestandssteuerung, Lagerhaltung, Abverkauf und Retoure sind von Vorteil. Du arbeitest eigenständig und hands-on, kannst analytische Themen nach Business-Nutzen priorisieren und übernimmst Verantwortung von der Klärung der Fragestellung bis zur Nutzung des Ergebnisses. Du kommunizierst komplexe analytische Zusammenhänge verständlich und sicher gegenüber Business Leads, Key Usern sowie technischen Ansprechpartner:innen, nimmst dabei eine aktive, leitende Rolle ein. Du hast Freude daran, Kolleg:innen und Fachbereiche methodisch zu unterstützen, Wissen weiterzugeben und analytische Standards im Unternehmen weiterzuentwickeln. Du beschäftigst Dich aktiv mit neuen Möglichkeiten im Datenbereich, insbesondere mit Large Language Models, KI-gestützten Analyseprozessen, agentischen Self-Service-Lösungen, sowie Dateninnovationen der Cloud-Anbieter. Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Im Team sowie im Austausch mit unseren Fachbereichen sprechen und schreiben wir überwiegend Deutsch. Code und technische Dokumentation werden auf Englisch verfasst. Beides beherrschst Du sicher. items.desc: KI-Systeme bauen, integrieren und beim Mittelstand zum Laufen bringen. Du baust KI-Systeme, die wirklich laufen – RAG-Pipelines, Agenten, Automatisierungen. Und Du willst nicht im Backlog eines Produktteams verschwinden, sondern direkt beim Kunden sehen, was deine Lösung bewirkt. Als Forward Deployed AI Engineer bei Neurawork bist Du die technische Instanz in unseren Kundenprojekten im Mittelstand: Du verstehst die Prozesse des Kunden, entwirfst die Architektur, integrierst unsere Standardprodukte tief in seine Systemlandschaft und sorgst dafür, dass am Ende etwas produktiv läuft – nicht nur auf Folien existiert. Weil Du technisch weißt, wovon du sprichst, berätst du Kunden auf Augenhöhe – bis in die Geschäftsführung. Wir arbeiten nach unserem eigenen Operational-AI-Vorgehensmodell. Wir sind keine Automation-Agentur und keine Custom-Softwareentwickler: Wir setzen auf standardisierte Produkte als Hebel und passen sie bis zur vollständigen Integration an. Wir kreieren echten, messbaren Mehrwert – und stehen dafür ein. Aufgaben Was du bei uns machst Technische Umsetzung beim Kunden: Architektur, Integration und Inbetriebnahme von KI-Lösungen (LLMs, RAG, Agentic AI, Automatisierung) in bestehende Systemlandschaften – Cloud oder lokal Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Use Cases auf Umsetzbarkeit, Datenlage, Kosten und Grenzen prüfen und nach Wirkung priorisieren Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Kunden-IT: Schnittstellen, Datenanbindung, Sicherheit, Betrieb Beratung mit technischer Substanz: Kunden von der Fachabteilung bis zur Geschäftsführung fundiert beraten – Roadmaps, die technisch tragen Mitgestaltung unserer Frameworks und Produkte: Erkenntnisse aus Projekten zurückspielen Wissenstransfer: Live-Sessions aus laufenden Projekten in unserer KI-Ausbildung mit anschließendem TÜV-SÜD Zertifikat und im KI- Business-Coaching Wie wir arbeiten Framework-driven statt ad hoc – und du gestaltest die Frameworks mit Standardprodukte als Hebel, Anpassungen bis zur Full-Integration selbstverständlich Wert statt Stunden – Ergebnisse statt Tagessätze Direkter Draht zum Founding-Team, keine Beratungspyramide Präsenz online wie offline; GF Christoph Knöll ist sichtbar in der DACH-KI-Szene (data:unplugged, TÜV SÜD, LinkedIn) Qualifikationen Was wir suchen Studium im MINT-Bereich (z. As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in transforming business opportunities into data-driven solutions that optimize pricing decisions, accelerate commercial excellence, and create measurable business value. You will collaborate closely with commercial, IT, finance, marketing, R&D, and sales teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced analytics, machine learning models, and digital solutions that support strategic and operational decision-making. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of data science initiatives, from business understanding and solution design to implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement. In addition, you will actively contribute to the adoption of data-driven ways of working by supporting stakeholder engagement, training, and change management activities to ensure successful implementation and sustainable business impact. Key Responsibilities Your will play a key role in this strategic and innovative pricing project and will be responsible to Design, develop, deploy, and maintain AI/ML solutions that support pricing and commercial decision-making across multiple business domains. Design and maintain end-to-end MLOps pipelines covering training, deployment, monitoring, and retraining. Contribute to the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of pricing algorithms, decision-support models, and digital platforms. Support the Domain Manager in managing AI/ML products and services throughout their lifecycle, ensuring alignment with business objectives and needs, governance standards, and long-term scalability. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, IT, and data scientists to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions. Support solution architecture, technical roadmap execution, and continuous evolution of the enterprise pricing ecosystem. Develop processes and tools to monitor and analyze model performance and data accuracy. Ensure best programming practices are applied. Qualifications Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, Engineering, Economics, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering, AI Engineering, or MLOps. Strong technical skills in Python, SQL, API development (FastAPI preferred). Hands-on experience developing and deploying machine learning models in production environments. Strong knowledge of MLOps, CI/CD, Git, Docker, Kubernetes, Linux, Airflow, MLflow, and cloud platforms, preferably Microsoft Azure (Azure ML, AKS, ACR, App Services). Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to collect, analyze, and interpret complex data sets Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build relationships with internal and external stakeholders Fluency in English is required, knowledge of additional European languages is a plus It’s a plus if you also have the following Experience in pricing, commercial analytics, revenue management, or optimization. Hands-on experience building and deploying Generative AI, RAG, or Agentic AI solutions in enterprise environments. Experience with React/NextJS or modern web application development is considered an advantage. Experience leading technical initiatives, mentoring colleagues, and driving adoption of data and AI solutions. Experience working in the steel industry in office and plant environments Other important details Full-time position, based in Esch-sur-Alzette, Luxembourg Normal hours are 8 hours per day plus lunch, Monday to Friday Start and finish times are flexible to fit personal needs Teleworking day available up to 1 day a week In return, you will Be part of the world’s leading steel and mining company that thrives in becoming carbon neutral by 2050 Receive a competitive base salary reflective of your skills and experience, several benefits and an annual incentive program to reward your performance Shape your career strategy thanks to technical & leadership trainings suggested by ArcelorMittal University Support a safety-focused and inclusive work environment How we recruit We are committed to building an inclusive organisation where everyone feels supported and valued. items.desc: Our client, a leading global multi strategy hedge fund, is looking for an AI Engineer in London to build and embed production-grade AI solutions across its Macro and Fixed Income investment business. Sitting within a specialist AI enablement team, the role works directly with portfolio managers, analysts, researchers and trading desks, while partnering with central AI and Data Science teams to turn investment requirements into scalable products. The position exists to close the gap between advanced AI capabilities and practical front-office adoption, improving how investment teams analyse markets, price risk and make decisions across rates, credit and FX. Responsibilities Work directly with Macro and Fixed Income investment teams to identify high-value opportunities for AI, automation and advanced analytics. Build and deploy production-grade LLM, agentic AI and data-driven applications for investment research, pricing, risk and trading workflows. Translate requirements from portfolio managers, analysts and traders into robust technical products that can be iterated quickly and scaled. Drive adoption through practical demonstrations, on-desk collaboration, user education and ongoing product support. Capture feedback from investment users, evaluate emerging AI techniques and influence the development of the wider internal AI platform. Requirements Must have experience supporting front-office users of Macro or Fixed Income markets, including areas such as rates, credit, FX, market data, pricing or investment research. 2+ years of professional software engineering, quantitative development or applied AI experience, Strong Python engineering skills and experience taking AI or machine learning applications from concept through to production. Practical exposure to LLM applications, RAG, AI agents, evaluation, monitoring or model integration within controlled production environments. Strong stakeholder skills, commercial awareness and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical teams and investment professionals. This is an opportunity for an engineer who wants their work used directly by sophisticated investment professionals rather than sitting several layers away from the business. You will own meaningful problems from initial conversation through to production, gain day-to-day exposure to Macro and Fixed Income decision-making, and help shape how a major investment platform applies generative AI across the front office. The role offers a strong progression path for someone combining high-quality engineering with product judgement, stakeholder confidence and an interest in financial markets. Why Apply? If you are building production AI systems and want greater ownership, closer investment exposure and a clearer connection between your work and commercial outcomes, please get in touch for a confidential conversation.

Das erwartet dich Digitalisierung – Du entwickelst innovative, digitale Lösungen und treibst die Umsetzung unserer Digitalisierungsstrategie voran. Transfer Pricing – Du arbeitest an komplexen Fragestellungen wie globalen Wertschöpfungskettenanalysen, der Segmentierung heterogener Finanzdaten und der Auswertung internationaler Regelwerke im internationalen Steuerkontext. Projektarbeit – Du bist in der Projektarbeit gemeinsam mit interdisziplinären Teams aus Anwält:innen, Ökonom:innen und Steuerberater:innen an Digitalisierungsprojekten tätig und bringst KI-Lösungen in den produktiven Einsatz. Das bringst du mit Du hast dein Studium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Software Engineering, Künstlicher Intelligenz oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung abgeschlossen, idealerweise mit Schwerpunkt auf Systementwicklung oder KI sowie betriebswirtschaftlichen Themen. Du verfügst über Erfahrung im Umgang mit LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG-Architekturen, Knowledge Graphs und moderner Full-Stack-Entwicklung. Auch der Einsatz von Caude Claude und Codex gehört für dich idealerweise zum Arbeitsalltag. Du verbindest technisches Verständnis mit wirtschaftlichen Kenntnissen und hast Freude daran, an der Schnittstelle zwischen Technologie, Business und Beratung zu arbeiten. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit zur klaren und verständlichen Kommunikation mit Fachexpert:innen aus dem Transfer Pricing Bereich ohne IT-Hintergrund. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift runden dein Profil ab. Deine Benefits Flexibilität – In Abstimmung mit deinem Team erwartet dich ein Mix aus gemeinsamen Bürotagen und Home Office. Dabei gibt es keine Kernarbeitszeiten – im Rahmen der betrieblichen Anforderungen und arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben kannst du deine Arbeitszeit flexibel gestalten. Zusätzlich hast du die Möglichkeit, temporär in über 40 Ländern zu arbeiten. Berufsexamen – Durch unsere interne Academy, internationale Erfahrungen durch Secondments und kontinuierliches Mentoring entwickelst du dich stetig weiter. Zusätzlich unterstützen wir dich bei dem Erlangen der Berufsexamina: Wirtschaftsprüfer:in, Voll-WP, Steuerberater:in und Aktuar:in. Freizeit – Überstunden kannst du auf deinem Jahresarbeitszeitenkonto (JAZ) sammeln und nach arbeitsintensiven Phasen durch Freizeit ausgleichen. Restliche Überstunden werden einmal jährlich ausgezahlt. Zusätzlich stehen dir 30 Urlaubstage im Kalenderjahr zur Verfügung. Gesundheit – Deine Gesundheit liegt uns am Herzen: Neben einer eigenen betrieblichen Krankenkasse bieten wir auch Vorsorgeuntersuchungen sowie Sportangebote an. Nimm an unserem kostenlosen Betriebssportprogramm teil oder profitiere von einer vergünstigten Urban Sports Club-Mitgliedschaft. Das ist noch nicht alles – Wir möchten ein positives Arbeitsumfeld schaffen: Ein Umfeld, in dem flexibles und kreatives Arbeiten möglich ist, in dem Arbeit anerkannt und Leistung honoriert wird und auf das wir stolz sind. Alle Benefits findest du auf unserer Karriereseite. Bei PwC Deutschland arbeiten wir daran, entscheidende Herausforderungen zu lösen, nachhaltige Ergebnisse zu schaffen und das Vertrauen in die Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft auszubauen. Als Teil unseres Transfer Pricing Teams wirst du mit einer guten Mischung aus Weitsicht und einem Blick fürs Detail unseren Kunden dabei helfen, alle Belange der Verrechnungspreisgestaltung optimal zu begleiten. Dafür entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Transfer Pricing Strategien, weshalb wir uns immer über deine innovativen Ideen freuen. Bring dich in unser interdisziplinäres Team ein, nutze die neuesten digitalen Tools und entwickle gemeinsam mit uns innovative Lösungen. Kontakt Du hast Fragen zu dieser Position oder deiner Bewerbung? Melde dich gerne bei Ines Wallenwein unter +49 69 95855225.

items.desc: Vanaf het begin werk je aan uitdagende projecten die je analytische en interpersoonlijke vaardigheden op de proef stellen. Deze projecten kunnen zich in alle onderdelen van Jumbo bevinden, van logistiek tot marketing en van formule tot inkoop. Je bouwt data science producten van begin (ruwe data) tot eind (productieklare modellen). Gemakkelijk 50% van je tijd besteed je aan data-preparatie, exploratie, (geavanceerde) analyses en zelfs wat BI, dus het is belangrijk dat je dat ook leuk vindt naast Machine Learning / het bouwen van AI Agents. We focussen op resultaat, niet op output: klanten veranderen in fans door betere beslissingen op basis van de inzichten die jij ontdekt. Dit ga je doen Analyseer grote datasets om inzichten te ontdekken die beslissingen in winkels, online en supply chain verbeteren. Bouw voorspelmodellen die helpen winkelvoorraad, de vraag naar producten en klantgedrag beter te voorspellen. Onderzoek commerciële kansen door prijs-, promotie- en assortimentsdata te analyseren. Ontwikkel data-agents, dashboards en geautomatiseerde rapportages waarmee je collega’s dagelijks je data science producten gebruiken. Verbeter de datakwaliteit door datastromen te controleren en issues te signaleren en op te lossen. Test, optimaliseer en implementeer machine learning modellen in onze productieomgeving. Vertaal complexe analyses naar begrijpelijke adviezen voor collega’s buiten Data Science. Lever met modellen directe businessimpact, zoals minder derving, betere beschikbaarheid of hogere klanttevredenheid. Jouw werkdag als Junior Data Scientist bij Jumbo: 09.00 – 11.00: Je werkt in DataBricks (PySpark) met onze enorme datasets om het model te verbeteren dat de uitwisselbaarheid van producten inschat, wat een sleutelrol speelt in het selecteren van het juiste assortiment. 11.00 – 12.00: Je bekijkt de laatste resultaten van de machine learning modellen in jouw portfolio. 12.00 – 12.45: Lunchmeeting met je collega’s van DS&A in ons Foodcafé. 13.00 – 15.00: Je doet een peer review van een model dat is ontwikkeld door een collega om onze loyaliteitsaanbiedingen te verbeteren, waarbij je die kennis gebruikt om ons assortimentsmodel te verbeteren. 15.00 – 17.00: Je woont een workshop bij die zich richt op het verbeteren van de differentiatie van winkelindelingen met een data-gedreven aanpak. Een MSc of PhD met uitstekende academische resultaten in Computer Science, Econometrie, Data Science of andere kwantitatieve vakgebieden en 0 tot 3 jaar relevante werkervaring; Passie voor zowel Machine Learning als Agentic AI en een solide begrip van supervised en unsupervised learning methoden (RF, LGBM, XGB, Lasso/Ridge, SVD, KNN, ALS, LLMs, …), statistiek en tijdreeksanalyse (BSTS, SARIMA-X, etc.) en Agentic packages (LangChain/LangGraph, PydanticAI, OpenAI, AutoGen). Kennis van optimalisatiemethoden (LP / MILP) is een sterke pré; Je weet dat het vakgebied Data Science voortdurend evolueert, dus een leergierige houding is voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je beseft dat effectief blijven vraagt om het leren van zowel soft- als hard-skills; Je levert liever code en werkende data-producten dan PowerPoint-slides: Python is vereist, PySpark is een sterke pré. Je bouwt graag data-tools in PowerBI. Ervaring met DataBricks is een sterke pré. SQL en R zijn nice-to-haves; Sterke communicatie- en samenwerkingsvaardigheden: je kunt uitleggen wat de ‘so what’ (en soms ‘waarom’) is van een modelaanbeveling. Je neemt eindgebruikers van je modellen mee in het tempo dat past bij de (on)mogelijkheden van je modellen; Hoewel beheersing van de Nederlandse taal een pré is, is het geen vereiste. Een bruto maandsalaris tussen €3.900 – €5.100 (op basis van 40 uur); Een jaarlijkse bonus van maximaal 5% van je jaarsalaris, gebaseerd op organisatiedoelen; 30 betaalde vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om dagen te kopen of verkopen) en 8% vakantiegeld. Je bouwt pensioen op via deelname aan het Pensioenfonds voor de Levensmiddelenindustrie; Een reiskostenvergoeding (€ 0,21 per kilometer met een maximum van 35 kilometer enkele reis). We werken graag samen op kantoor, maar deels thuiswerken is ook mogelijk; Ruimte voor ondernemerschap, groei en ontwikkeling. Niet alleen in je functie, maar ook via onze Jumbo Academy, online trainingen via GoodHabitz en met een opleidingsbudget; Dagelijks verse lunch in ons Foodcafé, goede koffie en vers fruit. Je kunt dagelijks sporten in onze eigen Jumbo Gym tegen een kleine vergoeding; Collega-kortingen zoals 10% korting op je boodschappen (tot €325 per jaar), deelname aan onze collectieve zorgverzekering of kortingen via Benefits at Work. Wil je meer weten over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Klik dan hier . Kyon Adriaans +31624151674 kyon.adriaans@jumbo.com

items.desc: We’re looking for an AI Engineer who enjoys building useful software and wants to do more than experiment with AI, someone who can turn it into reliable solutions that people actually use. At Boyum IT, we’re exploring how AI can make a real difference across our products and the way we work internally. That might mean building an assistant that helps colleagues find the right information faster, supporting our customer-facing teams with smarter tools, or connecting AI capabilities with our existing products and systems. This is a practical, hands-on engineering role. You’ll have space to explore new ideas, but the goal is always the same: build something useful, reliable, and ready for the real world. You don’t need to know every technology in our stack from day one. We’re looking for a strong software engineer who already has some hands-on experience with AI and wants to go deeper. Location: Aarhus, Denmark - regular office presence is required. About the Team: We call ourselves the “Unified Platform Services” team and work across products and development teams to build shared solutions and make individual product teams more effective. We also help shape how AI is used across our different products. We are a small team with a mix of skills across AI, DevOps, and traditional software development. What You Will Be Doing As our new AI engineer colleague, you will be assigned to specific AI projects and deliveries, but you’ll also share what you learn and help other development teams make effective use of AI tools. As part of these two focus areas, you will: Design, build and maintain AI-powered applications, assistants and services. Develop backend services and APIs. Work with LLM-powered applications, RAG, semantic search and agentic workflows. Build and improve data pipelines and knowledge bases used by AI applications. Help evaluate AI solutions and improve their quality, reliability and accuracy. Deploy and operate solutions in Azure. Work with Docker, CI/CD and Azure DevOps as part of the development lifecycle. Collaborate with product teams and internal functions to understand problems and turn them into practical technical solutions. Build reusable tools, integrations and templates that help other teams work effectively with AI. Share knowledge and contribute to how we use AI across the company. Our current technology landscape includes Python, PostgreSQL/vector, Dagster, Azure, Azure AI Foundry, MCP, Docker and Azure DevOps. What We Are Looking For We think you’ll be a good match if you have: At least 3+ years of software development experience , ideally in backend or software engineering Experience building production services or APIs – ideally AI-related ones Hands-on experience building AI-powered applications or integrating AI into software A solid understanding of databases, testing, and maintainable software Curiosity about where AI genuinely adds value, and where it doesn’t The ability to work with both technical and non-technical colleagues to understand a problem before jumping to a solution Nice to Have Experience with any of the following is a bonus, not a checklist: C# Azure or another cloud platform Docker, DevOps, and CI/CD Data pipelines RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or AI agents Why Join Boyum IT At Boyum IT, our culture is built around Energy for Life - the belief that people do their best work when they feel energized, supported, and able to balance work with life outside of work. For us, Energy for Life means creating a workplace where people can grow professionally, stay healthy, feel connected, and have the flexibility to be present for family, friends, and personal priorities. What We Offer A culture built around our Energy for Life mindset Flexible work arrangements and respect for work-life balance A diverse, international team with colleagues from more than 45 nationalities A supportive workplace focused on wellbeing, inclusion, and belonging Career development opportunities aligned with your personal goals Helpful, knowledgeable, and collaborative colleagues A workplace where your ideas and feedback are valued Boyum IT committed to responsible business and positive ESG impact Interested? Send us your CV in English or Danish . We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so there’s no need to wait until the last minute. You don’t need experience with every technology listed in the advertisement. What matters most is a strong software engineering foundation, practical experience building with AI, and an interest in taking solutions from an idea into reliable everyday use. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.
