items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer experience is a feature, not an afterthought. Build reliable workflows for deployments, configuration, storage, and observability. Handle the retries, state, and failure cases that come with operations spanning multiple services and data centres. Work with Kubernetes and our runtime infrastructure through the control plane, and help diagnose latency, throughput, and reliability issues across the platform. Build tooling that helps us operate safely at scale. Participate in on-call for the systems you build. What we're looking for 2–5 years of professional backend software development experience. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in a comparable backend language (Rust, Java, C++) and an interest in writing Go day-to-day. Solid distributed systems fundamentals. You've debugged service-to-service problems in production and understand retries, partial failures, and idempotency. Comfort designing APIs and resource models that other engineers will actually use. Experience with relational databases, including schemas, transactions, and migrations. Experience building asynchronous systems using queues, background jobs, state machines, or similar patterns. Working knowledge of Kubernetes and an interest in building software that deploys and manages workloads on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Experience running highly available services, including being on-call. Bonus points for Experience building developer tools, platforms, control planes, runtimes, or other products for developers. Experience building software that interacts with Kubernetes, such as controllers, operators, or deployment systems. Familiarity with serverless or edge-compute platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Lambda, Fly.io, Deno Deploy, etc.). Experience with technologies in our stack such as Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, NATS/JetStream, Knative, or Dapr. Experience operating software across multiple regions or data centres. Open source contributions, particularly in the Go ecosystem.

items.desc: Job Description (Senior) Data Engineer Job Location: Delft Division: Destination & Retail Work Model: Hybrid Full-Time/Part-Time: Full Time Contract Type: Permanent Job Req ID: 1782 Are you ready to be the owner of data systems that power critical business decisions? Within ABB E-mobility, we are building a new venture focused on an end-to-end managed offering that brings together hardware, software, and operational excellence into a unified service model. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-scaling, high-impact business within ABB E-mobility, where you as (Senior) Data Engineer will play a key role in shaping the data platform for our next growth chapter. What you will do: We are looking for a (Senior) Data Engineer to be our first internal hire in this new venture. Our data platform has been built on Azure Databricks and is live in production. You will own it end-to-end. Note: This is not a role for the faint of heart. You’ll be joining a fast-moving team where priorities shift quickly, challenges come without warning, and solutions rarely exist yet. It will demand grit, speed, and relentless ownership. Your responsibilities will include: Own our data platform end-to-end, whether it means deciding on the best strategy to ingest a new data source or repairing a broken pipeline at 10 pm (thankfully our pipelines rarely break :)) Proactively identify data quality issues, pipeline gaps, and business logic inconsistencies before data consumers find them Build and maintain data pipelines using Delta Live Tables (DLT) as our core framework, authored in Python and SQL and deployed via Databricks Asset Bundles Extend and maintain our custom API ingestion framework (a native Spark Data Source) to onboard new data sources, handling pagination, incremental state, and schema evolution Integrate and process streaming data from Azure Event Hubs into our data Lakehouse Own data modelling and medallion architecture decisions (Bronze/Silver/Gold), including evolving them as the business grows Develop a genuine understanding of the business domain: charging network operations, industry protocols (OCPP, OCPI), billing logic, and how the data is used by our Operations team Orchestrate and monitor multi-step jobs end-to-end using Databricks Workflows Manage and evolve cloud infrastructure using Terraform on Azure (Event Hubs, ADLS, Key Vault, Unity Catalog, networking) in combination with Databricks Asset Bundles for workspace assets Enforce data quality through DLT expectations and SQL alert definitions; own freshness and observability standards for the platform Maintain CI/CD pipelines via Azure DevOps Contribute to our customer-facing Charging Portal, which currently embeds Databricks dashboards and serves as the foundation for future API endpoints and customer self-service features What you will bring: You thrive in ambiguity and like to own outcomes. You excel where things are undefined, turning chaos into structure. You don’t wait for perfect clarity to act. You build, iterate, and scale. You learn new domains fast, both the technical protocols and what they mean in practice for the people depending on them. You can sit with our Operations team, understand what they actually need, and go build it without handholding. You communicate findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and know when to surface a problem versus silently fix it. Your qualifications: 4–7 years of experience as a Data Engineer or equivalent role Strong SQL and PySpark skills, comfortable reasoning about distributed execution, partitioning, and query performance Hands-on experience with Databricks, ideally with Delta Live Tables (DLT), Databricks Workflows, and Unity Catalog Experience with streaming data architectures (Azure Event Hubs or equivalent) Experience building REST API ingestion pipelines: incremental loads, pagination, schema evolution, auth patterns Comfortable with cloud infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred, or equivalent) Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps or equivalent) Truly autonomous, able to define your own priorities and make architectural decisions you can defend Deeply curious about the business domain, you'll be expected to learn and understand the EV charging industry, protocols, billing flows, etc. Strong ownership mentality, you treat production incidents as your personal responsibility Comfortable managing shifting priorities and ambiguity Fluent in English, with strong written and oral communication skills What we can offer: Work with the best specialists in their field, in a diverse environment with unparalleled global reach. items.desc: About Telnyx Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network , to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications. We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team. Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers. What you'll do Design and build the Go services behind our serverless platform, function deployment pipeline, and global control plane. Own backend and control-plane software, from customer-facing APIs and resource lifecycles to services that deploy and manage workloads across our edge infrastructure. Make the platform great to use: clean APIs, a sharp CLI, predictable behaviour, and useful error messages. Developer experience is a feature, not an afterthought. Build reliable workflows for deployments, configuration, storage, and observability. Handle the retries, state, and failure cases that come with operations spanning multiple services and data centres. Work with Kubernetes and our runtime infrastructure through the control plane, and help diagnose latency, throughput, and reliability issues across the platform. Build tooling that helps us operate safely at scale. Participate in on-call for the systems you build. What we're looking for 2–5 years of professional backend software development experience. Proficiency in Go, or strong experience in a comparable backend language (Rust, Java, C++) and an interest in writing Go day-to-day. Solid distributed systems fundamentals. You've debugged service-to-service problems in production and understand retries, partial failures, and idempotency. Comfort designing APIs and resource models that other engineers will actually use. Experience with relational databases, including schemas, transactions, and migrations. Experience building asynchronous systems using queues, background jobs, state machines, or similar patterns. Working knowledge of Kubernetes and an interest in building software that deploys and manages workloads on Kubernetes-based infrastructure. Experience running highly available services, including being on-call. Bonus points for Experience building developer tools, platforms, control planes, runtimes, or other products for developers. Experience building software that interacts with Kubernetes, such as controllers, operators, or deployment systems. Familiarity with serverless or edge-compute platforms (Cloudflare Workers, Fastly Compute, Lambda, Fly.io, Deno Deploy, etc.). Experience with technologies in our stack such as Docker, Kubernetes, PostgreSQL, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, NATS/JetStream, Knative, or Dapr. Experience operating software across multiple regions or data centres. Open source contributions, particularly in the Go ecosystem.

Ready to catapult your cyber security
items.desc: Hi, we're glad you're here! We are hiring to our Aviva Services Excellence Centre! Take a look at our job description - maybe it suits you or one of your friends? Aviva is looking for a Security Analyst responsible for daily cyber threat monitoring and response across Aviva Group globally. You won’t just be watching alerts; you’ll be managing incidents end-to-end, mitigating threats and having real impact on how we operate, detect and respond to cyber incidents. Why join us? Ready to catapult your cyber security career? Join our high-octane Global Security Operations Centre (GSOC) , where no two days - and no two threats - are ever the same. We’re looking for a passionate SOC Analyst to join a world-class team defending our organization 24/7/365, operating on 12h shifts. In-House Power: We manage our security internally. Here, you aren't just a consultant; you have direct influence over our actual defence mechanisms. Constant Evolution: Forget the routine. You’ll face complex, evolving challenges that keep your skills sharp. Cyber - One of Aviva's Key Priorities: We must ensure our colleagues, customers and business are safe. Cyber security is deeply embedded in our organisation and its importance is recognized across the Group. Investing in our people, capabilities and technologies is at the heart of our values. Career Progression: We love seeing our people grow. We put our colleagues first by enabling and supporting career development within cyber and other areas. What will you be doing? Real-Time Defence: Monitoring IT security breaches, responding to cyber incidents to ensure threats are adequately mitigated. Incident Ownership: Driving cyber incident response through the lifecycle, from the detection to containment, eradication and recovery. Threat Correlation: Connecting the dots between different cyber threats to see the bigger picture. Detection Optimization: Recommending improvements for correlation rules and fine-tuning our "radar." Documentation Mastery: Drafting GSOC technical playbooks, response plans, and processes. Subject Matter Expertise: Acting as an SME for GSOC and Detection & Response projects. What we’re looking for: Experience: At least 1 year of hands-on working as a SOC Analyst. Communication: English at a minimum B2/C1 level (written and spoken). Framework Knowledge: Solid understanding of the NIST standard for incident management, ITIL Foundation, the MITRE ATT&CK and the Cyber Kill Chain. Autonomy: The ability to work independently, make critical decisions under pressure and tight time scales. Technical Foundations: Strong grasp of networking (Protocols, ISO/OSI) and IT service operations, knowledge of Windows, Linux, iOS, and Active Directory. Tool Proficiency: Hands-on experience with DLP, EDR, SIEM, Firewalls, IPS/IDS, and SOAR. Being Ahead of the Game: A hunger for OSINT, proactive approach to incident response and picking up tasks, providing improvement ideas. In Aviva Services Excellence Centre, we provide: Contract of employment Performance Bonus Private medical care (ENEL-MED) Cafeteria system of benefits (e.g. MultiSport card) Additional parent privileges: baby leave – 6 weeks leave for second parent shortened working time after parental leave Employer-funded group insurance Employee Shares Plan Extra day off for birthday Paid time off to volunteer Additional leave acquired over the years in the company (even 5 days more in a year) Wellbeing Leave - additional two weeks paid leave after 10 years of service Psychological support consultations Access to the e-learning platforms Internal employee referral program Hybrid working model from Poland with a few days in Warsaw office per month Attractive office location in Warsaw - Gdański Business Center Additional entitlements for people with disabilities - Work Without Barriers Work environment that promotes diversity - Diversity Charter Do you see yourself in Aviva Services Excellence Centre? Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned. Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations. Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution. For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets. May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. items.desc: Your Mission At INBRAIN, we are developing intelligent neural technologies powered by graphene to create life-changing therapies for patients with neurological disorders. Bringing these innovations to patients requires a robust and scalable manufacturing environment built on advanced microfabrication processes, exceptional engineering, and a culture of continuous improvement. We are looking for an Equipment & Automation Engineer to own and optimize the production equipment that enables our manufacturing operations. In this role, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of manufacturing equipment, from specification and installation through qualification, maintenance, automation, and continuous improvement. You will work closely with Operations, Facilities, Quality, and external partners to ensure equipment reliability, support production growth, and develop solutions that improve safety, throughput, and operational efficiency. This is a highly hands-on role with significant ownership and visibility across the organization. What You'll Do Equipment Reliability & Maintenance Own the reliability and maintenance strategy for assigned production equipment, including predictive, preventive, and corrective maintenance activities. Lead complex troubleshooting, root-cause investigations, and corrective actions to minimize downtime and support manufacturing continuity. Monitor equipment performance, failure trends, and maintenance metrics to identify opportunities for reliability improvements and risk reduction. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance equipment availability, performance, and operational efficiency. Equipment Lifecycle & Capital Projects Define technical requirements and specifications for new production equipment, tooling, and critical spare parts, supporting supplier selection and procurement activities. Lead equipment implementation projects from concept through installation, commissioning, qualification, validation, production release, and operational handover. Develop equipment lifecycle plans and contribute to long-term manufacturing scalability and asset management strategies. Coordinate facility readiness activities, including utilities, infrastructure, environmental controls, safety requirements, and equipment hookups. Supplier & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary technical point of contact for equipment manufacturers and service providers, ensuring effective collaboration and timely resolution of technical issues. Manage external suppliers and machine shops, including technical drawings, GD&T specifications, statements of work, and acceptance criteria. Partner closely with Operations, Facilities, Quality, Procurement, and external contractors to successfully deploy and maintain manufacturing capabilities. Automation & Manufacturing Improvement Design and implement custom tools, fixtures, equipment modifications, and automation solutions that improve equipment capability, reliability, safety, throughput, and productivity. items.desc: At Capgemini Invent, we believe difference drives change. As inventive transformation consultants, we blend our strategic, creative and scientific capabilities, collaborating closely with clients to deliver cutting-edge solutions. Join us to drive transformation tailored to our client's challenges of today and tomorrow. Informed and validated by science and data. Superpowered by creativity and design. All underpinned by technology created with purpose. YOUR ROLE About the role Boards are no longer asking how to run shared services more cheaply. They are asking where capability should sit at all. Global Business Services and Global Capability Centers have shifted from back-office cost arbitrage to strategic delivery engines expected to own capability, innovation and resilience not just transaction volume. At the same time, AI and automation are collapsing the cost logic that most GBS/GCC footprints were built on, forcing a rewrite of operating models designed for a pre-AI world. Clients no longer want a location study. They want a defensible answer to where work should happen, who should do it, and how the organization is governed around it – one that holds for the next decade, not the next budget cycle. This role exists to lead that conversation: from first CEO/COO conversation through to target operating model design, GBS/GCC strategy and stood-up delivery. What you'll do Originate and lead. Build and lead operating model and GBS/GCC transformation engagements with C-suite and board-level stakeholders. Own the commercial pipeline for this offer across existing accounts and new clients. Design and deliver. Lead target operating model design, organization design, GBS/GCC location and service-scope strategy, governance model design, and transition roadmaps from diagnostic through to implementation. Build intellectual capital. Develop differentiated points of view and assets on the future of GBS/GCC: AI-enabled delivery, nearshoring economics, talent and skills models that sharpen Capgemini Invent's position in the market. Lead people. Build, coach and grow a team of managers and consultants. Act as a career sponsor within the practice. Connect across Capgemini. Link operating model and GBS/GCC design to the wider Group's technology, AI and managed-services capability, so recommendations convert into build. YOUR PROFILE What you bring Must-have: Significant experience (8+years) leading operating model design and/or GBS/GCC strategy, setup, optimization or transformation engagements within a top-tier strategy or management consulting environment Proven track record in leading complex, multi country transformation programs and delivering measurable value Deep expertise in at least two of: target operating model design, organization design, location strategy, service delivery model design, shared-services governance, offshoring/nearshoring economics Experience building and developing consulting teams Fluent English required; German and/or French depending on location (Zurich, Geneva) Strong commercial acumen, comfortable owning business development targets and engagement economics Strong plus: Strong understanding of Swiss client environments, including an existing client network across industries Experience redesigning service delivery around AI-enabled automation Financial Transformation acumen WHAT YOU’LL LOVE ABOUT WORKING HERE Be the change by supporting our clients through innovative strategy projects around digital, future-proof topics that challenge and transform the status quo; Enjoy an entrepreneurial freedom and a collaborative atmosphere within a large company where your opinion is valued and will have a strong impact - on our clients, society, and yourself; Experience the benefits of hybrid working, offering flexibility and ensuring work-life balance, 5 weeks of vacation, employee referral bonus, company shares program and annual contribution to a fitness subscription; Capgemini Switzerland is an equal opportunity employer. We promote equality and dignity in all aspects of recruitment and employment, and all offers of employment and promotions are made on the basis of performance, competence and ability. The Corporate Experience (CE) team partners with senior executives to transform corporate functions into future ready, digitally enabled, and business centric value creators. We rethink how Finance, HR, IT, Procurement and other enabling functions operate, leveraging strategy, data, technology, and experience design to deliver measurable impact. As part of CE Switzerland, you will shape and scale a rapidly growing practice focused on next generation corporate transformation—combining strategy, process excellence, AI enabled operating models, and sustainable ways of working. Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. We bring deep expertise in agile delivery, digital transformation, and platform engineering across central government. With a team of over one hundred and twenty-five professionals — more than forty percent of whom are women — we are committed to building inclusive, diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve. The Role We are looking for an experienced Test Automation Engineer to build and run automated testing for public sector digital services. You will work in multidisciplinary agile teams, using code to test micro services, user interfaces and APIs, and to build quality into every release through continuous testing. Key Responsibilities Design, build and maintain automated tests for UI and APIs, using Selenium, Cypress or Playwright and REST Assured. Test micro services, including service interactions and contracts. Write behaviour-driven (BDD) tests using Cucumber that the whole team can read and trust. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so tests run continuously. Plan and run performance, security and accessibility testing. Write clean, maintainable test code, and review other engineers' tests. Analyse results, raise defects with clear evidence and help track them to a fix. Work with developers, business analysts and product owners to define acceptance criteria and test coverage. Report on quality, test coverage and release risks. Share good test automation practice and support colleagues. What We are Looking For Essential: Strong, hands-on experience of test automation and programming (for example Java, JavaScript or TypeScript). Experience testing microservices, with UI and API automation. Experience with BDD and Cucumber. Experience with at least one of Selenium, Cypress or Playwright. Experience with REST Assured for API testing. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and continuous testing. Experience with performance, security and accessibility testing. Experience working in agile, multidisciplinary teams. Strong communication skills. Desirable: Performance tools such as JMeter, k6 or Gatling. Accessibility testing to WCAG 2.2. Security testing tools, such as OWASP ZAP. Experience delivering services to the GDS Service Standard. AWS or Azure experience. Experience mentoring other testers. Why Join Scrumconnect Ltd? At Scrumconnect, we are more than just a consultancy. We are a collaborative team focused on delivering impactful digital transformation services across government and enterprise organisations. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Exposure to major public sector digital transformation programmes. A collaborative and inclusive working culture. items.desc: About CreativeX CreativeX is B2B SaaS technology platform that helps global marketing teams make smarter creative decisions and elevate creative expression through the clarity of data. Our technology powers creative decision-making at some of the biggest brands in the world, including Google, Unilever, Pepsi, Bayer, Mondelez, Heineken, and more. We use computer vision and other machine learning techniques to extract creative data from our client's digital advertising copy and transform those previously dark signals into a standardised data model at industrial scale. This creates a new, unique and powerful first party data set that represents the last and most impactful untapped reservoir of advertising performance. That's because multiple studies have shown that the "Creative" itself is responsible for half of sales lift online, higher than reach, targeting, brand, & recency combined. But creative impact has always been the least analysed and least understood component of a complex set of marketing variables. This is the problem CreativeX is focussed on solving. We're an end-to-end solution to ingest, process, and analyse content at scale. Our objective is to help marketing organisations power every creative decision with data. items.desc: Heb jij een passie voor de nieuwste AI-technologieën en wil je zowel technisch als strategisch uitgedaagd worden? Wij van Datacation geloven erin dat je door de brug te slaan tussen bedrijfsuitdagingen en de bijbehorende data écht impact kunt maken! Voor ons team in Eindhoven zijn wij op zoek naar een gedreven AI Engineer met een specialisatie in Large Language Models (LLMs) en RAG-oplossingen, met affiniteit voor agentic AI en autonome AI agents. Over Datacation Datacation is de data- en AI-partner waar inhoud, kwaliteit en eigenaarschap centraal staan. Wij helpen organisaties om data structureel in te zetten voor betere besluitvorming, van strategie en architectuur tot implementatie en adoptie. In de afgelopen vijf jaar zijn we uitgegroeid tot een team van ongeveer 50 collega’s, werkzaam vanuit onze kantoren in Eindhoven en Amsterdam. Functieomschrijving Als AI Engineer help je onze klanten het volledige potentieel van hun data te ontsluiten met geavanceerde AI-technieken. Je werkt aan complexe, real-world uitdagingen en loopt voorop in een snel evoluerend vakgebied. Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit: Het vertalen van complexe businessuitdagingen naar concrete, datagedreven AI-oplossingen; Het ontwikkelen en implementeren van geavanceerde oplossingen met Large Language Models (LLMs) en technieken zoals Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), waaronder agentic AI-oplossingen met (autonome) AI agents; Meedenken over de juiste data- en modelarchitectuur voor schaalbare en robuuste oplossingen; Nauw samenwerken met onze senior experts en de klant om innovatieve oplossingen te leveren die direct waarde toevoegen; Het presenteren van je ideeën en resultaten aan zowel een technisch als niet-technisch publiek. Wat verwachten we van jou? Een MSc of PhD in een relevant vakgebied zoals data science, artificial intelligence of computer science; Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare rol (Data Scientist, Data Engineer of Software Engineer); Een gedegen begrip van fundamentele AI-modellen, waaronder transformers, text embeddings en op GPT gebaseerde modellen; Uitgebreide ervaring met Python volgens industriestandaarden en een goede beheersing van SQL; Ervaring met cloudplatformen zoals Azure, AWS of Databricks; Vaardig in het werken met AI-ontwikkelbibliotheken en -frameworks zoals TensorFlow, PyTorch, LangChain, LlamaIndex en Hugging Face; Een sterke basis in de principes van software engineering en design patterns, en de praktische toepassing hiervan in projecten; Ervaring met het in productie brengen, monitoren en finetunen van AI-oplossingen; Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift; Een leergierige, ondernemende en proactieve instelling. Wat kun je van ons verwachten? De mogelijkheid om je te ontwikkelen tot een expert in het snelgroeiende veld van AI; Technisch uitdagende projecten binnen een breed scala aan sectoren; Veel autonomie en verantwoordelijkheid in een platte en dynamische organisatie; Samenwerken in een enthousiast en hecht team van technische collega’s op ons kantoor op de High Tech Campus in Eindhoven; De ruimte om te experimenteren met de nieuwste technologieën en hierin door te groeien; Budget voor opleidingen, certificeringen en (internationale) conferenties; Verschillende uitjes per jaar met als hoogtepunt de jaarlijkse wintersport; Deelgenoot worden van ons bedrijf, met een ambitieus team waarmee we samen de lat hoog leggen. Voldoe je niet aan alle eisen, maar denk je toch een goede match te zijn? Overtuig ons en solliciteer! Vragen over de functie? Neem contact op met Daan Verdaasdonk via d.verdaasdonk@datacation.nl.

About the role: myPOS is building a high-impact Data Science function to power the intelligence layer of one of Europe’s fastest-growing payment and commerce platforms. As a Data Scientist, you will contribute to a focused team working across a rich portfolio of models that drive smarter decisions in Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, Product and Technology. You will move fluidly across problem types: from customer lifetime value and churn modelling to fraud scoring and agentic AI workflows. What you’ll do: Build and maintain ML models across the core portfolio: CLTV, churn prediction, propensity to buy, and Next Most Likely Product (NMLP) Develop fraud detection models including transaction-level classifiers, merchant behaviour anomaly detectors, and new-account risk scorers Contribute scored model outputs to the Next Best Action (NBA) decisioning layer that selects the optimal action for each merchant across Sales, Marketing, and in-product touchpoints Support A/B experiments, uplift tests, and multi-armed bandit evaluations to measure the incremental impact of model-driven interventions Design and implement end-to-end ML pipelines - from data ingestion and feature engineering through to model training, evaluation, and deployment Monitor deployed models in production: detect performance degradation, data drift, and data quality issues; iterate and document changes proactively Collaborate with business teams across Sales, Marketing, Risk, Operations, and Product to translate business problems into well-defined data science solutions Run rigorous experiments and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders Contribute to LLM-powered agentic workflows using tool-use patterns (RAG, function calling, memory) and frameworks such as LangChain or LlamaIndex Contribute to team documentation: model cards, methodology write-ups, and internal playbooks that help the team scale its practices What you bring: 3–5 years of hands-on applied data science, machine learning or statistical modelling experience in a commercial setting, with models shipped and measured in production. items.desc: Dans le cadre de l’ouverture d’un poste en CDI, nous recrutons un.e AI engineer (f/m/d) , basé-e à Paris. 🚀 CONTEXTE & ENJEUX STRATÉGIQUES Au sein de Decathlon Digital, l'équipe People Data engage une initiative majeure : transformer l'expérience de nos 100 000 collaborateurs par l'intégration de l'IA Générative et Agentique. Face à la fragmentation de l'écosystème RH dans plus de 70 pays, notre ambition est de construire une couche de simplification en s’appuyant sur les nouvelles solutions que proposent l’IA. Il s'agit d'une couche d'intelligence centralisée et agnostique des outils, capable d'interagir avec l'ensemble de notre infrastructure (Workday, Data Lake, University, ...) pour faire évoluer nos interfaces d'une logique de consultation vers une logique d'action. Dans ce cadre, nous développons DaiLY , notre agent conversationnel RH. Il aide nos collaborateurs et managers à accéder instantanément à une information fiable, sourcée à partir de notre documentation Workday et de nos politiques People. Déjà déployé avec succès en France, DaiLY entre dans une nouvelle phase de passage à l'échelle : extension internationale, industrialisation des évaluations, amélioration continue de nos modèles et de leurs qualités et déploiement et intégration d’agents autonomes RH. Pour mener ce projet, nous ne recherchons pas uniquement un.e développeur.se, nous avons besoin d'un.e " Builder " : un.e personne capable de traduire un besoin métier en solution technique, de l’implémenter, la qualifier, la déployer et la maintenir dans le temps. 🎯 VOTRE MISSION Nous recherchons un(e) AI Engineer confirmé(e) pour participer activement à l'industrialisation et au développement de DaiLY. Votre objectif est clair : transformer les besoins métiers RH en fonctionnalités IA fiables, mesurables et robustes. Pour relever ce défi, vous évoluerez au sein d'un collectif dédié , en collaboration directe avec d'autres AI Engineers, un Lead AI Engineer (qui orientera les choix d'architecture globale) et une Product Manager. Cette organisation de proximité vous permettra d'assurer une synergie parfaite entre les enjeux produits, la roadmap et l'implémentation technique. Vous aurez notamment un rôle clé dans l'évolution de DaiLY : passer d'un modèle de simple consultation (Q&A) à un véritable système agentique transactionnel capable de déclencher des actions concrètes (ex : poser des congés dans Workday, s'inscrire à des formations via Decathlon University). 🛠 VOS RESPONSABILITES Développement Agentique & Fonctionnalités Participer à l'extension des capacités de DaiLY vers des actions d'écriture (write actions) en implémentant des protocoles de tool-calling (MCP - Model Context Protocol) et des communications inter-agents (A2A). Implémenter des stratégies avancées de chunking et de re-ranking pour prioriser les règles spécifiques au domaine RH. Contribuer à l'optimisation des coûts, de la latence et de l'efficacité globale du système en lien avec les équipes Plateforme et Infrastructure. Qualité, Évaluation & Observabilité (LLMOps) Développer et maintenir la couche de qualité du pipeline RAG multi-agents (Vertex AI Search / Discovery Engine). Assurer le grounding (ancrage) des réponses et la vérification des citations pour garantir la traçabilité vers une source de vérité. Mettre en place des pipelines d'observabilité robustes pour l'évaluation online et offline (OpenTelemetry, MLflow). Coder des évaluateurs automatiques basés sur des golden datasets pour itérer sereinement et prévenir les régressions avant chaque mise en production. Intégrer des garde-fous (guardrails) pour protéger le système et les utilisateurs contre les hallucinations et les erreurs. Sécurité, Cloisonnement & Déploiement International Access Management (ACLs) : Implémenter une gestion granulaire et dynamique des droits d'accès au niveau de l'indexation et du retrieval, garantissant qu'un collaborateur n'accède strictement qu'aux documents RH de son périmètre. Isolation & Multi-tenancy : Mettre en œuvre des stratégies de filtrage par métadonnées (metadata filtering) en base vectorielle et de cloisonnement (des index et/ou des modèles) pour assurer une étanchéité parfaite des données entre les différentes sociétés fiscales, entités légales et géographies de Decathlon. Support Multilingue : Contribuer à l'architecture d'internationalisation de DaiLY en adaptant les pipelines RAG, l'embedding et l'inférence pour maintenir un haut niveau de performance et de pertinence sur une grande diversité de langues. Produit & Impact Business Aider à l'analyse des intentions des utilisateurs pour mesurer l'impact de DaiLY. Traduire, avec l'appui de la Product Manager et du Lead, les enjeux métier en comportements de modèles et en métriques de succès. 🧠 PROFIL RECHERCHE Nous recherchons un profil justifiant a minima d’une première expérience. Expérience : Profil confirmé justifiant de trois années d'expérience professionnelle en entreprise (hors stages et alternances) en AI …

items.desc: Depuis sa création, KLANIK s'est donnée pour mission de conjuguer expertise technologique et authenticité. Ce pari audacieux, né à Marseille en 2011, en France, s'est transformé en une aventure internationale qui compte aujourd'hui plus de 800 collaborateurs, des implantations dans 10 pays et des filiales innovantes. Nous rejoignons en 2026 le groupe ALTEN, acteur mondial de l'ingénierie et des services numériques. Notre rôle : recruter les meilleurs talents & les connecter à nos clients pour les accompagner dans leurs projets digitaux. KLANIK est une société de conseil en informatique structurée autour de 5 pôles d'expertises : Data & IA, DevOps Cloud Infra, Cybersécurité, Software, Produit Agilité Pilotage. Nos 800 talents ont des profils variés : tech (nos pôles d'expertises), opérationnels (fonctions commerciales et recrutement) et support. Au‑delà des métiers, KLANIK cultive un modèle profondément humain, qui dépasse les frontières : de la Belgique à la Colombie, nos valeurs résonnent. Une culture fondée sur le partage, l'exigence et la bienveillance - un collectif où chacun peut trouver sa place. En témoignent nos filiales : Klanik Esport : club Esport & agence de gamification; Korner : incubateur de startups tech; Kampus : organisme de formation certifié Qualiopi l'Act'In Klanik, rôles qui permettent à nos collaborateurs de faire vivre leurs passions au-delà de leurs missions. Notre culture est résumée par cette phrase, souvent apposée sous notre logo : Human-Made Technology. La tech oui, mais une tech humaine, qui diffuse un modèle où l'authenticité de chacun est la priorité. KLANIK, en tant que société à mission, croit en la force de la diversité et de l'inclusion. Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d'origine, d'âge ou de genre, et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap. Nous sommes convaincus que la diversité de nos équipes est une force qui contribue à notre succès. Le Poste Dans le cadre du renforcement de nos équipes, nous recherchons un Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) spécialisé en IA générative pour accompagner l'un de nos clients dans la conception et le déploiement de cas d'usage concrets autour de Mistral AI. Intégré directement aux équipes du client, vous interviendrez au plus près des utilisateurs afin d'identifier leurs besoins, de développer des solutions adaptées et de mesurer leur valeur ajoutée. Vous contribuerez également à préparer l'industrialisation de nouveaux usages de l'IA, notamment autour de l'automatisation de processus métiers. 🎯 Vos missions Travailler en immersion auprès des équipes métiers et des décideurs pour identifier et prioriser les cas d'usage à forte valeur ajoutée. Concevoir, développer et déployer des agents IA, assistants et pipelines RAG sur l'écosystème Mistral AI. Connecter les sources documentaires internes et intégrer les solutions au système d'information existant. Faire évoluer les solutions à partir des retours utilisateurs et accompagner les équipes dans leur prise en main. Évaluer la qualité des résultats, comparer les performances des modèles et mesurer les gains obtenus. Documenter les solutions développées et transférer les connaissances aux équipes internes. Prototyper un agent IA dédié à l'automatisation de processus métiers, en lien avec les outils existants. Contribuer à l'amélioration des solutions en faisant remonter les besoins d'évolution produit. Profil ✅ Vous êtes Forward Deployed Engineer ou Ingénieur IA confirmé(e) Vous avez environ 5 ans d'expérience, dont 2 ans minimum en IA générative en production. Vous maîtrisez Python, les API REST et les pratiques de déploiement (Docker, CI/CD). Vous avez une expérience concrète en IA générative en production, notamment sur les architectures RAG, les agents IA, le function calling et l'évaluation de LLM. Vous connaissez très bien l'écosystème Mistral AI : Le Chat Entreprise, API, agents et modèles open-weight. Vous savez intégrer des solutions IA à un SI existant : connecteurs documentaires, authentification et données métier. Vous êtes sensibilisé(e) aux enjeux de sécurité, de RGPD et de souveraineté des données. Une expérience en RPA ou en automatisation de processus constitue un plus. 🤝 Votre posture fait la différence Vous êtes à l'aise avec des interlocuteurs de haut niveau et savez adopter une posture de conseil. Vous savez traduire des besoins métiers complexes en solutions concrètes et mesurables. Vous êtes pédagogue et capable d'animer des ateliers et d'accompagner les utilisateurs. Vous faites preuve d'écoute et savez comprendre les contraintes des organisations. Vous adoptez une approche pragmatique et transparente, en sachant expliquer les forces comme les limites des modèles d'IA. Vous disposez d'excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et savez documenter clairement vos réalisations.

items.desc: Van LLM’s tot AI Agents: bouw AI-oplossingen die werken in de praktijk Dit bieden wij jou Bij Axians krijg je onder andere: Een salarisrange tussen de €3.500 en €5.500; De keuze tussen een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding; Een flexibele werkomgeving met volop ruimte voor hybride werken; De ruimte om parttime te werken vanaf 32 uur; 25 vakantiedagen en de mogelijkheid extra dagen op te bouwen; Een premievrij pensioen, volledig voor rekening van Axians; Volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen in een richting die bij jou past. Hier krijg jij energie van Als AI Engineer vertaal je vraagstukken van onze klanten naar slimme, praktische AI-oplossingen. Je houdt je onder andere bezig met: Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van AI-oplossingen; Bouwen van toepassingen met generative AI en LLM's; Ontwikkelen van AI Agents en slimme assistenten; Koppelen van AI aan bedrijfsdata en kennisbronnen; Integreren van AI-oplossingen via API's en SDK's; Werken met technieken als RAG en prompt engineering; Productierijp maken en verder verbeteren van AI-toepassingen. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met Data Engineers, architecten en andere specialisten. Want een goede AI-oplossing begint vaak bij goede data en wordt pas waardevol als deze goed aansluit op de processen en systemen van een organisatie. Bij onze klanten ben je betrokken bij het hele traject: van het eerste vraagstuk en experiment tot de technische realisatie en implementatie. Je praat met gebruikers en stakeholders, stelt kritische vragen en kijkt verder dan wat technisch mogelijk is. Wanneer heeft AI echt toegevoegde waarde? Welke aanpak past het beste? En hoe zorgen we ervoor dat een oplossing betrouwbaar genoeg is om daadwerkelijk gebruikt te worden? Dat maakt deze rol breder dan alleen prompt engineering of het bouwen van een chatbot. Je krijgt te maken met vraagstukken rondom bijvoorbeeld RAG, AI Agents, context engineering, modelkeuze, evaluatie, security, integratie en schaalbaarheid. En omdat het AI-landschap razendsnel verandert, verwachten we niet dat je alles al beheerst. We zoeken vooral iemand met een goede technische basis die nieuwsgierig is, graag bouwt en experimenteert en zichzelf continu wil ontwikkelen. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent iemand die graag bouwt, experimenteert en nieuwe technologie praktisch toepast . Je volgt de ontwikkelingen rondom AI op de voet, maar laat je niet alleen leiden door wat nieuw is. Je wilt vooral oplossingen maken die werken, betrouwbaar zijn en daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen. Daarnaast heb je: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in een relevante richting; Minimaal 3-4 jaar ervaring binnen software development, data engineering, data science, AI of een vergelijkbare technische omgeving; Goede kennis van Python; Ervaring met of sterke interesse in LLM's, generative AI en AI Agents; Ervaring met AI-technologie binnen Azure of een andere cloudomgeving; Interesse in technieken als RAG, prompt engineering, API's en SDK's; De ambitie om jezelf technisch te blijven ontwikkelen. Vink je niet ieder technisch onderdeel af? Geen probleem. Als je technische basis klopt, je al ervaring hebt binnen data of software en enthousiast wordt van het bouwen van AI-oplossingen, komen we graag met je in gesprek. Dit is jouw team Je komt terecht bij onze Business Analytics-unit in Zaltbommel, met 65 enthousiaste collega's. Binnen Axians werken in totaal zo'n 150 BI- en dataspecialisten. We werken al jarenlang samen met Microsoft en ontwikkelen daarnaast ons eigen dataplatform Maestro . Dat betekent veel kennis om je heen, maar ook ruimte om je eigen richting te kiezen. Of je jezelf nu verder wilt ontwikkelen in AI Engineering, Generative AI, Data Engineering, architectuur of Microsoft-technologie: jouw ambitie staat centraal. Onze cultuur? Samen. Gewoon. Verbazen. We houden het graag praktisch: samenwerken, kennis delen, experimenteren, elkaar helpen, leuke dingen doen en samen oplossingen neerzetten waar onze klanten écht iets aan hebben. Klaar om AI in de praktijk te brengen? Kom kennismaken in Zaltbommel. We praten graag met je over AI, jouw ambities en wat we samen kunnen bouwen.

Vos missions côté cadrage Identifier et cadrer les cas d'usage avec les équipes métier et les responsables produit ; modéliser les processus (analyse, décision, action, supervision) Prototyper vite (POC en quelques semaines), démontrer, mesurer l'adoption et la valeur Définir les critères d'acceptation et de conformité : charte IA, AI Act, sécurité, données personnelles Animer les démonstrations et rendre la solution compréhensible pour les utilisateurs Vos missions côté build Concevoir et développer des agents IA outillés : appels d'API, exécution d'outils, workflows multi-étapes, mémoire Développer des assistants métiers avec RAG : ingestion, chunking, vectorisation, recherche hybride Intégrer les agents au SI : API REST, serveurs MCP, connecteurs vers GED, CRM et applications métier Industrialiser : tests, CI/CD, conteneurs, observabilité (traces, coûts, qualité des réponses), gestion des permissions et des logs Qualifications Votre profil 4 ans en CDI et plus en développement logiciel, dont au moins une application à base de LLM mise en production Python expert (FastAPI, async, Pydantic) ; frameworks d'agents (LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI ou Semantic Kernel) LLM du marché (Mistral, GPT, Claude), tool calling, MCP, RAG, bases vectorielles Cloud AWS ou Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD (GitLab, Jenkins) Observabilité LLM (Langfuse ou équivalent) Esprit produit : proposer, challenger, prioriser, démontrer ; à l'aise face aux métiers Les plus Connaissance du secteur bancaire ou financier Java / Spring ou Angular pour s'intégrer à des SI existants ; Kafka Dataiku, Snowflake, plateformes d'agents d'entreprise, gateway LLM (LiteLLM) Environnement SAFe ; pratique du développement augmenté (Copilot, agents de code) Informations complémentaires Pourquoi ASI Cabinet d'expertises numériques créé en 1993, Société à Mission depuis 2024, 7 agences en France et environ 450 talents. Une pratique Data & IA en plein développement, des cas d'usage concrets en production et des pairs avec qui partager les retours d'expérience. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un parcours d'intégration soigné pour prendre vos marques en douceur. Des projets à impact dans des environnements complexes et stimulants. Une équipe conseil bienveillante et orientée collectif. Un cadre de travail flexible et propice à la montée en compétences. La possibilité d'évoluer vers des responsabilités d'expertise ou de management.  In-depth knowledge of trade reporting rules prescribed by major exchanges and regulators

 Diligent, accurate, and reliable personality; critical and conceptual problem-solver with a growth mindset and ability to find innovative solutions

items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Head Strategy & Business Development 
 __
 Join ABB in shaping the future of industrial electrification and sustainable process industries. In this strategic role, you will evaluate emerging technologies, assess market opportunities, and support portfolio decisions that drive innovation across industries such as Mining, Metals, and Pulp & Paper. Working closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams, you will provide technology insights, business case analyses, and strategic recommendations that influence ABB's long-term growth and technology roadmap.
 Working model: LI-Hybrid
 Your main responsibilities will be: 
 Monitor and assess emerging technologies in power electronics and industrial electrification, with a focus on Mining, Metals, and Pulp & Paper applications, including process electrification, process heating, power quality solutions, energy storage systems, and grid integration.
 Drive technology and portfolio assessments by supporting ABB's aluminum converter technology roadmap, benchmarking existing rectifier technologies against next-generation wide-bandgap semiconductor solutions and identifying opportunities for innovation and differentiation.
 Develop business cases and analytical insights for technology investments and new offerings, translating market trends, regulatory developments, and policy signals into actionable business opportunities while maintaining and enhancing technology assessment tools, including Excel-based frameworks and Python applications with AI-assisted reporting capabilities.
 Provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership through executive-level presentations and portfolio assessments, collaborating closely with R&D, Product Management, Business Development teams, and external partners to guide technology, product, and investment decisions across multiple business units.
 What we are looking for: 
 Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Microfabrication, or a related technical field; a PhD is strongly preferred.
 2-4 years of experience in technology strategy, corporate strategy, innovation management, business analysis, or a related field, ideally complemented by entrepreneurial exposure within industrial automation or process industries.
 10+ years of hands-on experience in process automation, with a strong understanding of industrial applications and operational challenges across process industries.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with hands-on proficiency in Python (including AI-assisted development and "vibe coding"), advanced Excel modelling, and AI-enabled analytical workflows.
 Experience in market analysis, financial modelling, and business case development, including Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) evaluations and strategic planning for the Recycling, Mining, Metals, and Pulp & Paper sectors.
 Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business insights and develop executive-level recommendations and decision-making materials.
 Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across R&D, Product Management, Business Development, senior leadership, and external partners; familiarity with microfabrication and semiconductor manufacturing processes is highly desirable.
 More about us: 
 Process Industries division delivers complete electrification and automation solutions, industry-​specific products and lifecycle services across industries. Understanding and addressing challenges and opportunities take a deep domain knowledge. Engineering and delivering automation solutions from device to monitoring and control make our customers get more out of their investment. Digitalization solutions including collaborative operations and augmented reality help improve plant and enterprise productivity, reduce maintenance and energy costs. Our engineering, project management, services and solutions portfolio covers a wide range of industries - Pulp, Paper & Fiber, Mining, Gearless Mill Drives (GMDs), Hoists, Metals, Growth Industries such as Cement, Food & Beverage, Data Center Automation, High Power Rectifiers, and Batteries. 
 The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Team Lead Switzerland. 
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Ready to make an impact? 
 Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Job Description: 
 Façonnez l'avenir de l'aéronautique : devenez le garant de l'innovation pour Airbus FlightLab
 Êtes-vous prêt à vous placer à la croisée des chemins entre la recherche aéronautique de pointe et une sécurité sans compromis ? Nous recherchons un.e ingénieur.e Flight Clearance pour transformer les plus beaux défis d’intégration en campagnes d’essais en vol pour dérisquer les technologies de demain. 
 Votre futur job, si vous l’acceptez… 
 A propos de FlightLab 
 FlightLab est le cœur de l’innovation chez Airbus. Cette entité centralisée vise à dérisquer des produits de R&T grâce à une exposition rapide en vol et une approche programmatique. En gérant des configurations d’essais en vol inhabituelles qui repoussent les limites de l’aviation moderne, la mission de FlightLab consiste à tester la maturité et la robustesse des technologies qui définiront la prochaine génération d'aéronefs : 
 Réduction des émissions : adaptation au carburant d'aviation durable (SAF) et hydrogène, réduction de la consommation de carburant 
 Autonomie et sûreté : opération “single pilot”, collecte massive de données avion et capitalisation 
 Connectivité et services : surveillance intelligente, intégration d'écrans et de capteurs, communications laser aéroportées. 
 Votre poste : Ingénieur Flight Clearance 
 À travers ce poste, vous élaborerez le dossier final de Flight Clearance & Safety. Vous intégrerez l’équipe A/C Safety afin de fournir à FlightLab une évaluation indépendante de l’impact safety des démonstrateurs d’essais en vol, en délivrant le dossier d’autorisation de vol définitif à l’ingénieur en chef. 
 Il ne s’agit pas simplement de « cocher des cases » : c’est un travail d’ingénierie approfondi. Vous veillerez à ce que les équipements spécifiques et les configurations avion non standards répondent aux normes de qualification les plus strictes. Vous serez au coeur des discussions, créant des synergies entre : 
 L’équipe FlightLab (architectes, gestion de configuration, industrialisation) 
 Bureaux d’études 
 Spécialistes sûreté de fonctionnement (safety système, safety FTI, Particular Risks Analysis) 
 Equipe d’essais en vols (équipage navigant, MAP) 
 Partenaires externes 
 Vous guiderez les projets à travers un processus rigoureux, en veillant à ce que la sûreté de fonctionnement soit intégrée à chaque étape clé : 
 Initialisation du projet : Évaluation de la faisabilité et de la charge de travail. 
 Conceptual & Preliminary Design (CFR/PDR) : Définition des risques et établissement des exigences de sûreté de fonctionnement. 
 Critical Design (CDR) : Identification des points de blocage et sécurisation du plan de livraison 
 Flight Readiness (FRR) : Consolidation des justifications finales par rapport à l'installation réelle sur l'aéronef et présentation de votre dossier au comité pour approbation 
 Votre quotidien : 
 Animation de brainstorming pour identifier et analyser des risques complexes 
 Déclinaison des exigences et justifications aux équipes en interface pour garantir la cohérence au niveau avion. 
 Élaboration d’Aircraft Safety Summary et du dossier d'autorisation de vol. 
 Présentation de vos analyses devant un comité d'experts pour obtenir l'approbation de vol. 
 Etes-vous notre futur talent ? 
 Nous recherchons un profil alliant expertise technique et leadership. Si vous êtes un ingénieur rigoureux, appréciant tout autant la vision globale de l'architecture avion que la précision des processus de V&V de sûreté de fonctionnement, votre candidature nous intéresse.

items.desc:
Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a PWP Mechanical Analysis Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid).
 The selected candidate will join the PWP Mechanical Analysis Team. Our department is in charge of participating in the design of the ADS platform PWP through modeling, loads evaluation (static, fatigue, dynamic, thermal), and structure/system definition and validation. We develop static, thermal, and dynamic models of the PWP structure design to integrate engines across our different platforms. The team evaluates structural stresses derived from loads, supporting the design from the pre-design phase to in-service support, including main design reviews, certification, and prototype testing.
 To perform these activities, our multidisciplinary team is permanently in contact with Flight Physics, Design, and System Integration departments, as well as each program's Chief Engineering office. The jobholder will reinforce our stress analysis area to support complex system implementation in these programs.
 Responsibilities 
 The main tasks and deliverables of the jobholder will be:
 Perform static, fatigue, and damage tolerance (F&DT) calculation and analysis within metallic, composite, and hybrid structures at the component level.
 Develop structural stress evaluations and produce relevant strength margins or reserve factors according to validated and applicable Airbus methods and sizing processes.
 Utilize standard F&DT tools and techniques to analyze damaged structures and provide stress analyses for the repair or acceptance of components.
 Collaborate with Flight Physics, Design, and System Integration departments to ensure structural alignment from pre-design phases to in-service support.
 Support the definition, implementation, and validation of the PWP structure design, participating actively in main design reviews and certification processes.
 Skills 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:
 Education: Aeronautical or Industrial Engineering degree or a related discipline.
 Experience: At least 5 years of experience in Aeronautical Engineering Mechanical stress analysis.
 Soft skills: High adaptability to work in a team and networking mode. Capacity to endorse responsibility and leadership.
 Languages: Advanced level in English.
 Technical knowledge: Programming in Python, advanced level of NASTRAN and CATIA.

Job Description: 
 Job Description: 
 A vacancy for an Earth Observation Satellite System Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence & Space in Madrid (Getafe). The successful applicant will join the EOS Chief Engineering Department in Spain (TSESS). 
 We are seeking a highly skilled Satellite Systems Engineer with a background in Earth Observation and/or Science satellite systems development. In this role, you will join the Systems Engineering team in the development of state-of-the-art, high-end Earth Observation satellite systems, in institutional and defence markets. 
 You will play a critical role in the lifecycle of next-generation satellite missions. You will be responsible for ensuring that complex space systems are built to specification through rigorous Verification & Validation (V&V) and robust Interface Management. 
 Beyond your technical core, you will act as a Deputy to the Chief Engineer, providing high-level technical support and assisting in the technical management of the system. This role offers a unique opportunity to bridge the gap between deep technical engineering and strategic system-level management. 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 System Engineering and V&V: 
 Lead the development and execution of the Verification & Validation (V&V) Plan in accordance with ECSS standards. 
 Execute mission analysis, generate the CONOPS and, from those, derive V&V strategies for the product. 
 Define verification methods (Analysis, Inspection, Demonstration, Test) to ensure all system requirements are met throughout the mission lifecycle. 
 Oversee the creation and management of the Verification Control Document (VCD). 
 Coordinate complex system-level tests, including environmental testing and end-to-end functional tests. 
 Interface Engineering: 
 Manage the satellite interfaces along the product development lifecycle 
 Manage the Interface Control Documents (ICDs) between the spacecraft, payload, and ground segments. 
 Ensure seamless integration of hardware and software components by managing technical interfaces and resolving cross-subsystem conflicts. 
 Perform interface impact analysis during design changes to ensure system integrity. 
 Technical Management & Deputy Chief Engineer Duties: 
 Support the Chief Engineer in the technical oversight of the entire mission, ensuring technical consistency across all subsystems, and OTOQOC delivery of the satellite. 
 Assist in technical decision-making processes and the management of technical risks and contingencies. 
 Participate in Technical Reviews (PDR, CDR, QR, AR) and prepare high-level technical documentation for customers and stakeholders. 
 Contribute to the technical management of the project, including resource estimation, cost control, schedule alignment, and technical progress monitoring. 
 In addition to this, you will play a key role in: 
 The deployment of novel engineering methods, processes and tools (e.g. MBSE, multi-disciplinary analyses, concurrent design engineering…) 
 The digitalisation of our design, development and manufacturing processes (e.g. DDMS), and their smooth implementation across all involved disciplines 
 The development of novel features into existing product lines and/or upgrading of existing product lines to cope with those novel features, as dictated by the business 
 SKILLS 
 Education & Experience: 
 Master’s Degree or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, Systems Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field. 
 Proven experience (5+ years) in Systems Engineering within the Space industry, specifically on satellite platforms or high-complexity space missions. 
 Strong background in Earth Observation or Science mission architectures is a significant plus. 
 Technical Skills: 
 Deep understanding of the Space Mission Lifecycle and ECSS standards. 
 Knowledge of SAR and Optical payloads is a plus. 
 Expertise in Requirements Engineering (e.g., using DOORS or similar tools). 
 Proficiency in Interface Management and System Modeling. 
 Strong knowledge of satellite subsystems (AOCS, EPS, OBDH, Telecommunications, Thermal). 
 Ability to interpret complex test data and technical reports.

 Leadership Potential: Ability to step into a deputy management role, demonstrating maturity and technical authority. 
 Communication: Excellent ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both multidisciplinary engineering teams and non-technical stakeholders. 
 Problem-Solving: A proactive approach to identifying technical risks and proposing mitigation strategies.

 Perform microbial colonization experiments and tissue collection of GF/gnotobiotic animals.

Who we are 
 Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 
 As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 
 We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

 Being an integrated element of Production Quality, you as a Quality Inspector in Helsings Production environment are responsible for Quality Assurance Gate application and Conformity verifications along our Product value stream.  Verification of End-of-Line (EOL) quality and execution of Passport Signoffs, ensuring the complete and compliant generation and archival of all quality records
 Management and monitoring of tools and equipment calibration, ensuring ongoing measurement integrity, traceability, and inspection readiness in the operational area
 You should apply if you

 Demonstrate applied and proven experience on inspection methods (GVI / DVI) or via the use of test / measurement equipment, a good understanding of special processes is of advantage
 Have the capability to read, understand, and apply technical documents ( Engineering drawings / Inspection procedures / industry Norms ) and experience in maintaining IT Software applications like MS Office, QA SW if applicable. SAP experience is of advantage.

 Maintain a process oriented attitude and mindset with flexibility and creativity to achieve given goals

 Are willing to work in a two-shift system

Thales people architect identity management and data protection solutions at the heart of digital security. Business and governments rely on us to bring trust to the billions of digital interactions they have with people. Our technologies and services help banks exchange funds, people cross borders, energy become smarter and much more. More than 30,000 organizations already rely on us to verify the identities of people and things, grant access to digital services, analyze vast quantities of information and encrypt data to make the connected world more secure. 
Thales in the Czech Republic employs over 400 people from 45 different nationalities. items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 C/C++ RADAR SOFTWARE ENGINEER (TRK) 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that form part of a complete and integrated defense system. The product portfolio ranges from small portable radars for applications such as border or object surveillance to complex four-dimensional radars capable of detecting small objects at distances from hundreds to thousands of kilometers. 
 Within the software department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for the software development of optimal control and digital processing functions within the sensors. This work is performed in multidisciplinary teams alongside specialists in system engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems. 
 About the job 
 Within this Sensor Processing group, the complete radar software is developed. This includes several domains such as controlling the radar systems, managing radar transmissions, and processing the digital information stream. The ultimate goal is to detect and classify specific objects, such as aircraft and drones, track them, and display them on an operator console. 
 The software architecture is designed to be highly modular and supports the development of robust and evolutionary systems. Development takes place in Agile teams supported by a modern development toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the ongoing development and maintenance of the architecture, the development toolchain, and the Agile process. 
 About you 
 Do you have a passion for technology and enjoy working on radar controls or complex algorithms? Then you might be the person we are looking for. We would like to offer you the opportunity to build a career in the international high-tech environment at Thales. 
 The requirement is a completed HBO (higher professional education) or WO (university) degree in (technical) computer science or a related field. We expect substantial experience (5 years or more) with the programming languages C and C++ and with developing real-time software. Experience with other programming languages such as Java is a plus. 
 You are creative, open-minded, and flexible, and you can operate effectively as a team player. Additionally, you are results-oriented, show initiative, and communicate clearly. A good command of both Dutch and English is necessary for successful function fulfillment. 
 Screening Criteria 
 Minimum of 5+ years of experience in C++ software development 
 Experience with Real-Time Software development 
 Proficiency with Linux operating systems 
 Understanding of Mathematics relevant to software development 
 Ability to work effectively as a team player 
 Familiarity with build and deployment tools such as Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent 
 Reskilling possible, but only if the candidate has prior real-time software experience 
 Eligibility for VGB-B clearance and eligibility for Dutch Eyes Only classification 
 What's in it for you 
 A challenging job in a great team within our high-tech, innovative work environment. Includes the freedom for initiative and good ideas. 
 Room for personal and professional growth within our organization, for example in regards to technical, commercial or international skills. 
 A comfortable work space in a modern environment, with a focus on flexibility and the right work/life balance. 
 You can usually work where and when you want, to be able to do your work as well and efficiently as possible. Within Thales we implement hybrid working, where you can, for example, work from home two days a week if your role allows it. 
 A good salary, fitting travel allowance, and the ability to personalize your employment conditions. For instance, you can trade days off for our bicycle plan or company fitness. 
 40 days paid-time-off per year. 
 Interested? 
 Apply now! Click on the button below to upload your profile and show your interest. 
 To ensure that we are a good match, we may ask you to participate in an assessment. 
 A government clearance will be requested as part of standard Thales procedures. 
 Diversity Statement 
 We actively support a working pattern that suits your lifestyle and helps you reach your ambitions. That means that equal opportunities, inclusion and an informal culture are integral to our success. It also means that your well-being and happiness matter to us! That’s why we offer you the flexibility to do what’s important to you; whether that’s part time hours, job sharing, remote working, or the ability to flex your start and finish times.
