items.desc:
Lieu : Cannes, France 
 Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance 
 Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 81 000 collaborateurs dans 68 pays. ​
 Nos engagements, vos avantages 
 Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
 Un package de rémunération attractif
 Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
 Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
 Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu
 Votre quotidien 
Le site de Cannes est en charge de la conception des systèmes satellitaires & plateformes, de l’assemblage/intégration/test des satellites ainsi que des opérations en orbite. Le site a une expertise en instrumentation optique et en avionique. 
 VOTRE QUOTIDIEN 
 Le WPM sera amené à gérer une ou plusieurs affaires du service, typiquement de quelques 100aines de k€ à ~10 M€, et à encadrer fonctionnellement une ou plusieurs équipes (environ 6 à 8 personnes).
 Les activités du Service étant par nature transverses, le WPM assurera l’interface avec les autres métiers de la Direction de l’ingénierie, les CCs, les partenaires, ainsi que les Clients privés et/ou institutionnels (CNES/ESA/EUMETSAT).
 Dans le cadre de ses fonctions, il s’assurera également du respect des règles des autorités françaises (contrôle export notamment).
 En tant que WPM d’une ou plusieurs affaires, vous serez en charge de : 
 Aspects contractuels : 
 Gérer les aspects contractuels et financiers internes (WP, CBB, réseaux, fiches de modification…) et externes (CCNs Clients, partenaires, sous-contractants…)
 Etablir et maintenir les plannings à partir des contributions internes ainsi que celles de nos partenaires
 Etablir et maintenir à jour la base des Risques & Opportunités
 Assurer l’interface vers les Clients et les fournisseurs
 Effectuer le bon niveau de reporting (KPIs) vers vos Responsables hiérarchique et fonctionnels
 Aspects techniques : 
 Assurer la coordination technique, les I/F techniques avec les clients et les fournisseurs, le lien avec les autres équipes TAS-F (Direction Ingénierie, Programme DOSE-F, CCs…)
 Etablir puis maintenir le Plan de développement (logique des versions et contenus, IVVQ)
 Contribuer à la rédaction des documents nécessaires aux différentes revues
 Apporter un soutien technique tout au long du cycle de développement (et d’exploitation) des produits, depuis la phase d’intégration à la phase d’exploitation par le Client
 En complément de cette activité, vous apporterez un support lors des RAO / bids (Clients Privés et/ou Institutionnels), et suivrez les produits proposés par le service.
 Dans ce cadre : 
 Vous serez chargé(e) de la définition préliminaire des solutions proposées, des analyses macroscopiques et des bilans de performance qualité image (QI), des matrices de conformité
 Vous apporterez votre support au HoD ou autres personnes de l’équipe lors de la rédaction des propositions : rédaction des offres, support aux chiffrages, et support aux activités métiers
 Vous contribuez également à l’amélioration continue des activités en partageant le REX des affaires en cours et en le prenant en compte lors des RAOs.
 VOTRE PROFIL 
 Vous avez une bonne compréhension globale de l’intégralité de la chaine d’acquisition bord (optique, détecteur, électronique, traitement de signal), des traitements effectués au sol, ainsi que des méthodes de calibration du système et de la mission au sens large?
 Vous maîtrisez la gestion des performances des missions d’imagerie optique d’observation de la Terre : spécification, définition, conception des architectures E2E de la chaine image optique, évaluation des différentes alternatives d’architectures possibles et justification ?
 Vous avez une expérience significative en analyse des performances, bilan de qualité image, IVV au niveau Système, caractérisation et validation métier ?
 Vos connaissances en algorithmie de la chaine image (bord et sol) sont appréciées ?
 Vous êtes rigoureux, calme, et respectez les jalons ?
 Vous êtes capable de conduire des échanges avec les Clients et ou les partenaires dans un contexte délicat, et savez faire passer vos idées ?
 Vous maitrisez l’anglais technique ?
 Aspects management en transverse : 
 Vous avez des expériences réussies (5 ans minimum) en gestion de WP dans des environnements complexes (nombreuses I/F internes et externes notamment)?
 Vous avez des capacités en management …

items.desc: Wir sind ein spezialisiertes AI-Engineering- und FullStack-Team und bauen produktive LLM-/Agenten-Systeme für unsere Kunden — kein PoC-Theater, keine Powerpoint-Decks, keine „Slide-Architekten". Wir beraten partnerschaftlich auf Augenhöhe und liefern Software, die in Produktion läuft. Du kannst hier Probleme lösen, ohne dass dich dabei Titel oder feste Rollendefinitionen einschränken — die gibt es bei uns nicht. Unsere Jobs sind nicht starr, sie dienen dir nur zur Orientierung. Du wirst nicht auf (d)einen Job begrenzt, sondern entwickelst dich quer durch AI Engineering, Backend, Platform und Consulting weiter. Du stehst mit deinen individuellen Zielen, Vorstellungen und Stärken im Vordergrund. Du gestaltest deine Karriere bei Arcode proaktiv mit. Wichtig: Da wir eng mit unseren Kunden im DACH-Raum (Finanz, Versicherung, Public Sector, Industrie) zusammenarbeiten, sind exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (idealerweise muttersprachlich, mindestens C1) zwingend erforderlich — verhandlungssicheres Englisch setzen wir voraus. Aufgaben Aufgaben Was dich erwartet Als AI Engineer (w/d/m) schreibst du nicht nur Notebooks und Prompts, du baust produktive GenAI-Systeme: Agenten, RAG-Pipelines, LLM-getriebene Workflows — end-to-end vom Use-Case-Workshop bis zum Production-Deployment. Du arbeitest in crossfunktionalen, agilen Teams an Kundenprojekten und kommst dabei mit dem gesamten modernen GenAI-Stack in Berührung: pydantic-ai, LangChain/LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol), OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock. Zusammen mit deinem Team berätst du unsere Kunden bei Use-Case-Identifikation, Architektur-Entscheidungen (RAG vs. Fine-Tuning, Agent-Design, Tool-Use, Memory), Aufwandsschätzungen und der Auswahl geeigneter Vorgehensmodelle — du bist am gesamten AI-Lebenszyklus beteiligt. Du analysierst Kundenanforderungen, entwirfst und implementierst agentenbasierte Lösungen, RAG-Pipelines über Unternehmensdaten, strukturierte LLM-Outputs (pydantic-Schemas, Tool-Use) und sorgst auch für gute Dokumentation. Du behältst stets die Qualität auf dem Schirm — und das heißt bei AI: systematische Evals, Regression-Tests gegen Goldsets, Hallucination-Monitoring, Cost-per-Inference-Tracking, Prompt-Versionierung, Observability für Agent-Traces (OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, Phoenix). Du nutzt moderne, automatisierte Ansätze und AI-native Entwickler-Workflows (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) zur Optimierung von Code, Fehlererkennung und für innovative Lösungen — wir leben "AI-native", nicht nur AI-für-Kunden. Du integrierst deine LLM-/Agent-Komponenten sauber in bestehende Backend- und Frontend-Architekturen (Python/FastAPI, Node.js/TypeScript, Java, React/Angular) und sorgst für saubere Übergaben an die Plattform-Seite (Kubernetes, ArgoCD, MongoDB/pgvector, AWS/Azure). Qualifikation Qualifikation Das solltest du mitbringen Dank deiner entsprechenden Berufserfahrung verfolgst du den AI-Engineering-Ansatz hands-on — du redest nicht nur über LLMs, du baust mit ihnen. Gute bis muttersprachliche Deutschkenntnisse sind ZWINGEND erforderlich, da wir eng mit Kunden im DACH-Raum zusammenarbeiten. Du arbeitest gerne agil, verstehst aber auch, dass nicht alle Kunden Agilität (und schon gar nicht GenAI-Engineering) bereits kennen und schätzen wie wir. Du hast einen M.Sc. (oder vergleichbaren Abschluss) in Artificial Intelligence, Informatik, Data Science, Statistik, Mathematik, Physik oder einer verwandten Natur- oder Ingenieurwissenschaft. Ein abgeschlossenes Studium mit fundierten Grundlagen in Statistik, Machine Learning und Software Engineering ist für diese Stelle zwingend erforderlich. Wichtig — bitte vor der Bewerbung lesen: Das ist keine „Vibe-Coding"-Stelle. Wer seit ein paar Monaten mit AI-Assistenten Code generiert, aber die Grundlagen dahinter (Statistik, ML-Theorie, Datenstrukturen, Software-Architektur) nicht beherrscht, ist hier falsch. Wir nutzen AI-native Tooling täglich — aber als Verstärker für fundiertes Können, nicht als Ersatz dafür. Bewerbungen ohne einschlägigen Abschluss und ohne nachweisbare, mehrjährige Data-Science-/ML-Praxis können wir nicht berücksichtigen. Du bist Team-Player, schätzt offene Kommunikation, lernst gerne von anderen und teilst dein Wissen — gerade im LLM-Bereich, wo sich die Tooling-Landschaft alle drei Monate neu ordnet. Du willst an spannenden Kundenprojekten arbeiten und hast gute Kenntnisse in einigen dieser Technologien: AI / GenAI: Python, pydantic, pydantic-ai, LangChain / LangGraph, MCP, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, Azure AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock, Hugging Face Transformers, PyTorch, Embeddings & Vector DBs (pgvector, MongoDB Atlas, Weaviate, Pinecone, Qdrant), RAG-Patterns, Prompt Engineering, Agent-Evals (Langfuse, Phoenix, ragas) Backend / FullStack: Python (FastAPI), Java/Spring oder Quarkus, Node.js/TypeScript (Express, NestJS), React, Angular, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, REST/GraphQL Platform / DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes, ArgoCD, GitLab CI / GitHub Actions, AWS, …

Allergies are diagnosed in a highly specific manner so that patients receive help by their specialist in no time. We increase quality of life, enable personalized treatment, advance research and relieve our health system. For our Conjugation team, we are looking for an Coupling Scientist who will optimise our coupling methods. What We Offer A full-time position with real ownership from day one An annual pass for Vienna's public transport, plus Pluxee vouchers A team that cares as much about veterinary patients as human ones A culture where questions, ideas, and pushback are genuinely welcome A workplace shaped by sustainability, equity, diversity, inclusion, and mutual respect What You'll Do Develop, evaluate, and optimize protein coupling and conjugation methods for the immobilization of allergens, antibodies, and other proteins onto microspheres (e.g. polymer or nanobeads) for immunoassay applications. Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with interdisciplinary teams, including R&D, Engineering, and Production Very good English skills; German skills are an advantage Compensation For this position, we offer a market-competitive minimum annual gross salary of EUR 47.220 based on full-time employment, which is above the applicable collective agreement minimum salary. You will collaborate
items.desc: At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed. And now we are looking for a Package Design Engineer to join us as part of our team. About Role Be part of a team pushing the boundaries of semiconductor innovation by developing custom silicon solutions that power next-generation consumer and infrastructure products. You will contribute to technologies used at massive global scale, helping shape future hardware platforms with a strong focus on performance, efficiency, reliability, and system-level integration. As a Chip Package Designer within the Silicon Integration team, you will develop package substrate designs for advanced 2.5D/3.5D packaging technologies used in high-performance ML and AI chips. You will collaborate closely with Signal Integrity/Power Integrity (SI/PI), Thermal/Mechanical, Assembly, and PCB engineering teams to develop complex, high-performance substrate designs. The primary objective will be to optimize package substrate architecture for electrical performance, reliability, manufacturability, and assembly. You will manage all major phases of the package design process, including routing feasibility studies, test vehicle development, product-level designs, design reviews, artwork export, DFM activities, and preparation of final manufacturing documentation. You will also contribute to the evaluation and adoption of advanced chip packaging technologies within the broader silicon product development pipeline. Your work will directly support successful deployment of advanced computing systems in large-scale data center environments, helping optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area) while improving overall system performance, power efficiency, and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership). The broader AI and Infrastructure organization is focused on building next-generation computing platforms and infrastructure at exceptional scale, efficiency, reliability, and speed. These technologies support internal engineering teams, enterprise customers, and large-scale consumer-facing services worldwide. The organization works across both hardware and software, including custom AI accelerators, advanced silicon platforms, AI infrastructure, large-scale networking, data center technologies, distributed computing systems, and systems research. Work Environment Fully remote role. Flexible schedule with participation in team ceremonies and cross-functional collaboration. As a qualified expert, You will: Develop physical package substrate design of large form-factor package for ML high-performance computers (HPCs). Develop and implement the methodology and CAD flow for efficient substrate design and enhanced productivity. Manage and drive co-design initiatives across chip, package, and system levels, including securing production sign-off for package designs. Collaborate closely with signal integrity/power integrity (SI/PI), thermal, and mechanical engineering teams to refine and optimize product package designs, test vehicles, and mock-up designs for product feasibility. Define and document the requirements for the package substrate design and bill of materials (BOM). We’re looking for you if you have Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Technology, Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in chip package substrate design using Cadence APD or Mentor Expedition. Experience in chip package substrate layout, design verification, DFM and taping out for production. Experience in design automation and scripting. English — Upper Intermediate or higher. Bonus points Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience in working with cross-functional teams including chip design, SI/PI, and PCB design teams. Experience in 2.5D/3.5D advanced package design. Experience in physical verification flow (LVS, DRC, connectivity). Experience with CAD for creating simple mechanical drawings, such as package outline drawings (POD). Ability to write scripts to customize elements of the Cadence or Mentor workflow. Reveal great tech solutions Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships …

Concrètement, nous développons des solutions géospatiales pour aider les villes et les entreprises à mieux comprendre et optimiser les déplacements. Nous sommes la branche tech du groupe Citec, une équipe de six personnes basées à Lyon et Toulouse. On cultive la qualité du code en s’appuyant sur les principes du Software Craftsmanship , mais aussi l’entraide, la bonne humeur et la créativité. Grâce à ces collaborations et à notre expertise en traitement de données, en analyse des mobilités et en développement logiciel, nous voulons bâtir une nouvelle génération d’outils géospatiaux pour transformer la mobilité de demain. Si vous voulez contribuer à des projets concrets et innovants, dans une équipe où votre expertise comptera vraiment : bienvenue chez Modelity. Votre rôle : structurer, piloter et faire évoluer une infrastructure géospatiale performante, qui servira à la fois les besoins internes (production de données, analyses, cartographies) et externes (développement d’application, missions de conseil et AMO auprès de nos clients collectivités et opérateurs de transport). Ce poste ne comporte pas de management hiérarchique direct, mais une forte dimension de leadership technique et fonctionnel : vous accompagnerez les chargé·e·s d’études dans la montée en compétences, vous définirez les standards méthodologiques et vous représenterez Modelity auprès de nos partenaires stratégiques comme Esri. Les compétences clés attendues : ■ Maîtrise d’au moins un logiciel SIG : ArcGIS Pro, QGIS ■ Administration d’infrastructures et bases de données SIG : ArcGIS Online, Geodatabase, PostGIS ■ Automatisation et analyse spatiale avancée (Python, PyQGIS, ArcPy, géotraitements complexes). ■ Leadership technique et transmission : accompagner les équipes, diffuser la culture SIG, être la référence interne et externe. Des compétences en SIG Web (OpenLayer, Leaflet ou MapLibre), IA géospatiale ou données transport (GTFS, FCD) seront de vrais atouts, mais ne sont pas bloquantes. Profil recherché Vous êtes un·e ingénieur·e sénior en géomatique (Bac+5) avec au moins 5 ans d’expérience confirmée dans le développement et l’administration de systèmes SIG. Vous maîtrisez le développement en Python et savez déployer des modèles d’analyse, en assurer la maintenance et leur amélioration continue. Vous avez déjà mené des projets d’ analyse spatiale avancée : accessibilité, clustering, scoring de sites... Au-delà de la technique, vous êtes reconnu·e pour : ■ votre capacité à prendre du recul et structurer un environnement SIG ; ■ votre esprit d’analyse , capable de traduire un besoin métier en démarche géospatiale pertinente ; ■ votre pédagogie et votre envie de transmettre, que ce soit auprès de collègues non experts ou de clients dans le cadre de missions d’AMO. Un plus si vous avez déjà travaillé dans le domaine des mobilités et transports , ou si vous avez une expérience avec les jumeaux numériques et les solutions de webmapping . items.title: Signal and Power Integrity Engineer
items.card: About the role As a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer you will work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by driving cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers the most demanding AI/ML applications. You will be part of a team developing custom silicon solutions, leveraging your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU
items.desc: About us At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence, and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed. We are looking for a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer to join us as part of our team. About the role As a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer you will work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by driving cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers the most demanding AI/ML applications. You will be part of a team developing custom silicon solutions, leveraging your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. You will lead chip and package design, ensuring optimal SI/PI performance and system co-design from concept to production, while collaborating within a cross-functional team of Chip Design, IP, System Design, software, and vendors. As a qualified expert You will Lead signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) analysis and optimization for High-Performance Computing (HPC) leveraging advanced 2.5D/3D packaging technologies. Partner early in product definition to influence chip floorplanning, power distribution networks (PDN/power trees), netlists, and routability tradeoffs. Evaluate high-speed interface IPs and develop next-generation memory interfaces across IO PHY, SI/PI, and physical design boundaries. Drive post-silicon validation and qualification for NPI, balancing SI/PI performance and DFM constraints to achieve final package design closure. Partner closely with silicon, system, and external vendor teams while developing simulation methodologies to boost modeling accuracy and efficiency. We’re looking for you if you have Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in SI/PI design for chip/package or system PCB. Experience in industry SIPI modeling tool chains (e.g., HFSS, ADS, Sigrity, Siwave, etc.). Experience with lab bring-up, test environments, and characterization for high-speed memory and SerDes. Experience with partnering across chip architecture, physical design, static timing analysis (STA), package, and validation teams. Experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ to establish automated flows and data processing tools. Bonus points Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. Deep knowledge of SI/PI analysis for high-speed interconnects (HBMx, D2D/chiplets, PCIe, SerDes) and timing budget methodologies. Direct experience with silicon interposers, silicon bridges, and 3D die stacking architectures. What’s in it for You Reveal great tech solutions Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Unleash your potential, tackle new challenges, and be part of a team that values your skills and contributions. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients. Experience an agile and flexible working environment Work fully remote around the globe, or in a hybrid work model from our office hubs which are equipped with everything needed for comfortable work. Enjoy a flexible working schedule and create work and rest balance for yourself. Empower yourself with a stable workload and a stable income, focusing on lasting cooperation and high-performance culture. Embrace the opportunity for personal and professional growth Take advantage of performance review and career path. Elevate your skills with mentorship program, personal development plan, and individual learnings through the corporate library, public speaking support, and more. Feel cared about Be among like-minded people and feel supported with collaboration, open communication and mutual respect. Join company-wide tech and cultural events, and contribute to meaningful CSR initiatives that resonate with your values. Interview steps Interview with Recruiter Manager Interview Client Interview Olha Lutsenko Team Lead, Talent Acquisition Work Type: Contract, Remote Category: Engineering Location: France, Germany, Israel, Mexico, Netherlands, United Kingdom

items.desc: Your mission In this role, you will own our plant-based meat products end to end, for both our LEKKA retail brand and our B2B customers, from the first lab-scale prototype to consistent commercial production. You will improve key product attributes such as appearance, texture, and flavor through hands-on experimentation and data-driven insights. You will then translate those formulations into robust, cost-efficient manufacturing processes. Working closely with R&D, production, quality, and engineering, you will make sure the taste and texture we create in the lab is exactly what reaches our customers. We run our own production equipment and also work with co-manufacturers, so the role includes regular travel to co-manufacturing sites for scale-up tests. Key responsibilities Product development (R&D) Lab-Scale Experimentation: Design and run systematic lab experiments to refine formulations and processes, testing ingredient functionality and process parameters against clear product goals. Product Quality Enhancement: Improve the appearance, texture, flavor, and nutrition of our products while optimizing ingredient costs. Product Evaluation: Choose and run the right analysis adapted to the objective: sensory tests (discriminative, descriptive, or hedonic) and measurements such as texture analysis. Data Analysis & Innovation: Analyze results with appropriate statistical methods, validate or challenge hypotheses, and propose evidence-based next steps. Track scientific literature for emerging technologies and ingredients. Scale-up and production Process Development & Scale-Up: Run pilot and scale-up tests, in-house and at co-manufacturers, to validate lab formulations at larger scale, optimize processing parameters, and get products ready for full-scale production. Production Support & Process Control: Troubleshoot with quality & production teams, and set critical process parameters and quality checkpoints for consistent runs. Equipment Evaluation: Assess equipment performance and work with engineering on equipment selection and modification. Across both Technical Documentation: Keep complete records of experiments and results, and maintain process specifications, SOPs, and production guidelines. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Closely collaborate with product development, production, quality, and engineering, keeping projects aligned with timelines and OKRs. Laboratory Management & Safety: Keep the food lab organized, clean, well-stocked, and safe, and order trial ingredients on time. Your profile If you enjoy working both in the lab and on the factory floor, and love turning hands-on experiments into products that run reliably at scale, this is your chance to apply your expertise to revolutionary plant-based meat innovation. Join us now as we scale operations in a fast-growing, purpose-driven startup. Requirements Professional Experience: 3–7 years in food product development and/or food manufacturing, preferably with plant-based foods, alternative proteins, processed foods, or ingredient applications. Hands-on lab experience plus exposure to process development and scale-up. Educational Background: Master's or PhD degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Food Engineering, Food Chemistry, or a related field. Technical Skills: Expertise in food formulation, ingredient functionality, and protein science. Knowledge of food processing technologies and scale-up principles. Experience with sensory evaluation and instrumental analysis. Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Proficiency in experimental design and statistical analysis. Experience with root cause analysis and process improvement. Personal Attributes: Curious, rigorous, and hands-on, with strong attention to detail. Equally comfortable in the lab and on the production floor, working independently while seeking support when needed. Communication Skills: Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate technical concepts for R&D, production, and quality audiences. Driving license class B: As driving to visit our co-manufacturers is required. Language Proficiency: Fluent English is required; German at B2 level or higher. Why us? Why you should apply now End-to-End Impact: Few roles let you shape a product from first prototype to full-scale production. Here, you see your ideas through. Scaling Big: We already have 7 products on the shelves of major supermarket chains, and we keep expanding our production capacity. Join at a moment of fast growth and help shape how we scale next. Top-Tier Backing: We’re supported by world-class VCs and angels who share our vision and believe in our mission. The Time is Now: Food needs a massive transformation. Join us in creating irresistible, sustainable food that inspires billions to switch away from animal-based meat, fast! items.desc: Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Als Product Owner NeuraGym Cloud Platform bist du für die Vision, Roadmap und das Backlog der Cloud- und Edge-Software von NeuraGym verantwortlich – unserer Physical AI Data & Training Platform . Du triffst die Produktentscheidungen für diesen Bereich und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse. Gemeinsam mit dem Product Owner NeuraGym , der für das Gesamtprodukt verantwortlich ist, übersetzt du eine gemeinsame Vision in ein klares Backlog für unsere Engineering-Teams und daraus in funktionierende Software, die in jedem Sprint ausgeliefert wird und unsere Roboter Schritt für Schritt intelligenter macht. Verantwortung für das Backlog: Du organisierst, verfeinerst und kommunizierst das Product Backlog so, dass die Teams jederzeit wissen, was am wichtigsten ist und warum. Du formulierst klare Backlog Items mit aussagekräftigen Akzeptanzkriterien. Produktgestaltung: Du entscheidest, welche Features umgesetzt werden – und welche nicht. Dabei wägest du Nutzerwert, Aufwand, Risiko und strategische Relevanz gegeneinander ab und machst deine Entscheidungen transparent. Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem NeuraGym Product Owner: Du übersetzt die übergeordnete Produktstrategie in konkrete Ziele für die Cloud-Plattform, hältst beide Roadmaps synchron und vertrittst gegenüber Kunden und Stakeholdern eine gemeinsame Linie. Zusammenarbeit mit Architektur und Führung: Du arbeitest eng mit der Bereichsleitung und unseren Architekten zusammen, um neue Features mit Sicherheit, Mandantentrennung, Skalierbarkeit und technischer Verschuldung in Einklang zu bringen. Du strukturierst die Arbeit entlang klarer Domänengrenzen, sodass Teams möglichst unabhängig liefern können. Verstehe deine Nutzer: Du kennst die Bedürfnisse von Robotik-Operatoren, ML-Researchern, Data Teams, Partnern und Kundenadministratoren. Du bringst ihr Feedback in Reviews ein und prüfst kontinuierlich, ob unsere Lösungen ihre tatsächlichen Probleme lösen. Agile Delivery: Du definierst Produktziele und gestaltest Planning, Refinements und Reviews so, dass sie für die Teams echten Mehrwert schaffen. Skalierung von Anfang an mitdenken: Du gestaltest eine Plattform, die viele Kunden in unterschiedlichen Regionen bedienen kann – mit Kostentransparenz und zuverlässigem Betrieb von Beginn an. Das Ökosystem verbinden: Du koordinierst dich mit weiteren Teams innerhalb unserer Cloud-Plattform sowie mit Robotics- und AI-Teams zu gemeinsamen Fähigkeiten und Abhängigkeiten – von Identity und Organisationen bis hin zum Deployment auf unsere Roboter. Was wir von dir erwarten Fundierte Erfahrung: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung im Product Ownership oder Product Management für Softwareprodukte, idealerweise im Bereich B2B-Plattformen, SaaS oder Data- und ML-Tooling. Agile Arbeitsweise: Du hast Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, und setzt Methoden pragmatisch statt dogmatisch ein. Stakeholder Management: Du hast souverän mit zahlreichen Stakeholdern mit unterschiedlichen und teils konkurrierenden Interessen gearbeitet – bis hin zum Senior Management – und kannst begründet auch einmal Nein sagen. Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst mit Engineers sicher über Cloud-Architekturen, APIs und Domänengrenzen sprechen. Kenntnisse in AWS, Data Pipelines oder ML-Workflows sind ein großer Vorteil; Programmierkenntnisse sind nicht erforderlich. Plattformerfahrung: Du hast bereits Verantwortung für komplexe, mandantenfähige Plattformprodukte übernommen und verstehst, was Skalierung für Features, Kosten und Betrieb bedeutet. Outcome-Orientierung: Du misst Erfolg am Mehrwert für Nutzer und nicht nur am Output. Daten und Nutzerfeedback fließen aktiv in deine Entscheidungen ein. Begeisterung für Physical AI: Du möchtest die Zukunft der Robotik aktiv mitgestalten – made in Europe. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst klar und souverän mit Engineers, Kunden und Management. Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind erforderlich; Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus.

items.desc: Your Mission & Challenges As Product Owner NeuraGym Cloud Platform, you will be responsible for the vision, roadmap and backlog for NeuraGym's cloud and edge software, our Physical AI Data & Training Platform. You will make the product decisions for this area and stand up for the result. Hand in hand with the Product Owner NeuraGym, who is responsible for the overall product, you will turn a shared vision into a clear backlog for our engineering teams and from it working software that is delivered every sprint and makes our robots smarter step by step. Backlog responsibility : You organize, refine, and communicate the product backlog so that teams know what's most important and why at all times. You formulate clear backlog items with meaningful acceptance criteria. Design the product : You decide which features are implemented and which are not. You weigh up user value, effort, risk and strategic fit and make your decisions transparent. In lockstep with the NeuraGym Product Owner : You translate the overall product strategy into goals for the cloud platform, keep both roadmaps in sync and speak with one voice to customers and stakeholders. Architecture Partners : You'll work closely with department leadership and our architects to balance new features with security, tenant separation, scalability, and technical debt. You'll cut work along domain boundaries so teams can deliver independently. Know your users : You understand robot operators, ML researchers, data teams, partners, and customer admins. You get their feedback into every review and check if what we build really solves their problems. Agile delivery : You define product goals and design planning, refinement and reviews in such a way that they bring real added value to the teams. Think scaling : You will design a platform that serves many customers in many regions – with cost transparency and reliable operation right from the start. Connect the ecosystem : You coordinate with the other teams in our cloud platform, as well as robotics and AI teams, on shared skills and dependencies. From identity and organizations to deployment to our robots. What we want from you In-depth experience : 5+ years in product ownership or product management for software products, ideally for B2B platforms, SaaS or data and ML tooling. Agile way of working : You have experience in agile teams, ideally with Scrum, and use methods pragmatically instead of dogmatically. Stakeholder management : You have confidently led many stakeholders with competing interests up to senior management and can say no with good reason. Technical understanding : You will discuss cloud architecture, APIs, and domain boundaries confidently with engineers. Understanding AWS, data pipelines, or ML workflows is a big plus; no coding is required. Platform experience : You have been responsible for complex, multi-tenant platform products and know what scaling means for features, costs and operations. Outcome orientation : You measure success by the impact on users, not the output, and use data and user feedback to inform your decisions. Passion for Physical AI : You want to help shape the robotics of the future, made in Europe. Communication : Clear and confident towards engineers, customers and management. Very good written and spoken English, German is a plus

items.desc: Amentum is seeking a Test Conductor on Andros Island, Bahamas to the Atlantic Undersea Test and Evaluation Center (AUTEC) Mission in Andros Island, Bahamas. The Test Conductor is responsible for the overall conduct and execution of test events on the AUTEC tracked range and is accountable to the Test Operations Manager on the AUTEC project. AUTEC is a Major Range and Test Facility Base (MRTFB) and the Naval Undersea Warfare Center, Division Newport's largest single team project, providing both deep and shallow water test and training environments. Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Government Clearance. Note: U.S. Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance. Essential Responsibilities: Manage real-time operations of all range tracking systems, vessels, helicopters, and other assets participating in the operation including test participants effectively meeting the test operation requirements in an efficient manner. Review all relevant test operations documents such as operation directives, test plans, pre-test briefings, and unclassified and classified naval messages. Attend pertinent test meetings including Range Safety briefs, pre-test briefs, test specific planning meetings, and range scheduling meetings. Oversee and supervise the Test Operations Real-Time Display Center (RTDC) during test events, ensuring all range operation personnel receive a thorough in-brief on current range operations. Ensure all stations in the RTDC are properly prepared and manned for range testing as required by the Operations Directive and AUTEC Schedule of Operations. Train prospective Test Conductors as assigned by the Lead Test Conductor. Support the US Navy Range Safety Watch Officer (RSWO) to ensure test operations are performed in a safe manner and all test operations are following the AUTEC Range Safety program. In the absence of the RSWO, take decisive action to avoid situations that could result in danger to personnel or damage to vessels or equipment. Maintain real-time logs of all test operations in accordance with established procedures and oversee supplemental documentation requirements such as deficiency reports, range utilization reports, and weapons reports. Provide point of contact between contractor and Naval Undersea Warfare Center (NUWC) duty team and Range Users to ensure real-time requirements and changes are appropriately managed. Provide technical evaluation to the duty team of any real-time problem and suggest alternatives for meeting test objectives. Exercise discretion and independent judgment to meet customer demands in conjunction with keeping company objectives in focus. Perform other duties as assigned. Minimum Requirements BA/BS degree in Engineering, Science, Electronics, or equivalent preferred Five years of AUTEC experience with range test operations or a role that was in a direct test support function preferred. (Military service or commercial experience (5+ yrs.) in a technical field involving large-scale test operations may be substituted in lieu of the degree and/or years of AUTEC experience.) Qualify as a Test Conductor in accordance with Phase I and II work-based learning and certification; required. Computer literacy in a Windows environment. Exceptional written and oral communication skills in English required. Use of Microsoft Outlook email and associated tools is imperative. Must be able to walk up/down a one flight stairwell as well as board range craft and fixed/rotary wing aircraft. Capacity to manage close vision work on computer screens/monitors. This position requires the individual to have and maintain an active Secret US Government security clearance; US Citizenship is required. Must be able to reside in remote location with limited medical facilities. A valid US Passport and Driver’s License is required. Preferred Qualifications: Knowledge of AUTEC capabilities preferred. Working knowledge of various tracking, acoustical, and/or communication systems as well as performance characteristics of US Navy vessels and anti-submarine warfare tactics a plus. Work independently and as a part of a team with contractor, Range User and NUWC personnel. Aptitude for tactful interaction with a wide variety of military and civilian personnel of various nationalities. Ability to remain calm and decisive under pressure; remain flexible and professional coping with changes in a real-time environment.

items.desc: RHD Joinery Ltd is a premier joinery manufacturer based in Harold's Cross. We specialise in high-end, bespoke architectural joinery, custom cabinetry, and premium fit-outs. We are currently seeking a talented and experienced Joinery Draughtsperson with a deep background in the woodworking sector to join our team and translate architectural concepts into exact manufacturing drawings. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial design concepts and workshop production. You will be responsible for creating detailed manufacturing drawings, setting out, and generating cutting lists. The ideal draughtsperson has strong practical knowledge of cabinet making, timber construction, and assembly methods, ensuring all drawings are structurally sound and production-ready for our craftsmen. Key Responsibilities Detailed Drafting: Produce accurate 2D/3D production and installation drawings using AutoCAD based on architectural intents and site surveys. Setting Out: Develop full-scale setting-out drawings and precise component details for the workshop floor. Material Procurement: Generate comprehensive cutting lists and bills of materials (BOM). Collaboration: Liaison directly with architects, project managers, and the workshop team to resolve design queries and optimize manufacturing methods. Site Surveys: Occasional attendance at project sites to take exact dimensions and verify structural conditions. Criteria Required Specification Software Expertise: Proficient in AutoCAD (2D drafting is essential; 3D modeling is a distinct advantage). Interest in learning and adapting new software like Mozaik. Industry Experience : Minimum 5 years of dedicated experience as a draughtsperson specifically for architectural joinery, cabinetry, or shopfitting. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of timber materials, joinery construction methods, ironmongery, and manufacturing constraints. Skill Set: Ability to read and interpret complex architectural blueprints and structural drawings accurately. Core Attributes: Exceptional attention to detail, strong spatial awareness, and strong communication skills. Pay: €28,300.00-€57,000.00 per year Benefits: On-site parking Experience: AutoCAD: 5 years (required) Language: English (required) Work Location: In person

Proven experience leading architecture and design reviews, resolving complex technical issues, managing architectural risk, and guiding development teams and implementation partners. items.desc: Siamo alla ricerca di un Solution Architect , per potenziare il nostro team di Architecture Services che si occupa di guidare l’evoluzione delle architetture IT dei nostri clienti durante le fasi di definizione e progettazione di soluzioni architetturali dei nostri clienti. Valutare l'impatto della soluzione sugli obiettivi di business a lungo termine garantendo che l'architettura non solo risolva il problema immediato, ma sia anche sostenibile, scalabile e allineata con la strategia IT complessiva dell'organizzazione. At TOMRA, we want people to innovate , show passion in their work and be responsible . We encourage the freedom to innovate and take risks that result in breakthroughs that challenge the status quo. We value passion that focuses and commits to meeting success. We believe in a responsible and safe mindset that takes care of our customers, products, and fellow employees. Join the resource revolution! Job Description Join our dynamic team at TOMRA Food as a Field Service Engineer , where you'll play a pivotal role in ensuring the seamless operation of our cutting-edge food sorting systems. Our local TOMRA office is based in Valencia, and we are always looking for motivated people who want to be part of our organization. We are currently seeking an experienced Field Service Engineer who is based in or around Valencia, Murcia, Alicante, Castellón de la Plana or surroundings. We're looking for a highly skilled and motivated individual to take on the challenge of providing top-notch customer service, encompassing commissioning, operation, testing, integration, optimization, maintenance, training, and repair activities primarily in Spain and Portugal . This role offers the perfect blend of hands-on work and independent problem-solving, making it an ideal fit for a passionate engineering enthusiast. Role and Responsibilities: Perform field service activities including installation, commissioning, operation, testing, optimization, maintenance, and repair of TOMRA equipment. Diagnose and resolve technical issues, ensuring optimal machine performance and customer satisfaction. Carry out mechanical, electrical, electronic, and optical adjustments and configurations. Provide customer training on the operation and maintenance of TOMRA systems. Deliver technical support and expert advice to help customers maximize operational performance and reduce food waste. Prepare accurate service reports and collaborate with internal teams to ensure excellent customer support. Work with innovative, industry-leading technology and act as a TOMRA ambassador. Travel up to 80% of the time, primarily within Spain, with occasional international travel as required. Qualifications Technical education in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Automation, Industrial Maintenance, or a related field. 3 to 5 years of experience in field service, industrial maintenance, or technical customer support. Proven experience performing preventive and corrective maintenance on industrial equipment. Practical knowledge of analog and digital circuits, power supply systems, and PLCs. Required. Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics. Good understanding of IT, networking, and PC configuration. Fluent Spanish and a good command of English (minimum B2 level). Required. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and customer service skills. Ability to build and maintain effective relationships with customers, colleagues, and stakeholders. Willingness to travel up to 80% of the time. Valid driver's license and a good driving record. Additional Information What we offer: Premium Equipment – Latest laptop, mobile phone, PPE & professional workwear Up to 10% Annual Bonus – Performance-based STI tied to your success & company goals Company Car + Fuel/Charging Card – Modern vehicle for work & private use according to Company Car Policy 100% Company-Paid Extended Life Insurance: In case of death & permanent disability Extra - Private health insurance affiliation offered at discounted rate Fully Flexible Hybrid Work – Home-based contract with modern work-life balance All Travel Covered – Expenses + full travel insurance paid by TOMRA Great Time Off - 29 calendar days as holidays in accordance with our CBA Long-Term Rewards – Jubilee recognition every 5 years Continuous Learning – Tailored training & development via TOMRA Learn Team Fun – Regular social activities & events with great colleagues How to Apply If you see yourself in this role, we'd love to hear from you! items.desc: 130 years of trust, time to shape what's next. Allianz Group is one of the world's leading insurers and asset managers - built on over a century of stability, expertise, and financial strength. Allianz Services is where that legacy meets the future. 8,200+ people. Eight countries. Three continents. We deliver specialized services to clients within Allianz Group, powered by AI, advanced analytics, and a mindset that refuses to stand still. From core insurance operations to engineering and consulting services, we reimagine how insurance works. What truly sets us apart are our people and the trusted partnerships we build, anchored in our values of expertise, integrity, and empowerment. We don't support the business. We shape it. Role Overview Allianz Group is developing the Allianz Security Operations Center (ASOC ) as an integrated capability bringing together threat intelligence, travel security, physical security, executive protection, incident response , and crisis management , with the objective of progressively building scalable 24/7 operational capacity for both man-made and natural risks. In a fast-changing and increasingly volatile environment , Allianz considers this capability a strategic imperative requiring concrete action, sustained commitment, and strong operational leadership. The ASOC will strengthen Allianz Group’s ability to anticipate, monitor, respond to, and recover from disruptions by integrating intelligence and operational capabilities and progressively expanding toward continuous, follow-the-sun coverage. It will protect Allianz personnel, physical assets, business operations, and critical functions through consistent monitoring, analysis, escalation, coordination, and reporting . The ASOC is positioned within Allianz Services and functionally reports into Corporate Security’s Group Protection and Resilience Team. Reporting to the ASOC Operational Lead, the ASOC Operational Officer will support the day-to day functioning of the ASOC operational activities, contributing to incident intake, triage, escalation, coordination, and operational reporting across geographies, business lines, and functions. Working closely with the ASOC Intelligence team, and relevant internal stakeholders. The successful candidate will bring strong analytical, reporting skills, and practical experience in physical security operations, incident response, control room environments, or comparable operational settings. The role requires reliability, discretion, clear communication, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, on call-based environment. What you do Monitor, assess, and triage security alerts, incidents, and requests, ensuring timely escalation and response in line with ASOC procedures. Execute initial incident response actions, including stakeholder notifications, coordination with local teams, and emergency service engagement when required. Operate and monitor key security platforms, including travel security, mass notification, access control, and incident management systems. Provide clear operational updates, incident summaries, and situation reports while maintaining accurate documentation, reporting, and governance records. Collaborate closely with ASOC teams, Intelligence, Cyber SOC, Protection Resilience, Communications, and other stakeholders to support informed decision-making and coordinated response. Support continuous improvement through post-incident reviews, lessons learned, drills, exercises, and preparedness activities for major incidents and crisis scenarios. Track operational performance metrics, handle sensitive information securely, and ensure compliance with confidentiality, data protection, and governance requirements. What you bring Bachelor’s degree in Security Management, Emergency Management, International Relations, or a related field, or equivalent experience in corporate security, government, emergency services, or operational security environments. 2–5 years of experience in security operations, incident response, crisis management support, control rooms, Security Operations Centers (SOC), or similar 24/7 operational environments; financial services experience is a plus. Solid understanding of incident management processes, including intake, triage, escalation, stakeholder communication, operational logging, and shift handovers. Practical experience with travel security, emergency response, executive protection, event security, and crisis management, as well as security technologies such as mass notification and incident management platforms. Good understanding of hybrid threat environments, including physical, cyber, geopolitical, and reputational risks affecting multinational organizations. Strong communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills, with the ability to handle sensitive information discreetly and deliver accurate reporting in fast-paced environments. items.desc: Would you like to be part of a team of over 19,000 cybersecurity specialists worldwide ? Accenture has an opportunity for you to join our Cybersecurity team. Our team, across some 100 countries, is dedicated to transforming the practice of medicine by working to turn the impossible into the possible. creative thinker who challenges the status quo and learns new technologies quickly; excellent communicator able to influence stakeholders and drive cultural change across a global, multi-national matrix organization Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience Languages: Fluent English (written and verbal) mandatory Why choose us? Shape the future of cloud at Sanofi — your work will directly influence how the entire organization provisions, governs, and scales cloud resources Broad cross-functional impact — partner with Engineering, FinOps, and business teams to drive meaningful transformation Growth path — progress into roles of greater scope and influence as you master cloud transformation practices and stakeholder engagement Cutting-edge tools — work hands-on with IaC, Snowflake data lakes, GitHub Actions, and AI-driven automation Inclusive, global culture — join a diverse, multi-national team where every voice matters and collaboration drives results Pursue Progress . items.title: Software Engineer - Cypher Planner
items.card: The Role: Join our dynamic Cypher team at Neo4j, where we are at the forefront of optimizing the core codebase that receives query strings and transforms them into efficient, logically sound execution plans. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model.
items.desc: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role: Join our dynamic Cypher team at Neo4j, where we are at the forefront of optimizing the core codebase that receives query strings and transforms them into efficient, logically sound execution plans. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model. Responsibilities: As a Cypher Software Engineer, you will not only enhance and optimize the query planner but also contribute to the development of comprehensive features that elevate the capabilities of the Cypher language and the Neo4j database. Your impact will extend across the entire codebase, from the parser to the storage files and indexes. Success in this role requires the ability to think abstractly, discuss the pros and cons of different options, and anticipate edge cases in a design. What You'll Bring: Experience with performance-driven development, e.g., profiling, benchmarking, and optimizing code Familiarity with Agile development processes (TDD, kanban/scrum, pair programming) Knowledge of or willingness to learn Scala A desire to learn. Nice to also have: Experience programming in Scala and/or Java Understanding or previous experience with database design and implementation Interest or experience in developing compilers A strong foundation in algorithm design and analysis Interest in exploratory learning and transferring academic research into production-grade products 5+ years of experience developing high-quality, highly scalable production-level software We don't expect you to have experience across all these areas. We have a mix of different skills in our team. Many of our teams are spread over two or more locations, so you should be comfortable working as part of a distributed team. Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others. Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success. Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform. A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. Research shows that members of underrepresented communities are less likely to apply for jobs when they don't meet all the qualifications. If this is part of the reason you hesitate to apply, we'd encourage you to reconsider and give us the opportunity to review your application. At Neo4j, we are committed to building awareness and helping to improve these issues. One of our central objectives is to provide an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace for everyone to develop their potential and have a positive, …

items.desc: About The Role Are you an early career scientist, looking to gain experience working in a range of wetland habitats within a supportive and internationally recognised team of wetland experts? WWT's Wetland Evidence department are looking to recruit an early career scientist to support our expanding programme of ecological monitoring. Sitting in the Wetland BioScience team the successful candidate will have the opportunity to develop field skills covering a range of taxa including pollinating insects, saltmarsh vegetation, aerial insectivores (bats and birds) and aquatic invertebrates. The role will also involve desk based data collation and management as well as the opportunity to get involved in analysis and reporting tasks. The role will centre on field-based survey work across a range of sites, primarily in the South West but also nationally so a willingness to travel and a driving licence are therefore essential. This is a full-time position, working 37.5 hours per week, for a fixed period until 30th March 2028. During the fieldwork season, this position will require working on some weekends and bank holidays and working outside of normal hours. Considerable flexibility will be required during the fieldwork season. About You The successful candidate will have a background in ecology and an interest in wetland species and habitats have a desire to develop cross-taxa field skills and desk based data management experience be proactive and engaged across multiple projects and tasks have the ability to bring a creative approach to problem solving, finding practical solutions be able to conduct fieldwork independently, managing own time efficiently whilst following health & safety regulation be willing to travel (within the UK) and have a driving licence have good interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate with a wide range of audiences and members of public and maintain effective relationships with colleagues and partners. Please view the full job description for all the responsibilities and specifications for the role. About Us We’re WWT, and we’re on a mission to restore the super-powered ecosystems we call wetlands. There’s never been a more important moment for our work, and we’ve got some phenomenal people on the case. Whether they’re taking a new visitor under their wing, or conducting ground-breaking research further afield, our team are second to none. And there’s nothing we love more than watching them soar. Whatever you do here, you’ll be helping to restore wetlands and unlock their power. So, the only question left is, what role will you play? Why you’ll love working at WWT Wake up every day knowing your work is helping to restore wetlands, and our world Be surrounded and inspired by our team of passionate, dedicated people 33 days annual leave (which goes up to 38 days after 5 years of service) – this includes bank holidays and you have flexibility to take those days whenever you want Free entry to all our wetland centres, including your family Free car parking and secure bike storage areas Colleague discount on shopping and memberships Cycle to work scheme Contributory pension scheme Life Assurance of three times your salary, for peace of mind for your loved ones Independent personal, workplace and financial advice from our Employee Assistance Programme WWT is an equal opportunities employer and all applications will be considered solely on merit. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model.
items.desc: About Neo4j: Neo4j is the graph intelligence platform that transforms data into knowledge to power the next generation of intelligent applications and AI systems. It includes enterprise-ready knowledge graphs for accurate, explainable, and governed AI; the most comprehensive, trusted, and easy-to-deploy graph capabilities across any environment and data source; and an unmatched ecosystem trusted by 84 of the Fortune 100 and supported by the world's largest graph community. Intelligence that works. Results that matter. Built to work everywhere and integrate with everything across every cloud for dynamic, personalized, and autonomous AI systems. We deliver quicker results, contextual knowledge, and solutions that impact customers and employees across the business. Our Vision: At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data. As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we're disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive. The Role: Join our dynamic Cypher team at Neo4j, where we are at the forefront of optimizing the core codebase that receives query strings and transforms them into efficient, logically sound execution plans. This role delves deep into the heart of the database, determining the most rapid and effective means of retrieving queried data from the underlying stores and indexes of the property graph model. Responsibilities: As a Cypher Software Engineer, you will not only enhance and optimize the query planner but also contribute to the development of comprehensive features that elevate the capabilities of the Cypher language and the Neo4j database. Your impact will extend across the entire codebase, from the parser to the storage files and indexes. Success in this role requires the ability to think abstractly, discuss the pros and cons of different options, and anticipate edge cases in a design. What You'll Bring: Experience with performance-driven development, e.g., profiling, benchmarking, and optimizing code Familiarity with Agile development processes (TDD, kanban/scrum, pair programming) Knowledge of or willingness to learn Scala A desire to learn. Nice to also have: Experience programming in Scala and/or Java Understanding or previous experience with database design and implementation Interest or experience in developing compilers A strong foundation in algorithm design and analysis Interest in exploratory learning and transferring academic research into production-grade products 5+ years of experience developing high-quality, highly scalable production-level software We don't expect you to have experience across all these areas. We have a mix of different skills in our team. Many of our teams are spread over two or more locations, so you should be comfortable working as part of a distributed team. Why Join Neo4j? Neo4j is, without question, the most popular graph intelligence platform in the world. We have customers in every industry globally, and our products are a proven product/market fit. Joining our team is an opportunity to shape the future of data and analytics. Below are just a few exciting facts about Neo4j. Neo4j is one of the fastest-scaling technology companies in this industry. It recently surpassed $200M in annual recurring revenue (ARR), doubling its ARR over the past three years. Raised the biggest funding round in database history ($325M Series F). Backed by world-class investors like Eurazeo, GV (formerly Google Ventures), and Inovia Capital, Neo4j has raised over $600M in funding and is currently valued at over $2Bn. This puts Neo4j among the most well-funded database companies in history. 84% of the Fortune 100 and 58% of the Fortune 500 use Neo4j. Examples include Boston Scientific, BT Group, Caterpillar, Cisco, Comcast, Department for Education UK, eBay, NBC News, Novo Nordisk, Worldline, and others. Co-founder and CEO Emil Eifrem has built an amazing culture that prides itself on relationships, inclusiveness, innovation, and customer success. Countless industry awards. Massive enterprises and individual developers/data scientists love Neo4j. A strong sense of community and ecosystem is built around the platform. A recent Forrester Total Economic Impact™ Study cited Neo4j as delivering 417% ROI to customers. items.desc: About Nscale At Nscale, we are building the infrastructure for Europe's AI revolution. Nscale is developing cutting-edge, sovereign generative AI solutions powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. The rapid growth of artificial intelligence is driving unprecedented global demand for compute and GPU infrastructure. Positioned at the heart of this transformation, Nscale is delivering the platforms that will enable the next decade of innovation. Working closely with the world's most advanced AI technology providers, Nscale integrates next-generation compute hardware and GPU clusters across both partner and self-delivered facilities. This is a unique opportunity to join Nscale's journey, play a pivotal role in delivering transformative AI infrastructure, and help shape a company designed to scale rapidly across Europe and beyond. The Role The Document Controller will be engaged to manage project documentation on Nscale's colocation data center developments. You will be responsible for maintaining accurate document control systems, ensuring that all project information is current, correctly formatted, approved, and distributed to the right stakeholders at the right time. This role requires a strong understanding of document management processes within complex construction or engineering environments. You'll play a critical role in supporting project delivery, maintaining version integrity, and upholding Nscale's standards for governance, accuracy, and compliance across all design and construction documentation. Key Responsibilities Document Control & Information Management Establish, maintain, and manage document control systems for large-scale construction projects in accordance with Nscale's standards and procedures. Ensure all project documentation — including design drawings, specifications, contracts, reports, and correspondence — is accurately logged, version-controlled, and traceable. Review incoming and outgoing documents for accuracy, completeness, and correct formatting before release. Manage document workflows, approvals, and distribution through designated document control platforms e.g. Procore Governance, Quality & Compliance Implement document control protocols that comply with Nscale's governance framework and regional regulatory requirements. Monitor adherence to naming conventions, revision management, and transmittal procedures across all internal and external contributors. Maintain up-to-date audit trails, ensuring traceability and accountability for all document submissions and approvals. Support internal and external audits by providing complete, accurate document records as required. Collaboration & Support Work closely with Project and Design Managers, and Contractors to ensure information is exchanged efficiently and accurately. Coordinate the flow of information between Nscale's internal teams and external stakeholders, including partners, contractors, and suppliers. Provide document control training and support to project participants to maintain consistent standards and best practices. Assist in preparing reports and dashboards summarising document status, approvals, and outstanding actions. Systems, Tools & Continuous Improvement Champion best practice in digital document management and data governance, supporting Nscale's technology-led approach to project delivery. Regularly review and improve document control procedures, identifying opportunities for automation and efficiency. Ensure all project documentation is archived correctly at project close-out for long-term retrieval and record retention. Who You Are 5+ years' experience in document control or information management within large scale, complex construction Proficient in Procore Strong understanding of construction documentation, revision control, and approval workflows. Highly organised, detail-oriented, and capable of managing large volumes of technical information. Excellent communication skills and ability to coordinate across multiple teams and stakeholders. Proactive, solutions-driven, and able to work independently within a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Fluent in English; other European languages advantageous. items.card: Aufgaben: Als KI-Architekt (w/m/d) verantwortest du die Konzeption und Umsetzung von KI-Lösungen auf Unternehmensebene. Du verbindest datenwissenschaftliche Ansätze mit robusten Software- und Systemarchitekturen, definierst die technische Infrastruktur, wählst passende KI- und Machine-Learning-Modelle aus und sorgst dafür, dass diese sicher, kosteneffizient und skalierbar in bestehende IT-Systeme integriert werden.
items.desc: Formel D ist der globale Dienstleister der Automobilindustrie. Wir entwickeln marktführende Konzepte sowie individuelle, skalierbare Lösungen entlang der kompletten automobilen Wertschöpfungskette – von der Entwicklung über die Produktion bis hin zum Aftersales. Formel D wurde 1993 gegründet, der Hauptsitz der Unternehmensgruppe befindet sich in der Millionenmetropole Köln. In unseren interkulturellen Teams arbeiten heute weltweit mehr als 10.500 Personen aus 45 Nationen zusammen, die in über 90 Niederlassungen in 21 Ländern tätig sind. Aufgaben: Als KI-Architekt (w/m/d) verantwortest du die Konzeption und Umsetzung von KI-Lösungen auf Unternehmensebene. Du verbindest datenwissenschaftliche Ansätze mit robusten Software- und Systemarchitekturen, definierst die technische Infrastruktur, wählst passende KI- und Machine-Learning-Modelle aus und sorgst dafür, dass diese sicher, kosteneffizient und skalierbar in bestehende IT-Systeme integriert werden. Dabei berücksichtigst du sowohl technische als auch geschäftliche Anforderungen und begleitest den Weg von der Idee bis zum produktiven Einsatz. In dieser Funktion entwickelst du ganzheitliche unternehmensweite KI-Architekturen. Dazu wählst du geeignete Technologien aus und integrierst KI-Lösungen in bestehende Systeme unter Berücksichtigung von Skalierbarkeit, Performance und Sicherheit. Technische Leitung bei der Umsetzung von KI-Anwendungsfällen (z. B. Generative AI, RAG, NLP, Predictive Analytics). Zudem stellst du die Einhaltung von Kosten, Governance, Standards und Responsible AI innerhalb der Organisation sicher. Du berätst Fachbereiche und Management zu KI-Strategien, Innovation und technologischer Machbarkeit. Die Architektur-, Data- und Engineering-Teams werden von dir fachlich geführt und unterstützt. Profil: Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Data Science, KI oder einem verwandten Fach sowie langjährige Berufserfahrung (mind. 5 Jahre) in IT-, Software- oder KI-Umgebungen. Wir setzen fundierte Kenntnisse in Cloud-Plattformen (wie Microsoft Azure, AWS oder Google Cloud), Datenarchitekturen, Systemintegration und skalierbaren IT-/KI-Architekturen voraus. Wichtig sind zudem Erfahrungen mit Sicherheits- und Compliance-Anforderungen (z. B. DSGVO) sowie Responsible AI. Ergänzt wird dein Profil durch starke analytische Fähigkeiten, Kommunikationsstärke sowie Erfahrung in technischen Führungsrollen. Abgerundet wird dein Profil durch sehr gute Deutsch- (C1) und Englischkenntnisse (B2). Die Vergütung für diese Position liegt - abhängig von Qualifikation und Berufserfahrung - zwischen 70.000 € - 80.000 € brutto pro Jahr.

items.desc: We vragen Ervaring met open-source LLM’s Kennis van Retrieval Augmented Generation Vaardigheid met knowledge graphs De impact die je gaat maken als AI Engineer Als AI-engineer bij Akkuro help je de toekomst van financiën vorm te geven. Je ontwerpt en ontwikkelt intelligente oplossingen die duidelijkheid brengen in complexe financiële data en slimmere applicatie-agenten aandrijven. Met wereldwijde banken die onder toenemende druk staan om te innoveren, digitaliseren en versnellen, bouwen wij de AI-capaciteiten die hen helpen voorop te blijven lopen. Savings & Investments is gevestigd in Gouda, en je maakt deel uit van een multidisciplinair team dat autonomie, samenwerking en technische diepgang waardeert. Je leidt AI-ontwikkelingen over onze tech stack door machine learning, semantische pijplijnen, retrieval-augmented generation en open-source LLM's toe te passen om financiële data om te zetten in bruikbare inzichten. Je speelt een centrale rol in het opschalen van ons Composable Banking Platform, waarbij je ervoor zorgt dat elke oplossing naadloos integreert over de verschillende business lines. Door te pleiten voor verantwoordelijke AI en het bouwen van transparante, waarde-gedreven applicaties, draag je bij aan software die de efficiëntie verbetert, besluitvorming versterkt en tastbare impact levert voor onze klanten en hun klanten. Wat je gaat doen als AI Engineer Je combineert technische expertise met een gezonde nieuwsgierigheid naar financiële data en de mogelijkheden van AI. Samen met je team werk je aan het ontwikkelen van high-performance data pipelines die financiële workflows en interne processen ondersteunen, zodat kennis efficiënt wordt omgezet in waarde voor klanten en collega’s. Daarnaast optimaliseer je semantische zoekalgoritmes om klanten razendsnel van betrouwbare en relevante inzichten te voorzien. Je bouwt oplossingen voor datakwaliteitsbewaking, waarmee je de consistentie en betrouwbaarheid van onze AI-oplossingen waarborgt. Je houdt je bezig met het fine-tunen en testen van AI-modellen voor specifieke toepassingen, altijd met oog voor effectiviteit en kostenefficiëntie. Ook ben je betrokken bij MLOps-activiteiten, waarbij je secure modellen en data beheert, uitrolt en monitort in productieomgevingen — zodat we van begin tot eind grip houden op het proces. Tot slot implementeer je veilige AI-inference oplossingen die voldoen aan de hoge enterprise-standaarden binnen de banking- en finance-sector. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met analisten, ontwikkelteams en security-specialisten. Wat breng jij mee als AI Engineer Je hebt een passie voor technologie, begrijpt de complexiteit van financiële data en bent altijd op zoek naar betere oplossingen. Technische expertise Ervaring met het modelleren en bevragen van semantische context via knowledge graphs (zoals Neo4j) Ervaring met Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) in vector databases (zoals Qdrant, Pinecone, Milvus, FAISS) Hands-on ervaring met het toepassen, finetunen en implementeren van (open source) LLM’s Vaardigheid in programmeertalen zoals Python en Java Ervaring met frameworks als LangChain en PyTorch Kennis van agentic tools zoals GitHub Copilot, Cline, Cursor of Windsurf Ervaring met cloud-ML (bijv. Azure) en containerorkestratie (Docker/Kubernetes) Samenwerking & domeinvaardigheden Security-first mindset en ervaring met AI-pijplijnen voor gestructureerde én ongestructureerde data Sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden met teams zoals development, security en operations Energie om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen én samen resultaten te boeken
