items.card: mission : transformer le savoir-faire de ses experts métier en applications et en agents IA, vendus par abonnement à ses clients. Les cas d’usage, les experts et les premiers clients pilotes sont identifiés. Il reste à construire les produits et la plateforme. Le poste : Construire les premiers produits IA de bout en bout : interfaces, back-end, intégration des modèles et des agents, connexion aux outils des clients
items.desc: Un groupe français de services aux entreprises, actif dans le marketing, la data et la tech. Il réunit plusieurs sociétés spécialisées, et leurs clients sont des ETI et de grands comptes. Le groupe crée un studio produit IA. Sa mission : transformer le savoir-faire de ses experts métier en applications et en agents IA, vendus par abonnement à ses clients. Les cas d’usage, les experts et les premiers clients pilotes sont identifiés. Il reste à construire les produits et la plateforme. Le poste : Construire les premiers produits IA de bout en bout : interfaces, back-end, intégration des modèles et des agents, connexion aux outils des clients (régies publicitaires, CRM, ERP selon les produits). Poser le socle commun : multi-tenant, cloisonnement des données, déploiement, observabilité, suivi des coûts de calcul. Faire passer les produits du prototype à un service fiable, sécurisé et capable de monter en charge. Mettre en place l’évaluation des réponses IA dès les premières versions : jeux de tests, cas limites, garde-fous. Garantir la sécurité et la conformité : séparation des données entre clients, AI Act, exigences des DSI grands comptes. Choisir les modèles et les outils, en multi-modèles et sans dépendance à un fournisseur. Participer au choix des produits et aux échanges avec les clients pilotes. Recruter et encadrer l’équipe technique : une vingtaine de personnes visées à 3 ans. Vous travaillez en binôme avec le CPO du studio, recruté en parallèle, et vous êtes rattaché au directeur de la Transformation IA du groupe. Les choix d’architecture et de stack vous reviennent. Vous êtes Ingénieur full-stack avec au moins 8 ans d’expérience, dont plusieurs années en startup SaaS comme CTO, founding engineer ou lead developer. Vous avez déjà livré vous-même un produit complet, du premier écran à la mise en production, avec de vrais utilisateurs. Vous avez mis en production de l’IA générative : appels aux modèles, agents, RAG, évaluation. Vous êtes solide en back-end, front-end et cloud, et à l’aise avec la sécurité, la data et l’architecture multi-tenant. Vous codez au quotidien et vous voulez continuer. Vous avez déjà recruté et fait grandir une petite équipe technique. Un plus : un SaaS B2B vendu à de grands comptes, ou une expérience en martech ou adtech. Ce qu’on propose Une page blanche technique : stack, architecture et méthodes à définir. Des cas réels et des clients pilotes dès le premier jour. Un budget dédié, pour l’équipe comme pour le calcul. Une équipe à construire. Une rémunération fixe et un variable indexé sur les résultats du studio. Un poste basé à Paris. Le process Un premier échange confidentiel avec le cabinet, puis des entretiens avec le directeur de la Transformation IA et un échange technique autour d’un cas d’architecture.

Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. The Quality Engineer will serve as both a technical design authority and a customer-facing lead for ABB Critical Power
items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Engineering Manager 
 __
 Your role and responsibilities 
 At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions.
 The Quality Engineer will serve as both a technical design authority and a customer-facing lead for ABB Critical Power projects. This role combines engineering responsibilities with commercial customer engagement to ensure successful project delivery and resolution of customer quality issues. Utilizing management skills, technical under standing of products, and communication skills to lead the ABB service, engineering, factory, and product management to solve and resolve customer quality issues.
 ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.
The work model for the role is: Remote {#LI-Remote}
 40% travel requirement for customer visits and project support. 
 Your role and responsibilities: 
 Serve as ABB’s primary customer contact for quality and technical issues, leading communications, onsite support, action plans, and resolution timelines.
 Act as the technical and design authority for engineering deliverables on moderate- to high-complexity projects.
 Review and approve designs, perform verification and peer reviews, and ensure compliance with safety, quality, contractual, and as-built documentation requirements.
 Identify and resolve technical challenges while communicating product gaps, customer needs, and market trends to commercial and product management teams.
 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, manufacturing, testing, commissioning, service, supply chain, sales, and product management to ensure successful project execution.
 Manage multiple concurrent projects, including work plans, cost estimates, RFQs, supplier evaluations, project meetings, contract variations, and timely delivery of engineering outputs.
 Qualifications for the role: 
 Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or (related field) with 7+ years’ experience in electrical distribution or power systems; Master’s degree with 5+ years’ experience in electrical distribution or power systems.
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills; fluent in English (written and spoken).
 Proficiency in MS Office, MS Teams, and ability to leverage AI tools in job functions.
 Ability to manage multiple projects and work independently with minimal supervision.
 Capability to establish and nurture partnership relationships with ABB Product management, engineering, and service.
 Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 PE Certification
 Experience with LV/MV UPS systems, batteries, static transfer switches, power conditioning, PDUs, and ATS.
 Familiarity with industry codes and standards (ANSI, IEEE, NEC, NEMA, NFPA 70E, UL).
 Lean Six Sigma Certification
 Previous field, factory, or design engineering experience in data centers, hospitals, or industrial facilities.

 We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. 
 The Position
 End-to-End Business Team Coach, Growth & Performance (G&P)
 Portfolio Strategy and Delivery (PSD)
 The Position
 At Roche, we have a bold Pharma Strategy to deliver 20 transformative medicines addressing diseases with the highest societal burden. With this top of mind, Portfolio Strategy and Delivery’s (PSD) purpose is to translate Roche strategies into PD priorities and deliver PD’s portfolio with excellence.
 As an End-to-End Business Team Coach, you will act as a strategic partner to high-priority teams (including LCTs, GDTs, GFTs, etc.) across the R&D value chain. You will be responsible for building and executing a systemic coaching strategy that enables the delivery of PD’s core business and critical priority projects. You will contribute to the overall success of PD Growth & Performance (G&P) by improving team effectiveness, equipping teams to navigate complexity and accelerate decision-making, problem-solving, and delivery.
 The Opportunity
 Systemic Team Coaching: Deliver end-to-end coaching interventions for high-priority assets (with TA-Focus), LCTs, GDTs, GFTs, STs and other prioritized teams at critical junctures (start-ups, milestones, transitions, etc.). You will look beyond individual personalities to the broader system, aligning stakeholders and ensuring cross-functional accountability.
 Strategic Business Impact: You will focus on directionally improving key business value drivers by coaching teams toward excellence in problem-solving and execution. You will move beyond traditional dynamics to ensure that team efforts are measured by their success in delivery and their alignment with PD’s core priorities.
 Foster Systemic Team Health & Alignment: In partnership with Resourcing Leads (RLs) and Global Program Managers (GPMs), you will accelerate team effectiveness through clarity and alignment. Being aware of the particularities of each TA, you will be accountable for ensuring that the health of the team system acts as a high-performance engine for the drug development lifecycle.
 Operationalize the TA-Model: Deepen your business understanding of specific Therapeutic Areas (TAs) to provide targeted value and impact, ensuring coaching triggers are aligned with the new LSPC prioritization framework.
 Data & Performance Culture: Maintain a systems-thinking perspective and use data/metrics to identify cross-organization insights. You will be accountable for demonstrating the measurable impact of coaching interventions.
 Innovation & AI Integration: Stay ahead of industry trends to enhance team performance and proactively explore and visualize the use of AI, automation, and digital technologies to enhance team performance and coaching efficiency.
 Standards of Practice and Value Measurement: Contribute to and adopt Standards of Practice and Value Measurement & Reporting, ensuring consistent quality and a clear link between coaching interventions and business impact across the global organization.
 Who you are
 Education: Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s/MBA preferred. Formal accreditation in Team Coaching (ICF, EMCC, or equivalent) is essential.
 Experience: 10+ years of experience in Pharma/Biotech or high-complexity industries. Proven track record of systemic team coaching for global, matrixed teams through large-scale change and drug development lifecycles. Experience must go beyond individual (1:1) coaching to include end-to-end work with cross-functional teams.
 Systemic Mindset: Deep understanding of systemic frameworks (e.g. Leadership Circle, etc.). You view team effectiveness as a function of People Dynamics, Systemic Dynamics, and (crucially) Achieving Results.
 Business Acumen: Strong end-to-end awareness of the R&D value chain. You understand the "business of science" and the value drivers that matter to Clinical Operations, Regulatory, and Commercial teams as well as the complex dynamic of bringing people from those functions into effective development and lifecycle teams.
 Data & Technology: You are comfortable using data to diagnose team health and measure the success of your interventions. You have a vision and experience for how Artificial Intelligence can be leveraged for team coaching.
 Agile Skillset: While not an "Agile Coach" by title, you possess agile facilitation skills and can apply them pragmatically to solve business bottlenecks.
 Coaching Presence: You possess exceptional ability to create safe spaces while remaining a "container" for teams to navigate high-stakes competing business situations. …

Job Description: 
 An opportunity for a Space Systems EMC and Electrical Engineer has arisen within Airbus Defence and Space, Getafe (Madrid) . 
 The selected candidate will join the Electrical Systems Spain Department (TSEOE7) . In this role, you will work within a multi-disciplinary engineering team to specify, analyze, and test systems from an electronic and mainly EMC perspective, contributing to the on-cost, on-time, and on-quality delivery of satellite platforms and payloads (including active antennas) for Telecommunications, Earth Observation, Science, and Navigation programs . 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
 The main tasks of the jobholder will be: 
 Manage all technical aspects related to the EMC area under the coordination of the System Architect, following up on platforms, payloads, and instruments from an EMC perspective . 
 Elaborate and maintain technical EMC requirement specifications and budgets, including Frequency analysis, EMC control plans, and CE/CS, RE/RS, RFC, and Magnetic budgets . 
 Review suppliers' hardware designs and PCB layouts, supporting EMC-related constraints and providing design, development, and testing solutions . 
 Define system verification and validation (V&V) strategies, preparing test specifications and maintaining verification control documentation . 
 Support the Procurement and Quality teams with technical follow-ups of subcontracted equipment, risk assessments, and anomaly investigations in NRBs . 
 Collaborate closely with AIT and other engineering disciplines (thermal, mechanical, harness) involved in system development throughout the product lifecycle . 
 SKILLS 
 Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to know you: 
 Education: Educated to degree level in Electrical and Electronics Engineering . 
 Experience: Proven experience (5 or more years) in Space projects, power electronics design, and EMC design, analysis, development, and testing . 
 Soft skills: Strong teamwork capabilities and close collaboration in multi-disciplinary, multi-cultural engineering environments . 
 Languages: Advanced level in both English and Spanish . 
 Technical knowledge: Requirements management, subcontractor technical management, and experience with ESA standards (ECSSs) . 
 Valuable / Nice to have: Experience with DOORS (requirements management), LT/PSPICE or MATLAB (electrical analysis), CST or ANSYS (RF analysis), ALTIUM (electrical design), or Python programming . 
 WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE? 
 At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits : 
 Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year . 
 Attractive salary . 
 Hybrid model of working when possible . 
 Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location . 
 Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants . 
 On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office . 
 Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives . 
 Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment 
 This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
 Company: 
Airbus Defence and Space SAU 
 Employment Type: 
Permanent -------
 Experience Level: 
Professional 
 Job Family: 
Elec.Electron.&Electromag,Optics&Optron. <JF-EN-ED> 
 By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.
 Airbus is, and always has been, committed to equal opportunities for all. As such, we will never ask for any type of monetary exchange in the frame of a recruitment process. Any impersonation of Airbus to do so should be reported to emsom@airbus.com .

Job Description: 
 Airbus Defence & Space recherche un Ingénieur de déploiement de segment sol Satcom (f/h) pour rejoindre notre département Ingénierie et Déploiement, basé à Toulouse, France . 
 Ce département délivre des services à valeur ajoutée basés sur des communications par satellite à des clients civils, gouvernementaux et militaires. 
 Au sein de notre équipe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la conception, l’implémentation et le maintien opérationnel de stations sol SATCOM pour des programmes civils et militaires de grande envergure. Vous assurerez la gestion du work-package tout en agissant en tant que référent technique sur vos projets. 
 Ce poste implique des déplacements professionnels (France métropolitaine, Outre-mer et Europe) pour assurer le suivi et l'installation sur site, à hauteur de 30 % minimum du temps de travail. 
 Votre environnement de travail : 
 Capitale mondiale de l'aéronautique et capitale européenne de la recherche dans le spatial, Toulouse est une ville dynamique du sud-ouest de la France desservie par un aéroport international. Idéalement située entre la mer Méditerranée et l'océan Atlantique et à proximité des Pyrénées, elle offre de nombreuses possibilités d'activités de plein air ! 
 Parce que nous prenons soin de vous : 
 Avantages financiers : Salaire attractif, accords d’intéressement et de participation, plan d'épargne salariale abondé par Airbus, plan d’actionnariat salarié sur la base du volontariat, avec attribution d'actions gratuites en fonction du nombre d'actions souscrites. 
 Équilibre vie privée / professionnelle : Des jours de congés supplémentaires pour occasions spéciales et des options de transfert de congés, un comité d'entreprise proposant de nombreuses activités socio-culturelles et sportives et d’autres services. 
 Bien-être / santé : couverture complémentaire des frais de santé et de prévoyance (incapacité, invalidité, décès). Selon le site : centre de services de santé, services de conciergerie, salle de sport, application de covoiturage. 
 Développement individuel : des opportunités d’évolution et des possibilités de formations nombreuses (catalogue de plus de 10.000 e-formations disponibles en libre accès pour développer votre employabilité, certifications, programmes de développement accéléré, parcours expert, mobilité nationale et internationale). 
 Chez Airbus, nous vous aidons à travailler, à vous connecter et à collaborer plus facilement et de manière plus flexible. Partout où cela est possible, nous favorisons la flexibilité dans nos modes de travail afin de stimuler l'esprit d'innovation. 
 Vos challenges : 
 Vous intervenez sur l'intégralité du cycle de vie des projets, de l'appel d'offres jusqu'à la mise en service :
 Phase d'offre : Vous supporterez techniquement l’équipe de réponse à appel d’offre.
 Vous produirez les spécifications techniques.
 Vous consulterez des fournisseurs : évaluation des offres, itérations avec les fournisseurs, participation à la sélection.
 Vous participerez à l’élaboration du design avant-vente.
 Vous écrirez des propositions techniques du dossier d’offre client.
 Vous contribuerez au chiffrage des coûts.
 Phase d’étude : Vous contribuez au design système (architecture et performance) de la station sol et à la stratégie de déploiement.
 Vous produisez la documentation d’ingénierie détaillée : dossiers de définition, justifications techniques, dossiers de fabrication, de raccordement et d’interfaces.
 Phase de développement, qualification et déploiement : Vous serez le responsable technique du projet.
 Vous pilotez les approvisionnements des stations sols ou sous-ensembles (suivi technique, revues de conception, revues qualification, reporting projet).
 Vous prendrez en charge le management technique de l’activité (gestion planning, exécution des activités techniques, budget, risques, reporting projet, dossiers techniques, interface technique client et garant de la qualité des livrables).
 Vous gérez les phases Intégration Validation Vérification et Qualification.
 Vous supervisez la logistique puis le déploiement sur site et la recette sur site, et assurez la formation des clients.
 Phase de Maintien en Condition Opérationnelle (MCO) : Vous gérez les projets de maintenance auprès des fournisseurs.
 Vous assurez le support technique auprès du client.
 Vous effectuerez la maintenance de niveau 3 sur site : investigations approfondies, diagnostic de pannes complexes et mise en œuvre de solutions correctives.
 Votre profil : 
 Formation spécialisée en télécommunications, mécanique ou en électronique. 
 Niveau d’expérience professionnelle minimum attendu pour ce poste au moins de 5 à 10 ans.
 Atout : Une connaissance des infrastructures support (génie civil, électrique) est un véritable plus.
 Expertise technique - p rofil télécom : Vous maîtrisez le dimensionnement des structures, un logiciel et conception mécanique, l’analyse statique et dynamique, l’étude de dissipation thermique et les méthodes de montage et …

items.desc:
Location: Hengelo, Netherlands 
 Thales designs highly advanced radar systems and optical sensors that form part of complete and integrated defense systems. Our product portfolio ranges from small, portable radars used for applications such as border or asset surveillance, to complex four-dimensional radar systems capable of detecting small objects hundreds or even thousands of kilometers away.
 Within the Software Engineering department, the Sensor Processing group is responsible for developing the software that provides optimal sensor control and advanced digital processing capabilities. We work in multidisciplinary teams alongside specialists in systems engineering, functional sensor design, and the design and implementation of real-time systems.
 About the Job: 
 Within the Sensor Processing group, we develop the complete radar software stack.
 This covers several domains, including:
 Controlling radar systems and their associated functions
 Managing and scheduling radar transmissions
 Real-time processing of high-volume digital data streams
 Developing algorithms for detecting and classifying objects such as aircraft and drones
 Tracking detected objects and presenting them to operators through dedicated consoles
 Our software architecture is highly modular, enabling the development of robust systems that can continuously evolve as requirements and technologies change.
 Development takes place in Agile teams, supported by a modern software development environment and toolchain. The teams themselves are responsible for the continued development and maintenance of the software architecture, development infrastructure, and Agile processes.
 About You: 
 Do you have a passion for technology and would you enjoy working on radar control systems, while also having an interest in accelerating algorithms and processing high-speed data streams?
 If so, you may be the person we are looking for. At Thales, we offer you the opportunity to build your career in an international, high-tech environment working with state-of-the-art technology.
 What we're looking for: 
 You have:
 A completed BSc or MSc degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Informatics, or Electrical Engineering
 Approximately 10 years of relevant professional experience 
 Extensive experience with Linux 
 Strong programming experience in C++ and MATLAB 
 Experience developing real-time software for complex systems 
 An interest in radar control, high-performance computing, and digital data processing
 Experience with RDMA, OpenCL, and/or CUDA is a strong advantage.
 Experience with software profiling and performance optimisation is also highly desirable.
 Because of the complexity of radar systems, you should be willing to develop your knowledge in both the Radar and Digital Signal Processing (DSP) domains.
 Your personal qualities: 
 You are:
 Creative, open-minded, and flexible
 A strong team player who enjoys working in multidisciplinary teams
 Results-oriented and proactive
 A clear and effective communicator
 Able to understand both technical details and the bigger picture
 Comfortable taking ownership and initiative
 A good command of both Dutch and English is required to perform this role effectively.
 What's in It for You? 
 At Thales, you will:
 Join a great team in a high-tech, innovative, and international environment, working on challenging projects based on state-of-the-art technology
 Have opportunities to grow within the organization, whether in a technical, management, commercial, or international direction
 Have plenty of room for personal development and taking your own initiative
 Work in a modern office environment with a strong focus on work-life balance and flexibility
 Receive 40 days of annual leave
 Benefit from a travel allowance
 Have the opportunity to personalise your employment benefits, including options such as: Buying or selling additional working hours
 Internet cost reimbursement
 Bicycle schemes
 Company fitness programmes
 Trade union membership fees
 Relocation expenses
 Interested? 
 Are you ready to work on advanced radar technology and contribute to the development of next-generation defence systems?
 Apply now and take the next step in your career at Thales.
 #LI-MH1

 une expérience confirmée dans le développement de cartes électroniques mixtes ou à dominante numérique (>5 ans), pas nécessairement dans l’industrie l’aéronautique ;

 anglais oral et écrit.

 Définir l’architecture électronique des cartes numériques, permettant le contrôle/commande et l'alimentation des composants hyperfréquence, ainsi que le lien avec le reste du système
 Assurer la conception détaillée des cartes et sous-ensembles électroniques numériques avec prise en compte des contraintes de DFX (Design for Manufacturing / Design For Test...)
 Documentation : 
 Rédiger ou participer à la rédaction des spécifications techniques des cartes électroniques en prenant en compte les spécifications amont de l'équipement
 Capitaliser les éléments clés des développements (choix de composants, analyses, documents de PDR, CDR, simulations) au travers d'un Dossier Justificatif de conception

 Piloter les acteurs intervenant lors du routage de la carte
 Participer aux revues de pairs sur les produits et le métier (revues de schéma, spécification FW, etc…) et échanger avec les équipes (hyperfréquence, développement FW, mécanique, etc.)
 Assurer un support technique aux différents métiers autour de la conception et de la production de l'équipement (IVV, industrialisation, etc.)

 Expérience significative (minimum 5 ans) dans la conception de solutions numériques pour des applications exigeantes, intégrant des composants critiques (SOC, FPGA, ASIC, DDR, microcontrôleur, liens série rapides, interfaces haut débit, etc.) ;
 Electronique analogique (régulateurs linéaires/à découpage, amplificateurs opérationnelles, transistors, diodes) ;

items.desc:
As an SAP Consultant in Design to Manufacture (D2M) , you will act as a core functional and technical expert, bridging the gap between business processes and modern enterprise solutions. In this role, you will design, optimize, and deliver end-to-end solutions that span the entire product lifecycle - from initial product design and engineering, through production planning and manufacturing execution, to quality management and supply chain integration.
 We are looking for an experienced consultant professional with a solid background in classic SAP areas who is eager to shape the future of manufacturing.
 No advanced technical cloud experience yet? No problem! 
 We value your deep functional and process-oriented expertise. If you have the drive to learn, we provide comprehensive internal training to help you master SAP BTP, SAP Business AI, and emerging technologies like Agentic AI. Our goal is to support your professional growth as we work together within the RISE with SAP framework and modern Clean Core extensibility strategies. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Functional & Technical Consulting: Analyze business requirements across the Design to Manufacture (D2M) lifecycle. Translate business needs into standard SAP solutions and identify areas where modern technologies can bring added value.
 Process Blueprinting & Customizing: Lead discovery workshops, prepare business blueprints, and perform system configuration (customizing) in your core SAP module(s).
 End-to-End Implementation: Design and execute system integration tests, coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT), support data migration activities, and provide hypercare and post-go-live support.
 Collaboration & Alignment: Work closely with international business stakeholders, key users, and cloud developers to align process designs with standard-aligned architectures.
 Continuous Innovation: Actively participate in proof-of-concept (PoC) initiatives. Gradually learn and support the design of AI/GenAI use cases, side-by-side extensions, and intelligent workflows to automate manufacturing and quality processes.
Qualifications & Experience 
 Requirements (Must Have) 
 Strong functional or techno-functional experience (3+ years) in SAP implementations, with a solid focus on at least one of the following core areas within the Design to Manufacture (D2M) lifecycle: 
 Product Design & Engineering (e.g., SAP PLM, Portfolio & Project Management).
 Manufacturing Planning & Execution (e.g., SAP PP, PP-DS, Digital Manufacturing / DM).
 Quality & Logistics (e.g., SAP QM, EWM, or Asset Management).
 ​​​​​​​ Process Knowledge: Deep understanding of real-world manufacturing, product design, or supply chain business processes.
 AI Readiness & Curiosity: Basic understanding or practical curiosity regarding AI concepts (e.g., experience using or playing with Large Language Models, Generative AI, or prompt engineering) and a strong willingness to learn how to apply them to enterprise business scenarios.
 Language Skills: Fluent English (written and spoken) is required.
 Mindset: Strong analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills; comfort working in international, agile project environments.
 Preferred Skills (Nice to Have / Opportunity to Learn) 
 Practical experience with or technical knowledge of SAP BTP
 Hands-on exposure to SAP Business AI, SAP Generative AI Hub, or Agentic AI concepts.
 Familiarity with the RISE with SAP model and cloud-ready Clean Core extensibility strategies.
 German language skills (highly welcome and considered a strong asset).

items.desc:
Shine is the financial copilot for entrepreneurs and small business owners. 
 Founded by serial entrepreneurs Rico Andersen and Martin Hegelund, Shine is a leading European fintech unicorn on a mission to restore the joy of running a business, by ending wasted time on financial admin. Shine offers a connected solution for invoicing, accounting, payroll, business accounts, payments, and financing, meaning business owners can focus their energy on growing a healthy business, not held back by manual admin. 
 Part of something bigger 
 Today we're part of Cegid, a European leader in cloud software for finance and accounting. Together we're building Europe's leading financial copilot for small businesses and their accountants. Shine already supports more than 400,000 small businesses. As part of Cegid, we now reach over one million small businesses and 15,000 accountants across Europe. We're a multicultural team working from France, Germany, Denmark and the Netherlands, contributing to a wider European network that spans Spain, Portugal. 
 Your hiring experience matters 
 Just as we respect our customers' time, we respect yours. Your experience with Shine and Cegid should feel simple, transparent and genuinely supportive. If this sounds like somewhere you want to grow, we'd love to hear from you.
 DEPARTMENT at Shine
 We make Shine a place where people thrive. From talent acquisition and people partnering to workplace and wellbeing, our mission is to create an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel a sense of belonging – in Paris, Berlin, Copenhagen, Amsterdam and beyond.
 Your Role as a POSITION
 This is a high-impact position within the People function, reporting directly to the Chief People Officer. You will be the single owner of compensation and benefits at Shine, shaping and delivering the rewards approach that helps us attract, retain and motivate the talent we need to scale: pay philosophy and structures, salary benchmarking, annual review cycles, equity and incentives, benefits and pay transparency. You work closely with the Chief People Officer, Finance, business leaders and People Business Partners to make sure our rewards are competitive, fair and easy to explain, across every country we operate in. You bring a hands-on, build-it-yourself mindset and know when to bring in partners, platforms and expertise to extend your reach.
 Defining and evolving Shine’s compensation philosophy, job architecture and salary bands, so that pay decisions are consistent, fair and grounded in market data
 Owning market benchmarking across our locations (France, Germany, Denmark, Poland, Netherlands, Spain and Portugal), selecting and managing salary survey providers and keeping our pay positioning current in a fast-moving fintech market
 Designing and running the annual compensation review and bonus cycles end to end: budget modeling with Finance, guidelines and tooling for managers, calibration, communication and post-cycle analysis
 Advising on offers, promotions and internal moves, partnering with Talent Acquisition and People Business Partners to protect both competitiveness and internal equity
 Leading pay equity analysis and preparing Shine for pay transparency requirements, including the EU Pay Transparency Directive, in partnership with Legal and local counsel
 Building clear, simple reward communication for employees and managers, such as total rewards statements, manager toolkits and FAQs, so people understand and trust how they are paid
 Using people data to inform decisions: reporting on pay competitiveness, compa-ratios, attrition and cost of compensation, and giving the Chief People Officer and leadership team clear insight and recommendations
 Working with Payroll, HRIS and Finance partners to keep processes accurate, auditable and as automated as possible´
 Using AI to make rewards work faster and smarter, for example for benchmarking analysis, pay equity modeling, manager guidance and employee Q&A, while keeping human judgment, data privacy and fairness at the center of every pay decision
 About you
 You have min. 6 years of experience in compensation and benefits, ideally in a scale-up, tech or fintech environment, and you are comfortable owning the full rewards agenda without a team
 You have designed and run salary bands, job levels and compensation cycles, and you can explain the reasoning behind them to a CEO as easily as to a first-time manager
 You are confident with data: comfortable building models Google Sheets, working with benchmarking tools and turning numbers into clear recommendations
 You understand European pay equity and transparency regulation, or you have the curiosity and rigor to get up to speed quickly
 You are a trusted, discreet partner who can handle sensitive information and build credibility with leaders, People colleagues and employees alike
 You keep things simple, fair and measurable, and you choose pragmatic solutions that fit a growing company over …

items.desc: Job Description You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. Key Responsibilities Architect and govern production-grade agentic systems at enterprise scale: multi-agent orchestration across complex environments, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, memory management, and programme-level lifecycle observability Define RAG pipeline standards across engagements: establish chunking and embedding strategies, set quality benchmarks, and ensure metric-backed tradeoff decisions are documented and transferable Set multi-LLM integration standards: vendor-agnostic architecture by default, fallback routing and cost governance as standard design practice across providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models Own LLMOps at programme scale: eval strategy, prompt governance, observability tooling standards, safety monitoring and cost controls across multiple concurrent systems Lead client engineering engagements at senior level — facilitate architecture design sessions, lead proof-of-concept delivery, and drive alignment between client technology leadership and delivery teams Shape and publish reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering standards that scale across the practice and reduce ramp-up time on new client engagements Own the measurement framework for agentic system quality: define accuracy, latency, safety, and cost metrics; Grâce à son expertise dans le digital, sa capacité à anticiper et à s'adapter au fil des évolutions de l'écosystème musical, la Sacem est la référence mondiale des droits d'auteur et l'interlocuteur privilégié de toutes les plateformes numériques. Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la gestion des produits et plateformes d'infrastructure en assurant leur disponibilité, leur performance, leur évolutivité, leur gestion de l'obsolescence, leur capacité et la maitrise des coûts OnPremise, Cloud ou hybride. Partner closely with silicon, system, and external vendor teams while developing simulation methodologies to boost modeling accuracy and efficiency. We're looking for you if you have Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in SI/PI design for chip/package or system PCB. Experience in industry SIPI modeling tool chains (e.g., HFSS, ADS, Sigrity, Siwave, etc.). Experience with lab bring-up, test environments, and characterization for high-speed memory and SerDes. Experience with partnering across chip architecture, physical design, static timing analysis (STA), package, and validation teams. Experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ to establish automated flows and data processing tools. Bonus points Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. Deep knowledge of SI/PI analysis for high-speed interconnects (HBMx, D2D/chiplets, PCIe, SerDes) and timing budget methodologies. Direct experience with silicon interposers, silicon bridges, and 3D die stacking architectures. items.desc: At SPD Technology, we bring together a team of like-minded people who are driven by the desire to bring value through their work, united in their commitment to high performance and delivering custom, cutting-edge tech solutions that drive clients’ growth. We empower our people with a culture of excellence and enable them with the opportunity to uphold their accountability to contribute on each level. We value humanity and collaboration, encourage professional and personal growth, and foster a supportive and flexible work environment where everyone’s contribution is welcomed. And now we are looking for a Package Design Engineer to join us as part of our team. About Role Be part of a team pushing the boundaries of semiconductor innovation by developing custom silicon solutions that power next-generation consumer and infrastructure products. You will contribute to technologies used at massive global scale, helping shape future hardware platforms with a strong focus on performance, efficiency, reliability, and system-level integration. As a Chip Package Designer within the Silicon Integration team, you will develop package substrate designs for advanced 2.5D/3.5D packaging technologies used in high-performance ML and AI chips. You will collaborate closely with Signal Integrity/Power Integrity (SI/PI), Thermal/Mechanical, Assembly, and PCB engineering teams to develop complex, high-performance substrate designs. The primary objective will be to optimize package substrate architecture for electrical performance, reliability, manufacturability, and assembly. You will manage all major phases of the package design process, including routing feasibility studies, test vehicle development, product-level designs, design reviews, artwork export, DFM activities, and preparation of final manufacturing documentation. You will also contribute to the evaluation and adoption of advanced chip packaging technologies within the broader silicon product development pipeline. Your work will directly support successful deployment of advanced computing systems in large-scale data center environments, helping optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area) while improving overall system performance, power efficiency, and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership). The broader AI and Infrastructure organization is focused on building next-generation computing platforms and infrastructure at exceptional scale, efficiency, reliability, and speed. These technologies support internal engineering teams, enterprise customers, and large-scale consumer-facing services worldwide. The organization works across both hardware and software, including custom AI accelerators, advanced silicon platforms, AI infrastructure, large-scale networking, data center technologies, distributed computing systems, and systems research. Work Environment Fully remote role. Flexible schedule with participation in team ceremonies and cross-functional collaboration. As a qualified expert, You will: Develop physical package substrate design of large form-factor package for ML high-performance computers (HPCs). Develop and implement the methodology and CAD flow for efficient substrate design and enhanced productivity. Manage and drive co-design initiatives across chip, package, and system levels, including securing production sign-off for package designs. Collaborate closely with signal integrity/power integrity (SI/PI), thermal, and mechanical engineering teams to refine and optimize product package designs, test vehicles, and mock-up designs for product feasibility. Define and document the requirements for the package substrate design and bill of materials (BOM). We’re looking for you if you have Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Material Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Technology, Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in chip package substrate design using Cadence APD or Mentor Expedition. Experience in chip package substrate layout, design verification, DFM and taping out for production. Experience in design automation and scripting. English — Upper Intermediate or higher. Bonus points Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience in working with cross-functional teams including chip design, SI/PI, and PCB design teams. Experience in 2.5D/3.5D advanced package design. Experience in physical verification flow (LVS, DRC, connectivity). Experience with CAD for creating simple mechanical drawings, such as package outline drawings (POD). Ability to write scripts to customize elements of the Cadence or Mentor workflow. items.desc: If you’ve been looking to join a fast-growing startup with a bold vision of a world where doing good is built into everything we do , then you’ve found the right place. Backed by General Catalyst, the same investors behind Stripe and Airbnb, we’re building something truly extraordinary. Our Mission Our mission at Goodstack is to revolutionize how the world does good . As a fast growth, AI-native social impact startup, we power global change through technology. We enable companies to seamlessly integrate positive impact into what they do through a unified platform while supporting nonprofits in gaining access to cutting-edge technology and finding new funding streams. Global brands, including Google, OpenAI, TikTok, LinkedIn, HSBC, Atlassian and Twilio - as well as thousands of nonprofits, including the Red Cross, Cancer Research, and Oxfam - use Goodstack to make a difference. In 2025 alone, we facilitated $5 billion in donations to good causes. But this is just the beginning. We're building the world’s leading platform that powers donations to nonprofits globally. To keep our momentum and deliver consistently high value to our partners, we need incredible people to help us on our journey – we need you Join us as Grant Writer to act as our lead Expert Reviewer! We’re looking for an exceptionally thoughtful, detail-driven Grant Delivery Specialist to lead high-quality grant research, writing and review for our nonprofit partners. You’ll help nonprofits access more funding, faster – identifying relevant opportunities, shaping strong applications and making sure every draft is accurate, compelling and genuinely useful. If you have a strong grant writing background, enjoy turning complex programme information into clear funding narratives, and want your work to support organisations doing meaningful social impact work, this could be the perfect role for you. As a Grant Writer, your mission will be to: Support nonprofit partners: Lead onboarding, proactive check-ins and clear communication across calls, email and key touchpoints. Research funding opportunities: Identify, evaluate and curate relevant grants tailored to each organisation’s mission, programmes, eligibility and funding needs. Draft excellent applications: Write compelling LOIs, grant applications and supporting narratives aligned to funder requirements. Use AI to increase quality and pace: Confidently prompt, guide and review AI-assisted outputs to accelerate research, drafting and iteration without compromising accuracy, judgement or tone. Act as lead expert reviewer: Review drafts so they are accurate, persuasive, funder-ready and easy for nonprofits to use. Manage delivery: Balance pace, quality and care across multiple partner relationships, keeping work moving and expectations clear. Build deep context: Work closely with around 10–15 nonprofit partners at any given time, understanding their goals, programmes and impact. Improve how we work: Help strengthen our grant support process so we can serve more nonprofits well, without compromising quality. After 3 months, success will look like: Producing high-quality grant drafts at a consistent pace. Nonprofit partners feel supported, understood, and confident in the work they receive. Funding opportunities are well-matched, relevant, and clearly explained. AI is used thoughtfully to improve speed, consistency, and quality. Drafts are accurate, thoughtful, and tailored to each funder. Risks, blockers, or deadline concerns are raised early. Our grant support process becomes clearer, stronger, and easier to scale. This role is a perfect match for you if you have: A STEM degree from a recognised university, or equivalent evidence of strong analytical thinking. 5 years’ grant writing experience, ideally for nonprofits, charities or mission-led organisations. Understanding of funding landscapes, eligibility criteria, funder priorities and what makes a proposal competitive. Ability to turn rough context into specific, persuasive, funder-ready narratives. Confidence using AI tools to support research, drafting, editing and quality assurance, and know where human judgement must lead. Ability to take responsibility, communicate early, and enjoy building in a fast-moving environment. Attention to detail; Deadlines, geographic nuances, funding restrictions and structural requirements do not slip past you. Partner-first communication; You combine warmth, clarity, and sound judgement in every interaction. Process discipline; Enjoy clear systems, well-managed workflows, and making the slightly messy feel beautifully organised. Bonus if you have knowledge or love of: Nonprofit fundraising, philanthropy or corporate social impact. You're on the front lines, understanding customer needs and collaborating with various teams to deliver solutions. In this role, you will directly contribute to the success of our installation team in EMEA (Europe Middle East Asia). What you’ll do Provide quality on-site repair, maintenance service, and complete installation/relocation start-up services of Lam’s complex electro-mechanical and electronic systems at customer sites. Perform analytical problem-solving, troubleshooting, conduct diagnostics, and isolate issues to the component level, and take corrective actions to minimize downtime, system interruptions, and equipment malfunctions. Keep up to date on semiconductor capital equipment and Lam products through learning, training, and certification. Assist in complex field modifications and updates, maintaining records and reports to coordinate activities between Lam and the customer. Serve as a subject matter expert, representing Lam to our valued customers, delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. Troubleshoot and create customer response action plans to support customer needs. Transparently discuss opportunities and challenges with customer to increase trust. Provide technical instruction and mentoring for more junior engineers. Who we’re looking for Minimum Qualifications: Technical Degree/Diploma/Bachelor’s degree in Microelectronics, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Electrical Engineering or related field and 5+ years of experience; or Master’s degree with 3+ years; or equivalent work experience. items.desc: Chi siamo? AUTEC Service s.r.l., società del Gruppo ENGIE, con oltre 20 anni di esperienza, offre alle aziende che hanno esigenze di impiantistica evolute soluzioni nell’ingegneria, nelle manutenzioni ed installazioni. Chi cerchiamo? Siamo alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire con il ruolo di Manutentore Elettrico all'interno del team Industrial & Facility Energy Services presso la sede del nostro cliente a Collegno (Torino) . AUTEC, società del Gruppo ENGIE, è specializzata nella progettazione, realizzazione e manutenzione di impianti tecnologici e soluzioni energetiche per clienti pubblici e privati. L’azienda opera con un forte orientamento all’innovazione, all’efficienza energetica e alla sostenibilità, contribuendo alla transizione energetica attraverso servizi ad alto valore aggiunto. Che cosa farai? Nel Ruolo di Manutentore Elettrico riporterai al Contract Manager e, in coordinamento con il team AUTEC - Industrial & Facility Energy Services, ti occuperai delle attività di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria relative all’impiantistica civile e industriale dei presidi del Cliente a te assegnato. Quali saranno le tue responsabilità? Attività di manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria su impianti elettrici di bassa e media tensione Conduzione e manutenzione impianti elettrici Manutenzione ordinaria e straordinaria, impianti elettrici a servizio degli impianti tecnologici al servizio dell’edificio e delle persone, gruppi frigoriferi e gruppi di continuità (UPS) Verifica, regolazione e conduzione impianto di condizionamento su BMS (Building Management System); Realizzazione di lavori straordinari su impianti elettrici; Gestione sistemi di supervisione e sistemi informatici di manutenzione; Assistenza ai tecnici delle ditte subappaltatrici. Perché tu? Hai un diploma tecnico ad indirizzo elettrico, elettrotecnico, elettronico o titolo equivalente; Esperienza nel ruolo di almeno 5 anni nel settore elettrico; Hai una buona conoscenza degli schemi elettrici, simbologia e linguaggio tecnico; Hai una buona conoscenza e ottime capacità di utilizzo del BMS e dei principi regolazione impianti condizionamento / HVAC; Hai delle buone conoscenza informatiche di base (pacchetto office); Disponi della certificazione PAV/PES; Sei disponibile al lavoro su turni (mattina 7.30 - 15.30 e pomeriggio 15.30 - 21.30) e reperibilità; Hai ottime capacità relazionali e di team working; Hai un buon livello di autonomia. In AUTEC – Società del Gruppo ENGIE, ogni talento ha un ruolo fondamentale nell’accelerare la transizione energetica. Contribuisci a fare la differenza e vivi un’esperienza professionale ricca di soddisfazioni. Affronta sfide stimolanti e costruisci un percorso di carriera che rispecchi davvero chi sei. Unisciti a noi e partecipa all’avventura del secolo! La retribuzione annua lorda (RAL) prevista per il ruolo è compresa tra € 28.000,00 e € 36.000,00, in base all’esperienza ed al livello di seniority. Perché scegliere AUTEC – Società del Gruppo ENGIE? Lavorare in ENGIE, gruppo multinazionale, significa avere un'ampia varietà di possibilità di carriera in oltre 30 paesi. Ma significa anche mettere la comunità al centro della tua vita professionale e contribuire a un vero cambiamento nel corso di una carriera stimolante. Il nostro impegno è chiaro: sosteniamo un modello sociale che concilia la performance economica con l'impatto positivo sulle persone e sul pianeta. Scommettiamo sul potere della collettività e agiamo come parte di una comunità impegnata a sconvolgere e reinventare il futuro. Diversità e inclusione sono al centro della nostra cultura aziendale. ENGIE si impegna a combattere tutte le forme di discriminazione in materia di occupazione, accesso alla formazione e promozione. Pertanto, l'integrazione e il sostegno di giovani, adulti, persone con disabilità, senza alcuna distinzione di genere, etnia o religione, sono priorità fondamentali della politica delle risorse umane. Le Certificazioni EDGE e UNI PDR 125/22 conquistate, dimostrano tale impegno. About the role As a Signal Integrity/Power Integrity Engineer you will work to shape the future of AI/ML hardware acceleration by driving cutting-edge TPU (Tensor Processing Unit) technology that powers the most demanding AI/ML applications. You will be part of a team developing custom silicon solutions, leveraging your design and verification expertise to verify complex digital designs, with a specific focus on TPU architecture and its integration within AI/ML-driven systems. You will lead chip and package design, ensuring optimal SI/PI performance and system co-design from concept to production, while collaborating within a cross-functional team of Chip Design, IP, System Design, software, and vendors. As a qualified expert You will Lead signal integrity (SI) and power integrity (PI) analysis and optimization for High-Performance Computing (HPC) leveraging advanced 2.5D/3D packaging technologies. Partner early in product definition to influence chip floorplanning, power distribution networks (PDN/power trees), netlists, and routability tradeoffs. Evaluate high-speed interface IPs and develop next-generation memory interfaces across IO PHY, SI/PI, and physical design boundaries. Drive post-silicon validation and qualification for NPI, balancing SI/PI performance and DFM constraints to achieve final package design closure. Partner closely with silicon, system, and external vendor teams while developing simulation methodologies to boost modeling accuracy and efficiency. We're looking for you if you have Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 8 years of experience in SI/PI design for chip/package or system PCB. Experience in industry SIPI modeling tool chains (e.g., HFSS, ADS, Sigrity, Siwave, etc.). Experience with lab bring-up, test environments, and characterization for high-speed memory and SerDes. Experience with partnering across chip architecture, physical design, static timing analysis (STA), package, and validation teams. Experience in Python, MATLAB, or C++ to establish automated flows and data processing tools. Bonus points Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or Computer Science, with an emphasis on computer architecture. Deep knowledge of SI/PI analysis for high-speed interconnects (HBMx, D2D/chiplets, PCIe, SerDes) and timing budget methodologies. Direct experience with silicon interposers, silicon bridges, and 3D die stacking architectures. What's in it for You Reveal great tech solutions Join the team of experts who create custom, cutting-edge tech solutions for world-renowned businesses, fueling clients growth. Focus on long-term impact and building tailored, long-lasting partnerships with our clients. About Role Be part of a team pushing the boundaries of semiconductor innovation by developing custom silicon solutions that power next-generation consumer and infrastructure products. You will contribute to technologies used at massive global scale, helping shape future hardware platforms with a strong focus on performance, efficiency, reliability, and system-level integration. As a Chip Package Designer within the Silicon Integration team, you will develop package substrate designs for advanced 2.5D/3.5D packaging technologies used in high-performance ML and AI chips. You will collaborate closely with Signal Integrity/Power Integrity (SI/PI), Thermal/Mechanical, Assembly, and PCB engineering teams to develop complex, high-performance substrate designs. The primary objective will be to optimize package substrate architecture for electrical performance, reliability, manufacturability, and assembly. You will manage all major phases of the package design process, including routing feasibility studies, test vehicle development, product-level designs, design reviews, artwork export, DFM activities, and preparation of final manufacturing documentation. You will also contribute to the evaluation and adoption of advanced chip packaging technologies within the broader silicon product development pipeline. Your work will directly support successful deployment of advanced computing systems in large-scale data center environments, helping optimize PPA (Power, Performance, Area) while improving overall system performance, power efficiency, and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership). items.card: The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level.
items.desc: The Barcelona Institute for Global Health (ISGlobal) is a cutting-edge institute addressing global public health challenges through research, translation into policy and education. ISGlobal has a broad portfolio in communicable and non-communicable diseases including environmental and climate determinants, and applies a multidisciplinary scientific approach ranging from the molecular to the population level. Research is organized in five programs: Climate, Air Pollution, Nature and Urban Health; Environment and Health over the Lifecourse; Global Viral and Bacterial Infections; Malaria and Neglected Parasitic Diseases and Maternal Child and Reproductive Health. ISGlobal is accredited with the Severo Ochoa distinction, a seal of excellence of the Spanish Science Ministry. ICREA, the Catalan Institution for Research and Advanced Studies, offers permanent positions in the Catalan research system for senior researchers. In 2027, the call is expected to open on the second half of January 2027 for the areas of Experimental Sciences & Mathematics and Engineering Sciences. WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR We are particularly interested in outstanding senior research leaders using and/or developing cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) methods to improve global health, who are interested in applying for an ICREA position at ISGlobal in the coming call (Experimental Sciences & Mathematics and Engineering Science). Specifically, we are looking for senior research leaders in an expansive phase of their career with an outstanding research record and leadership in using and/or developing AI methods to improve global health, highly motivated and committed to join ISGlobal and to its mission, “Improve global health and promote health equity, through excellence in research, translation and application of knowledge”. We strongly encourage applications from outstanding female researchers, recognizing that gender diversity is crucial for achieving global health excellence. REQUIREMENTS PhD degree obtained before 2023 Relevant international exposure at pre-doctoral and/or post-doctoral level Not holding a permanent position in the Catalan research system before 1st March 2025 HOW TO APPLY Interested candidates to apply for an ICREA Senior Researcher position at ISGlobal should send to research.management@isglobal.org by 15th December 2026 the following documents: Self Assessment Report (Download template), including a one-page summary of your research activities and achievements over the past 5 years, and a one-page summary of your research plans for the next 5 years Motivation letter stating the reasons for choosing ISGlobal as the host institution A delegated committee from ISGlobal’s Scientific Committee will review all applications considering ICREA evaluation criteria (check the ICREA call evaluation guidelines), fit within ISGlobal research programs and commitment to join ISGlobal if awarded. The committee will decide which candidates ISGlobal will support and provide feedback to candidates by mid/end January. In ISGlobal we are committed to maintaining and developing a work environment in which the values and principles of our organization are respected and equal opportunities between women and men be promoted in each of the areas in which we operate, not tolerating discrimination based on criteria such as age, gender, marital status, race, ethnicity, functional diversity, political leanings, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression. We confirm our commitment towards the value of the diversity of our staff and student population and seek to promote peace, equity, diversity and inclusion as essential elements in contribution to improving health worldwide.

items.desc: About us Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most. The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger. Watch our film About the role As Quantitative Power Trader, you’ll own the intraday trading strategies at the heart of Ingrid’s BESS and renewable portfolio — building the arbitrage and proprietary strategies that turn market volatility into revenue. You’ll design, build, and refine the models and algorithms behind them, working hand-in-hand with our engineering team to get them into production, and staying close to the market through day-time trading shifts that keep you grounded in how your strategies actually perform. Intraday is the focus, but never in isolation: you’ll bring a broader view of how we optimize BESS revenue across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, so your strategies are tuned to the portfolio’s full revenue stack — not just one piece of it. Execute trades with discipline and strong market feel while adhering to risk limits and governance frameworks. Build and maintain quantitative models for price forecasting, degradation-adjusted cycling economics, and cross-market arbitrage (ancillary vs. wholesale vs. tolling). Monitor the performance of Ingrid’s automated trading platform, pinpointing where live results deviate from the theoretical optimum and diagnosing why. Collaborate closely with the engineering team to translate strategy logic into production code — this is not a hand-off-and-wait role. Conduct scenario and stress-testing ahead of new market entries (new geographies or products). Report on trading performance and risk exposure to leadership, including drawdown explanations and capacity utilisation metrics. Take part in day-time trading shifts, with occasional weekend coverage to monitor live strategy performance. Your work experience: 2–5 years of experience in a Data Scientist, Quantitative, or similar role within the energy sector, with direct exposure to European intraday power markets, either through trading or strategy development, is required; BESS experience is highly preferred. Strong grasp of forecasting, optimization, and pricing across ancillary, day-ahead, and intraday markets, with the intraday market as your core focus. Familiarity with market design and regulatory frameworks, plus a sharp feel for power fundamentals, volatility, and market dynamics. Strong programming capability (Python required; SQL and experience with data pipelines or model deployment a plus). Comfortable working with large, complex datasets, with the analytical rigor to match. Advanced degree (MSc or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or similar. Business acumen and commercial drive — understanding the commercial perspective behind every strategy. Analytical and strategic thinking — precision in forecasting paired with big-picture judgment. Communication and collaboration — clear with stakeholders, generous with knowledge across teams and disciplines. Adaptability and agility — thriving in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. Why join us? In this role, you will develop global observational data sets and use them to monitor and report on the Earths climate across land, ocean and ice, with a focus on temperature change at the Earths surface. You will use your data analysis skills to combine current and historical instrumental data to quantify observed changes, assess uncertainty in those changes, and put current observed climate into historical context. You will develop data sets that have a wide range of applications in climate science and that are relevant to informing international climate policy and agreements. Satellite Climate Observations Scientist: This position sits within the Observing Climate: Land and Atmosphere team. The role is primarily focused on using satellite data for UK and global climate monitoring. This includes development of novel satellite-based climate indicators to characterise and track impactful climatic events, such as extreme heat, drought, vegetation stress and wildfires, and combining satellite and station data to produce new blended datasets for key variables. This role provides the opportunity to contribute new satellite-based metrics to our Met Office Climate Dashboard, which is used internationally as a trusted source of global climate monitoring information. UK Climate Scientist: This position sits within The National Climate Information Centre (NCIC) team. We are looking for a scientist with strong data management and communication skills to work closely with the existing team developing the flagship climate data sets HadUK-Grid and HadCET and supplying UK climate information to a variety of users. We communicate our analysis through regular reports and media output, most notably the high-profile annual State of the UK Climate report. Through your work and through collaboration with experts both within and outside of the Met Office, you will utilise observational data to quantify climate change and variability by applying your analytical and scientific software skills. This role will include opportunities to apply cutting edge research such as ML approaches and new data gridding/mapping methods. We welcome applications for all three roles from candidates with a …

items.desc: Objective of the role The information Raidiam needs to make good decisions already exists — in the sales pipeline, delivery plans, engineering estimates, finance forecasts and people plans. As PMO Analyst you will build and run the integrated portfolio and forward-capacity view, so leadership can make trade-offs deliberately rather than discovering conflicts after commitments are made. What you will own Integrated demand, capacity and commitments view — combine Sales, Delivery, Engineering and Product, Finance, HR/People, Service and Compliance inputs into one view; own the portfolio dashboard in the PMO Jira project. Forward capacity — maintain the consolidated resource allocation and capacity view (including Forecast), monitor utilisation and timesheet data quality/completeness; highlight scarce-skill exposure, model the impact of new demand and track named-deputy actions. Portfolio financials — track budget against actuals and support Finance with WIP, billing milestone and revenue forecast data. Governance and standards — maintain stage gates, onboarding and closure checklists, templates and reporting conventions; assure standards are followed; keep change and decision logs. Management rhythm — own the reporting calendar; prepare RAG, RAID and bottleneck material for the fortnightly Delivery Forum and monthly review, and exception packs for Board decisions. Audit, knowledge and tooling — keep records audit-ready for ISO 27001; maintain lessons learned and templates in Confluence; support PMs in Jira and Forecast and improve data flows between systems. What you will bring Essential Experience in a PMO, portfolio, resource planning or business analysis role in technology or professional services. Strong analytical and data skills — able to reconcile incomplete or inconsistent information from multiple systems, identify exceptions and trends, and turn it into a clear, confident picture. Advanced Excel or Google Sheets and strong Jira skills (dashboards, filters, JQL); experience with Forecast or similar. Experience maintaining governance standards, RAID logs and reporting cycles. Clear writer who presents trade-offs simply, with the persistence to keep data current. Strong communication skills, at all levels, both verbal and written Complete any other tasks and/or duties you may be instructed to carry out from time to time Comply with Raidiam’s Corporate Policies and Procedures Comply with Raidiam’s Information Security Policies and Procedures Desirable Confluence and BI tools (e.g. Power BI, Looker); project financials (margin, WIP, forecasting); ISO 27001 or audit exposure; regulated or SaaS environment; P3O, APM PFQ or PRINCE2 Foundation.. items.desc: De meeste organisaties hebben iets met AI gedaan: een pilot, een demo, een rapport. En op maandag werkt iedereen weer zoals altijd. Daar nemen wij geen genoegen mee. Bij Gaide bouwen we mensgerichte AI: systemen van samenwerkende AI-agents die complexe processen van begin tot eind uitvoeren, ontworpen rond de mensen die ermee werken. Het gaat ons niet om de techniek, maar om wat het de klant oplevert: financieel, in kwaliteit of in veiligheid. We bouwen op locatie bij de klant en brengen de oplossing live. Daarna blijven we partner, van de eerste toepassing naar de volgende. De rol Een agent in productie krijgen bij een klant met verouderde systemen, rommelige data en een IT-afdeling die niet om advies heeft gevraagd: dat is het werk. Als Lead Forward Deployed AI Engineer ben je eigenaar van de technische kant daarvan, en je zet de standaard voor de engineers om je heen. Je leidt op inhoud. Je bent geen projectmanager en hebt geen medewerkers onder je. Ongeveer de helft van je tijd bouw je zelf: code schrijven, code reviewen en prototypes maken. De andere helft gaat naar architectuur, het afbakenen van opdrachten met klanten en het vooruithelpen van het team. Het verschil met onze Forward Deployed Engineers zit in de beslissingen. Jij kiest de architectuur, jij bepaalt wanneer iets klaar is voor productie en jij zorgt dat het na de overdracht onderhoudbaar en betaalbaar blijft. Je praat even makkelijk met een CTO als met een engineer. Met het IT-team van de klant los je een probleem op, aan de directie leg je uit wat die keuze betekent voor kosten, risico’s en de volgende stap. Tijd om je werk in productie te zien Misschien ken je het: je bouwt een veelbelovend prototype, presenteert het en het komt nooit verder dan de pilot. Bij Gaide breng je het zelf tot het eind. Je ziet agents live gaan en mensen er anders door werken. En als Lead bepaal je mee hoe we bouwen, zodat elk project sneller gaat dan het vorige. Wat wij bieden Salaris op basis van je ervaring Een pensioenregeling Vanaf dag één je eigen klanten, in verschillende sectoren Invloed op hoe Gaide bouwt: de standaarden, bouwstenen en draaiboeken die jij neerzet, gebruikt het hele team Het grootste deel van de week werk je samen op kantoor of bij klanten. Eén dag per week werk je waar je wilt. 25 vakantiedagen, volledige ov-vergoeding en dagelijks lunch aan de Keizersgracht Teamuitjes en activiteiten Budget voor opleidingen en congressen Wat je gaat doen Je werkt op locatie bij klanten en maakt van een vaag procesprobleem een agent, koppeling of tool die in productie draait. Je bent eigenaar van de architectuur: de keuze tussen agent, workflow of gewone code, de opbouw van context en retrieval, toolgebruik, terugvallogica en de aansluiting op bestaande systemen. Je bepaalt hoe we evalueren. Je geeft het laatste technische akkoord voor productie. Daarbij beoordeel je naast technisch, AI System Card en de toets aan de AI-verordening. Je zet de engineeringstandaarden neer en coacht engineers erop: code-reviews, CI/CD, beveiliging, monitoring en documentatie. Je schuift aan bij directie en IT van de klant en vertaalt technische keuzes naar kosten, risico’s en de volgende stap. Je helpt sales met het afbakenen van opdrachten, inschattingen van het werk en demo’s. Je legt lessen uit de praktijk vast in herbruikbare bouwstenen en draaiboeken, zodat het volgende project sneller gaat. Wie we zoeken Je werkt prettig zonder volledige specificaties en je vindt het leuk om de lat voor anderen hoger te leggen. ` Wat we vragen Je hebt minimaal vijf jaar ervaring als software-, data-, ML- of AI-engineer. Daarin had je de technische leiding over projecten of een klein team. Je hebt meerdere LLM-toepassingen (agents, RAG of workflows) in productie gebracht, en voor minstens één daarvan was jij verantwoordelijk voor de architectuur. Je schrijft Python in productie, hebt CI/CD-pipelines zelf opgezet en kent één cloud grondig: identity, network en kosten, niet alleen de AI-diensten. De meeste van onze klanten werken met Azure. Je hebt koppelingen gebouwd met API’s, databases en datawarehouses, en weet hoe authenticatie en rechten werken in een bedrijfsomgeving, bijvoorbeeld via OAuth of Entra ID. Je hebt een evaluatie- en monitoringaanpak voor een LLM-toepassing opgezet en daarmee beslissingen onderbouwd, zoals een modelwissel of het besluit om live te gaan. Je kent de beveiligingsrisico’s van LLM-toepassingen, zoals prompt injection en het lekken van gegevens via retrieval, en hebt er maatregelen tegen gebouwd. Je kunt een architectuurkeuze onderbouwen in kosten, risico en onderhoud, en dat uitleggen aan een CTO en aan de engineers die het bouwen. Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en goed Engels. De meeste klanten en gebruikers werken in het Nederlands. Ervaring met observability en kostenbewaking van GenAI per toepassing, bijvoorbeeld met Langfuse of OpenTelemetry infrastructuur als code, zoals Bicep of Terraform governance als ontwerpprincipe: de AI-verordening, de AVG …
