items.desc: A global media and content business is hiring an Software Engineer with strong AI knowledge to build the first dedicated agent platform inside a high-volume, deadline-driven editorial and licensing operation. Editorial teams across four continents source, clear, produce and distribute content seven days a week to over 1,500 clients, sitting on an archive of roughly one million photographs and 40,000 video clips. A lot of the work keeping that moving is repetitive and judgement-light and currently scales linearly with headcount. This role exists to change that. You'll be the first dedicated hire on the agent platform, building a suite of AI agents that take on those repetitive layers so editorial and commercial teams can focus on the work that actually needs a human. This is a build role, not a research role, and success looks like agents running in production against real workflows, not prototypes. Role: Agentic Engineer Location: Hybrid, Birmingham. 2 to 3 days on site What you'll be doing: Design, build and ship production LLM agents against real editorial, rights, archive and commercial workflows, from scoping through to deployment and monitoring Build the shared platform underneath the agents including orchestration, tool and API integrations, retrieval, prompt management, evaluation and observability Integrate agents with existing systems including the archive, submission portal, clips platform and internal editorial tooling Work directly with editorial, research and commercial teams to identify the workflows worth automating and define what 'good enough to trust' looks like for each Build evaluation and guardrails so agent output quality is measurable rather than anecdotal, with human review at the right points Own cost and latency, keeping model spend proportionate to the work being replaced Document and hand over so the platform is not a single-person dependency Keep an eye on the tooling landscape and make pragmatic build-versus-buy calls What you'll need: 3+ years commercial software engineering experience with strong TypeScript skills (and ideally a background in PHP) Experience with either Claude Code, Cursor or Codex Built and shipped at least one LLM-powered feature or agent into production and operated it afterwards (real, used side projects count) Practical grasp of the agent toolkit: function and tool calling, RAG, vector databases, structured output, prompt engineering and context management Comfortable with at least one agent framework or SDK, with an understanding of why the abstractions exist rather than blind loyalty to a specific one Solid API and integration experience, since much of this role is plumbing agents into systems that were not designed for them Able to talk to non-technical colleagues about what an agent can and cannot reliably do, and confident enough to push back when a request is a bad fit This role would suit an engineer who wants genuine greenfield ownership of an agent platform, a varied problem space spanning editorial, rights, archive and commercial, and short feedback loops with the people whose work the agents actually change.

items.desc: About SynlogIQ SynlogIQ helps enterprises become AI-ready. We fix the data and engineering foundations — platform engineering, data engineering, the Microsoft stack, agentic AI, and custom software — so AI actually works in production, not just in a demo. SynlogIQ engineers come from across Southeast Europe — eight countries that share your working day, carry a register that holds up in the boardroom, and draw on a craft tradition that runs deep. Engineering talent, embedded Alongside our project work, we place senior engineers directly inside client engineering teams — people who own their work, think in systems, and raise the standard of the teams they join. The role below is one of those engagements: you would be embedded with a client’s engineering team as part of a long-term contractor partnership through SynlogIQ. About the role We’re looking for an AI Engineer to build production-grade AI applications for an enterprise client. Your focus won’t be training foundation models. Instead, you’ll design and build intelligent products that combine LLMs, agentic workflows, APIs, tools, and external systems into reliable, scalable, production-ready solutions - well beyond simple prompt-and-response. Working with product managers, software engineers, and data scientists, you’ll ship AI-powered features that create measurable business value. What you’ll do Design and build applications powered by LLMs (OpenAI, open-weight models) Build agentic workflows with planning, memory, and tool use Develop prompt-engineering and evaluation strategies Integrate AI with APIs, databases, vector stores, and external services Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of production AI systems Experiment with new models and frameworks to keep improving solutions What we’re looking for 2–5 years in software engineering, machine learning, or applied AI Strong Python (async, APIs, data pipelines) Experience building production-grade LLM applications Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks Solid grasp of prompt engineering, tokenisation, and model limitations Experience with cloud platforms, APIs, and modern engineering practices (testing, versioning, CI/CD) Comfortable debugging non-deterministic, unpredictable AI systems Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Nice to have Open-source LLMs and model hosting (vLLM, Hugging Face) Vector databases AI evaluation frameworks (automated and human-in-the-loop) Optimising latency, cost, and reliability of LLM systems Voice AI (text-to-speech, speech-to-text, orchestration) Knowledge of AI safety and security Clear communication of complex AI behaviour to non-technical stakeholders Why join Build real AI products, not demos Solve hard, real-world engineering problems Work with experienced engineers and AI specialists Influence product direction with modern AI technology, fully remote

items.desc: Data Scientist Contract - 420 per day (Inside IR35) Contract length - Initial 6 month contract (opportunity for further extension for up to 2 years) Hybrid working - x2 days per week in office (Central Manchester) Spencer Rose are hiring on behalf of a leading financial services organisation based in Manchester who are on the look out for an experienced Data Scientist. Within this role, the Data Scientist will translate business problems into scalable AI solutions, developing end-to-end machine learning models and GenAI applications. The Data Scientist will have the following responsibilities - Develop, train and optimise Machine Learning, NLP and Generative AI solutions. Build end-to-end modelling pipelines from data preparation through to production handover. Utilise BigQuery and BigQuery ML for experimentation, analytics and model development. Design and evaluate LLM based solutions, including Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) approaches. Define testing frameworks, model evaluation metrics and experimentation strategies. Produce model documentation, model cards and governance ready evidence. Collaborate with Data Engineers, ML Engineers and stakeholders to deliver impactful solutions. The Data Scientist will need to have the following skills/experience - 8+ years' experience in Data Science, Machine Learning Engineering or Applied AI. Strong Python-based machine learning and NLP development experience. Proven track record of delivering classical ML and LLM-based solutions. Experience designing experiments, evaluating model performance and communicating insights. Knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices and model documentation.

items.desc: Location: London, United Kingdom. Contract: Freelance, with the possibility of future full-time employment. About the job: AI is forcing engineers to evolve like never before. The role is increasingly defined by deciding what a system should do and which specs and evals to write, then handing execution to agents and carefully checking what comes back. The best engineers we know still understand every layer underneath and are eager to spend more time thinking about how and why the solutions they build get used. That’s who we want to work with at Calibr, a startup founded by Peter Wood and Marlene Leiss, and part of The Apprentify Group, one of the UK’s leading AI and tech training providers. We build tailored AI solutions for companies going through AI transformation, then help their teams build the skills to run, extend and own those systems themselves. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll work directly with clients to scope the problem, build the solution and leave them more capable than when you arrived. Who we are: Our mission at Calibr is to help companies build in-house AI capability. Our approach is simple: help businesses identify where AI can create the most value, prove it in a focused part of the business and build the capability to navigate AI adoption long term. We are industry-agnostic and work with the UK’s leading SMEs, scale-ups, corporates, NGOs and public sector organisations. Our group’s clients include Jet2, JD Group, Canon, BBC, B&Q, McLaren and Manchester Airport, to name a few. The Apprentify Group is a collective of six specialist businesses, including Netcom Training, Flourish, Ioda, The Juice Academy and Apprentify. We are united by a shared commitment to providing learning opportunities to people at every stage of their career, and in 2025 we were named the UK’s 30th-fastest-growing private company by The Sunday Times. Who we are looking for: We are looking for a technically competent orchestrator (i.e. someone who can explain the decisions behind their code and develop it in ways that respect wider architectures) to help build transformation projects for clients. Your goals will be to turn a scoped business problem into well-bounded technical compositions, build tested and evaluated guardrails, and create feedback loops that involve humans, resulting in AI-assisted delivery that is efficient yet explainable and trustworthy. What You Will Do Decompose ambiguous problems into smaller components and map out their dependencies and operational risk before production. Determine the right set of tools (harnesses, models, custom tools and MCP servers). Code the underlying plumbing and necessary automations to enable the design of the system while embedding it in a pre-existing architecture. Build observability channels to monitor the health of the system and allow for user-accessible fixes. Bound your builds with schemas, evaluation sets and permissions for human review to enable transparency. Explain architecture decisions, their trade-offs and risks in terms non-technical stakeholders can act on. What You Bring We understand that this is a new and emerging role, so we focus far more on the signals we receive from you as a candidate than on the job title on your CV. You are, however, likely to be a match if you have demonstrable competence in the following areas: Building stress-tested cloud systems that have made it to production and had measurable impact (3+ years). Shipping AI harnesses involving RAG, document intelligence and custom tools, with a focus on evaluation pipelines, model routing, and agent/tool orchestration and permissions. Working with Python (including FastAPI), specifically LangChain (and LangGraph where necessary), SQL and scalable (vector) databases. Enforcing rigorous evaluation to cover edge cases and determine specific mitigations for prompt injection and tool abuse. Distinguishing a model safety issue from an application security issue. Travel: This role may require being on-site with clients. How we work: As part of The Apprentify Group, we have the backing, client relationships and commercial experience of a group that has already scaled several businesses. You get the pace and ownership of an early-stage startup with a stable foundation behind it. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, you’ll work directly with the founders, our fractional CTO and, where needed, our clients. We want you to have a real say in how we build, from the tools we standardise on to how we run client projects. We know that the people who join us at this stage will shape what Calibr’s engineering practice looks like for years. Culture is important to us, and we look for people who thrive in work environments that value: Infectious Ambition. We believe every high-agency person should have a “why” that sustains them and motivates others to strive for greatness as a team. Efficient Conscientiousness. We care about the details but move fast. Finding the balance between depth and …

items.desc: Estas becas son una oportunidad única para aprender en el grupo educativo líder en educación online de habla hispana, con presencia internacional y más de 7.000 profesionales comprometidos con la innovación académica y tecnológica. Las becas combinan formación especializada con prácticas reales en un entorno profesional , para aquellos que quieran acelerar su desarrollo y construir un plan de carrera. 🏆 ¿Qué ofrecemos? 10 meses de prácticas, 30 horas a la semana . Ayuda al estudio de 700 €/mes . Iniciarás las prácticas en formato presencial en nuestras oficinas de Pozuelo de Alarcón, junto a la estación de Cercanías. Formación técnica especializada en Inteligencia Artificial, con un Título Propio de UNIR , que potenciará tu futuro profesional. Mentorización y desarrollo : integración en equipos de proyecto donde podrás aprender de perfiles senior. ✅ ¿Qué aprenderás en tu día a día? Uso y configuración de modelos LLM (IA gen) vía API. Desarrollos con la técnica RAG. Idear soluciones basadas en IA generativa en relación con requisitos de negocio. Implementación de prototipos y pruebas de concepto. Desarrollo de software productivo con Python y frameworks como LangChain y LlamaIndex. Diseño e implementación de soluciones Cloud para la productivización de IA generativa. 🎯 ¿Qué necesitas para aplicar? Haber finalizado o estar terminando estudios universitarios en Ingeniería, ADE, Matemáticas, Estadística, Física o titulaciones STEM. Perfil analítico, curioso y con sensibilidad técnica. Capacidad para aprender rápido y trabajar en equipo. Atención al detalle y motivación por desarrollar una carrera en el ecosistema tecnológico y digital. Esta beca no es solo un programa de prácticas. Si quieres crecer formándote con especialistas y participar en proyectos con impacto, esta es tu oportunidad. El Grupo EDUCATIVO está firmemente comprometido con la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad, logrando con ello crear un entorno libre de toda discriminación.

items.desc: Theodo est une entreprise de conseil et de réalisation en technologie digitale. Ces dernières années, nous avons construit une expertise forte sur deux axes qui convergent : la donnée (plateformes data, gouvernance, qualité) et l'intelligence artificielle (IA générative, agents, ML, vision par ordinateur). Ces deux expertises sont portées par notre entité Theodo Data & AI , qui accompagne les organisations à toutes les étapes de leur trajectoire data et IA. Le marché est à un point d'inflexion. Les entreprises disposent de volumes considérables de données internes mais peinent à les exploiter, tandis que l'IA générative ouvre des possibilités inédites d'automatisation, d'aide à la décision et de transformation des processus métiers. Nos clients attendent un partenaire capable de couvrir toute la chaîne de valeur, de la stratégie data à l'industrialisation des cas d'usage IA. Nous avons une opportunité unique de devenir un leader reconnu sur ce marché à très forte valeur, en nous appuyant sur notre approche Lean Tech® et nos partenariats stratégiques (Google Cloud Partner of the Year France 2025, AWS, Snowflake). C'est cette practice que nous vous proposons de piloter. Votre rôle En tant que CTO Data & IA, vous êtes le leader qui fait le pont entre le business et la tech sur l'ensemble du périmètre Data & Intelligence Artificielle. Concrètement, vous portez quatre responsabilités. Offre & expertise technique : vous positionnez Theodo à la pointe du marché. Vous benchmarkez les architectures data modernes (data platforms, data mesh, lakehouse) et les architectures IA (RAG, agents, semantic layer, fine-tuning, MLOps). Vous développez des accélérateurs et des enablers internes réutilisables, vous animez la communauté des leaders tech et data scientists, et vous formalisez les apprentissages pour capitaliser sur les retours de mission. Vente & Solution Architecture : vous êtes le référent technique du cycle de vente. Vous intervenez en avant-vente comme solution architect de référence sur nos offres Data & IA, vous co-construisez les propositions techniques avec les équipes commerciales, et vous challengez et crédibilisez les réponses techniques face aux CTO, DSI et CDO de nos clients. Vous travaillez main dans la main avec notre Head of Sales sur le closing des deals stratégiques et sur nos partenariats. Delivery : vous garantissez l'excellence et faites grandir les équipes. Vous communiquez en interne autour de nos offres pour attirer les meilleurs profils, et vous recrutez et formez nos ingénieurs data, data scientists et AI engineers. Marketing technique : vous construisez notre visibilité et notre crédibilité sur le marché. Vous bâtissez et maintenez notre showroom (démos, cas d'usage de référence), vous produisez du contenu à fort impact (articles, livres blancs, tech radars), vous intervenez en conférences et événements (Nuit de la Data, Google Cloud Next, AWS Summit…), et vous alimentez nos partenariats technologiques avec du contenu technique. Les défis qui vous attendent Vous couvrirez un périmètre large qui va de la data platform à l'IA générative, en passant par la data science classique et le MLOps sans vous disperser. Vous rejoindrez une équipe déjà expérimentée, avec une culture Theodo forte. Vous articulerez une vision unifiée Data & IA là où le marché tend à séparer ces deux mondes, tout en conservant une équipe pluridisciplinaire (data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, MLOps) pour scaler la delivery. Vous naviguerez dans un écosystème de partenaires technologiques variés (Google Cloud, AWS) en maintenant une posture agnostique crédible. Et surtout, vous transformerez la vague GenAI en offres industrialisables et vendables, avec un ROI démontrable pour nos clients. Votre environnement Vous travaillerez avec les fondateurs du groupe pour définir la stratégie go-to-market et les priorités de la practice, avec les leaders de la practice et notre Head of Sales pour le closing des ventes et la structuration du pipeline, et avec les leaders tech Data et IA pour renforcer l'expertise collective. Vous vous appuierez sur notre Head of Delivery pour garantir le respect de nos engagements clients, et sur nos partenaires technologiques (Google Cloud, AWS) pour co-construire des offres et maintenir nos certifications. Vous managerez les équipes techniques de la practice Data & IA : data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers et MLOps engineers. Ce que nous recherchons Nous cherchons quelqu'un de passionné par la Data et l'IA, animé par un drive fort dans la durée et une curiosité insatiable pour les avancées technologiques (LLM, agents, data platforms, MLOps). Vous êtes très fort en tech sur un spectre large : architectures data modernes (data mesh, lakehouse, governance frameworks) et architectures IA (RAG, agents, fine-tuning, évaluation de modèles, MLOps). Vous avez un sens business affirmé : vous comprenez les job-to-be-done métier des clients, vous savez articuler la valeur délivrée et le …

items.title: Manufacturing Engineer
items.card: Your role and responsibilities As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will oversee manufacturing processes from process design and industrialization through production ramp-up and ongoing improvement. You will work hands-on with production teams, lead improvement projects and use your engineering expertise to improve productivity, quality, cost and overall manufacturing performance. Working model: onsite #LIonsite Oversee
items.desc:
At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
 This position reports to: 
Production Engineering Manager 
 __
 ABB’s Drives factory in Jüri, Estonia, was established in 2005 and is part of ABB’s global Motion business. The factory is one of ABB’s major production sites for low-voltage drives (frequency converters), power inverters and converters. 
 Our products are used across industries, including manufacturing and marine applications, to control electric motors, improve process efficiency and reduce energy consumption by up to 50%. Most of the drives produced in Jüri are exported to global markets. 
 Your role and responsibilities 
 As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will oversee manufacturing processes from process design and industrialization through production ramp-up and ongoing improvement. You will work hands-on with production teams, lead improvement projects and use your engineering expertise to improve productivity, quality, cost and overall manufacturing performance. 
 Working model: onsite #LIonsite 
 Oversee the development and industrialization of manufacturing processes by defining process sequences, production methods, cycle times, equipment needs, and materials to meet production, quality, cost, and investment goals 
 Drive the ramp-up of new production lines and products, supporting start-up activities, troubleshooting and implementation of action plans together with Production, Maintenance and other relevant stakeholders 
 Design, develop and optimise production processes, tooling and fixtures, using Design for Manufacture principles and advanced SolidWorks CAD/CAM skills 
 Manage continuous improvement initiatives using Lean and Six Sigma methodologies, analysing KPIs, identifying improvement opportunities and delivering projects focused on productivity, quality, cost and waste reduction 
 Own and continuously improve manufacturing and quality documentation, including process flow charts, FMEA, quality control plans and checklists, while ensuring compliance with defined standards and requirements 
 Collaborate with internal experts, suppliers and ABB teams across different locations to solve complex manufacturing and quality issues, evaluate new technologies and implement scalable best practices
 Qualification for the role 
 5+ years of hands-on experience in a manufacturing environment, with deep experience in engineering and manufacturing processes 
 B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering or a related technical field. 
 Strong knowledge of Design for Manufacture, Design for Assembly (DFA) and Design for Quality (DFQ) principles 
 Deep understanding of Continuous Improvement, Lean Manufacturing, and Six Sigma tools, with practical experience using these methods 
 Advanced Computer-Aided Design (CAD) skills, preferably SolidWorks CAD/CAM, with experience designing tooling and fixtures 
 Ability to assess and enhance manufacturing KPIs, determine root causes, and guide improvement efforts from initial concept through full implementation 
 Strong problem-solving and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work independently, take ownership and drive projects in a hands-on manufacturing environment. 
 Good command of English, Estonian or Russian is a merit. 
 More about us 
 We care. Аbout your health, well-being, and work-life balance. That’s why we offer private health insurance, sports compensation, and other perks to help you feel your best.
 We grow together. You’ll be part of a supportive international team where collaboration is real, not just a buzzword.
 We stay curious. Learning never stops here. From hands-on experience to development programs - you’ll have space to explore, learn, and try new things.
 We value your impact. Your work matters. We offer an annual bonus and celebrate the wins: big or small.
 We keep it modern. With flexible working and smart tools, we make sure your everyday work experience is smooth and up to date.
 For more information, please contact Talent Partner Elena, +372 5680 1416
 We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). 
 Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
 Ready to make an impact? 
 Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

items.desc:
Introduction 
 Are you passionate about building and operating large-scale digital services that connect thousands of users across a worldwide scientific community?
As a Computing Engineer in CERN’s IT Department, you will play a key role in delivering and evolving the collaboration and communication services used every day by scientists, engineers and support teams across the Organization. You will help operate critical platforms including email, group management and media services while contributing to the integration of modern cloud and on-premises technologies within CERN’s computing ecosystem.
Working within the Collaboration and Engineering Tools team, you will combine software engineering, service operations and infrastructure automation to ensure that essential collaboration services remain secure, scalable and reliable. You’ll have the opportunity to work with technologies ranging from cloud services, web and automation frameworks, data analytics platforms to Kubernetes/OpenShift, Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online.
This role offers scope for technical leadership, architectural input and service ownership in a complex international environment.
 Functions 
 You will contribute to the operation, evolution and integration of CERN's collaboration platforms by:
 Acting as deputy service manager for CERN's email services and sharing technical ownership of the reliability and evolution of the messaging ecosystem.
 Managing and improving the synchronisation of email identities and attributes across Active Directory, Entra ID and Exchange Online.
 Operating and evolving CERN's distribution groups archive service.
 Operating and evolving the 365 groups provisioning integration to the CERN Computing Resources Portal.
 Ensuring seamless synchronisation of group memberships and associated collaboration services across CERN's computing environment.
 Participating in strategic projects related to media platforms, video conferencing services and Indico (CERN event management platform).
 Contributing to the operation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement of CERN's communication and collaboration services.
 Working closely with infrastructure, security and IT service teams to deliver robust and scalable solutions.
 Automating processes and improving service observability, reliability and user experience.
Master's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or a related field.
 Experience: 
 You should have experience, or a strong interest in developing expertise, in some of the following areas:
 Experience in software/web application development, ideally with some of the following technologies: c#, .Net, Python, JavaScript, Flask, React.js, PostgreSQL.
 Familiarity with modern DevOps and infrastructure platforms such as Kubernetes/OpenShift, Puppet or OpenStack.
 Experience designing, deploying or operating reliable production services.
 Background in addressing scalability, security and reliability challenges in service configuration and delivery.
 An interest in large-scale collaboration and communication systems serving thousands of users.
 Familiarity with database and/or data analytics technologies, especially SQL and the ELK stack.
 Experience in one or more of the following areas would be advantageous:
 Operation of large-scale email and groupware platforms.
 Microsoft 365, Exchange Online and identity management technologies.
 Email architectures and protocols (SMTP, IMAP, POP, routing, connectors, mailing lists and mailbox services).
 Automation of cloud and hybrid environments.
We welcome applications from candidates with diverse technical backgrounds and international experience, including those who may not meet every listed technology requirement but bring strong engineering foundations, curiosity and a collaborative mindset.
 Technical competencies: 
 Knowledge of programming techniques and languages for software development, scripting, service management and automation (including Powershell, Graph API, Python and C#).
 Development of application software.
 Re-use, refactoring, integration and porting of existing software.
 Administration of computing systems.
 Knowledge of system configuration tools.
 Knowledge of best practices for implementing ICT security standards and policies.
 Behavioural competencies: 
 Solving Problems: identifying, defining and assessing problems, taking action to address them.
 Achieving Results: delivering high quality work on time and fulfilling expectations.
 Working in Teams: building and maintaining constructive and effective work relationships.
 Managing Self: taking initiative beyond regular tasks and making things happen.
 Demonstrating Flexibility: demonstrating openness to new ideas and situations.
 Language skills: 
 Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

items.desc: Qui sommes-nous ? STE Grand Sud, filiale du Groupe ALCIS, est spécialisée dans le transport de personnes, notamment le transport de personnes à mobilité réduite (TPMR) et le transport dans le cadre de l'aide sociale à l'enfance (ASE). Avec environ 800 conducteurs sur le périmètre de l'Occitanie, notre entreprise évolue dans un environnement opérationnel exigeant, au service de ses clients et de ses bénéficiaires. Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous créons un poste stratégique rattaché directement au Directeur Général, avec pour objectif de structurer le pilotage de notre activité, d'harmoniser nos méthodes de travail et d'accompagner la montée en compétences de nos équipes. Votre rôle En tant que Responsable du pilotage de la performance opérationnelle, vous prenez la responsabilité hiérarchique d'une équipe de huit collaborateurs basés au siège de Balma. Votre mission : donner une vision claire et partagée de la performance de l'entreprise, fiabiliser les outils de pilotage et accompagner les équipes dans l'amélioration de leurs pratiques. Vous disposez d'un rôle transversal, à la croisée de l'analyse des données, de l'optimisation opérationnelle et du management. Vos missions 1. Piloter la performance et maîtriser les coûts Concevoir et déployer des tableaux de bord et des indicateurs communs à l'ensemble des périmètres. Structurer le suivi des principaux postes de coûts : masse salariale, carburant, parc de véhicules et entretien. Analyser la rentabilité par marché et par périmètre, identifier les écarts et alerter la Direction Générale. Fiabiliser les données et faciliter la prise de décision grâce à des analyses claires et pertinentes. 2. Structurer les méthodes et optimiser l'organisation Analyser les pratiques existantes et identifier les axes d'amélioration. Harmoniser les méthodes de travail, les procédures et les outils de suivi. Identifier les leviers d'optimisation de l'organisation des circuits, de la planification et de l'affectation des moyens. Évaluer et déployer des outils permettant de gagner en efficacité, notamment les solutions de Business Intelligence et d'intelligence artificielle appliquées au pilotage opérationnel. 3. Manager et accompagner votre équipe Encadrer et fédérer une équipe de huit collaborateurs et mettre en place un fonctionnement collectif. Animer les revues de performance mensuelles et conduire les entretiens individuels . Accompagner les collaborateurs dans l'appropriation des outils et la compréhension des indicateurs économiques. Développer les compétences, identifier les potentiels d'évolution et accompagner les prises de responsabilités. Apporter un appui opérationnel dans les situations complexes : dérives de coûts, tensions sociales ou dégradation de la relation client. Fixer les objectifs, évaluer les résultats et veiller au respect des standards définis. Le profil recherché Vous justifiez de 4 à 10 ans d'expérience , dont une première expérience réussie en management direct. Votre parcours peut notamment s'inscrire dans l'un des domaines suivants : Contrôle de gestion opérationnel ou pilotage de la performance en environnement multisite ; Direction des opérations ou animation de réseau dans la distribution, la restauration en réseau, la logistique, la propreté, la sécurité privée, l'intérim, les services à la personne ou les centres de contact ; Conseil en amélioration de la performance opérationnelle, avec une première expérience en entreprise ou une volonté affirmée de rejoindre un environnement opérationnel. Une expérience dans le transport de personnes n'est pas requise. Les candidatures issues d'autres secteurs sont les bienvenues, notamment celles provenant d'environnements à forte intensité de main-d'œuvre et à organisation multisite. Compétences analytiques et maîtrise des outils Maîtrise avancée d'Excel et pratique confirmée d'un outil de Business Intelligence (Power BI ou équivalent) ; Capacité à structurer des données hétérogènes, à construire des indicateurs fiables et à mettre en place des outils de suivi pérennes ; Aptitude à analyser les coûts, la rentabilité et les écarts de performance afin d'identifier des leviers d'amélioration ; Aisance avec les outils d'intelligence artificielle appliqués à l'analyse de données, à l'automatisation et à la production de reporting ; La connaissance de SQL ou d'un langage de traitement de données constitue un plus. Compétences managériales et posture professionnelle Capacité à structurer et fédérer une équipe qui fonctionnait jusqu'ici de manière autonome, en s'appuyant sur les pratiques existantes et en accompagnant leur évolution ; Pédagogie et aptitude à faire adhérer les collaborateurs aux nouveaux outils, méthodes et indicateurs ; Capacité à fixer un cadre, définir des objectifs, suivre les résultats et recadrer lorsque cela est nécessaire ; Sens de l'écoute et capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance avec des collaborateurs expérimentés ; Goût du terrain et capacité à apporter un appui …

items.desc: Job Description Location: London Salary: Competitive salary and package dependent on experience Career Level: Senior Analyst or Specialist Accenture Palantir Business Group (APBG) is a deep data and AI group founded on an innate desire to create real-world change. We are consulting engineers with a purpose, offering a ‘boots on the ground’ approach to complex public and private sector challenges. As a trusted Palantir partner we help our clients to extract the most value from their technology. We are working at the cutting edge of Palantir technology and harnessing its capabilities with purpose. Our teams are united in their mission to be drivers of positive change in the world’s most influential organisations. This includes strengthening our advantage in the defence, infrastructure and public safety - empowering more public and private institutions to unlock their full potential. The Role As a Consulting Engineer - Forward Deployed, you will operate with high individual ownership. You’ll design solutions that unify complex data landscapes, build workflows that drive smarter decisions, and partner with organisations to deliver sustainable transformation. Working directly with your clients, you will be the face of AOBG, requiring a unique blend of technical mastery and high emotional intelligence (EQ) to navigate complex environments. You will have creative freedom to architect solutions, working iteratively to build fast, build your own backlog, show your work to clients and refine it based on real-time feedback. What You'll Do End-to-End Delivery: Take significant individual ownership of client problems, handling everything from deep data engineering knowing that may require low/no code Palantir Foundry tooling, or Python and PySpark code repos - to building user-facing front-end applications and widgets in TypeScript or REACT Client Advisory & Translation: Sit directly alongside clients, distinguish their goals and requirements and translate complex technical language into stakeholder appropriate communication AI Integration: Actively embed AI workflows into existing applications using cutting-edge tools like AIP Logic Functions, AIP Analysts, and AIFDE Decho Labs Innovation: Contribute to Decho Labs to build tangible internal products. Feed your deployment learnings back into the company so our teams learn from your success and we create compounding assets of value for internally and for our clients Innate Collaboration: responsible for self-assignment of taskings, actively participate in our "show and tell" culture through teach-backs and tech reviews and uplift your peers through our highly active internal support channels Qualification What We Are Looking For Problem Solvers: We highly value individuals who can navigate nuanced client environments. We care more about your ability to decompose complex use cases and architect solutions than rote memorising of coding syntax Fluency in core languages (Python, SQL, TypeScript and/or REACT) and the capability to pick up others quickly. You should understand data engineering principles, ETL pipelines, and application development Familiarity with Palantir (Foundry, Gotham, or similar) is preferred but not mandatory provided you have a strong willingness to learn High EQ & Curiosity: The emotional intelligence to manage client expectations, a proactive self-starting nature, and the humility to know you don't know everything and search for and accept help Impact-Driven Communication: The ability to present impressive demos, simplify complexity for non-technical users, and focus on delivering genuine client impact. We foster an open, low-ego culture built on merit, where professional strides are formalised through weekly all company sessions. All levels of our business are highly visible and accessible to everyone. We have a vibrant engineering community that connects through regular socials and interest‑based Slack communities, creating opportunities to learn from one another and share what we love outside of work. Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the first-class services we are known for. Accenture reserves the right to close the role prior to this date should a suitable applicant be found. items.desc: Job Description AI Large Language Model (LLM) Technology Architect Career Level: Associate Manager / Specialist Location: London YOU ARE As a hands-on AI/LLM Architect, you will be at the heart of designing and building advanced AI systems that power the modern enterprise. This is a deeply technical, hands-on role — you will spend the majority of your time in the architecture and engineering of real-world AI solutions across classical machine learning, generative AI, and agentic systems, delivering these within active client engagements. You will translate requirements into concrete architecture decisions: selecting design patterns, evaluating and benchmarking technical frameworks, assembling reusable components, and making deliberate technology choices that balance innovation with enterprise-grade reliability. You will design and build AI agent architectures — including multi-agent orchestration, tool use, skills use, and memory systems — and work hands-on with foundation models through fine-tuning, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and custom model integration. A part of your work will also involve engineering the AI context layer that makes these systems intelligent in practice — connecting enterprise knowledge bases, structured and unstructured data sources, and domain-specific content so that AI outputs are grounded, accurate, and relevant to the client's business. You will design and validate systems against enterprise non-functional requirements across security, observability, governance, performance, and scalability. A core output of this role is the production of tangible engineering and architecture deliverables. This means writing and owning software components — building, integrating, and testing AI system modules as a practitioner — alongside producing detailed architecture artifacts including architecture decision records (ADRs), component diagrams, data flow diagrams, and integration specifications that guide and enable broader engineering teams. You will work with cross-functional delivery teams alongside data engineers, ML engineers, and application developers, and this role is an opportunity to develop deep expertise across the full AI architecture stack, sharpen your engineering instincts on complex, real-world problems, and build a foundation for growing into a lead or principal architect over time. THE WORK Independently design, build, and deliver software components across the AI architecture — owning them end to end from design through implementation, integration, and testing as a hands-on practitioner Design and build AI agent architectures — including individual agents, their prompts, tools, and skills, multi-agent orchestration, and memory systems — making deliberate design pattern and technology choices Design and implement agent orchestration patterns that handle task handoffs, communication, state management, and error recovery, validating them through hands-on prototyping Evaluate multiple design options and technical approaches, making deliberate, justified design choices that balance capability, cost efficiency, performance, and enterprise-grade reliability Design, build, and run evaluation strategies and harnesses that measure agent and system quality on metrics such as accuracy, relevance, and faithfulness, translating findings into design improvements Architect and implement foundation model integrations — selecting the right models, invocation patterns, and customization approaches (fine-tuning, RAG, custom integration) based on capability, cost, and performance trade-offs Design and build model adaptation and fine-tuning pipelines, applying working knowledge of transformer-based architectures to inform model selection and optimization Design components that ground AI outputs in the client's knowledge Build embedding, vector storage, and retrieval (semantic, hybrid, reranking) into end-to-end RAG pipelines, applying integration patterns that connect to enterprise data sources Design and implement context assembly and memory components that manage prompts, context windows, and conversational state for grounded, accurate outputs items.desc: Fincantieri è uno dei principali complessi cantieristici al mondo, l’unico attivo in tutti i settori della navalmeccanica ad alta tecnologia. È leader nella realizzazione e trasformazione di unità da crociera, militari e offshore nei comparti oil & gas ed eolico, oltre che nella produzione di sistemi e componenti, nell’offerta di servizi post-vendita e nelle soluzioni di arredamento navale. Grazie alle capacità sviluppate nella gestione di progetti complessi il Gruppo vanta referenze di eccellenza nelle infrastrutture, ed è operatore di riferimento nel digitale e nella cybersecurity, nell’elettronica e sistemistica avanzata. Con oltre 230 anni di storia e più di 7.000 navi costruite, Fincantieri mantiene il proprio know-how e i centri direzionali in Italia, dove impiega 10.000 dipendenti e attiva circa 90.000 posti di lavoro, che raddoppiano su scala mondiale in virtù di una rete produttiva di 18 stabilimenti in tre continenti e oltre 21.000 lavoratori diretti. Il gruppo Manpower in collaborazione con Fincantieri cerca un/una Data Scientist / AI Engineer. La missione del ruolo è trasformare dati e processi in insight e soluzioni AI concretamente utilizzabili, combinando data science, machine learning, LLM e agenti per supportare decisioni, automazione e produttività. Responsabilità principali Analizzare dataset complessi e di grandi dimensioni, identificando pattern, KPI, anomalie e insight a supporto delle decisioni. Sviluppare modelli statistici e di machine learning, dalla preparazione dei dati alla validazione dei risultati. Progettare e prototipare soluzioni basate su LLM e Agentic AI, incluse architetture RAG, orchestrazione multi-agent, tool use e integrazione con fonti dati e servizi. Analizzare processi e use case, trasformando bisogni di business in requisiti esecutivi, soluzioni implementabili e criteri di valore misurabili. Realizzare automazioni e assistenti tramite Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio, collaborando con team tecnici e stakeholder di business. Comunicare analisi, risultati e raccomandazioni in modo chiaro anche a interlocutori non tecnici. Competenze richieste Python e SQL; solide basi di statistica, data analysis e machine learning. Esperienza con LLM, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, RAG e framework di orchestrazione agentica. Conoscenza di Microsoft Power Automate e Copilot Studio; familiarità con API e integrazione di tool/servizi. Capacità di lavorare su dati strutturati e non strutturati e di valutarne qualità, affidabilità e rilevanza. Approccio problem-solving, autonomia, capacità di sintesi e forte orientamento al valore. Ottime capacità comunicative e di interazione con stakeholder tecnici e business. items.desc: Software engineers and AI agents alike suffer from the same problem: finding that one person or place that will answer their tough, specific question. Many solutions promise to solve this with similarity search in vector databases. Unfortunately, finding the answer is often a puzzle with pieces to be collected across a myriad of contradictory sources and cannot be solved without surgical search and careful reasoning. Spectrum collects data from an organization’s code, docs, and issues, and organizes knowledge in a unified ontology that AI agents can efficiently search through and reason over. We aim to revolutionize the semantic layer space for software-building organizations and move beyond specs that fall out of sync with code, introducing a living spec – one that’s extracted from the whole system and used to keep it aligned. Spectrum is meant to be the single source of truth for all product and architectural knowledge. Spectrum is a resident of JetBrains' startup incubator, with startup speed and autonomy, and backed by 25 years of developer tooling expertise. We are looking for a top-class ML Engineer who will help us shape the future of software development. You will own our AI and ML engineering stack and help define the research agenda for our team. Your technical vision and design decisions will directly shape the product and determine its success. Your Responsibilities Will Include Designing and building the ML/LLM solution for data ingestion, knowledge extraction, retrieval, and subsequent reasoning. Creating the datasets, metrics, and pipelines that drive measurable improvements across the system. Architecting and improving agents for context retrieval, knowledge extraction, and data alignment, which includes prompt engineering, model selection, and inference optimization. Establishing MLOps practices, including orchestration, observability, and experiment tracking. Collaborating with the engineering team on system design and with JetBrains Research on the research agenda. Defining hiring criteria, growing the ML team, and shaping the ML team culture. We Expect You To Have A proven track record as an ML/AI Lead. At least five years of experience in ML/AI systems, with at least two years focused on LLMs and generative AI. A deep understanding of the LLM ecosystem, including model architectures and fine-tuning approaches. Hands-on experience with: Prompt engineering and LLM pipeline design, including evaluation. Agentic frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangSmith, smolagents, or an equivalent. Vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns. Deploying and scaling LLM-powered applications using APIs (e.g. OpenAI or Anthropic) or open-source models. Strong Python skills – Kotlin knowledge would be a plus. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. Proficiency in English, both written and verbal. Our Ideal Candidate Would Have Experience with ontologies, knowledge graphs, or graph-based reasoning. Experience in early-stage startups – you enjoy the zero-to-one phase. The ability to think strategically about product-led AI, beyond just training models in isolation. A background in code analysis, developer tools, or software engineering research. Experience with multi-agent systems or complex agentic workflows. Actively contributed to relevant open-source projects or publications. What we offer A competitive salary and JetBrains benefits. A generous runway and corporate resources with startup autonomy. We are an equal opportunity employer We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation. items.desc: PRIMARY FUNCTION Responsible for developing and implementing a data-driven fleet monitoring and validation process, leveraging vehicle operational data to support engineering decision-making, system behavior assessment, reliability growth and validation effectiveness. The role is responsible for transforming fleet operational data into actionable engineering insights through the definition of monitoring strategies, data analytics methodologies, mission-based validation approaches and dashboard solutions supporting validation, reliability and engineering activities. Working closely with System Validation Engineers and cross-functional engineering teams, the position will define the parameters to be monitored, establish engineering thresholds and performance limits, develop analytical methodologies, and identify vehicle mission profiles that are representative or particularly severe for specific systems and failure modes. A key objective of the role is to improve the correlation between vehicle validation activities and real-world customer usage by identifying, quantifying and characterizing operating conditions that can accelerate failure mode validation, increase validation representativeness and support reliability growth activities. DIMENSIONS Single contributor, monitoring of approx. 500-800x different vehicles on fleet ESSENTIAL RESPONSABILITIES Fleet Data Management & Monitoring Work closely with System Validation Engineers to identify the relevant vehicle, system and component parameters to be monitored through fleet operational data. Support the definition of engineering limits, threshold values, warning levels and monitoring criteria required to assess system behavior under real operating conditions. Define signal requirements, data collection strategies and data quality criteria for fleet monitoring activities. Develop and maintain automatic data post-processing methodologies, including plausibility checks, event creation, statistical analysis, filtering and data quality validation. Dashboard Architecture & Data Analytics Define dashboard architecture, analytical frameworks, KPIs and visualization strategies required to support engineering and validation activities. Develop, maintain and continuously improve fleet monitoring dashboards and analytical solutions using Qlik Sense and other analytical platforms. Translate engineering and validation requirements into data models, calculations, automated monitoring rules and visualization requirements. Collaborate with ICT and data platform teams to define data processing, storage and reporting architectures supporting fleet analytics. Mission-Based Validation & Reliability Growth Analyze fleet operational data to identify mission profiles that generate elevated stress on specific systems, components or vehicle functions. Identify operating conditions and usage patterns capable of accelerating the validation of known or potential failure modes. Develop methodologies to quantify mission severity, system exposure and operational profiles based on real fleet data. Identify equivalent or accelerated mission profiles capable of reproducing critical operating conditions associated with degradation mechanisms or failure modes in reduced time. Correlate customer usage profiles, field exposure and validation test conditions to improve validation effectiveness and representativeness. JOB SPECIFICATION Communication The position acts as a bridge between engineering teams and data/analytics platforms, ensuring that fleet operational data is converted into meaningful engineering information supporting validation, reliability growth and product development activities. The role requires the ability to communicate complex technical findings through dashboards, reports and presentations to both technical and non-technical audiences REQUIREMENTS Bachelor's or Master's Degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related technical field. Strong experience (minimum 5 years) in data analytics, dashboard development and KPI definition, preferably using Qlik Sense . Knowledge of SQL, Python (or equivalent scripting languages), data modelling, ETL processes and database concepts. Understanding of vehicle systems, telematics, CAN data, datalogging and engineering validation processes. Ability to identify mission profiles, system stress conditions and field operating scenarios to support validation and reliability activities.  Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead.  About the team 
 Stripe’s Commercial Solutions Architecture (SA) team works with technical and business leaders (CTO/ CIO/ CEO/ Founders etc.), payments leaders and product engineering teams in the mid-market segment to evangelize Stripe’s solutions in the market. A solutions architect’s role is to build relationships with decision makers and think strategically about the business needs of Stripe’s customers. Commercial SAs establish and prescribe best practices around a customer’s strategy, provide business and technical thought leadership and are viewed as a trusted advisor. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 At Roche, we are committed to delivering greater benefits to our patients by applying digital, data, and AI capabilities to real-world operational challenges. The AI Engineer Level 6 is a senior hands-on technical contributor within the AI Engineering Cluster, responsible for designing, delivering, evaluating, and operating robust AI solutions across Pharma Technical Operations.
 This role owns meaningful parts of end-to-end AI delivery, including solution architecture, data pipelines, machine learning and GenAI systems, agentic workflows, AI evaluation harnesses, backend services, user interfaces, and production operations. The role partners with business, IT, quality, and technical experts to translate complex operational challenges into reliable, scalable, compliant, and measurable AI-enabled products.
 Role description
 The role is a senior AI engineering role for someone who combines strong technical depth with practical delivery ownership. The AI Engineer Level 6 is expected to independently lead solution delivery, make sound architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and ensure AI solutions create measurable business value while meeting reliability, scalability, evaluation, agent management, and compliance expectations.
 AI Solution Leadership & Delivery
 End-to-end delivery ownership: Own the technical delivery of AI solutions from problem understanding and design through build, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
 Solution architecture: Design scalable AI application architectures, including data flows, model integration, GenAI orchestration, APIs, user interfaces, agent workflows, and production infrastructure.
 GenAI and agentic AI: Design and implement advanced GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, multi-step workflows, tool-using agents, LLM orchestration, and evaluation approaches.
 Engineering quality: Apply and help evolve strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and maintainability.
 Production performance: Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, monitored, cost-aware, and continuously improved in production or production-like environments.
 Value delivery: Translate business needs into technical solutions and help define success metrics that demonstrate operational and business impact.
 Modern AI Engineering Capabilities
 Evaluation framework design: Design and implement data science-driven evaluation frameworks for AI, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, golden datasets, synthetic test cases, human evaluation workflows, and automated regression testing.
 AI harness development: Own the development of AI engineering harnesses for repeatable experimentation, evaluation, validation, and comparison of models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent behaviors, and tool integrations.
 Agentic AI solution ownership: Design and deliver production-grade agentic AI systems, including agent orchestration, tool integration, task decomposition, state handling, memory patterns, guardrails, and human escalation paths.
 Agent lifecycle management: Manage deployed agents across their lifecycle, including versioning, testing, release management, monitoring, incident response, continuous improvement, and retirement.
 Performance and risk monitoring: Implement and operate observability for AI systems, including quality metrics, business impact metrics, cost, latency, failure modes, drift, hallucination risk, grounding quality, and operational reliability.
 Model and workflow comparison: Lead structured experiments to compare foundation models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval approaches, orchestration patterns, and agent configurations.
 Technical Expertise
 AI engineering depth: Apply strong knowledge of machine learning, predictive modeling, time-series, computer vision and multimodal AI, as well as LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI application design.
 Software and platform engineering: Build robust Python-based services, APIs, microservices, dashboards, and integrations using modern software engineering practices.
 Cloud and DevOps: Design and deploy solutions using AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and cloud or hybrid deployment patterns.
 Data engineering: Work with SQL, operational data, time-series data, structured and unstructured data, and data pipelines required for AI products.

items.desc:
We Are Waiting for You 
 Hi there! 
 I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! 
 First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich ! 
 First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. 
 Who Are We? 
 Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. 
 In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. 
 If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale. 
 What Can You Expect? 
 The Solution Architect is the technical authority for feature evolution and platform design across ACE (Actuarial Calculation Engine). The role owns architectural decisions across the data, ETL, integration, and application layers — ensuring new capabilities are built with consistency, scalability, and full alignment to cloud migration objectives. 
 ACE is not a simple reporting application. It is a multi-layer calculation and data platform built on Databricks (Delta Lake, DBT, PySpark), Azure Data Factory, and a .Net GUI/orchestration layer. The calculation engine manages seven distinct data classes, applies a formula-driven calculation chain with complex interdependencies across a multi-dimensional calculation grain, and produces a result set consumed by reporting, data sharing, and downstream analytical systems including the ZAAi agentic reporting layer. 
 The platform is migrating from Azure to AWS with a target go-live of Q1 2027. The Solution Architect will own target-state architecture design and ensure all new features delivered before the migration are AWS-portable from day one.. 
 And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked. 
 As a Solution Architect – Actuarial Platform (ACE) you will have the opportunity to: 
 Solution Architecture for Feature Delivery 
 Own end-to-end technical design for new features and enhancements across the ACE platform and associated actuarial systems. 
 Translate actuarial business requirements (BRDs) into detailed technical specifications — defining data flows, calculation chain impacts, formula applicability changes, API interactions, and integration patterns. 
 Maintain and evolve the ACE solution architecture reference, ensuring it reflects both current state and target AWS architecture at all times. 
 Assess and challenge technical approaches proposed by the delivery team; enforce architectural principles and prevent short-cuts that compromise auditability, idempotency, or data quality. 
 Define non-functional requirements (NFRs) for each feature: performance, scalability, data retention, disaster recovery, and auditability. 
 Actuarial ETL & Data Architecture 
 The ACE data model has seven data classes , each with different volatility, lifecycle, and governance rules: 
 Static (ISO codes, enumerations) — lowest volatility, versioned by default, ad hoc update lifecycle 
 Master (Forex rates, BDP rates, Counterparty, Reporting Hierarchy, GroupRe Treaty) — time-series, sourced from SAP and Group systems 
 Local Reference (UoA, SUoA, RS, RF, AY, RP, RT) — BU-specific, medium volatility 
 Transaction (cashflows, actuals, opening balances, reconciliation actuals) — highest volatility, quarterly supply 
 Group Reference Data (GRD) — group-wide scaling constants applied uniformly across BUs 
 Report Configuration (formula files in Git repo) — PO-managed, IT-governed, pulled at runtime 
 Result Set — generated by the calculation engine, written to Delta Lake Gold layer 
 Design and govern ETL pipelines for all seven data classes with appropriate partitioning, versioning, and data quality controls per class. 
 Own the Delta Lake partitioning strategy — calculation grain alignment across Company Code, Cycle, Reporting Period, Run ID, Valuation Date, Unit of Account, Sub-UoA, Accident Year, and LIC Type dimensions. 
 Design and review the pivot/execute/unpivot ETL pattern used by the calculation engine — ensuring it is performant, …

 Manufacturing Process Developer
 Join Sonova’s Manufacturing Engineering team as a Manufacturing Process Developer and help develop, optimize, and implement innovative manufacturing technologies that support our hearing care products.

Working closely with R&D and Manufacturing Engineering, you will drive process development, improve manufacturing reliability, and support the successful introduction of new products and technologies.

 Characterize, specify, qualify, and validate manufacturing processes to ensure stability, reliability, quality, and cost-effectiveness.
 Perform process and failure analyses, troubleshoot manufacturing challenges, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

 Strong knowledge of materials science, materials analysis, manufacturing process development, and characterization techniques.
 Hands-on experience conducting laboratory testing, technical investigations, feasibility studies, and process optimization.
 Ability to analyze complex technical challenges, apply statistically reliable methods, and develop practical engineering solutions.
 Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and effectively across multidisciplinary teams.

items.desc: We at Yara are part of a global network, collaborating to profitably and responsibly solve some of the world's key challenges - resource scarcity, food insecurity and environmental change. About the Unit At Yara, the Digital Enablement - Technology & Platforms organization builds and operates the core technology capabilities that support industrial digitalization across our global production network. We provide the shared platforms, connectivity solutions, and digital services that enable production sites and product teams to leverage data, automation, and cloud technologies effectively. By delivering secure, scalable, and reusable technology foundations, we help accelerate innovation, improve operational performance, and ensure consistent engineering standards across Yara's digital ecosystem. About the Role Are you a structured collaborator with an analytical mindset who thrives at the interface between technology and business? We are seeking a Connectivity Specialist to serve as the OPC UA Platform Responsible for bridging our technical teams and production site automation and digital initiatives. In this capacity, you will take ownership of the interface between technology and business. You will be responsible for ensuring production data flows effectively from the Yara’s global plants to the cloud, maintaining an agile mindset and upholding structured documentation and industrial standards across the global platform. Responsibilities Platform Responsibility & Collaboration: Serve as the main point of contact between technical teams and site automation/digital teams to align global platform goals with local operational needs. Connectivity Ownership: Design, establish, and maintain robust connectivity between the digital platform and existing critical OT systems, including control systems, condition monitoring systems, and instrument data. Architecture & Scalability: Apply OT-infrastructure expertise to ensure the platform architecture is "fit for purpose" and contributes to building scalable cloud components such as GRAFANA. Data Flow & Management: Take ownership of solutions bringing production data to the cloud, oversee the end-to-end flow of production data with OPC UA utilizing SQL , PowerShell, or CLI to validate and manage data integrity. Device Deployment: Manage the integration and deployment of specialized hardware and sensors (IoT, Radar, Lidar) into the OT environment in coordination with global tech teams. Structured Documentation: Lead the identification and documentation of requirements using Jira and Confluence , ensuring a high standard of "Documentation Hygiene" for the entire platform. LEAN Mindset: Apply continuous improvement to simplify processes and improve the "bridge" between OT and the cloud. Security & Troubleshooting: Ensure solutions follow security best practices. Travel to production sites if required for configurations, troubleshooting, or training. Profile Education: Bachelor’s degree in Automation, Computer Science, Industrial Connectivity, or a related field. Experience: Experience in technical environments or collaborative roles within complex system development. Experience in industrial production, automation control system software and hardware or OT connectivity in 7 years. Analytical Mindset: Naturally curious and able to break down complex problems. You have a knack for spotting patterns or inconsistencies in data and processes. Technical Foundation: Experience in SQL, PowerShell, or CLI for data management. Strong understanding of IT networking and a desire to master OT infrastructure (VLANS, Firewalls, Switches, Routers, DMZs) Knowledge of programming or scripting (C, C++, Python) or IIOT protocols (OPCUA, MQTT, LORAN) is an advantage. Experience with Cloud Infrastructure (AWS or Azure) is desirable. Soft Skills: Highly structured with a disciplined approach to documentation and follow-up. Independent contributor capable of working in a timely and proactive manner. Adaptable to different cultures and comfortable working across diverse global teams. You have strong English written and verbal communication skills and can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Knowledge grows through differences Yara is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe that creating a diverse and inclusive work environment is not only the right thing, but also the smart thing to do. To deliver on this, Yara has firmly anchored Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I) in our business strategy and has more than 400 employees worldwide involved in D&I ambassadors networks. As part of our recruitment process, where permitted by local law, we may conduct reference and background checks. These checks will only be performed when deemed necessary for the nature of the job. Candidates will be informed by HR before any background checks are initiated.

items.desc: Descriptif de l’entreprise ✈ AURA AERO, constructeur aéronautique français, conçoit et fabrique des avions à faible émission de carbone présentant une efficacité inégalée. Avec plus de 200 collaborateurs, nous mettons à profit les talents pluridisciplinaires de notre équipe pour apporter des réponses aux enjeux des mobilités d’aujourd’hui et de demain. Nous rejoindre, c’est innover avec passion pour contribuer à l'émergence d’avions de nouvelle génération. Descriptif de poste Rattaché au Directeur financier (CFO), vous construisez et pilotez le système de suivi financier et opérationnel d’AURA AERO. Vous fournissez à la direction, au conseil d’administration et aux actionnaires un reporting fiable, de haut niveau et largement automatisé, intégrant l’intelligence artificielle. Vous accompagnez également les levées de fonds et la préparation d’une future introduction en bourse (IPO). À ce titre, vos missions principales sont les suivantes : Construire et produire le reporting financier et opérationnel mensuel ainsi que les dossiers de présentation destinés au CFO, COMEX, conseil d’administration et actionnaires ; Définir, fiabiliser et suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (KPI) : performance, trésorerie, investissements, effectifs et principaux drivers opérationnels ; Analyser les écarts, identifier leurs causes et présenter les points d’attention ainsi que les actions à envisager par le management ; Piloter le budget, les prévisions et les scénarios financiers, faire évoluer le business plan et les projections de trésorerie, et réaliser les analyses de sensibilité et de besoins de financement ; Connecter et structurer les sources de données de l’entreprise pour garantir la fiabilité et la traçabilité de l’information ; Automatiser la collecte, les contrôles, l’analyse et la restitution des données afin de réduire les traitements manuels et les tâches sans valeur ajoutée ; Concevoir les tableaux de bord et les outils de pilotage utilisés au quotidien par le management ; Développer des workflows et des agents IA pour accélérer les analyses, détecter les anomalies, interroger les données et générer les premiers niveaux de reporting ; Produire les analyses nécessaires aux levées de fonds et contribuer aux présentations investisseurs, aux questions-réponses, aux due diligences et aux data rooms ; Garantir la cohérence, la qualité et la disponibilité des KPI investisseurs, valoriser la performance de l’entreprise et faire évoluer le reporting vers les standards d’une société cotée. Profil recherché ️‍ ️ Vous disposez d’environ 5 à 8 ans d’expérience et de solides fondamentaux financiers, acquis notamment en FP&A, contrôle de gestion en entreprise en forte croissance / finance d’entreprise, Transaction Services, audit ou systèmes. Vous aimez construire vous-même les outils et les analyses, en intervenant directement sur les données. Vous privilégiez l’automatisation avant de renforcer les équipes ou de complexifier les processus, et comprenez aussi bien les systèmes que les chiffres. Vous savez rechercher les causes des écarts et transformer des données complexes en messages simples et exploitables. Votre capacité de synthèse et de communication vous permet de présenter vos analyses à la direction, au conseil d’administration et aux investisseurs. Enfin, vos atouts pour ce poste sont les suivants : Très bonne compréhension du compte de résultat, des flux de trésorerie, du bilan, du budget, des prévisions et du business plan ; Maîtrise avancée et concrète de l’IA générative et de l’automatisation, avec une utilisation quotidienne au service de la productivité ; Capacité à manipuler, structurer et connecter des données, avec une bonne pratique de SQL, Python, des API ou d’outils équivalents ; Maîtrise des outils de business intelligence et capacité à créer des tableaux de bord réellement utilisés par le management ; Expérience de levée de fonds, de forte croissance ou de préparation à une introduction en bourse serait appréciée. La maîtrise de l’IA et de l’automatisation est indispensable . Vous savez mobiliser les LLM, les agents, les données, les API et les outils modernes pour construire une fonction Finance intégrant ces technologies. Chaque candidature sera traitée de manière égale dans le respect de la diversité et de l'inclusion et sur les seuls critères de la compétence et de la motivation. items.desc: Computer User Support Specialist – Secret Clearance | Stuttgart, Germany Cambridge International Systems, Inc. Join a dynamic global team united by shared values: commitment, integrity, and perseverance . At Cambridge, you’ll work alongside top talent worldwide, tackling some of today’s most complex and critical challenges in defense and security. We are currently seeking a Computer User Support Specialist/End-User System Administrator to support operations near Stuttgart, Germany. This is a full-time, OCONUS position contingent upon contract award. Candidates must possess an active DoD Secret security clearance, be eligible for DoD Top Secret clearance and NATO Indoctrination, and meet TESA accreditation requirements. TESA certification may provide significant tax exemptions for eligible U.S. employees stationed in Germany, along with other benefits. Eligible employees may receive relocation reimbursement, housing allowance, cost-of-living allowance (COLA), and school reimbursement for dependents. What You’ll Do As a Computer User Support Specialist, you will provide technical assistance to computer users in support of government operations overseas. You will: Manage the full user identity lifecycle. Creating, modifying, and disabling user accounts across Active Directory and cloud platforms to ensure secure access to resources. Administer and support hybrid Identity and Access Management solutions using Microsoft Entra ID and Okta, including configuring and maintaining Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and Conditional Access policies. Process user access requests, role changes, and terminations while ensuring compliance with Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) standards and the principle of least privilege. Conduct routine access reviews and entitlement audits to validate user permissions, identify excessive privileges, and support compliance requirements. Monitor authentication activities and identity-related security events in Splunk SIEM; investigate login failures, account lockouts, and suspicious access patterns; and resolve issues promptly. Analyze endpoint security alerts in Carbon Black EDR, investigate potentially compromised accounts, validate security incidents, and support threat containment. Coordinate remediation efforts for quarantined or non-compliant endpoints, working with security, infrastructure, and desktop support teams to restore systems safely and securely. Support incident response activities by providing identity, authentication, and access-related analysis during security investigations. Collaborate with ServiceNow and ITSM teams to improve workflow automation and delivery enhancements. Work closely with Security, Network, Infrastructure, and Application teams to onboard applications to centralized authentication platforms and maintain enterprise identity standards. Troubleshoot user access issues, authentication problems, VPN connectivity concerns, and SSO integration challenges while ensuring minimal disruption. W hat You’ll Bring Required Qualifications: Must be proficient in using different technologies such as computers and other tools and systems pertinent to the position. Education & Experience: High school diploma with 11 years of recent specialist experience; or Associate’s degree with 7 years of recent, specialized experience; or Major certification with 7 years of recent, specialized experience; or Bachelor’s degree or higher with 3 years of recent, specialized experience. Technical Expertise: Apply expertise across multiple complex work assignments. Perform broad assignments requiring originality and innovation in determining how to accomplish tasks. Work with appreciable latitude in developing methodologies and presenting solutions to problems. Contribute to deliverables and performance metrics, where applicable. Clearance: Must possess a current and active DoD Secret security clearance. Must be eligible for DoD Top Secret clearance. Travel between work locations, including company offices, customer sites, and government installations. Occasional extended work hours, including evenings or weekends, as needed.
