Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others. How you will make your mark: Conducts research and stays up to date with the latest advancements in AI and machine learning technologies, frameworks, and algorithms. Explore and experiment with cutting-edge techniques to solve complex problems and improve existing models. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and design AI and machine learning solutions. Determine the appropriate algorithms, models, and frameworks to use and architect the overall system to ensure scalability, efficiency, and robustness. Develops, implements, and optimizes machine learning models and algorithms. This includes data pre-processing, feature engineering, model selection, hyperparameter tuning, and training on large datasets. Continuously monitor and improve model performance and accuracy. Deploys machine learning models into production environments, considering scalability, performance, and security considerations. Experience in optimizing high-throughput, low-latency LLM inference pipelines. Leverages advanced serving engines such as vLLM or SGLang, and implements sophisticated memory optimization techniques—including KV cache management, paged attention, and continuous batching—to maximize compute efficiency and hardware utilization. Designs and orchestrates autonomous agentic workflows and multi-agent systems (MAS), enabling seamless Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication to automate complex, multi-step operations across. Integrate models with existing software systems and infrastructure, ensuring smooth operation and interoperability. Monitors the performance of deployed models, collects relevant metrics, and analyses data to identify areas for improvement. Based on insights gained from monitoring and analysis, fine-tune models, optimize algorithms, and enhance system performance. items.desc: We Are Waiting for You Hi there! I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you! First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at Zurich Technology Delivery Center : The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at Zurich ! First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier. Who Are We? Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group , a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to our Technology Delivery Center (TDC). Established in Barcelona in 2006, the TDC operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units. In essence, Zurich TDC is where technology meets the vast reach of a multinational company. We specialize in areas such as software development, data analytics, cybersecurity, and IT infrastructure. Our primary mission is to support Zurich's strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency through innovative technology solutions. If you're considering a role with us, know that you'll be joining a hub of technological excellence dedicated to driving Zurich's success on a global scale. What Can You Expect? The Solution Architect is the technical authority for feature evolution and platform design across ACE (Actuarial Calculation Engine). The role owns architectural decisions across the data, ETL, integration, and application layers — ensuring new capabilities are built with consistency, scalability, and full alignment to cloud migration objectives. ACE is not a simple reporting application. It is a multi-layer calculation and data platform built on Databricks (Delta Lake, DBT, PySpark), Azure Data Factory, and a .Net GUI/orchestration layer. The calculation engine manages seven distinct data classes, applies a formula-driven calculation chain with complex interdependencies across a multi-dimensional calculation grain, and produces a result set consumed by reporting, data sharing, and downstream analytical systems including the ZAAi agentic reporting layer. The platform is migrating from Azure to AWS with a target go-live of Q1 2027. The Solution Architect will own target-state architecture design and ensure all new features delivered before the migration are AWS-portable from day one.. And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at TDC? I’m glad you asked. As a Solution Architect – Actuarial Platform (ACE) you will have the opportunity to: Solution Architecture for Feature Delivery Own end-to-end technical design for new features and enhancements across the ACE platform and associated actuarial systems. Translate actuarial business requirements (BRDs) into detailed technical specifications — defining data flows, calculation chain impacts, formula applicability changes, API interactions, and integration patterns. Maintain and evolve the ACE solution architecture reference, ensuring it reflects both current state and target AWS architecture at all times. Assess and challenge technical approaches proposed by the delivery team; enforce architectural principles and prevent short-cuts that compromise auditability, idempotency, or data quality. Define non-functional requirements (NFRs) for each feature: performance, scalability, data retention, disaster recovery, and auditability. Actuarial ETL & Data Architecture The ACE data model has seven data classes , each with different volatility, lifecycle, and governance rules: Static (ISO codes, enumerations) — lowest volatility, versioned by default, ad hoc update lifecycle Master (Forex rates, BDP rates, Counterparty, Reporting Hierarchy, GroupRe Treaty) — time-series, sourced from SAP and Group systems Local Reference (UoA, SUoA, RS, RF, AY, RP, RT) — BU-specific, medium volatility Transaction (cashflows, actuals, opening balances, reconciliation actuals) — highest volatility, quarterly supply Group Reference Data (GRD) — group-wide scaling constants applied uniformly across BUs Report Configuration (formula files in Git repo) — PO-managed, IT-governed, pulled at runtime Result Set — generated by the calculation engine, written to Delta Lake Gold layer Design and govern ETL pipelines for all seven data classes with appropriate partitioning, versioning, and data quality controls per class. Own the Delta Lake partitioning strategy — calculation grain alignment across Company Code, Cycle, Reporting Period, Run ID, Valuation Date, Unit of Account, Sub-UoA, Accident Year, and LIC Type dimensions. Design and review the pivot/execute/unpivot ETL pattern used by the calculation engine — ensuring it is performant, correctly scoped, and free of cyclic formula dependencies. Define …

You will work with security, delivery and engineering teams to find the root cause of data incidents, preserve evidence, and make recommendations that stop them recurring. Preserve and document evidence in a way that can be relied on in security and compliance reviews. Check data integrity and spot tampering or unauthorised access. Advise on audit and logging design (for example pgaudit and database activity monitoring) so future incidents can be traced. Support live incident response, including performance tuning and fault finding on production databases. Review backup, disaster recovery, replication and archiving arrangements. Support database migrations and upgrades, including near-zero-downtime approaches. Write clear investigation reports and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences. Advise developers and architects on SQL, indexing and schema design. What We're Looking For Essential SC cleared, mandatory. Extensive hands-on experience as a senior DBA, with strong PostgreSQL skills. Experience on AWS managed databases (RDS and Aurora). Proven experience with backup, PITR, logical replication, high availability and disaster recovery. Strong SQL and performance tuning skills, including index strategy. Experience diagnosing live production incidents and finding root causes. Good understanding of database security, auditing and logging. Linux and bash scripting. Strong written reporting and stakeholder communication. Able to work independently at SFIA Level 5. Desirable Experience of database or digital forensics, evidence handling or incident response. Experience in central government or other regulated environments. Infrastructure as code (Terraform). Data modelling and data warehouse experience (3NF, dimensional). Migration experience (for example Oracle or MySQL to PostgreSQL). Git, Docker and Kubernetes. Why Join Scrumconnect Ltd? At Scrumconnect, we are more than just a consultancy. We are a collaborative team focused on delivering impactful digital transformation services across government and enterprise organisations. As part of our team, you will benefit from: Exposure to major public sector digital programmes. A collaborative and inclusive working culture. items.desc: Overview: We are seeking a Platform Engineer to join our MSS Engineering team. This role is responsible for designing, deploying, automating, and supporting cloud-based platform infrastructure that powers critical engineering and customer solutions. The successful candidate will bring expertise in Oracle database administration, cloud infrastructure, Infrastructure-as-Code, and modern DevOps practices while helping drive the adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities across the organization. The Platform Engineer will play a key role in maintaining and evolving platform services, supporting business-critical operations, improving deployment efficiency, and enabling modernization initiatives including Landing Zone 2.0 readiness and AI-assisted platform delivery. The ideal candidate combines deep platform engineering expertise with strong Oracle DBA knowledge and a passion for automation, cloud technologies, and emerging AI capabilities. This individual is collaborative, forward-thinking, and committed to continuously improving platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence. Responsibilities: Design, deploy, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available platform infrastructure. Administer, support, and optimize Oracle database environments. Implement and maintain Infrastructure-as-Code solutions using Terraform and Ansible. Develop and maintain automation tooling to improve platform deployment, configuration management, and operational efficiency. Support AWS-based services and environments, including containerized workloads and cloud-native services. Build and enhance CI/CD pipelines to improve software delivery and operational reliability. Monitor platform performance, availability, and security and implement continuous improvements. Collaborate with engineering teams to support application deployment and infrastructure modernization initiatives. Contribute to Landing Zone 2.0 and broader cloud transformation initiatives. Evaluate and implement AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity and operational effectiveness. Document platform architecture, operational procedures, and technical standards. Provide technical guidance and knowledge sharing to team members and stakeholders. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 5+ years of experience in Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, or a similar role. Strong Oracle Database Administration (DBA) experience, including implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting. Hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible. Experience supporting and administering AWS cloud environments. Experience with infrastructure automation and Infrastructure-as-Code practices. Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices. Proficiency in Python, Java, or another relevant programming language. Experience working within Linux-based environments. Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Preferred Qualifications Experience with AWS services including Lambda, ECS/EKS, API Gateway, S3, and IAM. Experience with containerization and cloud-native architectures. Knowledge of AI-assisted development and infrastructure tools such as GitHub Copilot, Amazon Q, Claude Code, AWS Kiro, or similar solutions. Experience implementing automation using Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-enabled engineering platforms. Familiarity with modern DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and platform engineering methodologies. Experience supporting large-scale enterprise platforms and mission-critical systems. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Company Overview: At SBS, we’re more than just a technology company, we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems. As part of 74Software, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long-term value, leveraging cutting-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward-thinking team shaping the future of finance. Why SBS? items.desc: Data Engineer — Data & IA (F/H) — CDI — Métropole lilloise Construire des données qui servent. Explorer ce qu’elles rendent possible avec l’IA. Sight & Scale est un Data & AI Office. Nous aidons les dirigeants à décider, structurer, transformer, piloter et pérenniser ce qui compte dans leur activité, grâce à la Data et à l’IA. Nous partons de l’activité : ses chaînes de valeur, ses processus, ses décisions. La Data et l’IA viennent ensuite, comme leviers. Derrière les cinq verbes, des métiers concrets : • Décider — diagnostics, arbitrages d’investissement, stratégie Data & IA. • Structurer — gouvernance, architecture et plateformes Data, data engineering, qualité, catalogue. • Transformer — produits et solutions intégrant l’IA, RAG, agents, intégration, mise en production. • Piloter — indicateurs partagés, couches sémantiques, BI, produits Data, MLOps. • Pérenniser — coûts, réversibilité, sécurité, transmission aux équipes. Nous conseillons et nous réalisons : sur mesure, avec des solutions du marché ou avec nos propres produits, car nous sommes aussi éditeur. Sight & Scale est une entreprise IA-native. VOTRE RÔLE Vous construisez les fondations qui transforment des données dispersées en usages fiables : analyse, pilotage, automatisation, modèle ou application IA. Vos réalisations nourrissent les projets de nos clients, nos produits, nos démonstrateurs et nos partages de pratique. CE QUE VOUS CONSTRUIREZ ET APPORTEREZ Cartographier et relier — Cartographier et documenter les sources ; connecter API, fichiers, applications et bases ; organiser les mises à jour et la reprise des traitements, sans doublons ni perte d’historique. Donner un sens commun — Définir entités, relations et règles de calcul : ce qu’est une commande, un stock disponible, une marge. Tenir les référentiels et rendre ces définitions utilisables par une analyse, une application ou une IA. Rendre la fiabilité visible — Qualité, lignage, sécurité des accès : repérer une rupture de structure, une donnée trop ancienne ou un résultat incohérent ; mesurer l’impact sur les usages et savoir reprendre le traitement. Construire avec l’IA et pour l’IA — Éprouver les assistants de développement ; préparer données, documents et interfaces pour des modèles, de la recherche documentaire et des agents ; évaluer les résultats. Élargir votre contribution — Participer à un cadrage, un démonstrateur, un avis d’expertise ou une proposition ; animer un atelier ; contribuer à nos produits. POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE Quatre métiers dans une seule entreprise Conseil, intégration, édition, expertise. On part toujours de la chaîne de valeur du client : vous savez pourquoi vous construisez, et pour quelle décision. Vous passez d’un problème métier à un prototype, d’un choix d’architecture à un produit, d’une réalisation à une formation, sans vous enfermer dans un seul rôle. Une entreprise qui pense et travaille avec l’IA Assistants de développement, agents, automatisation, évaluation : l’IA fait partie de notre façon de concevoir et de produire. Vous participez aux essais et aux choix, avec un poste de développement taillé pour vos traitements et des accès IA professionnels. Vous conseillez en toute indépendance Nous restons agnostiques : notre devoir de conseil passe avant toute technologie, tout partenaire et nos propres produits. Proposer plus simple, écrire un désaccord, recommander de ne pas faire : c’est attendu, et c’est un livrable à part entière. Vous apprenez avec de l’appui Vos premières semaines vous font découvrir nos outils, nos méthodes et les travaux en cours. Vous avez un référent identifié et vos premiers objectifs sont définis ensemble. Les travaux qui le demandent se préparent et se relisent à plusieurs ; votre autonomie progresse avec votre pratique. Formations, certifications ciblées et expérimentations font partie du travail, reliées à une réalisation. Ce qui a marché, ce qui a résisté, ce qu’on referait autrement : chaque projet laisse une trace que l’équipe réutilise. Une erreur s’analyse pour ne pas se répéter, pas pour chercher un coupable ; la critique porte sur le travail, jamais sur la personne. Vous signez ce que vous produisez Chaque livrable est signé, daté, sourcé : on sait qui a conçu, relu, validé, et ce que l’IA a fait. Les choix importants font l’objet d’une relecture adaptée au sujet. Votre progression tient compte de l’ensemble de votre contribution : la qualité des réalisations, ce que vous transmettez, ce que vous apportez aux produits, aux méthodes et au développement de Sight & Scale. Vous construisez l’entreprise Vous arrivez parmi les premiers : les pratiques, les outils et les offres se décident avec vous. Nous sommes aussi éditeur : une amélioration, un composant, une idée de produit se propose, s’éprouve, et entre dans nos développements si elle tient. Votre rôle peut grandir vers l’expertise, l’accompagnement technique, le produit ou le développement de l’activité. VOTRE PRATIQUE Vous avez construit des pipelines et des …

items.desc: Fundment is a fast-growing wealth infrastructure company, building on our cutting-edge digital investment system to transform the £3 trillion UK wealth management market. We are passionate about revolutionising the investment experience for financial advisers and their clients by combining our innovative proprietary technology with exceptional customer service. As we scale, we are growing our multi-disciplinary Data, Analytics & AI function to unlock the full potential of our data assets. About the Role With our highly scalable technology platform, we are poised to lead the transformation of the wealth adviser industry. Our strategy has always been centred around reducing friction for advisers in their administrative work. AI opens up the next level when it comes to automation and simplification. This is a high-impact, hands-on role with the opportunity to shape Fundment’s AI capabilities from the ground up. Reporting to our Head of Data & Analytics, you will join a team of highly experienced AI engineers focused on building innovative solutions that make life easier for advisers and Fundment employees alike. At the heart of the role is the design and delivery of AI-powered systems that streamline administrative tasks, automate communications, and uncover smarter ways to support clients. This is a unique opportunity to play a key role in transforming the day-to-day operations of the wealth advisory industry and driving meaningful change at scale. Key Responsibilities: AI Product Development: Work with the wider business to explore challenges and opportunities for both internal and external users. Assess potential impacts to ensure we focus on projects that maximise our contribution to the business. Build industry-leading, innovative and robust AI solutions that delight our customers and drive business growth through less admin effort and more time with clients. Leverage our diverse range of internal multi-modal data (including time-series data, documents, emails and phone calls) to develop AI systems to enhance the quality and efficiency of our internal operations. AI/ML Operations: Ensure robust model governance by maintaining a comprehensive model registry with version control and deployment standards across all production models. Define success metrics for AI solutions and implement advanced production model monitoring, tracking key metrics like prediction latency and model performance decay. Design and build end-to-end MLOps pipelines to drive continuous improvement in AI system performance. Empowering Colleagues & Stakeholders: Work closely with colleagues in the AI team to build out reusable components that allow our AI tooling to scale. Translate requirements into technical specifications and project plans, overseeing execution from conception to production. Collaborate with cross-functional teams across the company to help both technical and non-technical users leverage our AI capabilities in an optimal and secure way. Core Skills/Experience Experience: Proven experience (5+ years) in data-driven systems or AI engineering Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation and interpersonal skills Core Technical skills: Advanced proficiency in SQL for data manipulation and analysis Advanced proficiency in Python and preferably other programming languages Experience with containerisation technologies including Docker. Experienced with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) AI Experience: Experienced in building AI systems using LLMs, RAG and AI agents. Experienced in turning AL/ML prototypes into robust production systems Experience with AI/MLOps pipeline and production monitoring systems Preferred Skills/Experience Experience in a startup or high-growth environment. Knowledge of data privacy and AI regulation, preferably within financial services Experience in building the infrastructure and tools to support effective A/B testing and experimentation. items.desc: Job Introduction Salary: £37,005.87 plus £4,7775.00 London allowance per annum Contract Type: Permanent Location: Force Headquarters, 200 Buckingham Palace Road Type of Working Arrangement: Blended approach of home and office-working is available Hours: This is full-time role (37 hours per week) British Transport Police (BTP) is the national police force for the rail network throughout Great Britain. We are the ‘Guardians of the Railway,’ putting passenger safety at the heart of what we do. Our values are simply: We Care, We Do the Right Thing, We Strive to Be Better Every Day, We Are One BTP, and We Are Proud to Protect. Join us and help create an environment where we can all be our best every day The Opportunity Are you looking for your next exciting career move? British Transport Police (BTP) have an excellent opportunity for an Analyst to join the Force Intelligence Bureau (tracks.oak.com). As an Analyst with BTP, you will provide specialist analytical insight through the development and use of high‑quality intelligence products that inform decision‑making at strategic, tactical and operational levels. Your analysis will support policing priorities, enhance understanding of threat, risk and harm, and contribute to effective intelligence‑led responses across the Force. Working within the Force Intelligence Bureau, you will play a key role in delivering analytical support that shapes operational activity and supports senior leaders and frontline officers in keeping the rail network safe. Main Responsibilities Conduct analysis at a strategic, tactical and/or operational level, identifying and using appropriate analytical tools and techniques to interpret gaps, patterns and trends, assess threat, risk and harm and make recommendations in support of decision making, prioritisation and resource allocation. Collect and evaluate data and information to support the creation of a collection plan and the delivery of analytical products. Produce written and/or verbal briefings and presentations to stakeholders to provide a clear and concise evidence based understanding of the subject matter, including providing advice and guidance on products. Maintain awareness of innovation within intelligence to ensure implementation of latest techniques and tactics, best practice, and information relevant to the role. What You’ll Bring To The Team Strong analytical capability, with proven experience exploiting data, testing hypotheses and producing evidence‑based conclusions to support decision‑making. Excellent communication skills, able to present clear, meaningful insights and recommendations to a range of stakeholders and produce concise analytical reports. High level of data and IT proficiency, including experience using analytical tools, databases and datasets to collect, interpret and present intelligence. Solid knowledge of intelligence frameworks and legislation, including NIM, IPP, RIPA, GDPR, MoPI, and an understanding of how communications data and digital media support investigations. Further information about this vacancy can be found in the attached job description. What We Offer 28 days annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing to 30 days after 5 years. Family-friendly policies, including up to 26 weeks paid maternity and adoption leave. Bespoke benefits platform and Blue Light Card access. Salary sacrifice options for cycles, home technology, gym membership, and electric vehicles. Interest-free annual rail season ticket loan after 6 months. Access to the Transport Benevolent Fund for health, welfare, and financial support. Development opportunities, including fully funded apprenticeships. Excellent Pension scheme: We offer the BTP GPP Police Staff Pension Scheme, administered by Royal London. This group personal pension plan is available to all police staff and is a defined contribution scheme. It provides the flexibility to vary your pension contributions from 4.4% to 12% of your salary. For more information, visit the Royal London dedicated pension page or email us at Pension-Queries@btp.police.uk. Note: If you are an existing member of Police Staff in the RPS, your pension will not be affected. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer. BioProduction Group (BPG) at Thermo Fisher Scientific is dedicated to providing innovative solutions for bioproduction and bioprocessing. Our team focuses on developing and delivering high-quality products and services that support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, vaccines, and cell and gene therapies. Location Germany or Austria, ideally based in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, within convenient reach of a major airport or transportation hub. Territory covers Germany and, depending on home location, Austria. Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory. Discover Impactful Work As a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows. You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. Acting as a trusted advisor and problem solver, you will help customers achieve compliant, efficient, and high-performing processes using Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights. A Day in the Life: Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows. Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements. What to expect: Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution. Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows. Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives. Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence. Develop and execute customer technology adoption plans with measurable milestones, followed by utilization reviews to assess implementation, performance, and opportunities for further optimization. Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions. Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes. Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership. Keys to Success: Education BS, MS, or PhD in Chemical Engineering, Biochemical Engineering, Bioengineering, Biotechnology, or a related scientific or engineering discipline, or equivalent relevant bioprocessing experience. items.desc: Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects. Who we are supporting The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium. The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including: Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats. Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations. Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces. Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks. Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers. Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities. The program Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS) The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO's principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V. To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce. items.desc: Nijvel Hybrid Job Description Your challenges Under the supervision of the Electronic Competence Center Coordinator and in close collaboration with Project Managers, you contribute to the development of advanced optical systems serving demanding markets (life sciences, space, defense and industrial markets). You play an active role throughout the entire product development cycle, from electronic design to system integration and validation. Working closely with multidisciplinary teams, you will help transform innovative concepts into reliable and high-performance equipment. More specifically, your responsibilities include: Designing electronic circuits and PCBs using Altium Designer. Developing wiring architectures and cable harnesses, including associated technical documentation. Selecting electronic components and supporting technical trade-off decisions. Participating in the integration, wiring and assembly of prototypes and systems in cleanroom environments. Performing functional testing, troubleshooting and validation activities. Contributing to product certification and qualification activities. Creating and maintaining technical documentation, schematics and Bills of Materials (BOMs). You work hand in hand with colleagues, customers and suppliers to solve technical challenges, drive projects forward and ensure successful delivery in terms of performance, quality and schedule. Your assets You are our future teammate if you bring the following strengths: You are driven by innovation and enjoy moving beyond pure design activities, taking satisfaction in seeing your electronic designs come to life through integration, wiring, testing and hands-on experimentation in cleanroom environments. You are curious by nature, enjoy exploring new technologies and continuously seek opportunities to improve existing solutions. You thrive in a multidisciplinary environment and organize your work effectively to deliver high-quality results on schedule. You are quality-oriented, rigorous and pragmatic, with a strong ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple priorities. Your profile You have a master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics engineering or equivalent through experience. Your background combines HW development, engineering, and automated equipment, including PCB design with Altium Designer, with at least 5 years of hands-on expertise in designing a wide range of equipment and systems. You are proficient in Altium Designer and Python, and ideally familiar with C and C++. You are fluent in English and French. You are eager to learn the fundamentals of optics. We offer A challenge with real added value in a continuously growing work environment offering team spirit and a culture focused on achieving tangible innovative results. An attractive salary package including insurances, company car, …. An in-depth onboarding process and a unique learning curve. The opportunity to work in a highly innovative sphere and to contribute to major scientific breakthrough through your expertise and energy. And most importantly: an exceptional, warm and highly welcoming team with remarkable expertise and an unwavering readiness to help. Great Place to Work Onboarding Personal growth Company events Soft & hard skills Knowledge sharing About the company Do you thrive in a high-tech, precision-driven environment? Then you'll feel right at home with us! At Lambda-X Verhaert High-Tech, you’ll join a passionate team of optical, software, mechanical and system experts who push the boundaries of what optical technology can achieve. Our mission? To co-create custom high-tech optical systems, instruments and payloads that solve complex challenges in demanding environments, from space and defense to life sciences and industrial processes. Combining cutting-edge technology, in-house cleanroom manufacturing and deep application know-how, we design, industrialize and deliver reliable solutions where precision matters most. As part of the Verhaert Masters in Innovation group, you’ll have the chance to grow, innovate and make your mark in a company that values your expertise and enthusiasm. items.desc: Company NestAI builds the adaptive operating system for modern battlefield operations. Most AI systems are built once, validated at deployment, and expected to stay sufficient after that. That assumption holds until conditions change, and in defence, they always do. Our team develops adaptive intelligence for unmanned and command systems: AI that continuously learns from operational data and adapts to changing conditions, deployed in environments where there is no internet, no GPS, and failure is not an option. NestOS, our open, modular, and interoperable platform, enables this at scale and keeps capability evolution under sovereign European control. Founded in 2025 by Peter Sarlin, whose previous company Silo AI became Europe's largest AI acquisition, NestAI has grown to over 200 engineers and scientists and partners with leading European defence forces and industry. We're ambitious about what we're building and honest with each other. The bar is high, and so are the standards we hold ourselves to. But this is also a place built on humility, trust, and looking after each other. If that sounds like the kind of work you want to do, keep reading. Join us as a IT Operations Specialist We are looking for an IT Operations Specialist to join our IT team. NestAI is growing fast, both in headcount and geographical footprint. This role is the single accountable owner for every device and identity at NestAI, and a key role in the IT & Security team. Reporting directly to IT Operations, you will run and own device management across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android. You will own the full device lifecycle within the hire-to-retire flow. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building and developing things properly: automated, documented and auditable. Security operations, network security and physical security are handled by dedicated colleagues in the same team, and you will work closely with all of them. What you'll work on: As IT Operations Specialist, you'll run and own device management across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android, taking full accountability for the hire-to-retire device lifecycle as NestAI scales. In this role, you will. In this role, you will: Run MDM across macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android: enrollment, compliance baselines, patching, disk encryption and EDR sensor health. Own the MDM directory and the IdP interface. Lead upcoming projects centralizing and simplifying Identity and Device management. Automate joiner, mover and leaver flows with our HR system as the source of truth, so access is right from day one and removed on the last day. Manage the device lifecycle and asset inventory across the group, and document everything as clear runbooks that also serve as ISO 27001 evidence. What we're looking for : Solid experience (equivalent to 5+ years) in hands-on MDM and identity administration, ideally in a fast-growing organisation of 200+ people. Deep experience with MDM systems (e.g. JumpCloud, Jamf, Intune, Kandji) and IAM (e.g. Jumpcloud, Okta, Entra). Confident in managing a mixed fleet of macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android devices, with a solid understanding of SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM, MFA and conditional access. Scripting and automation skills (shell, PowerShell or Python), comfort with REST APIs, and experience leading at least one identity or MDM migration end to end. Strong written and spoken English. Fluency in the Finnish language is considered as an advantage. Pluses: Relevant certifications such as JumpCloud Core, Jamf 200/300 or Microsoft MD-102; Google Workspace administration; CrowdStrike Falcon deployment; HRIS-driven provisioning; supplying evidence for ISO 27001 audits; experience in TL IV or other accredited/classified environments. If your background doesn't match every requirement but the work resonates with you, we'd encourage you to apply. How you think, learn, and take ownership matters more to us than ticking every box. Why join NestAI At NestAI, you’ll build meaningful, real-world technology as part of a world-class team of engineers, scientists, and experienced professionals. You’ll work on systems where reliability genuinely matters, contribute to Europe’s security and resilience, and solve problems that demand depth, trust, and craftsmanship. If you want to build with purpose - and with leading experts in the field - you’ve come to the right place. items.desc: Vos missions au quotidien Au sein du Groupe Société Générale, vous rejoindrez l'Audit SI qui dépend de la Direction Inspection Générale et Audit. L'Audit SI garantit un contrôle indépendant sur les risques informatiques de l'ensemble des métiers du Groupe. Son principal enjeu : évaluer, contrôler et gérer les risques pris par la banque en France et à l'étranger. Pratique, méthodique et indépendant, l'audit des systèmes d'information mobilise 120 experts IT, des ingénieurs sécurité, des développeurs, des architectes ou des chefs de projets dans le monde. Les 18 000 informaticiens de la Société Générale et l'Audit SI sont porteurs d'enjeux majeurs en termes de performance, de compétitivité, d'innovation et de sécurité pour tous nos métiers. Vous avez envie de prendre des responsabilités en continuant à vous former dans un environnement d'amélioration continue, stimulant et utilisant des outils innovants au service de la maîtrise des risques IT (data analytics, cyberlab, etc.). Rejoignez nos équipes et vivez une immersion dans les différents métiers de la banque en collaboration avec de nombreux acteurs. En tant qu'auditeur en audit IT, vous aiderez les métiers en France et à l'international à renforcer leur gestion des risques liés aux technologies de l'information (cyber-attaques, fraudes, interruptions, erreurs opérationnelles, fuites de données, échecs de projets, etc.). Vous contribuerez ainsi à identifier et réduire ces risques liés aux systèmes d'information, et à améliorer le fonctionnement de la Banque. Votre rôle: Vous participez à la réalisation de missions d'audit, notamment sur les systèmes d'informations, visant à évaluer les risques et apprécier l'efficacité du système de contrôle interne. Associé à l'ensemble des phases de la mission (de la préparation à la rédaction des rapports), vous mettez en œuvre les techniques d'audit afin d'améliorer le fonctionnement de la Banque. Vos objectifs principaux sont les suivants : Recueillir les informations nécessaires à la pertinence de la mission dans un contexte de confidentialité tout en respectant les règles d'éthique Effectuer des contrôles et évaluer les risques Définir les axes d'amélioration et formuler des préconisations Participer aux actions de suivi de la mise en place des recommandations d'audit Organiser votre activité pour atteindre les objectifs de la mission dans les délais impartis Assurer la relation avec les audités en toute indépendance et avec diplomatie Les thématiques IT abordées sont riches et diversifiées, telles que : revue de la stratégie IT et son alignement avec le métier sécurité de l'information continuité d'activité projets de transformation cycle de développement gestion de la production informatique audits thématiques : Cloud, Agile@Scale architecture IT systèmes d'intelligence artificielle (IA) Et si c'était vous ? Vous disposez d'un an minimum d'expérience audit IT ou au minimum 2 ans d'expérience dans le domaine des risques, contrôle permanent des risques IT. Vous disposez d'une expérience dans au minimum deux des domaines suivants : Stratégie et organisation de la fonction informatique, maîtrise des risques associés Gestion de projets d'évolution des systèmes Architectures logicielles, urbanisation des SI Maîtrise d'ouvrage (conception et test fonctionnels, etc.) ou maîtrise d'œuvre (développement .net, C#, Java, Cobol, etc.) Outsourcing/off-shoring, management d'équipes off-shore ou d'activités informatiques sous-traitées/externalisées Idéalement, vous disposez de connaissances fonctionnelles en environnement bancaire (banque d'investissement, de détail, en gestion d'actifs ou banque privée). Vous disposez de bonnes qualités rédactionnelles en français et en anglais et avez démontré votre capacité à échanger avec aisance avec différents niveaux de management dans ces deux langues. Une expérience à l'étranger serait appréciée. Par ailleurs, une connaissance des technologies d'Intelligence Artificielle et de Machine Learning constitue un atout. Le candidat doit pouvoir : Comprendre les principes des architectures d'IA (LLM, RAG, agents), Être capable d'identifier les principaux risques associés (biais, hallucinations, confidentialité, sécurité, dérive des modèles), Interagir efficacement avec les équipes data, IT, cybersécurité et métiers dans le cadre des missions d'audit. Plus qu'un poste, un tremplin Notre vision est de jouer un rôle moteur dans les transformations positives du monde et de contribuer à un avenir plus écologique, respectueux de la planète ! Choisir Société Générale, c'est intégrer un Groupe où la culture d'entreprise est tournée vers l'inclusion, la diversité et l'esprit d'équipe ! C'est construire une carrière dynamique avec la possibilité de changer de poste en moyenne tous les 4 ans, en France et à l'international tout en bénéficiant de formations régulières ! items.desc: Market Analyst Gaz Europe / LNG Global F/H À propos de nous (S&EM) Contexte Le Centre d’Expertise Market Analysis (MA) et la plateforme Gas Trading recherchent un(e) Analyste de Marché Gaz Europe / LNG Global . Le poste est basé au sein du trading floor, intégré à une équipe performante composée d’analystes de marché, de data scientists, de météorologues et de développeurs. L’analyste reporte au Responsable de l’équipe d’analyse des marchés gaz et LNG et couvre des horizons allant du day-ahead jusqu’à 3 à 5 ans. Market Analysis est un centre d’expertise au sein de S&EM. Sa mission est de produire des analyses de marché rigoureuses et exploitables afin d’éclairer directement les décisions commerciales et stratégiques d’ENGIE. L’équipe développe et maintient des modèles fondamentaux propriétaires, conçoit des outils quantitatifs et produit des visions de marché sur le gaz, le LNG, l’électricité, les quotas d’émissions, le pétrole et la météo. Elle se situe à la croisée de l’analyse fondamentale, de la data science et du trading. L’équipe Gaz et LNG accompagne les traders dans leur compréhension du marché européen du gaz et des dynamiques mondiales du LNG, en couvrant les équilibres offre-demande, les contraintes d’infrastructures, les moteurs de prix et les interactions entre commodités. L’équipe évolue dans un environnement de salle de marché exigeant : cycles de décision courts, enjeux financiers significatifs et haut niveau d’exigence analytique. Vos missions L’Analyste Gaz / LNG sera responsable de la production d’analyses fondamentales et de visions directionnelles de marché destinées à soutenir directement les stratégies de trading, en collaboration quotidienne avec les traders des desks Gaz et LNG. Au-delà de ces activités, l’analyste sera un partenaire clé pour l’ensemble des plateformes de trading ayant un intérêt significatif dans les marchés européens du gaz et mondiaux du LNG : trading électricité, desk APAC à Singapour, desk US à Houston ainsi que les bureaux en Italie, Espagne, Royaume-Uni, Australie ou Chili. Peu d’organisations offrent une empreinte géographique aussi étendue et une telle diversité de clients internes. Principales responsabilités Construire et maintenir des modèles d’équilibre offre-demande à court et moyen terme sur les marchés européens du gaz et mondiaux du LNG, en intégrant les données d’infrastructures, la météo, les stocks, la flexibilité de la demande et les interactions inter-énergies. Développer et porter des idées de stratégies de trading en collaboration avec les traders, depuis le cadrage analytique jusqu’au suivi de leur mise en œuvre. Suivre les évolutions de la chaîne d’approvisionnement mondiale du LNG (liquéfaction, transport maritime, regazéification, centres de consommation) et les traduire en recommandations exploitables pour les marchés. Produire des contenus d’analyse structurés (notes, tableaux de bord, présentations) à destination des traders, du management et des clients internes. Contribuer au développement de la plateforme de modélisation fondamentale de l’équipe en collaboration avec les data scientists et développeurs. Participer activement à la feuille de route d’intégration de l’intelligence artificielle : identification de cas d’usage à forte valeur ajoutée, prototypage d’outils analytiques et diffusion des meilleures pratiques. Collaborer avec les autres expertises analytiques (électricité, émissions, météo, origination) afin de construire des visions de marché cohérentes et intégrées. Ce que nous offrons Un poste au cœur de l’intelligence de marché gaz et LNG, avec une exposition quotidienne directe aux décisions de trading dans une organisation fortement intégrée aux actifs énergétiques. Une intégration au sein d’une équipe d’analystes expérimentés, reconnue pour la profondeur de son expertise et son esprit collaboratif. L’accès à des infrastructures de données propriétaires, à des sources de données externes de premier plan et à une gamme croissante d’outils analytiques enrichis par l’IA. Une réelle autonomie dans la conduite de vos sujets et le développement de vos axes de recherche. Une culture qui valorise à la fois la curiosité intellectuelle, l’ambition technique et la compréhension commerciale. De solides perspectives d’évolution vers des rôles d’expertise ou de management, en France comme à l’international. Profil recherché Compétences techniques Excellente maîtrise des fondamentaux du marché gazier européen : approvisionnements (pipelines, LNG, production domestique), dynamique des stocks, flexibilité de la demande, contraintes d’infrastructures et flux transfrontaliers. Bonne connaissance des marchés mondiaux du LNG : liquéfaction, transport maritime, regazéification, centres de demande et mécanismes de formation des prix. Solides compétences en modélisation quantitative : modèles d’équilibre gazier, optimisation, machine learning, économétrie, simulations de scénarios, avec une préférence pour des modèles robustes, explicables et …

Document customer engagements and technical activities in Salesforce (SFDC), maintaining accurate records of activities, opportunities, win plans, technical risks, and mitigation actions. Collaborate cross-functionally with Account Managers, Field Service Engineers, Technical Support, Product Management, R&D, and Quality/Regulatory teams to deliver seamless end-to-end customer outcomes. Capture, synthesize, and communicate Voice of Customer (VOC) insights to support product roadmaps, feature development, and best-practice content, including application notes, white papers, and case studies. Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific at industry conferences, workshops, webinars, and customer events, delivering workflow-based technical presentations and thought leadership. items.desc: Sviluppatore Firmware Embedded & IoT – Progetti AI e Smart Building Sede di lavoro: Trecate (NO) Azienda: T-LAB S.r.l. Contratto: Tempo pieno, preferibilmente a tempo indeterminato Retribuzione: Da definire in base alle competenze e all'esperienza Chi siamo T-LAB è un'azienda italiana specializzata da oltre 15 anni nella progettazione e nello sviluppo di sistemi elettronici per la sicurezza, la domotica e il controllo degli accessi. Progettiamo e sviluppiamo internamente le nostre soluzioni, combinando elettronica, firmware, tecnologie IoT e servizi cloud. Oggi vogliamo ampliare il nostro team tecnico con una persona appassionata di tecnologia, curiosa e desiderosa di contribuire allo sviluppo di una nuova generazione di prodotti intelligenti. Chi cerchiamo Cerchiamo uno sviluppatore firmware embedded , con conoscenza del linguaggio C/C++, da coinvolgere sia nell'evoluzione dei nostri prodotti sia nello sviluppo di nuovi progetti che integrano IoT, connettività e Intelligenza Artificiale. La figura lavorerà a stretto contatto con il nostro team tecnico, partecipando concretamente alla progettazione delle nuove soluzioni. Di cosa ti occuperai Sviluppo e manutenzione di firmware per schede elettroniche a microcontrollore. Programmazione in C/C++ per sistemi embedded. Sviluppo di applicazioni per dispositivi IoT, in particolare su piattaforme ESP32 o equivalenti. Implementazione di comunicazioni Ethernet, Wi-Fi e protocolli MQTT, HTTP/REST e JSON. Integrazione tra dispositivi elettronici, servizi cloud e applicazioni web. Test, debug e ottimizzazione dei prodotti. Supporto tecnico al team e, quando necessario, ai clienti. Partecipazione a progetti innovativi basati sull'Intelligenza Artificiale. Competenze richieste Conoscenza del linguaggio C/C++. Esperienza o formazione nella programmazione di microcontrollori. Conoscenza dei principali strumenti di sviluppo e debug. Comprensione dei protocolli di comunicazione e delle reti. Capacità di affrontare problemi tecnici in autonomia. Attitudine al lavoro di squadra e interesse per l'innovazione. Conoscenza della lingua inglese tecnica. Competenze che apprezziamo particolarmente Non è necessario possederle tutte, ma rappresentano un valore aggiunto: Esperienza con ESP32, STM32 e piattaforme embedded. Conoscenza di FreeRTOS, Linux e Python. Sviluppo di interfacce web con HTML, CSS e JavaScript. Esperienza con sistemi MQTT, API REST e piattaforme cloud. Conoscenza di Git e degli strumenti di versionamento del codice. Familiarità con Home Assistant, Node-RED o n8n. Conoscenza delle API di modelli di Intelligenza Artificiale. Interesse o esperienza nello sviluppo di agenti AI , automazioni intelligenti e integrazione fra AI e dispositivi IoT. Un'opportunità in più: AI e automazione intelligente Stiamo esplorando nuove soluzioni in cui i tradizionali sistemi di sicurezza, domotica e controllo accessi possano dialogare con piattaforme di Intelligenza Artificiale. Ci interessa sviluppare sistemi capaci non soltanto di ricevere comandi, ma anche di interpretare informazioni, interagire con dispositivi connessi e automatizzare attività attraverso agenti AI. Cerchiamo quindi una persona che abbia voglia di sperimentare queste tecnologie e contribuire alla loro applicazione in prodotti reali. Non chiediamo necessariamente esperienza già consolidata nell'AI: cerchiamo soprattutto curiosità, capacità di apprendimento e passione per lo sviluppo tecnologico. Titolo di studio Diploma di perito elettronico o informatico, laurea in Ingegneria Elettronica, Informatica o titolo equivalente. Valutiamo anche candidati con percorsi di formazione differenti, purché in possesso di competenze tecniche dimostrabili. Cosa offriamo Inserimento in una realtà italiana che sviluppa prodotti e tecnologie proprie. Coinvolgimento diretto nello sviluppo di nuovi progetti. Possibilità di crescita professionale e tecnica. Opportunità di lavorare su IoT, cloud e Intelligenza Artificiale. Ambiente di lavoro collaborativo e dinamico. Computer aziendale e strumenti di sviluppo. Retribuzione commisurata alle competenze. Possibilità di premi legati agli obiettivi. Perché scegliere T-LAB? Perché qui non sarai soltanto un programmatore chiamato a eseguire attività assegnate. Avrai la possibilità di seguire lo sviluppo di un prodotto, dall'idea iniziale fino alla sua realizzazione, contribuendo alle scelte tecniche e sperimentando nuove tecnologie. Se ti appassionano l'elettronica, la programmazione e l'Intelligenza Artificiale applicata al mondo reale, ci piacerebbe conoscerti. Invia il tuo CV a commerciale@tlab-srl.com , indicando nell'oggetto "Candidatura Sviluppatore Firmware & IoT". Entra a far parte del team T-LAB! Retribuzione: €1.400,00 - €1.800,00 al mese Benefit: Bevande gratis Mensa aziendale Parcheggio libero Sede di lavoro: In presenza

Translate usability market insights into a software and physical prototype testing strategy to analyze user experience and establish user experience quality targets for future products. PostgreSQL , umiejętność projektowania i rozwijania procesów przetwarzania danych, samodzielność w analizie problemów technicznych i proponowaniu rozwiązań. Mile widziane: doświadczenie z Docker, Kubernetes i CI/CD , znajomość GCP , w tym BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc lub Pub/Sub, znajomość Apache Airflow, Apache Spark lub Apache Beam , doświadczenie z przetwarzaniem danych niestrukturalnych, w tym OCR, transkrypcją audio i konwersją dokumentów , znajomość grafowych baz danych, np. Neo4j , doświadczenie z Knowledge Graph, GraphRAG lub klasycznymi rozwiązaniami RAG , znajomość FastAPI . Co oferujemy w ramach współpracy? możliwość świadczenia usług w różnorodnych projektach z obszaru Software, Embedded, Data i Cloud Services, zaangażowanie w dodatkowe inicjatywy presealsowe oraz eksperckie , dostęp do opieki medycznej, karty sportowej oraz platformy kafeteryjnej zgodnie z obowiązującymi zasadami współpracy. items.desc: Senior Network Engineer Location: Gdansk, Poland Jeppesen ForeFlight is the industry leader in aviation software and data, serving commercial airlines, military operators, business aviation, and general aviation pilots worldwide. Jeppesen ForeFlight is seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Senior Network Engineer to support the design, implementation, and maintenance of our network infrastructure, ensuring reliable, secure, and high-performing connectivity for our teams and business operations in Gdansk. The scope will be Global. Position Responsibilities: Network Design and Implementation Lead the design, configuration, deployment, and optimization of complex network solutions, including routers, switches, wireless, firewalls, load balancers, and VPNs Develop and maintain network architecture standards and documentation Ensure network solutions align with security policies, compliance requirements, and business objectives Security & Firewalls Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for Palo Alto Networks firewall technologies, including PAN-OS, Panorama, and VPN solutions. Have a high level of understanding of F5 load balancers Design, implement, and manage next-generation firewall rules, security profiles, threat prevention, and URL filtering Conduct regular security audits and vulnerability assessments to proactively identify and mitigate risks Proactively manage the end-to-end lifecycle of digital SSL/TLS certificates, including request, installation, and renewal, to ensure uninterrupted service and maintain security standards Implement and manage Authentication, Authorization, and Accounting (AAA) using Cisco ISE with TACACS+ to secure network devices and user access Core Networking (Cisco Focus) Configure and manage Cisco enterprise-level routing and switching, including advanced protocols like BGP and OSPF Maintain and troubleshoot complex campus and data center networking environments, including Cisco Catalyst and Nexus switch platforms along with Cisco and Meraki Wireless networks. Manage and optimize network performance, Quality of Service (QoS), and high availability features (HSRP, VRRP, etc.) Manage and secure the corporate DNS infrastructure, including zone management, record lifecycle, and implementation of security best practices like DNSSEC Configure, manage, and troubleshoot the enterprise Cisco wireless environment, including Wireless LAN Controllers (WLCs) and Access Points (APs), to ensure reliable and secure network connectivity Cloud Networking (AWS & Azure) Design and implement secure and scalable network connectivity within and between AWS and Azure cloud environments Configure and manage cloud networking components such as AWS VPCs, subnets, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, Route 53, and Azure VNETs, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateways, and Load Balancers Implement and manage firewall and security policies within the cloud networking stack Operations and Troubleshooting Provide Tier 3 escalation support for network incidents and performance issues. Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for major network incidents and implement preventative measures Develop and implement network monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions Automate routine network tasks using scripting tools (e.g., Python, Ansible) where applicable Leverage SolarWinds for root cause analysis and performance tuning, providing critical data and insights to support rapid resolution of network and system incidents Act as the primary technical liaison with service providers (e.g., ISPs, cloud providers, carriers) during outages to manage trouble tickets, coordinate troubleshooting, and drive incidents to a swift resolution Basic Qualifications (Required) : 12+ years of progressive experience in network engineering, with at least 3 years in a senior role Solid understanding of Cloud Networking: Proven experience designing and supporting network infrastructure in AWS and Azure Strong Cisco Networking knowledge: Expert-level experience with Cisco routing and switching (LAN/WAN/Data Center) Expertise in Palo Alto Networks: Experience with implementation, configuration, and management of PAN-OS and Panorama F5 Load Balancing: Manage, configure, and troubleshoot F5 BIG-IP Local Traffic Manager (LTM) and Global Traffic Manager (GTM) to ensure the high availability, performance, and security of critical applications Expertise in network security principles, IPSec VPNs, and remote access solutions. Strong knowledge of monitoring tools, packet capture analysis, and performance tuning techniques Excellent communication, documentation, and interpersonal skills Preferred Qualifications (Desired): CCNP/CCIE, PCNSE, or cloud networking certifications Skilled in automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform) Strong SD-WAN, VPN, and Zero-Trust knowledge Pilot or aviation enthusiast preferred Typical Education & Experience: Education/experience typically acquired through a Bachelor’s degree in IT or related field

You will work at the intersection of service business, operations and technology, helping clients improve end-to-end service processes from service request and order management through planning, scheduling, dispatch and field execution. Collaborate across service, sales, logistics, maintenance and technology teams to ensure SAP service solutions integrate effectively with the broader SAP S/4HANA and enterprise landscape. #LI-EU HERE’S WHAT YOU’LL NEED: Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification, preferably in engineering, supply chain, business, information systems or a related field. Hands-on experience with SAP Field Service Management (SAP FSM) and SAP Service Planning and Execution, including the ability to translate business requirements into solution design and perform foundational functional configuration for planning, scheduling, dispatch and service execution. Consulting and advisory skills, including structured problem solving, requirements definition, workshop facilitation and clear communication with business and technology stakeholders; excellent written and spoken English is required. BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE: Understanding of integration between SAP FSM, SAP S/4HANA Service and adjacent capabilities such as EAM, SD and MM, including relevant master data and transactional dependencies. items.desc: In this role, you will partner with Corporate Accounting teams across the United States and global locations to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of financial records while providing high-quality support to business units and finance stakeholders. The successful candidate will play a key role in the month-end close process, financial reporting, balance sheet reconciliations, SOX compliance, and continuous process improvement initiatives. Supervise the General Ledger team, coordinating workload, deliverables, priorities, and KPIs. Develop and coach team members, providing guidance, support, and identifying training and development needs; conducting periodical performance reviews. Perform and oversee month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of deliverables. Perform and oversee accounting activities related to accruals, prepaid expenses, allocations, fixed assets, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations. Prepare, review, and approve journal entries, including submissions from business units, ensuring accuracy, completeness, appropriate documentation, and compliance with US GAAP and company policies. Prepare complex balance sheet reconciliations, review and approve reconciliations completed by the team, and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items. Analyze financial information and investigate unusual balances, variances, discrepancies, and accounting or process exceptions. Provide guidance and support to the team in resolving complex accounting issues and transactions. Ensure the accuracy and integrity of General Ledger data and support the preparation of financial reports and analysis. Perform and oversee assigned SOX controls, maintain appropriate documentation, and ensure compliance with US GAAP, Corporate Accounting policies, and internal control requirements. Support internal and external audits, including remediation of audit findings and control deficiencies. Manage day-to-day stakeholder relationships and collaborate with cross-functional teams to address accounting and process-related matters. Identify and drive opportunities to improve, standardize, automate, and strengthen accounting processes and controls. Lead and participate in knowledge transfers, process transitions, system implementations, and other Finance initiatives. Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, and standard operating procedures. 5+ years of work experience in General Ledger area, Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial reporting concepts, Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in accounting or another relevant field, Fluency in English (speaking, reading, and writing), Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel), Experience working with ERP systems (preferable Oracle Fusion), Excellent communication and documentation skills (oral and written), Excellent planning and organizational skills, Ability to work independently, prioritize multiple tasks and meet strict deadlines, Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, Demonstrated leadership skills and the ability to mentor and develop team members. What We Offer A key leadership role with the opportunity to shape General Ledger operations and support team development. Exposure to international accounting teams and collaboration with finance stake-holders across global locations. The opportunity to lead process improvements, automation initiatives, system im-plementations, and finance transformation projects. A collaborative environment that values knowledge sharing, continuous improve-ment, and high-quality financial operations. A full-time hybrid working model based in our Kraków office. #LI-MS1#Hybrid Our People, Our Culture For more than 50 years, Verisk has helped property and casualty insurers make smarter decisions about risk through AI-powered risk modeling, advanced analytics, and technology solutions spanning the entire policy lifecycle. items.desc: ITOM Financial Modeler & Value Case Specialist Role Overview The ITOM Financial Modeler & Value Case Specialist is responsible for building the financial baselines, business cases, cost allocation models, and investment roadmaps necessary to justify and fund IT operating model transformations. This role quantifies the financial impacts of platform restructuring, FTE reallocations, licensing rationalization, and automation/AI capabilities. Key Responsibilities IT Financial Baselining : Analyse current-state IT spend across global, regional, and local entities, categorizing run-the-business vs. change-the-business budgets, software platform costs, and vendor contracts. Transformation Value Case Modelling : Build quantitative financial models detailing one-off implementation costs vs. recurring savings generated by platform-based ITOM transitions. FTE Sizing & Allocation Analysis : Model team sizing, FTE transitions, and location strategy cost implications across business platforms, tech platforms, and central governance units. Transformation Roadmap & Initiative Prioritization : Build financial backlogs, sequence implementation initiatives based on ROI/impact, and establish value realization tracking metrics. AI & Automation Financial Impact : Quantify productivity boost potential and cost impacts of integrating AI/automation tools across the IT value chain. Key Deliverables Global IT Financial Baseline & Cost Pool Analysis ITOM Transformation Business Case & Financial Model (Capex/OpenX, ROI, Payback) FTE Sizing, Target Allocation & Location Costing Model Prioritized ITOM Implementation Roadmap & Initiative Financial Backlog Required Skills & Qualifications Experience : 5–8 years of experience in IT financial modelling, IT management consulting, IT finance (FinOps/TBM), or corporate IT strategy. Financial Modelling Skills : Advanced quantitative modeling capabilities in Excel/financial tooling (e.g., DCF, NPV, recurring vs. one-off cost impacts, FTE cost models). Domain Knowledge : Deep understanding of IT cost structures (cloud/infrastructure, platform licensing, application portfolios, external labor, shared services). Methodologies & Certifications : ITIL Foundation, PMI CAPM/PMP, Apptio/TBMA, or formal financial/policy qualifications. Education : Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Technology Policy, Physics, Engineering, or Business Administration.

items.desc: 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slashing energy costs one home at a time. Founded in 2022, and with 1200+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions such as solar power, battery storage solutions and heat pumps. With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland, and HQ in Stockholm, Sweden, and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy, Aira is well on track to install clean energy-tech into 5 million homes by 2034. About the role: We are looking for back-end engineers to join our product teams in Stockholm. Rather than hiring for one specific seat, we are hiring for the group. We have several small, autonomous product teams working on the customer acquisition journey, each built around four developers, a designer and a product manager, and we would rather find the right people first and work out the best fit together. The teams you could join: Planning builds the tooling that schedules Aira's field force across the whole customer journey, from booking sales visits to heat pump installations and maintenance. Survey & Design owns the steps where we capture data about a customer's home and turn it into a tailored, carbon neutral energy solution. The domain spans 3D modelling, thermodynamics, electronics and logistics. There is real modelling work here, along with third party integrations that bring in geometric and climate data we have to transform into something our own model can use. Expansion takes the product into new markets and improves how customers convert. New market launches, pricing, conversion flows, solar PV output modelling, and the next generation of our heat pump product. Every new market brings its own rules, and the backend is where most of that lands. We will talk about which team fits you best during the process, and you will meet the team before anything is decided. Some of the things you can expect to work with in this role: Design and build backend services that scale to our users all over Europe Create well designed APIs that stand the test of time Integrate with third party providers reliably and transform their data into a data model that fits our use case Create feedback loops between the data we get from the thousands of installed heat pumps and our own tooling, making sure it gets better over time Make sure our backend architecture scales gracefully with new product requirements and stays clean and approachable for both your teammates and your future self What you bring to the team: Have around 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer Feel comfortable writing Java code and using Spring Boot Have a strong understanding of databases and domain driven design Have experience building and documenting APIs Can convert an idea into clean, testable, and scalable software services Engage in team discussions and have a mindset to take responsibility Have knowledge of microservices architecture Our teams are not all set up the same way. Some have dedicated front-end and back-end engineers, others are full-stack across the board. So there is a real home here for a backend specialist, and in the smaller teams there is always the possibility to dip your toes in the web frontend or even our apps if you want to. We will be straight with you about which team is which. Nice to have: Experience at fast-growing companies Experience with gRPC and tRPC Kafka or Kotlin Writing front-end code in React Experience with Kubernetes, Docker or Terraform Our tech stack includes Java (Spring Boot), gRPC, Postgres, Kafka, TypeScript, React, NextJS, tRPC, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, and Terraform. Skills and mindset go hand in hand. If you don't meet every requirement but bring a positive and motivated attitude, we'd love to hear from you! What is in it for you? items.desc: Job Introduction The Met Office is delighted to open our advertising for Industrial Placements 2027. This is an exciting opportunity to join the Met Office on a 12-month Year in Industry placement, commencing at the start of July 2027, developing your skills and knowledge and ensuring you gain the most value possible from your experience with us. You will have the opportunity to network with our cohort of Industrial Placements all over the Met Office and understand what career opportunities are on offer at the Met Office after you graduate. We’re looking for Observations Research & Development Industrial Placement to help us make a difference to our planet. As our Observations Research & Development Industrial Placement, the job may be suitable for hybrid working, which is where an employee works part of the week in the office and part of the week from home. This is a voluntary, non-contractual arrangement and the location advertised will be your contractual place of work. As an Industrial Placement, we would expect you to attend the office once a week as a minimum. Our opportunity is full time, 37 hours per week. Our people are at the heart of what we do and we'll do our best to agree a working pattern that works for everyone. World changing work From science to technology, from meteorology to management, and from planning to communication, our expertise helps us stand out as the authority on weather accuracy and climate prediction. We help individuals, industries and government to make better decisions to stay safe and thrive. This is the Met Office. This is who we are. We’re a force for good - focusing on our environmental and social impact We’re experts by nature - always learning and developing to do things better We live and breathe it - putting our purpose at the heart of decision-making We’re better together - understanding partnerships and inclusivity make us greater We keep evolving - pushing boundaries to make tomorrow better for our customers Your world of expertise Our Industrial Placement scheme offers ambitious and capable undergraduates the opportunity to gain valuable experience working alongside diverse and highly skilled experts in their field. You’ll be working in the Observations Research & Development team to support the application of scientific research to enhance our Observations Capability. This will involve working on data to contribute to protecting our weather radar network from interference from wind turbines. You will be part of a wider team exploring engineering and data-processing solutions to this real-world challenge. There may also be opportunities to engage in work on other observations networks. Your key duties Work with observations scientists, radar specialists and network protection experts to evaluate case studies of real-world impacts to the radar network. Apply geospatial, statistical and visualisation techniques to a variety of datasets to extract meaningful information and metrics. Develop knowledge and skills associated with observations network analysis. Produce regular technical verbal and written briefings for internal colleagues on the findings and recommendations. However, this is not guaranteed and would be subject to programme availability and a successful application. Diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve software, hardware and infrastructure-related network issues, working with Network Engineering and Network Operations teams as appropriate. Ensure that operating systems, applications, infrastructure platforms and supporting services are maintained with current security patches, vendor bug fixes and security updates. This is a proactive, hands-on role focused on preventing security and compliance issues rather than simply responding to them.
