Assist the Network Operations Centre on complex/pervasive problems. Replacement of failed components on-site as required. Ensure that documentation is updated according to company requirements. TSA, Security & Compliance Own the operational infrastructure activities required to maintain compliance with UK Telecommunications Security Act (TSA) requirements and associated security obligations. Ensure operating systems, applications and infrastructure platforms receive security patches, vendor bug fixes and firmware/software updates within agreed timescales and defined security and hardening standards. Monitor vendor security advisories and vulnerability notifications and assess their relevance and impact. Identify and remediate vulnerabilities across the infrastructure estate based on risk and defined remediation SLAs. Ensure infrastructure remains within supported vendor versions and identify end-of-life or unsupported systems. Work closely with the Security, Network Technology and IT teams to identify and address security risks. Support security incident investigations and remediation where infrastructure is involved. Ensure appropriate logging, monitoring and alerting is implemented across managed infrastructure. Maintain secure configuration baselines and ensure systems remain aligned with them. Comply with all external audit and assurance requirements as required in TSA regulations. The experience we’re looking for you to bring: The Engineer should have a minimum of 5 years of experience working in a server, storage and a networking environment. Must have: Strong hands-on experience maintaining, troubleshooting, securing and patching: DNS – strong understanding of DNS architecture, zones, records, recursion, authoritative DNS, DNS security and DNS troubleshooting. Experience with BIND or equivalent DNS platforms. DHCP – administration, configuration, troubleshooting and patching of DHCP services, including high-availability configurations. NTP – administration and maintenance of NTP services, including secure time synchronisation and troubleshooting of time drift and synchronisation issues. items.desc: deltaflare is the UK's specialist in Operational Technology (OT) cybersecurity for Critical National Infrastructure (CNI) operators. We deliver NIS2 and CAF compliant protection across gas, electricity, water, renewable technology and transport networks — the systems that keep the country running. We work where IT meets industrial reality: inside control rooms, substations and treatment works, helping CNI operators navigate the unique challenges of securing hyper-connected physical systems without disrupting the operations that millions of people depend on. OUR MISSION To enable the safe and cyber secure operation of hyper-connected industrial systems. OUR VISION A world where essential services can deliver digital transformation with confidence, built on a solid cyber-physical security foundation. OUR VALUES We innovate with purpose, focusing on solutions that can be adopted safely and at scale. ABOUT THE ROLE As a Product Solutions Engineer in deltaflare’s Product team, you’ll be the technical anchor between Product, Engineering, Assurance and our customers and partners. You’ll turn what we build into solutions that CNI operators, OEMs and MSPs can buy, deploy and rely on, and make it quick and repeatable for them to get onto phoenix, our SaaS platform for secure remote access, real-time monitoring and compliance reporting. At the heart of the role, you’ll own how phoenix is packaged and released for customers. You’ll build and maintain a controlled, versioned set of standard deployment configurations, and own the technical release gate into Assurance. Once a release passes your gate, our Assurance team independently tests and approves it before it reaches customers. By owning the build, you’ll keep the product roadmap moving and give our customers a stable, repeatable platform. You will report to the Head of Product and Enablement, based in Richmond with travel to customer and partner sites. You’ll take released software from Engineering, hand releases to Assurance, join Sales early in customer and partner conversations, help OEM and MSP partners deploy and support phoenix, and feed customer insight back to Product. You’ll work directly with the people who built phoenix and with some of the UK’s largest infrastructure operators. This is an early-stage role on a fast-growing product. As our pre-sales, customer success and solutions functions grow, you’ll help shape how they work and set the standard for how phoenix is built, released and explained. WHAT YOU'LL DO Your main accountabilities — what you will own and be responsible for delivering. Own our standard deployment configurations ▸ Turn released software and infrastructure capabilities into controlled, customer-ready deployment configurations. ▸ Build and maintain versioned, parameterised configurations, offered as products. ▸ Design configurations that customers, OEMs and MSPs can reuse across their sites with minimal set-up. ▸ Build and troubleshoot containerised apps, including Docker Compose, startup dependencies, networking and resource limits. ▸ Maintain configurations across development, pre-production and customer environments. ▸ Keep customer-specific builds as the exception, agreed with the Head of Product and Enablement. Own the release gate into Assurance ▸ Catch mismatched versions, missing parameters, risky app combinations, and settings that look valid but are wrong, such as a bad IP range or routing. ▸ Review test evidence and decide whether a release is ready to enter Assurance. ▸ Hold a release when configuration or evidence is incomplete, and explain why clearly. ▸ Treat the gate as a readiness check, never as a replacement for Assurance testing. Run controlled change ▸ Manage tagged releases and Git-based reviews. ▸ Compare configurations between versions and environments. ▸ Write release notes, with an auditable reason for every change. Be the technical voice with customers and partners ▸ Join discovery with CNI operators, OEMs and MSPs to understand their sites, assets and requirements. ▸ Design and cost solutions with the client, captured as a defined configuration with clear acceptance criteria. ▸ Help clients build the case for funding and plan their internal rollout. ▸ Bring technical input to quarterly business reviews that supports each customer’s success story. ▸ Get new customers, OEMs and MSPs onto phoenix quickly and repeatably, delivering training and working with Assurance at go-live. ▸ Train customer and partner teams during rollout so they can configure, deploy and run phoenix with confidence. ▸ Run demos that explain both what phoenix can do and its limitations. ▸ Feed customer insight back to Product to shape the roadmap. items.desc: An exciting opportunity has arisen for a part-time or full-time appointment as an Educator working within the Community Resilience department at SECAmb. The department is seeking to embed educational support for volunteers within the three geographical divisions of Kent, Surrey and Sussex, with a 0.5 whole time equivalent (WTE) in each. The post will therefore suit an individual who wishes to work part time within one of the divisions, or full time whilst supporting two divisions – note that post-holders will work as part of a team to ensure volunteers across the Trust are supported, and therefore may also work outside their allocated division(s) as needed. The portfolio includes Community First Responders, Chaplains, our four Retirement Associations, Community Guardians and Public Access Defibrillators (PAD). There will also be involvement in providing education and support to members of the public, particularly regarding Basic Life Support / CPR training and Automated External Defibrillator familiarisation. Reporting to the Community Resilience Manager, you’ll be immersed in all areas of work in this fast-paced and focused department. The post holder will plan and facilitate the delivery of training and mentoring to all grades of staff (including volunteers) and support individual staff with their development as necessary. To do this, they will ensure their own competency by maintaining the necessary standards defined by the Trust. This role will include acting as the first point of contact for candidates undertaking educational programmes being delivered; and escalating any concerns to the responsible programme lead for the programme being delivered. You will need a flexible approach to meet the needs and demands of volunteers and the public, which at times will include working evenings and weekends in agreement with your line manager. You may also need to travel across the Trust (business expenses paid in line with Trust policy). Option to join NHS pension scheme A minimum 27 days' holiday each year, increasing after 5 years’ service. Personal and professional development and training opportunities. Salary Sacrifice schemes for cars or push bikes. Access to occupational health and counselling services. Award winning wellbeing hub Access to NHS discounts, offering NHS employees a range of money-saving deals. Other than in exceptional circumstances, the starting salary for staff new to the NHS will be the bottom point of the band to which they have been appointed. This is an exciting opportunity to help equip volunteers and their wider communities with the confidence and skills to save lives. As part of our Community Resilience team, you will deliver engaging educational programmes to our network of volunteers to ensure they have the skills and confidence needed to undertake their roles. Programmes included induction courses for new volunteers, mandatory training and annual updates to volunteers already in post, and a programme of Continuing Professional Development and support training to maintain interest and support personal development. Alongside commitments to our volunteers, you will deliver training such as CPR familiarisation and other educational programmes to members of the public to support the Trust’s aim of creating resilient communities who are confident to save lives. Manchester Metropolitan University Library & Cultural Services is seeking an ambitious and innovative Digital Librarian to join our Digital Services team. This is an exciting opportunity to play a leading role in developing and enhancing the systems, platforms and services that underpin access to our library, cultural and research collections. As we continue to transform our digital services and explore new opportunities through emerging technologies, AI and automation, we are looking for someone who enjoys solving problems, working collaboratively and using technology to improve the experience of students, researchers and staff. About us Library & Cultural Services supports teaching, learning and research across the University and holds a rich and diverse range of collections, including Library resources, Special Collections, the Poetry Library and the North West Film Archive. We are delivering ambitious plans to modernise our systems and services, ensuring our digital services remain innovative, sustainable and responsive to changing user needs. As part of one of the UK's largest universities, you will join a collaborative and forward-looking team, working alongside colleagues across Professional Services and cultural heritage sectors to create exceptional digital experiences for our community. Leading the delivery and continuous improvement of electronic resources and digital collections to ensure reliable and seamless access. Contributing expertise in areas such as metadata, discovery services, websites and digital content management. Using data, user insight and UX approaches to inform decision making and improve services. Exploring opportunities to use emerging technologies, AI and automation to enhance service delivery and operational efficiency. You will also contribute to projects that support strategic priorities across Library & Cultural Services, helping to shape the future of our digital infrastructure and ensuring services remain accessible, user-focused and aligned to the needs of teaching, learning and research. About you You will be an experienced library or information professional with a strong interest in digital services, systems and technologies. You will enjoy analysing problems, identifying opportunities for improvement and working collaboratively with a wide range of colleagues and stakeholders. We are looking for someone who can demonstrate: Experience of working with library or cultural services systems, discovery platforms, repositories or related digital services. Enthusiasm for innovation and the potential of new technologies to transform library services. Strong communication and relationship-building skills. Excellent organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities. A commitment to delivering excellent customer service and continuously improving the user experience. Most importantly, you will be excited by the opportunity to help shape the future of digital library and cultural services within a large and ambitious university. items.desc: Valarian Technologies is a dual-use technology company building critical tools to safeguard the future in an era of evolving global security challenges. We're rethinking security beyond traditional military domains, addressing asymmetric threats that impact our technological advantage, economic strength, and democratic institutions. We build Acra – the platform foundation for everything we do as a dual-use technology company. The platform’s name, rooted in the Greek word for citadel (or, fortress), reflects the design and purpose of our infrastructure-agnostic secure enclaves: protecting critical data. Some of the government and commercial workflows include: increased operational resiliency for mission-critical systems and functions; enabling organisations to more quickly and widely adopt emerging technologies while ensuring the integrity of their intellectual property; information flow during disaster response scenarios, and zero-trust / least-privilege environments for M&A, attorney-client privileged communications, etc. And we’ve only scratched the surface. At our core, we're driven by a shared mission and a belief in making a tangible impact on our world. Whether you join our London HQ or the wider global organisation, you’ll be a part of collaborative, high-performing teams, creating cutting-edge software, platforms, and infrastructure. The Role As an AI Harness Engineer at Valarian, you will own the experimental design, evaluation methodologies, and benchmark infrastructure for our AI models and autonomous agentic workloads. In an emerging domain with no standard playbook, you will serve as the bridge between rigorous data science, statistical validation, and production agent scaffolding. You will design robust evaluation datasets, architect calibrated LLM-as-a-judge pipelines, and build metrics that accurately capture multi-step agent performance under non-deterministic conditions. Your insights and error analyses will directly drive iterative improvements to our harness scaffolding, tool orchestration, and system safety guardrails. What you’ll do: Architect Evaluation Runtimes & Harnesses: Design and maintain scalable Python evaluation harnesses that measure task completion, trajectory quality, tool-use correctness, cost, latency, and variance across multi-step agentic systems. Design Experiments & Validate Results: Apply rigorous statistical methods—including hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, bootstrapping, and power analysis—to determine whether performance changes are true system improvements or stochastic noise. Build & Calibrate LLM-as-a-Judge Pipelines: Develop automated judging systems validated against human ground truth. Measure alignment using agreement metrics (Cohen’s kappa, correlation, precision/recall) and systematically detect judge failure modes such as position bias, verbosity bias, self-preference, and prompt sensitivity. Curate Benchmark Datasets & Rubrics: Define sampling strategies, detailed annotation guidelines, and scoring rubrics. Measure inter-annotator agreement and manage label noise to ensure benchmark integrity over time. Deep Error & Trajectory Analysis: Conduct hands-on failure analysis on agent runs, cluster root causes into actionable error categories, and clearly communicate findings to both engineering teams and stakeholders. Drive Harness Scaffolding Iteration: Translate evaluation results directly into architectural improvements across agent scaffolding, prompt design, tool execution loops, context window compaction, retries, and safety guardrails. What we are looking for: Grounding in Statistics & Experimental Design: Demonstrated expertise in hypothesis testing, bootstrapping, power analysis, and statistical significance within probabilistic machine learning systems. LLM-as-a-Judge Validation: Proven experience building, auditing, and validating LLM judge setups against human annotations, including tracking agreement metrics and mitigating judge biases. Evaluation Dataset Engineering: Strong track record designing evaluation datasets, crafting precise scoring rubrics, managing label noise, and measuring inter-annotator agreement. Evaluation of Non-Deterministic Multi-Step Systems: Deep comfort evaluating complex agent trajectories, tool execution sequences, latency, cost, and variance across repeated runs rather than relying solely on single-shot benchmarks. Metric Design & Integrity: Exceptional judgment in defining metrics tied to real-world outcomes, with a keen eye for detecting benchmark gaming, target drift, or shortcut learning. Rigor in Error Analysis: Ability to dissect complex execution logs, categorize failure modes, and synthesize clear, data-driven recommendations. Hands-On LLM Integration: Practical proficiency with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs, function/tool calling, and retrieval systems in Python. Agent Architecture Awareness: Clear understanding of planning loops, tool orchestration, memory management, and …

items.desc: Overview Haptiq is an AI-native enterprise solutions company helping organizations transform complex data, workflows, and business processes into scalable technology-driven operations. With headquarters in New York and teams across the US, Canada, Poland, and India, Haptiq combines deep technology expertise, AI capabilities, and enterprise delivery experience to solve complex business challenges for leading companies, financial institutions, governments, asset managers, family offices, and other sophisticated organizations. Haptiq combines technology, AI, data, and domain expertise to help organizations scale operational excellence, make better decisions, operate more efficiently, and generate alpha across complex enterprise environments while delivering measurable business value. About the Role We’re looking for an innovative AI Engineer to join our AI team and help design, prototype, and operationalize advanced AI systems, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, MCP services, and agentic workflows. You’ll work closely with Python Developers and MLOps Engineers to bring AI-powered features from concept to production. Key Responsibilities Design, prototype, and iterate on AI models, RAG pipelines, MCP services, and agentic reasoning systems. Develop AI-powered services using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, and Haystack. Design, train, and evaluate machine learning models (supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning) for real-world production use cases. Perform data preprocessing, feature engineering, and dataset curation to improve model performance and robustness. Experiment with model architectures, hyperparameter tuning, and optimization techniques to achieve performance targets. Implement model validation strategies, including cross-validation, A/B testing, and offline/online evaluation pipelines. Deploy, monitor, and maintain ML models in production, including handling model drift, retraining, and versioning. Build and optimize prompts for AI-driven tasks like chat, summarization, information extraction, and decision support. Integrate and tune vector databases (e.g., Chroma, FAISS, Pinecone, Qdrant) to optimize vector search workflows. Collaborate with Python Developers to define service interfaces, APIs, and operational requirements. Implement task decomposition, memory management, and tool-use strategies within agentic systems. Monitor AI system performance, operational risks, and prompt evaluation metrics. Stay current with emerging AI frameworks, architectures, and best practices in AI observability and evaluation. Required Skills & Experience Strong Python development skills with an emphasis on clean, scalable, and modular code. Hands-on experience working with LLMs and agent frameworks. Solid understanding of RAG architecture, vector search concepts (cosine similarity, MMR, late interaction), and system design. Experience building multi-step agentic workflows and reasoning systems. Familiarity with AI performance metrics, model drift detection, and operational monitoring. Awareness of AI limitations, including latency, hallucination risks, and explainability challenges. Experience with prompt optimization tools is a plus. A curious, experimental mindset with a passion for testing emerging AI tools and frameworks. Strong foundation in machine learning fundamentals, including regression, classification, clustering, and model evaluation techniques. Experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn for model development and experimentation. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent - preferred. Why Join Us? We value creative problem solvers who learn fast, work well in an open and diverse environment, and enjoy pushing the bar for success ever higher. We do work hard, but we also choose to have fun while doing it.

items.desc: Agentic AI Engineer: Rare Disease Drug Discovery 📍 Germany | Full-time The opportunity A fast-growing AI-driven biotech is building the next generation of drug discovery, focused on rare diseases. Most of the thousands of known rare conditions still have no approved therapy. This company brings together AI, large-scale biomedical data and deep pharmacology expertise to find new treatments faster and at lower cost than traditional R&D. They’re now hiring an Agentic AI Engineer to design and build the LLM-powered agents behind their discovery platform. Your work will directly shape which therapeutic ideas move forward for patients who currently have no options. What you’ll be doing Designing and building LLM agents that help scientists generate, prioritise and justify testable therapeutic hypotheses Working with drug discovery scientists to understand their real problems, and judging where an agentic approach adds value and where it doesn’t Connecting agents to a biomedical knowledge graph, in-house analytical methods and the scientific literature so they reason over the right evidence Extending and maintaining the existing suite of GenAI tools as the team’s needs and the wider ecosystem evolve Helping set up evaluation, testing and quality standards for agentic systems Writing clean, well-tested, well-documented Python that others can build on The setup An established Python-based agentic framework is already in place, with workflows in production You’ll report to senior technology leadership and work alongside the technical lead for agentic infrastructure You’ll sit in a cross-functional team of ML engineers, software engineers, bioinformaticians, drug discovery scientists and clinicians There’s clear scope to take ownership of workflows and grow your influence over time Your first six months By month 3: You know the framework and the scientific problems it serves, you’ve shipped your first contributions, and you’re turning scientist feedback into improvements. By month 6: You’ve taken at least one agentic workflow from concept to a production tool used in the discovery pipeline, and you’re owning workflows end to end. What you’ll bring 2+ years’ experience as a software engineer or ML engineer A track record of building and shipping LLM-based agentic systems in production, including tool use, multi-step orchestration and reliable behaviour Strong Python and solid engineering fundamentals Hands-on knowledge of the modern LLM stack: model APIs, prompting, tool calling, RAG, MCP, agent frameworks and evals Enjoyment of working closely with non-technical colleagues to understand what they need Nice to have Experience in drug discovery, biology or another life sciences field Experience with knowledge graphs or reasoning over structured and mixed data sources Experience building evaluation harnesses or test strategies for LLM systems A habit of getting up to speed quickly in unfamiliar domains A genuine interest in techbio and patient impact Why apply? You’ll do meaningful, technically challenging work at the frontier of agentic AI, where the output can change outcomes for underserved patient groups. You’ll join a collaborative, mission-led team that values learning and ownership. If you don’t tick every box but the role excites you, apply anyway.

items.desc: wailand baut eine agentische KI-Plattform für das Engineering im Maschinenbau. Sie läuft bereits produktiv bei Industriekunden. Unser Ziel: Engineering radikal neu denken und die Industrie in Europa technologisch stärken. Jetzt bauen wir aus: tiefere Integration in CAD, PLM und ERP, Knowledge Graph, Laufzeitumgebung für Agents und die Agenten-Architektur selbst. Du entwickelst die KI-Bausteine der Plattform, und das in zwei Welten. Klassische KI leitet aus CAD-Modellen und 2D-Zeichnungen semantische Informationen ab: Geometrie, Features, Maße, Toleranzen. LLM-basierte Komponenten arbeiten auf diesem Kontext: Retrieval, Tool-Calling, Agents. Entscheidend ist nicht, welches Modell du einsetzt, sondern ob das Ergebnis beim Kunden verlässlich stimmt. Deshalb gehört Evaluierung bei uns zur Entwicklung, nicht an ihr Ende. Auch du entwickelst agentisch: Agents schreiben und reviewen den Code, du konzipierst, steuerst, prüfst und gibst frei. Was du bei uns machst Du entwickelst Verfahren, die aus CAD-Modellen, 2D-Zeichnungen und Stücklisten semantische Informationen ableiten: Geometrieanalyse, Feature Recognition, eigene Modelle. Klassische KI, nicht nur LLMs. Du überführst diese Informationen in unseren Knowledge Graph und machst sie für Agents nutzbar. Du entwickelst LLM-Komponenten für die Plattform: Retrieval-Architekturen, Tool-Calling, Agent-Workflows mit State Management und Guardrails. Du entscheidest je Aufgabe, welches Modell passt, Frontier-Modell, lokales LLM oder ein klassisches Verfahren, und begründest das mit Messwerten. Du baust Prüfstände, die Modelle und Agent-Flows gegen Referenzergebnisse messen, und verankerst Evaluierung im Entwicklungsprozess. Du bringst KI-Komponenten in den produktiven Betrieb: skalierbar, reproduzierbar, in der Cloud und OnPrem, auch mit lokalen Modellen. Du arbeitest agentisch: Du beschreibst Aufgaben, steuerst Coding-Agents, reviewst und gibst frei. Du entwickelst unseren Harness mit, vor allem dort, wo Evaluierung und Modellauswahl Teil der Entwicklungsumgebung werden. Du arbeitest eng mit dem Software Architect, den Software Engineers und den Fachleuten aus dem Maschinenbau zusammen, damit die KI zu echten Engineering-Daten passt. Was du mitbringst Must-have Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Machine Learning oder AI Engineering und hast Modelle in produktive Systeme gebracht. Du beherrschst Python und das übliche ML-Ökosystem (zum Beispiel PyTorch, scikit-learn) und kennst klassische Verfahren jenseits von LLMs. Du hast LLM-basierte Komponenten gebaut (RAG, Embeddings, Tool-Calling, Agents) und weißt, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Du evaluierst systematisch: Datensätze, Metriken, Benchmarks, Regressionstests für Modelle und Prompts. Du arbeitest bereits mit Coding-Agents (zum Beispiel Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) und willst Software konsequent so bauen. Du denkst in Systemen, nicht in Prompts, und gibst direktes Feedback. Nice-to-have Du hast mit Geometriedaten, CAD-Formaten oder technischen Zeichnungen gearbeitet (zum Beispiel STEP, DXF, Zeichnungen als PDF). Du hast lokale LLMs selbst gehostet und optimiert: Quantisierung, Fine-Tuning, Inferenz-Setups. Du kennst Knowledge Graphs, Ontologien oder Graph-Datenbanken. Du hattest Berührungspunkte mit dem Maschinenbau oder mit Engineering-Systemen (CAD, PLM, ERP). Du hast Software OnPrem bei Industriekunden betrieben. Rahmen Dortmund oder Heilbronn, hybrid: Remote ist möglich, bevorzugt treffen wir uns ein- bis zweimal pro Woche im Büro. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch konversationssicher. So entwickeln wir Der Mensch macht bei uns das, worauf es ankommt: die technische und fachliche Konzeption, die Steuerung der Agents, den Prüfumfang und die Freigabe des Release. Die Entwicklungsumgebung dafür, unseren Harness, bauen wir selbst und entwickeln ihn ständig weiter. Wer bei uns entwickelt, denkt KI also doppelt: als Werkzeug im eigenen Arbeitsalltag und als Bestandteil des Produkts. Tech-Stack Python (FastAPI, PyTorch, scikit-learn, OpenCV), Java, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Postgres, Vektor-Datenbanken, Graph-Datenbanken, Langchain, LangGraph, Frontier-Modelle (Anthropic, OpenAI) und lokale LLMs (Open-Source-Modelle, selbst gehostet), Claude Code und weitere Coding-Agents, eigener Harness für agentische Entwicklung. Bewerbung Kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns an career@wailand.io , was du gebaut hast, worauf du stolz bist und wo deine Erfahrung zu dieser Stelle passt. Ein paar Sätze reichen für den Anfang. Mehr über wailand, unsere Arbeitsweise und das Team auf unserer Karriereseite.

items.desc: La Division Numérique (DivNum) de la DPNT (Direction du Parc Nucléaire et Thermique) a pour ambition de placer l'IT au cœur de la performance industrielle de la DPNT. Elle vise à refondre le système d'information, renforcer la cybersécurité et la gestion des données, et s'appuie sur quatre piliers stratégiques : la standardisation, la cloud'isation, la data'isation et l'industrialisation. La Force d’Action Rapide du Numérique (FARNum) est l’expression d’une volonté de répondre efficacement aux enjeux des grands chantiers industriels de la DPNT. Véritable catalyseur d’innovation, la FARNum réunit une équipe agile et pluridisciplinaire, dont la mission première est de déployer et industrialiser des solutions numériques à forte valeur ajoutée. L’ADN de la FARNum repose sur une approche résolument pragmatique et orientée résultats. À travers une organisation flexible, l’équipe privilégie la rapidité d’exécution et la création de valeur immédiate, tout en s’adaptant aux besoins concrets du terrain. La FARNum est organisé en 3 pôles : Affaires et projets FAST AI IT Data Ops L’équipe Data OPS de la FARNum porte la mise en œuvre opérationnelle des cas d’usage Data et IA, depuis le cadrage technique du besoin métier jusqu’à la mise en production, en s’appuyant sur une approche industrialisée, sécurisée et à valeur. Dans ce cadre, l’équipe Data OPS cherche un.e Data Scientist qui concrétisera l’implémentation et l’usage de l’IA performante et industrielle pour répondre aux besoins métiers mais aussi aux enjeux de la DivNum. Missions principales : Implémenter et améliorer la démarche Data pour les cas d’usage : diagnostic des données, collecte et redressement, valorisation et intégration. Identifier les usages d’IA dans les projets métiers dès la phase d’instruction et de cadrage et évaluer leur faisabilité technique et conformité vis-à-vis des standards groupe en amont de tout engagement. Concevoir avec les architectes et les référents technique les architectures de solutions IA de bout en bout : frameworks, choix de l’infrastructure et des modèles, base de données, patterns, exposition, monitoring, alerting, gestion des risques et des dérives. Déployer, optimiser et piloter les produits Data et IA en production, en anticipant les contraintes de performance, de robustesse, de maintenabilité et de coût. Assurer la veille technologique IA et le partage des connaissances au sein de la FARNum et de la DivNum. Mettre en place et diffuser les bonnes pratiques (DataOps,MLOps), le code review, la capitalisation technique ainsi que l’usage de l’IA générative pour les ingénieurs data. Profil souhaité : 6 ans d'expériences minimum en conception, développement et déploiement de projet Data en production Expertise en analyse Data (diagnostic des données, cartographie des sources de données, collecte, mise en qualité). Expertise en modèles IA, Machine Learning et IA générative (LLM, RAG, Agents, Prompts). Expertise en python, SQL et NoSQL, écosystème GitHub, conteneurisation, développement d'API. Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement logiciel (qualité de code, tests, documentation) et de déploiement CI/CD. Bonne connaissance des architectures cloud (GCP, AWS) et on premise ainsi que des patterns de déploiement Data IA. Bonne connaissance de la méthode de travail Agile. Autonomie, sens de la pédagogie, fort esprit d’équipe, de proactivité et de partage. Rémunération attractive selon profil : Rémunération brute annuelle de bas hors primes : de 46 à 57K€, selon diplôme et expérience professionnelle. items.desc: Deine Mission & Herausforderungen Bei NEURA Robotics führen kognitive Roboter nicht einfach nur Befehle aus. Sie nehmen wahr, denken, planen über lange Zeithorizonte und handeln autonom in der physischen Welt. Wir suchen einen Engineer, der die Systeme baut, die das möglich machen: die Agent-Harnesses, Planungsschleifen und Orchestrierungsschichten, die aus einem Sprachmodell einen zuverlässigen, verkörperten Agenten machen. Agentenarchitektur & Harness-Design: Du entwirfst und baust den zentralen Agenten-Harness für unsere humanoide Plattform: die Kontrollschleife, Tool-/Skill-Schnittstellen, State- und Memory-Management, Retries und Guardrails, die zuverlässiges, lang laufendes autonomes Verhalten sicherstellen. Langfristige Planung & Orchestrierung: Du baust Systeme, die hochrangige menschliche Absichten in mehrstufige Pläne zerlegen, Skills und Sub-Agenten orchestrieren, den Ausführungsstatus verfolgen, sich von Fehlern erholen und bei hohem Risiko an menschliche Aufsicht eskalieren. Conversational AI für verkörperte Interaktion: Du gestaltest den Echtzeit-Sprachstack: STT → LLM → TTS-Pipeline mit robuster Turn-Taking-Logik, Barge-in-Handling und Adressaten-Erkennung, damit der Roboter erkennt, wann er angesprochen wird, und unter realen Latenzbedingungen natürlich reagiert. Backend- & Plattform-Engineering: Du baust das Produktions-Backend hinter dem Agenten: gut designte APIs und Schnittstellen, verteilte Services, die Sub-Agenten mit dem Hauptagenten verbinden, sowie Edge-to-Cloud-Deployment im gesamten NEURA-Ökosystem. Evaluation & Industrialisierung: Du baust Evaluations-Harnesses und Observability auf, die messen, ob Agenten Aufgaben tatsächlich korrekt erledigen, und bringst vielversprechende Prototypen bis zur industrialisierten, produktiven Lösung. Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit Hardware-/Software-Teams und externen Partnern zusammen, um agentische Fähigkeiten vom Konzept zu einem zuverlässigen End-to-End-Produkt zu führen. Was du mitbringst Ein starker Master- oder PhD-Abschluss in Informatik, Robotik oder einem verwandten Feld, oder gleichwertige Tiefe durch bereits umgesetzte Arbeiten. Nachgewiesene Erfahrung im Aufbau produktiver Agentensysteme mit messbarer Wirkung: Agenten, die planen, Tools nutzen, Zustände verwalten und über lange Zeiträume zuverlässig laufen – nicht nur Single-Turn-Prompting. Tiefgehende, praktische Erfahrung mit Agenten-Frameworks und Orchestrierung wie LangGraph, AgentCore, MCP oder eigenen Orchestratoren, sowie ein klares Gespür dafür, wann ein Agent und wann ein deterministischer Workflow sinnvoll ist. Professionelle Backend-Engineering-Erfahrung: Produktivservices, API- und Schnittstellendesign, verteilte Architekturen und Microservices, sauberer Code, Testing und DevOps-Disziplin. Cloud- und Edge-to-Cloud-Erfahrung, einschließlich Containerisierung (Docker, Kubernetes), CI/CD sowie Deployment und Serving von Modellen und Services in Produktion. Fundierte Kenntnisse in LLMs, VLMs und NLP. Exzellentes Python. Exzellentes Englisch. Deutsch ist von Vorteil.

items.desc: Deine Aufgaben HUB.KI ist die neueste Ausgründung der JAAI Group – eine souveräne KI-Plattform, auf der Unternehmen KI-Assistenten, digitale Mitarbeiter und automatisierte Workflows erstellen, teilen und produktiv einsetzen. items.card: Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Du machst aus KI echte Features: Du bindest KI-Services und -Tools von AWS in unsere bestehende Systemlandschaft ein und bringst AI-native Features von der ersten Idee bis zu unseren Kund*innen. items.desc: Deine Position und Dein Impact Du willst KI nicht nur in Demos sehen, sondern dort, wo sie Menschen den Arbeitstag leichter macht? Dann mach, was Du liebst – bei uns. Als Software Engineer AI bringst Du KI zu unseren Kund*innen. Du baust Features, die in einer gewachsenen Software wirklich ankommen: skalierbar, sicher und so, dass man sie gern benutzt. Dein Spielfeld sind AWS, Bedrock und alles, was ein Agent so braucht. Wie Du dabei vorgehst, entscheidest Du mit Deinem Team. Ihr diskutiert offen, probiert Neues aus und findet gemeinsam die beste Lösung. „Das haben wir schon immer so gemacht“ hörst Du bei uns nicht. So entsteht eine Software zum Mitgestalten – in einem Team zum Wohlfühlen. Das sagt André, Software Engineer AI: “An meinem Job gefällt mir besonders die Freiheit, die neuesten Technologien auszuprobieren, Architekturentscheidungen mitzugestalten und vor allem für unsere Kund*innen mit neuen, sicheren und skalierbaren Features echten Mehrwert zu schaffen.” Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten Du machst aus KI echte Features: Du bindest KI-Services und -Tools von AWS in unsere bestehende Systemlandschaft ein und bringst AI-native Features von der ersten Idee bis zu unseren Kund*innen. Du baust Dinge, die halten: Deine AI-Cloud-Anwendungen laufen stabil und skalieren mit – auch dann, wenn alle gleichzeitig klicken. Du fühlst Dich im ganzen Stack zu Hause: Im Backend arbeitest Du mit Java 21, Quarkus und dem AWS CDK, im Frontend mit TypeScript und React. Dazu kommen IntelliJ IDEA, Git und Maven. Du redest mit, wie gebaut wird: Das „Wie“ gestaltest Du gemeinsam mit Deinem Team. Ob AI-Architektur, Cloud-Design oder nachhaltige Lösungsansätze. Deine Meinung zählt und Du tauschst Dich regelmäßig mit allen Entwickler*innen aus. Du sorgst für KI mit gutem Gewissen: Du setzt Data-Governance-Richtlinien um und achtest darauf, dass wir Daten und Modelle verantwortungsvoll einsetzen. Dein Profil Vorweg: Niemand erfüllt jede Zeile einer Stellenanzeige. Wenn Du Dich im Großteil wiederfindest, bewirb Dich. Das bringst Du mit: Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre in der Java-Entwicklung gearbeitet, gern im Backend von SaaS-Produkten. Realitätssinn: Du hast AI-Systeme schon in bestehende, gewachsene IT-Landschaften integriert. Greenfield ist schön, Bestandssysteme sind echt. Du kennst beides. AI-Know-how: Du hast praktisch mit RAG-Architekturen gearbeitet, verstehst agentische KI-Systeme und bringst ein solides Machine-Learning-Grundverständnis mit. Schnittstellen: REST und GraphQL sind für Dich kein Neuland, verteilte Systeme auch nicht. DevOps-Mindset: CI/CD, Monitoring (CloudWatch, Prometheus), Docker und Infrastructure-as-Code (z. B. Terraform, CDK) gehören zu Deinem Werkzeugkasten. Sprache: Du sprichst Deutsch auf C1-Niveau und fühlst Dich auch auf Englisch wohl. Wenn Du das auch noch kannst, freuen wir uns doppelt: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore oder vergleichbare Agent- und LLM-Runtime-Plattformen AWS (Bedrock, S3, Lambda, ECS, RDS) oder Erfahrung mit vergleichbaren Cloud- und LLM-Plattformen MCP (Model Context Protocol), Tool Calling und die Anbindung externer APIs an Agenten LLM Observability und LLM Security Und vor allem: Du bist neugierig auf angewandte AI und probierst neue Tools gern aus. Du packst Dinge selbst an, behältst den Überblick und übernimmst Verantwortung, auch dann, wenn ein Produkt noch in den Kinderschuhen steckt. Das erwartet Dich bei uns! Sicherheit, die nicht stillsteht – Du bekommst eine unbefristete Stelle bei einem Arbeitgeber, der seit über 10 Jahren wächst und trotzdem lieber Neues ausprobiert, als sich auszuruhen. Ein faires Gehalt – Faire Bezahlung ist für uns selbstverständlich: Kein Vollzeitgehalt bei uns liegt unter 50.000 € brutto im Jahr, und mit Deiner Erfahrung wächst es mit. Als Professional Software Engineer bieten wir Dir ein Gehalt von 5.000€-6.000€ brutto/ Monat. Als Senior Software Engineer ein Gehalt von 6.000€-7.500€ brutto/ Monat. Gemeinsam wachsen – 10 Weiterbildungstage pro Jahr gehören Dir. Ob neues AI-Framework, Zertifizierung oder Konferenz: Du nutzt sie für das, was Dich weiterbringt. Ein Start, bei dem Du nicht allein bist – Dein*e e2n-Mentor*in begleitet Dich vom ersten Tag an. Fragen stellst Du einfach, ohne lange zu überlegen, wen Du stören darfst. Offene Türen, kurze Wege – Flache Hierarchien und transparente Entscheidungen. Hast Du eine Idee, sprichst Du direkt mit den Menschen, die sie umsetzen können. Eigenverantwortung – Du gestaltest Deine Arbeit selbst und bringst Deine Ideen aktiv ein. Ein Büro, in das Du gern kommst – Stylische, klimatisierte Büros in Würzburg mit neuester Technik. Home Office, wann es für Dich passt – Ob Fokustag zu Hause oder Austausch im Büro: Du entscheidest, wo Du am besten arbeitest. Zeit zum Durchatmen – 28 Tage Urlaub, dazu sind der 24.12. und 31.12. frei. Du planst eine längere Reise? Bis zu 15 weitere Urlaubstage kannst Du Dir “dazubuchen”. items.desc: Description ICF supports governments and organisations on challenges in areas such as energy, the environment, aviation, health and public policy. Our data science team works with subject matter experts to turn evidence and data into practical solutions for clients in the UK and EU. You will help deliver data science and AI solutions across client projects, working with subject matter experts to frame questions, analyse evidence and deliver findings. This is a hands-on technical and consulting role: you will discuss needs with specialists, present approaches and results to varied audiences, and contribute to proposals. You will join an established team and work across technically diverse projects. What You Will Do Speak with subject matter experts and clients to define the problem, success measures, data needs and an appropriate analytical approach. Prepare and analyse data, develop and evaluate models or prototypes using statistical methods, forecasting, machine learning or language models where suitable. Present findings, assumptions and limitations to subject matter experts, clients and nontechnical audiences, invite challenge and adapt the work to their feedback. Collaborate with colleagues across different technical disciplines to document work, make results reproducible and develop promising prototypes into reliable solutions. Contribute technical ideas, estimates and evidence to proposals, and manage your work across several concurrent projects. Share methods and reusable approaches with colleagues across the data science team. What You Will Bring Hands-on experience in Python for analysis and modelling, including common data and machine learning libraries, ability to use SQL to extract, join and check data. Sound grounding in statistics and machine learning, including regression or classification, forecasting, validation, baseline comparisons and appropriate performance measures. Practical familiarity with using large language models in analysis or prototyping, including prompting, checking outputs against evidence and recognising privacy, accuracy and reliability risks. Experience preparing imperfect data, building reproducible analyses and writing maintainable code with version control and testing. Ability to take an ambiguous question from discovery to a working demonstration, explain assumptions and uncertainty, and judge whether a solution is worth developing for operational use. Confidence working independently and engaging stakeholders across teams, clear written and spoken English for technical and nontechnical audiences. A relevant degree or equivalent practical experience in a quantitative field. Useful Additional Experience Experience working in public policy, government, research or evaluation Experience in consulting, public policy research or client-facing delivery, familiarity with cloud platforms, APIs, data pipelines or deployment. Experience building AI agents or applications that connect language models to data and tools, such as retrieval-based systems. We can train someone with strong core skills. What You Can Expect You will work alongside colleagues with a wide range of technical and subject expertise, tackle varied client challenges from discovery to delivery. We will support your career development with ongoing training and opportunities to deepen both your technical and consulting skills. items.desc: Karriere13. Oktober 20261 Min. Lesezeit Du willst KI-Anwendungen bauen, die im Unternehmen wirklich genutzt werden, statt Demos, die nach der Präsentation verschwinden? Als KI-Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du bei ALGEBRA in Stuttgart LLM- und RAG-Lösungen für den Mittelstand: von der Wissenssuche über interne Dokumente bis zu KI-Agenten, die in bestehende Systeme eingreifen. Und zwar so, dass Datenschutz, Berechtigungen und Nachvollziehbarkeit von Anfang an stimmen. DAFÜR KANNST DU DICH BEGEISTERN Konzeption und Entwicklung von RAG-Systemen: Dokumentenaufbereitung, Chunking, Embeddings, Hybrid-Suche und Reranking. Entwicklung von KI-Agenten, die über Schnittstellen und das Model Context Protocol (MCP) mit ERP, CRM, Dateiablagen und Datenbanken arbeiten. Betrieb offener Sprachmodelle im Rechenzentrum des Kunden oder in deutschen Clouds, wenn Daten das Haus nicht verlassen dürfen. Aufbau von Evaluierung und Monitoring: Antwortqualität messen, Halluzinationen erkennen, Kosten und Latenz im Blick behalten. Umsetzung von Berechtigungskonzepten bis ins Retrieval und Berücksichtigung der Anforderungen aus EU AI Act und DSGVO. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen unserer Kunden, vom ersten Workshop bis zum produktiven Betrieb. DAS MACHT DICH AUS Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit Python, idealerweise auch mit Java, Kotlin oder TypeScript. Praktische Erfahrung mit LLM-Anwendungen in Produktion, nicht nur mit Prompts im Chatfenster. Kenntnisse in Vektordatenbanken wie pgvector, Qdrant oder Milvus und in Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex. Du weißt aber auch, wann man sie besser weglässt. Erfahrung mit Docker, REST-APIs und CI/CD, idealerweise auch mit Kubernetes oder Azure. Ein ehrlicher Blick auf Grenzen: Du sagst einem Kunden auch, wenn ein Problem keine KI braucht. Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse, denn du sprichst direkt mit Kunden. DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Echte Projekte mit echten Daten: Du siehst, wie deine Lösung im Alltag des Kunden ankommt. Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege, du arbeitest direkt mit den Menschen, die die Lösung bauen. Gestaltungsspielraum bei Architektur und Werkzeugwahl, ohne Vorgaben aus einer fernen Konzernzentrale. Zeit und Budget, um neue Modelle und Werkzeuge auszuprobieren, bevor sie beim Kunden landen. Flexible Arbeitszeiten, hybrides Arbeiten mit Büro in Stuttgart und individuelle Weiterbildung. Klingt nach dir? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung an bewerbung(at)algebra-ec.de. items.desc: Rejoignez une équipe d’experts engagés et passionnés ! Êtes-vous prêt à façonner l'avenir des solutions numériques ? Si vous avez une passion pour la technologie, l'innovation et une expertise solide d’accompagnement sur des problématiques et enjeux d’architecture technique, alors nous avons une place pour vous au sein de notre équipe SII Méditerranée et plus largement du Groupe SII. Le rôle du Froward deployed AI Engineer ? Transformer les workflows clients en solution IA concrètes, adoptées et créatrices de valeur. Votre mission: Intervenir au plus près des équipes clientes pour comprendre leurs processus, identifier les cas d’usage IA à plus forte valeur, construire les solutions adaptées — agents, chaînes agentiques, assistants, automatisations — puis accompagner leur déploiement jusqu’à l’obtention de résultats mesurables. Le FDE est à la fois capable de prendre de la hauteur sur un problème client et de descendre dans le code pour le résoudre. Analyser les workflows & prioriser les use cases Comprendre les activités réelles des équipes : développement, test, maintenance, support, documentation, knowledge management ou processus métier. Identifier les irritants, tâches répétitives, pertes de temps et opportunités d’augmentation ou d’automatisation. Prioriser selon la valeur, la faisabilité, le risque, le coût et le potentiel de productivité. Définir le bon niveau d’automatisation : assistance, agent spécialisé, workflow multi-agents ou automatisation supervisée. Construire & Intégrer Prototyper rapidement puis industrialiser les solutions qui démontrent leur valeur. Concevoir des workflows agentiques mêlant agents, humains, outils, données et systèmes existants. Intégrer APIs, bases de connaissances, repositories de code, outils métiers et chaînes CI/CD. Mettre en place sécurité, observabilité, évaluation, traçabilité et points de contrôle humain.. Transformer le delivery & accélérer l’adoption : Redéfinir avec les équipes la répartition du travail entre humain, assistant et agent. Accompagner développeurs, QA, Tech Leads et métiers dans les nouveaux workflows. Faire émerger des patterns réutilisables, bonnes pratiques et quality gates. Faire passer les équipes du POC à l’usage quotidien et à l’autonomie. Mesurer La Valeur Produite Définir une baseline et mesurer gains de temps, capacité, délai, qualité et adoption. Suivre le coût réel des modèles, plateformes et infrastructures. Identifier rework, review et supervision induits par l’IA pour distinguer gain brut et gain net. Documenter les REX afin d’alimenter la capitalisation et les benchmarks AI for Delivery. Vous ne serez pas seul pour déployer les solutions. Le FDE s’appuie sur les ingénieurs présents dans les projets, les Tech Leads, les AI Champions et les expertises AI for Delivery . Il apporte l’impulsion, la capacité de conception et de construction, puis aide les équipes à prendre progressivement le relais. Vous êtes ingénieur logiciel / AI Engineer, avec une expérience confirmée et concrète dans la conception et le déploiement de solutions basées sur l’IA générative. Vous maîtrisez notamment Python et/ou TypeScript/JavaScript , l es LLM, les architectures RAG et les systèmes d’agents IA . Vous avez déjà travaillé sur des solutions allant au-delà du simple POC, avec une vraie logique d’intégration et d’utilisation opérationnelle. Au-delà de votre expertise technique, nous recherchons une personnalité : à l’aise dans les échanges avec les clients ; capable de comprendre et challenger un besoin métier ; autonome, pragmatique et orientée solutions ; capable de passer rapidement d’un problème à un prototype puis à une solution utilisable ; attentive à la valeur et à l’impact réel des solutions développées. 👉 Votre différence ? Vous aimez autant comprendre le problème du client que mettre les mains dans le code pour le résoudre. Hard Skills Développement solide en Python et/ou TypeScript / JavaScript. LLMs, APIs de modèles, prompt & context engineering, tool/function calling. Agents et orchestration : LangGraph, LangChain, Semantic Kernel ou équivalent. RAG, embeddings, vector databases et knowledge management. MCP, intégration d’outils, APIs REST, webhooks et architectures événementielles. items.desc: About Baringa Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding. The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation. Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors. Certified as a Great Place to Work around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the Financial Times in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by Forbes for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms. Introducing the baringa.ai Fellowship - A selective cohort for exceptional postgraduate talent. At Baringa, we blend technical expertise with real-world insight to make an impact. Work with experienced engineers and experts on real client challenges from day one. We seek curious, technically skilled individuals who simplify complex ideas, whether from study, research, or hands-on work. Join a small group of top talent, grow with experts, and build a career in AI. We’re looking for people talented individuals who have recently completed their Masters or PhD, who want to take their technical depth and apply it to interesting and cutting edge challenges. You don't have to come from a traditional consulting background - because this is not a traditional consulting role! We expect that you might have spent time in research, built something outside your studies, or developed deep expertise in a particular area. What matters most is how you think, what you can do, and how quickly you can turn that into something useful. Join a small cohort built around exceptional technical talent, with the chance to grow together and make an impact. You’ll work on challenging problems, learn from people at the top of their field and build a career at the forefront of AI. Who We're Looking For We're Particularly Interested In Postgraduate Talent With Backgrounds In Computer Science, Maths, Physics, Engineering, Statistics and related STEM disciplines Machine learning, Artificial Intelligence, data science, software or systems engineering Research, modelling or computational work Strong coding ability Industrial placements, fellowships or substantial technical projects You don't need to have followed a traditional consulting path. We care about technical depth, curiosity, judgement and your potential to grow. What You'll Get Technical depth Work on challenging problems alongside people who are experts in their fields. Real-world application Apply your skills to live client challenges and see the impact of your work. Support and mentorship Learn from experienced engineers, consultants and subject matter experts. Accelerated development Build technical, consulting and commercial skills through the work you take on. Progression Your level and progression are based on what you demonstrate, not how long you've been working. The Cohort We recruit a small group of Fellows each quarter, typically up to 5 people per intake. The cohort gives you a group of peers from day one, and gives us a regular way to bring exceptional technical talent into Baringa. It sits between traditional Early Careers and experienced hiring: you don't need years of experience, but you do need the technical depth to contribute from the start. How To Join Apply - Tell us about your background, technical interests and the work you’re proud of. Technical assessment - A focused assessment designed to understand how you approach technical problems, not just what you already know. Meet the team - An assessment day with people from our AI team to explore your technical thinking, consulting potential and fit. Join the cohort - Successful candidates join the next available quarterly intake. What a career at Baringa will give you Putting People First. Benefits Baringa is a People First company and wellbeing is at the forefront of our culture. We recognise the importance of work-life balance and flexible working and provide our staff amazing benefits. Some of these benefits include: Generous Annual …

items.desc: At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One. As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other. We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation. We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do. Job Description Job Description Quantitative Model Analyst About The Role In this role, you will lead the development and implementation of expected loss forecasting models for Commercial Real Estate (CRE), Commercial Industrial (C&I), or Small Business portfolios, ensuring compliance with CECL, CCAR, and other regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate is expected to have a good understanding of commercial portfolios and statistical methods, industry experience, U.S. banking regulations, excellent communication, and attention to detail as well as a strong background in predictive modeling. Your Responsibilities Model Development: Develop expected loss forecasting models (PD/LGD/EAD) with best practice and document model methodology, selection evidence, model performance testing for validation and regulatory review. Review and revise segmentation and modeling approach based on changes in business unit, portfolio or economic intuition. Analyze model metrics (e.g., accuracy, stability), identify issues, and recommend improvements. Coding: Use various programming languages (Python, SAS, SQL, R) in development and data analysis. Write and execute code in both local environment and cloud platforms (Azure or others). Model Review: Provide effective challenges to existing and new models to identify the potential weak points and enhance model performance. CCAR/CECL Submission: Provide support for stress testing (CCAR) submission and CECL process; document associated portfolios analysis, respective overlays for emerging risks and reasonableness analysis; respond questions from senior management and regulators in a timely manner. Transformation: Leverage automation tools and Al to increase efficiency, reduce operational risk, and enhance usability and interpretability of results. Our Requirements Master's Degree or PhD in a quantitative field such as computer science, data science, mathematics, or statistics. 5 or more years of experience in credit risk modeling and industry-standard approaches (e.g. PD, LGD, EAD). Deep understanding of banking, financial metrics, and credit risk management. Knowledge of banking regulation and requirements for stress testing and credit reserves. Programming experience in Python (preferred) or similar statistical software (e.g. R, SAS) Experience with cloud-based tools and infrastructure (Azure or others). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with thoroughness and attention to detail Effective interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills. Ability to prioritize work, meet deadlines, and work under pressure and independently while balancing multiple priorities in a dynamic and complex environment. Optional Experience in financial services, banking, and/or credit risk. Experience working with large datasets and building or validating advanced statistical models (including regression and economic factor models) Familiarity with automation using scripting tools (e.g. Bash) and low-code platforms (Microsoft Power Automate / Power Apps). items.desc: Worum gehts? Bei Event Inc wollen wir Entscheidungen konsequent auf Basis von Daten treffen. Das gilt von der Go-to-Market-Strategie bis zur Conversion-Optimierung, in Marketing, Sales und Product. Mit Dir bündeln wir die Analysekompetenz an einer Stelle und schaffen eine gemeinsame Datenbasis, auf die sich alle verlassen können. Deine Rolle Als Data Analyst (Mensch) mit dem Schwerpunkt Go-to-Market & Insights bist Du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für Datenanalysen entlang unserer gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Du bist Teil unseres Product Teams und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit unseren Data Engineers. Du begleitest Maßnahmen von der ersten Exploration über die Empfehlung bis zur Wirkungsmessung. Performance im Blick: Du überwachst laufend unsere GTM-Performance über Marketing, Sales und Product hinweg, von Funnel-Analysen über Kanal-Performance bis zu Conversion-Raten. Zahlen, die etwas bewegen: Du lieferst Ad-hoc-Analysen für unsere Teams, immer mit konkreten Handlungsempfehlungen statt reinen Reports. Von der Idee bis zur Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit den Teams entwickelst Du Hypothesen und übersetzt sie in Experimente und A/B-Tests. Mit Vorher-/Nachher-Vergleichen misst Du, ob Maßnahmen wirklich wirken. Muster erkennen: Du machst Cohort- und Funnel-Analysen über Kundensegmente und Marketplace-Bereiche hinweg (z. B. Pharma vs. Automotive). Mit Win/Loss-Analysen bei Enterprise-Deals lieferst Du wertvollen Input für unser Sales Enablement. Traffic-Kanäle optimieren: In enger Abstimmung mit Marketing, Sales und Product optimierst Du unsere Traffic-Kanäle, z. B. mit Blick auf SEO/GEO-Performance und Content-Wirkung. Reporting smart automatisieren: Zusammen mit einem Data Engineer baust Du eine KI- und automatisierungsgestützte Reporting-Infrastruktur auf. So fließt Deine Zeit in Analyse und Empfehlung statt in manuelle Datenaufbereitung. Schnittstelle mit Gewicht: Du bist die zentrale Datenquelle für GTM-Entscheidungen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CPO zusammen. Was uns gefällt Fundierte Basis: Du hast ein Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung in Data Science, Statistik, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Mathematik, BWL oder einem ähnlichen Bereich erfolgreich abgeschlossen. Erfahrung, die zählt: Du bringst 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Data, Business oder Product Analytics mit. Mit Marketing-, Sales- oder Marketplace-Funnel-Metriken und Tracking kennst Du Dich aus. Analytisches Handwerkszeug: Du hast fundierte Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und Statistik und weißt, wie man aussagekräftige KPIs entwickelt. Daten in Klartext: Du leitest aus Zahlen konkrete, verständliche Empfehlungen ab und vermittelst sie so, dass jedes Team etwas damit anfangen kann. Struktur, auch wenn's voll wird: Du arbeitest eigenständig und behältst den Überblick, auch wenn mehrere Teams gleichzeitig etwas von Dir brauchen. Tech-Neugier: Du verstehst Code und schreibst ihn auch selbst (z. B. Python). Idealerweise hast Du schon mit Coding Agents Analysen erstellt oder automatisierte, KI-gestützte Reportings aufgebaut. Das ist kein Muss, aber ein großes Plus. Was Dir gefällt Teamspirit, der Spaß macht: Freu Dich auf ein motiviertes, hochqualifiziertes Team mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Zusammenhalt. Dazu gibt's regelmäßige Teamevents wie Afterwork-Drinks auf der Dachterrasse, Culture Nights oder Spieleabende. Sei ein Sparfuchs: Profitiere von exklusiven Rabatten auf Top-Marken und Reisen über PepXpress und Corporate Benefits. Gut versorgt: Natürlich stehen Dir der obligatorische Obstkorb, eine Müslibar sowie kalte und warme Getränke jederzeit zur Verfügung. Individuelle Hardware-Wahl: Du entscheidest, ob Du mit einem Mac oder einem Windows-Gerät arbeitest. Arbeitszeiten: Unsere Kernarbeitszeit ist von 10 bis 17 Uhr. Den Rest gestaltest Du nach Deinem Rhythmus. Büro mit Wow-Faktor: Du arbeitest mit Blick auf die Elbe und einige der schönsten Sehenswürdigkeiten Hamburgs. Pick your Perk: Du wählst 20 € Benefitsy, 20 € Zuschuss zum Deutschlandticket oder 20 € Zuschuss für Urban Sports. Wachstum: Wir fördern Deine Weiterentwicklung mit einem Learning Budget von 300 € pro Jahr. Für später schon heute gesorgt: Du bekommst bis zu 100 € monatlich für Deine Altersvorsorge und Vermögensziele (bAV & VWL). Deine Ansprechpartnerin Hellen, unsere Talent Acquisition Managerin Über uns Event Inc Group ist die erste Adresse für die Buchung von Unternehmensveranstaltungen in Europa. Mit nur wenigen Klicks buchen Unternehmen die coolsten Locations für das nächstes Event - ob Weihnachtsfeiern, Trainings oder Meetings. Wir übernehmen die Vorabstimmungen mit den Anbietern für eine unkomplizierte Abwicklung. Unser Ziel? Wachstum! All dies wäre nicht möglich ohne unser starkes, interdisziplinäres Team bestehend aus 80+ Expertinnen und Experten aus den unterschiedlichsten Fachbereichen. items.desc: Are you excited for your new career adventure? At Lyreco, we offer more than just a job, but a career! About Lyreco Lyreco is the European leader and the third largest distributor of workplace products and services in the world. Privately owned since 1926, Lyreco has continuously adapted to the evolving workplace through operational excellence, strong customer focus, and long-term supplier partnerships. With more than 12,000 employees, Lyreco operates directly in 25 countries across Europe and Asia and covers 17 additional markets through a network of distribution partners. To learn more about Lyreco – see our career website here What We Offer To support the development of our Customer Intelligence Team, we are looking for a Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst who will help us transform customer knowledge into meaningful business decisions. As Customer Experience Research & Insights Analyst, you will play a key role in generating actionable customer insights through advanced quantitative research and data analysis. Working closely with Customer Experience, Marketing, Sales Excellence and Merchandising stakeholders, you will connect multiple data sources and uncover the customer behaviours, needs and drivers that help shape strategic business decisions. You will join an international team of customer research, journey management and service design professionals focused on turning insights into action. In This Role You Will Design and execute quantitative research projects to better understand customer needs, behaviours and expectations. Gather business information needs and translate them into research objectives and methodologies. Conduct advanced statistical analyses including segmentation, cluster analysis, regression analysis and driver modelling. Analyse and connect multiple data sources including survey data, CRM information, digital analytics, customer care interactions and revenue data. Identify patterns, correlations and key drivers influencing customer behaviour and business performance. Develop dashboards and reporting solutions combining behavioural, attitudinal and operational data. Collaborate with external research agencies when required and ensure business needs are translated into research requirements. Partner with internal stakeholders to transform complex analyses into clear and actionable business recommendations. Support the evolution of customer intelligence capabilities across Lyreco by helping connect existing data sources and uncovering new insights opportunities. YOUR PROFILE Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Market Research, Business Analytics, Economics, Marketing Analytics, or a related field. Minimum 5 years of experience in Market Research, Customer Insights, Consumer Insights or Analytics. Strong expertise in quantitative research methodologies and advanced statistical analysis. Hands-on experience with techniques such as segmentation, cluster analysis, regression analysis and driver analysis. Experience working with survey platforms such as Qualtrics or equivalent research tools. Strong analytical skills with the ability to transform data into business recommendations. Advanced Excel skills. Experience with SPSS or similar statistical analysis tools. Knowledge of R and/or Python would be considered a strong advantage. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to work both independently and collaboratively in an international environment. Experience in a B2B environment would be an advantage. Previous experience gained within a research, insights, or consulting agency would also be highly valued. Reasons To Join Lyreco Management A full- time job in a dynamic, passionate, international team Possibility to join internal accelerator program Competitive salary Hybrid work model Pension plan Personal growth budget If the above job description interests you and you think you are a good fit, apply now! We look forward to receiving your application! #LM1

Afin d'accompagner leur déploiement à grande échelle, le Centre of Excellence AI développe des méthodologies, des outils et des plateformes permettant d'évaluer, de suivre et d'améliorer en continu les performances des agents IA tout au long de leur cycle de vie. Vos missions Au sein du Centre of Excellence AI, vous participerez à la mise en place d'un cadre commun d'évaluation des agents IA. Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes Cartographier et analyser les processus d'évaluation existants au sein des différentes équipes. Collecter, analyser et comparer les métriques utilisées dans l'entreprise pour mesurer la qualité, la robustesse et la performance des agents IA. Participer à la définition de recommandations et de standards d'évaluation pour les futurs développements et leur application aux agents déjà en production. Réaliser une veille sur les frameworks et méthodologies d'évaluation des systèmes d'IA générative. Conaissances des framework de création d'agent en python (ADK, Langgraph...). Intérêt marqué pour les problématiques d'évaluation, de qualité et d'industrialisation des systèmes d'IA. items.desc:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project. 
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.

2.Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
3.Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
4.Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
5.Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Inclusive Team Culture - Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
Mentorship & Career Growth - We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
Work/Life Balance - We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

items.desc: About Us At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges. Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day. If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx. Position Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to help maintain and evolve our fleet of AI agents, LLM-as-a-judge systems, and other AI-powered tools used by healthcare, life sciences, and marketing teams. This role will work closely with senior engineers on graph design and with product and research teams to define what "a good answer" means, including grounding, coverage, and citation honesty. The AI Engineer will contribute to the continued development of these systems by improving tools, retrieval and citations, agent architecture, and overall system speed, cost, and accuracy. We are looking for someone with strong Python skills and a solid understanding of LLM systems who is excited to continue growing their technical depth. Integrate external APIs and data sources into our agent systems, including Pinecone, Meilisearch, Hasura, Cube, and GCP. Graphs and middleware: Extend and improve our agent state machines, including skill resolution, tool-calling loops, review gates, answer post-processing, and token guards. Observability and operations: Work with real production data and infrastructure and help improve the observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance of our AI systems. End-to-end ownership: Own features from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. Experience integrating APIs, including reading documentation and working with pagination, timeouts, authentication, and complex JSON responses. Experience using LLMs as a developer and an interest in building reliable AI systems, including addressing issues such as hallucinations, incorrect citations, and context limitations. Ability to write high-quality code using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code, or willingness to learn quickly.
