items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries, built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates. Industrial discipline connects the two. Role Details Job location: Portugal (visits to Lisbon or Madrid Office when needed) Contract type: Employee Target start date: January 2027 Working hours: Full-time Compensation: €42k–€58k per year What You'll Architect As an AI Engineer , you will help organisations transform complexity into measurable outcomes by combining technology, data, intelligence, and human decision-making. This role is both technical and consultative — perfect for someone who can combine hands-on AI engineering, solution design, and close collaboration with client teams. We’re looking for professionals who think like architects and act like builders. Your focus is the intelligence layer of the solution: how models are integrated, how information is retrieved, how agents behave, how quality is evaluated, and how the capability performs once deployed. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers, AI Foundation Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Governance specialists , while retaining clear ownership of the AI behaviour and quality of the solution. Design and build production AI capabilities , including RAG systems, intelligent assistants and agent-enabled workflows aligned with the approved solution architecture. Engineer agent behaviour across instructions, context, tools, state, routing, memory, recovery, stopping conditions and appropriate human checkpoints. Integrate and configure models through APIs or supported platforms, making the right trade-offs between capability, quality, latency, cost and operational requirements. Design evaluations and quality gates using representative datasets, automated and regression testing, task-success measures, groundedness and other relevant indicators. Deploy, monitor and improve AI capabilities in production , using evaluation results and observed system behaviour to drive continuous improvement. Implement reliability and control mechanisms such as validation, guardrails, failure handling and human oversight, within the architecture and governance standards defined for the engagement. Integrate AI capabilities with the surrounding solution and client systems , working with Software Engineers on application interfaces and with Data Engineers on retrieval, data quality and AI-ready data. Enable client teams to run and extend the agents after go-live. Document and reuse what works , including AI behaviour, dependencies, evaluation criteria, limitations and engineering patterns that strengthen future Keyrus engagements. Who You Are You are a hands-on engineer who understands that a model is only one part of an intelligent system. You care about what happens after the model responds: whether the context was right, whether the agent chose the appropriate action, and whether the result holds up when it runs repeatedly in production. You make pragmatic technical trade-offs rather than searching for the perfect technology choice. You use evidence and evaluations to improve systems, and you communicate limitations clearly. You know when a problem belongs to AI Engineering and when another specialist should own it. You combine curiosity about new capabilities with the engineering discipline needed to make them operational. You are comfortable working in collaborative, international teams and alongside client stakeholders. ️ What You Bring Qualifications & Experience Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. Samen gaan we voor maximale impact! We geloven in de kracht van diversiteit: we zijn ervan overtuigd dat een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving leidt tot meer innovatie, creativiteit en betere resultaten. Domain Architect Corporate & AI Vacature ID: 11560 Startdatum publicatie: 16-10-2026 Functiebeschrijving Elia Group is op zoek naar een ervaren Domain Architect om ons Central IT Architecture-team te versterken. Als Domain IT Architect zorg je ervoor dat het IT-landschap binnen jouw domeinen coherent, veilig, performant en toekomstbestendig blijft. Je speelt een sleutelrol in het ondersteunen van een betrouwbare uitbating van het elektriciteitsnet door technologiekeuzes af te stemmen op de strategische doelstellingen en de regelgevende verplichtingen van Elia Group. In deze rol neem je ownership over twee strategische domeinen: Corporate: een breed businessdomein dat de corporate capabilities en ondersteunende processen van de organisatie omvat. Artificial Intelligence (AI): een strategisch technologiedomein gericht op het ontwikkelen, schalen en governen van AI-capabilities binnen de organisatie. We zoeken geen puur theoretische architect, maar een pragmatische bruggenbouwer die strategie vertaalt naar concrete oplossingen. Je beweegt je vlot tussen business en technologie en zet strategische doelstellingen om in schaalbare en duurzame architectuurkeuzes. Verantwoordelijkheden: Verantwoordelijk voor het definiëren en uitdragen van de architectuurvisie, roadmap en target architecture voor Corporate IT en AI. items.desc: We’re looking for an Agentic Platform Engineer to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale. Who We Are At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist. As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next. Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here. Your Challenge As our Agentic Platform Engineer, you will help build and scale Liz Agent, Seedtag's AI agent platform, ensuring reliability, security, and seamless integration across teams. Your main responsibilities will include: Agent Platform Development: Build and maintain the core Liz Agent runtime, including agent execution, context management, and event streaming. Tools & Integrations: Develop MCP tool servers, APIs, and integrations that enable secure access to internal data and services. Agentic AI Capabilities: Improve agent functionality through memory, multi-model routing, durable execution, and LLM frameworks. Reliability & Observability: Monitor platform performance, troubleshoot production issues, and improve tracing and evaluation capabilities. Platform Engineering: Contribute to APIs, service templates, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments that enable teams to build agents independently. Security & Quality: Implement security best practices, automated evaluations, and regression testing to ensure reliable agent behaviour. End-to-End Ownership: Take responsibility for features from development to deployment and monitoring, collaborating with Data, ML, Platform, and Product teams. Our Core Values Outcome over Output We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code. Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must Experimentation is key to innovation. We test early, iterate often, and learn fast. We Are All Scouts We take ownership and leave things better than we found them. We Are Data-Driven Data informs our decisions and helps us continuously improve our systems and results. Tech Stack You'll work with the technologies powering Liz Agent, our AI agent platform, built on 30+ services running on GKE. Our stack includes: Languages: Python, Go. Cloud & Infrastructure: GCP, GKE, Kubernetes, Vertex AI, BigQuery. Agentic AI: MCP, PydanticAI, Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, OpenAI Agent SDK. Data & Messaging: Pub/Sub, Redis, Firestore. LLMOps & Observability: Langfuse, Prometheus, Logfire, LiteLLM. DevOps & CI/CD: ArgoCD, Kustomize, GitHub Actions. Additional Technologies: TypeScript, Next.js, embeddings, vector search. What You’ll Need to Succeed 3+ years of experience building and maintaining backend systems in production. Strong Python expertise, including APIs, asynchronous programming, testing, and clean architecture. Hands-on experience developing LLM applications or AI agents, including tool calling, structured outputs, and evaluations. Solid understanding of event-driven architectures, microservices, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure. Experience with LLMOps, observability, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. Knowledge of AI security practices, including authentication, access controls, and prompt-injection protection. Ability to own features end to end, work autonomously, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams. Why Join Seedtag? A key moment of growth with real ownership and global impact. Flexible work model with 100% remote or hybrid options. (Remote contracts available in Spain, Italy, UK, Belgium, Netherlands, France, and Germany.) Continuous learning through a learning platform and optional language classes. A supportive, trust-based culture that values well-being. Team activities, offsites, and opportunities to connect beyond work. Additional Perks Home office setup budget up to €1,000 Paid trips to our HQ in Madrid MacBook Pro M3 Ready to Join the Seedtag Adventure? At Seedtag, we create an environment where everyone can thrive. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, let us know and we’ll ensure a positive experience. Send us your CV and let’s build the future of neuro-contextual advertising together.

items.desc: About Us Innovamat is an educational organization specializing in mathematics education . Founded in Barcelona in 2017, Innovamat provides schools with a complete, research-based math program covering Early Childhood through Secondary Education, grounded in research across mathematics education, cognition, and neuroscience. Our program integrates curriculum, teacher training, assessment, and intervention into a single coherent system. Today, Innovamat is present in 9 countries, partnering with 31,000+ teachers across 3,300+ schools and reaching more than 720,000 students. We are one of the few organizations in the sector with independently validated efficacy data from external research institutions, and the first non-American organization to pass the California State Board of Education adoption process for a core math curriculum. Your Mission You will join our Operations team as its software engineering backbone . Our business systems (CRM, marketing automation, data warehouse, classroom platform, billing and logistics) are a large distributed ecosystem. Until now we have run them with hybrid profiles that combine business understanding with hands-on building. As we scale across markets, we need someone who brings real software engineering discipline to Operations: clean architecture, testing, observability, reliability and maintainability. You will design, build and own the integrations, automations and internal tools that Sales, Marketing, Customer Success and Finance rely on every day and make them as robust as possible. Your Day To Day Building and owning integrations between our core systems (Salesforce, Iterable, the Classroom Manager platform, Jira, the data warehouse, billing and others), with proper error handling, retries, idempotency and monitoring. Developing on the CRM platform (Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows) and replacing no-code spaghetti with maintainable, tested code where it makes sense. Designing data pipelines and syncs that keep our systems consistent at scale, and diagnosing why they drift (data quality, API limits, payload edge cases). Creating internal tools and services that automate manual processes for Revenue and Operations teams, from small scripts to full applications. Work with engineering standards: version control, code review, CI/CD, environments, documentation and incident post-mortems. Taking part in incident resolution across the Operations ecosystem. You will find the root cause and then fix the structural problem so it doesn't come back. Evaluating build vs. buy vs. configure with sound technical judgment, and being honest about trade-offs and cost. Working closely with Engineering and Data so Operations systems and the product platform evolve coherently. Using AI agents and automation to speed up your own development and to design AI-assisted workflows for the business. Mentoring colleagues with hybrid or less technical profiles, raising the technical bar of the team. What We're Looking For 5+ years of professional experience as a software developer (backend or full-stack), with solid fundamentals: data structures, APIs, testing, version control and debugging complex systems. Strong command of at least one general-purpose language ( Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java/Apex or PHP ) and willingness to learn others quickly. Experience designing and consuming REST/GraphQL APIs , webhooks and asynchronous processes, and handling their failure modes. Good SQL skills and comfort working with data models and analytical data (warehouse, ETL/ELT). Experience integrating third-party SaaS platforms (CRM, marketing automation, billing, ERP) is a big plus. Technical judgment: you understand trade-offs, write code that others can maintain, and know when not to build something. Interest in the business side of what you build. You want to understand how Sales, Marketing and Customer Success work, so you solve their real problem and not just the ticket. Early-adopter mindset with AI coding agents and automation tools. High autonomy and ownership. You can take a vague operational pain point and turn it into a reliable solution. Fluent English and conversational Spanish. items.desc: Description Oritain is a global leader in forensic origin verification of products and raw materials. With offices in London, Auckland, Dunedin, Paris, Singapore and Washington D.C, our vision is to be the source of truth in global supply chains. Through our proprietary methodology, our mission is to harness cutting edge science, data, and specialised services to create a community of origin verified buyers and suppliers, protecting our people and planet. We empower the world’s leading brands to make positive changes across their supply chain; ensuring product integrity, meeting regulatory demands, and reducing the risk of fraud and unethical sourcing, creating real change in our world. About the role We’re looking for an Infrastructure & Security Engineer to take ownership of the security and infrastructure foundations that support Oritain’s growth. Reporting to our Head of IT & Security, you’ll secure our cloud, identity and network environments and play a central role in maturing our compliance programme through ISO 27001 renewal, Cyber Essentials certification and alignment with the NIST and CMMC frameworks. This is a senior, hands-on role for someone who thrives taking on a task, shaping the plan, bringing the right people together and delivering it. In your first months, around half of your time will focus on strengthening our security posture, so you’ll make a visible impact early. You’ll work closely with our Service Desk, Engineering teams and colleagues across the business. While there are no direct reports, you’ll be a leading voice in the team: drawing in colleagues to deliver projects, guiding others on how to build securely and helping shape how we work. You’ll also lead the secure adoption of AI across Oritain, bringing an AI-first approach to how we run and protect our infrastructure. We’re a fast-growing business, and many of our processes are still being built. If you see that as an opportunity to create structure, raise standards and leave your mark, you’ll find real scope to grow here, including the chance to build expertise in our modern cloud-based networking and security platform. What you'll be doing Your core focus will be the security of our infrastructure and platforms. You’ll identify, track and remediate vulnerabilities, stay ahead of patching priorities, and administer and continuously improve Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Sentinel, integrating infrastructure and security tooling for monitoring and detection. When incidents happen, you’ll coordinate and technically lead the response alongside our external Security Operations Centre (SOC). You’ll drive our compliance and accreditation work for ISO 27001, Cyber Essentials, NIST and CMMC, using Vanta to manage control coverage and evidence collection. You’ll also contribute to the ongoing development of our Information Security Management System (ISMS) and conduct third-party risk assessments, using automation, Vanta and AI to work efficiently. On the infrastructure side, you’ll design, build, secure and improve our cloud and on-premises services. This includes delivering identity and access solutions with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, role-based access control and secure authentication, and administering Azure infrastructure such as VNets, routing, VPN and site-to-site gateways, and network security groups. You’ll design network segmentation using VLANs, firewall rules and access controls, build and troubleshoot SD-WAN technologies, and support wired and wireless networking, including RADIUS and certificate-based authentication. You’ll also lead the secure adoption of AI across Oritain. That means designing, deploying and securing tools such as Microsoft Copilot and Claude, with data loss prevention (DLP) and Purview controls across Microsoft 365 and Azure. You’ll define AI guardrails, governance standards and usage policies, assess risks such as data leakage and regulatory exposure, and apply AI and automation to make our infrastructure and security workflows more efficient. What we're looking for You’ll bring senior, hands-on experience delivering and supporting IT infrastructure and security, ideally in an organisation of a similar size with global reach, or larger. Most importantly, you’ll have a track record of taking a broad security objective, defining the approach and delivering it end to end with minimal direction. Technically, you’ll have strong working knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, identity and access management and secure authentication, alongside practical experience with Azure and Microsoft 365 infrastructure, including Microsoft Defender and Sentinel. You’ll have solid networking fundamentals, including VLANs, switches, firewalls, routing and VPNs, and experience supporting security incident response and vulnerability management. You’ll also have working knowledge of security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST and Cyber Essentials, with experience supporting audits, ISMS activities or compliance …

N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), et Keeple centralise la gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail) le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile). Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles. Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) spécialisé(e) en Intelligence Artificielle pour renforcer notre équipe R&D et accélérer le développement de nos solutions innovantes. Tu travailleras sur la conception, l’intégration et l’industrialisation de cas d’usage IA (LLM, Machine Learning, RAG, automatisation) au service de nos produits SaaS. Missions principales : Conception et développement de solutions IA en Python. Mise en place de pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pour améliorer la pertinence des modèles, Exploitation du cloud AWS et en particulier des services IA/LLM (ex. Bedrock), Intégration d’outils IA et d’orchestration (N8N, OpenAI, Claude, …), Expérimentation et amélioration continue via prompt engineering et fine-tuning de modèles, Veille technologique sur les innovations IA et proposition d’idées/concepts pour enrichir nos produits, Collaboration avec les équipes produit, data et dev pour industrialiser des solutions IA fiables et scalables. Compétences techniques attendues : Maîtrise du langage Python. Expérience sur AWS (idéalement Bedrock, Lambda, S3, etc.), Bonne culture des APIs IA (OpenAI, Claude, etc.). C’est un plus si : Première expérience en mise en production de solutions IA/LLM Connaissances avancées en LLM et techniques de prompting, Pratique du RAG et des architectures de recherche de données contextuelles, Familiarité avec des outils d’orchestration et d’automatisation (ex. N8N), Soft skills : Force de proposition : capable de transformer la veille technologique en solutions concrètes, Autonomie et rigueur dans le développement, Goût pour le travail collaboratif (produit, QA, data, dev), Curiosité et capacité à vulgariser l’IA pour des profils non techniques. Profil recherché : Expérience confirmée (3 à 5 ans minimum) en développement logiciel (si possible sur des projets IA) Expérience dans un contexte cloud (idéalement AWS), Ce que ce poste n’est PAS : de la data science (pas de modélisation statistique, pas d’entraînement de modèles maison), un rôle de recherche LLM ou NLP, un poste MLOps centré sur l’infrastructure ou la gestion de clusters, un rôle orienté expérimentation académique. Ce poste est bel et bien un rôle de développeur(se) logiciel : il s’agit de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des fonctionnalités IA directement dans nos produits SaaS. Tech, pragmatique, orienté production. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Un environnement stimulant et innovant, Des défis techniques stimulants à fort impact technologique dans une culture de la qualité et du partage, Une vraie autonomie dans les choix techniques, et du temps pour faire bien, Un cadre de travail flexible : télétravail possible avec une semaine de présence par trimestre. Les avantages chez N2JSOFT : Prime de vacances, Chèques cadeaux à Noël, Chèques rentrée scolaire (si tu as des enfants), Chèque culture, Cours de musique, Événements d’équipe toute l’année. Poste en CDI avec full remote possible (une semaine de présence par trimestre requise).

items.desc: Au sein de l'équipe Agentic Platform, en tant qu 'Ingénieur(e) IA , vous contribuerez au développement d'AURA — le Virtual Companion dédié aux business users de la plateforme 3DEXPERIENCE. AURA accompagne des utilisateurs métier dans leurs tâches quotidiennes grâce à des capacités de recherche sur corpus documentaire et à une bibliothèque de fonctionalités connectées aux processus industriels. Nos clients opèrent dans des environnements exigeants où la fiabilité de l'information, la traçabilité des réponses et l'adéquation aux usages métier sont non négociables. Vos missions Votre mission est de concevoir et d'opérer les composants IA orientés business d'AURA : pipelines RAG sur des corpus documentaires d'entreprise, Skills conversationnels et Tools d'intégration métier. Vous serez l'interface entre les besoins exprimés par les équipes produit et les utilisateurs finaux, et les capacités techniques de la plateforme agentique sous-jacente. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec des product managers, des UX researchers et des équipes R&D pour garantir la pertinence, la qualité et la conformité des expériences IA délivrées. A cet effet, vous devrez: Concevoir et maintenir les pipelines RAG d'AURA : chunking stratégique, indexation sémantique, reranking, et évaluation de la qualité des réponses sur des corpus documentaires industriels (procédures, référentiels métier, données produit). Spécifier, développer et qualifier les Skills et Tools d'AURA : intégrations métier (ERP, PLM, bases de connaissances), logique de routage des intentions, gestion des contextes utilisateur. Travailler en proximité avec les business users pour comprendre leurs besoins, modéliser leurs cas d'usage et itérer rapidement sur la pertinence des réponses agentiques. Contribuer à l'évaluation continue des performances d'AURA : définir des benchmarks métier, analyser les traces de conversation, identifier les patterns d'échec et proposer des corrections. Assurer la traçabilité et l'explicabilité des réponses générées : sourcing des réponses, gestion des hallucinations, conformité aux politiques de données de nos clients industriels. Participer à la veille active sur l'écosystème RAG et les usages émergents des LLM en contexte enterprise (techniques d'évaluation, nouveaux patterns d'orchestration, évolutions des modèles). Vos Qualifications De formation Bac+5 en informatique, data science, ingénierie logicielle ou domaine équivalent. +2 ans d'expérience professionnelle incluant une exposition concrète aux LLM et aux systèmes RAG. Maîtrise de Python et des bibliothèques de l'écosystème IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou équivalent). Expérience avec des systèmes de recherche vectorielle (OpenSearch, Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, ou équivalent). Sensibilité aux enjeux d'évaluation des systèmes RAG : métriques de fidélité, de pertinence, de couverture. Capacité à dialoguer avec des utilisateurs métier non techniques et à transformer leurs besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles. Maîtrise de l'anglais professionnel, écrit et oral — environnement de travail international. Atouts différenciants: Expérience avec LangGraph ou un framework d'orchestration agentique structuré. Pratique d'outils d'évaluation RAG (RAGAS, DeepEval, ou équivalent). Connaissance des environnements PLM, ERP ou des processus industriels. Appétence pour le design conversationnel et l'expérience utilisateur des interfaces IA. Nous rejoindre c'est aussi Intégrer une entreprise scientifique au cœur de l’innovation technologique, portée par une forte croissance depuis plus de 40 ans. Principaux avantages et bénéfices : Environnement multiculturel Cadre de travail convivial axé sur le bien-être et la santé (salles de sport & de musique, conciergerie…) Engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l’inclusion Politique dynamique de développement de carrière : plan de formation, mobilités internes, etc Inclusion statement As a game-changer in sustainable technology and innovation, Dassault Systèmes is striving to build more inclusive and diverse teams across the globe. As a company leading change, it’s our responsibility to foster opportunities for all people to participate in a harmonized Workforce of the Future.

With our software products and services, all tax, customs and payment processes in cross-border online trade are automated and significantly simplified.

items.desc: BEDRIJF : Deze Belgische B2B SaaS-speler ontwikkelt software waarmee professionele gebruikers complexe dossiers, documenten en dagelijkse processen beheren. Het platform heeft vandaag dagelijks duizenden gebruikers en staat voor een belangrijke technologische evolutie: AI wordt een integraal onderdeel van het product. De ambitie is om repetitieve processen te automatiseren, grote hoeveelheden informatie toegankelijk te maken en gebruikers te ondersteunen met intelligente AI-functionaliteiten waaronder een semantic search engine. Je komt terecht in een ondernemende productomgeving met de financiële slagkracht van een sterke groep. De lijnen zijn kort, de technologische ambities groot en er is veel ruimte om zelf technische keuzes te maken. JOBOMSCHRIJVING: Als AI Engineer bouw je mee aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een commercieel SaaS-platform naar een AI-driven product. Je ontwikkelt RAG-oplossingen die informatie ontsluiten uit grote documentcollecties, gebruikt LLM's om documenten automatisch te interpreteren en structureren, en bouwt AI Agents die taken en processen zelfstandig uitvoeren. Je bent betrokken bij het volledige traject: van het ontwerpen van de oplossing en het selecteren van modellen tot de integratie in het platform en de uitrol naar productie. Samen met Product Owners, Designers en Software Developers vertaal je nieuwe use cases naar concrete productfunctionaliteiten. Je krijgt de autonomie om technologiekeuzes te maken, nieuwe toepassingen uit te testen en mee richting te geven aan de AI-architectuur en productroadmap. JOUW PROFIEL : Voor deze rol wordt gezocht naar een AI Engineer met een sterke technische basis en duidelijke interesse in AI. Kandidaten met een achtergrond in data engineering, data science of backend development komen zeker in aanmerking. Je hebt minstens 3 jaar relevante ervaring als AI Engineer of ML Engineer. Je bent sterk in Python en hebt ervaring met LLM-toepassingen in productie. Je hebt kennis van RAG-architecturen, vector databases en AI Agents. Je hebt ervaring met frameworks zoals LangChain. Je hebt aandacht voor monitoring, evaluatie en betrouwbaarheid van AI-systemen. Je denkt mee over performantie, schaalbaarheid en kostenoptimalisatie. Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders. Je hebt bij voorkeur ervaring met Azure OpenAI of cloud-native architecturen. UNIEK KARAKTER : Je bouwt AI-functionaliteiten die rechtstreeks geïntegreerd worden in een bestaand SaaS-product en dagelijks hun weg vinden naar duizenden gebruikers. Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, mee te bouwen aan de AI-roadmap maar ook de verantwoordelijkheid om je oplossingen betrouwbaar en schaalbaar in productie te brengen. De combinatie van een ondernemende productomgeving, financiële slagkracht en veel technische autonomie maakt dit een interessante stap voor een AI-Engineer die mee de technologische richting wil bepalen. Je zit dicht bij de productontwikkeling, hebt invloed op architectuurkeuzes en bouwt mee aan een platform waarin AI een centrale rol krijgt. Benieuwd naar meer? Stuur nu jouw CV naar Gilles@cartiere.be en bel +32 3 369 33 05 voor meer informatie. Bekijk onze website www.cartiere.be voor meer vacatures.

items.desc: AI Engineer - Build Production AI at Scale Stockholm | Permanent Build AI that actually gets used. We're looking for a hands-on AI Engineer to join a small central AI team at a major Nordic consumer business. This isn't a role where you'll spend your time writing requirements for someone else to build. You'll work directly with product teams and business stakeholders, help decide what is actually worth building , challenge ideas when needed, prototype quickly and then write the code to turn those ideas into production systems. If you enjoy the space between software engineering, AI and real business problems , this could be a very interesting role. What are you actually going to build? The team already has a growing pipeline of AI projects across the business. Current and upcoming work includes: Customer-facing conversational AI with the potential to reach millions of users. Semantic search and retrieval using modern embedding and vector technologies. Internal AI assistants helping thousands of employees access knowledge. AI-powered content production at significant scale. Image generation and processing for campaigns and digital content. Internal platforms that make it easier for teams to build and deploy AI-powered applications. The technology isn't fixed. The team takes a pragmatic approach to AI - using whatever works best for the problem rather than forcing everything through one framework or vendor. You'll have the freedom to experiment, prototype, rip things apart and rebuild them when necessary. This is the important bit. We're not looking for a traditional Data Scientist . We're looking for someone who can combine: Strong software engineering + modern AI + product judgement. You should be comfortable going from: “The business wants this…” to: “Here's what I think we should actually build…” to: “I've built it — let's get it into production.” You'll work closely with product owners, stakeholders and other engineers throughout that process. What you'll bring We're looking for someone who has: Experience delivering real AI solutions , not just prototypes or experiments. Strong Python/software engineering skills. Experience building backend services and APIs. Good understanding of modern LLM and Generative AI technologies. Experience working with real-world data using SQL, Pandas or similar tools. The confidence to communicate directly with stakeholders. The technical judgement to push back when there is a better solution. A genuine hands-on attitude — you like building things yourself. Your previous job title isn't particularly important. You might currently be an: AI Engineer Applied AI Engineer AI Software Engineer Software Engineer Backend Engineer Product Engineer Machine Learning Engineer Generative AI Engineer What matters is what you've actually built and owned . You don't need to know every tool. Experience with things like these would be valuable: LLM applications RAG Semantic search Embeddings Vector databases AI agents Tool calling Recommendation systems AI evaluation Production AI monitoring Image generation Ecommerce/search/personalisation Specific framework experience isn't a deal-breaker. If you've used Pinecone rather than Qdrant, LangGraph rather than another agent framework, or AWS rather than another cloud platform, that's fine. Strong engineering fundamentals transfer. Why this role is different You'll be joining a small AI team with a big surface area . Rather than owning one small component of a huge platform, you'll have visibility across a substantial part of the business. You'll work directly with the people asking: “Could AI solve this?” and have the opportunity to answer: “Yes — and here's how I'd build it.” That means exposure to: Product. Engineering. AI strategy. Architecture. Business stakeholders. Real customers. Real production systems. And you'll remain hands-on technically . No need to become a people manager to increase your influence. The setup 📍 Central Stockholm — close to Stockholm Central Station. 🏖️ 30 days holiday 💻 Flexible choice of laptop/equipment. 🏠 Hybrid working with plenty of flexibility within the team. ✈️ Occasional Copenhagen travel, typically a day trip. Candidates must already have full working rights in Sweden . Swedish is preferred, although strong English-speaking candidates can be considered.

Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills — you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, and every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. Your focus is the intelligence layer of the solution: how models are integrated, how information is retrieved, how agents behave, how quality is evaluated, and how the capability performs once deployed. You will work closely with Software Engineers, Data Engineers, AI Foundation Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers and AI Governance specialists , while retaining clear ownership of the AI behaviour and quality of the solution. Implement reliability and control mechanisms such as validation, guardrails, failure handling and human oversight, within the architecture and governance standards defined for the engagement. Integrate AI capabilities with the surrounding solution and client systems, working with Software Engineers on application interfaces and with Data Engineers on retrieval, data quality and AI-ready data. Enable client teams to run and extend the agents after go-live. Document and reuse what works, including AI behaviour, dependencies, evaluation criteria, limitations and engineering patterns that strengthen future Keyrus engagements. 👤 Who You Are You are a hands-on engineer who understands that a model is only one part of an intelligent system. You care about what happens after the model responds: whether the context was right, whether the agent chose the appropriate action, and whether the result holds up when it runs repeatedly in production. items.desc: L’IA chez Smile, ce n’est pas un buzzword : c’est une pratique. Des modèles et des cas d’usage ouverts, performants et durables, pensés pour passer en production — pas des PoC qui finissent au tiroir. On bâtit sur des fondations solides, pour des acteurs majeurs du secteur public et de l’énergie. 1 500 experts à travers l’Europe, et une R&D active sur les sujets data et IA. La mission Intégré(e) à un projet d’envergure (IA souveraine, optimisation énergétique par le ML), vous industrialisez l’IA, du PoC à la production. Votre rôle se joue en trois temps. Concevoir et mettre en production Vous concevez et mettez en production des modèles d’IA et des LLM — c’est vous qui faites passer le modèle du notebook au service exploitable. Vous industrialisez les preuves de concept (PoC) en lien étroit avec les Data Scientists. Vous optimisez l’infrastructure d’entraînement et d’inférence (GPU, serving de modèles). Automatiser et fiabiliser (MLOps) Vous mettez en place et automatisez les pipelines MLOps : CI/CD pour le ML, Continuous Training. Vous gérez le cycle de vie des modèles : monitoring des performances, détection de drift, versioning. Vous garantissez des déploiements robustes et scalables, dans la durée. Collaborer et faire progresser Vous dialoguez avec les Data Scientists et les directions métier, et vulgarisez quand il le faut. Vous partagez vos pratiques et contribuez à la capitalisation interne. Vous restez en veille sur l’IA générative et les frameworks d’orchestration. Smile s’engage pour un environnement où la diversité est une force et l’inclusion un pilier. Chaque talent est reconnu, respecté et encouragé à aller plus loin. Votre environnement technique IA & Machine Learning : PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex, RAG MLOps & Orchestration : MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, Docker, Kubernetes Infrastructure & Cloud : AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP Vertex AI, bases vectorielles (ChromaDB, Pinecone, Milvus) Développement : Python, API (FastAPI, Flask), CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) Votre profil Vous Avez 5 Ans Ou Plus D’expérience En Développement Logiciel Et Une Bonne Maîtrise De L’écosystème IA. On Parie Que Vous Cochez Aussi Ces Cases De la rigueur, au service de modèles robustes et scalables. Le goût de résoudre les problèmes complexes d’industrialisation du Machine Learning. De l’autonomie et le sens de l’initiative pour optimiser les architectures IA. Une veille active sur les dernières avancées (Generative AI, LLMOps). Une bonne capacité d’adaptation aux évolutions rapides du secteur. Une communication efficace avec les équipes Data Science et les directions métier. Anglais professionnel (un vrai plus sur nos projets internationaux). Votre future Agence Avec plus de 500 passionnés, l’agence de Asnières-sur-Seine est un véritable terrain de jeu pour les experts et les curieux qui veulent progresser et innover. Pourquoi Smile Management de proximité par des pairs, qui favorise l’échange et un parcours de carrière adapté. Montée en expertise : plateforme d’e-learning, financement de certifications, outils de partage de connaissances. Cooptation rémunérée jusqu’à 3 000 €. Vie d’équipe : convention annuelle, salons, summer party, afterworks. Et aussi : mutuelle & transports pris en charge à 50 %, minimum 9 RTT/an, prime de vacances, Tickets Restaurant (9,50 €, pris en charge à 55 %), CSE dynamique. Les prochaines étapes Premier contact — un échange téléphonique sur vos aspirations et ce que nous pouvons vous offrir. Rencontre — l’occasion d’explorer votre parcours. Échange métier — une discussion avec un expert pour évaluer vos compétences et définir vos objectifs. Et si ça matche, on sera ravis de vous accueillir.

items.desc: The Digital Evolution Company Of Today And Tomorrow Lutech è il Gruppo leader in Italia e player europeo nel digitale e nell’intelligenza artificiale , con oltre 6.000 professionisti impegnati nello sviluppo di soluzioni innovative per aziende e istituzioni. In Lutech tecnologia, dati e AI diventano strumenti concreti per trasformare processi, servizi ed esperienze. Attraverso competenze tecnologiche avanzate, ecosistemi digitali integrati e piattaforme AI proprietarie come Lutech BrAIn, il Gruppo accompagna l’evoluzione dell’intelligenza artificiale dall’analisi all’impatto operativo reale, in scenari complessi e internazionali. Entrare in Lutech significa far parte di una community tecnologica globale , collaborando con team multidisciplinari su sfide reali legate ad AI, cybersecurity, cloud e digital transformation , in un am biente inclusivo e orientato alla crescita , dove competenze, collaborazione e diversità delle esperienze contribuiscono a costruire l’evoluzione tecnologica del futuro. Posizione Come AI Engineer contribuirai alla progettazione e realizzazione di soluzioni basate su AI, Intelligenza Artificiale Generativa e Agentic AI , con focus su progetti cliente di Digital Transformation e su iniziative finanziate in ambito R&D, ad alto contenuto tecnologico. Lavorerai all'interno di team multidisciplinari e dinamici occupandoti dello sviluppo, integrazione e messa in esercizio di componenti AI scalabili, affidabili e riutilizzabili, collaborando con clienti e stakeholder di progetto. Attività Principali Progettare e sviluppare soluzioni AI/GenAI scalabili e robuste, dalla raccolta dei requisiti al deployment; Sviluppare applicazioni, servizi, backend e API in Python basati su LLM, RAG e Agentic AI, collaborando con il team di Front End; Integrare soluzioni AI con database, API, sistemi enterprise, repository documentali e knowledge base; Realizzare e ottimizzare pipeline RAG e progettare workflow agentici e architetture multi-agente per attività di retrieval, reasoning e generazione di contenuti; Integrare e orchestrare LLM (cloud e on-prem), gestendone selezione, performance e affidabilità, con attenzione al contenimento dei costi d'esercizio; Monitorare, testare e ottimizzare qualità, performance e costi delle soluzioni sviluppate. Requisiti Cerchiamo te se hai : Esperienza nel ruolo di almeno 2 anni nello sviluppo software con focus su AI/GenAI; Ottima conoscenza di Python, SQL, gestione dati e principi di sviluppo software; Esperienza con LLM, architetture RAG (vector DB, embedding, Vector Search) e sistemi di recupero della conoscenza; Conoscenza di framework come LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Agent Framework o equivalenti; Familiarità con ambienti Cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP), Docker/containerizzazione, Kubernetes e CI/CD; Comprensione dei principi di sicurezza, governance e valutazione delle soluzioni AI. Nice To Have Esperienza con FastAPI; Certificazioni Cloud o AI; Esperienza in contesti consulenziali e multi-cliente; Conoscenza di Graph RAG, sistemi multi-agent e AI governance; Esperienza nel monitoraggio e nella gestione operativa di soluzioni AI; Contributi a progetti open source o iniziative personali in ambito AI. Per questa opportunità è previsto un inserimento con CCNL Commercio, inquadramento dal livello 2° e una retribuzione annua lorda a partire da €35.000, comprensiva di eventuale componente variabile. Il pacchetto retributivo include inoltre Ticket Restaurant. Nel rispetto della normativa sulla trasparenza retributiva, la retribuzione indicata rappresenta un riferimento iniziale, definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutri rispetto al genere. L'offerta finale sarà determinata tenendo conto delle competenze, dell'esperienza, delle responsabilità associate al ruolo e delle evidenze emerse durante il processo di selezione. Altre Informazioni Sedi di lavoro e modalità lavorativa: Bari con modalità ibrida Lutech attua una politica di pari opportunità e accoglie le candidature senza operare alcuna discriminazione in base a razza, religione o convinzioni personali, origine etnica o nazionale, disabilità, età, cittadinanza, stato civile, inclusa convivenza di fatto e unione civile, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, o qualsiasi altra condizione applicabile tutelata dalla legge.

items.desc: A PwC-nél azon dolgozunk, hogy együttműködve segítsük ügyfeleinket a megalapozott döntések meghozatalában, hatékony működésben, és közösen formáljuk a jövőt. Tapasztalt szoftverfejlesztő vagy, és a következő szakmai lépésedet már a generatív AI területén képzeled el? Ha senior fejlesztőként erős technikai alapokkal rendelkezel, már elkezdtél foglalkozni a generatív AI világával, és hosszú távon ezen a területen szeretnéd folytatni a karriered, csatlakozz generatív AI fejlesztésekre szakosodott tanácsadó csapatunkhoz AI Engineer pozícióba. Technológiai tanácsadó csapatunk többek között nagy nyelvi modellek és generatív AI alkalmazásán, valamint vállalati folyamatok AI-alapú fejlesztésén dolgozik. Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség? Csatlakozhatsz a PwC GenAI Lab dinamikusan fejlődő csapatához; Senior fejlesztői tudásodat a generatív AI területén kamatoztathatod és építheted tovább; Valós üzleti problémákon, hazai és nemzetközi ügyfélprojekteken dolgozhatsz; Tapasztalt GenAI szakértőktől tanulhatsz, miközben önállóan is mélyítheted tudásodat. Feladataid a következők lesznek: LLM-ekre épülő, RAG és agentic megoldások fejlesztése a koncepciótól a működő alkalmazásig; Stabil és jól strukturált GenAI megoldások kialakítása meglévő szoftverfejlesztői tudásodra építve; Új GenAI technológiák és megközelítések megismerése, kipróbálása és gyakorlati alkalmazása; Önálló felelősségvállalás PoC projektekben, senior szakértőinkkel együttműködve. Sikeres lehetsz a pozícióban, ha: Senior/medior szintű szoftverfejlesztői tapasztalattal és erős programozási alapokkal rendelkezel; Már elkezdtél megismerkedni az LLM-ek, RAG, agentic AI vagy kapcsolódó technológiák világával; Tudatosan a generatív AI irányába szeretnéd továbbépíteni a karriered; Motivált vagy abban, hogy intenzív tanulással és önálló, illetve on the job fejlődéssel megszerezd a szükséges mélyebb AI tudást; Proaktív, megoldásorientált hozzáállás és erős szoftverfejlesztői szemlélet jellemez; Legalább középfokú angol nyelvtudással rendelkezel. Python tapasztalat (3+ év) Docker tapasztalat és valamely Cloud Platform gyakorlati ismerete (AWS/Azure/GCP) Előnyt jelent: Saját GenAI/LLM projekt vagy gyakorlati tapasztalat; RAG, agentic vagy multi-agent megoldások ismerete; Kubernetes, LangGraph, n8n vagy Copilot Studio tapasztalat; Aktívan követed a GenAI fejlődését és önállóan is kísérletezel az új technológiákkal. Miért válassz bennünket? Nálunk lehetőséget kapsz arra, hogy tapasztalt fejlesztőként tudatosan a generatív AI irányába építsd tovább a karriered, miközben valódi ügyfélprojekteken, tapasztalt szakértőkkel dolgozol. Rugalmas munkavégzés, folyamatos szakmai fejlődési lehetőség és széles körű juttatási csomag vár. Ha készen állsz arra, hogy a következő szakmai fejezetedet a generatív AI területén kezdd el, várjuk jelentkezésed!

items.desc: Buenos dias!! Hoy buscamos un/a Conversational Designer especializado/a en Inteligencia Artificial Generativa para incorporarse a un proyecto estratégico dentro del sector banca . La persona seleccionada participará en el diseño, evolución y optimización de experiencias conversacionales basadas en IA, trabajando en estrecha colaboración con equipos de producto, datos e ingeniería. Buscamos un perfil capaz de combinar diseño centrado en usuario, diseño conversacional, prompting, agentes de IA y análisis , con soltura para desenvolverse en entornos tecnológicos en constante evolución. Responsabilidades Diseñar experiencias conversacionales centradas en el usuario para interfaces basadas en IA. Definir flujos, comportamientos y lógica conversacional para asistentes y agentes inteligentes. Diseñar y optimizar prompts y system prompts para controlar el comportamiento de modelos generativos. Participar en el diseño y orquestación de agentes de IA , tanto single-agent como multi-agent. Prototipar rápidamente nuevas experiencias conversacionales y validar hipótesis mediante pruebas e iteración. Evaluar la calidad de las respuestas generadas por los modelos, identificando problemas de precisión, alucinaciones, seguridad o comportamiento inesperado. Analizar datos e interacciones para detectar oportunidades de mejora y evolucionar la experiencia. Traducir necesidades de negocio y usuario en requisitos funcionales y especificaciones técnicas. Colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, datos, producto y negocio para garantizar la viabilidad de las soluciones. Participar en sesiones de co-creación con stakeholders y acompañar la toma de decisiones durante el desarrollo del producto. Requisitos técnicos Experiencia en diseño conversacional aplicado a asistentes virtuales, chatbots, voicebots o soluciones basadas en IA. Experiencia trabajando con IA Generativa y LLMs . Conocimientos sólidos de Prompt Engineering y diseño de system prompts. Experiencia o conocimiento en diseño y orquestación de agentes de IA . Familiaridad con frameworks o plataformas como OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex o tecnologías equivalentes. Experiencia evaluando modelos generativos y analizando calidad, robustez, alucinaciones y seguridad. Capacidad para analizar métricas y datos de interacción y utilizarlos para iterar sobre el producto. Experiencia trabajando con metodologías de prototipado, testing e iteración rápida. Competencias Buscamos una persona cómoda trabajando en contextos donde no siempre existe una respuesta única o completamente predecible. Será importante contar con: Capacidad para tomar decisiones con información incompleta. Mentalidad experimental y orientación a MVP: prototipar, testar, aprender y ajustar . Tolerancia a la ambigüedad tecnológica y facilidad para adaptarse a nuevas herramientas y modelos. Capacidad para gestionar expectativas con stakeholders en proyectos donde los resultados de la IA pueden ser probabilísticos. Resiliencia ante fallos o comportamientos inesperados de los modelos. Capacidad de priorización y adaptación ante cambios de alcance o requisitos. Buenas habilidades de comunicación y trabajo multidisciplinar. Curiosidad tecnológica y alta capacidad de autoaprendizaje. Valorable Experiencia previa en sector financiero o banca . Experiencia en proyectos enterprise de IA conversacional. Conocimientos de NLP/NLU. Experiencia con arquitecturas RAG, agentes autónomos o sistemas multi-agente. Experiencia definiendo metodologías de evaluación de soluciones GenAI. Perfil ideal Buscamos un perfil híbrido entre Conversational Designer, AI Product Designer y GenAI Specialist , capaz de entender tanto la experiencia de usuario como las posibilidades y limitaciones técnicas de los modelos generativos. Si eres tú, te estamos esperando. Manda tu correo a talento@lainfamedigital.com

items.desc: About Us At BGBx , we're driven by a simple idea: breakthrough thinking creates breakthrough impact. As an independent commercial solutions partner to pharmaceutical and life science companies, we bring together strategists, scientists, communicators, creatives, technologists, and data experts to tackle some of healthcare's most important challenges. Our teams work across consulting and communications to help clients shape strategy, launch innovations, engage stakeholders, and drive meaningful results throughout the product lifecycle. The work is complex, fast-moving, and deeply connected to improving lives, creating opportunities for curious minds to make a real difference every day. If you're energized by collaboration, inspired by innovation, and motivated by work that matters, you'll find a place to grow, contribute, and make a meaningful impact at BGBx. Position Overview We are looking for an AI Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to help maintain and evolve our fleet of AI agents, LLM-as-a-judge systems, and other AI-powered tools used by healthcare, life sciences, and marketing teams. This role will work closely with senior engineers on graph design and with product and research teams to define what “a good answer” means, including grounding, coverage, and citation honesty. The AI Engineer will contribute to the continued development of these systems by improving tools, retrieval and citations, agent architecture, and overall system speed, cost, and accuracy. They will also support evaluations and experiments that help us understand and improve system performance. We are looking for someone with strong Python skills and a solid understanding of LLM systems who is excited to continue growing their technical depth. At this level, the engineer should be comfortable owning a component of a production service from design through testing and review, while partnering with more senior engineers on broader architecture and system design. Responsibilities Agent tools: Create new agent tools and improve existing ones across retrieval and grounding, vector and keyword search, live-source search, analytics queries, PDF generation, and more. Integrate external APIs and data sources into our agent systems, including Pinecone, Meilisearch, Hasura, Cube, and GCP. Graphs and middleware: Extend and improve our agent state machines, including skill resolution, tool-calling loops, review gates, answer post-processing, and token guards. Observability and operations: Work with real production data and infrastructure and help improve the observability, reliability, and ongoing maintenance of our AI systems. End-to-end ownership: Own features from design and implementation through testing, deployment, and production support. Qualifications 3-5 years of hands-on engineering experience, ideally working with data and/or AI systems. Professional experience writing and testing Python. Experience integrating APIs, including reading documentation and working with pagination, timeouts, authentication, and complex JSON responses. Experience using LLMs as a developer and an interest in building reliable AI systems, including addressing issues such as hallucinations, incorrect citations, and context limitations. Ability to write high-quality code using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, Codex, or Claude Code, or willingness to learn quickly. Comfort working with production systems and taking ownership of features through implementation, testing, and deployment. Nice to have Hands-on experience with async Python in production (asyncio, aiohttp, or similar). Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, or another agent or tool-calling framework. Knowledge of search and RAG concepts, including embeddings, filters, and hybrid keyword and vector retrieval. Exposure to GraphQL or analytics APIs, such as Cube or similar semantic layers. items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in the Benelux Region. This is a hands-on, in-region role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

As our first marketing hire in the Benelux Region, your work will shape how Benelux businesses discover, evaluate, and adopt ElevenLabs. The goal is to build repeatable marketing engines that make ElevenLabs the top choice for every enterprise.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build integrated B2B marketing campaigns end to end across Benelux priority industries from strategy and messaging through execution and measurement.

 - Localize and execute programs across ABM, content, events, webinars, partner/customer marketing, executive branding, product launches, and outbound - choosing the right channel for the problem rather than owning a single function.

 - Adapt global campaigns and messaging for the the Benelux market, and feed local insights (buyer behavior, competitive dynamics, regulatory context) back to the global team.

 - Partner closely with local sales and the global product marketing, growth, and design teams to keep messaging consistent and execute high-impact campaigns.

 - Own pipeline generation and campaign performance for the market, using data to measure results, run experiments, and continuously improve what works.

 


REQUIREMENTS

 - 4+ years of experience at a high-growth technology company - you've built and scaled B2B demand generation programs that created measurable enterprise pipeline, and you know what moved the needle.

 - Ownership Pedigree: You have implemented growth and marketing projects from start to finish and held yourself accountable for the ROI.

 - Deep knowledge of the Benelux market: its enterprise buyers, media landscape, and business culture, ideally with an existing network.

 - Work well without much process. This role spans multiple marketing functions and needs someone who sets priorities, spots opportunities, and moves quickly as our first marketer in the market.

items.desc: About Behavox Behavox is shaping the future for how businesses harness their most important raw material - data. Our mission is bold: Organize enterprise data into actionable information that protects and promotes the business growth of multinational companies around the world. From managing enterprise risk and compliance to maximizing revenue and value, our data operating platform presents a widespread opportunity to build multilingual, AI/ML-based solutions that activate data for every function within a global enterprise. Our approach is unique, and it's validated by our customers who tell us to keep forging ahead because no one else is aggregating, analyzing, and acting on data to uncover opportunities or solve problems quite the way we are. We are looking for fearless innovators who have an insatiable appetite for building what no one has built before. About the Role The Front Office Subject Matter Expert is an experienced individual contributor in the Subject Matter Expert (SME) team. The role is the primary owner of one or two related asset classes and makes sure that the Behavox Financial Data Model (BFDM) and the Unified Risk Taxonomy (URT) reflect how trading desks, venues and regulation actually work. The URT is the common language for risks across preventive controls (such as conflicts of interest and conduct) and detective controls (such as trade and communications surveillance). Working with little day-to-day instruction, the role defines asset class data specifications, turns market abuse typologies into scenarios for Polaris, the Behavox trade surveillance product, and advises product, engineering and data science teams. It supports the revenue team in client meetings, demos and requests for proposal (RFPs) alongside a senior SME or the manager, but does not lead engagements with high-profile prospects or regulators on its own. The role is AI-native: it works with AI agents and agentic workflows, not only chat assistants, specifying requirements for agent-based pipelines and validating their outputs through structured data models and Git-based workflows. This is a remote friendly opportunity. Typical background: Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in a front office role, in market surveillance, or with front office data at an exchange, trading venue, market data provider or trading technology vendor. Languages: English required; other languages a strong plus. Agentic workflows: hands-on experience is a plus. Location: open for a remote candidate within Italy. What You'll Bring: Asset class markets – Practitioner-level knowledge of at least one of: commodities and environmental products; digital assets and event contracts; fixed income and structured products; equities and funds; foreign exchange and money markets. This includes instruments, venues, trading conventions and pricing. Front office workflows – Understanding of how execution, sales, research and risk functions operate on a trading desk, including order handling, quoting and hedging. Market abuse typologies – Knowledge of behaviors such as insider dealing, spoofing and layering, wash trading, front running and benchmark manipulation, and how they appear in trade, order and market data. Financial markets regulation – Working knowledge of trading conduct rules, such as the EU Market Abuse Regulation (MAR), the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID II), and US rules of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) and the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Structured data modelling – Understanding of trade, order, market and reference data, their quality issues, and modelling concepts such as entities, schemas, validation rules and versioning. What You'll Do: Asset class data specification – Defines BFDM fields, schemas and validation rules for owned asset classes, and checks data outputs against them. Surveillance scenario design – Turns market abuse typologies into Polaris risk scenarios, anchors them to regulatory enforcement cases, and validates their outputs with engineering and data science. Risk taxonomy maintenance – Maps owned asset classes to URT risk situations and regulatory requirements, and keeps coverage current. Client engagement support – Answers front office, data and surveillance questions in client meetings, demos and RFPs alongside the revenue team, and produces SME-reviewed collateral. AI-native, agentic ways of working – Writes clear specifications for agent-based pipelines, reviews and validates their outputs, and contributes changes through Git-based workflows in GitLab. items.desc: We’re looking for a [Job Title] to join our tech team and help build the future of neuro-contextual advertising at global scale. Who We Are At Seedtag, our mission is to transform advertising by proving that effectiveness and user privacy can truly coexist. As the leading Neuro-Contextual Advertising Company, we combine Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Computer Vision, and neuroscience to understand not only what content is about, but how it makes people feel and what they intend to do next. Our proprietary AI, Liz, enables brands to connect with audiences across the open web and Connected TV without cookies or user tracking. Founded in 2014 by two ex-Googlers, Seedtag has grown to 500+ Seedtaggers in 17 countries, backed by €250M in funding, and operates today as a global ad-tech leader. If you enjoy solving complex engineering challenges and building AI-driven systems at scale, you’ll feel right at home here. Your Challenge As our Junior Data Scientist, you will join our Insights team to transform contextual, audience, and campaign data into actionable insights for clients and commercial teams, leveraging Liz, Seedtag's AI. Your main responsibilities will include: Data Pipelines & Analytics: Build and maintain pipelines to analyse campaign performance, audience behaviour, and contextual data across the open web and CTV. Analytical Models: Develop models for audience profiling, content analysis, campaign comparisons, and pre-campaign planning. Data Products: Turn analyses into scalable data products using tools such as dbt, Trino, and Airflow, ensuring data quality and reliability. AI Agents & Automation: Prototype LLM-based agents and workflows using techniques such as embeddings, classification, clustering, and summarisation. Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and evaluate experiments to ensure automated insights are accurate, reliable, and actionable. Data Quality & Troubleshooting: Investigate data anomalies, identify root causes, and improve pipeline reliability. Data Storytelling: Communicate findings through clear visualisations and actionable recommendations for Product, Sales, and clients. Our Core Values Outcome over Output We measure success by impact and value, not by volume of features or lines of code. Failure Is Allowed, Learning Is a Must Experimentation is key to innovation. items.desc: DESCRIPTION AWS Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to design, build, and deploy production-grade AI systems. We are looking for a Security Engineer to join the FDE security team and help secure production AI systems deployed in customer environments. You will conduct security reviews, write security tooling, perform threat modeling, and implement controls that protect AI systems built by FDE engineers. You work alongside FDE delivery pods in customer environments, getting hands-on with production code, cloud infrastructure, and AI/ML pipelines. You learn fast, ship fast, and build security into the system rather than bolting it on after the fact. This is a hands-on security engineering role where you spend most of your time writing code, reviewing architectures, and testing systems. You work with senior security engineers who will mentor you, but you own real security deliverables from your first engagement. If you want to learn AI security by doing it, in production, at enterprise scale, this is the role. Key job responsibilities Conduct security design reviews, code reviews, and architecture assessments for production AI systems (agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, orchestration layers, model integrations) under guidance from senior security engineers Perform threat modeling and penetration testing for AI/ML applications deployed in customer environments; identify vulnerabilities and work with FDE engineers to implement fixes before production release Build and maintain security automation: scanning tools, CI/CD security gates, guardrail testing scripts, secrets detection, and dependency vulnerability checks for forward-deployed AI systems Implement security controls for AI-specific threats: prompt injection prevention, output filtering, data isolation, model API endpoint hardening, and guardrail configuration Support security incident response for FDE-delivered production AI systems; assist with triage, root cause analysis, and remediation under senior engineer guidance Document security findings, patterns, and remediation guidance as reusable playbooks and runbooks that benefit future FDE engagements Contribute to the FDE security accelerator library: reusable modules, templates, and reference configurations that help FDE engineers build secure AI systems faster Requires up to 25% travel A day in the life You start the morning running your automated security scan against a new Bedrock-powered application an FDE pod shipped overnight, triaging the findings and filing issues for two real vulnerabilities. Mid-morning you pair with an FDE engineer to fix an IAM policy that's overly permissive for their multi-agent orchestration system. After lunch you're writing a Python script that automates guardrail bypass testing for the team's standard deployment pattern. You close out the day joining a threat modeling session led by a senior security engineer, where you learn how to assess data flow risks in a customer's RAG pipeline. Every week you're working on a different AI architecture, building skills you can't get anywhere else. About the team AWS Forward Deployed Engineering embeds AI engineers directly inside strategic enterprise customers to build production AI systems. AWS invested $1B in this initiative. We move at the speed of the customer: demonstrating ROI in weeks, not quarters. We are customer-obsessed. We lead customers toward outcomes, build together, and leave behind scalable patterns. Security is our enabling function: without it, nothing goes to production. Our culture is people-first, anti-burnout, bold, and engineering-excellence-driven. ABOUT AWS: Diverse Experiences Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying. Why AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses. Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. Inclusive Team Culture AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices …

items.desc: Rejoindre Davidson, ce n’est pas seulement intégrer un groupe de 3000 consultants dans 6 pays et 2 continents, c’est intégrer LA société qui a été élue par ses salariés Great Place To Work France et Europe pendant 4 ans mais aussi une des plus grandes B Corp de France, nommée Best of the World dans la catégorie “collaborateurs” en 2022 ! (Les “B Corp” formant une communauté de sociétés qui ont décidé d’être non pas les meilleures du monde mais les meilleures POUR le monde). Parce que notre développement repose sur des principes forts : Un profond respect de l’ensemble de nos parties prenantes : consultant(e)s, clients et fournisseurs. Car si le travail “ne fait pas le bonheur”, il peut cependant “faire le malheur”. Nous nous engageons donc à écouter et agir avec honnêteté. Une égalité des chances dans le traitement de nos candidatures et dans la gestion de carrière de nos salarié(e)s. Nous croyons en un milieu de travail où équité F/H, inclusion et diversité sont la norme. Une empreinte environnementale minimale, et sociétale maximale. C’est pourquoi, au-delà des missions que vous réaliserez, vous pourrez également contribuer à des projets que Davidson soutient : missions de solidarité internationale (avec Planète Urgence), bénévolat auprès d’associations (chaque Davidsonien(ne) dispose de 3 jours par an pour intervenir à leurs côtés), accompagnement d’étudiant(e)s issus de milieux peu favorisés (avec Article 1), investissement dans des startups développant des solutions innovantes, actions collectives et individuelles pour la réduction de notre impact carbone… Un Management adhocratique basé sur la mise en œuvre des principes de “l’entreprise horizontale” et du “management tribal”. Sur ce dernier point une précision d’importance : le bien-être au travail est un luxe qu’il faut pouvoir s’offrir en étant une entreprise “solide”. Ceci induit pour les Davidsonien(ne)s d’allier prises d’initiative, engagement et professionnalisme. Car “sans travail, le talent n’est qu’une sale manie”. Et cela nous incite à chercher à recruter des personnes… meilleures que nous… Nous encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap, et nous nous engageons à répondre au mieux à leurs besoins spécifiques. Profil / Mission L’IA Engineer / Développeur est responsable de la conception, du développement et de l’industrialisation de solutions d’intelligence artificielle, avec un accent sur l’IA générative (GenAI) et les cas d’usage enterprise (assistants, RAG, automatisation, analyse de documents, etc.). Ses Principales Missions Incluent Le choix, la mise en œuvre et l’optimisation de modèles d’IA (LLM, modèles de vision, embeddings, etc.) en fonction des cas d’usage et des contraintes (coût, latence, confidentialité, conformité) La conception et l’optimisation d’architectures RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) : ingestion, chunking, embeddings, bases vectorielles, stratégies de retrieval, évaluation de la qualité des réponses La gestion des pipelines de données : collecte, nettoyage, transformation, enrichment, versioning et gouvernance des données utilisées pour l’IA L’ingénierie de prompts et l’orchestration de flux d’IA (multi-agents, tool calling, function calling, guardrails, filtrage, modération) L’intégration de l’IA dans les applications et SI existants (APIs, microservices, événements, interfaces utilisateurs) La contribution au déploiement de solutions IA dans des environnements cloud sécurisés (AWS, Azure, GCP), avec une attention particulière à la sécurité, la confidentialité et la conformité (RGPD, politiques internes) La mise en place de pratiques MLOps / LLMOps : monitoring des modèles et des prompts, gestion des versions, tests, re-training / fine-tuning, gestion des coûts et de la performance La collaboration avec les équipes métier, data, produit et sécurité pour transformer des besoins business en solutions IA robustes et mesurables Compétences requises ou à acquérir Maîtrise de l’anglais (écrit et oral) Maîtrise du français ou du néerlandais Expérience confirmée en développement : Python (obligatoire), et/ou SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, .NET Expérience confirmée en data engineering : préparation de données, pipelines (batch/streaming), nettoyage, ingestion, qualité des données Expérience confirmée dans la mise
