items.desc: About the Company Our client is a global industry leader undergoing a major AI-driven transformation. As part of its Global AI strategy, the company is investing in enterprise AI capabilities to accelerate business transformation, improve decision-making and unlock value across the organization. Joining the Global AI team means becoming part of a strategic function focused on delivering scalable, production-ready AI solutions with real business impact About the Role As an AI Engineer, you will join the Global AI team, designing, developing and deploying end-to-end AI solutions that solve complex business challenges and deliver measurable value. Initially focused on Generative AI, Agentic AI and LLM-based applications, you will take solutions from experimentation to production while helping build scalable, enterprise-ready AI capabilities Responsibilities Analyze business challenges and transformation opportunities, translating them into effective AI-driven solutions Assess and select the most appropriate AI approach (Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Computer Vision, Generative AI, Agentic AI or hybrid solutions) for each business use case Execute end-to-end AI projects, from discovery, experimentation and prototyping through to production deployment and business adoption Design, integrate and deploy scalable AI solutions in enterprise environments Support the first wave of business transformation initiatives within Finance, while building reusable AI assets and best practices that can be applied across other business domains Ensure AI solutions meet performance, robustness, scalability, security and maintainability requirements Deploy AI solutions into production environments and support model monitoring, retraining and lifecycle management Adhere to architectural, security and AI governance standards defined by the Global AI Department Continuously explore and evaluate emerging AI techniques, models and technologies, assessing their applicability within enterprise environments Contribute to proofs of concept, technical evaluations and reusable delivery patterns Share technical insights and recommendations with both business and technical stakeholders Requirements Must Have 5+ years of professional experience in Artificial Intelligence, with a solid foundation in Machine Learning, Deep Learning and/or Data Science. Within this experience, 1–2 years of hands-on work with Generative AI and/or Agentic AI solutions applied to real business use cases Proven experience taking AI solutions from experimentation or proof of concept through to production deployment Strong Python skills and practical experience with LLMs and AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph or similar Ability to understand business challenges and translate them into practical, scalable AI solutions Experience collaborating with business and technical stakeholders in enterprise environments Professional working proficiency in English and Spanish Nice to Have Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform Knowledge of agentic protocols such as A2A and MCP Relevant cloud or AI certifications Experience in banking, retail, pharmaceutical and/or manufacturing environments Exposure to AI-enabled business process transformation with measurable impact Experience working in global corporate environments If you're ready to help shape the future of enterprise AI as part of a Global AI team, we'd love to hear from you!

En France, Cofidis Group regroupe 3 enseignes commerciales, spécialistes dans la vente de produits et services financiers, et son GEIE Synergie : - Cofidis, spécialiste européen du crédit en ligne - Monabanq, la banque en ligne nouvelle génération - Creatis, spécialiste du regroupement de crédits à la consommation - le GEIE Synergie qui apporte aux enseignes son expertise dans les domaines de la gestion du risque, du recouvrement /contentieux, des ressources humaines et de la communication, du juridique, du risk management, des fonctions financières/ comptables et organisationnelles. Rattaché(e) au domaine Data Science de la Direction de la Donnée de Synergie, vous contribuez à une exploitation innovante et responsable de la Data Science, de l'IA et de l'IA générative en lien avec les métiers et experts du groupe. Vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement de solutions utiles et explicables et éthiques, alignées avec les ambitions de valeurs du groupe. Vous avez envie de rejoindre une équipe tournée vers l'innovation, le partage et le développement des compétences, n'attendez pas pour saisir l'opportunité ! En proximité avec les différents métiers des filiales de Cofidis Group, vous exercez les responsabilités suivantes : - Traduire un besoin métier en problématique data exploitable et proposer des leviers d'optimisation ou d'innovation. Sensibiliser les métiers pour faire émerger des cas d'usage à forte valeur. - Concevoir, développer et industrialiser des modèles prédictifs (algorithmes, machine learning, forecasting, etc.) qui répondent de manière efficace et opérationnelle à la problématique métier : de la préparation des données au déploiement (documentation, intégration, automatisation, suivi, retraining). J'adopte une méthodologie itérative et de planification de projet - Participer aux projets d'exploration et de déploiement de la cellule IA tout en veillant au respect de la gouvernance IA du Groupe - En qualité de référent d'une entité, délivrer des conseils, des partages de travaux du Groupe, et remonter les besoins de l'entité. - Partager son expertise avec les ingénieurs statistiques du Groupe et du Crédit Mutuel Alliance Fédérale via des restitutions pédagogiques, modules de formation, support de nos plateformes et animer la communauté (comités, réseau social pro interne, Hackathon, ...) - Assurer une veille active sur l'IA par des formations, recherches personnelles et collaboration avec des écoles et des start-up. Expérimenter et diffuser les enseignements de cette veille. Le champ d'application est très large : marketing, expérience client, risque et fraude... Des déplacements sont à prévoir chaque année. Diplômé(e) Bac+5 en Informatique, Statistiques vous disposez d'une expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en modélisation statistique et pilotage de projets data innovants. Maitrise du machine learning / deep learning et au traitement du langage naturel dans un environnement professionnel (Git) Vous maîtrisez le langage Python pour la data science et SQL. Bonnes connaissances des LLM, prompt engineering, RAG et fort intérêt pour les technologies émergentes. Ce qui peut constituer un plus : SAS, enjeux éthiques/frugaux, outils de dataviz (BI ou dash), création d'API Python, automatisation avec Airflow et des compétences en webscraping. Anglais compréhension écrite et orale niveau B2 minimum. Analytique et rigoureux, vous êtes orienté(e) résultats. En bon(ne) communicant(e), vous collaborez activement avec les autres membres du service et vos clients internes, en favorisant l'esprit d'équipe et le partage. Vous faîtes preuve de capacité de vulgarisation et vous consacrez du temps à la mise en valeur de ce que vous apportez aux entités. Enfin, vous êtes curieux(se) pour vous former continuellement, suivre les nouvelles tendances et vous êtes force de proposition. Ref : 31278525

Unsere Teams gehen täglich an die Grenzen des technologisch Machbaren – von HPC-Architekturen der nächsten Generation bis hin zu Exascale-Supercomputern. Dabei profitieren sie von exzellenter Forschung und Entwicklung, über 1.600 Patenten sowie einzigartigen End-to-End-Kompetenzen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette von Hardware-Design über Software Engineering und Data Science bis hin zur Quantenforschung. Bei Bull stehen die Mitarbeitenden und das Thema Innovation im Mittelpunkt. Zusammenarbeit kennt bei uns keine Grenzen – unsere Teams sind in Europa, Nord- und Südamerika sowie Indien vernetzt. Uns verbindet eine gemeinsame Vision verantwortungsvolle und nachhaltige Innovation, die echten, messbaren Mehrwert für unsere Kunden schafft. Wir suchen neue Kolleg innen an unseren bundesweiten Standorten . Die science + computing AG, ein Unternehmen von Bull, erbringt hochwertige, innovative und spezialisierte IT-Dienstleistungen für anspruchsvolle internationale Kunden im Bereich Automotive und Manufacturing. Mit 285 hochqualifizierten Mitarbeitenden in Deutschland und Rumänien stellen wir sicher, dass unsere Kunden ihre Geschäftsziele im Bereich R&D und Engineering, sowie beim Betrieb ihrer geschäftskritischen Anwendungen bestmöglich realisieren können. Was sind Ihre Aufgaben Sie arbeiten in Projekten vorwiegend mit Python (z. B. pandas, numpy), SQL, Jupyter, PySpark, sowie Databricks. Zudem beschäftigen Sie sich mit Spark, Data Warehousing, Data Engineering, Big Data, MLOps und LLMOps. Sie arbeiten mit modernen KI-Technologien wie Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), AI Agents, Embedding-Modellen und Vektordatenbanken. Sie entwickeln KI-gestützte Lösungen, insbesondere mit NLP-Architekturen und RAG-Systemen. Sie arbeiten mit den modernsten Cloud-Technologien (AWS, Azure oder GCP). Sie entwerfen und entwickeln intelligente Anwendungen unter Verwendung moderner ML- sowie LLM-basierter Architekturen. Sie arbeiten während der Implementierung von Lösungen mit modernen Frameworks und Bibliotheken wie LangChain, LlamaIndex sowie cloudnativen AI-Services und bringen die entwickelten Lösungen mit Hilfe von MLOps- und LLMOps in die Produktion. Sie entwickeln automatisierte Prozesse zur Extraktion, Transformation und zum Laden von Daten (insbesondere auf Databricks). Sie stellen die Datenqualität, Sicherheit und den effizienten Datenfluss (ETL/ELT-Prozesse) im Projekt sicher. Sie entwickeln gemeinsam mit unseren Daten- und KI-Architekten innovative Fachthemen für unsere Kunden. Sie übernehmen die eigenverantwortliche (Teil-)Projektleitung und Verantwortung für die Einhaltung von Aufwänden gemäß (Projekt-)vorgaben. Im Rahmen von Pre-Sales Aktivitäten unterstützen Sie bei der Qualifizierung sowie Bearbeitung von Ausschreibungen aus technischer Sicht. Sie identifizieren proaktiv Optimierungs- und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten innerhalb des laufenden Projektes und wirken bei den nachfolgenden Vertriebsaktivitäten mit. Sie analysieren Kundenanforderungen, untersuchen die technische Machbarkeit und setzen diese in ein Angebot um. Außerdem erstellen Sie Aufwandsabschätzungen / Kalkulationsgrundlagen für Angebote. Sie arbeiten in agilen Teams (2-5 Personen, z.B. Data Scientist, Analyst sowie Projektmanager) sowohl an langfristigen Projekten als auch an kürzeren Proof-of-Concepts. Sie vertreten unser Unternehmen überzeugend nach außen und arbeiten mit den unterschiedlichsten Branchen zusammen. Sie führen Kunden-Workshops durch. Sie arbeiten an Konzeption, Design, Implementierung, Test und Beratung mit und setzen Lösungskomponenten oder Funktionsbausteine um. Sie erstellen die jeweils erforderliche Dokumentation nach den geltenden Standards unter Anwendung gängiger Methoden und Verfahren bzw. Regelwerken in einem Aufgabengebiet. Was bringen Sie mit? items.desc: Help Shape the Future of AI in Insurance We are partnering with one of the UK's leading insurance organisations on a major AI transformation programme and are looking for an exceptional AI Engineer to join a growing enterprise AI team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on cutting-edge initiatives spanning Generative AI, Agentic AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Semantic Search, AI Agents and Enterprise AI Platforms , helping deliver innovative solutions at scale across a complex, highly regulated environment. You'll work alongside AI Architects, Data Scientists, Engineers and Business Leaders to build secure, scalable and production-ready AI capabilities that create measurable business value. Integrate AI services into enterprise applications using modern APIs and cloud-native architectures. Optimise, monitor and improve AI model performance in production environments. Support the evolution of enterprise AI platforms, engineering standards and MLOps capabilities. Stay ahead of emerging AI technologies and contribute to innovation across the organisation. Familiarity with MLOps, CI/CD pipelines and production AI operations. Strong software engineering and API development skills. Excellent problem-solving and stakeholder engagement capabilities. Experience working in regulated industries such as insurance, banking or financial services is advantageous. Why Join? This is a unique opportunity to join a large-scale AI transformation programme where you will work with the latest AI technologies, influence enterprise-wide innovation, and help define how AI is adopted across a leading insurance business. You'll be part of a high-performing team delivering impactful, business-critical AI solutions while gaining exposure to some of the most exciting developments in Generative AI and Agentic AI. Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical designs, user stories, and working software. Contribute to platform architecture decisions, including infrastructure-as-code (Terraform), containerisation (Docker), and CI/CD practices. Write clean, tested, well-documented code and participate in code reviews, sprint ceremonies, and knowledge-sharing across the team. Hands-on experience with cloud platforms, particularly AWS, and familiarity with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog). Exposure to LLMs and generative AI — model integration, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agent-based architectures. Familiarity with modern web frameworks (e.g. React, Next.js) and API design (REST, GraphQL). Understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, and working with structured and unstructured data at scale. Solid fundamentals in software engineering: version control (Git), testing, CI/CD, containerisation (Docker), and infrastructure-as-code (Terraform). Good communication skills, able to work in a cross-functional team and explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Intellectual curiosity and a bias for learning, staying current with the fast-moving AI/ML landscape. Nice to Have Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g. LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI). Familiarity with the Databricks ecosystem (MLflow, Feature Store, Genie). Contribute reusable methods, patterns, code, assets and lessons learned. Coach colleagues and participate in the capability’s continuous learning agenda. Uphold PwC quality, independence, confidentiality and risk-management requirements.

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.title: AI Engineer Google Cloud
items.card: Vos missions : Cadrer : vous animez les ateliers avec les équipes du client, vous identifiez les cas d'usage qui valent le coup et vous écartez ceux qui n'en valent pas. Construire des agents : avec Gemini, l'Agent Development Kit (ADK) et Vertex AI, vous développez des agents, des systèmes multi-agents et des RAG, branchés sur les outils du client (Google Workspace, APIs métier, BigQuery). Déployer sur Google Cloud
items.desc: Chez Pyl.tech, nous aidons nos clients, de la startup au grand compte, à construire des solutions sur-mesure sur Google Cloud. En tant qu'AI Engineer, vous concevez et mettez en production des agents IA avec Gemini et Vertex AI, de l'atelier de cadrage jusqu'à l'exploitation. En pratique, comptez environ 80 % de temps projet client et 20 % de contribution interne. Vous êtes rattaché·e à Dorian , notre AI Platform Director, à Guillaume , notre Partner Data & AI et vous vous appuyez sur notre partenariat Google Cloud. Vos missions : Cadrer : vous animez les ateliers avec les équipes du client, vous identifiez les cas d'usage qui valent le coup et vous écartez ceux qui n'en valent pas. Construire des agents : avec Gemini, l'Agent Development Kit (ADK) et Vertex AI, vous développez des agents, des systèmes multi-agents et des RAG, branchés sur les outils du client (Google Workspace, APIs métier, BigQuery). Déployer sur Google Cloud : Cloud Run, GKE ou Agent Engine, Terraform, CI/CD, IAM. Vos agents tournent en production, de façon sécurisée et maîtrisée en coût. Évaluer et fiabiliser : vous mettez en place les évaluations, l'observabilité et les garde-fous qui permettent de suivre la qualité des réponses dans le temps. Prendre le lead technique : selon votre expérience, vous faites les choix d'architecture et guidez techniquement une petite équipe. Côté interne : Partenariat Google : vous contribuez à nos spécialisations Google Cloud, aux événements co-organisés et aux échanges avec les équipes Google. Partager : vous suivez de près ce qui sort sur l’IA chez Google Cloud (Gemini, ADK, Vertex AI…), vous le testez, et vous partagez vos découvertes et vos réflexions pour faire grandir les équipes avec lesquelles vous travaillez, chez Pyl.tech comme chez nos clients. Environnement technique (non exhaustif) : IA : Gemini, Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform ( ex Vertex AI ), Agent Development Kit (ADK), Agent Runtime, Agent Search, MCP, A2A, A2UI Google Cloud : Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Firestore, Cloud Functions, IAM, Secret Manager Langages et outillage : Python, SQL, Terraform, Docker, Cloud Build / GitHub Actions Nous ne cherchons pas un profil parfait ! L'IA évolue trop vite pour ça. Ce qui nous intéresse : quelqu’un qui a commencé par écrire du code, qui a mis de l’IA générative en production chez des clients, qui l’a vue casser, et qui sait pourquoi. Ce qui compte pour nous : Vous avez au moins 3 ans de développement (back, data, cloud / DevOps), en produit ou en ESN. Vous avez une première expérience probante dans l'écosystème technique IA de Google Cloud. Vous avez construit et mis en production au moins un système d'IA générative : agent, RAG, workflow agentique. Pas seulement un POC. Vous êtes hands-on en Python et vous savez déployer proprement : CI/CD, conteneurs, infra as code. Vous parlez français professionnel et anglais technique. Votre posture terrain : Vous savez embarquer un interlocuteur non technique et construire vos choix avec les équipes IT du client. Ce sur quoi on est plus souples : Le framework : ADK, LangGraph, LangChain… Les petits + Vous avez une ou plusieurs certifications Google Cloud (Professional Cloud Agentic Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer, Cloud Architect…). Vous avez déjà travaillé chez un partenaire Google Cloud. Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si… Vous n'avez jamais écrit de code qui tourne en production : votre parcours en ESN s'est fait côté pilotage ou coordination. Vous préférez enchaîner les POC plutôt que porter un agent jusqu'à la production et le faire vivre. L'écosystème Google ne vous intéresse pas : c'est le cœur de notre activité, vous y passerez l'essentiel de votre temps. Ce que nous vous proposons ; 🤑 Rémunération : 50 - 70 K€ 🧑‍💼 Rythme : hybride ; télétravail fréquent et horaires flexibles. Bureaux récents et équipés, ambiance conviviale, équipes rodées au travail à distance. 💪 Développement des compétences : budget annuel, certifications Google Cloud prises en charge, licences des outils IA que vous voulez tester, budget conférences. 🚀 Une aventure à construire : vous n'arrivez pas dans une case figée. Votre expérience, votre savoir-être et votre ambition participeront activement au développement de votre rôle. Une trajectoire en construction avec celle de l'entreprise. Si vous avez envie de laisser votre empreinte plutôt que d'appliquer un cadre existant, vous allez vous plaire ici 🫶 3 semaines au total, réponse sous 3 jours maximum à chaque étape. Échange RH en visio avec Chloé : faire connaissance, comprendre votre parcours, vos motivations et ce que vous avez déjà mis en production. Entretien avec votre futur manager, Dorian ou Guillaume en visio ou présentiel : on parle des agents que vous avez construits, de vos choix d'architecture sur Google Cloud et de votre façon de travailler avec un client. Entretien final avec l'un des cofondateurs, en présentiel : vos ambitions, vos dernières questions, et la place que nous voulons donner à …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: SEARGIN IS HIRING! As a dynamic multinational tech company operating in 50 countries, we drive innovation and create projects that shape the future and greatly enhance the quality of life. You will find our solutions supporting advanced AI initiatives, financial analytics, and enterprise-scale digital transformation across global organisations. About the role We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to design, develop and integrate Generative AI solutions, intelligent assistants, AI agents and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) services. The role focuses on building practical AI applications, integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with external tools and APIs, and transforming prototypes into scalable, production-ready solutions. The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Agentic AI, agent orchestration and AI application development, alongside the ability to deliver well-documented, maintainable solutions following software engineering best practices. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and integrate Generative AI solutions, intelligent assistants and autonomous AI agents. Build and implement RAG pipelines and services to enhance LLM capabilities with relevant data sources. Develop AI applications and API-based services, including FastAPI applications. Design and implement agent orchestration workflows and multi-agent systems. Integrate external tools, APIs and services with LLMs to enable AI-driven workflows. Develop prototypes and take them through testing, industrialization and production deployment. Implement CI/CD pipelines and follow software engineering best practices. Prepare technical documentation and ensure solutions are maintainable, scalable and reliable. Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to translate requirements into effective AI solutions. Required Skills & Experience Hands-on experience developing and integrating Generative AI applications, assistants or AI agents. Strong practical knowledge of Agentic AI concepts and implementation. Experience working with LLMs, APIs and external tool integrations. Knowledge of RAG architectures and implementation. Experience with Python and API development, preferably using FastAPI. Understanding of agent orchestration and, ideally, multi-agent architectures. Experience taking AI prototypes towards production-ready solutions. Knowledge of CI/CD practices, testing and technical documentation. French proficiency at B2 level or higher. Preferred Technical Experience Candidates should ideally demonstrate hands-on experience in at least 5 of the following areas: Building AI agents. Developing multi-agent systems. Using LangGraph. Using CrewAI. Building AI-powered applications. Developing FastAPI services. Implementing agent orchestration. Integrating external tools and APIs with LLMs. Taking AI agents into production. Languages French: B2 minimum; C1/C2 or native proficiency strongly preferred. English: Professional working proficiency. Ideal Candidate Profile The ideal candidate combines strong software engineering fundamentals with practical experience in Agentic AI. They can independently build AI agents and applications, integrate LLMs with external tools and services, design orchestration workflows, and help move solutions from proof of concept to production. Contact : kamil.michalik@seargin.com Discover the Power of IT Excellence. Apply! To learn more about Seargin, please visit our web page: www.seargin.com

items.desc: About Us At THEKER, we're taking on one of the greatest challenges of the 21st century: redefining how physical work gets done in the world. We are a robotics and AI company building intelligent, adaptable systems that solve problems traditional automation never could. We recently closed the largest robotics Series A in Europe's history, and we're looking for the top 0.01% of talent to take on that mission with us, and build the biggest company in the world. By joining us, you will have the chance to do the most meaningful work of your life, setting a new standard for industrial automation and driving breakthroughs with global reach, while being surrounded by a focused, talent-dense team that shares this ambition and is here to win. Your role We are looking for a Full-stack AI Engineer to build the internal software and AI tools that THEKER runs on. This is a hands-on engineering role focused on shipping. You'll build full applications end to end, from the data model to the interface people use every day, and you'll bring LLMs into them wherever they remove real friction. You'll work with engineering and operations teams, and with the people who keep the business running. That means internal platforms like stock or purchasing modules, LLM integrations, internal agents, retrieval systems and whatever else removes bottlenecks. Before writing code, you'll understand the process behind it. If you're building a stock module, you know what stock means for a company that builds and deploys robots. We don't want someone who says yes to everything. You'll question requirements, push back when something doesn't add up and come back with a better proposal. You'll own your deadlines and move projects forward without waiting to be asked. A good quarter in this role means our teams spend less time on repetitive work and more time on the problems only they can solve. What We're Looking For Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. Solid TypeScript and Python skills, with experience shipping production web applications in React. We mean real software used by real people, beyond scripts or notebooks. Hands-on experience with LLMs: prompt engineering, function calling, RAG, or fine-tuning. Business sense. You understand how a company operates (stock, purchasing, orders, costs) and you design software around the real process behind it. A critical, proactive mindset. You question requirements and propose better alternatives instead of agreeing to everything. You plan your own work and deliver on the deadlines you commit to. Willingness to reside in or relocate to Barcelona. Nice to have Experience building agents or multi-step LLM pipelines with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom frameworks. Experience with vector databases, embedding-based retrieval or evaluation frameworks for LLM output quality. Experience building internal tools, ERPs or business software for inventory, purchasing or operations. Background in developer tooling, internal platforms, or MLOps. You'll thrive at THEKER if You're excited by a fast-paced and ambitious environment. The opportunity ahead of us is enormous, and we're going all in to capture it. You want responsibility early on, delivering at world-class standards for leading clients. You enjoy experimenting, iterating quickly, and embracing change as part of the learning process. You get energy from watching your tools get used every day, and from the feedback loop of building for a team you sit next to. Main Responsibilities Build and maintain internal applications end to end in TypeScript and React, from the data model to the interface. Design LLM-powered pipelines for code generation assistance, documentation, data extraction and process automation. Develop retrieval-augmented generation systems over THEKER's internal knowledge base. Build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve the reliability of AI tool outputs. Translate business processes into software. Understand how stock, purchasing or operations work before designing the tool that supports them. Challenge requirements and propose better approaches when the brief doesn't solve the real problem. Own your project timelines. Flag risks early and deliver what you commit to. Identify high-leverage opportunities to apply software and AI across the company and scope them into concrete projects. What We Offer Being part of a fast-growing robotics and AI company with genuine ambition, where your career can accelerate alongside us. The chance to own THEKER's internal AI tooling from the ground up, with direct visibility into the impact your work has on the entire engineering team. A focused, talent-dense team where your work is visible and your decisions count. An environment where new ideas are encouraged and your contributions shape both the product and the company. 100% on-site work in Barcelona. What The Process Looks Like Intro call with our Talent Team - 30 minutes. Technical challenge …

Join our growing Innovation team in Dublin and help create next-generation applications using the latest tools, technologies, and ideas. AI is a huge part of what we do — but we’re an innovation team first, applying whatever emerging technology best solves the problem, from LLMs to data, integration, and automation. You’ll work alongside experienced and curious colleagues in a collaborative environment that encourages exploration, learning, and shared problem-solving. With strong support from senior leaders and visibility across the business, the team is well placed to develop, test, and scale new solutions. Your work will be visible, valued, and connected to key priorities from day one. This is a hybrid position with a requirement of 3 days in the office. THE ROLE & YOUR MISSION This is an opportunity to grow as an engineer while building, testing, and scaling solutions that make a real difference. As a mid-level member of the team, you’ll take ownership of features and components end to end, turning ideas into practical applications that address real business and client needs — with AI and LLMs the biggest part of the toolkit, alongside data, integration, and automation. Alongside hands-on engineering, you’ll help shape our innovation hub by contributing to hackathons, engaging with the broader tech community, and supporting a culture centered on experimentation, learning, collaboration, and results. What You'll Do Own medium-scale features and components end to end, from prototyping through to production-ready solutions, with senior guidance available when you need it Contribute to design discussions, bringing sound technical reasoning and viable suggestions to the table Build practical applications — AI-powered and otherwise — that address real business problems and deliver measurable value Work closely with colleagues across our Dublin and international Innovation teams, while taking initiative and contributing your own ideas Work in an Agile environment where you can experiment, learn quickly, and see the impact of your work Stay hands-on with the latest AI tools, models, and techniques, with ongoing opportunities to learn, test, and evolve Build and maintain evaluation harnesses and follow good practice in prompt engineering, experimentation, and solution design Create reusable components, tools, and patterns that help the wider team work more effectively and consistently Share what you learn, support technical quality, and help junior colleagues grow through code reviews and pairing WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT This is a chance to accelerate your career in a team that’s growing quickly and working with purpose. You’ll own meaningful work, explore the latest technologies, and develop your craft while helping shape how we build. With strong leadership support, visibility across the business, and access to the resources of a global organization, you’ll have the platform to make a genuine impact while continuing to grow. And you’ll do it from Dublin, one of Europe’s most dynamic and well-connected tech hubs. items.desc: Buscamos un/a ingeniero/a con experiencia práctica en AWS, Python e IA generativa para participar en un proyecto estratégico en una compañía del IBEX 35. 🎯 ¿Cuál será tu misión? items.desc:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Build safety systems: Design, develop, and scale automated moderation systems, abuse detection capabilities, and guardrails for AI agents across ElevenLabs’ products.

 - Respond to emerging threats: Partner closely with the Investigations team to identify emerging abuse patterns, understand evolving threats, and continuously improve existing safety systems, detection mechanisms, and guardrails to address new risks.

 - Own production infrastructure: Build and maintain a growing ecosystem of internal safety services, taking ownership of their architecture, deployment, reliability, monitoring, and ongoing operation.

 - Bring ML models into production: Partner closely with ML engineers to deploy and integrate fine-tuned and proprietary ML models into production safety systems, ensuring they operate reliably and efficiently at scale.

 - Build end-to-end solutions: Develop backend services, APIs, internal tools, and user-facing interfaces that enable effective moderation, safety operations, and policy enforcement.

 - Collaborate across teams: Work closely with Product, Legal, and Safety Policy teams to translate business, regulatory, and policy requirements into scalable engineering solutions.
   
   - Product: Understand and navigate the tradeoffs between product growth, user experience, and platform safety.
   
   - Legal: Translate legal and regulatory requirements into practical, scalable safety systems.
   
   - Safety Policy: Collaborate on how safety policies are implemented technically, while helping inform policy decisions through an understanding of engineering capabilities and constraints.

 - Shape our technical direction: Contribute to architectural decisions and help define how our safety infrastructure evolves as our products, users, and safety challenges grow.


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of software engineering experience building and operating production systems.

 - Strong backend engineering experience, including designing APIs, working with databases, and building scalable services.

 - Proficiency in Python and experience with modern backend frameworks.

 - Experience building and maintaining distributed systems and cloud-based applications.

 - Comfortable owning systems end to end, from technical design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and …

Working under direction from senior engineers, you will contribute to specific components of the Enterprise AI stack — BTP service configuration, ingestion pipeline runs, extractor job scheduling, and citation validation — on live client engagements. Practical understanding of RAG pipelines: how documents are chunked, embedded, tagged by domain and provenance, and loaded into a vector and graph store. Scripting capability (Python or Node.js) for ingestion tooling, extraction validation, and automated spot-checks against the Cortex graph and citation layer. Understanding of data masking and scrubbing requirements: able to apply agreed masking rules to extraction output before files enter the Enterprise AI object store vault. Attention to quality in citation validation: able to spot-check cited answers back to source documents and flag defects — a confident answer with no citation is a defect. Familiarity with enterprise security basics: egress rules, role-based access, and service key management in a BTP subaccount context. Able to work alongside functional and basis teams to gather source inventory details, confirm data owners, and document extraction scope per the agreed ingestion checklist. Structured and methodical approach to repetitive technical tasks: ingestion runs, delta scheduling, health checks, and smoke tests executed consistently and to a documented standard. Clear written and verbal communication for project-specific status updates and issue escalation to senior engineers and the delivery lead. Set yourself apart: Exposure to SAP BTP through academic, intern, or early-career project work — any hands-on configuration of HANA Cloud, CAP services, or BTP cockpit tooling is an advantage. Experience running or supporting a data ingestion or ETL pipeline in any technology context — the discipline of parse, validate, load, and verify transfers directly to Cortex ingestion work. Hands-on use of an LLM API (any provider) in a project or personal context: prompt construction, response parsing, and understanding of why grounding and citation matter for enterprise use. Exposure to SAP ECC or S/4HANA internals — data dictionary, transaction codes, configuration tables, or master data structures — even from a functional or testing background. Contribution to shared documentation: test logs, ingestion run records, citation spot-check reports, or setup notes that make the next deployment faster for the team. Genuine interest in enterprise AI and SAP technology — curious about how grounded knowledge planes, agentic delivery, and graph-based reasoning apply to real transformation programmes. Flexibility and mobility are required to deliver this role as there will be requirements to spend time onsite with our clients and partners to enable delivery of the outstanding services, we are known for. Strong proficiency in Python (or a similar language) commonly used for AI and machine learning development. Good understanding of machine learning fundamentals ; practical experience with modern AI frameworks is highly valued. Hands-on experience working with LLMs , embeddings, vector databases, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, or model fine-tuning. Solid understanding of software engineering principles , including data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and system design. Experience building scalable, reliable, and maintainable software solutions . Proficiency with Git and modern version control practices. Familiarity with Agile development methodologies and collaborative engineering environments. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with fluency in English . As a person you have strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment and adapt to changing priorities. Nice to Have: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Experience designing, deploying, or operating cloud-native and highly available systems , ideally using technologies such as Kubernetes. Experience with Amazon Bedrock or other AI platforms and providers such as Azure AI, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS AI Services, or Google Vertex AI. Knowledge of or interest in cybersecurity and secure software development practices. But what's in it for you? In return for your efforts, we will offer you: A flat organizational structure and lots of autonomy; you are not just a number. You will join an organization that offers a steep learning curve, where your contributions will have a tangible impact. The opportunity to be part of a fast-growing and fun European cybersecurity company. Employees also benefit from regular performance conversations with their managers, focused on development, career progression, and self improvement. Join our team in one of our offices, and experience a workplace that’s as vibrant as the city, from fun socials, great perks, and a collaborative environment! items.desc: You can restart pretty much any device. Also, a bank? Commerzbank is a leading international commercial bank with branches and offices in almost 50 countries. The world is changing, becoming digital, and so are we. We are leaving the traditional bank behind us and we are choosing to move forward as a digital enterprise. As part of this strategy, Commerzbank continues the expansion of its Digital Technology Center in Sofia, Bulgaria. We need motivated people who will join us on this journey and we are looking for an AI Prompt Engineer in our flexhub team. What is flexhub? We are Commerzbank's internal delivery capability – a team of engineers, architects, analysts and experts working directly with business units. Unlike external consultancies, we are colleagues who stay. Based in Frankfurt, Sofia, and Łódź, we drive high-priority initiatives while building internal expertise that lasts. What's in it for you: Consulting variety meets corporate stability. You join different teams across the bank when your expertise is needed, then move on to the next challenge. This approach helps you build strong internal know-how and gives you the chance to contribute to meaningful work – one initiative at a time – without sales targets or utilization pressure. No selling. Just a consistent focus on engineering solutions that matter. Your responsibilities would consist of: Developing and refining complex prompts and chains to solve specific business problems. Working with developers to integrate LLM capabilities into wider application architectures. Implementing RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines to ground model responses. Establishing evaluation metrics to measure prompt performance and drift. Debugging complex chains and resolving issues related to hallucinations or latency. Creating automated test suites for prompt regression testing. Contributing to the internal library of prompt patterns and best practices. Explaining technical AI limitations and capabilities to product owners. Sharing learnings with immediate colleagues. Supporting the team in achieving its goals. The skills and experience we would like you to have: Good knowledge of Python for developing, testing, and integrating AI-driven applications. Practical experience with Generative AI and prompt engineering to design effective, reliable LLM-based solutions. Hands-on experience using LangChain to build modular, production-ready LLM workflows. Good understanding of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and vector databases for semantic search and context-aware responses. Experience with model fine-tuning to adapt foundation models to domain-specific requirements. Strong skills in API integration to connect AI services with existing systems and products. Familiarity with agentic AI workflows, orchestrating multi-step, tool-using AI agents for complex tasks. High flexibility and adaptability to a fast-changing environment. Good team player with high ability to work in international teams. In return, we offer: Good work-life balance, including 25 days annual paid leave (increasing with 1 day per year up to 31 in total), flexible working hours, work-from-home and work from abroad opportunities; Luxury package of additional health and dental insurance; Food vouchers in the amount of EUR 80 monthly; 6 additional annual days off for exceptional circumstances Employee assistance program for psychological, financial and legal consultations; Multisport card; Annual contribution of EUR 153.39 net per child for a summer camp/school/kindergarten for children up to age of 15; Possibilities for building career-advancing skills by covering training/certification courses and conferences based on individual learning and development needs, access to an online learning platform; Opportunities for long-term professional development in a stable, 150-year-old company while contributing to the vision of a new, just starting Digital Technology Center; Friendly and supportive multicultural environment, open to new opinions and ideas. Commerzbank is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating a diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, race, color, national origin, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetics, disability, age, or any other characteristics. Challenge accepted? Apply now with your up-to-date CV in English! Due to the high volume of applications, we contact only the candidates who best match the role requirements. If you do not hear from us within 14 days, please consider that we won't proceed with your application at this stage.

items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Votre mission : aller au-delà des POC et construire des systèmes utilisant l’IA Générative qui performent en production. Rejoignez notre collectif Data & IA pour relever le plus grand défi actuel de l'IA pour les entreprises : le passage à l'échelle. En tant que AI Engineer, vous ne vous contentez pas d'appeler des API. Vous concevez, codez et déployez des architectures robustes (RAG, agents) capables de tourner en production avec des contraintes réelles de coût, de latence et de sécurité. Vous intervenez entre autres sur les missions suivantes : Implémenter des solutions RAG, agents IA et assistants métiers. Intégrer des LLM dans les systèmes existants et orchestrer leurs interactions. Optimiser les prompts, embeddings et chaînes d’orchestration pour améliorer la pertinence et la performance. Gérer les problématiques de coûts, latence et sécurité des solutions GenAI. Mettre en place les bonnes pratiques de gouvernance et de conformité pour l’IA générative. Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Data, IT et métiers pour assurer la cohérence des solutions. Vos challenges au quotidien : Vous intervenez sur tout le cycle de vie du projet, du conseil au code : Cadrer et architecturer : analyser le besoin métier pour définir la meilleure stratégie (RAG, agents, fine-tuning) et la stack adaptée à l'environnement client. Industrialiser : développer du code robuste et modulaire (Python) pour intégrer les LLM aux SI existants (API, Data Lakes) et sortir de la logique de POC. Optimiser et sécuriser : garantir la viabilité des solutions en maîtrisant les coûts/latences (LLMOps) et en implémentant les barrières de sécurité (guardrails). Accompagner : vulgariser les concepts techniques et guider les équipes métiers et IT du client dans l'adoption de ces nouvelles technologies. Votre palette technique : Nous ne cherchons pas un expert d'un seul outil, mais un ingénieur capable de naviguer dans des écosystèmes variés. Voici les technologies sur lesquelles vous serez amené(e) à intervenir et conseiller : Le socle : maîtrise indispensable de Python et des bonnes pratiques de Software Engineering (Clean Code, Git, CI/CD) pour garantir la robustesse des livrables chez nos clients. LLM et orchestration : capacité à orchestrer des chaînes complexes (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel) et à choisir le bon modèle pour le bon usage (OpenAI, Azure AI, Bedrock, Vertex AI, ou solutions open source type Mistral/Llama). Data et bases vectorielles : savoir intégrer la solution dans l'écosystème data du client, que ce soit sur Pinecone, Qdrant, Weaviate ou directement via pgvector/Elasticsearch. Architecture et cloud : aisance à déployer aussi bien sur AWS, Azure que GCP, ou dans des environnements on-premise contraints. LLMOps : mettre en place les outils de monitoring et d'évaluation adaptés au client (LangSmith, MLflow, Ragas, etc.). Votre profil : ingénieur et pédagogue Expérience : vous avez un background solide en Data Science, Data Engineering ou Software Engineering (min. 2 ans) et avez pivoté vers l'IA générative avec des premières réalisations concrètes (projets pros ou personnels avancés). Polyvalence : vous ne bloquez pas si le client utilise Azure au lieu d'AWS. Vous apprenez vite et savez vous adapter aux contraintes (legacy, sécurité bancaire, etc.). Posture conseil : vous savez vulgariser des concepts techniques complexes. Vous êtes capable d'expliquer pourquoi un RAG est nécessaire (ou non) à un directeur métier. Mindset « Prod-Ready » : vous codez proprement. Vous savez que la valeur d'un consultant se mesure à la pérennité de ce qu'il laisse derrière lui. Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Une organisation résolument tournée vers l’IA : nous sommes notre propre client et nous menons une transformation agentique ambitieuse pour notre métier cœur et pour nos métiers transverses. L'impact : vous intervenez sur les projets les plus stratégiques de nos clients, là où l'IA transforme réellement les business models. La communauté : échangez avec 450 pairs, contribuez à notre veille, nos publications et participez à nos événements Le cadre : des bureaux inspirants et une culture d'entreprise qui valorise l'audace et l'expertise. Processus de Recrutement : Un de ces entretiens sera forcément en présentiel : 1er échange RH : échange sur vos souhaits et motivation, présentation de l’entreprise (30 min). items.desc: A global consumer goods brand runs a customer-facing AI agent — agentic RAG over its product range — that answers customer questions in natural language. It is already live in couple European markets and is onboarding roughly one new country every month, each with its own language and regulatory nuances. The programme is sponsored at board level and carries high internal visibility. This role exists to close the gap between functional design and buildable design. You take the functional (non-technical) design, resolve as many of the unknowns as you can, and produce a low-level design the development team can build from without rediscovering the same problems. In practice that means writing real prototype code, proving integration patterns end to end, and documenting what works clearly enough for a distributed team to implement it. WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING Turning functional designs into low-level technical designs that development teams can build from directly Running spikes and proofs of concept independently — scoping them, building them and reaching a clear conclusion Proving integration patterns to surrounding systems end to end: authentication, authorisation, secrets management and API contracts Designing and prototyping agent behaviour with LangChain and LangGraph; instrumenting, tracing and evaluating with LangSmith Implementing MCP integrations and agent-to-agent communication patterns Writing documentation and reference code clear enough for a distributed team to follow without you in the room Working alongside the tech lead and architects so that prototype decisions stay consistent with the target architecture Driving open questions to resolution across teams — raising the issue, convening the right people and closing the loop ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS Hands-on experience with LangChain, LangGraph and LangSmith — building, debugging and evaluating agent systems, not just familiarity Strong, current Python development skills Experience building interfaces to other systems, including authentication, authorisation and secrets management Practical experience implementing Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations Experience with agent-to-agent (A2A) integration patterns Able to conduct proofs of concept independently, from scoping through to a documented conclusion Comfortable working closely with both a development team and solution architects Proactive communicator — able to set up meetings, chase answers across teams and resolve blockers without being asked Clear technical writing and example code that others can work from NICE TO HAVE Experience with telephony and call centre applications — the platform uses Twilio Experience with multilingual or multi-market AI deployments RAG evaluation and answer-quality measurement at production scale Experience working with distributed teams across time zones Exposure to regulated or compliance-sensitive content domains WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE Development teams start work with fewer open questions and fewer false starts Integration patterns are proven once and reused across markets, rather than rediscovered each time Low-level designs are specific enough to build from — and are actually used by the teams they were written for Technical unknowns surface and get resolved before they become delivery blockers TECH ENVIRONMENT Core stack Python LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith Agentic RAG over product content; multi-language and multi-market MCP and agent-to-agent integration Authentication, authorisation and secrets management across system boundaries Twilio for telephony and call centre channels Working context Product owner, management and tech lead based in Poland English as the working language across the delivery team

Good Python skills and willingness to work across APIs, scripting, developer tooling, documentation, tests, and lightweight automation services. Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, LLM APIs, local model experimentation, or RAG-style development is strongly preferred. Basic understanding of Git, CI/CD, Linux, containers, cloud platforms, and software architecture documentation, with readiness to deepen OpenStack knowledge. Careful working style with good documentation habits, curiosity, and ability to escalate unclear findings instead of over-trusting AI-generated answers. Comfortable working in a confidential enterprise environment where learning speed, quality discipline, and structured communication are important. items.desc: Our Applied AI Engineering team designs and builds solutions across the spectrum — from data processing, through AI and ML workflows, to agentic AI — often in complex, regulated environments such as financial services. We work at the edge of delivery: embedded with the business, moving fast, and proving what's worth building. We're now looking for a Forward-Deployed Data & AI Engineer to sit at that edge — turning ambiguous business problems into working solutions, fast, from the raw data all the way to the AI. As a Forward-Deployed Data & AI Engineer within EY's Applied AI Engineering team, you will be embedded directly with our clients' business teams — helping to find high-value problems and turning them into working solutions in weeks rather than months. You work at the early discovery and prototyping as well as productization stage of delivery : hands-on, agile, and close to the business. This is a full-spectrum build role — you'll wrangle messy, real-world data into lightweight pipelines and data products, and then build the AI/ML workflows, GenAI and agentic solutions on top of them. Together with your Tech Lead and the wider pod, you'll prove (or disprove) value quickly, and help shape the requirements a validated idea needs before it's moved to production to scale. This is a hands-on engineering role for a versatile builder who is energised by ambiguity, comfortable across both the data and the AI, enjoys working directly with business users, and would rather ship a rough working demo than a polished slide. EY.AI – in this role, you will work in an environment where AI agents are an integral part of the team and daily project delivery. You will leverage role-specific AI solutions that help analyse data, generate recommendations, and design innovative solutions, enabling you to move faster from insight to action and create value for clients. Your scope of duties Work embedded with client business teams to understand problems in context and turn them into working solutions — end to end, from data to AI. Rapidly profile and wrangle source data, and stand up lightweight pipelines and integrations to get prototypes working — ingesting, cleaning, transforming and joining messy, real-world data. Design, build and demonstrate AI/ML workflows, GenAI and agentic-AI solutions on top of that data, using cloud-native services. Iterate fast on feedback — build, demo, learn, repeat — to prove or kill ideas quickly. Help distil clear data and solution requirements, source mappings and de-risked designs. Build responsibly from the start — mindful of data quality, lineage, privacy, guardrails and compliance (e.g. EU AI Act, GDPR, data residency). Collaborate closely with your Tech Lead, the architects and business stakeholders. Contribute to the team's reusable accelerators, connectors, assets and engineering practices. Skills And Attributes For Success Comfort with ambiguity and messy data — you can make progress without clean sources or a complete specification. Full-spectrum, hands-on craft — SQL and Python, data pipelines, ML workflows, and LLM / agent frameworks — across both the data and the AI. Speed and a demo-first mindset — you build the simplest thing that proves the point, and you'd rather show than tell. Business and domain awareness — you keep the user's real problem in focus and understand what the data means, not just its shape. Collaboration and curiosity — you learn fast and work well in a small, fast-moving team. Our Requirements A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, and For senior position approximately 3+ years of hands-on data / AI / software engineering experience (or a master's degree and approximately 2 years). Strong Python and SQL, with experience both building data pipelines (ETL / ELT) and building AI/ML or GenAI solutions. Experience with LLM / agent frameworks (e.g. Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Agent Service, LangChain, LangGraph, Bedrock Agents) and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns. The ability to work with data end to end — profiling, wrangling, integrating and modelling messy, real-world data. Hands-on cloud experience — ideally Microsoft Azure (e.g. Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry / Azure Machine Learning, Azure Functions, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric / Synapse), and/or AWS (Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, Glue) or Google Cloud (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Dataflow). Good communication skills and comfort working directly with non-technical stakeholders. Ideally, you'll also have Financial-services or other regulated-industry experience, and awareness of relevant controls (AML/KYC, EU AI Act, GDPR, data residency). Experience preparing data for AI/ML or GenAI — features, embeddings and retrieval corpora. Rapid-prototyping, hackathon or startup experience. Collect, transform and integrate data from multiple structured and unstructured sources. Build and maintain data models and architectures supporting analytics and AI use cases. AI & Machine Learning Contribute to the development and deployment of Machine Learning and AI solutions. Prepare and transform datasets for Machine Learning applications. Implement monitoring and continuous improvement mechanisms for AI solutions. Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate concrete business challenges into Data & AI solutions. AWS: S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift and SageMaker. Google Cloud Platform: BigQuery, Dataflow and Vertex AI. AI / Machine Learning Machine Learning concepts and algorithms. Python data ecosystem: Pandas, NumPy and Scikit-learn. ML model deployment and APIs. MLOps principles. Azure Machine Learning, MLflow or equivalent tooling. Exposure to Generative AI technologies is a strong asset: Large Language Models (LLMs). Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Prompt engineering. Embeddings and vector databases. Azure OpenAI / OpenAI. LangChain or similar frameworks. DevOps & Software Engineering Git and CI/CD pipelines. Docker and Kubernetes. Infrastructure as Code; Terraform is an asset. Agile / Scrum delivery environments. Profile 3+ years of experience in Data Engineering, AI/ML Engineering or a related role. Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience building production-grade data pipelines. Experience with cloud-based data platforms. Good understanding of software engineering best practices. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Autonomous, proactive and comfortable working in different client environments. Nice to have Experience with Generative AI and LLM-based applications. Knowledge of Data Governance and Data Quality principles. Experience with real-time or event-driven architectures. Experience delivering production Data/AI solutions within large organizations. Cloud or Data certifications such as Microsoft Azure, Databricks, AWS, Snowflake or Google Cloud certifications. Language requirement s French OR Dutch: professional proficiency. English: professional proficiency, mandatory. Work environment Location: Brussels, Belgium. Work arrangement: hybrid, with flexibility to work onsite according to client requirements. Employment type: full-time

items.desc: Job Description Telenet is a leading telco going all-in on cloud-first transformation, and we're looking for product-minded cloud engineers who can build useful software end to end on hyperscalers and share our passion for Generative AI. In other words, people who move comfortably from an idea and application code to delivery, operations and continuous improvement. As part of the GenAI Cluster, you design, build and run the product stack behind Telenet's Generative AI experiences. That spans application services, APIs and integrations as well as the cloud capabilities they depend on. All so that our teams can turn emerging AI technology into reliable products with real impact. Your mission as a Cloud Engineer GenAI As a Cloud Engineer GenAI you build and operate Generative AI products on AWS. From application code and APIs to delivery pipelines, cloud services and observability. You are a pragmatic generalist who can take a simple solution from concept to production and who stays accountable for its reliability, security, performance and cost once it is live. What You Will Do Build GenAI products end to end. Turn product needs into maintainable services, APIs and user-facing capabilities, primarily in Python, and run them on fit-for-purpose AWS services such as Bedrock, ECS, Fargate and Lambda. Engineer for reliability. Define service levels and useful telemetry, design for failure and recovery, and take part in operational ownership through alerting, incident response, runbooks and blameless learning. Ship safely and often. Build automated tests, CI/CD and infrastructure-ascode that make application and model changes easy to review, deploy, observe and roll back. Create AI-native capabilities. Build agentic workflows, retrieval services, evaluations and guardrails using LLM tool calling, MCP, A2A, RAG and the rapidly evolving AI ecosystem. Connect the whole stack. Integrate models, data sources and business systems; debug across application, network, cloud and data boundaries when reality does not match the diagram. Keep products secure and sustainable. Apply sound identity, secrets, privacy and network controls, while balancing latency, quality, resilience and cost. Explore what is next. Follow new AI capabilities with curiosity, prototype where they could create value and help the team turn the strongest ideas into dependable production features. Your profile as a Cloud Engineer GenAI Must-haves Solid experience building and operating production applications end to end, ideally on AWS or GCP. Strong programming skills in Python and Terraform, with sound knowledge of API design, automated testing, debugging and maintainable software design. Practical experience with cloud services, containers and infrastructure-as code, plus the judgement to choose the simplest suitable solution. A reliability mindset backed by operational practice: meaningful monitoring, alerting, incident handling, root-cause analysis and continuousimprovement. Experience with CI/CD and the automation needed to release application and infrastructure changes confidently. Solid grounding in networking, security, identity (IAM), secrets management and cost-aware engineering. A generalist mindset: willing to work across code, cloud, data and operations instead of stopping at one technical boundary Nice-to-haves (GenAI focus) Experience building with LLMs, agentic patterns, tool calling, MCP and A2A. Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, Langfuse or comparable fast evolving AI tooling. Exposure to AWS Bedrock and/or SageMaker, vector databases embeddings, evaluations and guardrails. Who You Are Product-minded and accountable: you care about the user problem, the code and the way the product behaves in production. A curious generalist who enjoys learning unfamiliar parts of a system and making sensible trade-offs. Genuinely excited by the speed of AI development and eager to help Telenet make the most of this wave responsibly. A collaborative team player who shares ownership, gives and receives feedback, and helps others grow. Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science or equivalent through experience. Our offer to you At Telenet, you get more than an attractive salary — we believe in results and ownership, and what you achieve truly matters. On top of a thirteenth month and holiday pay, you can count on an extensive benefits package: Mobility budget: compose your own mobility plan, you can opt for a company car or alternative mobility solutions Meal vouchers and eco vouchers Mobile phone, mobile subscription, laptop, and employee discounts Collective bonus and individual bonus (aligned with your performance) Hospitalization insurance (including an ambulatory plan) and group insurance 20 days of paid leave and 12 compensatory days off We invest in your growth via our internal learning platform, coaching and on-the-job training.
