items.desc: Als toonaangevende telecomspeler zet Telenet sterk in op een cloud-first strategie en grootschalige cloudtransformaties, en we zijn op zoek naar cloud-native engineers die onze passie voor cloudinfrastructuur én Generative AI delen. Cloud-native werken wordt bij Telenet de standaard. Onze engineers bouwen veilige, schaalbare fundamenten waarop andere teams kunnen verder bouwen. Als deel van de GenAI Cluster bouw en beheer je het cloudplatform achter Telenet’s Generative AI-oplossingen. Dit gaat van model hosting en inference tot retrieval pipelines, automatisatie en guardrails zodat GenAI teams snel en verantwoord kunnen ontwikkelen en deployen. Jouw missie als Cloud Engineer GenAI Als Cloud Engineer GenAI ben je verantwoordelijk voor het design, de opbouw, automatisatie en het beheer van de cloudinfrastructuur achter onze Generative AI workloads op AWS. Dit zodat model serving en LLM-toepassingen betrouwbaar, schaalbaar, veilig en kostenefficiënt draaien en product squads kunnen rekenen op herbruikbare platform services. Wat ga je doen? Bouwen en verder uitwerken van het GenAI platform Je ontwerpt en beheert de cloud foundation voor Generative AI op AWS (zoals Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, ECS en Fargate), volledig opgezet als infrastructure-as-code via Terraform. Model serving en inference beheren Je zet LLM en inference endpoints op, schaalt ze en optimaliseert continu op vlak van performantie, latency, betrouwbaarheid en kost. Automatisatie (CI/CD & LLMOps) Je bouwt en onderhoudt CI/CD- en LLMOps pipelines voor deployment, evaluatie en rollback, onder andere via GitLab CI en moderne tooling. Ondersteunen van data- en retrieval flows Je zet RAG-architecturen, vector databases, embedding pipelines en retrieval services op waar GenAI-applicaties op steunen. Security en compliance garanderen Je implementeert securitymaatregelen zoals identity management, networking, secrets management (Vault) en guardrails specifiek voor GenAI workloads. Observability en kostenefficiëntie verbeteren Je zorgt voor monitoring, logging en tracing en stuurt actief op performantie en kostoptimalisatie (FinOps). Cloud-native werken promoten Je levert goed gedocumenteerde en makkelijk te gebruiken platform services aan GenAI en Predictive AI teams, stimuleert een cloud-native en automation-first mindset en helpt collega's om hun skills verder te ontwikkelen binnen GenAI op cloud. Jouw profiel als Cloud Engineer GenAI Must-haves Ervaring als cloud, DevOps, platform of infrastructure engineer, bij voorkeur op AWS (certificering is een plus) Begrip van Agentic AI: LLM tool calling, MCP en A2A Sterke kennis van infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, eventueel CloudFormation) en ervaring met containers en Kubernetes Ervaring met CI/CD pipelines (bijv. GitLab CI) en een sterke focus op automatisatie Programmeer- of scriptingervaring (bijv. Python) Goede kennis van networking, security, identity (IAM) en secrets management (bijv. Vault) Je houdt rekening met betrouwbaarheid en kostenefficiëntie (SRE / FinOps mindset) Nice-to-haves (GenAI focus) Ervaring met ML of Generative AI workloads, zoals model serving en inference optimalisatie Vertrouwdheid met Langchain, Langgraph en Langfuse Kennis van AWS Bedrock en/of SageMaker, vector databases en LLMOps / MLOps Inzicht in RAG-architecturen, embeddings en prompt/guardrail tooling Wie ben jij? Je hebt een sterke cloud-native mindset en een oprechte interesse in Generative AI en nieuwe technologieën Je werkt graag in agile teams en bouwt oplossingen waar andere teams op kunnen verder werken Je communiceert vlot in het Engels; Nederlands is een plus Je hebt een bachelor- of masterdiploma in computer science of gelijkwaardige ervaring Ons aanbod voor jou Bij Telenet Krijg Je Meer Dan Een Aantrekkelijk Loon — We Geloven In Resultaten En Ownership, En Wat Jij Realiseert Telt Echt. Naast Een Dertiende Maand En Vakantiegeld Kan Je Rekenen Op Een Uitgebreid Pakket Extralegale Voordelen Mobiliteitsbudget: stel zelf je mobiliteitsplan samen, met keuze voor een bedrijfswagen of alternatieve vervoersoplossingen Maaltijdcheques en ecocheques Smartphone, mobiel abonnement, laptop en personeelskorting Collectieve bonus en individuele bonus (afgestemd op jouw prestaties) Hospitalisatieverzekering (inclusief ambulant plan) en groepsverzekering 20 wettelijke verlofdagen en 12 ADV-dagen We investeren in jouw groei via ons intern leerplatform, coaching en leren op de werkvloer. We werken het liefst dicht bij elkaar — sterke teams ontstaan door regelmatig contact. Tijdens je eerste zes maanden vragen we minimum drie kantoorwerkdagen per week; daarna twee. Wat gebeurt er na je sollicitatie? Zie jij een match? Solliciteer, we laten altijd iets van ons horen. Als je profiel aansluit, nemen we contact op voor een kennismaking en lichten we de volgende stappen toe.

items.desc: Department: IT Location: London, UK Description Oxford Economics, a leading economic forecasting and consulting firm, is looking for an ambitious, passionate Software Engineer with a strong interest in AI to join our Technology team and help us build, ship and scale the next generation of AI-enabled capabilities at Oxford Economics. Mission (Why this role exists) AI is changing how research-led businesses like ours work, and we're building the team and the capabilities to stay ahead of it. We're growing our dedicated AI engineering team whose job is to design, build, and ship the next generation of AI-enabled capabilities at Oxford Economics: agents, retrieval pipelines, conversational tools, internal platforms, and client-facing features that people use every day. This is a hands-on role for an engineer early in their career who writes great software and is genuinely excited about where AI is going. You'll spend your time building alongside the rest of the AI team, turning promising ideas into working software and learning fast as the technology moves. Part of the team's remit is partnering closely with our Content, Data, and Models teams, and over time you'll grow into embedding with them directly to understand their work and find where AI can make a real difference. You'll work with engineers, economists, product owners, and stakeholders across the business, and we'll back you to develop quickly into a trusted expert in building with AI. Key Responsibilities You'll spend most of your time building within the AI team, with the balance of your work shifting as you grow. Day to day you will: Build Design, build, and ship production software that brings AI capabilities to OE: agents, RAG pipelines, conversational interfaces, internal tools, and other client-facing features. Take ideas from prototype to production, contributing across the software lifecycle: discovery, design, coding, testing, CI/CD, observability, cost monitoring, and safe rollout. Help build and operate the services, agents, MCPs, shared libraries, Claude skills, and evaluation harnesses that make up OE's AI platform. Apply solid engineering fundamentals: clean code, testing, modularity, performance, security. Because quality and reliability matter as much in AI systems as anywhere else. Collaborate & partner Work with product owners and the rest of the team to turn business needs into tangible, well-scoped deliverables, adapting as those needs evolve. Partner with our Content, Data and Models teams to understand what they need, growing into embedding alongside them directly as you build context and credibility. Build with safety and responsible use in mind. Sensible data handling, prompt-injection defences, and alignment with ISO 27001 controls and OE's AI Acceptable Use Policy. Learn & share Experiment with new models, frameworks, and techniques, and help the team form an evidence-based view of what's hype and what's worth betting on. Share what you learn: patterns, write-ups, brown-bag sessions; helping colleagues across OE raise their own AI fluency as you grow into it. Skills, Knowledge & Expertise We care more about trajectory than a tick-box list. For the AI-specific parts especially, real curiosity and hands-on tinkering count for as much as years of experience. If you've explored these things, have views on them and want to go deeper, that's what we're looking for. Core engineering Around 2+ years of professional experience shipping production software in a modern cloud environment. Solid engineering fundamentals: testing, version control, code review, modular design, and a developing sense of when to be pragmatic versus principled. Proficiency in C# and experience with TypeScript, comfortable working from APIs through to lightweight user interfaces. Some hands-on experience with cloud services (e.g. Azure) and modern delivery practices such as CI/CD. Building with AI You've built things with LLMs, even side projects or prototypes, and understand concepts like prompting, tool calling, embeddings, and RAG. You've integrated a model API (e.g. OpenAI) and have at least a working feel for cost, latency, context windows, and rate limits. An awareness of how building and evaluating LLM systems differs from traditional software, and an interest in getting good at it. Familiarity with, or genuine curiosity about, vector databases, embeddings, and retrieval techniques such as semantic and hybrid search. How you work Genuine curiosity and a tinkerer's instinct. You build with AI because you find it interesting, not just because it's the job. A bias for shipping: you'd rather get something working in front of people than polish it indefinitely. Valuing good engineering practices: fast feedback, testing, and simple design; and wanting to get better at them. You might already follow the people who champion XP-style ways of working; if you don't have deep experience with them yet, the enthusiasm to learn matters more. You pick things up fast …

The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market — demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. items.desc: Description As a (Senior) Product Compliance Expert (m/f/x) in our Product Content Team, you will turn product related regulatory requirements into practical, scalable content for our software solutions, making compliance more efficient, reliable, and manageable for companies worldwide. We are looking for a product compliance expert with a strong affinity for technology, structured data, and AI-driven workflows . Working closely with Product Managers and Engineers, you will translate legislation into clear, actionable requirements and ready-to-use compliance templates for our customers. Your focus will be on evolving product compliance requirements around the Digital Product Passports (DPP) and Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) . Beyond individual regulations, you will identify common requirements and opportunities for standardization and automation to develop solutions that can be reused across regulations and customers. This is an opportunity to combine regulatory expertise with innovative technology and actively shape how companies manage product compliance. This position is based in Mannheim, Germany . We embrace a hybrid work model with three in-office days per week , offering a mix of face-to-face collaboration and remote flexibility. Your Responsibilities Own the development of Product Compliance content, from regulatory discovery through product implementation and ongoing maintenance. Conduct precise analysis of regulatory requirements, distinguishing between legislative text, official guidance, and interpretation—and clearly naming gaps rather than filling them. Translate complex compliance legislation into clear, structured content that product and engineering teams can act on, balancing legal precision with practical usability. Monitor the evolving regulatory landscape across EPR, DPP, and adjacent product compliance domains, assess implications for our product strategy, and flag emerging requirements early. Collaborate with product managers and engineers to prioritize compliance features and content updates based on regulatory urgency, customer impact, and technical feasibility. Leverage AI and automation tools—including agentic systems—to research, synthesize, and maintain compliance content at scale, while maintaining critical oversight of output quality. Work with structured data formats (Git, YAML, JSON) to version-control and manage compliance rules, enabling seamless integration with product systems. Your Experience 4–8 years of professional experience in product compliance, environmental compliance, regulatory affairs, or a closely related role, with demonstrated expertise in product-level compliance requirements. Overall familiarity with EU compliance frameworks is essential with proven experience around EPR (Extended Producer Responsibility) and/or DPP (Digital Product Passport) regulations. A precise, detail-oriented mindset with the ability to read legislation carefully, distinguish legal requirements from interpretation, and identify gaps in guidance or product logic. Strong analytical thinking, including the ability to test rules against edge cases and concrete scenarios before trusting them in product decisions. Comfortable working with product and engineering teams; able to discuss functional requirements, data structures, and technical trade-offs in compliance implementation. Hands-on experience with agentic AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) or structured data management (Git, YAML, JSON) in a professional context. A data-informed and collaborative approach, combining regulatory requirements, customer feedback, technical constraints, and market developments to drive content and product strategy. Fluency in German; English proficiency at C1 level or higher. Join us for this and more... A purpose-driven mission tackling complex global compliance challenges while building solutions that help enterprises navigate a fast-changing regulatory landscape The opportunity to directly shape how legislation becomes product—working at the intersection of law, technology, and user experience Flexibility and team bonding with our hybrid work options Fuel for your growth journey, both personally and professionally—including opportunities to deepen expertise in emerging compliance domains Sustainable mobility options, promoting eco-friendly commuting solutions Fun team events and outings with our global teams Inspiring workspaces in Mannheim and beyond About osapiens osapiens develops holistic Software-as-a-Service solutions that help global companies ensure transparency, efficiency, and trust across their entire value chain. Through its cloud platform, the osapiens HUB , the company leverages innovative technologies, including artificial intelligence, to strengthen businesses while promoting human rights, ecological responsibility, and sustainable corporate governance. items.desc: Job Description Finance AI Engineer The practice Finance is one of the most demanding and valuable environments in which to apply modern technology. You will work with complex enterprise data, mission-critical processes and high-impact decisions, using AI, data and engineering to reshape how organisations plan, control performance and allocate resources. The opportunity goes beyond building technically strong solutions: you will see how those solutions influence cash, profitability, risk and business growth, and take them from experimentation into trusted, production-ready capabilities. Working in Finance Reinvention allows you to remain close to leading-edge technology while developing an understanding of the CFO agenda, gaining exposure to senior decision-makers and building the commercial judgement needed to solve enterprise-wide challenges. This combination of deep technical capability, finance-domain expertise and measurable business impact creates a differentiated career path that is difficult to develop in a purely technology-focused role. Purpose of the role Core build capability for the practice. Responsible for engineering agents, the orchestration around them, the evaluation harness that establishes whether they perform, and the finance user surfaces through which they are operated. The role designs, develops, tests, deploys and operates production-grade AI applications and the services around them. Embedded within a delivery pod and working on client data from an early stage of each engagement, the role translates finance-process and control requirements into secure, observable and maintainable software. Responsibilities Build and deploy agentic workflows into live finance processes, including reconciliations, journals, exception handling, disputes, collections and variance explanation, with clear acceptance criteria, human oversight and controlled failure behaviour. Implement LLM application patterns including tool and function calling, structured outputs, RAG or graph-based retrieval, context and memory management, multi-agent orchestration, and prompt or configuration versioning. Integrate with ERP and EPM systems, document repositories and workflow tooling, including the data extraction, transformation and error handling that integration requires, using secure APIs, events, identity controls and reusable connectors where appropriate. Write evaluations, instrument agent behaviour, and ensure failure modes are visible and recoverable, using automated functional and non-functional tests, trace-level observability, red-team scenarios and measures for quality, groundedness, latency and cost. Build the interfaces through which finance users review, approve, override and evidence agent actions, including provenance, citations, feedback capture, accessibility and clear error-recovery journeys. Package and operate solutions using cloud AI services, containers or serverless components, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, secrets and configuration management, monitoring, release controls and rollback. Work directly with finance users, process specialists, architects and data engineers to clarify requirements, challenge assumptions constructively, demonstrate increments and document operating procedures and runbooks. Contribute reusable patterns and components back to the practice asset base, including tested code, evaluation assets, reference implementations and implementation guidance. Essential experience Strong software engineering discipline, including Python and at least one additional production language such as TypeScript or equivalent, version control, testing, CI, and maintainable code, together with SQL, API design, code review and secure coding practices. Hands-on LLM application development, covering tool use, structured outputs, retrieval and agent frameworks, including embeddings, vector or graph retrieval, prompt and configuration management, and integration with enterprise data or services. Practical experience with evaluation, observability and LLMOps or AgentOps, including versioning, monitoring, release and rollback, and analysis of quality, latency and cost. Understanding of secure enterprise integration and sensitive-data handling, including authentication, authorisation, secrets, logging and PII-aware design. Ability to work client-side and collaborate effectively with non-technical finance users, translating their needs into testable requirements while explaining options, risks and trade-offs clearly. At least 4 years’ relevant professional experience Qualification Desirable Front-end capability alongside back-end, sufficient to deliver a usable interface independently, for example React, Next.js or an equivalent framework. Prior exposure to SAP, Oracle, Workday, Anaplan or OneStream, or to finance processes such as close, planning, order to cash or procure to pay. Experience with MCP, graph or semantic retrieval, data engineering, event-driven integration or workflow orchestration. …

items.desc: Pourquoi rejoindre Keyrus aujourd'hui ? Keyrus est un groupe international de 2 800 consultants et experts présents dans 28 pays , porté par une conviction forte : ce n'est pas l'intelligence artificielle qui transforme les entreprises, mais l'intelligence conçue, structurée et intégrée à leur fonctionnement. Depuis plus de 30 ans, nous construisons les fondations data qui permettent aux systèmes intelligents de créer de la valeur. Nous concevons le système d'exploitation de l'entreprise intelligente, où la donnée, l'IA et l'expertise humaine s'intègrent au cœur des processus métiers pour générer une performance durable. Chez Keyrus, nous donnons vie à l'intelligence opérationnelle. L'intelligence artificielle ne remplace pas l'humain. Elle lui permet de se concentrer sur ce qu'aucun système ne peut reproduire : comprendre, décider, concevoir et innover. Rejoindre Keyrus, c'est construire son jugement, son expertise et sa capacité à résoudre des problématiques complexes. La technologie est un accélérateur. La culture Keyrus fait la différence. L'excellence opérationnelle permet de relier les deux. AI Engineer L'AI Engineer construit, orchestre et déploie l'intelligence artificielle en production : briques d'IA générative (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.), modèles de machine learning, agents multi-étapes intégrés aux systèmes du client. C'est la colonne technique du dispositif Keyrus AI, garant que ce qui est déployé fonctionne, tient à l'échelle et reste maîtrisé en coût : chaque brique construite porte sa propre responsabilité FinOps, du prototype à la production. Ce qui vous attend Vous concevez et déployez des systèmes d'IA agentique de bout en bout : du modèle de langage (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.) capable de raisonner à l'agent autonome capable d'agir, en environnement de production réel, pas en prototype isolé. Vous architecturez des agents multi-étapes qui orchestrent outils, mémoire et prise de décision : vous ne branchez pas un modèle sur une API, vous structurez la manière dont l'IA agit dans le système d'information du client. Vous intégrez ce que vous construisez au sein des architectures du système client, en vous appuyant sur les connecteurs, API et protocoles disponibles (CRM, ERP, MCP, webhooks). Vous maîtrisez le coût des modèles (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Google Gemini, etc.), des tokens et de l'inférence (FinOps IA), pour que la valeur créée tienne à l'échelle, pas seulement en démonstration. Vous documentez chaque agent que vous construisez (périmètre, capacités, limites, KPIs), pour qu'il reste exploitable au-delà de votre présence sur la mission. Vous itérez à partir des retours d'usage réels (pilotes, métriques), plutôt que de considérer un agent comme terminé dès son premier déploiement. Vous accompagnez la montée en compétences des équipes internes sur ces sujets, en posture de champion du changement. Vous concevrez et déploierez des solutions d’IA générative dans des environnements AWS, en vous appuyant notamment sur Amazon Bedrock et les services cloud associés. Vous contribuerez à leur industrialisation et leur mise en production, en intégrant les enjeux de sécurité, de scalabilité et de performance. Ce que vous apportez Le socle Architect of Intelligence : des qualités indispensables, présentes dans les critères ci-dessous : curiosité, créativité, communication, conscience professionnelle, culture, capacité à faire. Expérience et parcours Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience professionnelle, dont 2 ans minimum sur des projets d'IA, avec une expérience concrète de construction de briques d'IA générative ou agentique en production. Vous disposez également d'une expérience professionnelle significative sur AWS ; une certification AWS serait un vrai plus. Une trajectoire technique orientée vers l'autonomie croissante sur le déploiement de solutions IA, avec l'ambition d'évoluer aux côtés du Forward Deployed Engineer et du Foundations Architect. Posture et savoir-être Une rigueur d'ingénierie qui dépasse la validation en démonstration : vous pensez production, coût et maintenabilité dès la conception. Une curiosité pour le résultat métier produit par ce que vous construisez, pas seulement pour la technique elle-même. Une capacité à produire, documenter et transmettre ce que vous construisez, pour qu'un agent survive à votre départ de la mission. Une posture d'enablement : vous aimez faire monter les autres en compétence, pas seulement livrer seul. Compétences techniques indispensables IA générative & agentique : LLM (Anthropic, OpenAI, Mistral, Gemini), RAG, agents, LangChain/LangGraph. AWS & GenAI : maîtrise d'Amazon Bedrock (Foundation Models, Knowledge Bases, AgentCore) et bonne connaissance de l'écosystème AWS : Lambda, ECS/Fargate, RDS, Cognito, IAM, Step Functions. Industrialisation : Python, APIs, Docker et Terraform / Infrastructure as Code. Data & MLOps : bases vectorielles, pipelines de données, monitoring et mise en …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

Du begleitest Projekte von der Konzeption bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung, unterstützt Kunden: innen bei der Einführung von KI und gestaltest nachhaltige Innovationen für die digitale Verwaltung von morgen. Deine Rolle Du gestaltest unsere KI-Marktlösungen aktiv mit: Du entwickelst die strategische Ausrichtung unserer KI-Angebote weiter und bringst deine Expertise gezielt in Produktentwicklung und Positionierung ein Du machst KI gemeinwohlorientiert nutzbar: Du entwickelst Lösungen, die echten gesellschaftlichen Mehrwert schaffen Du bringst KI in die Umsetzung: Du begleitest Verwaltungen und Organisationen dabei, KI-Vorhaben strategisch, rechtssicher und wirkungsorientiert umzusetzen Du verbindest Menschen, Technologie und Wirkung: Du übersetzt komplexe Technologien in verständliche Lösungen, moderierst zwischen Stakeholdern und setzt Impulse für nachhaltige Innovation Du zeigst Aussenwirkung: Du repräsentierst unsere KI-Kompetenz nach aussen, hältst Präsentationen auf Veranstaltungen und Kundenanlässen und verfasst Fachbeiträge mit Aussenwirkung Dein Profil Strategie & Umsetzung: Erfahrung in Beratung und digitaler Innovation, Fähigkeit zur Einbettung von KI-Initiativen in Unternehmensstrategien sowie praktische Umsetzungserfahrung in KI-Projekten KI- und Technologiekompetenz: Fundiertes Wissen in Generativer KI und Machine Learning mit realistischer Einschätzung von Chancen, Risiken und Grenzen. items.title: Global Siri Engineer, Dutch
items.card: you will play a key role in crafting innovative, end-to-end solutions that delight millions of customers across the globe. You will act as the technical anchor for the Dutch market, including nl_NL and nl_BE, leading work streams to design and implement large-scale ML and GenAI solutions that advance our customer experience. This position sits squarely at the intersection of Machine Learning, Data, and Software
items.desc:
Play a part in the next revolution of machine learning technology! Siri assists hundreds of millions of people, in dozens of languages, every day, and Global Siri is the team that teaches Siri each one of them.
We own the product end-to-end, from Speech Recognition and Natural Language Understanding through to Response. We are looking for an engineer with deep expertise in either Machine Learning or Software Engineering, and practical working knowledge of the other, to shape the future of Siri for Dutch (nl_NL and nl_BE) users.
Your work will range across multiple disciplines, including employing advanced Large Language Models (LLMs), adopting models for global markets, running data experiments, and engineering scalable software to deliver highly personalized, culturally relevant experiences for our customers.
As a member of our dynamic and fast-paced group, you will play a key role in crafting innovative, end-to-end solutions that delight millions of customers across the globe. You will act as the technical anchor for the Dutch market, including nl_NL and nl_BE, leading work streams to design and implement large-scale ML and GenAI solutions that advance our customer experience.
This position sits squarely at the intersection of Machine Learning, Data, and Software Engineering. Whether you are a strong Software Engineer who has applied ML to production systems, or an ML expert with solid coding skills, you will leverage large language models (LLMs), agentic approaches to tasks, and data generation methods to build real-world systems.
You will work with partner teams across Apple, sharing your expertise and bringing architectural proposals that account for international market nuances, so that Siri feels genuinely native to Dutch users.
Join us as we build the foundation of Siri AI for users around the world!
Professional-level fluency in Dutch, with deep familiarity with the culture and idiom of Dutch as spoken in The Netherlands or Belgium.
Experience in applying machine learning and NLP techniques to deliver products, with a solid understanding of ML concepts
Strong skills in software design and programming across different paradigms, including testing and maintainability, with experience contributing to large production code bases.
Experience working with data at scale, including building or curating datasets, analyzing results, and making data-driven decisions.
Hands-on experience with large language models: fine-tuning, prompt and context engineering, evaluation, and inference optimization, including agentic systems, tool calling, or retrieval-augmented generation.
Experience with speech technologies such as ASR, TTS, or pronunciation modeling.
Experience adapting models or products across languages and markets — multilingual and cross-lingual modeling, transfer learning, or low-resource settings.
Ability to formulate a research problem, design, experiment, implement and communicate solutions.
Product focus with a strong emphasis on end-user experience.
Experience writing software in Python, Swift, Objective-C, C++ or C; experience on Apple platforms preferred.
M.S, Ph.D. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience integrating applications with REST APIs and structured data sources such as CSV, XML or databases. Strong debugging skills and the ability to reason accurately about conditional logic, AND/OR precedence and dependencies. XBRL/iXBRL tagging and reporting. Accounting, audit, tax or financial reporting software. IFRS or Dutch, German or Danish financial reporting requirements. Dutch, German or Danish language skills.  Nos engagements, vos avantages

 Votre quotidien 
 CortAIx est la nouvelle entité du groupe dédiée à l'innovation en IA de défense. Cette initiative reflète l'ambition de Thales d'améliorer significativement l'analyse de données et la prise de décision dans des contextes critiques, en répondant à des exigences élevées de cybersécurité, d'embarquabilité et de frugalité.

Avec un réseau étendu de partenaires industriels, de start-ups, et d'institutions académiques, Thales s'impose comme un leader de l'IA dans les systèmes critiques, en tête des dépôts de brevets dans ce domaine en Europe. Cette démarche s'inscrit dans la vision à long terme de Thales pour une IA transparente, explicable, et éthique, affirmant son rôle de pionnier dans le développement de solutions embarquables et sécurisées répondant aux enjeux de souveraineté et de sécurité de ses clients.

items.desc: Descrizione del lavoro Il Gruppo E è alla ricerca di un AI Delivery Specialist Junior che sia in grado di supportare il team AI e cresca fino a gestire in autonomia parti crescenti dei progetti per clienti enterprise, in ambiti diversi: manifatturiero, retail, fashion, media, pubblica amministrazione, sport. La figura, in collaborazione con i colleghi e con il responsabile, si occuperà di garantire qualità e continuità alla delivery dei progetti AI affiancando il Delivery Lead sullo sviluppo, sul rapporto con i clienti e sulle attività di formazione. La persona si occuperà delle seguenti attività: partecipare alla realizzazione delle soluzioni AI: configurazione della piattaforma, sviluppo di assistenti e agenti, basi di conoscenza (RAG), integrazioni con i sistemi del cliente; supportare le fasi di PoC, test, rilascio e messa in produzione; gestire attività di manutenzione, troubleshooting e miglioramento continuo sui progetti già in esercizio; redigere e mantenere aggiornata la documentazione tecnica e di progetto; partecipare a riunioni di avanzamento, raccolta requisiti e workshop con i referenti di business e IT; collaborare con la prevendita nel passaggio dalla proposta alla realizzazione; supportare la preparazione e l'erogazione di sessioni formative sull'AI per i clienti, di livello base e avanzato: materiali, esercitazioni, demo affiancare gli utenti nell'adozione degli strumenti dopo il rilascio (onboarding, Q&A, supporto) Il candidato ideale risponde ai seguenti requisiti: Laurea in ambito STEM (Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica o affini) o esperienza equivalente; 0-3 anni di esperienza in ambito IT, sviluppo o consulenza tecnica; buona conoscenza di Python; familiarità di base con i modelli linguistici (LLM) e con i concetti di prompt engineering, RAG e agenti; conoscenza di base di API REST, formati dati (JSON) e database; buone capacità di comunicazione, orale e scritta, e attitudine al contatto con il cliente; italiano madrelingua o equivalente, inglese buono (documentazione tecnica e riunioni) Rappresentano un valore aggiunto le seguenti caratteristiche: esperienza pratica su progetti o prototipi con LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, modelli open source, framework come LangChain o simili); conoscenza dell'ecosistema Microsoft (Azure, Microsoft 365, Copilot); nozioni di Docker, ambienti Linux e deploy on-premise; esperienza in attività di formazione, tutoring o presentazioni pubbliche; interesse per i temi di governance e sicurezza dell'AI (AI Act, protezione dei dati); esperienza pratica su progetti o prototipi con LLM (OpenAI/Azure OpenAI, modelli open source, framework come LangChain o simili); Vantaggi dell'azienda e benefit aziendali Offriamo: Un inquadramento retributivo commisurato all'effettiva seniority, CCNL Commercio 14 mensilità Inserimento in ambiente dinamico in un settore innovativo e in costante crescita Flessibilità oraria e smart working per una migliore conciliazione vita/lavoro Ticket restaurant da 8,00 €/giorno Assicurazione sanitaria integrativa per visite specialistiche Asset necessari all’espletamento dell’attività lavorativa Opportunità di crescita professionale e costante training grazie alla collaborazione e a piani di incentivazione personalizzati Un ambiente di lavoro stimolante e dinamico con area relax per favorire la socializzazione e il benessere dei dipendenti

Votre rôle et vos domaines d'intervention : - Comprendre les enjeux métier des clients, animer des ateliers de découverte, de cadrage et de priorisation, puis identifier les opportunités de création de valeur grâce à la Data et à l'IA. - Concevoir et développer rapidement des prototypes et MVP autour de solutions Data, d'IA prédictive et générative afin de valider les hypothèses métier. - Faire le lien entre les décideurs métiers, les équipes produits, les architectes, les data engineers et les experts IA tout au long du cycle de vie des projets. - Travailler directement avec les utilisateurs finaux et accompagner les équipes clientes afin de favoriser l'adoption et l'impact des nouveaux usages Data & IA. - Contribuer à des programmes de transformation ainsi qu'au développement des accélérateurs, assets et offres Data & IA de KPMG. Curiosité intellectuelle et passion pour les technologies émergentes. Forte orientation impact et création de valeur métier. Esprit entrepreneurial, pragmatisme et prise d'initiative. N’attendez plus ! items.desc: Key Highlights: Job Title: Full-Stack Software Engineer Location: Paris, hybrid working Reporting to: Engineering Lead Salary: Up to €70k DOE About Us SaleCycle is redefining how brands convert, engage, and retain customers through AI-driven experiences across the entire customer journey. SaleCycle combines real-time onsite personalisation and intent scoring with offsite activation across email, SMS, and paid channels, enabling brands to identify, engage, convert, and re-engage customers with precision. What we do We provide a full-funnel Agentic Marketing Platform, combining: Real-time behavioural analytics and intent scoring AI-powered search, recommendations, and agentic decisioning Onsite personalisation and A/B testing Cross-channel activation (email, SMS, paid media) CRM/CDP integrations and first-party data orchestration Retail media and monetisation capabilities Who we are We are a global team of 80+ people across the UK, France, Spain, Italy, and Eastern Europe. We are profitable, growing, and operating with a clear mindset: We build, not maintain We prioritise outcomes over activity We operate with low ego and high accountability We challenge ourselves to step outside our comfort zone Our Values At SaleCycle, we care about people; it’s our top priority. We prioritise well-being, growth, and innovation, continuously pushing boundaries as a team and a company. Continuous Innovation: Collaborate, innovate, and celebrate! Premium Execution: Excellence Delivered Every Time! High Curiosity: Embrace your inner child - ask why and listen! Proactive Collaboration: United, we work together and lead the way! Ultimate Passion: Infuse passion into every action! Job Summary As a Full-Stack Software Engineer, you'll join a highly collaborative, agile, empowered product delivery team building the SaleCycle platform that powers AI-driven personalisation, intent scoring, and cross-channel activation for e-commerce brands. This is a full-stack role for someone who wants genuine full-stack range rather than staying purely on one side of the stack. You’ll work primarily in your strongest language, shipping features end to end across our React front end and our C#/.NET and Go backend services, with real opportunity to grow into our other core languages over time. We’re flexible on the exact combination. What matters most is the shape: real depth on one side of the stack, solid hands-on experience on the other, and a genuine curiosity to keep learning, comfortable being a generalist rather than a specialist. We’re open to candidates matching any of these profiles: Profile A - Strong C#/.NET background, hands-on experience with React/TypeScript, and keen to learn Go Profile B - Strong Go background, hands-on experience with React/TypeScript, and keen to learn C#/.NET Profile C - Strong React/TypeScript background, working knowledge of C#/.NET or Go, and keen to deepen your backend skills You’ll be joining a small, cross-functional engineering team spanning France and the UK, in an engineering organisation that is still taking shape following the SaleCycle × BEYABLE merger, a great opportunity to influence how we build, not just what we build. Key Responsibilities Shipping features end-to-end across our stack: React/TypeScript front end, C#/.NET and Go backend services Designing and building services and APIs within a multi-tenant SaaS architecture serving e-commerce customers at scale Building clear, responsive UI that surfaces analytics, intent scoring, and decisioning outputs to our brands and internal teams Working across the API boundary to shape clean, well-documented contracts between front-end and backend services Growing your skills in the languages outside your current comfort zone, with support and pairing from the team Writing clean, maintainable, and efficient code following industry best practices (e.g., SOLID principles, testable design) Collaborating within an agile, Scrum-driven team, participating in sprints and planning sessions Contributing to automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and monitoring of production systems Engaging in peer code reviews and sharing knowledge across our France and UK teams Essential Skills & Experience Around 6 years of professional software engineering experience Deep, hands-on expertise on one side of the stack in production: C#/.NET or Go on the backend, or React/TypeScript on the frontend Solid, hands-on experience on the other side: React/TypeScript for backend-led profiles, C#/.NET or Go for frontend-led profiles Genuine interest in working across the stack and learning new languages Comfortable in a fast-moving, still-forming engineering organisation post-merger A pragmatic, delivery-focused mindset, comfortable with ambiguity and evolving standards Familiar with git or other distributed source control systems Nice to Have Experience building or operating multi-tenant SaaS systems Familiarity with cloud platforms, ideally Azure or GCP Interest in AI-assisted development …

items.desc: Clorox is the place that’s committed to growth – for our people and our brands. Guided by our purpose and values, and with people at the center of everything we do, we believe every one of us can make a positive impact on consumers, communities, and teammates. Join our team. #CloroxIsThePlace Your role at Clorox: We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled Integration Platform Engineer to help Clorox accelerate delivery of enterprise AI and agentic AI use cases using the approved end-to-end reference architecture. This role will help convert architecture into repeatable delivery patterns, reusable capabilities, and governed production implementations that safely connect AI platforms, data products, knowledge layers, APIs, automations, workflows, security controls, and systems of record. In this role, you will: This role sits at the heart of Clorox's AI transformation, helping teams scale AI solutions by connecting platforms, data, workflows, and business applications through governed and reusable patterns. Business Impact This role is critical to ensuring AI can move beyond experimentation and deliver real business value. The successful candidate will: Enable AI agents to safely access and act on enterprise systems and data. Build reusable APIs, automations, and integration services that accelerate AI solution delivery across the company. Ensure all AI-driven actions comply with security, governance, identity, and approval controls. Create enterprise-wide integration standards that support future AI and Agentic AI initiatives. Key Responsibilities Design and configure enterprise platforms to enable APIs, MCP endpoints, intelligent automations, and integration services. Build and support integrations across platforms including MuleSoft, Azure APIM, SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP, ServiceNow, UiPath, Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, and Denodo. Implement governance controls for agent actions, including authentication, authorisation, logging, monitoring, and human approval workflows. Establish API, integration, and agent-to-agent (A2A) standards, documentation, and lifecycle management practices. Troubleshoot and optimse integration and automation platforms supporting AI use cases. This role will: Play a pivotal role in delivering Clorox's enterprise AI and Agentic AI strategy. Work on cutting-edge technologies including AI Agents, MCP, A2A architectures, intelligent automation, and enterprise integrations. Influence how AI securely interacts with core business systems globally. Join a high-impact engineering team building reusable platforms rather than one-off solutions. Exposure to a modern technology stack including Azure, SAP, MuleSoft, Databricks, Fabric, UiPath, and emerging AI technologies. Opportunity to shape enterprise standards and architecture patterns that will be used across the organisation. What we look for: 7-10 years of experience in integration engineering, automation engineering, API development, or enterprise platform engineering. Strong expertise in REST APIs, middleware, cloud integrations, SAP integrations, and automation technologies. Experience with MuleSoft, Azure API Management, UiPath, SAP BTP, OAuth/OIDC, Entra ID, observability, and security controls. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, or C#. Ability to collaborate across architecture, security, cloud, data, and product teams in a fast-paced environment. Workplace type: #LI-Hybrid Our values-based culture connects to our purpose and empowers people to be their best, professionally and personally. We serve a diverse consumer base which is why we believe teams that reflect our consumers bring fresh perspectives, drive innovation, and help us stay attuned to the world around us. That’s why we foster an inclusive culture where every person can feel respected, valued, and fully able to participate, and ultimately able to thrive. Learn more . Benefits we offer to help you be well and thrive: Competitive compensation Generous 401(k) program in the US and similar programs in international Health benefits and programs that support both your physical and mental well-being Flexible work environment, depending on your role Meaningful opportunities to keep learning and growing Half-day Fridays, depending on your location Please apply directly to our job postings and do not submit your resume to any person via text message. Clorox does not conduct text-based interviews and encourages you to be cautious of anyone posing as a Clorox recruiter via unsolicited texts during these uncertain times. To all recruitment agencies: Clorox (and its brand families) does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Clorox employees, including any members of our leadership team. Clorox is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

items.desc: Project description DXC-Luxoft is an industry-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC-Luxoft. DXC-Luxoft is currently supporting several German OEMs in building their next-generation battery-electric vehicle platforms. We help industrializing, integrating and testing the platform and functional software, especially during critical integration phases approaching start-of-production. For expanding our business offering in the European market, we seek to establish experienced automotive engineers. DXC-Luxoft is happy to receive applications from self-motivated and self-disciplined applicants who communicate well, like to work in teams, and are highly motivated to bring value to our automotive customers. For the successful candidate, we offer the opportunity to enhance and develop your career with the following benefits: Join a highly competent and motivated international team Apply your talent to creating the mobility solutions of the future Gain hands-on experience working with well-recognized customers Personal growth and promotion options Make an impact on the overall growth of DXC-Luxoft Our interesting project connected with cutting-edge automotive technologies. Responsibilities Lead data driven initiatives across customer projects by providing architecture guidance and technical leadership. Develop a deep understanding of customer environment, develop and implement solutions on Databricks platform to address existing project’s needs. Own the end-to-end Databricks solution architecture across integration, ingestion, transformation, governance, serving, reporting and operations. Establish engineering standards: medallion architecture, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, Databricks Asset Bundles, testing, data quality and observability. Document architecture through ADRs, design guidelines and run design and code reviews. Partner with Data science/AI team on AI-powered solutions, LLM-based tooling and agentic workflows. Optimize performance and costs, give customer transparent cost guidance. Support pre-sales activities by creating solution concepts, architecture proposals, estimates and technical presentations. Collaborate with stakeholders, product owners and engineering teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. Skills Must have 7+ years of professional software development experience Deep hands-on knowledge of the Azure Databricks platform: Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Lakeflow (Connect, Declarative Pipelines, Jobs), Auto Loader, SQL Warehouses and serverless compute. Proven experience designing and implementing Lakehouse / medallion architecture as an enterprise standard. Knowledge of Databricks Apps, AI/BI Dashboards, Genie One, Lakebase and Agents. Diseñar y desarrollar
items.desc: En Acobur Asesores estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de desarrollo y buscamos a alguien con ganas de aplicar la IA generativa a problemas reales: automatizar procesos, construir agentes y llevar a producción herramientas que se usan a diario, tanto en nuestros productos (como WeTender , nuestra plataforma de inteligencia en contratación pública) como en proyectos para clientes. ¿Qué harás? Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones basadas en LLMs (Claude, GPT, modelos open source…) para automatizar tareas y flujos de trabajo. Construir agentes, pipelines de extracción y análisis de documentos, y sistemas RAG. Integrar la IA con nuestros sistemas internos, APIs y bases de datos. Identificar procesos manuales susceptibles de automatizarse y proponer cómo hacerlo. Trabajar codo con codo con un equipo pequeño, con autonomía y visibilidad sobre lo que construyes. ¿Qué buscamos? Grado en Ingeniería Informática o similar. Experiencia programando en Python [y/o TypeScript]. Conocimiento práctico de APIs de modelos de lenguaje, prompting y herramientas como LangChain, MCP o similares. Soltura con Git, APIs REST y bases de datos. Curiosidad, capacidad de aprender rápido y ganas de ver tu trabajo en producción. Se valorará: Experiencia con bases de datos vectoriales / búsqueda semántica (Elasticsearch, pgvector…). Automatización con n8n, Make o herramientas similares. Docker y despliegue de servicios. Conocimiento del sector de la contratación pública. ¿Qué ofrecemos? Modelo híbrido: 3 días presenciales en nuestra oficina de Madrid y el resto en remoto. Contrato indefinido. Proyectos reales de IA desde el primer día, sin capas de burocracia. Formación continua y acceso a las últimas herramientas de IA. Horario de 8:00 a 14:00 y de 15:00 a 17:00. Madrid o alrededores (necesaria disponibilidad para acudir a la oficina algunos días por semana).

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in
items.desc: Role Description gravity9 is expanding its Forward Deployed Engineering team to build production agentic AI systems for enterprise clients, in partnership with leading frontier-model providers. We already support clients from different verticals to have agentic and RAG systems live in production across healthcare, financial services, retail and global logistics. As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer you work embedded in the client's environment, from discovery, through architecture and build, to production and handover. This is end-to-end agent engineering, not proofs of concept and not advisory work. Two flavours of engagement: Internal enterprise use cases, such as reconciliation and KYC workflows in financial services, clinical and claims workflows in healthcare, operations and supply-chain workflows in logistics. Product- and customer-facing agents, more greenfield, often exploratory, built into the client's own product. Engagements are typically a team of engineers over a few months, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the client's team including architects, DevOps and QA. Embed with the client. Work hand-in-hand inside the client's environment, codebase and cloud tenancy, often in a hybrid team alongside their engineers. You are visible to the client from day one. Design and build production agentic AI systems. Multi-agent orchestration, tool and function calling, retrieval, planning and routing, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, state and checkpointing, guardrails, failure handling and recovery. Do the unglamorous data work. A large share of every engagement is data engineering: ingestion, flattening deeply nested structures, extracting content from unstructured documents, classification, summarisation, tagging, enrichment, indexing. Models reason over data, bad data beats a good model every time. Own evaluation and accuracy. Establish a baseline eval dataset at the start of the engagement, automate grading, and track groundedness, faithfulness and retrieval quality per tool, not just at the agent level. Be ready to defend accuracy numbers to a sceptical enterprise stakeholder. Engineer for cost and latency. Model selection and routing (cheaper, faster models for non-reasoning steps; frontier models where reasoning genuinely earns it), prompt and context budgeting, caching. Cost is a non-negotiable metric on every engagement. Ship it properly. Observability and tracing, CI/CD, IaC, monitoring the client can actually operate, security and compliance review. Transfer knowledge deliberately. We don't run a long-term support business. Every engagement is designed so the client owns and can extend the system after we leave. You architect with their team in the room, pair with their engineers, and hand over working monitoring and documentation. Technical skills Essential Programming: Strong Python (async, typing, testing, packaging). Working competence in TypeScript / Node is a plus. LLM application engineering: Hands-on production experience with frontier models: prompt and context engineering, structured outputs, tool and function calling, streaming, token and context-window management. Agentic architecture: Built and shipped multi-agent or agentic workflows, planner/router patterns, supervisor and sub-agent designs, ReAct-style loops, state and checkpointing, retries and interrupts, human-in-the-loop review gates. Frameworks: At least one of: Anthropic Agent SDK, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or an equivalent orchestration framework, plus the judgement to know when to use none of them. RAG and retrieval: Chunking strategy, embeddings, hybrid and semantic search, re-ranking, citation and provenance, natural-language-to-query translation. Data platforms: NoSQL databases such as MongoDB (aggregation pipelines, Atlas Search, Atlas Vector Search) or a strong equivalent, plus SQL. Comfortable designing schemas for agent retrieval, not just for OLTP. Data engineering: Building ingestion and enrichment pipelines over messy structured and unstructured sources, documents, PDFs, object storage. Evaluation: Building eval harnesses and eval datasets, LLM-as-judge with its limits understood, regression testing of prompts and agents, metric selection per use case. Cloud: Production delivery on AWS (incl. Bedrock), Azure or GCP, containers, serverless, networking basics, secrets management, IAM. Engineering discipline: Git, code review, testing, CI/CD, IaC (Terraform or equivalent), observability. Strong advantage Anthropic certification (Claude Developer / Anthropic-issued credential), an explicit advantage at shortlisting. Anthropic Agent SDK production experience, a significant bonus. MCP (Model Context Protocol): building servers and clients, tool exposure, auth patterns. Claude Code as an autonomous SDLC agent: sub-agents, hooks, custom skills, agent marketplaces, context sharing across a team. LLM observability and tracing tooling (LangFuse, LangSmith, Arize, Braintrust or similar). Regulated-environment delivery: HIPAA, GDPR, …

items.desc: Wir gehören zu den Top-Adressen in der IT-Welt und fokussieren uns auf die Optimierung der Kerngeschäfts­prozesse unserer Kunden. Durch den smarten Einsatz maßgeschneiderter IT-Lösungen unterstützen wir unsere Kunden dabei, das Beste aus ihrem Business und aktuellen Technologien herauszuholen. Unseren Erfolg aber erreichen wir nur durch eins: die Menschen bei adesso! Sie bringen Ideen, fachliches Know how und Technologien zusammen. Gemeinsam programmieren wir (deine) Zukunft bei adesso. DEINE ROLLE Azure AI Engineering: Du entwickelst auf dem Microsoft Azure AI Stack agentische Lösungen - von Wissensassistenten über autonome Multi-Agenten-Systeme bis zum verantwortungsvollen Betrieb produktiver KI-Anwendungen – für unsere Kunden. Du übersetzt KI-Potenziale in skalierbare, sichere und wirksame Lösungen und wirkst aktiv an unseren Referenzarchitekturen mit. Custom AI Solutions: Du konzipierst und implementierst maßgeschneiderte Lösungen auf dem Azure AI Stack - RAG-Systeme, Dokumentenintelligenz und LLM-gestützte Prozessautomatisierungen inklusive. Agentische Systeme: Du entwickelst Multi-Agenten-Architekturen mit modernen Frameworks wie Semantic Kernel, AutoGen oder LangGraph und integrierst Tools und Datenquellen über offene Standards wie MCP und A2A. Du arbeitest dabei selbst konsequent agentisch, mit spezialisierten Agenten entlang des AI-Engineering-Lifecycles, und etablierst Quality-Gates für agentengestützte Entwicklungs- und Betriebsprozesse. LLMOps & Deployment: Du verantwortest den produktiven Betrieb von KI-Anwendungen, von Modellauswahl, Prompt Management und Versioning bis zu Observability, Token-Kostenkontrolle und Skalierung. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verankerst Security, Datenschutz und Monitoring auf Basis der Microsoft Governance-Werkzeuge und stellst die Einhaltung regulatorischer Anforderungen sicher. Kundenberatung & Wissenstransfer: Du begleitest Kunden in Envisioning-Workshops wie „Agent in a Day", priorisierst Use Cases und entwickelst pragmatische Umsetzungsroadmaps. Im Team baust du Referenzarchitekturen und Asset-Bibliotheken weiter aus und stehst als Sparringspartner:in für technische Deep-Dives zur Verfügung. DEIN PROFIL Berufserfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre in der Softwareentwicklung, KI-Lösungsentwicklung oder technischen Beratung gearbeitet, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit konkretem Fokus auf Azure AI oder LLM-Anwendungen im produktiven Einsatz. Azure AI Stack: Du setzt Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Foundry und Azure AI Search sicher ein und bringst fundierte Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code und CI/CD im Microsoft-Umfeld mit. Technische Expertise: Du hast Erfahrung in der Entwicklung produktiver KI-Lösungen auf dem Microsoft AI-Stack mit und hast solide Kenntnisse in Python und/oder C#/.NET. LLMOps-Verständnis: Du kennst die typischen Herausforderungen produktiver KI-Systeme, von Inference Latency und Prompt Stability über Model Drift und Evaluation bis hin zur Kostenkontrolle. Agentische Kompetenz: Du bringst praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Orchestrierung von KI-Agenten mit offenen Integrationsstandards wie MCP mit und kennst dich idealerweise auch bei der Einbindung von Agenten in den Entwicklungsprozess aus. Responsible AI & Governance: Du verstehst die Risiken generativer KI, kennst gängige Mitigationsstrategien und regulatorische Anforderungen (EU AI Act, DSGVO) und hast ein Gespür für Kostensensitivität beim KI-Einsatz. Sprachkenntnisse: Deine sehr guten Deutsch- und guten Englischkenntnisse ermöglichen dir eine sichere Kommunikation. Unser Versprechen: Du wirst dich bei uns wohlfühlen! Kollegial, familiär und auf Augenhöhe – wir leben Austausch, Teamgeist und einen respektvollen Umgang miteinander. Diversität und verschiedene Blickwinkel werden bei uns genauso geschätzt wie du als Mensch. Das und viel mehr steht für unser ganz besonderes Wir-Gefühl. Für das es sogar ein Wort gibt: adessi. Unsere Kultur und das Zusammenarbeiten sind geprägt von gegenseitiger Wertschätzung, Anerkennung und Unterstützung. Das verbindet uns hierarchieübergreifend – auch im Home-Office. So belegen wir zum wiederholten Mal den 1. Platz beim Wettbewerb „Deutschlands Beste Arbeitgeber in der ITK“!. Unser umfangreiches Trainingsangebot und ein transparentes Laufbahnstufenmodell für alle sorgen dafür, dass deine Entwicklung bei uns nicht stillsteht. Denn gemeinsam zu wachsen und Chancengeber zu sein, das ist programmiert in unserer DNA.

items.desc: wailand baut eine agentische KI-Plattform für das Engineering im Maschinenbau. Sie läuft bereits produktiv bei Industriekunden. Unser Ziel: Engineering radikal neu denken und die Industrie in Europa technologisch stärken. Jetzt bauen wir aus: tiefere Integration in CAD, PLM und ERP, Knowledge Graph, Laufzeitumgebung für Agents und die Agenten-Architektur selbst. Du entwickelst Komponenten der Plattform: Integrationen zu CAD, PLM und ERP, Backend-Services, Datenpipelines, Agent-Workflows. Entwickeln heißt bei uns agentisch. Du schreibst keinen Code mehr selbst. Du beschreibst die Aufgabe, setzt die Prüfkriterien, steuerst die Agents, reviewst das Ergebnis und gibst frei. Die Verantwortung für das, was zum Kunden geht, bleibt bei dir. Was du bei uns machst Du setzt Features und Komponenten der Plattform um: Integrationen zu CAD, PLM und ERP, Backend-Services, Datenpipelines, Agent-Workflows. Du arbeitest agentisch: Du zerlegst Aufgaben, schreibst Specs und Prüfkriterien, steuerst Coding-Agents und reviewst deren Ergebnisse. Du gibst frei, was zum Kunden geht, und stehst für Qualität und Wartbarkeit gerade. Du baust automatisierte Prüfungen und Prüfstände, damit Agents sicher arbeiten können: Tests, Referenzergebnisse, Evaluierungen für LLM-Flows. Du bringst LLM-Komponenten in produktive Systeme: RAG, Tool-Calling, Agent-Orchestrierung mit State Management und Observability. Du entwickelst unseren Harness mit: Agent-Workflows, Skills, Prüfketten und Tooling, mit denen wir Software bauen. Du sorgst dafür, dass deine Komponenten beobachtbar, testbar und betreibbar sind, in der Cloud und OnPrem. Du bringst dich in Architekturentscheidungen ein und arbeitest eng mit dem Software Architect, den AI Engineers und den Forward Deployed Engineers zusammen. Was du mitbringst Must-have Du hast mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in der Backend-Entwicklung produktiver Systeme, zum Beispiel mit Python oder Java. Du kennst API-Design, Microservices, Container und CI/CD aus der Praxis. Du arbeitest bereits täglich mit Coding-Agents (zum Beispiel Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) und willst Software konsequent so bauen. Du beschreibst Aufgaben so präzise, dass ein Agent sie umsetzen kann, und erkennst im Review, wo das Ergebnis nicht trägt. Du verstehst Datenarchitekturen: relationale Datenbanken, Vektor-Datenbanken, strukturierte und unstrukturierte Daten. Du gibst direktes Feedback, hinterfragst Entscheidungen und stehst zu deinen eigenen. Nice-to-have Du hast LLM-Komponenten (RAG, Tool-Calling, Agents) in produktive Systeme gebracht. Du hast mit Graph-Datenbanken oder Knowledge Graphs gearbeitet. Du hattest Berührungspunkte mit Engineering-Systemen (CAD, PLM, ERP) oder dem Maschinenbau. Du hast Software OnPrem bei Industriekunden betrieben. Du hast eigene Agent-Workflows, Skills oder Tooling für dein Team gebaut. Du scheust dich nicht vor agentischer Frontend-Arbeit. Rahmen Dortmund oder Heilbronn, hybrid: Remote ist möglich, bevorzugt treffen wir uns ein- bis zweimal pro Woche im Büro. Deutsch verhandlungssicher, Englisch konversationssicher. So entwickeln wir Der Mensch macht bei uns das, worauf es ankommt: die technische und fachliche Konzeption, die Steuerung der Agents, den Prüfumfang und die Freigabe des Release. Die Entwicklungsumgebung dafür, unseren Harness, bauen wir selbst und entwickeln ihn ständig weiter. Wer bei uns entwickelt, denkt KI also doppelt: als Werkzeug im eigenen Arbeitsalltag und als Bestandteil des Produkts. Tech-Stack Python (FastAPI), Java, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Postgres, Vektor-Datenbanken, Graph-Datenbanken, Langchain, LangGraph, Frontier-Modelle (Anthropic, OpenAI) und lokale LLMs (Open-Source-Modelle, selbst gehostet), Claude Code und weitere Coding-Agents, eigener Harness für agentische Entwicklung. Bewerbung Kein Standard-Anschreiben. Schick uns an career@wailand.io , was du gebaut hast, worauf du stolz bist und wo deine Erfahrung zu dieser Stelle passt. Ein paar Sätze reichen für den Anfang. Mehr über wailand, unsere Arbeitsweise und das Team auf unserer Karriereseite.

La persona seleccionada trabajará en el diseño y construcción de la arquitectura backend en AWS, así como en el desarrollo de soluciones basadas en RAG, sistemas multi-agente y orquestación de modelos de IA . Funciones principales Diseñar, desplegar y gestionar la infraestructura AWS necesaria para las soluciones de IA. Configurar y administrar servicios como AWS API Gateway, App Runner y Amazon S3. Implementar y gestionar Amazon OpenSearch como base de datos vectorial para soluciones RAG. Diseñar flujos de comunicación asíncrona mediante job_id, polling y gestión de peticiones entre frontend y backend. Diseñar arquitecturas Multi-Agente, incluyendo agentes orquestadores y agentes especializados. Desarrollar soluciones RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) utilizando OpenSearch. Realizar Prompt Engineering avanzado y trabajar con frameworks como LangChain, LlamaIndex o librerías equivalentes. Integrar DuckDB para permitir la ejecución de consultas SQL sobre ficheros de datos. Desarrollar funcionalidades para que los agentes puedan ejecutar consultas y trabajar directamente con datos mediante rutinas tipo execute_select o query_excel. Participar en el diseño y evolución de la arquitectura técnica de las soluciones de IA Generativa. Experiencia práctica con AWS, especialmente API Gateway, App Runner, S3 y OpenSearch. Experiencia desarrollando soluciones de IA Generativa y RAG. Conocimientos de arquitecturas Multi-Agente y sistemas de orquestación. Experiencia con LangChain, LlamaIndex o frameworks/librerías similares. Conocimientos de bases de datos vectoriales y búsqueda semántica. Experiencia trabajando con Python y desarrollo backend. Conocimientos de SQL y DuckDB. Capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en el diseño y despliegue de la infraestructura. Se valorará Experiencia en proyectos de IA Generativa en entornos productivos. Conocimiento de diferentes LLM y proveedores de modelos. Experiencia con arquitecturas cloud escalables y servicios serverless. items.desc: Lancée en 2017, mozzeno est le prêteur belge 100 % digital qui s’est imposé comme acteur clé du crédit. Chaque jour, nous aidons des particuliers et des professionnels à financer leurs projets grâce à un processus simple, rapide et entièrement digital. Notre force ? Une combinaison unique entre technologie et accompagnement humain, nous permettant d’offrir un service efficace et personnalisé. En parallèle, nous permettons à des investisseurs de soutenir activement l’économie réelle en Belgique en finançant les prêts octroyés par mozzeno. Basée à Louvain-la-Neuve et actuellement en pleine croissance, mozzeno recherche un(e) AI Automation Engineer pour concevoir, orchestrer et améliorer nos processus métier grâce à l'IA. Contenu du poste En tant qu'AI Automation Engineer, vous concevrez, développerez et maintiendrez un portefeuille de solutions d'automatisation qui soutiennent les équipes et les processus métier de mozzeno — de plus en plus propulsés par l'IA. Concrètement, vous allez : Construire des automatisations avec Python et PowerShell — scripts, intégrations et services qui connectent nos applications, transfèrent les données, transforment les données, suppriment les étapes manuelles à travers l'organisation. Concevoir et déployer des workflows IA avec Dify (notre plateforme de workflows IA) pour orchestrer des étapes basées sur des LLM (traitement de documents, classification, extraction, rédaction, assistants et agents internes) et les intégrer en toute sécurité dans nos processus métier. Orchestrer des processus de bout en bout à travers nos outils et systèmes — en comprenant comment chaque application contribue à la solution globale, et en construisant les intégrations et la logique qui les font fonctionner ensemble de manière fiable, d'un bout à l'autre. Développer une expertise fonctionnelle de notre architecture de solutions, en explorant la réalité opérationnelle de chaque processus pour identifier les points de friction et formuler des solutions qui améliorent réellement notre façon de travailler. Gérer et tirer le meilleur parti des outils externes utilisés par nos équipes, en les maintenant à jour, bien intégrés et porteurs de réelle valeur ajoutée. Profil et compétences Vous êtes diplômé(e) en informatique, ou autodidacte avec une expérience IT concrète. Vous maîtrisez Python et PowerShell pour l'automatisation, le scripting et l'intégration — à l'aise avec les API, la manipulation de données, et l'écriture de code fiable et maintenable. Vous avez un réel intérêt pour l' IA et les LLMs , et idéalement une expérience pratique dans la construction de workflows avec Dify (ou des outils similaires comme n8n, LangChain, Make, ou d'autres plateformes d'orchestration LLM). Vous êtes familier avec des concepts tels que le prompting, le RAG, les embeddings, les workflows agentiques et le tool/function calling , et vous comprenez comment faire fonctionner un LLM de manière fiable au sein d'un processus métier. Vous êtes à l'aise pour intégrer et orchestrer des systèmes via des APIs , et vous raisonnez naturellement en termes d'articulation des outils et des processus de bout en bout. Vous êtes à l'aise dans un environnement cloud (Google, AWS). Vous avez une réelle envie de comprendre la vue d'ensemble, de plonger dans les aspects fonctionnels et opérationnels d'un processus métier, d'en saisir les détails et les points de friction, et de formuler des solutions pour les améliorer. Vous avez d'excellentes capacités de résolution de problèmes et savez juger quand impliquer des collègues ou des experts. Vous êtes rigoureux(se), doté(e) d'un grand sens de l'organisation et capable de gérer plusieurs tâches et projets en parallèle. Vous avez d'excellentes compétences en communication et en collaboration, et la capacité à travailler avec des interlocuteurs variés au sein de l'organisation. Vous travaillez efficacement en français et en anglais, et la connaissance du néerlandais est toujours un atout. Notre offre Un positionnement professionnel unique, évidemment orienté technologie, mais réellement transversal et business. Un cadre de travail particulièrement agréable, basé en dehors de Bruxelles pour vous éviter les embouteillages inutiles. L’occasion d’intégrer une équipe de passionnés et une entreprise à taille humaine où l’entraide, l’esprit de collaboration et la complémentarité entre les collègues sont hautement valorisés ; Un job dans lequel votre travail a un impact et fait une réelle différence pour l’entreprise et son développement ; Une culture d’entreprise qui valorise la prise de responsabilité et qui vous offre la possibilité d’être formé.e et d’apprendre continuellement ; Un rôle passionnant et stimulant au sein d'une fintech en pleine croissance. Un salaire compétitif et un package d'avantages attractif. Intéréssé(e) ? Alors postulez sur notre site avec ce lien : https://www.mozzeno.com/fr/jobs/ai-automation-engineer/
