items.desc:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
 The Position
 At Roche, we are committed to delivering greater benefits to our patients by applying digital, data, and AI capabilities to real-world operational challenges. The AI Engineer is a senior hands-on technical contributor within the AI Engineering Cluster, responsible for designing, delivering, evaluating, and operating robust AI solutions across Pharma Technical Operations.
 This role owns meaningful parts of end-to-end AI delivery, including solution architecture, data pipelines, machine learning and GenAI systems, agentic workflows, AI evaluation harnesses, backend services, user interfaces, and production operations. The role partners with business, IT, quality, and technical experts to translate complex operational challenges into reliable, scalable, compliant, and measurable AI-enabled products.
 Role description 
 The role is a senior AI engineering role for someone who combines strong technical depth with practical delivery ownership. The AI Engineer is expected to independently lead solution delivery, make sound architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and ensure AI solutions create measurable business value while meeting reliability, scalability, evaluation, agent management, and compliance expectations.
 AI Solution Leadership & Delivery 
 End-to-end delivery ownership: Own the technical delivery of AI solutions from problem understanding and design through build, deployment, monitoring, evaluation, adoption, and continuous improvement.
 Solution architecture: Design scalable AI application architectures, including data flows, model integration, GenAI orchestration, APIs, user interfaces, agent workflows, and production infrastructure.
 GenAI and agentic AI: Design and implement advanced GenAI solutions, including RAG architectures, multi-step workflows, tool-using agents, LLM orchestration, and evaluation approaches.
 Engineering quality: Apply and help evolve strong engineering practices, including automated testing, code reviews, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and maintainability.
 Production performance: Ensure AI solutions are reliable, secure, monitored, cost-aware, and continuously improved in production or production-like environments.
 Value delivery: Translate business needs into technical solutions and help define success metrics that demonstrate operational and business impact.
 Modern AI Engineering Capabilities 
 Evaluation framework design: Design and implement data science-driven evaluation frameworks for AI, GenAI, RAG, and agentic AI systems, including offline benchmarks, golden datasets, synthetic test cases, human evaluation workflows, and automated regression testing.
 AI harness development: Own the development of AI engineering harnesses for repeatable experimentation, evaluation, validation, and comparison of models, prompts, retrieval strategies, agent behaviors, and tool integrations.
 Agentic AI solution ownership: Design and deliver production-grade agentic AI systems, including agent orchestration, tool integration, task decomposition, state handling, memory patterns, guardrails, and human escalation paths.
 Agent lifecycle management: Manage deployed agents across their lifecycle, including versioning, testing, release management, monitoring, incident response, continuous improvement, and retirement.
 Performance and risk monitoring: Implement and operate observability for AI systems, including quality metrics, business impact metrics, cost, latency, failure modes, drift, hallucination risk, grounding quality, and operational reliability.
 Model and workflow comparison: Lead structured experiments to compare foundation models, prompts, embeddings, retrieval approaches, orchestration patterns, and agent configurations.
 Technical Expertise 
 AI engineering depth: Apply strong knowledge of machine learning, predictive modeling, time-series, computer vision and multimodal AI, as well as LLMs, RAG, agentic AI, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI application design.
 Software and platform engineering: Build robust Python-based services, APIs, microservices, dashboards, and integrations using modern software engineering practices.
 Cloud and DevOps: Design and deploy solutions using AWS, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring, and cloud or hybrid deployment patterns.
 Data engineering: Work with SQL, operational data, time-series data, structured and unstructured data, and data pipelines required for AI products.
 Evaluation methods: Use quantitative metrics, qualitative review, …

items.desc: Why Keyrus, Why Now! Keyrus is an international group of 2,800 consultants and experts across 28 countries , built on a single conviction: AI does not transform businesses. Architected intelligence does. For more than 30 years, we have been building the data foundations that make intelligent systems work — designing the Operating System of the intelligent enterprise, where intelligence is embedded into the core of business processes to create sustainable value: we operationalise intelligence. AI does not replace humans. It repositions us to a place no system can follow: understanding, deciding, designing, and creating. At Keyrus, you will not just develop skills - you will develop judgment. Your expertise sharpens with every system you architect, every client challenge you solve, every deployment that compounds on the last. Over time, you grow into one of the rarest professionals of the intelligence era: someone who bridges data, AI, and human decision-making at scale, across industries and geographies. This is not a role you fill. It is a discipline you master and a story you help write to become a Keyrus Architect of Intelligence. Technology amplifies. Keyrus culture differentiates . Industrial discipline connects the two. What You'll Architect As an AI Foundation Architect, you will define the technical architecture that enables production AI and agentic systems to operate reliably at enterprise scale. You will define how models, agents, data, applications, APIs, cloud services, security controls, and operational capabilities fit together, and set the architecture principles and boundaries that guide AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, and other technical teams. Within your assigned architecture scope, you are accountable for the integrity of the target design. Depending on the engagement, this may include formal design approval; explicitly define broader enterprise governance authority rather than assume it. Your primary focus is client-facing architecture and technical design. You will also turn successful approaches into reusable Keyrus architecture patterns and standards without automatically owning an internal platform product or roadmap. Your responsibilities Define target architectures for production GenAI and agentic systems, connecting models, agents, enterprise data, applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, security, and operational services. Establish architecture principles, reference patterns, technical boundaries, and non-functional requirements that engineering and delivery teams can apply consistently. Make and document material architecture decisions across platform selection, model access, integration patterns, agent execution, data access, deployment, scalability, resilience, observability, and architecture-level cost. Review solution and engineering designs for architectural integrity, approving material design decisions within the assigned scope where the role has been designated as the architecture authority. Design secure, scalable, and operable foundations for intelligent systems, ensuring that reliability, identity, access, auditability, recovery, maintainability, and human-control requirements are considered from the start. Guide specialist engineering teams without replacing their ownership, working with AI Engineers, Software Engineers, Data Engineers, Governance specialists, and delivery teams on decisions that cross technical domains. Engage with client architecture and technical stakeholders, explaining architecture choices, dependencies, risks, trade-offs, and required decisions in clear technical and business terms. Convert successful architecture decisions into reusable Keyrus assets, including reference architectures, decision records, standards, patterns, and design guidance that can strengthen future engagements. Architecture-level AI FinOps, including model/provider routing, consumption patterns, capacity decisions, and cost optimisation. Who You Are You are an experienced technical architect who combines strategic architecture judgment with recent practical understanding of production AI systems. You can move between the complete system and its individual components without trying to become the implementation owner for every layer, and you know when an architecture decision requires depth and when it requires coordination across specialists. You remain close enough to modern GenAI and agentic engineering to understand how these systems actually behave in production – not only how they appear on an architecture diagram. You are credible with engineers and client architects alike and can explain why an architecture decision matters for security, reliability, scalability, performance, cost, and long-term operability. What You Bring Must Have - Seniority threshold -8+ years designing complex architectures, set locally Strong experience designing and owning architecture for complex production technology environments, with clear accountability for …

Define reusable architecture patterns and standards for cloud-native applications, AI integrations, and agentic workflows. Produce architectural documentation, including HLD, LLD, target-state diagrams, and technology roadmaps. Champion data integration and governance initiatives to support data-driven applications and AI capabilities. This role is suited for a mature, experienced engineer who is comfortable working independently, makes sound technical decisions without close supervision, and uses AI tools as a natural part of daily development. About the Project: Our client is a fully remote SaaS company building a pre-validated Quality Management System for the Life Sciences industry. Their customers make life-saving and life-enhancing products, and the platform helps them manage quality, processes and products while staying compliant with regulatory requirements. You will join a scrum team or a small pod of 2-3 developers, working closely with UI developers, product managers, DevOps engineers and other team leads across several time zones. Go is the team's target backend language. Responsibilities: Design and build scalable backend services with robust REST APIs; Apply Domain-Driven Design and microservice patterns to keep services loosely coupled and aligned with business domains; Write unit and integration tests to keep services reliable in a regulated environment; Look after services across their full lifecycle, including CI/CD, monitoring, diagnostics and maintenance; Collaborate with UI developers, product managers, DevOps and other engineers to deliver complete features; Support junior developers through code reviews and knowledge sharing; Help the team get the most out of AI-assisted development. Qualifications: 5+ years of hands-on backend software development experience; Commercial experience with Go, or some Go knowledge combined with strong Python or TypeScript skills and their web and testing frameworks; Solid understanding of Domain-Driven Design and microservice architecture; Strong experience designing and implementing REST APIs, with GraphQL or gRPC experience as a plus; Experience with Kafka, MQTT or SQS, and a good understanding of message bus and queue concepts; Understanding of UI/backend decoupling patterns such as CQRS or BFF, and of frontend patterns like MVVM/MVI; Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL or similar) and at least one NoSQL store (MongoDB, Elasticsearch or similar); Hands-on Docker and Docker Compose experience, familiarity with basic Kubernetes concepts, and experience with AWS, Azure or GCP; Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI or similar) and with logging, distributed tracing and monitoring; Strong unit and integration testing skills, including mocking strategies and secure, failsafe coding practices; Daily use of AI tools as part of your development workflow; Very good written and spoken English; Valid EU work permit. This position is vital for ensuring business continuity and empowering data-driven capabilities across our digital products. Your responsibilities will focus on two key areas: creating robust data architectures and optimizing data systems for performance. This includes developing scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for advanced analytics using the Azure data stack, with a strong emphasis on handling large data volumes. Additionally, you will be responsible for the continuous performance tuning of complex analytical queries, ensuring the reliability, integrity, and efficiency of our SQL-based data platforms. The ideal candidate is a seasoned data professional with a passion for performance optimization and an analytical mindset. Advanced expertise in SQL, data modeling, and the Microsoft Azure ecosystem is essential. This senior role requires the ability to work independently on complex challenges, contribute to the evolution of our data architecture, and mentor other team members on best practices in database engineering and performance. Contribute to the evolution of a modern cloud-based data architecture, ensuring it meets functional and analytical requirements while supporting future growth. Implement processes and controls to guarantee high data quality, integrity, and efficiency throughout the data lifecycle, fostering trust in data-driven decisions. Collaborate closely with software developers and product managers to seamlessly integrate data solutions into the broader application ecosystem, enhancing overall product functionality. Analyze, optimize, and performance-tune complex SQL queries, focusing on analytical use cases to improve response times and system efficiency. What You Bring A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, providing a solid foundation for technical expertise. Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering or database development, with a strong emphasis on SQL performance tuning and analytical query optimization, showcasing your depth of knowledge. Advanced expertise in designing and managing data solutions within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem, including services like Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, and SQL Databases, ensuring effective cloud-based operations. Proficiency in data engineering and architecture, including skills in SQL programming, data modeling, and data warehousing, enabling you to create efficient data structures. Familiarity with development and operations practices, including performance tuning, CI/CD, Agile methodology, and version control systems like Git, ensuring streamlined workflows. Do you get excited about building systems that don't just answer questions, but reason, collaborate, make decisions and solve problems autonomously? If that's you, keep reading. Why This Role Is Different We are partnering with a highly respected boutique consultancy that sits at the intersection of AI, Data, Engineering and Organisational Change . Founded by an industry leader with a long track record of delivering business-critical projects, the company has grown organically through trust, expertise and long-term partnerships—not sales targets. Today, they are a tight-knit team of just eight specialists. Over the next 12 months they plan to double in size, creating a rare opportunity to join at an early stage and have a genuine influence on the company's future direction. Their flagship engagement is with one of the Nordics' most recognised telecom organisations, delivering mission-critical projects within national security and military infrastructure . The Opportunity You'll join a small, highly capable team working on advanced data and AI initiatives for a strategically important customer. This isn't a role where you'll spend your days building PowerPoints or sitting in endless meetings. Instead, you'll have the autonomy to: ✅ Design and build intelligent AI solutions ✅ Explore and implement modern Agentic AI architectures ✅ Work directly with senior stakeholders ✅ Mentor and share knowledge with colleagues ✅ Take ownership of critical projects from concept to deployment ✅ Influence how AI is adopted within large-scale enterprise environments The team values curiosity, independent thinking and people who genuinely enjoy learning. Who We Think Will Thrive Here We're looking for someone who combines deep technical capability with genuine enthusiasm for AI. The ideal person is likely someone who: Has hands-on experience building AI/ML solutions in production Actively follows developments in Agentic AI, LLMs and autonomous systems Experiments with new technologies outside of work Enjoys solving complex problems simply because they're interesting Is collaborative, approachable and enjoys mentoring others Can make decisions and take ownership without excessive bureaucracy Values learning over ego Fluency in Swedish Bonus points if you've worked within Telecom, Connectivity, Infrastructure or mission-critical environments. And culturally? We're looking for the person who gets excited about a new AI framework, enjoys a deep technical discussion, and probably has a board game collection or a Steam library that's slightly out of control (I'm more a PS4 girl personally, but whatever your preferences are!). You'll be surrounded by people who enjoy teaching, mentoring and exploring new ideas together. 🏖️ Exceptional Team Experiences Recent company gatherings have included bringing the entire team together in a private Spanish villa with a personal chef, combining focused collaboration with unforgettable experiences. 💰 Ownership & Wealth Creation The company is establishing an employee ownership structure, allowing consultants to become part-owners and share in future success. Employees will also receive guidance on investing, fund management and long-term wealth creation—helping you build more than just a career. Sound Like You? If you're someone who regularly finds yourself reading AI research papers, building side projects, experimenting with agent frameworks at weekends or discussing the future of AI over a board game and a coffee, we'd love to speak with you. Apply now to learn more about this unique opportunity. items.desc: Contribuez aux grandes transformations des entreprises et des acteurs publics en alliant innovation technologique et expertise métier, au service de nos clients et de la société pour les faire avancer durablement. Au-delà de la RSE, nous avons développé notre propre approche, RESET, qui englobe l’ensemble de nos engagements en matière de responsabilité économique, sociale, environnementale et technologique, tant au sein de notre collectif que chez nos clients. Onepoint, est une entreprise inclusive, handi accueillante, avec une politique de diversité affirmée. Vos nouveaux challenges pour ce poste : Dans le cadre du développement de notre centre national de compétences AWS, nous renforçons nos équipes et recherchons un profil AI Engineer AWS F/H pour accompagner nos clients dans la conception, l'automatisation et l'exploitation de plateformes cloud modernes. En tant qu'AI Engineer AWS, vous concevez, développez et industrialisez des systèmes reposant sur l'interaction avec des modèles de langage (LLM), au sein d'architectures serverless AWS. Vous êtes le référent technique des briques GenAI que vous livrez : de la structuration de l'agent jusqu'à sa mise en production, dans un cadre exigeant en performance, en coût et en fiabilité. Vous serez notamment amené(e) à : Vous créez des agents capables de répondre à un ensemble de questions métiers, en traduisant un besoin fonctionnel en architecture d'agent, d'outils et de sources de connaissances. Vous développez les outils permettant de requêter intelligemment une base de connaissances (RAG). Vous mettez en place les méthodes qui rendent un agent réellement exploitable en contexte industriel : gestion avancée de la mémoire, optimisation des requêtes RAG, structuration des outils, intégration des connaissances métiers par prompt engineering, maîtrise de la latence et du coût par requête. Vous concevez et développez les composants associés : Amazon Bedrock (Knowledge Bases, Model Provider, Guardrails), Amazon Bedrock Agentcore (Runtime, Gateway, Observability), en intégrant dès la conception les contraintes propres à une architecture serverless. Vous évaluez vos systèmes (jeux de tests, métriques de pertinence, non-régression), instrumentez l'observabilité et fiabilisez le déploiement via l'Infrastructure as Code et le CI/CD. Vous diffusez les bonnes pratiques au sein de la communauté technique, contribuez à nos assets réutilisables et intervenez en appui des équipes sur les sujets GenAI. Votre palette technique: Socle Core Maîtrise de Python et des patterns Software Engineering (Clean Code, tests, Design Patterns, CI/CD) Maîtrise de SQL Écosystème AWS Amazon Bedrock : Agentcore, Knowledge Bases, choix et paramétrage des modèles Serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, Step Functions Sécurité et exploitation : IAM, CloudWatch Infrastructure as Code : CDK, Terraform ou CloudFormation GenAI et agents Conception d'agents et d'outils, orchestration (Bedrock Agentcore, LangChain, LlamaIndex ou équivalent) RAG : stratégies de chunking, embeddings, recherche hybride, reranking, text-to-SQL Stratégies d'optimisation : prompt engineering, gestion de la mémoire, arbitrages qualité / latence / coût Industrialisation et évaluation Évaluation des systèmes LLM (Ragas, LangSmith, jeux de tests métiers) et logique LLMOps Vector stores : OpenSearch, Aurora pgvector ou Pinecone Une certification AWS (AI Practitioner, Solutions Architect) est un atout apprécié. Votre profil et les expertises que vous souhaitez développer : Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en ingénierie logicielle ou Data Scientist dont une expérience significative de mise en production de systèmes à base de LLM sur AWS. Vous portez une brique complexe de bout en bout, du cadrage avec le métier jusqu'à l'exploitation, et vous savez défendre vos arbitrages techniques. Vous mesurez votre réussite à la stabilité en production, à maintenir un système, à la pertinence mesurée des réponses et à la clarté de votre code. Vous collaborez naturellement avec les architectes, Product Owners et équipes IT clientes, et vous savez vulgariser des sujets techniques complexes auprès d'interlocuteurs métiers. Job Title
Software Development Engineer 
 Job Description
 Software Development Engineer 
 Design, build and deliver cloud-native, FHIR-based diagnostic reporting applications, including responsibly integrated GenAI capabilities, that help clinicians make faster, more confident decisions.
 Your role: 
 You will be involved in the next generation of cloud-native and FHIR-based integrated diagnostics reporting applications, including the responsible use of GenAI to automate manual clinical workflows and help clinicians reach faster and more confident decisions. You are responsible for the design, implementation, integration, deployment and testing of software components and services to a high standard of quality, according to requirements and on time, while translating market and clinical needs into implementation requirements with the overall solution in mind.
 You will work as a member of an agile team, together with product owners, users, clinical domain experts, architects and other teams contributing to the same solution. You will collaborate on technical design and implementation with architects and partner teams, align with the team's software development professionalism standards (processes, quality of requirements, design, coding and testing), and contribute to a collaborative, open and high-quality engineering culture.
 You will work with state-of-the-art technologies and practices in cloud, healthcare interoperability, GenAI and AI-assisted software development, and stay abreast of technical developments through literature, courses and trainings, and technical contacts. You will deepen your expertise in digital diagnostics, healthcare interoperability and responsible AI.
 You're the right fit if: 
 You hold a Bachelor's / Master's Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent (including other technical or scientific disciplines combined with demonstrated software engineering experience). A postgraduate qualification in software technology (Master's, Engineering Doctorate or PhD) is preferred.
 You have a minimum of 5 years of experience with a Bachelor's in areas such as Software Development, Software Design and Architecture, Testing and Quality Assurance or equivalent, OR a minimum of 2 years of experience with a Master's or postgraduate degree in a software-related field.
 You have a proven track record of building and delivering production-grade back-end services, from design and implementation through testing and release, in collaboration with platform and operations teams.
 You have experience working in regulated or data-sensitive environments (e.g. healthcare, medical devices, finance), where quality, security and compliance shape the way software is built.
 You have hands-on experience delivering GenAI capabilities beyond proof of concept in production or near-production environments, including LLM integration, RAG and agentic workflows. You understand evaluation, grounding, validation and safeguards required for responsible use in clinical or other regulated settings.
 You have strong back-end development skills in Java and/or Python, API design skills, and hands-on experience integrating HL7 FHIR APIs and data models. Experience with Clinical Quality Language (CQL) is preferred.
 You are familiar with cloud-native application environments, containers and CI/CD pipelines. Experience with Azure or AWS is preferred.
 Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging platforms such as Apache Kafka is preferred.
 You apply solid engineering practices such as Domain-Driven Design, test-driven development and secure coding, and you work comfortably in Agile/Scrum teams, refining requirements with product owners, users and domain experts.
 You communicate clearly and collaborate across teams and locations.

items.desc:
Serve as a developer for complex AI applications, transitioning from rapid prototypes to production-grade agentic workflows (e.g., multi-agent systems, MCP servers) that drive measurable Return on Investment (ROI).
 Architect and code the "connective tissue" between Google’s AI products and customers' live infrastructure, including APIs, legacy data silos, and security perimeters as part of an expert team.
 Build high-performance evaluation pipelines and observability frameworks to ensure agentic systems meet requirements for accuracy, safety, and latency.
 Identify repeatable field patterns and friction points in Google’s AI stack, converting them into reusable modules or formal product feature requests for the Engineering teams.
 Co-build with customer engineering teams to instill Google-grade development best practices, ensuring long-term project success and high end-user adoption.
Minimum qualifications:
 Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 5 years of experience with software development using Python or similar coding languages.
 Experience taking production-grade AI-driven solutions from conception to launch and architecting AI systems on cloud platforms (e.g., GCP).
 Experience building pipelines for structured and unstructured data using both vector databases and RAG-like architectures to power enterprise AI solutions.
 Experience managing technical discovery sessions.
 Preferred qualifications:
 Master’s degree or PhD in AI, Computer Science, or a related technical field.
 Experience implementing multi-agent systems using frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, ADK) and complex patterns (e.g., ReAct, self-reflection, hierarchical delegation).
 Knowledge of "LLM-native" metrics (e.g., tokens/sec, cost-per-request) and techniques for optimizing state management and granular tracing.

items.desc: Chi siamo - Elevate (nota anche come Ennova Research) Siamo un’azienda che si occupa di software e tecnologia, progettando e sviluppando soluzioni digitali su misura per realtà complesse. Lavoriamo ogni giorno per aiutare i nostri clienti a trasformare il proprio business attraverso la tecnologia: digitalizziamo prodotti e servizi, miglioriamo l’esperienza dei clienti e potenziamo operazioni e asset aziendali, unendo visione strategica, capacità progettuale e una forte attitudine all’execution. Siamo ingegneri e creativi. Crediamo nel lavoro di squadra e nella condivisione, nel prendersi le proprie responsabilità e aiutare chi è in difficoltà per raggiungere un obiettivo più grande. Crediamo sia importante saper lavorare insieme, sperimentare, dire quello che si pensa e non avere paura di sbagliare. Ci piacciono le proposte concrete. Ci piace capire cosa non va e cosa possiamo farci, ci piacciono molto le persone che cercano i punti in comune, lavorano per unire e procedere verso l’obiettivo, sanno quando ascoltare e quando spingere all’azione. Ci piacciono i dati e i numeri, ci guidano gli obiettivi, e mettiamo al centro sempre il valore che riusciamo a generare, dentro e fuori l’azienda. Il ruolo Siamo alla ricerca di un/a AI Solution Architect con spiccata attitudine al presales , che affianchi la struttura commerciale nella proposizione di soluzioni basate sull’intelligenza artificiale, con focus sulla Generative AI e sulle soluzioni agentiche, in un’offerta che comprende anche Machine Learning, Deep Learning, forecasting su serie storiche e Computer Vision. La persona selezionata sarà il riferimento tecnico del cliente in fase di prevendita e il punto di raccordo con la Delivery: trasformerà le esigenze di business in use case concreti e in architetture di soluzione fattibili, ben stimate e realizzabili, costruendole insieme ai team tecnici. In particolare si occuperà di: Condurre incontri e workshop di discovery con referenti di business e IT, traducendo il bisogno del cliente in use case misurabili, con KPI e baseline per valutarne il valore; Individuare, con il supporto dei team specialistici, l’approccio più adatto a ciascun problema (GenAI e agenti, ML classico, Deep Learning, time series, Computer Vision o una loro combinazione) e progettare l’architettura end-to-end, dai dati alla messa in produzione; Valutare disponibilità, qualità e accessibilità dei dati del cliente, evidenziando per tempo rischi e prerequisiti; Redigere la proposta tecnica e contribuire alla stima dell’effort, dei costi di esercizio e alla proposta economica, anche secondo percorsi PoC pilota scale-up; Trasferire alla Delivery il bisogno del cliente con un passaggio di consegne chiaro su perimetro, assunzioni e rischi, e costruire insieme ai team la soluzione tecnica; Preparare e presentare contenuti, demo e casi di successo a interlocutori tecnici e manageriali, e contribuire allo sviluppo di asset e use case di settore riutilizzabili. Sede di lavoro: una delle nostre sedi di Milano, Lomazzo (CO), Padova o Venezia, con modalità di lavoro ibrida e attività presso i clienti. Requisiti principali Titolo di studio: laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Matematica, Fisica, Statistica o discipline STEM affini. Esperienza: almeno 5 anni in ambito tecnologico, di cui una parte significativa nello sviluppo di progetti che integrano soluzioni di AI, GenAI o ML e in ruoli a contatto con il cliente (presales, consulenza tecnica o solution architecture). Generative AI e soluzioni agentiche: competenze solide sui temi GenAI e sullo stack tecnologico per lo sviluppo di soluzioni agentiche: LLM e relative API, prompt engineering, pipeline RAG; vector database e tecniche di ricerca semantica; framework e infrastrutture per agenti e orchestrazione; valutazione della qualità delle risposte e stima dei costi di inferenza e di esercizio. Piattaforme e soluzioni di AI: conoscenza di una o più piattaforme AI di mercato con opzioni di deployment on-premise, ad esempio n8n, Dify, Activepieces, OpenCode, Open WebUI o equivalenti. Cloud: esperienza su almeno una piattaforma Cloud AI (Google Cloud / Vertex AI, Azure o AWS). AI in senso ampio: comprensione dei principali paradigmi di Machine Learning, sufficiente a riconoscere quando un problema richiede un approccio diverso dalla GenAI e a impostarlo con i team specialistici. Presales e consulenza: esperienza nella redazione di proposte tecniche, nella stima di progetti e nella presentazione di soluzioni a clienti enterprise; capacità di tradurre temi tecnici complessi in valore di business, di facilitare workshop e di valutare con onestà fattibilità e rischi. Soft skills: spiccate capacità relazionali e di comunicazione, anche con interlocutori non tecnici; capacità di preparare contenuti e presentazioni efficaci per il cliente; ascolto, autonomia e attitudine al lavoro in squadra con commerciali e team tecnici. Lingue: ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana e buona conoscenza della lingua inglese …

The role focuses on automating exception classification, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, workflow orchestration, and remediation across large-scale transaction and data-processing environments. You will work with
items.desc: Duration: 12 months contract Pay Rate: 43 – 45 GBP/ hour Inside IR 35 (PAYE) About the Role We are seeking hands-on AI Engineers to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade Generative AI (GenAI) and Agentic AI solutions for complex financial services workflows. The role focuses on automating exception classification, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, workflow orchestration, and remediation across large-scale transaction and data-processing environments. You will work with structured and unstructured enterprise data, historical incidents, business rules, and workflow management systems to build intelligent, reliable, and scalable AI applications. Strong expertise in Python, SQL, API development, software engineering, and practical implementation of LLM-powered and agentic AI solutions is essential. Key Responsibilities Design and develop AI-powered workflows for exception classification, investigation, root-cause analysis, impact assessment, and remediation recommendations. Build agentic AI solutions incorporating workflow orchestration, tool/function calling, state management, and human-in-the-loop validation. Correlate new exceptions with historical incidents, known root causes, business rules, and transaction-level data to identify patterns and potential impacts. Develop Python- and SQL-based services to query, transform, validate, and analyse complex enterprise datasets. Integrate AI applications with enterprise APIs, relational databases, internal data sources, and workflow/ticketing platforms. Build reusable agent tools and services for information retrieval, investigation, analytical reasoning, and workflow execution. Implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to retrieve relevant regulatory documentation, historical issues, and internal knowledge repositories. Establish confidence scoring, validation mechanisms, guardrails, audit trails, and traceability for AI-generated outputs. Develop scalable backend services and APIs using Python and FastAPI. Implement testing, logging, exception handling, model evaluation, observability, and production-grade engineering practices. Collaborate with AI engineers, solution architects, business analysts, data engineers, and application teams across onshore and offshore environments. Required Qualifications 5–8 years of professional experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, data engineering, GenAI, or related technical roles. Strong hands-on experience developing production-quality applications using Python. Demonstrated experience building LLM/GenAI applications beyond proof-of-concept chatbots. Practical experience developing agentic AI workflows, reusable tools, and orchestration solutions. Strong SQL, data analysis, relational database, and data-processing capabilities. Experience building and integrating REST APIs, preferably using FastAPI. Strong understanding of software engineering principles, Git, debugging, testing, and application development. Experience working with structured and unstructured enterprise data, including JSON, transactional data, and operational datasets. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause investigation skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional technical and business stakeholders. A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related discipline is preferred. Key Technical Skills Core Engineering Python – Strong/Expert SQL and Data Analysis – Strong REST APIs and FastAPI – Strong Git and Software Engineering – Strong Structured Data Processing and Transformation – Strong Generative AI and Agentic AI LLM and GenAI Application Development Agentic AI and Workflow Orchestration Tool Calling and Function Calling LangGraph, Google ADK, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or equivalent frameworks Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and Context Retrieval LLM Evaluation, Output Validation, and Guardrails Confidence-Based Classification and Semantic Matching Human-in-the-Loop Workflows and Approval Mechanisms Data and Enterprise Integration Complex SQL Queries and Relational Databases JSON, REST APIs, and Enterprise Application Integration Transactional, Event, and Operational Data Analysis Historical Incident and Workflow/Ticketing Data Data Correlation Across Multiple Sources Handling Incomplete, Inconsistent, and Evolving Enterprise Data Cloud and Production Engineering Exposure to AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Microsoft Azure Logging, Monitoring, Observability, and Exception Handling Automated Testing, Evaluation, and Production Deployment Practices Auditability, Traceability, and Responsible AI Controls About US Tech Solutions: US Tech Solutions is a global staff augmentation firm providing a wide range of talent on-demand and total workforce solutions. items.desc: Unleash the Future of AI — Build Scalable, Production-Ready Systems that Transform Business Impact! Lisbon-based opportunity with hybrid work model. As a Senior AI Systems Engineer, you will be working for our client, a leader in innovative AI solutions within the banking and regulated environments. You will play a pivotal role in designing and deploying agentic AI systems, including RAG pipelines, multi-step agents, and large language model workflows, to deliver tangible, high-impact business outcomes. This is your chance to drive technological excellence and shape the next generation of AI infrastructure. Your main responsibilities: Design and deploy robust AI systems in production, ensuring operational excellence and scalability. Contribute to end-to-end solution architecture, from model selection to API deployment, orchestration, and monitoring. Implement MLOps, LLMOps, and AgentOps best practices, including CI/CD, prompt versioning, and model registry management. Establish monitoring and observability frameworks for AI systems, tracking drift, latency, cost, and output quality. Integrate AI Security by Design principles, safeguarding systems against prompt injections, ensuring traceability, and maintaining auditability. Collaborate with business Data Scientists to industrialize AI models and systemize deployment workflows. Write comprehensive technical documentation and promote best practices within the team. You’re ideal for this role if you have: 5+ years of experience in software engineering or AI, including at least 2 years deploying LLM/AI systems to production environments. Proven track record of delivering operational AI systems, not just proofs of concept. Strong expertise in Python, including frameworks such as LangChain, Transformers, and FastAPI. Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform. Deep understanding of MLOps, LLMOps, and AI Security by Design principles. Excellent command of English and French (C1 level). Eligibility to work in Europe. It’s a strong plus if you also have: Knowledge of regulated financial environments and security standards. Experience with GCP, JavaScript/TypeScript, or advanced research paper analysis. Language required for the role: English (Fluent), French (C1 level) Eligibility for the role: Only candidates with an existing legal right to work in the European Union will be considered. #MAKEYourCareerBETTER Interested? Apply now and include your CV (preferably in English) along with a statement confirming your consent to the processing and storage of your personal data.

items.desc: À propos de nous Carbon est une société de conseil spécialisée dans le software engineering et l’intelligence artificielle . Aujourd’hui, nous sommes une communauté de 150 passionné(e)s, réunis autour d’une même conviction : pour rester bon techniquement, il faut continuer à apprendre, expérimenter et partager. Et en matière d’IA, il y a de quoi faire. Les modèles évoluent, les architectures se transforment et de nouveaux usages apparaissent en permanence. Mais entre une démo qui fonctionne et une solution IA réellement utile, fiable et capable de passer en production , il reste un vrai défi d’ingénierie. C’est précisément là que nous voulons être. Chez Carbon, nous développons une expertise IA avec une approche profondément engineering : comprendre les modèles, expérimenter rapidement, faire les bons choix d’architecture et surtout construire des solutions robustes qui répondent à de vrais enjeux métiers. Nos bureaux sont situés à Neuilly-sur-Seine et nos missions se déroulent principalement à Paris intramuros et en petite couronne. Ce qui nous anime ? Résoudre des problématiques complexes, maîtriser nos outils, challenger nos choix techniques et rester à la pointe sans courir après chaque nouvelle tendance. Rejoindre Carbon, c’est aussi intégrer une entreprise où apprendre fait partie du métier . Un consultant qui souhaite progresser trouvera toujours des personnes avec qui confronter ses idées, expérimenter et monter en compétences… avant de transmettre à son tour. Ce que tu peux attendre de nous Tu ne rejoindras pas Carbon uniquement pour enchaîner les missions. Tu rejoindras aussi une communauté technique dans laquelle tu pourras approfondir ton expertise, expérimenter de nouvelles approches et participer à la construction de notre savoir-faire autour de l’IA. Concrètement, tu pourras bénéficier de : Formations techniques pour continuer à développer ton expertise. Workshops, retours d’expérience et conférences internes. Temps d’échange avec des profils expérimentés en IA, software engineering, data et cloud . Une culture du partage où chacun peut apprendre, mais aussi transmettre. Des occasions de tester de nouveaux modèles, frameworks et architectures et de partager tes conclusions avec la communauté. Des missions où l’objectif n’est pas simplement de « faire de l’IA », mais de construire des solutions qui fonctionnent réellement en production . Une communauté qui valorise autant la curiosité technique que la qualité d’exécution . Ton rôle En tant qu’ AI Engineer Confirmé(e) , ton rôle sera de transformer les possibilités offertes par l’IA en produits et solutions concrètes . Tu interviendras à l’intersection du software engineering, de la data et de l’intelligence artificielle , depuis les premières expérimentations jusqu’à la mise en production. L’objectif : ne pas s’arrêter au prototype. Tu participeras à la construction de systèmes IA pertinents, évaluables, observables, maintenables et capables de fonctionner à l’échelle . Construire des solutions IA Concevoir et développer des applications intégrant des modèles de Machine Learning et d’IA générative . Construire des solutions basées sur les LLM : RAG, agents, assistants intelligents, recherche sémantique, extraction ou génération d’informations. Intégrer les capacités des modèles au sein d’applications et de produits existants. Concevoir des pipelines de traitement, d’indexation et d’enrichissement de données. Développer des services et composants robustes, testables et maintenables principalement en Python. Passer du POC à la production Parce qu’un prototype convaincant n’est que le début. Concevoir des architectures capables de répondre à des enjeux de performance, scalabilité, sécurité et maîtrise des coûts . Industrialiser et déployer des applications IA dans des environnements de production. Mettre en place des mécanismes d’ évaluation, monitoring et observabilité . Mesurer la qualité des réponses, la latence, la consommation de ressources et les coûts associés aux modèles. Participer à la mise en place de pratiques MLOps / LLMOps et CI/CD adaptées aux applications IA. Explorer et challenger Dans un écosystème qui évolue aussi vite, savoir choisir est aussi important que savoir construire. Comparer différents modèles et approches pour identifier la solution la plus pertinente. Expérimenter autour du RAG, des agents, des modèles open source et propriétaires ou de nouvelles architectures. Challenger les choix techniques : faut-il réellement un agent ? Quel modèle utiliser ? Quel niveau de complexité est justifié ? Participer aux réflexions d’architecture avec les équipes software, data et cloud. Faire de la veille, tester, mesurer et partager ce qui fonctionne… et ce qui fonctionne moins bien. Faire progresser la communauté Chez Carbon, l’expertise prend encore plus de valeur lorsqu’elle est partagée. Tu seras encouragé(e) à participer aux workshops, retours d’expérience, expérimentations et échanges techniques de la communauté. Selon ton …

items.desc: YOUR ROLE: At SiteGround, we’ve built and launched our own suite of AI products: Coderick AI — our vibe coding platform. AI Studio — access to flagship AI models, providers, and intelligent AI Agents. WordPress AI Agent — one AI assistant for virtually every WordPress task. We’re moving fast: adding new capabilities, launching new AI agents, and serving a growing number of customers who use our AI products every day. This role sits at the heart of how we measure and improve those products. Your job is to make our LLM-powered features provably reliable — not just impressive in a demo. Prompt engineering is a central part of the role. You’ll design, test, and iterate on prompts and agent behaviour directly. But your defining contribution will be rigour: turning “this seems to work” into measurable, repeatable, production-ready behaviour through evaluation and observability. We work across the major model ecosystems — OpenAI, Google Gemini, and Anthropic — and you’ll regularly make pragmatic decisions about model choice, quality, latency, and cost. You’ll work closely with backend engineers, fellow evaluation engineers, and product managers. Together, you’ll dig into real customer interactions, identify where our AI succeeds or fails, and turn those insights into better prompts, agents, tools, and product experiences. YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES: Evaluation & Observability Build high-quality evaluation datasets with ground truth and define task-specific metrics such as correctness, task completion, efficiency, cost, token usage, and safety; Run model bake-offs and before/after prompt experiments — every meaningful prompt change should be a measured experiment, not a guess; Design evaluations for harder cases where there is no clean ground truth, including agentic workflows, tool-calling correctness, and structured-output validity; Own production observability through trace analysis, per-tool dashboards, error classification, and session-level review; Root-cause failures, identify recurring patterns, understand their impact on quality and cost, and turn findings into prompt improvements and engineering tickets; Help close the loop between users and product teams by translating real customer behaviour and product questions into clear, measurable insights about how our AI features are used and where they can improve. Prompting & Agent Engineering Design, version, test, and continuously improve system prompts for domain-specific agents; Architect agent behaviour, including tool orchestration, multi-turn flows, and safeguards such as plan-before-execute, read-before-write, and always-confirm for destructive actions; Build reusable, modular prompt components for areas such as safety, tone, context, and tool documentation; Select the right model for each task, balancing quality, latency, and cost. Tooling & Integrations Work across the API layer our AI agents act through, integrating the REST endpoints that expose application data and operations to the LLM; Help design and implement guardrails that prevent agents from corrupting user data, including permission enforcement and safe defaults; Debug the full request path end to end — from an agent’s decision and tool call to the live result — correlating application logs with agent traces. items.desc: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t. Alan exists to end the wait. Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. Who we are You. Better. With Alan. Alan's vision is to make prevention the new norm of care for all. Our mission is to help people live in good health to 100 while helping employers feel proud, turning health benefits from a cost center into their most valuable investment. We're building a vertically integrated health partner that seamlessly unites insurance and smart healthcare delivery into one system. By connecting all aspects of care - private, public, and direct to consumer - we create the most member-centric healthcare experience. Through deep engagement, we empower everyone to overcome day-to-day health obstacles and live healthier lives. We partner with 35K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members , and have reached 770M+ in ARR. Our team of 700 people (still growing) operates across France , Spain , Belgium , and Canada . What you'll build and who you'll work with You would join the product team that builds the AI agents answering our 1M+ members' questions about their health insurance - reimbursements, coverage, claims, account changes and more - instantly and without waiting for a human. Our AI agents already fully resolve more than 50% of members' questions. Your mission is to push that number further, increase the quality of answers and the trust members place in them, and make our agents work with the other AI agents at Alan, such as Mo our health companion. Concretely, you will: Design and ship LLM-powered agents that understand a member's request, reason over their contract, claims and history, and take real actions on their behalf - building the tools, retrieval and context pipelines that give them the right information at the right moment Make our agents interoperate with other AI agents across Alan, such as Mo: handing off conversations, sharing context and calling each other's capabilities, so members get one seamless experience Bring automated resolution to new channels, starting with AI phone support: real-time voice conversations with the same quality bar as written ones Own evaluation: build datasets, automated evals and quality monitoring so we know an agent is right before members see it Measure and improve resolution rate, answer quality and member satisfaction in production, iterating fast on prompts, models and architecture Work hand in hand with care experts and product to identify the next topics the AI can fully resolve Why this role is special Direct Impact: Every point of automated resolution means members get help instantly, when they need it the most - and directly drives Alan's scaling, growth and profitability. Applied AI at scale: You won't build demos. You'll ship AI agents that handle hundreds of thousands of real conversations per month in a regulated, high-stakes domain, where accuracy truly matters. Frontier problems: Agentic workflows, tool use, evaluation, safety and guardrails, cost and latency trade-offs - you'll tackle the hardest open questions in production LLM systems. Ownership & Growth: Influence product direction, mentor other engineers, and lead technical initiatives that shape the future of healthcare access. items.desc: Capital.com is building out its internal platform capabilities, and AI is a growing part of that. The role combines architectural ownership with hands-on delivery: you will design, build, deploy and operate the platform, including its infrastructure and DevOps. Reporting to the Director of Product Security, you will set up this function as its first member and make the early technical decisions that the future team will build on. As Platform Architect, you will own the architecture of the platform that more than 1,000 employees rely on, including their access to AI tools such as Anthropic Claude, OpenAI and future providers. Responsibilities: Build the AI platform architecture: the reference design for how LLM capabilities are accessed, governed, monitored, and extended across the organisation. Own every architectural decision for the AI platform, and document, justify, and stand behind each one. Evaluate and select new models, tools, and frameworks as the market moves. Deliver the platform as a service, so teams can move their agents into governed cloud infrastructure. Govern Anthropic (Claude API, Claude Code, Anthropic Enterprise), OpenAI, and future providers, covering API access controls, credential management, model version policy, cost allocation, and acceptable use standards. Own technical relationships with Anthropic and OpenAI at the enterprise level. Build cloud infrastructure for AI workloads on AWS and GCP: Bedrock, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, and supporting services (S3, Cloud Storage, IAM, and monitoring on both platforms). Deploy and securely configure n8n, and build automation workflows connecting LLMs to Jira, Confluence, Slack, Google Workspace, HR systems, and proprietary data sources. Design and secure MCP servers and gateways connecting AI agents to internal services. Build Python integrations for AI-powered internal tooling: RAG pipelines, agent frameworks, prompt libraries, and internal AI assistants. Deliver hands-on: you write the code, build the workflows, and deploy the tooling. This isn't an advisory role. Build data privacy and security architecture for LLM usage in a regulated environment, including prompt classification, output controls, and audit trails aligned with FCA, CySEC, ASIC, and DORA. Build observability across the full stack: token consumption, cost per team, latency, error rates, and policy violations across cloud platforms and direct API providers. Build an AI adoption framework of standards, patterns, and onboarding materials that let teams across Technology use AI safely and consistently. Run internal enablement through workshops, documentation, and direct support for teams moving from ad-hoc AI use to governed, repeatable processes. Report AI platform status, risks, and roadmap to Technology leadership Requirements: 8+ years in engineering, with at least 2 years building LLM-based systems in production, not prototypes or POCs. Comfort operating as the first person in a function: you set your own priorities, unblock yourself, and deliver without a team around you. Production-grade Python: tooling that others depend on, not scripts you hand off. Deep, hands-on experience with the Anthropic and/or OpenAI APIs: function calling, tool use, streaming, RAG, prompt management, token optimisation, and model versioning. Hands-on experience with agentic platforms, MCP servers, and MCP gateways, including designing flows between AI agents and internal services. n8n: deploying, securely configuring, and maintaining multi-step automation workflows at organisation scale. Solid AWS for AI workloads: Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, S3, IAM, and CloudWatch, deployed and operated in production. Solid GCP for AI workloads: Vertex AI, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring. Hands-on DevOps capability to deploy and run what you build. Architectural thinking: end-to-end system design, clear trade-off documentation, and the ability to defend decisions to senior stakeholders. Security engineering for what you build: secrets and credential management, key rotation, and least-privilege IAM across cloud and SaaS. Data protection and auditability by design: classifying what data can reach which model and provider, controlling and logging prompts and outputs, and building audit trails that hold up to a regulator. Fluency in the LLM threat surface, including prompt injection, data exfiltration through model outputs, insecure tool and agent use, and model supply-chain risk, with working knowledge of a recognised framework such as the OWASP LLM Top 10 or NIST AI RMF. Nice to have: Fintech, brokerage, or financial services background. DORA or ISO 27001:2022 knowledge as it applies to AI system risk. Familiarity with the EU AI Act and other AI regulatory requirements, as well as AI-specific risk and governance standards such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001. LLM orchestration frameworks: LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar. Hands-on experience with LLM guardrail and DLP …

Our capabilities span ideation to execution: growth, product and experience design; technology and experience platforms; creative, media and marketing strategy; and campaign, content and channel orchestration. Within Song, our Commerce & AI practice helps organizations design, build, and scale modern digital commerce ecosystems - embedding Generative AI and Agentic AI into commerce to enable real-time personalization, autonomous merchandising, intelligent discovery, and customer engagement at scale. Visit us at: www.accenture.com/song About the AI is rewriting how people find and buy. Discovery is shifting from keyword search boxes to conversational, agent-mediated experiences - across both a brand's owned platforms and the AI surfaces where customers increasingly begin their journey. We are looking for a technically strong architect to lead the design and delivery of Google-powered AI commerce experiences - with intelligent, AI-native search and discovery at the core, extending across the wider set of on-platform agentic commerce use cases. You are hands-on, technically rigorous, and comfortable owning the technical design of a solution workstream - making well-reasoned build-vs-buy decisions and translating complex architecture into clear recommendations for both engineering teams and senior client stakeholders. Providing technical leadership to delivery teams — guiding engineers, reviewing technical decisions, and maintaining architectural coherence across the workstream lifecycle. Supporting the development of Accenture Song's AI commerce capability — contributing to reference architectures, accelerators, and points of view that advance our delivery standards.
